To cultivate interdisciplinary innovative thinking methods for students to integrate basic knowledge of architectural environment interaction principles, architectural structures, architectural environments, digital media, and other related majors into the design process, and to understand the technical application modes and methods in different design stages. The course assessment method is to express the design scheme through drawings and models, considering the relationship between the building and the surrounding environment. The design concept is clear and innovative, the overall functional flow of the design scheme is reasonable, the technical drawings are complete and the drawings are clear and beautiful, and the solid model can accurately reflect the completion effect of the scheme.

default.zh: 人工智能与Python程序基础面向建筑与设计学院智慧建筑与建造专业二年级本科生开课，是智慧建筑与建造专业基础课程的核心课程之一，对学生了解人工智能及Python程序的基础知识和基本方法具有重要意义。课程包括Python程序基础、人工智能基础理论、人工智能基础技术三部分。教学内容包括Python的基础语法、Python的库及应用、搜索问题、知识表示、逻辑推理、优化问题、机器学习、神经网络和大语言模型的基本概念、算法原理与实际应用。课程的主要目标是适应人工智能时代发展需求，使学生较为系统地理解人工智能的基本原理和技术方法，及其在建筑领域的应用场景，培养具备跨学科知识结构和创新实践能力的复合型建筑人才；了解并掌握Python基础语法和工具资源，将编程技能与建筑数据分析相结合，培养学生的逻辑推理和抽象思维能力，并解决建筑全生命周期中的实际问题；培养学生自主学习探索能力，强化团队协作精神，全面提升学生的综合素质与终身学习能力，使其在快速变革的科技与行业环境中具备持续成长的核心竞争力。课程采用平时作用和期末作业结合的考核方式，利用Python完成人工智能驱动的智慧建筑项目。
default.en: Artificial Intelligence and Python Programming Fundamentals is aimed at second year undergraduate students majoring in Smart Building and Construction at the School of Architecture and Design. It is one of the core courses of the Smart Building and Construction Fundamentals course, and is of great significance for students to understand the basic knowledge and methods of artificial intelligence and Python programming. The course includes three parts: Python programming basics, basic theories of artificial intelligence, and basic technologies of artificial intelligence. The teaching content includes the basic syntax of Python, Python libraries and applications, search problems, knowledge representation, logical reasoning, optimization problems, basic concepts, algorithm principles, and practical applications of machine learning, neural networks, and large language models. The main objective of the course is to adapt to the development needs of the artificial intelligence era, enable students to systematically understand the basic principles and technical methods of artificial intelligence, as well as its application scenarios in the field of architecture, and cultivate composite architectural talents with interdisciplinary knowledge structure and innovative practical ability; Understand and master the basic syntax and tool resources of Python, combine programming skills with building data analysis, cultivate students' logical reasoning and abstract thinking abilities, and solve practical problems throughout the entire life cycle of buildings; To cultivate students' ability to learn and explore independently, strengthen their teamwork spirit, comprehensively enhance their comprehensive quality and lifelong learning ability, and enable them to have the core competitiveness for sustainable growth in the rapidly changing technology and industry environment. The course adopts a combination of regular tasks and final assignments for assessment, using Python to complete intelligent building projects driven by artificial intelligence.

default.zh: 当代建筑史将历史方法和批判理论应用于从当代初（18 世纪中叶）到现在的西方和非西方世界的建筑史和装饰艺术的研究。以跨文化视野重构建筑与装饰艺术研究的范式，通过对18世纪中叶至当代的物质文化进行历史化解读，揭示全球化进程中权力、技术与美学的复杂互动。通过整合物质文化史、空间哲学的多维视角，重点分析建筑实践中意识形态。课程强调在历时性脉络中建立跨地域比较框架，考察启蒙理性对建筑美学的标准化影响。课程目标包括：在基本认识层面，对建筑环境生产所涉及的技术、社会、政治、文化和经济因素有基本的了解，并对当代建筑史上的一些主要结构有广泛的了解。在技能掌握层面，熟悉过去三个世纪的主要历史、政治和社会事实。阐明建筑对委托、设计、建造、使用、保存和拆除建筑物的人们不断变化的意义。在鉴赏评析层面，将历史方法和批判理论应用于从当代（18 世纪中叶）开始至今的西方世界建筑和装饰艺术史的研究。
default.en: History of Contemporary Architecture applies historical methods and critical theory to the study of architectural history and decorative arts in both the Western and non Western worlds from the early 18th century to the present day. Reconstructing the paradigm of architecture and decorative arts research from a cross-cultural perspective, through a historical interpretation of material culture from the mid-18th century to contemporary times, revealing the complex interaction between power, technology, and aesthetics in the process of globalization. By integrating the multidimensional perspectives of material cultural history and spatial philosophy, the focus is on analyzing ideology in architectural practice. The course emphasizes the establishment of a cross regional comparative framework within a diachronic context, examining the standardized impact of Enlightenment rationality on architectural aesthetics. The course objectives include: to have a basic understanding of the technical, social, political, cultural, and economic factors involved in the production of building environments at a fundamental level, and to have a broad understanding of some of the major structures in contemporary architectural history. At the level of skill mastery, familiarize oneself with the major historical, political, and social facts of the past three centuries. Elucidate the constantly changing significance of architecture for those who entrust, design, construct, use, preserve, and demolish buildings. At the level of appreciation and analysis, apply historical methods and critical theory to the study of the history of architecture and decorative arts in the Western world from the mid-18th century to the present day.

default.zh: 本课程针对智慧建筑与建造专业本科二年级设置，通过课程教学旨在使学生了解和掌握公共建筑设计方法、建筑数字化设计方法，理解并掌握公共建筑形态、空间、结构、构造等设计参量对建筑绿色性能的影响机理，提高综合运用所学的理论知识独立分析和解决建筑智慧设计问题的能力，主要课程目标为：树立学生服务碳达峰与碳中和等国家重大战略需求的理想信念，培养学生综合分析建筑智慧设计问题的能力，加强学生综合应用建筑学、计算机科学与技术等多学科知识的能力；培养学生掌握公共建筑设计原理，能够将建筑环境交互原理、建筑结构等相关专业知识融入公共建筑设计过程；使学生掌握建筑数字化设计方法，具备在建筑智慧设计中综合应用建筑数字化设计方法与技术改善建筑绿色性能的能力，以及对设计成果进行数字化表达的能力。
default.en: This course is designed for second year undergraduate students majoring in Smart Building and Construction. Through the teaching of the course, students aim to understand and master the design methods of public buildings and digital design methods, understand and master the impact mechanism of design parameters such as public building form, space, structure, and construction on the green performance of buildings, and improve their ability to independently analyze and solve smart design problems by comprehensively applying theoretical knowledge. The main course objectives are to establish students' ideal beliefs in serving major national strategic needs such as carbon peak and carbon neutrality, cultivate their ability to comprehensively analyze smart design problems in buildings, and strengthen their ability to comprehensively apply interdisciplinary knowledge such as architecture, computer science, and technology; Train students to master the principles of public building design, and be able to integrate relevant professional knowledge such as building environment interaction principles and building structures into the process of public building design; Enable students to master the methods of digital design in architecture, possess the ability to comprehensively apply digital design methods and technologies to improve the green performance of buildings in intelligent design, and have the ability to digitally express design results.

default.zh: 《中外建筑史》是为辅修建筑学专业的学生开设的课程之一，通过对西方国家在历史上不同时期、不同地域、不同人文背景下的建筑发展概况、以及中国古代建筑体系的发展历程的介绍，帮助学生全面了解中外建筑不同的发展历史、建筑形态特征、艺术与技术特点、以及建筑发展的规律与趋势，是一门带有软科学性质的课程。 本课程的主要任务是使学生掌握中外建筑遗产的基本知识，提高建筑历史和理论方面的修养，提高建筑欣赏与评析能力，培养学生正确的建筑史观，最终达到提高学生专业素养与设计水平的目的。
default.en: This course is one of the courses for students majoring in architecture. It can help the students thoroughly understand and master the basic artistic and technical characteristics, main thoughts and theories and typical design of architecture in China and western countries through the introduction of the developments of architecture in different periods and different regions of western countries and the developments of traditional Chinese timber frame system. It is an important course with a character of soft science that can help the students to improve the ability of architectural appreciation, to elevate the theoretical standard and to establish a proper conception of architecture history.

default.zh: 本课程面向辅修建筑学专业的本科生。课程由建筑结构和建筑构造两部分内容组成。建筑结构和建筑构造是建筑学专业的基础课程。通过建筑结构教学，使学生了解建筑结构的各种受力构件、结构的类型和结构体系在各种荷载作用下的总体力学反应，理解结构形式建筑功能的关系、结构形式与结构选型的关系。建筑构造是一门实践性较强的综合技术科学，通过本课程的学习，使学生掌握民用建筑设计原理、建筑构造的基本原理和一般构造方法，培养学生建筑构造设计、建筑方案设计与绘图的能力。本课程最终成绩采用累加式，评价指标项包括期末考试、平时测试和课下作业。
default.en: This course is aimed at undergraduate students majoring in architecture as a minor. The course consists of two parts: architectural structure and architectural construction. Architectural structure and construction are fundamental courses in the field of Architecture. Through the teaching of architectural structure, students can understand the various load-bearing components, types of structures, and overall mechanical reactions of structural systems under various loads. They can also understand the relationship between structural forms and building functions, as well as the relationship between structural forms and structural selection. Architectural construction is a comprehensive technical science with strong practicality. Through the study of this course, students will master the principles of civil architectural design, basic principles of architectural construction, and general construction methods, and cultivate their abilities in architectural structural design, architectural scheme design, and drawing. The final grade for the course depends on several indexes, which are final exams, regular tests and homework. The final grade for the course depends on several indexes, which are final exams, regular tests and homework.

default.zh: 建筑环境学面向建筑环境与能源应用工程专业的本科生开课，是最重要的基础课程之一。课程主要讲授建筑外环境、建筑内环境，建筑环境对人体健康舒适的影响，重点使学生掌握建筑外环境对建筑环境的影响；建筑内环境及对人体健康舒适的影响；了解建筑热湿负荷的计算方法；掌握建筑环境评价与营造方法；熟悉和掌握建筑室内环境控制的理论基础和控制技术的基本方法。 课程主要包括建筑外环境、建筑热湿环境、人体对热湿环境的反应、室内空气质量、室内空气环境营造的理论基础、建筑声环境、建筑光环境等内容。 本课程考试成绩采用累加式，包括课后作业、期末考试和项目研究，总评成绩以百分计，满分100分。
default.en: Built Environment is a fundamental and compulsory course to students of both two professional directions in built environment and building energy. The course is one of the most important basic courses. The course mainly deals with the outdoor environment of buildings, indoor environment, and the influence of environment on human health and thermal comfort; to master the influence of the built exterior environment on the built interior environment, and the built environment on the health and thermal comfort; to give students a better understanding of the calculation method of building heat and moisture load; to grasp the evaluation method and how to create a better built environment; to grasp the theoretical basis of indoor environment control and basic methods of control technology. The course mainly includes outdoor environment of buildings, indoor environment, human response to indoor thermal environment, indoor air quality, theoretical foundation of indoor air environment creation, building acoustic environment and building light environment etc. The course is taught by way of lectures, exercises, case studies and discussions. The results of the course evaluation are cumulative. The assessment includes homework, final exam, and project studies. The total score is 100 points.

default.zh: 本课程对于加强学生的设计理论知识、培养学生的专业素养和提高设计水平有着重要作用。通过对西方国家在历史上不同时期、不同地域、不同人文背景下的设计发展概况以及设计体系的发展历程的介绍，帮助学生全面了解中外设计史不同的发展历史、形态特征、艺术特点、以及设计发展的规律与趋势，同时对历史上不同时期的设计理论、美学观点加以介绍和阐释，以促进学生设计理论素养的充实与提高，培养学生正确的设计观，最终达到提高学生专业素养与设计水平的目的。
default.en: History of Design is one of the main specialized courses of design major, which plays an important role in strengthening students' theoretical knowledge of design, cultivating students' professional quality and improving their design level. By introducing the general situation of design development in western countries at different time, in different regions and in different cultural background, and the development course of Chinese design system, it will help students to fully understand the development history, shape features, artistic features, as well as the laws and trends of design development between Chinese and foreign countries. At the same time, the design theories and aesthetic views in different periods of history are introduced and explained, so as to promote the enrichment and improvement of students' design theoretical literacy, cultivate students' correct design concept, and finally achieve the purpose of improving students' professional literacy and design level.

default.zh: 本课程通过讲授公共艺术的概念、发展简史，赏析成功案例，使学生理解公共艺术在现代社会中的作用，了解公共艺术与建筑、城市的关系。通过对经典案例解析掌握公共艺术设计的方法步骤。通过实践设计提高公共艺术设计能力。其教学目标如下：1.建立公共艺术设计思维概念，通过设计实践案例来解析原理；建立学生对公共艺术类型的基本原理的运用能力，掌握基本的设计程序；2.了解城市环境中组织和界面处理的方法，具有评价公共艺术能力。3.能够使学生在专业视野、艺术修养、设计思维等方面得到进一步拓展，能表达创作理念和艺术观点，提高对高品质人文景观设计的水平。
default.en: This course aims to understand the concept and development history of public art, appreciate successful cases, further analyze classic cases, and master the methods and steps of public art design. Enable students to understand the role of public art in modern society and the relationship between public art, architecture, and cities. The teaching objectives are as follows: 1. Establish the concept of public art design and analyze the principles through design practice cases; Establish students' ability to apply basic principles of public art types and master basic design procedures; 2. Understand the methods of organization and interface processing in urban environments, and have the ability to evaluate public art. 3. It can further expand students' professional perspectives, artistic cultivation, design thinking, etc., express creative concepts and artistic viewpoints, and improve their level of high-quality humanistic landscape design

default.zh: 设计美学面向辅修设计学专业本科生开课，是重要的基础理论课程。本课程以案例欣赏、美学分析为方法，在审美的高度上理解设计，在审美欣赏中把握设计之美的创造规律，在审美反思中领悟设计之美的本质，在审美体验中体会设计之美的力量，在历史的反思中总结设计的发展规律。 课程主要包括设计与美学、设计美的本质、设计美的形式、设计的媒介力量、设计美的文化差异、技术革命与设计革命 、设计的转型与审美化生存等内容。 本课程最后的成绩采用累加式，综合考虑期末考试、课程作业和讨论等。
default.en: Design aesthetics is an undergraduate course for undergraduates majoring in media technology and art. It is an important basic theory course in the platform course. This course is a case analysis of aesthetic appreciation, to understand the design method, in the aesthetic height, grasp the beauty of the design creation rules in aesthetic appreciation, understanding the essence of design beauty in aesthetic reflection, experience the beauty of the design strength in aesthetic experience, summarize the rule of development of design in the history of the reflection. The course mainly includes the design and aesthetic, the essence of design, the design form and design of the media power, the beauty of the design of cultural differences and beauty of technology revolution and the revolution of design, design and transformation of aesthetic survival etc.. The final results of this course are cumulative, taking into account the end of the semester, assignments .

default.zh: 任何设计都离不开传达和传播，本课程旨在引导学生从辩证唯物主义和历史唯物主义的立场出发，了解和掌握人类传播活动产生和发展的一般规律，了解和学习传播学的基本概念、主要理论、传播模式和研究方法；了解传播学主要学术流派的理论观点；了解和掌握传播结构中的传播者、传播内容、传播媒介、受众的传播效果等各重要要素以及之间的广泛联系；批判地吸收西方传播学的科学成分并应用于我国大众传播尤其是新媒体设计与传播实践。
default.en: Mass communication is a major course in the field of design. Any design can’t do without communication, the purpose of this course is to guide students from the perspective of dialectal materialism and historical materialism ,human communication actives to understand and grasp the general rule of development theory, communication mode and research methods; understand the main academic school of communication theory; extensive contacts with the important factors to understand and grasp the communicators ,communication content, communication structure in the media ,audience and communication effect; critically absorb western communication science and applied in mass communication in our country especially in new media design &communication practice.

default.zh: 建筑环境交互原理是面向智慧建筑与建造专业学生的理论性和计算性较强的辅修专业课程，也是研究建筑外环境、建筑材料传热传质机理、建筑围护结构综合传热阻、建筑物围护结构保温隔热、建筑物围护结构防潮、建筑物围护结构热湿耦合传递、室内空气品质及通风、建筑热光声交互理论及计算性方法的一门综合性技术课程。通过本课程的课堂教学和计算性设计环节，培养学生创新意识、设计技能、综合分析和解决工程科学知识的应用能力。
default.en: The Interaction Principle of Building Environment is a theoretical and computational minor course aimed at students majoring in smart building and construction. It also studies the external environment of buildings, the heat and mass transfer mechanism of building materials, the comprehensive heat transfer resistance of building envelope structures, the insulation and heat insulation of building envelope structures, the moisture-proof of building envelope structures, the coupled heat and moisture transfer of building envelope structures, indoor air quality and ventilation A comprehensive technical course on the theory and computational methods of thermal, optical, and acoustic interaction in architecture. Through classroom teaching and computational design in this course, cultivate students' innovative awareness, design skills, and the ability to comprehensively analyze and solve engineering science knowledge.

default.zh: 当今的产品不仅仅满足人们的使用要求，更重要的还要做到好用、易用。而量化用户体验对有效提高产品的使用质量至关重要。本课程详尽介绍了有效且可靠地收集、分析和呈现典型的用户体验度量数据：操作绩效（正确率等）、用户体验问题（频率和严重程度）、自我报告式的满意度及生理/行为数据。同时对“综合性量化度量数据”等问题进行了专门介绍，而且结合案例等形式对当前与用户体验相关的新内容进行了讲解。 通过该课程的学习，一方面，使学生深入理解和掌握用户体验的要素、评估方法、度量方法及统计学分析方法，能够应用以用户为中心的产品设计方法进行设计，使设计不再仅仅依靠想象力，而是通过对多种因素的综合考量，创造一种良好的用户体验，使设计工作更加有效，物有所值；另一方面，使学生能够运用所学知识从定性和定量两个方面对产品进行综合评价，培养学生综合运用用户体验相关知识指导设计，设计出符合用户、市场和环境的产品，进而提升学生自主学习和终身学习的意识，提升学生不断学习和适应发展的能力。
default.en: Today，a product not only should meet the users’ demands for utilization, but also make users operating it friendly and easily. Quantizing user experience is very important to advance the quality of produce in use. This course will introduce the methods of collecting and analyzing and presenting the measurement data of typical user experience effectively and reliably in details, which includes operation performance (such as accuracy etc.), user experience problems (such as frequency, order of severity etc.), satisfaction degree from user self-report, and physiology or behavior, and so on. At the same time, this course also introduce some problems specially, such as integrated and quantized measurement data. Combined with case studies, the course will give the latest development related to user experience. This course will give students great insight to understand and master the factors of user experience and the methods for evaluation, measurement and statistical analysis. And it will help students to carry out a design from the view of User-Centered Design, thinking series of factors, creating a good user experience to improve the effect of design except designers’ imagination. On the other hand, the course will help students to give overall evaluation quantitatively and qualitatively using the knowledge learned in the related course, and it will develop students' design capacity to finish the design of a produce under the guidance of user experience knowledge, which meets the requests from users, market and environment. And then, it will improve students autonomous learning ability and consciousness of life-long study, and promote students the ability of continuous learning and adaptive development.

default.zh: 智能创意设计基础是面向二年级学生开设的一门设计基础辅修课程，旨在帮助学生掌握智能时代下的基本设计技能与专业素养。课程通过结构化的教学方法，引导学生树立正确的价值观与义利观，理解设计创造价值的基本原则，培养兼具文化底蕴与技术敏锐度的设计思维。课程涵盖设计原理、艺术专题、设计调研与分析、设计构思与场景构建、迭代完善等多个环节。学生将学习形式美与构图美的基本法则，掌握“洞察-定义-构思-原型-测试”的设计思维方法与流程。同时，课程引入生成式AI辅助设计工具，如即梦、Midjourney等，提升学生数字工具辅助设计的能力。通过小组讨论、一对一辅导、联合点评等多元化教学方式，课程强调学生学习的研究性与创造性。学生不仅能够丰富设计表达手段，用书面、口头及模型等方式表达设计意图，还将初步具备综合分析与协调工作的能力，为未来的专业发展奠定坚实基础。
default.en: "Fundamentals of Intelligent Creative Design" is an elective design foundation course tailored for sophomore students, aiming to equip them with fundamental design skills and professional competencies in the era of intelligence. Through a structured teaching approach, the course guides students to establish correct values and a sense of ethics, understanding the fundamental principle that design creates value by addressing user needs. It cultivates a design thinking approach that blends cultural heritage with technological acumen. The curriculum covers various aspects, including design principles, art topics, design research and analysis, design conceptualization and scenario construction, and iterative refinement. Students will learn the basic rules of formal beauty and composition, mastering the design thinking process of "observation-definition-conception-prototyping-testing". Additionally, the course introduces generative AI-assisted design tools such as Jimeng and Midjourney, enhancing students' abilities in digital design assistance. Through diversified teaching methods, including group discussions, one-on-one tutoring, and joint reviews, the course emphasizes research and creativity in students' learning. Students will not only enrich their design expression means, articulating design intentions through written, oral, and model presentations but also develop preliminary capabilities in comprehensive analysis and coordination, laying a solid foundation for their future professional development.

On the other hand, the course will help students to give overall evaluation quantitatively and qualitatively using the knowledge learned in the related course, and it will develop students' design capacity to finish the design of a produce under the guidance of user experience knowledge, which meets the requests from users, market and environment. default.zh: 建筑构造是一门实践性较强的综合技术科学，构造节点设计是建筑设计的一个重要的组成部分。通过本课程的学习，使学生掌握民用建筑构造的基本原理和一般构造方法，培养学生建筑构造设计与绘制建筑施工图的能力。 建筑构造是面向建筑学专业、城市规划专业 环境艺术专业2年级学生的课程。它研究建筑物各组成部分以及各部分之间的构造方法及组合规律，即阐述建筑构造的基本理论和实际应用问题。建筑构造设计是建筑设计的一个重要的组成部分，是建筑平面、立面、剖面设计的继续和深入，同时也是建筑工程相关专业必不可少的学习内容。通过本课程的学习，学生将掌握民用建筑中主要构件的设计依据、组成方式、材料选择、构造特点、适用范围、常见做法等知识，熟悉构件之间的组合规律，掌握建筑构造基本原理，建筑节点详图绘制技能，学会综合运用建筑材料、建筑结构、建筑物理、建筑设备、建筑施工等有关知识，合理设计构造方案。 课程主要包括概论、地基、基础、墙体、楼板层、地层、楼梯、电梯、台阶、坡道、屋顶、门窗、地下室、变形缝等主要部件的设计要求与构造做法。本课程最终成绩采用累加式，包括期末考试、平时测试和课下作业。
default.en: Building construction is a practical and comprehensive technical science. Building construction detail design is an important part of architecture design. By learning this course, students could grasp the basic principles of civil construction and general construction methods, also cultivate students` capacity of designing building structure and creating architectural working drawing. This curriculum is for the second year students of architecture and urban plan. The main content is to explain construction methods and rule of various parts` composition and combination between them in the buildings. Building structure design is an important part of architectural design, which is the extension of building plane, facade, section design, meanwhile is the essential content of related profession in building engineering. Through the study of this course, students would master the main components of civil construction design basis, composition, material selection, structural characteristics, scope of application, conventional construction method, etc., be familiar with the composition law of building components, master building construction basic principles, building detail drawing skills, learn to use building materials, building structures, building physics, construction equipment, construction and other related knowledge to design rational structural programs. The course includes introduction and requirements and construction conventional methods of foundation, wall, floor, strata, stairs, elevators, steps, ramps, roofs, doors and windows, basement, deformation joints and other major components of the buildings. The final results of this course are cumulative, including final exams, quizzes and homework.

default.zh: 建筑设计专题-1是建筑学辅修专业的核心课程。对于一个学生基本设计态度以及基本工作方法的养成具有重要的意义。课程包括原理讲授和设计研讨两个部分，并形成以设计课程为中心的核心课程体系，主要课程目标是通过结构有序的教学方法使学生树立正确的价值观念，明晰社会责任，掌握基本的设计研究能力和设计表达能力，进一步建立设计思维，获得基本的建筑设计能力。课程最后的成绩采用累加式，包括研究报告，作业成果和平时练习等。
default.en: Topics in Architectural Design-1 is a core course for the minor in Architecture. It is of great significance for the development of a student's basic design attitude as well as basic working methods. The course consists of two parts: principle lectures and design seminars, and forms a core course system centred on design courses. The main course objectives are to enable students to set up correct values, clarify social responsibilities, master basic design research and design expression abilities, further establish design thinking, and acquire basic architectural design abilities through structured and orderly teaching methods. The final grade of the course is cumulative, including multiple homework results and daily practice.

default.zh: 本课程是一门面向建筑学专业二年级学生的专业设计核心课程，是帮助学生掌握建筑设计的基本技能，建立专业素养的一门课程。建立建筑设计的技术意识，学习在技术等综合矛盾制约下建构空间的思路和基本方法，了解设计过程的基本思维规律。进一步丰富和提高建筑表达的手段，建立较为完整的设计表达方式。 课程环节包括理论学习、专题学习、设计训练和模型制作等；教学方式主要有专题讲授、讨论式教学及班级联合点评等；考核方法采用累加式，综合考虑设计图纸、实验报告和模型等。
default.en: This course is an architecture oriented professional design course for students of grade two. It helps the students master the basic skills of architectural design and professional quality. It also helps to develop a technical awareness of architectural design, students can learn the way of thinking and basic methods of space design under the comprehensive contradiction of technology, and understand the basic thinking rules of design process. This course further enriches and improves the skills of architectural expression, and establish integrated means of design expression. This course including theoretical study, thematic learning, design training and model making, etc. Teaching methods mainly include topic lectures, discussions and interclass joint review, etc.; The method of assessment is accumulative, and design drawings, laboratory reports and models are taken into comprehensive consideration.

default.zh: 本课程是一门面向建筑学辅修专业第三学年的专业核心课程，是帮助学生掌握建筑设计的基本技能，建立专业素养的一门课程，使学生了解建筑空间与使用功能、行为体验和场地环境之间的关系，建立对建筑设计核心内容的系统认识，从而掌握建筑空间设计的基本流程与方法。 课程环节包括理论知识讲座、方案设计、模型制作等；教学方式包括专题讲授、一对一辅导、互动研讨及联合点评等；考核方法采用累加式考评，综合考虑设计图纸的表达、模型制作和过程汇报等。
default.en: Architectural Design Topic-2 course is a core professional course aimed at the third year undergraduate students minor in Architecture. It is a course that helps students master the basic skills of architectural design and establish professional literacy. The aim is to enable students to understand the relationship between architectural space and functional use, behavioral experience, and site environment, establish a systematic understanding of the core content of architectural design， and become familiar with and master the basic processes and methods of architectural design. The course segments include theoretical knowledge lectures, scheme design, model making, etc; The teaching methods include special lectures, one-on-one tutoring, interactive discussion, and joint review; The assessment method adopts a cumulative evaluation method， which comprehensively considers the expression of design drawings, handmade model making， and reporting.

default.zh: 住宅建筑设计历来是建筑设计教学的基本内容之一。本课程讲授住宅建筑的设计理论和设计方法，曾获得哈尔滨工业大学优秀课程。随着人民生活水平和居住质量要求的快速提升，如何应对住宅建设“量质并重”发展，培养学生良好的设计能力和职业素养，引导学生紧密联系时代及国家政策导向，厚植“人民建筑师”使命一直是本课程的核心教学目标。 本课程为建筑学专业三年级的核心课程，区别于之前的其他建筑设计课程，为学生进一步学习后继专业课程打下坚实基础，对日后从事更加复杂的建筑设计工作起到重要的衔接作用。 侧重向经典案例学习，通过前沿理论方法与设计思维的学习，要求学生系统掌握： （1）关注老城区旧有住区的现存问题，针对现存问题提出优化解决方案。 （2）研究住宅作为一种特殊建筑类型的空间组合规律，学习住宅单体设计和户内空间设计的基本原则与方法。 （3）以人为本，探索基于人体尺度和生活方式的室内空间精细化设计策略与方法。
default.en: Residential architectural design has always been one of the fundamental components of architectural design education. This course teaches the design theory and methods of residential architecture, and has received the distinction of being an excellent course at Harbin Institute of Technology. With the rapid improvement of people's living standards and the increasing demands of living quality, the core teaching objective is to address the development of "equal emphasis on quantity and quality" in residential construction, to cultivate students' good design ability and professional literacy, to guide students to closely align with the times and national policy guidance, and to foster a sense of duty as “architects for the people”. This course is the core course of the third year of Architecture major, which is different from other preceding architectural design courses. It lays a solid foundation for students to further learn the subsequent professional courses and plays an important role in connecting them to engage in more complex architectural design practice in the future. Focusing on learning from classic cases, students are required to systematically master the following through the study of cutting-edge theoretical methods and design thinking: (1) Address existing problems in the old residential areas of the old urban area and propose optimized solutions for the these challenges. (2) Study the spatial combination rules of residential buildings as a special type of building, and learn the basic principles and methods of individual residential design and indoor space design. (3) Prioritize a people-centric approach and explore refined design strategies and methods for indoor spaces based on human scale and lifestyle.

default.zh: 《中国建筑史》是建筑学专业的一门重要基础课程，课程从中国建筑史学的发展历程开始，帮助学生认识中国建筑在世界建筑体系中的历史地位，理解中国的自然地理和社会文化条件对中国建筑发展的影响。通过讲授中国古代建筑的基本建造方法、基本建筑构件、整体基本特征、几个发展阶段的主要特点、几种类型的主要特点和几个重大转折点的前因后果，使学生了解中国古代建筑的基本构成特点、各时期重大建筑事件、技术进步、建筑代表作品、匠师和基本建筑理论。通过掌握中国古代建筑的发展历史，学会思考建筑历史发展中的一些理论问题。通过讲授不同功能类型的建筑特点，分析和评价典型实例，使学生提高建筑理论、建筑艺术和建筑历史的修养。通过分析中国建筑的创作思想和设计意匠，注意历史课和设计课的思维融通，丰富学生的建筑语汇与设计手法，为建筑设计增强形象思维能力。从整体上发挥建筑史的综合作用，达到培养既具创新思维又有实际能力的建筑专业人才的目标。帮助学生树立正确的建筑史观，培养学生批判性思维的能力，通过实例分析掌握建筑学的一些基本原理及建筑史学的研究方法。
default.en: History of Chinese Architecture is an important basic course for architecture majors. Starting from the development of Chinese architectural history, the course helps students to understand the historical status of Chinese architecture in the world architectural system and the influence of China's physical geography and social and cultural conditions on the development of Chinese architecture. By teaching the basic construction methods, basic building components, overall basic characteristics, the main characteristics of several development stages, the main characteristics of several types and the causes and consequences of several major turning points of ancient Chinese architecture, students can understand the basic composition characteristics of ancient Chinese architecture, major architectural events in various periods, technical progress, architectural representative works, craftsmen and basic architectural theories. By mastering the development history of ancient Chinese architecture, we can learn to think about some theoretical problems in the development of architectural history. By teaching the characteristics of different functional types of buildings, analyzing and evaluating typical examples, students can improve the cultivation of architectural theory, architectural art and architectural history. Through the analysis of the creative ideas and design intentionaries of Chinese architecture, attention is paid to the integration of thinking between history and design courses, to enrich students' architectural vocabulary and design techniques, and to enhance the ability of image thinking for architectural design. In order to achieve the goal of cultivating architectural professionals with both innovative thinking and practical ability, we should give full play to the comprehensive function of architectural history as a whole. To help students establish a correct view of architectural history, cultivate students' ability of critical thinking, and master some basic principles of architecture and research methods of architectural history through case analysis.

default.zh: 《外国建筑史》是建筑学专业的主干专业课之一，通过对外国古代建筑的基本理论和基本知识、外国近现代和当代建筑基本理论和基本知识的讲授，使学生树立正确的建筑观、加强建筑素养和建筑理论知识。教师在教学中要采用辩证唯物主义和历史唯物主义方法论和社会发展规律对建筑的影响等方法和观点，帮助学生全面了解建筑的发展规律，以促进学生建筑理论素养的充实与提高。 课程内容包括了解和掌握以欧美国家为主线的外国建筑历史发展的过程和基本史实，了解世界建筑传统的多元性及相互影响与传承关系。了解和掌握各种自然条件、文化类型、社会和经济因素对建筑发展的影响；了解和掌握历史上各主要建筑风格形成的历史背景，理解各时期建筑理论和建筑美学的主要观点。了解和掌握历史上建筑空间、环境与场所等概念的发展及其与意识形态、结构技术、社会生活等的关系。了解和掌握近现代欧美各国主要建筑流派的基本理论和代表人物的主要作品的艺术特色；理解建筑中诸元素的相互制约关系，加深对建筑本质与特性的认识。
default.en: The History of Foreign Architecture is one of the main professional courses in the field of architecture. Through teaching the basic theories and knowledge of ancient foreign architecture, modern and contemporary foreign architecture, students can establish a correct architectural concept, strengthen their architectural literacy, and theoretical knowledge. Teachers should adopt methods and perspectives such as dialectical materialism, historical materialism, and the impact of social development laws on architecture in their teaching, to help students comprehensively understand the development laws of architecture and promote the enrichment and improvement of students' architectural theoretical literacy. The course content includes understanding and mastering the historical development process and basic historical facts of foreign architecture centered on European and American countries, as well as understanding the diversity, mutual influence, and inheritance relationship of world architectural traditions. Understand and master the impact of various natural conditions, cultural types, social and economic factors on the development of architecture; Understand and master the historical background of the formation of major architectural styles in history, and understand the main viewpoints of architectural theory and aesthetics in different periods. Understand and master the development of historical concepts such as architectural space, environment, and place, as well as their relationship with ideology, structural technology, social life, etc. Understand and master the basic theories of major architectural genres in modern Europe and America, as well as the artistic characteristics of the main works of representative figures; Understand the mutual constraints of various elements in architecture, deepen understanding of the essence and characteristics of architecture.

default.zh: 建筑光学是理论性比较强的专业技术基础课。通过学习使学生掌握建筑光学设计的基本原理和基本方法：掌握建筑日照原理及相应的建筑日照分析、学会利用棒影日照图求解建筑阴影及日照面积、建筑间距、朝向及日照时间等问题。了解人眼的构造，明确人眼的视觉特点。掌握光度学基本知识及相关理论应用。掌握光通量、发光强度、照度、亮度等各物理量的物理意义及相应运算法则。掌握材料的光学性质，如光透射比、反射比及吸收比。了解视度的概念及其影响因素。掌握采光设计及照明设计的基本原理和方法。学会采光设计、照明设计中各种参数的选择与确定；学会利用光度学理论进行采光计算、照明计算。
default.en: Physics in Building（optics ） is one of the relatively strong professional and technical basic courses. By learning, students can know the basic principles and basic methods of building optics, understand the principles and the corresponding sunlight analysis of construction, use stick sunlight shadow map for building shadow and sunshine area, building spacing, orientation and sunshine time etc. The objectives of the course are: to study the basic knowledge and related theory of photometry; to learn the physical meaning of each physical quantity and corresponding algorithms, such as luminous flux, luminous intensity, luminance, illuminance. Understand the structure of the human eye and clarify its visual characteristics. Master the optical properties of materials, such as light transmittance, reflectance, and absorption ratio. Understand the concept of visibility and its influencing factors. to learn the basic principles and methods of lighting design; to institute and determine various parameters for lighting design; to utilize photometry theory for lighting calculation, illumination calculation.

default.zh: 建筑物理学是研究建筑中声、光、热的物理现象和运动规律的一门科学，是建筑学的组成部分。其任务在于增强建筑功能，创造适宜的生活和工作环境；研究人在建筑环境中的声、光、热因素作用下，通过听觉、视觉、触觉和平衡感觉所产生的反应；采取技术措施，调整建筑的物理环境的设计，从而使建筑物达到特定的使用效果。 建筑物理（热），也常被称作建筑热工学，是建筑物理学的基本组成部分，是建筑专业人才必须掌握的专业基础课。课程介绍建筑中发生的热质传递的基本原理，包括如何通过建筑规划和设计上的相应措施，经济、合理地解决房屋的保温、防热、防潮、节能等问题，以创造良好的室内热环境并提高围护结构的耐久性，降低建筑在使用过程中的能耗。通过本课程的讲授、习题和实验的训练，将使学生掌握建筑热工学的基础知识和基本原理、能较熟练地进行热工计算，具备围护结构保温、防潮、防热等方面的设计计算与分析能力，建立较系统的建筑热工技术理念，具备在建筑创作中综合运用所学知识解决建筑热工设计问题的能力，并为建筑节能、绿色建筑的设计与研究奠定理论基础。
default.en: Building Physics, which is an important part of architecture, focuses on the phenomenon and laws of acoustic, lighting and thermotics within building. It aims at enhancing building function and create well living or working environment. In this course, human’s reaction and feelings on the factors of acoustic, lighting and thermotics in building environment are studied, as well as how to make a comfortable building environment through technology and design method. Building Thermal Engineering (or named Thermal Physics of Building), is an important part of Building Physics, and is a fundamental course for advanced professional architect. In this course, some important topics will be lectured, such as the principles of heat and mass transfer occurred in building, how to do thermal insulation, heat shielding & moistureproof through architectural planing and design. Consequently, appropriate indoor thermal environment is formed, durability of building envelope is improved and building energy consumption is reduced. Through the course lectures and exercises, experimental training, the students will learn the basic knowledge, calculation skills and design method of building thermal engineering, and will construct their system concepts of building thermal technologies. Moreover, this course will help students to establish solid theoretical foundation for design and study on building energy efficiency and green building.

default.zh: 课程简介：本课程是建筑学专业的专业技术基础课。通过本课程教学，使学生了解建筑结构的各种受力构件、结构的类型和结构体系在各种荷载作用下的总体力学反应，理解结构形式建筑功能的关系、结构形式与结构选型的关系。使学生在建筑设计方案阶段估算和比较各种建筑设计方案，确定最佳的平面形式和空间形式，使建筑空间的功能性艺术性与建筑结构的合理性更趋完美统一。
default.en: Course Description： This course is a foundation of technical courses for the major of architecture. Through this course, the students will understand the various structural elements by force, the structural type and general mechanical response of the structural system in a variety of load, the relationships between structure and building function, between structural form and structure selection. By estimating and comparing the various architectural design options in the architectural design, the students will learn to determine the best form of plan and space so that to coordinate space function, architecture art and rational structure as a whole.

default.zh: 数字技术深远地影响着建筑创作过程，推动了建筑设计思维演化，革新了建筑信息建模、性能模拟和优化设计方法与技术。本课程是面向建筑学专业三年级学生的课程，具有多学科交叉、理论实践结合特征，旨在培养学生立足数字技术展开建筑前沿设计理论、方法、策略与技术维度上的创新性思考能力。通过课程理论学习与循序渐进的专题训练，使学生了解数字建筑发展时代需求，熟悉数字建筑本质内涵特征，掌握数字建筑设计思维逻辑；培养同学们立足碳中和与可持续发展时代背景，开展数字建筑学习的历史使命感。同时，课程将使学生熟悉数字建筑信息建模方法、数字建筑性能模拟方法、数字建筑优化设计方法和数字建筑智慧建造方法，能够应用数字化建模工具展开建筑形态、空间、材料和构造信息建模实践，开展数字建筑性能模拟实践，进行数字建筑多目标优化设计和建造实践。
default.en: Digital technology has a profound impact on the process of architectural creation, driving the evolution of architectural design thinking, and innovating building information modeling, performance simulation, and optimization design methods and technologies. This course is aimed at third year students majoring in architecture, with the characteristics of interdisciplinary and theoretical practice integration. It aims to cultivate students' innovative thinking ability in the dimensions of cutting-edge architectural design theory, methods, strategies, and technology based on digital technology. Through course theoretical learning and gradual thematic training, students can understand the needs of the digital architecture development era, familiarize themselves with the essence and characteristics of digital architecture, and master the logic of digital architecture design thinking; Cultivate students' sense of historical mission in conducting digital architecture learning based on the background of carbon neutrality and sustainable development. At the same time, the course will familiarize students with digital building information modeling methods, digital building performance simulation methods, digital building optimization design methods, and digital building intelligent construction methods. They will be able to apply digital modeling tools to practice building form, space, material, and structural information modeling, carry out digital building performance simulation practice, and carry out multi-objective optimization design and construction practice of digital buildings.

default.zh: 《中外建筑史B》是城乡规划大类专业的一门重要的专业理论课，通过对西方国家在历史上不同时期、不同地域、不同人文背景下的建筑发展概况、以及中国古代建筑体系的发展历程的介绍，帮助学生全面了解中外建筑不同的发展历史、建筑形态特征、艺术与技术特点、以及建筑发展的规律与趋势，是一门带有软科学性质的课程。 本课程的主要任务是使学生掌握中外建筑遗产的基本知识，提高建筑历史和理论方面的修养，提高建筑欣赏与评析能力，培养学生正确的建筑史观，最终达到提高学生专业素养与设计水平的目的。
default.en: This course is a specialized course for the senior undergraduate students of the majors of City Planning. It can help the students thoroughly understand and master the basic artistic and technical characteristics, main thoughts and theories and typical design of architecture in China and western countries through the introduction of the developments of architecture in different periods and different regions of western countries and the developments of traditional Chinese timber frame system. It is an important course with a character of soft science that can help the students to improve the ability of architectural appreciation, to elevate the theoretical standard and to establish a proper conception of architecture history.

default.zh: 联合设计工坊是建筑与设计学院本科三年级学生的课程设计专业课，课程与国外知名院校建筑学、城乡规划、风景园林、设计学等专业教授或职业设计师和研究学者合作，在夏季学期两周集中英语授课，具有多文化交融和多学科交叉的特点。联合设计结合专业领域的国际前沿动态拟定设计题目，参加本课程的同学将以小组形式参与工作坊的研究及设计工作，与国内外教师共同开展设计研究。国际联合设计工作坊为建筑与设计学院本科高年级学生进一步丰富专业知识、开拓国际视野、进入世界一流大学继续深造、到国外事务所实习以及与国外设计师合作工作打下坚实基础，对国际化设计人才培养起到重要的促进作用，在各专业本科教学计划中占有重要地位。
default.en: The Joint Design Workshop is a core design course for third-year undergraduate students of the School of Architecture and Design. Co-taught with professors, professional designers and research scholars specializing in architecture, urban and rural planning, landscape architecture, design studies and other disciplines from world-renowned overseas universities, this two-week intensive English-taught program is delivered during the summer semester and features multicultural integration and interdisciplinary collaboration. Drawing on cutting-edge international research trends across relevant disciplines, the workshop sets design topics aligned with global industry frontiers. Students enrolled in the course conduct research and design work in groups, carrying out design studies alongside faculty from both home and abroad. The International Joint Design Workshop lays a solid foundation for senior undergraduates of the School of Architecture and Design to expand their professional knowledge, broaden their global perspectives, pursue further studies at world-top universities, undertake internships at overseas design firms, and collaborate with international designers. It plays a vital role in fostering globally competitive design talents and occupies a prominent position in the undergraduate teaching curriculum of all majors within the school.

default.zh: 数字技术应用课程是数字化建筑设计教学体系中重要教学环节，目的是让学生掌握相关数字技术进行建筑设计应用，并加强学生对最新技术应用了解。 通过本课程内容与专业课程内容紧密结合的针对具体应用的教学，进一步增强数字技术应用能力、提高建筑设计中数字技术应用水平。依据数字技术发展与应用实际情况，课程内容每年都会微调，教学内容涵盖数据采集技术、数据处理技术、信息模型（BIM）生成、复杂形态生成与模型搭建、性能模拟分析及验证。重点教学内容信息模型生成、复杂形态生成。
default.en: The digital technology application course is an important teaching link in the digital architectural design teaching system, with the aim of enabling students to master relevant digital technologies for architectural design applications and strengthening their understanding of the latest technology applications. By closely integrating the content of this course with professional courses and providing teaching tailored to specific applications, we can further enhance our digital technology application capabilities and improve the level of digital technology application in architectural design. Based on the development and application of digital technology, the course content is adjusted annually, covering data collection technology, data processing technology, information model (BIM) generation, complex form generation and model construction, performance simulation analysis and verification. Key teaching content information model generation and complex form generation.

default.zh: 本课程是研究物质的热力性质、热能与其他能量之间相互转换的一门工程基础理论学科，是建筑环境与设备专业的技术基础课。主要用于提高学生热工基础理论水平，培养学生分析和处理热工问题的综合分析能力。为学生今后的专业学习储备必要的基础知识，同时训练学生在实际工程中的理论联系实际的能力。 本课程共11章，通过对本课程的学习，使学生掌握有关物质热力性质、热能有效利用以及热能与其它能量转换的基本规律，并能正确运用这些规律进行各种热工过程和热力循环的分析计算，了解和掌握工程热力学问题研究、分析和解决的基本方法，掌握热力学问题的数学建模方法和手段。此外本课程在有关计算技能和实践技能方面也使学生得到一定的训练。因此本课程不仅是学习后续课程，包括《供热工程》、《空调工程》、《建筑热源》等主要专业的理论基础外，而且能广泛服务于机械工程、动力工程、冶金、石油、电力工程等各个研究领域。 本课程以经典宏观热力学为理论体系，主要特点是理论分析、实验研究与工程实际应用密切结合，其中基础理论部分占60%，工程应用部分占40%。
default.en: Engineering Thermodynamics is an engineering theoretical course for researching thermodynamic characteristics of materials and inter conversions of thermal energy and other types of energy, it is a basic course of HVAC discipline as well. It is mainly to improve thermal engineering theoretical skills of the students, help them to achieve the comprehensive ability of analyzing and dealing with thermal engineering problems. It also tries to reserve necessary basic knowledge for their further studies in disciplinary field, and obtain the ability for integrating theory with practice in their real engineering working time afterwards. This course consists of 11 chapters. Through the study of this course, students will master the basic laws related to the thermodynamic properties of substances, the effective utilization of heat energy, and the conversion of heat energy and other energy. They will be able to correctly apply these laws to analyze and calculate various thermal processes and thermal cycles, understand and master the basic methods of researching, analyzing, and solving engineering thermodynamic problems, and master the mathematical modeling methods and means of thermodynamic problems. In addition, this course also provides students with certain training in computational and practical skills. Therefore, this course is not only aimed at studying the theoretical foundations of major majors such as "Heating Engineering", "Air Conditioning Engineering", and "Building Heat Source", but also widely serves various research fields such as mechanical engineering, power engineering, metallurgy, petroleum, and power engineering. The course takes classic macroscopic thermodynamics as its theoretical system. Its main characteristics consist of theoretical analysis, experimental study and close integration with practical engineering applications. In the course basic theory section takes proportion of 60%, meanwhile engineering application section takes 40%.

default.zh: 本课程为建筑环境与能源应用工程专业主要的技术基础课之一。通过本课程的学习，使学生掌握以牛顿三大定律为基础的经典力学基本理论在流体力学中的具体应用以及表现形式，同时增强学生的流体方面专业理论水平，为学生的后续专业课程《流体输配管网》、《热质交换原理与设备》、《供热工程》、《通风空调》、《建筑冷热源》及《燃气输配与储存》等学习储备必要的基础知识，同时训练学生在实际工程中理论联系实际的分析能力和通过实验研究解决实际问题的应用能力。内容主要包括：流体特征、流体静力学、流体运动学、流体动力学基础、量纲分析和相似原理、流动阻力和能量损失、边界层和绕流运动、不可压缩流体的管道流动、气体紊流射流、一元气体动力学基础等内容。
default.en: It is one of important technical basic courses for undergraduates of Building Environment and Energy Application Engineering. Through the study of this course, students can master the specific applications and manifestations of the basic theories of classical mechanics based on Newton's three laws in fluid mechanics. The objective of the course is to enhance the solid fluid professional background knowledge, to deposit necessary knowledge for future courses’ study, what’s more to cultivate the comprehensive ability to apply theory with practice in the engineering applications. At the same time, the objective of the course is to enhance their professional theoretical level in fluids and prepare students for their subsequent professional courses "Fluids". Learn and store necessary basic knowledge such as "Transmission and Distribution Pipe Network", "Heat and Mass Exchange Principles and Equipment", "Heating Engineering", "Ventilation and Air Conditioning", "Building Cold and Heat Sources" and "Gas Transmission, Distribution and Storage", and train at the same time Students have the analytical ability to integrate theory with practice in actual engineering and the application ability to solve practical problems through experimental research. The content mainly includes: Properties of Fluid, Fluid Statics, Fluid Kinematics, Basics of Fluid Dynamics, Dimensional Analysis and Similitude, Flow Drag and Energy Loss, Boundary-layer and Flow around Immersed bodies, Steady Incompressible Flow in Pressure Conduits, Air Turbulent Jets, Basics of One-Dimensional Steady Flow of Compressible Fluids, etc.

default.zh: 传热学是建筑环境与能源应用工程专业四年制本科的主要专业基础课。 本课程在“建筑环境与能源应用工程专业”的知识结构中是至关重要的。建筑环境与能源应用专业所研究解决的一个主要问题是花费一定热量（冷量）来满足建筑物的温湿度要求。气候在变化，建筑物构件每时每刻都在传热；用以改变室内温湿度条件的技术手段包含采暖、空调，热源、冷源等等，大都以传热为主要的物理过程。因此学生传热学学得好坏，直接地影响学生的专业水平。 学生通过本课程的学习，可以掌握系统的、完整的传热学基本理论和方法体系，了解传热学的最新进展和发展方向，为建筑传热过程分析、冷热负荷计算、换热器设计计算、设备计算选型、运行能耗评估等专业课的学习奠定坚实基础。主要内容包括导热基本理论、稳态和非稳态导热，对流换热基本理论、准则关联式，辐射换热基本定律、计算，换热器与传热学应用，有限差分法解决传热问题等。传热学的实质内容是质量守衡，动量守衡与能量守衡。要求学生掌握温度场与热流密度场的概念、能够应用三大守衡将研究对象的传热问题转化为数学模型，列出方程，对部分简单边界条件问题能够求出解析解，并能够应用运用有限差分法在计算机上求解一般的传热问题。
default.en: Heat Transfer is the professional basic course for quadrennial undergraduate students of Architecture Environment and Energy Application Engineering. Heat Transfer plays an important role in the knowledge structure of the Architecture Environment and Energy Application Engineering. Most issues studied and solved by the specialty are temperature issues and humidity issues（cost some heat or cold to meet the building's temperature and humidity requirements）. With the climate changing, heat transfer happens all the time in the structure elements. Heat transfer is the main physical processes during heating, air conditioning and ventilating which could change indoor temperature and humidity conditions. So, the Learning levels of the curriculum can affect directly the level of students' expertise. Through this course, students can master system and complete basic heat transfer system, to understand the latest developments in heat transfer and development direction, laying a solid foundation for specialized courses of building heat transfer analysis, thermal load calculations, heat exchanger design calculations, equipment Selection of calculation, and energy consumption assessment. The primary contents are base theory of conduction, steady and unsteady conduction, base theory of convection, criterion expressions, base rules and calculation methods of thermal radiation, heat exchanger and knowledge application, numerical methods about finite difference and so on. The prime of heat transfer is mass conservation, energy conservation, momentum conservation. The conception of temperature field and heat current field is required to know. Students is expected to use the three conservation laws to create mathematic model of heat transfer questions, establishes and solves the equations with some simple boundary conditions, and to use the finite difference method to solve some normal heat transfer projects on computer.

default.zh: 热质交换原理与设备是建筑环境与能源应用工程专业的主要专业理论课之一，在增强学生的专业理论水平、提高学生在实际工程中理论联系实际的能力方面具有重要地位。本课程主要讲授热质传输理论, 重点使学生掌握空气进行热质处理基本原理和方法，掌握间壁式与混合式热质交换设备原理和热工计算。 课程主要包括绪论及传质的理论基础，传热传质问题的分析与计算，空气热湿处理，吸附和吸收处理空气原理与方法，间壁式热质交换设备的热工计算，混合式热质交换设备的热工计算。 课程采用讲授、作业、实验等方式教学。课程考核成绩采用累加式，考核环节包括课后作业、实验报告和期末考试，总评成绩以百分计，满分100分。
default.en: Theory of heat and mass transfer and equipment is one of the main professional theory courses in the building environment and energy application engineering. It plays an important role in enhancing the professional theoretical level of the students and improving the students' practical ability in engineering. This course mainly deals with the theory of heat and mass transfer, focusing on the students to master the basic principles and methods of air treatment，the principle and thermal calculation of both the wall-type and mixing-type heat and mass exchange equipments. The course mainly includes the introduction, the analysis and calculation of heat transfer and mass transfer, the principle and method of air treatment, adsorption and absorption of air, the thermal calculation of the wall-type and mixing-type heat and mass exchange equipments.

default.zh: 本课程为建筑环境与能源应用工程专业重要专业必修课，是沟通专业基础课与专业课之间的桥梁。介绍各类工程管网的共性和个性水力特征，管网构成、管网设计、分析基本方法，泵与风机原理和工作性能，管网运行调节方法等，能够利用水力计算及工况分析软件完成典型工程管网的设计和问题求解。通过课程学习，掌握枝状、环状管网设计、分析、调试基本理论和方法，具备初步的管网工程设计和实践能力。能够正确应用设计手册和参考资料进行上述管网系统的设计、调试和调节，同时为从事其它大型、复杂管网工程的设计和运行管理打下初步基础。 课程内容主要包括：气体、液体及多相流管网共性和个性水力特征、设计计算与分析；泵与风机的理论基础；泵、风机与管网系统的匹配；枝状管网水力工况分析与调节；环状管网系统水力计算方法及其工况分析等。通过本课程的学习，目的是使学生进一步拓宽专业基础口径，为学习有关后续课程打下必要基础，并具备初步的工程管网设计、实践和问题分析能力。 课程采用累加考核方式，包括：期末笔试、课后习题及软件应用和实验等，总成绩以百分制计。
default.en: It is one of important professional required courses for undergraduates of Building Environment and Energy Application Engineering. It is a bridge between basic core courses and specialized courses. The course introduces the common and individual hydraulic characteristics of all kinds of engineering pipe networks, and its composition, design and analysis methods. Combined with working principles and performance of pumps and fans and its operation regulation method, the design and problem solving of typical engineering pipe network can be completed by using hydraulic calculation and working condition analysis software. Through the course study, help students to learn the basic theory and methods of designing, analyzing and commissioning for branched and loop pipe network, to have the ability of its engineering application and analysis by using design manual & reference materials, also to lay a preliminary foundation in design and operation management for other comprehensive and complicated pipe networks. Course contents mainly include: hydraulic characteristics of gas, liquid and multi-phase pipe networks——commonality and individuality; theoretical basis for pumps and fans; matching operation between pumps, fans and the pipe network system; hydraulic operating modes analysis and adjustments for the branched pipe network; theory of hydraulic calculating methods for the loop pipe network. The objective of the course is to widen professional field of view for undergraduates, to deposit necessary knowledge for future courses’ study, and furthermore to cultivate their practical ability in the pipe engineering applications. The results of the course evaluation are cumulative, including final exam, course assignments, experiment & software application, total scores are in percentage terms.

default.zh: BIM应用与实践是建筑环境与能源应用工程专业的一门专业课，在培养学生应用现代软件工具进行探索、综合分析能力等方面占有重要的地位。建筑信息模型技术在建筑业的变革中发挥着极为重要的作用，中国建筑业需要利用BIM技术实现规划、设计、施工和运维等各阶段、各专业、各环节的无缝衔接。 本课程主要讲授BIM技术Revit软件的基础知识和暖通设计相关的操作方法，使学生较深入地了解现代工具在建筑环境与能源应用工程设计与科研领域的应用方法。通过本课程的上机实践环节着重培养学生应用现代工具分析、解决专业问题的思维和能力，支撑专业学习成果中相应指标点的达成。
default.en: BIM Application and Practice is a professional course in the field of Building Environment and Energy Application Engineering, which plays an important role in cultivating students' ability to explore and comprehensively analyze using modern software tools. Building information modeling technology plays an extremely important role in the transformation of the construction industry. China's construction industry needs to use BIM technology to achieve seamless integration of planning, design, construction, and operation and maintenance stages, specialties, and links. This course mainly teaches the basic knowledge of BIM technology Revit software and the operating methods related to HVAC design, enabling students to have a deeper understanding of the application methods of modern tools in the field of architectural environment and energy application engineering design and research. Through the hands-on practice section of this course, the focus is on cultivating students' thinking and ability to apply modern tools to analyze and solve professional problems, supporting the achievement of corresponding indicator points in professional learning outcomes.

default.zh: 本课程的主要任务是使学生掌握蒸气压缩式制冷与热泵的热力学原理、主要设备的性能及选择计算，掌握溴化锂吸收式制冷机的工作原理、建筑热源系统及设备，了解冷热电联供系统，可再生能源和余热利用等，掌握建筑冷热源系统设计的基本方法。通过本门课程的学习，使学生具有设计、管理建筑冷热源系统的初步能力，并掌握设计、管理其他用途冷热源系统的基本知识。
default.en: The main task of this course is to enable students to master the thermodynamic principles of steam compression refrigeration and heat pumps, the performance and selection calculation of main equipment, master the working principle of lithium bromide absorption refrigerator, building heating source system and equipment, understand the combined cooling and heating system, renewable energy and waste heat utilization, etc., and master the basic methods of building cooling and heating source system design. Through the study of this course, students have the preliminary ability to design and manage building cooling and heating source systems, and master the basic knowledge of designing and managing other uses of cooling and heating source systems.

default.zh: 本课程为专业课，是建筑环境与能源应用工程专业的专业核心课程。通过本课程的学习，学生系统地了解目前以热水或蒸汽为热媒的供暖和供热系统的工作原理和设计知识。 课程主要讲授内容为以热水和蒸汽为热媒的供暖系统与集中供热系统的工作原理和设计方法，以及运行管理的基本知识。围绕集中供热系统的三大组成部分，学习运行管理的基本知识，结合现代科学技术的发展增加新材料、新技术和新设备等内容，要求学生理解掌握供暖系统和集中供热系统设计过程中的重要环节。其中供暖系统部分要求学生重点掌握热负荷的组成与计算、散热末端设备的原理与技术经济要求以及水力计算的基本方法。集中供热系统部分要求学生重点掌握热负荷延续时间图、供热调节方法、供热管网布置原则与敷设方式以及系统定压方式和水压图绘制。 要求学生运用已学习过的专业基础课知识解决供热工程中的实际应用问题，理解供暖系统和集中供热系统设计过程中的重要环节。通过本课程的学习，学生在供热系统原理的基础上能够掌握与供热系统有关的设计、施工、运行管理的基本技能。课程要求学生运用已学习过的专业基础课知识解决供热工程中的实际应用问题。其中既包括通过理论推导和证明而得出的理论公式，也包括应用数学方法归纳整理的经验公式，以及大量实践经验总结的实用数据和参考指标。为学生后续进行供热工程的源、网、用户设计、运行调节以及优化以及开展更进一步的研究提供基础。 课程采用讲授、作业练习、案例分析等方式教学。课程考核成绩采用累加式，考核环节包括作业与期末考试等，总评成绩以百分计，满分100分
default.en: This course is one of the specialized courses, as well as the core course of Building Environment and Energy Application Engineering. By taking this course, students will be able to systematically understand the heating systems whose heat medium is hot water or steam and their working principles and designing knowledge. This course systematically introduces heating systems whose heat medium is hot water or steam and working principles and designing methods of centralized heating systems, as well as basic knowledge of operation management, and in addition, novel materials and equipments combining development of modern science and technology. Students are required to understand the important links in the design process of heating systems. The heating system part requires students to master the composition and calculation of heat load, the heat dissipation terminal equipment, and the basic methods of hydraulic calculation. The central heating system requires students to focus on mastering the heat load duration diagram, heating regulation methods, heating network layout principles and laying methods, as well as the system constant pressure method and water pressure diagram drawing. Students are required to solve practical problems in heating engineering by using knowledge in basic courses that they have already learned, and comprehend heating systems and important stages of designing process of centralized heating systems. By taking this course, students will be able to master basic skills of designing, construction and operation management relating to heating systems.The course requires students to apply the knowledge of professional basic courses to solve practical application problems in heating engineering. This includes theoretical formulas, empirical formulas, as well as a large amount of practical data and reference indicators. Provide a foundation for students to design, adjust and optimize the source, network, and user of heating engineering in the future, as well as conduct further research. The course is taught by way of lectures, exercises, case studies and discussions. The results of the course evaluation are cumulative. The assessment includes homework and final exams. The total score is 100 points.

default.zh: 供热工程基础是建筑环境与能源应用工程专业的一门专业课，在培养学生工程思维、综合分析能力方面占有重要的地位。本课程讲授以热水为热媒的供暖和供热系统的工作原理和设计知识，运用专业基础课知识解决供热工程中的实际应用问题。其中既包括通过理论推导和证明而得出的理论公式，也包括应用数学方法归纳整理的经验公式，以及大量实践经验总结的实用数据和参考指标。结合现代科学技术的发展，增加新材料、新技术和新设备等内容。通过本课程的学习，要求学生了解和掌握建筑环境与能源应用专业涉及到供暖系统与集中供热系统的工作原理、设计方法和运行管理的基本知识，具备供热系统相关设计、运行与管理的基本能力，同时掌握利用系统仿真等现代化工具分析解决实际工程问题的技能。 课程主要内容分为室内供暖系统和城镇集中供热系统两部分：室内供暖系统，包括热负荷计算、散热器热水供暖系统及其组成、散热器选型计算、热水供暖系统水力计算；城镇集中供热系统，包括热负荷概算、供热系统组成及其流量计算、供热管网水力计算、水压图绘制、水力工况分析、供热调节基本原理与方法、供热管线的敷设和构造。要求学生围绕供热系统的三个组成部分重点掌握热负荷计算、水力计算与运行调节的基本原理，理解室内供暖系统和集中供热系统设计过程中的重要环节。 课程采用讲授、作业练习、案例分析和讨论等方式教学。课程考核成绩采用累加式，考核环节包括课后作业、课堂考察和期末考试，总评成绩以百分计，满分100分。
default.en: Basic of Heating Engineering is a professional course in the field of Building Environment and Energy Application Engineering, which plays an important role in cultivating students' engineering thinking and comprehensive analysis abilities. This course teaches the working principles and design knowledge of heating and heating systems using hot water as the heating medium, and applies professional basic course knowledge to solve practical application problems in heating engineering. This includes both theoretical formulas derived and proven through theoretical derivation, empirical formulas summarized and organized using mathematical methods, as well as a large amount of practical data and reference indicators summarized from practical experience. Combining the development of modern science and technology, adding new materials, technologies, and equipment. Through the study of this course, students are required to understand and master the basic knowledge of the working principles, design methods, and operation management of heating systems and central heating systems in the field of Building Environment and Energy Applications. They are also required to have basic abilities in the design, operation, and management of heating systems, and to master the skills of using modern tools such as system simulation to analyze and solve practical engineering problems. The main content of the course is divided into two parts: space heating system and urban district heating system: space heating system, including heat load calculation, radiator hot water heating system and its composition, radiator selection calculation, and hydraulic calculation of hot water heating system; Urban district heating system, including heat load estimation, heating system composition and flow calculation, hydraulic calculation of heating pipeline network, drawing of water pressure diagram, hydraulic condition analysis, basic principles and methods of heating regulation, and laying and construction of heating pipelines. Students are required to focus on mastering the basic principles of heat load calculation, hydraulic calculation, and operation regulation around the three components of the heating system, and understand the important links in the design process of space heating systems and district heating systems. The course is taught through lectures, classroom assessments, case studies, and discussions. The course assessment results are cumulative, and the assessment process includes homework, project research, and final exams. The total assessment score is calculated as a percentage, with a maximum score of 100 points.

default.zh: 《燃气输配及储存》面向于建筑环境与能源应用专业的城市能源方向的本科生开课，是一门重要的专业课程，在培养学生工程思维、设计、开发解决方案、环境与可持续发展、综合分析能力等方面占有重要地位。课程主要讲授城市燃气管网系统组成、管网水力计算和水力工况、调压器的结构和基本原理，以及压缩天然气和液化天然气工艺流程等。帮助学生深入了解燃气输配系统设计的基本原理和方法。通过本课程的课堂教学、案例剖析和课程设计等环境着重培养学生的工程思维和实践能力。 课程主要包括燃气分类及用途、城市燃气需用量及供需平衡、燃气长距离输气系统、城市燃气管网系统、燃气管道及其附属设备、燃气管网水力计算、燃气管网水力工况、燃气的压力调节及计量、燃气的储存、压缩天然气供应、液化天然气供应、液化石油气供应等内容。 课程采用讲授、互动交流、实验、作业练习等方式教学。课程考核成绩采用累加式，考核环节包括课后作业、课上互动和期末考试，总评成绩以百分记，满分100分。
default.en: The course of gas transportation, distribution and storage is one of the main professional courses for the students from major of building environment and energy application. Through studying this course, the capacity of engineering design method, methods for solving engineering problems, thought of environment and sustainable development, analysis based on complex conditions could be improved. In this course, the taught contents mainly include structure of gas pipeline, hydraulic calculation and condition of gas pipeline, structure of pressure regulator and its regulated method. By the manners of teaching in class, case study and engineering design, it could be enhanced that the capacity of project design method and practical application. The teaching content mainly includes introduction, type and application of gas, calculation of gas consumption and balance of supply and consumption, system of gas transportation in long pipeline, structure of gas pipeline in city, gas pipeline and its accessory equipment, hydraulic calculation of gas pipeline, hydraulic condition of gas pipeline, pressure regulator and flow measurement of gas, storage of gas, application of CNG, application of LNG and application of LPG. The course is taught by the way of teaching, interactive, experiments, homework, etc. The results of the course evaluation are cumulative. The assessment includes homework, combined train, and final exams. The total score is 100 points.

default.zh: 本课程拟讲授人类城市的发展历程，探讨城市的定义及城市起源的不同观点，介绍人类最早的新石器城市及其群系特征，各古老文明代表性城市的形态特征及其发展演变，从横向上概述各大文明的城市地域特点及文明间的交流，纵向上强调从农业文明到工业文明催生的城市革命，在层次上涵盖物质文明、制度文明与精神文明对城市的影响；引导学生用宏阔的文明史观来思考城市这种大尺度的文明成果，从不同子系统及要素的相互作用机制来理解城市的复杂性，介绍人类重要的城市规划思想及其时空背景，通过对不同城市形态的解读使学生学会阅读城市，梳理人类城市史上“理想城市”理念的发展历程，使学生了解“乌托邦”思想倾向的意义与危险；开展讨论使学生反思、批判城市存在的问题，分析现代科技革命给现代城市发展带来的挑战与机遇；引导学生欣赏城市之美，激发对传统城市的热爱并唤醒城市历史文化保护的意识。
default.en: This course is to teach the development of human city, discusses the definition and the different opinions about the origin of the city of city, introduces the earliest Neolithic human cities and the characteristics of the formation of each representative urban morphological characteristics and evolution of ancient civilization, Outlines the major cities of civilization regional characteristics and exchanges among civilizations from the horizontal, stresses revolution of the city from agricultural civilization to industrial civilization on the longitudinal, and covers the influence of the material civilization, the institutional civilization and the spiritual civilization on the city; Guide students to think in summer of civilization history to urban civilization achievement of such a large scale, from the mechanism of the interaction of different subsystems and elements to understand the complexity of the city, introduces the important time for mankind city planning thoughts and its background of time and space, through the understanding of the different urban form to make the students learn to read, combing the history of human cities "ideal city" concept of development, make the students understand the meaning of "Utopia" mindset and its dangerous; The discussion enables students to reflect and criticize the problems existing in the city, and analyzes the challenges and opportunities brought by the modern scientific and technological revolution to the development of modern cities. Guide the students to appreciate the beauty of the city, arouse their love for the traditional city and arouse their awareness of the protection of the city's history and culture.

default.zh: 城乡规划原理1课程是城市规划专业的专业基础课程，课程的主要包括城市居住区规划的基本理论知识和城市居住区规划的编制方法，是居住小区修建性规划设计课程的理论基础。课程的主要任务是培养学生掌握城市居住区规划的原理，包括掌握居住区规划基本概念及其相关知识；居住区结构组织形式及其历史演变；城市居住区住宅群规划的原则、要求及布置形式；城市居住区道路系统规划的内容、原则与方法；城市居住区绿地系统规划的内容、原则与方法；城市居住区公共设施规划内容、原则与方法；城市旧居住区改造规划的原则与方式；城市居住区规划的技术经济指标体系的组成及量化
default.en: Urban and Rural Planning Principle 1 is a specialized basic course for graduate students in the specialty of Urban Planning. The course makes the theory foundation for the course of Residential Quarter Planning and Design, and it consists of basic theory knowledge and establishment methods of residential quarter planning. The aim of the course is to train students to master urban residential quarter planning principle including: basic meaning and relative knowledge of residential quarter planning; organization form and historical evolution of urban residential quarter planning; planning rules, requirements and distribution of residential building block; planning content, rules and methods of road system, green space system and public facility system; rules and methods of urban old residential quarter reconstruction planning; component and quantification of technique and economic factor system of urban residential quarter planning.

default.zh: 规划设计专题-1课程的讲授内容为住区修建性详细规划。本课程引导学生复习掌握学过的城市规划与建筑设计等相关知识，并灵活运用于住区修建性详细规划中；结合各阶段实践教学环节，对住区的道路、公共建筑、住宅群体和绿地等进行综合规划与设计，在巩固已有城市规划理论与方法的基础上，了解和掌握城市住区规划的先进思想、理论和实践实例，拓展规划视野，开阔规划思路，为实际住区规划工作和进一步探索城市住区规划新方法奠定基础，同时掌握城市不同用地间在空间上的联系对对应；熟练掌握详细规划工作的内容、方法、步骤，培养学生表达规划设计意图的能力，巩固和加深对城市规划原理和居住区规划原理的理解。
default.en: The teaching content of the Planning & Design Topic-1 course is Constructive Detailed Planning of Residential Area. This course mainly guides students to review the relevant knowledge of urban planning and architectural design they have learned, and to flexibly apply them to the Constructive Detailed Planning of Residential Area. Through practical teaching at various stages, students will carry out comprehensive planning and design of roads, public buildings, residential groups, and green spaces in residential areas. On the basis of consolidating existing urban planning theories and methods, students will understand and master advanced ideas, theories, and practical examples of urban residential planning, which can expand planning perspectives, broaden planning ideas and lay the foundation for the actual residential planning design and further exploration of new methods of urban residential planning. In this course, students will understand the spatial connections and correspondences between different urban land uses, acquire proficiency in the content, methods, and steps of detailed planning work. This course not only cultivates students' ability to express planning and design intentions, but also consolidates and deepens their understanding of urban planning principles and residential area planning principles.

default.zh: 城乡规划原理1课程是城市规划专业的专业基础课程，课程的主要包括城市居住区规划的基本理论知识和城市居住区规划的编制方法，是居住小区修建性规划设计课程的理论基础。课程的主要任务是培养学生掌握城市居住区规划的原理，包括掌握居住区规划基本概念及其相关知识；居住区结构组织形式及其历史演变；城市居住区住宅群规划的原则、要求及布置形式；城市居住区道路系统规划的内容、原则与方法；城市居住区绿地系统规划的内容、原则与方法；城市居住区公共设施规划内容、原则与方法；城市旧居住区改造规划的原则与方式；城市居住区规划的技术经济指标体系的组成及量化
default.en: Urban and Rural Planning Principle 1 is a specialized basic course for graduate students in the specialty of Urban Planning. The course makes the theory foundation for the course of Residential Quarter Planning and Design, and it consists of basic theory knowledge and establishment methods of residential quarter planning. The aim of the course is to train students to master urban residential quarter planning principle including: basic meaning and relative knowledge of residential quarter planning; organization form and historical evolution of urban residential quarter planning; planning rules, requirements and distribution of residential building block; planning content, rules and methods of road system, green space system and public facility system; rules and methods of urban old residential quarter reconstruction planning; component and quantification of technique and economic factor system of urban residential quarter planning.

default.zh: 本课程教学理论结合实践，在课程中结合实际案例展开教学，将城乡规划的知识、解决问题的能力以及城乡规划工作中的方法等内容融合在一起，来提高学生的学习兴趣和综合性能力。课程内容主要包括城市与城市发展；城市规划学科发展概述；城市规划基本概念与内容；城乡规划的编制与实施；城市总体布局等。在教学过程中采用多媒体教学手段，通过计算机大屏幕投影，结合课堂讲授、实例评析和交流互动讨论，使学生了解城市规划的基本理论，了解城市总体规划的编制内容与编制方法。
default.en: This course combines teaching theory with practice, and combines practical cases in the course of teaching, which integrates the knowledge of urban and rural planning, the ability to solve problems and the methods of urban and rural planning work together, so as to improve students' learning interest and comprehensive ability. The course content mainly includes cities and urban development; overview of urban planning discipline development; basic concepts and contents of urban planning; preparation and implementation of urban and rural planning; overall urban layout. In the teaching process, multimedia teaching methods are adopted, through computer large screen projection, combined with classroom teaching, case analysis and interactive discussion, so that students can understand the basic theory of urban planning, and understand the preparation content and method of overall urban planning.

default.zh: 城乡规划原理-2是城市规划专业的核心理论课程，也是城乡规划专业教育中最为重要的课程之一，是一门培养学生城市规划理论与实践能力的专业核心课。本课程通过多媒体教学手段使学生掌握有关城市及城乡规划的基本理论知识，并熟悉城乡规划的编制方法和编制内容，扩展学生的视野和认识城市、改造城市的能力，提高学生理性思维和形象思维的能力，为其它城乡规划专业课程打下扎实的理论基础。 本课程教学理论结合实践，在课程中结合实际案例展开教学，将城乡规划的知识、解决问题的能力以及城乡规划工作者必须具备的职业道德和关注公共利益等方面的内容综合融贯在一起，以期整体提高学生的综合性能力。本门课程的主要内容包括城市与城市发展；城市规划学科发展概述；城市规划基本概念与内容；城市规划的编制与实施；城市规划的调查分析；城市的性质与规模；城市建设用地的评价与选择；国土空间规划以及专项规划等。
default.en: Urban & Rural Planning Theory-2 is the core theoretical course of urban planning and one of the most important courses in urban and rural planning education. It is a professional core course that cultivates students' theoretical and practical abilities in urban planning. This course uses multimedia teaching methods to enable students to master basic theoretical knowledge about cities and urban-rural planning, familiarize themselves with the methods and contents of urban-rural planning, expand their horizons and abilities to understand and transform cities, improve their rational thinking and image thinking abilities, and lay a solid theoretical foundation for other urban-rural planning courses. This course combines teaching theory with practice, and combines practical cases to carry out teaching in the course. It integrates knowledge of urban and rural planning, problem-solving abilities, professional ethics and public interest concerns that urban and rural planning workers must possess, in order to comprehensively improve students' comprehensive abilities. The main content of this course includes cities and urban development; Overview of the Development of Urban Planning Discipline; Basic concepts and content of urban planning; The formulation and implementation of urban planning; Survey and analysis of urban planning; The nature and scale of the city; Evaluation and selection of urban construction land; National spatial planning and special planning, etc.

default.zh: 通过实际地段的预先设计，进一步掌握城市设计相关理论和设计方法，熟悉城市设计过程。从而在课程学习过程中培养学生从城市设计角度发现问题、分析问题、解决问题的能力。课程主要包含目标包含：（1）根据城市建设需求，每年由学生自行选定设计地段，要求学生对地段及周围地区环境进行深入细致的调查研究，分析其现状用地功能、周边环境条件等方面存在的问题及机会，在此基础上合理确定该地段的城市设计目标和设计概念。（2）按照城市设计的理论和方法，对地段进行城市设计方案设计，设计重点在于准确的功能定位、合理的交通组织及宜人的环境景观塑造。调动各种城市设计元素，创造一处环境舒适、景观优美的城市空间，使其成为城市中充满活力的区段，体现该城市区段应有的价值。（3）培养学生独立完成城市设计方案及各体统分析的能力。
default.en: By pre-designing the actual location, the course enables students to further master the theories and methods related to urban design, and become familiar with the urban design process. Furthermore, during the course learning process, students are trained to discover, analyze, and solve problems from the perspective of urban design. The main objectives of the course include: (1) Based on the needs of urban construction, students are required to independently identify the design site each year. Students are required to conduct in-depth and detailed investigation and research on the site and surrounding environment, analyze the existing problems and opportunities in terms of land use functions and surrounding environmental conditions, and reasonably determine the urban design goals and concepts of the site on this basis. (2) According to the theories and methods of urban design, students can design urban design schemes for the site. The design focus in the course is on accurate functional positioning, reasonable traffic organization, and pleasant environmental landscape shaping. Mobilize various urban design elements to create a comfortable and beautiful urban space, making it a vibrant segment of the city and reflecting the value that this segment. (3) Cultivate students' ability to independently complete urban design schemes and analyze various systems.

default.zh: 《场地设计原理》是城市规划、风景园林专业和环境设计专业的一门综合性工程技术基础课，在培养学生创造性思维、综合设计能力和场地设计实践能力方面起着重要的作用。课程通过多媒体教学、场地调研、案例分析等手段，对与场地设计相关的内容进行了分析，对场地设计的基本理论知识、场地分析、设计要素构成、设计步骤、设计要点进行了综述，使学生掌握有关室外环境设计涉及的建筑布局、道路、广场、场地、竖向、绿化、管线等要素的相关知识，熟悉场地及室外环境小品设施的设计方法，为学生后续的课程设计提供解决方法。同时，使学生初步了解和掌握国内外场地及室外环境工程设计的技术经验和先进理论，为今后进一步学习和研究奠定基础，因此本门课在城市规划专业、风景园林专业及环境设计专业教学计划中占有重要地位。
default.en: THEORY OF SITE DESIGN is a comprehensive engineering technology basic course for urban planning, landscape architecture and environmental design majors, which plays an important role in cultivating students' creative thinking, comprehensive design ability and site design practice ability. Through multimedia teaching, site investigation, case analysis and other means, the course analyzes the content related to site design, summarizes the basic theoretical knowledge of site design, site analysis, design element composition, design steps, and design points. Further, students can master the relevant knowledge about the elements of building layout, roads, squares, sites, vertical, greening, and pipelines involved in outdoor environment design, be familiar with the design methods of the site and outdoor environmental sketch facilities, which provide support for the subsequent curriculum design. At the same time, students will initially understand and master the technical experience and advanced theory of field and outdoor environmental engineering design at home and abroad, laying a foundation for further study and research in the future. Therefore, this course plays an important role in the teaching plan of Urban Planning, Landscape and Environmental Design.

default.zh: 城市道路与交通是高等工科院校中城市规划专业的主干课程之一，是一门培养学生城市交通规划与道路设计基本理论和实践能力的专业课程。本课程主要研究交通工程学基本理论、城市交通规划的理论与方法、城市道路及其附属设施设计理论与方法、城市交通管理与控制的基本知识。在教学过程中综合运用先修课程中的有关知识和技能，结合各种实践教学环节，进行城市规划专业人员必不可少的基本训练，为日后从事城市规划工作打下基础，因此本课程在城市规划专业的教学计划中占有非常重要的地位。
default.en: Urban Road and Traffic is one of the main courses of urban planning in high engineering colleges and universities. It is a professional course that trains students’ basic theory and practical ability of urban traffic planning and road design. The main contents of this course are the basic theories of traffic engineering, the theories and methods of urban traffic planning, the theories and methods of urban road and ancillary facilities design, and the basic knowledge of urban traffic management and control. In the teaching procedures, this course comprehensively applies with relevant knowledge and skills that have been studied in pre-course, combines with a variety of practical teaching links, carries on essential basic training for urban planning professionals, and lays a foundation for engaging in urban planning in the future, so it occupies very important position in the teaching plan of urban planning.

default.zh: 场地设计课程是城市规划专业本科生一门重要的设计课程。该课程的设置力求使学生运用学过的“城乡规划原理1（住宅区规划原理）”、“测量学”以及“室外工程技术”中的相关知识，对城市场地及室外环境设施进行设计。 课程培养学生独立完成室外场地竖向设计的能力；掌握室外环境设计、小品及街道家具设计的基本方法；掌握室外工程设施的构造及节点设计方面的基本知识。课程的主要内容包括：住宅小区的竖向设计；场地室外工程设施设计；园林建筑小品设计。
default.en: Site Engineering Design is an important design course for graduate students in the specialty of Urban Planning. Through this course, students could know how to make urban site design and outdoor environment embellishment design by using relative knowledge in courses of “Theory of Residential Quarter Design”, “Surveying” and “Site Engineering Technology”. The aim of this course is to train students to own abilities to complete outdoor site design independently, to know basic methods about outdoor environmental design and street furniture design, and to master knowledge about site engineering facility construction and detailed design.
