The content of Site Engineering Design includes: site design of a residential quarter, site engineering facility design and landscape architecture design. The main goals of this course are three aspects: ability to complete the vertical design of outdoor space independently; master the basic methods of exterior design, sketches and street furniture design; master the basic knowledge of the construction and node design of outdoor engineering facilities. The content of teaching includes design concept and planning scheme. design concept is designated to understand the terrain characteristics of the site, and reasonably determine the total layout of the site, and carry out the design of the outdoor engineering facilities. And planning scheme is referred to students use the theoretical knowledge to follow the different design stages of the results required to complete the drawing of the drawings and a brief design description. In terms of teaching method, classroom teaching will use multimedia teaching equipment to combine teaching and practical case analysis. According to the contents of each part of the teachings, put forward the practical issues related to the detailed planning and construction of the teaching content, and let think, discuss, and explain on the one hand to improve students' interest in learning, and on the other hand can make students learn the theory and detailed planning and construction practice. In the process of building design, site design is critical. China has vast territory, with north-south terrain so obvious. But in the construction, site design principles are the same, to the greatest extent to maintain the original site terrain style, and reduce the capital investment of field engineering. The importance of site design in architectural design is manifested in three aspects: firstly, the site design ensures the balance of earthwork in the construction area. In the process of design, there is the need try best to maintain the original style and landscape environment in the construction site, and make appropriate amendments in the original terrain and geomorphology. In other words, it is necessary to design the site to maximize the construction area to ensure the balance of earthwork to ensure that the building can be carried out in a relatively flat environment for construction operations. Secondly, the vertical design of the site design directly affects the spatial composition of the building, needing fully take into account the terrain, geological and specific environmental characteristics, to weaken the difficulty of vertical design. Thirdly, Road design is also an important part of the design of the site, which directly affects the overall layout of the building and the construction function requirements. Environmental protection is the key and important concern of site design. The process of site design requires the use of the basic principles of architectural composition, showing a flexible and diverse sense of contrast, and natural integration, fully embodying the principle of harmony between man and nature, to play the site design in the maintenance of environmental principles in the positive role.

default.zh: 规划设计-1是城市规划专业重要的专业核心课程，本课程本学期主要讲授住区修建性详细规划内容。课程采用课堂讲授、案例分析、现场参观、设计研究、阶段性构思及方案的辅导和讨论等多种教学方式方法，立足于居住区规划原理课程的教学内容，将城市规划原理1、住宅建筑设计原理、公共建筑设计原理、绿化景观环境设计原理等理论知识灵活运用于居住小区的规划设计中，使学生了解当前城乡住区的发展建设现状和趋势，从住区调查和相关文献资料查阅解析入手，学习住区规划设计中指标的计算和应用，在完成住区的整体构思与定位、住区结构规划设计的基础上，进行住区道路交通设计、绿化景观设计、公共建筑设计和住宅群体布置等规划设计工作，并就住区规划方案中重要的公共空间及绿化核心景观进行深化设计，做到住区定位恰当、结构合理、交通安全、居住舒适和空间景观优美的同时，掌握住区规划设计及修建性详细规划设计的工作内容、方法和步骤，并进一步训练提高学生城乡居住环境综合分析研究能力和规划构思及成果的图纸表达能力，巩固和加深对相关专业知识的理解和实际应用，并为后续的修建性详细规划、城市设计、毕业设计等学习研究和专业相关能力培养打好坚实基础。
default.en: Urban Planning & Design Studio-1 is an important core course for urban planning majors. This semester, the main focus of this course is to teach detailed planning for residential construction. The course adopts various teaching methods such as classroom lectures, case analysis, on-site visits, design research, guidance and discussion of phased ideas and plans. Based on the teaching content of the course on residential planning principles, the course flexibly applies theoretical knowledge such as urban planning principles 1, residential building design principles, public building design principles, and green landscape environmental design principles to the planning and design of residential communities, To enable students to understand the current development and trend of urban and rural residential areas, starting from residential survey and relevant literature review and analysis, to learn the calculation and application of indicators in residential planning and design. On the basis of completing the overall concept and positioning of residential areas, residential structural planning and design, planning and design work such as residential road traffic design, green landscape design, public building design, and residential group layout are carried out, And deepen the design of important public spaces and green core landscapes in the residential planning plan, to achieve appropriate positioning, reasonable structure, traffic safety, comfortable living, and beautiful spatial landscape of the residential area. At the same time, master the work content, methods, and steps of residential planning and detailed construction planning and design, and further train and improve students' ability to comprehensively analyze and research urban and rural living environments, as well as their ability to express planning concepts and results on drawings, Consolidate and deepen the understanding and practical application of relevant professional knowledge, and lay a solid foundation for subsequent learning and research on construction detailed planning, urban design, graduation design, and the cultivation of professional related abilities.

default.zh: 规划快速设计培训课程设置力求使学生运用学过的知识，对指定设计地段进行快速规划设计，达到理解、消化学过理论知识的目的。该课程目的是考核和训练学生对所学基本知识的掌握以及综合运用各方面知识进行快速设计的能力。一方面，达到学生能够运用所学的理论知识完成相关图纸的绘制以及简要的设计分析问题。另一方面，学生能够掌握快速设计的方法，提高快速独立快速地完成规划设计的能力。
default.en: The training course for rapid planning and design aims to enable students to apply the knowledge they have learned to quickly plan and design designated design areas, in order to understand and digest the theoretical knowledge they have learned. The purpose of this course is to assess and train students' mastery of the basic knowledge they have learned and their ability to comprehensively apply various aspects of knowledge for rapid design. On the one hand, it aims to enable students to apply their theoretical knowledge to complete the drawing of relevant drawings and brief design analysis problems. On the other hand, students can master the methods of rapid design, improve their ability to quickly and independently complete planning and design, and achieve the ability to quickly and independently complete urban design.

default.zh: 本课程是风景园林专业的一门重要的专业核心课程，以植物为主线，系统介绍植物学的基本理论与植物景观设计方法。对于风景园林专业学生而言，课程目标是培养其辨识常用景观植物、理解植物形态结构与功能的关系，培养其在具体项目实践中合理选用植物材料的分析和研究能力，以及运用所学知识分析、解决与植物学相关问题的能力。对于其他专业的学生而言，本门课程可作为一门通识课，引领同学了解多姿多彩的植物世界，了解植物景观设计的方法，培养其热爱自然、建立环境保护意识和自然界可持续发展的正确价值观。 课程教学内容以视频、文稿、动画、图片的方式呈现，要求学生仔细观看和阅读课程材料，按时完成单元测验和作业，积极参与讨论，分享学习体会，交流学习经验。
default.en: This course is an important professional core course for landscape architecture majors. With plants as the main line, it systematically introduces the basic theories of botany and plant landscape design methods. For students majoring in landscape architecture, the goal of the course is to cultivate their ability to identify common landscape plants, understand the relationship between plant morphological structure and function, develop their ability to analyze and research the rational selection of plant materials in specific project practice, and use the knowledge they have learned to analyze and solve problems related to botany. For students of other majors, this course can be used as a general course to guide students to understand the colorful plant world, understand the methods of plant landscape design, and cultivate their right values of loving nature, establishing environmental protection awareness and sustainable development of nature. The course content is presented in the form of videos, manuscripts, animations and pictures. Students are required to carefully watch and read the course materials, complete unit tests and assignments on time, actively participate in discussions, share learning experiences and exchange learning experiences.

default.zh: 1. 贯彻落实习总书记生态治国理念，有效引导学生深刻领会“绿水青山就是金山银山”蕴含的经济发展与自然生态系统及人文生态系统间的辩证关系。紧扣习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想铸魂育人这个核心任务，在课程内容中找到“触点”和“融点”，即尊重自然规律、生态过程及生物多样性的核心思想，当前世界面临着人口、资源、环境污染和生态破坏等问题，引导学生树立生态先行的景观规划设计哲学观，“顺应自然规律、重视生态价值”、实现“可持续发展、永续发展”；结合实践教学环节，以“润物无声”的方式教育和引导学生感受黑龙江得天独厚的大冰雪、大森林、大湿地、大界江等自然与人文资源所蕴藏的精神力量，贯彻“绿色”生态文明教育，树立学生为社会服务、为家国服务、为人类谋求生态系统服务和福祉的使命感和责任感。 2. 基于自然和人文科学相关知识，综合考虑自然生态环境和人文生态环境因素，研究风景园林规划设计的复杂问题；熟悉景观调查研究的基本原理、主要内容，掌握景观调查研究的基本操作程序、调查方法、数据采集方法、数据统计及分析方法、调研报告的撰写方法。 3. 通过调查、实验、统计、模拟等方法，（1）深入掌握调研全过程（设定研究问题——确定研究范围——制定调研计划——实施调研——数据整理分析——补充调研——数据再整理分析——调研结果汇总——完成调研报告）；（2）学会运用相关仪器及设备采集数据，科学地分析景观学复杂巨系统中的各类问题、得出科学结论并完成调研报告；（3）通过团队合作，培养学生的沟通能力和团队合作能力。
default.en: This course is a core course for Landscape Architecture majors with comprehensive, social and technical characteristics. It cultivates students' ability and quality to find and analyze problems on the basis of comprehensive consideration of natural ecological environment and humanistic ecological environment factors. Through the theoretical study and field research training of this course, students will master the following knowledge and have the following abilities: 1. Based on the relevant knowledge of natural and human sciences, comprehensively consider the natural ecological environment and human ecological environment factors, and study the complex issues of landscape architecture planning and design; Familiar with the basic principles and main contents of landscape investigation and research, master the basic operating procedures, investigation methods, data collection methods, data statistics and analysis methods, and research report writing methods of landscape investigation and research. 2. Through investigation, experiment, statistics, simulation and other methods, (1) in-depth understanding of the whole process of research (setting research questions -- determining the scope of research -- formulating research plans -- implementing research -- data collation and analysis -- supplementary research -- data re-collation and analysis -- summary of research results -- completion of research reports); (2) Learn to use relevant instruments and equipment to collect data, scientifically analyze various problems in the complex giant system of landscape science, draw scientific conclusions and complete research reports; (3) Cultivate students' communication skills and teamwork ability through teamwork.

default.zh: 《环境设计概论》是环境设计专业本科阶段的必修课，主要目标是培养艺术设计专业学生处理建筑室外环境的能力，使学生通过课程的学习，掌握建筑外环境设计的基本原理与知识，并具备环境景观设计的基本能力。课程中会运用案例分析的方法，例如，别墅院落的外部景观设计或公园设计分析。通过一系列室内外环境设计的案例讲解，自然引出环境设计的原理和方法。使得学生能在现实中理解原理和概论的知识，避免理论性太强，导致低年级学生认识和理解上的困难。具体的课程内容主要包括建筑外环境设计概述、生态设计理念、微气候环境、空间设计、场地设计和地形、水体、设施、植物诸要素的特性及在环境设计中的基本方法。在教学中注重理论与实践的结合，培养学生发现问题、分析问题和解决问题的能力。使学生了解建筑外环境设计领域的概念、脉络、原则和方法，认识到环境对建筑、城市的重要意义，能够正确处理建筑与环境、人与自然的关系，为今后从事环境景观设计实践工作奠定基础。
default.en: “Principle of Exterior Environmental Design” is an obligatory course of Art and design discipline at the undergraduate stage. Main goal is to cultivate students’ ability of handling outdoor environment, to master basic principles and knowledge of exterior environmental design, and to learn foundamental skills of environmental landscape design. The course will use case analysis methods, such as the exterior landscape design or park design of the villa yard. Through a series of cases of indoor and outdoor environment design, the principles and methods of environmental design are introduced naturally. It enables students to understand the principles and the general knowledge in reality and avoid the theory too strong, which leads to the difficulties in understanding and understanding of junior students. Course content mainly includes exterior environmenta design overview, ecological concept and metnod, environmental micro-climate, outdoor space design, site design and terrain, water, facilities, plant and other elements’ characteristics and design method. It’s important to emphasize both theory and practice in teaching to improve the ability of students such as discovering, analyzing and solving problems. The students will learn to understand the concepts, context, principles and methods of Exterior Environmental design, and will get the expanding and training about professional perspective, artistic accomplishments and design idea for the future practical work.

default.zh: 本课程通过介绍室内空间设计的含义、发展和基本观点，掌握室室内设计的内容和方法步骤，培养学生获得室内空间设计的依据、要求的能力为重点。旨在为后续的建筑空间设计、室内环境设计等专业课程的学习提供理论基础。其教学目标如下：1.树立正确的室内外环境设计思想，通过案例来解析原理在设计实践中的运用；掌握基本的室内设计的分类和设计程序；2.熟悉室内空间环境中设计中组织和界面处理的方法，深化学生对各种类型空间设计的基本原理的运用能力。3.能够使学生在专业视野、艺术修养、设计思维等方面得到进一步拓展，更加准确的把握专业学习方向，进而全面提升室内设计的专业素质。
default.en: This course introduces the meaning, development and basic views of interior space design, masters the contents and methods of interior design, and focuses on cultivating students' ability to obtain the basis and requirements of interior space design. It aims to provide a theoretical basis for the subsequent study of architectural space design, interior environment design and other professional courses. Its teaching objectives are as follows: 1. Establish the correct indoor and outdoor environment design ideas, and analyze the application of principles in design practice through cases; Master basic interior design classification and design procedures; 2. Be familiar with the methods of organization and interface processing in the design of interior space environment, and deepen students' ability to apply the basic principles of various types of space design. 3. It can further expand students' professional vision, artistic accomplishment, design thinking and other aspects, and more accurately grasp the professional learning direction, so as to comprehensively improve the professional quality of interior design.

default.zh: 室内环境设计1是一门培养学生设计素质，学习创造性思维并掌握室内设计规律的专业必修课。本课程主要以同学日常生活中熟悉的人居空间作为设计题目，通过对生活模式和设计模式内在联系的思考，综合运用前面所学知识学习正确的设计构思方法，初步掌握室内空间环境设计的基本原则、方法与步骤。本课程以室内设计原理为基础，以设计概念的初步建立为主线，要求学生通过研究建筑设计和室内设计的联系和区别，利用模型推敲和图式思维在方案阶段进行设计构思，学习室内空间形态的塑造，了解和掌握室内色彩设计和常用的装修材料及构造作法。
default.en: Interior Design -I is a course of training design quality, creative thinking and learning to master the law of professional interior design. The subject of this course is mainly as a living space design which is familiar with everyday life. Through the analysis of relations between life style and design mode, integrating with the front knowledge, students grasp the right way of design thinking and master the basic principles, methods and procedures of interior design. This course is based on interior design theory, establishing the main line by preliminary design concepts, which requires students to study the links and differences between architecture design and interior design. Making use of design model and map-minded thinking on the stage of programming, the course is aimed to train students to form the indoor space shape, understand and grasp the interior color design, decoration materials fabric and construction.

default.zh: 本课程以美学规律和室内设计原理为基础，借助室内设计方法以及实践方式，培养学生获得室内环境中家具与陈设装饰艺术设计的能力为重点。其教学目标如下：1. 树立正确的设计思想，理论联系实际，以室内设计原理和方法为基础，贯穿始终；了解家具设计与陈设元素与室内空间环境设计中发现问题、识别与分析需求的方法与途径；2. 熟悉室内家具与陈设装饰设计方法、过程及设计原则；3.深化学生对室内设计中家具与陈设装饰设计方法的运用能力；4.进一步深化学生分析与解决功能需求到深层审美意义营造问题的能力。
default.en: This course on the basis of aesthetic rules and interior design principle, with the help of indoor design method and practice way, trains the student to obtain furniture and furnishings in indoor environment decoration art design ability as the key point. The teaching objectives are as follows: 1. To set up the correct design ideas, theoretical connection with practice, based on interior design principles and methods; Understand the problems, identification and analysis needs of furniture design and layout elements and interior space environment design; 2. Familiar with the design methods, process and design principles of interior furniture and furnishings; 3. To deepen students' ability to use furniture and furnishings in interior design; 4. Further deepening the students' ability to analyze and solve functional requirements to create problems in the deep aesthetic sense.

default.zh: 本课程是面向环境设计专业高年级本科生的专业设计课，具有进阶行、拓展性的特征。通过基于居住区类型的环境设计训练，培养学生以问题为导向的居住区环境设计的思维方式；掌握居住区室外环境的基本设计程序与方法；拓展以环境实质空间设计与更新作为关注、解决社会问题的手段。 通过课程学习使学生掌握以下知识，具备以下能力： 课程目标1.了解居住区环境的类型、基本构成要素，尤其关注设计发展趋势 课程目标2.训练从使用者需求、场地客观条件两个层面寻找、发现、归纳问题，提出有效解决社会与空间问题的方案能力； 课程目标3.掌握环境设计的多种表达方法，持续学习人工智能、机器学习等设计手段，并能应用于设计的全过程。
default.en: The course is a professional design course aimed at senior undergraduate students majoring in environmental design, with advanced and expandable features. Through environmental design training based on residential area types, cultivate students' problem-oriented thinking style in residential area environmental design; Master the basic design procedures and methods of outdoor environment in residential areas; Expanding the use of environmental substantive space design and updating as a means of solving social problems. Through course and training, students can master the following knowledge and abilities: Course objective 1:Understand the types and basic elements of residential environment, with a particular focus on design development trends Course objective 2:Train the ability to discover and summarize problems from the perspectives of user needs and objective site conditions, and propose effective solutions to social and spatial problems; Course objective 3:Master various expression methods of environmental design, continuously learn design methods such as artificial intelligence and machine learning, and be able to apply them throughout the entire design process.

default.zh: 冰雪艺术创作是设计学专业本科教学计划中具有特色的集中实践性教学环节。本课主要传授和研究冰雪艺术设计的方法，造景规律及与冰雪艺术设计相关的材料、结构及灯光设计等有关方面的知识，通过对冰雪环境艺术设计的训练，使学生深入了解和掌握具有寒地特征的冰雪环境艺术设计的基本规律；掌握冰雪景观设计基本表现形式和方法，培养学生冰雪景观设计的表现技巧和设计能力。
default.en: The practice of ice and snow design is one of the most featured and concentrated practical learning in the undergraduate teaching program of art design major. This curriculum mainly researches the methodology of design, and knowledge including laws of landscape manufacturing, relative materials of design, structural and lighting design. While developing their skills of expression and ability to design, students are trained to grasp the basic laws, form of expression, and methodology in the environmental design of ice and snow.

default.zh: 一、课程基本信息 课程代码： 22AR31509 课程名称： 室内照明艺术专题 总学时：16 理论学时：16 实验学时：0 上机学时：0 实践学时： 0 课外辅导学时： 0 学分：1.0 开课单位：建筑与设计学院 授课对象：环境设计专业本科生 开课学期：3春 先修课程：室内设计原理、室内环境设计-1 二、课程简介 总目标：理解光在创造情感以及改变我们对周围世界感受方面是非常有用的设计工具。本课程 是针对环境设计专业开设的关于室内设计中照明艺术效果的一门必修课程。是通过学习室内照明原理、室内照明灯具、室内照明艺术效果等方面的知识，使学生能够基本掌握室内设计中照明设计的方法，并能独立完成室内设计的照明系统设计任务。 课程目标：（1）认识室内照明设计在室内设计中的重要性，了解掌握其内容体系；了解室内照 明与人的关系； （2）培养从实态调研中发现问题，分析问题，解决问题的能力； 从不同建筑类型中汲取优秀的照明设计理念，从而搭建完整的照明设计程序， 并构建绿色节能照明设计方法。 （3）通过实验模型制作深刻理解照明设计艺术，掌握室内照明设计的基本方法。 通过以上3个课程目标的学习，让学生理解：没有光，什么都不存在，照明设计是可以实现设 计目标的一种高效而有力的方法。室内照明艺术是室内设计的一切，它在你感知和体验空间中扮演着重要的角色。因为它从根本上影响了几何图形的外观，从而影响我们的情绪和情感。所以室内照明设计是及其重要的。优秀的照明方案取决于光源的特性，以及我们如何在空间中分配它。
default.en: 1.General Information Course Code：22AR31509 Course Title：Features on the art of Interior lighting Credit Hours：16 Lecture：16 Lab：0 Computer Lab: 0 Practical: 0 Tutoring: 0 Credit(s)：1.0 Offering Department: College of Architecture and Design School/Division of Design Students: Undergraduate majoring in environmental design Term: Spring Third Prerequisites: Interior design principle and interior environment design-1 2.Course Description Overall goal: understanding light is a very useful design tool in creating emotions and changing our feelings about the world around us. This course It is a compulsory course on lighting art effect in interior design for environmental design majors. Through learning the knowledge of indoor lighting principles, indoor lighting fixtures, indoor lighting artistic effects, etc., students can basically master the lighting design methods in indoor design and independently complete the lighting system design task of indoor design. Course objectives: (1) understand the importance of interior lighting design in interior design, and understand and master its content system; Learn about indoor photos The relationship between people and light; (2) Cultivate the ability to find problems, analyze problems and solve problems from real research; Learn excellent lighting design concepts from different building types, so as to build a complete lighting design program,And build a green energy-saving lighting design method. (3) Through the production of experimental models, we can deeply understand the art of lighting design and master the basic methods of indoor lighting design. Through the study of the above three course objectives, students can understand that nothing exists without light, and lighting design can be realized It is an efficient and powerful method to calculate goals. Interior lighting art is everything in interior design. It plays an important role in your perception and experience of space. Because it fundamentally affects the appearance of geometry, and thus affects our emotions and emotions. So indoor lighting design is very important. An excellent lighting scheme depends on the characteristics of the light source and how we allocate it in the space.

default.zh: 《数字剪辑与合成》是一门研究数字影视剪辑与合成基本理论、基础知识和基本技能的专业课。通过对本课程的学习，能够树立正确的影视剪辑思想和影视时空观念，掌握数字影视剪辑与合成的基本理论、基本知识和基本技能，并能运用这种观念及所学知识和技能进行数字影视艺术作品创作。 作为培养学生数字影视剪辑与合成技术和艺术创作能力的课程，其主要教学内容包括：数字影视剪辑与合成概述，镜头的剪辑技巧，剪辑中的选择，叙事剪辑和表现剪辑，作为时空结构方式的剪辑，影视剪辑中的节奏，数字影视剪辑技术；动画合成技术及Alpha合成技术，滤镜技术及调色技术，文字动画与粒子动画，跟踪及稳定，数字合成的常用插件等。
default.en: “Digital Editing and Compositing” is a professional course that studies the basic theories, knowledge, and skills of digital film and television editing and compositing. Through the study of this course, one can establish a correct understanding of film and television editing and spatiotemporal concepts, master the basic theories, knowledge, and skills of digital film and television editing and compositing, and apply these concepts, knowledge, and skills to create digital film and television art works. As a course to cultivate students' abilities in digital film and television editing and compositing technology and artistic creation, its main teaching content includes: overview of digital film and television editing and compositing, camera editing techniques, selection in editing, narrative editing and performance editing, editing as a spatiotemporal structure, rhythm in film and television editing, and digital film and television editing technology; Animation compositing technology and alpha compositing technology, filter technology and color matching technology, text animation and particle animation, tracking and stability, commonly used plugins for digital compositing, etc.

default.zh: 《录音艺术与声音设计》是设计学系的基础课程，是一门富有创造力和实践性的课程，旨在探索声音在各种媒体和艺术领域中的关键作用。无论您是想成为专业音频工程师、音乐制作人、电影制片人还是声音设计师，本课程都将提供您所需的基本技能和知识。内容包含学习如何选择合适的麦克风、布置录音设备以及创建最佳的录音环境。我们将深入研究采样率、比特率和声音信号的特性；掌握数字音频工作站（DAW）的使用，学会音频编辑、混音和应用声音效果。您将了解如何改进和修复音频；探索各种声音效果，如混响、合唱、合成等，以及如何将它们应用于不同的创作项目。发挥创意，打造独特的声音；学习声音设计的核心原则，包括声音与故事叙述之间的关系。您将掌握如何为电影、游戏、广告和多媒体项目创建引人入胜的声音。
default.en: Recording Art and Sound Design is a fundamental course in the Department of Design, a creative and practical course aimed at exploring the key role of sound in various media and art fields. Whether you want to become a professional audio engineer, music producer, film producer, or sound designer, this course will provide you with the basic skills and knowledge you need. The content includes learning how to choose the appropriate microphone, arrange recording equipment, and create the best recording environment. We will conduct in-depth research on the characteristics of sampling rate, bit rate, and sound signal; Master the use of Digital Audio Workstation (DAW), learn audio editing, mixing, and applying sound effects. You will learn how to improve and repair audio; Explore various sound effects such as reverberation, choir, synthesis, and how to apply them to different creative projects. Unleash creativity and create a unique voice; Learn the core principles of sound design, including the relationship between sound and storytelling. You will learn how to create captivating sounds for movies, games, advertisements, and multimedia projects.

default.zh: 交互设计是数字创意设计辅修专业的主干课程，课程以双语形式讲授。通过对本课程的学习，首先使学生理解交互设计的基本概念和过程，包括：交互设计概述、交互设计的过程。其次使学生理解数字媒体产品设计的基本原理，包括：如何概念化交互，以及从认知、情感化和社会化交互方面理解数字媒体产品；其次使学生掌握设计数字媒体产品的基本方法，包括不同界面形式的研究与设计问题、如何建立、如何设计产品原型等等。
default.en: Interaction design is the main course of the minor of digital creative design, which is taught in bilingual form. By this course, the first aim is to make the students understand the basic concepts and process of interaction design, including: overview of interaction design. The second aim is to make student understand the fundamentals of digital media product design, including: how to conceptualize interaction, and understanding of digital media products from the fields of cognitive, emotional, and social interaction. The third aim is to make student master the basic methods of designing digital media products, including: the research and design considerations for different interface forms, how to establish the requirements, how to design the prototype, and so on.

default.zh: “电子游戏设计与制作”课程是数字媒体艺术相关专业的必修课程。该课程主要讲授游戏场景制作流程、游戏关卡设计基础、游戏角色设计与制作以及游戏的基本编程技术等内容， 培养学生电子游戏的设计与制作能力。
default.en: The course "Video Game Design and Production" is required for majors in digital media arts. This course mainly teaches the production process of game scenes, the basis of game-level design, the design and production of game characters, and the basic programming technology of games, etc., to cultivate students' ability to design and produce electronic games.

default.zh: 设计美学是面向数字媒体艺术系本科生开设的基础理论课程。本课程以案例欣赏、美学分析为方法，在审美的高度上理解设计，在审美欣赏中把握设计之美的创造规律，在审美反思中领悟设计之美的本质，在审美体验中体会设计之美的力量，在历史的反思中总结设计的发展规律。 课程主要包括设计与美学、设计美的本质、设计美的形式、设计的媒介力量、设计美的文化差异、技术革命与设计革命 、设计的转型与审美化生存等内容。 本课程结课成绩采用累加式，包括期末考试、讨论等，另外，需要学生独立完成2个实验，通过设计艺术案例实验探索，理解设计美学的相关理论，能够将设计美学知识用于解决文化产品的创意设计问题。
default.en: Design aesthetics is a fundamental theoretical course designed for undergraduate students majoring in digital media art. This course uses case analysis and aesthetic analysis as methods to understand design from an aesthetic perspective, grasp the creative laws of design beauty in aesthetic appreciation, comprehend the essence of design beauty in aesthetic reflection, appreciate the power of design beauty in aesthetic experience, and summarize the development laws of design in historical reflection. The course mainly includes design and aesthetics, the essence of design beauty, the forms of design beauty, the media power of design, cultural differences in design beauty, technological revolution and design revolution, design transformation and aesthetic survival, and other contents. The final grades of this course are cumulative, including final exams, discussions, etc. In addition, students are required to independently complete two experiments. Through the exploration of design art case experiments, they can understand the relevant theories of design aesthetics and apply design aesthetics knowledge to solve creative design problems of cultural products.

default.zh: 交互设计是数字创意设计辅修专业的主干课程，课程以双语形式讲授。通过对本课程的学习，首先使学生理解交互设计的基本概念和过程，包括：交互设计概述、交互设计的过程。其次使学生理解数字媒体产品设计的基本原理，包括：如何概念化交互，以及从认知、情感化和社会化交互方面理解数字媒体产品；其次使学生掌握设计数字媒体产品的基本方法，包括不同界面形式的研究与设计问题、如何建立、如何设计产品原型等等。
default.en: Interaction design is the main course of the minor of digital creative design, which is taught in bilingual form. By this course, the first aim is to make the students understand the basic concepts and process of interaction design, including: overview of interaction design. The second aim is to make student understand the fundamentals of digital media product design, including: how to conceptualize interaction, and understanding of digital media products from the fields of cognitive, emotional, and social interaction. The third aim is to make student master the basic methods of designing digital media products, including: the research and design considerations for different interface forms, how to establish the requirements, how to design the prototype, and so on.

default.zh: 本课程旨在探索新媒体在建筑与设计领域的应用。课堂采用美国加州大学伯克利分校的教学方法，理论与实践并重，帮助学生在新媒体与科技对于不同类型的设计与建筑项目，从设计概念初期，中期，实践等环节的探索。相关论坛主题包含人机交互，虚拟环境，装配式设计，互动式建筑与设计，以及人工智能探索等领域
default.en: This course aims at exploring how new media play various roles during different stages in Architectural and Design industries, as well as new possibility in the future. The course comprises eight forums, including eight lectures/ seminars and four in-class project reports and discussions. Students will be encouraged to exposes themselves to the latest technologies, learning how these art-vanguard tools can benefit various design disciplines for new inventions. The main content of this class spans virtual world design, digital manufacture and construction, interactive architecture/ design, intelligent environment, etc. The course evaluation is divided into two phases, including mid-term and final report. Students can either choose their current projects, proposing any possible new media/ technologies that might be beneficial, or pick any in-depth case studies to present new vision of technological applications in design projects.

default.zh: 《数字剪辑与合成》是一门研究数字影视剪辑与合成基本理论、基础知识和基本技能的专业课。通过对本课程的学习，能够树立正确的影视剪辑思想和影视时空观念，掌握数字影视剪辑与合成的基本理论、基本知识和基本技能，并能运用这种观念及所学知识和技能进行数字影视艺术作品创作。 作为培养学生数字影视剪辑与合成技术和艺术创作能力的课程，其主要教学内容包括：数字影视剪辑与合成概述，镜头的剪辑技巧，剪辑中的选择，叙事剪辑和表现剪辑，作为时空结构方式的剪辑，影视剪辑中的节奏，数字影视剪辑技术；动画合成技术及Alpha合成技术，滤镜技术及调色技术，文字动画与粒子动画，跟踪及稳定，数字合成的常用插件等。
default.en: “Digital Editing and Compositing” is a professional course that studies the basic theories, knowledge, and skills of digital film and television editing and compositing. Through the study of this course, one can establish a correct understanding of film and television editing and spatiotemporal concepts, master the basic theories, knowledge, and skills of digital film and television editing and compositing, and apply these concepts, knowledge, and skills to create digital film and television art works. As a course to cultivate students' abilities in digital film and television editing and compositing technology and artistic creation, its main teaching content includes: overview of digital film and television editing and compositing, camera editing techniques, selection in editing, narrative editing and performance editing, editing as a spatiotemporal structure, rhythm in film and television editing, and digital film and television editing technology; Animation compositing technology and alpha compositing technology, filter technology and color matching technology, text animation and particle animation, tracking and stability, commonly used plugins for digital compositing, etc.

default.zh: 本课程旨在培养学生掌握二维动画从创意构思到成片输出的全流程创作能力，并在传统动画技法基础上，深度融合AIGC（人工智能生成内容）技术，引导学生形成“艺术主导、技术赋能”的现代创作观。
default.en: This course is aiming to equip students with the end-to-end creative capabilities for 2D animation, from initial idea development to final output. Building on traditional animation techniques, it deeply integrates AIGC (Artificial Intelligence Generated Content) technology, guiding students to cultivate a modern creative mindset of "art-led, technology-empowered."

default.zh: 动画2是媒体专业基础课程，从零基础开始系统学习 Maya，学习MAYA模型、材质、灯光、渲染等模块的使用方法与操作技巧。 主要学习 Maya 的基本操作、 NURBS、 Polygons、 Subdivision 三种建模方式。从结构较为简单的实体造型设计到结构复杂的造型设计，由浅入深，逐步训练学生对该软件的基本操作技能以及运用该软件进行三维设计的能力、表达技巧，掌握正确的实体造型设计的方法，并提高学生在设计过程中的创造力、表现力与判断力。学生可以轻松地了解三维动画软件工具是如何在实践过程中应用的。以学习软件操作为主线，在授课中同时引入建筑知识、装饰装修材料知识、艺用光影知识的教授。精讲MAYA软件操作入门，软件基础建模，学会认识摄像机类型和常用人体工程学知识，简单了解构图知识。
default.en: Animation-2 software MAYA is a foundational course for media majors. Starting from a complete beginner level, students will systematically learn the use and operational techniques of Maya, including its model, materials, lighting, and rendering modules. The course primarily focuses on the basic operations of Maya, NURBS, Polygons, and Subdivision modeling techniques. From simpler solid modeling designs to more complex ones, the course gradually trains students in the basic operational skills of the software and their ability to use it for 3D design, expression techniques, and mastering the correct methods for solid modeling design. It also enhances students' creativity, expressiveness, and judgment during the design process. Students will easily understand how 3D animation software tools are applied in practice. The course is centered around learning software operations, while also incorporating the teaching of architectural knowledge, decorative materials knowledge, and artistic knowledge of light and shadow. It provides an in-depth introduction to Maya software operation, basic modeling, understanding camera types and common ergonomic knowledge, and a basic understanding of composition knowledge.

default.zh: 《数字影像特效》课程是一门用以培养学生在电影，电视，广告与多媒体生产创作中制作特殊艺术视觉效果的专业课，本课程将从理论与技术层面上讲授电影特技技术在影视制作过程中的作用以及它的生产流程，培养学生理论联系实际，掌握影视特技制作的基本原理、专业知识与技能，训练出学生独立参与影视创作的专业能力
default.en: The course "Digital Special Effects" is a professional course aimed at cultivating students' ability to create special artistic visual effects in film, television, advertising, and multimedia production. This course will teach the role of film special effects technology in the film and television production process from a theoretical and technical perspective, as well as its production process. It aims to cultivate students' ability to integrate theory with practice, and master the basic principles, professional knowledge, and skills of film and television special effects production, Train students' professional ability to independently participate in film and television creation.

default.zh: 传播学是设计学学科的一门主干课程，任何设计都离不开传达和传播，本课程旨在引导学生从辩证唯物主义和历史唯物主义的立场出发，了解和掌握人类传播活动产生和发展的一般规律，了解和学习传播学的基本概念、主要理论、传播模式和研究方法；了解传播学主要学术流派的理论观点；了解和掌握传播结构中的传播者、传播内容、传播媒介、受众的传播效果等各重要要素以及之间的广泛联系；批判地吸收西方传播学的科学成分并应用于我国大众传播尤其是新媒体设计与传播实践。
default.en: Mass communication is a major course in the field of design. ItAny design can’t do without communication, the purpose of this course is to guide students from the perspective of dialectal materialism and historical materialism ,human communication actives to understand and grasp the general rule of development theory, communication mode and research methods; understand the main academic school of communication theory; extensive contacts with the important factors to understand and grasp the communicators ,communication content, communication structure in the media ,audience and communication effect; critically absorb western communication science and applied in mass communication in our country especially in new media design & communication practice.

default.zh: 网站与网络程序设计是高等工科院校中数字媒体类专业一门主干课程。在教学过程中综合运用先修课程中所学到的有关知识与技能，结合各种实践教学环节，进行网络媒体技术与设计人员所需的基本训练。为学生进一步学习有关专业课程和日后从事网络程序设计工作打下基础。在培养学生网站系统综合设计能力、提高解决复杂网络程序设计问题的能力等方面占有重要地位。
default.en: Web site and Web programming is a major course in the digital media industry of higher engineering colleges. In the teaching process of comprehensive use of the prerequisite learned in the knowledge and skills, combined with a variety of practical teaching links, the network media technology and design staff required basic training. For students to further study the relevant professional courses and in the future to engage in network programming to lay the foundation. In the training of student website system design capabilities, improve the ability to solve complex network programming problems and other aspects of an important position.

default.zh: 《虚拟现实系统》课程是数字媒体专业的主干课程。在课堂教学中使学生了解虚拟现实的主要应用领域以及相关技术，能够熟练使用原理与方法设计与制作虚拟现实作品，完成在游戏、影视、策展以及空间表现中的设计实践。在实验教学中通过构建虚拟互动环境，能够使学生综合利用设计、人机工程、建筑、心理和美学等多门学科中所学知识，完成实验任务。
default.en: Virtual Reality System is the main course of digital media major. In the classroom teaching, students can understand the main application fields of virtual reality and related technologies, and be skilled in the use of principles and methods to design and produce virtual reality works, and complete the design practice in games, movies, exhibitions and space performance. Through the construction of virtual interactive environment in experimental teaching, students can make comprehensive use of the knowledge learned in design, ergonomics, architecture, psychology, aesthetics and other disciplines to complete experimental tasks.

default.zh: 《游戏引擎基础》是一门本科生课程，旨在介绍游戏引擎的基本原理和开发技术。通过理论讲解和实验实践，学生将学习游戏引擎的核心概念、工作原理以及如何利用游戏引擎创建游戏项目。
default.en: Game Engine Fundamentals is an undergraduate course designed to introduce the fundamentals and development techniques of game engines. Through theoretical explanations and hands-on experience, students will learn the core concepts of game engines, how they work, and how to use them to create game projects.

default.zh: 本课程针对智能建造专业本科三年级（上学期）设置，使学生了解和掌握大空间公共建筑中建筑、规划、景观专业的综合关系，并掌握相关建筑结构、建筑环境、数字媒体等相关专业的技术应用方式，具备建筑技术性设计的能力，掌握建筑、规划、景观综合设计的方式方法。致力于提高学生综合运用所学的理论知识独立分析和解决问题的能力。 课程目标要求如下： 课程目标1. 培养建筑、规划、景观学科中综合解决问题的能力，将多学科知识综合地应用到设计中去，在设计推进过程中体会由城市设计开始到建筑设计、景观设计、技术设计、构造设计的建筑设计全过程。 课程目标2. 培养新型设计技术的应用能力，将建筑结构、建筑环境、数字媒体等相关专业融入设计全过程，体会设计技术在不同设计阶段的应用模式与方法。 课程目标3. 培养设计与技术之间的平衡能力，能够运用科学设计方法实现设计技术提升，解决设计问题，体会建筑学思考方式与科学研究之间的区别与联系。
default.en: This course is set up for the third grade ( spring semester ) of intelligent construction major, aiming that students can understand the comprehensive relationship of architecture, planning and landscape in large space public buildings design, master the technical application methods of related majors such as building structure, building environment and digital media, gain the ability of building technical design, and master the methods of comprehensive design of architecture, planning and landscape. It is committed to improving students ' ability to analyze and solve problems independently by using the theoretical knowledge they have learned. The course objectives are as follows : Course Objectives 1.Cultivate the ability to solve comprehensively problems in architecture, planning, and landscape disciplines, apply multidisciplinary knowledge to design, and experience the whole process of architectural design from urban design to architectural design, landscape design, technical design, and structural design during the design advancement process. Course objective 2.Cultivate the application ability of new design technology, integrate building structure, building environment, digital media and other related majors into the whole process of design, and experience the application modes and methods of design technology in different design stages. Curriculum objective 3.Cultivate the balance between design and technology, can use scientific design methods to achieve design technology improvement, solve design problems, and experience the difference and connection between architectural thinking and scientific research.

default.zh: 本课程是智慧建筑与建造专业本科生的专业设计核心课程。旨在面向我国新时期城镇建设的特殊需求，以“高层建筑设计”为核心，通过理论学习与循序渐进的设计专题训练，培养学生在建筑竖向维度展开深层次思考的综合能力与专业素养：使学生了解功能、技术、文化、艺术、经济及环境等复杂多元因素对高层建筑设计问题的影响作用，以及建筑前期策划——概念生成——深化设计——设计表达的整个过程；熟悉高层建筑的结构体系以及相应的构造做法；掌握高层建筑设计中的结构选型方法，并能够设计适应该结构体系的构造作法和节点详图；熟悉高层建筑安全性的相关知识，掌握高层建筑防火设计的流程与方法。授课方式以专题性讲授与讨论式教学为主，辅以案例分析等环节；考核方式为设计图纸+调研作业。
default.en: This course is a core professional design course for undergraduates majoring in intelligent building design and construction. Facing the special demands of urban construction in the new era, the course focuses on "high-rise building design", to cultivate students' comprehensive ability and professional quality to carry out deep thinking in the vertical dimension of architecture, through theoretical learning and step-by-step design training. To be specific, it aims to enable students to understand the impact of complex and multiple factors such as function, technology, culture, art, economy and environment on high-rise building design issues, as well as the whole process of pre-architectural planning -- concept generation -- deepening design -- design expression; to be familiar with the structural system of high-rise buildings and corresponding construction practices; to master the building structure selection method in high-rise building design, and be able to design the construction method and node details suitable for the structure system; Familiar with the relevant knowledge of high-rise building safety, master the process and method of high-rise building fire protection design. The teaching method is mainly thematic teaching and discussion teaching, supplemented by case analysis and other links; The assessment is based on the design drawing + research work.

default.zh: 产品交互设计课程重点培养用户行为分析能力、信息架构设计思维、交互原型开发技术、多模 态体验创新、可用性验证方法及跨平台协同设计能力。课程着力构建以用户为中心的交互系统设计 思维，强化商业目标与技术实现的平衡能力，提升全链路交互设计专业素养。
default.en: The key objectives of the Product Interaction Design course are to cultivate capabilities in user behavior analysis, information architecture design thinking, interactive prototyping technology, multimodal experience innovation, usability testing methods, and cross-platform collaborative design. The course focuses on building a user-centered mindset for interactive system design, strengthening the ability to balance business objectives with technical implementation, and enhancing comprehensive, end-to-end professional competencies in interaction design.

default.zh: “产品机遇与设计流程”在“产品设计造型与创意”的基础上进一步提高学生的产品设计理论水平与实践能力，是一门理论与实践紧密结合的课程。结合讲授基于产品机遇的设计方法与流程，要求学生按规定的设计选题，在以用户为中心的设计理念的指导下完成设计大作业，并通过设计体现创造能力。使学生进一步理解“以用户为中心”的设计理念，基本掌握基于产品机遇的设计方法与流程，并加强学生对产品形态创造和设计结果表达的能力。
default.en: "Product Opportunities and Design Process" is a course that closely integrates theory and practice, aiming to further enhance students' theoretical understanding and practical skills in product design, building upon the foundation of "Product Design Form and Creativity." By teaching design methods and processes based on product opportunities, students are required to complete a major design project on a given topic, guided by the user-centered design philosophy, and to demonstrate their creative abilities through the design. The course enables students to deepen their understanding of the "user-centered design" approach, gain a basic mastery of product opportunity-based design methods and processes, and strengthen their ability to shape product forms and effectively communicate design outcomes.

default.zh: 本课程通过介绍服务设计的含义、发展和基本观点，掌握服务设计的内容和方法步骤，培养学生获得服务设计的依据、要求的能力为重点。旨在为后续的专业课程的学习提供理论基础。
default.en: This course introduces the meaning, development, and basic perspectives of service design, equipping students with the content, methods, and procedural steps involved. The main emphasis is on developing students' ability to acquire the foundations and requirements for service design. Ultimately, the course aims to provide a theoretical foundation for subsequent study in related professional courses.

default.zh: 计算机辅助产品设计重点讲解三维基础建模、产品曲面建模、虚拟产品装配、产品分解与动画制作、机械工程图样绘制及产品渲染，主要是培养学生计算机在产品设计中的应用能力，提高学生构思产品的三维设计表达能力，并在此基础上培养学生对三维CAD应用软件的自学能力。 本课程使用Creo Parametric软件，全面系统地介绍了其基础知识及应用，同时结合大量典型实际产品对Creo的各个功能模块进行了全面系统的讲解，具体包括软件的安装、设置、草图设计、零件设计、曲面设计、造型曲面设计（ISDX）、自由式曲面设计、装配设计、工程图设计、高级渲染、产品动画设计等模块，使学生深入理解和掌握Creo的基本建模方法及装配、分解、仿真动画、渲染、机械工程图等技术；掌握顶下设计思想以及骨架模型、部件拆分等内容，进而能够熟练运用所学知识将构思产品进行三维表达，提高学生综合设计能力；培养学生综合运用CAID相关知识设计出满足生产加工要求，同时具有自主学习和终身学习的意识，有不断学习和适应发展的能力。
default.en: Computer-aided Product design focuses on three-dimensional basic modeling, product surface modeling, virtual product assembly, product decomposition and animation, engineering drawing and product rendering. It mainly focuses on cultivating students computer application ability in product design, improving students' three-dimensional design expression ability in conceiving products, and on this basis, cultivating students self-study ability in three-dimensional CAD application software. This course uses Creo parametric software to comprehensively and systematically introduce its basic knowledge and application. At the same time, combined with a large number of typical actual products, it comprehensively and systematically explains each functional module of Creo, including software installation, setting, sketch design, part design, surface design, modeling surface design (ISDX), free-form surface design, assembly design, engineering drawing design, advanced rendering Modules such as product animation design enable students to deeply understand and master Creo's basic modeling methods and technologies such as assembly, decomposition, animation, rendering and engineering drawing; Master the top and bottom design idea, skeleton model, component disassembly and other contents, and then be able to skillfully use the knowledge to express the conceived product in three dimensions, so as to improve students' comprehensive design ability; Cultivate students to comprehensively use CAID related knowledge to design products that meet the requirements of production and processing, have the awareness of independent learning and lifelong learning, and have the ability to continuously learn and adapt to development.

default.zh: 当今的产品不仅仅满足人们的使用要求，更重要的还要做到好用、易用。而量化用户体验对有效提高产品的使用质量至关重要。本课程详尽介绍了有效且可靠地收集、分析和呈现典型的用户体验度量数据：操作绩效（正确率等）、用户体验问题（频率和严重程度）、自我报告式的满意度及生理/行为数据。同时对“综合性量化度量数据”等问题进行了专门介绍，而且结合案例等形式对当前与用户体验相关的新内容进行了讲解。 通过该课程的学习，一方面，使学生深入理解和掌握用户体验的要素、评估方法、度量方法及统计学分析方法，能够应用以用户为中心的产品设计方法进行设计，使设计不再仅仅依靠想象力，而是通过对多种因素的综合考量，创造一种良好的用户体验，使设计工作更加有效，物有所值；另一方面，使学生能够运用所学知识从定性和定量两个方面对产品进行综合评价，培养学生综合运用用户体验相关知识指导设计，设计出符合用户、市场和环境的产品，进而提升学生自主学习和终身学习的意识，提升学生不断学习和适应发展的能力。
default.en: Today，a product not only should meet the users’ demands for utilization, but also make users operating it friendly and easily. Quantizing user experience is very important to advance the quality of produce in use. This course will introduce the methods of collecting and analyzing and presenting the measurement data of typical user experience effectively and reliably in details, which includes operation performance (such as accuracy etc.), user experience problems (such as frequency, order of severity etc.), satisfaction degree from user self-report, and physiology or behavior, and so on. At the same time, this course also introduce some problems specially, such as integrated and quantized measurement data. Combined with case studies, the course will give the latest development related to user experience. This course will give students great insight to understand and master the factors of user experience and the methods for evaluation, measurement and statistical analysis. And it will help students to carry out a design from the view of User-Centered Design, thinking series of factors, creating a good user experience to improve the effect of design except designers’ imagination. On the other hand, the course will help students to give overall evaluation quantitatively and qualitatively using the knowledge learned in the related course, and it will develop students' design capacity to finish the design of a produce under the guidance of user experience knowledge, which meets the requests from users, market and environment. And then, it will improve students autonomous learning ability and consciousness of life-long study, and promote students the ability of continuous learning and adaptive development.

default.zh: 产品设计造型与创意是关于“产品形态与使用方式”设计的专业课程。主要由产品形态设计思维与形态设计表现两方面知识构成，其教学目的是培养学生对形态诸功能的认识与理解，并依据和运用相关的知识对产品形态进行创造与表现。产品设计造型与创意的基本内容涵盖三大方面,具体如下：1.产品造型的基本概念；2.产品造型的创意方法；3.产品形态的表现规则。
default.en: The course of Form and Creative of Product Design is about how to design the form of product. It mainly is constituted by the idea of form design and the expression of form design. The aim of teaching is how to make the students realize and understand the functions of product form, therefore create new form of product by using the relating knowledge. The basic contents of Form and Creative of Product Design are made up of three ways, as follows:(1)The basic conception of product form; (2) The method of creating product form; (3) The expression of product form。

default.zh: 交互设计是数字创意设计辅修专业的主干课程，课程以双语形式讲授。通过对本课程的学习，首先使学生理解交互设计的基本概念和过程，包括：交互设计概述、交互设计的过程。其次使学生理解数字媒体产品设计的基本原理，包括：如何概念化交互，以及从认知、情感化和社会化交互方面理解数字媒体产品；其次使学生掌握设计数字媒体产品的基本方法，包括不同界面形式的研究与设计问题、如何建立、如何设计产品原型等等。 其主要任务是培养学生： 目标I. 树立正确的交互设计思想，掌握交互设计的基本理论、基本知识和基本技能，具有数字媒体产品设计的能力； 目标II. 掌握复杂数字媒体产品的用户数据收集、需求建立与原型设计的方法，通过信息综合得到合理有效的结论，考虑社会、健康、安全、法律、文化及环境等因素； 目标III. 能够针对复杂的数字媒体产品提出方案，设计满足特定用户需求的交互产品，并能在设计环节中体现创新意识。
default.en: Interaction Design is a core course of the Digital Creative Design minor program and is taught in a bilingual format. Through this course, students will first understand the fundamental concepts and processes of interaction design, including: an overview of interaction design and its core process. Secondly, the course enables students to comprehend the basic principles of digital media product design, including: how to conceptualize interaction, and to understand digital media products from the perspectives of cognitive, emotional, and social interaction. Furthermore, students will master the essential methods for designing digital media products. This encompasses the research and design issues of different interface forms, how to establish the design, and how to create product prototypes, among other key topics.

default.zh: 本课程主要讲授产品设计表现技法的内容、工具及颜料的特点及应用。课程作为培养学生产品设计表达能力的技术基础课，主要讲授在一般工作条件下根据视觉表达的基本艺术手法将美学法则和专业设计等紧密结合，把产品设计的外观和结构通过直观的视觉手段进行展示。通过本课程的课堂教学、产品设计造型与创意表现等环节，着重培养学生利用工业设计基础理论和工业设计方法来解决工业产品视觉化表达的能力，增强创新意识。
default.en: This course mainly introduces the content, tools, characteristics and application of expression in products. This course as a technical basic course to cultivate students' ability of expression of industrial design, mainly taught in general working conditions according to the basic artistic visual expression combines the aesthetic rules and professional design, the appearance and structure of product design are displayed by visual means. Through the course of classroom teaching, product design and creative performance and other aspects, with emphasis on cultivating students with the basic theory of industrial design and industrial design method to solve the ability of industrial products visual expression, enhance the awareness of innovation.

default.zh: 该课程的目的是通过讲授使学生认识到可再生能源，特别是太阳能的重要性，以实现节能和可持续发展。该课程涉及到以下内容： 1) 传授与可再生能源这一领域有关的基础理论，特别是与太阳能技术和应用有关的基本原则。 2) 分析不同形式的可再生能源的运用方法和途径，并着重于以下范畴：太阳能的收集和储存、利用太阳能生产热水、太阳能供暖和空调、用于生产能源和海水淡化系统的太阳能热利用系统、光伏系统、太阳能系统的设计、建模和模拟、风能、风力涡轮机、性能、设计，可再生能源系统的经济分析。 3) 让学生熟悉使用现代方法来估计上述系统的性能和规模。 本课程为外籍专家共建课程，授课教材与授课教师为同一人（Soteris Kalogirou教授，欧洲科学院院士），该教材是作者担任国际期刊Renewable Energy 以及个人多年研究与工程应用基础上，凝练出的一门与能源利用相关的教材。目前已在全球100多所大学推广该教材与课程。
default.en: The purpose of this lessor is to teach the students to realise the importance of renewable energy sources and specifically of solar energy in an effort to achieve energy conservation and sustainable development. The course is, 1. To teach the students in the basic principles related to the broad area of renewable energy sources (RES) and specifically to the technology and application of solar energy. 2. To analyse the methods and ways of utilisation of the different forms of RES with more emphasis to the following areas: ？ Collection and storage of solar energy. ？ Production of hot water with solar energy. ？ Solar heating and air conditioning. ？ Heliothermic systems for the production of energy and desalination systems ？ Photovoltaic systems ？ Design, modelling and simulations of solar systems. ？ Wind energy, wind turbines, performance, design. ？ Economic analysis of renewable energy systems. 3. To familiarise the students to the use of modern methods for the estimation of the performance and sizing of the above systems. This course is co-built by foreign expert and ourselves teacher, and the teaching materials and instructors are the same person (Professor Soteris Kalogirou, academician of the European Academy of Sciences). The textbook is a condensed material related to energy utilization, developed by the Editor as an international Journal of Renewable Energy and based on years of personal research and engineering applications. Currently, this textbook and course have been promoted in over 100 universities worldwide.

default.zh: 课程定位与学术背景 本课程立足于后人类语境下的“混合生态学”随着气候变化与数字技术的困境纠缠，传统自然与人工环境的物理边界已趋于消解，景观设计正面临着从“对环境的静态园区”向“对极端的复杂适应”的范式转移。在此背景下，本课程旨在打破传统空间设计的近期，引入生成式计算艺术与多模态大语言模型技术，探讨物质与数字拓扑在宏观尺度上的深度融合。课程将引导学生重新利用人地关系，建立跨越传统碳基生物与硅基演算的“新自然”认知框架。 核心与设计方法 课程核心聚焦于“不可见景观要素（Invisible Landscapes）”的工具象化表达与跨文化转译。教学中，将抛弃传统设计的“唯论”，转而关注空间中隐形的生态与物理力场——如热环境感知（热环境感知）、微气候风场、以及社会感知的心理边界。学生将学习如何跳出繁杂的内容底层逻辑，运用前沿的人工智能图像、视频及生成工具，将这些抽象的环境元数据翻译为高保真视觉影片与沉浸式声画体验。通过“音频模式自然提取”到“生成结构推演”的逻辑，赋予数据以场所精神，完成从监听环境要素到跨情感艺术叙事的升华。 16学时密集型工作坊，本课程致力于完成学生从“空间美化者”向“感知翻译官”的身份转换。课程要求学生具备宏观的生态认知 视野，能够熟练生成运用式AI工具进行概念推演。学生需以个人形式，针对极端或未来气候设定，提出一个横跨视、听、动多维度的数字景观概念或跨创意环境干预措施。引导学生在未来复杂混合生态系统下的设计思维与创意驾驭能力。
default.en: Course Positioning and Academic Context This course is grounded in the frontier perspective of "Hybrid Ecology" within a post-human context. As climate evolution and digital technologies become deeply entangled, the physical boundaries between traditional natural and artificial environments are rapidly dissolving. Landscape design is facing a paradigm shift from the "static reshaping of environments" to the "deep adaptation to extremes." In this context, this course aims to transcend the visual limitations of traditional spatial design by introducing generative computational art and multimodal Artificial Intelligence (AI) technologies, exploring the deep integration of physical environments and digital media at a macro scale. The course will guide students to re-examine the human-land relationship and establish a "neo-nature" cognitive framework that surpasses traditional carbon-based biology and silicon-based computation. Core Content and Design Methodology The core of the curriculum focuses on the concrete expression and cross-media translation of "Invisible Landscapes." The pedagogy will discard the conventional "visual-centric" approach to design, turning its attention to the invisible ecological and physical force fields within spatial environments—such as Thermal Environment Perception, microclimate wind fields, and the psychological boundaries of social perception. Students will learn to bypass complex underlying coding logic, utilizing cutting-edge AI image, video, and audio generation tools to translate abstract environmental metadata into high-fidelity visual spectacles and immersive audio-visual experiences. Through logical training from "natural pattern extraction" to "generative structure deduction," students will endow data with the spirit of place (genius loci), achieving an elevation from objective environmental elements to cross-media artistic narratives. Teaching Objectives and Expected Outcomes As a pioneering and experimental 16-hour intensive workshop, this course is dedicated to facilitating the students' identity transformation from "spatial beautifiers" to "perceptual interpreters." The course requires students to cultivate a macro-level ecological adaptability vision and become proficient in using generative AI tools for conceptual deduction. Ultimately, on an individual basis, students are required to independently complete and submit a multi-dimensional digital landscape conceptual short film or a cross-media environmental intervention proposal (spanning visual, auditory, and kinetic dimensions) addressing a specific extreme or future climate scenario. This aims to foster students' independent creative capabilities, forward-thinking design logic, and media mastery within the complex hybrid ecosystems of the future.

default.zh: 《碳中和城市前沿》是面向"双碳"战略目标下城市可持续发展需求而开设的一门专业选修课。课程主要通过课堂讲授、研讨互动和小型工作坊等多种形式，系统介绍能源、碳排放与水循环等城市运行核心要素的基本原理，以及实现碳中和城市的前沿技术与应用路径。课程内容涵盖能源转换与高效利用、碳达峰与碳中和路径、水循环与水能利用、低碳城市前沿技术等，旨在培养学生面向碳中和城市建设的科学素养、工程视野与综合应用能力。
default.en: Frontiers in Carbon Neutral Cities is a specialized elective course designed to address the needs of sustainable urban development under China's "Dual Carbon" strategic goals (carbon peaking and carbon neutrality). Through a combination of classroom lectures, interactive seminars, and mini workshops, the course provides a systematic introduction to the fundamental principles of energy, carbon emissions, and the water cycle—the core elements underpinning urban systems—as well as the cutting-edge technologies and implementation pathways for achieving carbon-neutral cities. The course content covers energy conversion and efficient utilization, carbon peaking and carbon neutrality pathways, the water cycle and water energy utilization, and frontier technologies for low-carbon cities. It aims to cultivate students' scientific literacy, engineering vision, and comprehensive application capabilities oriented toward the development of carbon-neutral cities.

default.zh: 建筑计划是建筑设计的前期工作或对于建筑设计的研究工作。建筑计划学是现代的计划科学与建筑科学相交叉而产生的新兴边缘学科，是以建筑计划作为研究对象的知识体系，其中涉及建筑设计方法论、环境行为心理学、建筑策划等方面的内容。通过讲授本课程，使学生初步树立建筑计划的意识，掌握建筑计划的基本理论和方法，提高建筑计划与设计的能力。课程目标在于：从建筑计划学的角度对应毕业要求中的工程知识、问题分析、设计与开发解决方案、研究、工程与社会。
default.en: Architectural planning is the preliminary work on architectural design or the research work on architectural design.Architectural planning is an emerging marginal discipline produced by the intersection of modern planning science and architectural science. It is a knowledge system with architectural planning as the research object, which involves architectural design methodology, environmental behavior psychology, architectural planning and other aspects. Through teaching this course, students can initially establish the awareness of architectural planning, master the basic theories and methods of architectural planning, and improve the ability of architectural planning and design.

default.zh: 本课程是公共建筑设计原理的扩展性课程，针对图书馆建筑这一特殊建筑类型的设计问题做专题性介绍，以培养学生专业素养和提高设计能力为着眼点，使学生对于图书馆这类重要公共建筑的设计有全面、切实的认识，为日后从事建筑设计实践打下坚实基础。
default.en: The course is the expansible one of the Public Building Design, which introduces design problems of Library Building, in order to train students to have professional qualities, improve design abilities and develop a broad overall and solid view of this kind of Public Building design, furthermore, to lay a solid foundation for architecture design practices in future.

default.zh: 本课程是一门面向建筑学本科高年级学生的专题理论课程，具有综合性、社会性、技术性的特点，是对学生专题建筑认知的扩展。本课程以“现代校园建筑”为核心，内容包含理论学习、专题学习；培养学生在建筑横向维度上进行更深层次理解的素质，支撑专业学习成果中相应指标点的达成。 本课程将深入探讨校园建筑的整体规划设计、功能设计要点及未来发展趋势，详细介绍现代校园建筑设计发展背景及现状，系统分析综合校园及各类校园建筑的规划设计要点，重点思考智慧校园、低碳校园、健康校园等技术和理念。通过本课程的学习，使学生掌握校园建筑设计的基本理论、方法与技能，提高其在校园建筑设计和规划方面的专业素养和综合能力，为未来从事各类型校园建筑策划及设计相关工作打下坚实基础。 课程教学方式主要有课堂讲授、项目案例解析和自主研究学习；课程考核方法是根据学生的课堂出勤情况和结课论文的质量来综合评定，总成绩中课堂结课汇报占比100%。
default.en: This course is a thematic theory course for upper-year students in architecture, which is comprehensive, social and technical in nature, and is an extension of students' thematic architectural knowledge. With "contemporary campus architecture " as the core, this course includes theoretical and thematic studies; it cultivates students' quality of deeper understanding in the horizontal dimension of architecture and supports the achievement of the corresponding index points in the professional learning outcomes. This course will discuss the overall planning and design of campus architecture, functional design and future development trends, introduce the background and current situation of contemporary campus architecture architectural design, systematically analyze the planning and design of general campus architectures and various types of specialized campus architectures, and focus on thinking about the design concepts and methods of smart campus architecture, green campus architecture and healthy campus architectures. Through the study of this course, students can master the basic theories, methods and skills of campus architecture design, improve their professional literacy and comprehensive abilities in campus architecture design and planning, and lay a solid foundation for their future work in the fields of types of campus architecture preliminary planning and design projects. The teaching methods of the course mainly include classroom lectures, project case analysis and independent study; the course assessment method is based on the students' classroom attendance and the quality of the final paper. In the total score, final papers account for 100%.

default.zh: 工业建筑设计专题是高等工科院校中建筑学专业的设计拓展类课程，专门针对工业建筑这一特殊类型的设计问题做专题性介绍。课程目标主要是了解工业建筑的类型特征和设计基础知识，掌握相应设计原理和方法。在教学过程中运用先修课程中掌握的知识和技能，结合实践教学环节，领悟工业建筑的独特性设计思维和设计要点。进一步拓展视野，了解当代工业建筑的变化趋势，探索未来工业建筑的发展方向。
default.en: The design of the industrial architecture is one of the professional courses in higher engineering college in architecture. The course is an extension to the lecture serials of special topic on industrial architecture. The course mainly includes the introduction of the basic theories and principle methods of the industrial architecture design. With the related knowledge and skills the students learned before and based on various practical projects, it makes the students to master the special professional thinking and requirements of industrial building design. To broaden the horizons, it also makes the students to understand the development of modern industrial architecture and its possible changing trends.

default.zh: 本课程是公共建筑设计原理的扩展性课程，专门对体育场馆这一特殊类型建筑的设计问题做专题性介绍，属于专业性实用性具强的专业课。主要目的是使学生：①了解、掌握体育建筑的分类及其共性特点，相关设计理论及方法；②熟悉其功能空间构成及相关规范要求，掌握视线设计、消防疏散设计原理与计算方法；③加深对体育建筑所需的大跨结构选型、结构形态和建筑造型等知识与设计的认知。通过本门课程的学习，达到以下课程目标： 目标1：使学生了解本课程的性质、任务，与其它课程的关系；掌握体育建筑的性质、类型及其共同特征；了解体育建筑的功能结构、分区及流线设计。 目标2：使学生通过学习体育建筑的视线设计原理和评价，掌握座席视线升起的计算方法。 目标3：了解和掌握体育建筑的防火疏散设计规范要求和设计手段。 目标4：了解体育建筑屋盖的主要结构形式及其应用特点，了解体育建筑的结构选型和建筑造型的密切关系，掌握正确处理二者关系的原则和手法。
default.en: This extended professional course of the design principles of public building provides a thematic introduction to the design issues of stadiums with strong specialty and practicability. The course aims are listed below: (1) To make students understand and comprehend the classification, commonalities, and characteristics of sports buildings, as well as relevant design theory and methodology. (2) To guide students to be familiar with the composition of functional spaces and relevant specification requirements of sports buildings, sightline design, design principles and calculations for fire evacuation. (3) To acquaint students with the specialized knowledge and design of the long-span structure selection, structural form, and shape of sports buildings.Through the study of this course, to achieve the following course objectives: (1) Students will be able to understand the nature, targe of the course, and the relationship with other courses. They will learn the nature, types, and common characteristics of sports buildings and comprehend the functional structure, partition, and circulation design. (2) To enable students to acquire the calculation method of raising the audience’s sightline via learning sightline design principles and assessment of sports buildings. (3) To understand and acquire code requirements for the fire evacuation plan and design methods of sports buildings. (4) To guide students to understand primary structural forms and application characteristics of the sports building roof. As well as to comprehend close relations between the structure selection and architectural modeling of sports buildings, and to grasp principles and methods of dealing with the relations.

default.zh: 在介绍人口老龄化、老年人环境需求、老年人建筑发展趋势的基础上，结合我国“以居家养老为基础、以社区服务为依托、以机构养老为补充”的养老方针，深入讲解与之相对应的住宿照料型养老设施、日间照料型养老设施、老年住宅/适老化住宅的设计要求，并介绍有代表性的国内外设计实例。
default.en: Phase with the introduction of an aging population, and environmental needs of the elderly, the elderly on the basis of the architectural trends, combined with our "home care, community service as the basis, institutional pension supplement" pension policy, in-depth explanation corresponding residential care facilities for the elderly, the type of day-care facilities for the elderly, elderly residential / suitable for the aging residential design requirements, and describes the representative domestic and foreign design examples.

default.zh: 本课程是一门面向建筑学本科高年级学生的专题理论课程，具有综合性、社会性、技术性的特点，是对学生专题建筑认知的扩展。本课程以“当代医院建筑”为核心，内容包含理论学习、专题学习；培养学生在建筑横向维度上进行更深层次理解的素质，支撑专业学习成果中相应指标点的达成。 本课程将深入探讨医疗建筑的整体规划设计、功能设计要点及未来发展趋势，详细介绍当代医院建筑设计发展背景及现状，系统分析综合医院及各类专科医院的规划设计要点，重点思考智慧医院、绿色医院和健康医院等新兴医院的设计理念与方法。通过本课程的学习，使学生掌握医院建筑设计的基本理论、方法与技能，提高其在医疗建筑设计和规划方面的专业素养和综合能力，为未来从事医疗建筑设计和健康科学领域的相关工作打下坚实基础。 课程教学方式主要有课堂讲授、项目案例解析和自主研究学习；课程考核方法是根据学生的平时成绩和结课案例分析成果的质量来综合评定，总成绩中平时成绩占比20%，结课案例分析成果占比80%。
default.en: This course is a thematic theory course for upper-year students in architecture, which is comprehensive, social and technical in nature, and is an extension of students' thematic architectural knowledge. With "contemporary hospital architecture" as the core, this course includes theoretical and thematic studies; it cultivates students' quality of deeper understanding in the horizontal dimension of architecture and supports the achievement of the corresponding index points in the professional learning outcomes. This course will discuss the overall planning and design of medical buildings, functional design and future development trends, introduce the background and current situation of contemporary hospital architectural design, systematically analyze the planning and design of general hospitals and various types of specialized hospitals, and focus on thinking about the design concepts and methods of smart hospitals, green hospitals and health hospitals and other emerging hospitals. Through the study of this course, students can master the basic theories, methods and skills of hospital architectural design, improve their professional literacy and comprehensive abilities in medical architectural design and planning, and lay a solid foundation for their future work in the fields of medical architectural design and health science. The teaching methods of the course mainly include classroom lectures, project case analysis and independent study; the course assessment method is based on the students' usual performance and the quality of the final case study ppt. In the total score, usual performance accounts for 20% and final case study ppt account for 80%.

default.zh: 文化，是建筑之灵魂。对建筑中制度文化与精神文化的探究，是解决建筑之“为什么”方面的问题。 课程的目的在于从文化的视野去探究建筑表象背后更为深刻的故事，使学生能够分析与建筑空间的观念、形式相关联的种种文化因素，并能够解释建筑空间形式及其演变方式因文化而异的现象；能够以比较研究的方法理解不同文化背景下的建筑空间生成与发展动因，具备跨文化的建筑视野。 课程内容包括了东西方的文化特征、中国建筑与儒释道文化、建筑与哲学、建筑与人类学四个专题，通过专题讲授结合课堂汇报、讨论的教学形式，建立起中西方文明与建筑交互的整体架构，搭建中西方文明影响下的建筑思想或流派的比较研究平台。
default.en: Civilization is the soul of architecture. The research of institutional civilization and spiritual civilization is to solve the problem of “why” in architecture. The purpose of curriculum is to explore underlying stories behind images of architecture from the perspective of civilization, to enable students to analyze cultural elements associated with architecture form and notions of space. Furthermore, students are instructed to explain the phenomena that architecture space form and their evolvements vary with different civilizations, and they are required to using comparative study to grasp generation and development of architecture space in different culture background with the cross-cultural view. The curriculum includes four topics: Eastern and Western cultural characteristics, Chinese architecture and Confucianism, Buddhism and Taoism culture, architecture and philosophy, and architecture and anthropology. The curriculum combines topic-based teaching with discussion in class to build an overall framework of interaction between Chinese and Western civilizations and architecture is established. And a comparative research platform of architectural thoughts or schools under the influence of Chinese and Western civilizations is built.

default.zh: 本课程拟探讨城市的定义及城市起源的不同观点，介绍人类最早的新石器城市及其群系特征，讲授中国城市的起源及中国城市的发展历程，从横向上概述中华文明不同的城市地域特点及地域间的交流，纵向上强调农业革命、周秦之变、唐宋之变及全球化引发的城市革命，在层次上涵盖物质文明、制度文明与精神文明对城市的影响；引导学生用宏阔的文明史观来思考城市这种大尺度的文明成果，从不同子系统及要素的相互作用机制来理解城市的复杂性；介绍先秦两种重要的城市规划思想及其时空背景，通过对不同城市形态的解读使学生学会阅读城市，梳理中国都城史上从“黄河时代”到“运河时代”的迁移历程，使学生了解都城选址反映出的政治、军事、经济的复杂考量；开展讨论使学生反思、批判城市存在的问题，分析现代科技革命给现代城市发展带来的挑战与机遇；引导学生欣赏城市之美，激发对传统城市的热爱并唤醒城市历史文化保护的意识。
default.en: This course aims to explore diverse perspectives on the definition and origin of cities, introduce the earliest Neolithic cities and their formation characteristics, teach the origin and development process of Chinese cities, summarize the regional characteristics and inter-regional exchanges of different cities in Chinese civilization horizontally, and emphasize the agricultural revolution, changes during the Zhou and Qin Dynasties, transformations in Tang Song Dynasties, as well as urban revolution caused by globalization vertically. It encompasses the influence of material civilization, system civilization, and spiritual civilization on urban areas. The objective is to guide students in contemplating large-scale civilizational achievements of cities within a broad framework of civilizational history while comprehending city complexity through interaction mechanisms among various subsystems and elements. This paper introduces two significant urban planning concepts along with their temporal and spatial backgrounds during pre-Qin period. By interpreting different urban forms, students can learn how to analyze cities while tracing migration processes from "Yellow River Era" to "Canal era" in Chinese capital's history; thus enabling them to understand complex political, military, and economic considerations reflected in capital city locations. The discussion prompts students to reflect upon existing issues within cities while analyzing challenges as well as opportunities brought about by modern scientific and technological revolutions for contemporary urban development. Students are guided towards appreciating city aesthetics which stimulates love for traditional cities while awakening awareness regarding historical-cultural preservation.

default.zh: 本课程讲授外国城市的发展历程，横向上概述各大文明的城市地域特点及文明间的交流，纵向上强调从农业文明到工业文明催生的城市革命，在层次上涵盖物质文明、制度文明与精神文明对城市的影响；引导学生用宏阔的文明史观来思考城市这种大尺度的文明成果，思考城市发展的动力因素，从不同子系统及要素的相互作用机制来理解城市的复杂性。介绍人类重要的城市规划思想及其时空背景，通过对不同城市形态的解读使学生学会阅读城市，理解城市布局对建筑的影响及建筑对城市空间的建构。梳理西方城市史上“理想城市”理念的源头与后续影响，使学生了解“乌托邦”思想倾向的意义与危险；开展讨论使学生反思、批判城市存在的问题，分析现代科技革命给现代城市发展带来的挑战与机遇；引导学生欣赏城市之美，激发对传统城市的热爱并唤醒城市历史文化保护的意识。树立正确的城市发展观，培养学生批判性思维的能力，学会分析外国城市发展的得与失。
default.en: This course aims to provide an in-depth understanding of the development process of foreign cities. It explores the urban regional characteristics of major civilizations and their horizontal exchanges, while emphasizing the vertical urban revolution from agricultural civilization to industrial civilization. Additionally, it examines the impact of material civilization, institutional civilization, and spiritual civilization on cities at various levels. By adopting a broad perspective on civilizational history, students are encouraged to contemplate the significant achievements made by cities and explore the driving factors behind urban development. Furthermore, they will gain insights into the complexity of cities through an examination of different subsystems and elements that interact within them. Through analyzing diverse urban forms, students will learn how to interpret cities and comprehend how urban layouts influence architecture as well as how architectural construction shapes urban spaces. The origin and subsequent influence of "ideal city" concepts in Western city history will be analyzed to help students understand both its significance and potential dangers associated with utopian ideologies. Discussions will enable students to reflect upon and critique existing issues within contemporary cities while also analyzing challenges and opportunities brought about by modern scientific and technological revolutions for their future development. Moreover, this course seeks to cultivate an appreciation for the beauty inherent in cities while stimulating a love for traditional ones thus awakening awareness regarding historical preservation efforts. Ultimately, this course aims to establish a correct concept regarding urban development while simultaneously training students' critical thinking abilities so that they can effectively analyze both gains achieved as well as losses incurred during foreign urban developments.

default.zh: 《文化传承与建筑创新》从建筑文化传承与发展的角度探讨建筑创新问题，主要包括五方面内容：建筑与文化；文化传承与建筑文化生态学；建筑文化遗产的保护、传承与更新；建筑地域性；传统文化在当代建筑创作中的表达与应用。课程采用专题性讲授、案例教学、启发式教学、互动问答教学、实地调研等教学方法，以充分发挥学生的主观能动性，激发学生的创造性思维，培养学生的创新能力。 通过讲授本课程，使学生深刻认识东西方建筑文化的异同；掌握建筑文化生态学的理论与方法，树立建筑文化生态意识；认识与理解建筑文化遗产的价值、遗产保护的相关理念，掌握建筑文化遗产的传承与更新模式；深入了解建筑地域性与全球化的关系，认识建筑地域性的研究方法，掌握地域性建筑创作的表达方式与设计方法；深入认识传统文化与当代建筑创作的关系，深入掌握传统文化在当代建筑创作中的表达方式与设计方法。
default.en: The course "Special Topics on Culture Heritage and Architectural Innovation" explores architectural innovation from the perspective of architectural culture inheritance and development. It primarily encompasses five main aspects: 1.Fundamental Concepts and Theories of Architecture, Culture, and Cultural Ecology. 2.Introduction to Architectural Cultural Ecology. 3.Basic Concepts and Theories of Inheritance and Renewal of Architectural Culture Heritage. 4.Concepts and Theories of Architectural Regionalism. 5.Expression and Application of Traditional Culture in Modern Architecture. The course uses various teaching methods, including case studies, heuristic teaching, interactive Q&A sessions, and practical assignments, to fully engage students, stimulate their creative thinking, and develop their innovative capabilities. Through the instruction of this course, students will gain an understanding of the fundamental concepts and related theories of architectural culture and architectural cultural ecology. They will also acquire knowledge of the structure, operation, and mechanisms of the architectural cultural ecosystem, fostering an awareness of architectural cultural ecology. Furthermore, the course will enable students to appreciate the value of architectural culture heritage and the associated principles of heritage preservation. Students will be equipped with models for the inheritance and renewal of architectural culture heritage. Moreover, students will explore the topics of architectural regionalism in the context of globalization and the methodologies for regionalism research. They will also develop the skills to express regional characteristics in architectural design. Lastly, this course will intend to facilitate students' comprehension of the relationship between traditional culture and modern architecture, as well as the connection between Chinese architectural tradition and modernity, equipping them with the means and methods of expressing traditional culture in contemporary architecture.

default.zh: 本课程是一门主要面向本科三年级学生的综合性理论课程，其目的是在学生学完部分专业课程的基础上，进一步拓展绿色建筑设计专项内容的知识和能力。了解我国绿色建筑发展伟大成就，加强社会主义核心价值观培养，认识新时期我国城镇绿色建筑建设任务的重要性与艰巨性，培养科学素养、社会责任感及职业素养；掌握绿色建筑基本概念、设计要求、基本原理、设计原则、设计方法、相关法规标准等知识构成，能够将专业知识用于解决复杂工程问题，在设计环节中体现创新意识，充分考虑健康、环境及安全等因素；培养学生分析问题和进行绿色建筑技术综合集成设计的能力，能够理解和评价针对复杂工程问题的专业工程实践对环境、社会可持续发展影响的能力，具备建筑学学科国际视野，培养自主学习和终身学习的意识，有不断学习和适应发展的能力。课程内容主要包含绿色建筑概况（绿色建筑基本概念、发展背景、评价体系及设计要求等）、绿色建筑场地设计（场地安全、生活便利、资源节约及宜居环境等）、绿色建筑本体设计（方案设计及技术设计等）及国内外绿色建筑实践项目实例解析。
default.en: This course is a comprehensive theoretical course mainly for undergraduate students in the third year, whose purpose is to further expand the knowledge and ability of green building design on the basis of the completion of some professional courses. To understand the great achievements of Chinese green building development, strengthen the cultivation of socialist core values, understand the importance and arduousness of task of Chinese green building construction, and cultivate scientific literacy, social responsibility and professional literacy. Master the basic concept, design requirements, basic principles, design principles, design methods, regulations and standards of green buildings, and be able to apply professional knowledge to solve complex engineering problems, reflect innovative consciousness in the design process, and fully consider health, environment and safety factors. To cultivate students' ability to analyze problems and conduct comprehensive and integrated design of green building technology, understand and evaluate the impact of professional engineering practice on the environment and social sustainable development of complex engineering problems, international vision of architecture, awareness of independent learning and lifelong learning, and continuously learn and adapt to development. The course mainly includes the general situation of green buildings (basic concept, background, evaluation system and design requirements of green buildings, etc.), site design (site safety, convenience of life, resource saving and livable environment, etc.), design technology (scheme and technology design, etc.) and practice projects at home and abroad.

default.zh: 本课程针对目前普遍关注的绿色建筑可持续发展问题，结合建筑行业的专业背景，较为系统的介绍了绿色建筑的基本概念和内涵、绿色建筑在我国及世界范围内的发展历史和现状、绿色建筑的评价方法、绿色建筑设计模式和方法、绿色建筑案例分析、绿色建筑关键技术及我国绿色建筑使用后评估等内容，是一门关于绿色建筑概况的通识性课程。通过该课程的学习，使学生认识绿色建筑的基本概况，明晰绿色建筑与技术之间的关系，即绿色建筑是与所在地区气候及资源相适宜的技术的优化集成，而非所谓高新、昂贵技术堆砌的产物；建立绿色建筑可持续发展的观念，认识坚持适合我国国情的绿色建筑发展道路的科学性和必然性，逐步培养学生的学习动力和分析问题的能力，将学生的素质教育有机结合在一起。
default.en: This course is aimed at the sustainable development of green building with the background of the construction industry. It is a general curriculum of green building which systematically introduces the basic concept and connotation of green building, history and the present situation of green building both in China and throughout the world, evaluation methods of green building, design patterns and methods of green building, case analysis of green building, key technology of green building and post evaluation of green building in China, etc. Through the study of this course, the students will have a basic, clear understanding of green building and relationship between green building and corresponding technologies, which means green building is the optimal integration with the appropriate climate and resources in particular region, rather than the so-called high-tech, expensive technology packing products; establish the concept of sustainable development of green building, realize the scientific nature and necessity of adhering to the green building development path suitable for Chinese national conditions, combine students' quality education organically and gradually cultivate their learning motivation and ability of analyze problems.

default.zh: 《可持续住宅设计专题》是住居类建筑专精领域的拓展性专题课程，偏于研究型理论导入，聚焦住宅设计前沿理念与集成技术的专题介绍讲解，使学生在先修课程基础上，对于前沿住宅设计理论、研究及设计方法（包含理念、功能、技术等层面）有所接触，形成一定深度的相关知识概念体系架构，主要目的培养学生依托于住宅类型建筑的研究型设计综合与创新能力，更深入理解住宅建筑对于人生活品质提升的重要作用，培养建筑学科人才加强社会责任感与使命感。 该课程应作为人居环境导论、建筑设计基础、建筑设计、建筑计划学等课程的延续或补充，在前序和相关课程基础上，帮助学生进一步认识居住建筑发展的前沿趋势、被动式设计要点和节能减排的可持续设计理念，深刻了解地域性对居住建筑的影响，理解和掌握住宅建筑科学设计的理论和方法。课程主要内容为可持续居住建筑的设计理念、方法和设计参与因素等，简要梳理居住建筑的发展脉络、经典案例以及未来发展趋势等，帮助学生树立“以人为本”和“因地制宜”的设计观，了解被动式设计和设计理念的升级可以为建筑节能减排和可持续带来明显增益，增强学生设计创新精神，改进提效设计流程与思考方法。
default.en: "Special Topic on Sustainable Residential Design" is an advanced specialized course in the field of residential architecture. It focuses on the introduction of research-oriented theories, with a specific emphasis on presenting cutting-edge concepts and integrated technologies in residential design.
