Building on students' prior coursework, the course exposes them to frontier theories, research, and design methodologies in residential design (encompassing aspects such as concepts, functions, and technologies), enabling them to develop a structured and in-depth knowledge system in this domain. Its primary objective is to cultivate students' comprehensive and innovative capabilities in research-based design of residential buildings, deepen their understanding of the crucial role of residential architecture in enhancing people's quality of life, and foster a stronger sense of social responsibility and mission among talents in the architecture discipline. This course should serve as a continuation or supplement to courses such as Professional Introduction, Fundamentals of Architectural Design, and previous architectural design courses. Based on the foundation laid by these preceding and related courses, it helps students further recognize the cutting-edge development trends of residential architecture, the key points of open residential design, and the sustainable design concepts centered on energy conservation and emission reduction. It also enables students to gain a profound understanding of the impact of regional characteristics on residential buildings, as well as master the theories and methodologies of scientific residential design. The main content of the course includes the design concepts, methods, and influencing factors involved in sustainable residential architecture. Additionally, it briefly outlines the development context of residential buildings, classic cases, and future development trends. Through this, the course assists students in establishing a "people-oriented" and "adaptation to local conditions" design philosophy, helps them understand that passive design and the upgrading of design concepts can significantly contribute to building energy conservation, emission reduction, and sustainability, strengthens their spirit of design innovation, and improves the efficiency of their design processes and thinking methods.

default.zh: 算法与设计课程是建筑学专业数字化建筑设计系列课程中一门。通过学习，是目前建筑设计应用新的技术进行设计的方法之一。 使学生清晰的了解参数化设计的概念、方法和应用。结合参数化设计软件等工具，让学生具备了更高层次的使用计算机进行辅助设计的能力； 使学生能够通过编程化、参数化等手段，了解和实现造型形式和空间关系； 使学生能够有能力解决在设计中遇到的大量的、重复性调整工作，并能够在设计课程中得到应用。
default.en: Algorithm and Design course is one of the series courses of digital architectural design for architecture major. Learning is one of the methods of applying new technology to architectural design at present. To enable students to clearly understand the concept, method and application of parametric design. Combined with parametric design software and other tools, so that students have a higher level of computer-aided design ability; Enable students to understand and realize the shape form and spatial relationship by means of programming, parameterization, etc. To enable students to be able to solve the large number of repetitive adjustment tasks encountered in design and be able to be applied in design courses.

default.zh: 建筑创作技术观课程涵盖建筑材料、结构、构造等知识。通过本课程学习，使学生了解建筑技术发展概况、技术与艺术的辨证关系、以及建筑技术在建筑设计中的地位和作用，使学生能正确运用建筑技术知识从事建筑创作，提升建筑设计能力。系统的讲授建筑技术发展的历史脉络、阶段特征、材料选择、构造特点、作用表现等知识，熟悉建筑技术发展、驱动的规律，掌握建筑技术与建筑创作的作用原理与关联机制，培养学生举一反三、自主学习的能力。面对新材料、新技术、复杂的技术现象，可以做到科学、理性、系统的进行解读。培养多学科、交叉、综合运用多种手段的建筑设计思维。系统、整体的从建筑创作角度，看待材料、建筑结构、建筑物理、建筑设备、建筑施工等有关知识，通过综合技术手段，解决建筑设计中的方案深化问题。
default.en: The course on the concept of architectural creation technology covers knowledge from multiple disciplines such as building materials, building structures, and construction. Through this course, students will understand the development overview of architectural technology science, the dialectical relationship between architectural technology and art, as well as the position and role of architectural technology in architectural design. They will have a preliminary understanding of the relevant knowledge of architectural technology science, enabling them to correctly apply architectural technology knowledge to engage in architectural creation and improve their architectural design abilities. Through this course, students will acquire technical knowledge. Understand the historical context, stage characteristics, material selection, structural characteristics, and functional performance of the development of architectural technology, be familiar with the laws of development and driving of architectural technology, master the principles and correlation mechanisms of architectural technology and architectural creation, and cultivate students' ability to draw inferences from one example and learn independently. In the face of new materials, new technologies, and complex technological phenomena, scientific, rational, and systematic interpretation can be achieved. Cultivate a multi-disciplinary, interdisciplinary, and comprehensive approach to architectural design thinking. From a systematic and holistic perspective of architectural creation, we view knowledge related to materials, building structures, building physics, building equipment, and construction, and solve the problem of deepening solutions in architectural design through comprehensive technical means.

default.zh: 本课程是一门面向建筑学、城市规划、景观学和设计学专业高年级学生的专业选修课程，针对现代木建筑快速发展，同时建筑教育缺失的问题，以木结构建筑材料在建筑中的基本特征、技术规律和设计原则为主要内容，旨在帮助学生扩展木结构建筑技术与设计方面的知识储备。在教学过程中运用先修课程中掌握的知识和技能，结合实践教学环节，领悟木建筑的独特性设计思维和设计要点。
default.en: This course is a professional elective course for senior students majoring in architecture, urban planning, landscape science and design. Aiming at the rapid development of modern wood architecture and the lack of its relative knowledge in education, it mainly focuses on the basic characteristics, technical rules and design principles of wood architecture. It is designed to help students expand their knowledge of wood construction technology and design.With the related knowledge and skills the students learned before and based on various practical projects, it makes the students to master the special professional thinking and requirements of wooden construction.

default.zh: 新能源概论是可再生能源领域中占有重要地位的一门学科，它包括太阳能、风能、生物质能、可燃冰、地热能等利用技术。新能源已经成为当前的研究重点，也是产业发展的重点。这些能源的应用研究内容主要是计算各方面自然存在的能量，再通过研究不同机构用其吸收这些能量，使其成为可用能源。它的应用是一门多学科的综合技术，包括大气环境、海洋环境学、流体力学等学科。通过课程学习使学生掌握新能源能利用技术的基本理论与研究方法。
default.en: The introduction to new energy plays an important role in regenerative energy field. New energies include solar, wind, biomass energy, combustible ice and geothermal energy. It has become a central research issue of modern technology and pillar of industries. The study of new energies mainly concentrated on calculating the total energy that spread in the fields of nature and how to make these energies into application, which includes multi disciplines, including atmospheric environment, ocean engineering environments, fluid dynamics and so on. This course aims at letting students master the basic theories and methodologies in new energy field.

default.zh: 《低碳能源技术与应用》是针对低碳建筑供能系统的发展需求，而开设的一门专业必修课。它主要通过课堂授课，讲授新型的建筑能源系统、包括自然冷源、多能互补、燃气冷热电三联供、太阳能供热、发电、采光、空气净化、地热能、生物质能的高效利用技术以及在建筑中的工程应用。讲授内容将涉及各类新型低碳能源系统的运行原理、系统设计、适用性、以及优缺点等，来培养学生开阔的低碳技术视野以及工程运用能力。
default.en: Low carbon energy technology and Application is a professional compulsory course for the development needs of low-carbon building energy systems. It mainly teaches new energy systems, its efficient utilization technologies, and the engineering applications in low-carbon buildings, including natural cold sources, multi-energy complementary, gas-cooled/heat/power, solar heating, solar electricity generation, solar lighting, air purification, geothermal energy, biomass energy. The lecture content will involve the operation principle, system design, applicability, and advantages and disadvantages of various new low-carbon energy systems, so as to cultivate students' broad vision of low-carbon technology and engineering application ability.

default.zh: 化工原理面向建筑环境与能源应用工程专业建筑能源方向的本科生开课，是一门专业基础课，是学生学习专业课程的前期理论性较强的课程，在培养学生理论联系实际、以专业思维解决工程问题方面具有重要的作用。 课程的内容以化工原理的传热传质部分为主，以传输理论及单元操作原理为重点，使学生深入理解热量传输和质量传输过程的机理，初步了解传热传质过程的设备。通过本课程的课堂教学、习题分析等环节，着重培养学生进行燃气领域传热传质过程的设计计算以及选择传热传质设备的能力，支持学生学习燃气净化的相关技术。 课程主要包括绪论、热量传输过程、传质分离过程理论、蒸馏单元操作、 吸收单元操作、萃取单元操作、燃气领域涉及的传热设备和传质设备，以及各单元操作的工艺计算等内容。 课程采用讲授、课后习题以及习题课方式教学。课程考核成绩采用累加式，考核环节包括平时参与讨论、课后作业和期末考试（闭卷），总评成绩以百分计，满分100分。
default.en: 《Principles of Chemical Engineering》is an important professional basic course for the students from the building energy direction of the major of building environment and energy application. It has strong theoretical property, and is the basic for the studying of the related subsequent professional courses. By studying this course, the capacity of linking of theory and practice, and solving the engineering problems using theory knowledge could be enhanced. In this course, the heat and mass transfers during chemical engineering are the main contents, while the principle of transmission and unit operation are the key contents. Furthermore, it will be detailed taught that the mechanism of heat transfer and mass transfer, and the related equipment. By lecture and homework, the capacity of calculation for heat and mass transfer and choosing the related equipment could be trained. The main contents in this course include introduction, process of heat transfer, theory of mass transfer and separation, operation of distillation, operation of absorption, operation of extraction, equipment of heat and mass transfer used in field of natural gas, and the calculation of technological process referred in above operations. The course is taught by way of lectures, exercises, and discussions. The results of the course evaluation are cumulative. The assessment includes discussions, homework, and final exams. The total score is 100 points.

default.zh: 绿色建筑面向于建筑环境与建筑能源两个方向的本科生开课，是一门专业选修课，也是一门综合性技术课，课程在培养学生工程思维、综合分析能力方面有重要的意义。 课程开设目的是使学生及时了解国内外最新的绿色建筑理论与技术发展动态，掌握绿色建筑国内外发展历史、绿色建筑内涵、绿色建筑实现的目标、绿色建筑评价标准、绿色建筑关键技术及绿色建筑实际工程案例。使学生认识绿色建筑的基本知识结构，为进一步学习和实践绿色建筑设计打下基础。课程围绕绿色建筑的定义、关键技术以及实际工程案例三方面展开，要求学生了解绿色建筑的基本概念与相关术语、绿色建筑规划的原则与方法；掌握绿色建筑室内环境控制技术、绿色建筑围护结构节能设计、绿色建筑材料与设备等关键技术；结合绿色建筑工程案例、学习绿色建筑相关的设计规范与评价体系、了解绿色建筑运营管理等内容。使学生能运用已学习过的专业知识解决绿色建筑中的实际应用问题，理解绿色建筑设计和运行过程中的重要环节，了解包括建筑节能技术在内的绿色建筑技术与理论研究的学术动向及发展脉络。 课程考核采用项目研究撰写科技报告的方式。以某些学术论文发以及最新的绿色建筑技术文献为载体，将绿色建筑设计、运行等内容有机融合串联。要求学生结合本门课程内容与专业知识，针对绿色建筑关键技术、前沿研究、实际问题进行分析并撰写课程报告，提高学生的理解能力、应用所学知识、方法解决建筑环境与能源应用相关工程问题的实践能力。
default.en: "Green Building" is offered to undergraduate students with two directions: Building Environment and Building Energy. It is a specialized elective course as well as a comprehensive technical course. This course holds significant importance in cultivating students' engineering mindset and enhancing their comprehensive analytical skills. The course's objective is to ensure that students stay informed about the latest developments in green building theory and technology, both domestically and internationally. It aims to Enable students to understand the basic knowledge structure of green building.The course revolves around the definition, key technologies, and practical engineering cases of green buildings, requiring students to understand the basic concepts and related terminology of green buildings, as well as the principles and methods of green building planning; Master key technologies such as indoor environmental control technology for green buildings, energy-saving design of green building envelope structures, and green building materials and equipment; Combining green building engineering cases, learning design specifications and evaluation systems related to green buildings, and understanding green building operation and management.The course is designed to empower students to apply their acquired professional knowledge to solve practical issues within the field of green building, understand the critical aspects within green building design and operational processes, understand the academic trends and developmental context of research in the areas of energy-efficient and green building technology and theory. The course assessment adopts the method of writing technology reports. Students are required to combine the course and professional knowledge, analyze and write course reports on key technologies, cutting-edge research, and practical issues related to green building, in order to improve their understanding ability, practical ability to solve HVAC engineering problems

default.zh: 《建筑传热》是一门双语课程，是工科高等学校建筑环境与能源应用工程专业的专业理论选修课之一，对于增强学生的专业理论水平、提高学生国际视野方面，在跨文化背景下进行沟通和交流有积极作用。 本课程的主要任务是通过课堂教学培养学生理论知识的分析及应用能力，支撑专业学习成果中相应指标点的达成。掌握建筑传热的基本理论与模型，具有从事建筑环境与能源应用工程工作所需的专业理论知识，能够将解决一定工程问题。该课程使学生较深入了解英国建筑传热计算模型与方法, 增强学生的专业素养。 课程主要内容主要包括绪论，各种建筑材料热力参数，建筑传热计算分析及地面传热计算Mercy公式，热路系统热力组成四部分。 课程采用讲授、讨论和项目研究等方式教学。课程考核成绩采用累加式，考核环节包括考勤、课后作业和项目研究，总评成绩以百分计，满分100分。
default.en: Building heat transfer is one of the professional theory courses of building environment and energy application engineering. It is a bilingual course which plays an important role in enhancing students ' professional theoretical level and improving students' international vision. The course mainly deals with s the British traditional building heat transfer calculation model, the ground heat transfer formula and the thermal circuit theory. Students can get more understanding of the British building heat transfer calculation model and method. The course mainly includes the introduction, the traditional building heating model , thermal parameters for gase, heat loss from a solid floor, basic thermal elements. The course is taught by way of lectures, exercises and discussions. The results of the course evaluation are cumulative. The assessment includes homework and presentation. The total score is 100 points.

default.zh: 《数据挖掘与能源智慧管理》是建筑环境与能源应用工程专业的一门专业选修课程。课程主要目的是在当前智慧城市建设、物联网和大数据技术迅猛发展的背景下，培养学生利用数据挖掘这一前沿技术来进行建筑能源系统智慧管理的能力，拓展其知识面和技术视野。课程主要任务是通过课堂教学、案例剖析等环节，让学生大体上了解适用于建筑环境与能源智慧管理领域的数据挖掘基本算法知识，具备对建筑环境与能源智慧管理领域产生的海量数据进行初步的数据挖掘、知识发现以及结果显示的能力；初步具备利用数据挖掘技术和专业技能，对建筑能源系统管理方案进行简单的评估与优化的能力；以及利用数据挖掘技术，对现场测试的海量数据背后的知识进行分析和解释，并通过信息综合得到合理有效结论的能力。 课程总体上分为基础知识和专业应用两大部分。基础知识部分主要包括绪论、数据的基础知识、数据预处理、聚类分析、分类算法、关联性和相关性；专业应用部分又以城镇供热和燃气为主要能源智慧管理对象，具体包括智慧供热相关概念及标准解读、系统仿真、负荷预报与故障诊断等智能决策、智能调控，智慧燃气的基本概念、SCADA系统、管网GIS综合管理系统、智慧燃气系统构建等内容。 课程采用课堂讲授的教学方式。课程考核成绩采用累加式，考核环节包括课堂平时测验和撰写技术报告，总评成绩以百分计，满分100分。
default.en: "Data Mining and Smart Energy Management" is a professional elective course for the major of Building Environment and Energy Application Engineering. The main purpose of the course is to cultivate students' ability to use the cutting-edge technology of data mining to carry out the intelligent management of building energy system and expand their knowledge and technical vision under the background of the rapid development of smart city construction, internet and big data technology. The main task of the course is to make students generally understand the basic data mining algorithm applicable to the field of built environment and energy smart management through classroom teaching and case analysis, and have the ability to conduct preliminary data mining, knowledge discovery and result display of massive data generated in the field of built environment and energy smart management. Additionally, make the students have the ability to use data mining technology and professional skills to carry out simple evaluation and optimization of building energy system management schemes. Lastly, make the students have the ability to use data mining technology to analyze and explain the knowledge behind the massive data in field tests, and to obtain reasonable and effective conclusions through information synthesis. The course is generally divided into two parts: basic knowledge and professional application. The basic knowledge part mainly includes introduction, basic knowledge of data, data preprocessing, cluster analysis, classification algorithm, correlation and correlation; The professional application part takes urban heating and gas as the main energy intelligent management objects, including intelligent decision-making and intelligent regulation such as smart heating related concepts and standard interpretation, system simulation, load forecasting and fault diagnosis, basic concept of smart gas, SCADA system, GIS integrated management system of pipe network, and construction of smart gas system. The course is given mainly by classroom teaching. The assessment result of the course is the summation of in-class exam and writing technical report. The total score is 100 points.

default.zh: 城市社会学课程是城乡规划专业必修课程。城市社会学讨论的中心问题一直围绕着城市的发展与运行、以及在这过程中赋予的社会生活的意义展开。以此为核心，本课程将从主要概念、重要理论、城市结构等方面的内容对城市社会学的知识体系进行概括性的讲授。具体的教学内容包括：城市社会学导论、城市社会学的理论流派、城市社会结构、城市组织与社区、城市社会分层、城市空间结构、城市社会问题等。本课程面向于城乡规划专业学生，教学重点在于将城市社会学中与城乡规划研究内容相关的理论、方法、规律提炼为若干知识要点进行讲解，使学生能够系统地掌握相关知识并运用到专业实践当中。课程的教学目标为：掌握城市社会学相关的基础理论知识，如城市社会学基本概念、理论流派、城市结构、研究议题等；了解不同时期城市人口、经济、社会、文化对于城市发展的影响及城市社会发展规律，以及由此表现出的城市多样性特征；认识现实社会中的城市现象与问题，并能够运用城市社会学中所学知识，对现实社会中的城市问题展开较为深入分析与研究。
default.en: Urban Sociology is the major required course for urban and rural planning. According to central issue of urban sociology revolves around urban development and operation, the meaning of social life in this process, this course summarizes the knowledge system of urban sociology discipline through main concepts, important theories, and urban structures. Based on this, the main course contents include urban sociology introduction, urban sociology theories, urban social structure, urban organization and community, social stratification, the urban spatial structure, urban social problems. Due to its vast knowledge system, the course only extracts the theories, methods and rules closely associated with urban-rural planning discipline, which benefit students to use the relative knowledge into professional practice by the interdisciplinary view. The teaching course objectives can be divided into 4 aspects: To master the basic urban sociology theoretical knowledge, like basic concepts, core theories, urban structures, important issues, etc. To understand the influence of urban population, economy, society and culture to urban development, development rules of social development and the urban diversity characteristics of shown from that. To recognize and analyze the phenomenon and problems in the real society.

default.zh: 本课程在讲授社会调查研究的相关概念、基本原理、方法体系和对应程序的基础上，结合大量的城乡规划、城乡建筑和景观的调查研究成果案例，介绍城乡社会调查研究的基本类型、调查方法、统计分析方法、思维加工方法以及城乡社会调查研究的逻辑过程和一般程序，讲解社会调查研究方案制定的内容，包括调查方案设计内容及策略和相关指标设计要点，详细讲授城乡社会调查研究的选题及意义、调查计划总体安排和调查核心内容制定，讲授不同调查论题下方法选用技术和基础技巧，讨论调查初步成果与资料整理方法、分析研究和归纳技术与方法，结合不同类型的论题讲解调查成果的凝结及表达：即调查研究报告的框架编制及逻辑、调查核心内容的数据分析与表述、调查报告写作方式和展开模式特点，详细的分解讨论调查报告摘要、引言、主体文体、结论的写作要点，强调调查报告的真实性、客观性和独特视角，同时解析调查数据的分析与运用、量化分析的方法和表达；由案例和典型报告选择为触媒引导学生关注城乡规划社会问题、关注民生、重视实证方法、重视调查数据的意识，培养学生从现象中发现问题、分析问题和解决问题的能力，为加深理解城市及规划社会规律和专业特点及知识，为后续的学习能力、研究能力的培养打好坚实基础。
default.en: Based on teaching related concepts, basic principles, method system and corresponding procedures of the social investigation and research, this course introduces basic types, statistical analysis methods, thinking processing methods, logical process and the general procedures of urban and rural social investigation and research, combined with a large number of investigation and research results of urban and rural planning, buildings and landscape. The content of how to make the social research program is discussed, including the strategies of investigation program design and points of related indicators design. Topics selection and significance of urban and rural social survey, overall arrangements for the investigation plan and developing the core content of the survey are introduced. This course also teaches methods of selection and basic skills according to different topics, discusses the initial results of the survey and data collation, analysis and induction methods, explains the condensation and expression of survey results combined with different types of topics: that is, framework and logic of the research report, data analysis and presentation of the core content, writing characteristics and development modes of the report. Furthermore, detailed decomposition of the investigation report’s summary, introduction, subject style, writing points of the conclusion is discussed, emphasizing the authenticity, objectivity and unique perspective of the survey report, and analyzing the analysis and application of the survey data, quantifying methods and expression of the analysis. This course leads students to focus on urban and rural planning social issues, concern about people's livelihood, pay attention to empirical methods and the awareness of survey data by selecting cases and the typical reports, and develops students’ ability to find problems, analyze problems, and solve problems from the phenomenon in order to deepen understanding urban and the related specialized knowledge and lay a solid foundation for further study and research.

default.zh: 城市规划需要数据科学的支持，本课程主要介绍基于R语言的数据科学方法。R语言是大数据时代最优秀的空间数据分析工具之一。基于R的数据分析过程和结果能够有力支撑城乡规划学、建筑学、风景园林学等专业的设计和研究。本课程主要讲授R语言基础、开源数据的获取方法以及基于R的空间分析。通过课题讲授和上机操作结合的方式，使学生初步掌握R语言技巧。 本课程建设目标： （1） 提高学生的数据采集、分析、处理、表达能力。 （2） 在大数据时代背景下，开阔学生对于数据处理和运用的思维。 （3） 通过计算机语言的学习开拓学生设计和研究的思路。
default.en: Urban planning needs supports from data science. R language based data science methods are introduced in this course. R is one of the best programming languages in the big data era. Both procedure and results of R based data analysis can support design and research in fields of urban planning, architecture and landscape architecture in many ways. In this course knowledge of R language basic, open data acquisition and data analysis will be introduced. In this class students will learn R by both theoretical lectures and operational practice. Targets of this course includes: (1) Improving students’ abilities in data acquisition, analysis, processing and expression. (2) Widen views of students in thinking with data science knowledge. (3) Exploring new ideas for design and research.

default.zh: 伴随着现代计算机技术、信息通讯技术的发展，特别是无线网络、智能手机终端、数字社会媒体的全面普及，现代人类社会的社交方式、生活方式已全面数字化、算法化。城市作为社会生活的空间容器和物态载体，随之也全面数字化、算法化，，呼唤计算城市科学（Computational City Science）：城乡规划学科的计算机化转型，响应信息技术所激发的时代性变革，实现“城市让生活更美好”的历史责任。同时，实现国家“十四五”“数字中国”“数字经济”“数字城市”重大战略的学科响应。 计算城市科学导论课程，是计算城市科学课程体系的基础部分，通过本课程学习，希望使学生响应城乡规划学科计算机转型的时代需求，树立计算思维范式，掌握计算城市科学的概念和内涵，计算城市科学所需的计算机科学、数学、统计学、概率论等相关学科的基础知识体系，具备开展计算城市科学自主学习和自主实践的基本技能，为后续相关课程学习奠定基础。
default.en: With the development of modern computer technology and information communication technology, especially the popularization of wireless networks, smart phone terminals, and digital social media, the social methods and lifestyles of modern human society have been fully digitized and algorithmized. City, as the space container and physical carrier of social life, is also fully digitalized and algorithmized. It calls for Computational City Science: the computerized transformation of urban and rural planning disciplines, in response to the era changes stimulated by information technology, Realize the historical responsibility of "Better City Makes Life Better". At the same time, realize the disciplinary response of the national "14th Five-Year Plan", "Digital China", "Digital Economy" and "Digital City" major strategies. Introduction to computational city science is the basic part of the computational city science curriculum system. Through this course, it is hoped that students will respond to the need of the era of computational transformation of urban planning discipline, establish the computational thinking paradigm, master the concept and connotation of computational city science, and the basic knowledge system of computer sciences, mathematics, statistics, probability theory and other related disciplines required, and have the basic skills to independently carry out study and practice of computational urban science, and lay the foundation for subsequent related courses.

default.zh: 城乡规划学科的研究内容逐渐从注重于表象的研究深入到本质的探索，研究手段也从定性迈向定性和定量相结合，城乡规划系统工程学则是运用系统工程学的理论与方法，借助运筹学、控制论、信息论、计算机技术等现代科学技术手段，解决具体系统问题，即城乡规划、建设、决策、管理中的系统问题，使其性能达到最优的设计方法和技术，以此来推动城乡规划学科的发展和提高。 城乡规划系统工程学主要包含两方面内容，一方面介绍了城乡规划系统工程学的基础理论，阐明了对复杂的城乡巨系统实行整体考虑、系统分解和综合的思想方法与工作步骤。另一方面系统介绍了国内外目前在城乡规划与建设方面行之有效的系统分析、预测、模拟、优化、评价和决策等定量方法和技术。 本门课程以整体的、综合的、系统的观点，试图结合具体实例，对城乡系统不同阶段问题进行定量的分析，引入了系统工程学一些先进的学术思想、理论、方法和技术，在一定程度上提高了城乡规划的系统性和科学性。同时，通过本课程学习，能够使学生建立起以系统研究的视角看待和解决复杂城乡系统问题的思维方式。
default.en: The research of city and rural planning subject has been turned into exploration of urban essence from study of urban surface. Its research means have also been applied in both qualitative and quantitative ways. By introducing Science of System Engineering, Operational Research, Cybernetics, Information Theory and computer technique into it, Science of System Engineering in City and Rural Planning can solve many system problems such as urban planning, policy, management etc. and optimize the system capability. The research content of Science of System Engineering in City and Rural Planning mainly include two parts. In one part, the basic theories of this course are introduced, as well as its thoughts and research approaches to complex urban giant system are expounded. In another parts, some quantitative means and technique of system analysis, forecast, simulation, optimization, evaluation, decision-making in current urban planning process are discussed. With the holistic, integrated, and systemic viewpoint, in this course, many system problems are analyzed quantitatively by introducing some advanced academic thoughts, theories and technique. At this point, it will make urban planning more systemic and scientific. At the same time, through the curriculum learning, the students can establish a way of thinking to see and solve the complex urban and rural system problems through the view of systematic research.

default.zh: 城市经济学作为运用经济学规律研究城市产生、形成、发展和空间资源分配效率的科学，是城市规划专业的核心课程之一。通过课程学习，使学生能够对城市在产生、成长、城乡融合的整个发展过程中的经济关系及其规律的了解和掌握。使学生能了解城市经济系统的基本概念与原理、应用方法、最新理论与发展趋势。通过案例教学与课堂讨论，使学生了解和掌握城市发展过程中人口与产业集聚过程、城市人口、城市土地以及城市住宅建设和城市空间开发、城市基础设施建设等方面的城市开发过程中的经济基本规律和市场经济发展特点。从宏观和微观的研究角度，结合当前我国社会经济发展过程中的相关问题，进行课堂讨论与案例解析。使学生能够认识城市与城市系统、城市经济运行、城市经济关系和城市经济规律，具有解决城市公共管理问题的基本能力，并在熟悉城市经济学知识的基础上掌握和了解市场经济条件下的城市开发的相关知识。
default.en: In the course of urban economics, students will learn how to using the economics principle to study on the urban space science and urban planning. Urban economics as a required course of urban planning. In the course, students can have understanding the city in the entire development process such as urban growth, urban and rural integration and economic relations of urban economics rules. In the lecture, Students can understand the basic concept of urban economics, basic principle and application method of urban economics, as well as the latest theory and the development tendency about urban development and economics. In the course, we also having case teaching and team discussion about different cites population and industrial agglomeration in the course of urban development process. students will focus on basic economic law of urban development process, urban population growth, urban land development and urban housing construction under the condition of market economy development. From the view of macroscopic and microscopic, the students will consider the connecting present domestic situation of socio - economic development - related problems in the process. through the course, students can also understand the basic characteristic and market economy development in the process of urban development, such as urban population growth, urban land use and the construction of urban housing market and as well as urban infrastructure construction.

default.zh: 风景园林规划原理是一门理论与实践相结合的教学课程，是在学习城乡规划原理的基础上，通过系统的理论学习和实际案例分析解读的基础上，深入了解城市绿地系统的构成与设计方法，了解风景园林规划的专业知识，掌握园林绿地设计的基本要素，主要是风景园林构图、园林建筑布置、园林小品安排、园林植物种植等基本知识的掌握和运用。了解城市园林发展的历史和中国古典园林的发展及园林建造特征，了解当前城市绿地系统规划的基本理论和应用技术方法，掌握城市园林绿地规划的内容和设计方法。同时，该课程顺应了时代的发展和需要，适时增加了诸如自然保护地体系、国家公园体系等内容介绍，丰富了课程的知识点和系统的生态观。其主要课程内容包括六个方面：1.风景园林规划概论；2.城市绿地系统规划；3.城市园林绿地要素规划设计；4.园林风景构图；5.各类型城市绿地设计；6.自然保护地规划导引。作为设计原理类课程，其讲授的内容、方法适用于国土空间规划、总体规划、详细规划、公园绿地设计等设计课程。
default.en: The principle of Landscape architecture planning is a teaching course combining theory and practice. Based on the study of the principle of urban and rural planning, and also by systematic theoretical study, analysis and interpretation practical cases , we can have a deep understanding of the composition and design method of urban green space system, understand the professional knowledge of landscape architecture planning, and master the basic elements of garden green space design. It is mainly the master and application of the basic knowledge of landscape architecture composition, landscape architecture layout, landscape furniture arrangement and garden plant planting. We also learn the history of the development of urban gardens, the development of Chinese classical gardens and the characteristics of garden construction, understand the basic theory and application technology methods of the modern urban green space system planning, and master the content and design methods of urban green space planning. At the same time, the course conforms to the development and needs of the time, we added contents such as the natural protected area system, national park system, etc., to enrich the knowledge point of the course and the systematic ecological view. The main course contents include six areas: 1. Introduction to landscape architecture planning; 2. Urban green space system planning; 3. Planning and design of urban green space elements; 4. Landscape composition; 5. Design of various types of urban green space; 6. Guide to natural protected area planning. As a course of design principles, the content and methods we taught are applicable to national space planning, comprehensive planning, detailed planning, park green space design and other design courses.

default.zh: 本课程将系统讲授中外历史文化保护规划的理论发展与实践经验。通过本课程学习，使学生：（1）理解习近平文化思想的核心内涵及其内在基本逻辑；（2）了解中外历史文化保护的发展历程以及主要理论；（2）了解当前城乡历史文化遗产保护状况，理解城乡历史文化保护与发展的关系；（3）熟悉我国城乡历史保护的体系、类型、内容与方法，为专业课程的学习打好理论基础，以便更好地从事相关规划、设计与管理工作。
default.en: This course will systematically teach the theoretical development and practical experience of historical and cultural protection planning in China and abroad. (2) Understand the development process and main theories of historical and cultural preservation at home and abroad; (2) Understand the current status of urban and rural historical and cultural heritage protection, and comprehend the relationship between urban and rural historical and cultural protection and development; (3) Familiarize oneself with the system, types, content, and methods of historical preservation in urban and rural areas in China, laying a solid theoretical foundation for the study of professional courses, in order to better engage in related planning, design, and management work.

default.zh: 本课程旨在通过理论与实践相结合的教学模式，帮助城乡规划专业学生掌握大语言模型（LLMs）在城市规划中的应用技术，培养数据科学思维和人工智能工具的使用能力。课程将引导学生从城市科学视角出发，学习LLMs的专业领域应用技术，掌握基于R/Python的大语言模型调用与城市大数据分析方法，解决城市规划设计与城市科学研究的核心问题，提升学生的核心技术竞争力。
default.en: This course aims to help urban and rural planning students master the application technology of large language models (LLMs) in urban planning and cultivate the ability to use data science thinking and artificial intelligence tools through a teaching model that combines theory and practice. The course will guide students to learn the application technology of LLMs from the perspective of urban science, master the large language model calling and urban big data analysis methods based on R/Python, solve the core problems of urban planning and design and urban science research, and enhance students' core technical competitiveness.

default.zh: 你真正“看见”过你生活的城市吗？每天穿行的街道、转角的老建筑、热闹的广场、安静的老厂房与街角庭院……它们不只是地图上的坐标，更是一座城市的记忆、体温与心跳。《城市认识》是一门带你重新发现城市的课程。在这里，你将学会用眼睛丈量街道，用图纸拆解空间，用数据洞察活力，用心灵感受温度。从漫步街头到仰望天际线，从解读一张热力图到理解“15分钟生活圈”，你将一步步读懂城市为何迷人、如何运转、为谁而建。课程没有枯燥的理论堆砌，只有鲜活的案例、真实的城市问题和一次次有趣的思想碰撞。最终，你将和小伙伴一起，完成一次属于你们的城市发现报告。如果你对脚下的城市充满好奇，这门课会给你一双全新的眼睛。
default.en: Have you ever truly seen the city you live in? The streets you walk every day, the old buildings on the corner, the bustling squares, the quiet former factories and courtyard gardens—they are more than just dots on a map. They carry a city’s memory, warmth, and heartbeat. Understanding Cities is a course that takes you on a journey to rediscover the city around you. You will learn to read streets with your eyes, break down spaces with drawings, uncover patterns through data, and feel the pulse of urban life. From strolling through neighborhoods to gazing at skylines, from decoding a heatmap to understanding the “15-minute living circle,” you will gradually grasp why cities are fascinating, how they work, and for whom they are built. No boring theories—just real-world cases, genuine urban questions, and plenty of engaging discussions. At the end, you and your team will present your very own urban discovery report. If you are curious about the city beneath your feet, this course will give you a brand new pair of eyes.

default.zh: 《街道景观设计专题》是风景园林专业的选修课程，为适应城市更新和存量发展的需求，结合街道空间更新和利用的问题，通过对街道类型、空间形态、慢行交通等专业知识的综合运用，使学生提高综合解决城市、功能、美学、社会等城乡人居环境品质问题的能力。课程通过理论学习和实地调研，掌握街道导则编制、街区规划设计和街道景观设计的具体方法和途径。课程分为两部分。第一部分是对街道景观设计原理的学习，包括基本概念、调研方法和法规标准。第二部分是通过街道实地调研，采集基础数据进行研判，完成规划设计方案。
default.en: This course is a professional elective course for landscape science majors. The content is including the comprehensive application of street type, spatial form, slow traffic and other professional knowledge to resolve the problems of street space renewal and utilization in order to meet the needs of urban renewal and stock development. That enables students to improve their ability to solve urban, functional, aesthetic, social and other urban and rural residential environment quality problems. The course aims to master the specific methods and approaches of street guide preparation, street planning and design, and street landscape design through theoretical study and field investigation. The course is two parts. The first part is the principles of street landscape design, including basic concepts, research methods and laws and regulations. The second part is to collect basic data for research and judgment and complete the planning and design scheme through the street field survey.

default.zh: 陶艺创作及实验是环境设计专业学生的专业方向选修课。课程主要讲授陶艺的基本概念、发展历史、设计与制作方法，赏析陶艺作品，培养学生的艺术情操。课程通过教师的示范和辅导，使学生熟悉并掌握捏塑成型、泥条盘筑和拉坯成型等陶艺制作的基本方法。在实践教学环节中，教师将启发学生关注艺术与生活的联系，辅导学生综合运用陶艺制作的方法结合身边的学习生活进行创作。
default.en: Pottery art creation and experiment is an optional course for students majoring in architecture, urban and rural planning, landscape architecture and environmental design etc. The course mainly teaches the basic concepts, development history, design and production methods of ceramic art, appreciates ceramic works, and cultivates students' artistic sentiment. Through the teacher's demonstration and guidance, the course enables students to be familiar with and master the basic methods of pottery making, such as kneading molding, clay bar molding, and the method of modeling of ceramic drawing machine etc. In the practice teaching link, the teacher will inspire students to pay attention to the connection between art and life, and guide students to use ceramic art production methods to create in combination with the learning life around them.

default.zh: 本课程通过对现代设计发展过程中设计现象、设计师、设计作品、设计风格等方面的记录和梳理，使学生较为深入的了解和认识设计产生及演变的规律，以形成正确的设计观。其教学目标如下：1.树立正确的设计思想，通过案例来解析设计规律在实践中的运用；2.了解不同历史时期设计师是如何回应技术发展和社会需求，以此帮助学生学会观察优秀学者的足迹，从研究主体的角度理解和进行学习的能力。3.能够使学生在专业视野、艺术修养、设计思维等方面得到进一步拓展，能借助历史上的创作理念和艺术观点，提高对高品质人文设计的水平。
default.en: hrough recording and sorting out design phenomena, designers, design works, design styles and other aspects in the development process of modern design, this course enables students to have a deeper understanding and understanding of the law of the emergence and evolution of design, so as to form a correct view of design. Its teaching objectives are as follows: 1. Establish correct design ideas, analyze the application of design laws in practice through cases; 2. 2. Learn how designers respond to technological development and social needs in different historical periods, so as to help students learn the ability to observe the footprints of outstanding scholars and understand and learn from the perspective of research subjects. 3. It can further expand students' professional vision, artistic accomplishment, design thinking and other aspects, and improve their level of high-quality humanistic design with the help of historical creative ideas and artistic viewpoints.

default.zh: 展示设计是对展示环境的设计，同时涉及建筑设计与室内设计两个学科范畴。本课程的展示设计中，视觉传达设计的概念以多功能、多形式的形态介入到展示空间与展示道具的设计中，成为其有机组成部分。 展示设计是设计学专业本科生的专业选修课。展示设计是伴随商品经济的发展、科学文化的进步，而发展起来的一项应用性较强的专项设计，包括各类的博物馆、展览会、商业店面与橱窗的陈列设计和展示道具造型设计等。展示现已发展成一项具有较高经济效益和极大文化影响力的产业。他将建筑空间设计、室内环境艺术设计与平面艺术设计等几个方面内容高度结合起来，它是艺术设计工作者必须掌握的一项专业设计内容。《展示设计》在我国还是一门较新的专项工作。在本科层次的设计教育中，把它作为一门课程开设，目的是使学生及时了解新的学科知识，更快更好地掌握参与社会实践的能力，培养知识结构全面的艺术设计人才。 课程重点：从展示设计的视觉创意与表现手法入手，对其进行分类和概括总结，通过理论知识与方法的详细论述来引导具体的设计实践。 课程组成：展示设计概念剖析：本质、特征、种类、发展价值。 展示空间设计解析：创造最适宜的观展空间场所。 强调人的情感体验与参与性。 关注人的空间体验。 展陈—建筑—环境的一体化设计。 现代展示中的交互空间与虚拟空间。 展示空间中的光健康：灯光设计 光与影的塑造：颜色配比 分类与原则 设计风格 视觉印象
default.en: Display design is the design of the display environment, involving both architectural design and interior design. In the display design of this course, the concept of visual communication design is involved in the design of display space and display props in the form of multi-function and multi-form, becoming an organic part of it. “Exhibition Design” is a specialized elective subject for undergraduate students who are in the major of Art and Design. Exhibition Design is a professional design of strong practical application with the development commodity economy and the progress of science and culture, including in the various types of museums, exhibitions, commercial storefront, display props design and so on. Exhibition has developed into a high economic benefits and a great cultural influence industry. It integrates in high degree of architecture space design, interior environment art and design ,graphic art and design and other aspects, so art and design workers must master this professional design. In our country, “Exhibition Design” is a relatively new special work. As a course to set up in the undergraduate level education, it intends to enable students to keep abreast of new subject knowledge, to grasp the ability of participate in social practice faster and better ,and to bring up art design talent with comprehensive knowledge structure. Course focus: start with the visual creativity and expression techniques of display design, classify and summarize them, and guide specific design practice through detailed discussion of theoretical knowledge and methods. Course composition: Display design concept analysis: essence, characteristics, types, development value. Analysis of exhibition space design: create the most suitable exhibition space. It emphasizes people's emotional experience and participation. Pay attention to people's spatial experience. Integrated design of exhibition, architecture and environment. Interactive space and virtual space in modern exhibition. Light health in exhibition space: Lighting Design Shaping light and shadow: color matching、Classification and principles Design style、Visual impression

default.zh: 课程是通过融合 AI 技术、跨学科知识和实践项目，构建前沿性、实践性和创新性的课程。课程通过人工智能技术赋能，从视觉感受与知觉的体验进行科学的训练，致力于培养具备未来视野和创新能力的设计人才。
default.en: This course integrates AI technology, interdisciplinary knowledge, and practical projects to create a cutting-edge, practice-oriented, and innovative curriculum. Empowered by artificial intelligence, it employs scientific training in visual perception and sensory experience, aiming to cultivate design talents with future-oriented vision and innovative capabilities.

default.zh: 本课程系统介绍故事创意与写作的基本涵义、创意写作的学科视野、理论基础与教学教法等理论观点，梳理总结国内外创意写作理论与实践案例，借鉴传统形态学、叙事学等理论，从创意写作学角度探讨该文体“是什么”“好的作品是什么样”“怎样写出类似的作品”的可操作性和创新性的完整结构，分析新型媒介发展对故事创意与写作理论与实践的影响，强化创意与写作、故事与传播关系的实践能力与学习理念。写作离不开传播，在社会媒体化的环境中进行创意写作实战，建立跨媒体、跨学科、跨文化的思维观念与学习体系。
default.en: This course systematically introduces creative story idea, the basic meaning of writing, vision of the course of creative writing, theoretical basis, teaching methods and other theoretical viewpoints. This course orders and summarizes the theory and practical cases of creative writing at home and abroad, draws on traditional morphology, narratology and other theories, and discusses the complete structure of operability and innovation of "which style is used", "what is a good work" and "how to write similar works" from the perspective of creative writing. The impact of the development of new media on the theory and practice of story creativity and writing is analyzed, this course strengthens the practical ability and learning philosophy of the relationship between creativity and writing, story and communication. Writing cannot be separated from communication, by practicing creative writing in a social media environment, it is possible to establish cross-media, interdisciplinary, and cross-culture thinking concepts and learning system.

default.zh: 本课程通过理论教学和实验教学，使学生学习、理解二维动画、电影、电视、电子游戏、虚拟现实等五种影像作品的制作技术、构成元素、影像空间及与观众（用户）的关系，从纵向和横向脉络把握其媒介形态演进关系。进而，将理论与方法运用到影像作品分析之中，针对实际的影像艺术作品，理解数字影像作品的基本特性，掌握分析不同类型作品的基本方法，从元素、技术、空间、用户等视角进行分析，从而具备运用恰当方法分析和鉴赏影像作品实际案例的能力。最终为后续的数字媒体专业课程学习，奠定感性的实际案例分析基础。
default.en: Through theoretical and experimental teaching, this course aims to enable students to learn and understand the production techniques, constituent elements, image space, and relationship with the audience (users) of five types of image works, including two-dimensional animation, movies, television, electronic games, and virtual reality, and to grasp the evolution relationship of their media form from a vertical and horizontal perspective. Furthermore, applying theories and methods to the analysis of image works, aiming at actual image art works, understanding the basic characteristics of digital image works, mastering the basic methods of analyzing different types of works, analyzing from the perspectives of elements, technology, space, users, etc., thus possessing the ability to use appropriate methods to analyze and appreciate actual cases of image works. Ultimately, it lays the foundation for emotional practical case analysis for the subsequent study of digital media courses.

default.zh: 本课程是数字媒体技术专业、数字媒体艺术专业开设的一门专业课。本课程吸收了计算机图形学和色彩学的新成果，较好地解决了计算机色彩基本原理、各种色彩系统和色彩设计的有机衔接。通过详细讲述几十种不同的实用色彩搭配方案，让数字化环境下的色彩设计变得科学、简约和快捷。课程的主要目的包括：较详细地讲述数字色彩的基本原理，学习混色系统与显色系统、数字色彩体系；讲述色彩的生理与心理要素；教会学生使用数字色彩的配色工具；以数字色彩模型为基础，学习三个大类的色彩配置：以色相为主的数字色彩――横切面配色，以明度、饱和度为主的数字色彩――纵切面配色，最后学习复杂的数字色彩―综和配色。
default.en: This course is a compulsory course for digital media technology major and digital media art major. This course has absorbed the new achievements of computer graphics and color science, and solved the organic connection of computer color basic principle, various color systems and color design. Through detailed description of dozens of different practical color matching scheme, let the color design in the digital environment become scientific, simple and fast. The main purpose of this course include: the basic principle in detail about the study of digital color, color mixing system and color system, digital color system; physiological and psychological factors about the color; teach students to use digital color tools; digital color model, color configuration learning three categories: hue the cross section of digital color - color, brightness, saturation based on digital color -- longitudinal color, finally learn complex digital color -- Synthesis and color

default.zh: 《录音艺术与声音设计》是设计学系的基础课程，是一门富有创造力和实践性的课程，旨在探索声音在各种媒体和艺术领域中的关键作用。无论您是想成为专业音频工程师、音乐制作人、电影制片人还是声音设计师，本课程都将提供您所需的基本技能和知识。内容包含学习如何选择合适的麦克风、布置录音设备以及创建最佳的录音环境。我们将深入研究采样率、比特率和声音信号的特性；掌握数字音频工作站（DAW）的使用，学会音频编辑、混音和应用声音效果。您将了解如何改进和修复音频；探索各种声音效果，如混响、合唱、合成等，以及如何将它们应用于不同的创作项目。发挥创意，打造独特的声音；学习声音设计的核心原则，包括声音与故事叙述之间的关系。您将掌握如何为电影、游戏、广告和多媒体项目创建引人入胜的声音。
default.en: Recording Art and Sound Design is a fundamental course in the Department of Design, a creative and practical course aimed at exploring the key role of sound in various media and art fields. Whether you want to become a professional audio engineer, music producer, film producer, or sound designer, this course will provide you with the basic skills and knowledge you need. The content includes learning how to choose the appropriate microphone, arrange recording equipment, and create the best recording environment. We will conduct in-depth research on the characteristics of sampling rate, bit rate, and sound signal; Master the use of Digital Audio Workstation (DAW), learn audio editing, mixing, and applying sound effects. You will learn how to improve and repair audio; Explore various sound effects such as reverberation, choir, synthesis, and how to apply them to different creative projects. Unleash creativity and create a unique voice; Learn the core principles of sound design, including the relationship between sound and storytelling. You will learn how to create captivating sounds for movies, games, advertisements, and multimedia projects.

default.zh: 本课程所涉及的内容展示了在社会网络的作用下正在浮现与发展起来的一些交叉学科领域，讨论了社会和技术领域相互联系的若干基本问题。主要包括社会网络的基本知识、基础数学知识，社会关系中的结构平衡，博弈论、进化博弈以及博弈论简单应用，信息网络，网络信息级联，小世界理论，流行网络等等。本课程将结合具体的社会媒体中的实例来解释相对应的理论。
default.en: This course presents cross-disciplinary knowledge in the context of social media and network, and discusses several basic problems about the society and technology. The content of this course mainly includes the basic knowledge of the social network, the foundations of mathematics, structure balance in the social relations, game theory and its application, web information, information cascade, small world theory and so on. We will introduce these theories with many useful application cases.

default.zh: 媒体数据分析课程是数字媒体艺术专业限修课程，为学生后续进行毕业设计毕业论文开阔视野，在培养学生综合运用专业编程能力、创意能力方面具有重要的作用。 本课程主要讲授媒体数据分析的基本原理和方法，包括回顾数学相关知识、数据采集的常见方法、数据可视化部分方法、朴素贝叶斯、聚类、协同过滤，以及常见的机器学习算法，线性回归、逻辑回归、神经网络。后续的实验环节，学生针对两个实际问题，提出相应的解决方案。 通过该课程的学习，使学生掌握概率论、统计学、机器学习的基本原理，从而指导数据分析实践；掌握数据分析在媒体运作中的作用，培养媒体操作过程中的数据思维，使学生能够使用数学工具分析实际问题；掌握Python数据分析的方法和工具，掌握可视化分析的方法和工具，能够编程实现数据分析的算法；通过数据分析的实践案例分析，使学生能够设计数据分析的实验解决实际问题。
default.en: Media Data Analysis is a course for digital media art undergraduate students, but also a practical course for students who want to find a job in data analysis area. And it enlarge the view of students who are preparing thesis. And it plays a significant role in developing programming skills and creative ability of students. This course introduces the basic principles and methods of media data analysis, including the review of mathematical knowledge, data acquisition methods, data visualization methods, naive Bayesian, clustering, collaborative filtering, and common machine learning algorithms, such as linear regression Logic regression, neural network. In the following experimental section, students should propose a solution for two corresponding problems. Through the study of the course, students can master the theory of probability, statistics, machine learning, further to practice data analysis, and can master the role of data analysis in the operation of the media. And students can use Mathematical tools to analyze practical problems, and master Python data analysis methods and tools and visual analysis methods and tools to be able to pro-grammatically implement the data analysis algorithm, through which students can design data analysis experiments to solve practical problems.

default.zh: 互动装置艺术设计是一门跨学科的综合性较强的艺术形式，它包括了设计艺术、计算机图形技术、编程语言、传媒硬件材料等各类学科，是“场地+材料+情感”综合体现。《互动装置艺术设计》意在培养学生互动装置艺术设计和创作表现能力，使学生充分理解互动装置艺术设计的概念、特性、类型以及在环境设计、公共艺术、产品设计、展示设计中的应用，了解互动装置艺术设计在当前社会环境建设中的发展前景；通过动创意设计与动手制作模型相结合，开发学生立体的创造性思维，提高动手能力，掌握互动装置艺术设计与制作的知识和技能，具有互动装置艺术设计作品鉴赏能力和设计创新能力。互动装置艺术作为后现代艺术的一个主要艺术运动开始了自身的发展历程。在教学中以互动装置艺术的观念与形式为研究对象，进行了四个内容的研究：根据对互动装置艺术的历史渊源回顾，综述了互动装置艺术的本质与特征、理论渊源、观念源头等；基于对互动装置空间艺术所根植的艺术语言组合的讨论，论述了其观念语义与形式语言；通过对置艺术的设计与训练，提出了新的设计思路与技巧；通过对互动装置空间设计作品的个案研究，总结了互动装置艺术中的观念与形式建构的一个有别于传统审美的审美体系
default.en: Interactive Installation Art design is an interdisciplinary comprehensive art form, it includes all kinds of art design, computer graphics, programming language, hardware media materials, is "site + materials + comprehensive reflection of emotion". "Interactive Installation Art design" aims to cultivate students' ability of Interactive Installation Art design and creation, to enable students to fully understand the Interactive Installation Art design concept, characteristics, types and in the environmental design, public art, product design, exhibition design, Interactive Installation Art design development prospects in the understanding of the social environment in the construction of the current through the combination of dynamic and creative; design and make model, develop students' creative thinking three-dimensional, improve the ability to master the design and fabrication of device art knowledge and skills, equipment with works of art and design appreciation ability and design innovation ability. The installation art, as a major art movement of post-modern art, has begun its own development course. In the teaching of the concept and form of Interactive Installation Art as the research object, the research of four aspects: according to the review of history of installation art, summarizes the essence and characteristic, Interactive Installation Art theory origin, concept of source language combination; discuss art rooted on space art based on the device, and discusses the the concept of semantic and formal language; through the design and training of opposing art, puts forward the design ideas and new skills; through the case of unit space design research, summarizes the concept of construction and Interactive Installation Art in the form of a is different from the traditional aesthetic aesthetic system.

default.zh: 本课程讲授利用数据可视化来帮助人们理解和分析信息和数据的设计方法。在信息时代，大量信息的涌现使得人们需要跨越文本、数字以及静态图像才能够实现有效的媒介传播。在本课程中，学生将会了解数据可视化的设计原则和基本方法。课程尤为关注可以帮助用户感知和理解大规模的复杂数据的交互性的动态可视化的设计与实现，而这是依靠常规的静态视觉呈现无法实现的。最终，学生将能够应用恰当的设计方法和技术来创建互动信息图和构建具有美感的可视化图形表示。
default.en: This course will teach students to use data visualization to help people understand and analyze information and data. Communicating effectively in our information overloading era requires us to move beyond text, number, and even static images. In this course, the students will learn design principles and basic methods of data visualization and be focused on design and implement dynamic interactive visualizations that allow the users to perceive and understand much more complex information that are not possible by using regular static visual representations. At the end of the class, students will apply the design principles and use proper technologies to create interactive infographics and apply design aesthetics to visualization graphs.

default.zh: 模型制作是产品设计专业的选修实验课程，通过实验教学使学生掌握产品设计所需要的基本知识和基本技能，体会蕴含在模型制作过程中的设计因素，不仅仅是在进行产品形态的塑造，也是对产品结构设计进行思考和产品模具的制造工艺进行探索。 模型制作使学生掌握实体模型建模方法，了解实物模型材料的性能、组成、用途以及选择，掌握工业产品表面装饰的一般方法和工艺；了解当代的新信息，能动地运用新材料、工艺和新技术；进行产品外观设计。
default.en: Model making is an elective experimental course for the product design major.Through experimental teaching, students can master the basic knowledge and skills required by product design and experience the design factors contained in the process of model making. It is not only shaping the product form, but also thinking about the product structure design and exploring the manufacturing process of product mould. Model making course make students to master the methods of entity modeling approach, and to understand the performance, composition, using and selection of materials, master the general methods and processes of surface decoration of industrial products; understand contemporary new information and use new materials, processes and technologies actively; and accomplish product appearance design.

default.zh: 本课程是产品设计专业本科教学的专业课程之一，价值分析是从技术和经济的角度研究价值，并通过研究产品功能与费用来探索提高价值的途径；设计管理是通过管理产品设计过程中的每一个步骤、协调参与产品设计的各个部门的关系来分析产品开发的方法。
default.en: his course is one of the core courses in the undergraduate program of Product Design. Value Analysis studies value from both technical and economic perspectives, exploring ways to enhance value by examining product functions and costs. Design Management analyzes product development methods by managing each step of the product design process and coordinating the relationships among all departments involved in product design.

default.zh: 本课程通过理论讲授、案例分析和实践项目，培养学生掌握数字产品设计的核心理论与方法，熟悉新媒体技术的应用场景，能够独立完成数字产品设计流程
default.en: This course, through theoretical lectures, case analysis, and practical projects, enables students to master the core theories and methods of digital product design, become familiar with the application scenarios of new media technologies, and independently complete the digital product design process.

default.zh: 本课程通过介绍包装设计的含义、发展和基本观点，掌握包装设计的内容和方法步骤，培养学生进行包装设计的依据、要求的能力为重点。旨在为后续的专业课程的学习提供理论基础。其教学目标如下： 目标1. 掌握以市场与用户为导向的战略性设计思维。使学生能够从市场策略、品牌定位和用户心理的角度出发，进行有针对性包装设计，并准确传达产品核心价值。 目标2. 深化材料、结构与视觉综合的造型语言。提高学生从材料特性、结构功能、制造工艺和视觉表现等多个维度进行一体化设计。 目标3. 树立以生命周期为导向的可持续设计价值观。培养学生从包装的整个生命周期（出发进行设计思考，力求在满足商业需求的同时，最大限度地减少对环境的影响。
default.en: This course focuses on introducing the meaning, development, and fundamental perspectives of packaging design, enabling students to master the content, methods, and steps of packaging design, and cultivating their ability to execute packaging design based on relevant foundations and requirements. It aims to provide a theoretical foundation for subsequent specialized courses. The teaching objectives are as follows: Objective 1: Master market-and-user-oriented strategic design thinking. Enable students to conduct targeted packaging design from the perspectives of market strategy, brand positioning, and user psychology, accurately conveying the core value of the product. Objective 2: Deepen the integrated modeling language of materials, structure, and visuals. Enhance students' ability to perform integrated design across multiple dimensions, including material characteristics, structural functionality, manufacturing processes, and visual expression. Objective 3: Establish a lifecycle-oriented sustainable design价值观. Cultivate students' ability to consider the entire lifecycle of packaging from the outset of their design thinking, striving to minimize environmental impact while meeting commercial requirements.

default.zh: 本课程以实验性材料，如智能材料、生物基材料、纳米材料等为核心研究对象，围绕其设计、制备、性能优化及应用场景展开教学。课程目标旨在培养学生掌握材料科学基础理论、具备解决复杂工程问题的能力，并通过实践与协作强化创新思维。
default.en: This course focuses on experimental materials—such as smart materials, bio-based materials, and nanomaterials—as its core research subjects, covering their design, preparation, performance optimization, and application scenarios. The course aims to equip students with foundational theories of materials science, develop their ability to solve complex engineering problems, and strengthen innovative thinking through hands-on practice and collaboration.

default.zh: 帮助学生理解展览策划和展览空间设计的基本知识。 掌握展览空间设计的思维逻辑与工作方法。 能够进行展览空间的策划与创作。
default.en: Equip students with a foundational understanding of exhibition planning and design, enabling them to master its logical approach and methodology for conceiving and executing their own spatial creations.

default.zh: 建筑构造实习是课堂理论讲授的重要补充和实践性应用环节，其目的是使学生了解和掌握构造的基本方法，巩固和丰富自己学习的构造课程内容，培养学生理论联系实际，提高在工地建造中观察、分析、解决问题的能力，为后续专业课程打下良好的基础。通过工地构造实习，还应使学生巩固所学理论，获的本专业实际知识，以培养实际工作能力和专业技能。教学内容及基本要求包括：了解工地的组织机构和生产组织管理情况；了解建筑结构的形式和施工方法；掌握建筑构造的特点和具体构造作法；掌握先进的施工技术和现代的管理方法；掌握新型的建筑材料性能和使用方法；了解行业内结构、构造、材料的发展方向。
default.en: Construction practice is an important supplement and application of classroom theory teaching, and an effective means to train architects and engineers. As a very important practical teaching link in the undergraduate teaching plan, its purpose is to make students understand and master the basic methods of construction, consolidate and enrich their own structural curriculum content, and train students to combine theory with practice. Teaching content and basic requirements include: to understand the organization of the practice units and production organization management; Understand the form and construction method of the building structure; Mastering the characteristics and concrete construction methods of building structure; Master advanced construction technology and modern management methods; To master the performance and use of new building materials; Understand the development direction of structure, structure and materials in the industry.

default.zh: 本课程采用讲授与上机的教学方式，通过学习MATLAB基本运算、编程方法、数据处理和图形与可视化等基础知识，培养学生利用计算机解决基础数值问题的能力，训练学生计算思维能力，培养学生树立正确的程序设计思维，逐步适应大数据和人工智能时代的学习与工作。
default.en: This course employs an instructional model integrating lectures and in？lab computer exercises. By covering the essential elements of MATLAB—basic operations, programming techniques, data processing, and graphical visualization—students are expected to cultivate competence in solving elementary numerical problems with computational tools, sharpen their computational thinking, foster a correct approach to programming logic, and progressively acclimate themselves to the demands of learning and professional practice in the age of big data and artificial intelligence.

default.zh: 1. 供热工程方向 供热工程课程设计是建筑环境与能源应用工程专业的一门主干设计实践课，是培养学生解决实际问题能力的重要教学实践环节。本课程以街区供热系统为设计对象，完成小规模的室内供暖系统和街区供热管网两部分设计，培养学生运用“供热工程”的理论和技术知识解决实际问题。要求学生了解供热工程相关的政策、法律法规、标准，掌握供热工程的方案设计、工程问题研究和计算机辅助设计方法，具有系统性与全局性解决问题的思维与意识，能够利用系统仿真等现代化工具分析解决实际工程问题，树立正确的设计观，为将来从事供热工程设计打下良好的基础。 课程以街区供热系统为设计对象，分为室内供暖系统和街区供热管网两部分设计：室内供暖系统设计，完成建筑物设计热负荷计算、室内供暖系统方案设计、散热器选型和供暖系统水力计算，绘制供暖系统首层平面图、供暖系统标准层（与顶层）平面图、供暖系统图、热力入口和管道井大样图；街区供热管网设计，完成供热区域设计热负荷计算、供热管网路由方案设计、供热管网水力计算、供热管网水压图设计，绘制供热管网管线平面图、管线纵断面图、主干线水压图。 2. 燃气输配方向 燃气输配课程设计是建筑环境与能源应用工程专业的重要实践性教学环节，是培养学生工程设计能力、树立正确设计观的重要环节。本课程通过燃气输配课程设计培养学生综合运用所学的基础理论、基本知识和基本技能解决工程技术问题的初步能力，提高使用现代工具进行工程计算和制图的能力，通过查阅文献资料（包括有关标准、规范、手册、标准图及其他资料）增强自主学习的意识，锻炼专业内容的交流能力。从学生对城市燃气的认知与了解入手，使其了解建筑环境与能源应用工程专业与人民生活需求切实相关，进一步加强学生的社会主义价值观培养，使其充分认识到节能减排的艰巨性与特殊性。 课程主要包括民用建筑室内燃气管道设计、低压燃气输配管网设计等。学生需要具备应用水力计算软件、工程制图、计算机辅助设计以及计算数据分析处理等能力完成燃气管道布线方案、燃气管道水力计算、民用建筑室内燃气管道布置图、编制设计说明书。 课程考核综合阶段考察和结题答辩的累加评分，满分100分。
default.en: 1 Heating Engineering Course Design for Heating Engineering is a compulsory design practice course for the major of Building Environment and Energy Application Engineering, and an important teaching practice link to cultivate students' ability to solve practical problems. This course takes the district heating system as the design object, completing the design of small-scale space heating systems and district heating networks, and cultivating students to apply the theoretical and technical knowledge of "heating engineering" to solve practical problems. Students are required to understand the policies, laws, regulations, and standards related to heating engineering, master the conceptual design, engineering problem research, and computer-aided design methods of heating engineering, have a systematic and global problem-solving mindset and awareness, be able to use modern tools such as system simulation to analyze and solve practical engineering problems, establish a correct design concept, and lay a solid foundation for future work in heating engineering design. The course takes the district heating system as the design object and is divided into two parts: space heating system design and district heating network design: space heating system design, completing building design heat load calculation, space heating system scheme design, radiator selection, and space heating system hydraulic calculation, drawing the first floor plan of the heating system, standard floor (and top floor) plan of the heating system, space heating system diagram, detailed drawing of the heating interface and pipeline well; Design the district heating network, complete the calculation of heating load in the heating area design, the design of heating network routing scheme, the hydraulic calculation of heating network, and the design of heating network water pressure diagram. Draw the heating network pipeline plan, pipeline longitudinal section, and main pipeline water pressure diagram. 2 Gas Transportation and Distribution Course design of gas transportation and distribution is an important practical teaching link of building environment and energy application engineering, and it is also an important link to train students' engineering design ability and establish correct design concept. This course through the curriculum design of gas transmission and cultivate students' comprehensive use of basic theory, basic knowledge and basic skills to solve engineering problems, the preliminary ability to improve the ability to use modern tools for engineering calculation and drawing, through consulting documents (including the related standards, specifications, manuals, standard drawing and other information) enhance the consciousness of autonomous learning, Practice professional communication skills. Starting with students' cognition and understanding of urban gas, make them understand that the major of building environment and energy application engineering is practically related to people's living needs, further strengthen the cultivation of students' socialist values, and make them fully realize the arduousness and particularity of energy conservation and emission reduction. The courses mainly include indoor gas pipeline design of civil buildings, low-pressure gas transmission and distribution network design, etc. Students are required to have the ability to use hydraulic calculation software, engineering drawing, computer-aided design and calculation data analysis and processing to complete gas pipeline wiring scheme, gas pipeline hydraulic calculation, civil building indoor gas pipeline layout, and design specifications. The cumulative score for the comprehensive stage of course assessment, assessment, and final defense is a maximum of 100 points.

default.zh: 遥感技术是城乡规划学科本科生必备的空间数据分析技术之一。本课程基于遥感成像原理和遥感数据分析技术与城市地表信息特征挖掘任务相结合，基于开源遥感数据处理平台进行课程实验，遥感数据分析的过程和结果能够有力支撑城乡规划学专业的设计和研究。本课程主要讲授遥感类型、成像原理、开放平台遥感大数据的获取与分析技术。通过课题讲授和上机操作结合的方式，使学生初步掌握遥感数据分析的技巧。
default.en: Remote sensing technology is one of the necessary spatial data analysis technologies for undergraduates in urban and rural planning disciplines. This course is based on the combination of remote sensing imaging principles and remote sensing data analysis technology with urban surface information feature mining tasks, and conducts course experiments based on open source remote sensing data processing platform. The process and results of remote sensing data analysis can effectively support the design and research of urban and rural planning majors. This course mainly teaches remote sensing types, imaging principles, and the acquisition and analysis technology of open platform remote sensing big data. Through the combination of topic teaching and computer operation, students can initially master the skills of remote sensing data analysis. Course Objective 1: Improve students' ability to collect, analyze, process and express remote sensing data. Course Objective 2: In the context of the era of big data, broaden students' thinking about the processing and application of remote sensing big data and master the methods of spatial data analysis. Course Objective 3: Develop students' ideas for urban and rural planning, design and research through the study of advanced remote sensing data processing methods.

default.zh: 本课程是培养学生在观念上从建筑向城市视角转换的重要实践教学环节，其主要任务是使学生熟悉各类城市公共建筑的功能布局以及与城市规划相关的要求，包括用地、交通、空间形态、环境景观等，培养学生分析环境、理解环境、尊重环境的思维观念，培养现场测绘、观察、分析的能力。本课程设计鼓励同学主动观察与分析城市现象，敏锐涉及城市发展动态和前沿课题，发掘城市文化背景，并以全面、系统的专业素质去处理城市问题。
default.en: This course is an important practical teaching link to train students to transform their concepts from the perspective of architecture to the city. Its main task is to familiarize students with the functional layout of various urban public buildings and the requirements related to urban planning, including land use, transportation, spatial form, environmental landscape, etc., and cultivate students' thinking concepts of analyzing, understanding and respecting the environment. Cultivate the ability of field mapping, observation and analysis. This course design encourages students to actively observe and analyze urban phenomena, sensitively relate to urban development trends and cutting-edge topics, explore urban cultural background, and deal with urban problems with comprehensive and systematic professional quality.

default.zh: 《植物实习》课程以城市公园绿地、城市广场绿地、城市住区绿地等典型城市绿地为例，实地讲授景观植物的形态、生物学特征和观赏特性，从而提高景观学专业本科生识别园林植物的能力，为《植物景观设计》课程中科学地应用植物创造园林景观打好基础。教学目标具体提如下：①了解哈尔滨市常见的园林树木、花卉、草坪与地被植物种类，其形态特点、观赏特征、生态习性；②了解哈尔滨市常见植物在园林绿化当中的应用形式。
default.en: Taking typical urban green spaces such as urban park green space, urban square green space and urban residential green space as examples, the course will teach the morphology, biological characteristics and ornamental characteristics of landscape plants on the spot, so as to improve the ability of undergraduates majoring in landscape science to identify landscape plants, and lay a good foundation for scientific application of plants to create landscape in the course of Plant Landscape Design. The teaching objectives are as follows: ① Learn about the common garden trees, flowers, lawns and ground cover plants in Harbin, their morphological characteristics, ornamental characteristics and ecological habits; ② Understand the application forms of common plants in landscape greening in Harbin.

default.zh: 通过本课程设计对所学动画课程进行总结，并使学生能够运用动漫创作的原理进行不同类型的动漫创作实践。
default.en: This course design summarizes the animation courses learned and enables students to apply the principles of animation creation to different types of animation creation practices.

default.zh: 网站与网络程序设计是高等工科院校中数字媒体类专业一门主干课程。在教学过程中综合运用先修课程中所学到的有关知识与技能，结合各种实践教学环节，进行网络媒体技术与设计人员所需的基本训练。为学生进一步学习有关专业课程和日后从事网络程序设计工作打下基础。在培养学生网站系统综合设计能力、提高解决复杂网络程序设计问题的能力等方面占有重要地位。
default.en: Web site and Web programming is a major course in the digital media industry of higher engineering colleges. In the teaching process of comprehensive use of the prerequisite learned in the knowledge and skills, combined with a variety of practical teaching links, the network media technology and design staff required basic training. For students to further study the relevant professional courses and in the future to engage in network programming to lay the foundation. In the training of student website system design capabilities, improve the ability to solve complex network programming problems and other aspects of an important position.

default.zh: 使学生了解和掌握数字媒体创作过程的前、后期创意思维、基本原理及技法。通过参观、学习、部分参与数字媒体制作部门的实际工作，培养学生的创意思维与动手能力。印证、巩固和丰富已学过的专业课程内容，培养学生理论联系实际，提高其在创作实际中调查研究、观察问题、分析问题及解决问题的能力。为后续专业课程的学习打下基础。同时为毕业设计(论文)积累资料。
default.en: Enable students to understand and master the digital media creation process of the Pre-and post-creative thinking, Basic Principles and Techniques. by visiting, learning and partially participating in the actual work of the digital media production department, students ' creative thinking and practical ability are cultivated. To confirm, consolidate and enrich the content of the professional courses that have been studied, to cultivate students ' theory and practice, and to improve their ability to investigate, observe, analyze and solve problems in the practice of Creation. For the follow-up professional courses to lay the foundation for Learning. At the same time for graduation design ( thesis ) to accumulate Information.

default.zh: 本课程是智慧建筑与建造专业四年级的实践课程，是基于项目的学习计划的重要部分。具体形式是学生去指定设计单位进行为期6周的实习，并在这段期间内由指导教师与建筑设计院共同对学生进行联合培养。其主要目的是让学生在实际操作中，在对工作环境与业务范围的亲自感知中，去理解建筑师的职能体系，熟悉建筑工程设计全过程。同时，也是对前面所学专业课程进行总结，完善学生的知识结构，提高动手能力，并在各专业的配合中感受团队精神。
default.en: This course is a practice course for the senior students of grade 4 in the major of Intelligent Building and Construction. It is an important part of the study plan. The course is to let students have a 6-week internship in designated design firms. During the period, the tutor and the agency will train the students together. The main purpose is to aid students to understand architects' function system and the whole process of architecture design in the actual operation and the perception of working environment and business confines. Meanwhile it is a summary for the former courses and will consummate students' knowledge structure and improve their practice ability and experience the team spirit in the coordination of different specialized areas.

default.zh: 航天与自动化集群专业导论课程紧密围绕杰出人才培养目标，以人才培养供给侧改革为抓手，结合航天与自动化集群相关专业的发展趋势、专业特点、培养目标、研究内容及应用领域，通过飞行器设计与工程类专业知识、航天发展背后的自动化力量、复合材料与智能工程类专业知识、电子科学与技术专业知识、光学工程专业知识、微电子科学与技术专业知识、光学遥感卫星的高精度姿态控制导论、运载火箭及导弹系统发展概述、复合材料在飞机上的应用现状及发展趋势、光电子产业当前发展概况、空间相机研究里程及科研心得、集成电路技术痛点及未来发展趋势、学术大师版块、工程巨匠版块、业界领袖版块、治国栋梁版块等方面的主题式授课，凝练校内专业知识内容，拓展校外前沿知识讲解。使学生对航天与自动化集群相关专业的发展趋势、专业特点、培养目标、研究内容及应用领域等形成宏观认识，为后续开展专业知识学习奠定相关基础。
default.en: Introduction to Disciplines of Astronautics and Automation closely focuses on the training objectives of outstanding talents, takes the supply-side reform of talent training as the starting point, and combines the development trend, professional characteristics, training objectives, research content and application fields of aerospace and automation cluster related majors. Through the professional knowledge of aircraft design and engineering, the automation power behind aerospace development, the professional knowledge of composite materials and intelligent engineering, the professional knowledge of electronic science and technology, the professional knowledge of optical engineering, the professional knowledge of microelectronics science and technology, the introduction of high-precision attitude control of optical remote sensing satellites, the development overview of launch vehicles and missile systems, the application status and development trend of composite materials on aircraft, the current development overview of the optoelectronic industry, the research mileage and scientific research experience of space cameras, the pain points and future development trends of integrated circuit technology, the academic master section, the engineering master section, the industry leader section, and the governance pillar section. Condense the content of on-campus professional knowledge and expand the interpretation of off-campus frontier knowledge. It enables students to form a macro understanding of the development trend, professional characteristics, training objectives, research content and application fields of aerospace and automation cluster related majors, and lays a relevant foundation for subsequent professional knowledge learning.

default.zh: 理论力学是各门力学课程的基础，同时是一门对工程对象进行静力学、运动学与动力学分析的技术基础课，在诸多工程技术领域有着广泛的应用。本课程的任务是使学生掌握质点、质点系、刚体和刚体系机械运动（包括平衡）的基本规律和研究方法，为学习相关的后继课程以及将来学习和掌握新的科学技术打好必要的基础；使学生初步学会应用理论力学的理论和方法分析、解决一些简单的工程实际问题；通过本课程的教学，着重培养学生在理论建模、结构工程、动力学分析等方面的分析、设计和应用能力，并支撑专业学习成果中相应指标点的达成。同时结合本课程的特点，培养学生科学的思维方式和正确的世界观，培养学生的相关能力。
default.en: The course mainly expounds classical mechanics theory. This course consists of two volumes. Part 1 covers the content of statics(Including the free-body diagram,planar force systems and couple systems, etc.), kinematics(Including the kinematics of a particle, the simple motion of a rigid body,resultant motion of a particle,etc.), dynamics(Including the particle dynamics,theorems of linear momentum,angular momentum and kinetic energy of particle systems ). Part 2 covers analytical mechanics (Including the fundamental equations of dynamics, Lagrange's equations of the first and the second kind, etc.)and mechanics vibration.

default.zh: 理论力学是研究物体机械运动一般规律的科学，是工科大学生重要的技术基础课。理论力学内容包括：静力学（研究物体平衡问题）、运动学（研究物体运动的几何性质）、动力学（研究物体机械运动状态的变化与作用力之间的关系），这些属于矢量力学范畴。还讲述虚位移原理、达朗贝尔原理、动力学普遍方程与拉格朗日方程、定点运动、非惯性系中的动力学、碰撞、机械振动基础等专题内容。 通过本课程的学习学生应掌握经典力学的基本理论和基本方法，并善于应用这些理论和方法解决工程实际问题，同时为后续课程打下基础。
default.en: Theoretical Mechanics A is a course studying the general rules of object’s mechanical motions. It’s a technical and basal curriculum and it’s important for engineering students. The contents of Theoretical Mechanics A involve: Statics (to study the balance of object), Kinematics (to study the geometry characteristic of object motion), Dynamics (to study the relation of object’s mechanical motion and forces on object), which belong to the vector mechanics category. It also involves: principle of virtual displacement, d’Alembert’s principles, general equations of dynamics and Lagrange’s equation, motion with a fixed point, dynamics of not inertia frame, impact, and mechanical vibration elements, etc. Through this curriculum, the students should master the basic theories and methods of classical mechanics and further apply them to the actual engineering problems.

default.zh: 理论力学是研究物体机械运动一般规律的科学，是工科大学生重要的技术基础课。理论力学内容包括：静力学（研究物体平衡问题）、运动学（研究物体运动的几何性质）、动力学（研究物体机械运动状态的变化与作用力之间的关系），这些属于矢量力学范畴。还讲述虚位移原理、达朗贝尔原理等专题内容，并可选择分析力学基础、碰撞理论、机械振动基础和自由刚体运动理论等专题内容来学习。 通过本课程的学习学生应掌握经典力学的基本理论和基本方法，并善于应用这些理论和方法解决工程实际问题，同时为后续课程打下基础。
default.en: Theoretical Mechanics B is a course studying the general rules of object’s mechanical motions. It’s a technical and basal curriculum and it’s important for engineering students. The contents of Theoretical Mechanics C involve: Statics (to study the balance of object), Kinematics (to study the geometry characteristic of object motion), Dynamics (to study the relation of object’s mechanical motion and forces on object), which belong to the vector mechanics category. It also involves some special contents such as principle of virtual displacement, d’Alembert’s principles, etc. And you can also choose to study topics such as fundamentals of analytical mechanics, collision theory, fundamentals of mechanical vibration and theory of free rigid body motion. Through this curriculum, the students should master the basic theories and methods of classical mechanics and further apply them to the actual engineering problems.

default.zh: 理论力学是研究物体机械运动的基本规律的学科。力学的一个分支。它是一般力学各分支学科的基础。理论力学C主要研究内容由静力学、动静法以及杆件变形内力分析三部分组成。其中，静力学研究作用于物体上的力系的简化理论及力系平衡条件，是本门课程的核心内容。理论力学的研究方法是从一些由经验或实验归纳出反映客观规律的基本公理或定律出发，经过数学演绎得出物体机械运动在一般情况下的规律及具体问题中的特征。理论力学的研究对象主要指质点、刚体及刚体系。理论力学建立科学抽象的力学模型（如质点、刚体等）。理论力学的另一特点是广泛采用数学工具，进行数学演绎，从而导出各种以数学形式表达的普遍定理和结论。 理论力学涉及众多的力学学科分支和广泛的工程技术领域，是一门理论性较强、与工程技术联系极为密切的技术基础课。通过本课程学习应使学生掌握经典力学的基本理论和基本方法，并善于应用这些经典力学理论和方法解决工程实际问题，同时为后续课程打下基础。通过课程学习，达到如下课程目标：掌握静力学公理与各类典型约束条件，掌握物体受力分析及受力图的正确表达；掌握各种力系的简化和平衡理论，并能利用这些理论来计算和求解工程结构中的力学问题，获得约束反力的解，并能够解决一定的工程实际问题；正确理解构件的强度、刚度、稳定性等基本概念，掌握不同类型内力图的表达方式，掌握外力、剪力及弯矩间的关系并加以应用；掌握动静法，利用达朗贝尔原理求解动力学问题。
default.en: Theoretical mechanics is the study of the basic laws of the mechanical motion of the subject, a branch of mechanic, and the basis of various branches of General mechanics. The main research contents of Theoretical mechanics C are composed of Static mechanics, Dynamic and static method and the Internal force analysis of rod deformation. The Static mechanics studies the simplified theory of the force system acting on an object and the balance condition of the force system, which is the core content of this course. The research method of theoretical mechanics is based on some basic axioms or laws summarized by experience or experiment that reflect the objective facts. The patterns of the mechanical motion of the object under normal circumstances and its characteristics in specific problems are obtained through mathematical deduction. The research objects in Theoretical mechanics mainly refer to scientific and reasonable abstract mechanics models, including mass points, rigid bodies and rigid systems. Another feature of Theoretical mechanics is the various universal theorems and conclusions expressed in mathematical form deriving from the extensive use of mathematical tools and mathematical deductions. Theoretical mechanics involves many branches of mechanics and a wide range of engineering and technical fields. It is a basic theoretical course that is closely connected with engineering technology. The teaching of this course should enable students to master the basic theories and methods of Classical mechanics, and be good at applying these theories and methods to solve practical engineering problems, and lay the foundations for the follow-up courses. By learning this course, students should meet the following objectives: mastering the Static axioms, a variety of typical constraints, the force analysis of an object, and the correct expression of the force diagram; mastering the simplification and balance theories of various force systems, being able to apply these theories on engineering structures to calculate and solve mechanical problems and obtain the solutions of constrained reaction forces, and being able to solve certain practical engineering problems; correctly understanding the basic concepts of strength, stiffness and stability of the components, mastering the expression of different types of internal force diagrams, and understanding and being able to use the relationship between external forces, shear forces and bending moments; mastering the Dynamic and static method and being able to use the D'Alembert’s principle to solve the dynamic problems.
