The source score is composed of final examination, practice and control system design.

default.zh: 自动控制实践（2）是自动化类专业的一门非常重要专业核心课程，隶属于自动控制实践核心课，旨在自动控制原理与自动控制元件的学习基础上，将自动控制理论与控制系统设计实践之间架设一座桥梁，将理论与实际衔接起来。本课程是一门面向工程应用、实践性较强的课程，也是后续学习过程控制、飞行器控制与制导、无人机控制等课程的基础，在培养学生控制系统综合分析能力、综合设计能力等方面占有重要地位。 本课程重点讲授三个部分内容：一是通过分析控制系统的输入信号、设计指标等，讲授构建控制系统的方法；二是分析解决控制系统设计中的主要问题，如误差分析及减小误差方法、扰动影响及抑制方法等；三是结合实例讲授几种典型的控制系统设计方法，如伺服系统、调节系统等。 通过本课程的课堂教学、后续的实验及计算机仿真等教学环节，着重培养学生进行控制系统设计的综合应用能力，以及控制工程科学知识的应用能力，增加创新意识，为解决实际工程问题奠定基础。
default.en: Automatic control practice (2), the second phase of the core course automatic control practice, is itself one of the important core courses for automation students. Taking automatic control theory and automatic control components as prerequisites, the course serves as a bridge connecting automatic control theories and control systems design practices. The course is oriented to engineering applications and is, therefore, strongly characterized with practicing. The course will lay a sound foundation for the study of succeeding courses, such as process control, guidance and control of flight vehicles, control of unmanned aerial vehicles. The course holds an important position in cultivating students’ overall abilities of analysis and design. The course mainly consists three parts. The first part gives the methodology of constructing a control system through the analysis of various input signals and performance indices of the control system. The second part deals with main problems in control system design via, for example, error analysis and methods to reduce control errors, disturbance analysis and suppression methods. In the third part, design procedures for typical control systems, including servomechanisms and regulation systems, are given, together with various practical design examples. Through the course study, including lecturing in class and real experiments and computer simulations outside class, it is expected that the overall capabilities are cultivated for students in control system design. In addition, it is also hoped that the sense on innovation of students is improved to lay a sound foundation for solving practical engineering problems.

default.zh: 最优控制基础是自动化类专业下设控制理论与控制工程模块中的一门重要基础课程，是现代控制理论中的一个非常重要的分支。本课程旨在介绍最优控制理论的基础知识和研究方法，主要内容包括：最优控制问题描述、古典变分法、Pontryagin极小值原理、动态规划、线性二次型最优控制、输出跟踪等。通过本课程的学习，学生可以掌握最优控制的内涵和本质、建立一个最优控制问题的数学描述、熟练使用欧拉方程求解泛函极值、应用古典变分法求解最优控制问题、深入体会极小值原理重要意义及其重要应用、掌握动态规划及线性二次型最优求解思想；此外，还可以使用数学仿真软件完成一个较复杂的工程最优控制问题的求解和结果分析。通过实验操作深刻体会最优控制思想，有效提高学生解决工程实际问题能力。
default.en: “Fundamentals of Optimal Control” is a very important course opened in the module of control theory and control engineering, which is suitable for the third-year undergraduate majored in automation. It is also a significant branch in modern control theory. The course aims to introduce fundamental theory and research methods for optimal control theory. The main contents include: description of optimal control problem, classical method of calculus of variations, Pontryagin’s minimum principle, dynamic programming, linear quadratic optimal control, and output tracking, etc. Through the course, students could grasp the meaning and essence of optimal control, construct mathematical description for an optimal control problem, apply Euler equation to solve the extremum for functionals, solve optimal control problem by classical calculus of variations, realize the important meaning of minimum principle and its significant applications, grasp the idea of dynamic programming and linear quadratic optimal control. Moreover, students could make use of mathematical simulation software to solve and analyze a relatively complicated engineering optimal control problem. Experimental operations could also help students grasp optimal control idea deeply and increase their ability effectively to solve practical problems.

default.zh: 本课程为机器学习的介绍性课程，主要讲述机器学习中的相关概念、原理和算法。从分类和线性回归开始讲起，直到近期新发展的方法如决策树、支持向量机、集成学习以及贝叶斯网络等方法。内容涵盖机器学习中的监督学习、非监督学习及集成学习等主要类别的算法。并针对相关的机器学习方法进行实验练习，培养用机器学习方法解决实际问题的能力。
default.en: This course is an introduction about machine learning, mainly focusing on the relevant concepts, principles, and algorithms in machine learning. We start from classification and linear regression, until recent developed methods, such as decision tree, support vector machine, ensemble learning, and Bayesian networks. The contents cover algorithms in the main categories of machine learning, such as supervised learning, unsupervised learning, and ensemble learning. We also help students to conduct experimental exercises on relevant machine learning methods to cultivate the ability to solve practical problems using machine learning methods.

default.zh: 该课程是力学专业的一门技术基础课。着重介绍经典控制理论的基本概念、基本理论和基本分析方法。同时，紧密结合工程实际，以空间飞行器系统为研究对象，应用控制理论中的基本方法来分析、研究和解决实际问题。通过本课程的学习，使学生能建立数学和控制系统之间的关系，培养学生的系统概念和掌握系统动态性能的分析方法，为进一步专业课学习和参加控制工程实践奠定必要的基础。 1、树立正确的设计思想，理论联系实际，具有创新精神； 2、掌握控制系统的基本理论、基本知识和基本技能，了解飞行器姿态控制的一般规律，具有分析飞行器控制系统的能力； 3、掌握飞行器控制的原理和方法，具有进行仿真研究的初步能力。 4、了解飞行器控制的新理论、新方法及发展趋向。
default.en: This course is a technical foundation course for mechanics majors. It focuses on introducing the basic concepts, basic theories and basic analysis methods of classical control theory. At the same time, it closely integrates with engineering practice, takes space vehicle system as the research object, and applies the basic methods in control theory to analyze, study and solve practical problems. Through the study of this course, students can establish the relationship between mathematics and control system, cultivate the system concept and master the analysis method of system dynamic performance, and lay the necessary foundation for further professional course study and participation in control engineering practice. 1、Establishing correct design ideas, linking theory to practice and having innovative spirit. 2、Master the basic theory, basic knowledge and basic skills of control system, understand the general law of aircraft attitude control, and have the ability to analyze aircraft control system. 3、Master the principles and methods of aircraft control, and have the preliminary ability to conduct simulation research. 4、Know the new theories, new methods and development trends of aircraft control.

default.zh: 计算力学课程主要是一种数值计算方法，如有限单元法有限差分方法。有限元等方法是求解各类工程问题的最有效的数值计算方法。这种数值计算方法是当今广泛应用的计算机求解技术。为此，要求学生深刻理解有限元法和有限差分方法的基本算法和求解方法。教材中首先介绍了有限元刚度矩阵概念和通过插值函数表示的位移方程。然后，介绍了各种能量方法，如卡氏定理、最小势能原理，以及加权余量法。最后，说明了如何应用于求解各类工程力学问题。有限差分方法主要内容包括：双曲方程、抛物方程和椭圆方程的差分格式等。设置该课程的目的就是向学生系统的介绍有限元等数值计算方法，包括数学建模，求解方法和计算程序。使学生能够理解有限元法等方法的基本理论和计算机应用技术。
default.en: The course of computational mechanics is mainly concerned with the numerical methods, e.g., the finite element method and finite difference method, which are the most effective numerical method that can be used to obtain the accurate solutions for various engineering problems. The numerical methods introduced in this textbook are nowadays very widely used computational techniques that it is essential for students to understand their basic solution algorism and applications of those techniques. The concept of finite element stiffness matrix and associated displacement equation in terms of interpolation functions are introduced first. The energy methods such as the first theorem of Castigliano, the principle of minimum potential energy and the method of weighted residual are described and illustrated with various examples. Finally, the applications to various engineering problems are illustrated. The main contents of finite difference method include: finite difference formats for hyperbolic, parabolic and elliptic equations. The material of this course of computational mechanics is expected to be useful for students who would like to learn the mathematical modeling, solution procedure and the computer programs used for solving practical problems. The objective of the course is to introduce various aspects of the numerical methods as applied to engineering problems in a systematic manner and to enable the students to understand the basic theory and computer implementation of the theory developed.

default.zh: 《空气动力学》是飞行器设计与工程、工程力学、飞行器环境与生命保障工程的工程基础类课程。本课程主要讲授空气与物体发生相对运动时，所出现的各种物理现象和遵循的基本规律以及空气与物体之间的相互作用力，以及飞行器气动部件空气动力学特性及其基本计算方法。本课程的教学注重培养学生的兴趣，着重培养学生对空气动力学基础理论知识的掌握，具备必要的空气动力学分析、计算和基本实验技能，为从事专业技术和科学研究打下基础。
default.en: The course Aerodynamics is an engineering basic course covering aircraft design and engineering, engineering mechanics, aircraft environment and life support engineering. This course mainly focuses on the various physical phenomena and basic laws that occur when air and objects move relatively to each other, as well as the aerodynamic characteristics of aircraft aerodynamic components and their basic calculation methods. The aim of this course is to cultivate students' interests on aerodynamics, and to make them master the necessary aerodynamic analysis, calculation and basic experimental skills, laying a foundation for engaging in professional technology and scientific research.

default.zh: 这是一门培养科学兴趣和提升科学能力素养的课程。通过力学各方向科研教师介绍目前承担的航天领域相关科研工作，使学生们了解航天专业技术发展过程中遇到的问题以及解决方案；促进学生的科研思考能力和解决问题的能力。
default.en: This is a course that cultivates scientific interest and enhances scientific literacy. By introducing the current research work in the aerospace field undertaken by teachers in various fields of mechanics, students can understand the problems encountered in the development of aerospace technology and their solutions; Promote students' scientific research thinking and problem-solving abilities.

default.zh: 这是一门培养科学兴趣和提升科学能力素养的课程。通过力学各方向科研教师介绍目前承担的航天领域相关科研工作，使学生们了解航天专业技术发展过程中遇到的问题以及解决方案；促进学生的科研思考能力和解决问题的能力。
default.en: This is a course that cultivates scientific interest and enhances scientific literacy. By introducing the current research work in the aerospace field undertaken by teachers in various fields of mechanics, students can understand the problems encountered in the development of aerospace technology and their solutions; Promote students' scientific research thinking and problem-solving abilities.

default.zh: 通过热力学学习，要求学生牢固掌握热力学中温度、功和热、能量、热力学第一定律和熵、第二定律等的基本概念和基本理论，深刻理解热力学自由能和热力学基本定律在求解热力学问题时的重要作用以及利用自由能值最小化或熵值最大化确定平衡条件，利用平衡条件确定相图的基本原理；熟练地运用这些基本概念和基本原理理解和分析热力学系统，将所学的热力学知识和具体的工程问题融合起来，培养学生的逻辑思维和分析能力，实现学生们能将热力学的基础和专业知识用于解决具体复杂热力学工程问题的目标。 学生学习热力学课程之后，需达到的基本要求如下： 1．对热力学的基本概念和基本分析方法有明确的认识。能确定热力学系统的熵和自由能等状态函数，获取平衡条件并能看懂和分析相图。 2．对自由能和化学势，以及相变和相图有较明确的认识，理解和掌握基本的原理和分析方法。 3．掌握从热力学的角度分析和思考具体工程问题的能力，提高对热力学基础理论的理解，培养底层思维能力，为将来能解决核心问题和在基础层面上进行创新打好基础。
default.en: This is an introductory course to thermodynamics. Topics of this course includes temperature, work and heat, energy, the first law of thermodynamics, entropy and the second law of thermodynamics, free energy, phase transformations of pure substances and mixtures. A portion of the above topics involves statistical mechanics. After finishing this course, students are expected to learn the above topics, fully understand them and are able to apply these fundamental principles to solve related engineering problems.

default.zh: 本课程是复合材料与工程以及相关专业的一门重要的技术基础课，主要内容有应用弹性力学、应用塑性力学。在学生学习完基础课，对变形体材料与结构的力学性能有一定了解后，进入专业课学习之前，进一步对变形体的弹性和塑性力学分析方法进行系统的学习，为更好地学习专业课打下坚实基础。本课程主要介绍弹性力学平面问题的基本概念、基本方程、基本解法，空间问题的基本理论与基本解答，以及薄板小挠度弯曲问题的一般理论等。介绍弹性力学的基本概念和分析方法，研究弹性体在外界因素影响下的应力、应变和位移。结合具体的平面问题和空间问题进行学习和应用。研究变形体有弹性进入塑性的屈服条件，产生塑性的加载条件，以及分析塑性变形和应力特征的本构关系。通过本课程的学习，使学生对弹塑性力学的经典研究内容有全面的了解，为后续课程的学习以及今后实际工程应用中奠定重要基础。
default.en: The course is one important technology course of major of composite materials and engineering, as well as related professional basic courses. Its main content includes application elasticity and plasticity mechanics. Students completing the basic course, there is a certain understanding of the mechanical properties of materials and structures for deformable solids, before entering the specialty course, students learn systematically further analysis methods of elasticity and plasticity, in order to lay a solid foundation for better learning professional courses. This course introduces the basic concepts of plane problems, the basic equation, the basic solution, and the general theory of space issues and answers, as well as thin small deflection bending problem with the general theory etc. The basic concepts of elasticity and analytical methods are introduced, and elastomers under the influence of external factors, stress, strain, and displacement are researched. Students learn the combination of a specific plane, and space issues, and have application of them. In addition, we study the yield conditions of the deformable solid, the loading conditions of the plastic solid. The plastic deformation and stress distribution of the deformable solid are then studied by establishing the plastic stress-strain relationship of the deformable solid under external loading and displacement boundaries. Learning through the curriculum, students have a comprehensive understanding of the contents of the Elastic-plastic characteristics of deformable solid, laid an important foundation for the subsequent course of learning as well as practical engineering application in the future.

default.zh: 《材料科学与工程基础BII》课程是复合材料与工程专业的一门专业方向核心课程。材料科学理论是复合材料与结构学科的重要基础和支柱。本课程主要内容包括：材料热力学，相图的分析和使用方法，掌握以相变方法改变材料晶体结构、微观组织结构的原理和规律，包括材料热力学、相图、扩散、凝固和结晶、固态相变等基础理论。 通过本课程的学习，学生应掌握材料科学的基本理论和基本方法，并善于应用这些理论和方法解决工程实际问题，同时为后续课程打下基础。
default.en: “Fundamentals of Materials Science and Engineering BII” as a main specialized basic course focuses on the basic theories of composite materials science and engineering. The contents of this course involve: material thermodynamics, phase diagram and phase transition, diffusion, solidification and crystallization, solid phase transition. Through this curriculum, the students should master the basic theories and methods of material science and further apply them to the actual engineering problems.

default.zh: 复合材料导论课程是高等工科院校复合材料与工程专业的一门重要的基础课。其目的是使学生通过对本课程的学习，了解复合材料的定义、特点、分类和应用，了解复合材料的基本性能和发展概况，掌握近年来国内外复合材料研究的新理论、新进展，获得复合材料技术必要的基本理论、基本知识，为后续专业课程的学习和从事复合材料的研究打下坚实基础。本课程主要讲授复合材料领域中的基本理论和基础知识，以及近年来国内外复合材料研究的新理论、新进展。包括复合材料定义、分类、特性等基础知识、基体材料、增强材料、复合材料界面、聚合物基复合材料、金属基复合材料、陶瓷基复合材料等内容，是复合材料与工程专业学生非常重要的核心课，在培养学生具备一定的复合材料与工程的综合分析能力、综合设计能力等方面占有重要的地位。通过本课程的课堂教学和课后实践等环节，为后续专业基础课和专业课学习打下良好的基础。
default.en: Introduction of Composite Materials course is an important basic course for composite materials and engineering major’s students. The aim of this course is enable students to understand the definition, characteristics, classification and application of composites, to understand the basic properties and development of composites, to study the new theory and progress of composite materials in recent years, and to obtain basic theories and basic knowledge of composite materials. This course mainly teaches the basic theory and basic knowledge in the field of composite materials, as well as the new theories and developments of composite materials research at home and abroad in recent years, including the definition, classification, characteristics and other basic knowledge of composite materials, matrix materials, reinforced materials, composites interface, polymer matrix composites, metal matrix composites, ceramic matrix composites and so on. It is an important basic course for composite materials and engineering major’s students. Through classroom teaching and after-school practice, it plays an important role in training students' comprehensive analysis ability and design ability of composite materials and engineering. It is very helpful for the follow-up professional basic courses and specialized courses study.

default.zh: 《材料科学与工程基础上》主要讲述材料结构和工艺的理论基础，主要研究材料的组成、结构与性能之间的相互关系和变化规律。本课程重点讲授晶体结构与缺陷（点缺陷、面缺陷）等材料科学基础理论等内容。为后续课程奠定基础，同时为将来从事复合材料研究与开发打下坚实的理论基础。
default.en: Fundamentals of Materials Science and Engineering mainly discusses the theoretical basis of material structure and technology. The course mainly explains the composition of materials, the interrelationship and variation patterns between structure and performance. The course focuses on the fundamental theories of materials science, such as crystal structure and defects (point defects, surface defects). To lay the foundation for subsequent courses and lay a solid theoretical foundation for future research and development in composite materials.

default.zh: 《材料科学与工程基础》主要讲述材料结构和工艺的理论基础，主要研究材料的组成、结构与性能之间的相互关系和变化规律。本课程重点讲授晶体结构与缺陷（点缺陷、面缺陷）等材料科学基础理论等内容。为后续课程奠定基础，同时为将来从事复合材料研究与开发打下坚实的理论基础。
default.en: Fundamentals of Materials Science and Engineering mainly discusses the theoretical basis of material structure and technology, and mainly studies the interrelationships and variation patterns between the composition, structure, and properties of materials. This course focuses on the fundamental theories of materials science, such as crystal structure and defects (point defects, surface defects). To lay the foundation for subsequent courses and lay a solid theoretical foundation for future research and development in composite materials

default.zh: 《材料科学基础》是力学拔尖学生培养基地善义班的一门专业方向核心课程。材料科学是现代科学技术的重要物质基础和支柱。本课程主要内容包括:晶体结构与缺陷，包括空间点阵、指数标定、结合键、常见晶体结构的几何特征、晶体缺陷、界面以及塑性变形等基础知识；相图的分析和使用方法，掌握以相变方法改变材料晶体结构、微观组织结构的原理和规律，包括材料热力学、相图、扩散、凝固和结晶、固态相变等基础理论。 通过本课程的学习，学生应掌握材料科学的基本理论和基本方法，并善于应用这些理论和方法解决工程实际问题，同时为后续课程打下基础。
default.en: “Fundamentals of Materials Science” as a main specialized basic course focuses on the basic theories of materials science and engineering. The contents of this course involve: crystal structure and defects, including space lattice, index calibration, bond, common crystal structure, crystal defects, interface and plastic deformation; phase diagram and phase transition, including material thermodynamics, phase diagram, diffusion, solidification and crystallization, solid phase transition. Through this curriculum, the students should master the basic theories and methods of material science and further apply them to the actual engineering problems.

default.zh: 《复合材料与结构》主要讲授复合材料基本概念、分类、特点及基本性能，复合材料层板基础理论和方法，复合材料破坏机理与破坏准则，典型复合材料结构的设计方法及准则，复合材料制备工艺，复合材料与结构力学性能测试方法等。要求学生掌握复合材料的概念、基本性能和材料设计基本概念；掌握经典层合板理论以及单层板微观和宏观力学性能的分析方法，应用刚度矩阵分析层合板的刚度特性，利用强度准则进行层板的破坏分析，根据刚度和重量设计要求进行层合板的铺层计算和设计；掌握复合材料结构设计方法和复合材料结构设计一般原则；掌握复合材料的成型工艺基本概念、特点和工艺基础理论以及复合材料实验方法和测试设备的操作要领，具备一定的解决复合材料结构制备与评价实际问题的能力。
default.en: The course "Composite Materials and Structures" mainly teaches the basic concepts, classifications, characteristics, and basic properties of composite materials, basic theories and methods of composite laminates, failure mechanisms and criteria of composite materials, design methods and criteria of typical composite material structures, preparation techniques of composite materials, and testing methods for mechanical properties of composite materials and structures. Require students to master the concepts, basic properties, and material design of composite materials; Master the classic theory of laminated plates and the analysis methods of micro and macro mechanical properties of single-layer plates, apply stiffness matrix analysis to analyze the stiffness characteristics of laminated plates, use strength criteria to analyze the failure of laminated plates, and calculate and design the layering of laminated plates according to the requirements of stiffness and weight design; Master the design methods and general principles of composite material structures; Master the basic concepts, characteristics, and basic theories of composite material forming technology, as well as the operation essentials of composite material experimental methods and testing equipment, and have the ability to solve practical problems in the preparation and evaluation of composite material structures.

default.zh: 科学与工程计算基础是利用计算机求解计算模型的数值分析方法的基础课程，是工科数学分析、代数与几何、固体力学基础的后续课程，用来衔接飞行器、力学或者复合材料相关专业课程。本课程包括插值、拟合、数值积分法、非线性方程求解、线性方程组求解、常微分方程数值解法、有限元方法、Monte-Carlo方法、神经网络及机器学习方法入门等内容。本课程特别注重学生的计算分析能力和程序编写能力的培养，增强利用数值模拟解决力学和航天国防领域相关挑战性科学和工程问题的能力。通过学习本课程，使学生能够掌握科学与工程计算分析方法，并且能够做相应的误差分析，并且具有实现算法的编程能力，提高学生综合运用数值分析方法解决实际工程问题的能力。
default.en: Calculating Fundamentals of Scientific and Engineering is a basic course of numerical analysis methods for solving computational models using computers. It is a follow-up course of Engineering Mathematical Analysis, Algebra and Geometry, and Solid Mechanics, which is used to link professional courses related to Aircraft Design, Mechanics, or Composite Materials. This course includes interpolation, fitting, Numerical integration, nonlinear Equation solving, System of linear equations solving, Ordinary differential equation numerical solution, Finite element method, Monte Carlo method, neural network and introduction to machine learning methods. This course pays special attention to the cultivation of students' numerical analysis and programming abilities, enhancing their ability to solve challenging scientific and engineering problems in the fields of mechanics and aerospace defense through numerical simulation. By studying this course, students will be able to master scientific and engineering calculation and analysis methods, perform corresponding error analysis, and have the programming ability to implement algorithms, improving their ability to comprehensively apply numerical analysis methods to solve practical engineering problems.

default.zh: 《弹箭空气动力学》是飞行器设计与工程、飞行器环境与生命保障工程、空间科学与技术专业本科生的一门专业课程，通过本课程的学习，使学生初步了解弹、箭部件气动力设计原理和分析方法，在内容上兼顾弹、箭结构的特殊性与一般绕流物体的一般性，重点掌握空气动力学的基本概念、基本原理及分析导弹和火箭的主要部件及组合体在不同状态下的空气动力特性的基本方法，使学生树立正确的飞行器结构工程设计思想，培养学生对所学理论的综合运用能力，为学生进一步从事飞行器设计工作打下基础。
default.en: Aerodynamics of Missile and Rocket is a specialized course for undergraduate students majoring in Aircraft Design and Engineering, Aircraft Environment and Life Support Engineering, Space Science and Technology. This course has a simple object to provide an insight into related knowledge regarding aerodynamic design theory and analysis method of missile and rocket, including particularity of missile and rocket structure and universality of flow around the object. This course focuses on elucidating basic concepts of aerodynamics, basic principles and the basic methods of analyzing the aerodynamic characteristics of the main components and components of missiles and rockets in different states. It is an important course to form the engineering design idea of aircraft structure. This course emphasizes the combination of physics theory with practical applications. It can be used for some practical purpose including spacecraft design.

default.zh: 飞行器结构力学是固体力学领域中重要学科，在工程设计中，结构设计起到了举足轻重的作用，而飞行器结构力学是结构设计中所必备的基础知识。只有充分应用结构力学的概念，才可以在工程结构设计中做到优化结构方案、优化结构投资组合、合理设计构件的受力。本课程的主要任务是通过课堂教学等环节培养学生的创新意识与应用能力。 课程目标对学生的能力要求如下： （1）培养学生具有结构优化设计的思想和能力，了解结构设计主要研究内容是研究工程结构的受力和传力规律，研究如何进行结构优化的学科。在结构设计的过程中具有对结构形式进行简化，对结构的体系进行整体布置；对结构荷载、构件受力的优化、传力途径的优化等方面的能力。 （2）通过本课程的学习，使学生掌握杆系和薄壁结构的组成原理及其受力和变形分析的方法、薄壁结构理论，使学生了解和掌握结构的受力和传力特点以及薄壁结构的基本理论和基本计算方法，培养学生对结构设计和强度计算的概念和综合处理能力，培养从事飞行器结构设计和强度计算的高技术人才。 （3）能够独立研究平面杆系结构的强度、刚度和稳定性，了解各类结构的受力性能，为学习有关专业课程以及进行结构设计和科学研究打好力学基础，培养飞行器结构分析与计算等方面的能力。
default.en: Structural design plays an important role in engineering design, and Structural Mechanics of Spacecraft is the necessary basic knowledge in structural design. Only by fully applying the concept of Structural Mechanics of Spacecraft can optimize the structural scheme, optimize the structural investment portfolio and rationally design the stress of components in the design of Engineering structures. The main task of this course is to cultivate students' innovative consciousness and application ability through classroom teaching and other links. The requirements for students' abilities are as follows: (1) To train students to have the idea and ability of structural optimization design, understand the main content of structural design is to study the force and force law of Engineering structure, and study how to optimize the structure. In the process of structural design, it has the ability to simplify the structure form, to arrange the structure system as a whole, to optimize the structure load, the stress of components, and the way of transmission. (2) Through the study of this course, the students can master the composition principle of the bar structure, the force and displacement method of its stress and deformation analysis, the theory of thin-walled engineering beam, so that they can understand and master the mechanical and force characteristics of the structure and the basic theory and calculation method of thin-walled engineering beam, and train the students to design and strengthen the structure. Degree calculation concept and comprehensive processing ability, training high-tech personnel engaged in aircraft structure design and strength calculation. (3) Ability to independently study the strength, stiffness and stability of planar truss structures, understand the mechanical properties of various structures, lay a good mechanical foundation for learning relevant professional courses, structural design and scientific research, and train the ability of aircraft structural analysis and calculation.

default.zh: 多体系统动力学是研究关于由多个部件组成的约束复杂机械系统在外力作用下的运动规律与动态特性的理论。飞行器多体动力学基础以现代空间飞行器为服务对象，讲授基于矢量力学和分析力学原理的多体系统动力学建模与仿真的基本概念、原理和方法及其在航天器工程中的应用，通过本课程学习使学生了解和掌握多体系统动力学建模基本原理及方法，初步具备多体系统动力学分析的理论基础和基本应用技能，为今后进一步学习和从事多体系统动力学与控制研究奠定基础。
default.en: Dynamics of multibody system is the theory of the constraint complex mechanical system which consists of multiple components, and it studies the law of motion and the dynamical performances under the external force. Foundations of dynamics of multibody systems for vehicle, serviced for space vehicle, it mainly teaches the basic concepts, principles and methods of the multibody system dynamics, including modeling and simulation based on the vector mechanics and the analytic mechanics, and its application in the spacecraft engineering. This course helps the undergraduate students understand and master the principles and the basic methods of the multi-rigid-body system dynamics modeling, equip with the theoretical foundation and basic application skills of the multibody system dynamics analysis for further learning and engaging in the research of the multibody system dynamics and control.

default.zh: 《飞行器导航原理》是面向航天学院第三学年本科生的一门专业课程。课程主要讲述引导飞行器等载体完成航行任务的多项导航技术。 课程主要讲述了导航技术的相关内容，介绍了导航技术的发展过程、发展现状与未来趋势，介绍了导航的基本概念、原理和方法，深入介绍了惯性导航系统、卫星导航系统、天文导航系统等导航系统的系统组成、工作原理、特点与应用范围，并分析了导航系统及其组合系统的选择、应用与关键技术，可为学生在相关领域的研究工作打下坚实的理论基础。
default.en: The Principles of Flight Vehicle Navigation is a specialized course for Junior Undergraduates of School of Astronautics, which focuses on multiple navigation techniques to guide the navigation vehicle to complete navigation tasks. The Principles of Flight Vehicle Navigation is mainly about the navigation technology. The course describes the development history, the current situation and future trends of navigation technology, and introduces basic concepts, principles and methods of navigation. Then in depth exploration the system composition, working principle, characteristics and application field of inertial navigation system, satellite navigation system, celestial navigation system and so on. At last, analysis the selection, application and key technology of navigation system and its combination system. Through the study of this course, the students will lay a solid theoretical foundation for future research work in related fields.

default.zh: 基础天文学是飞行器设计与工程大类空间科学与技术专业的一门自然科学基础核心课程。通过本课程的讲授，综合展示天文学各分支学科中对于太阳系、恒星、星系和宇宙的研究成果，了解天文学的历史、现状和发展前景，掌握时空度量、天体运动和演化、宇宙的构成和基本特征等天文学基础知识以及天文观测的基本原理和方法，具备进行空间观测和分析的初步能力，为深入学习后续专业课程奠定坚实的理论基础和专业素养。
default.en: Fundamental Astronomy is a core physical science course for space science and technology direction of flight vehicle design and engineering major. Through the course, fruit of research on solar system, star, galaxy up-to universe taken by sub-disciplines of astronomy are brought forth. You will get the essential knowledge about history, development and foreground of astronomy; rules of celestial-body motion and evolution; the space-time metric; characteristic and structure of cosmos; the principle and method of space observation through studying. Foundation of continue research capacity and academic culture would be possessed.

default.zh: “激光原理A”是电子科学与技术专业本科生的一门专业基础课，主要讲授激光的光与物质的相互作用、激光器的基本原理、光学谐振腔和激光的典型应用。学习本课程的目的是使学生能掌握有关激光的基本原理，深入理解激光的产生过程，掌握激光光束的特性和谐振腔理论。在光与物质相互作用方面，重点讲授光与物质相互作用的自发发射、受激发射和受激吸收的概念和公式，为后续激光器的基本原理的学习打下基础。此外，有关光谱线加宽的内容也为后续激光原理的定量描述奠定了基础。在激光器的基本原理方面，重点讲授产生激光所需具备的条件、激光器的结构、激光形成过程和激光特性等内容。在定量描述方面，重点介绍激光器速率方程、增益系数、激光振荡的阈值条件、激光输出能量和功率等内容。在光学谐振腔方面，介绍谐振腔的稳定性、谐振腔的损耗、谐振腔中的模式、高斯光束的特性和传输变换、非稳腔等相关内容，重点讲授激光光束的特点和对激光光束的定量描述，为激光应用中，传输和控制激光光束提供理论指导。同时会简要讲授激光的典型应用。
default.en: PRINCIPLES OF LASERS A is a basic course for undergraduates majoring in Electronic Science and technology. In this course, the interaction of light and matter, basic principle of laser, optical resonator and typical applications of laser are mainly taught. The aim for this course is to make students master the basic principles of lasers, learn about the production mechanism of laser, the properties of laser beam and theory of optical resonators. In the chapter of the interaction of light and matter, the concepts and formulas about spontaneous emission, stimulated emission and stimulated absorption are taught. It lays a foundation for the study of the basic principle of laser. In addition, the contents about the broadening of spectral lines also laid the foundation for the quantitative description of the subsequent laser principle. In the chapter of the basic principle of laser, the conditions required to generate the laser, laser structure, formation of laser, and characteristics of laser are mainly taught. In order to quantitatively describe, the rate equation of laser, gain coefficient of medium, threshold conditions of laser oscillation, output energy and power of laser and so on are mainly introduced. In the chapter of optical resonator, stability conditions of coaxial spherical cavity, loss of the resonator, characteristics of Gaussian beam, propagation and transformation of Gaussian beam, unstable cavity are introduced. The characteristics of laser beam and quantitative description of laser beam are mainly taught. It provides theoretical guidance for transmitting and controlling laser beam in laser applications. At the same time, the typical applications of laser are briefly taught.

default.zh: 主要掌握和熟悉微电子器件基本结构的工作原理、物理概念和主要性质。本课程为学生介绍微电子器件单元结构的基本物理规律和性质，包括pn结、金属和半导体接触和MIS结构的基本物理性质、器件物理和半导体传感器等基础，为从事集成电路、微电子器件、传感器及应用、光电子技术等方面的工作打下必备的理论基础。
default.en: Master and be familiar with the working principles, physical concepts, and main properties of the basic structure of microelectronic devices. This course introduces the basic physical laws and properties of the unit structure of microelectronic devices, including the basic physical properties of p-n junctions, metal and semiconductor contact and MIS structures, device physics, and semiconductor sensors, etc. This course lays a necessary theoretical foundation for the integrated circuits, microelectronic devices, sensor applications, and optoelectronic technology.

default.zh: 本课程是本科生专业核心课程，使学生了解并掌握p-n结、双极型和场效应晶体管的基本结构、工作原理和电特性规律，为本专业学生后续课程的学习建立相关知识基础。要求学生掌握p-n结、双极型和场效应晶体管的基本结构、工作原理和直流特性、交流特性、频率特性和功率特性规律；了解并掌握主要微电子器件工作原理和基本特性与其内部载流子运动基本规律和微观过程的内在联系；具备认识和分析分立器件和集成电路工作原理及电特性的基本能力。
default.en: This is a core professional course for undergraduates majoring. The course enables students to understand and master the p-n junction, knows well the basic structure, the working principle, and the electrical characteristics of the bipolar and field effect transistors, to establish a knowledge base for students of this major to learn subsequent courses. Students are required to master the p-n junction, the basic structure, working principle, DC characteristics, AC characteristics, frequency characteristics, and power characteristics of the bipolar and field effect transistors; Understand and master the internal relations between the working principles and basic characteristics of major microelectronic devices and the basic laws and microscopic processes of their internal carrier movement; Have the basic ability to understand and analyze the working principles and electrical characteristics of discrete devices and integrated circuits.

default.zh: 《微电子工艺》是集成电路学科学生非常重要的专业核心课，是学习后续专业课如数字集成电路设计基础、模拟集成电路设计基础、MEMS基础等课程的基础。本课程主要讲授半导体集成电路制造技术流程，单项工艺技术基本原理、工艺方法及所依托的技术基础，常用的工艺设备，近年出现的新工艺技术以及集成电路制造工艺未来发展趋势。 重点使学生熟悉和掌握微电子芯片制造当前普遍采用的单项工艺方法，包括：硅片制备，外延，氧化，扩散，离子注入，化学汽相淀积，物理汽相淀积，光刻，腐蚀，金属互连等；掌握各单项工艺中常见问题以及解决措施；了解典型器件工艺集成（流程）技术。内容涉及面广，信息量大，而且新技术、新工艺、新设备不断涌现，是一门实践性和理论性均较强的技术类专业核心课程，承担着技术基础掌握与技术传承两个任务。 本课程学习包括两个部分：线上网络MOOC课程学习和线下翻转课堂学习，二者是互为补充的关系，线上网络课程学习强调广度，线下课堂学习强调深度。课程期末考试采取累加式计分方式，期末笔试成绩占总成绩的60%，平时成绩占10%（讨论、小测验等）； 线上MOOC课程占30%（线上课程总分100分，记录成绩总分30分）。
default.en: Microelectronics Processing is one of the most important courses to all the students in Integrated Circuit discipline, which is a knowledge foundation of the subsequent specialty lessons such as Digital Integrated Circuit Design, Analog Integrated Circuit Design, Base of MEMS technique. Microelectronics Processing is a specialized course studied the manufacture technique of Integrated Circuit on semi-conductors, including the technique principles，methods, application, and the physics basis of the relative individual item of fabrication method. The usual process equipment, as well as the newly developed techniques these years, and the future development tendency of the microelectronic processes are also recommended in this course. After finishing the lesson, students should be familiar with each individual fabrication method for semiconductor devices and integrated circuit chips, including: wafer fabrication. epitaxy, oxidation, diffusion, ion implantation, chemical vapor deposition (CVD), physical vapor deposition, photography and etching technique, metal interconnect, etc. Furthermore, they should know and master the common problems and typical solutions in each individual process; they must understand and grasp the technique of fabrication integration (flow) for the typical devices. The content covered a wide range and a large amount of information, accompanying with the constant emergence of new technology, new fabrication method and new equipment. It is a practical and theoretical technical core curriculum, undertaken the two tasks to master the technical basis and technical inheritance. The course studying consists of two parts: online MOOC courses and Flipped Classroom. These two are complementary to each other. It emphasizes the breadth for the online learning, while the classroom learning emphasizes the depth in the flipped classroom. The final exam take the cumulative scoring method. Final written examination results accounted for 60% of the total score; Regular grades accounted for 10% of the total score (including discussions, quizzes and others); MOOC online courses accounted for 30% of the total score ( the total score 100 points, record score of 30).

default.zh: 硬件描述语言是自顶向下、SoC设计方法的基础，Verilog HDL是目前电子设计自动化（EDA）工具支持的三种硬件描述语言之一。本课程是大规模数字集成电路设计与实现的基础课程，课程目的是通过本课程的学习，学生能够完成实际硬件行为的Verilog HDL建模，并运用到大规模数字集成电路芯片设计流程中。课程主要内容包括集成电路设计领域背景知识，CMOS数字集成电路单元结构、特性、设计及应用；Verilog HDL的框架结构、语法基础、编程风格、任务与函数，基础元件的RTL建模，验证平台结构与设计，复杂硬件功能的RTL建模、验证与综合等。
default.en: Hardware description language is the basis of top-down and SoC design method. Verilog HDL is one of the three hardware description languages supported by electronic design automation (EDA) tools at present. This course is a basic course for the design and implementation of large-scale digital integrated circuits. The purpose of this course is to enable students to complete Verilog HDL modeling of actual hardware behavior and apply it to the design process of large-scale digital integrated circuits. The course contents include background knowledge in the field of integrated circuit design, Basic cell structure, characteristics, design, and application of CMOS digital integrated circuits; Verilog HDL framework structure, syntax basis, programming style, tasks and functions, RTL modeling of basic components, verification platform structure and design, RTL modeling, verification and synthesis of complex hardware functions, etc.

default.zh: 本课程讨论模拟集成电路的分析与设计，既着重基本原理，也着重于学生需要掌握的现代工业中新的范例。本课程从如下几方面介绍模拟集成电路设计技术：讲述器件的基本物理原理和工作原理，介绍器件结构、分析器件的I/V特性、器件模型；讲述CMOS单级和差分级放大器以及电流电压基准电路，通过对基本电路性能的量化建立有效的分析工具；介绍电路的二个非理想性，即频率响应和噪声；讲授反馈、运放和反馈系统中的稳定性，利用反馈的有益特性，可以设计出高性能、稳定的运放，并学会在速度、精度和功耗之间进行折中考虑。本课程成绩采用累加式，包括期末考试、大作业和实验。
default.en: The course deals with the analysis and design of analog integrated circuits, emphasizing fundamentals as well as new examples that students need to master in today’s industry. The course introduces and discusses design of analog integrated circuits as below: First, the course describes basic physics and operation of devices, and introduces the structure and I/V characteristic of devices; then deals with single-stage and differential amplifiers and current references and voltage references, developing efficient analytical tools for quantifying the behavior of basic circuits; introduces two imperfections of circuits, frequency response and noise; describes feedback operational OPAMP and stability in feedback systems. With the useful properties of feedback analyzed, to design high performance, stable OPAMPs, and understand the trade-offs between speed, precision and power dissipation. The course score is given according the exam, the homework and the report of experiment.

default.zh: 嵌入式系统已经从8位发展到16位、32位，系统的设计和应用也更加复杂。掌握32位嵌入式系统的设计及其应用的相关知识在现实工程领域中具有重要意义。《嵌入式系统及应用》重点介绍了32位ARM嵌入式处理器及其组成，对嵌入式系统实现过程中软/硬件的设计环节和步骤进行了分析和讲解。本课程的目的是通过对目前常用嵌入式系统的介绍和分析，使学生熟悉和掌握嵌入式系统设计与应用的方法，并具备开发现代电子系统的能力。
default.en: The data-width of embedded systems has been enhanced from 8 bits, 16 bits to 32 bits, hence the embedded applications or systems are more and more complex. So it’s of great importance to master the corresponding knowledge of 32 bits embedded system, which could be applied to engineering. Applications of Embedded System mainly introduces ARM, a 32 bits embedded processor, and its architecture. In the course, the design flow of the embedded system, included software design and hardware design is analyzed and explained. After learning the various design methods of embedded systems, the students should understand the methodology of design and application of embedded systems, and have the capability to develop the modern electronic systems.

default.zh: 《微电子系列实验》包含固态电子论实验与微电子器件与工艺实验两部分内容。 固态电子论实验是与面向微电子科学与技术系本科生所开设的核心课程《固态电子论》相配套的实验教学课程。开设的目的是使学生通过实验熟悉半导体物理的基础理论和半导体的主要性质，为以后的半导体器件、传感器及应用、集成电路等专业课程的学习，以及学生将来从事电子科学与技术方面的工作打下必备的基础。本课程涵盖了固态电子学的电学、光学等特性的一系列基础性实验，使学生们掌握了固态电子论中一些重要现象和理论,并使学生在实验中观察现象，发现问题，分析原因，提高解决问题的能力。实践证明，该课程的开设取得了很理想的效果。 微电子器件与工艺实验是涵盖“微电子器件原理”与“微电子工艺”两门课程内容的实验课程。其中，实验类型以综合型为主，具有先进性。在教师组织指导下，要求学生课前预习，学会使用实验仪器，自己动手完成实验操作内容，分析实验现象，进行数据处理，写出实验报告。通过本门课程学习，使学生掌握微电子重要元器件性能及其关键工艺参数的测试实验原理、方法，熟悉微电子行业常用测试仪器、设备，加深对微电子技术理论的理解。并在实验操作中观察现象，发现问题，分析原因，从而提高动手能力和综合素质。 本课程的考核采用累加方式计分，成绩按各实验项目学时权重进行累加，各实验项目又按实验操作40%和实验报告60%计分，满分100分。
default.en: "Microelectronics Series Experiments" includes two parts: The Solid-State Electron Theory Experiment and Microelectronic Devices and Process Experiment. The Solid-State Electron Theory Experiment is an experimental teaching course that is compatible with the core course "Solid-State Electrons" for undergraduates of the Department of Microelectronics Science and Technology. The purpose of the program is to enable students to become familiar with the basic theories of semiconductor physics and the main properties of semiconductors through experiments, so as to lay the necessary foundation for the study of semiconductor devices, sensors and applications, integrated circuits and other professional courses in the future, as well as for students to engage in electronic science and technology in the future. This course covers a series of basic experiments on the electrical, optical and other characteristics of solid-state electronics, so that students can master some important phenomena and theories in solid-state electronics, and enable students to observe phenomena, find problems, analyze causes, and improve their ability to solve problems in experiments. Practice has proved that the course has achieved very satisfactory results. Microelectronic Devices and Process Experiment is an experimental course covering two courses: "Principles of Microelectronic Devices" and "Microelectronic Technology". Among them, the experimental type is mainly comprehensive and advanced. Under the guidance of the teacher, students are required to preview before class, learn to use experimental instruments, complete the experimental operation content by themselves, analyze experimental phenomena, process data, and write experimental reports. Through the study of this course, students will master the testing and experimental principles and methods of the performance of important components of microelectronics and their key process parameters, be familiar with the commonly used testing instruments and equipment in the microelectronics industry, and deepen their understanding of the theory of microelectronics technology. And observe the phenomenon in the experimental operation, find the problem, and analyze the cause, so as to improve the hands-on ability and comprehensive quality. The assessment of this course is scored by accumulation, and the results are accumulated according to the weight of the credit hours of each experimental item, and each experimental item is scored according to 40% of the experimental operation and 60% of the experimental report, with a full score of 100 points.

default.zh: 主要掌握和熟悉半导体物理的基础理论、物理概念和主要性质。本课程为学生介绍半导体物理的基本规律和性质，包括半导体材料的基本物理性质、半导体中的载流子及其运动状态、器件物理和半导体传感器等基础，为从事集成电路、微电子器件、传感器及应用、光电子技术等方面的工作打下必备的理论基础。
default.en: Master and be familiar with the basic theories, physical concepts and main properties of semiconductor physics. This course introduces the basic laws and properties of semiconductor physics, including the basic physical properties of semiconductor materials, carriers and their motion states in semiconductors, and device physics and semiconductor sensors, etc. This course lays the necessary theoretical foundation for the integrated circuits, microelectronic devices, sensor applications, and optoelectronic technology.

default.zh: 本课程是本科生专业核心课程，为本专业学生后续课程的学习建立相关知识基础。本课程旨在揭示构成各类半导体器件（如二极管、晶体管等）的内部物理机理、电气特性与性能极限。课程内容以PN结为基础，系统讲授双极型晶体管（BJT）和金属-氧化物-半导体场效应晶体管（MOSFET）的核心工作原理，重点分析其I-V特性、频率响应、开关特性及非理想效应。同时，课程将进一步拓展至化合物半导体器件、光电器件等前沿专题。
default.en: This course is a core undergraduate specialization course designed to establish the essential knowledge base for students' subsequent studies in the program. It aims to reveal the internal physical mechanisms, electrical characteristics, and performance limits of various semiconductor devices (such as diodes, transistors, etc.). The curriculum begins with the PN junction as its foundation, then systematically covers the core operating principles of the Bipolar Junction Transistor (BJT) and the Metal-Oxide-Semiconductor Field-Effect Transistor (MOSFET). Key analyses focus on their I-V characteristics, frequency response, switching behavior, and non-ideal effects. Furthermore, the course extends into advanced topics, including compound semiconductor devices and optoelectronic devices.

default.zh: 《红外辐射与计量》课程是为光电信息科学与工程（光学工程方向）本科生开设的专业理论基础课程。该课程是从事红外辐射计算、红外辐射测温、红外辐射源设计、红外辐射参数测量、红外探测器设计、红外诱饵研制、红外成像系统设计、红外诊疗仪器设计、红外对地遥感、红外制导、红外探测与识别等领域工作的基础和前提。该课程既有系统的基础理论，又有广泛的应用领域，并且是不断发展的活跃学科，本着处理好基础与应用、面与点及系统理论与新进展的关系，同时考虑我校的学科特色，课程除了重点讲授红外辐射基本概念、红外辐射基本规律外，还主要介绍了典型红外辐射源、典型目标与背景红外辐射特性、红外辐射定标、量值传递与溯源等内容，能够让学生掌握红外辐射的基本概念与定律、红外辐射的发生、成像等相关理论知识，了解红外辐射标准的建立、辐射定标以及量值传递与溯源等基本概念和方法，从而具备解决红外辐射分析计算、测量、成像、探测等红外技术问题的基本素质与能力，为从事光电信息科学与工程方面的工作打下坚实基础。
default.en: Infrared Radiation and Metrology is a professional theoretical foundation course for undergraduates (Optical Engineering) majoring in Optoelectronic Information Science and Engineering. It is a specialized required curriculum, which is the research basis and premise for those who engage in infrared radiation calculation, infrared radiation thermometry, infrared radiation source design, infrared radiation parameters metrology, infrared detector design, infrared decoy development, infrared imaging system design, infrared diagnosis instrument constructor, infrared remote sensing of the earth, infrared guidance, infrared detection and recognition and other fields of works. This course has both the basic system theory and a wide range of application directions, and is an active discipline of sustained development. In accordance with the principle of handle well the relationship between foundation and application, and also between surface, point, system theory and new progress in the meanwhile considering the subject characteristics of our curriculum, this course is mainly focus on the basic concepts, basic laws of infrared radiation, and at the same time introduce the typical infrared radiation sources, the infrared radiation characteristics of typical targets and backgrounds, infrared radiometric calibration, transfer and traceability in length, which is able to help students master the basic concepts and laws of infrared radiation, infrared radiation occurrence, infrared imaging, and at the same time, comprehend the basic concepts and methods of the radiation standard establishment, radiation calibration and quantity transmission and traceability of radiation standard. By studying this course, students can be provided with the basic quality and ability of solving infrared radiation calculation, metrology, imaging and detection etc. Furthermore, students can possess a solid foundation for the follow-up work of Optoelectronics Information Science and Engineering.

default.zh: 《智能视觉系统设计》课是覆盖智能视觉工程、光电信息科学与工程、电子科学与技术、光学工程等多学科和专业的专业基础课，是培养能在智能视觉工程、应用光学、光电子学、光信息科学、电子信息科学以及测量与控制领域从事科学研究、教学、产品设计、生产技术或管理工作的高级专门人才所必须重要基础课。 本课的主要教学目的是向学生介绍智能视觉系统设计的基本理论、基本知识和基本方法，各种智能视觉系统的成像原理、光电转换原理、成像链路及优化方法，在此基础上进行实际设计案例训练。在教学过程中，注意培养学生的逻辑思维能力、实际动手能力和创新能力。 通过本课程的学习，学生可以根据智能视觉系统光学成像原理来计算智能视觉系统的性能参数、分析智能视觉系统的成像性能，从而正确地进行智能视觉系统的具体设计。此外，在研究和工作中，可针对现有的智能视觉系统提出光学系统的设计指标，通过系统的优化来提升智能视觉系统的整体性能。 通过本课程的学习，学生能够将应用光学、物理光学、信息光学、微纳光学专业知识用于解决复杂智能视觉系统的设计问题；学生能够利用应用光学、物理光学、信息光学、微纳光学的基本原理选择适当的智能视觉系统结构，识别、表达、并通过文献研究分析复杂智能视觉系统设计与性能优化的工程问题，以获得有效结论；学生能够具有自主学习和终身学习新型智能视觉系统设计前沿技术的意识，有不断学习和适应发展智能视觉系统设计的能力。
default.en: 《Intelligent Visual System Design》 course is a professional foundation course that covers multiple disciplines and majors such as intelligent visual engineering, optoelectronic information science and engineering, electronic science and technology, optical engineering, etc. It is an important basic course for cultivating advanced specialized talents who can engage in scientific research, teaching, product design, production technology or management work in the fields of intelligent visual engineering, applied optics, optoelectronics, optical information science, electronic information science, and measurement and control. The main teaching purpose of this lesson is to introduce students to the basic theory, knowledge, and methods of intelligent vision system design, as well as the imaging principles, photoelectric conversion principles, imaging links, and optimization methods of various intelligent vision systems. Based on this, practical design case training will be conducted. In the teaching process, attention should be paid to cultivating students' logical thinking ability, practical hands-on ability, and innovative ability. Through the study of this course, students can calculate the performance parameters of intelligent vision systems and analyze their imaging performance based on the optical imaging principles of intelligent vision systems, thereby correctly designing intelligent vision systems. In addition, in research and work, design indicators for optical systems can be proposed for existing intelligent vision systems, and the overall performance of intelligent vision systems can be improved through system optimization. Through the study of this course, students will be able to apply professional knowledge in applied optics, physical optics, information optics, and micro/nano optics to solve design problems of complex intelligent vision systems; Students are able to use the basic principles of applied optics, physical optics, information optics, and micro/nano optics to select appropriate intelligent vision system structures, identify, express, and analyze engineering problems related to the design and performance optimization of complex intelligent vision systems through literature research, in order to obtain effective conclusions; Students have the awareness of self-learning and lifelong learning of cutting-edge technologies in the design of new intelligent visual systems, and have the ability to continuously learn and adapt to the development of intelligent visual system design.

default.zh: 视觉仿真技术课程面向智能视觉工程专业本科开课，是重要的专业基础课程之一，也是学生学习后续专业课的基础。本专业核心课程通过深入探讨视觉仿真技术的前沿发展，涵盖视觉仿真理论基础、材质特性测量建模、蒙特卡洛积分原理、视觉仿真模型构建、光线追迹算法原理、GPU并行实时仿真以及视觉仿真实践方法等基本理论与技术。学生将学习应用数学建模与光线追迹等技术构建复杂场景下的全链路视觉仿真模型，培养解决实际工程问题的能力。通过课程学习，学生将了解视觉仿真技术的基本概念、研究热点、发展趋势和前沿应用，具备分析复杂场景下全链路视觉仿真问题的理论基础，以及利用光线追迹方法进行定量仿真分析的能力。实验方案设计和实验技能训练将逐步提升学生应用视觉仿真技术解决实际工程问题的能力，为今后从事数字孪生、视景仿真等研究奠定理论基础。 课程主要包括绪论、视觉仿真理论基础、材质特性测量建模、蒙特卡洛积分原理、视觉仿真模型构建、光线追迹算法原理、GPU并行实时仿真以及视觉仿真实践等内容。学生将通过课堂学习和动手实践，掌握视觉仿真技术的基本理论、技术方法以及实践技能。考核方式采用累加式方法，包括平时成绩、课堂小测、仿真实验和期末考试，以全面评价学生的学习效果和能力水平。
default.en: The course of visual simulation technology is one of the important basic courses for undergraduate students majoring in intelligent visual engineering, and it is also the basis for students to learn subsequent professional courses. The core course of this major deeply discusses the cutting-edge development of visual simulation technology, covering the basic theories and technologies of visual simulation theory, material property measurement modeling, Monte Carlo integration principle, visual simulation model construction, ray tracing algorithm principle, GPU parallel real-time simulation and visual simulation practice methods. Students will learn to apply techniques such as mathematical modeling and ray tracing to build full-link visual simulation models in complex scenarios and develop the ability to solve practical engineering problems. Through the course study, students will understand the basic concepts, research hotspots, development trends and cutting-edge applications of visual simulation technology, have the theoretical basis for analyzing full-link visual simulation problems in complex scenarios, and the ability to use ray tracing method for quantitative simulation analysis. Experimental scheme design and experimental skill training will gradually improve students' ability to apply visual simulation technology to solve practical engineering problems, and lay a theoretical foundation for future research on digital twin and visual simulation. The course mainly includes introduction, theoretical basis of visual simulation, material property measurement modeling, Monte Carlo integration principle, visual simulation model construction, ray tracing algorithm principle, GPU parallel real-time simulation and visual simulation practice, etc. Students will master the basic theories, technical methods and practical skills of visual simulation technology through classroom learning and hands-on practice. The assessment method is cumulative, including ordinary scores, classroom quizzes, simulation experiments and final exams, so as to comprehensively evaluate students' learning effect and ability level.

default.zh: 航天电子与控制导论课程紧密围绕杰出人才培养目标，以人才培养供给侧改革为抓手，结合航天学院相关专业的发展趋势、专业特点、培养目标、研究内容及应用领域，通过智能视觉工程专业知识、智能视觉军民典型场景中的需求与应用、集成电路设计与集成系统专业知识、航天集成电路技术发展、自动化类专业的发展历程与未来趋势、自动化类专业知识、自动化技术在工业现场中的应用、商业航天控制技术发展等方面的主题式授课，凝练校内专业知识内容，拓展校外前沿知识讲解。使学生对航天学院相关专业的发展趋势、专业特点、培养目标、研究内容及应用领域等形成宏观认识，为后续开展专业知识学习奠定相关基础。
default.en: The course Introduction to Aerospace Electronics and Control is closely aligned with the goal of cultivating outstanding talent. Using supply-side reform in talent training as a key approach, and taking into account the development trends, disciplinary characteristics, training objectives, research content, and application fields of the relevant majors in the School of Astronautics, the course delivers thematic lectures on topics including professional knowledge in intelligent vision engineering; the needs and applications of intelligent vision in typical military and civilian scenarios; professional knowledge in integrated circuit design and integrated systems; developments in aerospace integrated circuit technology; the development history and future trends of automation-related disciplines; professional knowledge in automation; applications of automation technology in industrial settings; and developments in commercial aerospace control technology. The course refines and consolidates on-campus disciplinary knowledge while also expanding students’ horizons through the introduction of cutting-edge developments beyond the university. In this way, it helps students develop a broad understanding of the development trends, disciplinary characteristics, training objectives, research content, and application fields of the majors related to the School of Astronautics, thereby laying the groundwork for their subsequent study of specialized knowledge.

default.zh: 《飞行力学》是工科高等院校控制科学与工程学科或航空宇航科学与技术学科一门专业课程。本课程通过课堂教学和上机实验环节，培养学生运用高等数学、理论力学和空气动力学基础知识进行飞行器制导控制系统动力学建模的能力。 本课程以大气层内拦截导弹为主要背景，讲述飞行力学中常用的坐标系和坐标转换关系、作用在导弹上的气动力和气动力矩的基本特性和数学描述方法、作用在导弹上的反作用推力以及推力产生的反作用力矩的基本性质和数学描述方法、直接侧向力与气动力复合控制导弹的侧向喷流气动干扰效应及其数学描述方法、重力的特性和数学描述方法、大气层内导弹运动方程组的推导方法。学生通过学习飞行力学的基础知识，具备推导任何类型飞行器运动方程组的能力，掌握飞行器制导控制系统的基本建模原理和方法。通过计算机仿真实验，令学生设计大气层内飞行器机动飞行弹道，掌握飞行器质点运动模型的数值求解能力。
default.en: “Flight Dynamics” is a specialized course for engineering students who are major in Control Science and Engineering or Science and Technology in Aeronautics and Astronautics in technical universities. Via lectures and computer experiments, the purpose of this course is to train the students to have the capability of establishing dynamic mathematical models to describe the motions of flight vehicles via using knowledge on advanced mathematics, theoretical mechanics, and aerodynamics. The typical background of this course is that an endo-atmospheric interceptor missile intercepting a maneuvering target. Based on the motion of this interceptor missile, some normal coordinates and coordinates transformations in flight dynamics are introduced. Then the properties and mathematical descriptions of aerodynamic forces and the moments yielded by aerodynamic forces are given. Next, the properties and mathematical descriptions of reaction propulsion and its moments are presented. It follows that the properties of aerodynamic disturbance effect on side direction reaction propulsion are analyzed and a mathematical description for this effect is given. Moreover, the gravity on the missile is studied and mathematically depicted. Using the above results, equations to describe the missile motion are derived from the principles of Newton’s mechanics. Via studying the above knowledge on flight dynamics, the students will master the fundamental principle and method of modeling the flight motion and so have the capability of deriving motion equations for any type of flight vehicles. In computer simulation experiments, the students will design maneuvering flight paths of an aircraft, such that they are able to obtain numerical solutions for flight motions.

default.zh: 《飞行器控制与制导》是工科高等院校控制科学与工程学科或航空宇航科学与技术学科一门专业课程，本课程的主要任务是通过课堂教学、实验教学及上机实验等环节培养学生建立面向控制系统设计的飞行器运动数学模型的能力，以及运用自动控制理论知识设计飞行器制导控制系统的能力。 本课程以大气层内拦截导弹拦截空中机动目标为典型背景，在已经建立起拦截导弹全弹道运动数学模型的基础上，讲授导弹制导控制系统的分析、设计和仿真方法。导弹制导控制系统总体设计方面的内容包括：导弹制导控制系统的基本组成；制导控制系统设计的基本阶段和步骤。导弹控制系统设计方面的内容包括：导弹运动方程组的简化；导弹稳定控制系统设计中的线性控制方法；导弹稳定控制系统设计中的非线性控制方法；新型导弹稳定控制系统设计技术的发展趋势。导弹制导律设计方面的内容包括：古典导引规律分析，即追踪法、平行接近法、比例导引法及改进的比例导引法；导弹导引头探测目标并输出制导信息的基本工作原理；导弹现代导引规律设计方法，即线性二次型最优制导律及微分对策制导律、变结构制导律、非线性制导律等。
default.en: “Flight Control and Guidance” is a specialized course for engineering students who are major in Control Science and Engineering or Science and Technology in Aeronautics and Astronautics in technical universities. Via lectures and computer experiments, the purpose of this course is to train the students to have the capability of establishing mathematical models to describe the motions of flight vehicles for the design of flight control systems and the capability of designing flight control systems using knowledge on control theories. The typical background of this course is that an endo-atmospheric interceptor missile intercepts a flying target with maneuvers. Based on some missile motion models and target-missile relative motion models, some methods to analyze and design missile guidance and control systems are presented, and some methods to simulate missile guidance and control systems are practiced here. In essence, this course presents the constitution of a missile guidance and control system and the basic phase of designing the system. In order to practice the design of missile control system, the equations to describe missile motions are simplified and linearized. Some missile autopilot design methods such as classical design method in frequency domain and modern design method using Linear Quadratic Regulator are presented. Moreover, detailed analyses of classical guidance laws are provided, such as target pursuit approach，parallel Line-of-sight approach, Proportional Navigation Guidance Law and its modifications. In meanwhile the principle of how target seekers work is introduced. Finally, some modern guidance laws, such as Linear quadratic optimal guidance law, differential games guidance law, sliding-mode guidance law and nonlinear guidance law are presented.

default.zh: 随着社会的进步、经济和科技的不断发展，人类已经将活动范围扩展到外太空，并且加快了迈向整个宇宙的步伐，进而推动了航天事业的迅猛发展。作为航天工程的重要组成部分，航天器控制技术是航天器完成特定的空间探测、开发以及应用任务的有效保障。控制系统的性能直接影响着航天器自身的在轨寿命、工作性能甚至任务的成败。通过本课程，使得学生掌握航天器控制系统主要组成、基本工作原理以及未来的发展方向，并注重培养学生对航天器控制问题的研究兴趣，为今后继续从事相关研究奠定基础。
default.en: With the progress of society as well as the continuous development of the economy, science and technology, humanity has already extended their activities to outer space, and accelerated the pace towards the entire universe, thus promoting the rapid development of the space industry. As an important subsystem of aerospace engineering, effective spacecraft control is an important guarantee for spacecraft to complete certain specific space exploration, development, and application tasks effectively. The performance of the spacecraft control system has important meaning for spacecraft on-orbit life, operating characteristics or even success of space missions. By learning this course, the students are expected to grasp the composition of spacecraft control system, fundamental working principle, as well as the development direction in the future. It also focuses on fostering students’ interests on spacecraft control problems, and lays the foundations for future scientific research activities.

default.zh: 现代导航传感器技术与实践是探测制导与控制专业本科生的核心专业课，是学生从事探测制导与控制领域研究工作的基础。本课程利用授课教师所在中心科研设备包括惯性传感器、视觉传感器、北斗（GPS）、磁传感器等传感器和无人机、无人车等运行载体，搭建专业理论与工程实践高度结合的学习和研究平台，增强学生对导航传感器基础理论理解和实际工程应用的掌握，培养和提高学生动手实践和自主创新能力。
default.en: Modern Navigation Sensor Technology and Practice is the core professional course for undergraduate students majoring in detection guidance and control, which is the foundation for students to engage in research work in the field of detection guidance and control. This course utilizes the scientific research equipment of Sapce Control and Inertial Technology Research Cente , including inertial sensors, visual sensors, Beidou (GPS), magnetic sensors, and operational carriers such as drones and unmanned vehicles. These help establish a learning and research platform that highly integrates professional theory and engineering practice to enhance students' understanding of the basic theory of navigation sensors and practical engineering applications, and cultivate and improve their hands-on practice and independent innovation abilities.

default.zh: 《飞行器先进制导与控制》是探测制导与控制技术专业的重要课程，也是自动化专业导航制导与控制模块的关键组成，旨在培养学生对于飞行器先进制导控制系统的分析、设计、综合等能力。课程围绕飞行器先进制导与控制技术，主要讲授四部分内容：①飞行器数学建模，包括飞行器建模基础和典型模型；②飞行器先进姿态控制技术，包括基于动态逆的姿态控制和基于反步法的姿态控制；③飞行器先进制导技术，包括标称轨迹再入制导、预测校正制导和准平衡滑翔制导；④飞行器先进制导控制一体化技术，包括基于高阶模型的制导控制一体化和基于降阶模型的制导控制一体化。通过本课程的课堂教学以及后续的实验环节，学生将较为全面地认识飞行器先进制导与控制技术。
default.en: Advanced Guidance and Control of Flight Vehicles is an important course in the Detection Guidance and Control major and a key component of the navigation guidance and control module of the Automation major. It aims to cultivate students' abilities in analysis, design, and synthesis of advanced guidance and control systems for flight vehicles. The course focuses on advanced guidance and control technologies and mainly teaches four parts: ① mathematical modeling of flight vehicles, including modeling basics and typical models; ② advanced attitude control technologies of flight vehicles, including attitude control strategies based on dynamic inverse and back-stepping control; ③ advanced guidance technologies of flight vehicles, including nominal trajectory-based re-entry guidance, predictor-corrector guidance and quasi-equilibrium gliding guidance; ④ advanced integrated guidance and control (IG&C) of flight vehicles, including IG&C strategies based on full-order model and reduced-order model. Through the theoretical teaching and subsequent experimental session of this course, students will have a more comprehensive understanding of advanced guidance and control technologies of flight vehicles.

default.zh: 视觉导航原理与实践是控制科学与工程学科的一门比较重要的基础理论和工程实践相结合的专业选修课，在培养学生创造性思维、综合设计能力和导航制导工程实践能力等方面占有重要的地位。 本课程主要以智能移动机器人为授课对象，主要讲述机器人在未知环境下的位姿估计和环境地图构建方面的基础理论知识和工程实际应用算法。本课程的教学内容既包含了大量视觉导航方面的基本理论，又包含了许多与应用设计相关的基本设计方法，帮助学生建立一个视觉导航的基本知识框架。 课程以主讲教师承担的智能机器人领域科研项目为背景，以实验室已具备的仪器和自主研发的系统样机为依托，通过理论学习和实验设计，增强学生对智能机器人视觉导航系统基础知识的理解，增强对智能机器人领域的研究兴趣，提高学生自主创新能力和技术应用水平。为学生将来进一步从事与机器人导航、智能视频监控、飞行器末制导和视觉伺服等方面的研究和工作打下坚实的基础。同时，通过学习视觉导航原理与实践技术，完成对现有的传统导航技术的补充。
default.en: Principle and Practice of Visual Navigation is a professional elective course that combines the basic theory and engineering practice of controlling science and engineering disciplines. It plays an important role in cultivating students' creative thinking, comprehensive design ability and navigation guidance engineering practice ability. This course mainly focuses on intelligent mobile robots. It mainly introduces the basic theoretical knowledge and engineering application algorithms of mobile robots pose estimation and environment map construction under unknown environments. The content of this course covers a large number of basic theories of visual navigation, and contains many basic design methods related to application design to help students establish a basic knowledge framework for visual navigation. The course is based on the research projects of the intelligent robots undertaken by the lecturer. Based on the instruments already in the laboratory and the self-developed system prototype, the students can understand the basic knowledge of the intelligent robots visual navigation system through theoretical study and experimental design. To enhance research interest in the field of robots and improve students' independent innovation ability and technology application level. It will lay a solid foundation for students to further research and work in robot navigation, intelligent video surveillance, aircraft terminal guidance and visual serving. At the same time, by learning principle and practice of visual navigation, the existing traditional navigation technology is complemented.

default.zh: 数字图像处理是自动化类专业的一门专业基础课，也是面向视觉感知与认知、智能无人系统领域的一门专业课。 学生通过数字图像处理课程的学习，能够掌握数字图像处理的基本概念、理论、方法和技术，包括数字图像的数学描述、空频域变换、图像增强与复原、图像的表达与描述、图像分割与目标检测、目标的跟踪等内容，并了解本领域最新发展成果与动态。通过本课程的课堂教学、实例演示、实验操作以及计算机仿真等环节的培养，着重培养学生对数字图像处理系统的综合分析与设计能力，实际的动手与实践能力，以及相关科学知识的综合运用能力，增强学生的创新意识，支撑专业学习成果中相应指标点的达成。
default.en: Digital image processing is a fundamental course in automation majors, as well as a specialized course in the fields of visual perception and cognition, and intelligent unmanned systems. Through the study of digital image processing courses，the students can master the basic concepts, theories, methods and techniques of this course, including mathematical description of digital images, spatial frequency domain transform, image enhancement and restoration, image representation and description,image segmentation and object detection, object tracking et al. At the same time, the students can know and understand the latest developments in the field. Through the training of classroom teaching, experimental demonstration and operation, computer simulation, this course focuses on the cultivation of the students' comprehensive analysis and design ability of digital image processing system and practical ability. On the other hand, the course can promote the students’ the comprehensive utilization ability of related theoretical knowledge, enhance students' awareness of innovation.

default.zh: 本课程是一门综合性强，在理论与实践相上多学科交叉，强调控制系统设计工程化的一门专业课。 本课程讲解常见的直流电动机和交流电动机的拖动工作原理和控制系统设计方法，建立电动机运动控制系统的运动学和动力学数学模型，利用自动控制理论的基本原理和分析方法对其进行分析。直流电机部分的主要课程内容包括速度反馈单闭环控制系统设计、电流速度双闭环系统的基本结构和工程设计方法等。交流电机部分则主要分析交流电动机的速度控制方法，研究和掌握矢量控制和直接转矩控制的基本原理。然后在此基础上，本课程以转台例具体讲解一类实际伺服运动控制系统。 本课程着眼于提高学生解决运动控制系统设计中的工程实际问题的能力。
default.en: This course is a professional course which has strong comprehensiveness. It is multidisciplinary in theory and practice. It lays stress on engineering designing of control system. This course studies the driving principle and motion control system design of electrical machines, including direct current motor and asynchronous current motor, builds the kinematics and dynamics model of motor motion control system ,and analyzes the control system by applying the theory and analysis method of Automatic Control Principle. For the direct current motor, the main contents include the speed closed loop design of electrical machine, the structure of the current and speed double closed loop and the engineering design methods. For the asynchronous current motor, the course mainly analyzes the speed control method and studies the principle of the vector control and direct torque control. And on these bases, this course studies one kind of practical Servo motion control system taking Turn-table as an example This course looks at improving the students’ ability of analyzing and solving realistic engineering problems of motion control system.

default.zh: 过程控制面向自动化专业类学生开设，是一门与实际生产过程联系十分密切的课程，是自动控制理论、自动控制实践课程的延伸和发展。课程主要讲授过程控制系统的组成、基本分析设计步骤与设计方法，以及过程控制中的建模方法与仪表选用等内容。章节包括过程控制概述、检测与变送仪表、执行器、过程建模和PID控制系统、串级控制系统、前馈控制系统、大时延控制系统、解耦控制系统的分析与设计以及模型预测控制。重点是使学生知道如何将控制理论与系统实际结合、熟悉掌握过程控制系统的常用设计方法、并知晓这些设计方法的使用场合。课程采用累加式考试方式，包括平时课堂表现、课程报告及实验报告。
default.en: Process Control is an elective course of automation, and it's closely related to the actual production process, and is the extension and development of automatic control theory and automatic control practice course. The course mainly introduces the composition of process control system, basic analysis and design methods, as well as modeling methods and instrument selection in process control. This course includes an overview of process control, detection and transmitter, actuator, process modeling, the analysis and design of PID control system, cascade control system, feedforward control system, time-delay control system, and decoupling control system, as well as model predictive control. The key is to let students know how to combine control theory with system reality, familiar with the common design methods of process control system, and know how to use these design methods. The course adopts accumulative examination method, including daily classroom performance, course reports, and experimental report.

default.zh: 《汽车动力学与控制》课程是为控制科学与工程学科及相关专业学生的发展而开设的，旨在拓宽学生视野，激发科研兴趣，锻炼科研能力。本课程介绍了汽车动力学建模的基础理论、轮胎力学及汽车空气动力学；重点介绍以纵向运动为主的驱动动力学和制动动力学，以及以垂向运动为主的行驶动力学和以侧向运动为主操纵动力学等内容。本课程结合实际工程项目开发经验，从动力学分析与建模、控制系统分析与设计和仿真验证几个方面讲授车辆驱动、制动、悬架系统的动力学与控制相关内容。通过本课程的学习，使学生了解汽车系统动力学研究的主要内容，熟悉系统建模的基础理论、轮胎力学和空气动力学的基础，掌握纵向、垂向和侧向动力学的建模和分析方法以及三向动力学对整车性能的影响，了解车辆计算机建模与仿真相关的软件；引导学生学习运用动力学、运动学知识建立汽车模型和仿真分析汽车动态特性的方法，掌握汽车系统动力学分析与建模、以及控制器设计和应用的基本思路，以此培养学生解决科学、工程问题的能力；使学生理解汽车技术与国民经济、环境、社会、可持续发展的关系，了解未来技术发展趋势和主要特点，为其今后从事相关领域的工程设计工作打下良好的理论、技术和实验基础。
default.en: The course ‘Vehicle Dynamics and Control' is designed for the development of students in the fields of control science and engineering. It aims to broaden students' horizons, stimulate their research interests, and exercise their research abilities. This course introduces the basic theory of automotive dynamics modeling, tire mechanics, and automotive aerodynamics. It focuses on the driving dynamics and braking dynamics dominated by longitudinal motion, as well as the driving dynamics dominated by vertical motion and the control dynamics dominated by lateral motion. This course combines practical engineering project development experience to teach the dynamics and control related content of vehicle driving, braking, and suspension systems from the aspects of dynamic analysis and modeling, control system analysis and design, and simulation verification. Through the study of this course, students will understand the main content of automotive system dynamics research, become familiar with the basic theories of system modeling, tire mechanics, and aerodynamics, master the modeling and analysis methods of longitudinal, vertical, and lateral dynamics, as well as the impact of three-dimensional dynamics on overall vehicle performance, and understand software related to vehicle computer modeling and simulation. It guides students to learn the methods of using dynamics and kinematics knowledge to establish car models and simulate and analyze their dynamic characteristics, master the basic ideas of car system dynamics analysis and modeling, as well as controller design and application, in order to cultivate students' ability to solve scientific and engineering problems. It enables students to understand the relationship between automotive technology and national economy, environment, society, and sustainable development, understand the future trends and main characteristics of technological development, and lay a solid theoretical, technical, and experimental foundation for their future engineering design work in related fields.

default.zh: 博弈论自从诞生以后快速发展，不仅其理论日臻成熟完善，而且应用范围日益广泛。博弈论的应用已涵盖经济学、生物学、社会与管理科学、军事与决策理论、计算机、 人工智能等，特别是它与控制论的相互影响和促进。博弈论或者控制论属于普适性的学科，与传统的物理学、力学或数学等不同, 控制与博弈不仅要认识世界, 而且更重要地是能动地改造世界。控制与博弈之间有着深刻的内在联系：控制论所处理的对象主要是机器等没有智能的力学系统，目的是设计控制，让客观事物按照控制者的主观愿望运行；而博弈可以看作控制的延伸或发展，它所控制的对象是有智能的。对象可能有着不同的目标，这就形成了非合作博弈；对象也可能同你合作，但必需兼顾它的利益，这就形成了合作博弈。未来的被控对象范围将更为广泛，无人驾驶、移动机器人、可以在线规划弹道的飞行器等均可被视为有智能的被控对象。作为控制论与博弈论的交叉学科，基于博弈的控制理论与控制导向的博弈理论，可望成为一个从理论到应用都极具重要性的交叉学科发展方向。 本课程的研究对象是博弈论，为自动化类的本科生开设。课程希望能够使得学生了解和掌握博弈方面的基本概念、相关理论方法和最新研究成果，实现博弈论与实际应用的交叉结合，内容强调基础理论以及前沿性与探索性，课程具体目标包括： (1)使学生了解和掌握博弈论的基本思想、理论和方法，能够在自动化领域的系统建模中运用博弈论的思想和方法。 (2)启发学生能够使用博弈论方法思考，能够应用博弈论的模型、基本理论和方法分析和解决实际问题，并通过文献研究，从系统的角度对自动化领域的自主系统工程问题进行建模和分析，以获得有效结论。 (3)训练学生能够针对自动化领域的系统工程问题，基于博弈论方法设计和开发适当的解决方案，设计满足特定需求的系统，并能够在设计环节中体现创新意识,使得学生在未来控制领域的工作与研究活动中更具有竞争力。 (4)通过上机实验课培养学生对相关编程语言、数据结构和算法的使用。
default.en: Game theory has rapidly developed, not only maturing and improving its theories but also expanding its applications. The application of game theory has covered various fields, including economics, biology, social and management sciences, military and decision theory, computer science, artificial intelligence, and especially its mutual influence and promotion with control theory. Game theory and control theory belong to universal disciplines, unlike traditional disciplines such as physics, mechanics, or mathematics. Control and game theory not only aim to understand the world but, more importantly, to actively transform it. There is a profound intrinsic connection between control and game theory: control theory primarily deals with non-intelligent mechanical systems such as machines, aiming to design controls that make objective things operate according to the subjective desires of the controller. On the other hand, game theory can be seen as an extension or development of control, controlling intelligent objects with different objectives, leading to non-cooperative games, and cooperative games where the object must balance its interests. The scope of controlled objects in the future will be broader, encompassing intelligent controlled objects such as unmanned vehicles, robots, and flying machines capable of planning trajectories online. As an interdisciplinary field at the intersection of control and game theory, control theory based on games and game theory oriented towards control is expected to become an extremely important direction of interdisciplinary development, both in theory and application. This course focuses on the study of game theory and is designed for undergraduate students majoring in control. This course aims to enable students to understand and grasp the basic concepts, relevant theoretical methods, and the latest research results in game theory, achieving an interdisciplinary combination of game theory and practical applications. The course emphasizes both fundamental theory and cutting-edge explorations, with specific objectives including: (1) Enabling students to understand and grasp the fundamental ideas, theories, and methods of game theory, allowing them to apply the ideas and methods of game theory in system modeling in the field of automation. (2) Inspiring students to think using game theory methods, applying models, basic theories, and methods of game theory to analyze and solve practical problems, and conducting literature research from a systematic perspective to model and analyze engineering problems of autonomous systems in the field of automation, in order to obtain effective conclusions. (3) Training students to design and develop appropriate solutions based on game theory methods for engineering problems in the field of automation, designing systems that meet specific requirements, and demonstrating innovative thinking in the design process, making students more competitive in their future work and research activities in the field of control. (4) Cultivating students' abilities to use tools including computer programming, data structure and algorithms through practical lab sessions.

default.zh: 机器人学是一门高度交叉的前沿学科，它的巨大进步和应用是二十世纪自动控制最有说服力的成就，并随着各相关领域的技术进步，在生产加工制造、医疗、服务等众多行业得到了越来越广泛的成功应用。本课程为机器人学的基础课程，为自动化类专业本科生掌握工业机械臂的基本特性、掌握对其进行分析、设计和控制的基本方法以及从事相关研究奠定基础。通过本课程的学习，学生将掌握机器人的概念、种类和分类方法，了解机器人学的研究领域及其发展方向，掌握机器人数学描述、机器人运动学、动力学、轨迹规划的基本分析方法，并掌握简单的机器人控制方法。学习本课程将为进一步学习机器人学课程提供有效的基础和承接。
default.en: Robotics is a highly interdisciplinary and cutting-edge discipline, and its tremendous progress and application are the most convincing achievements of automatic control in the 20th century. With the technological progress in various related fields, it has been widely and successfully applied in many industries such as production, processing, manufacturing, healthcare, and services. This course is a fundamental course in robotics, laying the foundation for undergraduate students majoring in automation to master the basic characteristics of industrial robotic arms, master the basic methods of analyzing, designing, and controlling them, and engage in related research. Through the study of this course, students will master the concepts, types, and classification methods of robots, understand the research fields and development directions of robotics, master the basic analysis methods of robot mathematical description, robot kinematics, dynamics, and trajectory planning, and master simple robot control methods. Studying this course will provide an effective foundation and continuation for further learning of robotics courses.

default.zh: 随着数字技术的发展和成熟，自动控制系统从已经从模拟系统过渡到数字系统，数字信号处理的能力是本科生应该具备的能力之一。数字信号处理课程主要为自动化及探测与制导专业的本科三年级学生开设，课程主要讲授数字信号处理的基本理论和方法。本课程的主要内容分为离散信号及系统的时域分析方法、变换域分析方法以及时域离散系统的设计方法两大部分。时域分析方法主要包括典型序列及其表示和运算、系统的时域表示和时域特性分析，线性常系数差分方程的求解，信号的采样及重建等；变换域分析方法主要包括离散时间傅立叶变换（DTFT），周期序列的傅立叶级数（DFS），离散傅立叶变换（DFT）及快速傅立叶变换算法（FFT）；离散系统的设计部分包括数字滤波器的结构、无限冲激响应（IIR）和有限冲激响应（FIR）滤波器的设计方法。此外，本课程将结合实际系统，介绍数字信号处理理论的应用实例。由于数字信号处理的基本理论涉及到很多抽象的数学推导过程，为了使学生对理论知识有更具象的了解，本课程还将结合MWorks软件在课堂上做图形及动画演示，介绍使用MWorks软件进行简单数字信号处理的方法。
default.en: With the development and maturity of digital technology, the automatic control system has been transferred from analog system to digital system. The ability of digital signal processing should be mastered by the undergraduate students. The course of Digital Signal Processing is designed for junior students of specialty of automation, detection, and guidance. This course is mainly about the basic theory and method of digital signal processing. The main contents of this course can be divided into two parts: the method of time-domain analysis and transform-domain analysis of discrete signal and system; and the designing method of discrete system. The time-domain analysis method mainly includes the analysis of typical sequences and their time-domain representation and operation; the time-domain representation and characteristics of systems; the solution of linear constant coefficient difference equation; the sampling and reconstruction theory of signal, etc. The transform domain analysis methods mainly include the discrete-time Fourier transform (DTFT), the discrete Fourier series (DFS), the discrete Fourier transform (DFT), and the fast Fourier transform algorithm (FFT); the design of the discrete system including the structure of digital filter; the designing methods of infinite impulse response (IIR) and finite impulse response (FIR) filter. In addition, the application of digital signal processing theory in the actual system will be introduced. The basic theory of digital signal processing involves many abstract mathematical derivations, in order to enable the students to have a more concrete understanding of theoretical knowledge, this course also introduces MWorks software to demonstrate graphics and animation, and the methods of simple digital signal processing using MWorks software.

default.zh: 本课程是自动控制专业的一门专业选修课程，同时它也是一门实践性和工程性很强的课程。通过本课程的教学使学生掌握硬件描述语言Verilog HDL的设计方法，能够进行初步的基于FPGA器件的数字系统设计，为学生以后从事控制领域的工程开发打下坚实的基础。 本课程的目标是提供足够的FPGA及其设计方法的信息，让学生实现良好的FPGA设计，并能够验证结果的正确性。由于课程时间紧张，所以本课程没有涵盖Verilog HDL全部特性，而是向学生展示如何简洁，高效，正确的利用Verilog语言描述硬件设计。 本课程采用累加式考核方法，包括随堂作业、综合实验及综合报告，以此培养学生的创新思维能力。我们将把科研项目中遇到的具体问题结合到教学中，使学生对FPGA技术产生了浓厚的兴趣。
default.en: This course is a professional elective course of the automatic control, at the same time is also a very practical and engineering course. Through the teaching of this course to enable students to master the hardware description language Verilog HDL design methodology, carry out the preliminary digital systems design based on the FPGA device, lay a solid foundation for students engaged in the field of control engineering development in the future. The goal of this course is to provide sufficient information of the FPGA and its design method to enable students to achieve good FPGA design, and be able to verify the correctness of the results. Course time constraints, this course does not cover all the features of Verilog HDL, but rather to show the students how to write concise, efficient, and correct Verilog descriptions of hardware designs. This course adopts an accumulative method, including Quiz exams, comprehensive experiment and comprehensive reports, in order to train the students' creative thinking ability. The specific problems encountered in research projects will be incorporated into teaching. So that students had a strong interest in the FPGA technology.
