default.zh: 《快速控制原型与硬件在环仿真技术》是一门应用性强、实践为主的课程，是为控制科学与工程学科及相关专业学生的发展而开设的，主要是对基于模型设计这一国际先进开发理念的培养和普及，是控制系统实践过程的重要环节。讲授内容是目前国际上控制系统设计的重要方法，将基于模型的功能设计和后续实践验证无缝连接，从而提高开发效率。快速控制原型是将算法模型编译后下载到特定仿真硬件平台中实时运行并控制实际对象，从而可以快速验证和修改设计算法，降低开发周期和成本。当控制器设计完成后，需在闭环下对其进行详细测试。由于可能面临极限测试、失效测试或在真实环境中测试费用较昂贵等问题，硬件在环仿真技术成为一个行之有效的方式。硬件在环仿真利用特定仿真硬件平台在实验室中模拟对象在实际工作条件下的运动过程，来达到全面验证控制器开发质量及控制算法可靠程度，降低测试周期和成本，提高测试的安全性。本课程的主要任务是通过课堂教学及亲手实践，使学生们掌握快速控制原型与硬件在环仿真技术的建立方法以及在控制系统设计中的应用，培养学生的理论联系实际、并解决问题的能力。
default.en: Rapid Control Prototype (RCP) and Hardware in the Loop (HIL) Simulation Technology is a highly applied and practical course designed for the development of students in the field of control science and engineering and related majors. It mainly cultivates and popularizes the international advanced development concept of model-based design, and is an important part of the practical process of control systems. The teaching content is currently an important method for control system design internationally, seamlessly connecting model based functional design and subsequent practical verification to improve development efficiency. RCP is a system that compiles and downloads algorithm models to a specific simulation hardware platform for real-time operation and control of actual objects, enabling rapid verification and modification of design algorithms, reducing development cycles and costs. After the controller design is completed, it needs to be tested in detail in a closed-loop system. Due to potential challenges such as extreme testing, failure testing, or high testing costs in real-world environments, HIL simulation technology has become an effective approach. HIL utilizes computer hardware platforms to simulate the motion process of objects under actual working conditions in the laboratory, in order to comprehensively verify the quality of controller development and the reliability of control algorithms, reduce testing cycles and costs, and improve testing safety. The main task of this course is to enable students to master the methods of establishing RCP and HIL simulation technology, as well as their application in control system design, through classroom teaching and hands-on practice, and to cultivate their ability to connect theory with practice and solve problems.

default.zh: 《新能源功率变换器原理及控制技术》是一门主要介绍变换器在新能源系统中如何应用的课程。它主要包括基本电力转换器件介绍、交-直流变换器原理与控制、直-直流变换器原理与控制以及直-交流变换器原理与控制四大部分，全面涵盖了最基本的电流电压变换拓扑形式。目前，功率变换器作为电力系统中不可或缺的部分，对变换器工作原理的熟练掌握有助于学生建立牢固的电力电子技术基础知识，了解最新的功率变换器技术前沿，为后续的专业研究提供理论和技术保障。
default.en: 《Fundamental and Control of Power Converter in New Energy Systems》 is a course that focuses on how converters are used in new energy systems. It mainly consists of four parts: introduction of basic power conversion devices, AC-DC converter principle and control, DC-DC converter principle and control, and DC-AC converter principle and control, which comprehensively cover the most basic current-voltage converter topology forms. At present, power converter as an indispensable part of the power system, a good grasp of the working principle of the converter will help students to establish a solid basic knowledge of power electronics technology, understand the latest power converter technology frontier, and provide theoretical and technical protection for the subsequent professional research.

default.zh: 塑性力学研究物体在塑性屈服状态下材料的本构关系和塑性区域发展变化及破坏规律，是一门既有较强的理论性、又有较高实用价值的专业课，也是工程力学、材料塑性加工等专业的一门必修课。其主要内容有：塑性变形基本特征和经典塑性本构模型，桁架的拉压弹塑性变形，粱的弯曲弹塑性变形，粱和刚架的塑性极限载荷分析，应力应变状态分析，塑性屈服条件，塑性本构基础，简单弹塑性问题，柱体扭转及沙堆比拟等。其前期课程有《理论力学》、《材料力学》、《弹性力学》等。通过课程学习，学生可了解塑性力学的经典内容及其在工程中的典型应用，从而培养分析问题和解决问题的能力。
default.en: Plasticity is a subject that addresses the constitutive relations, development of plastic regions and failure behaviors of material under plastic yielding. It is a professional course being highly theoretical and practical at the same time, and is compulsory for students of engineering mechanics and plastic working. The main contents covered in the course are as follows: the characters of plastic deformation and classic plastic constitutive models, the plastic tension/compression in truss, plastic bending in beams, analysis of plastic ultimate load of beams and frames, stress and strain state analysis, plastic yielding conditions, basics of plastic constitutive relations, simple elastic-plastic problems, torsion of bars and sand-heap analogy, etc. The prerequisite courses are theoretical mechanics, mechanics of materials, and elasticity. Students will learn in this course the classics of plasticity and their typical applications in engineering, through which skills of analysis and problem solving will be strengthened.

default.zh: 非线性振动基础是立志于航空航天动力学与控制问题研究的工程力学专业学生的一门重要课程。主要内容包括单自由度系统非线性振动的基础知识，涉及研究非线性振动问题的定性理论（如稳定性理论、相平面分析等）和定量方法（如Lindstedt-Poincare摄动技术、平均法和多尺度法等）。课程内容还涉及到非线性振动理论与方法在航空航天领域实际问题的应用等方面。
default.en: Nonlinear Vibration is an important course for undergraduates aspiring to study Dynamics and Control in Aeronautics and Astronautics majoring in Engineering Mechanics. This course provides a fundamental coverage of nonlinear vibrations of single-degree-of-freedom systems. Qualitative theory (e.g., stability analysis, phase plane analysis) and quantitative methods (e.g., Lindstedt-Poincare perturbation techniques, Average method, Multiple scale method) will be illustrated in detail. Applications of the methodologies to practical systems in the fields of Aeronautics and Astronautics will be addressed.

default.zh: 随着计算机及大数据和人工智能的飞速发展，科学工程计算在自然与社会科学和工程技术等许多领域有着广泛的应用，是解决诸如热学、力学、电磁学、经济和金融等问题的重要手段。《计算方法》课程也叫《数值分析》是数学、土木和人工智能等理工科众多专业的一门必修的基础课程。通过本课程的学习，使学生基本掌握计算方法的基本知识、方法及其原理，培养学生的分析、判断、计算和实验能力，使其基本具备应用计算机从事科学和工程计算的能力，为继续学习专业课程奠定基础。
default.en: With the rapid development of computers, big data and artificial intelligence, scientific engineering computing has been widely applied in many fields such as natural and social sciences and engineering technology. It is an important means to solve problems such as heat, mechanics, electromagnetics, economics, and finance. The course "Computational Methods", also known as "Numerical Analysis", is a compulsory basic course for many science and engineering majors such as mathematics, civil engineering and artificial intelligence. Through studying this course, students will be able to master the basic knowledge, methods and principles of computational methods. This course can also cultivate the students’ analytical, judgmental, computational and experimental abilities with the ability to apply computers in scientific and engineering calculations. In particular, this course can lay the foundation for continuing learning professional courses.

default.zh: 应用软件工程是工程力学专业一门实践型专业课，学生在掌握了力学基础和力学专业先修课程内容后，应具备应用大型通用有限元软件解决实际工程力学问题的能力。本课程应教会学生掌握应用Ansys有限元软件的技能，同时介绍其他通用有限元软件的共同特点，启发学生自主学习其它大型有限元软件。 课程主要内容包括Ansys基本功能简介、结构分析的基本过程、几何建模、网格划分、加载和求解、结果后处理、结构静力分析、结构动力分析、结构非线性静力分析、复合材料结构分析等。 通过本课程的学习，学生能够掌握现代计算机大型软件计算和分析工具使用方法和理论，能够对复杂工程问题进行预测与模拟，为学生完成毕业论文和毕业后工作打下坚实基础。
default.en: Engineering of Applied Software is a professional practical course. The students should have the ability to utilize the finite element software solve the mechanics problem after they learn the basic and professional mechanical courses. This course will teach the students how to use the software package - ANSYS. We will also introduce the characteristic of other software and enlighten the technical ability of using other large-scale software. The main content includes the basic concept of the finite element analyses, the basic operation method of Ansys which includes preprocess procedures, modeling and meshing, loading and solution, post processing, structural static analysis, modal analysis, structural nonlinear static analysis, composite structures analysis. The characteristic of this course is that teaches only the essential and ensures plenty of practice. Students should practice after the teacher taught the main content. The course is taken in the computer laboratory. The students can master the method and theory to use the modern computer large-scale software. They can also predict and simulate the complex engineering problems. Study of this course will be beneficial to the thesis and job after their graduation from the school for the students.

default.zh: 复合材料结构设计是复合材料与工程本科生专业的选修课。本课程进一步讲解复合材料力学基础，复合材料结构设计基础以及典型复合材料结构设计等课程内容。为了充分发挥复合材料可设计性特点，本课程利用复合材料力学基础知识对复合材料典型结构设计，培养学生具备针对具体环境使用对复合材料结构进行分析和设计的能力，提高解决实际工程中复合材料结构设计问题的能力。
default.en: Composite material structure design is an elective course for undergraduates majoring in composite materials and engineering. This course further explains the mechanics foundation of composite materials, the design foundation of composite structures and the design of typical composite structures. In order to exert the design characteristics of composite materials, this course utilizes the basic knowledge of composite mechanics to design typical composite structures, cultivates students'ability to analyze and design composite structures used in the specific environment, and improves the ability to solve the design problems of composite structures in engineering.

default.zh: 本课程介绍超材料的基本概念、分类、不同功能、设计方法，包括五零模超材料、手性超材料、非局部效应超材料、声学超材料、热超材料等，详解其超常规功能以及主要设计、试验方法。使学生对超材料建立初步、全面的认识，并掌握基本的设计方法，培养其科研兴趣。
default.en: This course introduces the basic concepts, classifications, different functions, and design methods of metamaterials, including pentamode metamaterials, chiral metamaterials, non-local metamaterials, acoustic and thermal metamaterials, etc. Samples are prepared and experiments are conducted. Through this course, students will establish a preliminary and comprehensive understanding on metamaterials, design methods, and cultivate interests in scientific research.

default.zh: 该课程主要是引导学生从单纯的上课学习，向从事科学研究转变。引导同学们规划自己的学业生涯的和未来发展方向。课程通过示范性讲解，分享成功人士的经验和教训。课程重点介绍读研过程中涉及到的文献检索方法、文章/专利撰写方法、实验/计算工作经验、项目申请/报告撰写、论文开题/中期/答辩、沟通交流/团队合作方式、情感生活等一系列可能问题的解决方法和建议，帮助新生答疑解惑。激发学生的学习热情，训练学术基本素养。
default.en: The main purpose of this course is to guide students from simple classroom learning to engaging in scientific research. Guide students to plan their academic career and future development direction. The course shares the experiences and lessons of successful individuals through exemplary explanations. The course focuses on introducing literature retrieval methods, article/patent writing methods, experimental/computational work experience, project application/report writing, paper proposal/mid-term/defense, communication and communication/team cooperation methods, emotional life, and a series of possible problem-solving methods and suggestions involved in the postgraduate study process, to help freshmen answer questions and doubts. Stimulate students' enthusiasm for learning and train their basic academic literacy.

default.zh: 鉴于航天器敏感元件与执行机构是航天器控制系统的基本组成和设计关键，本课程重点讲述如太阳敏感器、星敏感器、惯性敏感器、冷气推进器、电推进、飞轮、控制力矩陀螺等常用敏感元件和执行机构，具体阐述其工作原理、分类、特点、测试以及应用等，并辅以实物演示，让学生对航天器姿态控制系统的设计有一个较为全面的了解和认知。通过本课程的学习，为将来从事航天领域科研和研究，特别是从事航天器总体设计、姿态控制系统设计、敏感器或执行机构设计的学生奠定理论和技术基础。
default.en: In view that sensors and actuators are the key to spacecraft control systems design, this course will focuses on commonly used sensors and actuators such as solar sensor, star sensor, inertial sensor, cold-gas propulsion system, electric propulsion, flywheel, control moment gyro, etc. The working principle, classification, characteristics, testing and application method for each component will be explained in detail in order to let students have a comprehensive understanding of the design of spacecraft attitude control system. Through the study of this course, we will lay a theoretical and technical foundation for future research in the aerospace field, especially for the spacecraft system design, attitude control system design, sensor or actuator design.

default.zh: 《航天器电源系统》是一门理论知识与工程设计相结合的课程，通过本课程的学习，使学生了解航天器电源系统的设计特点与设计方法，能够开展航天器电源系统方案选择与方案设计。 本课程主要包括：电源系统的设计准则与设计步骤、空间环境对电源系统的主要影响及对策、太阳电池电性能计算及电路布局设计、锂离子蓄电池组的工作特性及充电策略、电源功率调节原理及全调节母线电源系统、电源能量平衡策略及电源系统设计计算。 本课程考试成绩采用累加式，包括课堂提问成绩、课下作业成绩、期末考试成绩。
default.en: This lesson is the basic course for students from spacecraft design and lectured by introducing spacecraft power system design principle, design methodology and relative overall design knowledge. The detail content of the lesson includes spacecraft power system constitution and design principle; the influence of space environment to spacecraft power system; the design of solar cell panel, battery and power control equipment; power system technical parameters selecting; design examples of LEO spacecraft.

default.zh: 卫星星务系统是卫星六大系统中最重要的分系统之一，星务系统是卫星的数据中心，同时是卫星的控制中心。星务系统以综合电子系统硬件为载体，与卫星全部部件通过不同的数据接口相连，各部件按约定协议将产生的工程参数发送至星务系统，星务系统对各工程参数进行正确性与有效性的判断，并做出相应处置；然后星务系统按协议将工程参数进行解析与编排，根据卫星管理控制要求，将重新编排后的工程参数发送至对应单机或地面系统。 上述管理控制过程的全部环节所涉及到的硬件以软件逻辑就是本课程的讲授核心，涉及到星载嵌入式系统、测控系统、计算机网络、软件工程等学科，是一门综合性较强的课程，卫星星务系统设计的好坏，直接决定了地面管控人员能够对卫星的管控程度，以及卫星的好用、易用程度。通过本课程的学习，不仅能够掌握星务系统的设计方法，同时对卫星总体设计能够产生深刻的认识。 《微纳卫星星务系统》是飞行器设计与工程专业的重要专业选修课，是与工程实际联系极为紧密的一门课程，在培养学生创造性思维、综合设计能力和实践能力方面占有重要的地位。
default.en: Housekeeping system is one of the most important subsystems among the six major satellite systems. Housekeeping system is both the data center and control center of the satellite. This system takes the integrated electronic system hardware as the carrier, and is connected with all components of the satellite through different data interfaces. Each component sends the generated engineering parameters to the housekeeping system according to the agreed protocol. The satellite system judges the correctness and effectiveness of each engineering parameter and makes corresponding disposal. Then the satellite system parses and arranges the engineering parameters according to the protocol, and sends the rearranged engineering parameters to the corresponding component or ground system according to the requirements of satellite management and control. The hardware and software logic involved in all aspects of the above management and control process is the core of this course. It involves on-board embedded systems, measurement and control systems, computer networks, software engineering and other disciplines. It is a comprehensive course. The quality of housekeeping system design directly determines the degree of control of satellites by ground control personnel, as well as the ease of use and ease of use of satellites. Through the study of this course, we can not only master the design method of the housekeeping system, but also have a deep understanding of the overall design of the satellite. ' Design of Housekeeping System of Microsatellite ' is an important professional elective course for aircraft design and engineering. It is a course closely related to engineering practice. It plays an important role in cultivating students ' creative thinking, comprehensive design ability and practical ability.

default.zh: 《飞行器制导控制仿真》是航天工程专业的技术基础课，介绍如何利用数学工具与可视化分析工具进行飞行器动态系统仿真和分析，主要讲授以下知识点：编程语言对矩阵的构建和基本操作语句；矩阵线性代数运算指令、特殊运算符指令和专用数学函数；程序流程控制指令和程序设计；图形基本操作指令和绘制图形的一般过程；图形句柄和函数句柄；飞行器动态系统建模仿真与分析流程。通过该课学习，可为学生进行《航天器轨道动力学》、《航天器姿态动力学》、《远程火箭弹道学与制导方法》、《导弹飞行力学》等核心课程实践训练提供基础。
default.en: Spacecraft Guidance and Control Simulation is a technical foundation course for aerospace engineering majors. It introduces how to use mathematical and visual analysis tools to simulate and analyze dynamic systems of spacecraft. The following knowledge points are mainly introduced: programming language for matrix construction and basic operation statements; Matrix linear algebra operation instructions, special operator instructions, and specialized mathematical functions; Program flow control instructions and program design; Basic operation instructions for graphics and the general process of drawing graphics; Graph handles and function handles; Modeling, simulation, and analysis process of aircraft dynamic systems. Through this course, students can receive practical training in core courses such as spacecraft orbit dynamics, spacecraft attitude dynamics, long-range rocket trajectory and guidance methods, and missile flight mechanics.

default.zh: 弹性力学及有限元B课程是飞行器设计与工程类本科生的一门专业核心课，也是学生们学习后续相关专业方向课的基础。课程主要讲授理想弹性体平面问题力学分析的基本理论及基本解答，以及应用有限单元法求解弹性力学平面问题的基本理论和基本方法，重点使学生理解弹性力学及有限单元法的基本概念与基本理论，掌握应用弹性力学理论及有限单元法分析问题及解决问题的基本方法。 课程主要包括平面问题的基本理论和解答，以及用有限单元法求解弹性力学平面问题的基本理论和方法。本课程考试成绩采用累加式，包括平时作业、大作业和期末考试三部分。
default.en: Mechanics of Elastic Solids and Finite Elements Method B is a core specialty course to undergraduates of Spacecraft Design and Engineering category. It is also a knowledge foundation of following relevant specialty direction courses. The course mainly concerns basic theories and solutions of mechanic analysis of plane problems in ideal elastic body, as well as basic theories and methods of solving plane problems of elastic mechanics with application of Finite Element Method. The emphasis of the course is understanding of basic concepts and theories of mechanics of elasticity and Finite Element Method, as well as mastering of basic methods of problem analysis and solution with theories of elastic mechanics and Finite Element Method. The course mainly concerns basic theories and solutions of plane problem as well as basic theories and methods of solving plane problem of elastic mechanics with application of Finite Element Method. The cumulative type of examination of the course is adopted, which includes usual homework, project homework and final exam.

default.zh: 本课程主要阐释宏观电磁场理论。首先，该课程分析电学与磁学的各个实验定律，总结出电磁场的普遍规律，建立麦克斯韦方程组、电磁场需满足的边界条件以及洛伦兹力公式；接着针对恒定电磁场问题说明恒定场的基本性质和求解电场和磁场问题的一些基本方法（主要为三种：分离变量求解拉普拉斯方程，镜像法和格林函数方法）；然后，重点讨论电磁波的传播和辐射，包括自由空间的电磁波的性质、界面上的反射折射以及金属中的电测波的传播问题，在介绍金属波导和谐振腔之后进一步拓展至光波导和等离子体的概念；介绍一般情况下势的概念、势满足方程和解的形式，介绍辐射电磁场的计算，以及电磁波衍射的计算方法。
default.en: This course focuses on the theory of macro electromagnetic field. Firstly, the course analyses the various experimental law of electricity and magnetism, summarizes the general law of the electromagnetic field, establishes the Maxwell equations, boundary conditions for electromagnetic fields and the Lorenz force formula; next, for the constant electromagnetic field problem, some basic methods that constant field and basic properties for electric field and magnetic field problems(mainly three kinds: separation solution Laplasse equation, variable mirror method and Green function method); then discusses the propagation of electromagnetic waves and radiation, including the properties of electromagnetic waves existing in the free space, reflection and refraction on the interface, and the problem of electromagnetic wave propagation in metal, the concept of optical wave-guides and plasma ex-citations are given after the introduction of metal wave-guide and resonant cavity; introduces the concept of the general situation, the form of potential and the form of the equation, presents the calculation of radiated electromagnetic fields and calculation method of electromagnetic wave diffraction.

default.zh: 导波光学与集成光学是以经典电磁波理论为基础，研究光和光信号在各类介质光波导中传播特性；在光电子学和微电子学基础上，采用集成方法研究和发展光学器件和混合光学-电子学器件系统的一门学科。随着集成光路技术的发展，尤其是光通讯、光学信息处理和光传感等领域的广泛应用，使这门学科的内容愈来愈丰富。本课程主要内容有：介质光波导的电磁波理论、射线光学理论和模式的概念；平面光波导、矩形介质波导和圆光波导中光的传播特性；光波导的耦合模理论及耦合器件；晶体在外场作用下的光学性质；集成光无源和有源器件；集成光学与纳米光子学。
default.en: Waveguide optics and integrated optics is a discipline that studies the propagation characteristics of light and optical signals in various dielectric optical waveguides based on classical electromagnetic wave theory; and uses integrated methods to research and develop optical devices and hybrid optoelectronic device systems based on optoelectronics and microelectronics. With the development of integrated optical circuit technology, especially the widespread application in fields such as optical communication, optical information processing, and optical sensing, the content of this discipline has become more and more abundant. The main content of this course includes: electromagnetic wave theory of dielectric optical waveguides, ray optics theory, and the concept of modes; The propagation characteristics of light in planar optical waveguides, rectangular dielectric waveguides, and circular optical waveguides; Mode coupling theory and coupling devices of optical waveguides; The optical properties of crystals under external field action; Integrated optical passive and active devices; Integrated optics and nanophotonics.

default.zh: 《实验设计与数据处理》是一门重要的专业课。它利用数理统计的原理和方法解决实际生产过程的问题。它不仅提供如何正确地设计科学实验和收集数据的方法，而且也提供如何正确地整理、分析数据，得出客观、科学的结论的方法。本课程任务使学生能够掌握常用的实验设计原理及设计方法、实验结果的统计分析方法，了解常用的数理统计软件。通过该门课程的学习，可以掌握基本的实验（调查）设计和统计分析方法，为学生毕业论文以及将来从事科研工作打基础，支撑人才培养规格中设计实验、数据分析要求的实现。
default.en: The course ‘Experimental Design and Data Processing’ is an important course that uses principles and methods of mathematical statistics to solve practical problems in production processes. It not only provides methods for designing scientific experiments and collecting data correctly, but also provides methods for organizing and analyzing data correctly to draw objective and scientific conclusions. The task of this course is to enable students to master commonly used principles and methods of experimental design, statistical analysis of experimental results, and familiarize themselves with commonly used mathematical statistical software. Through this course, students can master the basic methods of experimental (survey) design and statistical analysis, which will lay the foundation for their graduation thesis and future research work, and support the implementation of design experiment and data analysis requirements in the talent training specifications.

default.zh: 光纤传感技术与应用是一门专业选修课。光纤传感技术是随着现代光纤技术的成熟而发展起来的传感技术中的一个新领域。和常规传感器相比，光纤传感器具有许多独特的优点，因此在短短几十年内，光纤传感技术迅速发展并在众多领域得到了广泛应用。本课程旨在向学生介绍光纤传感器的基本原理、构成及其应用。通过本课程的学习，学生能够掌握光纤传感技术基础、常用的光纤传感器件基础、主要光纤传感技术原理和前沿发展，以及光纤传感技术的主要应用。
default.en: Optical fiber sensor technology and applications is a professional elective course. Optical fiber sensor technology is a new area of the developed sensor technology with modern optical fiber technology matures. Thanks to many unique advantages compared with conventional sensors, optical fiber sensor technology has been developed rapidly in the past a few decades, and has been finding applications in many fields. This course aims to introduce the basic principles, compositions and applications of optical fiber sensors to students. Through the study of this course, students will be able to master the basics of fiber optic sensing technologies, commonly used fiber optic sensor components, main principles and cutting-edge developments of fiber optic sensing technologies, as well as the main applications of fiber optic sensing technologies.

default.zh: 本课程为一门专业课，通过对该课程的学习，学生可以掌握光通信技术的基本原理和方法，提高学生分析问题和解决问题的能力，为学生今后的学习和研究奠定一定的理论基础。课程的主要内容包括光通信技术的发展，光纤通信系统的基本原理、关键技术、关键器件；卫星光通信系统的基本原理、卫星光通信光信号的发射与接收技术，卫星光通信系统主要参量分析，及卫星光通信中信号的瞄准、捕获和跟踪技术。本课程教学以讲课为主，配合讨论的方式教学。讲课形式采取PPT与板书相结合，教师讲授与学生讨论相结合的形式。讲课重点在于介绍光通信技术领域的基本知识和前沿进展。
default.en: This course is a specialized course. Through studying this course, students can master the basic principles and methods of optical communication technology, improve their problem analysis and problem-solving abilities, and lay a certain theoretical foundation for their future learning and research. The main content of the course includes the development of optical communication technology, the basic principles, key technologies, and key devices of optical fiber communication systems, the basic principles of satellite optical communication systems, the transmission and reception techniques of satellite optical communication optical signals, the main parameter analysis of satellite optical communication systems, and the signal pointing, acquisition, and tracking techniques in satellite optical communication. The teaching of this course is mainly lecture-based, supplemented by discussion. The lecture format combines PowerPoint presentations and blackboard writing, and the teaching involves a combination of teacher-led instruction and student discussion. The emphasis of the lecture is on introducing basic knowledge and cutting-edge advancements in the field of optical communication technology.

default.zh: 物理光学是电子科学与技术专业的一门重要的专业基础课，具有承前启后的作用，是学习后续专业课的基础，也是今后从事科研不可缺少的基础。通过该课程的学习将使学生掌握物理光学的基本知识，掌握分析问题的基本方法，培养学生运用光学知识解决后续课程以及以后工作中所遇有关问题的能力。 本门课程的教学内容前一部分讨论光的传播，以经典光学为主线，以光的电磁理论为基础，着重讲授光在各向同性介质、各向异性介质中的传播规律以及光的干涉、衍射、偏振特性。后一部分讨论光与物质的相互作用，包括晶体的感应双折射，光的吸收、色散和散射。 本门课程在注重物理思想的阐述的同时，适当引入现代光学的有关新概念和前沿课题，如激光原理，傅立叶光学基础等；注重启发式教学，形成师生间的互动；注重课程内容的系统性、综合性，培养学生分析问题和解决问题的能力。
default.en: Physical Optics as an important fundamental and specialized course holds an important position for students majoring in Electronic Science and Technology. It is a link between the previous and follow-up courses. Therefore, it becomes a necessary base for the students to learn later specialized courses and engage in future scientific researches. After the course, the students will master the basic ways of analyzing problems and gain the ability of solving the problems that may be encountered in later courses and research work. The main contents of this course fall into two parts. The first part, based on the electromagnetism theory of optics, is to discuss the propagation of optics, it puts much emphasis on the optical propagation law through isotropy medium and anisotropism medium and the optical characteristics of interference, diffraction and polarization. The second part is to discuss the interaction between optics and substances, including induction double refraction, absorption, dispersion and scattering of the optics. It will pay much attention to the interpretation of physical ideas and the introduction of new concepts and front projects of modern optics, such as the principle of laser, the basis of Fourier Optics and so on. In addition, the heuristic education way will be emphasized so as to foster the students’ ability of analyzing and solving problems.

default.zh: 量子电子学导论课程是光电工程大类专业本科生基础课，为学生后续开展光电子器件、激光及激光应用技术等各类专业课的学习提供必要的基础知识，为建立分析微观物理问题的基本思维方法奠定基础。课程以科学原子模型的探索进程为主线，介绍近现代物理学及相关理论体系的重大发展飞跃，讨论原子中电子运动的基本特征和重要规律及其对原子能态、光谱现象的决定关系，并以原子物理为载体阐述量子力学基本概念，建立运用量子理论处理微观物理问题的基本思维范式和方法，掌握量子力学求解的氢原子模型基本特征和规律；同时，掌握电子自旋与轨道角动量耦合等重要概念以及能级精细结构、光谱跃迁等机制。
default.en: Introduction to Quantum Electronics is a basic course for undergraduates majoring in optoelectronic engineering. It provides necessary basic knowledge for students to carry out the subsequent study of various professional courses such as optoelectronic devices, laser and laser application technology, and lays a foundation for the establishment of basic thinking methods for analyzing microphysical problems. The course focuses on the exploration process of scientific atomic model, introduces the major development leap of modern physics and related theoretical systems, discusses the basic characteristics and important laws of electron motion in atoms and their determining relations to atomic energy states and spectral phenomena, and expounds the basic concepts of quantum mechanics with atomic physics as the carrier. Establish the basic thinking paradigm and method of applying quantum theory to deal with microphysical problems, and master the basic characteristics and laws of the hydrogen atom model solved by quantum mechanics; At the same time, the important concepts such as the coupling of electron spin and orbital angular momentum, as well as the mechanism of energy level fine structure and spectral transition are mastered.

default.zh: 本课程包含热力学和统计物理两大部分，为研究热运动提供了理论方法。其中热力学部分包括热力学的基本规律、均匀物质的热力学性质、单元系的相变等三部分，重点在于介绍热力学的基本概念以及利用热力学处理问题的方式方法。统计物理部分包括近独立粒子系统的概率分布，玻尔兹曼统计，玻色统计和费米统计，系综理论等，介绍了统计物理的基本思想和概念，以及用统计物理解决问题的方法。热力学和统计物理是本课程的两条主线，既相互独立，又相互联系，在处理热力学问题上是相辅相成的。本课程的教学目的是使学生学习关于热现象的宏观理论和微观理论；培养学生分析问题解决问题的能力。通过本课程的学习,学生能够掌握热力学和统计物理分析问题、处理问题的理论、方法, 并能应用该理论、方法解决具体系统的热力学问题。
default.en: The course, composed of thermodynamics and statistical physics, provides a method for studying thermal motion. Thermodynamics includes basic thermodynamic concepts and laws, thermodynamic characteristics of the uniform material, and department of the phase-change unit. The emphasis of Thermodynamics is to present the basic thermodynamic concepts and the ways to solve problems with thermodynamics. Statistical physics includes probability distribution, Bolrzmann distribution, Boson distribution and Fermion distribution. The basic concepts and methods of statistical physics are presented. Thermodynamics and statistical physics are the main threads of the course. They are connected with while independent from each other in solving thermodynamic problems. The purpose of this course is to provide students with macro-scopical and microcosmic theories on thermal phenomena and to cultivate students’ ability of analyzing solving problems. Through this course, students can master the theories and methods to solve the problems in specific thermodynamic systems.

default.zh: 本课程讲授几种主要微能源系统的工作原理、基本结构以及输出特性，让学生能够深入的了解微能源系统内部的微结构对其输出性能的影响。通过本课程的课堂教学、后续的实验操作以及计算机仿真等环节，着重培养学生们对微能源系统的综合分析和设计能力，增加创新意识，支撑专业学习成果中相应指标点的达成。课程目标要求如下：（1）讲授微型燃料电池的工作原理和基本结构，使学生具备微能源系统分析问题的知识基础，掌握微能源系统的理论基础、研究热点、发展趋势及前沿应用；（2）讲授微型氢氧燃料电池/微型甲醇燃料电池的输出特点和主要分析方法，培养学生分析和解决工程实践中微能源系统的能力；（3）介绍常见微能源系统问题的基本实验技能和计算机仿真方法，使学生得到实验方案设计和实验技能的基本培训，逐步具备应用先进工具解决工作实际问题的能力。
default.en: This course teaches the working principles, basic structures and output characteristics of several major micro power sourcesm, allowing students to have a deep understanding of the impact of the internal microstructure on the output performance of micro power sources. Through the classroom teaching, subsequent experimental operations, and computer simulation of this course, we focus on cultivating students' comprehensive analysis and design capabilities for micro power sources, increasing their awareness of innovation, and supporting the achievement of corresponding indicator points in professional learning outcomes. The course objectives are as follows: (1) Teach the working principle and basic structure of micro fuel cells, so that students have the ability to analysis the problems of micro power sources, and master the theoretical basis, research hot spots, development trends and cutting-edge applications of micro power sources; (2) ) Teach the output characteristics and main analysis methods of micro hydrogen-oxygen fuel cells/micro methanol fuel cells, and cultivate students' ability to analyze and solve the problems of micro power sources in engineering practice; (3) Introduce basic experimental skills and computer simulation of common micro power sources. This method enables students to get basic training in experimental plan design and experimental skills, and gradually acquire the ability to apply advanced tools to solve practical work problems.

default.zh: 本课程是无线通信集成电路设计的基础课程。授课教师从射频微电子技术的前沿出发，结合工程经验，对无线通信电路集成设计的原理以及容易被忽略的问题给出了详尽的阐述，阐述了通信集成电路设计特征。课程分5部分，主要介绍了无线通信集成电路系统发展史，以及当今射频集成电路前沿简介、无线通信（模拟/射频集成电路）设计的约束和要求；电路设计中谐波失真机理及分析；电路的噪声机理与噪声分析；电路阻抗匹配机理及分析；模拟/数字信号的调制技术与无线通信标准中集成电路性能要求和接收机架构简介。本课程针对许多工业界人士的需求和问题进行了分析和解释，同时可作为相关专业的高年级本科生的课程。
default.en: This course is a fundamental subject of wireless communication integrated circuits. The keynote speaker, from the insight cut-edge of Radio-Frequency(RF) microelectronics, presents a great of details on the principles of the technologies of integration circuits about communications and the omitted problems about RF microelectronics. The course expatiates on the design methodologies of RF integrated circuits. The course contains five parts. It introduces the history of wireless communication and integrated circuits, and cut-edge of RF integrated circuits, and the rule of discipline and constraints of analog/radio frequency integrated circuits designs in communication systems, the circuit mechanism and analysis of harmonic distortion; the mechanism and analysis of circuit noise; the mechanism and analysis of circuit resistance matching; the technology modulation of analog/digital signal, and demands of integrated circuits for wireless standards, and brief introduction of Receiver architecture. The course is presented the analysis and interpretation for the problems and needs of many industrial people. It acts as the course of the relative high-grade students.

default.zh: MEMS课程是一门针对高等工科院校中微电子科学与工程专业开设的重要选修课程，涉及物理学、化学、生物学、电子学、机械学等多个学科领域，旨在培养学生从事MEMS研究开发及应用的专业技术课。主要讲述MEMS的定义、发展及其作用，重点讲述硅体微机械加工、表面微机械加工、DRIE、LIGA等MEMS工艺技术基础；讲述MEMS微传感器与微执行器、光与射频MEMS等典型MEMS器件；介绍MEMS在航天、国防、汽车电子、消费电子、生物医学等方面的应用实例。
default.en: MEMS is one of the most important new courses for the students of Micro electronic Science and Enginering in advanced technology college, involves a wide and diverse range of technical areas including physics, chemistry, biology, electronics and mechanics, aiming to enhance the students’ skills in MEMS researching and application. This course introduces the definition, development and effect of MEMS, particularly basics of manufacture process，such as bulk and surface micromachining and DRIE, LIGA, MEMS sensors and actuators, optical and RF MEMS, as well as the application in spaceflight, national defense, automotive and consumption electronics, and biomedicine.

default.zh: 微传感器课程是高等工科院校中微电子专业一门新开设的重要课程之一，涉及物理学、化学、生物学、电子学等多个学科领域，在教学过程中综合运用先修课程所学的有关知识技能及相关学科领域的知识，进行从事微传感器研究开发及应用方面的技术人员所需要的基本技能的训练，为学生以后从事微传感器研究开发打下坚实的基础。因此在微电子专业的教学计划中占有重要地位。
default.en: Microsensor curriculum in engineering colleges are microelectronics professionals to open a new one of the essential curriculum, involving physics, chemistry, biology, electronics and other fields, in the teaching process by the integrated use of pre-study curriculum relevant knowledge, skills and knowledge in the field of related disciplines to conduct engaged in micro sensor research and development and application of technical personnel required by the basic skills training for students to engage in future micro-sensor research and development and lay a solid foundation. Therefore, in micro-electronic professional teaching programs occupies an important position.

default.zh: 本课程结合无线网络和传感器技术的最新发展及应用现状，介绍了无线传感器网络的基本概念和发展现状。针对无线传感器网络节点探测功能，介绍了常用微型传感器的工作原理和选型技术。要求学生重点掌握无线传感器网络通信技术、关键支撑技术和网络协议标准。最后，课程针对近年来海洋无线传感器网络快速发展的需求，阐述了海洋无线传感器网络节点的构成和通信协议。
default.en: This course introduces the wireless sensor networks’ basic concepts and development status according to the latest developments and applications. We introduced the working principles and selection techniques about some common micro sensors which are used to target detecting. Students need to focus on mastering wireless sensor network communication technology, key supporting technologies and standards of network protocol in this course. Finally, the composition and communication protocols are introduced focusing on the rapid development of ocean wireless sensor networks in recent years.

default.zh: 随着计算机科学在现代各种学科的日益深入，结合各学科的知识特点，掌握相关计算机软件技术基础知识在学习各学科知识的过程中日益重要。《计算机软件技术基础》概括了软件工程、现代操作系统和数据结构在计算机体系中的地位，特点和作用等基础知识，课程侧重于基本概念和基础理论知识的介绍，以一个软件工程师的角度看待和处理现实问题。这些都有利于学生们在专业学习中理解硬件设计语言以及其他各种辅助设计软件在微电子设计、实现、模拟和仿真中所起的各种作用。有利于学生充分利用计算机这一系统工具，将更多的精力集中在微电子学科的学习和创新上。
default.en: The deeper various subjects were penetrated with computer technologies, the more important it is to grasp corresponding basic knowledge of software technologies integrated with the knowledge characteristics of various disciplines. The course of fundamental technology of the computer software introduces the primitive theory of software engineering, modern operating system and data structure, and concludes their characteristics, status and functions in the computer system. The course focuses on the introduction of basic concepts and knowledge. It could help the students to understand and handle questions about the real world as a software engineer. It is beneficial to help students master the hardware description language and other design aided tools, which are used to design and implement chips in microelectronics. Students could pay more attention to study and innovation in the field of microelectronics by taking full advantage of computer system tools.

default.zh: 本课程是各类微电子器件及装备的基础课程。授课教师从微电子技术的发展出发，结合工程经验，对微电子器件的原理以及容易被忽略的问题给出了详尽的论述，阐述了微电子器件失效机理。课程分2大部分，主要介绍了微电子器件可靠性的背景知识、常用的数学模型、相关的统计理论、微电子器件的失效原理与分析、可靠性设计、器件的选用与控制、以及可靠性评价和标准等。本课程针对许多工业界人士的需求和问题进行了分析和解释，同时作为相关专业的高年级本科生和低年级研究生的课程。
default.en: This course is a fundamental subject of all kinds of microelectronic devices and equipments. The school teacher, from the development of microelectronics technologies, gives a great of details on the principles of the microelectronic devices and the omitted problems about microelectronics. The course expatiates on the invalidation effects of microelectronics. The course contains two parts. It mainly introduces the background of microelectronic devices, the common mathematical modules of microelectronic devices, the relative statistical theories, the principles and analysis of invalidation for microelectronic devices, design reliability of microelectronic devices, the selection and control of the devices, and reliable evaluation and standards of microelectronic devices. The course is presented the analysis and interpretation for the problems and needs of many industrial people. It acts as the course of the relative high-grade students and junior postgraduates.

default.zh: 近年嵌入式系统中软件所占的比例越来越大，嵌入式软件是专为特定嵌入式环境设计的软件，在许多方面与通用软件具有很大的差异。本课程的目的是使学生了解嵌入式软件的应用环境，掌握嵌入式软件的特点，学习嵌入式软件的系统分析，设计和实现的要点。主要内容包括嵌入式软件开发工具与方法，嵌入式软件调试工具与调试技术；嵌入式操作系统结构与工作原理。本课程帮助学生建立系统级的概念、分析和设计方法，为培养具有系统观念的工程师打下坚实的基础。
default.en: The software is taking the increasing portion of the embedded system. Embedded software is usually customized for specific application environment, and it is quite different from the general software. This course will help students to understand the character of embedded software and its application environment, learn the analysis, design and implementation of embedded software. The course consists of development tools and methods of embedded software, debug tools and techniques of embedded software, the structures and mechanism of embedded OS (operating system). This course will help the students establish the concepts, analysis and design capabilities at the system level and lay the foundations of engineer with system perspectives.

default.zh: 微处理器结构主要介绍微处理器结构设计的原理与方法。本课程首先对微处理器的发展历程及特点、计算机体系结构与组织、当代先进系统级芯片结构进行概述，然后重点介绍微处理器性能和成本定义及评估方法，基于此详细介绍指令集体系结构设计原则，分析了数据通路和控制逻辑的设计技术。RISC技术是微处理器设计主流技术，本课程重点介绍了RISC结构的特点，以MIPS处理器为例，分析了其指令集的特点及组成，给出了采用该指令集进行汇编语言程序实现的方法和规则，详细分析并介绍了基于MIPS指令集的单周期处理器、多周期处理器以及流水结构处理器数据通路及控制结构设计方法。介绍了层次式存储系统以及cache的原理及设计方法。本课程为面向应用的系统解决方案设计打下理论基础。
default.en: Microprocessor architecture mainly introduces the principles and methods to design the microprocessor architecture. The course first gives an overview of the development history and characteristics of microprocessors, computer architecture and organization, and contemporary advanced system level chip architecture. Then the definition and evaluation methods of microprocessor performance and cost are focused on. Based on this, the design principles of instruction set architecture are introduced in detail, and the design techniques of data path and control logic are analyzed. RISC technology is the mainstream technology of microprocessor design. This course focuses on the characteristics of RISC architecture, taking MIPS processor as an example, analyzes the characteristics and composition of MIPS’ instruction set, gives the methods and rules of implementing assembly language with this instruction set, analyzes and introduces the design methods of the data path and control structure of single-cycle processor, multi-cycle processor and pipeline processor based on the MIPS instruction set in detail. And principles and design methods of memory hierarchy system and cache are introduced. The course lays a theoretical foundation for designing the application-oriented system solutions.

default.zh: 课程从空间辐射环境的介绍及对器件/电路的危害开始，从器件/电路材料选择、工艺和设计加固等方面，讲述辐射环境下对集成电路的特殊要求和设计方法。课程内容分为5章。首先对辐射环境进行介绍，包括空间辐射环境、大气辐射环境和地面辐射环境，描述空间辐射环境对集成电路产生的危害，即辐射效应，主要是总剂量效应和单粒子效应。第2章对集成电路制造采用的材料及其辐射特性进行介绍，同时介绍从工艺上对集成电路的加固技术，包括硅材料和SOI材料。第3章主要讲述存储器的加固设计技术，系统层面主要是错误修正编码技术，讲述汉明码的加固方法，可以纠正存储器中的1位错误；在电路层面主要是存储单元的加固；探测修正加固技术主要是通过加入探测电路来达到检错、纠错的目的。第4章主要讲述瞬态错误在组合电路中的传播，包括电屏蔽，逻辑屏蔽和锁存窗口屏蔽效应，及其抑制技术，时序电路的加固主要讲述锁存器和触发器的加固。第5章主要讲述电路抗总剂量辐射性能和抗单粒子辐射性能的评估方法，包括在计算机环境的评估技术，以及地面模拟试验系统和测试方法。
default.en: The course will first introduce space radiation environment and the harm to the device / circuit, and how to select device / circuit material, process and hardened design technique. Then the special requirements for integrated circuit and design method under the radiation environment will be proposed. The content of the course is divided into five chapters. The radiation environments are introduced first, including the space radiation environment, atmospheric radiation environmental and terrestrial radiation environment. The hazards of the space radiation environment to the integrated circuit, which is mainly total ionizing dose effects and single event effects are summarized. In the second chapter, the material and radiation characteristics used for integrated circuit are introduced, and the hardened techniques of integrated circuit, including silicon material and SOI material, are introduced. The third chapter focuses on memory hardened design techniques, the system level is mainly error correction code technique, Hamming code hardened method, which can correct one bit error in a memory. At the circuit level, the hardened method for memory cell is introduced. Detection and correction technique is mainly through adding detection circuit to achieve the purpose of error detection and error correction. The fourth chapter focuses on transient error propagation in combinational circuits, including electrical masking, logic masking and window masking effects, and suppression techniques to transient error propagation. For sequential circuits mainly deals with the hardness of latches and triggers. The fifth chapter focuses on the evaluation methods of total dose radiation performance and single event effect radiation performance of the circuits, including computer environment evaluation technique, ground simulation test system and test methods.

default.zh: 《生物芯片技术》是电子信息科学与技术专业现在和未来的一个重要发展分支，借助于集成电路制备技术，根据分子间特异性地相互作用的原理，将生命科学领域中不连续的分析过程集成于衬底表面以制备微型生物化学分析系统。 本课程以微电子工艺为基础，主要讲授生物芯片领域的基础理论、实用工艺基础、主要研究成果、最新进展及未来发展趋势，使学生初步掌握各种生物芯片的基本原理和制作工艺方法，明晰微加工和微电子技术在固相表面构建微型生物化学分析系统当中的应用，为其在微电子学专业方面的进一步学习奠定一定的理论和应用基础。 重点使学生熟悉和掌握微生物芯片类型以及当前普遍采用的工艺制作方法，包括：微阵列芯片，蛋白质芯片，微流控芯片，体硅加工技术，腐蚀，键合技术，功能薄膜制备等；掌握各类型芯片工作原理，常见问题以及解决措施。内容涉及面广，信息量大，而且新技术、新工艺、新设备不断涌现，是一门实践性和理论性均较强的技术类专业选修课程。 该课程以讲授为主，累加式计分方式，结课考核需提交一篇不少于3000字课程报告，内容针对一种类型的生物芯片展开，附主要参考文献，文献阅读量不少于5篇，占成绩60%；平时成绩占10%（讨论、课程难点讲解等）； 实验成绩占30%（实验操作以及实验报告）。
default.en: Biochip technique is an important branch for the growing trend in the field of electronic information science and technology. With the help of integrated circuit fabrication technology, the biochip integrated some un-continuous analysis process on the substrate surface, which based on the principle of intermolecular specific interactions in the field of life science. Therefore, the biochip offers exciting possibilities for the miniaturization of analytical instruments, called micro total analysis system (μ-TAS). Based on MEMS engineering and biochemistry, this course will mainly introduce the basic theory in the field of biochip, as well as practical process, the main research results, the latest progress and trend in the future. The student should master the basic principle for all kinds of biochip and the fabrication methods. The studying of biochip course is beneficial for the students, improving their ability that use their learning to solve and analysis some practical problems, which lay the theoretical foundation for the application and further study in microelectronics field. Micro total analysis system (μ-TAS) offers the potential for highly efficient, simultaneous analysis of a large number of biologically important molecules in genomic, proteomic and metabolic studies. Students should be familiarized with the types and fabrication methods of biochip widely used in current production, including: microarray chip, protein chip, microfluidic chip, silicon bulk machining, corrosion, bonding technology, function film fabrication; grasp the working principle of various types biochip, common problems and solutions. With the new technology, new equipment constantly emerging, biochip technology raises fascinating possibilities for new analytical assays in various fields such as bioelectronics assembly, biomechanics and sampling techniques, as well as in chips or micro-devices. This course aims to describe the present state-of-the-art of microsystems for use in biotechnological research, medicine and diagnostics. The cumulative scoring method was adopted in this course. a course report about one kind of biochip, should be submitted, no less than 3,000 words, with main references，at least 5 papers reading, accounting 60% of the total score; usually 10% of the results (discussion, curriculum difficulties, lectures, etc.); experimental scores accounted for30% (experimental operations and experimental reports, etc.).

default.zh: 本课程以国家需求为导向，集成电路设计技术为基本教学内容，结合学校理论教学优势和国企研究所面向应用设计技术优势，力争架起理论学习、校园教育与国家急需集成电路设计技术之间的桥梁，抓住集成电路发展的时代机遇，培养能够满足实用化需求的、具备新颖和灵活的设计技术的高水平人才。课程聘请中电集团第14研究所专家讲授，课程分析集成电路产业需求和技术人才需求，探讨国家亟待解决的芯片技术难题，讲授集成电路芯片设计技术及产品实用化技术。课程结合高校关键技术难点研发能力和知名企业集成电路可靠性、实用性以及全面性等优势，涵盖高精度ADC、DAC、PLL单元设计、芯片系统规划及原理分析以及芯片应用与设计技巧等课程内容。
default.en: With national demand-oriented and IC design technology as the basic teaching content, this course combines the theoretical teaching advantages of schools and application-oriented design technology advantages of state-owned research institutes, and strives to build a bridge between theoretical learning, campus education and the country's urgent need for IC design technology, seize the opportunities of the era of IC development. Cultivate high-level talents with novel and flexible design techniques that can meet practical needs. The course is taught by experts from the 14th Research Institute of CLP Group. The course analyzes the needs of integrated circuit industry and technical talents, discusses the chip technology problems that need to be solved in the country, and teaches integrated circuit chip design technology and product practical technology. The course combines the research and development ability of key technical difficulties of colleges and universities with the reliability, practicability and comprehensiveness of integrated circuits of well-known enterprises, covering high-precision ADC, DAC, PLL unit design, chip system planning and principle analysis, chip application and design skills and other courses.

default.zh: 主要掌握和熟悉集成电路和电子科学与技术等专业方向的基础理论，涉及到固体物理和半导体物理等方面的物理概念和主要性质。本课程为学生介绍固态电子学的基本物理规律和性质，包括集成电路材料的基本物理性质、导电性以及半导体中的载流子及其运动状态，为从事集成电路、微电子器件、传感器及应用、光电子技术等方面的研究和工作打下必备的理论基础。
default.en: Master and be familiar with the basic theories of integrated circuits and electronic science and technology, involving the physical concepts and main properties of solid physics and semiconductor physics. This course introduces the basic physical laws and properties of solid-state electronics, including the basic physical properties and conductivity of integrated circuit materials, as well as the carrier and its motion state in semiconductors. This course lays a necessary theoretical foundation for the research and work in integrated circuits, microelectronics devices, sensor applications, and optoelectronic technology.

default.zh: 本课程面向微电子科学与工程专业大二本科生，主要介绍光电微系统这一后摩尔时代的微电子先进技术，让学生了解及掌握相关方向的前沿进展。本课程采用课堂讲授及课堂分组讨论的授课方式，结合科研项目实例，以充分激发学生的学习兴趣，开拓学生的眼界。 本课程以光电微系统的简要介绍开篇，讲授相关的基本概念、特性、发展历史及各项领域中的典型应用，概述光电微系统现今面临的技术瓶颈。本课程重点讲授光电微系统所涉及到的几种关键技术：光电探测器、硅光芯片以及异构异质集成技术。首先介绍光电探测器这一光——电之间的桥梁，讲解各种材料、器件结构、探测架构和器件功能及读出电路，结合中电11所优势方向，讲述第四代焦平面技术。其次介绍硅基光电子芯片，分别讲述光波导、调制器、耦合器、光发生模块、光收集集成模块等的基本概念、功能、原理及发展趋势。再次，围绕光电微系统必不可少的封装集成技术展开讲解，介绍chiplet芯粒概念、芯片级封装、系统级封装、多芯片模块、2D/3D异构集成架构以及各种软件异构集成方法等。最后，对于半导体IDM模式进行概述，介绍国内外光电工艺相关布局。通过本课程的学习，学生将对光电微系统技术形成初步认知，同时学生的科研素质得到一定提升。
default.en: This course is aimed at sophomore students majoring in microelectronics science and engineering. It mainly introduces optoelectronic microsystems, an advanced technology of microelectronics in the post-Moorish era, so that students can understand and master the frontier progress in related fields. This course adopts the teaching methods of classroom teaching and classroom group discussion, combined with examples of scientific research projects, in order to fully stimulate students' interest in learning and broaden their horizons. This course begins with a brief introduction of optoelectronic microsystems, teaching the basic concepts, characteristics, development history and typical applications in various fields, and outlining the technical bottlenecks faced by optoelectronic microsystems today. This course focuses on several key technologies involved in optoelectronic microsystems: photodetectors, silicon photonic chips, and heterogeneous integration technologies. First of all, the photodetector is introduced as a bridge between light and electricity, explaining various materials, device structure, detection architecture and device function and readout circuit, combined with the advantages of the CETC 11th Institute to describe the fourth generation of focal plane technology. Secondly, silicon photonic chips are introduced, including the basic concepts, functions, principles and development trends of optical waveguide, modulator, coupler, optical generation module and optical collection integrated module. Thirdly, it focuses on the essential packaging and integration technology of optoelectronic microsystem, introducing the chiplet concept, chip level packaging, system level packaging, multi-chip module, 2D/3D heterogeneous integration architecture and various software heterogeneous integration methods. Finally, the semiconductor IDM mode is summarized, and the domestic and foreign layout of photoelectric technology is introduced. Through the study of this course, students will form a preliminary cognition of optoelectronic microsystem technology, and their scientific research quality will be improved to a certain extent.

default.zh: 应用光学是空天光电信息领域非常重要的专业基础课，是后续专业课的基础。本课程系统地讲授光学成像系统的基本理论和知识、理想光学系统的分析方法、典型光学系统的成像原理及分析方法等。主要内容包括：几何光学基本定律；球面与球面系统；平面与平面系统（平面反射镜、棱镜等）；理想光学系统；光学系统中的光束限制（孔径光阑、视场光阑、景深等）；光能及其计算等。本课程实践性比较强，需要做大量的习题来帮助学生加深对各种光学系统的理解，培养学生光学系统综合分析能力和工程应用能力，增加创新意识。 课程成绩采用累加式，综合考虑平时成绩和期末笔试成绩。
default.en: Applied Optics is a very important foundational course in the field of Aerospace Optoelectronic Information, which is the basis of learning the following specialized courses. This course systematically lectures on basic theories and knowledge of optical imaging system, analytical methods of ideal optical systems, imaging principles and analytical methods of typical optical systems. The contents include: fundamental laws of geometrical optics; spherical surface and spherical surface systems; plane surface and plane surface systems (plane mirror, prism, etc.); ideal optical system; restriction of light beam in optical systems (aperture stop, field aperture, field depth, etc.); light energy and its calculation. This course has strong practicality and requires a large number of exercises to help students deepen their understanding of various optical systems, cultivate their comprehensive analysis and engineering application abilities in optical systems, and increase their innovation awareness. The courses score is cumulative, taking into account the regular grades and final exam score.

default.zh: 《智能视觉工程导论》是一门面向国家重大战略需求与科技前沿的多学科交叉课程。本课程秉承立足航天、服务国防的特色，系统阐述智能视觉工程的核心概念、基本原理及技术体系。课程内容贯通人类视觉机理与机器视觉技术，涵盖从平面视觉感知、立体视觉重建到可感知特征表示等关键理论，并深入剖析智能视觉在国防安全、工业生产、城市治理等关键领域的应用现状与发展趋势。通过本课程学习，学生将掌握智能视觉工程的专业知识，了解三维视觉、实时分析等前沿动态，并重点培养运用光学、数学、计算机科学和人工智能等多学科知识解决复杂工程问题的能力。课程致力于培养具备扎实理论基础、熟练工程实践能力、创新意识及国际视野的拔尖创新人才，使其能够胜任智能视觉相关领域的技术攻关、系统设计与前瞻性研究工作。
default.en: "Introduction to Intelligent Vision Engineering" is a multidisciplinary course designed to address the nation's major strategic needs and scientific frontiers. Adhering to the unique focus of aerospace and serving national defense, this course systematically explains the core concepts, fundamental principles, and technical systems of intelligent vision engineering. The content bridges human visual mechanisms and machine vision technologies, covering key theories from planar visual perception, stereo vision reconstruction, to perceptible feature representation. It also deeply analyzes the current applications and development trends of intelligent vision in critical fields such as national security, industrial production, and urban governance. Through this course, students acquire professional knowledge in intelligent vision engineering, gain insights into cutting-edge advancements such as 3D vision and real-time analysis, and focus on developing the ability to solve complex engineering problems by integrating knowledge from optics, mathematics, computer science, and artificial intelligence. The course aims to cultivate outstanding innovative talents with solid theoretical foundations, proficient engineering skills, creative thinking, and an international perspective, enabling them to excel in technical innovation, system design, and forward-looking research in intelligent vision-related fields.

default.zh: 《红外视觉系统原理与应用》课程是智能视觉工程专业唯一一门涉及红外技术的专业基础课程。该课程是从事红外视觉成像系统设计、红外辐射计算、红外辐射测温、红外辐射源设计、红外辐射参数测量、红外探测器设计、红外诱饵研制、红外检测及诊疗仪器设计、红外对地遥感、红外制导、红外探测与识别等领域工作的基础和前提。该课程既有系统的基础理论，又有广泛的应用领域，且理论不断发展、技术持续迭代更新。本着处理好基础与应用、面与点及系统理论与新进展的关系，同时考虑我校的智能+专业学科建设特色，课程除了重点讲授成像与视觉的基本概念、红外辐射基本概念、红外辐射基本规律外，还主要介绍典型红外辐射源及目标与背景的红外光谱辐射特性、红外的大气传输、红外光学系统、红外探测器及其制冷技术、信号处理与显示、红外定标及量值传递与溯源、红外技术的工程应用等内容，让学生掌握红外辐射的基本概念与定律、红外辐射的发生、传输、成像、显示等相关理论知识，了解红外辐射标准的建立、辐射定标以及量值传递与溯源等基本概念和方法，具备解决红外辐射分析计算、成像、测量、探测等红外技术的基础知识、应用技能与专业素质，为今后从事光电信息科学与工程方面的工作打下坚实基础。
default.en: Principles and Applications of Infrared Vision Systems is the sole specialized foundational course in the Intelligent Visual Engineering program that covers infrared technology. This course serves as the fundamental prerequisite for careers involving the design of infrared visual imaging systems, infrared radiation calculations, infrared radiation thermometry, infrared radiation source design, infrared radiation parameter measurements, infrared detector development, infrared decoy fabrication, infrared-based diagnostic and therapeutic instrument design, infrared Earth remote sensing, infrared guidance, and infrared detection/recognition technologies. The curriculum integrates systematic foundational theories with broad application domains, reflecting continuous advancements in both theoretical frameworks and technological iterations. Guided by the principles of balancing foundational knowledge with practical applications, comprehensive coverage with focused depth, and established system theories with cutting-edge developments—while aligning with our university's "Intelligence+" disciplinary development strategy—the course emphasizes core concepts in imaging and vision, fundamental principles of infrared radiation, and key laws governing infrared phenomena. Key teaching contents include: basic concepts of imaging and vision, basic concepts and laws of infrared radiation, typical infrared radiation sources, infrared spectral radiation characteristics of targets and backgrounds, infrared atmospheric transmission, infrared optical systems, infrared detectors and their cooling technologies, signal processing and display, infrared calibration, measurement value transfer and traceability, and engineering applications of infrared technology. Through this program, students will master: the basic concepts and laws of infrared radiation; theories related to infrared radiation generation, transmission, imaging, and display; methods for establishing infrared radiation standards, radiation calibration, and measurement value transfer/traceability; and acquire foundational knowledge, applied skills, and professional qualities to solve practical problems in infrared radiation analysis, infrared imaging, infrared measurement, and infrared detection, laying a solid foundation for future careers in optoelectronic information science and engineering.

default.zh: 光纤视觉传输技术课程面向智能视觉工程专业的本科生开课，是一门涉及光学、光纤、数字电路等多学科交叉的综合性很强的专业选修课。该课程讲授光纤传光原理及特性、光视觉传输传输系统和信息光纤传感技术等知识，以培养学生独立获取知识的能力为第一位，在重点讲授基本原理、基础知识、关键技术和适用技术上，结合实际研究结果，拓宽学生知识面，使学生掌握实际的光纤应用技术，为学生将来参加相关科研、就业、继续深造奠定技术基础。通过课程向大家介绍光纤视觉传输应用领域所涉及的基础知识和相关技术，包光纤视觉传输技术及系统和光纤传感技术和新型应用方向。该课程能够培养学生多学科综合运用能力以及高通量视觉传输问题的解决能力。除课堂讲授外，通过让学生自己查阅资料、完成设计作业和计算仿真等方式，提高学生学习的自主性和使用现代化信息工具的能力，同时根据该领域的发展，介绍新技术、新应用等，扩展学生视野，为将来深入学习和解决实际问题提供思路。
default.en: The Fiber Optic Vision Transmission Technology course is designed for undergraduate students majoring in Intelligent Vision Engineering. It is an interdisciplinary elective course that integrates optics, fiber optics, digital circuits, and other fields. The course covers the principles and characteristics of fiber optic light transmission, optical vision transmission systems, and information fiber optic sensing technology. Its primary goal is to cultivate students' ability to independently acquire knowledge, with a focus on fundamental principles, core concepts, key technologies, and applicable techniques. By incorporating practical research findings, the course broadens students' knowledge base, equips them with practical fiber optic application skills, and lays a technical foundation for their future participation in related research, employment, or further studies. The course introduces foundational knowledge and relevant technologies in the field of fiber optic vision transmission applications, including fiber optic vision transmission technology and systems, fiber optic sensing technology, and emerging application directions. It aims to develop students' multidisciplinary integration capabilities and their ability to solve high-throughput vision transmission problems. Beyond classroom instruction, the course enhances students' autonomy in learning and their proficiency in using modern information tools. Additionally, it keeps students updated on the latest advancements in the field, introducing new technologies and applications to broaden their perspectives and provide insights for future in-depth studies and practical problem-solving.

default.zh: 《多传感器智能融合成像技术》课是基于多谱段成像信息融合、多类型传感器像质增强的智能融合成像专业课，可服务于智能视觉工程、光电信息科学与工程、电子科学与技术、光学工程等学科，作为专业选修课为本科生未来从事应用光学、智能视觉、精密仪器等领域的科学研究、工程实践应用提供引导性支持。作为大三、大四学生选修课，注重学生实践操作，给学生提供基本可见光/红外成像系统图像视频的操作过程，结合图像数据信号，实现像素融合的算法试验。 课程目标1：了解和掌握多波段光学成像系统设计的理论基础、技术途径、核心难点、发展趋势和前沿应用；了解和掌握惯性传感器、位置传感器、温度传感器等对补偿环境变化、增强成像像质的作用，具备根据不同应用环境，开展成像性能分析、智能成像增强的设计理念，能够综合运用多传感器信息融合方法提升成像系统的鲁棒性与适应性。 课程目标2：通过可见光和红外多波段成像实验与案例分析，培养学生对多传感器智能融合成像系统的建模、仿真、优化与集成能力，形成对影响成像因素的分析能力，结合多传感器信息开展补偿、标定，提升图像像质和光谱信息可信度。 课程目标3：通过多多因素的分析，使学生其具备解决复杂工程问题的实践素养和创新意识能力。
default.en: 《Multi-sensor Fusion for Intelligent Imaging》 is a professional course based on multi-spectral imaging information fusion and multi-sensor image quality enhancement. It mainly serves disciplines such as Intelligent Vision Engineering, Optoelectronic Information Science and Engineering, Electronic Science and Technology, and Optical Engineering. As a professional elective course, it provides guiding support for undergraduates who intend to engage in scientific research and engineering applications in the fields of applied optics, intelligent vision, and precision instrumentation in the future. Designed for junior and senior undergraduates, the course emphasizes practice, offering students operational experience with basic visible-light/infrared imaging systems for images and videos, combined with image data signals, to conduct algorithmic experiments for pixels fusion. Target 1:？？ Understand and master the theoretical foundations, technical approaches, core challenges, development trends, and cutting-edge applications of multi-band optical imaging system design; learn the roles of inertial sensors, position sensors, temperature sensors, and others in compensating for environmental changes and enhancing imaging quality. Develop the ability to conduct imaging performance analysis and intelligent imaging enhancement design tailored to different application environments, and be capable of comprehensively utilizing multi-sensor information fusion methods to improve the robustness and adaptability of imaging systems. Target 2:？ Through experiments and case studies involving visible and infrared multi-band imaging, cultivate students' abilities in modeling, simulation, optimization, and integration of multi-sensor intelligent fusion imaging systems. Foster analytical skills for identifying factors affecting imaging, and enable the use of multi-sensor information for compensation and calibration to enhance image quality and the reliability of spectral information. Target 3:？？ Through multi-factorial analysis, equip students with practical literacy and innovative problem-solving capabilities to address complex engineering challenges.

default.zh: 毕业论文（设计）是本科生专业培养的最后一个环节，是通过实践教学全面锻炼和提升学生专业综合能量和素养的关键环节。其课程目标包括： （1）进一步深化和扩展所学到的基础知识、专业知识；培养学生综合运用所学的知识，分析和解决自动化技术领域的工程技术问题的能力。 （2）提高实验动手能力，提高自学能力和独立工作的能力，使学生受到工程师所应具有的基本训练，具备开展科学研究工作的基本能力。 （3）培养学生的表达能力和团队精神，培养创新意识和创新精神，树立正确的人生观、价值观，在思想政治素质方面得到进一步的提高。
default.en: Graduation thesis (design) is the last link of undergraduate professional training, and it is a key link to comprehensively exercise and enhance students' professional comprehensive energy and quality through practical teaching.Its course objectives include: (1) Further deepen and expand the basic knowledge and professional knowledge learned;To develop students' ability to comprehensively apply the knowledge they have learned to analyze and solve engineering problems in the field of automation technology. (2) Improve the hands-on ability of experiments, improve the ability of self-study and the ability to work independently, so that students receive the basic training that engineers should have, and have the basic ability to carry out scientific research. (3) Cultivate students' expression ability and team spirit, cultivate innovative consciousness and spirit, establish correct outlook on life and values, and further improve their ideological and political quality.

default.zh: 为了转变传统教育思想观念，变被动教学为主动开放式求学，培养学生协作攻关、善于创新、勤于实践、攻坚克难的科研精神，特此在整个大二春季学期开设创新科研实践课程。本课程以项目实践为主，要求每位学生根据自身的兴趣和需求，从创新科研实践数据库中自主选择项目内容，在对应的科研项目导师指导下，掌握科学研究基本方法，熟悉整个科学研究流程，将所学的理论知识与具体实际问题相结合，自主完成创新性研究项目设计，研究实施方案论证，最终完成项目结题报告、成果汇报等工作。课程考核方式主要分为：项目开题，中期检查，结题答辩验收等。
default.en: 划译 In order to transform traditional educational ideas and concepts, change passive teaching into active and open learning, and cultivate students' scientific research spirit of collaborating, innovating, practicing, and tackling difficulties, an innovative scientific research practice course is specially offered throughout the spring semester of sophomore year. This course is mainly based on project practice, requiring each student to independently choose project content from the innovative scientific research practice database based on their own interests and needs.Under the guidance of the corresponding scientific research project mentor, students will master basic methods of scientific research, familiarize themselves with the entire scientific research process, combine the theoretical knowledge learned with specific practical problems, independently complete the design of innovative research projects, and complete the research content of the project.Finally, they will complete project conclusion reports, results reporting, and other work.The assessment methods of the course mainly include project proposal, mid-term inspection, and conclusion defense and acceptance.

default.zh: 通过认识实习教学环节培养，组织学生参观微电子产品生产企业或科研院所，开设与微电子专业设计、制造、测试、封装相关的专题讲座，使学生了解微电子业发展现状，熟悉当前微电子产品生产过程，了解常用仪器设备，巩固和丰富已学过的专业知识，培养学生的思考能力，理论联系实际能力。 学生通过在认识实习过程中，相关企事业单位介绍，对专业发展前沿、工作领域进行初步了解，从而提高对专业学习的理解，提高专业技能和综合素质，为后续课程学习打好基础。 认识实习采取学习总结报告形式进行考核，累加式考核方式计分：30%平时表现+70%实习报告，满分100分。
default.en: The course of Cognition Practice in Microelectronics science & engineering, students were organized to visit microelectronics enterprises or scientific research institutes, listening some seminar related with microelectronics professional design, manufacturing, testing and encapsulation, etc. Let students understand the development of microelectronics industry, familiar with the current microelectronics production process, understand the instruments and equipment, consolidate and enrich the professional knowledge, cultivate the students' thinking ability, theory with practice. In the process of recognized practice, make students a preliminary understanding of the frontier and work fields, so as to improve their understanding of professional learning, improve professional skills and comprehensive quality, and lay a good foundation for the follow-up course learning. The evaluation of this course adopts cumulative assessment score: usual performance accounted for 30% of the total score, the internship report accounted for 70% of total score. The score was 100 points

default.zh: 微电子科学与工程专业生产实习在校内微电子实验室指导学生进行微电子器件（如双极型晶体管）制作，完成工艺操作及工艺参数测试。 双极型晶体管主要工艺步骤：（1）清洗→（2）一氧→（3）光刻基区→（4）硼扩→(5)光刻发射区→(6)磷扩→(7)光刻引线孔→(8)镀铝→(9)反刻铝→(10)去胶并合金化→(11)中测→(12)划片→(13)上架烧结→(14)压焊→(15)封帽→(16)成测。其中，重点应掌握氧化、光刻、扩散关键单项工艺。 采取累加式考核方式计分：30%平时表现+30%结课考试+40%实习报告，满分100分。 通过生产实习教学环节培养，使学生了解微电子产品生产现状，熟悉常用生产设备、仪器，产品制作过程，巩固和丰富已学过的专业知识。培养学生的动手能力，理论联系实际能力。提高解决实际问题的能力和综合素质。并为后续课程学习打好基础。
default.en: The course of Production Practice in Microelectronics science & engineering, guide the students to fabricate the microelectronics devices (such as bipolar transistor) on the silicone substrate in the intramural microelectronics Laboratory, completing all the operation of the process flow and the measure of the process parameters. To carry out the process production of Bipolar Transistor at the microelectronics laboratory, the main process are as follows: (1)Cleaning→(2)First oxidation→(3)Lithography base→(4)B-diffusion→(5)Lithography emitter→(6)P-diffusion→(7)Lithography stack contact→(8)Aluminum Evaporation→(9) Etchback Aluminum→(10) Phototesist stripping and Alloying→(11)Middle test→(12)Scribe→(13)Sintering on the cassette→(14)Wirebonding→(15)Packaging→(16)Final test. Among these processes, the students should focus on the key individual processes such as oxidation, photolithography and diffusion. The evaluation of this course adopts cumulative assessment score: usual performance accounted for 30% of the total score, the final exam accounted for 30% of the total score, internship report accounted for 40% of total score. The score was 100 points Through the training of production practice, students could understand the status quo of microelectronic products. They may be familiar with production equipment and production process with the professional knowledge to consolidate and enrich what they learned from the books. This course aims at developing students' practical ability, integrating theory with practical ability, improving the ability to solve practical problems. The studying of this course lays a good foundation for the follows courses.

default.zh: 毕业论文（设计）是本科生专业培养的最后一个环节，是通过实践教学全面锻炼和提升学生专业综合能量和素养的关键环节。其课程目标包括： （1）进一步深化和扩展所学到的基础知识、专业知识；培养学生综合运用所学的知识，分析和解决微电子科学与工程领域的工程技术问题的能力。 （2）提高实验动手能力，提高自学能力和独立工作的能力，使学生受到工程师所应具有的基本训练，具备开展科学研究工作的基本能力。 （3）培养学生的表达能力和团队精神，培养创新意识和创新精神，树立正确的人生观、价值观，在思想政治素质方面得到进一步的提高。
default.en: Graduation thesis (design) is the last link of undergraduate professional training, and it is a key link to comprehensively exercise and enhance students' professional comprehensive energy and quality through practical teaching.Its course objectives include: (1) Further deepen and expand the basic knowledge and professional knowledge learned;To develop students' ability to comprehensively apply the knowledge they have learned to analyze and solve engineering problems in the field of Microelectronics Science & engineering. (2) Improve the hands-on ability of experiments, improve the ability of self-study and the ability to work independently, so that students receive the basic training that engineers should have, and have the basic ability to carry out scientific research. (3) Cultivate students' expression ability and team spirit, cultivate innovative consciousness and spirit, establish correct outlook on life and values, and further improve their ideological and political quality.

default.zh: 智能视觉系统课程设计是衔接智能视觉理论知识与工程实践的核心实践环节，立足智能制造、人工智能等前沿领域需求，以培养学生系统设计、工程应用及创新能力为核心目标。本课程设计紧密结合智能视觉系统的核心技术体系，涵盖图像采集、预处理、特征提取、目标检测与识别、系统集成等关键模块，整合传感器技术、CCD/CMOS成像原理、数字图像处理算法及嵌入式视觉系统等核心知识点，实现理论与实践的深度融合。 课程设计采用“理论引导-实践操作-项目落地”的分层教学模式，引导学生从硬件选型（相机、镜头、光源等）、软件编程（基于OpenCV、PyTorch等工具）到系统调试，完整掌握智能视觉系统的设计流程与实现方法。通过模拟工业检测、目标定位、智能识别等真实应用场景，学生将分组完成综合性设计项目，在实践中深化对机器视觉与人工智能交叉融合的理解，提升问题分析、团队协作及工程创新能力，为后续从事智能视觉相关领域的研发、应用与维护工作奠定坚实的实践基础，助力学生适应智能制造产业对复合型技术人才的需求。
default.en: The course design of Intelligent Vision System is a core practical link connecting theoretical knowledge and engineering practice of intelligent vision. Based on the needs of cutting-edge fields such as intelligent manufacturing and artificial intelligence, it aims to cultivate students' abilities in system design, engineering application and innovation. Closely integrated with the core technology system of intelligent vision systems, this course design covers key modules including image acquisition, preprocessing, feature extraction, target detection and recognition, and system integration. It integrates core knowledge points such as sensor technology, CCD/CMOS imaging principles, digital image processing algorithms and embedded vision systems, realizing in-depth integration of theory and practice. Adopting a hierarchical teaching mode of "theoretical guidance - practical operation - project implementation", the course design guides students to fully master the design process and implementation methods of intelligent vision systems from hardware selection (cameras, lenses, light sources, etc.), software programming (based on tools such as OpenCV and PyTorch) to system debugging. By simulating real application scenarios such as industrial inspection, target positioning and intelligent recognition, students will complete comprehensive design projects in groups, deepen their understanding of the cross-integration of machine vision and artificial intelligence in practice, and improve their abilities in problem analysis, team collaboration and engineering innovation. This course design lays a solid practical foundation for students to engage in research and development, application and maintenance in intelligent vision-related fields, helping them adapt to the demand for compound technical talents in the intelligent manufacturing industry.

default.zh: 图像处理与机器视觉今年来得到迅速发展。课程从工程的角度介绍视觉处理的基本知识，主要讲述底层图像处理，各类基本图像变换和视觉特征的提取，特征描述与目标识别等内容，在激发学生学习兴趣的同时使学生切实理解教学内容并能应用到实践中，为日后的专业领域研究及工程实践打好基础。课程的主要任务是，通过形象化的课堂教学、实验上机题目及实践环节，培养学生图像处理和机器视觉方向基础知识的理解和工程应用能力，培养学生的创新意识和团队协作能力。
default.en: Image processing and machine vision develop rapidly in recent years. The course introduces the basic knowledge of image and vision processing from the perspective of engineering. It mainly covers low-level image processing, various basic image transformation, visual feature extraction, feature description and target recognition, which can stimulate students' interest in learning and enable students to effectively understand course content and apply it to practice, therefore lay a good foundation for future professional research and engineering practice. The main task of the course is to cultivate students' understanding and engineering capability of basic knowledge in image processing and machine vision, and to foster students' innovation and team cooperation capability through knowledge point visualization, designed experiment topics and programming practice.

default.zh: 微电子机械系统（Micro Electro Mechanical Systems, MEMS）是近年来发展起来的一种新型多学科交叉的技术，应用该技术的陀螺仪具有体积小、成本低、功耗少、抗冲击能力强等优点，目前MEMS陀螺仪已广泛应用于航空航天、机械制造、生物化学、汽车电子等各个领域。本课程通过授课与实验形式，结合MEMS陀螺仪原理、结构和性能特点，使学生对惯性传感器件的开发和应用有直观的认知，在此基础上通过实际惯性系统设计，培养和锻炼学生的创新精神、创新思维能力和科学研究水平。同时，在教学与实验过程中，结合本学科具体情况，介绍本学科体系、学科发展过程、学科前沿和本学科特色，增进学生对本专业技术和发展方向的了解。
default.en: Micro Electro Mechanical Systems (MEMS) are new multidisciplinary technology that developed in recent years. At the moment, the MEMS gyroscope is widely used in aerospace, machinery manufacturing, biological chemistry, automotive electronics and other fields, which has with the advantages of small size, low cost, low power consumption, strong shock resistance ability, etc. In this course, the principle, the structure and the performance feature of the MEMS gyroscope is introduced by lectures and lab tutorial to show the development and application of inertial sensor to the students. On this basis, the spirit of innovation and the scientific research level are cultivated through designing the inertial system. Simultaneously, according to the subject specific situation, the subject system, developing, frontier and feature will be given in the course to enhance student’s knowledge about this professional technology and development direction.

default.zh: 信息物理系统（Cyber-Physical System， CPS）深度融合了通信、计算与控制， 能够实现信息层与物理层实时交互、动态优化。信息物理系统在智能家居、智能交通、远程医疗、智能制造以及军事等领域具有广泛的应用前景。然而，随着“震网病毒”攻击事件的发生，信息物理系统的安全问题受到极大关注。围绕信息物理系统的安全问题，本课程主要学习信息物理系统的概念、介绍相关攻击案例、学习如何从自动控制的角度分析信息物理系统的安全性、设计安全控制策略。在此基础上，依托实验室自主智能无人系统实验平台（包括无人车、无人机、机械臂、气浮平台等），带领学生开展相关实验。通过实验演示网络攻击对系统安全性的影响、验证设计的安全控制算法。 该课程属于新兴的交叉研究领域，课程主要内容包括：信息物理系统概述、信息物理系统安全性介绍、信息物理系统安全性分析、欺骗攻击情形下信息物理系统的安全滑模控制设计。
default.en: Cyber-Physical System (CPS) closely integrates communication, computing and control, enabling real-time interaction and dynamic optimization between the cyber layer and the physical layer. CPS has a wide range of applications in the fields of smart home, smart transportation, telemedicine, smart manufacturing and military, etc. However, with the occurrence of the Stuxnet attack, the security issue of cyber- physical systems has received great attention. Focusing on the security of cyber- physical systems, this course focuses on the concept of cyber-physical systems, introduces relevant attack cases, talks about how to analyze the security of cyber- physical systems from the perspective of automatic control, and designs security control strategies. On this basis, the students are led to conduct relevant experiments based on the laboratory's autonomous intelligent unmanned system experimental platform (unmanned vehicles, drones, robotic arms, air-floating platforms, etc.). The experiments demonstrate the impact of network attacks on system security and verify the designed security control algorithms. The course belongs to an emerging cross-study area, and the main contents of the course include: overview of cyber-physical systems, introduction to cyber-physical system security, cyber-physical system security analysis, and secure sliding-mode control design under deception attack scenarios.

default.zh: 有效载荷是空间飞行器实现航天任务的核心组成部分，《空间飞行器有效载荷设计》是研究这一核心组成部分的基本原理和设计方法的一门课程， 在培养学生航天器总体设计、有效载荷设计分析及航天器工程实践能力等方面占有重要的地位。本课程主要通过讲授几类常见的、重要的航天器有效载荷（光学、通信、雷达等），使学生了解和掌握航天器有效载荷设计、使用、分析的基本原理。通过本课程的课堂教学、讨论、随堂问卷等环节，着重培养学生们航天器有效载荷设计与分析能力，增加创新意识，支撑专业学习成果中相应指标的达成。
default.en: Payload is the core component of the space vehicle to realize the space mission. 'Space Vehicle Payload Design' is a course to study the basic principles and design methods of this core component. It plays an important role in cultivating students ' overall spacecraft design, payload design analysis and spacecraft engineering practice ability. This course mainly teaches several common and important spacecraft payloads (optics, communication, radar, etc.), so that students can understand and master the basic principles of spacecraft payload design, use, and analysis. Through the classroom teaching, discussion, in-class questionnaire and other links of this course, we focus on cultivating students ' ability of spacecraft payload design and analysis, increasing their awareness of innovation, and supporting the achievement of corresponding indicators in professional learning results..

default.zh: 本课程将系统介绍当前国际航天高校和商业航天公司流行的微纳卫星设计与研制的各方面，并针对典型的微纳卫星项目的方案特点进行剖析，帮助学生更好的认识微纳卫星、了解微纳卫星的设计思路。基于紫丁香创新工场开展实验实践，锻炼学生独立解决问题能力和团队配合能力，为我校培养高水平航天人才。教学内容主要包括：微纳卫星发展现状、基本概念以及系统组成；典型微纳卫星任务剖析；微纳卫星分系统和典型载荷介绍；面向任务的微纳卫星需求分析与方案设计。
default.en: This course will give a brief introduction of the latest technology development of the field of nano-satellite, and analyse the characteristics of typical nano-satellite projects to help students better understand nano-satellites and the design arts of nano-satellites. Experimental practice based on the Lilac Nano-satellite Workshop will help students to develop independent problem-solving and teamwork skills. The content of the course includes: the current development of nano-satellite and basic concepts; typical nano-satellite mission analysis; introduction of nano-satellite subsystems and typical payloads; nano-satellite mission analysis and design.

default.zh: 生物芯片是互联网医疗、智能家居的重要组成部分，具有广阔的创新空间。今年来，生物芯片的研究与发展逐渐成熟，由实验室研究向实用化产品发展。生物芯片设计多领域知识的交叉，辐射射计算机、自动控制、通信、机电一体化、生化检测等专业的知识和技术。其中的嵌入式技术是微流控芯片的流体控制与生化检测的控制核心。 本课程的目的是使学生了解以生物芯片为主的智能健康监控设备的概念，了解生物检测方法的类别，学习掌握嵌入式软件的系统分析，设计和实现的要点，围绕生物芯片中嵌入式系统的设计和应用，培养学生创新实践的兴趣和能力。 主要内容包括生物芯片的发展简介，最新生物芯片等智能健康监控设备分析，生物芯片对嵌入式系统的功能需求；嵌入式软件开发工具与方法，嵌入式软件调试工具与调试技术；嵌入式操作系统结构与工作原理；面向嵌入式软件的软件工程。本课程帮助学生建立系统级的概念、分析和设计方法，为培养具有系统观念的工程师打下坚实的基础。
default.en: Biochips are an important part of Internet medical care and smart home, and have a broad space for innovation. This year, the research and development of biochips has gradually matured, from laboratory research to practical products. Intersection of knowledge in multiple fields of biochip design, professional knowledge and technology of radiation computer, automatic control, communication, mechatronics, biochemical detection, etc. The embedded technology is the control core of the fluid control and biochemical detection of the microfluidic chip. The purpose of this course is to enable students to understand the concept of intelligent health monitoring equipment based on biochips, understand the categories of biodetection methods, learn to master the key points of system analysis, design and implementation of embedded software, and focus on embedded systems in biochips Design and application, cultivate students' interest and ability in innovative practice. The main contents include an introduction to the development of biochips, the analysis of the latest biochips and other intelligent health monitoring equipment, the functional requirements of biochips for embedded systems; embedded software development tools and methods, embedded software debugging tools and debugging techniques; embedded operating systems Structure and working principle; software engineering for embedded software. This course helps students develop systems-level conceptual, analytical, and design methods, providing a solid foundation for developing systems-minded engineers.

default.zh: 本课程是面向本科生开设的集成电路创新创业大赛的培训课程，课程目标在于通过有针对性的项目分析、管理和技术培训，使学生能够系统、准确地了解竞赛内容，推动学生积极参加相关设计竞赛，培养学生在集成电路和智能传感器应用方面的创新实践能力，适应我国集成电路人才培养要求。课程内容包括讲授集成电路设计和智能传感器应用相关的设计流程和软件使用方法。并通过典型竞赛题目设立全部流程的实践实验，培养学生全面掌握项目规划、方案设计、晶体管级设计、后端版图和智能传感器应用等方面的创新能力。课程要求学生能够掌握matlab、candence、altium designer等软件的使用，正确完成典型案例的设计。
default.en: This course is an undergraduate courses in China College IC Competition training.
