Students are required to master the basic theories involved in the synthesis of inorganic compounds and master the principles and methods of high-temperature synthesis, low-temperature synthesis, high-pressure synthesis, etc., master the synthesis design methods and skills of organic compounds, learn how to design their synthesis routes by reverse cutting according to the known molecular structure, and master the synthesis and characterization methods of organic-inorganic hybrid materials. To enable students to have the purpose and requirements of analysis, combined with the characteristics of various instrumental analysis methods they have learned, the application scope of the methods, and the ability to select appropriate analysis methods in scientific research. Develop students' ability to analyze and solve problems with materials independently.

default.zh: 生物化学是生命科学各专业的一门重要的专业基础课。生物化学是用化学的理论和方法研究生物体的化学组成以及在生命活动中所发生的化学变化及其调控规律，从而阐明生命现象本质的一门学科。通过生物化学的学习，使学生系统地掌握现代生物化学的基本理论、基本知识，掌握生物化学的基本技术，培养学生从分子水平认识生命现象的能力，训练学生分析问题和解决问题的能力，了解近期生物化学的新进展，启发学生的创新精神，为学生进一步学习生物学的有关后续课程准备必要的生物化学知识，并为以后从事与生命科学有关的教学、科研与生产奠定基础。
default.en: Biochemistry is an important course for all major of life sciences. Biochemistry is a discipline that uses chemical theories and methods to study the chemical composition of organisms, the chemical changes that occur in their life activities, and their regulations. Through the study of biochemistry, students should systematically master the basic theory and basic knowledge of modern biochemistry, master the basic techniques of biochemistry, develop students' abilities to recognize life phenomena at the molecular level, train their ability to analyze and solve problems, and understand recent advances in biochemistry, prepare necessary biochemical knowledge for students' further follow-up courses in biology, and lay the foundation for future teaching, research and production related to life sciences.

default.zh: 自现代化学工业诞生以来，控制技术一直是化学工业发展的关键推动力之一，决定了化学工业的过程性。与机械、汽车、电子设备等离散制造行业相比，多尺度构成了应用化学及化工行业的典型特点，化工行业需要在分子、单元、过程等尺度上，通过人工智能的互联、耦合与协同，科学地解决跨尺度间的传递与协同机制问题。把人工智能等现代信息技术与化工知识相融合，构建综合性的知识体系，突出数字技术对应用化学学科发展在方法论方面的重要意义。内容包括：材料基因工程、魔幻的团簇与合金材料、AI构筑多孔材料万花筒、AI为锂离子电池助威、AI让有机光电材料大放异彩、AI助力药物设计、AI助力波谱分析、典型化学反应的催化材料与反应机制、高端专用化学品功能调控机制、AI前沿在过程系统工程中的应用及功能纳米材料介尺度结构形成机制与性能调控、装备/过程层次的介科学研究与应用、层次界面与跨层次耦合的介科学研究与应用以及从虚拟过程到无人工厂-介科学驱动的过程工业智能化。
default.en: Since the birth of modern chemical industry, control technology has always been one of the key driving forces for the development of chemical industry, determining the processability of the chemical industry. Compared with discrete manufacturing industries such as machinery, automobiles, and electronic equipment, multi-scale composition is a typical feature of the applied chemistry and chemical industry. The chemical industry needs to scientifically solve the problem of transmission and collaboration mechanisms across scales through the interconnection, coupling, and collaboration of artificial intelligence at molecular, unit, and process scales. Integrating modern information technologies such as artificial intelligence with chemical knowledge, constructing a comprehensive knowledge system, and highlighting the significant methodological significance of digital technology in the development of applied chemistry. The content includes: material genetic engineering, magical clusters and alloy materials, AI building a porous material kaleidoscope, AI boosting lithium-ion batteries, AI making organic optoelectronic materials shine, AI assisting drug design, AI assisting spectral analysis, catalytic materials and reaction mechanisms for typical chemical reactions, functional regulation mechanisms for high-end specialized chemicals.

default.zh: 催化在国民经济中起着十分重要的作用，它在炼油、化工、环保、制药、能源、材料等行业中已创造出巨大的经济效益和社会效益，特别是目前人们面临着能源利用、环境保护等重大问题，都要依赖于催化过程来解决，催化科学已成为发展现代工业和高新技术不可缺少的科学基础。 本课程对化工与化学学院三年级本科生开课，通过本课程的学习，学生应对催化科学和技术的发展趋势有一个概括的认识和了解；掌握有关催化作用的基本知识、掌握酸碱催化、金属催化、金属氧化物催化、工业中的重要催化反应过程及绿色催化化学等相关知识，掌握催化剂的制备、生产和表征方法等。
default.en: Catalysis plays a very important role in the national economy, it creates enormous economic and social benefits especially in petrochemical industry, environmental protection, pharmacy, energy, materials and other industries. Catalytic science has become indispensable for modern industry and practically for the solution to the facing major issues such as energy and environmental protection. This course is open to the junior students of Chemistry and Chemical Engineering. Through this course study, students should have a broad knowledge and understanding of the developments in the catalytic science and technology; grasp the knowledge about the nature of catalysis, acid-base catalysis, oxidation catalysis, green chemistry and so on. Also students should understand the preparation and characterization of catalysts.

default.zh: 课程是为材料化学系开设的一门必修自然科学专业课，是为材料化学本科学生学完无机、有机、分析化学等基础化学之后，进一步了解固体材料的特性问题而开设的。课程内容主要介绍现代晶体材料的分类和制造方法，晶体结构性质，晶体的缺陷，晶体生长理论，固相反应原理，及晶体的电学性质，光学性质，磁学性质。
default.en: Crystal chemistry is the study of solid materials, which may be molecular. Solid-state chemistry studies both synthesis, the structure and the physical properties of solids. It therefore has a strong overlap with solid-state physics, mineralogy, crystallography, ceramics, metallurgy, thermodynamics, materials science and electronics with a focus on the synthesis of novel materials.

default.zh: 功能材料课程是材料化学专业的专业主干课程。本课程着重培养学生掌握功能材料的基本分类、组成、结构与性能，并对常见功能材料的制备、应用和性能评价方法有所了解。通过课堂教学使学生了解与掌握有关功能材料的基本性质、生产工艺以及电介质陶瓷材料、功能转换材料、超导材料、半导体材料、敏感材料、磁性材料、高分子材料等方面的基本知识及主要应用领域。
default.en: Functional materialsI is one of the main courses for materials chemistry students. This course emphasizes grasping the category, component, structure and properties of functional materials, and knows some about common materials preparation, application and properties evaluation. In this class, students can master the fundamental properties, production technique of functional materials, and primary knowledge of electric ceramic materials, functional transition materials, superconductor, semi-conductor, sensor materials, magnetic materials, high polymer materials and their main applications.

default.zh: 化工原理课程属工程技术科学学科，是化工和化学类及相近专业一门必修的基础技术课。是在学生学完了《高等数学》、《大学物理》、《物理化学》等先修课程后开设。主要任务是用自然科学原理考察、解释和处理化工生产中单元操作过程的基本原理，典型设备及其计算（包括选型）方法，以培养学生分析和解决有关工程实际问题的能力。
default.en: The course of Chemical Engineering Principles belongs to the discipline of Engineering Technology Science and is a compulsory basic technical course for chemical engineering, chemistry and related majors. It is offered after students have completed prerequisite courses such as Advanced Mathematics, College Physics, and Physical Chemistry. The main task is to use natural science principles to investigate, explain, and process the basic principles, typical equipment, and calculation (including selection) methods of unit operation processes in chemical production, in order to cultivate students' ability to analyze and solve practical engineering problems.

default.zh: 《绿色碳科学与技术》是基于何鸣元院士提出的“绿色碳科学”概念，总结我国开展相关学术研究取得的最新成果，使学生面对双碳目标重大国家需求，学习创新思想，培养创新能力。本课程的总目标是为了全面提高绿色碳科学人才自主培养质量、造就拔尖创新人才，使学生面对双碳目标重大国家需求，学习创新思想，培养创新能力。其内容主要包括碳能源体系运行规律，碳能源体系化学反应中所涉及的氧化还原过程，并从碳、氢、氧三种元素来综合理解“绿色碳科学”，进而培养学生系统掌握负碳、零碳、低碳和脱碳的基本概念及科学基础，树立绿色低碳理念。使学生理解绿色碳科学内涵、掌握绿色碳科学基础理论、促进绿色碳科学技术应用，并有机融合低碳与绿色发展的思政元素，实现课程思政协同育人成效。培养学生的系统思维和创新思维的科学素养。教学方法采用教育信息化与课堂教学的深度融合，培养学生自主学习和终生学习的意识，引导和启发学生利用现代工具适应智慧教学能力，能够运用计算科学的基础概念和相关信息技术进行问题求解、系统设计等相应活动的能力。
default.en: Green Carbon Science and Technology "is based on the concept of" green carbon science "proposed by Academician He Mingyuan. It summarizes the latest achievements of relevant academic research in China, enabling students to face the major national needs of the dual carbon goal, learn innovative ideas, and cultivate innovative abilities. The overall goal of this course is to comprehensively improve the quality of independent cultivation of green carbon science talents, cultivate top-notch innovative talents, and enable students to face the major national needs of the dual carbon goal, learn innovative ideas, and cultivate innovative abilities. The content mainly includes the operational laws of the carbon energy system, the redox processes involved in the chemical reactions of the carbon energy system, and a comprehensive understanding of "green carbon science" from the three elements of carbon, hydrogen, and oxygen. This will cultivate students' systematic understanding of the basic concepts and scientific foundation of negative carbon, zero carbon, low-carbon, and decarbonization, and establish the concept of green and low-carbon. Enable students to understand the connotation of green carbon science, master the basic theories of green carbon science, promote the application of green carbon science and technology, and organically integrate the ideological and political elements of low-carbon and green development, achieving the synergistic effect of ideological and political education in the curriculum. Cultivate students' scientific literacy in systematic and innovative thinking. The teaching method adopts a deep integration of educational informatization and classroom teaching, cultivating students' awareness of self-directed learning and lifelong learning, guiding and inspiring students to use modern tools to adapt to intelligent teaching abilities, and being able to apply basic concepts of computational science and related information technology for problem-solving, system design, and other corresponding activities.

default.zh: 固体物理是研究固体的物理性质、微观结构、固体中各种粒子运动形态和规律及它们相互关系的学科，是物理、化学和材料科学的基础。本课程为一门专业选修课，主要内容包括晶体结构、晶体缺陷、晶格振动、金属自由电子论和能带理论等。通过固体物理的整个教学过程，使学生理解晶体结构、固体电子论和能带理论等基础理论知识，掌握周期性结构的固体材料的常规性质和研究方法，了解固体物理领域的一些新进展。本课程以理论教学为主，同时注重培养学生综合运用所学知识，对现代科学实验和实际工作中出现的现象进行科学合理解释的能力。
default.en: Solid state physics is a discipline that studies the physical properties, microstructure, motion patterns and laws of various particles in solids, as well as their interrelationships. It is the foundation of physics, chemistry, and materials science. This course is a professional elective course, mainly covering crystal structure, crystal defects, lattice vibration, metal free electron theory, and band theory. Through the entire teaching process of solid state physics, students can understand basic theoretical knowledge such as crystal structure, solid electron theory, and band theory, master the conventional properties and research methods of periodic structured solid materials, and understand some new developments in the field of solid state physics. This course focuses on theoretical teaching, while also focusing on cultivating students' ability to comprehensively apply the knowledge they have learned and provide scientific and reasonable explanations for phenomena that arise in modern scientific experiments and practical work.

default.zh: 结构化学是高等院校化学专业的一门主干基础课程。它主要在原子、分子水平上讨论物质的性质与电子结构和空间结构间的关系，是物理化学的重要分支。随着学科间的相互交叉，结构化学为许多前沿的理论问题以及实验技术提供了理论基础。它依据结构决定性能、性能反映结构的基本原则，研究物质的结构与性能间的关系，使学生掌握微观物质运动的基本规律，获得原子和分子结构、性质的基本理论和基础知识，加深对无机化学、有机化学等前修课程的理解，为后续课程的学习以及从事科学研究打下坚实的基础。 课程内容主要包括绪论，量子力学基础知识，原子和分子的结构及性质，涉及微观粒子所遵循的量子力学规律，原子中电子的分布和能级、分子的化学组成、分子的空间构型和构象、分子中电子的分布、化学键的性质和分子的能量状态等。课程考试成绩采用累加式，综合考虑期末笔试，出席、平时表现和作业完成情况。
default.en: Structural chemistry, as one important branching of physical chemistry, is a major course for chemistry studies in university. It probes the electron and space structures at the atomistic and molecular levels and relates them with physical properties. With the development of interdiscipline, structure chemistry provides fundamentals for the latest issues and techniques in theories and experiments. It investigates the relationship between the structures and properties of substances based on the fact that structures determine properties and in turn the properties reveal structures. In this course, knowledge of quantum mechanics and structures and characteristics of atoms and molecules are introduced, concerning quantum rules for microscopic particles, distributions and energy levels of electrons in an atom, components, space structure and configuration, electron distributions, bonding, and energy states of molecules. After finishing the course students should know the intrinsic rules of motions at a microscopic state, learn the knowledge and basic principles about the structures and features of atoms and molecules, better understand the contents of inorganic and organic chemistry they previous studied, and have a knowledge foundation for the latter specialty lessons and scientific research.

default.zh: 《化学信息学》课程主要面向化学化工类大三年级学生开设，共32学时。本课程强调实践并侧重于计算机与网络的应用。课程主要内容为：Internet上的化学信息检索工具，Internet上的化学数据库，Internet上的化学虚拟图书馆与电子期刊，分子图形学软件，计算化学软件与资源，化学专家系统，计算机辅助有机合成和材料设计，科学计算工具及可视化，化学CAI教育与远程信息资源等。课程介绍了很多常见的、功能强大的化学软件与系统，如：ISIS/Draw， ChemSketch，ChemOffice，Gaussian， KnowItAll，ChemLab，ORIGIN等。
default.en: Information Technology is the backbone of modern society. Chemical information is a new frontier subject which is based on Chemistry, Computer Science and Information Technology and chemical engineering. It congregates chemistry, chemical engine philology, computer expression, management and network transmission of chemical knowledge, molecular graphics, and use of expert system of chemistry, chemistry statistics, CAI chemistry education and remote information transfer. This course emphasizes practical and application of computer and network. The main contents of the course include internet retrieval tools, chemical database, virtual library and electronic journal, molecular graphics and computational chemistry software, expert system of chemistry, computational assistant of organic synthesis and material design, scientific computational tools and its visualization, and CAI chemistry education and remote information transfer. The course also introduces some usual but powerful chemical software and system, such as ISIS/Draw， ChemSketch，ChemOffice，Gaussian， KnowItAll，ChemLab，ORIGIN and etc.

default.zh: 机器学习是人工智能研究领域中的重要分支，它研究如何利用计算机从数据中进行学习，以获取新的知识与技能，并提高自身的性能表现。随着以数据驱动型科学为主的“大数据”时代的到来，机器学习已经逐渐渗入到科学技术以及日常生活中的各个领域。另一方面，机器学习在化学领域的应用具有悠久的历史。近年来利用机器学习算法辅助分子和材料发现和设计正不断取得革命性突破。本课程讲授机器学习基本概念，介绍几种常见的机器学习算法，及其在化学前沿领域的典型应用实例，同时讨论机器学习为化学学科带来的挑战与机遇。
default.en: Machine learning is an important branch of artificial intelligence, which studies algorithms whose performance improves with data. With the advent of the era of "big data" based on data-driven science, machine learning has gradually penetrated into science and technology and various fields in human daily life. On the other hand, the application of machine learning in the field of chemistry has a long history. Recently, the use of machine learning algorithms is continuously making breakthroughs for accelerating molecules and materials design and discovery. This course presents basic concepts of machine learning, commonly used machine learning algorithms, and noteworthy applications in chemistry and materials science. Besides, current challenges and further breakthroughs will be introduced in those domains.

default.zh: 能源是人类生存和发展的基础，随着社会的发展，人们对清洁能源的需求量越来越大。在清洁能源开发过程中，材料的研制是一个非常重要的内容，所用材料很大程度上决定着能源的性能和成本等。清洁能源材料化学及应用这门课主要从原理和微观机制、化学成分、组织结构、制备与性能的关系等方面介绍储氢材料、锂离子电池材料、太阳能电池材料、相变储能材料等新能源材料，同时对这些材料的发展应用前景及趋势等进行了说明。
default.en: Energy is the basis for human survival and development. With the development of society, people need more demands for clean energy. In the development of clean energy, materials development is very important, materials largely determine the performance and cost of energy. Clean energy material chemistry and application, in this course. mainly content the principle and the micro mechanism, chemical composition, microstructure, preparation and properties as well as the relationship between the hydrogen storage materials, thermoelectric materials, lithium ion battery materials, solar cell materials, photocatalytic materials, phase change energy storage material and other new energy materials, while at the same time material development and application prospects and trends are described.

default.zh: 高分子材料成型加工课程为高分子材料与工程专业的主干课程，在专业课程体系中占有重要的地位。全面掌握和了解高分子材料成型加工技术，在高分子原材料与制品之间架起桥梁，形成有机的关联，对学生专业知识的培养和工程能力的提高有着举足轻重的作用。 本课程围绕我校本专业主干方向和特色，结合学生就业后从事的生产、科研方向，主要讲授高分子材料在加工中的流变学现象，塑料的成型加工原理和经典成型方法；复合材料的成型加工原理和常用生产方法。主要涉及：加工过程中的流变现象、物料混合、塑料的挤出成型、注射成型、压延成型、热成型等，树脂基复合材料的手糊成型、缠绕成型、预浸料与模塑料成型、拉挤成型、RTM成型等内容。通过本门课程的学习，使学生对高分子材料专业知识体系有正确的理解，为后续的课程学习及毕业论文工作打下坚实的基础，可为学生毕业后在材料加工、科学研究及产品开发等方面提供技术支撑。
default.en: Polymer Materials Processing is the main course of Polymer Science and Engineering, which plays an important role in the professional curriculum system. Students will master and understand the molding process technology of polymer materials in this course, and will form an organic relationship between the raw materials and products of polymers. This course plays a decisive role in the cultivation of students' professional knowledge and the improvement of their engineering ability. The course will focus on the main direction and characteristics of Polymer Science and Engineering major in Harbin Institute of Technology, which would combine with the production and scientific research direction of students after employment. The course includes rheology of polymer materials in processing, forming principle and classic forming method of plastics, and forming principle and common production method of composite materials. The course will involve: rheology of polymer processing, mixture of material, plastic extrusion molding, injection molding, calendering molding, thermal molding, etc., resin matrix composites hand paste molding, winding molding, pre-dip material and mold plastic molding, pulling and extruding molding, RTM molding, etc. Students will understand the professional knowledge of polymer materials after studying the course. The course will lay a foundation for the subsequent professional study and graduation thesis writing, which will provide technical support for students in materials processing, scientific research and product development after graduation.

default.zh: 通过此课程的学习使学生全面掌握缩合聚合反应如合成纤维的线型缩聚、合成树脂的体型缩聚和开环缩聚的聚合工艺，加成聚合反应如自由基本体聚合、自由基乳液聚合、自由基悬浮聚合、阳离子聚合、阴离子聚合和配位聚合的两大工艺体系的材料体系、工艺特点、生产工艺参数设计、聚合反应操作过程控制、产物性能控制、反应设备及辅助装置的选择与设计、产物的分离、后处理、 回收，同时熟悉各聚合工艺的典型应用，对学生专业知识的培养和提高有着举足轻重的作用，为学生今后就业提供基础技术支撑。
default.en: Polymerization processes is one of the key optional courses for polymer materials students, which plays an important role in the professional course system. The main contents of the course involve material system, technological process control, synthetic property control, equipment choice, products separate and upper process for condensation polymerization such as linear polycondensation of synthetic fiber, body polycondensation of synthetic resin and ring opening polymerization process and addition polymerization such as free radical mass polymerization, free radical emulsion polymerization, free radical suspend polymerization，free radical solution polymerization, cation polymerization, anion polymerization, coordination polymerization. This course is very important for culturing and improving the professional knowledge of the students. It is also important for the students to acquire basic technology for their future work.

default.zh: 通过此课程的学习使学生全面掌合成纤维的基础知识，如合成纤维的发展状况、合成纤维基本概念、纤维结构、纤维结构的形成、后处理纤维的结构和性能;了解一些典型的通用纤维的结构性能及应用领域，其中包括聚酯纤维、聚酰胺纤维、聚丙烯纤维、聚丙烯纤维腈。在特种纤维部分主要介绍聚氯乙烯纤维，含氟聚合物纤维、聚氨酯弹性纤维、高模量碳纤维、芳香聚酰胺纤维、超高分子量聚乙烯纤维等品种的相关内容。全面了解和掌握合成纤维的相关知识、掌握主要纤维品种的结构性能、了解纤维的基本应用领域，对学生专业知识的培养和提高有着举足轻重的作用，为学生今后就业提供基础技术支撑。
default.en: The main contents of this course involve the basic knowledge about the development of synthetic fibers, synthetic fibers, the basic concepts of the fiber structure, fiber structure formation of the post-processing of the structure and performance of the fiber. And students can also understand the structure performance and applications of many typical generic fibers including polyester fibers, polyamide fibers, polypropylene fibers, polypropylene fibers nitrile. Moreover, in the special fiber section, polyvinyl chloride fibers, fluoro-polymer fiber, polyurethane elastic fiber, high modulus carbon fiber, aromatic polyamide fiber, ultra-high molecular weight polyethylene fiber varieties will be introduced. Comprehensive understanding and mastery of the knowledge of the synthetic fiber have a pivotal role in the cultivation and improvement of students' professional knowledge, and provide basic technical support for the future career of the students.

default.zh: 《配合物的认识与应用》课程是化学类专业的选修课程。课程主要内容，从认识配合物的应用入手，主要讲述配合组成、结构、合成、反应性与功能特性等方面的基础知识。重点讲述配合物的结构与性能。通过本课程的学习，使学生对配合物的组成、成键特性、发光性能、磁学性能、配合物的稳定性、反应性具有初步认识，使学生了解晶体配合物的结构解析的方法与步骤；注重培养学生严谨求实的治学思想，独立分析问题解决问题的能力，为今后在化学、材料科学等领域的研究工作打下初步基础。
default.en: The course of "understanding and application of complexes" is an elective course for students majoring in chemistry and related specialties. The main content of the course starts with understanding the application of complexes, and mainly describes the basic knowledge of the composition, structure, synthesis, reactivity and functional characteristics of complexes. The structure and properties of the complexes are emphasized. Through the study of this course, students will have a preliminary understanding of the composition, bonding characteristics, luminescent properties, magnetic properties, stability and reactivity of complexes, and that, students can also understand the methods and steps of structural analysis of crystal complexes. Objection of this course is to make the students cultivate the rigorous and realistic research ideas, and train the ability to analyze and solve problems independently, to lay a preliminary foundation for future research in chemistry, materials science and other fields.

default.zh: 《合成橡胶材料学》主要面向高分子专业的本科生开课，学生全面了解和掌握合成橡胶的相关知识对学生专业知识的培养和提高起着非常重要的作用，为学生今后学习、就业提供基础技术支撑。课程主要讲授了通用橡胶和特种橡胶的基本概况、分类、性能及应用。通过学习使学生了解合成橡胶材料的性能特点、选用原则、最新研究现状和未来发展趋势；了解橡胶配方设计中常用助剂品种：增塑剂、防老剂、抗氧剂；以及掌握橡胶的配合体系中的硫化、补强、增塑、防老的机理和应用等。 本课程考试成绩采用累加式，包括期末笔试、平时作业和调研报告三部分。
default.en: Synthetic Rubber is mainly for the undergraduate students of macromolecule specialty. Comprehensive understanding and mastery of the knowledge of the synthetic rubber have an important role in the cultivation and improvement of students' professional knowledge, and provide basic technical support for the future career of the students. The content of the rubber includes basic concept, classify, properties and applications of general purpose rubber and some special rubber. The students can understand the properties, selection principle, classify, latest research and future development trends of the general purpose rubber types . Also, the students will understand the action principles and application of addition agents commonly used in formulation designing, which include plastifier, aging-inhibiting, oxidation inhibitor, etc. Moreover, the students can grasp the mechanism and application of sulfuration, reinforcement, plasticization and aging-inhibiting. The score of the course includes final exam, homework and report.

default.zh: 通过本课程的学习，学生能够掌握块体多晶固体材料的固态化学理论和应用基础，学习材料结构和物理化学性质的现代检测技术，并了解这些技术的优质和限制,可以做到有针对性地选择适用目标体系的合成技术和表征手段，学会处理和分析固体结构和物理化学性质的数据。课程目标概括为： (1) 使学生熟悉化学块体多晶材料的基本原理和应用基础，以及用于其结构、物理和化学性质研究的现代技术; (2) 掌握块体多晶固体材料的无机固态化学基础知识，涵盖在不同层级和固体相平衡下的结构特性，以及多晶固体材料的现代检测技术发展; (3) 开发自主选择技术的基本理论，以解决各种基础和应用科学问题。
default.en: 1) to get students acquainted to the fundamentals and applied basics of chemistry bulk polycrystalline solids as well as modern techniques of the modern techniques used for their structure, physical and chemical properties investigation; 2) to get the fundamental knowledge on the inorganic and solid state chemistry of bulk polycrystalline solids with the respect to the features of their structure on the different hierarchical levels and phase equilibrium in solids, the wide possibilities of the modern examination techniques of the polycrystalline solids investigation; 3) the development of the basics for self-sufficient choice of techniques allowing to solve various fundamental and applied tasks. At the end of this course, students should: Learn the fundamental and applied basics of solid state chemistry of bulk polycrystalline solids and the modern techniques of the investigation of their structure, physical and chemical properties, will get know the benefits and limitations of these techniques, will be able to choose the techniques for targeted synthesis of the solids and detailed investigation of obtained polycrystalline solids by their own depending on the required properties of final materials, treat and analyze the data on structure and physical and chemical properties of solids.

default.zh: 《塑料材料学》主要讲授塑料材料的基本概况，分类和性能及应用。主要包括通用塑料品种、工程塑料以及部分常用特种塑料的性能、应用、改性研究、最新研究现状和未来发展趋势。介绍塑料加工和配方设计中常用助剂品种：增塑剂、热稳定剂、抗氧剂、光稳定剂、抗静电剂等的作用机理及应用情况。
default.en: The content of the plastics materials includes basic concept, classify, properties and applications. The modified research, latest research and future development trends of the general purpose plastics types, engineering plastics and some special plastics will been introduced. It is mainly about the action principles and application of addition agents commonly used in plastics processing and formulation designing, which include plastifier, heat-stable inhibitor, oxidation inhibitor, fireproofing agent, light stabilizer, static inhibiter, colouring agent, filler etc.

default.zh: 树脂基复合材料课程是高等工科院校中高分子材料专业的一门主干课程，在教学过程中综合运用先修课程中所学到的有关知识和内容，结合各种实践环节，讲授高分子复合材料方面工程技术人员所需的基本知识和必备技能，为学生进一步学习有关专业课程和日后从事该领域的生产、研究和开发工作打下基础。本课程主要讲授树脂基复合材料的基础知识、增强材料及其制备机理、树脂材料及其合成原理、界面作用理论等基础知识；同时，还讲授增强体、树脂基体、界面作用在树脂基复合材料设计、成型、生产中的应用原则。通过本课程的课堂教学，结合后续的专业实验操作等环节，着重培养学生们在树脂基复合材料方面的设计能力和制造能力，以及高分子材料科学知识的应用能力，增加创新意识。
default.en: Polymer matrix composite course is one of the main courses of polymer materials in engineering filed. In the teaching process, the knowledge learned in pre-courses are comprehensive used. Combined with various practical skills, the experimental skills for engineer and technician in polymer composite field are trained. It is helpful for students to further study the knowledge in this field. This course mainly focusses on the basic knowledge of resin matrix composites, for examples, the preparation mechanism of reinforced materials, the synthesis principle of resin materials, the theory of interface action and so on. At the same time, the application principles of reinforcement, resin and interface action on design, molding and production of composites are also focused on. Based on the knowledge studied in this course, student design ability and manufacturing ability in resin matrix composites are built. The innovation ability of student will be also enhanced.

default.zh: 该课程是高分子材料专业的一门选修课程。课程主要讲授胶粘剂和涂料的基本概念、性能特点、基本组成、固化机理或成膜机理以及胶接工艺过程，重点使学生了解胶粘剂的粘附理论、研究热点、发展趋势及前沿应用；熟悉和掌握常用胶粘剂的性能特点、组成、固化机理和应用；了解胶粘剂的胶接工艺过程等。 课程主要包括概论及应用介绍、热固性树脂胶粘剂、热塑性树脂胶粘剂、压敏胶、橡胶型胶粘剂、密封胶粘剂、胶接工艺基础以及涂料介绍。 本课程考试成绩采用累加式，包括期末考试、平时、课堂作业和课后报告四部分。
default.en: The course Adhesives and Paints is an optional one of Polymer Materials & Engineering, which explains the basic knowledge of adhesives and paints to make students understand the characteristics and applications of adhesives and paints. Through this course, students will know the history of adhesives and paints, be familiar with its application status and development foreground and master its correlated basic knowledge and adhesive principle including basic composition, component function, curing mechanism, structure properties and application of resin adhesive systems (such as epoxy, phenolic, PU, acrylic acid etc.), basic composition, component function, vulcanization system and principle, modification principle, structure properties and application of rubber adhesive systems (such as neoprene, NBR). Basic concept, characteristics, requirements and classification about sealing adhesive are introduced besides surface treatment of aiming materials, design of adhesive joint, applying of adhesive and basic theory and principles of adhesive techniques. The main composition, solvent function, properties and application of all kinds of paints are introduced.

default.zh: 功能高分子材料课程是高分子材料专业的主要课程，在专业课程体系中占有重要地位。功能高分子材料是目前国内外材料领域研究的热点，广泛接触和了解功能高分子材料的研究进展，掌握材料功能设计的基础理论知识，对学生专业知识的培养和提高以及扩大学生的知识体系，有着举足轻重的作用，为学生今后就业与发展提供基础技术支撑。 功能高分子材料课程是高等工科院校中高分子材料专业的一门主干课程，在教学过程中综合运用先修课程中所学到的有关知识和内容，进行高分子方面技术人员所需的基本知识和技能训练，为学生进一步学习有关专业课程和日后从事该领域的生产、研究和开发工作打下基础。本课程主要讲授化学功能高分子材料、高分子液晶、光学功能高分子材料、自修复高分子材料、碳纳米管高分子复合材料的品种、组成、结构特点，特定功能的功能设计原理、功能高分子的合成及材料制备工艺，各类功能高分子材料的应用领域及最新研究动向。
default.en: The course of Functional Polymer Materials is the main course of polymer materials major and occupies an important position in the professional curriculum system. Functional polymer materials are currently a hot research topic in the field of materials both domestically and internationally. They have extensive exposure and understanding of the research progress of functional polymer materials, master the basic theoretical knowledge of material functional design, and play a crucial role in cultivating and improving students' professional knowledge, as well as expanding their knowledge system. They provide basic technical support for students' future employment and development. The Functional Polymer Materials course is a core course in the polymer materials major of higher engineering colleges. It comprehensively applies the relevant knowledge and content learned in the prerequisite courses during the teaching process, providing basic knowledge and skills training for polymer technicians, laying the foundation for students to further learn relevant professional courses and engage in production, research, and development work in this field in the future. This course mainly teaches the variety, composition, and structural characteristics of chemical functional polymer materials, polymer liquid crystals, optical functional polymer materials, self-healing polymer materials, carbon nanotube polymer composites, specific functional design principles, synthesis and material preparation processes of functional polymers, application fields and latest research trends of various functional polymer materials.

default.zh: 《高分子膜材料》是介绍高分子膜和膜过程基础知识的一门课程。通过该课程的学习，使学生对高分子膜科学技术得到详细的了解，在此基础上掌握膜过程的基本理论，高分子膜的特性和应用，掌握高分子膜的典型制备及性能测试方法，了解新型膜过程等内容，扩大学生的专业知识体系，为学生今后的多样化就业和从事功能高分子分离膜方向的合成、性能、加工及应用方面的研究提供基础理论和技术支撑。
default.en: Polymeric Membrane Materials is a basic course for students to understand the polymeric membranes and membrane processes. Polymeric membranes have been widely applied in various aspects such as water and chemical treatments. It is the powerful technology to build up the environmentally-friendly society. Based on the study of this course, the student will understand the basic theory of polymeric membrane materials,the characteristics and applications of membrane processes, and the fabrication of polymeric membranes. At last, the emerging membrane material and processes will be briefly introduced.

default.zh: 绿色高分子材料课程作为高分子专业学生的专业选修课，以拓宽学生视野，了解绿色高分子材料相关内容为主要目的，同时为学生日后从事相关领域的生产、研究和开发工作打下基础。课程主要介绍绿色高分子材料的发展，讲授几种代表性绿色高分子材料及其应用，使学生深入理解高分子材料降解与稳定化的基本原理，并掌握充分运用此原理来设计制备可应用型绿色高分子材料的能力。本课程考试成绩采用累加式，包括课堂测试、课程报告和期末成绩。
default.en: As subject elective for the students from major of polymer, the main purpose of the course《Green Polymer Materials》is to broaden the horizons, to understand the related content, and lay the foundation for students who will work on the production, research and development of green polymer materials in related fields. The main contents of the course are several typical natural green polymer materials, typical synthetic green polymer material and their application, the course will help the students have a deep understanding on the principle of degradation and stability of polymer materials, and have the ability to make full use of the principle to design and prepare applicable green polymer materials. The examination results of this course are cumulative, which includes classroom test,course report and final exam.

default.zh: 本课程是高分子材料与工程专业的重要专业方向选修课程。本课程通过讲解生物医用高分子材料特点，即生物高分子与人体血液、组织的相容性，使学生掌握生物医用高分子材料的表面改性技术、表征方法和实际应用。在此基础上，使学生们掌握目前生物医用高分子材料的分类、合成的基本理论知识和基本方法；通过讲述本领域最新文献，指导学生阅读和掌握本领域最新科研动态，帮助学生了解在组织工程与人造器官、止血材料、和生物降解材料等方面的应用以及生物医用高分子的最新发展方向。
default.en: The course of Biopolymer Materials and Applications is an important optional one of the Department of Polymer Materials & Engineering, which explains the characterization of biomedical polymer materials and introduces the compatibility between biopolymer and body blood or tissues to make students master the surface modification technology of biomedical macromolecule materials. Through the discussion of recent research progress in this course, students will learn how to read papers, and master the classification and the basic theory knowledge and methods of synthesis of biomedical macromolecule materials and know the application on the tissue engineering and artificial organs, hemostatic materials, and biodegradable materials, etc.

default.zh: 液晶高分子经过70年的开发研究，其成就已使世人瞩目，其发展速度是许多重要科技领域都无法比拟的，其影响力目前已远远超出高分子材料科学或化学科学与材料科学的范畴，正在向生命、信息、通信、环境等学科拓展，并不断涉及其它科技领域。本课程的主要内容由六部分组成：液晶高分子基础知识、液晶高分子的表征、液晶高分子构性关系及分子设计、结构用液晶高分子材料、液晶高分子的成型加工、液晶高分子的前沿应用。将液晶高分子作为选修课程为本科生开设，可以开拓学生视野，丰富知识面，可使学生对高分子材料的性能特点和先进性有较全面的认识，为其今后在实际工作中掌握和利用该部分知识奠定基础，为学生进一步学习有关专业课程和日后从事该领域的生产和研发工作打下基础。
default.en: After 70 years of development and research, the achievements of liquid crystal polymers have attracted attention from the world. Their development speed is unmatched in many important technological fields, and their influence has far exceeded the scope of polymer materials science or chemical science and materials science. They are expanding into disciplines such as life, information, communication, environment, and constantly involving other technological fields. The main content of this course consists of six parts: basic knowledge of liquid crystal polymers, characterization of liquid crystal polymers, structural relationships and molecular design of liquid crystal polymers, structural materials of liquid crystal polymers, molding and processing of liquid crystal polymers, and cutting-edge applications of liquid crystal polymers. Offering liquid crystal polymer as an elective course for undergraduates can broaden students' horizons, enrich their knowledge, enable students to have a comprehensive understanding of the performance characteristics and progressiveness of polymer materials, lay a foundation for mastering and using this part of knowledge in their future practical work, and lay a foundation for students to further study relevant professional courses and engage in production and research and development in this field in the future.

default.zh: 电极材料结构表征是一门面对化学工程与工艺专业(电化学工程系) 大学本科三年级以上学生开设的双语选修课程。课程采用理论基础和研究前沿相结合的形式，讲授材料结构解析领域应用最为广泛的几大表征手段在电极材料结构表征中的应用。所选表征手段包括: X射线衍射、X射线吸收精细结构谱学、X射线光电子能谱、固体核磁共振、电子显微和电子衍射。针对每种表征手段，在详细介绍实验原理的基础上，选取相关的国际前沿研究论文作为结构解析案例。课程中所选实例涵盖锂离子电池、铅酸电池、固体氧化物燃料电池及下一代新型化学电源等多种电池装置中的电极材料。通过学习，使学生了解主流表征手段，并能够将所学知识运用到实际的材料结构解析工作中，为以后从事新型化学电源的研究打下良好的基础。
default.en: Structural Analysis of Electrode Materials is an optional course for the 3rd year undergraduate students of Chemical Engineering and Processing (Electrochemical Engineering). This course is an introduction to the theory and practice of some major characterization techniques widely adopted in material sciences. The selected techniques include: X-ray Diffraction (XRD), X-ray Absorption (XAS, XANES and EXAFS), X-ray Photoelectron Spectroscopy (XPS), Solid State Nuclear Magnetic Resonance (SSNMR), SEM and TEM. Materials covered will include Li-ion batteries (positive and negative electrodes) and solid oxide fuel cells. The basic goals of the course are to develop understanding and skills in the techniques of structural analysis of electrode materials. The course will prepare the student for work in advanced topics in chemical engineering and material sciences.

default.zh: 本课程主要讲授析氢反应、氢氧化反应、氧气还原反应、氧气析出反应、二氧化碳还原反应、氮气还原反应中的电催化机理、相应的电催化剂的制备工艺及其在能源转化领域的应用。
default.en: This course mainly introduces the electrocatalytic mechanism，the preparation process of corresponding electrocatalysts and their application in energy conversion of hydrogen evolution reaction, hydrogen oxidation reaction, oxygen reduction reaction, oxygen evolution reaction， carbon dioxide reduction reaction and nitrogen reduction reaction.

default.zh: 《金属腐蚀原理》是化学工程与工艺专业的学术前沿轨道限选课程。使学生们了解各种腐蚀类型，局部腐蚀的特点及自然条件下腐蚀特点；熟悉电化学腐蚀热力学，电化学腐蚀动力学，以及局部腐蚀中丝状腐蚀、晶间腐蚀、选择性腐蚀、剥蚀的产生机理及影响因素；掌握析氢腐蚀与析氧腐蚀特征，易钝化金属的腐蚀特征，晶间腐蚀、电偶腐蚀、点蚀的产生机理及影响因素。了解化工设备及化工生产中常见的腐蚀类型及防护方法。
default.en: "Theory of Metal corrosion" is an elective course offered in the forefront track of the Chemical Engineering and Technology discipline. The course aims to equip students with an understanding of various corrosion types, characteristics of localized corrosion, and corrosion features under natural conditions. It further aims to familiarize students with the thermodynamics of electrochemical corrosion, electrochemical corrosion kinetics, and the mechanisms and influencing factors behind filamentous corrosion, intergranular corrosion, selective corrosion, and exfoliation in localized corrosion. The course emphasizes the mastery of characteristics related to hydrogen evolution corrosion, oxygen evolution corrosion, corrosion of passivatable metals, and the mechanisms and influencing factors behind intergranular corrosion, galvanic corrosion, and pitting corrosion. Additionally, students gain insights into common corrosion types and protective measures in chemical equipment and chemical production processes.

default.zh: 本课程是化学工程与工艺专业的智能工艺轨道限选课程。主要包括高性能新型电镀液研发方法和先进电镀工艺设计。全自动化电镀生产线控制技术；有限元仿真模拟计算方法在先进电镀技术中的应用；量子化学计算在开发先进电镀电解液中的应用；无氰电镀新技术；PCB及芯片电镀技术；先进特种镀技术等内容。
default.en: This course is an intelligent process orbit limited course for the Chemical Engineering and Process major. This mainly includes the research and development methods of high-performance new electroplating solutions and the design of advanced electroplating processes. Fully automated electroplating production line control technology; The application of finite element simulation calculation method in advanced electroplating technology; The application of quantum chemical calculations in the development of advanced electroplating electrolytes; New technology for cyanide free electroplating; PCB and chip electroplating technology; Advanced special plating technology and other related content.

default.zh: 《先进化学电源技术》是化学工程与工艺专业的智能工艺轨道限选课程。化学电源广泛应用于车辆、飞机、便携式用电设备、通讯设备、航空航天、军事等各个行业，在国民经济中发挥着重要作用，本课程在前期学习化学电源基础理论的基础上，系统地介绍了锌锰电池、铅酸电池、镉镍电池、氢镍电池、锌银电池、金属空气电池、锂电池、锂离子电池、燃料电池的制造和先进技术。
default.en: Advanced Technology of Chemical Power Source is a required course for intelligent process direction of chemical engineering and technology (Electrochemistry). Chemical power supply is widely used in vehicles, aircraft, portable electrical equipment, communication equipment, aerospace, military and other industries, and plays an important role in the national economy. Based on the basic theories of chemical power sources, the manufacture technologies and new advances of zinc-manganese battery, lead-acid battery, cadmium-nickel battery, nickel-hydrogen battery, zinc-silver battery, metal-air battery, lithium battery, Li-ion battery and fuel cell are systematically introduced.

default.zh: 化工企业技术创新与应用是由企业技术人员主讲、实现校企合作育人的课程，其目的是使学生了解化工企业在产品或工艺流程设计、工业生产等方面的技术创新情况，在将来从事科学研究、工程应用、技术开发和项目管理等工作时，能够将创新思维用于实践活动中。
default.en: The technological innovation and application in chemical enterprises is a course taught by enterprise technicians to realize the school-enterprise cooperation and education. Its purpose is to enable students to understand the technological innovation of chemical enterprises in product or process design, industrial production, etc., and to be able to apply innovative thinking to practical activities when engaged in scientific research, engineering application, technology development and project management in the future.

default.zh: 《电化学工程设计》是化学工程与工艺专业的智能工艺轨道限选课程。作为一门工程实践课程，训练学生对化学电源理论与工艺、电镀工艺和工程制图等的综合运用，要求学生在从事电池、电镀等与化工相关的研究、设计、开发的工作时，具有综合运用所学电化学专业知识及电工、材料、工程制图等知识解决实际问题的能力。
default.en: Electochemical Engineering Design is a required course for intelligent process direction of chemical engineering and technology (Electrochemistry). As an engineering practice course, it trains the students to comprehensively apply the theory and process of chemical power source, electroplating process and engineering drawing ability. Students are required to have the comprehensive ability to use these knowledge to solve practical problems in the research, design and development of chemical power source, electroplating and other chemical engineering.

default.zh: 《化工过程分析与合成》是化学工程与工艺专业的专业课程，分为化工过程系统稳态模拟与分析、化工过程系统动态模拟与分析、化工过程系统的优化和换热网络合成等部分。通过本课的学习，使学生掌握典型化学过程的模拟、分析和优化，具有对化工生产过程操作工况的设计、调优等，培养学生分析化工过程系统过程、设计化工过程操作工况和就专业问题有效沟通的能力，提高创新意识。
default.en: “Chemical Process Analysis and Synthesis” is a professional elective course for chemical engineering and technology. The course is divided into chemical process system steady-state simulation and analysis, chemical process system dynamic simulation and analysis, chemical process system optimization and heat exchanger network synthesis. Through the study of this course, students will be able to master the knowledge of the simulation, analysis and optimization of typical chemical process. In addition, students will be capable of design and optimization to the chemical production process operation. This course can also cultivate students’ abilities to analyze the chemical system process, design the chemical process operating condition and communicate effectively on professional problems, as well as improve their consciousness of innovation.

default.zh: 本课程是高等学校化工相关专业的主干课，是研究物质分离和纯化的工程技术学科。讲授传质与分离工程的原理、重要的分离单元操作及分离技术的进展。利用相平衡、热力学和动力学的微观机理，传热、传质和动量传递理论来研究化工生产实际中复杂物系的分离和提纯技术。通过本课程的学习，使学生掌握常用分离过程的基本理论，操作特点，所用设备的设计计算方法和强化改进操作的途径，对一些新分离技术有一定的了解。 课程主要包括绪论、机械分离、传质理论和相平衡、气液分离设备和其他分离技术几个部分，本课程考试采用累加式，包括期末笔试、作业和平时三部分。
default.en: Separation Processes in Chemical Engineering is a main course of chemical engineering in Colleges and universities, and it is an engineering technology to study the separation and purification of substances. This course revealed the principles of mass transfer and separation engineering, the separation unit operation and the progress of separation technology. The separation and purification technology of complex system in chemical production practice are study by the microscopic mechanism based on phase equilibrium, kinetics and thermodynamics, heat transfer, mass transfer and momentum transfer theory. Through the study of this course, students can master the basic theory of common separation process, operation characteristics, the design calculation method of the equipment and the way to strengthen the improvement operation, and they will have a certain understanding of some new separation technology. The course mainly includes introduction, mechanical separation, mass transfer theory and phase equilibrium, gas-liquid separation equipment and other separation technology. This course uses cumulative test, including the final written examination, homework and the usual performance three parts.

default.zh: 本课是化学工程与工艺专业的专业选修课程，包括工程力学基础和化工设备设计基础两大部分。通过本课的学习，使学生掌握化工设备和机械的基本理论、基本知识以及设计的基本方法，为从事化工工艺过程研究、工艺设计、设备使用及维护打下基础。
default.en: This is an elective course for students in the major of Chemical Engineering and Technology. The course includes engineering mechanics basic knowledge and chemical equipment design basic knowledge. Through the study of this course, students can master the basic theory, basic knowledge and basic design methods of chemical equipment and machinery, and lay the foundation for the research of chemical process, process design, equipment use and maintenance.

default.zh: 化学反应工程是化学工程与工艺专业的化工基础选修课程。 本课程通过对反应过程的解析、利用反应热力学和化学反应动力学知识，结合反应器内流动、混合和传递过程，研究反应过程的分析和计算、反应技术的研究和开发、反应器的设计和评述，实现反应过程的最佳化，从而提高化学反应的工程和工艺水平。 本课程主要分八章，重点介绍均相反应过程，包括均相反应动力学基础，均相反应器，非理想流动；非均相反应过程－气固相催化反应过程；气固相催化反应器；气液反应过程与反应器等。 通过这门课程，学生可了解如何在工业规模上实现最佳的化学反应方案，学会如何分析各种反应过程，并掌握各种反应器的优化设计能力。
default.en: Chemical reaction engineering is concerned with the exploitation of chemical reactions on matter transformations and energy transformations. Chemical reaction engineering aims at studying and optimizing chemical reactions in order to define the best reactor design. This course allows students to know how to explore optimum solutions on a commercial scale. Moreover, the course will help students learn how to analyze chemical reactions and apply the theory to solve design problems of chemical reactors.

default.zh: 化工设计为我校化学工程与工艺类专业的专主干业课，主要介绍化工设计的基本原理、设计程序、设计规范以及设计计算方法。内容包括：化工设计概述；工艺流程的选择与设计；物料衡算，热量衡算；化工设备的选型与设计；化工系统设计；车间装置布置设计；化工管道设计等。以培养学生综合利用所学的理论知识，建立工程概念，锻炼学生分析问题和解决问题的能力。
default.en: Chemical engineering design is main course of chemical technology specialty of Harbin Institute of Technology, which mainly introduces the fundamental principals; design process, design norms and design calculate method of chemical engineering design. The content contains the overview of chemical engineering design, the choice and design of technology process, calculation of mass and energy balances, choice and design of chemical engineering device, the chemical engineering system design, the layout of workshop, chemical engineering pipe design.In addition, the course teaches engineering skills through the design and analysis of chemical processes and process units in order to assess product quality, economics, safety, and environmental impact. This course will help undergraduate students in chemical engineering develop engineering skills early in their studies.

default.zh: 化工热力学是化学工程学的一个重要分支，是化工过程研究、开发与设计的理论基础。本课程主要介绍热力学的基本知识和概念；热力学基本定律及其在化工过程中的应用。通过课堂讲授和课堂讨论等教学环节，系统全面地介绍运用热力学基本原理，对化工过程中的能量转化、传递、使用和损失情况进行热力学分析，对过程、设备或装置的能量有效利用程度进行评价。通过本课程的学习，使学生掌握流体物态变化的基本规律及状态性质；热力学函数及能量转化的基本规律，为化工过程的研究打下牢固的理论基础。同时，培养学生的热力学理念和思维方式，使其具备运用基本理论和研究方法，分析、解决化工过程实际问题的能力；培养学生创新精神和自主学习能力，以适应化工行业的未来发展需要。
default.en: Chemical Engineering Thermodynamics is an important branch of chemical engineering and the theoretical basis for research and development (R&D) in chemical processes. This course mainly covers the basic knowledge and concept of thermodynamics, and in particular, introduces the fundamental laws and their application in chemical processes. The thermodynamic analysis of energy conversion, transfer, use, and loss in the chemical process is comprehensively introduced to evaluate the energy efficiency of the process and equipment. At the end of this course, students will be able to master the laws and state properties of fluid state changes, the basic rules of thermodynamic function, and energy conversion. It will develop students' thermodynamic ideas and ways of thinking, train students' ability to analyze and solve practical problems, and lay a solid theoretical foundation for the study of chemical processes. It will also cultivate students' innovative spirit and self-learning ability to meet the future development of the chemical industry.

default.zh: 《电动车能源系统》是化学工程与工艺专业的专业选修课程，主要讲授用于电动车的化学电源系统知识。电动车是国家重点发展的战略性新兴产业，对解决国家能源安全和环境污染具有重要意义。能源系统是电动车的核心和心脏，直接决定电动车的续驶里程、成本、安全性等综合性能，是化学电源极为重要的应用领域。本课程在介绍电动车能源系统的组成和分类等基本概念和工作原理的基础上，系统讲述动力电池系统总体方案设计（系统设计）、结构与电连接设计、电池管理系统设计、热管理设计、结构仿真分析、试验验证技术等内容。
default.en: The "Energy System for Electrical Vehicles" course mainly teaches the knowledge of chemical power sources used in electric vehicles. Electric vehicles are a strategic emerging industry and are of great significance in solving national energy security and environmental pollution. The energy system is the core and heart of electric vehicles, directly determining their comprehensive performance such as driving range, cost, and safety, which is an extremely important application field for chemical power sources. On the basis of introducing the basic concepts and working principles of the electric vehicle energy systems, this course systematically discusses the system design, structure design and electrical connection, battery management system, thermal management, structural simulation analysis, experimental verification, and other contents of the power battery system.

default.zh: 电化学反应工程是能源化学工程专业的重要支撑课程之一。作为电化学工程的最大分支，电化学反应工程是学生在学习化学电源工艺学和电镀工艺学基础上，对电化学工程知识的完整性补充。本课程的教学目的就是注重电化学工程的整体性和工程性，使能源化学工程的同学掌握比较全面的电化学工程的专业知识，从而具有宽广的专业基础知识。 电化学反应工程包含与电解、电镀和化学电源工程化有关的内容，涉及与电化学工程有关的基本知识和电化学工程的应用等。包括电化学工程的历史、现状、发展方向、研究领域及其作用；电化学工程的质量因数，传质、传热过程的分析与计算，电极表面电位及电流密度的分布；电化学反应器的分类、反应器的联结与组合、反应器的设计；电极材料和膜材料等基础知识。应用部分结合化学电源和电镀，介绍氯碱工业、无机电合成、有机电合成、金属的电解提取与精炼、熔融盐电化学和电解加工的原理和应用。
default.en: Electrochemical reaction engineering is one of the important supporting courses for energy chemical engineering specialty. As the largest branch of electrochemical engineering, this course is the supplement to the courses Chemical power supply technology and Electroplating technology. The purpose of this course is to pay attention to the integrity and to Make the students of energy chemical engineering master the comprehensive knowledge of electrochemical engineering, so then broad professional knowledge. The electrochemical engineering comprises electrolysis, electroplating and electrochemical power source and their industrial process. This curriculum involve the basis of electrochemical engineering, such as research field in electrochemical engineering and the history, status quo, direction of development, research field and application of electrolysis; figures of merit, analysis and calculation of mass transport, heat transport, potential and current density distribution on surface of electrode; sorts of electrochemical reactor, coupling and assembling in reactor, and reactor design; electrode and membrane materials。The curriculum also involve the application of electrochemical engineering, such as chlor-alkali industry, inorganic electrosynthesize, organic electrosynthesis, metal extraction and refining, and electrochemical machining.

default.zh: 本课程主要电化学加工技术的基本方法和特点，主要内容有：（1）电化学加工技术概述，包括电化学加工的基本原理、方法和应用领域；（2）电解加工和磨削，包括加工精度控制和影响电解效率和加工质量的因素等；（3）电化学抛光，包括工艺、设备和影响电化学抛光表面质量的主要因素；（4）电铸加工，包括电铸工艺、电解液和控制内应了的措施等；（5）电化学方法制备特种金属材料，包括多孔金属材料、纳米材料、复合材料等。
default.en: This course mainly includes the basic methods and characteristics of electrochemical processing technology, the main contents of this course: (1) An overview of the electrochemical processing technology, including basic principles, techniques and applications of electrochemical processing technology (2) Electrolytic processing and grinding, including machining precision control and influencing factors of electrolytic efficiency and processing quality etc (3) Electrochemical polishing, including techniques, equipments and the main factors affect the quality of electrochemical polishing surface (4) Electroform processing, including electroforming process, electrolyte and control measure of inner stress etc (5) Preparation of special metal materials using electrochemical technique, including porous metal materials, nanometer materials, composite materials etc.

default.zh: 《无机材料合成方法》是化学工程与工艺专业的专业方向选修课程，包括材料设计原理及合成方法和材料表征检测方法两大部分。通过本课的学习，使学生掌握材料合成和结构设计的基本理论、基本知识以及检测技术的基本原理，为从事电化学材料制备、分析化学材料检测及纳米材料结构分析打下基础。
default.en: "Inorganic Material Synthesis Method" is an elective course for chemical engineering and technology majors, including material design principles, synthesis methods and material characterization methods. The students will master the basic theories for material synthesis and structural design and obtain basic principles for characterization technology through this course, which may lay a foundation for the materials preparation of electrochemistry, the materials detection of analytical chemical and the structural analysis of nanomaterials.

default.zh: 从晶体结构出发讲授了离子晶体的热缺陷、电荷缺陷、组成缺陷等点缺陷结构与传导特性的关系，分析了具有离子、电子传导性的混合传导体的结构特性，介绍了固体电解质的传导机制。重点讲授固体离子/电子传导体的电导率的测定方法，固体电极反应原理与固体电池原理。相关的电化学理论知识为本课程的难点。结合国内外研究进展，讲解固体氧化物传导体的应用实例（如钠硫电池、全固态锂电池、固体氧化物燃料电池等固态电池的实际应用与发展前景）
default.en: From the point of view of crystal structure, this course introduces the relationship between point defects (including thermal defect, charge defect and composition defect, etc) and conductivity characteristics of ionic crystals. It also analyses the structure of mixed ionic-electronic conductors, and introduces conductivity mechanism of solid electrolytes. The course emphasizes measurement methods of solid ionic/electronic conductivity, and focuses on the principles of solid electrode reaction and solid state cell. Related electrochemical theoretical knowledge for this course is the difficult points. Many of the applications of solid oxide conductors are listed according to research progresses at home and abroad.

default.zh: 纳米电化学是一门讲述电化学、材料科学、纳米科学与技术等交叉领域的课程。本课程在阐述纳米电化学基本概念与原理的基础上，系统介绍自组装膜纳米电极、纳米材料的电化学合成、染料敏化太阳能电池、碳纳米管的电化学性质和应用研究。通过本课程的学习，将增加对纳米科学、电化学等交叉领域的知识和最新进展的了解和认识，开阔学生视野，丰富知识面，促进化学化工与多学科知识的融会贯通。要求学生在了解纳米电化学历史、发展现状以及应用领域的基础上，掌握纳米电化学的基本原理和研究方法。
default.en: Nanoelectrochemistry is an interdisciplinary course on electrochemistry, material science, nanoscience and nanotechnology. The course states the basic concepts and principles of nanoelectrochemistry, and gives a systematic exposition of self-assembled nanostructured electrode, electrochemical synthesis of nanomaterials, dye-sensitized solar cell, electrochemistry and application of carbon nanotube, with an aim to increase the understanding on the phenomena and progress of nanoscience as well as electrochemistry, broaden outlook, and enrich knowledge on multiple disciplines. On the basis of well understanding the history, progress, and application of nanoelectrochemistry, students should grasp the basic principles and research strategies of nanoelectrochemistry.

default.zh: 通过多种方式的教学，使学生掌握汽车涂装技术中前处理、涂料、涂装方法、涂膜的干燥和固化、涂装工艺设计及工艺管理、涂装质量管理和测试方法等知识点。以学生的学习为中心，培养学生把握汽车涂装技术发展方向的能力，引导学生通过查阅文献等方式加以了解和领会相关的新理论、新方法和新技术。
default.en: Through a variety of teaching, students can master the knowledge points of pretreatment, coatings, coating methods, drying and curing of coating films, coating process design and process management, coating quality management and testing methods in automotive coating technology. Focusing on students' learning, it cultivates students' ability to grasp the development direction of automotive coating technology, and guides students to understand and comprehend relevant new theories, new methods and new technologies by consulting literature.

default.zh: 随着经济发展，科技进步，对能源需求越来越大，环境污染越来越严重。因此绿色、清洁新型能源的开发越来越受到重视，其产业化发展速度越来越快，产业规模逐渐增大，其应用也越来越广，在国民经济中发挥的作用越显著。新型化学电源这门课程就是讲述在科技发展过程中，出现的新型锂离子电池、低温燃料电池、氧化还原液流电池和钠硫电池等知识的一门课程。 新型化学电源是化学工程与工艺专业（电化学专业）的选修课程之一。新型化学电源课程系统阐述了锂离子电池基本原理、正负极材料的种类、特性、生产和应用等；低温燃料电池基本的基本原理、结构、电极材料、制备关键技术；氧化还原液流电池的原理、特性、应用、研究进展；钠硫电池的基本原理、结构、性能以及电极材料和电解质溶液的概况等。通过新型化学电源课程的学习，要求学生在明确锂离子电池、低温燃料电池、氧化还原液流电池和钠硫电池基本概念的基础上，掌握相关基础理论和性能指标，了解各种新型化学电源的原理、应用领域、生产关键技术以及制造工艺技术等，为以后从事新型化学电源的研究、开发、生产等工作打下坚实的基础。
default.en: Environment pollution is worse and worse with economic development and technology advancement. So, the exploitation of novel electrochemical power sources has been paid attention in the past decades. Its industrialization development is more and more fast. Its scale of industry is sharply increasing. Its applications are of diversification. Novel electrochemical power sources are playing an important role in national economy. Novel electrochemical power source is a course about the lithium ion battery, low-temperature fuel cells, redox flow battery, Na-S battery, and so on. Novel electrochemical power source is one of the elective courses for students studying in the specialty of chemical engineering and technology. This course expounds the production, storage, transportation and utilization of lithium ion battery; the detailed introduces the integrated utilization of lithium ion battery and the principle, structure of fuel cells, electrode materials and preparation technology, the generate electricity, getting heat and storage of redox flow battery, the primary principle, structure and performances of Na-S battery. Students having studied this course should grasp the basic concepts of lithium ion battery, low-temperature fuel cells, redox flow battery, and Na-S battery, master their important theories and performances, understand the general situation of the production, transformation, and utilization of different novel electrochemical power sources and their preparation technology. After having studied this course, students should make a stable foundation for engaging in the research and development and manufacture of novel electrochemical power sources.

default.zh: 《仿生功能性电极材料》是化学工程与工艺专业的专业选修课程，分为绪论、成分与结构仿生材料、功能仿生材料、智能综合仿生的功能性电极材料、仿生功能性电极材料的应用领域五个部分。通过授课、讨论和文献报告等形式让学生了解仿生功能性电极材料的设计、制造过程及其在化学电源等领域的应用，达到培养学生分析问题、解决问题和独立从事电化学和电化学分析科学研究能力的目的。
default.en: Biomimetic Functional Electrode Materials is a professional elective course for chemical engineering and technology, which is divided into five parts: introduction, composition and structure of biomimetic materials, functional bionic materials, intelligent comprehensive bionic functional electrode materials, and application fields of biomimetic functional electrode materials. Through lectures, discussions, and literature reports, students can understand the design, manufacturing process and application of biomimetic functional electrode materials in the fields of chemical power supply, so as to cultivate students' ability to analyze problems, solve problems, and independently engage in scientific research in electrochemistry and electrochemical analysis.

default.zh: 《先进电化学储能材料》是化学工程与工艺专业的专业方向选修课程，主要讲授电化学原理、分析方法、先进材料等。通过本课程的学习，使学生了解电化学储能材料的基本原理、现状和领域的最新发展动态，掌握专业发展趋势，丰富学生的知识结构，提高学生的创新意识，掌握以下内容：电化学储能技术原理、下一代电化学储能材料、储能安全与分析、先进电化学储能材料表征技术等内容，为学生以后从事电化学研究打下基础。
default.en: Advanced Electrochemical Energy Storage Materials is a professional direction elective course for chemical engineering and technology majors, mainly teaching electrochemical principles, analytical methods, advanced materials and so on. Through the study of this course, students can understand the basic principles of electrochemical energy storage materials, the current situation and the latest development in the field, master the professional development trend, enrich the knowledge structure of students, improve the students' innovative consciousness, and master the following contents: the principles of electrochemical energy storage technology, the next generation of electrochemical energy storage materials, the energy storage safety and analysis, and the characterization technology of advanced electrochemical energy storage materials, which will lay the foundation for students to engage in the future electrochemical research.

default.zh: 《电池反应与可视化技术》是化学工程与工艺专业的专业选修课程，该课程在阐明经典化学电源及多种成像技术表征基本理论和基本概念的基础上，系统地介绍电子显微成像技术、X射线成像技术、中子成像技术、核磁共振成像技术、多方法综合成像技术和下一代成像技术等先进成像方法。
default.en: "Battery Reaction and Visualization Technology" is a professional elective course for chemical engineering and technology majors. This course clarifies the basic theories and concepts of classical chemical power and the characterization of various imaging technologies. Based on that, this course systematically introduces electron microscopy imaging technology, X-ray advanced imaging methods, neutron imaging technology, nuclear magnetic resonance imaging technology, multi-method integrated imaging technology and next-generation imaging technology. After the study of this course, I would like to let the student mainly master the basic concepts and basic theories, structural composition, and characteristics of the classic chemical power source, and be able to analyze the actual electrochemical dynamics process in the battery reactions; Master the basic concepts of a variety of visual imaging techniques involved in the course, basic theory, structural composition, functional characteristics and application scenarios; Master the advantages and limitations of representative visualization technologies in the process of understanding battery reaction dynamics; Understand the application scope and development trends of different imaging technologies, and master the ability to learn to choose related imaging technologies for reasonably observing various electrochemical processes inside the battery.

default.zh: 《新能源材料制备与分析技术》是新能源材料与器件专业重要的基础课程，是学习固体物理、太阳能电池与器件等相关课程的基础，在培养新能源材料与器件专业学生的基本概念、逻辑思维、综合分析能力等方面占有重要的地位。 本课程主要讲授功能纳米材料制备和结构表征等相关知识和方法，使学生深入了解和掌握当代新能源材料相关的制备和表征理论。通过课堂教学、课程作业、论文撰写、考试等环节，来着重培养学生扎实的材料制备和表征知识，锻炼其综合问题分析能力以及相关知识的应用能力，同时增加学生的创新意识，支撑专业学习成果中相应指标点的达成。
default.en: New Energy Material Preparation and Analysis Technology is an important foundational course for students majoring in new energy materials and devices. It serves as the foundation for studying related courses such as solid state physics, solar cells and devices, and plays an important role in cultivating students' basic concepts, logical thinking, and comprehensive analysis abilities in the field of new energy materials and devices. This course mainly teaches knowledge and methods related to the preparation and structural characterization of functional nanomaterials, enabling students to have a deep understanding and mastery of the preparation and characterization theories related to contemporary new energy materials. Through classroom teaching, course assignments, paper writing, exams, and other links, we focus on cultivating students' solid knowledge of material preparation and representation, exercising their comprehensive problem analysis ability and related knowledge application ability, while increasing students' innovation awareness and supporting the achievement of corresponding indicators in professional learning outcomes.

default.zh: 能源催化基础课程是为新能源材料与器件专业本科生开设的一门专业课，共32学时。本课程的目的在于使学生了解能源形势和催化对能源供应的贡献，学习掌握催化剂的基本知识、催化作用的基本规律和催化过程的化学本质，结合典型能源催化实例剖析理解催化剂的结构、性能和催化机理，了解催化技术在传统能源、新能源、污染防治和环境友好催化技术开发等方面的应用。为今后解决能源催化复杂工程问题或从事新型催化剂的开发提供坚实的理论基础和专业技能，能够基于催化原理并采用科学方法对能源催化工业问题进行分析或研究。课程教学方法主要为教授法，课程成绩采用累加式，包括平时成绩、课堂讨论和课程报告。
default.en: Principles of Energy Catalysis is a specialized course for undergraduates majoring in New Energy Materials and Devices, with a total time of 32 hours. The purpose of this course is to enable students to understand the energy situation and the contribution of catalysis for the supply of energy, to learn basic knowledge of catalyst including the chemical nature and basic rules of the catalysts in the catalytic process, to understand the structure, performance and catalytic mechanism with the aid of typical examples of application of energy catalyst, to understand roles that catalytic technology plays in traditional energy, new energy, pollution prevention and environmental friendly developments etc. Finally, all students are equipped with a solid theoretical foundation and professional skills to solve the complex engineering problems or do some research about development of new catalysts using scientific methods. The course teaching method is teaching. Course scores are cumulative, including homework, classroom discussion, and summary report.

default.zh: 《空天能源系统》是新能源材料与器件本科生选修课，本课程从航天器系统分类出发，学习和掌握电源系统，包括主电源、蓄电池组、电化学测试方法及电源测试系统等内容。通过本课程的学习，使学生能够掌握航天器能源系统中各种电源的原理及特性、所能够解决的实际问题以及发展趋势；通过对基本理论的阐述，培养学生科学地、严谨地处理该学科发展中的问题，并拓展其思维；通过具体的航天器电源系统的设计学习，培养学生思考、分析和解决问题的能力。
default.en: “Energy Systems for Aerospace” is an elective course for undergraduate students majoring in new energy materials and devices. Starting from the classification of spacecraft systems, this course aims to learn and master power systems, including main power sources, battery packs, electrochemical testing methods, and power testing systems. Through the study of this course, students will be able to master the principles and characteristics of various power sources in spacecraft energy systems, the practical problems that can be solved, and the development trends; By elaborating on basic theories, cultivate students to scientifically and rigorously handle problems in the development of the discipline, and expand their thinking; Through the design and learning of specific spacecraft power systems, cultivate students' ability to think, analyze, and solve problems.

default.zh: 燃料电池是一种高效、环境友好的发电装置，它直接将贮存在燃料与氧化剂中的化学能转化为电能，是重要的新能源器件。课程通过介绍燃料电池的发展历史、燃料电池的化学和热力学基础、燃料电池的电化学基础、燃料电池的主要部件，在此基础上介绍目前研究发展热点的固体氧化物燃料电池、质子交换膜燃料电池、直接醇类燃料电池以及碱性燃料电池的发展前沿。通过本课程的学习，使学生掌握燃料电池这种电化学器件涉及化学、热力学、电化学相关的基础理论，培养学生具有分析处理电化学问题的初步能力；使学生了解燃料电池的研究和应用前沿，培养学生综合运用电化学、热力学、材料学等知识解决实际问题能力；通过课堂讨论等环节提升学生的创新意识、个人沟通能力和团体协作能力。
default.en: Fuel cells are an efficient and environmentally friendly power generation devices that directly convert chemical energy stored in fuels and oxidants into electrical energy. They are important new energy devices. The course introduces the development history, the chemical and thermodynamic foundations, the electrochemical foundations, together with the main components of fuel cells. Based on this, it introduces the current research and development hotspots of solid oxide fuel cells, proton exchange membrane fuel cells, direct alcohol fuel cells, and alkaline fuel cells. Through the study of this course, students will master the basic theories related to chemistry, thermodynamics, and electrochemistry of fuel cells, which are electrochemical devices, and cultivate their initial ability to analyze and handle electrochemical problems; Enable students to understand the research and application frontiers of fuel cells, and cultivate their abilities to comprehensively apply knowledge such as electrochemistry, thermodynamics, and material sciences to solve practical problems; Enhance students' innovation awareness, personal communication skills, and group collaboration abilities through classroom discussions and other activities.

default.zh: 本课程在储能材料制备方法、表征与分析方法的基础上，以常见的储能材料，如氢储能材料、二氧化碳储能材料、电化学储能材料等为对象，进行系统而深入的介绍；对关键储能材料的工作原理、最新研究进展与发展趋势等进行详细阐述；同时，也对近年来储能材料领域原创性研究成果进行系统做介绍。
default.en: Based on the preparation, characterization, and analysis methods of the energy storage materials, this course provides a systematic and in-depth introduction to common energy storage materials, such as hydrogen energy storage materials, carbon dioxide energy storage materials, electrochemical energy storage materials, etc. This course introduces the detailed principle, the latest research progress, and development trends of the main energy storage materials. At the same time, the original research achievements in the field of energy storage materials in recent years is also systematically introduced.

default.zh: 《生物质技术与前沿进展》是新能源材料与器件专业的能源模块专业选修课，课程使学生了解能源形势和生物质能在能源供应中的地位，初步掌握生物质资源主要形式、生物质能转化的原理和前沿技术、为从事生物质能源转化利用方面的科学研究和技术开发打下基础。 本课程主要讲授生物质转化沼气、电能、乙醇、生物气、液化油、生物柴油等生物质能产品的原理、技术、工艺过程，使学生掌握生物质能源生产与再生产的技术和方法。着重培养学生对生物质能产品转化和利用的综合分析和设计能力，培养学生对生物质能源科学知识的应用能力、增加创新意识，支撑专业学习成果中相应指标点的达成，，主要达到以下4点目标： 课程目标1：掌握生物质转化沼气、电能、燃料乙醇、生物气、液化油、生物柴油的原理和全周期、全流程工艺设计方法，了解影响上述生物质能源产品转化技术方案和工艺运行的各种因素。 课程目标2：基于可再生能源理论，知晓和理解环境保护和可持续发展的内涵； 课程目标3：能就生物质能源转化和利用的原理、特点和研究方法等专业问题，以口头、文稿、图表等方式，准确表达自己的观点并与业界同行和社会公众进行交流。 课程目标4：具有自主学习的能力，能够不断提高对生物质能源转化和利用的基本理论和相关技术问题的理解能力和提出问题的能力。
default.en: “Biomass conversion Technology and Frontier "is an elective course for the energy module in major of New Energy Materials and Devices. The course enables students to understand the energy situation and the position of biomass energy in energy supply, preliminarily grasp the main forms of biomass resources, the principles and frontiers of biomass energy conversion, and lay the foundation for scientific research and technological development in biomass energy conversion and utilization. This course mainly teaches the principles, technologies, and processes of biomass energy conversion products such as methane, electricity, ethanol, biogas, liquefied oil, and biodiesel, enabling students to master the technologies and methods of biomass energy production and reproduction. Emphasis is placed on cultivating students' comprehensive analysis and design abilities in the conversion and utilization of biomass energy products, cultivating their application ability in biomass energy science knowledge, increasing their innovation awareness, and supporting the achievement of corresponding indicators in professional learning outcomes. The main objectives are to achieve the following four points: Objective 1: Master the principles and full cycle and full process process design methods of biomass conversion into biogas, electricity, fuel ethanol, biogas, liquefied oil, and biodiesel, and understand various factors that affect the conversion technology scheme and process operation of the aforementioned biomass energy products. Objective 2: Based on renewable energy theory, understand and understand the connotation of environmental protection and sustainable development; Objective 3: To be able to accurately express one's views on professional issues such as the principles, characteristics, and research methods of biomass energy conversion and utilization, and communicate with industry peers and the public through oral, written, graphical, and other means. Objective 4: Have the ability to learn independently and continuously improve the understanding and problem-solving skills of the basic theories and related technical issues of biomass energy conversion and utilization.

default.zh: 本课程为新能源模块选修实验课程，主要面向“碳达峰”、“碳中和”政策，探索电池系统运行过程中的热量管理过程。通过本课程，加深对“双碳”的理解，形成绿色能源、循环利用思维方式，加深对课堂所学材料、催化、电化学等相关理论知识的理解，并通过实验验证部分理论的内容，锻炼学生创新实验技能、知识集成应用能力和工程能力，培养学生独立工作和从事科学研究工作的能力。 本课程具体包括“热电池单体电池组装与放电性能测试”、“热电池电堆组装与放电性能测试”、“电堆热量体系建立与评价”3个实验项目，共计24 学时。
default.en: This course is an elective experimental course for the new energy module, mainly aimed at "carbon peaking" and "carbon neutrality" policies, exploring the heat management process during the operation of battery systems. Through this course, we aim to deepen our understanding of "dual carbon", develop a green energy and circular utilization mindset, deepen our understanding of theoretical knowledge related to materials, catalysis, electrochemistry, etc. learned in the classroom, and validate some theoretical content through experiments. We aim to exercise students' innovative experimental skills, knowledge integration and application abilities, and engineering abilities, and cultivate their ability to work independently and engage in scientific research. This course specifically includes three experimental projects: "Assembly and Discharge Performance Testing of Single Cell Thermal Batteries", "Assembly and Discharge Performance Testing of Thermal Battery Stacks", and "Establishment and Evaluation of Thermal System of Stacks", totaling 24 class hours.

default.zh: 一、课程基本信息 课程编号： 22CC32070 课程名称：电池低碳技术 英文名称：Low Carbon Technology in Batteries （1） 课程学时： 24 讲课学时： 24 实验学时： 0 上机学时： 0 习题学时：0 课程学分：1.5 开课单位：化工与化学学院 授课对象：新材料化工大二大三学生 开课学期： 1秋 先修课程：无机化学、电化学知识 二、课程目标 能源行业正在经历革命性的变化，向清洁、可再生和低碳技术转型。《电池低碳技术》这门课程是在新能源电池中引入新型低碳技术是为了满足对以下领域的需求：未来有能力跨越经济和技术领域的能源系统，包括储能系统、电力系统如何工作以及未来的电网和能源市场如何运作。 通过本课程的学习，使学生获得对以下内容的基本理解开始：现代储能系统的物理特性和工程应用之间的联系——包括风能和太阳能等可再生能源的低碳技术；以及电池和储氢系统中低碳技术；电解槽在低碳电网的运行和经济性等。最终以该课程中各种新能源系统中所运用的低碳技术为中心的单元让学生能够运用他们的专业知识整合大规模的可再生能源和将能源资源分配到储能电池、电力系统中，涵盖技术以及经济方面、运营和环境规划以及“双碳”战略的实现。 课程目标要求：完成本课程后，学生将能够： （1）定义基本电化学概念，低碳技术，认知不同的新能源储能系统工作原理及应用场景 （2）深入了解锂电池（锂离子电池，固态电池，钠电池）中的低碳技术的应用 （3）深入了解燃料电池中的低碳技术的应用 （4）深入了解太阳能光伏电池中的低碳技术的应用 （5）简单了解储氢系统中低碳技术的应用 （6）简单了解电力电网系统中低碳技术的应用 （7）掌握有效的口头和书面能力沟通技巧，包括公开演讲和新能源储能系统中低碳技术报告在更广泛的双碳战略工程领域。 （8）了解低碳技术知识在实际生产和生活中的巨大作用，具备运用所学低碳技术分析处理新能源电池低碳问题、生活中存在碳排放问题和未来我国双碳战略所面临的碳足迹问题的能力 三、课程思政 落实国家“双碳”战略需求和省政府文件要求，立足国家骨干专业建设，对接新能源汽车技术技能人才培养需求，从行业、产业、政策、标准、产品五个维度，国内、国际两个视角，围绕课程“从油车到新能源汽车的能源转化”的新能源转化，“精益求精、追求卓越”的工匠精神，“绿水青山就是金山银山”的生态文明观三大思政建设目标，挖掘思政元素，确定本教学项目的思政育人目标： （1）结合纯电动汽车的性能特点，培养学生树立节约能源、绿色出行、低碳生活、保护生态的意识； （2）从低碳技术在我国自主品牌纯电动汽车应用现状培养学生建立民族自信心、增强民族自豪感和使命感，培养学生的爱国主义精神；（3）从各种电池体系中低碳技术逐渐国产化及目前存在的技术瓶颈问题引导学生要敢为人先，不断创新，培养学生奋发图强、报效国家的精神； （4）从新能源汽车的用电安全与使用维护引导学生养成良好的操作习惯，树立安全生产意识，时刻牢记安全第一，深刻理解规范意识、安全意识、培养职业素养。
default.en: The energy sector is undergoing revolutionary change as it transitions to clean, renewable, and low-carbon technologies. 《Low Carbon Technology in Batteries》this course brings low carbon technology into the new energy storage systems in response to satisfy the following requirement: including how power systems work and how a future grid and energy marketplace could operate. Attention is given to developing the knowledge and skills to perform deft technoeconomic analysis of energy systems. This course provides students with a basic understanding of the links between the physics and engineering applications of modern energy storage systems -including low-carbon technologies from renewable energy sources such as wind and solar; and Low-carbon technology application in batteries and hydrogen storage systems; the final operation and economics of electrolyzers in low-carbon power grids, etc. Finally, low carbon technologies used in various new energy systems in the course enable students to apply their expertise in integrating large-scale renewable energy and distributing energy resources into backup batteries, power systems, covering technologies as well as economic aspects, operational and environmental planning and the realization of the “Dual-Carbon” strategy.

default.zh: 碳中和技术与途径是在全球气候变化及环境问题日益严峻背景下为实现“双碳”目标，提出的在化学工程与技术学科专业开设的一门专业选修课，以碳达峰、碳中和理论为基础，通过对碳减排、碳零排和碳负排等相关的零碳电力技术、氢能技术、二氧化碳捕集封存技术、工业原料替代与循环利用、二氧化碳资源化技术等核心技术的基本原理、工艺过程、技术特点和发展趋势，让学生全面了解碳中和技术与途径相关的技术。通过本课程学习，让学生基本理解碳中和是我国实现可持续发展的内在要求，是推动构建人类命运共同体的责任担当。
default.en: Carbon-neutrality technology and approaches are proposed as a professional elective course in the field of chemical engineering and technology, in response to the increasingly urgent global climate change and environmental issues and the goal of achieving "carbon peaking and carbon neutrality". This course is based on the theory of carbon peaking and carbon neutrality, and provides students with a comprehensive understanding of carbon neutral technologies and pathways related technologies through the basic principles, processes, technical characteristics, and development trends of core technologies such as carbon reduction, carbon zero emission, and carbon negative emission. These core technologies include zero-carbon power technology, hydrogen energy technology, carbon dioxide capture and storage technology, industrial raw material substitution and recycling, and carbon dioxide resource technology. Through this course, students will develop a basic understanding that carbon neutrality is an inherent requirement for sustainable development in China and a responsibility for promoting the construction of a community with a shared future for mankind.

default.zh: 《氢能技术与前沿进展》主要学习氢气的制取及储存技术及前沿进展。包括化石能源制氢（烃类制氢、天然气制氢、煤制氢和甲醇制氢）、电解制氢（水电解制氢、水的光解制氢）、太阳能制氢、生物质制氢技术和其他新型制氢技术及发展现状。
default.en: The course 《Technology and Progress on Hydrogen Energy》 mainly focus on the technology and process in the production and storage of hydrogen. It included the preparation technologies of hydrogen such as hydrogen production from fossil energy (hydrocarbon, methane, coal and methanol), water electrolysis and water photolysis, solar energy, biomass and other technology.

default.zh: 《新能源器件与系统》是新能源材料与器件等相关专业的选修课程，本课程主要讲授新能源材料与器件，包括电化学储能器件、氢能与燃料电池、热电器件及新型光热调控器件的的设计、制备方法和表征手段，器件的基本原理、组装技术和评价方法。通过本课程的学习使掌握专业领域技术理论的基础上，同时结合该方向的国内外前沿研究进展，进一步掌握新能源器件相关的基本理论和知识，为学生将来从事新能源材料与器件方面的研究奠定良好理论基础，同时也为培养学生较强的研发能力、创新意识和较高的综合素质。
default.en: Introduction of Devices and Systems for New Energy is an elective course for the students of major of new energy materials and devices and other related majors. This course mainly teaches the design, preparation and characterization methods of new energy materials and devices, including electrochemical energy storage devices, hydrogen energy and fuel cells, thermoelectric devices and new photothermal regulatory devices, as well as the basic principle, assembly technology and evaluation method of the devices. Through the study of this course, students will master the basic theories and knowledge related to new energy devices on the basis of mastering the technical theories in the professional field and combining the cutting-edge research progress at home and abroad in this direction, so as to lay a good theoretical foundation for the future research of new energy materials and devices. At the same time, it also aims to cultivate students' strong research and development ability, innovation consciousness and high comprehensive quality.

default.zh: 能源、材料、信息科学是新技术革命的先导和支柱。作为特殊形态的光电转换薄膜，已成为微电子学、光电子学、磁电子学、传感器、太阳能利用等新兴学科的材料基础，是高新技术的重要组成部分。通过本课程的教学，使学生了解光电转换薄膜材料和器件的制造、检测以及在各前沿领域的应用，掌握光电转换薄膜技术的基本概念和方法，为学生今后从事相关领域的研究工作打下坚实的基础。
default.en: Energy, materials and information science are the forerunners and pillars of the new technological revolution. As a special form of photoelectric conversion film, it has become the material foundation of emerging disciplines such as microelectronics, optoelectronics, magnetoelectronics, sensors, and solar energy utilization, and is an important component of high-tech. Through the teaching of this course, students will understand the manufacturing, testing, and application in various cutting-edge fields of optoelectronic conversion film materials and devices, master the basic concepts and methods of optoelectronic conversion film technology, and lay a solid foundation for their future research work in related fields.

default.zh: 《能源材料清洁生产与节能减排新技术》是新能源材料与器件专业的双碳模块专业选修课。新能源材料是实现新能源转化和利用以及发展新能源技术的关键，新能源产业的发展离不开新能源材料的开发和应用。本课程旨在响应国家发展战略，围绕战略性新兴产业发展需求，给学生传授新能源材料清洁生产知识，以实现节能减排，为从事新能源转化利用方面的科学研究、技术开发和实践生产打下基础。 本课程主要讲授锂离子电池材料、燃料电池材料、太阳能电池材料、储氢材料、生物质材料的组成、结构、清洁生产方法及性能等，系统的介绍新能源材料工程领域的基本理论和清洁生产技术进展。着重培养学生对能源材料清洁生产与节能减排新技术的综合分析和工艺设计能力，培养学生对能源材料科学与工程知识的应用能力、增加创新意识，支撑专业学习成果中相应指标点的达成。
default.en: “Clean Production of Energy Materials and Energy Saving and Emission Reduction "is an elective course for the “dual carbon module” in major of New Energy Materials and Devices. New energy materials are the key to achieving the transformation and utilization of new energy and developing new energy technologies. The development of the new energy industry cannot be separated from the development and application of new energy materials. This course aims to respond to national development strategies and focus on the development needs of strategic emerging industries. It aims to impart knowledge on clean production of new energy materials to students, in order to achieve energy conservation and emission reduction, and lay the foundation for scientific research, technological development, and practical production in the field of new energy conversion and utilization. This course mainly teaches the composition, structure, clean production methods, and performance of lithium-ion battery materials, fuel cell materials, solar cell materials, hydrogen storage materials, and biomass materials. It systematically introduces the basic theories and clean production technology development in the field of new energy material engineering. Emphasis is placed on cultivating students' comprehensive analysis and process design abilities in clean production of energy materials and new technologies for energy conservation and emission reduction, cultivating students' application ability in energy material science and engineering knowledge, increasing innovation awareness, and supporting the achievement of corresponding indicator points in professional learning outcomes.

default.zh: 本课程为实验课程，主要面向“碳达峰”、“碳中和”政策，探索开发可持续的 CO2捕集、转化方法。通过本课程，加深对“双碳”的理解，形成绿色能源、循环利用思维方式，加深对课堂所学材料、催化、电化学等相关理论知识的理解，并通过实验验证部分理论的内容，锻炼学生创新实验技能、知识集成应用能力和工程能力，培养学生独立工作和从事科学研究工作的能力。 本课程具体包括“离子液体高效捕集CO2”、“电催化还原CO2制乙酸”、“人工光合作用”、 “多级结构电极协同催化CO2还原制乙醇”4个实验项目，共计24 学时。
