default.en: This course is an experimental course, mainly aimed at "carbon peak" and "carbon neutral" policies, and exploring and developing sustainable CO2 capture and transformation methods. Through this course, we will deepen our understanding of "double carbon", form a thinking mode of green energy and recycling, deepen our understanding of materials, catalysis, electrochemistry and other related theoretical knowledge learned in the classroom, and verify some theoretical contents through experiments, so as to train students' innovative experimental skills, knowledge integration and application abilities and engineering abilities, and cultivate their ability to work independently and engage in scientific research. This course specifically includes 4 experimental projects, including "Efficient CO2 capture by ionic liquids", "Electrocatalytic reduction of CO2 to acetic acid", "Artificial photosynthesis", and "Multi level structured electrodes for collaborative catalytic reduction of CO2 to ethanol", totaling 24 class hours.

default.zh: 《电化学创新设计》包括化学电源材料计算与设计和电镀体系理论设计两部分。本课程采用任务驱动法进行实践教学。讲授部分主要介绍燃料电池和锂离子电池相关材料的电化学性能计算与分析方法，及电镀添加剂吸附于电镀过程有限元仿真方法。在讲授电化学创新设计相关基础操作、数据分析方法的基础上，教师设定2类创新设计题目，包括化学电源材料计算与设计和电镀层仿真与设计，学生分组确定相关设计中涉及的模型、计算方法和参数，提交计算任务并进行结果汇总分析，查阅文献列举出能够验证计算结果的物理表征与电化学测试结论，完成设计说明书的全部任务，形成设计报告，并完成设计答辩。 通过课程训练学生对化学、电化学、化学电源和电镀基本理论、计算机软件模拟和计算、数据整合与分析的综合能力，要求学生在从事电池、电镀等与化学、材料相关的研究、设计、开发的工作时，具有综合运用所学电化学专业知识及计算化学、模拟仿真等知识解决实际问题的能力。
default.en: "Electrochemical Innovative Design" includes two parts: calculation and design of materials for electrochemical power sources and theoretical design of electroplating systems. This course adopts a task-driven approach in teaching practice. In the teaching part, the basic operations and data analysis methods will be introduces, including the calculation and analysis methods of the electrochemical properties of materials related to fuel cells and lithium-ion batteries, as well as the finite element simulation method of electroplating additives adsorbed in the electroplating process. Based on the basics, two innovative design topics will be set, regarding materials for chemical power sources and electroplating. Students work in groups to determine the models, calculation methods, and parameters involved in the design, and then submit calculation tasks and summarize the result for analysis. The calculation results should be verified by listing physical characterizations and electrochemical methods in literatures. The design will be completed after finishing a design report and passing the defense. Through the course training, students are required to develop comprehensive abilities in chemistry, electrochemistry, basic theories of chemical power sources and electroplating, computer software simulation and calculation, data integration, and analysis. Students are expected to have the ability to apply their knowledge of electrochemistry and computational chemistry, simulation, and other related knowledge to solve practical problems when engaging in research, design, and development work related to batteries, electroplating, and other chemical and materials-related fields.

default.zh: 本课程旨在培养学生运用系统思维、工程思维和创新思维解决复杂化工工程问题的能力，提升学生的逻辑思维、批判性思维和创造性思维水平，为后续专业课程学习和未来职业发展奠定坚实基础。
default.en: This course aims to cultivate students' ability to solve complex chemical engineering problems by applying systems thinking, engineering thinking and innovative thinking, enhance their logical thinking, critical thinking and creative thinking skills, and lay a solid foundation for their subsequent professional course study and future career development.

default.zh: 本课程专为化学专业本科生量身打造，聚焦“AI+材料化学”交叉领域，旨在培养具备数据科学思维与化学学科素养的新型人才。课程以化学实际问题为切入点，融合机器学习技术与材料化学基础理论，通过“学用结合”的教学模式，帮助学生掌握AI技术赋能材料研发的核心方法，形成适应智能化化学研究需求的创新思维，为未来从事新材料开发、绿色化学等前沿领域奠定跨学科基础。 教学内容从机器学习与Python编程基础起步，逐步深入化学信息学、材料多尺度特种的数字化解析，并结合语言大模型的知识挖掘、第一性原理计算与AI融合等前沿技术，重点围绕合金材料设计、多孔材料开发等典型场景展开。通过“数据采集—特征提取—模型构建—虚拟验证”的完整项目实践，学生将学习运用AI工具优化材料性能预测、合成路径设计等关键环节，突破传统化学研究中试错成本高、跨尺度分析难等瓶颈。
default.en: This course is specially designed for undergraduate students majoring in chemistry, focusing on the interdisciplinary field of "AI + Materials Chemistry." It aims to cultivate a new generation of talent with both data science thinking and solid chemistry knowledge. Taking real-world chemical problems as entry points, the course integrates machine learning techniques with fundamental theories of materials chemistry. Through a "learning-by-doing" teaching model, it helps students master core methods for AI-powered materials research, fostering innovative thinking that meets the demands of intelligent chemical research. This builds a cross-disciplinary foundation for future work in cutting-edge areas such as new materials development and green chemistry. The course starts with the basics of machine learning and Python programming, gradually advancing into cheminformatics and digital analysis of multiscale material features. It incorporates frontier technologies such as knowledge extraction using large language models and the integration of first-principles calculations with AI. The course emphasizes typical scenarios like alloy design and porous material development. Through hands-on projects that follow the full cycle of "data collection — feature extraction — model building — validation," students will learn to use AI tools to optimize material property prediction and synthesis pathway design, helping to overcome traditional bottlenecks such as high trial-and-error costs and challenges in cross-scale analysis in chemical research.

default.zh: 本课程专注于化学领域专用大语言模型（Chemistry-Specific LLMs）的基础理论、关键技术及其在智能合成中的应用。课程内容涵盖分子表示学习、反应预测、逆合成规划等核心技术，结合机器人化学家和自动化实验平台等前沿实践，旨在培养学生运用 AI 工具解决化学合成问题的能力。 课程的核心内容包括四个方面：首先，化学大模型基础部分将深入解析分子表示方法、模型架构及化学数据集构建原则，为学生打下坚实的理论基础。其次，智能合成技术模块将重点介绍分子生成与优化、逆合成分析及反应条件推荐等技术，帮助学生掌握智能合成的关键技能。第三，实验自动化部分将探讨自动化平台架构与高通量优化，让学生了解如何利用自动化技术提升化学实验效率。最后，伦理与前沿模块将分析双重用途风险、可靠性评估及多模态大模型发展趋势，培养学生的伦理意识和对前沿技术的洞察力。 本课程的教学特色在于实践导向，学生将通过上机操作主流工具，将理论知识与实际应用紧密结合。同时，课程整合了化学信息学、机器学习与自动化控制等多学科知识，打破学科壁垒，培养学生的跨学科思维。此外，伦理教育贯穿课程始终，结合最新研究，培养学生负责任使用 AI 的意识。 通过本课程的学习，学生将掌握化学大模型的核心原理与应用技能，能够独立完成分子设计、反应优化等任务，并具备评估 AI 方案可靠性及伦理风险的能力。课程适合化学、药学、材料科学等领域的研究生及高年级本科生，帮助他们为未来从事 AI 驱动的化学研究奠定坚实基础。
default.en: This course focuses on the fundamental theories, key technologies, and applications in intelligent synthesis of Chemistry-Specific Large Language Models (Chemistry-Specific LLMs). It covers core technologies such as molecular representation learning, reaction prediction, and retrosynthetic planning, and integrates cutting-edge practices involving robotic chemists and automated experimental platforms. The aim is to equip students with the ability to use AI tools to solve chemical synthesis problems. The core content of the course includes four main aspects. First, the foundation of chemical large language models will delve into molecular representation methods, model architectures, and principles of constructing chemical datasets, laying a solid theoretical foundation for students. Second, the intelligent synthesis technology module will focus on techniques such as molecular generation and optimization, retrosynthetic analysis, and reaction condition recommendations, helping students master the key skills for intelligent synthesis. Third, the experimental automation section will explore the architecture of automated platforms and high-throughput optimization, enabling students to understand how to enhance the efficiency of chemical experiments using automation technologies. Finally, the ethics and frontier module will analyze dual-use risks, reliability assessment, and the development trends of multimodal large language models, cultivating students' ethical awareness and insight into emerging technologies. The teaching features of this course emphasize a practice-oriented approach. Students will integrate theoretical knowledge with practical applications through hands-on operations of mainstream tools. The course also integrates multidisciplinary knowledge from cheminformatics, machine learning, and automated control, breaking down disciplinary barriers and fostering students' interdisciplinary thinking. Moreover, ethical education is integrated throughout the course, combining the latest research to cultivate students' awareness of responsible AI use. Through this course, students will master the core principles and application skills of chemical large language models, be able to independently complete tasks such as molecular design and reaction optimization, and possess the ability to assess the reliability and ethical risks of AI solutions. This course is suitable for graduate students and senior undergraduates in chemistry, pharmacy, materials science, and related fields, helping them lay a solid foundation for future AI-driven chemical research.

default.zh: AI+电化学通过将人工智能技术与电化学能源系统深度融合，为清洁能源技术的突破提供了全新路径。课程聚焦AI在电化学领域的核心作用——从加速新型材料研发（如电解质、高效催化剂）到优化电池、电解槽及燃料电池的性能与寿命，同时借助智能算法破解传统能源设备研发周期长、调控复杂等难题，推动能源系统向低碳化、智能化加速转型。学生将通过本课程了解机器学习、数字孪生等工具在电化学系统中的应用逻辑，例如构建电池寿命预测模型、设计电解水制氢的动态调控策略，并理解AI如何赋能锂/钠离子电池、储氢系统等关键技术，。课程还通过实际案例（培养从微观材料设计到宏观能源系统集成的跨学科能力，最终引导学生洞察AI+电化学在降低全产业链碳排放、促进循环经济中的战略意义，为我国“双碳”目标下的能源结构转型提供兼具技术创新与可持续视野的解决方案。
default.en: AI+Electrochemistry provides a new path for breakthroughs in clean energy technology by deeply integrating artificial intelligence technology with electrochemical energy systems. The course focuses on the core role of AI in the field of electrochemistry - from accelerating the development of new materials (such as electrolytes、high-efficiency catalysts) to optimizing the performance and life of batteries, electrolyzers and fuel cells. At the same time, it uses intelligent algorithms to solve the problems of long R&D cycles and complex regulation of traditional energy equipment, and promotes the accelerated transformation of energy systems towards low-carbon and intelligent ones. Through this course, students will understand the application logic of tools such as machine learning and digital twins in electrochemical systems, such as building a battery life prediction model, designing a dynamic control strategy for water electrolysis to produce hydrogen, and understanding how AI empowers key technologies such as lithium/sodium ion batteries and hydrogen storage systems. The course also uses actual cases (cultivating interdisciplinary capabilities from micro-material design to macro-energy system integration, and ultimately guiding students to gain insight into the strategic significance of AI+electrochemistry in reducing carbon emissions across the entire industry chain and promoting a circular economy, and providing solutions that combine technological innovation and sustainable vision for my country's energy structure transformation under the "dual carbon" goal.

default.zh: 毕业论文（设计）是化学工程与工艺辅修专业的工程实践课程。通过毕业设计的训练，培养学生能够综合运用所学的知识，借助文献研究，在团队中承担相应的研究任务，具有分析和解决电化学领域中复杂工程技术问题的能力，以及具有研究开发和设计电化学及相关领域新产品、新工艺、新技术的能力。
default.en: Graduation Thesis (Design) is an engineering practice course for minor Chemical Engineering and Technology. Through the training of graduation project, students are trained to comprehensively use the knowledge they have learned, undertake corresponding research tasks in the team with the help of literature research, have the ability to analyze and solve complex engineering and technical problems in the field of electrochemistry, and have the ability to research, develop and design new products, new processes and new technologies in electrochemistry and related fields.

default.zh: 毕业设计（论文）是为新能源材料与器件专业本科生开设的必修课，是新能源材料与器件专业本科生整个教学过程中最后一个重要的重要性教学环节，是综合考核本专业学生学业水平的主要形式。其目的是检查和培养学生掌握技能，综合运用知识进行独立分析、解决实际问题的能力，培养学生创新意识和严谨踏实的科学工作作风，通过毕业设计（论文），能够使学生理论联系实际，提高实践能力、科研能力和解决本专业工程实际问题的能力，培养学生积极的创新精神，增强学生的综合素质以及对毕业后工作岗位的适应能力。
default.en: Graduation design (thesis) is a required course for undergraduates majoring in new energy materials and devices, and it is the last important teaching link in the entire teaching process of undergraduates majoring in new energy materials and devices, and the main form of comprehensive assessment of the academic level of students in this major. Its purpose is to check and cultivate students' ability to master skills, make comprehensive use of knowledge to independently analyze and solve practical problems, and cultivate students' sense of innovation and rigorous and practical style of scientific work. Through graduation project (thesis), students can combine theory with practice, improve practical ability, scientific research ability and solve practical problems of this major. Cultivate students' positive innovative spirit, enhance students' comprehensive quality and adaptability to post-graduation jobs.

default.zh: 培养学生综合运用所学的知识，开展科学研究工作的初步能力，包括围绕研究内容开展调查研究、文献检索和搜集资料能力；培养学生方案论证，确定方案的能力；工程技术与经济指标的综合分析能力；锻炼理论分析、设计和计算的能力；对实验研究、实验装置的制作、安装、调试和使用的能力；撰写科技论文及设计说明书的能力；协同合作及组织工作的能力；培养学生协作精神，创新精神。
default.en: The aim of this course is to promote student grasp the development of their primary scientific research by applying the learned knowledge. The contents of this course include the following parts: training the students to investigate and collect references, establish a scheme, and analyze the technology and economic target; improving the ability of analysis skills, fabrication and use of the experimental equipment; improving the ability to write the thesis and solve the practical problems of experiment; promoting the students with the teamwork spirit, excellent communication ability and spirit of innovation.

default.zh: 毕业设计（论文）课程是高等院校实现本科培养目标要求的重要环节，是学生毕业前最后一个重要的实践阶段，是专业学习深化与升华的重要过程，是对学生综合素质与实践能力和创新意识的全面检验，是学生理论学习与实践成果的全面总结，是学生毕业及学位认证的重要依据，也是衡量高等学校教育质量和办学效益的重要评价内容。 撰写毕业论文是培养合格本科生的重要综合性环节，它对于培养学生科研能力与创新思维，检验学生综合知识水平有着重要意义。让学生在实践基础上进行理论总结和理论研究，引导学生进行前沿性课题，使学生具备较高的专业水平，同时具备相应的科研态度，成为创新型的合格人才。
default.en: Graduation design (thesis) course is an important link for colleges and universities to achieve the goal of undergraduate training, the last important practical stage before graduation, an important process of deepening and sublimating professional learning, a comprehensive test of students' comprehensive quality, practical ability and innovative consciousness, a comprehensive summary of students' theoretical learning and practical results, and a graduation and degree recognition. The important basis of certification is also an important content of evaluating the quality and efficiency of higher education.

default.zh: 生产实习是化学专业课程中的重要组成部分，进一步体现了理工结合的特色，具有实践性强、综合能力要求高的特点，是培养应用型人才的重要途径。通过实习使学生在掌握化学专业基本原理的基础上，了解基础知识与工程实际的联系，可以在理论和工程实践之间起到一个桥梁作用，培养学生理论联系实际，提高其在生产实际中调查研究、观察问题、分析问题以及解决问题的能力，提高学生的动手能力，为后续专业课程的学习打下基础。
default.en: Production practice is an important part of the chemistry major curriculum, which further reflects the characteristics of the combination of science and technology, has the characteristics of strong practicality and high comprehensive ability, and is an important way to train application-oriented talents. Internship enables students to grasp the basic principles of chemistry and understand the connection between basic knowledge and engineering practice, which can play a bridge role between theory and engineering practice, train students to combine theory with practice, improve their ability to investigate and research, observe problems, analyze problems and solve problems in production practice, and improve their hands-on ability. Lay a foundation for the study of subsequent professional courses.

default.zh: 生产实习是应用化学专业本科教学计划中非常重要的实践性教学环节，通过实习使学生在掌握应用化学学科基本原理的基础上，了解基础知识与工程实际的联系，可以在理论和工程实践之间起到一个桥梁作用，培养学生理论联系实际，提高其在生产实际中调查研究、观察问题、分析问题以及解决问题的能力和方法，为后续专业课程的学习打下基础。通过生产实习，使学生运用所学理论知识，验证和探讨生产实际问题；巩固和丰富专业知识；学习生产组织管理的初步知识；还应使学生了解现代化生产方式和先进制造技术，培养热爱专业、致力于祖国社会主义建设的思想。
default.en: Production Practice is a very important practical teaching link in the undergraduate teaching plan of applied chemistry, through which students can understand the connection between basic knowledge and engineering practice on the basis of mastering the basic principles of applied chemistry, which can play a bridge role between theory and engineering practice, cultivate students' ability to connect theory with practice, improve their ability and methods of investigation and research, observation of problems, analysis of problems and problem solving in production practice, and lay the foundation for the study of subsequent professional courses. Through production practice, students can use the theoretical knowledge they have learned to verify and discuss practical problems in production; consolidating and enriching expertise; Learn the preliminary knowledge of production organization and management; It should also enable students to understand modern production methods and advanced manufacturing technologies and cultivate the idea of loving their profession and devoting themselves to the motherland.

default.zh: 专业课程设计是在应用化学综合实验结课以后，在应用化学专业所开设的“精细有机合成原理”、“材料化学”、“表面化学”、“材料分析测试技术”等理论课程的基础上为应用化学专业本科生开设的一门综合的开放式的设计实验课。通过本课程的学习，使学生在已学的基本理论和实验技能基础上，掌握功能陶瓷材料、人工晶体材料或催化剂的制备、结构表征和性能测试方法；了解功能陶瓷材料、人工晶体材料或催化剂的应用领域及发展前景；提高查阅文献和实验设计的能力；提高综合运用所学的理论知识独立分析和解决问题的能力；进一步提高实验技能，锻炼总结归纳的能力。本课程设计分三个方向，由学生根据自己兴趣及需要选择其中之一：稀土改性钛酸盐陶瓷的制备、结构表征及电性能测试；γ-Al2O3催化剂的制备及其催化活性测试；稀土配合物/MCM-41介孔分子筛杂化发光材料的制备。树立基础知识和基本原理与实际材料或实际产品的结合理念，初步建立研制开发新材料和新产品的意识，为后续的毕业设计(论文)工作奠定必要的实验设计基础。通过本课程设计巩固并扩展应用化学专业课程的基本概念、基本理论及材料的分析方法和实现方法。
default.en: Major Course Design is one design course for the undergraduates of Applied Chemistry Specialty. Through the study of this course, students can master the preparation, structural characterization and performance testing methods of functional ceramic materials, artificial crystal materials and catalyst; understand the application field and development prospects; improve access to literature and experimental design capabilities; further improve the experimental skills, exercise summary induction ability. The main content of this course includes: the preparation, characterization and electrical properties of rare earth doped titan ate salts; the preparation and the catalytic detection of γ-Al2O3; the preparation of rare earth complexes/ MCM-41 mesoporous molecular sieve hybrid luminescent material, one of which is selected by students according to their own interests and needs. Through the study of the course, students can establish the combination concept of basic knowledge and actual materials, develop the new awareness of preparation new materials for the subsequent graduation design (thesis) work to lay the necessary experimental design basis.

default.zh: 土木工程导论是为土木工程专业低年级学生开设的一门前导性课程。通过课程学习，应了解土木工程的基本概念和发展历史；熟悉土木工程材料的发展历史、适用范围及发展趋势；熟悉建筑工程的特点及工程建设的基本流程，以及几种典型建筑结构体系的构成与工作原理；熟悉桥梁工程的发展历史、类型及工作原理；熟悉地下工程的主要类型、构成及施工方法；熟悉土木工程的主要灾害类型与预防手段；熟悉工程建设和运营的组织方式；了解土木工程专业的内涵及工程伦理的基本概念。课程目的是帮助学生了解土木工程的基本概念、基本内容和基本知识体系，学会运用工程思维和方法来解决工程问题，树立专业责任感和专业自豪感，为学习相关的后继课程打好必要的基础。
default.en: Introduction to Civil Engineering is a pioneering course for lower grade students majoring in civil engineering. Through course learning, one should understand the basic concepts and development history of civil engineering; Familiar with the development history, scope of application, and development trends of civil engineering materials; Familiar with the characteristics of building engineering and the basic process of engineering construction, as well as the composition and working principles of several typical structural systems; Familiar with the development history, types, and working principles of bridge engineering; Familiar with the main types, composition, and construction methods of underground engineering; Familiar with the main types of disasters and prevention measures in civil engineering; Familiar with the organizational methods of engineering construction and operation; Understand the connotation of civil engineering and the basic concepts of engineering ethics. The purpose of the course is to help students understand the basic concepts, content, and knowledge system of civil engineering, learn to apply engineering thinking and methods to solve engineering problems, establish a sense of professional responsibility and pride, and lay a necessary foundation for learning related follow-up courses.

default.zh: 土木制图基础主要研究用投影法绘制土木工程图样和解决空间几何问题的理论和方法，是土建专业类本科生必修的技术基础课，是学生最先接触的一门工程技术类课程，为后续课程和从事土木工程技术工作奠定必备的基础，承担着转变学生思维观念和引领学生建立工程意识的任务。通过研究正投影法的基本理论及其应用，进行空间实体（三维）——平面图（二维）——空间实物（三维）的转换，建立空间概念，提升学习者的形象思维能力；学生将具备阅读土木工程图样的能力：学习运用正确、规范的工程标准阅读、分析图形信息，表达设计思想。
default.en: Engineering Drawing is an application oriented subject that introduces the preparation representation and reading of engineering drawings. Considering scientific and technological level, engineering drawings, which is often called "the common technical language for engineers", is an important document in industry for design, manufacture, utilization and service. After learning this class, the students are supposed to be able to (1) master the basic theory and applications of orthographic projection and train students with abilities in design and innovation. （2）to be with a balanced skill in hand drawing,instrument drawing and computer assisted drawing as well as the ability in reading mechanical drawings.（3）to be able to conduct spatial and logical thinking, visual imagination, conceptualization,exploration and innovation.（4）to have serious working attitude, meticulous working style and their persistence in complying with related national standards. and (5) to cultivate the basic ability of drawing and reading civil engineering drawings, learn national drawing standards and other relevant provisions, properly use drawing instruments and tools and master drawing skills, master the contents and requirements of professional engineering drawings and (6) to cultivate the basic ability of plotting and reading civil engineering drawings.

default.zh: 本课程为土木工程专业本科教学计划“数学、力学、结构”主线中力学系列课程重要主干课之一，同时也是全国多数高校硕士研究生入学考试初试科目《结构力学》课程要求掌握知识点所涵盖的力学基础课。《结构力学》是土木工程专业建筑工程方向、岩土与地下工程方向、力学方向的专业基础课程。本课程的任务是向该专业的学生讲授土木工程中使用的各种工程结构力学分析的基础知识。本课程可划分为平面杆系的几何组成分析、静定结构的内力、位移计算、超静定结构内力和位移的计算的方法。通过本课程的教学使学生掌握结构组成的规律、力学性质和合理形式，以及结构的刚度、强度和稳定性的计算原理和计算方法，使学生具备运用结构力学基本知识分析、设计建筑和岩土工程结构的基本技能，为后续课程的奠定基础。
default.en: This course is one of the important core courses in the "Mathematics, Mechanics, Structures" mainline of the undergraduate teaching plan for civil engineering majors, and it is also a part of the basic mechanics knowledge required for the master's degree entrance examination of "Structural Mechanics" in most universities in the country. “Structural Mechanics I” is a fundamental professional curriculum for undergraduates who major in civil engineering (building engineering, geotechnical and underground engineering, mechanics). The mission of this course is to teach the basics of mechanics analysis of different structures in civil engineering for those who major this profession. The contents of this course include plane geometry configuration analysis, calculation methods of internal forces and deformation of statically determinate structure, calculation methods of internal forces and deformation of statically indeterminate structure. Through the study of this course, the students should master the configuration law, mechanical properties and reasonable forms of structures, as well as the analysis principles and calculation methods of stiffness, strength and stability of structures. After studying this course, the students can have the basic technical skills in analysis, design and construction of building and geotechnical structures by using the fundamental knowledge of structural mechanics, to lay the foundation for follow-up courses.

default.zh: 土木工程材料课程是土木工程专业的专业基础课，也是土木工程相关专业学生必须掌握的一门重要的工具课程。土木工程材料是构成房屋、道路、桥梁等的所有土木工程的物质基础，课程教学目的是使学生通过有关土木工程材料相关知识的学习，为后续进一步学习土木工程相关专业课程，以及从事相关专业技术工作提供土木工程材料的基础理论及实践应用能力的保证。 本课程以土木工程材料的基本概念、特性产生及变化的基本原理、工程应用与评价的基本理论及原则及其生态化发展的基本思路为重点，以胶凝材料、混凝土、砂浆、高分子材料等主要土木工程材料的组成、结构和性质间关系及外界因素对其性质影响分析为基础，从基本知识、基本原理、基本理论角度出发，通过土木工程材料的品种、技术指标、检测方法、评定指标、特点及应用的学习，达到培养学生具备合理正确评价、分析、判断、选用及改造研发工程材料基本技能的目的。
default.en: The course “civil engineering materials” is a basic course for civil engineering majors and an important tool course that college student must master. Civil engineering materials are the material basis of all civil engineering that constitute buildings, roads, bridges, etc. The purpose of the course teaching is to ensure the college students' basic theory and practical application ability of civil engineering materials for further study of civil engineering related professional courses and engage in relevant professional and technical work through the study of knowledge related to civil engineering materials. This course focuses on the basic concepts of civil engineering materials, the basic principles of the generation and change of characteristics, the basic theories and principles of engineering application and evaluation, and the basic ideas of ecological development. Based on the analysis of the relationship between the composition, structure and properties of cementitious materials, concrete, mortar, polymer materials and other major civil engineering materials and the influence of external factors on their properties, from the perspective of basic knowledge, basic principles and basic theories, through the varieties, technical indicators, detection methods, evaluation indicators, characteristics and applications of civil engineering materials, To achieve the purpose of training students with reasonable and correct evaluation, analysis, judgment, selection and transformation of engineering materials basic skills.

default.zh: 本课程主要讲述有关矿物和岩石，地质结构和构造，地下水，土壤和岩石的工程特性，危险地质现象及其工程地质问题，工程地质勘察和报告，工程地质特性的现场测试等方面的内容。本课程的学生旨在掌握工程地质学的基本原理，并获得分析工程地质条件和解决工程地质问题的能力。
default.en: This course presents/lectures on the minerals and rocks, geological structures and tectonics, groundwater, engineering properties of soils and rocks, hazardous geological phenomena and their engineering geology problems, engineering geology investigation and reporting, in-situ testing for engineering geology properties, as well as their mitigation measures. The students of this class aims at mastering the basic principles for engineering geology and at gaining the abilities for analyzing engineering geological conditions and for solving engineering geological problems.

default.zh: 该课程是土木工程专业建筑工程方向及城市地下空间工程专业本科生的一门必修专业基础课。主要研究土的物理力学性质、土中水的运动规律、土中应力、土的变形及强度的变化规律、土压力、土坡稳定性、地基承载力等内容。在教学过程中综合运用先修课程中所学到的有关知识与技能，结合实践教学环节，进行土木工程技术人员所需的基本训练，为学生进一步学习有关专业课程和日后从事土木工程工作打下基础。
default.en: This course is a required basic subject of special lecture for undergraduate students in civil engineering specialty (construction engineering direction、theoretical and applied mechanics direction) and with the purpose of training the students to understanding and mastering soil mechanics technique and theory .The main contents are listed below: Physical property and engineering classification of soil; Calculation of stresses in the ground base; Calculation of settlement; Shearing strength of soil; Bearing capability of ground base; Lateral press on retaining wall; Stability analysis of soil slope; shallow foundation design; pile foundation,etc. Besides, some experimentation contents are included in this course.

default.zh: 材料力学是关注结构强度和性能的工程学科学生们必修的一门基础课程。本课程主要目的是解决结构构件受拉、受压、受扭、受弯、受剪状况下的设计问题；固体力学中位移和变形、应力和应变、弹性、应变能等大多数基本概念都将在本课程中介绍；本课程推导得到的标准可以用于现有结构的安全检查或者新结构构件的设计。本课程的电算可以使学生熟悉并掌握应用编程软件解决力学问题。 本课程旨在使学生掌握基本的结构构件和他们的强度、刚度及稳定性。通过本课程的学习，学生们应能通过应用平衡条件、几何关系和材料本构关系解决实际工程中构件(例如：梁、杆件)的应力和应变分析问题；同时正确理解结构的强度、刚度和稳定性问题进而指导实际的设计问题。
default.en: Mechanics of materials is a basic engineering subject for engineering students who concerned with strength and physical performance of structures. The main topics are the analysis and design of structural members subjected to tension, compression, torsion, bending and shearing in this course. Some of the most fundamental concepts in solid mechanics are introduced. The criteria derived in this course can be used to check the safety of existing structures, or to design new structural members. The computer project can make the student to be familiar with solving mechanics problems with computers. This course aims to help engineering students to grasp the basics about structural members and their strength, stiffness and stability. At the end of this course, students should be able to apply the equilibrium conditions, geometric relations and material constitutive relations to solve practical engineering problems involving stress and strain analysis in elementary structural members, such as bars and beams. Issues on strength, stiffness and stability of structures should also be understood correctly to guide practical design.

default.zh: 土木工程材料是土木工程类专业学生的必修课程。该课程可以让学生掌握土木工程材料的组成，微观结构以及在土木工程中使用的材料工程性能。理解组成，结构与性能的关系，熟悉土木工程材料的规范标准。通过该课程的学习，学生可以获得根据土木工程施工要求选择选择原料，配制适当的配合比，在节约成本的情况下提高建筑物和构筑物的建筑寿命的基本原理和方法。同时学生可以了解目前土木工程材料的最新发展动态和绿色节能材料的开发与应用，以便开发新型土木工程材料以适应未来的市场需求。 在授课过程中，除了传统知识的传授外，结合人工智能在土木工程材料中的应用案例，分析未来人工智能与土木工程材料的关系以及发展方向，以提升学生材料科学与人工智能方向的交叉应用能力。另外结合实际工程案例分析，建筑结构耐久性与土木工程材料的关联度，帮助学生建立从微观尺度考虑宏观结构的思维模式。学生学会从材料原理和机理的角度分析建筑物破坏的原因，在新型建筑和建筑维修等领域，达到在建筑工程中节能增效的作用。通过国际前沿文献和工程案例的总结，加强学生阅读总结能力，并尝试应用于实践，提升其土木工程材料运用和实践的能力。
default.en: Civil engineering materials is a compulsory course for students majoring in civil engineering. This course can help students mastering the composition, microstructure and engineering properties of materials used in civil engineering; understanding the relationship between composition, structure and performance, and being familiar with the specifications and standards of civil engineering materials. After studying this course, students can achieve the basic theory and methods to select raw materials according to the requirements of civil engineering construction, design appropriate mixture ratio, and improve the building life of buildings and structures under the condition of saving costs. While students can understand the latest development trend of civil engineering materials and application of green energy-saving materials for developing new civil engineering materials to meet the future market demand. In the course, that will be analyzed that the relationship between artificial intelligence and civil engineering materials in the future combined with the application cases of artificial intelligence in civil engineering materials in order to improve students' cross-application ability in the direction of materials science and artificial intelligence. In addition, combined with the analysis of actual engineering cases, the correlation between the durability of building structures and civil engineering materials helps students establish a thinking mode of considering macro structures from the micro scale. Students learn to analyze the causes of building failure from the perspective of material principles and mechanisms, and achieve the role of energy conservation and efficiency in construction projects in the fields of new buildings and building maintenance. Through the summary of international cutting-edge literature and engineering cases, students will strengthen their ability to read and summarize, and try to apply them in practice, so as to improve their ability to apply and practice civil engineering materials.

default.zh: 房屋建筑学是哈尔滨工业大学土木工程学院为本科留学生开设的一门实践性较强 的综合技术科学，通过本课程的学习，使学生掌握民用建筑设计原理，建筑构造的基本 原理和一般构造方法，培养学生建筑构造设计，建筑方案设计与绘图的能力。具体目标 如下： 1．让学生掌握建筑的基本概念、发展历程、构成要素，深入学习建筑设计原理与 方法，了解建筑法规、规范及标准。 2．熟悉建筑构造原理与方法，掌握民用建筑中主要构件的设计依据，组成方式， 材料选择，构造特点，适用范围，常见做法等知识，熟悉构件之间的组合规律，掌握建 筑构造基本原理。
default.en: Building Architecture is a comprehensive technical curriculum offered by the School of Civil Engineering at the Harbin Institute of Technology for international students. Through this course, students will master the principles of civil architectural design, the fundamental theories of building construction, and general construction methodologies. The course further aims to develop students' abilities in architectural structural design, schematic design, and technical drafting. The specific objectives are as follows: 1. Enable students to master the fundamental concepts, historical development, and constituent elements of architecture; engage in an in-depth study of architectural design principles and methodologies; and acquire knowledge of architectural codes, regulations, and standards. 2. Familiarize students with construction principles and methods, ensuring mastery of the design basis, compositional approaches, material selection, structural characteristics, application scope, and common practices for key components in civil buildings. Develop proficiency in the integration principles between components and solidify understanding of the fundamental principles of architectural construction.

default.zh: 《C语言程序设计B》是非计算机专业的一门重要的计算机类专业基础课程。课程总学时为32学时，包括20学时的理论教学与12学时的上机练习。主要教学内容包括如下几个方面：1. 程序设计的方法学基础，介绍程序设计中的基本运算和基本I/O，基本控制结构与基本程序设计方法；2. 程序设计的问题求解基础，介绍程序设计中的枚举与递推，分治与递归等方法；3. 程序设计的算法和数据结构基础，介绍静态数据结构与排序查找算法等。通过本课程，使学生掌握用计算机分析和解决问题的思维方法以及程序设计的基本方法，建立从问题到算法再到程序的认知，在从问题到算法再到程序的问题求解及程序构造和实现的过程中理解高级语言的基本构造要素以及算法和数据结构在程序构造中的作用，具备良好的编程素养，以及综合运用所学程序设计语言和程序设计方法，设计、构造和应用计算系统求解科学或工程问题的程序设计和实现能力，为后继课程的学习和将来从事软件开发、解决复杂工程问题奠定编程能力基础。
default.en: C Programming B is an important foundational course in computer science for non-computer majors. The total course duration is 32 credit hours, including 20 hours of theoretical teaching and 12 hours of practical operation. The main teaching content includes the following aspects: 1. Fundamentals of programming methodology, introducing basic operations and I/O in programming, basic control structures, and basic programming methods; 2. Fundamentals of problem-solving in programming, introducing methods such as enumeration and recursion, divide and recursion in programming; 3. Fundamentals of program design, algorithms, and data structures, introducing static data structures and sorting search algorithms. Through this course, students can master the thinking method of computer analysis and problem solving and the basic method of program design, establish the cognition from problem to algorithm to program, understand the basic structural elements of high-level programming language, and the role of algorithm and data structure in programing in the process of problem solving, program construction and implementation from problem to algorithm to program, and have good programming literacy, and the ability to comprehensively apply programming languages and methods learned to design, construct, and apply computing systems to solve scientific or engineering problems in programming and implementation, laying the foundation of programming ability for subsequent courses and future engagement in software development and solving complex engineering problems.

default.zh: 《结构力学》是土木工程专业的专业基础课程。本课程的任务是向该专业的学生讲授土木工程领域使用的各种工程结构力学分析的基础知识。本课程包括平面杆系的几何组成分析、静定结构内力及位移的计算方法、超静定结构内力及位移的计算方法和移动荷载作用下的结构分析。通过本课程的教学使学生掌握结构组成的规律、力学性质和合理形式，以及结构刚度、强度的计算原理和计算方法，使学生具备运用结构力学基本知识分析、设计建筑和岩土工程结构的基本技能，为后续课程奠定基础。
default.en: “Structural Mechanics” is a fundamental professional curriculum for undergraduates who major in civil engineering. The mission of this course is to teach the basics of mechanics analysis of different structures in civil engineering for those who major this profession. The contents of this course include: plane geometry configuration analysis, calculation methods of internal forces and deformation of statically determinate structure, calculation methods of internal forces and deformation of statically indeterminate structure, and structural analysis forced by variable loads. Through the study of this course, the students should master the configuration law, mechanical properties and reasonable forms of structures, as well as the analysis principles and calculation methods of stiffness and strength of structures. After studying this course, the students can have the basic technical skills in analysis, design and construction of building and geotechnical structures by using the fundamental knowledge of structural mechanics, so as to lay the foundation for follow-up courses.

default.zh: 流体力学是土木工程专业的一门主要技术基础课。是该专业工程技术人员必须掌握的知识。它是研究流体平衡、运动及能量间内在联系与相互转换规律的一门学科，是一门以流体基础理论为主，结合一般工程技术的课程。学生通过本课程的学习后，能够获得流体力学方面基础理论的系统知识，实验技能和一定的分析、解决问题的能力。是后续专业课程学习的基础。
default.en: Fluid mechanics is a fundamental technical course in civil engineering that professional engineers and technical personnel must master. It explores the internal relationships and mutual conversion laws between fluid balance, motion, and energy, combining basic fluid theory with general engineering technology. Through this course, students can acquire systematic knowledge of basic theories of fluid mechanics, experimental skills, as well as analytical and problem-solving abilities. This subject serves as the foundation for subsequent professional courses.

default.zh: 测量学是土木工程专业的一门技术基础课，通过学习本课使学生掌握测量学的基本原理，测量仪器的基本构造及其操作，以及测量学在土木工程施工中的应用。 课程主要包括水准测量、角度测量、控制测量、地形图测绘、建筑工程测量、全站仪及应用等内容。通过课程学习，学生掌握测量学的基本理论和测量学的基本原理，掌握测量仪器的基本构造及其操作方法，具备进行大比例尺地形图测绘和土木工程、城市地下空间工程、工程管理专业相关测量工作的能力。
default.en: Surveying is a technical foundation course for civil engineering major. By studying this course, students will master the basic principles of surveying, the basic structure and operation of measuring instruments, and the application of surveying in civil engineering construction. Mainly including leveling measurement, angle measurement, control measurement, topographic mapping, construction engineering measurement, total station and application, etc. Enable students to possess the ability to conduct civil engineering surveying. Through course learning, students master the basic theories and principles of surveying, understand the basic structure and operation methods of measuring instruments, and have the ability to conduct large-scale topographic map surveying and related surveying work in civil engineering, urban underground space engineering, and engineering management majors.

default.zh: 本课程是土木工程专业（建筑工程方向）的一门核心专业课，介绍土木工程结构所承受的主要荷载和作用，以及基于可靠度的概率极限状态设计方法，主要内容包括： （1）荷载与作用的基本概念，作用的分类，结构设计的目标与任务。 （2）永久荷载与作用，包括：自重、土压力、水压力、预应力、变形作用。 （3）可变荷载与作用，包括：楼面活荷载、屋面活荷载、吊车荷载、雪荷载、风荷载、温度作用。 （4）偶然荷载与作用，包括：爆炸、撞击、火灾。 （5）地震作用。 （6）荷载的概率模型与代表值。 （7）结构构件抗力的统计分析与概率模型。 （8）结构可靠度的基本概念。 （9）基于概率的概率极限状态设计方法。 通过本课程的学习，让学生了解荷载和作用的计算方法，以及结构设计方法的基本原理，为进一步学习专业课程打下坚实的理论基础。
default.en: This course is a core professional course in the civil engineering major (building engineering direction). It introduces the main loads and actions which are subjected to by civil engineering structures, as well as the probability-based limit state design method based on reliability. The main contents contents of this course include: (1) Basic conceptof loads and actions, classificarton of actions , objective and tasks of structural design. (2) Permanent loads and actions, including: self-weight, soil pressure, water pressure, pre-stress, deformation actions;. (3) Variant loads and actions, including: floor live load, roof live load, crane load, snow load, wind load, temprature action. (4) Accidental loads and actions, including: explosion, impact, fire. (5) earthquake action. (6) Probability models and representative values of loads. (7) Statistical analysis and probability models of structural member resistance. (8) Basic concept of structural reliability. (9) probability-based limit state design method. Through the study of this course, students can understand the calculation methods of loads and actions, as well as the basic principles of structural design methods, and lay a solid theoretical foundation for further study of professional courses.

default.zh: 本课程主要讲授地质学基本知识及其在土木工程中的应用相关内容。通过本课程的学习，培养学生合理选址与地质资源利用、工程应用中正确认识地质灾害对工程结构的破坏机制、高效环保处理工程地质问题等方面的能力，增强用地质环境和人为环境相互作用的动态观点进行合理建筑布局和结构设计的意识。主要内容包括：1）地质学理论与工作方法的基本知识，包括地球形成、地质作用类型、三大岩石的成因与识别、三大岩石变形的工程特性、地质构造与工程选址、断层类型与识别、褶皱类型与识别、活动断层的类型与识别区域稳定性理论与分析方法、地应力场的分布规律与工程选址问题、地表水和地下水地质作用原理与工程特性、典型地质灾害成因机理、围岩稳定性、工程地质原位测试等知识；2）掌握工程地质的工作方法与试验技术，包括工程地质勘查技术，典型地质灾害和地质构造的调查技术、工程地质的野外工作方法、工程勘察典型原位测试技术与监测、岩石与岩体的室内外实验技术等；3）掌握工程设计中合理利用质资源的工作方法
default.en: This course mainly covers the fundamental knowledge of geology and its applications in civil engineering. Through the study of this course, students will develop abilities in rational site selection and utilization of geological resources, correctly understanding the mechanisms by which geological hazards damage engineering structures in engineering applications, and efficiently and environmentally handling engineering geological problems. It also aims to enhance awareness of designing reasonable building layouts and structures from a dynamic perspective that considers the interaction between geological and human environments. The main contents cover the following:1)Basic knowledge of geological theories and working methods, including the formation of the Earth, types of geological processes, genesis and identification of the three major rock types, engineering properties of deformation in the three major rock types, geological structures and site selection for engineering, types and identification of faults, types and identification of folds, types and identification of active faults, theories and analysis methods of regional stability, distribution patterns of the in-situ stress field and site selection issues, principles of surface water and groundwater geological processes and engineering properties, mechanisms of typical geological disasters, surrounding rock stability, in-situ testing in engineering geology, etc.; 2) Mastery of working methods and testing techniques in engineering geology, including engineering geological survey techniques, investigation techniques for typical geological disasters and structures, field methods in engineering geology, typical in-situ testing techniques and monitoring in engineering surveys, laboratory and field testing techniques for rocks and rock masses, etc.; 3) Mastery of working methods for the reasonable utilization of geological resources in engineering design.

default.zh: 《结构动力学》是土木工程专业本科生的一门专业基础课程，主要研究结构在动荷载作用下的动力响应规律及其分析方法。本课程在材料力学、结构力学等先修课程的基础上，引导学生完成由结构静力分析向结构动力分析的知识拓展。课程内容包括结构动力分析概述、动力荷载与动力自由度、体系运动方程的建立、单自由度体系自由振动与受迫振动分析、多自由度体系动力响应分析、振型分解法、阻尼模型、频率与振型的实用计算方法，以及逐步积分法等内容。通过本课程学习，学生能够掌握结构动力学的基本概念、基本理论和基本计算方法，具备运用力学知识、数学方法和现代计算工具分析结构动力问题的能力，为后续专业课程学习、工程结构抗震分析与设计以及相关科学研究奠定基础。
default.en: Structural Dynamics is a fundamental professional course for undergraduate students majoring in Civil Engineering. It focuses on the dynamic response behavior of structures subjected to dynamic loads and the corresponding analytical methods. Based on prerequisite knowledge from Mechanics of Materials and Structural Mechanics, this course guides students in extending their understanding from structural static analysis to structural dynamic analysis. The main topics include an introduction to structural dynamic analysis, dynamic loads and dynamic degrees of freedom, formulation of equations of motion, free and forced vibration analysis of single-degree-of-freedom systems, dynamic response analysis of multi-degree-of-freedom systems, modal superposition method, damping models, practical calculation methods for natural frequencies and mode shapes, and step-by-step integration methods. Through this course, students will master the basic concepts, theories, and computational methods of structural dynamics, and develop the ability to analyze structural dynamic problems using mechanics principles, mathematical methods, and modern computational tools. The course provides a solid foundation for further professional study, seismic analysis and design of engineering structures, and related scientific research.

default.zh: 本课程是土木工程的核心基专业基础课程，主要讲授土的物理力学性质、土中水的运动规律、土中应力、土的变形及强度的变化规律、土压力、土坡稳定性、地基承载力等内容。
default.en: The course is a fundamental core course in civil engineering, mainly covering the physical and mechanical properties of soil, the laws of water movement in soil, stress in soil, the rules of soil deformation and strength changes, earth pressure, slope stability, and foundation bearing capacity.

default.zh: 本课程为土木工程专业本科教学计划“数学、力学、结构”主线中力学系列课程重要主干课，同时也是全国多数高校硕士研究生入学考试初试科目《结构力学》课程要求掌握知识点所涵盖的力学基础课（此外还包含《结构稳定与极限分析A》课程）。本课程是前序《结构力学》课程的动力学部分，主要研究工程结构在例如像地震、强风及海浪等具有典型时变特征的动力荷载作用下的内力及变形响应，为进一步学习相关专业课（如工程结构抗震, 抗风，抗冲击）、未来进行工程设计及科学研究等奠定基础。课程主要包含结构动力分析简介、单自由度体系动力响应分析、多自由度体系动力响应分析及实用计算方法四部分，这四部分由浅入深，首先由动荷载的定义和分类入手介绍结构动力分析和静力分析的区别；然后通过引进动力自由度的概念引出结构体系运动方程的建立方法，并以工程中常见的两类（单自由度和多自由度）体系为例讲解运动方程的求解和结构动力响应的特点，使学生系统掌握结构动力学的基本理论和分析方法；并最终通过动力分析的实用计算方法及离散化分析使学生初步具备分析和解决实际工程问题的能力。通过本门课程学习，应对结构动力学的研究对象、研究内容有深入认识，同时系统掌握结构动力学的基本概念、基本理论和基本方法，并能够综合运用所学知识解决工程中的常见的动力学问题。
default.en: This course is a crucial part of the "Mathematics, Mechanics, and Structures" series of courses for undergraduate students majoring in Civil Engineering. It is also a required subject for the first stage of the national postgraduate entrance examination for most universities in China, covering the basic knowledge points of mechanics included in the prerequisite courses "Structural Mechanics" and "Structural Stability and Limit Analysis A."As the dynamic part of the prerequisite course "Structural Mechanics," this course mainly studies the internal force and deformation responses of engineering structures under typical time-varying dynamic loads such as earthquakes, strong winds, and ocean waves. It lays a foundation for further study of related professional courses, such as seismic，wind and impact design of engineering structures, and for future engineering design and scientific research. The course mainly includes an introduction to structural dynamic analysis, dynamic response analysis of single-degree-of-freedom systems, dynamic response analysis of multi-degree-of-freedom systems, and practical computational methods. These four parts are presented from shallow to deep. First, the difference between dynamic analysis and static analysis is introduced by defining and classifying dynamic loads. Then, the concept of dynamic degree of freedom is introduced to establish the equations of motion for structural systems. Using the two commonly used types of structural systems (single-degree-of-freedom and multi-degree-of-freedom) as examples, the solution of equations of motion and the characteristics of structural dynamic response are explained. The goal is to enable students to master the basic theory and analysis methods of structural dynamics. Finally, practical computational methods and discrete analysis are introduced to equip students with the ability to analyze and solve common engineering problems. Through this course, students should gain an in-depth understanding of the research objects and content of structural dynamics, systematically master the basic concepts, theories, and methods of structural dynamics, and be able to comprehensively apply the knowledge learned to solve common dynamic problems in engineering.

default.zh: 本课程是高等学校土木工程专业的主干专业课之一，是理论密切联系实践的工程类课程，所学内容与其它各门结构课程的学习紧密联系，也是工作中应用最多、最广的专业知识，并对学生在专业方向的进一步学习和发展起到重要作用。 开设本课程的目的是通过向学生讲授混凝土结构的材料性能、各类构件的受力性能及设计计算方法和构造，使其具备设计混凝土结构基本构件的设计能力，同时具备查阅规范和相关设计资料的能力。通过本课程的学习，要求学生熟悉混凝土和钢筋的材料力学性能，掌握混凝土结构的基本工作原理及主要特点，重点掌握基本构件的受力特征、设计计算方法、构造要求及规范条文，能够从事一般混凝土构件的设计。 本课程特点是以理论分析为依据，注重科学试验，但其理论的严密性较差。因此，在培养学生掌握基本构件的力学性能及设计方法的同时，要密切联系工程实践，逐步培养学生应用理论性和逻辑性很强的数学、力学知识来分析、解决工程中的具体问题，能灵活掌握影响结构性能的主要因素。此外，通过本门课程的学习，要培养学生严谨、一丝不苟的工作态度和不断进取、努力创新的钻研精神。
default.en: This course is one of the major courses of civil engineering major in colleges and universities. It is a kind of engineering course which is closely related to theory. The contents of this course are closely connected with the learning of other structural courses. It is a professional knowledge applied widely in the work, which also plays an important role on further learning and development for students in their professional fields. The purpose of this course is to teach students the material properties of concrete structures and mechanical properties and calculation methods of the design for various types of components, which can make students have the ability to design basic structural elements of concrete structures and have access to specification and relevant design documents. Through learning this course, students are required to be familiar with the mechanical properties of concrete and steel bars, to master the basic working principle and main features of concrete structures, to master the stress characteristics, design and calculation methods, structural requirements and standard provisions of basic components, and to be able to work on general designing of concrete components. The characteristics of this course are on account of theoretical analysis and to focus on scientific experiments, but the theory is less rigorous. Therefore, while training students to grasp the mechanical properties of basic components and design methods, it is necessary to closely contact with engineering practice and gradually train students to apply theoretical and logical mathematical and mechanical knowledge to analyze and solve specific problems in the project. The main factors that affect the performance of the structure were mastered flexibly. Besides, through learning this course, it is necessary to cultivate students to obtain meticulous working attitude and aggressive and innovative spirit.

default.zh: 钢结构基本原理是土木工程专业的主要专业课，课程内容包括： 学习钢结构的特点及应用和发展，钢结构设计方法；熟悉建筑钢材的主要性能，影响钢材性能的主要因素，破坏形式，钢的种类、规格和选用；掌握连接的工作性能，构造和计算以及焊接残余应力和焊接变形的影响；掌握受弯构件计算和设计，腹板的屈曲后强度和吊车梁的设计特点以及轴心受力构件、拉弯、压弯构件计算和设计，柱头和柱脚设计；介绍连接节点的设计原理。
default.en: The course of steel structures is a major course of department of civil engineering. This course introduces the basic characteristics about steel structure, the history of steel structure and the design methods of steel structures. The lecture books and references will be used and the recent research results in this area will be introduced. It includes introduction to structural steel materials, welded and bolted connections, loads on structures, tension members design, compression members design, flexural members design. The key points of this lecture are connections design, beams design, columns design, design of beam-column members and single-storey industrial buildings design. This course also introduces the earthquake-resistant design of steel structures and plastic design.

default.zh: 《基础工程B》课程为土木工程学院土木工程专业本科生的一门专业选修课，是以上专业及专业方向本科生的一门主干课程。通过该门课程的学习，使学生能够了解并掌握土的物理性质与工程分类、土的压缩性与地基沉降计算、土的抗剪强度与地基承载力、土压力与土坡稳定分析等土力学的基本知识；综合运用先修课程中所学到的结构设计和施工技术等知识与技能，结合实践教学环节，运用基础工程基本知识与原理，了解和掌握天然地基上的浅基础和桩基础的设计问题。通过本课程的学习与训练，使学生具备进行基础设计与管理的基本能力，为学生进一步学习有关专业课程和日后从事土木工程管理工作打下基础。 本课程坚持理论联系实际的教学方法，不断吸收先进理论知识和最新理论和实践的动态，并且坚持传统教学与现代化教学手段相结合，采用多媒体教学技术，把抽象的理论转化为具体的图像，提高学生学习兴趣。
default.en: Foundation Engineering B is a major elective course for undergraduates of the college of civil engineering. It is a major course for undergraduates of the above majors and majors. Through the study of this course, students can understand and master the basic knowledge of soil mechanics such as physical properties and engineering classification of soil, soil compressibility and foundation settlement calculation, soil shear strength and foundation bearing capacity, soil pressure and soil slope stability analysis. Make comprehensive use of the knowledge and skills of structural design and construction technology learned in the advanced courses, combine the practical teaching links, apply the basic knowledge and principles of basic engineering, and understand and master the design problems of shallow foundation and pile foundation on natural foundation. Through the study and training of this course, students will be equipped with the basic ability of basic design and management, which will lay a foundation for students to further study related professional courses and engage in civil engineering management in the future. This course adheres to the teaching method of combining theory with practice, constantly absorbs advanced theoretical knowledge and the latest trends of theory and practice, and adheres to the combination of traditional teaching and modern teaching methods, adopts multimedia teaching technology, transforms abstract theories into concrete images, and enhances students' interest in learning.

default.zh: 本课程是高等学校土木工程专业的主干专业课之一，是理论密切联系实践的工程类课程，所学内容与其它各门结构课程的学习紧密联系，也是工作中应用最多、最广的专业知识，并对学生在专业方向的进一步学习和发展起到重要作用。 开设本课程的目的是通过向学生讲授混凝土结构的材料性能、各类构件的受力性能及设计计算方法和构造，使其具备设计混凝土结构基本构件的设计能力，同时具备查阅规范和相关设计资料的能力。通过本课程的学习，要求学生熟悉混凝土和钢筋的材料力学性能，掌握混凝土结构的基本工作原理及主要特点，重点掌握基本构件的受力特征、设计计算方法、构造要求及规范条文，能够从事一般混凝土构件的设计。 本课程特点是以理论分析为依据，注重科学试验，但其理论的严密性较差。因此，在培养学生掌握基本构件的力学性能及设计方法的同时，要密切联系工程实践，逐步培养学生应用理论性和逻辑性很强的数学、力学知识来分析、解决工程中的具体问题，能灵活掌握影响结构性能的主要因素。此外，通过本门课程的学习，要培养学生严谨、一丝不苟的工作态度和不断进取、努力创新的钻研精神。
default.en: This course is one of the major courses of civil engineering major in colleges and universities. It is a kind of engineering course which is closely related to theory. The contents of this course are closely connected with the learning of other structural courses. It is a professional knowledge applied widely in the work, which also plays an important role on further learning and development for students in their professional fields. The purpose of this course is to teach students the material properties of concrete structures and mechanical properties and calculation methods of the design for various types of components, which can make students have the ability to design basic structural elements of concrete structures and have access to specification and relevant design documents. Through learning this course, students are required to be familiar with the mechanical properties of concrete and steel bars, to master the basic working principle and main features of concrete structures, to master the stress characteristics, design and calculation methods, structural requirements and standard provisions of basic components, and to be able to work on general designing of concrete components. The characteristics of this course are on account of theoretical analysis and to focus on scientific experiments, but the theory is less rigorous. Therefore, while training students to grasp the mechanical properties of basic components and design methods, it is necessary to closely contact with engineering practice and gradually train students to apply theoretical and logical mathematical and mechanical knowledge to analyze and solve specific problems in the project. The main factors that affect the performance of the structure were mastered flexibly. Besides, through learning this course, it is necessary to cultivate students to obtain meticulous working attitude and aggressive and innovative spirit.

default.zh: 无机材料科学是材料科学的重要组成部分，因其具有独特的原子和分子结合方式，形成的晶体和非晶体结构，具有抗压，耐高温以及声光电热等物理特性，在各大行业中均有重要的地位。重大创新的突破往往离不开材料的设计与创新，新材料的开发和性能的提升源于材料科学基础理论。所以在当前各行业科技急需转型升级的前提下，无机材料科学基础课程的基础理论显得更为重要。 本课程着重探求材料的结构、物相和反应三者的规律以及它们之间的有机联系，是开发新材料以及解决材料改性工作过程中的重要理论基础课程。包括三部分内容。1.主要讲授材料的聚集状态，包括晶体结构、晶体缺陷，熔体的结构，晶体的表面与界面现象。2.主要讲授材料的热力学，重点为二元、三元相图及其应用。3.主要讲授过程动力学，重点讲授物质的扩散原理及影响因素，固相反应原理及固相反应研究方法，相变原理。 通过本课程的学习，学生可以达到从原子/分子结构等基础原理调整材料的物理特性；具有改进和创新材料合成工艺制度的能力。初步具备分析问题和解决问题的科学研究能力。个人的文献阅读和归纳总结能力，以及团队合作能力获得提升。最后学生具备从材料的本质出发进行交叉学科工业高端设计和管理的能力。
default.en: Inorganic materials science is an important part of materials science, because it has a unique way of combining atoms and molecules, forming crystal and amorphous structures, with physical properties such as compression resistance, high temperature resistance and acousto-photoelectric heat, and has an important position in major industries. Major industrial breakthroughs are often inseparable from the design and innovation of materials, and the development and performance improvement of new materials originate from the fundamental of material science. Therefore, under the premise that science and technology in various industries urgently need to be transformed and upgraded, the fundamental of inorganic material science courses are more important. This course focuses on exploring the laws of structure, phase transition and reaction of materials and the relationship between them. It is an important theoretical basic course in the process of developing new materials and solving material modification. It consists of three parts. 1. The aggregation state of materials, include crystal structure, crystal defects, melt structure, crystal surface and interface. 2. The thermodynamics of materials, focus on binary and ternary phase diagrams and their applications. 3.Process dynamics, focus on the diffusion principle and influencing factors of substances, solid phase reaction principle and solid phase reaction research method, phase transition principle. Through the study of this course, students can achieve the ability to adjust the physical properties of inorganic materials from basic principles such as atomic/molecular structure; Have the ability to improve and innovate the material synthesis process system. Preliminary scientific research ability to analyze and solve problems. Individual literature reading and summarization skills, as well as teamwork skills. Finally, students have the ability to carry out interdisciplinary industrial high-end design and management from the essence of materials.

default.zh: 《材料分析测试方法》课程是土木工程专业土木工程材料方向重要的专业核心课，本课程主要讲授材料组成与结构的分析与表征方法，使同学们了解现代材料分析技术的基本原理和相关测试仪器的主要构造，学会图谱分析、样品制备和相关应用。 课程主要内容包括绪论、X射线衍射分析、电子显微分析和实验内容，着重培养学生们材料组成与结构的综合分析能力。 课程最后成绩采用累加式：综合考虑期末、实验、作业和平时表现等。
default.en: “Analysis and Characterization of Materials”is one of the core courses for undergraduate students majoring in civil engineering materials. This course mainly teaches the analysis and characterization methods of material composition and structure, makes students understand the basic principle of modern materials analysis technology, the basic structure of related testing instruments, the analysis method of spectrum, sample preparation, and the related applications. This course mainly includes the introduction, X-ray diffraction analysis and electron microscopic analysis. This course focuses on cultivating the student’s comprehensive analysis ability of material composition and structure. This course takes a cumulative examination form, including the final examination, experimental, homework and usual performance

default.zh: 《钢筋混凝土结构》课程是土木工程专业（土木工程材料方向）核心课之一。课程主要讲授钢筋混凝土构件的基本原理、力学性能及设计方法。重点使学生了解钢筋混凝土结构的理论基础、研究热点、发展趋势及前沿应用；熟悉和掌握钢筋混凝土构件的基本计算方法。 课程主要包括概论及应用介绍、材料性能、结构设计方法、受弯构件正截面、受弯构件斜截面、受压构件承载力等基本计算方法，以及装配式结构的工艺与原理。本课程考试成绩采用累加式，包括期末笔试、平时测试和作业三部分。
default.en: "Reinforced Concrete Structures" is one of the core courses for undergraduate students majoring in Civil Engineering (Civil Engineering Materials Direction). In this course, several commonly member s of reinforced concrete are introduced about their working principles, mechanical properties and design methods. After finishing the lesson student know the theoretical foundation, advanced studies, tendency and applications of the above basic member. Be familiar to mechanical calculation of reinforced concrete members. This course mainly includes the introduction, material performance, structural design method, the normal section bearing capacity of bending member, the oblique section bearing capacity of bending member, the bearing capacity of compression member, and the process and principles of prefabricated structures. The course scores are cumulative, including three parts: classroom test, homework and written examinations.

default.zh: 本课程为土木工程专业岩土与地下工程方向必修的专业课，它由地下空间规划与建筑两个部分所组成。该内容是学生必须掌握和了解的专业设计知识与基础，通过本门课程的学习，可使学生掌握地下空间规划的基本理论和方法，以及一般的地下空间建筑，如地下街和地下综合体、地下停车场、地下铁道、地下城市市政综合管廊等的建筑设计理论与方法，以此更深刻理解地下结构的设计基本理论。通过本课程的学习与训练，使学生具备进行基础设计与管理的基本能力，为学生进一步学习有关专业课程和日后从事土木工程管理工作打下基础。 本课程坚持理论联系实际的教学方法，不断吸收先进理论知识和最新理论和实践的动态，并且坚持传统教学与现代化教学手段相结合，采用多媒体教学技术，把抽象的理论转化为具体的图像，提高学生学习兴趣。 本课程共计32学时，2.0学分，通过考试的形式考核学生的学习情况，以百分制打分。
default.en: This course is a professional course in the direction of geotechnical and underground engineering for civil engineering majors. It consists of underground space planning and architecture. These contents are the professional design knowledge and foundation that students must master and understand. Through the study of this course, students can master the basic theories and methods of underground space planning, as well as the architectural design theories and methods of general underground space buildings, such as underground streets and underground complexes, underground parking lots, underground railways, underground urban comprehensive pipe galleries, etc., in order to gain a deeper understanding of the basic theories of underground structure design. Through the study and training of this course, students will be equipped with the basic ability of basic design and management, which will lay a foundation for students to further study related professional courses and engage in civil engineering management in the future. This course adheres to the teaching method of combining theory with practice, constantly absorbs advanced theoretical knowledge and the latest trends of theory and practice, and adheres to the combination of traditional teaching and modern teaching methods, adopts multimedia teaching technology, transforms abstract theories into concrete images, and enhances students' interest in learning. This course is a total of 32 hours, 2.0 credits, and the students' learning situation is assessed by the form of open roll examination.

default.zh: 本课程是高等学校土木工程专业的主干专业课之一，是理论密切联系实践的工程类课程，所学内容与其它各门结构课程的学习紧密联系，也是工作中应用最多、最广的专业知识，并对学生在专业方向的进一步学习和发展起到重要作用。 开设本课程的目的是通过向学生讲授混凝土结构的材料性能、各类构件的受力性能及设计计算方法和构造，使其具备设计混凝土结构基本构件的设计能力，同时具备查阅规范和相关设计资料的能力。通过本课程的学习，要求学生熟悉混凝土和钢筋的材料力学性能，掌握混凝土结构的基本工作原理及主要特点，重点掌握基本构件的受力特征、设计计算方法、构造要求及规范条文，能够从事一般混凝土构件的设计。 本课程特点是以理论分析为依据，注重科学试验，但其理论的严密性较差。因此，在培养学生掌握基本构件的力学性能及设计方法的同时，要密切联系工程实践，逐步培养学生应用理论性和逻辑性很强的数学、力学知识来分析、解决工程中的具体问题，能灵活掌握影响结构性能的主要因素。此外，通过本门课程的学习，要培养学生严谨、一丝不苟的工作态度和不断进取、努力创新的钻研精神。
default.en: This course is one of the major courses of students majoring in civil engineering. It is a kind of engineering course which is closely related to theory. The contents of this course are closely connected with the learning of other structural courses. It is a professional knowledge applied widely in the work, which also plays an important role on further learning and development for students in their professional fields. The purpose of this course is to teach students the material properties of concrete structures and mechanical properties and calculation methods of the design for various types of components, which can make students have the ability to design basic structural elements of concrete structures and have access to specification and relevant design documents. Through learning this course, students are required to be familiar with the mechanical properties of concrete and steel bars, to master the basic working principle and main features of concrete structures, to master the stress characteristics, design and calculation methods, structural requirements and standard provisions of basic components, and to be able to work on general designing of concrete components. The characteristics of this course are on account of theoretical analysis and to focus on scientific experiments, but the theory is less rigorous. Therefore, while training students to grasp the mechanical properties of basic components and design methods, it is necessary to closely contact with engineering practice and gradually train students to apply theoretical and logical mathematical and mechanical knowledge to analyze and solve specific problems in the project. The main factors that affect the performance of the structure were mastered flexibly. Besides, through learning this course, it is necessary to cultivate students to obtain meticulous working attitude and aggressive and innovative spirit.

default.zh: 《基础工程A》课程为土木工程学院城市地下空间工程专业本科生的一门主干课程。通过该门课程的学习，使学生能够了解并掌握土的物理性质与工程分类、土的压缩性与地基沉降计算、土的抗剪强度与地基承载力、土压力与土坡稳定分析等土力学的基本知识；综合运用先修课程中所学到的结构设计和施工技术等知识与技能，结合实践教学环节，运用基础工程基本知识与原理，了解和掌握天然地基上的浅基础和桩基础的设计问题。通过本课程的学习与训练，使学生具备进行基础设计与管理的基本能力，为学生进一步学习有关专业课程和日后从事土木工程管理工作打下基础。 本课程坚持理论联系实际的教学方法，不断吸收先进理论知识和最新理论和实践的动态，并且坚持传统教学与现代化教学手段相结合，采用多媒体教学技术，把抽象的理论转化为具体的图像，提高学生学习兴趣。
default.en: Foundation Engineering A is a major elective course for urban underground space engineering undergraduates. Through the study of this course, students can understand and master the basic knowledge of soil mechanics such as physical properties and engineering classification of soil, soil compressibility and foundation settlement calculation, soil shear strength and foundation bearing capacity, soil pressure and soil slope stability analysis. Make comprehensive use of the knowledge and skills of structural design and construction technology learned in the advanced courses, combine the practical teaching links, apply the basic knowledge and principles of basic engineering, and understand and master the design problems of shallow foundation and pile foundation on natural foundation. Through the study and training of this course, students will be equipped with the basic ability of basic design and management, which will lay a foundation for students to further study related professional courses and engage in civil engineering management in the future. This course adheres to the teaching method of combining theory with practice, constantly absorbs advanced theoretical knowledge and the latest trends of theory and practice, and adheres to the combination of traditional teaching and modern teaching methods, adopts multimedia teaching technology, transforms abstract theories into concrete images, and enhances students' interest in learning.

default.zh: 《建筑结构》课程是高等学校工程管理专业的专业课之一，是理论密切联系实践的工程类课程，所学内容与其它各门课程的学习紧密联系，也是工作中应用较为广泛的专业知识，并对学生在专业方向的进一步学习和发展起到重要作用。 开设本课程的目的是通过向学生讲授混凝土结构的材料性能、各类构件的受力性能及设计计算方法和构造，使其具备设计混凝土结构基本构件的设计能力，同时具备查阅规范和相关设计资料的能力。通过本课程的学习，要求学生熟悉混凝土和钢筋的材料力学性能，掌握混凝土结构的基本工作原理及主要特点，重点掌握基本构件的受力特征、设计计算方法、构造要求及规范条文，能够从事一般混凝土构件的设计。
default.en: "Building Structure" is one of the courses of students with major in Engineering Management. It is strongly related to the practical engineering projects as well as to other courses. This course is also widely applied in the practical engineering projects and plays an important role in guiding the further study of students. The purpose of this course is to train the students with the capability of structural design through teaching students the material performance of concrete structure, the mechanical performances of variant components, calculation method and construction performance and detailing, etc. Through this course, students are required to be familiar with the material mechanical properties of concrete and reinforcement and grasp the basic working principle and main characteristics of the concrete structure. More importance is on the mechanical performance of basic components, calculation and design approach, detailing, specifications and design of concrete structures.

default.zh: 经济学基础是工程管理专业本科生的必修课，本课程包括微观经济学和宏观经济学两部分内容。通过微观部分的学习，使学生掌握其基本原理和分析方法，熟悉价格形成的机理，决定价格的主要因素，并能解释价格机制的作用和市场运作的原理，理解资源配置有效性的含义及其条件，掌握有关企业行为的基本理论。通过宏观部分的学习，使学生掌握其基本原理和分析方法，熟悉财政政策、货币政策等，寻求经济的长期稳定增长、公平与效率之间的均衡。通过使学生理解国家各种经济政策出台的经济背景，从而达到培养学生对现实经济行为与经济现象的观察与分析能力，训练学生具有经济学的意识与思维方式的目标。
default.en: This course covers both microeconomics and macroeconomics.Through the study of microeconomics, students will master the basic principles and analytical methods of microeconomics, understand and be able to clearly explain the mechanism of price formation, the main factors determining prices, and the role of price mechanisms and the principles of market operation. They will also understand the meaning and conditions of effective resource allocation and the basic theories of enterprise behavior. Through the study of macroeconomics, students will master the basic principles and analytical methods of macroeconomics, be familiar with fiscal and monetary policies, seek a balance between long-term stable economic growth, fairness and efficiency, and understand that various national policies are based on economic background. The goal is to cultivate students' observation and analytical skills of real economic behavior and economic phenomena, and train them to have economic awareness and thinking.

default.zh: 本课程是为工程管理学生开设的专业限选课。运筹学是管理科学的重要分支。通过本课程的学习目的是使学生掌握若干运筹学的重要方法与技术，了解运筹学的原理和优化思想在管理领域的基本应用，建立起系统观点和优化观点，培养和提高学生分析和解决实际问题的能力。 运筹学作为工程管理专业的必修主干课程，是对与定量因素有关的管理问题通过应用科学的方法进行辅助管理决策制定的一门学科。课程主要内容包括线性规划、目标规划、整数规划、动态规划的建模求解及应用分析、图与网络优化技术和决策技术等。通过该门课程的学习，要求学生把握运筹学上述各个分支的基本理论、方法，掌握运筹学整体优化思想，同时结合常用数学软件（如LINGO等）讲解运筹学模型的一些实际案例，注重学生自主学习、实现教学互动，使学生在未来的实践工作中具有一定的定量分析、应用和解决实际问题的能力。
default.en: This course is a professional elective course for engineering management students. Operational research is an important branch of management science. The purpose of this course is to enable students to master several important methods and technologies in operations research, understand the principles of operations research and the basic application of optimization ideas in the field of management, establish systematic and optimization perspectives, and cultivate and improve students' ability to analyze and solve practical problems. Operational research, as a compulsory core course in the field of engineering management, is a discipline that assists management decision-making by applying scientific methods to management problems related to quantitative factors. The main contents of the course include modeling, solution and application analysis of linear programming, goal programming, Integer programming, dynamic programming, graph and network optimization technology and decision-making technology. Through the study of this course, students are required to grasp the basic theories and methods of the above-mentioned branches of operations research, master the overall optimization ideas of operations research, and explain some practical cases of operations research models in conjunction with commonly used mathematical software (such as LINGO etc.). Emphasis is placed on students' autonomous learning, achieving teaching interaction, and enabling them to have certain quantitative analysis, application, and problem-solving abilities in future practical work.

default.zh: 工程经济学A是由工程技术科学、经济学和管理学相互融合的一门综合性学科，培养工科学生具备一定的工程经济分析的基本理论和方法，紧密围绕工程项目开展过程中的投资决策问题而展开。主要包括：熟练掌握资金时间价值的内涵及计算公式；对拟建项目投入总资金进行估算；熟练掌握建设项目经济评价方法和参数，分析和判断投资项目的财务可行性和国民经济可行性；掌握不确定性分析和风险分析的种类和方法；掌握投资方案的比选与优化方法；掌握设备更新、租赁与改扩建项目方案评价方法等。
default.en: Engineering Economy A is a comprehensive discipline that integrates engineering technology science, economics and management. It cultivates engineering students with basic theories and methods of engineering economic analysis and closely revolves around investment decision-making issues during the development of engineering projects. Mainly including: proficiently mastering the connotation and calculation formula of the time value of funds; Estimate the total investment of the proposed project; Proficient in mastering the economic evaluation methods and parameters of construction projects, analyzing and judging the financial feasibility and national economic feasibility of investment projects; Master the types and methods of uncertainty analysis and risk analysis; Master the comparison and optimization methods of investment plans; Master the evaluation methods for equipment renewal, leasing and renovation and expansion project plans.

default.zh: 本课程是高等学校土木类智能建造专业的核心专业课之一，是理论密切联系实践的工程类课程，所学内容与力学和结构课程的学习紧密联系，结构性能、分析与设计将直接支撑智能建造其他专业课程学习，并对学生在专业方向的进一步学习和发展起到至关重要的决定性作用。 本课程特点是以理论分析为依据，注重科学试验。因此，在培养学生掌握基本构件的力学性能及设计方法的同时，要密切联系工程实践，逐步培养学生应用理论性和逻辑性很强的数学、力学知识来分析、解决工程中的具体问题，能灵活掌握影响结构性能的主要因素。此外，通过本门课程的学习，要培养学生严谨、一丝不苟的工作态度和不断进取、努力创新的钻研精神。
default.en: This course is one of the core professional courses for intelligent construction majors in higher education institutions in civil engineering. It is an engineering course that integrates theory and practice. The content covered is closely related to the study of mechanics and structural courses. Structural performance, analysis, and design will directly support the learning of other professional courses in intelligent construction, and play an important and essential role in students' further learning and development in their professional direction. The characteristic of this course is based on theoretical analysis, with a focus on scientific experimentation. As a result, it is necessary to closely connect with engineering practice while cultivating students' mastery of mechanical properties and design methods of basic elements, gradually cultivate students' application of theoretical and logical mathematical and mechanical knowledge to analyze and solve specific engineering problems, and be able to flexibly grasp the main factors affecting structural performance. Furthermore, it is vital to foster in students a rigorous and precise work attitude, as well as a spirit of continual improvement and creativity in research, through the study of this course.

default.zh: 《机器学习》是哈尔滨工业大学土木工程学院智能建造专业本科生的专业核心课。本课程旨在重点培养学生运用机器学习方法分析土木工程（大）数据的能力，并为相关课程的学习及科学研究奠定数据分析理论和方法基础。主要内容多变量分析、高斯混合模型和EM算法、贝叶斯与高斯过程模型等适用于土木工程（大）数据分析的基本理论与计算方法。理论讲解结合课后作业，加深对课堂理论教学内容的理解，使学生对结构健康监测有一定深度的理解。
default.en: This course is the professional core course of intelligent construction major. Through the course, we focus on cultivating the students' ability to use machine learning methods to analyze civil engineering (big) data, and lay the foundation for data analysis theories and methods for related course study and scientific research. The main contents of the course are the basic theories and calculation methods suitable for civil engineering (big) data analysis, which includes: multivariate analysis, Gaussian mixture model and EM algorithm, and Bayesian inference and Gaussian process.

default.zh: 本课程是一门理论与实践紧密结合的学科核心课，通过课程学习，让学生掌握深度学习这一人工智能研究分支的基础理论知识，包括人工神经网络、损失函数、正则化、反向传播算法等基本理论，了解多层感知机、卷积神经网络、残差神经网络、循环神经网络、注意力模型、自编码机、生成对抗网络等深度学习模型的基本原理与设计理念，熟练掌握Pytorch、Tensorflow等深度学习平台的使用和编程方法，达到合理利用深度学习模型解决本学科研究任务的能力。
default.en: This course is a core subject that closely integrates theory and practice. Through the course study, students will learn the basic theory of deep learning, which is a branch of artificial intelligence research. Including artificial neural networks, loss functions, regularization, and backpropagation algorithms, etc. They will also learn the basic principles and design concepts of deep learning models such as multilayer perceptron, convolutional neural networks, residual neural networks, recurrent neural networks, attention models, autoencoders, and generative adversarial networks, etc. After the course learning, students are expected to be proficient in programming using the Pytorch and the Tensorflow platforms. The are also expected to achieve the ability to reasonably employ deep learning models to solve research tasks in their concerned disciplines.

default.zh: 建筑力学与建筑结构课程是建筑学专业的一门重要的专业基础课，面向建筑学专业三年级学生授课。 建筑力学与建筑结构是相互支撑的一个整体，建筑力学为人们提供认识和分析建筑结构的方法，对建筑结构计算模型的凝练又丰富和发展建筑力学。通过本课程学习，使学生掌握建筑用混凝土、建筑用钢、建筑用木材等建筑材料的物理力学性能及材料基本力学性能指标的取值方法。掌握恒载、活载、风载、地震作用、温度作用等的概念、计算及取值方法。在掌握了简支梁板、连续梁板内力计算方法之后，掌握混凝土梁板、钢梁正截面承载力设计计算方法。在掌握主应力计算方法之后，掌握混凝土梁斜截面承载力计算方法。在掌握楼盖内力分析与计算方法之后，学会肋梁楼盖设计。在掌握排架结构内力计算方法之后，学会单层工业厂房的设计步骤和方法。在介绍框架和剪力墙内力计算方法之后，了解框架和剪力墙结构的设计计算步骤和方法。在介绍桁架内力分析方法之后，了解网架的工程应用和发展现状。在介绍木结构节点连接和构件设计计算之后，了解木结构的工程应用和发展现状。
default.en: Architectural Mechanics and Building Structure is an important basic professional course for architecture majors and it is taught for third-year students majoring in architecture. Architectural mechanics and building structure is an integral whole to support each other. Building mechanics provides people a method to recognize and analyze building structures. It is useful to enrich and develop architectural mechanics by compacting building structure models. Through this course, students will be able to master the physical and basic mechanical properties of building materials such as construction concrete, construction steel and construction timber. Students will be able to master the conception, calculation and accessor methods of dead load, live load, wind load, earthquake effect, temperature effect, and etc. After mastering the calculation methods 0f the internal forces of simply-supported beams and continuous beams, the design and calculation methods of the bearing capacity of concrete beams and steel beams will be mastered by students. After mastering the principal stress calculation method, students will be able to master the calculation method of shear capacity of concrete beams. After mastering the internal force analysis and calculation method of the building, students will learn to design method of floor system. After mastering the internal force calculation method of the truss structure, students will learn the design procedure and methods of the single-layer industrial building. After introducing the internal force calculation method for the frame and shear wall, the design procedure and methods of frame and shear wall system will be acquaint by students. After introducing internal force analysis methods of truss, students will be aware of engineering application and development status of the grid. After introducing the calculation of node connection and component design calculation of wood structure, students will be aware of engineering application and development status of wood structure.

default.zh: 《建筑经济与施工》是一门建筑学院本科生的必修专业课。本课程通过多媒体教学手段培养学生掌握有关建筑经济与建筑施工的基本理论知识、工艺流程及原理，为建筑学院各专业的相关课程打下扎实的理论基础。因此，本门课程在建筑学院各专业本科生的教学计划中具有重要的地位和作用。
default.en: Building Economy and Construction is a compulsory professional course for undergraduates in the School of Architecture. This course trains students to master the basic theoretical knowledge, technological process and principles of construction economy and construction through multimedia teaching means, and lays a solid theoretical foundation for the relevant courses of various majors in the School of Architecture. Therefore, this course has an important position and role in the teaching plan of undergraduate students in the School of Architecture.

default.zh: 本课程是高等学校土木工程专业的主干专业课之一，是理论密切联系实践的工程类课程，所学内容与其它各门结构课程的学习紧密联系，也是工作中应用最多、最广的专业知识，并对学生在专业方向的进一步学习和发展起到重要作用。 开设本课程的目的是通过向学生讲授混凝土结构的材料性能、各类构件的受力性能及设计计算方法和构造，使其具备设计混凝土结构基本构件的设计能力，同时具备查阅规范和相关设计资料的能力。通过本课程的学习，要求学生熟悉混凝土和钢筋的材料力学性能，掌握混凝土结构的基本工作原理及主要特点，重点掌握基本构件的受力特征、设计计算方法、构造要求及规范条文，能够从事一般混凝土构件的设计。 本课程特点是以理论分析为依据，注重科学试验，但其理论的严密性较差。因此，在培养学生掌握基本构件的力学性能及设计方法的同时，要密切联系工程实践，逐步培养学生应用理论性和逻辑性很强的数学、力学知识来分析、解决工程中的具体问题，能灵活掌握影响结构性能的主要因素。此外，通过本门课程的学习，要培养学生严谨、一丝不苟的工作态度和不断进取、努力创新的钻研精神。
default.en: This course is one of the major courses of civil engineering major in colleges and universities. It is a kind of engineering course which is closely related to theory. The contents of this course are closely connected with the learning of other structural courses. It is a professional knowledge applied widely in the work, which also plays an important role on further learning and development for students in their professional fields. The purpose of this course is to teach students the material properties of concrete structures and mechanical properties and calculation methods of the design for various types of components, which can make students have the ability to design basic structural elements of concrete structures and have access to specification and relevant design documents. Through learning this course, students are required to be familiar with the mechanical properties of concrete and steel bars, to master the basic working principle and main features of concrete structures, to master the stress characteristics, design and calculation methods, structural requirements and standard provisions of basic components, and to be able to work on general designing of concrete components. The characteristics of this course are on account of theoretical analysis and to focus on scientific experiments, but the theory is less rigorous.
