Therefore, while training students to grasp the mechanical properties of basic components and design methods, it is necessary to closely contact with engineering practice and gradually train students to apply theoretical and logical mathematical and mechanical knowledge to analyze and solve specific problems in the project. The main factors that affect the performance of the structure were mastered flexibly. Besides, through learning this course, it is necessary to cultivate students to obtain meticulous working attitude and aggressive and innovative spirit.

default.zh: 基础工程为土木工程专业本科生的一门主干课程。通过该门课程的学习，使学生能够了解并掌握基础工程的基本特点、主要形式、设计和计算理论；综合运用先修课程中所学到的结构设计和施工技术等知识与技能，结合实践教学环节，运用基础工程基本知识与原理，了解和掌握天然地基上的浅基础和桩基础的设计问题。通过本课程的学习与训练，使学生具备进行基础设计与管理的基本能力，为学生进一步学习有关专业课程和日后从事土木工程管理工作打下基础。
default.en: Foundation Engineering is a compulsory course for undergraduates majoring in civil engineering. Following contents would be taken in this course：basic principles and related regulations of foundation engineering design, types of common foundations and their application, Selection of foundation embedded depth, calculation of foundation bearing capacity, design method of rigid foundation, design principles and calculation methods of pile foundation, The basic idea of caisson structure during construction, construction of underground diaphragm wall, and Engineering protection measures for all kinds of special foundation soil, etc. This course is a backbone course of urban underground space engineering and plays an important role in the teaching plan of urban underground space engineering. Basic training for professionals in urban underground space engineering would be provided in this course and it is the basis for students to further study relevant professional courses and engage in urban underground space engineering in the future.

default.zh: 《工程岩体力学》课程是城市地下空间工程专业本科生的一门必修专业课。本课程主要研究不同受力条件下岩体的变形和破坏规律，并在工程地质定性分析的基础上定量研究工程岩体稳定性。在工程岩体力学课程教学中通过基本概念、基本理论、基本方法的教学，培养学生发现问题、分析问题和解决岩体力学问题的能力。为今后从事生产实际工作和科学研究打好基础。本课程共计32学时，2学分。通过闭卷考试的形式考核学生的学习情况，以百分制打分。
default.en: Rock Mechanics of Engineering is a compulsory course for undergraduates majoring in urban underground space engineering. This course mainly studies the deformation and failure rules of rock mass under different stress conditions, and quantitatively studies the stability of engineering rock mass on the basis of qualitative analysis of engineering geology. Through the teaching of basic concepts, basic theories and basic methods, students are trained to discover, analyze and solve problems in rock mechanics. It will lay a solid foundation for future production practice and scientific research. This course is with a total of 32 hours and 2 credits. This course examines student learning through a closed-book examination and scores by percentage grading system.

default.zh: 《地基处理》是城市地下空间工程专业本科生的一门专业方向选修课程。本课程主要培养学生改善不良场地条件、降低地基基础工程风险的能力，提高学生解决基础工程问题的综合分析能力。本课程主要讲授地基处理的基本原理、计算设计方法和施工方法，系统讲述地基处理的基本过程和主要检验依据。通过该课程的学习，学生能够理解地基处理的理论，掌握处理复杂岩土工程的方法，提高学生地下空间工程系统知识的综合应用能力。为学生进一步学习有关专业课程和日后从事地下工程领域的设计与研究工作打下基础，在城市地下空间工程专业的教学计划中占有重要的地位。
default.en: This course is accessible to undergraduate students majoring in urban underground space engineering. This course involves the basic knowledge and main technologies of ground treatment, containing the principles and methods, treatment technology, and design calculation manners. The students who finished this course could be capable to design a safe, economic, and reasonable foundation and ground engineering based on varied conditions, demands, and construction schemes. It lays a foundation for further study on the relevant major courses and being engaged in urban underground space engineering or research in the future. So it plays an important role in the teaching of urban underground space engineering specialty.

default.zh: 《岩土工程勘察》是城市地下空间工程专业的一门重要专业技术基础课。通过本课程的学习，能够使城市地下空间工程专业的学生全面了解岩土工程勘察的基本知识、基本步骤、基本原理和基本方法，初步掌握工程地质勘察和岩土工程勘察的基本原则、工作程序以及勘察手段等。
default.en: Geotechnical engineering investigation is an important basic technical course of civil engineering (geotechnical and underground engineering). Through the study of this course, students majoring in civil engineering (geotechnical and underground engineering) can fully understand the basic knowledge, basic steps, basic principles and basic methods of geotechnical engineering investigation, and preliminarily master the basic principles, working procedures and survey methods of engineering geological investigation and geotechnical engineering investigation.

default.zh: 量子力学是是物理学的分支学科，与相对论一起被认为是现代物理学的两大基本支柱，许多物理学理论和科学，如原子物理学、固体物理学、核物理学和粒子物理学以及其它相关的学科，均以量子力学为基础。以研究微观物质（比如原子、分子，电子等）运动规律为基本出发点建立的量子力学，开辟了人类认识客观世界运动规律的新途径，开创了物理学的新时代。量子力学作为智慧专业的选修课，不仅可以培养学生扎实的理论基本功，同时开阔了学生视野，为开展创新与交叉研究奠定坚实的基础。本课程重点介绍量子力学（非相对论）的基本概念、基本原理与基本方法。课程共六个章节。第一章为绪论:量子物理学发展史，量子力学研究的对象及特点，波粒二象性。第二章为波函数和薛定谔方程: 波函数的统计解释，态迭加原理，薛定谔方程，粒子流密度和粒子数守恒定律，定态薛定谔方程，一维无限势阱，线性谐振子，势垒贯穿。第三章为量子力学中的力学量:表示力学量的算符，动量算符和角动量算符，氢原子，厄密算符本征函数的正交性，算符与力学量的关系，算符的对易关系。第四章为态和力学量的表象：态的表象，算符矩阵表示，量子力学公式的矩阵表述，么正变换，狄拉克符号。第五章为微扰理论:非简并定态微扰理论。第六章为自旋与全同粒子:电子自旋。
default.en: Quantum mechanics is considered as one of the two foundations of modern physics. Many physical theories and sciences, such as atomic physics, solid state physics, nuclear physics, particle physics and other related disciplines, are based on it. Quantum mechanics is the established by study of the laws of motion of microscopic substances (such as atoms, molecules, electrons, etc.), which opened a new way for humans to understand the objective world. Quantum mechanics can provide a solid foundation for innovation and cross disciplinary research. This course focuses on introducing the basic concepts, principles, and methods of quantum mechanics. The course consists of six chapters. The first chapter is an introduction: the development history of quantum physics, the objects and characteristics of quantum mechanics research, and wave particle duality. The second chapter is about wave function and Schrodinger equation: statistical interpretation of wave function, state superposition principle, Schrodinger equation, conservation law of particle flow density and particle number, stationary Schrodinger equation, one-dimensional infinite potential well, linear harmonic oscillator, barrier penetration. The third chapter is about the mechanical quantities in quantum mechanics: operators representing mechanical quantities, momentum operators and angular momentum operator, hydrogen atoms, the orthogonality of Hermite operator eigenfunctions, the relationship between operators and mechanical quantities, the commutation relationship between operators. The fourth chapter is the representation of states and mechanical quantities. Chapter 5 is about Approximation methods (Perturbation theory and Variational principle). Chapter 6 is about spin and identical particles.

default.zh: 弹性力学课程是在修完理论力学、材料力学等课程之后的一门重要的力学课程，是固体力学的重要分支。弹性力学是研究在外荷载作用下的位移、应变和应力分布规律并分析变形体的强度和刚度的一门理论课程，也称为弹性理论。弹性力学课程以能量原理为基础，针对材料在小变形线弹性范围内的变形，分析各种结构或构件在弹性阶段的应力和位移，校核其强度和刚度。该课程它是从事变形固体力学的研究人员及从事结构强度分析的工程技术人员必备的基础知识，同时为进一步学习塑性力学，断裂力学和复合材料力学等固体力学分支学科提供必要的理论基础和研究方法。 该课程的教学任务是培养学生全面地掌握弹性力学的基本概念、基本原理及处理弹性力学问题的基本方法，了解线弹性经典问题的计算方法和基本解答，提高学生的分析和计算能力，培养学生的逻辑思维能力；并培养学生利用弹性力学方法来研究分析一般结构在外力作用下的变形、内力分布与承载能力，进一步提高学生对工程结构或工程材料的强度、刚度稳定性等实际力学问题的分析解决能力，使其满足建筑、机械、化工、航天等工程领域工作人员的基本科研素质需求。
default.en: On the base of theoretical mechanics and mechanics of materials, theory of elasticity is one of the most important mechanics courses for undergraduate students whose major are intelligent construction, this course is a component of solid state mechanics. The course will focus on the displacement of an elasticity body under external force based on the strain and stress distributions. By analysis of the displacements, strain and stress, the strength and stiffness materials are studied for particular applications. This course is a not only a fundamental for researches in the field of solid mechanics, but also very useful for technicians related with strength of structures. For students, this course will provide the basic skills and methods for a further research on plastic mechanics, fracture mechanics and composites mechanics, and so on. The objective of this course is to make undergraduate students grasp the basic concept, basic theory and basic method of theory of elasticity, undergraduate students should understand the calculation method and the basic solution of the classical problem of linear elasticity, and improve their analytical calculation capability and logical thinking capability. At the same time, students should can analyze the deformation, distribution of internal force and carrying capacity of general structure by using theory of elasticity, and should further improve their personal capabilities of solving practical mechanical problems of strength, rigidity and stability for engineering structure and engineering materials. This can meet the basic quality of scientific research of working person in the field of building, machinery, chemical industry, and aerospace.

default.zh: 岩土工程监测是地下工程类专业非常重要的核心专业课，是后续地下建筑结构设计、地下通风、地下防火、地下设备等专业课的基础，在培养学生地下空间结构设计综合分析能力、综合设计能力具有重要作用。 本课程在讲授岩土工程原位测试的基础上，主要讲授地基与基础、桩基静力、动力测试、深基坑开挖测试与监测、隧道检测与监测、沉桩对环境的影响、特殊土地区岩土检测与监测、探地雷达检测技术等岩土工程的测试方法、传感器特性、系统构成、以及测试数据的基本处理和应用。培养学生复核设计理论、验证解决复杂岩土工程结构新方法的综合分析与突发事故的处理能力，提高学生地下空间工程系统知识的综合应用能力，启迪学生创新意识，支撑专业学习成果中相应指标点的达成。 通过本课程的学习，学生除了掌握岩土工程基本力学性能的原位测试原理和技术、重要岩土工程测试参数计算的基本概念、岩土工程专用传感设备研究热点、发展趋势及应用前景之外，还将掌握防水、防渗、沉降、软弱不良地层等地下工程及特殊岩土工程处理的测试与监测系统设计、结构分析方法，初步具备分析和解决地下空间复杂岩土工程安全性系统综合分析能力，并培养学生运用信息、智能等交叉知识与技术，激发学生研发地下结构测试新设备的兴趣和独立工作能力个团队意识。
default.en: Geotechnical engineering monitoring is is one of the core professional course of underground space engineering and/or engineering-like speciality which is base of follow-up major courses such as foundation structure design and underground structure ventilation and fireproofing and devices. It is very important for training student comprehensive analysis and integrated design for complicated geotechnical engineering. Basing of instructing of in-situ testing of geotechnical engineering, the main teaching of this course will emphasize of subgrade and foundation and pile-foundation static and dynamic testing and deep excavation measurement and monitoring and tunnel testing and monitoring and environment effect caused by pile sinking and special soil area geotechnical detection and surveying and GPR probing technique whose measurement methods and sensors properties and system component and acquisition data processing and their handling and application will be discussed with students. This course aims to help students to have a thorough comprehension of geotechnical engineering review design theoretics and verifying the novel method to solve complex geotechnical engineering comprehensive analysis ability and solving of emergence problem. Addition to above hopes we also want to improve college student innovation capability and consciousness and fulfil the index points which are established to support the specialty learning. Participating in this course, except for knowing well of geotechnical engineering essential mechanical property in-situ testing theory and technology and important geotechnical engineering measurement parameter computation basic concepts and geotechnical engineering dedicated sensors research focus and developing and application prospect, students will be require to grasp of leakage and percolation e and sedimentation and soft and/or bad earth underground engineering and special section processing testing and monitoring system design and structural analysis method. Students have the possession of disposing of underground space geotechnical structural engineering systemic capacity and be able to apply information and intelligence technology and interdiscipline knowledge to deal with the underground structure testing and proving and monitoring so as to edify student’s creative project competence and interesting about research original device which will be used for geotechnical engineering and its underground structure security and optimal procedure.

default.zh: 人工智能（AI）已广泛应用于土木工程，如自动化汽车、建筑和桥梁退化检测、优化设计和施工管理等。本课程将介绍尖端的人工智能算法及其在土木工程领域各方面的应用。
default.en: Artificial Intelligence (AI) has been widely applied in Civil Engineering, such as Automated Cars, Building and Bridge Deterioration Detection, Optimized Design and Construction Management, etc. This class will introduce cutting-edge AI algorithms and their application in all aspects of the civil engineering field.

default.zh: 主要讲解日本正在积极推动的混凝土二氧化碳减排放技术的最新研究成果及动向，包括自修复混凝土、减碳混凝土、3D打印混凝土、蓄电混凝土等，介绍日本国内对于AI在混凝土方面的应用技术，针对哈尔滨特有的严寒气候特色，讲解日本的寒冷地混凝土施工技术。
default.en: This course mainly introduces the latest research results and trends of concrete carbon dioxide emission reduction technology that Japan is actively promoting, including self-healing concrete, carbon reducing concrete, 3D printed concrete, electric storage concrete, etc. It also introduces the application technology of AI in concrete in Japan, and focuses on the unique cold climate characteristics of Harbin to explain Japan's cold ground concrete construction technology.

default.zh: 《AI+工程结构抗震》是计划面向土木工程专业、城市地下空间工程专业、智能建造专业本科生的一门专业方向选修课程。课程依托智能化教学平台构建知识体系，着重培养学生两方面的核心能力：一是科学认知地震灾害特征及工程抗震关键问题的专业素养，二是运用人工智能技术解决工程实际问题的创新思维。课程内容聚焦人工智能技术原理及其在工程抗震领域的创新应用，通过构建“理论学习-实践应用-科研启蒙”三位一体的教学模式，着力培育学生跨学科思维与学术探究能力。教学过程中注重以真实工程问题为牵引，引导学生在解决复杂抗震课题的过程中深化专业认知，既为后续专业学习奠定坚实基础，也为未来从事工程抗震与智能技术融合领域的工作储备关键能力，在相关专业人才培养体系中具有重要支撑作用。
default.en: The AI+Seismic Design of Buildings course is a professional elective designed for undergraduate students pursuing degrees in Civil Engineering, Urban Underground Space Engineering, and Intelligent Construction. This course utilizes an intelligent teaching platform to establish a comprehensive knowledge system, with a primary focus on developing students' core competencies in two key areas: first, professional literacy in the scientific understanding of earthquake disaster characteristics and critical issues related to engineering seismic resistance; and second, innovative thinking in the application of artificial intelligence technology to address practical engineering challenges.

default.zh: 《机器视觉智能监测》课程通过学科交叉方式将先进的机器视觉方法与土木工程领域结构健康监测的实际广泛工程需求紧密结合，采用工业相机作为结构健康监测的测量工具，使用机器视觉方法处理工业相机采集的结构变形图像，以获得结构位移或应变等变形信息的一门人工智能视觉监测课程。通过该课程培养学生运用人工智能视觉技术解决结构健康监测领域存在的远距离非接触实时监测的瓶颈问题，通过工程案例解析和试验训练来培养土木工程领域复合型高端人工智能人才，以满足土木、交通、航天、材料、机械、能源等众多领域采用非接触方式监测结构变形的迫切需求。该课程内容主要包括相机标定方法、结构面内变形视觉监测方法、结构三维变形立体视觉监测方法、结构表观缺陷三维重建评定方法、结构表面全场变形监测方法，并列举出每种视觉监测方法相应的具体工程监测案例，如桥梁挠度变形监测、风机六自由度运动监测、混凝土表观缺陷三维重建评定、山体滑坡变形全场监测、大型体育场馆结构健康监测系统设计、传感器选型及监测系统开发等案例，同时提供相机标定试验及各种视觉监测方法教学试验训练。
default.en: Intelligent Monitoring based on Machine Vision is one of the optional courses for undergraduate students whose major are Civil Engineering. On the base of University physics, undergraduate students need to further study the course of Intelligent Monitoring based on Machine Vision. Through practical teaching, undergraduate students need to familiar with the error analysis and data processing, machine vision measurement method, and grasp the basic theories and experimental skills. This lays foundation for further learning the professional research and experimental measurement for graduation thesis of students. The objective of the course is to develop that students grasp the working principles and experimental skills of intelligent monitoring based on machine vision, and measure structural deformation parameters such as stress, strain, displacement, surface flaw, etc. for satisfying the demands of non-contact measurement of structural deformations in civil engineering, transportation, aerospace, materials, etc. The main contents include: experimental data processing, image acquisition, the principles and applications of 2D and 3D structural deformation measurement method based on monocular vison, the principle and application of 3D reconstruction method of structural surface flaws and the full-field deformation monitoring method.

default.zh: 弹性力学是土木工程和工程力学的专业基础课，是在理论力学和材料力学基础上进一步学习弹性力学的基本概念、基本原理和基本方法，了解线弹性经典问题的计算方法和基本解答，分析各种结构或构件在弹性阶段的应力和位移，校核其强度和刚度，提高分析和计算能力，培养学生的逻辑思维能力，利用弹性力学方法研究和掌握分析一般结构在外力作用下的变形、内力分布与承载能力的方法，以及为进一步研究工程结构的强度、刚度稳定性等力学问题并解决实际工程或材料中的力学问题的能力，为学习有关专业课程打好初步的弹性力学基础。
default.en: Elasticity Theory is a fundamental course for students majoring in civil engineering or engineering mechanics. It is a continue course focusing on the elastic properties of materials after the study of mechanical theory and materials mechanics. The main intention of the study of elasticity theory is to promote the understanding of the concepts and formulation of elasticity problems, and analyzing results obtained from commercial tools such as ANSYS and ABAQUS. Problem solving skills and techniques related with civil engineer or materials are relegated to an adjunct role with a solid basic of elasticity theory.

default.zh: 课程共计32学时，包括24学时课题讲授，8学时实验教学。通过课堂讲授和实验教学使学生掌握建筑结构、构件的静力、动力实验的加载方法、测量方法、试验方法、数据分析方法，掌握建筑结构试验的模型相似理论、结构试验数据误差分析及解决方法，为今后从事科学实验研究工作提供必要的基础知识。 课程的主要内容包括： (1) 模型相似(6h) (2) 试验加载方法(4h) (3) 数据测量方法(6h) (4) 数据处理与误差分析(2h) (5) 静载试验方法(1h) (6) 动载试验方法(1h) (7) 结构抗震试验方法(4h) (8) 动力特性识别(4h，试验) (9) 拟动力试验(4h，试验)
default.en: In this course, basic experimental methods will be introduced 24h, and two experimental tests will be conducted with 8h in the lab. This course is intended to introduce students to static and dynamic experimental methods, loading systems, instrumentation, seismic testing method, similitude and dimensional analysis, data processing, etc. The course covers aspects of static and structural dynamics problems. The course provides an overview of laboratory work and is complemented with several “hands-on” applications in laboratory using testing and computing equipment. The students will get acquainted with the following subjects: (1) Similitude, modeling, and dimensional analysis (6h) (2) Loading systems(4h) (3) Instrumentation(6h) (4) Data quality, Errors, and Processing(2h) (5) Static testing method(1h) (6) Dynamic testing method(1h) (7) Seismic testing methods(4h) (8) Dynamic performance identification (4h，experiment) (9) Pseudo-dynamic test (4h, experiment)

default.zh: 认识实习是教学计划中的一个重要实践性教学环节，是理论联系实际，增强感性认识的必要途径。是全面贯彻教育方针，培养学生实践能力和独立工作能力的一项重要措施。本实习是土木工程学院所有学生必经的教学环节。
default.en: Cognitive practice is the link between theory and practice in the teaching plan. It is the necessary way to enhance the perceptual knowledge. It is the comprehensive implementation education policy. It is to train students' practical ability and work independently ability. The cognitive practice is a key teaching link for the students of the civil engineering.

default.zh: 针对土木工程中量大面广应用的整体式单向板肋梁楼盖，开展设计计算，将使土木工程专业本科生巩固课堂相关章节所学的内容，强化整体式单向板肋梁楼盖设计思路和方法的认识，熟悉整体式单向板肋梁楼盖结构布置及构造，学会查阅设计资料，掌握整体式单向板肋梁楼盖的规定，使其在设计计算、理解规范、提高专业绘图能力等得到有效训练，最终熟练掌握整体式肋梁楼盖的结构布置方法、设计计算和绘制结构施工图。
default.en: The design and calculation for integral one-way slab floor with ribbed beams are carried out, which are applied widely and abundantly in civil engineering. It can make undergraduates of civil engineering obtain more skills. For example, the contents of the relevant sections in class are consolidated; the understanding of design ideas and methods for integral one-way slab floor with ribbed beams is strengthened; the layout and construction of integral one-way slab floor with ribbed beams are more familiar; the method of consulting the design data is studied; and the specifications of the integral one-way slab floor with ribbed beams are mastered. Besides, undergraduates can obtain effective trainings on studying the design and calculation, understanding the specifications and enhancing the ability of professional drawing. Finally, some skills for undergraduates are mastered expertly, including the structural layout method, design and calculation and the ability of drawing structure construction drawings for integral one-way slab floor with ribbed beams.

default.zh: 《基础工程B课程设计》是土木工程专业的一门必修专业课。基础工程课程设计是学生在完成教学计划规定的课程学习后，所进行的一个重要的实践教学球节，是继课堂教学、实验教学等环节之后的一个综合性较强的教学阶段。通过课程设计使学生受到设计方法的初步训统。本课程教学目的是培养学生的设计能力，经过本课程的学习，要求学生能够掌握大、中型建筑物的地基基础设计方法。 本课程的特点是理论密切联系工程实践，能够培养学生的逻辑思维能力，并且能够灵活地利用本课程的内容去分析工程实际问题，提高学生综合运用所学知识解决复杂工程问题的能力。 本课程充分利用模型、实物、多媒体软件，增强学生感性分析，以培养学生空间形象思维能力、工程实践应用能力和创新能力。
default.en: The design of foundation engineering B is a compulsory course in civil engineering. The design of the basic engineering course is an important practice teaching ball festival, which is a comprehensive and strong teaching stage after the teaching of classroom teaching and experimental teaching. Through the course design, the students are subject to the preliminary training of the design method. The purpose of this course is to develop the students' design ability, which requires students to master the foundation of large and medium-sized buildings. The characteristics of this course are the practice of close contact engineering of theory, can cultivate students' logical thinking ability, and can use the content of this course to analyze the practical problems of the project, and improve the ability of students to solve complex engineering problems. This course should make full use of models, physical, multimedia software, enhance student perceptual analysis, and cultivate students' spatial image thinking ability, engineering practice application ability and innovation ability.

default.zh: 《基础工程B课程设计与电算分析》是土木工程专业土木菁华班本科生的一门必修专业课。本课程教学目的是培养学生的设计能力，经过本课程的学习，要求学生能够掌握大、中型建筑物的地基基础设计方法及相应的设计内容，能够了解一种基础结构设计的电算软件或掌握一种数值分析方法。
default.en: “Foundation Engineering B Course Design and Computer Analysis " is a compulsory professional course for the students majoring in Civil Engineering (Civil Engineering Elite Class). The purpose of this course is to cultivate students' design ability. After the study of this course, students are required to master the foundation design method and design content of large and medium-sized buildings. Furthermore, the students should be proficient in commonly used designing software or a numerical analysis method.

default.zh: 《地下空间规划与建筑课程设计》是土木工程专业的一门必修专业课。本课程的先修课程为工程制图与识图、城市地下空间概论、土力学和地下工程施工技术等。学生通过本课程的学习，掌握或熟悉地下空间规划与设计的基本内容和设计方法，如城市地下空间规划理论、规划编制内容和编制程序，城市地下空间资源评估、需求预测，城市地下空间总体布局与形态，城市地下交通规划、公共服务空间规划、市政设施规划、物流系统规划，城市居住区地下空间规划，历史文化保护下的地下空间开发，城市地下空间综合防灾等。全面熟悉和了解地下工程基本知识，充分认识地下工程是国家的重要社会资源，是我国重点开发的土木工程领域，为进一步的专业实习打下扎实基础。 课堂讲授通过启发式教学、讨论式教学等教学方法和手段培养学生对城市地下空间规划与设计的了解，丰富学生的专业视野，对于目前城市地下空间规划与设计的发展具有一定程度的掌握，提高其应用基本概念和理论，提高分析问题和解决问题的能力，同时对我国目前城市地下空间规划与设计领域所取得成绩有一定了解，增加学生的爱国情操和专业精神。本课程会适当地安排一些课下调研和小组作业,使学生能够亲身体验城市地下空间规划与设计的现状和发展，培养学生发现问题和解决问题的能力、实际动手能力、团队合作能力、获取和处理信息的能力，激发学生的创新思维。
default.en: “Course Design of Underground Space Planning and Architecture Designing” is a compulsory course for civil engineering. The prerequisites for this course are engineering drawing and mapping, introduction to urban underground space, soil mechanics and underground engineering construction technology. Through the study of this course, students can master or be familiar with the basic content and design methods of underground space planning and design, such as urban underground space planning theory, planning content and preparation procedures, urban underground space resource assessment, demand forecasting, urban underground space overall layout and form, urban underground transportation planning, public service space planning, municipal facilities planning, logistics system planning, urban residential area underground space planning, underground space development under historical and cultural protection, urban underground space comprehensive disaster prevention, etc. Comprehensively familiar with and understand the basic knowledge of underground engineering, fully understand that underground engineering is an important social resource of the country, and is a key development of civil engineering fields in China, laying a solid foundation for further professional internship. Through heuristic teaching, discussion teaching and other teaching methods and means, classroom teaching cultivates students' understanding of urban underground space planning and design, enriches students' professional vision, has a certain degree of mastery of the current development of urban underground space planning and design, improves its application of basic concepts and theories, improves the ability to analyze and solve problems, and at the same time has a certain understanding of the achievements in the field of urban underground space planning and design in China, and increases students' patriotism and professionalism. This course will arrange some after-class research and group assignments appropriately, so that students can experience the current situation and development of urban underground space planning and design, cultivate students' ability to find and solve problems, practical ability, teamwork ability, ability to obtain and process information, and stimulate students' innovative thinking.

default.zh: 工程经济学课程设计是工程经济学课程的配套实践环节及课程教学内容的深化环节。通过课程设计使学生进一步掌握投资项目可行性研究的阶段和内容，市场分析与预测方法、可行性研究报告的编制步骤、格式与内容。从而提高学生应用工程经济的基本原理和基本方法，对复杂投资项目的科学决策能力和应用信息技术解决问题的实际操作能力和综合应用能力。课程的基本教学目标如下：理解基础经济要素的概念，掌握销售收入、成本、税金及利润之间的关系，现金流量的估算及现金流量图的画法；理解经济效益评价指标体系中各项指标的基本概念及含义。掌握两个以上技术方案经济效益比较方法、熟练应用资金的时间价值换算关系公式；掌握财务评价报表的编制和评价指标的计算，不确定分析和方案比选与优化方法；熟练应用软件对工程项目方案的经济性进行分析，建立各种工程经济定量评价模型和经济指标的计算模型，实现数据的自动处理，建立直观的计算机分析图形，提高学生借助信息技术分析和解决问题的能力；通过对工程项目的经济分析，培养学生对工程方案/项目进行可行性研究的综合应用能力。
default.en: The Course Exercise of Engineering Economy A is a supporting practical part of the engineering economics course and a deepening of the course teaching content. Through course design, students will further master the stages and content of investment project feasibility study, market analysis and prediction methods, and the preparation steps, format, and content of feasibility study reports. Improve students' ability to apply the basic principles and methods of engineering economy, make scientific decisions on complex investment projects, and apply information technology to solve practical problems. The basic teaching objectives of the course are as follows: to understand the concepts of basic economic factors, master the relationship between sales revenue, costs, taxes, and profits, estimate cash flow, and draw cash flow charts; Understand the basic concepts and meanings of various indicators in the economic benefit evaluation index system. Master the method of comparing the economic benefits of two or more technical solutions, and proficiently apply the time value conversion formula of funds; Master the preparation of financial evaluation reports and the calculation of evaluation indicators, uncertainty analysis, scheme comparison and optimization methods; Proficient in applying software to analyze the economy of engineering project plans, establish various quantitative evaluation models for engineering economy and calculation models for economic indicators, achieve automatic data processing, establish intuitive computer analysis graphics, and improve students' ability to analyze and solve problems using information technology; Through economic analysis of engineering projects, cultivate students' comprehensive application ability to conduct feasibility studies on engineering solutions/projects.

default.zh: 认识实习是土木工程专业实践教学的关键环节之一，通过参观和现场教学，使学生在学习专业课之前对本专业的学习内容和工程范围有一定的感性认识和初步了解，激发学生学习专业课的兴趣，增强学生学习的主观能动性，使学生在专业课学习时不断联系认识实习，为专业知识的学习奠定基础，认识实习可使学生初步了解本专业的学习内容，专业范围，了解本专业的现状和发展前景，认识实习为培养专业型人才起着重要作用。
default.en: Cognition practice is one of the key links in the practical teaching of civil engineering major. Through visits and on-site teaching, students can have a certain perceptual knowledge and preliminary understanding of the learning content and engineering scope of the major before learning professional courses, stimulate students' interest in learning professional courses, enhance students' subjective initiative in learning, and enable students to constantly contact cognition practice when learning professional courses, so as to lay the foundation for the study of professional knowledge. Cognition practice can enable students to initially understand the learning content and scope of the major, understand the current situation and development prospects of the major, and realize that practice plays an important role in cultivating professional talents.

default.zh: 掌握各种基础类型及基础设计的原则；了解基坑工程设计与施工；了解地下工程监测与检测技术。技能层面：能够计算地基承载力并进行基础选型；能够设计天然地基上浅基础；能够进行桩基础设计；初步掌握基坑工程设计与施工。态度层面：在学习知识和实践训练中发展智力、培养能力、掌握技能，重在工程应用；培养良好的情操，科学的工程意识。努力参与各种科学实践、工程实践和社会实践活动。
default.en: Master various foundation types and principles of foundation design; understand foundation pit engineering design and construction; understand underground engineering monitoring and detection technology. Skill level: able to calculate the bearing capacity of the foundation and select the foundation; be able to design shallow foundations on natural foundations; be able to design pile foundations; have a preliminary grasp of the design and construction of foundation pit engineering. Attitude level: developing intelligence, cultivating abilities, and mastering skills in learning knowledge and practical training, focusing on engineering applications; cultivating good sentiment and scientific engineering awareness. Efforts to participate in various scientific practice, engineering practice and social practice activities.

default.en: Surveying practice is an internship course for civil engineering majors. By studying this course, students can master the basic structure and operation of measuring instruments. Mainly including leveling measurement, angle measurement, topographic mapping and other contents. Through internships, students will acquire the ability to conduct large-scale topographic mapping and surveying.

default.zh: 房屋建筑学课程设计，是配合房屋建筑学同步开设的设计类课程。是哈尔滨工业大 学土木工程学院为本科留学生开设的一门实践性较强的综合技术科学，通过本课程，培 养学生建筑构造设计，建筑方案设计与绘图的能力。具体目标如下： 1． 培养学生逐渐地，从合理选择标准构造图集中的节点，到独立完成具有方案特 征的，如节能建筑，绿色建筑的构造节点设计及整体构造方案构建能力。 2． 培养学生举一反三，自主学习的能力，从而使学生在未来职业生涯中，面对日 益出现的新材料，新技术，做到迅速的掌握新型构造做法。
default.en: The Design of Building Architecture course is a design-focused curriculum component offered in parallel with the course of Building Architecture, which is a comprehensive technical curriculum offered by the School of Civil Engineering at the Harbin Institute of Technology for international students. The course is designed to cultivate students' competencies in architectural structural design, schematic architectural planning, and technical drawing proficiency. The specific pedagogical objectives are delineated as follows: 1. To cultivate students' ability to progressively transition from appropriately selecting nodal details in standard construction atlases to independently developing structural node designs and holistic construction schemes with programmatic characteristics, such as those for energy-efficient buildings and green architecture. 2. To foster students' capacity to generalize knowledge through self-directed learning, enabling them to rapidly master emerging construction methodologies in response to novel materials and technologies encountered in future professional practice.

default.zh: 本课程面向大学一年级学生开设，培养学生的科学与工程思维--计算思维，促进学生的计算思维与各专业思维交叉融合形成复合型思维，为各专业学生今后设计、构造和应用各种计算系统求解学科问题奠定思维基础，帮助学习者提高解读真实世界系统并解决全球范围复杂问题的能力。 本课程以“机器自动计算==>机器难于计算==>计算与社会/自然的融合”为脉络，引导学生建立“计算机世界观”，理解社会/自然问题利用计算手段进行求解的基本思维模式；理解高级语言/机器语言程序是如何被执行的,了解复杂系统化复杂为简单的基本思维；理解由问题、到算法、再到程序的问题求解思维模式，了解问题、算法与计算系统(资源和环境)之间的关系，了解难解性问题求解的基本思路；理解数据管理的手段(数据库与数据挖掘)，理解数据库和大数据的社会影响。理解机器网络、信息网络和网络化社会的形成机理，理解网络化的社会影响。
default.en: This course is an introductory technical one for all freshmen of university. Students will learn computational thinking which can lay a foundation for the further study to design, to construct and to apply computer systems or software systems or computer-based systems,and also which can help students to understand complicated systems in real worlds,such as social/natural network system based on Internet. This version of the course is suitable for the majors which are weakly related to computer techniques. The main contents of this course are as following: (1) Understand basic computational thinking and know how to build a simple computing system based on computational thinking; (2) Understand how program is compiled level by level and finally executed on hardware, and how complex system is built on simple component; (3)Understand problem solving procedure,i.e.problem analysis, algorithm design,and programming, relations among problem, algorithm and computing system, and know how to solve (hard) problem by constructing algorithm and executing algorithm; (4) Understand computational thinking about data management and data mining. Understand the relationship between data and social/natural problems; (5) Understand computational thinking about machine network(Computer network),information networks, and social/natural network based on internet. Understand the relationship between Internet and social/natural problems.

default.zh: 自动化、网络化、智能化是各学科未来发展的重要方向之一，面向各学科的计算系统或计算工具的开发与应用也成为各学科未来创新的关键领域，计算手段已发展为与理论手段和实验手段并存的科学研究的第三种手段，计算思维（含计算+、互联网+、大数据+和人工智能+）已成为各专业学生都应掌握的思维方式。本课程面向大学一年级学生开设，培养学生的科学与工程思维--计算思维（含计算+、互联网+、大数据+和人工智能+）以及必要的信息技术基础，促进学生计算思维与各专业思维交叉融合形成复合型思维，为各专业学生今后设计、构造和应用各种计算系统求解学科问题奠定思维基础，培养数据获取、分析和处理能力，帮助学习者提高解读真实世界系统并解决全球范围复杂问题的能力。
default.en: Automation, networking and intelligence are one of the important directions for the future development of all disciplines. The development and application of computing systems or computing tools for all disciplines has also become a key field for future innovation of all disciplines. Computing means have developed into the third means of scientific research coexisting with theoretical means and experimental means, computational thinking (including computing+, Internet plus, big data+and artificial intelligence+) It has become a way of thinking that students of all majors should master. This course is open to freshmen in college, to cultivate their scientific and engineering thinking -- computational thinking (including computing+, Internet plus, big data+and artificial intelligence+) and necessary information technology foundation, promote the cross integration of students' computational thinking and professional thinking to form a composite thinking, lay a thinking foundation for students of all majors to design, construct and apply various computing systems to solve disciplinary problems in the future, and cultivate data acquisition Analysis and processing abilities help learners improve their ability to interpret real-world systems and solve complex global problems.

default.zh: 《程序设计思维与实践》是我校优秀本科生培养框架下的入门级课程，是面向未来技术学院培养多工科专业领域拔尖生专门开设的计算机专业素养课和软件设计基础课，旨在帮助学生奠定坚实的计算机技术基础，积累程序设计实践经验，拓展学生运用计算机进行问题求解与工程应用的能力。 课程以学生掌握C语言语法和编程技术为基本要求，以在待求解问题域中建立数据思维、计算思维为培养目标；教学内容主要涵盖计算机基础、程序设计语言、面向任务的数据抽象与操作等内容，教学环节既包含为熟练驾驭计算机进行问题求解必备的程序设计思想、数据操作算法化及代码化等思维训练，设置了编程训练和实践环节。
default.en: Paradigm and Practice in Programing is an entry-level course under the framework of cultivating excellent undergraduate students in HIT. It is a computer literacy course and software design foundation course specifically designed for School of Future Technical, HIT, to cultivate students in engineering fields and majors. The aim is to help students lay a solid foundation in computer technology, accumulate practical experience in programming, and expand their ability to use computers for problem solving and engineering applications. The basic requirement of the course is to learn C language grammar and programming techniques, thereby, establish data thinking and computational thinking in the problem domain to be solved. Based on which, programming and practical training of data operations necessary for proficient computer problem-solving are designed as the key segment for students' ability promotion.

default.en: Automation, networking, and intelligence are important directions for the future development of various disciplines. The development and application of intelligent computing tools or systems for various disciplines have also become key areas for innovation in the future. Computational methods have developed into the third means of scientific research that coexist with theoretical and experimental methods. Computational thinking and artificial intelligence thinking have become ways of thinking that students in various majors should master. This course adopts an all English teaching method and is open to all undergraduate students. It cultivates students' scientific and engineering thinking - computing and intelligent thinking (including computing+, Internet plus, big data and artificial intelligence+), promotes students' computing thinking, artificial intelligence thinking and professional thinking to form a composite thinking, and lays a thinking foundation for students of all majors to design, construct and apply various computing and intelligent systems to solve disciplinary problems in the future.

default.zh: 自动化、网络化、智能化是各学科未来发展的重要方向之一，面向各学科的智能计算工具或系统的开发与应用也成为各学科未来创新的关键领域，计算手段已发展为与理论手段和实验手段并存的科学研究的第三种手段，计算思维与人工智能思维已成为各专业学生都应掌握的思维方式。本课程面向大学一年级学生开设，培养学生的科学与工程思维--计算与智能思维（含计算+、互联网+、大数据和人工智能+），促进学生计算思维、人工智能思维与各专业思维交叉融合形成复合型思维，为各专业学生今后设计、构造和应用各种计算与智能系统求解学科问题奠定思维基础。
default.en: Automation, networking, and intelligence are among the key future directions for various disciplines. The development and application of intelligent computing tools or systems tailored to different fields have also become crucial areas for future innovation. Computational methods have emerged as the third pillar of scientific research, alongside theoretical and experimental approaches. Computational thinking and AI thinking are now essential mindsets that students across all disciplines should master. This course is designed for first-year university students, aiming to cultivate their scientific and engineering thinking—computational and intelligent thinking (including computing+, internet+, big data, and AI+). It encourages the integration of computational thinking and AI thinking with discipline-specific thinking to form a composite mindset. This foundation will enable students to design, construct, and apply various computing and intelligent systems to solve disciplinary problems in their future studies and careers.

default.zh: 在智能化浪潮席卷全球的今天，人工智能已成为推动社会变革的核心力量。本课程专为大学一年级学生设计，旨在帮助学生建立对人工智能领域的基础认知。课程将用通俗易懂的方式介绍人工智能的基本概念、发展历程和典型应用。通过丰富的案例教学，学生将了解人工智能技术对社会各领域的影响，培养基本的计算思维和跨学科视野，为未来学术深造或职业发展奠定基础。课程注重学科交叉融合，引导学生探索人工智能与各领域的结合点，培养应对智能化挑战的综合素养，助力成为人工智能时代的领跑者。
default.en: In the context of global digital transformation, artificial intelligence (AI) has emerged as a fundamental driver of societal change. This course is designed for first-year undergraduate students to develop foundational knowledge in the field of artificial intelligence. The curriculum systematically presents the fundamental concepts, historical evolution, and practical applications of AI through clear and structured instructional methods. The course employs abundant case studies to demonstrate AI's impact across various sectors of society. Through this approach, students will acquire basic computational thinking skills and interdisciplinary understanding, establishing a solid basis for future academic pursuits or career development. The program emphasizes cross-disciplinary integration, enabling students to examine the intersection of AI with other academic disciplines. By cultivating comprehensive competencies to address intelligentization challenges, the course aims to empower students to become frontrunners in the AI era.

default.zh: 《高级语言程序设计》是计算机和电信大类/软件工程大类的一门重要的专业基础课程。设置本课程的主要目的是使学生掌握用计算机分析和解决问题的思维方法以及程序设计的基本方法，建立从问题到算法再到程序的认知，在从问题到算法再到程序的问题求解及程序构造和实现的过程中理解高级语言的基本构造要素以及算法和数据结构在程序构造中的作用，具备良好的编程素养，以及综合运用所学程序设计语言和程序设计方法，设计、构造和应用计算系统求解科学或工程问题的程序设计和实现能力，为后继课程的学习和将来从事软件开发、解决复杂工程问题奠定编程能力基础。课程具体目标如下： 课程目标1：掌握程序设计的方法学基础，培养学生阅读程序、编写程序和调试程序的能力，使学生能够选择与熟练运用现代化集成开发工具编写、测试和调试程序，了解鲲鹏体系和鲲鹏计算平台应用开发的流程，鲲鹏计算平台和X86平台的差异，以及针对编译型语言（C语言）掌握鲲鹏计算平台和X86平台代码编写及编译的差异，具备良好的编程素养、职业道德以及自主学习和终身学习能力。 课程目标2：掌握程序设计所需的问题求解基础，培养学生从问题抽象为数学模型或算法再转化为计算机可实现的程序的能力，使学生针对计算、统计、分类等相关的实际问题，能够有效使用程序设计语言和结构化程序设计方法，并恰当使用枚举、递推、分治或递归等常用问题求解方法，完成经典问题求解程序的设计与实现。 课程目标3：掌握程序设计所需的算法和数据结构基础，培养学生利用算法和数据结构构造程序的能力，使学生针对科学计算/文本处理/人工智能相关的复杂工程问题，能够使用恰当的算法和数据结构以及模块化程序设计方法，完成涉及排序、检索、匹配等算法的实际生活问题或与专业背景相关的工程实际问题的程序设计与实现。
default.en: 《High-level Language Programming》is an important basic course for Computer and Telecommunications/Software Engineering specialty. The main purpose of this course is to enable students to master a thinking mode of computer analysis and problem solving methods, and basic programming technology, so as to build knowledge from problems to algorithms to programs, understanding the basic construction elements of high-level languages and the role of algorithms and data structures in program construction, in the process of problems to algorithms, to problem solving and program construction and Implementation. Using programming language and programming methods comprehensively, the students can get professional programming capabilities, as well as capabilities of designing, construction and application of computing systems to solve scientific or engineering problems in program design and implementation. Therefore, this course lays a good foundation of programming skills for the subsequent courses. Also for their future work in solving complex engineering problems or software development. The specific objectives of the course are as follows: Curriculum objective 1: Understand the methodological foundations of programming and the fundamentals of problem solving; cultivate students' ability to read, write, and debug programs; choose the proper integrated development environment for the specific project and grasp the methods of editing, compiling, linking, running, and debugging programs in a common integrated development environment; master basic capabilities for debugging and testing programs using integrated development environments. Understand the Kunpeng architecture and application development process on Kunpeng computing platform, the differences between Kunpeng computing platform and X86 platform, as well as the differences in code writing and compilation for compiled language (C language) between Kunpeng computing platform and X86 platform. The students can get good programming literacy, professional ethics, and self-learning ability from this course. Curriculum objective 2: Master the fundamentals of problem solving in programming design. Cultivate students' ability to abstract problems into mathematical models or algorithms and then transform them into programs that can be implemented by computers, so that students can effectively use programming languages and structured programming methods for practical problems related to calculation, statistics, classification, etc., and properly use the common strategies of problem solving such as enumeration, iteration, divide and conquer, or recursion to complete the design and implementation of classic problem solving programs. Curriculum objective 3: Mastering the foundation of algorithms and data structures required for program design, cultivating students' ability to construct programs using algorithms and data structures, enabling them to use appropriate algorithms and data structures, as well as modular programming methods, for complex engineering problems related to scientific computing, text processing, and artificial intelligence Programming and implementation of real-life problems such as matching algorithms or engineering practical problems related to professional backgrounds.

default.zh: 《高级语言程序设计》是计算机专业的一门重要的计算机类专业基础课程。设置本课程的主要目的是使学生掌握用计算机分析和解决问题的思维方法以及程序设计的基本方法，建立从问题到算法再到程序的认知，在从问题到算法再到程序的问题求解及程序构造和实现的过程中理解高级语言的基本构造要素以及算法和数据结构在程序构造中的作用，具备良好的编程素养，以及综合运用所学程序设计语言和程序设计方法，设计、构造和应用计算系统求解科学或工程问题的程序设计和实现能力，为后继课程的学习和将来从事软件开发、解决复杂工程问题奠定编程能力基础。
default.en: “High-level Language Programming”is an important foundational course for computer science majors. The primary objective of this course is to equip students with the computational thinking and fundamental programming methodologies for analyzing and solving problems, establishing a cognitive framework from problem to algorithm to program. Throughout the process of problem-solving, program construction, and implementation, students will understand the basic structural elements of high-level programming languages, as well as the role of algorithms and data structures in program design. The course aims to cultivate strong programming literacy and the ability to comprehensively apply programming languages and methodologies to design, construct, and implement computational systems for solving scientific or engineering problems. This foundation will prepare students for subsequent courses and future careers in software development, enabling them to tackle complex engineering challenges with strong programming competence.

default.zh: 《集合论与图论》是计算机与电子通信大类专业的一门专业基础课程。本课程为后继的专业基础课及专业课提供必要的数学工具，为描述离散模型提供数学语言。该课程的设置主要是为了培养学生的抽象思维和逻辑推理能力，提高学生提出问题、分析问题和解决问题的能力，提高学生的数学修养及计算机科学素质。 要想用计算机解决问题就要为它建立数学模型，即描述研究对象及对象与对象之间的联系，并通过事物之间的联系找出事物的运动规律。集合论与图论为此提供了强有力的描述工具与推理理论。 本课程的目标是通过理论学习，使学生正确地理解概念，正确地使用概念进行推理，养成一个好的思维习惯，理解理论与实践的关系。引导学生观察生活、社会和大自然，分析事物间的联系，建立系统的模型，提出和解决其中的复杂工程问题。 本课程主要包含二部分内容：集合论与图论。集合论是整个数学的基础，也是计算机科学的基础，计算机科学领域中的大多数基本概念和理论，几乎均采用集合论的有关术语来描述和论证，而图论的基本知识则将始终陪伴着每一个计算机工作者的职业生涯。 计算学科以抽象、理论、设计为其学科形态，以数学方法和系统方法为其学科方法，本课程的核心目标就是在抽象和理论的基础上提供数学方法，因此，本课程是整个专业的基础课程，是计算机专业最重要的课程之一。
default.en: "Set Theory and Graph Theory" is a basic course of computer and electronic communication specialty. This course provides the necessary mathematical tools for subsequent professional basic courses and specialized courses, and provides mathematical language for describing discrete models. The curriculum is set to cultivate students' abstract thinking and logical reasoning ability, improve students' ability to propose problems, analyze problems and solve problems, and improve students' mathematical accomplishment and computer science quality. In order to solve the problem with computer, it is necessary to establish a mathematical model for it, that is, to describe the objects studied and the relationships among them, and to find out the law of motion through the connections among them. Set theory and graph theory provide powerful descriptive tools and reasoning theory for this purpose. The aim of this course is to make students understand the concept correctly, use the concept to reasoning correctly, develop a good habit of thinking, and understand the relationship between theory and practice through theoretical study. Guide students to observe life, society and nature, analyze the relationship between things, establish a model of the system, and propose and solve complex engineering problems. This course consists of two parts: set theory and graph theory. Set theory is the foundation of mathematics, but also the basis of computer science. Terms of set theory can describe most all of the basic concepts and theories in the field of computer science. The basic knowledge of graph theory will always accompany every computer worker’ occupation career. The form of computational discipline contains abstraction, theory and design, while the discipline methods consists of mathematical method and system method, the core goal of this course is to provide mathematical method, based on the abstraction and theory and therefore, this course is a basic course of the specialty, is one of the most important courses in computer science.

default.zh: 《离散数学》是未来技术学院人工智能模块的一门专业基础课程。本课程为后继的专业基础课及专业课提供必要的数学工具，为描述离散模型提供数学语言，为形式化的数学推理提供一套符号系统、推理理论与证明技术。该课程的设置主要是为了培养学生的抽象思维和逻辑推理能力，提高学生提出问题、分析问题和解决问题的能力，提高学生的数学修养及计算机科学素质。 要想用计算机解决问题就要为它建立数学模型，即描述研究对象及对象与对象之间的联系，并通过事物之间的联系找出事物的运动规律。离散数学为此提供了强有力的描述工具与推理理论。 本课程的目标是通过理论学习，使学生正确地理解概念，正确地使用概念进行推理，养成一个好的思维习惯，理解理论与实践的关系。引导学生观察生活、社会和大自然，分析事物间的联系，建立系统的模型，提出和解决其中的复杂工程问题。 本课程主要包含四部分内容：集合论、数理逻辑、图论与代数系统。集合论是整个数学的基础，也是计算机科学的基础，计算机科学领域中的大多数基本概念和理论，几乎均采用集合论的有关术语来描述和论证，而图论的基本知识则将始终陪伴着每一个计算机工作者的职业生涯。数理逻辑是用数学方法研究推理的形式结构和推理规律的学科，在电子线路、机器证明、自动化系统、编译理论、算法设计方法、自动程序设计、CAD方面有着广泛的应用。代数系统用于培养数学思维，侧重于将现有的知识系统化、形式化和抽象化，对于抽象数据类型、形式语义的研究很有用处，可以作为程序语言设计、编译器设计、计算机网络设计等的表示工具。 计算学科以抽象、理论、设计为其学科形态，以数学方法和系统方法为其学科方法，本课程的核心目标就是在抽象和理论的基础上提供数学方法，因此，本课程是整个专业的基础课程，是计算机相关专业最重要的课程之一。
default.en: "Discrete Mathematics" is a professional foundational course in the artificial intelligence module of the Future Institute of Technology. This course provides the necessary mathematical tools for subsequent professional basic courses and specialized courses, provides mathematical language for describing discrete models, and provides a symbol system, reasoning theory, and proof technology for formal mathematical reasoning. The curriculum is set to cultivate students' abstract thinking and logical reasoning ability, improve students' ability to propose problems, analyze problems and solve problems, and improve students' mathematical accomplishment and computer science quality. In order to solve the problem with computer, it is necessary to establish a mathematical model for it, that is, to describe the objects studied and the relationships among them, and to find out the law of motion through the connections among them. Discrete Mathematics provide powerful descriptive tools and reasoning theory for this purpose. The aim of this course is to make students understand the concept correctly, use the concept to reasoning correctly, develop a good habit of thinking, and understand the relationship between theory and practice through theoretical study. Guide students to observe life, society and nature, analyze the relationship between things, establish a model of the system, and propose and solve complex engineering problems. This course consists of four parts: set theory, mathematical logic, graph theory, and algebraic system. Set theory is the foundation of mathematics, but also the basis of computer science. Terms of set theory can describe most all of the basic concepts and theories in the field of computer science. The basic knowledge of graph theory will always accompany every computer worker’ occupation career. Mathematical logic is a discipline that uses mathematical methods to study the formal structure and rules of reasoning. It has extensive applications in electronic circuits, machine proof, automation systems, compilation theory, algorithm design methods, automatic programming, and CAD. Algebraic systems are used to cultivate mathematical thinking, with a focus on systematizing, formalizing, and abstracting existing knowledge. They are very useful for the study of abstract data types and formal semantics, and can be used as representation tools for programming language design, compiler design, computer network design, and more. The form of computational discipline contains abstraction, theory and design, while the discipline methods consists of mathematical method and system method, the core goal of this course is to provide mathematical method, based on the abstraction and theory and therefore, this course is a basic course of the specialty, is one of the most important courses for computer related majors.

default.en: "Discrete Mathematics" is a fundamental course in mathematics, physics, and natural sciences for undergraduate international students. This course provides the necessary mathematical tools for subsequent professional basic courses and specialized courses, provides mathematical language for describing discrete models, and provides a symbol system, reasoning theory, and proof technology for formal mathematical reasoning. The curriculum is set to cultivate students' abstract thinking and logical reasoning ability, improve students' ability to propose problems, analyze problems and solve problems, and improve students' mathematical accomplishment and computer science quality. In order to solve the problem with computer, it is necessary to establish a mathematical model for it, that is, to describe the objects studied and the relationships among them, and to find out the law of motion through the connections among them. Discrete Mathematics provide powerful descriptive tools and reasoning theory for this purpose. The aim of this course is to make students understand the concept correctly, use the concept to reasoning correctly, develop a good habit of thinking, and understand the relationship between theory and practice through theoretical study. Guide students to observe life, society and nature, analyze the relationship between things, establish a model of the system, and propose and solve complex engineering problems. default.zh: 《计算机与电子通信集群专业导论》是计算机与电子通信集群专业的大类基础课。课程对集群内的专业进行全面介绍，包括专业的研究内容与发展方向、哈工大本专业的特色与优势、专业人才培养方案和课程体系、毕业生去向、知名校友等，在企业中的职业规划与发展及其成长路径，在科研机构如何进行科学研究以及未来的学术发展，从而为学生进行专业选择提供基础信息和指导。
default.en: "Major Introduction to Computer and Electronic Communication Cluster" is a major basic course of computer and electronic communication cluster. The course provides a comprehensive introduction to the majors in the cluster, including the research content and development direction of the major, the characteristics and advantages of HIT's major, the training program and curriculum system for professional talents, the destination of graduates, well-known alumni, etc., the career planning and development and growth path in enterprises, how to conduct scientific research in scientific research institutions and the future academic development. It provides basic information and guidance for students to choose their major.

default.zh: 本课程面向大学一年级学生开设，期望通过项目实践和项目研讨的方式，强化学生程序实现和系统实现能力的培养，通过程序实现，深刻理解科学与工程应用涉及的计算与智能思维，为学生今后设计、构造和应用各种计算与智能系统求解学科问题奠定程序设计和系统实现的基础。具体目标为： 课程目标1：熟悉一种编程语言（例如C或C++）及其集成开发环境和智能辅助编程工具。 课程目标2：能够独立用编程语言设计和实现具有一定复杂度的系统或项目，通过项目实践体验项目中涉及的数据表示与存储、基本算法实现、用户界面及其人机交互等，进而形成用模块化程序设计方法实现目标系统的能力，以及借助大模型智能编程工具优化程序的能力。
default.en: This course is designed for first？year university students. Through project practice and project seminars, it aims to strengthen students’ ability in program implementation and system development. By writing and implementing programs, students will gain a deep understanding of the computational and intelligent thinking involved in scientific and engineering applications, laying a solid foundation in programming and system development for their future work in designing, constructing, and applying various computational and intelligent systems to solve disciplinary problems. The specific objectives are as follows: Course Objective 1: Be familiar with a programming language (such as C or C++), its integrated development environment, and intelligent programming assistant tools. Course Objective 2: Be able to independently design and implement moderately complex systems or projects using a programming language. Through project practice, experience data representation and storage, basic algorithm implementation, user interface and human？computer interaction, etc. Further develop the ability to implement target systems using modular programming methods, as well as the ability to optimize programs with the help of large？model？based intelligent programming tools.

default.zh: 各学科智能计算工具的开发与应用已成为各学科未来创新的关键领域，这类工具的开发不仅需要各学科的核心课程知识，更需要程序实现能力。本课程面向大学一年级学生开设，期望通过项目实践和项目研讨的方式，强化学生程序实现能力的培养，进而通过程序实现，深刻理解科学与工程思维--计算与智能思维，促进学生计算思维、人工智能思维与各专业思维交叉融合，为各专业学生今后设计、构造和应用各种计算与智能系统求解学科问题奠定程序实现基础。
default.en: The development and application of intelligent computing tools across various disciplines have become a critical domain for future innovation. Creating such tools requires not only core disciplinary knowledge but also programming implementation capabilities. This course, designed for first-year university students, aims to enhance students' programming skills through project-based practice and seminars. By engaging in hands-on implementation, students will deepen their understanding of scientific and engineering thinking—specifically, computational and intelligent thinking. The course further promotes the integration of computational thinking, AI thinking, and discipline-specific thinking, laying a foundation in programming implementation for students across majors to design, construct, and apply computing and intelligent systems in solving disciplinary problems in the future.

default.zh: 人工智能导论课程为大学生提供了系统了解人工智能相关技术及其前沿动态的窗口，对其学术发展和职业规划具有重要意义。特别是在当前人工智能技术飞速发展的背景下，以DeepSeek为代表的大模型技术取得了突破性进展，进一步凸显了本课程的价值。课程面向大学一年级学生开设，使学生能够全面了解人工智能的基本概念、发展历程、核心原理及最新技术趋势，培养计算思维、创新能力和跨学科融合意识。同时，由于人工智能技术涉及到多个学科领域，学生也将在课程中拓展跨学科知识，促进学科交叉融合与合作。此外，面对未来社会面临的挑战，如人工智能的广泛应用和影响，学生通过学习人工智能概论课程可以更好地应对，并为未来的职业发展做好准备。
default.en: The Introduction to Artificial Intelligence course provides a systematic window for college students to understand artificial intelligence related technologies and their cutting-edge dynamics, which is of great significance for their academic development and career planning. Especially in the context of the rapid development of artificial intelligence technology, breakthrough progress has been made in large model technology represented by DeepSeek, further highlighting the value of this course. The course is aimed at first-year college students, enabling them to comprehensively understand the basic concepts, development process, core principles, and latest technological trends of artificial intelligence, and cultivate computational thinking, innovation ability, and interdisciplinary integration awareness. Meanwhile, as artificial intelligence technology involves multiple disciplinary fields, students will also expand their interdisciplinary knowledge in the course, promoting interdisciplinary integration and cooperation. In addition, in the face of the challenges faced by future society, such as the widespread application and impact of artificial intelligence, students can better cope with them and prepare for their future career development by studying the course of Introduction to Artificial Intelligence.

default.zh: 本课程是面向人工智能专业本科生的计算机基础核心课程，以Python语言为载体，系统构建学生的程序设计知识体系。课程内容聚焦三大核心目标：首先夯实理论基础，通过深入解析程序设计的基本原理与Python语言的核心语法（包括数据类型、流程控制、函数模块等），帮助学生建立结构化的知识框架；其次强化实践能力，重点训练学生运用Python实现线性表、栈队列、树图等基础数据结构的存储方案及增删改查等核心算法，并熟练调用主流扩展库进行数据处理与可视化分析；同时注重工具应用，指导学生掌握Visual Studio Code、Jupyter Notebook等开发环境的配置与调试技巧。课程创新性地融合数据思维与计算思维培养，通过"问题抽象-算法设计-代码实现-优化验证"的递进式训练，同步提升面向过程的模块化编程能力和面向对象的系统设计能力。教学过程引导学生将编程技能转化为解决实际问题的综合能力，最终培养出具备扎实编程功底和创新实践能力的复合型人才，为后续人工智能算法实现与系统开发奠定坚实基础。
default.en: This course is a core foundational computer science subject designed for undergraduate students majoring in artificial intelligence. Using Python as the primary programming language, it systematically builds students' knowledge framework in program design. The curriculum focuses on three key objectives: First, it strengthens theoretical foundations by thoroughly analyzing the fundamental principles of program design and the core syntax of Python (including data types, control flow, functions, and modules), helping students establish a structured knowledge system. Second, it enhances practical skills by training students to implement basic data structures—such as linear lists, stacks, queues, trees, and graphs—using Python, along with core algorithms for operations like insertion, deletion, modification, and retrieval. Students will also gain proficiency in leveraging mainstream Python librariesfor data processing and visualization. Third, it emphasizes tool application by guiding students in configuring and debugging development environments such as Visual Studio Code and Jupyter Notebook. Innovatively, the course integrates data thinking and computational thinking, employing a progressive training approach—"problem abstraction → algorithm design → code implementation → optimization & verification"—to simultaneously develop students' abilities in modular programming (procedural-oriented) and system design (object-oriented). Throughout the teaching process, students are encouraged to transform programming skills into practical problem-solving capabilities. Ultimately, the course aims to cultivate well-rounded talents with solid programming expertise and innovative practical skills, laying a strong foundation for subsequent studies in AI algorithm implementation and system development.

default.zh: 《C语言程序设计A》是非计算机专业的一门重要的计算机类专业基础课程。设置本课程的主要目的是使学生掌握用计算机分析和解决问题的思维方法以及程序设计的基本方法，建立从问题到算法再到程序的认知，在从问题到算法再到程序的问题求解及程序构造和实现的过程中理解高级语言的基本构造要素以及算法和数据结构在程序构造中的作用，具备良好的编程素养，以及综合运用所学程序设计语言和程序设计方法，设计、构造和应用计算系统求解科学或工程问题的程序设计和实现能力，为后继课程的学习和将来从事软件开发、解决复杂工程问题奠定编程能力基础。 课程具体目标如下： 课程目标1：掌握程序设计的方法学基础，能够选择与熟练运用现代化集成开发工具测试和调试程序，具备良好的编程素养\、职业道德以及自主学习和终身学习能力。 课程目标2：掌握程序设计的基本问题求解基础，能够有效使用程序设计语言，完成枚举、递推、分治、递归等常用问题求解方法的程序设计并在计算机上实现。 课程目标3：掌握程序设计的基本算法和简单数据结构基础，针对计算相关的复杂工程问题，能够使用恰当的算法和数据结构，完成计算、统计、排序、检索、匹配相关的软件系统的构造、测试与实现。
default.en: 《C Language Programming A》is an important basic course for non-computer specialty. The main purpose of this course is to enable students to master a thinking mode of computer analysis and problem solving methods, and basic programming technology, so as to build knowledge from problems to algorithms to programs, understanding the basic construction elements of high-level languages and the role of algorithms and data structures in program construction, in the process of problems to algorithms, to problem solving and program construction and Implementation. Using programming language and programming methods comprehensively, the students can get professional programming capabilities, as well as capabilities of designing, construction and application of computing systems to solve scientific or engineering problems in program design and implementation. Therefore, this course lays a good foundation of programming skills for the subsequent courses. Also for their future work in solving complex engineering problems or software development. The specific objectives of the course are as follows: Curriculum objective 1: Understand the methodological foundations of programming and the fundamentals of problem solving; choose the proper integrated development environment for the specific project and grasp the methods of editing, compiling, linking, running, and debugging programs in a common integrated development environment; master basic capabilities for debugging and testing programs using integrated development environments. The students can get good programming literacy, professional ethics, self-learning , and lifelong learning abilities from this course. Curriculum objective 2: Master the fundamentals of problem solving in programming design. With the knowledge of programming language, gasp the common strategies of problem solving such as enumeration, recursion, iteration, divide and conquer and apply which effectively in real life problems. Curriculum objective 3: Understand basic algorithms and data structure of programming; according to the complex engineering problems, choosing the proper algorithms and data structures such as, calculation, collection, sorting, matching and retrieval to construct and develop a specific software or system, then test and debug on a computer.

default.en: 《C Language Programming B》is an important basic course for non-computer specialty. Using programming language and programming methods comprehensively, the students can get professional programming capabilities, as well as capabilities of designing, construction and application of computing systems to solve scientific or engineering problems in program design and implementation. Therefore, this course lays a good foundation of programming skills for the subsequent courses. Also for their future work in solving complex engineering problems or software development. The specific objectives of the course are as follows: Curriculum objective 1: Understand the methodological foundations of programming and the fundamentals of problem solving; choose the proper integrated development environment for the specific project and grasp the methods of editing, compiling, linking, running, and debugging programs in a common integrated development environment; master basic capabilities for debugging and testing programs using integrated development environments. The students can get good programming literacy, professional ethics, and self-learning ability from this course. default.en: Python is the preferred development language for scientific computing, big data and artificial intelligence. The main purpose of this course is to develop students' ability to analyze and design programs correctly and to develop practical problem-solving skills to solve scientific or engineering problems in their field of study. This course covers Python language basics, functions, recursion, modules, set types, algorithms, object-oriented programming, file processing, database manipulation and GUI programming basics. This course is mainly taught by teachers, supplemented by students' self-study after class. In teaching, more classroom demonstrations and teacher-student interaction are used. In the experimental course, we use the way of practice to teach on behalf of students to strengthen the training of practical ability and focus on the cultivation of practical programming ability. The course assessment method includes two parts: multiple experiments completed by individuals and large assignments completed by teams.

default.en: C++Programming B is an important basic computer science course for non-computer major undergraduate students. This course mainly teaches the basic concepts, core ideas, design processes, and methods of object-oriented programming, including the basics of object-oriented programming, commonly used data structures and data organization methods, commonly used algorithms and implementations, as well as the abstraction and implementation methods of classes in the system. The main purpose of this course is to cultivate students' good programming literacy, professional literacy, and self-directed learning ability in programming; Enable students to master the basic concepts, core ideas, design processes, and methods of object oriented programming; To cultivate students' ability to read, design, implement, and debug programs; To cultivate students' concepts and thinking for problem analysis, algorithm design, and system implementation, ultimately achieving the ability to comprehensively apply C++programming ideas and methods for the design, development, and implementation of small-scale application systems, thus possessing the ability to solve practical application problems. This course lays the foundation for future software development, solving engineering and scientific and technological problems, as well as in-depth learning of related courses.

default.zh: 本课程由两部分组成，即近世代数部分和数理逻辑部分。近世代数又称为抽象代数，主要研究对象是代数结构或者代数系统，以数、多项式、矩阵、变换和它们的运算为具体模型，建立起半群、幺半群、群、环和域等为研究对象的学科，研究这些代数结构的子结构，商结构，以及这些代数结构间的同态和同构。其理解结果在很多科学领域，例如组合理论，编码理论，网络安全等领域都有重要应用。数理逻辑是用数学的方法研究来研究思维推理的形式结构和推理规律的数学学科，在计算机科学中具有广泛的应用。主要讲述了命题连接词，自然语言的形式化，命题逻辑形式化的公理系统，一阶谓词逻辑的形式化公理系统，以及推理理论。
default.en: This course consists of two parts, including Modern Algebra and Mathematical Logic. Modern Algebra also called abstract algebra, its research content including algebraic structure or algebraic system, with numbers, polynomials, matrix, transformation and their algebraic operation as concrete models, gives the concept of semigroup, group, ring and field. Also gives the substructures and quotient structures of these algebraic structures and homomorphism and isomorphism between these structures. Mathematical logic concerns with the research of formal theory of man's reasoning with mathematics. It has widespread applications in computer science. we give concept of propositions and logical connectives, formalization of natural languages, formal axiomatic system of propositional logic, formal axiomatic system of first order predicate logic and theory of reasoning.

default.zh: 《数字逻辑与数字系统设计》是计算机类的一门专业基础课程，学习组合逻辑电路与时序逻辑电路的基本原理，掌握主要数字逻辑部件及数字系统设计的基本方法，熟悉使用如vivado等电子设计自动化工具，能够利用集成电路或可编程逻辑器件进行数字系统的设计与实现，并进行电路的功能、性能分析。培养学生针对具体问题设计、实现、分析数字系统的能力。 课程具体目标如下： 课程目标1：掌握逻辑代数的基础知识，能够利用逻辑代数原理及基本逻辑门来构造典型逻辑部件，能够熟练运用现代电子设计集成开发工具实现、分析逻辑部件。 课程目标2：掌握逻辑电路的分析方法及设计方法，能够利用基本逻辑部件来构造组合逻辑电路及时序逻辑电路，能够运用现代工具实现、分析逻辑电路。 课程目标3：运用逻辑设计思维，能够表达和分析与硬件系统相关的复杂逻辑电路问题。针对具体应用问题设计并实现一个数字逻辑系统，初步建立工程意识和系统观。
default.en: Digital Logic and Digital System Design is a professional foundation course in computer class, learning the basic principles of combinational logic circuits and timing logic circuits, mastering the main digital logic components and the basic methods of digital system design, familiar with the use of electronic design automation tools such as vivado, and able to use integrated circuits or programmable logic devices for the design and implementation of digital systems, and the circuit's Function and performance analysis. Students will develop the ability to design, implement and analyse digital systems for specific problems. The specific objectives of the course are as follows: Course Goal 1: To master the basics of logic algebra, to be able to use the principles of logic algebra and basic logic gates to construct typical logic components, to be able to use modern electronic design and integrated development tools to implement and analyse logic components. Course Objective 2: To master the analysis and design methods of logic circuits, to be able to use basic logic components to construct combinational logic circuits and time sequence logic circuits, to be able to use modern tools to implement and analyse logic circuits. Course Objective 3: To be able to express and analyse complex logic circuit problems related to hardware systems using logic design thinking. To design and implement a digital logic system for a specific application problem, and to establish a preliminary engineering awareness and system view.

default.zh: 数据结构与算法课程中文简介 一、课程基本信息 课程代码： 22CS22004 课程名称： 数据结构与算法 总学时：56 理论学时：40 实验学时：16 上机学时： 0 实践学时： 0 课外辅导学时：0 学分：3.5 开课单位：计算学部 授课对象：小卫星班(英才)、工科试验班、数学与应用数学、计算机与电子通信类 开课学期：2春、2秋 先修课程：集合论与图论、高级语言程序设计 二、课程简介 数据是客观世界的抽象描述，是信息和知识的载体。算法使计算机能够有效地从给定输入生成输出，帮助我们获取数据中的信息和知识。本课程介绍数据的表示、存储、访问方式，以及针对不同数据类型的各种算法的实现、评价和设计策略。数据结构与算法是计算机大类的专业基础课程，本课程旨在通过讲授基本的数据结构以及典型的应用算法，培养学生数据结构和算法的设计能力，使学生能够从数据对象的特性和问题的特征入手，选择适当数据结构并设计相应算法，提高学生的算法和数据结构修养，能够通过实际问题，设计和使用基本数据结构（线性结构、树形结构、图型结构）,能够对基本数据结构上的基本操作算法进行时间和空间复杂性的分析,能够根据算法的实际操作需求，选择、设计适合的数据结构，并能实现相关算法，能够分析计算复杂工程问题，抽象出逻辑结构和问题求解算法，并能设计或选择合理的存储结构，实现问题求解算法。

We try to let students understand it and know well about the basic data structures, widely-used algorithms and design ideas of algorithm types. Data structure and algorithm is a basic course for computer majors. This course aims to help students to acquire the ability to design data structures and algorithms by learning basic data structures and typical application algorithms, so that students can pick appropriate data structures and design corresponding algorithms based on the characteristics of data objects and problems, thus improving their skills on developing algorithms and data structures. Let students know how to develop algorithms by using basic data structures (linear structures, tree structures, graph structures) through practical problems, analyze the time and space complexity of basic operational algorithms on basic data structures, pick and design suitable data structures according to the requirements of algorithms. Finally, by learning this course, students can analyze complex engineering problems, find proper models and data structures, and implement relevant algorithms. Figure out the logical structure of the objects in problems, and can design a suitable storage structure to implement the algorithm to solve the problems.

default.en: Algorithm design and analysis is one of the most important professional courses for students in computer class. The goal of this course is to form the ability of algorithm design and analysis for student by teaching fundamental methods and technique of algorithm design and analysis as well as algorithms for some classical problems. The goal of this course is to train students to solve problems with high time and space efficiency as well as practical programming skills. The culture of algorithms is also taught in this course. Students could understand basic concepts and master the algorithm evaluation criteria through this course. They could use algorithm design techniques including divide-and-conquer, dynamic programming, greedy, search strategies to solve problems and analyze the time and space complexity of algorithms through the studying of this course. This course will make student know the basic algorithms for classical problems such as sort and selection problem, graph and network flow problem and string processing program. The abilities of reading papers related to algorithms, flexibly using algorithms to solve practical problems, algorithm implementation as well as experimentally testing the algorithms will be formed in this course.

default.zh: 《计算机组成原理》是计算机类的专业基础课。课程培养学生“全面系统掌握现代计算机系统的基本组成和内部运行机制，掌握计算机硬件系统的基本分析与设计方法，建立计算机系统的整体概念，具备设计和实现计算机系统，并使用计算机系统高效解决实际问题的能力”为主要目标。通过从整体框架入手，自顶向下，层层细化，通过对计算机系统概述、总线系统、存储系统（包括主存储器、高速缓冲存储器和虚拟存储器）、输入输出系统、中央处理器（包括运算方法和运算器、指令系统、CPU结构及功能），控制单元（包括其功能和组合逻辑以及微程序控制单元的设计思想和实现技术）的深入剖析，为全面培养学生系统认知能力、面向问题求解能力、系统开发与调试能力，以及设计与创新能力奠定良好的基础，并为进一步学习计算机设计与实践、接口技术、嵌入式系统、计算机体系结构、操作系统、计算机网络等后续课程奠定坚实的基础。
default.en: “ The Principles of Computer Organization ” is a fundamental course in computer science. The main goal of the course is to help student cultivate comprehensive and systematic understanding of the basic components and internal operating mechanisms of modern computer systems , grasp the basic analysis and design methods of computer hardware systems, establish the overall concept of computer systems, acquire the ability to design and implement computer systems, and efficiently solve practical problems using computer systems. By starting from the overall framework and refining it layer by layer from top to bottom, the computer system overview, bus system, storage system (including main memory, Cache memory and virtual memory), input and output system, central processing unit (including calculation methods and processors, instruction system, CPU structure and functions), The in-depth analysis of control units (including their functions and combination logic, as well as the design ideas and implementation techniques of micro-program control units) lays a solid foundation for comprehensively cultivating students' system cognitive ability, problem-solving ability, system development and debugging ability, as well as design and innovation ability. It also lays a solid foundation for further learning computer design and practice, interface technology, embedded systems, computer system architecture, operating systems and computer networks.

default.zh: 计算机系统是计算机大类与软件工程大类的专业基础课程，从程序员的视角阐述计算机系统的基本概念，并展示这些概念如何实实在在地影响应用程序的正确性、性能和实用性，使学生理解机器、阅读机器，并应用机器编写正确、高效、可靠且功能强大的程序。 课程通过计算机系统的漫游与深入分析，阐述了整个计算机系统的工作原理与设计方法，包括数据表示、ISA与程序执行、CPU设计、存储器系统、连接、优化、异常与进程、虚拟存储、系统级IO等知识模块，从而帮助学生逐步建立完整的计算机体系结构；系统性地理解计算机如何生成程序、执行程序、存储信息和交互通讯；建立高级语言程序、ISA、OS、编译器、链接器等之间的相互关联，对指令在硬件上的执行过程和指令的底层硬件执行机制有一定的认识和理解，从而增强学生在程序调试、性能提升、程序移植和健壮性等方面的能力。通过分析系统的不同结构对于上层应用软件编写、执行和数据存储的影响，培养程序员在更广阔空间应用计算机系统知识的能力。 课程通过5~8个配套的实验项目，使学生掌握复杂计算机编程调试环境的构建方法，熟练应用现代编程调试工具，分析计算机系统、破解可执行程序、实现OS的Shell命令行解释器、优化程序等，在新鲜有趣的实验中理解计算机系统的原理与方法，养成良好的编程习惯；并为其他十大系列课程的学习奠定坚实的基础。
default.en: Computer system is a core-course of CSE&SE major. Our aim is to explain the enduring concepts underlying all computer systems from a programmer’s perspective, and to show you the concrete ways that these ideas affect the correctness, performance, and utility of your application programs, and to promote you to understand machines, read machines, and use machines to write correct, efficient, reliable and powerful programs. Roaming in the computer system and thorough analysis, this course expounds the working principle and design method of the entire computer system, including data representation, ISA and program execution, CPU design, memory system, link, optimization, exception and processes, virtual memory, system level IO ,etc. knowledge modules, to help students to gradually establish a complete computer system architecture, to understand systematically how the computer generates programs, executes programs, stores information, and communicates. It establish relation between high level language programming, ISA, OS, compiler, linker, etc. It help the students to understand the instructions execution process on hardware and the underlying hardware execution mechanism, so as to enhance their abilities in program debugging, performance improvement, program transplantation and robustness, etc. By analyzing the influence of different system architectures on the upper application program writing, execution and data storage, It trains the ability of programmers to apply computer system knowledge in a wider space. Through 5~8 experiments, this course help the student to grasp the construction method of computer complex programming and debugging environment, to apply skilled modern programming debugging tools, analyze and break the computer system, implement the OS Shell command line interpreter, optimization program , etc., to understand the principle and method of the computer system in the fresh and interesting experiments, to develop good programming habits, and lay a solid foundation for other ten series of courses.
