default.en: 1.General Information Course Code：22CS31308 Course Title： Software Process and Project Management C Credit Hours： 40 Lecture： 32 Lab： 8 Computer Lab: 0 Practical: 0 Tutoring: 0 Credit(s)： 2.5 Offering Department: School of Software Students: 3nd year undergraduate student majoring in software engineering Term: Fall, 3nd year; Open Prerequisites: Advanced Language Programming, Object-Oriented Programming Languages (Java Programming / C++ Programming)，Introduction to Software Engineering Major 2.Course Description This course is a foundational course in the Software Engineering major. The teaching content is organized around the processes of software development, including requirements acquisition, requirements analysis, system analysis, system design, software process models, and project management. The key focuses of the course are the modeling techniques and methods for system analysis and design, agile development models, and their applications. The objective of this course is to enable students to understand the principles of software engineering and to cultivate an engineering mindset. Students will master the models and modeling methods for software requirements analysis, system analysis, and system design. They will also gain proficiency in software development process models and project management methods. Additionally, students will learn popular project management methods and tools, as well as methods and tools for software maintenance and configuration management. This course aims to equip students with the comprehensive ability to manage and develop complex software systems, effective communication skills, and the ability to manage and organize team collaboration. Students will also be able to write standardized documents such as project feasibility analysis reports, project plans, and project budget reports.

default.zh: 本课程面向人工智能相关专业本科生开设。该课程分为基础技术和高级技术两部分。基础技术 是信息检索这门课必须掌握的基本概念、基本原理和基本技能。高级技术部分是近年来出现的新的 检索方法或者新的研究动态。基础技术包括:绪论、经典信息检索模型、信息检索的评价、查询(Query) 处理与扩展技术、索引与匹配技术、Web 检索与排序算法。高级技术包括:交互式推荐系统，检索 增强生成(RAG)技术。通过本课程的学习，学生将系统掌握智能检索与生成领域的基本算法与核 心理论，了解常用的关键技术方法，建立起完整的知识体系。课程注重理论与实践相结合，培养学 生具备智能检索与生成系统的开发能力，为其今后从事信息检索及相关领域的研发工作奠定坚实基础。
default.en: This course is designed for undergraduate students in Artificial Intelligence and related majors. The course is divided into two parts: Fundamental Techniques and Advanced Techniques. The Fundamental Techniques are the basic concepts, principles, and skills that must be mastered in the subject of information retrieval. The Advanced Techniques part covers newly emerging retrieval methods or recent research trends. The Fundamental Techniques include: Introduction, Classical Information Retrieval Models, Evaluation of Information Retrieval, Query Processing and Expansion Techniques, Indexing and Matching Techniques, Web Retrieval and Ranking Algorithms. The Advanced Techniques include: Interactive Recommendation Systems, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) Technology. Through studying this course, students will systematically master the fundamental algorithms and core theories in the field of intelligent retrieval and generation, understand commonly used key technical methods, and establish a complete knowledge system. The course emphasizes the integration of theory and practice, cultivating students' development capabilities for intelligent retrieval and generation systems, laying a solid foundation for their future work in research and development in the field of information retrieval and related areas.

default.zh: 计算建模在现代计算机科学中起着重要的作用，是计算机大类的一门专业核心课程。在现代计算机科学与技术中面临复杂的科学与工程问题，其中复杂的结构化和非结构化大数据普遍存在。要想快速有效的解决这样的复杂大数据问题，首先需要为实际问题抽象出数学模型，并能够形式化描述问题的本质和规律。本课程所包括的随机化和概率统计技术能够给建模、分析和处理这些大数据，提供强有力的描述工具和技术手段。计算建模的应用范围包括机器学习、安全协议、大数据处理、生物计算和人工智能应用等相关领域。课程核心内容包括随机变量分布和密度函数、随机采样、参数估计、经典的随机过程、随机数生成与蒙特卡洛方法、马尔科夫链和随机游走、随机模拟、随机场等内容。对连续和离散随机信号的分析和计算方法进行了全面的介绍。课程在介绍随机计算理论的基础上，对相关理论和技术的数值计算和模拟，以及对其中经典算法在现代计算机科学与技术中的实际应用也进行了较详细的描述。通过本课程的学习，学生对随机信号及处理有充分的理论储备，对后续的随机算法和其它课程的学习有很好的铺垫。课程适用于高年级本科生和研究生。
default.en: Computation modelling plays an important role in modern computer science. It is a professional kernel curriculum. There are many structural and non-structural big data in complex engineering problems in modern computer. In order to solve these problems effectively and efficiently, it is necessary that you can model these problems into mathematical formal representation and simulate them by computational methods. Randomizing and probability statistics techniques in this course provide the powerful tools and technical methods to model, analyze and process these big data. It is commonly used in machine learning, secure protocols, big data processing, biometrics computing and artificial intelligence et. al. Its main contents include random variable distribution and density function, random sampling techniques, parameters estimation, classical random process, random number generation, Monte Carlo methods, Markov chains and random walks, random simulation, random fields and so on. It not only introduces the analysis and computation methods of continuous and discrete signal but also describes the numerical computation and simulation techniques. In addition, it also takes some practical applications in computer science as examples to demonstrate the power of random computing. All in all, this course gives a rigorous yet accessible treatment of the related topics in random signal processing. With its comprehensive selection of topics, along with many examples and exercises, this course is an indispensable for continuing learning other related courses, such as random algorithms.

default.zh: 随着多核处理器和高性能计算系统的发展，并行计算已经成为计算机科学与工程领域的必要基础之一。本课程介绍并行计算的理论、概念和技术，讨论并行计算机系统结构、并行算法和并行编程方法。主要内容包括：并行计算机的发展和分类，并行程序设计基础，OpenMP、MPI和CUDA等并行编程，并行程序性能分析和优化等。目标是使学生了解并行计算机的系统结构特征和并行计算的基本原理，掌握并行算法的设计、分析和编程实现方法，培养面向高性能计算系统的并行程序设计和优化人才。
default.en: With the development of multi-core processors and high-performance computing systems, parallel computing has become one of the necessary foundations in the field of computer science and engineering. This course introduces the theory, concept and technology of parallel computing, and discusses the system structure, parallel algorithm and parallel programming method of parallel computer. The main contents include the development and classification of parallel computers, basis of parallel programming, parallel programming methods such as OpenMP, MPI and CUDA, parallel program performance analysis and optimization, etc. The goal of this course is to enable students to understand the characteristics of the system architecture of parallel computers and the basic principles of parallel computing, master the design, analysis and programming methods of parallel algorithms, and cultivate talents for parallel programming and optimization of high-performance computing system.

default.zh: 语音处理是研究语音发声过程、语音信号的统计特性、语音的自动识别、机器合成以及语音感知等各种处理技术的总称，也是人工智能技术的一个重要应用领域，得到了研究者们的广泛关注，新技术新方法不断涌现。《智能语音处理》是面向计算学部学生的专业选修课程。以智能语音处理过程的总体框架为线索，全面阐述语音领域各项智能处理技术。培养学生树立智能语音处理领域的基本观念、基础概念、数学基础和专业理论与方法，建立起专业的思维方式和解决问题的领域专业素养。掌握数字信号处理的定义、采集、运算方法；掌握语音信号的表示和分析方法、语音的产生模型和感知模型，语音信号处理的关键技术：语音识别、语音合成、语音编码和说话人识别等。培养学生研究兴趣和科研动手能力，为今后开展本领域的科研开发工作形成完善的知识储备。
default.en: Speech processing is a general term for various processing technologies such as the study of speech production process, statistical characteristics of speech signals, automatic speech recognition, machine synthesis, and speech perception. It is also an important application field of artificial intelligence technology and has received widespread attention from researchers, with new technologies and methods constantly emerging. Intelligent Speech Processing is a professional elective course aimed at students in the faculty of computing. Taking the overall framework of intelligent speech processing as a clue, comprehensively elaborate on various intelligent processing technologies in the field of speech. Cultivate students to establish basic concepts, mathematical foundations, and professional theories and methods in the field of intelligent speech processing, and establish professional thinking patterns and problem-solving skills. Master the definition, acquisition, and operation methods of digital signal processing; Master the representation and analysis methods of speech signals, the generation and perception models of speech, and the key technologies of speech signal processing, such as speech recognition, speech synthesis, speech coding, and speaker recognition. Cultivate students' research interests and practical research abilities, and form a comprehensive knowledge reserve for future scientific research and development in this field.

default.zh: 自然语言被认为是思维的物质外壳，是最理想的人机交互方式。自然语言处理（即利用计算机自动处理人类语言）被视为"人工智能皇冠上的明珠"，是目前人工智能中的一个前沿技术。 《自然语言处理》是人工智能方向中的一门专业课，课程基于人工智能、机器学习的理论和方法对人类语言信息进行智能处理，实现自然语言的自动理解，提供更自然的人机交互方式。 该课程的目的是使学生理解计算机处理人类语言的基本原理，了解和掌握利用深度学习和预训练策略对自然语言建模和计算的常用方法，为学生今后设计、开发面向自然语言的人工智能应用系统奠定技术基础，提高学生的形式化思维、计算建模能力。 课程主要内容包括： 1．自然语言处理的核心知识，包括自然语言处理的基本概念、语言模型、子词切分、分布式表示、深度学习和Transformer模型。 2．大规模语言模型的核心知识，包括提示学习、语境学习、思维链以及基于人类反馈的强化学习等。
default.en: Natural language as the tool and means of thinking is regarded as the most ideal way of human-computer interaction. Natural language processing (ie, using computers to automatically process human language) is considered as the "crown jewel of artificial intelligence" and is currently a cutting-edge technology in artificial intelligence. "Natural Language Processing" is a core course for artificial intelligence major. Based on the theories and methods of artificial intelligence and machine learning, the course is focused on automatic understanding of natural language, so as to providing a more natural way of human-computer interaction. The purpose of this course is to enable students to understand the basic principles of computer processing of human language, and master common methods of modeling natural language via deep learning and pre-training strategies. It is commissioned to lay a technical foundation for students to design and develop artificial intelligence application systems for natural language in the future, and improve students' formal thinking and computational modeling capabilities. The main contents of the course include: 1. Core knowledge of natural language processing, including basic concepts of natural language processing, language models, sub-word segmentation, distributed representations, deep learning, and Transformer models. 2. Core knowledge of large language models, including prompt learning, contextual learning, chains of thought, and reinforcement learning based on human feedback.

default.zh: 计算机视觉是人工智能领域的重要分支，主要涉及利用计算机和人工智能技术模仿人类视觉系统，并处理、分析、理解和决策图像或视频等视觉信息的理论、方法和技术。近年来，计算机视觉在理论研究和应用落地等层面都取得了重要进展，并已广泛应用于人们的生产和生活中。 本课程旨在系统讲授计算机视觉领域的基本概念、原理和技术框架，揭示计算机视觉的科学内涵，并初步探讨它们在工业检测、无人驾驶、智能安防、医学图像、数码娱乐等人工智能领域的前沿应用和发展趋势。同时，本课程致力于培养学生在计算机视觉领域的专业技能，拓展学术视野，为其未来的学术研究和职业发展奠定坚实基础。 通过本课程的学习，学生将理解和掌握计算机视觉的基本原理和概念，包括图像滤波、特征检测、拟合与匹配、图像分类、分割、光流和立体视觉等核心算法；掌握基于深度学习的计算机视觉工具，并将其应用于图像识别、检测与分析等典型视觉任务场景。 本课程适用于本科三年级的学生，先修课程包括微积分、代数与几何、概率论与数理统计和高级语言程序设计等。本课程的授课教师具有丰富的教学经验和计算机视觉领域的背景。课程学时为32学时，其中理论授课24学时，实验实践8学时。课程内容由浅入深，难度水平逐步提升，学生需要在规定的时间内完成相应的作业和实验任务。本课程将采用多种教学方法，包括课堂讲授、案例分析、小组讨论和课程实验，以帮助学生全面理解和掌握计算机视觉相关知识，并培养解决实际问题的能力。本课程的考核方式包括平时成绩、实验成绩和期末考试。平时成绩包括课堂表现、出勤情况和课后作业；实验成绩包括实验课的表现和实验完成情况等；期末考试包括期末考试成绩等。 随着人工智能技术的不断发展，计算机视觉领域的研究和应用也将不断深化和拓展。本课程的目的是为学生打下坚实的计算机视觉理论基础，并培养学生在实际应用中的创新能力。通过本课程的学习，学生将具备计算机视觉领域的基本知识和技能，能够在未来的科研和工作中学以致用。
default.en: Computer vision represents a formidable subfield within artificial intelligence, encompassing the development of theories, methods, and sophisticated techniques that enable computers to emulate the human visual apparatus. This domain leverages the prowess of artificial intelligence to interpret, analyze, and make informed decisions based on visual data, including images and videos. The recent advancement of computer vision has been remarkable, showcasing significant strides in both theoretical foundations and practical applications, permeating through various facets of industrial production and everyday life. The objective of this course is to deliver a coherent and comprehensive exposition of the fundamental notions, underlying principles, and technical infrastructure intrinsic to computer vision. It aims to unravel the scientific essence of the discipline and acquaint students with the forefront of computer vision applications, such as autonomous vehicular technology, intelligent surveillance, medical imaging analytics, and the burgeoning sector of digital entertainment. Concurrently, this curriculum is designed to hone the students' expertise in computer vision, broaden their academic vista, and establish a robust groundwork for their scholarly inquiries and professional pursuits. Throughout the course, participants will gain fluency in the core tenets of computer vision. This includes a thorough treatment of image filtering, feature extraction, pattern fitting and matching, image categorization, segmentation, optical flow, and stereo vision principles. Students will become adept with prevalent computer vision instruments and deploy them across various visual processing tasks, including but not limited to facial recognition, object identification, and comprehensive image analysis. This curriculum is tailored for third-year undergraduate scholars, presupposing proficiency in calculus, algebra, geometry, probability theory, mathematical statistics, and advanced programming languages. Our seasoned instructors bring a wealth of pedagogical experience and domain-specific expertise. The course spans 32 instructional hours—24 dedicated to theoretical instruction and 8 to practical laboratory work. The curriculum is structured to progressively intensify in complexity, with students expected to fulfill designated homework and laboratory assignments within established timelines. Our pedagogical approach, encompassing lectures, case studies, collaborative discourse, and hands-on experimentation, is intended to facilitate a deep-rooted comprehension of computer vision and to nurture practical problem-solving capabilities. The evaluative framework of this course comprises continuous assessment, laboratory performance, and a culminating examination. Continuous assessment entails classroom engagement, attendance, and homework submission. The laboratory grade reflects students' experimental diligence and achievements. The final examination will gauge the comprehensive understanding of the course material. With artificial intelligence continually evolving, the scope and depth of computer vision research and applications are set to broaden. This course aspires to solidify students' theoretical knowledge in computer vision and foster innovative acumen in its application. Upon completion, students will possess the essential acumen and technical skill set pertinent to computer vision, equipping them for subsequent research endeavors and professional engagements.

default.zh: 语音处理是研究语音发声过程、语音信号的统计特性、语音的自动识别、机器合成以及语音感知等各种处理技术的总称，也是人工智能技术的一个重要应用领域，得到了研究者们的广泛关注，新技术新方法不断涌现。《智能语音处理》是面向计算学部学生的专业选修课程。以智能语音处理过程的总体框架为线索，全面阐述语音领域各项智能处理技术。培养学生树立智能语音处理领域的基本观念、基础概念、数学基础和专业理论与方法，建立起专业的思维方式和解决问题的领域专业素养。掌握数字信号处理的定义、采集、运算方法；掌握语音信号的表示和分析方法、语音的产生模型和感知模型，语音信号处理的关键技术：语音识别、语音合成、语音编码和说话人识别等。培养学生研究兴趣和科研动手能力，为今后开展本领域的科研开发工作形成完善的知识储备。
default.en: Speech processing is a general term for various processing technologies such as the study of speech production process, statistical characteristics of speech signals, automatic speech recognition, machine synthesis, and speech perception. It is also an important application field of artificial intelligence technology and has received widespread attention from researchers, with new technologies and methods constantly emerging. Intelligent Speech Processing is a professional elective course aimed at students in the faculty of computing. Taking the overall framework of intelligent speech processing as a clue, comprehensively elaborate on various intelligent processing technologies in the field of speech. Cultivate students to establish basic concepts, mathematical foundations, and professional theories and methods in the field of intelligent speech processing, and establish professional thinking patterns and problem-solving skills. Master the definition, acquisition, and operation methods of digital signal processing; Master the representation and analysis methods of speech signals, the generation and perception models of speech, and the key technologies of speech signal processing, such as speech recognition, speech synthesis, speech coding, and speaker recognition. Cultivate students' research interests and practical research abilities, and form a comprehensive knowledge reserve for future scientific research and development in this field.

default.zh: 图形学与虚拟现实作为专业选修课，是许多后续课程（如图像处理、模式识别、多媒体技术、计算机视觉等）的理论基础。本课程旨在使学生能够全面认识和理解计算机图形学和虚拟现实技术的研究内容及其应用方向。学生将了解计算机图形学与图像处理、模式识别、计算几何等相关学科的关系，掌握基本图形生成算法、图形变换与裁剪、图形建模与表示、真实感图形生成算法等知识，并了解计算机图形学的前沿进展。 通过本课程学习，学生将通过编写算法实现程序加深对图形学基本内容的理解，提高理论指导实践的能力。本课程旨在培养学生利用计算机进行图形生成、处理和显示算法设计与实现的能力，掌握“问题分析—算法设计—编程实现”的思想、技术和方法。这将为学生今后学习其他相关课程和从事计算机图形学及其应用方面的研究打下坚实基础。
default.en: As an elective course for majors, Graphics and Virtual Reality serve as the theoretical foundation for many subsequent courses, such as Image Processing, Pattern Recognition, Multimedia Technology, and Computer Vision. The course aims to provide students with a comprehensive understanding of the research content and application directions of computer graphics and virtual reality technology. Students will explore the relationship between computer graphics and related disciplines such as image processing, pattern recognition, and computational geometry. They will also acquire knowledge of fundamental graphics generation algorithms, graphics transformation and clipping, graphics modeling and representation, as well as realistic graphics generation algorithms, and stay informed about the latest developments in computer graphics. Throughout the course, students will deepen their understanding of fundamental graphics concepts by implementing algorithms and enhancing their ability to apply theory to practice. The course aims to cultivate students' ability to design and implement graphics generation, processing, and display algorithms using computers, while mastering the thought process, techniques, and methods of "problem analysis—algorithm design—programming implementation". This will lay a solid foundation for students to study other related courses and engage in research in the field of computer graphics and its applications in the future.

default.zh: 《嵌入式系统》是计算机大类的专业限选课，属于物联网工程专业的专业方向课。通过本门课程的学习，使学生理解嵌入式计算的特点，与通用计算系统在设计目标、开发资源、开发环境的不同，学习嵌入式系统的体系结构、组成，掌握嵌入式系统开发的过程和软硬件协同设计基本方法。培养学生嵌入式系统能力、实践动手能力、嵌入式系统分析与调试能力，培养学生的工程素质。 课程由浅入深，遵循“认识嵌入式系统→了解嵌入式体系结构→掌握微控制器的用法→解决实际问题”的思路，引导学生用高度精简的定制化计算机系统，高效、可靠的解决实际问题的能力。理解并体验嵌入式系统开发过程中需求分析、方案比选、硬件设计、程序编写、系统测试、文档撰写等完整开发流程；理解嵌入式系统面向特定应用且资源受限的特点，掌握针对具体问题进行需求分析、针对特定需求进行嵌入式系统设计的能力，并了解对嵌入式系统的性能进行分析评价的方法；掌握根据需求选取合适的开发工具、编程语言及硬件平台，完成嵌入式系统的设计和开发工作的方法；使学生理解并遵守行业相关标准，并具备良好的团队协作精神。
default.en: "Embedded Systems" is a major elective courses for computer majors, and it is also an orientation course of IoT Engineering. Through the study of this course, students can understand the characteristics of embedded computing, and the differences between general computing systems and embedded systems in terms of design goals, development resources, and development environments. Mastering the process, principles of embedded system, and the methods of software and hardware co-design. Cultivate students' embedded system ability, practical ability, embedded system analysis and debugging ability, and cultivate students' engineering quality. Following the idea of "knowing embedded systems -> understanding embedded architecture -> mastering the microcontrollers -> solving practical problems", this course guides students to use highly customized computer system to solve practical problems efficiently and reliably, establishes the idea of using the most simplified software and hardware to realize the required functions. Understand and experience the complete embedded system development process such as requirements analysis, scheme comparison, hardware design, software programming, functional testing, and document writing; understand the characteristics of embedded systems that are oriented to specific applications and have limited resources. Understand the methods of performance evaluating of embedded systems; master the selection of development tools, programming languages and hardware platforms according to the requirements; understand and abide by industry standards, and bring out the spirit of teamwork.

default.zh: 智能软件工程技术是当前软件工程领域的前沿技术。随着互联网技术的迅速发展，软件的生态环境变得更加开放、动态、复杂且持续演化，使得软件系统的规模和复杂性急剧增长，对软件开发的效率和质量提出了严峻的挑战。另一方面，人工智能等技术的快速发展以及大量开源软件和开源社区的出现为软件工程的发展带来了新的机遇。在以开源软件为代表的互联网软件开发活动中，积累了快速增长、规模庞大的软件大数据。这为实现软件智能化开发提供了数据基础，使软件开发从网络化、服务化向智能化方向演进。智能软件工程技术将人工智能技术应用于软件工程问题求解，以解决软件工程中面临的诸多挑战。 本课程旨在使学生掌握智能软件工程技术的理论和方法，了解国际上智能软件工程技术研究与实践应用的进展，并紧密结合工程应用，提高运用这些方法解决实际问题的能力，为未来从事软件工程以及与应用相关领域的研究奠定理论基础。具体授课内容包括：程序分析技术的基础理论、深度学习与自然语言的基础理论、代码表示学习和应用，缺陷报告仓库挖掘、安全漏洞相关的缺陷报告识别、数据驱动的软件缺陷预测和定位以及大规模代码预训练模型等。
default.en: Intelligent Software Engineering is a cutting-edge technology in the field of software engineering. The development of internet technology has made the software ecosystem more open, dynamic, complex, and continuously evolving, leading to a rapid increase in the scale and complexity of software systems. This presents significant challenges in terms of improving the efficiency and quality of software development. On the other hand, the rapid advancement of artificial intelligence and the emergence of numerous open-source software and communities have brought new opportunities for the development of software engineering. Internet software development activities, represented by open-source software, have accumulated vast amounts of software big data that are growing rapidly in scale. This data foundation establishes the basis for intelligent software development, enabling software development to evolve from networked and service-oriented to intelligent systems. Intelligent Software Engineering applies artificial intelligence techniques to solve software engineering problems and address the various challenges faced in the field. Through this course, students will gain a comprehensive understanding of the theories and methods of intelligent software engineering. They will also become acquainted with the international research and practical applications of intelligent software engineering and its close integration with engineering practices. The course aims to enhance students' ability to apply these methods to solve practical problems, laying a solid theoretical foundation for future careers in software engineering and related fields. Specific topics covered in the course include the foundational theories of program analysis techniques, deep learning and natural language processing, code representation learning and application, mining of bug repositories, identification of security-related bug reports, data-driven software vulnerability detection and localization, as well as large-scale pre-trained code models.

default.zh: 《工业系统建模与仿真》是计算机相关专业面向特色专业方向系列的核心课程，目的是使学生在掌握现代复杂工程系统数字化研制模式的基础上，掌握工业软件的分类、发展与应用领域、工业软件的价值和一般架构，掌握Modelica语言的基本语法及MWorks.Sysplorer的运用，通过作业和讲练结合方式增强学生对多领域统一建模与仿真知识的理解和运用能力，为学生将来对工业系统的建模与仿真实际应用与二次开发奠定坚实基础。
default.en: “Industrial System Modeling and Simulation "is a core course in a series of computer related majors oriented towards characteristic professional directions. The purpose is to enable students to master the classification, development, and application fields of industrial software, the value and general architecture of industrial software, the basic syntax of Modelica language, and the application of MWorks. Sysplor on the basis of mastering the digital development mode of modern complex engineering systems, By combining homework and lectures, students can enhance their understanding and application ability of unified modeling and simulation knowledge in multiple fields, laying a solid foundation for their future practical application and secondary development of industrial system modeling and simulation.

default.zh: 工业互联网是新一代信息通信技术与工业经济深度融合的全新工业生态、关键基础设施和新型应用模式。它以网络为基础、平台为中枢、数据为要素、安全为保障，通过对人、机、物全面连接，变革传统制造模式、生产组织方式和产业形态的新型工业生产制造和服务体系，对支撑制造强国和网络强国建设，提升产业链现代化水平，推动经济高质量发展和构建新发展格局，都具有十分重要的意义。 《工业互联网与企业信息化》课程旨在培养工业和信息化领域应用型与复合型人才，帮助学生掌握当前工业互联网的技术原理和基本架构，了解技术现状和未来发展趋势，学习新一代信息通信技术与工业经济深度融合的新型基础设施、应用模式和工业生态，形成工业互联网相关领域的认知和实践基础。该课程强调工程素质、软件建模与分析能力，培养学生自学、独立思考与创新能力，具体学习有关工业联网的体结构与关键技术，并通过企业应用案例了解工业互联网的现状。
default.en: The Industrial Internet is a new industrial ecology, critical infrastructure, and novel application model formed through the deep integration of next-generation information and communication technologies with industrial economics. It is based on networks, centered on platforms, driven by data, and secured by safety measures. By comprehensively connecting people, machines, and objects, it transforms traditional manufacturing methods, production organization, and industry patterns into a new industrial production and service system. This plays a vital role in supporting the construction of a strong manufacturing and networked nation, promoting the modernization of the industrial chain, driving high-quality economic development, and building a new development pattern. The "Industrial Internet and Enterprise Informatization" course aims to cultivate application-oriented and compound talents in the fields of industry and informatization. It helps students master the technical principles and basic architecture of the current industrial internet, understand the current technology status and future development trends, and learn about the new infrastructure, application models, and industrial ecology created by the deep integration of next-generation information and communication technologies with industrial economics. The course establishes a cognitive and practical foundation in the field of the industrial internet. The course emphasizes engineering quality, software modeling, and analytical skills while nurturing students' self-learning, independent thinking, and innovation abilities. Students will specifically study the structure and key technologies related to industrial networking and gain insight into the current state of the industrial internet through real-world enterprise application cases.

default.zh: 《服务建模与分析》是一门为软件工程专业学生设计的课程。课程主要目标是帮助学生理解服务及服务建模的核心概念，以及服务建模的相关知识。课程将深入探讨服务建模的分析方法和模型驱动的开发方法，以培养学生运用模型驱动思维分析和设计服务系统的能力。此外，课程还旨在提高学生的创新意识和服务创新能力，增强他们解决服务相关领域实际问题的能力，为未来进行服务系统相关软件研发打下坚实的基础。 课程的三大关键目标是：一是让学生理解和应用基于领域驱动的服务建模方法，以进行服务系统的分析设计。二是让学生理解模型驱动在面向服务开发中的关键含义，并能够在现有的实际框架下，基于服务模型实现服务系统。三是让学生理解和采用面向服务的软件开发理念，能够实现服务的创建、发布、调用和组合，从而实现服务系统的优化和创新开发。 总的来说，《服务建模与分析》是一门理论与实践相结合的课程，不仅教授学生服务建模与分析的理论知识，更注重提升学生的实践能力和创新思维，旨在为学生的未来服务系统相关软件研发工作做好全面的准备。
default.en: Service Modeling and Analysis" is an elective course designed for students majoring in software engineering. The main objective of the course is to help students understand the core concepts of service and service modeling, as well as the related knowledge of service modeling. The course delves into the analytical methods of service modeling and model-driven development methods, with the aim of nurturing students' ability to analyze and design service systems using a model-driven approach. Additionally, the course aims to enhance students' innovative awareness and service innovation capabilities, strengthen their ability to solve practical problems in service-related fields, and lay a solid foundation for future service system related software development. The course has three key objectives: firstly, to enable students to understand and apply domain-driven service modeling methods for the analysis and design of service systems. Secondly, to help students comprehend the crucial implications of model-driven development in service-oriented development, and to implement service systems based on service models within existing practical frameworks. Thirdly, to encourage students to understand and adopt the philosophy of service-oriented software development, enabling them to create, publish, invoke, and combine services, thus optimizing and innovatively developing service systems. In summary, "Service Modeling and Analysis" is a course that combines theory and practice. It not only teaches students the theoretical knowledge of service modeling and analysis but also emphasizes the enhancement of students' practical skills and innovative thinking. The course aims to provide comprehensive preparation for students' future work in service system related software development.

default.zh: 软件服务工程课是软件工程专业的方向选修课程之一，旨在使学生学习软件服务工程的内涵及相关知识，培养学生运用软件服务工程方法进行现代服务系统分析、描述、设计、实现、管理的能力，提高学生服务创新意识与能力，增强学生解决服务相关问题的能力。本课程主要内容包括：现代服务产业与服务学、服务的概念与特征、软件服务工程的基本概念与学科内涵、软件服务工程的知识体系、服务系统及其生命周期、服务工程与方法论、服务模式与服务创新方法、服务模型表示与分析方法、软件服务构件与服务组合、软件服务系统体系结构、软件服务开发技术、软件服务系统的运行及管控、服务价值工程、服务质量评价与保证、软件服务工程应用案例、软件服务工程研究新进展；AI赋能的智慧元宇宙服务与大服务2.0等等。本课程采用宏观与微观相结合、理论与实践相结合、系统思维与具体案例相结合的教学方法，使学生从多个学科角度对软件服务工程进行跨专业跨行业学习，初步掌握软件服务工程的基本概念、方法与技术，了解现代服务业的产业发展特点与现状，认识服务计算与服务工程的发展趋势，学会运用服务工程方法论解决现代服务业与服务系统相关的复杂工程问题，为我国发展服务型经济与服务型社会贡献力量。
default.en: The course, Software Service Engineering, is an elective course for the undergraduate students of software school. The purpose of this course is to teach the concepts and related knowledge of software service engineering, in order to improve student’s ability to apply service methodology for analysis, description, design, implementation and management of modern service systems, to promote their innovative conscious and problem-solving ability for services. This course includes the following contents, such as modern service industry and serviceology, concepts and features of services, basic concepts, discipline connotation and knowledge-body of software service engineering, service systems and their life-cycle, service methodology, service schema and service innovation methods, service modeling and analysis, software service components and service composition, software service architecture, software service development techniques, service operation and monitoring, service value engineering, service quality evaluation and assurance, software service application cases, development tendency of software service engineering, AI empowered smart metaverse service and big service 2.0, etc. Through teaching approaches of combination of macro-level and micro-level, theory and practice, system thinking and case study, this course can help students to learn the basic concepts, methods and techniques of software service engineering from multi-discipline and multi-aspects, to know development status of modern service industry, tendency of service computing and software service engineering, in order to enable students to apply software service engineering methodology in solving complicated problems of service industry and service applications, and to contribute to development of service-oriented economy and society.

default.zh: 在人工智能技术正从云端向物理世界广泛渗透的时代背景下，嵌入式人工智能已成为驱动智能汽车、物联网（IoT）设备及各类自主系统的核心技术。本课程旨在为有志于成为未来科技领军人才的学生，打通人工智能从算法理论到物理世界产品的关键环节。课程将系统性地探讨在功耗、算力及存储资源受限的边缘设备上实现并优化机器智能的核心方法论。这不仅是一门前沿的技术课程，更是一场旨在培养学生创造智能物理实体、应对国家在关键核心技术领域挑战的思想与实践相结合的旅程。 本课程致力于构建一个体系化的知识与能力结构。在理论层面，课程将从嵌入式系统的硬件体系结构出发，深入剖析 ARM 处理器及 AI 加速芯片的工作原理，并阐述并行计算架构、脉动阵列等关键技术在性能与功耗权衡中的作用。以嵌入式 Linux 操作系统为基础，学生将掌握其系统内核、文件系统、进程管理及核心操作指令，为高级软件开发奠定坚实基础。在人工智能应用层面，课程将聚焦于轻量化神经网络的设计原则，系统讲授模型压缩、量化及剪枝等核心优化技术。同时，学生将熟悉 TensorFlow Lite、NVIDIA TensorRT、Intel OpenVINO 等主流工业级推理框架，掌握在边缘设备上实现高效能人工智能部署的关键技能。最终，课程将讲授嵌入式智能系统的整体架构设计方法，整合硬件接口、传感器数据处理与 AI 模型部署，培养学生完整的智能应用开发能力。 本课程强调理论与实践的深度融合，采用“启发式”、“研讨式”及“翻转课堂”相结合的教学模式，并通过丰富的工程案例分析激发学生的学习兴趣。实验教学环节将在 Linux 开发环境中进行，包含四个核心实验：嵌入式开发环境构建、AI 推理框架与模型部署性能分析、传感器数据采集与处理、以及神经网络模型轻量化与推理性能评估，总计八学时。学生将以团队形式，完整经历系统设计、算法部署、硬件集成与软件调试的全流程，在解决真实世界问题的挑战中锻炼全栈工程能力。 课程的考核方式旨在全面评估学生的综合能力。最终成绩构成如下：课后作业（10%）、随堂测验（10%）、实验报告（30%）以及小组项目报告与答辩（50%）。课程将重点评估学生在期末项目中展现的系统性思维、创新能力与团队协作精神。我们期望学生不仅能构建一个功能强大的智能系统，更能通过高质量的项目报告与答辩，清晰地阐述其设计理念、技术实现路径与深入思考，从而将个人专业发展与国家在嵌入式人工智能领域的技术需求紧密结合。
default.en: In an era where Artificial Intelligence (AI) is transitioning from cloud-based platforms to real-world applications, embedded AI has emerged as the core technology driving autonomous systems, from intelligent vehicles to Internet of Things (IoT) devices. This course is designed for students aspiring to become future leaders in technology, aiming to bridge the final gap between AI algorithmic theory and its deployment in physical-world products. We will systematically explore the methodologies for implementing and optimizing machine intelligence on edge devices constrained by power, computation, and memory resources. This is not merely a course on advanced technology; it is an intellectual and practical journey focused on creating intelligent physical entities and addressing critical national technological challenges. This course is committed to building a comprehensive framework of knowledge and skills. At the theoretical level, we will begin with the hardware architecture of embedded systems, conducting an in-depth analysis of the operational principles of ARM processors and AI accelerator chips. Key concepts such as parallel computing architectures and systolic arrays will be examined to understand the trade-offs between performance and power consumption. Grounded in the embedded Linux operating system, students will master its kernel, file systems, process management, and essential command-line operations, establishing a solid foundation for advanced software development. On the AI application front, the course will focus on the design principles of lightweight neural networks and deliver systematic instruction on core optimization techniques, including model compression, quantization, and pruning. Students will gain proficiency in mainstream industrial-grade inference frameworks such as TensorFlow Lite, NVIDIA TensorRT, and Intel OpenVINO, mastering the critical skills for efficient AI deployment on edge devices. Ultimately, the course will cover the holistic architectural design of embedded intelligent systems, integrating hardware interfacing, sensor data processing, and AI model deployment to cultivate comprehensive capabilities in intelligent application development. The course emphasizes the deep integration of theory and practice, adopting a pedagogical approach that combines heuristic and seminar-style teaching with a flipped classroom model, supplemented by rich engineering case studies to stimulate student interest. The laboratory component will be conducted in a Linux development environment and consists of four core experiments (totaling 8 lab hours): Embedded Development Environment Setup, Performance Analysis of AI Inference Frameworks and Model Deployment, Sensor Data Acquisition and Processing, and Lightweight Neural Network Model Implementation and Inference Evaluation. Working in teams, students will experience the entire project lifecycle—from system design and algorithm deployment to hardware integration and software debugging—thereby honing their full-stack engineering capabilities by tackling real-world challenges. The assessment for this course is designed to comprehensively evaluate students' integrated abilities. The final grade is composed of homework assignments (10%), in-class quizzes (10%), laboratory reports (30%), and a final group project report and defense (50%). Particular emphasis will be placed on the systems thinking, innovative spirit, and teamwork demonstrated in the final project. Students are expected not only to build a robust intelligent system but also to clearly articulate their design philosophy, technical implementation, and critical reflections through a high-quality report and presentation, thus aligning their personal and professional development with the nation's technological demands in the field of embedded AI.

default.zh: 本课程是面向AI与先进技术领军班本科生设计的专业核心课程，旨在深入探讨三维空间计算技术的核心理论与前沿应用。课程紧跟技术发展浪潮，深度融合深度学习等先进方法，系统性地构建从“数据采集 - 质量优化 - 语义理解 - 真实感表示”的完整知识链条，致力于培养学生在人工智能领域中解决复杂三维问题的核心能力，为未来投身于AR/VR、自动驾驶、智能机器人等前沿领域的研发工作奠定坚实的理论与技术基础。 在知识层面，课程将引导学生系统掌握三维坐标系统、三维数据采集与重建的基本原理，深入理解深度学习在三维数据处理中的应用逻辑，学习点云、网格等数据的质量增强方法，并精讲NeRF（神经辐射场）、3D高斯泼溅等前沿真实感表示技术的核心概念。学生将不仅学习孤立的技术点，更能融会贯通，理解各技术模块之间的内在联系及其在真实工程场景下的应用。 在能力层面，课程强调实践与应用。通过系列实践项目，学生将能够独立完成三维数据的底层处理（如坐标转换、基础三维重建）与高层语义任务（如三维目标分类、场景语义理解），熟练运用Open3D、PyTorch3D等主流工具库，并具备将先进的深度学习模型无缝集成到三维数据处理流程中，以解决实际工程问题的能力。 在素质层面，课程着力培养学生严谨的科学思维与创新意识。学生将学会运用科学原理分析与解决三维空间计算领域的复杂问题，树立在工程实践中追求精确与创新的职业素养。同时，课程将激发学生对于如高斯泼溅等前沿技术的自主追踪与学习能力，并通过团队项目，培养其在跨学科团队中有效沟通、协作完成复杂研发任务的综合素养。
default.en: This course is a specialized core curriculum designed for undergraduates in the AI and Advanced Technology Leadership Program. It delves into the core theories and cutting-edge applications of 3D spatial computing. Keeping pace with technological evolution, the course deeply integrates advanced methodologies like deep learning to systematically construct a complete knowledge framework encompassing "Data Acquisition - Quality Optimization - Semantic Understanding - Photorealistic Representation." It aims to cultivate students' core competency in solving complex 3D problems within the field of artificial intelligence, laying a solid theoretical and technical foundation for future R&D in frontier areas such as AR/VR, autonomous driving, and intelligent robotics. Regarding knowledge objectives, the course guides students to master the principles of 3D coordinate systems, 3D data acquisition, and reconstruction. It provides an in-depth understanding of the application logic of deep learning in 3D data processing, covers quality enhancement methods for data like point clouds and meshes, and offers detailed explanations of core concepts behind state-of-the-art photorealistic representation techniques such as NeRF (Neural Radiance Fields) and 3D Gaussian Splatting. Students will learn not only isolated technical points but also how to integrate knowledge, understanding the intrinsic connections between various technical modules and their applications in real-world engineering scenarios. In terms of capability objectives, the course emphasizes hands-on practice and application. Through a series of practical projects, students will be able to independently implement low-level 3D data processing (e.g., coordinate transformation, basic 3D reconstruction) and high-level semantic tasks (e.g., 3D object classification, scene understanding). They will become proficient in using mainstream tools and libraries like Open3D and PyTorch3D, and gain the ability to integrate advanced deep learning models seamlessly into 3D data processing pipelines to tackle practical engineering challenges. For competency development, the course focuses on cultivating rigorous scientific thinking and an innovative mindset. Students will learn to analyze and solve complex problems in 3D spatial computing based on scientific principles, establishing a professional ethos that values precision and innovation in engineering practice. Furthermore, the course aims to inspire students' autonomous learning capability to track emerging technologies like Gaussian Splatting. Through team-based projects, it also fosters comprehensive qualities such as effective communication and collaboration within interdisciplinary teams to accomplish complex R&D tasks.

default.zh: 本课程旨在系统性地阐述多智能体系统（MAS）与智能机器人的核心理论与关键技术。课程 使学生掌握多智能体系统的分布式决策、协作、通信与博弈论基础，同时理解智能机器人的感知、规划、控制等核心模块，并重点探索多机器人系统如何作为MAS的具体体现与延伸。 培养学生具备设计与实现多智能体/多机器人协同解决方案的能力。通过仿真与实践项目，训练学生运用强化学习、共识算法等技术解决任务分配、路径规划、集群协同等复杂问题。引导学生了解前沿应用与发展趋势，激发创新思维，批判性分析多智能体系统的优势与挑战（如安全性、伦理问题），为未来科研或职业发展奠定坚实基础。
default.en: This course aims to systematically elucidate the core theories and key technologies of multi-agent systems (MAS) and intelligent robots. The course enables students to master the basics of distributed decision-making, collaboration, communication, and game theory in multi-agent systems, while also understanding the core modules of perception, planning, and control in intelligent robots. It focuses on exploring how multi robot systems can serve as concrete manifestations and extensions of MAS. Cultivate students' ability to design and implement multi-agent/multi robot collaborative solutions. Through simulation and practical projects, students are trained to use reinforcement learning, consensus algorithms, and other technologies to solve complex problems such as task allocation, path planning, and cluster collaboration. Guide students to understand cutting-edge applications and development trends, stimulate innovative thinking, critically analyze the advantages and challenges of multi-agent systems (such as security and ethical issues), and lay a solid foundation for future scientific research or career development.

default.zh: 医疗知识图谱构建与应用是面向本科高年级学生开设的一门专业选修课，本课程聚焦人工智能与医疗领域交叉前沿，旨在培养本科生掌握医疗知识图谱构建的核心技术与应用。通过理论授课、案例研讨与项目实践，使学生具备从医疗多源数据中自动提取知识、构建知识图谱并解决临床与科研问题的能力，为智慧医疗、医疗大数据分析等方向奠定基础。 课程可以分为理论基础—构建流程—应用场景三个部分。在理论基础部分，对知识图谱的定义、核心要素、核心技术、医疗领域特殊性、医疗知识图谱的典型应用场景进行深入全面的介绍。进而详细讲述医疗知识图谱的构建技术，介绍数据层的多源医疗数据整合，数据清洗与标准化。知识提取层的实体识别、关系抽取。知识融合层的实体消歧、知识推理与补全等实用技术。最后介绍医疗知识图谱的典型应用场景，如疾病诊断、健康管理等等。课程还安排了小型医疗知识图谱的构建实践，分组构建“慢性病管理”小型知识图谱。 课程兼具系统性、前沿性和实践性，目标是培养具备专业基础知识的“医学+AI”复合型人才。通过本课程，学生将掌握医疗知识图谱这一“AI+医疗”的核心工具，为参与智慧医院建设、临床决策支持系统开发等前沿工作铺平道路。
default.en: This course is an elective course for undergraduate students. It focuses on the intersection of artificial intelligence and medical fields, aiming to cultivate undergraduate students' mastery of the core technologies and applications of medical knowledge graph construction. Through theoretical lectures, case studies, and project practice, students are equipped with the ability to extract knowledge from medical multi-source data, construct knowledge graphs, and solve clinical and scientific research problems, laying the foundation for directions such as smart healthcare and medical big data analysis. The course can be divided into three parts: theoretical foundation, construction process, and application scenarios. In the theoretical foundation section, a comprehensive and in-depth introduction is given to the definition, core elements, core techniques, medical field specificity, and typical application scenarios of medical knowledge graphs. Further elaborate on the construction techniques of medical knowledge graph, introduce the integration of multi-source medical data, data cleaning and standardization at the data layer. Entity recognition and entity relation extraction in the knowledge extraction layer. Practical technologies such as entity disambiguation, knowledge inference, and completion in the knowledge fusion layer. Finally, typical application scenarios of medical knowledge graphs are introduced, such as disease diagnosis, health management, and so on. The course also arranged for the construction practice of a small-scale medical knowledge graph, grouping to construct a small-scale knowledge graph of "chronic disease management". The course combines systematicity, cutting-edge and practicality, with the goal of cultivating "medical+AI" composite talents with professional basic knowledge. Through this course, students will master the medical knowledge graph, the core tool of "AI+healthcare", paving the way for participation in cutting-edge work such as smart hospital construction and clinical decision support system development.

default.zh: 《计算机体系结构B》重点介绍计算机系统各种基本结构、设计技术和性能分析方法，使学生掌握计算机体系结构设计的核心要素。通过设计实现计算机硬件系统中的主要部件（例如CPU、Cache等），并采用量化方法对性能进行分析，培养学生计算机设计、调试、实现、分析及优化的能力。 课程具体目标如下： 课程目标1：理解计算机系统软硬件功能分配和分界面的确定，掌握计算机体系结构的基本概念和基本原理，建立计算机系统的完整概念，掌握计算机硬件系统的基本设计和分析方法，理解并掌握计算机软硬件系统协同设计方法，能够设计并实现计算机硬件的主要部件（例如缓存、运算器等），培养学生计算机硬件系统的设计和实现能力。 课程目标2：理解计算机软硬件对计算机系统性能的影响，掌握计算机软硬件系统性能的量化分析方法，掌握计算机硬件系统设计的优化方法以及基于硬件特点优化软件系统的方法，能够对整个计算机系统进行性能优化设计。 课程目标3：通过文献检索，阅读计算机体系结构领域的相关文献，了解计算机体系结构的发展趋势，能够分析和评价新应用、新技术、新材料对计算机体系结构发展的影响，并完成相关的分析报告。
default.en: Computer Architecture B provides an introduction of basic computer components, computer design technology, and performance analysis methods, enabling students to master the core elements of computer architecture design. By designing and implementing the main components of computer hardware systems (such as CPU, Cache, etc.), and using quantitative methods to analyze performance, students' abilities in computer design, debugging, implementation, analysis, and optimization are cultivated. The specific objectives of the course are as follows: Course Goal 1: Understand the organizational structure and working principle of the computer hardware system, with the computer hardware system cognitive ability; Students can design and implement the basic components of computer system (i.e., Cache, ALU) and improve the ability of hardware system design. Course Goal 2: Learn the effect of hardware on the whole computer system; Understand the performance of the computer hardware system quantitative analysis approach; Understand the optimization approach of the computer hardware system design and the optimization approach of the software system based on the hardware characters; Able to propose the performance optimization plan for the whole computer system. Course Goal 3: Understand the main research directions related to modern computer architecture; Know the new theory and new technology related to the hardware system of computer science through network or document retrieval; Able to write the related analysis report.

default.zh: 《人工智能的数学基础》是人工智能专业的一门专业核心课程，期望通过课程能使学生扎实掌握人工智能技术背后的数理基础，能够深入理解智能算法的本质，为后续各门课程的学习打下必要的数学知识铺垫，提高大家运用已有的数学工具来构建智能算法的能力。人工智能面向实际应用，需要对现实世界中的具体任务进行建模，并进行求解，其中最基本的建模就是线性逼近，最后转化为AX=b的方程组，对实际应用中的这种形式方程进行优化地、可计算的求解，在数学思维和计算思维之间进行切换，构建可用的算法是解决实际应用的关键。本课程将主要关注问题的数学表达及其优化求解，掌握基本的数学工具，培养使用工具解决实际问题的能力。通过学习，同学们将掌握AI中先进算法之后的数学思维，以及理解实际求解中使用的计算方法，并具备解决AI应用中典型问题的能力。在此基础上，能够具备对AI系统以及关键技术与算法进行分析与评价的能力。能够阅读最新的AI技术方面的论文，从而能够理解AI系统后面所涉及的本质数学问题及求解思路。
default.en: "Essential Mathematics for Artificial Intelligence" is a core professional course for artificial intelligence majors. It is expected that through this course, students can have a solid grasp of the mathematical basis in artificial intelligence technology, deeply understand the nature of intelligent algorithms, lay the necessary mathematical knowledge for the subsequent study of various courses, and improve their ability to use existing mathematical tools to build intelligent algorithms. For practical applications, artificial intelligence needs to model specific tasks in the real world and solve them. The most basic modeling is linear approximation, which is finally converted into equations of AX=b, and optimally and computationally solve this formal equation in practical applications, switching between mathematical thinking and computational thinking. Building stable and usable algorithms is the key to solving practical applications. This course will focus on the mathematical expression of problems and its optimal solution, master the basic mathematical tools, and cultivate the ability to use tools to solve practical problems. Through learning, students will master the mathematical thinking behind the advanced algorithms in AI, understand the calculation methods used in practical solutions, and have the ability to solve typical problems in AI applications. On this basis, it can have the ability to analyze and evaluate AI systems and key technologies and algorithms. Be able to read the latest papers on AI technology, so as to understand the essential mathematical problems involved in AI systems and their solution ideas.

default.zh: 模式识别与机器学习是人工智能的一个重要研究分支，是计算机学科学术研究和应用研究之间的重要桥梁，它在计算机各领域都有广泛的应用。其在诸如自然语言处理、计算机视觉、语音处理及各种科学与社会系统等应用中起着核心作用。本课程旨在培养学生针对数据智能分析的数学建模及模型求解能力，了解并初步掌握“问题——数学建模（概率意义下的数据表示与处理）——模型学习（优化算法）”的思想和方法。通过学习，使学生能够利用机器学习基本方法，常用模型及其求解算法，并根据具体问题设计并实现合理的智能数据分析算法及系统；掌握解决一般智能问题（如聚类、分类及特征表示）的形式化方法；掌握具体问题抽象化、复杂问题简单化的基本思想；熟练应用相关模型、算法；具备利用机器学习方法建立模式识别系统的能力；具备根据理论及实验结果分析相关模型和算法效果的能力；具备利用机器学习工具进行问题描述、建模及求解的素质；
default.en: Pattern recognition and machine learning are important research branches of artificial intelligence, serving as a bridge between academic and applied research in computer science. They have extensive applications in various fields of computer science. It plays a core role in applications such as natural language processing, computer vision, speech processing, and various scientific and social systems. This course aims to cultivate students' mathematical modeling and model solving abilities for intelligent data analysis, and to understand and initially master the ideas and methods of "problem mathematical modeling (probabilistic data representation and processing) - model learning (optimization algorithms)".Through learning, students can utilize basic machine learning methods, commonly used models and their solving algorithms, and design and implement reasonable intelligent data analysis algorithms and systems based on specific problems; Master formal methods for solving general intelligence problems, such as clustering, classification, and feature representation; Master the basic idea of abstracting specific problems and simplifying complex problems; Proficient in applying relevant models and algorithms; Ability to establish pattern recognition systems using machine learning methods; Ability to analyze the effectiveness of relevant models and algorithms based on theoretical and experimental results; Have the ability to use machine learning tools for problem description, modeling, and solving;

default.zh: “知识表示与推理”课程面向人工智能专业三年级学生开设。本课程旨在介绍知识表示与推理的基本理论、基本知识和基本技术。知识表示与推理是人工智能领域中的典型问题，通过知识对信息世界中的信息进行组织，从而使计算机系统可以解决复杂的任务。 网络中的无结构化文本数据中蕴含着丰富的知识，这些知识能够有效的帮助提升人工智能应用的性能。本门课程即围绕着网络中知识的获取、知识的组织和知识的表示等几个方面展开。通过介绍命名实体识别、关系挖掘、属性填充等技术方案使学生了解并掌握如何去利用机器自动构建中等规模的知识图谱，同时通过介绍知识表示、知识查询等多项技术向学生揭示知识图谱的使用方案，使学生掌握如何使机器能够便捷的组织、管理和查询知识图谱，以及利用知识图谱辅助其他人工智能应用提升其性能。总而言之，本门课程旨在向学生揭示知识的组织方式、查询方式和使用方式。
default.en: The course "Knowledge Representation and Reasoning" is offered to third-year students majoring in artificial intelligence. This course aims to introduce the basic theories, basic knowledge and basic techniques of knowledge representation and reasoning. Knowledge representation and reasoning are typical problems in the field of artificial intelligence. Information in the information world is organized through knowledge, so that computer systems can solve complex tasks. There are tremendous unstructured texts in the web, which contains lots of useful knowledge. This kind of knowledge can help improve the capacities of many artificial intelligent systems. This course then focuses on a series of topics including how to acquire knowledge from web, how to organize knowledge, and how to represent knowledge. Via telling students the techniques about name entity recognition, relation extraction, and attribute completion, the students know how to use machine to construct medium-scale knowledge graph, and simultaneously, via telling students the techniques about knowledge representation and knowledge searching, the students know the strategy of using knowledge graph. Besides, via the told techniques, the students also understand how to make machine organize, manage, and search knowledge graph, and how to use knowledge graph to improve the performance of other intelligent applications. In summary, this course aims at revealing the organizing mode, the searching strategy and the using method of knowledge.

default.zh: 软件工程专业导论课是为软件工程专业本科生开设的专业入门课程。本课程通过对软件工程专业范畴及其相关知识、技术内涵的介绍，使学生认知软件工程及其专业学科、知识体系和主要技术等，对于软件工程专业有较全面的初步认识，了解人工智能及大模型对软件工程的影响，为后续专业学习打下良好基础。本课程主要内容包括：软件工程基本概念、软件工程技术体系与知识体系、软件工程专业范畴与学科内涵、大模型对软件工程的影响、软件体系结构、软件生命周期与基本软件过程、软件需求工程、结构化分析方法与面向对象的分析方法、软件设计与开发方法、软件实现与编码、敏捷软件开发方法、软件测试与软件维护、软件工程过程与项目管理、软件质量保证、软件工程专业教育、软件工程人才的知识/能力/素质与职业发展、软件工程实践、大模型对于软件工程的影响等。 本课程以理论教学为主，适度结合软件工程实践，使学生初步掌握软件工程基本过程、方法、技术、项目管理及实践，学会运用软件工程技术解决复杂工程问题，提高其软件工程的系统分析方法及软件设计与实现能力。本课程还涉及软件工程教育与职业发展，使学生了解软件产业人才需求、软件工程人才成长要素与职业发展途径，提高终身学习能力和综合素质，为软件产业发展与科技强国做贡献。
default.en: The course, Introduction to Software Engineering Program, is an entrance course for the undergraduate students of software engineering. Through introducing the concepts, knowledge-body and techniques of software engineering, this course enables students to know software engineering, and set up a base for their next study phases. This course includes the following contents, such as basic concepts, scopes, techniques and knowledge-body of software engineering, software architecture, software life-cycle and processes, software requirement engineering, structural modeling and analysis methods, object-oriented model analysis methods, software design and development methods, software implementation and coding, agile software development methods, software testing and maintenance, software engineering project management, software quality assurance, software engineering education, knowledge/ability/quality and professional development of software engineers, software engineering practice, the impact of LLMs on software engineering, etc. Through combination of theoretical teaching/learning and practical exercise in the course, the students can learn basic processes, methods and techniques of software engineering, promote their practical ability to analyze, design and implement software systems，to apply software engineering knowledge in solving complicated engineering problems, and to manage software projects. This course deals with education and professional development of software engineering, in order to help students to know the demands of software industry, the required abilities and the development way, and to contribute to development of software industry and technological powerhouse through life-time learning.

default.zh: 《软件构造》是计算机大类/软件工程大类的一门重要的专业基础课程，目的是使学生在高级语言程序设计的基础上，认识软件构造的质量标准与目标，学习软件构造的基本过程，深入学习抽象数据类型与面向对象编程（OOP），初步掌握面向关键质量目标（安全性、可维护性、可复用性、健壮性、正确性等）的软件构造基本技术，从而具备面向质量目标的复杂软件构造方法与能力。 课程由四部分构成。第一部分是软件构造基础（主要介绍软件构造的多维度视图、软件构造的质量目标、软件生命周期模型、软件构造过程、软件配置管理与版本控制）。第二部分是抽象数据类型与面向对象编程，主要学习数据类型与类型检查、函数规约、抽象数据类型、面向对象编程，以及ADT和OOP中的等价性）。第三部分是面向可复用性和可维护性的软件构造方法与技术（包括可复用性的度量标准、可复用内容的层次与对外发布的形态、可复用类的设计与构造、面向可维护性的OO设计与构造原则SOLID、面向复用性和可维护性的典型设计模式、正则表达式和语法驱动的编程）。第四部分是面向健壮性的软件构造方法与技术（学习健壮性与正确性的概念和度量、异常与错误处理、断言与防御性编程，以及典型的软件测试方法与技术）。
default.en: "Software Construction" is an important foundational course for the Computer Science/Software Engineering major. The course aims to help students build upon their knowledge of advanced programming languages, understand the quality standards and goals of software construction, learn the fundamental processes of software construction, delve into abstract data types and object-oriented programming (OOP), and gain a preliminary grasp of software construction techniques aligned with key quality objectives (such as safety, maintainability, reusability, robustness, correctness, etc.), thereby developing the ability to construct complex software with a focus on quality objectives. The course consists of four parts. The first part covers the foundations of software construction, including multidimensional views of software construction, quality objectives of software construction, software life cycle models, software construction processes, and software configuration management and version control. The second part focuses on abstract data types and object-oriented programming, covering topics such as data types and type checking, function specifications, abstract data types, object-oriented programming, as well as equivalences in ADT and OOP. The third part explores software construction methods and techniques for reusability and maintainability, encompassing metrics for reusability, hierarchical levels and forms of reusable content, design and construction of reusable classes, SOLID principles for maintainable OO design and construction, typical design patterns for reusability and maintainability, as well as regular expressions and grammar-driven programming. The fourth part delves into software construction methods and techniques for robustness, including concepts and metrics for robustness and correctness, exception and error handling, assertions and defensive programming, as well as typical software testing methods and techniques.

default.zh: 本课程是软件工程专业的一门专业选修课程，教学内容围绕软件开发过程的需求获取、需求分析、系统分析、系统设计等内容进行组织。教学重点内容是系统分析与系统设计的建模技术和方法。 通过该课程的学习，学生能够理解软件工程思想，掌握软件需求分析、系统分析和系统设计的模型和建模方法，具备运用工程化的思想完成复杂软件系统的分析与设计能力，同时具备撰写需求规格说明书、系统设计说明书等规范化文档的能力。
default.en: This course is an elective course for software engineering majors. The teaching contents are organized around the requirements acquisition, requirements analysis, system analysis, system design and other contents in the software development process. The teaching focuses on the modeling techniques and methods of system analysis and system design. Through the study of this course, students can understand the idea of software engineering, master the models and modeling methods of software requirements analysis, system analysis and system design, have the ability to complete the analysis and design of complex software systems with the idea of engineering, and have the ability to write standardized documents such as requirements specification and system design specification.

default.zh: 一、课程基本信息 课程代码： 22CS32713 课程名称： 网络攻防技术B 总学时： 32 理论学时：32 实验学时： 上机学时： 实践学时： 课外辅导学时： 学分： 2 开课单位：计算学部 授课对象：信息安全专业等 本科 开课学期：2春 先修课程：信息安全概论、信息安全程序设计实践 二、课程简介 网络攻防技术A是一门面向网络空间安全及信息安全专业开设的专业课程，目的是让学生通过学习网络攻防理论及进行相关攻防实践，理解掌握网络攻防基本技术原理及思路，掌握常用的网络安全工具，具有解决网络安全中常见攻防问题的能力。 课程内容主要包括网络安全态势、网络安全历史、网络安全法律法规介绍、网络脆弱性分析、信息收集、Web漏洞攻击、SQL注入攻击、软件安全、逆向分析技术、PWN等内容，要求学生在掌握网络攻防原理与技术同时，熟练使用相关安全工具。
default.en: Introduction to Network Attack and Defense Technology B 1. General Information Course Code：22CS32713 Course Title：Network Attack and Defense Technology B Credit Hours：32 Lecture：32 Lab： Computer Lab: Practical: Tutoring: Credit(s)： 2 Offering Department: Faculty of Computing Students: Information Security etc.，Undergraduates Term: Spring, Second year Prerequisites: Introduction to Information Security, Practice in Information Security Program Design 2. Course Description Network Attack and Defense Technology is a professional course designed for the majors of cyberspace security and information security. The purpose is to enable students to understand and master the basic technical principles and ideas of network attack and defense, master commonly used network security tools, and have the ability to solve common attack and defense problems in network security by studying network attack and defense theory and conducting relevant attack and defense practices. The course content mainly includes network security situation, network security history, introduction to network security laws and regulations, network vulnerability analysis, information collection, web vulnerability attacks, SQL injection attacks, software security, reverse analysis technology, PWN and other contents. Students are required to master the principles and technologies of network attack and defense, and skillfully use relevant security tools.

default.zh: 互联网基础设施是互联网运转必不可少的系统集合，关键互联网基础设施主要包括域名系统（Domain Name System，DNS）和域际路由系统（Border Gateway Protocol，BGP）。互联网是网络空间的主要载体，保障互联网基础设施安全也是保障网络空间安全、维护网络主权的关键。全面、深入地掌握互联网基础设施的攻防方法及原理是对网络空间安全人才的重要需求。本课程涵盖4个部分：互联网体系与安全，域名系统安全，域间路由安全，安全思维与新进展。每个部分教学内容都涉及3个方面：原理与系统、安全分析、安全防护。本课程从互联网体系的设计出发，揭示网络体系和协议的设计与安全性之间的内在联系，介绍相关的安全性分析方法，进而结合具体安全事件对维系互联网正常运行所必不可少的DNS和BGP协议及实际系统进行原理及安全性介绍，同时介绍如何使用ping、traceroute、dig等常见网络工具进行安全分析实操。通过学习本课程，你将从安全的角度重新认识互联网体系和网络协议，并认识到通信需求和安全需求之间存在着天然的矛盾；你将具备互联网基础设施安全思维，能够使用理论和工具的分析互联网基础设施系统的安全性，并解读相关安全事件。
default.en: Internet infrastructure is a collection of systems that are essential for the operation of the Internet. The key Internet infrastructure mainly includes the Domain Name System (DNS) and the Border Gateway Protocol, (BGP). The Internet is the main carrier of cyberspace, and ensuring the security of Internet infrastructure is also the key to safeguarding cyberspace security and maintaining cyber sovereignty. A comprehensive and in-depth grasp of the attack and defense methods and principles of Internet infrastructure is an important demand for cyberspace security talents. This course covers 4 parts: Internet system and security, domain name system security, inter-domain routing security, and security thinking and new developments. Each part of the teaching content involves three aspects: principles and systems, safety analysis, and safety protection. Starting from the design of the Internet system, this course reveals the internal relationship between the design and security of the network system and protocols, introduces relevant security analysis methods, and then, alongside the introduction of specific security events, introduces the principle and security of the DNS and BGP protocol as well as the actual system, which are critical for maintaining the normal operation of the Internet. At the same time, this course introduces how to use common network tools such as ping, traceroute, and dig to conduct security analysis and practical operations. By studying this course, you will re-understand the Internet system and network protocols from the perspective of security, and realize that there is a natural contradiction between communication requirements and security requirements; you will develop infrastructure security thinking, be able to analyze the security of Internet infrastructure systems both from a theoretical perspective and by using tools, be able to interpret relevant security events.

default.zh: 本课程旨在培养学生具备作为网络工程师的基本素质。通过本课程的学习使学生掌握网络工程设计所涵盖的基本知识，并具备划分、设计、组织与管理网络的能力。掌握基本网络介质和经典网络设备的使用。 本课程突出实践教学，课堂教学为实践教学服务。在实践教学中，强调学生自主动手进行交换机、路由器等网络设备的配置与管理；保证学生完成课程学习后能够掌握网络管理与设计的基本技能，具备一定的组网经验，如：网络划分、路由、网络管理与控制等。
default.en: This course aims to make students qualified as network engineers. Through this course, students can understand some knowledge about network engineering design, have the ability of organizing, designing and managing network and know how to use network media and classical network equipment. This course focuses on experiment, and in-class teaching serves for experiment. In experiments, students will configure and manage switch and router themselves, and master the basic skills of network management and design, and have some experiences of network construction, such as network assignment, routing, network management and control.

default.zh: Web开发技术是软件工程专业的选修课。设置本课程的主要目的是培养学生掌握Web开发所需的技术，能够独立开发基本的Web应用。本课程的主要讲授内容包括Web前端的HTML、CSS、JavaScript、jQuery和React（或Vue），以及Web后端Java JDBC、Servlet和SpringBoot。 本课程以教师讲授为主，学生课后自学为辅。授课时采用较多的课堂演示、师生互动。实验课方面采用以练代讲的方式，加强学生动手能力的训练及注重实践编程能力的培养。 课程考核方法包括个人独立完成的多个实验和团队完成的大作业两个部分。
default.en: Web development technology is an elective course for software engineering major. The main purpose of this course is to prepare students to master the technology required for Web development and be able to independently develop basic Web applications. The main content of this course includes HTML, CSS, JavaScript, jQuery and React(or Vue) on the Web front end, and Java JDBC, Servlet and SpringBoot on the Web back end. This course is mainly taught by teachers, supplemented by students' self-study after class. In teaching, more classroom demonstrations and teacher-student interaction are used. In the experimental course, we use the way of practice to teach on behalf of students to strengthen the training of practical ability and focus on the cultivation of practical programming ability. The course assessment method includes two parts: multiple experiments completed by individuals and large assignments completed by teams.

default.zh: 《航天智能制造系统与应用》是一门为软件工程专业的学生设计的课程，专注于工业软件技术。本课程的目标是帮助学生理解工业领域中航天智能制造系统的主要技术和特点，并掌握相关的方法。这将为学生未来开发工业软件和实施工业信息化系统打下坚实的基础。 课程的理论目标是让学生掌握航天智能制造系统的特点和关键技术。具体来说，学生将学习航天制造领域的系统工程方法，了解目前航天领域复杂系统的研发模式，掌握基于数字线程的系统全生命周期管理方法，以及基于数字孪生的复杂航天装备设计制造流程。 此外，本课程还旨在培养学生的工程意识和系统观，树立以人为本、科学管理的思想，提高他们运用数学解决复杂问题的能力，并培养他们良好的职业精神。总的来说，这门课程旨在通过理论和实践的结合，为学生在航天智能制造领域的未来职业生涯做好全面的准备。
default.en: Aerospace Intelligent Manufacturing Systems and Applications" is an elective course designed for students majoring in software engineering, focusing on industrial software technology. The goal of this course is to help students understand the main technologies and characteristics of aerospace intelligent manufacturing systems in the industrial sector, and to master related methods. This will lay a solid foundation for students' future development of industrial software and implementation of industrial information systems. The theoretical objectives of the course are to enable students to grasp the characteristics and key technologies of aerospace intelligent manufacturing systems. Specifically, students will learn system engineering methods in the field of aerospace manufacturing, understand the current research and development patterns of complex systems in the aerospace field, master the method of system lifecycle management based on digital threads, and the process of designing and manufacturing complex aerospace equipment based on digital twins. In addition, this course also aims to cultivate students' engineering consciousness and systems perspective, establish a people-oriented, scientifically managed mindset, improve their ability to use mathematics to solve complex problems, and cultivate their professional spirit. Overall, this course aims to provide comprehensive preparation for students' future careers in the field of aerospace intelligent manufacturing through a combination of theory and practice.

default.zh: 《GPU计算》是哈尔滨工业大学计算机大类/软件工程大类的一门专业课程。当前我们进入了众核时代，一块普通家用显卡GTX780就包含2304个GPU核心。计算机软件面临着最大的变迁问题——从串行、单线程的问题求解方法切换到多线程同时执行的问题求解方法。 本课程目的是使学生了解GPU/AI处理器的基本设计理念，理解GPU/AI处理器计算模型，掌握面向GPU和AI处理器的软件设计、实现和调优技术， 培养学生面向实际计算密集型问题的并行处理器程序设计思维和能力。
default.en: GPU Computing is a selective course for general CS and SE students. We are arriving at a many-core era. You can find 2,304 GPU cores in a regular GTX 780 display card. We are facing a most indispensable challenging in software engineering, that is, a transfer from serial single-thread mode to simultaneous multi-thread mode. This course is practice-intensive with significant constractive learning, coding, experiments, writing, and presenting. NVIDIA GPU/Huawei Ascend AI Processor and the CUDA/CANN programming tools are used in the practice section of the course. Many have reported success in performing general-purpose parallel computation as well as neural network based artificial intelligence on them. Each programming assignment will involve successively more sophisticated programming skills. The experiments will be of your own design, with the requirement that the project must involve a demanding application such as data-intensive computation, followed by some form of visualization and display of results.

default.zh: 中文信息处理是面向计算机相关专业本科生的一门选修课。中文信息处理是指用计算机对中文的音、形、义等信息进行处理和加工。中文信息处理是自然语言信息处理的一个分支，是人工智能的重要研究内容，是一门与计算机科学、语言学、数学、信息学、声学、心理学等多种学科相关联的综合性学科。随着互联网的广泛普及，中文信息处理广泛应用于人机交互、信息传播、舆情分析、电子商务、决策支持、信息安全等领域，对推动中国信息产业发展、促进中外文化交流、繁荣中国传统文化具有重要作用。中文信息处理分为汉字信息处理与汉语信息处理两部分。本课程的主要内容包括中文编码原理、中文输入输出技术、中文分词方法、统计语言建模、中文词性标注、中文句法分析、汉英机器翻译、问答系统、以及知识推理、深度学习、语言大模型在中文信息处理中的应用等。目的是使学生掌握中文信息处理的主要方法和基本理论,了解中文语言处理研究的最新发展动态、主要研究对象及所面临的问题，为将来从事中文信息处理技术研究与系统开发奠定扎实的基础。
default.en: Chinese Information Processing is a professional course for undergraduate students majoring in computer science. Chinese Information Processing is refered to as processing pronunciation, form and meaning of Chinese Language using computer, which is a branch of natural language processing, an important area of artificial intelligence, and is an interdiscipline of computer science, linguistics, mathematics, information theory, acoustics and psychology. With development of Internet, Chinese Information Processing is widely used in human-machine interaction, information dissemination, public opinion analysis, electronic commerce, decision support, and information safety, etc.. and plays important role in promoting Chinese information industry, propelling international cultural exchange, and flourishing Chinese traditional culture. Contents of this course include: Chinese character coding, principle of Chinese character input and output, Chinese word segmentation, statistical language modeling, Chinese part-of-speech tagging, Chinese parsing, Chinese-English machine translation, question and answering, and applications of knowledge inference, deep learning and big language model on Chinese Information Processing. The aim of this course is to make students grasp main methodology and fundamental theory of Chinese Information processing, understand research status, research objects of and problems confronted in Chinese information processing and to establish the foundation for future work on research and engineering in this area.

default.zh: 《计算机体系结构D》重点介绍计算机系统各种基本结构、设计技术和性能分析方法，使学生掌握计算机体系结构设计的核心要素。通过设计实现计算机硬件系统中的主要部件（例如CPU、Cache等），并采用量化方法对性能进行分析，培养学生计算机设计、调试、实现、分析及优化的能力。 课程具体目标如下： 课程目标1：理解计算机系统软硬件功能分配和分界面的确定，掌握计算机体系结构的基本概念和基本原理，建立计算机系统的完整概念，掌握计算机硬件系统的基本设计和分析方法，理解并掌握计算机软硬件系统协同设计方法，能够设计并实现计算机硬件的主要部件（例如缓存、运算器等），能够应用工程基础知识解决复杂工程问题。 课程目标2：理解计算机软硬件对计算机系统性能的影响，掌握计算机软硬件系统性能的量化分析方法，掌握计算机硬件系统设计的优化方法以及基于硬件特点优化软件系统的方法，能够对整个计算机系统进行性能优化,能够设计满足特定需求的系统。 课程目标3：通过文献检索，阅读计算机体系结构领域的相关文献，了解计算机体系结构的发展趋势，能够分析和评价新应用、新技术、新材料对计算机体系结构发展的影响，并完成相关的分析报告，能够应用工程科学基本原理，并通过文献研究分析复杂工程问题。
default.en: This course provides an introduction of basic computer components, computer design technology, and performance analysis methods, enabling students to master the core elements of computer architecture design. By designing and implementing the main components of computer hardware systems (such as CPU, Cache, etc.), and using quantitative methods to analyze performance, students' abilities in computer design, debugging, implementation, analysis, and optimization are cultivated. The specific objectives of the course are as follows: Course Goal 1: Understand the organizational structure and working principle of the computer hardware system, with the computer hardware system cognitive ability; Students can design and implement the basic components of computer system (i.e., Cache, ALU) and improve the ability of hardware system design. Course Goal 2: Learn the effect of hardware on the whole computer system; Understand the performance of the computer hardware system quantitative analysis approach; Understand the optimization approach of the computer hardware system design and the optimization approach of the software system based on the hardware characters; Able to propose the performance optimization plan for the whole computer system. Course Goal 3: Understand the main research directions related to modern computer architecture; Know the new theory and new technology related to the hardware system of computer science through network or document retrieval; Able to write the related analysis report.

default.zh: 计算建模在现代计算机科学中起着重要的作用，是计算机大类的一门专业核心课程。在现代计算机科学与技术中面临复杂的科学与工程问题，其中复杂的结构化和非结构化大数据普遍存在。要想快速有效的解决这样的复杂大数据问题，首先需要为实际问题抽象出数学模型，并能够形式化描述问题的本质和规律。本课程所包括的随机化和概率统计技术能够给建模、分析和处理这些大数据，提供强有力的描述工具和技术手段。计算建模的应用范围包括机器学习、安全协议、大数据处理、生物计算和人工智能应用等相关领域。课程核心内容包括随机变量分布和密度函数、随机采样、参数估计、经典的随机过程、随机数生成与蒙特卡洛方法、马尔科夫链和随机游走、随机模拟、随机场等内容。对连续和离散随机信号的分析和计算方法进行了全面的介绍。课程在介绍随机计算理论的基础上，对相关理论和技术的数值计算和模拟，以及对其中经典算法在现代计算机科学与技术中的实际应用也进行了较详细的描述。通过本课程的学习，学生对随机信号及处理有充分的理论储备，对后续的随机算法和其它课程的学习有很好的铺垫。课程适用于高年级本科生和研究生。
default.en: Computation modelling plays an important role in modern computer science. It is a professional kernel curriculum. There are many structural and non-structural big data in complex engineering problems in modern computer. In order to solve these problems effectively and efficiently, it is necessary that you can model these problems into mathematical formal representation and simulate them by computational methods. Randomizing and probability statistics techniques in this course provide the powerful tools and technical methods to model, analyze and process these big data. It is commonly used in machine learning, secure protocols, big data processing, biometrics computing and artificial intelligence et. al. Its main contents include random variable distribution and density function, random sampling techniques, parameters estimation, classical random process, random number generation, Monte Carlo methods, Markov chains and random walks, random simulation, random fields and so on. It not only introduces the analysis and computation methods of continuous and discrete signal but also describes the numerical computation and simulation techniques. In addition, it also takes some practical applications in computer science as examples to demonstrate the power of random computing. All in all, this course gives a rigorous yet accessible treatment of the related topics in random signal processing. With its comprehensive selection of topics, along with many examples and exercises, this course is an indispensable for continuing learning other related courses, such as random algorithms.

default.zh: 本课程围绕随机算法设计与分析的理论、方法和技术展开。随机算法在近二十多年来从单纯的数论理论演变成为一整套工具和技术，并被越来越多地应用到各种信息技术中。随机算法的三大特性：简洁性、高效性和健壮性正是这种演变的源动力。本课程旨在为本科学生介绍高级算法的基本概念、随机算法设计和分析的主要技术和工具，以及随机算法的典型应用。 课程以随机算法设计和分析技术和工具作为主线，穿插随机算法的典型应用。要讲授的技术和工具主要包括：博弈论技术、矩与方差、球与箱子模型、概率方法、马尔科夫链与随机游走、蒙特卡罗方法、代数技术等；而主要应用包括网页去重、随即图、流算法、在线算法等。
default.en: The last twenty five years have witnessed a tremendous growth in the area of randomized algorithms. During this period, randomized algorithms have gone from being a tool in computational number theory to a mainstream set of tools and techniques with widespread application. Three benefits of randomization have spearheaded this growth: simplicity, speed, and robustness to input parameters. This course presents the basic concepts in the design and analysis of randomized algorithms at a level accessible to advanced undergraduates and to graduate students. The course will be organized into two interleaved parts. The first thread will develop basic probabilistic tools that are recurrent in algorithmic applications. The second thread will focus on specific areas of application. Applications will be given along with each tool to illustrate it in concrete settings. The following is a tentative outline of the course. Tools and Techniques:？Basic probability theory; randomized complexity theory; game-theoretic techniques; Markov, Chebyshev, and moment inequalities; limited independence; coupon collection and occupancy problems; tail inequalities and Chernoff bounds; conditional expectation and martingales; Markov chains and random walks; stable distributions; probability amplification. Applications:？ data structures; combinatorial optimization and graph algorithms; online and streaming algorithms; algorithms for massive data sets including similarity search, nearest neighbors, and clustering; number-theoretic algorithms.

default.zh: 随着多核处理器和高性能计算系统的发展，并行计算已经成为计算机科学与工程领域的必要基础之一。本课程介绍并行计算的理论、概念和技术，讨论并行计算机系统结构、并行算法和并行编程方法。主要内容包括：并行计算机的发展和分类，并行程序设计基础，OpenMP、MPI和CUDA等并行编程，并行程序性能分析和优化等。目标是使学生了解并行计算机的系统结构特征和并行计算的基本原理，掌握并行算法的设计、分析和编程实现方法，培养面向高性能计算系统的并行程序设计和优化人才。
default.en: With the development of multi-core processors and high-performance computing systems, parallel computing has become one of the necessary foundations in the field of computer science and engineering. This course introduces the theory, concept and technology of parallel computing, and discusses the system structure, parallel algorithm and parallel programming method of parallel computer. The main contents include the development and classification of parallel computers, basis of parallel programming, parallel programming methods such as OpenMP, MPI and CUDA, parallel program performance analysis and optimization, etc. The goal of this course is to enable students to understand the characteristics of the system architecture of parallel computers and the basic principles of parallel computing, master the design, analysis and programming methods of parallel algorithms, and cultivate talents for parallel programming and optimization of high-performance computing system.

default.zh: 本课程是计算机类的专业辅修课程。本课程主要内容包括：分布式系统的分类、特征、分布式文件系统、分布式事务处理、分布式共识的基本概念与基础理论、典型的分布式共识算法，以及典型的分布式系统；针对分布式通信、分布式计算、基于投票分布式共识等理论方法，结合具体的分布式应用场景进行上机实验，达到理论和实践有机结合，使学生能够从认识理解分布式系统的复杂性与不确定性，掌握布式系统钟同步算法、掌握选举算法、互斥算法、以及典型的分布式共识算法，培养学生针对不同分布式场景问题，选择优化应用分布式算法求解问题能力，提高学生分布式系统修养，为以后科研与实践打下坚实基础。
default.en: This course is minor course in the field of computer science. The main content of this course includes: the classification and characteristics of distributed systems, distributed file systems, distributed transaction processing, fundamental concepts and foundational theories of distributed consensus, typical distributed consensus algorithms, and typical distributed systems. Through hands-on experiments involving theoretical methods such as distributed communication, distributed computing, and voting-based distributed consensus, combined with specific distributed application scenarios, the course aims to achieve an organic integration of theory and practice. This enables students to understand the complexity and uncertainty of distributed systems, master distributed system clock synchronization algorithms, election algorithms, mutual exclusion algorithms, and typical distributed consensus algorithms. It also cultivates students' ability to choose and optimize distributed algorithms for solving problems in different distributed scenarios, enhances their understanding of distributed systems, and lays a solid foundation for future research and practical applications.

default.zh: 人工智能是计算机科学的一个分支，是一门研究机器智能的学科，即用人工的方法和技术，研制智能机器或智能系统来模仿、延伸和扩展人的智能，实现智能行为。它与生物工程和空间技术被称为当今世界的三大尖端技术，在高技术领域具有十分广泛而重要的作用。该课程的学习旨在掌握人工智能的基本概念和研究方法及其未来的发展趋势，为以后在该领域的深入研究打下基础。本课程要求学生学会知识的不同表示方法，了解各种表示方法的优缺点，在面临具体问题时可以选取合适的方法对问题进行表示。本课程以程序语言作为算法描述的工具，本课程要求在数理逻辑的经典谓词逻辑以及贝叶斯网络的基础上，学会不同的推理方法，并能够利用不同的方法实现推理。课程最终需要让学生在学会推理策略的基础上，利用不同的搜索策略（如盲目搜索与启发式搜索）对问题进行求解，并掌握不同的搜索方法的优缺点，并了解机器学习深度学习的基本方法。
default.en: Artificial intelligence is an interdiscipline. It is related to computer science, brain science, neurophysiology, psychology, linguistics, logic, cognitive science, thought science, behavioral science and mathematics. In addition, it is also related to information theory, control theory and systems theory etc. In this course, we give the basic theory and basic method of artificial intelligence. It contains knowledge representation, machine reasoning techniques, logic refutation principle, searching algorithm of graphs, production system and expert system, machine learning and application of artificial intelligence.

default.zh: 本课程是自动化专业，测控专业，生物医学工程专业的选修课，本课程主要目的是使学生初步了解脑-机接口（BCI）的基本原理和应用，为后续深入研究打下基础。通过本课程的学习，学生可以了解BCI使用的不同类型的大脑信号，了解BCI系统的每个组件以及命令控制的应用；熟悉BCI的主要类型，并掌握信号采集、处理、特征提取和转化的基本原理，熟悉现有BCI的具体原理和实现方法。
default.en: This course is an elective for majors in Automation, Measurement and Control, and Biomedical Engineering. Its primary objective is to provide students with a foundational understanding of the basic principles and applications of brain-computer interfaces (BCIs), laying the groundwork for further in-depth study. Through this course, students will learn about the various types of brain signals used in BCIs, the components of BCIs and their command-control applications; familiarize themselves with the main types of BCIs, and grasp the fundamental principles of signal acquisition, processing, feature extraction, and transformation. They will also become acquainted with the specific principles and implementation methods of existing BCIs.

default.zh: 信息检索技术是自然语言处理中的一个重要的内容，在自动文摘、情感分析、智能问答、用户画像等领域有着重要的应用，为学生们后续从事与自然语言处理技术相关的科研工作打下基础。本课程是一门针对高年级本科生的专业课，主要讲授信息检索基本模型及相关理论。课程的内容包括：经典的信息检索模型，如布尔模型、向量空间模型等；检索技术的评价方法和评价指标；文本处理和查询扩展等相关技术；索引的建立方法及检索过程中采用的一些数据结构及方法；针对互联网的Web检索技术及排序。本课程可以帮助学生了解信息检索技术的基本概念、发展历史及其在未来工作中的应用，掌握基础的信息检索理论和相关技术，结合人工智能、机器学习、语言处理技术对信息进行加工处理，并能够对系统进行合理的评价与分析。为学生今后设计、开发基于检索技术的应用系统奠定技术基础，提高学生形式化思维、建模的能力。
