Goal 1 focuses on building a thorough understanding of network architecture and core protocol principles, cultivating students' ability to apply network knowledge to analyze practical problems. Goal 2 emphasizes literature retrieval and technical review writing, guiding students to track cutting-edge developments in intelligent networking—particularly reinforcement learning-based network design—by consulting international frontier research papers and writing technical review reports, thereby enhancing their synthesis skills and academic perspective. The teaching methodology integrates heuristic, interactive, and case-based approaches. Teachers guide students through progressively structured question chains, transitioning them from passive knowledge reception to active exploration, thereby building systematic logical thinking frameworks. Collaborative learning through group discussions and presentations nurtures teamwork skills and communication abilities. Assessment is diversified to comprehensively evaluate students' depth of understanding and engineering practical capabilities.

default.zh: 一、课程基本信息 课程代码： 22EI32181F 课程名称： 信息处理的数学基础 总学时：32 理论学时：24 实验学时：8 学分：2.0 开课单位：电子与信息工程学院 授课对象：智能信息工程辅修专业 开课学期：2秋 先修课程：工科数学分析、代数与几何 二、课程简介 信息处理的数学基础是智能信息工程辅修专业一门基础课，其内容是通过提炼智能信息工程专业课程中所涉及的主要数学知识，并不失严谨性和准确性地有机融合在一起而形成，其基本概念、基本理论与基本方法在电子信息类学科中都发挥着重要作用。 本课程的教学目的是为辅修智能信息工程专业的学生打好数学基础，为其学习智能信息工程专业的后续课程提供必要的数学支撑。通过理论学习，使学生能够正确地理解智能信息工程专业所涉及的基本数学概念，启发学生的学习兴趣，培养学生的数学思维和创新能力，使学生具备较强的运用基础理论知识分析、解决实际问题的能力。
default.en: 1.General Information Course Code：22EI32181F Course Title：Mathematical Foundations for Information Processing Credit Hours：32 Lecture：24 Lab：8 Credit(s)：2.0 Offering Department: School of Electronics and Information Engineering Students: Intelligent Information Engineering Term: Fall, Second year; Open Prerequisites: Mathematical Analysis for Engineering, Algebra and Geometry 2.Course Description Mathematical Foundations for Information Processing is a basic course of the minor in intelligent information engineering. Its content is formed by refining the main mathematical knowledge involved in the courses of intelligent information engineering, without any rigor and accuracy. Basic concepts, basic theories, and basic methods of this course play an important role in the electronic information discipline. The aim of this course is to lay a solid foundation for students majoring in intelligent information engineering, and to provide necessary mathematical support for students to study the follow-up courses of intelligent information engineering. Through theoretical study, the course makes students correctly understand the basic mathematical concepts involved in the major in intelligent information engineering, inspires students' interest in learning, cultivates students' mathematical thinking and innovative ability, and equips students with the ability to apply basic theoretical knowledge to analyze and solve practical problems.

default.zh: 电子对抗技术B是电子信息工程专业的专业选修课。本课程主要讲授电子对抗的基本概念、基本理论和技术，课程以雷达对抗为主线，内容涉及通信对抗、光电对抗等领域的部分相关知识。通过教学和实验相结合，让学生既学到相关理论知识，又通过实验获得更多的感性认识，使学生了解电子对抗技术在现代战争中的重要性，培养学生解决电子对抗系统中复杂工程问题的能力。电子对抗技术主要包括电子侦察、电子干扰和电子防护等内容。电子侦察主要讲解如何通过对敌方设备辐射信号的截获、测量、分析、识别及定位，获取技术参数及位置、类型、部署等情报。内容涉及信号环境与信号截获的基本知识、搜索式超外差接收机、信道化接收机、常用测向技术的基本原理、对辐射源的定位等。电子干扰主要介绍有源、无源干扰及干扰机原理，以及降低目标截面积的原理和方法。内容涉及遮盖性干扰、欺骗性干扰、干扰机构成及干扰能量计算等。电子防护包括电子反侦察、抗干扰等相关技术。本课程需要学生掌握电子侦察的基本概念、基本原理以及无线电信号侦察的相关技术；掌握电子干扰的相关原理和技术，了解干扰机的基本组成；掌握电子战中保护己方电子设备的相关技术和基本方法。
default.en: Electronic Countermeasure Technology B is an elective course for electronic information engineering majors. This course mainly teaches the basic concepts, theories, and techniques of electronic countermeasures. The course focuses on radar countermeasures and covers some related knowledge in the fields of communication countermeasures, optoelectronic countermeasures, etc. By combining teaching and experiments, students can learn relevant theoretical knowledge and gain more intuitive understanding through experiments, enabling them to understand the importance of electronic warfare technology in modern warfare and cultivating their ability to solve complex engineering problems in electronic warfare systems. The main content includes electronic reconnaissance, electronic jamming and electronic protection etc. Electronic reconnaissance mainly explains how to intercept, measure, analyze, identify and locate the radiation signal of an enemy equipment, and access to technical parameters, location, type, and deployment information. The content involves basic knowledge of signal environment and signal interception, search based superheterodyne receivers, channelized receivers, basic principles of commonly used direction finding techniques, and localization of radiation sources. Electronic jamming introduces the principles of active and passive interferences and the jammer, as well as the principles and methods that reduce the radar cross section. The content involves covering interference, deceptive interference, interference machine composition, and interference energy calculation. Electronic protection includes electronic anti-reconnaissance, anti-interference technology. In this course, students need to master the basic concepts, the basic principles and the related technologies of radio signal reconnaissance; grasp the principles and techniques of radar interference, understand the basic components of the electronic jammer; master the related technology and basic methods to protect one's own equipment during the electronic warfare.

default.zh: 软件无线电是本世纪初的成熟并发展起来的一项新兴的无线电技术。它利用日益发展的计算机技术，将无线电系统逐步软件化，使得当前无线电系统的功能、结构发生了变革性的变化。这些变化的基本内涵叶同时向其他领域蔓延和扩散，引发了雷达、导航、声纳、生物电子等信息获取与处理系统的根本性变化传。 本课程立足于实际通信、雷达、图像处理等系统，采用理论结合实践方式教学，直接从当今无线电系统实现的先进理念和基本概念入手，着重系统软件化结构、软件化基本方法等原理，着重培养学生软件无线电的基本理论和基本技能，提高综合运用所学专业知识的能力，加强学生对现代无线电技术的理解和应用能力。 课程主要内容包括：软件无线电的基本概念和原理、模型；软件无线电系统的实现方法、系统结构；数字上/下变频技术；数字信号调制及处理算法；软件无线电实际系统构成、系统设计方法；无线传感器软件化典型应用，如软件雷达、认知无线电、多源图像软件融合处理等。
default.en: Being a new essential radio technology, Software defined radio(SDR) plays most of important role in modern radio system. Utilizing computer technologies, SDR transfers classical radio system to an assembled software and makes revolution in many aspects of radio mechanism, such as radio functionality, system structure, and etc. Spreading in information sensing and processing fields, such as radar, sonar, navigation and bioelectronics, the fundamental connotation of SDR has been altering their foundation permanently. This course aims at cultivating SDR skills of student and improving their comprehensive knowledge of excising synthetically. Several primary principles are taught in this course, including basic concepts, principles, mathematical models, implements and structures of SDR, Digital Up/Down Converter and digital signal modulation and processing algorithms, SDR system design and application, software wireless sensor and etc.

default.zh: 电子系统建模与仿真基础是电子信息类I电子信息工程专业本科生的一门重要专业选修课，该课程是以雷达系统为核心的专业课程学习、研究及毕业设计的基础，同时也是帮助学生将“数理与自然科学基础课程”、“大类专业基础课程”、“专业方向核心课程”和“专业方向选修课程”等课程知识有机结合并融会贯通的桥梁，在培养学生分析、解决复杂工程问题的能力及雷达系统综合设计能力等方面占有重要的地位。 本课程以先修课程相关知识为基础，全面地讲述各种统计特性（概率密度函数、功率谱密度）杂波的产生、参数估计及检验方法，并从目标散射模型、雷达信号波形、雷达信号处理等方面介绍雷达系统建模与仿真的基本概念与方法。该课程作为以“随机信号分析”为代表的信号分析与处理系列课程与以“雷达系统”为代表的电子系统应用之间的纽带，主要教学目标是培养学生扎实的系统建模和仿真理论基础，提高综合运用专业知识水平，掌握电子系统仿真的基本原理和方法，支撑专业学习成果中相应指标点的达成，并为从事雷达等复杂电子系统的设计与分析打下坚实基础。
default.en: is a professional selected course for senior undergraduates in electronic and information engineering, which is the fundamental of subsequent courses and graduation project. The course aims to build bridges among the following four types of curriculum system for students: mathematics and physics fundamental courses, major basic courses, professional compulsory courses, professional selected courses. The course introduces generation, parameter estimation and test methods for clutter with specific PDF and PSD, and explores fundamental methods for radar system simulation from target models, radar waveform and radar signal processing etc. Topics covered include: outline of system simulation, radar system simulation types; Monte Carlo method and importance sampling; random white and color noise generation; non-Gaussian coherent clutter generation; clutter parameter and PDF estimation; goodness-of-fit and correlation test; target and clutter models; target detection models; target parameter estimation models; spatial signal and noise models, and beam-forming simulation; radar data processing models, etc.

default.zh: 在互联网、政治经济、社会、公共卫生、金融、医疗健康、环境、海洋等等各个领域，都存在着PB量级的数据有待研究，且大数据分析的结果已经产生实际效应。本课程将从数据统计分析的数学基础、大数据智能分析与处理方法、大数据的分布式处理与并行计算以及大数据的多领域应用等不同层次，教授大数据分析与处理的基本方法、工具及应用。具体内容包括：（1）大数据分析与处理基础：数据科学发展情况；大数据的时代背景及其重要性；大数据分析与处理的典型应用。（2）数据统计分析的数学基础：聚类分析；多维数据分布；主成份分析；线性相关与回归。（3）大数据的智能处理：动态贝叶斯网络；机器学习；支持向量机；大规模数据上的模型应用。（4）大数据的分布式存储、处理与并行计算：HDFS；Hadoop与MapReduce，MapReduce并行计算；基于MapReduce的数据分析与智能处理方法的并行化。（5）大数据的信息融合问题：大数据时代，信息融合是关键。了解和掌握决策与估计理论；完成大数据处理与信息融合问题的模拟和仿真，并进行大数据信息融合性能分析。(6)大数据的可视分析问题：了解并运用已掌握的与人类视认知相一致的图形或者图像知识与软件，生动展示高维数据的内在结构与规律性。
default.en: In various fields such as the Internet, political economy, society, public health, finance, medical health, environment, ocean, etc., there are petabytes of data to be studied, and the results of big data analysis have produced practical effects. This course will teach the basic methods, tools and applications of big data analysis and processing from different levels, such as the mathematical basis of data statistical analysis, the intelligent analysis and processing methods of big data, the distributed processing and parallel computing of big data, and the multi-field application of big data. The specific contents include: (1) the basics of big data analysis and processing: the development of data science; the historical background of big data and its importance; Typical applications of big data analysis and processing. (2) Mathematical basis of statistical analysis of data: cluster analysis; multi-dimensional data distribution; principal component analysis; Linear correlation and regression. (3) Intelligent processing of big data: dynamic Bayesian network; Machine learning; support vector machines; Model applications on large-scale data. (4) Distributed storage, processing and parallel computing of big data: HDFS; Hadoop and MapReduce, MapReduce parallel computing; Parallelization of data analysis and intelligent processing methods based on MapReduce. (5) Information fusion of big data: In the era of big data, information fusion is the key. understand and master the theory of decision making and estimation; Complete the simulation and simulation of big data processing and information fusion problems, and analyze the performance of big data information fusion. (6) Visual analysis of big data: understand and use the knowledge and software of graphics or images that are consistent with human visual cognition to vividly demonstrate the internal structure and regularity of high-dimensional data.

default.zh: FPGA是可重新编程的半导体芯片。利用其内部预制的逻辑资源和可编程布线资源，用户可以将其配置为自己所需的用硬件来实现的各种功能电路。Verilog HDL是硬件描述语言的一种，用于数字电子系统设计。该语言允许设计者进行各种级别的逻辑设计，进行数字逻辑系统的仿真验证、时序分析和逻辑综合。 本课程的目的是为了让学生掌握FPGA应用设计、设计方法和Verilog语言相关技术和知识，为日后从事相关科研工作打下基础。 本课程的主要内容包括FPGA的硬件资源、Verilog HDL语言、数字系统设计和FPGA的开发工作等。 为了让学生掌握FPGA应用设计、设计方法和Verilog语言相关技术和知识，为日后从事相关科研工作打下基础。
default.en: FPGAs are reprogrammable silicon chips. Using prebuilt logic blocks and programmable routing resources, you can configure these resources to implement custom hardware functionality. Verilog HDL is a hardware description language which is used to design digital systems. Using Verilog HDL, you can implement digital logic designs, simulation and analysis. The main purpose of this course is to enable students to master the theoretical knowledge of Verilog HDL and FPGA, and to master the basic design methods with Verilog HDL and FPGA for days after engaged in related research work to lay the foundation. The main contents of the class include the hardware resources in FPGAs, Verilog HDL, digital systems design and Xilinx FPGA development tool.

default.zh: 优化算法基础与应用课程是电子工程系的一门选修课程。优化理论是一个重要的数学分支，它所研究的问题是讨论在众多的方案中什么样的方案最优以及怎样找出最优方案。优化问题在工程技术领域普遍存在，许多实际工程问题都需要用优化算法来解决。本课程主要是系统地讲述优化问题的基本概念和基本理论方法，着重讨论解决无约束优化问题、线性规划问题和有约束的非线性优化问题的基本算法。课程教学从优化理论的基本概念和基本原理入手，结合实践教学环节，培养学生运用所学知识解决实际优化问题的能力，进行工程技术人员所需的基本能力训练，为学生日后从事相关工作奠定坚实的基础。 本课程的教学目标是使学生具备以下能力：1. 掌握优化问题的基本概念和基本理论方法，具体包括无约束优化问题、线性规划问题以及有约束的非线性优化问题的基本特点和经典求解方法；2. 熟悉和掌握优化问题的主要分析和解决方法，熟悉将实际工程问题建模成数学优化问题并求解的基本方法，具备分析和解决实际优化问题的能力；3. 了解优化算法的计算机求解方法，逐步具有应用先进工具解决实际优化问题的能力。
default.en: Fundamentals and Applications of Optimization Algorithms is an elective course of the Department of Electronic Engineering. Optimization theory is an important branch of mathematics. The problem it studies is to discuss what kind of scheme is best in many schemes and how to find the optimal solution. Optimization problems are prevalent in the field of engineering technology, and many practical engineering problems need to be solved by optimization algorithm. This course mainly focuses on the basic concepts and basic theoretical methods of optimization problems, and focuses on the basic algorithms for solving unconstrained optimization problems, linear programming problems and constrained nonlinear optimization problems. The course is based on the basic concepts and basic principles of the optimization theory, combined with the practical teaching procedure, training students to use the knowledge to solve the practical optimization problem. This course is designed to conduct the basic competency training required by engineering and technical personnel to lay a solid foundation for students to carry out related work in the future. The goal of this course is to enable students: 1. To master the basic concepts and basic theoretical methods of the optimization problem, including the basic characteristics of the unconstrained optimization problem, the linear programming problem and the constrained nonlinear optimization problem and the classical solution method; 2. To be familiar with and master the main analysis and solving methods of optimization problems, to be familiar with the basic methods of modelling the practical engineering problems into mathematical optimization problems and solving them, and to have the ability to analyze and solve practical optimization problems; 3. To understand the computer optimization method of solving the optimization algorithm, and to gradually have the ability to apply advanced tools to solve practical optimization problems.

default.zh: 信号采样是联系模拟信源和数字信息的桥梁。人们对信息的巨量需求造成了信号采样、传输和存储的巨大压力。如何缓解这种压力又能有效提取承载在信号中的有用信息是信号与信息处理中急需解决的问题之一。压缩感知技术导论课程是基于近年来国际上提出的压缩感知理论，概述性地讲解为缓解这些压力提供的新颖有效的解决途径。压缩感知是建立在统计概率论、优化理论等基础上的一种全新信息获取与处理的理论框架，它基于信号的可压缩性，通过低维空间、低分辨、欠Nyquist采样数据的非相关观测来实现高维信号的感知。压缩感知不仅让我们重新审视线性问题，而且丰富了关于信号恢复的优化策略，极大促进了数学理论和工程应用的结合。本课程讲解的理论方法可以应用到无线通信、雷达探测、模式识别、图像压缩、图像超分辨重建等众多领域，通过对这门课程的学习，不仅为以后深入学习研究信号处理问题开拓了思路，也为其它学科领域的研究提供了新的契机。
default.en: Sampling is the bridge between analog source signal and digital signal. With the rapid progress of information technologies, the demands for information are increasing dramatically. So the existing system are very difficult to meet the challenges of high speed sampling, large volume data transmission and storage. How to acquire information in signal efficiently is an urgent problem in electronic information fields. Introduction to Compressed Sensing Technology course is from Compressed Sensing theory, which is an emerging theory of signal acquirement in recent years, and provides an overview of novel and effective solutions to alleviate these pressures. Compressed Sensing is a new developed theoretical framework for information acquisition and processing, which is based on optimization and statistical probability theory and so on. The high-dimensional signal can be recovered from the low-dimensional and sub-Nyquist sampling data based on the compressibility of signals. It not only inspires us to survey the linear problem again, but also enriches the optimization approaches for signal recovery to promote the combination of mathematics with engineering application. This course explains the theories and methods can be applied to wireless communication, radar detection, pattern recognition, image compression, image super-resolution reconstruction and many other fields. By learning the course, it not only develops our idea of further studying signal processing problems, but also provides a new opportunity for the study of other disciplines.

default.zh: 实时操作系统课程内容主要包括两大部分：实时操作系统理论和实时信号处理系统设计与实现。实时操作系统理论包括任务管理和调度、实时通信、信号量和消息队列、事件、异步信号和管道、时钟及同步方法；信号处理系统设计与实现包括实时信号处理系统设计、典型信号处理算法的多处理器实现、嵌入式Linux实时操作系统概述、嵌入式Linux实时操作系统开发环境及工具。通过课堂教学和课程设计，使学生将实时操作系统理论与数字信号处理方法的实现联系起来，加深对实时操作系统的理解，掌握实时信号处理系统设计的方法，具备独立开发实时信号处理模块的能力。
default.en: The main content of this course includes two parts: theory of Real-Time Operation System, design and implementation of Real-Time Signal Processing System. Theory of Real-Time Operation System mainly explains task assignment and scheduling, Real-Time communication, semaphore and message queue, event, asynchronous signal and pips, clock synchronization; Design and implementation of Real-Time Signal Processing System explains design of Real-Time signal processing system, implementation of classical signal process algorithms, introduction of embedded Linux system, development environment and tools for embedded Linux system. Through learning this course and projects, students can connect the theory of Real-Time operation system with the implementation of digital signal processing for a further comprehension. Further, the students can master the principle for Real-Time Signal Processing System designation and obtain the ability of developing Real-Time signal processing module independently.

default.zh: 程序设计是一门注重实践的课程，大学一年级学生虽然已修完C语言及部分数据结构等程序设计相关课程，但由于大部分学生为初学者，很少接触规模较大程序设计的实践和训练，程序设计水平停留于初级阶段，难以满足工程实际开发的要求。开设本课程的目的是，在学生修完C语言等基础课程之后，为学生提供程序设计实践指导和训练，结合实时信息处理软件设计的特点，介绍模块化程序设计思想和方法，讲授基于Visual Studio集成开发环境的工程创建、代码编写以及调试技能与技巧，介绍模块化、规范化高质量程序设计思想，通过较大规模程序的设计与上机实践，教授学生常用编程技能和技巧，使学生真正掌握大型程序设计方法，具备根据具体问题需求设计算法、通过团队沟通协作解决复杂工程问题的能力，快速成为能够担当工程研发任务的人才。
default.en: Programming is a practical course that emphasizes practical skills. Although first-year college students have completed courses related to programming such as C language and some data structures, most of them are beginners and have little exposure to large-scale programming practice and training. As a result, their programming skills remain at the initial stage, making it difficult to meet the requirements of practical engineering development. The purpose of offering this course is to provide students with practical guidance and training in programming design after completing basic courses such as C language. Combining the characteristics of real-time information processing software design, it introduces modular programming ideas and methods, teaches engineering creation, code writing, and debugging skills and techniques based on the Visual Studio integrated development environment, and introduces the concept of modular and standardized high-quality programming design. Through the design and practical application of large-scale programs, students are taught common programming skills and techniques, enabling them to truly master large-scale program design methods and possess the ability to design algorithms based on specific problem requirements, solve complex engineering problems through team communication and collaboration, and quickly become talents capable of undertaking engineering research and development tasks.

default.zh: 科学计算创新实践是本专业的一门选修实践课，主要是培养学生的工程实践能力、利用工具软件解决工程问题的能力，是后续学习和科学研究的基础，在培养学生系统综合分析能力、综合设计能力等方面占有重要的地位。科学计算语言已经成为科学与工程界的通用计算机语言，并为很多领域的首选计算机语言，为现代科学技术的发展做出了重要的贡献。随着科学计算集成开发环境中通信、信号处理专业函数库以及专业工具箱的成熟，它们逐渐为广大通信技术领域的专家、学者和工程师所熟悉，在通信理论研究、算法设计、系统设计、建模仿真和性能分析验证等方面的应用也越来越广泛。本课程以科学计算集成开发环境的基础为入门，先介绍科学计算工具的强大功能，然后进一步让学生对电子、通信和微波系统有一个基本概念，从系统建模原理和仿真的数值计算方法入手，让学生对科学有一个从量到质的认识。教学具有针对性，培养学生综合运用所学知识和解决实际的工程问题的能力，让学生对通信专业知识产生浓厚兴趣，为今后进一步深造或工作奠定坚实的基础。
default.en: The innovative practice of scientific computing is an elective practice course in this major, mainly to cultivate students' engineering practice ability, the ability to solve engineering problems using tools and software, and is the foundation for subsequent learning and scientific research. It occupies an important position in cultivating students' comprehensive analysis ability, comprehensive design ability, etc. Scientific computing language has become a universal computer programming language in the scientific and engineering fields, and is the preferred computer programming language for many fields, making important contributions to the development of modern science and technology. With the maturity of communication, signal processing professional function libraries, and professional toolboxes in scientific computing integrated development environments, they have gradually become familiar to experts, scholars, and engineers in the communication technology field. The application in communication theory research, algorithm design, system design, modeling and simulation, and performance analysis and verification is also becoming more and more extensive. This course is based on the foundation of scientific computing integrated development environment as an introduction, first introduces the powerful functions of scientific computing tools, and then further allows students to have a basic concept of electronic, communication, and microwave systems, starting from the principles of system modeling and simulation. Numerical calculation methods, let students have a quantitative understanding of science. The teaching is targeted, cultivating students' ability to comprehensively apply what they have learned and solve practical engineering problems, allowing students to have a strong interest in communication professional knowledge, and laying a solid foundation for further study or work in the future.

default.zh: Python科学计算与混合编程实践是电子信息方向的一门选修实践课，主要是培养学生的工程实践能力、利用工具软件解决工程问题的能力，是后续学习和科学研究的基础，在培养学生系统综合分析能力、综合设计能力等方面占有重要的地位。 Python已经成为科学与工程界的通用计算机语言，并为很多领域的首选计算机语言，为现代科学技术的发展做出了重要的贡献。随着Anaconda集成环境的推出，Python逐渐为科学计算领域的专家、学者和工程师所熟悉，在人工智能理论研究、算法设计、系统设计、建模仿真和性能分析验证等方面的应用也越来越广泛。 本课程以Python语言的基础为入门，先介绍Python的强大功能，然后进一步让学生对科学计算有一个基本概念，从系统建模原理和仿真的数值计算方法入手，让学生对Python仿真有一个从量到质的认识。教学具有针对性，培养学生综合运用所学知识和解决实际的工程问题的能力，让学生对通信专业知识产生浓厚兴趣，为今后进一步深造或工作奠定坚实的基础。
default.en: Python Scientific Computing and Hybrid Programming Practice is an elective practical course for students majoring in electronic information. Its primary objective is to cultivate students' engineering practice skills and their ability to use software tools to solve engineering problems. This course serves as the foundation for subsequent studies and scientific research, and it plays a significant role in developing students' comprehensive analytical and design capabilities. Python has become a universal programming language in the fields of science and engineering. It has made significant contributions to the advancement of modern science and technology. With the introduction of the Anaconda integrated environment, Python has gained familiarity among experts, scholars, and engineers in the field of scientific computing. Its applications have become increasingly widespread in areas such as artificial intelligence theory, algorithm design, system design, modeling and simulation, as well as performance analysis and validation. This course begins with the basics of the Python language, introducing its powerful features. It further provides students with a fundamental understanding of scientific computing, starting from the principles of system modeling and numerical computational methods for simulation. Students will develop a deeper comprehension of Python simulation, progressing from quantity to quality. The teaching is tailored to cultivate students' ability to apply their knowledge comprehensively to solve real engineering problems, thereby fostering a strong interest in communication-related knowledge and establishing a solid foundation for further study or work.

default.zh: 机器学习是新兴的多领域交叉方向，是人工智能领域的重要组成部分，本课程结合模式识别与统计机器学习在遥感技术和智能车领域应用的前沿方向，进行基本理论讲授。通过本课程的讲授，使学生建立人工智能领域新兴技术的基本概念，使学生掌握模式识别和机器学习的基本理论和方法，培养学生应用模式识别和机器学习方法解决实际问题的能力，提高综合运用所学理论知识独立分析和解决问题的综合能力，为培养学生解决复杂的工程问题的能力奠定基础。通过对前沿技术的介绍，培养学生具有国际视野，和文献综述能力，具备一定的专业沟通和表达能力，具备多渠道获取新知识能力，撰写学术报告能力，具有不断学习和适应发展的能力。本课程主要讲解模式识别和统计机器学习领域中的主要算法以及在的一些具体应用实例，包括光学目标识别、计算机视觉、搜索引擎、遥感技术和智能车等领域。课程内容包括监督学习（参数估计/非参数估计、支持向量机、核函数法、神经网络）和非监督学习（回归、聚类、深度学习）的机器学习方法与基本理论。通过遥感领域应用实例分析，使学生掌握基本理论，并将理论与实际相结合，深入理解模式识别与统计机器学习在遥感和智能车等领域的应用。
default.en: Machine learning is a scientific discipline that explores the construction and study of algorithms that can learn from data. This course combines the basic directions of the theory of and statistical machine learning in the frontier of remote sensing technology and intelligent vehicle. Through the course, students can establish the basic concepts of the emerging technology in artificial intelligence field. It can enable students to master the basic theories and methods of and machine learning, develop the engineering consciousness and ability, and train students' abilities of independent thinking and of analyzing and solving the complex engineering problems in and machine learning. Through the introduction of cutting-edge technology, cultivate students with an international perspective, improving the ability of literature review. During this course, the communication skills on complex engineering problems, and self-learning capabilities with multi-channel access to adapt the development can be enhanced. The main content is the main algorithms of and statistical machine learning in the field and in some specific applications, including optical target recognition, computer vision, remote sensing technology, search engine and intelligent vehicle etc.. The contents of the course include supervised learning (parameter estimation / non parametric estimation, SVM, kernel function, neural network) and unsupervised learning (clustering, dimensionality reduction, recommender systems, deep learning). Through the application of remote sensing field analysis, it develops students to master the basic theory, combining theory with practice, in-depth understanding of and statistical machine learning in remote sensing and intelligent vehicles and other fields of application.

default.zh: 模式识别与机器学习是近20多年兴起的一门多领域交叉学科，是人工智能领域的一个重要组成部分。主要涉及概率论、统计学、逼近论、凸分析、算法复杂度理论等多门学科。机器学习理论主要是设计和分析一些让计算机可以自动“学习”的算法，从数据中自动分析获得规律，并利用规律对未知数据进行预测。机器学习在实际工业生产中已经有了十分广泛的应用，例如：数据挖掘、计算机视觉、自然语言处理、生物特征识别、搜索引擎、医学诊断、DNA序列测序、语音和手写识别、遥感应用和无人系统运用。本课程分为24个学时，主要讲解模式识别和统计机器学习领域中的主要算法以及在遥感领域的一些具体应用实例。从数据的角度来看，机器学习一般分为监督学习和非监督学习。 从模型的输出角度来看，主要分为分类，回归，聚类，密度估计和数据降维。本课程培养学生应用模式识别与统计机器学习的基本技能和方法，具备机器学习程序设计与开发能力，为学生后续相关的学习及工作打下基础。
default.en: Machine learning and pattern recognition is a scientific discipline that explores the construction and study of algorithms that can learn from data. Such algorithms operate by building a model from example inputs and using that to make predictions or decisions; rather than following strictly static program instructions. Machine learning is employed in a range of computing tasks where designing and programming explicit. Example applications include spam filtering, optical character recognition, search engines and computer vision. This course provides a broad introduction to machine learning, data mining, and statistical pattern recognition, together with some typical applications from image processing and remote sensing. In this class, you will learn about the most effective machine learning techniques, and gain practice implementing them and getting them to work for your application. More importantly, you'll learn about not only the theoretical underpinnings of learning, but also gain the practical know-how needed to quickly and powerfully apply these techniques to new problems. Topics include supervised learning (parametric/non-parametric algorithms, support vector machines, kernels, neural networks). Unsupervised learning (clustering, dimensionality reduction, recommender systems, deep.The distinguishing feature of this course is that it combines the practice with the theoretical knowledge and the design skills. This is helpful for studying of other relative courses and future works.

default.zh: 本课程立足低年级本科生专业启蒙与学科认知核心需求，以电子信息学科全景解读、前沿技术普及、工程实践认知、职业发展引导为导向，融合校内名师系统讲授与行业专家专题授课，系统传递学科核心理论、技术脉络、前沿应用与发展前景，引导学生构建电子信息领域完整认知框架，厚植专业兴趣与家国情怀，明晰学习路径与成长方向。
default.en: This course is designed to meet the core needs of professional enlightenment and subject cognition for lower-grade undergraduates. It aims to provide a comprehensive understanding of electronic information disciplines, popularize cutting-edge technologies, foster an understanding of engineering practice, and guide career development. By integrating systematic lectures from renowned professors within the university and specialized courses from industry experts, the course systematically conveys the core theories, technological trajectories, cutting-edge applications, and development prospects of the discipline. It guides students to build a complete cognitive framework in the field of electronic information, cultivates their professional interests and national sentiments, and clarifies their learning paths and growth directions.

default.zh: 随着国产软件、国产操作系统、国产芯片研究和应用的不断深入和拓展，开源开发平台已经成为国内研究所、企业研发信息类处理应用的主要平台。Qt是一个功能强大的跨平台应用程序框架，其开源版本使得开发者可以在Windows、MacOS、Linux、Android等多个操作系统上使用它来开发信息处理、图形界面、数据库管理等工程应用，涉及信息处理、汽车、机器人、自动化、AI等行业。作为信息与通信工程类学生，需要尽快掌握开源开发工具及C++编程知识，打下信息与通信系统、信号与信息处理等方面应用的软件实现基础，培养工程化实践素质，提升学生们独立设计软件系统、动手编程实践的能力。 课程将面向对象编程的各种概念融入Qt开发平台的讲述之中，使得学生们具像化理解Qt中的面向对象理念，同时利用课程中大量的实践练习题、课后编程设计题等多种方式提升学生对面向对象概念的理解，熟悉软件开发过程，锻炼设计能力。 课程主要内容既包含面向对象基础、类和对象概念、类的定义和实现、继承与派生、静态成员、常成员、数据I/O等面向对象的方法，还包含开源Qt的环境、类、信号与槽、事件与绘图、窗口编程等Qt编程框架等等。
default.en: With the expanding application of domestic software, operating system, and chips, open source development platforms have become the most important platform for institutes and enterprises to research and develop their own information processing applications. Qt is a powerful cross-platform application framework, and its’ open source version enables developers to use it to program information processing applications on multiple operating systems, such as Windows, MacOS, Linux, Android, and so on. Meanwhile, Qt-based engineering applications for information processing, graphical interfaces, database management, have deeply involved in the industries of information processing, automobiles, robotics, automation, and AI. For students majoring in information and communication engineering, to master open source development tools and C++ programming knowledge should be done as soon as possible. This course is aiming at laying the foundation of software implementation for applications in information and communication systems, signal and information processing, cultivating the quality of engineering practice, and enhancing the students' ability to independently design software systems and hands-on programming practices.

default.zh: 高级语言程序设计是本专业的一门选修课，主要是培养学生的工程计算编程能力、利用工具软件解决工程问题的能力，是后续学习和科学研究的基础。本课程包括MATLAB的基础为入门，程序设计，数据可视化，科学计算应用和GUI程序设计等内容。教学具有针对性，培养学生综合运用所学知识和解决实际的工程问题的能力。
default.en: This course develops students' computational programming skills for engineering applications and their ability to solve engineering problems using specialized tools. Serving as a foundation for advanced studies and scientific research, the curriculum covers: MATLAB Fundamentals - Syntax and core operations Programming Techniques - Algorithm design and debugging Data Visualization - Scientific plotting and graphical representation Scientific Computing Applications - Numerical methods and simulations GUI Programming - Interactive interface development

default.zh: 单片机原理应用课程是电子信息类专业本科生的计算机类课程。本课程主要讲授单片机的基本原理、硬件结构和应用。课程教学目标是帮助学生建立单片机的基本概念，使学生掌握单片机的组成结构及各部分工作原理，掌握软硬件综合开发工具，进一步掌握软硬件实现技术，最终掌握单片机系统的实践应用基本技能和设计方法，使学生具备基于单片机的基本设计和应用能力。通过本课程的课堂教学、实践教学环节，培养学生硬件系统的综合分析与应用设计能力，以及运用计算机类科学知识的能力，为培养学生在智能系统中的单片机应用设计能力、系统综合分析能力、解决人工智能的复杂工程问题能力奠定基础。
default.en: Principle of Single Chip Microcomputer and Application is technical courses on electronic technology for majors of electronic information. It mainly introduces the principles of microcomputers, the principles and applications of the MCU. This course mainly teaches the basic principles, hardware structure, and applications of microcontrollers. The teaching objective of the course is to help students establish the basic concepts of microcontrollers, master the composition structure and working principles of microcontrollers, master software and hardware development tools, further master software and hardware implementation technology, and ultimately master the practical application skills and design methods of microcontroller systems, so that students have the basic design and application abilities based on microcontrollers. Through the classroom teaching and practical teaching of this course, aim to cultivate students' comprehensive analysis and design abilities in hardware systems, as well as their ability to apply computer science knowledge. This lays the foundation for cultivating students' microcontroller application design ability, system comprehensive analysis ability, and ability to solve complex engineering problems in intelligent systems.

default.zh: 本课程是电子与信息工程学院开设的一门面向未来技术学院（永坦班）的夏季实践类课程，其目的是使学生了解和掌握复杂嵌入式系统硬件开发知识、丰富已学过的专业基础课程内容，以嵌入式综合项目培养学生理论联系实际，提高其在项目开发过程中发现问题、分析问题以及解决问题的能力，同时也培养了学生注重团队协作的意识，为后续专业课程的学习打下基础。课程内容还包括学校对学科竞赛的政策，电子信息类学科竞赛解读、优秀项目作品分享，注重课赛结合，以课促赛。
default.en: This course is a summer practical course offered by the School of Electronic and Information Engineering for the School of Future Technology (Yongtan Class). Its purpose is to enable students to understand and master the hardware development knowledge of complex embedded systems, enrich the professional basic course content that they have learned, and train students to combine theory with practice through embedded comprehensive projects. Improve their ability to find, analyze and solve problems in the process of project development, and cultivate their awareness of teamwork, which lays a foundation for the study of subsequent professional courses. At the same time, the course content also includes the school's policy on discipline competitions, the interpretation of electronic information discipline competitions, the sharing of excellent project works, the combination of lessons and competitions, and the promotion of competitions with lessons.

default.zh: 该课程是一门学习数学建模知识并运用计算机软件实践典型数学建模项目的综合性课程。本课程在课堂教学部分主要讲授:(1)如何利用数学理论和方法分析和解决实际的工程问题，重点讲授创造性的思维方法，问题的前期分析，模型的整体设计、变量关系的数学描述、数学模型的求解、模型解的分析与检验；(2)针对仿真软件的使用，讲解该软件的使用基础和常用数学建模工具包的使用；本课程在上机实验部分，由易到难，从层次上分为基础实验、综合实验和项目实践。通过本课程的课堂教学及后续项目实践和计算机仿真等环节，使学生能应用数学、物理、计算机及相关理论知识和科学方法对复杂工程问题中技术层面的内容进行表达、分析与论证，培养学生分析实际问题、解决复杂环境下工程实践问题的能力，增加创新意识，并在项目实践中培养团队合作精神，支撑本专业学习成果中相应指标点的达成。
default.en: Mathematical modeling is a bridge between mathematics and the real question, as well as the main way of transformation from mathematics to practical productive forces. Mathematical modeling is widely used in various fields, by combining mathematical knowledge and computer software. The main contents of this course include an overview of mathematical modeling, simple model, elementary optimization model and programming model, Matlab project-based practices. By teaching the practice of the course, students would master the basic methods and principles of mathematical modeling for real-life problems, learn to analyze real problems, establish appropriate mathematical model and solve competency model. The course would lay the foundation for future research and engineering practice.

default.zh: 电子系统硬件设计与实践课程为电子信息类专业选修课，本课程以教师讲授为辅、学生动手实践为主，以培养学生的工程意识、创新意识为目标，以电子电路的设计应用为基础，要求学生能够综合运用模-数混合电路、单片机、嵌入式系统、DSP、可编程器件、EDA软件等知识和工程技能。经过需求分析、资料查询、方案论证、设计调试、指标测试、分析总结等过程，完成一个独立电子系统的创新设计与实现。通过本课程的学习，学生可以掌握电子系统分析与设计的整个流程，形成系统级设计的理念，锻炼团队合作能力，并最终设计出独立的中小型应用电子系统。
default.en: The course of Electronic system hardware design and innovation practice is an elective course for electronics and information engineering major and other related majors. Through lecture and practice, this course aims to develop student’s awareness of engineering and innovation. Based on the design and applications of electronic circuits, this course requires students to master the integrated use of analog-digital hybrid circuits, microcontrollers, embedded systems, DSP, programmable devices, EDA software etc. engineering knowledge and skills. After requirement analysis, information enquiry, scheme demonstration, designing and debugging, performance testing, summary and other processes, students can design an independent electronic system. Through teaching and experiments, students can master the entire process analysis and design of electronic systems, form a concept of system-level design, exercise the ability of teamwork, and finally design a small or medium independent applied electronic systems.

default.zh: 《基于Windows界面的机器学习程序设计》是电子信息类专业本科生的创新实践课。本门课程主要介绍面向对象的程序设计的基本思想，介绍Visual C++开发环境中各主要成分的作用和使用方法，以及机器学习中的强化学习和深度学习的相关概念与程序实现方法。让学生初步掌握C++语言、学会使用Visual C++开发环境，并在此基础上，初步掌握Visual C++平台上的强化学习、深度学习、以及深度强化学习编程实现方法。在项目开发实践中，掌握基于Visual C++的强化学习、深度学习、以及深度强化学习程序设计的综合项目，包括基于人机交互界面的强化程序设计、基于人机交互界面的深度神经网络程序设计、以及基于人机交互界面的深度强化学习程序设计等。通过这门课的学习，使学生具有一定的机器学习编程实际能力，学会数学工具和计算机相结合来解决实际问题，为后续课程打下良好的机器学习软件编程能力基础。
default.en: This innovative practical course for electronic information undergraduates integrates theory and hands-on practice to develop machine learning applications on the Windows platform. The curriculum begins with foundational knowledge, including object-oriented programming (OOP) concepts (e.g., classes, inheritance, polymorphism) in C++ and the use of Visual C++ tools such as MFC for interface design and project management. It then progresses to machine learning algorithms: reinforcement learning (RL) principles like Markov Decision Processes and Q-learning are applied to projects like game AI; deep learning (DL) fundamentals such as neural networks are implemented in C++ for tasks like handwritten digit recognition; and deep reinforcement learning (DRL) combines DL and RL for complex decision-making systems, exemplified by DQN-based autonomous control. Through project-based learning, students design interactive Windows GUI applications, such as RL-driven board game interfaces, visualized DL training systems for image classification, and real-time DRL demonstrations for dynamic environments. The course emphasizes translating mathematical tools (linear algebra, probability) into code for solving practical problems like loss optimization and policy gradients. Objectives include mastering C++ and Visual C++ tools, building end-to-end engineering skills from theory to deployment, and preparing students for advanced courses in intelligent systems or industrial software. Key features include a Windows-centric focus aligned with industry standards and an interdisciplinary blend of hardware-oriented thinking and software engineering to cultivate versatile technical expertise.

default.zh: 《基于单片机的创新实践》是一门以培养学生单片机综合运用能力的选修专业课程。本课程主要围绕C51系列单片机的工作原理及主要功能部件的设计、应用等内容设计实践课程题目。
default.en: Innovation Practice Based on MCU is an elective professional course designed to develop students' ability to use microcontrollers in an integrated manner. This course mainly focuses on the working principle of C51 series microcontroller and the design and application of main functional components to design the practical course topics.

default.zh: 专家系统是目前人工智能中最活跃、最有成效的一个研究领域，通常是指一类具有大量专门知识的计算机智能信息系统，它运用专门知识和人工智能中的推理技术来模拟人类专家解决各种复杂、具体的问题。课程通过总结前三代专家系统的设计方法和实现技术的基础上，在讲授专家系统基本知识的基础上，介绍大型分布式多级专家协作系统、广义知识表达、综合知识库与并行推理等技术，使学生了解人工神经网络专家系统、分布式人工智能专家系统以及多智能体协同系统等最新人工智能技术在专家系统中的应用。
default.en: Expert system is the most active and effective research field in artificial intelligence. It usually refers to a kind of computer intelligent information system with a lot of expertise. It uses expertise and artificial intelligence to predict the human experts. A complex and specific problem. On the basis of summarizing the design methods and implementation techniques of the first three generations of expert systems, the course introduces the techniques of large-scale distributed multi-level expert collaboration system, generalized knowledge representation, comprehensive knowledge base and parallel reasoning on the basis of teaching the basic knowledge of expert systems. Students can understand the application of the latest artificial intelligence technology such as artificial neural network expert system, distributed artificial intelligence expert system and multi-agent collaborative system in expert system.

default.zh: 智能感知系统创新实践入门课，是在了解和掌握电子系统基本原理、组成、结构和使用方法的基础上，学习将理论知识应用于实践应用，培养学生通过项目实践学习初步掌握系统应用创新的过程和方法，面向实际应用进行实验设计、验证和分析，培养学生将学习的知识与实践相结合的能力，提高学生自主学习、查阅文献，并通过团队合作分析和解决问题的能力，增强沟通与表达能力，初步感受团队合作的力量。通过本课程的课堂教学、实验设计和实践等环节，着重培养学生对实际问题的综合分析、设计及应用能力，增加创新意识，初步感受通过多种不同的形式和方法获得新知识的过程，为后续理论学习与科研实践活动打下良好的系统级实践入门基础。
default.en: Introduction to Innovation Practice for Intelligent Sensing System, based on understanding and mastering the basic principles, composition, structure and using methods of electronic systems, aims to let students learn apply theoretical knowledge to practical applications, initially master the process of system application innovation through projects, carry out experimental design, verification and analysis for practical applications, combine learned knowledge with practice, learn independently, consult literature, analyze and solve problems through teamwork, enhance communication and expression and initially feel the power of teamwork. Through the classroom teaching, experimental design and practice of this course, it focuses on cultivating students' comprehensive analysis, design and application ability to practical problems, increases their sense of innovation, and initially feels the process of acquiring new knowledge through a variety of different forms and methods. Follow-up theoretical study and scientific research practice activities lay a good foundation for system-level practice entry.

default.zh: 本课程是电子与信息工程学院开设的一门面向电子信息工程专业本科生的课程，生产实习（含认识实习）是本科教学计划中非常重要的实践性教学环节，其目的是使学生了解和掌握基本生产知识，验证、巩固和丰富已学过的专业课程内容，培养学生理论联系实际，提高其在生产中调查研究、观察问题、分析问题以及解决问题的能力和方法，同时也培养了学生注重团队协作的意识，为后续专业课程的学习打下基础。认识实习是在学生已掌握一定的专业基础知识的前提下，进一步增强感性认识，拓宽对于电子信息工程领域的设计、生产、加工过程、工艺设备及工艺装备的了解，为后续专业课程的学习奠定良好的基础。通过生产实习和认识实习，可以使学生了解信息产业发展现状和发展趋势及前沿技术，培养热爱专业、致力于祖国社会主义建设的思想。
default.en: This course is offered by the School of Electronic and Information Engineering for undergraduates majoring in electronic and information engineering. Production practice (including cognition practice) is a very important practical teaching link in the undergraduate teaching plan. Its purpose is to enable students to understand and master basic production knowledge, verify, consolidate and enrich the content of the professional courses they have learned, and train students to combine theory with practice. Improve their ability and method of investigation and research, observation, analysis and problem solving in production, and cultivate their awareness of teamwork, which lays a foundation for the study of subsequent professional courses. Cognitive practice is to further enhance perceptual understanding and broaden the understanding of design, production, processing, process equipment and process equipment in the field of electronic information engineering on the premise that students have mastered certain basic professional knowledge, so as to lay a good foundation for the study of subsequent professional courses. Through production practice and cognition practice, students can understand the current situation and development trend of the information industry and cutting-edge technology, and cultivate the idea of loving the profession and committing to the socialist construction of the motherland.

default.zh: 本课程由电子与信息工程学院面向电子信息工程专业本科生开设。通过毕业设计，学生可以综合运用大学期间学习获得的知识技能对毕业课题进行深入学习和创新研究，提出相应的解决方案并予以验证。锻炼提升学生综合知识应用能力、实践能力、自学能力、沟通能力、增强创新思维、培养复杂工程问题的解决能力、培养职业素养及责任感。为后续学业深造或就业打下基础。
default.en: This course is offered by the School of Electronic and Information Engineering to the students majoring in electronic information. Through graduation projects, students can comprehensively apply the knowledge and skills acquired during their undergraduate studies to conduct in-depth learning and innovative research on their graduation projects, propose corresponding solutions and verify their results. For students, Graduation Design can improve their comprehensive knowledge application ability, practical ability, self-learning ability, communication ability, enhance their innovative thinking, cultivate the ability to solve complex engineering problems, and cultivate their professional performance. It is a necessary course to prepare students for their further education or employment.

default.zh: 《电子系统综合设计》是针对电子信息类I本科生开设的一门综合性、设计性的实践类课程设计。本课程通过以工程实践为背景电子系统的设计与实现，使学生在了解电子系统的组成、设计原则与方法的基础上，将已学过的电子线路基础、数字逻辑电路与系统、微机与微控制器原理等课程知识综合运用于电子系统的设计过程中，进而掌握电子系统的构建、调试、测试方法，并初步具备电子系统软硬件设计能力。
default.en: The course of Integrated Design of Electronic Systems is a synthetic and designing practical course for electronics and information engineering major and other related majors. Through the design and implementation of an electronic system based on engineering practice, this course enables students to not only understand the basics of the composition, design principles and methods of electronic systems, but also to comprehensively apply the knowledge they have learned in Foundation of Electronics Circuits, Digital Logic Circuit and Systems, Principles of Microcomputers and Microcontrollers to electronic systems. Then master the construction, debugging, and testing methods of electronic systems, and initially possess the ability to design software and hardware of electronic systems.

default.zh: 本课程侧重信息技术与现代管理理念的结合，帮助学生理解以信息为基础的企业变革、企业变革过程中的技术问题、企业内部信息资源管理的内容，以及如何利用新的信息技术实现管理模式的创新、支持企业的业务战略等实践性问题。通过本课程设置的教学活动，使学生能够系统地掌握管理信息系统的基本理论知识，了解云计算、大数据、物联网和移动终端应用等新兴的信息技术对个人、组织和社会的影响，了解如何应用信息技术推动管理理念和方法的实现，并掌握如何有效地实施和应用信息系统来支持企业的业务发展和创新。使学生有能力在管理实践中创造性地使用不断涌现的新技术，为他们成为信息时代的新型管理人才或继续从事信息系统理论方面的研究工作打下坚实的理论基础。
default.en: This course focuses on the combination of information technology and modern management concepts, and aims to help students understand the information-based enterprise transformation, technical issues in the process of business transformation, contents of corporate internal information resource management, and how to use new information technology to support organizational strategy and business strategy. By learning this course, the students can be acquainted with the basic theoretical foundation of management information systems, understand the influences of emerging information technologies, such as cloud computing, big data, internet of things and mobile application, on individuals, organizations and societies, and master how to apply information technology to promote the implementation of management concepts and methods.

default.zh: This course focuses on the integration of information technology and modern management concepts, helping students understand information-based enterprise transformation, technical issues in the process of enterprise transformation, the content of internal information resource management, and how to use new information technologies to achieve management model innovation and support corporate business strategies and other practical issues. Through the teaching of this course, the following teaching objectives will be achieved: 1.Master the basic concepts and constituent elements of information systems, and understand the development trends of management information systems. 2.Master how enterprises use information systems to support strategic decisions and gain competitive advantages. 3.Master the main methods and software for information system development and implementation.

The following teaching objectives need to be achieved by learning this course: 2. default.zh: 运筹学是管理类各专业的专业基础课，主要介绍一些优化分析方法和实用运筹学模型，为后续课程奠定数量分析的基础理论方法。本课程主要内容包括：线性规划原理及方法；对偶理论；运输问题；整数规划及0-1规划；目标规划；图与网络分析；计划评审方法和关键路线法；动态规划，涵盖运筹学的主要分支。通过本课程的学习，使学生能够掌握运筹学的一些主要理论和方法，培养学生能运用模型来研究解决管理中实际问题的能力。
default.en: Operations Research is the specialized basic course in all managerial majors, which is designed to introduce some methods of optimization analysis and some practical models to the students. It helps the students to lay a good theoretical foundation of quantitative analysis for their successive courses. And it covers the main branches of operations research, i.e. linear programming principle and method, dual theory, transportation problem, integer programming and 0-1 programming, goal programming, graph and network analysis, program evaluation and review technique, dynamic programming, etc. Through the study of this course, the students are aimed to master some primary theories and methods of operations research and are taught to apply them to solve the practical management problems.

default.zh: 本课程是经济管理专业的基础课程，主要任务是培养学生收集数据和分析数据的能力，为后续课程的学习以及在经济管理领域从事定量研究奠定方法论基础。本课程主要讲授统计学的基本理论和基本方法，侧重统计方法在经济管理领域中的应用。通过本课程的学习，使学生能够正确地解释和使用常用的统计指标，掌握搜集和处理数据的基本方法，并利用统计分析软件对数据进行运算、建模和解读分析。本课程的内容包括统计资料的收集与整理、统计资料的描述、推断理论基础、参数估计、假设检验、χ2检验和方差分析、相关与回归分析、时间数列分析和指数分析。
default.en: This course is compulsory for all undergraduate students in School of Management, whose primary purpose is to develop the skills in business data analysis and to lay down the necessary theoretical foundation for future study. As an elementary level course on statistics, this course mainly focuses on how to apply statistical methods to address issues in business environment. By taking this course, the students are supposed to be able to 1) understand commonly used statistical notations and concepts, 2) collect data in a justifiable way, 3) correctly apply quantitative data analysis methods with the help of statistical software, and interpret results appropriately in business context. The contents of this course include: data collection and description, statistical inference theories, parameter estimation, hypothesis testing, χ2 test and analysis of variance, correlation and regression, time series data and index numbers.

default.zh: 本课程是面向辅修专业学生的经济管理类基础课程，主要任务是培养学生收集数据和分析数据的能力，为后续课程的学习以及在经济管理领域从事定量研究奠定方法论基础。本课程主要讲授统计学的基本理论和基本方法，侧重统计方法在经济管理领域中的应用。通过本课程的学习，使学生能够正确地解释和使用常用的统计指标，掌握搜集和处理数据的基本方法，并利用统计分析软件对数据进行运算、建模和解读分析。本课程的内容包括统计资料的收集与整理、统计资料的描述、推断理论基础、参数估计、假设检验、χ2检验和方差分析、相关与回归分析、时间数列分析和指数分析。

default.zh: 本课程旨在让学生对财务会计有一个基本的了解，涵盖了各种财务会计主题，包括基本会计理论、会计原则、记录商业交易的程序、资产和负债的计量以及财务报表的准备。更重要的是，学生将学习会计信息和数据如何帮助财务报表使用者促进决策。
default.en: This course is designed to provide a basic understanding of financial accounting and covers various financial accounting topics, including basic accounting theory, accounting principles, procedures to record business transactions, measurements of assets and liabilities and preparations for financial statements. More importantly, students will learn how accounting information and data assists financial statement users in facilitating their decision making.

default.zh: 本课程概述了应用科学(社会科学和技术)领域所需的主要统计多元数据分析工具和方法。 它将涵盖探索性统计部分，以及多元建模部分。
default.en: This course provides an overview of the main statistical multivariate data analysis tolls and methods required in the fields of applied sciences (social sciences and technology). It will cover a part on exploratory statistics, and another part in multivariate modeling.

default.zh: 运筹学是一种解决问题和决策的分析方法，在管理和商业、经济、供应链和金融中很有用。 本课程由三个部分组成，我们着重于确定性优化技术，在这里我们介绍了基本的优化技术，以及如何将实际业务问题形成数学模型。然后，我们研究了求解线性规划和整数规划的一些有效算法，并介绍了求解不同规划的一些基本计算机实现。之后，我们将介绍先进的优化技术和实际商业应用。
default.en: Operations Research is an analytical method of problem-solving and decision-making that is useful in management and business, economics, supply chain and finance. This course consists of three parts, we focus on deterministic optimization techniques where we introduce the basic optimization techniques and how to formulate real business problems into mathematical models. Then, we study some efficient algorithms for solving linear programs and integer programs and introduce some basic computer implementation of solving different programs. Next, we present advanced optimization techniques and real business applications.

default.zh: 现代商业的合规性和治理课程旨在探讨法律、商业、伦理、可持续性和企业社会责任在21世纪商业环境中的相互关系。随着企业日益全球化发展，商业伦理和社会责任成为商业本身的重要组成部分，需要考虑不同地区、管辖区域和文化之间的多种因素。 在对商业领域的综合性研究中，该课程涵盖了理解全球商业的动态环境，将商业战略与新的挑战相结合，比如现代互联但分散的全球系统以及社交媒体和国际交流的影响；识别商业伦理和社会责任的关键问题，并了解日益竞争和复杂的商业环境中的当前话题。
default.en: The Legal Ethics and Social Responsibility course is designed to explore the interplay between law, business and ethics, sustainability and corporate social responsibility as they become more critical in the business environment in the 21st. century. As businesses become more global, business ethics and social responsibility are an integral part of business itself – with many factors to consider across regions, jurisdictions and cultures. In a comprehensive approach to the field of business, this course covers understanding the dynamic environment of global business, integrating business strategy with new challenges – such as the modern interconnected, but fragmented global system and the influence of social media and international communication; identifying key issues of business ethics and social responsibility, and current topics in an increasingly competitive and complex business environment.

default.zh: 《管理学基础》是管理类专业的必修基础课，是整个管理学科体系的基础。本课程所介绍的管理基本理论和原则是其他管理学科的概括和总结，将为学生后续课程的学习奠定基础。课程以企业组织为研究对象，通过对管理的一般性问题的研究，致力于研究管理者如何有效地管理其所在的组织. 课程通过管理基本理论的讲授、管理基本思想的介绍和管理思维的培养来提升学生的管理悟性。通过本课程学习，使学生掌握管理的基础知识和基本理论，了解和掌握管理理论的产生、发展和作用，了解管理过程即计划、组织、领导、控制四个阶段及具体的活动内容，并结合课堂讨论、案例分析和角色扮演培养学生的管理思维，及综合分析和解决管理问题的能力。
default.en: "Management Fundamentals" is a compulsory course of management and the basis of the entire discipline system of management. The basic theory and principles of management introduced in this course are the generalization and summary of other management disciplines, which will lay the foundation for the students' advanced courses. This course is based on the research of corporate organization, and is devoted to the study of how managers can effectively manage their organization through the study of the general problems of management. The course introduces the basic theory and ideas of management and cultivates management thought for students to enhance their management savvy.Studying this course, students can master the basic knowledge and theory of management; understand and master the generation, development and function of management theory; understand the management process which has four stages: planning, organization, leadership and control and specific activities in each stage. And then, with classroom discussions, case studies and role play, the management thought of student and the ability to comprehensively analyze and address management issues can be well developed.

default.zh: 组织行为学是研究在组织中以及组织与环境相互作用，人们从事工作的心理活动和行为反应规律性的科学。它采用系统分析的方法，综合运用心理学、社会学、社会心理学、人类学、生理学、经济学和政治学等知识，研究一定组织中人的心理和行为的规律性，从而提高各级领导者和管理者对人的行为预测和引导能力，并以此为基础，设计与改进提高组织效能，从而更有效地实现组织预定的目标。 组织行为学是管理类各专业的一门专业基础课程。本课程的目标是通过系统讲授、案例分析、互动研讨、作业实践等环节，帮助学生掌握组织管理过程的普遍规律、基本原理和应用方法，能够运用所学理论分析管理中存在的各种心理现象与行为，培养正确处理和协调人际关系的能力，逐步提高分析问题和解决问题的能力，最终提高管理能力，也为进一步学习其他相关课程打下组织行为学的扎实基础。
default.en: Organizational Behavior is an introductory course which analyses human behavior at work with a focus on issues of personality, motivation, group interaction, occupational stress and health and organizational change. The course integrates knowledge from psychology, sociology, social psychology, anthropology and political science to examine issues related to aspects of the working environment and to the relationship between managerial strategies, organizational structures and their effects on performance, health and autonomy. The success of an organization depends entirely upon the actions of those within it. The individual’s behavior may be affected by many factors. The working environment, the groups he/she interacts with, the rules and roles within which he/she must operate, authority structures and the individual’s own perspectives are but a few. The practicing manager needs to understand these factors if he/she is to accurately assess the needs of working individuals.

default.zh: 组织行为学是是现代工商管理理论的重要组成部分，以心理学、社会学、社会心理学、人类学和政治学等学科为基础，以组织中人的心理活动和行为反应模式为研究对象。课程着重从工作行为的个体、群体与组织三个层次来分析影响组织绩效的有关因素，揭示人的工作行为的实质，以提高各级管理者对人的行为的预测、协调和控制能力，从而激发人的工作热情,最大限度地发挥人的工作潜能，有效实现组织目标。
default.en: Organizational Behavior is an important part of modern business management theory, which is based on psychology, sociology, social psychology, anthropology, political science and other disciplines, and studies the psychological activities and behavioral response patterns of people in organizations. This course focuses on analyzing the factors affecting organizational performance from the perspective of individuals, groups and organizations of work behavior, and reveals the essence of human work behavior, so as to improve the ability of managers at all levels to predict, coordinate and control human behavior, stimulate people's work enthusiasm, maximize their work potential and effectively achieve organizational goals.

default.zh: 领导力是高素质人才能力体系的重要组成部分，沟通能力是领导力的重要体现。《领导力与沟通》通过对沟通能力的系统讲授和训练，提高学生沟通技能，继而达到提升领导力的目的。课程以对领导力的理解为切入点，分别从领导的职能和领导者的日常工作重点两个角度，让学生领会沟通能力在领导力中的重要作用。无论领导的三个基本职能，即确定目标、寻找路径和激励和培养下属，还是在日常的管理活动中，领导者有70%的时间花在沟通上，并且管理中70%的问题来源于沟通，沟通活动都是领导工作的主体内容。关于对沟通能力的理解，课程注重思维和技能的训练。课程带领学生系统地理解沟通基本概念及特征、管理沟通过程与要素、基本沟通技能，如倾听与反馈、演讲、写作、招聘面试等，课程贯穿始终地强调有效沟通的三个关键词：良好意愿（goodwill）、换位思考（you-attitude）和可信度（credibility）。通过对项目答辩、社团活动组织与呈现、个人成长面试等真实组织环境中学生沟通技能综合运用的实践模拟，培养学生分析和解决实际管理问题、鼓励创造性思维、注重系统性思考的领导能力训练，为培养适应未来不确定环境下管理企业的优秀领导者奠定通识性素质基础。
default.en: ？Leadership is the core elements of the ability system of highly qualified personnel, and communication ability is an important manifestation of leadership. Through teaching and training systematically, will promote students' communication ability, and then achieve the goal of improving students' leadership. The course takes the understanding of leadership as the breakthrough point, and makes the students understand the important role of communication ability in leadership from two perspectives, namely, the functions of lead and the daily management focuses of leaders. Not only achieving the three basic functions of lead, determining target, finding path, and supervising and cultivating subordinates, but also in the daily management activities, the leaders have 70% of time spent in communication, and in management 70% of the problems derived from communication. Communication is the main content of leadership. With regard to the understanding of communication skills, the course focuses on the training of thinking and skills. The course will guide students to systematically understand the basic concepts and characteristics of communication, communication process and management elements, and basic communication skills, such as listening and feedback, speech, writing, interviews, meetings and so on. Throughout the course, three key words will be emphasized: good will, you-attitude, and credibility. By simulating the real organization environment, such as project defense, organization and presentation of university activities, recruitment interview and so on, the students could comprehensively use the communication skill, which could improve students' ability to analyze and solve practical management problems, encourage creative thinking, concentrate on the leadership training of systematic thinking, in order to cultivate general foundation for future excellent leaders to adapt to uncertain management surroundings.

default.zh: 《管理学基础》是管理类专业的必修基础课，是整个管理学科体系的基础。本课程所介绍的管理基本理论和原则是其他管理学科的概括和总结，将为学生后续课程的学习奠定基础。课程以企业组织为研究对象，通过对管理的一般性问题的研究，致力于研究管理者如何有效地管理其所在的组织. 课程通过管理基本理论的讲授、管理基本思想的介绍和管理思维的培养来提升学生的管理悟性。通过本课程学习，使学生掌握管理的基础知识和基本理论，了解和掌握管理理论的产生、发展和作用，了解管理过程即计划、组织、领导、控制四个阶段及具体的活动内容，并结合课堂讨论、案例分析和角色扮演培养学生的管理思维，及综合分析和解决管理问题的能力。
default.en: "Management Fundamentals" is a compulsory course of management and the basis of the entire discipline system of？management. The basic theory and principles of management introduced in this course are the generalization and summary of other management disciplines, which will lay the foundation for the students' advanced courses. This course is based on the research of corporate organization, and is devoted to the study of how managers can effectively manage their organization through the study of the general problems of management. The course introduces the basic theory and ideas of management and cultivates management thought for students to enhance their？management savvy.Studying this course, students can master the basic knowledge and theory of management; understand and master the generation, development and function of management theory; understand the management process which has four stages: planning, organization, leadership and control and specific activities in each stage. And then, with classroom discussions, case studies and role play, the management thought of student and the ability to comprehensively analyze and address management issues？can be well developed.

default.zh: 本课程综合法学、伦理学以及管理学、社会学等学科的理论和方法，为学生提供法学和伦理学基础知识。法律和商业伦理既是维持社会公正和经济秩序的基本行为规范，也是企业长远健康发展的基本保证。本课程采用案例教学为主的方法，结合管理专业的需求，有针对性地培养学生树立法律意识，自觉道德操守，增强责任意识。 课程目标1: 熟悉企业法律、伦理与社会责任相关概念、理论和法律法规 课程目标2: 运用相关理论识别、分析企业法律、伦理和社会责任相关实践中的问题，并做出正确的决策 思政目标1：培养学生现代商业伦理观念和职业道德。
default.en: This course integrates the theories and methods of law, ethics, management, sociology and other disciplines to provide students with basic knowledge of law and ethics. Law and business ethics are not only the basic norms of behavior to maintain social justice and economic order, but also the basic guarantee for the long-term healthy development of enterprises. This course adopts the method of case teaching and combines with the needs of management majors to train students to establish legal consciousness, conscious moral integrity and enhance their sense of responsibility. Course objective 1: Be familiar with concepts, theories, laws and regulations related to corporate law, ethics and social responsibility Objective 2: Use relevant theories to identify and analyze problems in corporate legal, ethical and social responsibility practices and make the right decisions Ideological and political goal 1: To cultivate students' modern business ethics and professional ethics.

default.zh: 市场营销学是工商管理类各专业的平台课，在学生的知识构成中发挥着重要的作用。本课程的教学目标是在相关基础课程完成的前提下，进行专业的基础理论与方法的训练。通过本门课的教学，使学生建立市场营销学的分析框架和思维方式，掌握营销管理的核心理论，逐步培养和训练学生联系实际的营销管理能力。同时，重点培养学生发现营销管理问题、分析营销管理问题和解决营销管理问题及有效沟通的能力。
default.en: Principles of Marketing is a ecnomic management platform class for various professional courses, the composition of the student's knowledge and play an important role. The teaching objectives of this course is to complete the foundation courses related to the premise to carry out professional training in basic theories and methods to develop a solid professional basis, and to prepare for the opening of specialized courses. By enabling students to develop the analytical framework for marketing and ways of thinking to grasp the basic concepts, the basic theories and the core of marketing management theories, and gradually develop and train students to practice marketing management capacity. Meanwhile, the focus on training students to identify marketing management problems, analyze marketing management problems,solve marketing management problems and effective communication skills.

default.zh: 经管类《跨专业综合实训》是经济管理试验班的一门认识实习课程，是在管理类平台课的基础上，依托经管类跨专业虚拟仿真综合实习平台、模拟现实仿真经济社会中制造型企业的全业务链过程开展的实践类课程。 该课程可以使学生对企业经营管理的基本过程有认知体验，认识经营管理各环节的工作内容和特点，为后续的专业学习奠定良好的基础；提高学生的观察能力、分析能力、判断能力和解决问题的能力，能运用所学知识解决简单的管理实践问题。同时，培养学生遵纪守法、爱岗敬业、诚实守信、社会责任、团结合作的职业精神。
default.en: "Comprehensive virtual simulation experiment of economics and management" is a cognitive practice course of the economic management pilot class. It is a practical course based on the management platform course, relying on the economic management cross specialty virtual simulation comprehensive practice platform, and simulating the whole business chain process of manufacturing enterprises in the economic society. This course can enable students to have a cognitive experience of the basic process of business management, understand the work content and characteristics of each link of business management, and lay a good foundation for subsequent professional learning; Improve students' observation ability, analysis ability, judgment ability and problem solving ability, and be able to use the knowledge learned to solve simple management practice problems. At the same time, we will cultivate students' professional spirit of abiding by disciplines and laws, loving their jobs, being honest and trustworthy, social responsibility, solidarity and cooperation.

default.zh: 会计学课程是经济管理学院平台课程之一，这门课程是经济管理类学生的基础课程，通过本门课程的学习使初学者掌握会计的基本理论、基本方法和基本技能。《会计学》课程内容包括会计定义、会计原则、会计假设、会计要素、会计基本等式、借贷记账法等基本理论，还包括制造业主要经济业务的核算，会计凭证、会计账簿和会计报表相关内容，还讲述了财产清查及会计核算形式等内容。
default.en: Basic Accounting is one of the courses offered by the School of Economics and Management. This course is the basic course for students of economic management. Through this course, students can master the basic theory, basic methods and basic skills of accounting. The accounting course includes the accounting theory, accounting principles, accounting assumptions, accounting elements, accounting basic equation, borrowing and accounting methods and other basic theory, but also the manufacturing economy of the main economic accounting, accounting documents, accounting books and accounting statements Related content, but also about the property inventory and accounting forms and other content.

default.zh: 会计学课程是经济管理学院平台课程之一，这门课程是经济管理类学生的基础课程，通过本门课程的学习使初学者掌握会计的基本理论、基本方法和基本技能。《会计学》课程内容包括会计定义、会计原则、会计假设、会计要素、会计基本等式、借贷记账法等基本理论，还包括制造业主要经济业务的核算，会计凭证、会计账簿和会计报表相关内容，还讲述了财产清查及会计核算形式等内容。
default.en: Basic Accounting is one of the courses offered by the School of Economics and Management. This course is the basic course for students of economic management. Through this course, students can master the basic theory, basic methods and basic skills of accounting. The accounting course includes the accounting theory, accounting principles, accounting assumptions, accounting elements, accounting basic equation, borrowing and accounting methods and other basic theory, but also the manufacturing economy of the main economic accounting, accounting documents, accounting books and accounting statements Related content, but also about the property inventory and accounting forms and other content.

default.zh: 《金融市场学》是经济与管理类专业的专业基础课之一，这门课对于希望较为全面知晓和把握金融基础理论及金融市场知识以及金融领域热点问题的同学会有帮助。本课程从三个方面进行讲授：第一篇 金融基础篇、第二篇 金融机构篇、第三篇 金融工具篇。具体讲授内容包括：金融范畴的形成与发展、货币与货币制度、国际货币体系与汇率制度、信用与信用形式、利息与利率、金融中介及其包括的范围、西方国家的金融中介体系、中国的金融中介体系、国际金融中介体系、存款货币银行、中央银行、现代货币的创造机制、金融市场及其要素、货币市场工具、资本市场工具、衍生工具市场、投资基金、证券价格与证券价格指数、资本市场的效率等。
default.en: 《Financial Markets》is one of the basic courses for economics and management majors. This course is helpful for students who want to understand and grasp the basic financial theories, financial markets knowledge and hot issues in the financial field in a more comprehensive way. This course is taught from three aspects: the first part of financial foundation, the second part of financial institutions, and the third part of financial instruments. Specific teaching contents include: the formation and development of financial category, money and monetary system, international monetary system and exchange rate system, credit and credit form, interest and interest rate, financial intermediaries and includes the scope, western financial intermediation system, China's financial intermediation system, international financial intermediation system, deposit money Banks, central bank, mechanism of modern monetary creation, financial markets and their elements, money market, capital market tools, derivatives markets, investment funds, stock price and the stock price index, the efficiency of capital market, etc.

default.zh: 《金融时间序列分析》主要介绍如何应用时间序列分析方法定量分析和描述具有随机特征的金融变量的动态发展规律和金融变量之间的相互关系。根据时间序列分析方法对金融现象进行认识分析，能够使用相关统计软件完成建模和预测等。本课程讲授的主要内容包括：线性时间序列模型、资产波动率模型及多元时间序列模型等。
default.en: [Financial Time Series Analysis] mainly introduces how to use time series analysis methods to quantitatively analyze and describe the dynamic laws of financial variables with random characteristics and the relationship between financial variables. Through the time series analysis method, we can understand and analyze financial phenomena, and can use relevant statistical software to complete modeling and forecasting. The main contents of this course include: linear time series model, asset volatility model and multivariate time series model.

default.zh: 经济学原理课程包括微观与宏观两部分。微观经济学以价格理论为中心，研究企业、家庭和单个市场等微观供求行为与价格之间关系。学习内容包括供求的含义及均衡价格的形成、与消费相关的效用论、与生产相关的生产理论和成本理论、市场与厂商理论和市场与福利等。宏观经济学以收入理论为中心，研究一个国家整体经济运行及政府如何运用经济政策来影响经济。学习内容包括国民经济的循环流转、国内生产总值的概念及基本核算方法、均衡国民收入的决定与乘数论、宏观经济政策的政策工具及应用、失业、货膨胀的形成原因及抑制通货膨胀的经济政策、经济增长的一般规律等。
default.en: The course of Principles of Economics includes two parts: microeconomics and macroeconomics. Microeconomics focuses on price theory and studies the relationship between micro supply and demand behavior and price of enterprises, households and single markets. The learning contents include the meaning of supply and demand and the formation of equilibrium price, the utility theory related to consumption, the production theory and cost theory related to production, the market and manufacturer theory, the market and welfare, etc. Macroeconomics focuses on income theory, studying the overall economic operation of a country and how the government uses economic policies to affect the economy. The learning contents include the circulation of the national economy, the concept and basic accounting methods of GDP, the determination and multiplier theory of balanced national income, the policy tools and applications of macroeconomic policies, the causes of unemployment and inflation, the economic policies to curb inflation, and the general laws of economic growth.

default.zh: 经济学原理课程包括微观与宏观两部分。微观经济学以价格理论为中心，研究企业、家庭和单个市场等微观供求行为与价格之间关系。学习内容包括供求的含义及均衡价格的形成、与消费相关的效用论、与生产相关的生产理论和成本理论、市场与厂商理论和市场与福利等。宏观经济学以收入理论为中心，研究一个国家整体经济运行及政府如何运用经济政策来影响经济。学习内容包括国民经济的循环流转、国内生产总值的概念及基本核算方法、均衡国民收入的决定与乘数论、宏观经济政策的政策工具及应用、失业、货膨胀的形成原因及抑制通货膨胀的经济政策、经济增长的一般规律等。

default.zh: 《宏观经济学》课程是以微观经济学为基础，强调总量分析方法，主要研究整个国民经济的总体经济行为，内容包括国民收入的生产、分配和消费，经济增长，失业，货币与通货膨胀，总需求与总供给，宏观经济政策等理论。《宏观经济学》课程可以为学生学习后续课程和进一步探究经济学知识奠定必要的基础。
default.en: Based on Microeconomics, Macroeconomics uses the aggregate analysis methods and focuses primarily on the aggregate economic behaviors of a national economy. Macroeconomics includes the following contents: the theory of production, distribution and consumption of the national income, economic growth, unemployment, monetary and inflation, aggregate demand and aggregate supply, macro-economic policy. The course of Macroeconomics can lay the necessary foundation for students to learn and further explore the knowledge of economics.

default.zh: 经济学基础（1）主要分析个体行为及其相互作用所产生的经济后果，并据此提出促进资源配置效率提高的相关微观政策。学生应该掌握激励、供求、成本、效用、市场结构、市场失灵等核心概念，并能够运用所学理论分析消费者行为、生产者行为、社会福利等领域的微观经济问题，并据此提出解决方案。通过本课程的学习，不仅可以掌握基本的微观经济学理论，还应该通过对经济学分析范式的反复应用，提高逻辑分析能力、问题识别能力和冲突解决能力等。通过课程的学习，学生应该深入理解个体决策的目标、动机及其效果, 能够在供求分析框架下分析市场均衡、社会福利和公共政策效果，深入理解不同的市场结构类型、特征及其均衡结果，深入理解成本理论、消费者行为理论、社会公平问题等相关知识，能够运用相关经济学理论分析现实问题，有根据的提出自己的观点。
default.en: Foundations of Economics (1) mainly analyzes individual behaviors and the economic consequences arising from their interactions, and accordingly proposes relevant microeconomic policies to improve the efficiency of resource allocation. Students are expected to master core concepts such as incentives, supply and demand, costs, utility, market structures, and market failures. They should also be able to apply the learned theories to analyze microeconomic issues in areas like consumer behavior, producer behavior, and social welfare, and put forward solutions based on this analysis. Through this course, students will not only grasp basic microeconomic theories but also enhance their logical analysis ability, problem identification ability, and conflict resolution ability by repeatedly applying the economic analysis paradigm. Additionally, they should deeply understand the goals, motivations, and effects of individual decisions, analyze market equilibrium, social welfare, and the effects of public policies within the supply-and-demand analysis framework, and gain a thorough comprehension of different market structure types, their characteristics, and equilibrium outcomes. Furthermore, students are required to deeply understand relevant knowledge such as cost theory, consumer behavior theory, and social equity issues, apply relevant economic theories to analyze real-world problems, and put forward well-founded viewpoints.

default.zh: 本课程主要研究市场经济中的消费者和企业的行为及其相互作用，描述市场经济的运行过程，分析市场机制的作用原理，从而解决社会资源的最优配置问题。课程旨在向学生介绍微观经济学的基本概念、基本构架和分析逻辑，培养对现实世界经济行为与经济现象的观察和运用马克思主义立场、观点和方法进行批判分析的能力，使学生能够批判地运用经济学的基本原理去观察、分析和解释现实生活中典型的经济现象和问题，并指导实践做出最优决策。 主要内容包括：（1）对微观经济学的深入理解和再认识（2）供求均衡价格理论；（3）需求理论；（4）生产与成本理论；（5）厂商行为与市场结构理论；（6）要素市场理论；（7）福利经济学。
default.en: The course mainly focuses on the behavior and interactions of consumers and enterprises in market economy and argues the principle of market mechanism so as to solve problem of optimal allocation of social resources. The course aims at introducing the basic concepts, framework and analytical logic of micro-economics to students, cultivating the ability to observe and apply Marxist standpoints, viewpoints and methods to critically analyze the real world economic behavior and economic phenomena, so that students can critically apply the basic principles of economics to observe, analyze and explain typical economic phenomena and problems in real life. And guide the practice to make the best decision. The main content of the course includes: (1) deep understanding and re-understanding of micro-economics, the research objects and methodology of Western economics, using Marxist standpoints and viewpoints to grasp useful analytical tools and methods; (2) Equilibrium theory of supply and demand; (3) demand theory; (4) production and cost theory; (5) Firm behavior and market structure theory; (6) Factor market theory; (7)Welfare Economics.

default.zh: 本课程是以微观经济学为基础，强调总量分析方法，主要研究整个国民经济的总体经济行为，内容包括国民收入的生产、分配和消费，经济增长，失业，货币与通货膨胀，总需求与总供给，宏观经济政策等理论。本课程可以为学生学习后续课程和进一步探究经济学知识奠定必要的基础。
default.en: Based on Microeconomics, this course uses the aggregate analysis methods and focuses primarily on the aggregate economic behaviors of a national economy. The course includes the following contents: the theory of production, distribution and consumption of the national income, economic growth, unemployment, monetary and inflation, aggregate demand and aggregate supply, macro-economic policy. The course can lay the necessary foundation for students to learn and further explore the knowledge of economics.

default.zh: 国际商务是经济与管理专业的毕业生必备的专业基础知识，是一门非常重要的专业基础课程。课程主要内容包括：全球经济一体化中的国际企业、贸易自由化和贸易保护的相关理论基础、贸易政策工具和国际多边贸易体制、国际商务活动中进入外国市场的策略和方式、国际金融概述、国际收支的基本概念和理论、国际收支平衡表及其主要内容、国际收支调节理论等。通过本课程的学习，使学生透彻掌握进国际商务的基本理论和主要知识，并具备运用理论分析问题的能力，开拓学生的国际视野。
default.en: International business is an essential basic knowledge for graduates of economics and management, which is a very important professional basic course.The main contents of the course include: the international enterprise in global economic integration , free trade and protectionism of the relevant theoretical basis, instruments of trade policy and the international multilateral trade system, strategies and methods for entering foreign markets in international business activities, international financial overview, basic concepts and theories of balance of payments,balance of payments and its main contents, balance of payments adjustment theory, etc.Through the study of this course, students will be able to master the basic theories and main knowledge of international business, and have the ability to use theoretical analysis to develop their international vision.

default.zh: 电子商务、社交网络、云计算、移动互联网与金融科技的快速发展把人类社会带入一个全新的数据驱动商业时代，对多维度数据的获取、管理和分析以辅助商业决策的能力已成为企业在大数据时代的核心竞争力之一。本课程属于经济与管理专业本科生基础课程，力图引导学生从技术和商业双视角学习商务数据分析的基础知识，将介绍数据挖掘、商务智能、机器学习和统计建模等数据分析基本概念，讲授描述统计、分类、回归、关联规则挖掘、数据可视化等数据分析基础方法的原理和应用方法，并引入在线推荐系统、金融大数据分析、流水线生产管理等商务管理场景下的实践及学术案例，与学生讨论误导性信息、隐私计算、算法伦理与监管等拓展话题。课程目标为帮助学生理解并掌握商务数据分析领域的基本概念、知识和方法以解决实践问题，学习数据分析工具R语言和RStudio的基本用法以完成数据分析流程和商务决策辅助。
default.en: Advancements in E-commerce, social network, cloud computing, mobile Internet, and FinTech have brought the human society into a new era of data-driven business. The capability of assisting business decision-making from the acquirement, management, and analysis of multi-dimensional data has become one of the core competencies for firms in the era of big data. As a fundamental course for the undergraduate students in the discipline of economics and management, this course aims to guide the students to learn the essentials of business data analysis from both the technological and business perspectives. We will cover the basic concepts of BDA: data mining, business intelligence, machine learning, statistical modeling, etc., and lecture on the theory basis and applications of the key data analysis tools including summary statistics, classification, regression, association rules mining, data visualization. The course will also feature the introduction to practical cases and academic research in various business management scenarios such as online recommender systems, financial big data analysis, and production line management, and discussions of contemporary extended topics including misinformation, privacy computing, ethics and regulation of algorithms, etc. The goals of this course are to help the students utilize the basic concepts, knowledge, and tools of BDA to solve practical problems, and to train their ability of using basic functions of R language in RStudio to perform data analysis and assist business decision-making.

default.zh: 公共管理，或者说公共行政是一门以致力于发展优异的治理的科学、知识和艺术。它日益受到理论和实务部门人士的广泛重视。公共事务、治理与领导力是公共行政领导力辅修专业的统领性课程，其教学目的就是让学生从整体的视角掌握公共行政领导力的知识框架。 本课程分为三大板块，即对公共事务的全面了解、对治理的历史演变与方法的掌握和领导力的概况与基本素质要求，这三大板块既相互独立又相互联系，促使学生在认知上由专业能力向社会服务能力扩展，为整体的公共行政领导力的学习打下基础。本课程由八讲完成，公共事务板块两讲、公共管理与治理板块四讲、领导力板块两讲。
default.en: Public administration, also known as public management, is a discipline that focuses on fostering effective governance. It has garnered significant attention from both theoretical and practical fields. Public affairs, governance, and leadership is a prominent course for the minor major of public administration leadership. Its teaching objective is to equip students with a comprehensive understanding of the framework of public administration leadership. The course consists of three major components: a comprehensive understanding of public affairs, an overview of the historical evolution of governance, and an introduction to leadership methods and basic quality requirements. These three components are both independent and interconnected, and aim to enhance students' cognitive and social service abilities, providing a strong foundation for public administrative leadership. The course comprises eight lectures, including three on public affairs, three on governance, and two on leadership.

default.zh: 算法与数据结构是一门重要专业基础课，主要介绍计算机解决非数值信息处理问题时所用的各种数据组织方法、存储数据结构的方法以及在各种结构上执行操作的算法。课程帮助学生较熟练地掌握线性表、栈、队列、数组、串、树、二又树、图等基本数据结构及相关算法，以及排序和查找原理与方法等。课程培养和训练学生运用高级程序设计语言编写设计清晰、可读性好的算法及初步评价算法的能力。通过本课程的学习，使学生较全面地掌握基本数据结构和算法相关的基础理论和知识，提高抽象表达实际问题并设计有效算法解决实际问题的能力，为学习后续课程奠定基础。
