default.en: This course is focus on the fundamental data structures and algorithms, along with supporting theoretical foundations and practical applications, which mainly introduces the various data organization methods used by computers to solve non-numerical information processing problems, the methods of storing data structure and the algorithms that perform operations on various structures. Topics include the following: 1. Data structures: linear tables, stacks, queues, strings, trees, heaps, hash tables, etc. 2. Efficient algorithms for sorting and searching. 3. Possible additional topics: algorithm design techniques like divide-and-conquer, dynamic programming, greedy algorithms etc. The course will help students to master the basic data structure and related algorithms, to use advanced programming language to write clearly designed, readable algorithms with preliminary algorithms evaluation, and to improve the ability to express practical problems in abstract term and solve it as well, which contributes to future study.

default.zh: 本课程系辅修学位的基础课程，旨在使学生深入了解政治学科的基本知识及其当代发展，掌握政治分析基本概念和方法，以及作为学科的“公共政策”基本的学科内容和较为系统的理论分析方法。以问题为导向，培养学生应用理论工具进行政治分析与政策分析的能力。 本课程主要包括政治科学理论以及政策科学理论两部分。具体内容包括：政治学的研究对象与研究领域，政治学的研究方法，政治学的基本框架与当代流派，现代政治运作的基本制度与政治决策过程；公共政策的基本概念、理论框架、基本要素，公共政策分析的价值观念、思维方法、模型路径；当代中国政府的结构和运行逻辑，当代中国公共政策制定与评估。 本课程以理论讲授以及案例讨论方式进行，通过本课程的学习，学生能初步掌握当代政治科学的研究范式，应用公共政策分析理论与分析工具，解构中国政府的结构和运行逻辑，培养科技领域领军人才的宏观政治意识与政策分析能力。
default.en: This course is one of the foundation courses for minor double degree, designed to enable students to master basic concepts and methods of political analysis. And it enables students to master basic subject content and systematic method of policy theoretical analysis. It trains students' ability to apply theoretical tools for problem-oriented political analysis and policy analysis. This course mainly includes political science theory and policy science theory. The curriculum including: research object and field of political science, research method of political science, basic framework of political science and contemporary research schools, basic system of modern political operation and the process of political decision-making, basic concepts, theoretical framework and elements of public policy, values, thinking methods and model path of public policy analysis, structure and operation logic of contemporary Chinese government. This course will be taught by the way of teaching and case analysis. Through the study of this course, students can master the research paradigm of contemporary political science, and apply public policy analysis theory and analysis tools. Students can deconstrue the Chinese government's structure and operation logic. Then we get the goal of cultivating the macro-political consciousness and policy analysis ability of leading talents in the field of science and technology.

default.zh: Python程序设计课程是大数据管理与应用专业的主要选修课程。通过本课程的教学使学生了解Python程序设计的基本规则，掌握运用Python处理相关数据。掌握Python数据处理的基本理论和方法，并具备一定的实践能力，为今后从事相关工作打下基础。
default.en: This course is the main elective course for big data management and application majors. Through the teaching of this course, students will understand the basic rules of Python programming and master the use of Python to process relevant data. Master the basic theories and methods of Python data processing, and possess certain practical abilities, laying a foundation for future related work.

default.zh: 为了培养学生在大数据环境下处理数据和管理数据的能力，本课程将主要通过课堂教学讲授数据、结构化数据、半结构化数据、非结构化数据、大数据等的概念及相应的数据管理理论与方法，并采用案例教学的方式讲授大数据在经济管理中的应用。结构化数据的管理主要通过关系数据库系统完成，相关内容包括关系数据库的特点、关系代数、SQL语句、关系数据库设计、数据库的安全性和完整性控制等。半结构化数据和非结构化数据的管理主要通过键值数据库、文档数据库等数据库管理系统来完成，课程的相关内容包括NoSQL的基本概念、键值数据库、文档数据库等的存储模式及其应用方法等。学生还将通过自主学习掌握一种流行的关系数据库管理系统、文档数据库管理系统及键值数据库管理系统的应用方法。
default.en: In order to develop students' ability of data processing and data management in a big data environment, this course will teach the concepts of data, structured data, semi-structured data, unstructured data, big data, and other concepts and corresponding data management theories and methods, and will teach the application of big data in economic and managerial field by case teaching. The management of structured data is mainly done through relational database system, which includes the characteristics of relational database, relational algebra, SQL statements, relational database design, database security and integrity control, etc. The management of semi-structured data and unstructured data is mainly done through the database management system such as key value database and document database, and the relevant contents of the course include the concept of NoSQL, the storage mode of key value database, document database and so on. Students will also learn how to solve the data management problems with a popular relationship database management system, document database management system and key value database management system.

default.zh: 为了培养学生量化分析经济管理问题的能力，本课程以概率论与数理统计、应用统计为基础，介绍数据挖掘中常用的多元统计建模方法以及开源统计软件R。通过课堂教学使学生了解多维数据的建模方法，掌握聚类与分类、数据压缩、相关分析与预测的基本原理和建模流程。教学主要内容包括：聚类分析、判别分析、主成分分析、因子分析和回归分析。其次，通过上机实验和探究式学习，使学生掌握各种分析方法的R实现，加深学生对这些建模方法的认识，增强学生利用统计软件处理数据和建模的能力。最后，结合实际经济管理数据，通过案例教学使学生能够根据不同类型的经济管理问题选择多元统计分析方法，进而培养学生从海量数据中发现问题、分析问题，并提供解决方案的能力。
default.en: This course aims to cultivate the students’ capability of conducting quantitative analysis on business and economics problems. Grounded in probability theory and applied statistics, this course will introduce the basic statistical methods and the most popular open-source statistical software used in data mining -- R to the students majored in E-commerce. The course will make the students understand the main techniques for manipulating the multi-dimensional big data. These techniques can be used for clustering and classification, data reduction, correlation analysis and forecasting. The course will teach cluster analysis, discriminant analysis, principal component analysis, factor analysis, and regression analysis methods. Through lab experiments and explorative study, the course also seeks to teach the students the implementation of different analysis methods in R software, and enhance their understanding of the different methods and their capability to manipulate data and construct statistical models via software. Finally, via case study approach and real data of business and economics problems, the course helps the students learn how to choose the appropriate multivariate analysis technique for different types of business problems, thus enhance the students’ ability to find, analyze, and solve problems in extensive data.

default.zh: 人工智能与机器学习课程是大数据管理与应用专业的核心课程。通过本课程的教学使学生从概念、基本理论及实际应用等方面了解机器学习。掌握机器学习的基本理论与方法，并具备一定的实践能力。通过教学提高学生利用机器学习方法解决实际管理问题的能力，扩展专业知识，为今后从事相关工作打下基础。
default.en: The course of artificial intelligence and machine learning is the core course of big data management and application. Through the teaching of this course, students will understand machine learning from concepts, basic theories, and practical applications. Master the basic theories and methods of machine learning, and possess certain practical abilities. By teaching, students can enhance their ability to use machine learning methods to solve practical management problems, expand their professional knowledge, and lay a foundation for future related work.

default.zh: 人工智能与机器学习课程是大数据管理与应用专业的核心课程。通过本课程的教学使学生从概念、基本理论及实际应用等方面了解机器学习。掌握机器学习的基本理论与方法，并具备一定的实践能力。通过教学提高学生利用机器学习方法解决实际管理问题的能力，扩展专业知识，为今后从事相关工作打下基础。
default.en: The course of artificial intelligence and machine learning is the core course of big data management and application. Through the teaching of this course, students will understand machine learning from concepts, basic theories, and practical applications. Master the basic theories and methods of machine learning, and possess certain practical abilities. By teaching, students can enhance their ability to use machine learning methods to solve practical management problems, expand their professional knowledge, and lay a foundation for future related work.

default.zh: 《大数据互联网金融》是一门培养学生理解和运用大数据互联网金融的相关专业知识、批判性思维能力的课程。本课程主要讲授大数据互联网金融的基本概念，理论基础与技术基础，多种互联网金融业务模式（第三方支付、P2P网络借贷和众筹）的特点与发展情况，银行数字化、货币数字化与区块链前沿知识，以及大数据互联网金融风险与监管科技，同时，对结合相关案例对大数据互联网金融的相关知识进行深入解析与探讨。通过课程的课堂教学与案例讨论，着重培养学生学习大数据互联网金融的专业知识，掌握和了解其在实践中的发展与应用，支撑专业学习成果中相应指标点的达成。
default.en: Big Data and Fintech is a course to cultivate students' understanding and application of relevant professional knowledge and critical thinking ability of big data and Fintech. This course mainly teaches the basic concept, theoretical basis and technical basis of big data Internet finance, the characteristics and development of various Internet finance business models (third-party payment, P2P online lending, and crowdfunding), the frontier knowledge of bank digitalization, currency digitalization and blockchain, as well as the risk and regulatory technology of big data Internet finance. Combined with relevant cases, the relevant knowledge of big data Internet finance is deeply analyzed and discussed. Through classroom teaching and case discussion, the course focuses on cultivating students' professional knowledge of big data Internet finance, mastering and understanding its development and application in practice.

default.zh: 这门课程涉及数字时代管理的基础概念和理论。具体来说，该课程关注企业如何通过建立数字基础设施和数字管理能力来适应数字时代的各种挑战。本课程中的知识和观点将使学生能够更深入地了解数字时代的企业管理。
default.en: This course is about the foundational concepts and theories of management in the digital era. Specifically, this course focuses on how firms can adapt to the various challenges of the digital era, by building digital infrastructures and digital management capabilities. The knowledge and perspectives in this course will enable students to gain a deeper understanding about business management in the digital era.

default.zh: 本课程是经济管理专业的基础课程，主要任务是培养学生收集数据和分析数据的能力，为后续课程的学习以及在经济管理领域从事定量研究奠定方法论基础。本课程主要讲授统计学的基本理论和基本方法，侧重统计方法在经济管理领域中的应用。通过本课程的学习，使学生能够正确地解释和使用常用的统计指标，掌握搜集和处理数据的基本方法，并利用统计分析软件对数据进行运算、建模和解读分析。本课程的内容包括统计资料的收集与整理、统计资料的描述、推断理论基础、参数估计、假设检验、χ2检验和方差分析、相关与回归分析、时间数列分析和指数分析。
default.en: This course is compulsory for all undergraduate students in School of Management, whose primary purpose is to develop the skills in business data analysis and to lay down the necessary theoretical foundation for future study. As an elementary level course on statistics, this course mainly focuses on how to apply statistical methods to address issues in business environment. By taking this course, the students are supposed to be able to 1) understand commonly used statistical notations and concepts, 2) collect data in a justifiable way, 3) correctly apply quantitative data analysis methods with the help of statistical software, and interpret results appropriately in business context. The contents of this course include: data collection and description, statistical inference theories, parameter estimation, hypothesis testing, χ2 test and analysis of variance, correlation and regression, time series data and index numbers.

default.zh: Python程序设计课程是大数据管理与应用专业的主要选修课程。通过本课程的教学使学生了解Python程序设计的基本规则，掌握运用Python处理相关数据。掌握Python数据处理的基本理论和方法，并具备一定的实践能力，为今后从事相关工作打下基础。
default.en: This course is the main elective course for big data management and application majors. Through the teaching of this course, students will understand the basic rules of Python programming and master the use of Python to process relevant data. Master the basic theories and methods of Python data processing, and possess certain practical abilities, laying a foundation for future related work.

default.zh: 战略管理是管理的重要组成部分，是在企业面对激烈变化的环境、残酷的市场竞争情况下，企业管理人员为了企业长期的生存和发展，确定和选择达到目标的动态管理过程。通过本课程的教学，使学生了解战略管理的基础知识，理解战略管理的基本概念，掌握进行战略分析、战略选择基本方法，帮助学生树立战略管理观念和思想，培养学生独立思考的能力，为他们以后从事相关实践工作和理论研究奠定基础。
default.en: Strategic management is an important component of management, which is a dynamic management process in which enterprise managers determine and choose to achieve goals for the long-term survival and development of the enterprise in the face of fierce changes in the environment and fierce market competition. Through the teaching of this course, students will understand the basic knowledge of strategic management, understand the basic concepts of strategic management, master the basic methods of strategic analysis and strategic selection, help students establish strategic management concepts and ideas, cultivate their independent thinking ability, and lay a foundation for their practical work and theoretical research in the future.

default.zh: 管理学研究方法是工商管理本科培养课程的重要组成部分。它是在学生掌握了一定的管理学基础课程以及统计学基本知识的前提下，进一步培养学生基本科学素养和研究能力的一门课程。该课程的授课内容主要内容包括科学哲学概述、管理学研究基本范式、研究问题提出、概念及其测量、构建概念间关系(视角、理论、机制、中介与调节)、理论贡献、研究设计以及数据分析等多个部分构成。它适合工商管理相关所有专业学生研修。它为培养具有高概念能力的管理者、高学术能力的研究生奠定基础。
default.en: Research design and method is among the core lectures of Corporation Administration. It is a lecture that can cultivate and develop students’ basic scientific quality and research skill. In order to master this lecture, students should know statistics and basic management knowledge in advance. It consists of philosophy of science, basic paradigms of management research, the proposition of research question, concept and its measurement, linking the concepts (perspective, theory, mechanism and mediator and moderators), theoretical contribution, research design and data analysis et al. it is suitable for every student of corporate management. It can be essential to cultivate managers with high conceptual skill and postgraduates with high academic skill.

default.zh: 本课程希望帮助学生了解创业基础理论、掌握识别创业机会的方法，准确捕捉市场痛 点、进行初步产品功能和服务设计，了解创业完整过程，并建立创业企业的商业模式和盈利方案，进行财务分析和融资规划。激发学生的创业激情，开发学生的创业潜能，使学生锻炼创业创意、创业计划宣讲及路演的实战技能；了解和掌握创业计划撰写的理论基础；了解和掌握创业计划撰写中关于市场分析、营销管理知识及方法，商业模式、生产计划/经商计划、财务分析、风险分析等等方法，具备分析和解决企业管理实践中积淀的系统问题的能力；熟悉和掌握常见企业创业的准备过程和实际管理过程，得到在企业创业准备和具体企业管理过程中的每一个环节的管理技能获得的基本训练，逐步具有应用先进工具解决创业企业实际管理问题的能力。
default.en: This course is expected to help students understand the basic theory of entrepreneurship, master the method of identifying entrepreneurial opportunities, accurately capture the market pain points, conduct preliminary product function and service design, establish the business model and profit plan of entrepreneurial firm, and conduct financial analysis and financing planning.Stimulate students' entrepreneurial passion, develop students' entrepreneurial potential, practice the practical skills of business plan presentation and road show; Understand and master the theoretical basis of business plan writing; Understand and master the knowledge and methods of market analysis, marketing management, business model, production plan/business plan, financial analysis, risk analysis and other methods in business plan writing, and have the ability to analyze and solve systemic problems accumulated in enterprise management practice; Familiar with and master the common preparation process and actual management process of enterprise entrepreneurship, get the basic training of management skills in every link of enterprise entrepreneurship preparation and specific enterprise management process, and gradually have the ability to apply advanced tools to solve practical management problems of entrepreneurial enterprises.

default.zh: 本课程主要面向经济与管理学院工商管理专业、市场营销专业的本科学生，是专业平台核心课程。希望使同学们掌握企业组织管理中的“人”的作用，人力资源管理的意义、内容和特征。在教学环节中着重培养学生的实战能力，人力资源管理的策划能力和组织能力，以及对人力资源管理的量化能力。通过人力资源管理课程的学习，使学生能够对相关的理论体系与方法有一个较全面的了解，掌握运用相关信息做出分析，学会剖析和解决问题的思路与方法，能供理论与实际相结合，是人力资源管理中的组织思想和管理技术的运用融入企业管理体系及企业整体的发展战略之中：结合案例、讨论使学生掌握人力资源管理的基本知识和工具的使用，并使之成为一个有效的管理者知识结构中的重要组成部分。 课程主要包括：人力资源管理理论发展及特征概念基本原理、工作分析、人力资源规划、招聘、薪酬管理、绩效考核、培训。本课程考试成绩采用累加式，包括期末笔试、平时测评和作业三部分。 课程最后的成绩采用累加式，综合考虑期末、平时测评、作业等。
default.en: This course is mainly aimed at undergraduate students majoring in business administration and marketing in the school of economics and management. It is the core course of professional platform. It is hoped that the students will grasp the role of "human" in enterprise organization and management, the meaning, content and characteristics of human resource management. The teaching process focuses on training students' practical ability, the planning ability and organizational ability of human resource management, and the quantitative ability of human resource management. Through the study of Human Resource Management courses, so that the students can of relevant theoretical system and the method has a more comprehensive understanding, to master relevant information used to make analysis, learn to analysis and the idea and method to solve the problem, can be used for integrating theory with practice, is the organization in human resources management idea and management technology used in enterprise management system and the overall development strategy: combining case, discussion to make the students master the basic knowledge and management tool of the human resource management, and make it become an effective and important management part of the knowledge structure. The courses mainly include: human resource management theory development and the basic principle of characteristic concept, job analysis, human resource planning, recruitment, salary management, performance appraisal, training. The exam results of this course are cumulative, including the final written test, the usual assessment and the assignments. The final grades of the course are accumulated, including the scores of the final, the usual assessment, homework and so on.

default.zh: 运营管理是一门非常重要的课程，它关注的是如何创造人们赖以生存的产品和服务。越来越多的公司也认识到有效的运营管理可以提高产品和服务水平，进而提高收入。本课程主要讲授了生产与运作的基本概念、生产与运作战略、产品与服务开发、运营网络设计与布置、工作设计、生产计划、质量管理等内容。另外，鉴于全球化、数字化、社会责任及可持续发展给企业运营带来的影响，本课程还将指导学生共同分析生产与运作管理在未来发展面临的挑战和机遇。在教学过程中，教师将结合具体教学内容，组织案例研讨和自主学习。通过本课程的教学，使学生能够了解生产与运作管理的基础知识，掌握生产与运作管理的基本概念和各项生产与运作工作的理论、方法，并结合案例讨论使学生熟练应用课程规定的内容，帮助学生树立系统管理观念和思想，培养学生独立思考的能力，为他们以后从事相关实践工作和理论研究奠定基础。
default.en: Production and Operations Management is important. It is concerned with creating the products and services upon which we all depend. More and more companies have come to realize that effective production and operations management gives the potential to improve revenues and, at the same time, enables goods and services to be produced more efficiently. This course mainly introduces the basic concepts of production and operations, operations strategy, products and services design, operations network design and layout, job design, production plan, quality management, etc. Otherwise, in view of the impact of globalization, digitalization, social responsibility and sustainable development on operations management, this course will guide students to analyze the challenges and opportunities of production and operations management in the future. During the class, teachers will integrate case learning and self-directed learning on the basis of teaching content. This course will help the students understand the basic concepts of production and operations management, and help them master the theory and methods of production and operations management. By discussing the cases in class, the students can not only establish the system of management knowledge but also strengthen their ability to think independently. All in all, this course will help them lay a foundation for their future studying and working.

default.zh: 毕业论文写作是大学生培养的重要环节。通过本课程的学习，可以帮助学生掌握如何确定研究选题的方法，掌握研究设计的路径和思维方法，掌握引言和文献综述的写作方法，掌握研究假设的提出方法，掌握选择研究方法和资料分析的技巧，掌握讨论与结论的写作方法，提高论文写作的基本规范。总体来说，本课程不仅能够提高学生对工商管理专业知识的理解和掌握水平，还有利于培养学生的知识运用能力、创新能力、逻辑思维、系统思维，对于培养学生严谨和科学的学术态度也大有裨益。
default.en: Dissertation Writing is an important part of university students' education. Through the study of this course, students can learn how to choose the research topic, master the path and thinking method of research design, master the writing method of introduction and literature review, master the method of positioning research hypotheses, master the skills of selecting research methods and data analysis, master the writing method of discussion and conclusion, and improve the basic standard of paper writing. In general, this course can not only improve the students' understanding of the professional knowledge of business management, but also help to cultivate the students' ability to use knowledge, innovation, logical thinking and systematic thinking, as well as the students' rigorous and scientific academic attitude.

default.zh: 数智时代的企业面临更加复杂多变的市场环境，消费者的需求呈现多样化、个性化的发展趋势。市场调查和分析是现代企业了解市场和顾客需求的重要手段，是企业进行各种决策的基础。《市场调查与分析》是一门实践性很强的课程，主要是介绍市场调研的基本理论知识和具体方法，包括市场调研的基础概念、市场调研设计、定性调查方法、问卷调查法、实验法、二手数据和在线数据库、标准化信息源、数据平台、描述性分析、差异分析和预测分析及市场调研报告的撰写等。该课程将前沿信息科学的知识融入到市场调研中，拓展调研数据的范畴、丰富调研设计的方法、挖掘调研背后的影响机制、有效分析调研的结果、清晰阐述调研的发现。 同时将这些理论、知识和方法与企业的市场调研实践紧密结合，具有很的实用性和可操作性。通过熟悉和掌握现代市场调查与分析的基本方法，使学生能够有效地利用这一基本工具，能运用于市场研究中解决实际营销工作的问题。
default.en: Enterprises in the era of digital intelligence are facing a more complex and changeable market environment, and consumers' needs are showing a trend of diversification and individualization. Market survey and analysis are important for modern enterprises to understand the market and customer needs and are the basis for enterprises to make various decisions. The course "Market Survey and Analysis" is a subject with strong practicality. It mainly introduces the basic theoretical knowledge and specific methods of market research, including the basic concepts of market survey, market survey design, qualitative survey methods, questionnaire surveys, and experiments methods, secondary data and online databases, standardized information sources, data platforms, descriptive analysis, differential analysis and predictive analysis, and writing of market research reports, etc. This course integrates the knowledge of cutting-edge information science into market research, expands the scope of research data, enriches the methods of research design, excavates the influencing mechanism behind the research, effectively analyzes the results of the research, and clearly expounds the findings of the research. At the same time, these theories, knowledge and methods are closely combined with the market research practice of the enterprise, which is very practical and operable. By familiarizing with and mastering the basic methods of modern market research and analysis, students can learn to use this basic tool effectively and apply it in market research to solve practical marketing problems.

default.zh: 《中级财务会计》是研究会计理论、会计核算方法、企业资金运动的综合性技术科学，是会计学专业的主干课程和专业必修课。它以工业企业的资金运动为研究对象，以会计信息系统的四大环节，会计要素的确认、计量、记录和报告，为主线、系统地分析引起六大会计要素变化的相关会计业务处理及会计信息提供的基本原理和方法。 课程主要介绍会计确认、计量、记录和报告的程序和方法。这既是财务会知识体系中的主体部分，又是企业会计工作中最重要、最基本的内容，既是对会计学原理中揭示的基本理论、基本知识和基本方法的具体运用，又是进一步学习高级财务会计的必要前提和基础。
default.en: Intermediate Financial Accounting is comprehensive technical science studying on the accounting theory, accounting method and the enterprise capital movement, it is a main and required course of accounting major. It regard industrial enterprise capital movement as the research object. The course introduces the four links of accounting information system: the recognition, measurement, record and report of accounting elements as the main line, systematically analyzes the accounting business processes that lead to the change of six accounting elements and the basic principle and method provided by accounting information. Namely the procedures and methods of accounting recognition, measurement, record and report. It is not only the main part of financial knowledge system , but also the most important and basic content in the enterprise accounting work. Not only the application of the basic theory, basic knowledge and basic methods revealed by the accounting principles, but also the necessary premise and basis to further study the senior financial accounting.

default.zh: 《税法》课程是会计学和财务管理专业本科生必须学习的一门课程，可以帮助学生构建完善的专业知识体系。会计学和财务管理专业的学生毕业后主要从事企业的财会税收工作，纳税知识是每一个企业、每一个财务工作者、每一个公民应具备的基本知识，需要在本科生学习阶段打好基础并提升处理涉税问题的技能。学好税法可以帮助企业更好地贯彻落实国家的税收政策、正确纳税、避免违法行为，严控偷逃税行为，促进企业健康稳健地发展，依法履行社会责任。近年来，我国不断深化税制改革，使税收政策更加适应国家发展建设的需要，推动经济可持续增长。可以说，税收关乎国家的发展大计和长治久安，税收知识不断更新，大学生必须在本科生学习阶段树立正确的纳税观念，夯实税收基础知识，掌握最新的税收政策，而且不断地提升自我学习和进步的能力，才能更好地做好将来的本职工作，正确履行纳税人应尽的纳税义务。 《税法》课程结合最新的税制改革方向，讲解最新的税收政策和税收知识，培养学生科学合理的纳税理念，解决企业和个人处理涉税问题的能力，提高企业的纳税管理水平，依法合规纳税，诚信纳税，促进企业安全稳健地发展，利国利民。
default.en: The course of Taxation Laws is a mandatory course for undergraduate students majoring in Accounting and Financial Management, which can help them build a comprehensive professional knowledge system. After graduation, students majoring in accounting and financial management mainly engage in the financial and tax work of enterprises. Tax knowledge is a basic knowledge that every enterprise, every financial worker, and every citizen should possess. It is necessary to lay a solid foundation and improve the skills to handle tax related issues during the undergraduate learning stage. Learning Taxation Laws well can help enterprises better implement national tax policies, pay taxes correctly, avoid illegal activities, strictly control tax evasion, promote healthy and stable development of enterprises, and fulfill social responsibilities in accordance with the law. In recent years, China has continuously deepened its tax system reform, making tax policies more suitable for the needs of national development and construction, and promoting sustainable economic growth. It can be said that taxation is related to the development plan and long-term stability of the country. Tax knowledge is constantly changing, and college students must establish a correct tax concept, consolidate their basic knowledge of taxation, master the latest tax policies, and continuously improve their self-learning and further abilities during the undergraduate learning stage. Only in this way can they better do their future job and fulfill the tax obligations that taxpayers should fulfill correctly. The course of Taxation Laws combines the latest direction of tax system reform, explains the latest tax policies and knowledge, cultivates students' scientific and reasonable tax concepts, solves the ability of enterprises and individuals to handle tax related issues, improves the level of tax management of enterprises, pays taxes in accordance with the law and regulations, pays taxes with integrity, promotes the safe and stable development of enterprises, and benefits the country and the people.

default.zh: “会计信息系统”是国家精品课程和国家精品在线开放课程，是会计学、财务管理、信息系统、大数据等专业学生非常重要的课程。本课程以系统的观点，软件工程学的方法，揭示了会计信息系统的内在联系和运动规律。使学生掌握会计信息系统的基本理论，会计软件的开发方法、开发步骤、系统设计思想、系统结构和应具备的基本功能，以及数据存储设计，输入输出设计等，了解会计信息系统的子系统划分，各子系统的分析、设计以及子系统之间的联系。使学生能在会计工作实践中，分析设计系统管理、凭证管理、出纳管理、账簿管理、报表管理等系统，并掌握会计软件开发方法和实际应用会计软件的能力，通过使用具有代表性的通用财务软件（如：用友ERP等），能够增强学生的实际动手能力，拓展学生的知识面。课堂理论教学与上机实验紧密融合，能够增强学生的系统设计理论水平和实际动手能力。为将来参加实际工作奠定坚实的知识基础。为培养既懂会计又懂ERP软件开发与应用的复合型人才发挥作用。
default.en: Accounting information system is a national-level quality course and national-level MOOC. It is one of important professional courses on accounting,finance management,information system,big data. With system viewpoint and the method of software engineering, it shows the inner relations of accounting information system. By learning this course, it makes students master some theories and methods, such as the basic theory of accounting information system, the development method of accounting software, the development steps, system design thoughts, system structure with basic functions, data storage design, input/output design, program design etc. students should understand the partition of subsystem, the analysis, design of each subsystem and the relation between subsystems which is of accounting information system. When students practice, they can analyze system management, credence management, receive and pay out money management, account book management and master the development method of accounting software as well as the ability to use the accounting software in practice. By using some famous financial soft wares, students not only obtain the ability to practice, but also learn system design method, the design program method and some skills about program. Accordingly student’s knowledge is expanded. Their ability to control financial decision support system is improved. Their knowledge becomes abundance. These are good for doing works in enterprise. It will play a positive role to cultivate the interdisciplinary who are both with accounting knowledge and ERP software development and application.

default.zh: 《财务管理》是经济管理大类的一门基础的、重要的主干专业课程。本课程以资本市场为背景，以现代公司制企业为对象，通过以组织企业财务活动、处理企业财务管理的一系列经济管理工作为线索展开，主要介绍企业财务管理的基本原理、概念和目标，并按照企业的经营活动着重阐述企业的资本筹集、资本运用及收益分配问题，最终实现企业的价值增长。通过本课程的学习，学生应达到如下基本要求： 1.理解并应用财务管理的基本理论和方法来分析企业的价值管理问题； 2.掌握企业财务管理的主要内容、目标及基本原则； 3.熟练掌握和运用财务决策的基本原理和决策工具； 4.使得学生能够实现对公司价值管理的全面性、综合性理解；通过财务指标、财务模型、财务函数等的学习，具备对企业的价值管理活动做出预测和决策运用的能力。
default.en: Financial Management is a basic and important main professional course of economics and management. With capital market as the background and modern corporate enterprises as the object, this course mainly introduces the basic principles, concepts and objectives of corporate financial management by focusing on a series of economic management work such as the organization of corporate financial activities and dealing with corporate financial management. In addition, it highlights the problems of capital raising, capital utilization and income distribution, and finally realizes the value growth of the enterprise according to the business activities of the enterprise. Through this course, students should meet the following basic requirements: 1.Understand and apply the basic theories and methods of financial management to analyze the value management of enterprises 2.Master the main contents, objectives and basic principles of enterprise financial management; 3.Master and apply the basic principles of financial decision-making and decision-making tools; 4.Enable students to realize a comprehensive and integrated understanding of corporate value management through the study of financial indicators, financial models, financial functions, etc., they have the ability to make predictions and decision-making applications for corporate value management activities.

default.zh: 财务管理学是一门实用性很强的课程，它融合了经济、会计、财务、法律和管理等多个领域的知识。本课程主要教授如何理解和应用资金的时间价值、如何评估风险、企业如何进行筹资和投资决策、如何管理短期资产、以及如何制定股利分配政策等。学习这门课程，学生能够掌握财务管理的基础理论和技能，提高财务决策的能力。学生还将学会如何用专业知识来分析和解决企业及个人财务管理中遇到的问题，制定出合理的解决策略。
default.en: Financial management is a practical course that blends knowledge from economics, accounting, finance, law, and management. It focuses on understanding the time value of money, assessing risks and returns, making corporate financing and investment decisions, managing short-term assets, and setting dividend policies. The goal is to equip students with fundamental financial management theories and skills, enhance their decision-making abilities, and enable them to analyze and solve real-world financial problems in both corporate and personal finance, developing professional solutions.

default.zh: 财务管理是企业管理的重要组成部分，主要研究如何有效地规划、控制和监督企业的资金运动，以达到企业价值最大化的目标。该课程涉及的内容广泛，包括财务分析、财务预测、财务决策、财务计划、财务控制和财务评价等方面。通过学习财务管理，学生可以掌握基本的财务分析方法，了解企业的财务报表和财务状况，并能够进行有效的财务决策和风险管理。
default.en: Financial management is an essential component of business management, mainly studying how to effectively plan, control, and supervise the capital movement of enterprises, in order to achieve the goal of maximizing enterprise value. This course involves a wide range of content, including financial analysis, financial forecasting, financial decision-making, financial planning, financial control, and financial evaluation. By studying financial management, students can master basic financial analysis methods, understand the financial statements and financial condition of enterprises, and be able to make effective financial decisions and risk management.

default.zh: 货币银行学是金融学必修课。通过本门课程的学习使学生能够较系统的了解和掌握货币、信用、利率、商业银行、中央银行和货币政策的基本概念和基本理论，基本掌握货币和金融体系的运行机制以及金融运行与经济运行相互关系，能利用有关知识独立分析和解决当前国际和国内货币银行方面出现的新问题、新政策和发展动向，提高对经济和金融规律的认识能力和把握能力，为进一步学习其他专业知识奠定必要基础。本课程主要内容包括：货币、货币制度、信用、利息与利率、金融市场与金融机构体系、商业银行、中央银行、货币政策等内容。本课程需要有一定的经济学和基础会计学的理论基础。
default.en: Money and Banking is the compulsory basic course for financial majors. Through the studying this course, students can systematically understand and master the basic concepts and essential theories of money, credit, interest rate, banking, monetary policy of the system of money and finance, and the relationship of finance and economy. In addition, this course can help students to use relevant knowledge to analyze and solve the new problems, new policies and new trends in the current international and domestic finance fields, which provides the students a good basis to study other courses. In this course, it includes: money and monetary institution, credit, interest and interest rate, financial market and financial system, commercial banks, central banks, monetary policy, and so on. This course requires the students have the basis of Economics and Essential Accounting.

default.zh: 证券是金融市场的基础类交易品种，而期货与期权是金融市场不断向深度发展过程中形成的重要的创新性金融工具（产品），在整个金融交易中占有重要地位。作为核心专业课程的证券、期货与期权交易，可以强化学生的金融专业的知识体系，在培养学生创新性金融意识，带动其它金融专业课程的学习中起着承下启下，引领的作用。 主要讲授金融市场重要衍生产品－－期货和期权的整个交易机理，交易过程以及交易策略，并进行比较，使学生清晰掌握它们的本质特征，全面把握期货与期权交易的两大基本功能，即套期保值功能和投机套利功能；同时，在介绍期货期权市场的组织结构和交易规则的基础上，通过与实时的大盘交易结合，使学生掌握不同金融产品交易价格的技术分析方法以及常用的经验交易策略，为学生将来从事实际工作做必要准备。
default.en: Futures and options are important financial instruments (products) that are emerging during the deep development of global financial markets. It plays an essential role in the whole financial transactions and also a guiding role in the process of undergraduates studying. Students can strengthen their financial professional knowledge system, be trained their innovative financial awareness, and promote other financial professional courses through the core professional course. This course mainly includes the following contents: Through introducing the important two derivative products - futures and options in market with the trading mechanism, the transaction process and trading strategies under comparisons, students can clearly grasp the essential characteristics of futures and options, a comprehensive grasp of futures and options trading two Basic functions, namely hedging function and speculative arbitrage function. At the same time, on the basis of introducing the organizational structure and transaction rules of futures option market, combined with real-time market transactions, the students can master the technical analysis methods of the transaction price and commonly used experience trading strategy of the two financial products to prepare their future work.

default.zh: 政治经济学是一门研究人类社会中支配物质资料生产和交换的规律的科学。目前，作为高等学校经济管理类专业所开设的政治经济学是特指由马克思在批判继承古典经济学基础上设立的，结合各时代社会经济实践所发展的一套关于社会经济活动规律的系统理论。考虑到本专业学生的知识结构、先修课程的特点和学时限制，本门课程采用课堂讲授与案例研讨相结合教学方法，使学生在充实经济学基本知识的基础上，学会运用比较法了解并掌握政治经济学基本理论；以先修业务课程知识为依托，熟练掌握资本主义市场经济和社会主义市场经济的运行模式，掌握不同经济体制下价值创造、价值增值、价值流转、价值分配等具体实现方式；初步了解社会经济活动规律的系统理论，进而以习近平新时代中国特色社会主义经济思想为指导，深入学习中国特色社会主义经济体制基本理论，领悟构建新发展格局、推动高质量发展的经济发展理念。 作为研究一个社会生产、资本、流通、交换、分配和消费等经济活动、经济关系和经济规律的经济学科，政治经济学是讲授市场经济运行机制的重要经济学科，也是提高学生人文素养和实践能力的重要途径。党的十八大以来，以习近平同志为核心的党中央加快完善社会主义市场经济体制，将社会主义市场经济体制作为社会主义基本经济制度的重要组成部分，强调使市场在资源配置中起决定性作用，更好发挥政府作用，强调正确认识和把握资本的特性和行为规律，深刻回答了加快完善社会主义市场经济体制面临的一系列重大理论和现实问题，丰富和发展了马克思主义政治经济学关于市场经济的理论。党的二十大报告把“构建高水平社会主义市场经济体制”作为加快构建新发展格局、着力推动高质量发展的重要战略任务。为深入学习贯彻党的二十大精神、主动服务国家战略，将习近平新时代中国特色社会主义经济思想融入《政治经济学》专业课程教学设计尤为重要。在对相对成熟的马克思主义经济基本原理进行创新讲解的基础上，针对社会主义经济制度篇章，尤其是在“社会主义商品经济和市场经济”的学习过程中，课程聚焦于中国社会主义市场经济体制的建立与完善进程，将基本理论具象到生活实景，通过具体案例分析将中国特色社会主义经济制度相关内容渗透到方方面面。 按照中国特色社会主义经济学以人民为中心的发展思想的根本立场和坚持解放与发展生产力的原则，通过对课程内容进行优化，培养学生具备利用马克思主义基本原理分析问题解决重大经济问题的能力： 课程目标1：系统掌握马克思主义政治经济学基本理论框架与内容，深刻认识资本主义和社会主义生产关系的实质以及它们的本质区别，深入理解辩证唯物主义与历史唯物主义的方法论。 课程目标2：培养学生利用马克思主义政治经济学基本理论，结合中国经济实践，正确认识社会经济发展规律的能力。 课程目标3：增强学生建设有中国特色社会主义的历史责任感，为中华民族伟大复兴贡献知识和力量。
default.en: International Business Law integrates legal expertise with international business practices. Given students’ knowledge structure, prerequisite course features and class hour limits, it uses a "classroom lectures + case discussions" model. While building students’ basic legal knowledge, it teaches them to master the course’s basic theories via comparative law. Based on prerequisite professional knowledge, students will learn domestic laws, international conventions and customs in international business, grasp legal knowledge for other international business operations, and master rules for resolving commercial disputes (focusing on international commercial arbitration) — while supporting their graduation thesis with professional theories and practical analysis. The Report to the 20th CPC National Congress proposes "promoting coordinated rule of law at home and in foreign-related matters", a practical requirement for advancing China’s socialist rule of law system. Strengthening foreign-related rule of law work is key to safeguarding international fairness, national sovereignty, security and development interests, and responding to external suppression. To serve national strategies, integrating ideological and political education into the course is vital: in learning "sources of International Business Law", historical sentiments and elements like "rule of law" and "national pride" are embedded; "Contract Law" includes "seeking truth from facts" and "integrity"; an "innovation class" lets students learn China’s labor law via simulated contract signing; case studies of enterprises like Huawei introduce national spirit and global perspective, permeating patriotism. Through this design, the course helps students master core knowledge, builds their international business skills, and supports thesis writing. Specific objectives: Cultivate students’ ability to apply the course’s basic theories via analysis, and enhance their capability to solve international commercial relations globally. Help students grasp international business law theories of different countries and improve conflict-solving skills via case analysis. Train interdisciplinary talents (proficient in economics, trade and law) to serve the national dual-circulation strategy.

default.zh: 计量经济学是以揭示经济活动中客观存在的数量关系为目的。本课程旨在培养和提高学生解决实际工作中可能会遇到的经济管理问题的能力，掌握经济与管理问题的一类定量解决方法。通过计量经济学本科阶段的教学，使学生能够了解数量分析课程在经济学课程体系中的地位，了解数量分析在实际经济管理工作中的作用；掌握基本的经典计量经济学理论与方法，并对计量经济学理论与方法的扩展和新发展有所了解；能够建立实用的计量经济学模型，应用计量经济学常用软件对经济管理问题进行定量分析，理解结果含义；具有进一步学习与应用高级计量经济学理论、方法与模型的基础和能力。 主要内容：经典单方程计量经济学模型，包括一元线性回归模型的基本假设，一元线性回归模型的参数估计，一元线性回归模型检验；多元线性回归模型的基本假设，参数估计和模型检验；计量经济学模型的异方差、序列相关性、多重共线性、内生解释变量和模型设定偏误问题；时间序列计量经济学模型基础、部分常用非经典计量经济学模型介绍，以及应用计量经济学模型建模问题。
default.en: The purpose of econometrics is to reveal the objective existence of the relationship between the economic activities. This course aims to cultivate and improve the ability of students to solve practical work may encounter economic management issues, study the economic and management issues a quantitative solution. Econometrics is one of most important branches of Economics. Its objective is to reveal the existence of quantitative relationship between economic activities. By econometrics undergraduate teaching, students will be able to: understand the status of quantitative analysis in economic course system, and the effect of the economic quantitative analysis on economics discipline development and real economy work; master the classical econometrics theory and methods and conceptually understand the development of modern econometrics in theory and methods; construct econometrics models and analyze the quantitative relationship between the amount of the economics phenomena by using econometrics analysis software; have basis and capability of further study and application of econometrics theory and method. The main content of the course includes: classical single-equation econometrics model including the basic assumptions, parameter estimation, test of simple linear and multi-linear regression model; heteroscedasticity, multi-collinearity, endogenous explanatory variable and specification bias of model; basis of time series econometric model, general introduction of non-classical econometric models；introduction of applied econometric model.

default.zh: 计量经济学研究是以揭示经济活动中客观存在的数量关系为目的。本课程旨在使学生掌握基本的经典计量经济学理论与方法，了解计量经济学理论与方法的扩展和新发展，能够建立实用的计量经济学模型，应用计量经济学常用软件对社会经济现象和经济管理问题进行定量分析，理解结果含义，具备进一步学习与应用高级计量经济学理论、方法与模型的基础和能力；通过计量经济学本科阶段的教学，使学生能够了解数量分析在实际经济管理工作中的作用，结合案例教学引导学生关注与思考身边的经济现象，客观评价我国的宏观经济政策效果，深入探究国计民生事件背后的原因。 主要内容：经典单方程计量经济学模型，包括一元线性回归模型的基本假设，一元线性回归模型的参数估计，一元线性回归模型检验；多元线性回归模型的基本假设，参数估计和模型检验；计量经济学模型的异方差、序列相关性、多重共线性、内生解释变量和模型设定偏误问题；时间序列计量经济学模型基础、部分常用非经典计量经济学模型介绍，以及应用计量经济学模型建模问题。
default.en: The purpose of econometrics is to reveal the objective existence of the quantitative relationship in economic activities. This course aims to enable students to master the basic classical econometrics theories and methods, understand the expansion and new development of econometric theories and methods, be able to establish practical econometrics models, apply econometrics software to quantitatively analyze socio-economic phenomena and economic management problems, understand the meaning of results, and have the foundation and ability to further learn and apply advanced econometric theories, methods and models; Through the teaching of econometrics at the undergraduate level, students can understand the role of quantitative analysis in actual economic management, combine case study to guide students to pay attention to and think about the economic phenomena around them, objectively evaluate the effect of China's macroeconomic policies, and deeply explore the reasons behind the national economy and people's livelihood events. The main content of the course includes: classical single-equation econometrics model including the basic assumptions, parameter estimation, test of simple linear and multi-linear regression model; heteroscedasticity, multi-collinearity, endogenous explanatory variable and specification bias of model; basis of time series econometric model, general introduction of non-classical econometric models；introduction of applied econometric model.

default.zh: 国际贸易原理是一门技术基础课,它主要学习国际贸易的基本概念及相关理论政策和措施。研究和学习国际贸易的产生发展作用；国际分工的概念，形式，发展特点以及影响国际分工的因素；研究世界市场的形成，发展特点，世界市场的价格种类及影响因素，世界市场的商品交易方式；学习地区经济一体化的概念，形式及发展情况；国际资本移动和跨国公司对国际贸易的影响等。 国际贸易理论是影响国际贸易政策的主要因素,贸易政策体现在关税壁垒措施,非关税壁垒措施,鼓励出口措施,出口管制措施等方面，各国实行这些措施对国际贸易的发展产生了极大的影响,因此本门课程还学习有关国际贸易理论和国际贸易政策措施。
default.en: The international trade principle is a technical basic course, it mainly studies the international trade the basic concept and the correlation theories policies and measures. Research and study international trade production development function; International division of labor concept, form, development characteristic as well as influence international division of labor factor; Research world market formation, development characteristic, world market price type and influencing factor, world market commodity exchange way; Studies the local economic integration the concept, the form and the state of play; International capital migration and Multinational corporation to international trade influence and so on. the international trade theory is the influence international trade policy primary factor, the trade policy manifests in the tariff barrier measure, the non-tariff barrier measure, encouraged the export measure, aspects and so on export regulation measure, various countries to implement these measures to have the enormous influence to the international trade development, therefore this curriculum also studied the related international trade theory and the international trade special operational policy measures.

default.zh: 财政学是现代经济学重要分支，聚焦政府经济行为。课程以市场失灵为切入点，明确政府职能，涵盖资源配置、收入分配、经济稳定等内容。通过对公共支出如教育、社保支出、公共收入如税收、国债等、公共选择如政府决策机制等方面的学习，让学生理解政府收支活动及其对经济的影响。该课程既注重理论体系的构建，从完全竞争市场假设出发推导政府职能；又强调理论联系实际，引导学生分析现实财政现象，为从事经济、财政领域工作或进一步研究奠定基础 。
default.en: Public finance is an important branch of modern economics, focusing on the economic behaviors of the government. Taking market failure as the starting point, the course clarifies the functions of the government and covers contents such as resource allocation, income distribution, and economic stability. Through the study of aspects like public expenditures (such as education and social security expenditures), public revenues (such as taxes and national debts), and public choices (such as the government decision-making mechanism), students are enabled to understand the government's revenue and expenditure activities and their impacts on the economy. This course not only attaches importance to the construction of the theoretical system, deriving the functions of the government starting from the assumption of a perfectly competitive market; but also emphasizes the connection between theory and practice, guiding students to analyze real-world fiscal phenomena and laying a foundation for them to engage in work in the fields of economics and public finance or conduct further research.

default.zh: 通过本课程的学习，能够使学生理解和运用产业经济学的基本概念和基本原理；能够使学生对产业经济的运行规律、产业结构及产业发展等问题进行分析与归纳，得出科学的结论。 1.使学生理解并掌握产业结构、产业组织、产业布局、产业发展、产业政策等产业经济学的基本概念，掌握产业结构优化理论、市场结构分析、企业行为理论、产业生命周期理论、产业政策制定与实施等基本原理，熟悉产业经济学研究的方法和体系，为学习后继课程和进一步获取产业经济知识奠定必要的基础。 着重培养学生综合运用产业经济学理论分析产业经济问题、理解产业政策效应和预测产业发展趋势的能力。通过案例分析、小组讨论等形式，提升学生的实践应用能力，使其能够针对具体产业问题提出合理的解决方案和政策建议。
default.en: Course Objectives Upon completion of this course, students will be able to understand and apply the fundamental concepts and principles of Industrial Economics. They will acquire the ability to analyze and synthesize issues related to the operational laws, industrial structure, and development of industries, thereby drawing scientific conclusions. Learning Outcomes Foundational Knowledge: Students will understand and master core concepts such as industrial structure, industrial organization, industrial layout, industrial development, and industrial policy. They will grasp key principles including industrial structure optimization theory, market structure analysis, firm behavior theory, industry life cycle theory, and the formulation and implementation of industrial policies. Furthermore, students will become familiar with the research methodologies and frameworks of Industrial Economics, laying a solid foundation for advanced courses and future knowledge acquisition. Practical Application: The course places special emphasis on cultivating students' ability to comprehensively apply Industrial Economics theories to analyze real-world problems, understand the effects of industrial policies, and predict development trends. Through case studies and group discussions, we aim to enhance students' practical application skills, enabling them to propose reasonable solutions and policy recommendations for specific industrial issues.

default.zh: 在基本经济学的基础上，深入学习数字经济的发展现状及数字经济运行规律，并能够运用基本经济学原理解释数字经济发展的相关问题。 课程将由浅入深进行，第一章的目的是理解数字经济的基础原理和含义，探讨数据作为生产要素的核心作用。第二章讲解数字经济技术与人才培育，大数据、区块链等技术发展以及数字素养培育，如何培养相关人才及其重要性；第三章探讨研究数字经济给生产力、生产关系带来的变革。在第四，第五章中延伸至公司治理，政府治理中数字经济带来的影响，并结合案例讨论。最后一章将梳理全球政策，包括国际组织及美、欧、日等主要经济体的数字经济战略，总结政策启示与趋势。帮助学生从多方面构建对数字经济的系统认知。
default.en: Based on basic economics, we will study the current development of the digital economy in-depth and examine the laws governing its operation, enabling us to apply fundamental economic principles to explain issues related to digital economy development. The course will proceed from shallow to deep. The purpose of the first chapter is to understand the basic principles and meanings of the digital economy, and to explore the central role of data as a factor of production. The second chapter explains digital economy technology and talent cultivation, the development of technologies such as big data and blockchain as well as the cultivation of digital literacy, how to cultivate relevant talents and their importance; the third chapter explores the study of the changes that the digital economy has brought about to the productivity and production relations. In the next two chapters, it extends to corporate governance, the impact of the digital economy in government governance, and discusses it with case studies. The final chapter will sort out global policies, including the digital economy strategies of international organizations and major economies such as the United States, Europe, and Japan, and summarize policy insights and trends. Help students build a comprehensive and systematic understanding of the digital economy from multiple perspectives.

default.zh: 信息资源管理课程通过信息资源管理的历史沿革、国内外现状及发展、信息资源管理的目标与任务、信息资源的内容管理与系统管理、企业与政府信息资源管理、信息政策法规、信息资源的优化配置等内容，让学员对信息资源管理领域有全面的认识。
default.en: The course of Information Resource Management provides students with a comprehensive understanding of the field of information resource management through its historical evolution, domestic and international status and development, goals and tasks, content and system management, enterprise and government information resource management, information policies and regulations, and optimized allocation of information resources.

default.zh: 图灵奖获得者吉姆·格雷（Jim Gray）指出，基于数据进行科学研究将成为继实验研究、理论研究、仿真研究之外的第四种研究范式。因此，能够有效管理和运用数据是各领域数据工作相关人员的必备技能之一。本门课程作为信息管理与信息系统、电子商务、大数据管理与应用和计算金融专业的专业基础课程，将从满足管理应用需求的角度出发，介绍数据管理与关系数据库、关系数据库标准语言SQL、关系数据库的完整性与一致性、关系数据库的安全性、关系模式的规范化、关系数据库设计、数据应用与数据治理等方面的概念、理论、技术与方法，使学生具备先进的数据管理理念，并能掌握数据库管理系统的应用方法。课程教学强调学科交叉融合，坚持“以学生为中心，学生学习与发展成效驱动”的教育理念，采用线上与线下相结合、理论与实践相结合的教学方式，着重培养学生的创新思维和实践能力。通过本门课程的学习，将使学生达成以下课程学习目标： ？ 学生能够理解和掌握数据库管理技术的相关概念、理论与方法，并熟练进行数据定义、数据操纵和数据控制。 ？ 学生能够具有批判性思维和系统化思维，具备使用数据管理理论选择适合的数据存储模式、进行数据存储设计的能力。 ？ 学生能够具有遵守企业道德规范、保护数据隐私的责任感和使命感。
default.en: Turing Award winner Jim Gray pointed out that data-based scientific research will become the fourth research paradigm after experimental, theoretical and simulation research. Therefore, being able to effectively manage and utilize data is one of the essential skills for those involved in data management in various fields. As a professional foundation course for majors in information management and information systems, e-commerce, big data management and application, and computational finance, this course will introduce the concepts, theories, techniques, and methods of data management and databases from the point of view of satisfying management applications, including relational databases, the standard language of relational databases, SQL, the integrity and consistency of relational databases, security of relational databases, normalization of the relational schema, the design of relational databases, data applications and data governance etc., so that students have advanced data management concepts, and can master the application of database management systems. This course is designed to equip students with advanced data management thinking and master the application of database management systems. The teaching of the course emphasizes the cross-fertilization of disciplines, adheres to the educational philosophy of "student-centered and driven by the effectiveness of student learning and development", adopts the teaching methods of combining online and offline, theory and practice, and focuses on cultivating students' innovative thinking and practical ability. Through the study of this course, students will achieve the following learning objectives: ？ Students are able to understand and master the theories, techniques and methods related to data management techniques and be skilled in data definition, data manipulation and data control. ？ Students are able to think critically and systematically, and have the ability to use data management theories to select appropriate data storage models and design data storage. ？ Students are able to have a sense of responsibility and mission to comply with corporate ethics and protect data privacy.

default.zh: 本课程的核心内容是电子政务与大数据驱动的社会治理的理论及实务。本课程系统将介绍电子政务系统应用及规划、评价等议题，以及大数据在社会治理中如何应用，全程结合真实案例进行讲解，增强学生的理解。 通过本课程的学习，学生将对电子政务及大数据驱动的社会治理理论体系有全面的掌握，并对一些关键社会治理领域的电子政务及大数据应用有所了解。
default.en: The essence of this course lies in the theoretical framework and practical applications of e-government and big data-driven social governance. The course will comprehensively cover topics such as the planning and evaluation of e-government systems, as well as the utilization of big data in social governance. Through real-life case studies, this course will enhance students' comprehension of e-government. Through the study of this course, students will attain a profound understanding of the theoretical framework of e- government and big data-driven social governance, and gain insights into the application of e- government and big data in key areas of social governance.

default.zh: 本课程是信息管理与信息系统专业本科生的专业基础课。学生在《C程序设计语言》课程的基础上，通过学习可以掌握面向对象程序设计的基本知识、原理和方法，获得面向对象程序设计的基本技能。 本课程以目前最具吸引力且功能强大的程序设计语言Java语言为主进行授课，主要内容包括Java语言基础、面向对象技术、图形界面设计、应用程序设计、异常处理、输入输出以及Java的网络通信、多线程机制和数据库编程等内容。
default.en: This course is a professional basic course of information system undergraduate students. Students can understand the theory and the methods of object-oriented programming by learning this course on the basis of course "C programming". Java language has been the most magnetic and powerful programming language because of its characteristics such as object-oriented programming, neutrally architecture, safety, strong and multi-thread. The course mainly contains the basis of Java language, technique of object-oriented programming, design of GUI, Exception handling, I/O, network communication, multithread, database programming and so on.

default.zh: 课程的内容包括五章。第一章介绍了搜索引擎的概念、 搜索引擎的发展历史、 一些著名的搜索引擎，以及现代搜索引擎与大数据、人工智能的相互关系等；第二章讨论了对搜索引擎原理与技术的初步分析，从模块方面大致介绍爬虫、索引、缓存等。从技术方面大致介绍自然语言处理、知识图谱技术、海量数据存储、分布式计算等；第三章从自然语言角度开始深入分析原理和实现、自然语言是搜索引擎进行文本处理的基础；第四章对爬虫技术进行了深入分析，并讲解链接去重，网页去重以及广告识别等相关算法原理，已经搜索引擎的构建机制；第五章深入分析了搜索引擎的整个对外服务工作流程，包括大数据分布式缓存、搜索智能提示、个性化搜索、图片搜索、搜索与广告、广告投放策略等。 上机课程，学习并练习爬虫技术，能够从网页上抓取信息并能够对抓取的信息进行统计分析，建立模型。
default.en: The course consists of five chapters. The first chapter introduces the concept of search engine, the history and development of some famous search engines, as well as the relationship between the modern search engines and big data、artificial intelligence. The second chapter discusses principle and system structure of the web search engine, and generally introduces the technology of web spider, index and cache. In addition, the second chapter also introduces technical aspects of natural language processing, knowledge mapping technology, massive data storage, distributed computing, etc. The third chapter deeply analyzes the principle of search engine, and introduces the current mainstream natural language processing technology. The fourth chapter discusses spider technology in details and introduces the knowledge and principle of link deduplication, webpage deduplication and advertising recognition. The fifth chapter deeply analyzes the entire external service workflow of search engines, including big data distributed cache, search smart tips, personalized search, image search, search and advertising. Computer experiments courses require students to learn and practice the spider technique, and use web spider to obtain the related information, analyze it using statistical knowledge and construct a model based on the achieved information.

default.zh: 本门课以地方政府和城市为研究对象，介绍公共管理、政府治理及城市发展等的理论知识和计量经济学的实证方法。本门课旨在让学生掌握地方政府治理与城市发展的基本理论、基本范畴和基本知识，从而对中国地方政府的治理模式、城市治理政策有一定的了解。在认识政府治理与城市发展关系的基础上，学习政府各方面的公共政策对城市发展的不同影响，并能通过基础计量经济学的方法对实际政府治理与城市发展问题进行实证验证。
default.en: This course takes local government and cities as the research object, and introduces the theoretical knowledge of public management, government governance and urban development and the empirical methods based on the basic econometrics.This course aims to make students master the basic theory and knowledge of local governance and urban development, so as to have a certain understanding of the governance models and urban governance policies of local governments in China. On the basis of understanding the relationship between government governance and urban development, students are allowed to learn the different effects of various aspects of government public policies on urban development, and be able to empirically verify the actual issues of government governance and urban development through basic econometric methods.

default.zh: 该课程将涵盖挖掘和分析文本数据的主要技术，目标是发现有趣的模式、汲取有用的知识、辅助决策，涉及数据挖掘、信息检索和自然语言处理等研究领域。课程的学习有助于我院学生了解学术前沿，提升基础知识的综合应用能力，对于今后的学术研究或应用技术研发均具有重要意义。为了培养学生的文本分析和文本挖掘能力，采用讲授法和少量讨论法相结合的教学方法，讲授涵盖核心文本挖掘操作，包括文本挖掘预处理技术、分类、聚类、信息提取、情感分析、主题分析、可视化方法、文本挖掘应用案例等教学内容，使学生较深入地了解文本分析与文本挖掘的基本方法。通过本课程的课堂教学、典型案例分析、热点问题讨论等方式，着重培养学生们对文本的分析与处理能力，以及文本分析与文本挖掘知识的应用能力，增加创新意识，以支撑专业学习成果中相应指标点的达成。采用累加式考试，包括平时与课堂参与占40%，结课考核占60%。
default.en: The course will cover the main text data mining and analysis technology, the goal is to find interesting patterns and to learn useful knowledge and decision making, including data mining, information retrieval and other research areas of Natural Language Processing. The course study will help our college students understand the academic front and enhance the comprehensive application ability of the basic knowledge, which will be of great significance for future academic research or application of technology research and development. This course covers the core of text mining, text mining pretreatment technology, including text classification, text clustering, information extraction, sentiment analysis, visualization methods and applications of text mining and other content. Through teaching, typical case analysis, hot topic discussion and so on, on one hand, the ability of text analysis and text mining can be well trained, on the other hand, the awareness of innovation can be enhanced. The cumulative test is adopted, including 40% classroom participation and 60% final examination.

default.zh: 大数据基础设施课程是大数据管理与应用专业的专业核心课程。通过本课程的教学使学生了解大数据组织与处理基本规则，掌握分布式数据存储、处理相关产品。掌握Hadoop系列产品的原理，并具备一定的实践能力，为今后从事相关工作打下基础。
default.en: The course of Big Data Infrastructure is a core professional course for the Big Data Management and Application major. Through the teaching of this course, students will understand the basic rules of big data organization and processing, and master distributed data storage and processing related products. Master the principles of Hadoop series products and possess certain practical skills, laying a foundation for future related work.

default.zh: 一门关于数据库管理系统（DBMS）的实践课程，探索架构、应用程序和与数据库的交互。该课程专注于DBMS的SQL版本。学生将学习数据库是什么、它的结构是如何的，以及如何使用SQL查询与之交互，使用特定的开源编辑器。
default.en: A hands-on course on DBMS, exploring architecture, applications and interactions with databases. The course focuses on SQL version of DBMS. Students will learn what is a database, how it is structured and how to interact with one using SQL queries into one specific open-source editor.

default.zh: 本课程是大数据管理与应用专业的基础课程。通过课程的教学使学生从管理，技术架构，商务运作流程，社会影响，电子商务系统规划，设计与开发等角度对社会媒体营销有较为全面的了解。掌握社会媒体营销的基本理论与方法，并具备一定的电子商务实践能力。通过教学和实践环节提高学生处理与社会媒体营销有关管理决策问题的能力，扩展专业知识，为今后从事相关工作打下基础。
default.en: This course is a common core course for the UG students of the majors of big data management and application. Through the teaching of the course, students have a comprehensive understanding of social media marketing from the perspectives of management, technical architecture, business operation process, social influence, e-commerce system planning, and design and development. Students should master the fundamental theories and methods of social media marketing, and have certain e-commerce practical ability. Through teaching and practice, students can improve their ability to deal with management decision-making issues related to social media marketing, expand their professional knowledge, and lay a foundation for future related work.

default.zh: 该课程介绍了关键的编程技能，重点放在面向对象设计和编码的核心概念上。该课程以高级语言Python为基础。课程旨在理解和掌握面向对象的概念，如类、对象、抽象、方法、方法重载、继承和多态性。 学生将通过在数据科学中处理不同的数据结构（如队列、列表和树）的具体应用来练习理论方面。
default.en: This course introduces key programming skills and focuses on the core concepts of object-oriented desing and coding. The course is based on the high-level language Python. The course aims at understanding and mastering object-oriented concepts such as classes, objects, abstraction, methods, method overloading, inheritance and polymorphism. Students will practice theoretical aspects on concrete applications in data science and by manipulating different data structures such as queues, lists, and trees.

default.zh: 课程遵循工程人才的成长规律，旨在培养领军人才掌握人力资源的知识体系及人力资源管理的基本理论，建立人工程人才力资源管理管理的知识结构，系统了解人力资源管理的方法合技能，建立解决复杂人力资源管理问题的基本素质。课程内容的核心为人力资源的知识体系及人力资源管理的基本理论，教学密切结合工程领军人才的工程知识基础与专业知识结构，讲授人力资源管理的专业知识、理论和技能。
default.en: The course follows development laws of engineering talents . It aims to train leading talents to master the knowledge system of human resources and the basic theory of human resources management, establish the knowledge structure of human engineering talent management resources management, and systematically understand the methods and skills of human resources management. Establish the basic quality of solving complex human resources management problems.The core of the course content is the knowledge system of human resources and the basic theory of human resources management. The teaching closely combines the engineering knowledge base and professional knowledge structure of engineering leaders to teach human resources management expertise, theory and skills.

default.zh: 该课程涵盖了各种问题，包括商业道德、算法决策机制、人工智能的现代方法和解释、寻求监管与创新之间的平衡，以及人工智能对个人权利、歧视和控制架构的影响。我们用案例研究来说明人工智能在特定行业的应用。
default.en: The course covers a variety of issues, including business ethics, mechanisms of algorithmic decision making, modern approaches of AI and explanation, the search for balance between regulation and innovation, and the effect of AI on individual rights, discrimination, and architecture of control. We use case studies on AI application to specific industry for illustration.

default.zh: 开设本课程的目的是帮助公共管理第二学位的本科生树立经济思维，提升其运用规范的方法研究区域基础设施建设和经济发展问题的能力，掌握区域资源空间配置和经济集聚规律的知识，初步具备区域经济政策设计的能力。本课程重视案例教学，整合了可用于区域基础设施和区域发展的经济分析和系统分析的基本工具，包括区位分析、系统分析、微观计量分析等。本课程旨在为区域科学发展与管理建立一套经济分析方法，提供一个经济计量视角，探索一种区域系统分析和定量评估方法。
default.en: The purpose of this course is to help undergraduate students with a second degree in public administration establish economic thinking, enhance their ability to apply standardized methods to study regional infrastructure construction and economic development issues, master knowledge of regional resource spatial allocation and economic agglomeration laws, and have a preliminary ability to design regional economic policies. This course emphasizes case teaching and integrates basic tools for economic and systematic analysis that can be used for regional infrastructure and development, including location analysis, systematic analysis, microeconomic analysis, etc. This course aims to establish an economic analysis method for regional scientific development and management, provide an econometric perspective, and explore a regional system analysis and quantitative evaluation method.

default.zh: 在当今时代，数据作为重要的商业资源已经渗透到每一个行业和业务职能领域，海量数据中孕育着新的挑战和机遇，大数据智能分析技术及其应用愈加重要。本门课程作为大数据管理与应用专业的核心课程，将主要介绍在数据时代的背景下如何利用数据挖掘、机器学习、人工智能等技术对客观存在的超大规模、多源异构、实时变化、蕴含价值的数据进行分析与应用的理论和方法。课程内容主要分为三大部分，一是大数据预处理方法，二是大数据分析的理论和方法，三是大数据智能分析理论与方法的应用案例。其中大数据预处理方法部分主要包括数据预处理的一般过程以及数据降维、特征选择方法等；大数据分析的理论与方法部分主要有监督学习、无监督学习及深度学习的理论与方法。通过本门课程的学习，将达到以下课程目标： ？ 学生能够理解和掌握大数据智能分析的基本概念、理论与方法，并能用于实际问题的解决； ？ 学生能够具备设计并改进大数据智能分析方法的能力； ？ 学生能够具有社会责任感，在实践中理解并遵守职业道德和规范，履行责任。
default.en: In nowadays, data has penetrated into every industry and business functional area as an important commercial resource. Data is breeding new challenges and opportunities, and the big data intelligent analysis theory and method become more and more important. As the core course of the major of Big Data Management and Application, this course will mainly introduce the theories and methods of how to use data mining, machine learning, artificial intelligence and other technologies to analyze the ultra-large scale, multi-source heterogeneous, real-time changing and valuable data. The course content is mainly divided into three parts: one is big data preprocessing method, the other is big data analysis theory and method, and the third includes some cases with big data intelligent analysis. Big data preprocessing methods mainly include a basic process of data preprocessing, data dimension reduction methods and feature selection methods, etc. The theories and methods of big data analysis mainly include supervised learning, unsupervised learning and deep learning, etc. Through the study of this course, the following course objectives will be achieved: ？ Students will be able to understand and master the basic concepts, theories and methods of Big Data Intelligent Analytics and be able to use them for practical problem solving; ？ Students will be able to have the ability to design and improve big data intelligent analytics methods; ？ Students will be able to have a sense of social responsibility, understand and follow professional ethics and norms in practice, and fulfil their responsibilities.

default.zh: 该课程提供了一个广泛的概述，涵盖了管理者在选择、使用和管理数字资源和技术方面面临的问题。将同时涵盖技术和战略方面。该课程介绍了知识经济、数字化转型和感知挑战。课程讨论了分析这一环境数据所涉及的内容，以及相关的技术、概念和伦理挑战。使用了多个企业案例和应用来说明理论方面。
default.en: This course provides a broad overview of issues managers face in the selection, use, and management of digital resources and technologies. Both technical and strategic aspects will be covered. It introduces knowledge economy, digital transformation and sensemaking challenges. It discusses what the analysis of this contextual data entails, as well as associated technical, conceptual and ethical challenges. Several business cases and applications are used to illustrate the theoretical aspects.

default.zh: 《时间序列分析》是统计学中的一个非常重要的分支，是以概率论与数理统计为基础、计算机应用为技术支撑，迅速发展起来的一种应用性很强的科学方法。时间序列是变量按时间间隔的顺序而下形成的随机变量序列，大量自然界、社会经济等领域的统计指标都依年、季、月或日统计其指标值，随着时间的推移，形成了统计指标的时间序列，例如，股价指数、物价指数、GDP和产品销售量等等都属于时间序列。
default.en: [Time Series Analysis] is a very important branch of statistics, based on probability theory and mathematical statistics, and supported by computer applications, which has rapidly developed into a highly applicable scientific method. A time series is a random variable sequence formed by variables in the order of time intervals. A large number of statistical indicators in natural, socio-economic, and other fields calculate their indicator values by year, quarter, month, or day. Over time, a time series of statistical indicators is formed, such as stock price index, price index, GDP, and product sales volume.

default.zh: 本课程的目的是教授项目管理技术背后的关键概念和基础知识，特别是技术项目。特别强调的是项目“领导力”和责任，而不仅仅是项目管理。本课程介绍Agile和Scrum方法和框架，并为学生提供基础知识，以了解开展成功项目的不同挑战。
default.en: The aim of this course is to teach the key concepts and fundamentals behind project management techniques and specifically on tech projects. A special highlight will be done on project “leadership” and responsibility and not just on project management. The course introduces Agile and Scrum methods and frameworks and gives students the basics to understand the different challenges of conducting successful projects.

default.zh: 本课程旨在为学生提供技术创新管理的基础知识。具体而言，学生将学习创新的概念、创新的类型、创新管理、开放式创新、基于创新的策略等。本课程将以创新如何在资讯时代推动未来商业的观点，补充学生的一般商业知识。
default.en: This course aims to provide students with foundational knowledge about technology innovation management. Specifically, students will learn about the concept of innovation, types of innovation, innovation management, open innovation, innovation-based strategies, etc. This course would complement students’ general business knowledge with perspectives on how innovation drives future business in the information age.

default.zh: R语言是一种开源编程语言，使用户能够轻松访问用于数据分析、数据可视化和建模的强大工具。该课程的目的是理解支撑数据驱动文化的概念，在R语言中体验这些概念，并通过部署应用程序提供数据科学见解。
default.en: R is an open-source programming language allowing users to have easily access to powerful tools for data analysis, data visualization and modelisation. The aim of the course is to understand the concepts underlying the data-savvy culture, experience these concepts in R and render data science insights by deploying apps.

default.zh: 大数据基础设施课程是大数据管理与应用专业的专业核心课程。通过本课程的教学使学生了解大数据组织与处理基本规则，掌握分布式数据存储、处理相关产品。掌握Hadoop系列产品的原理，并具备一定的实践能力，为今后从事相关工作打下基础。
default.en: The course of Big Data Infrastructure is a core professional course for the Big Data Management and Application major. Through the teaching of this course, students will understand the basic rules of big data organization and processing, and master distributed data storage and processing related products. Master the principles of Hadoop series products and possess certain practical skills, laying a foundation for future related work.

default.zh: 数字化正在革新营销策略。广告预算正在向数字媒体的更高支出方向转移。该课程的目的是向学生提供关于数字营销的商业优势和对营销成功的重要性的知识。同时，学生将制定一个数字营销计划，了解各种数字渠道以及如何整合不同的数字媒体并创建营销内容，以及如何优化网站和进行搜索引擎优化。
default.en: Digitalization is revolutionizing marketing strategy. Advertising budgets are shifting towards higher expenditures in digital media. The aim of this course is to provide students with the knowledge about business advantages of the digital marketing and its importance for marketing success. At the same time, students are going to develop a digital marketing plan, to get introduced to various digital channels and how to integrate different digital media and create marketing content, how to optimize a Web site and SEO optimization.

default.zh: 本课程为学生在确定职业目标和制定行动计划方面提供持续的支持。引导学生获得可持续的就业能力，并在快速变化的就业市场趋势中发展他们的专业知识。
default.en: This course provides our students with continual support in identifying career goals and developing action plans. Guiding our students towards sustainable employability and developing their expertise on rapidly changing employment market trends.

default.zh: 《专业导论》是经济与管理学院大数据管理与应用（第二学士学位）专业的入门课程，通过对大数据的背景，数据科学的理论基础，数据分析的流程，数据分析的工具等了解专业的基本知识。
default.en: Introduction to Major is an introductory course for the major of Big Data Management and Application (the second bachelor's degree) of the School of Economics and Management, which aims to understand the basic knowledge of the major through the background of big data, the theoretical basis of data science, the process of data analysis, and the tools of data analysis.

default.zh: 《金融风险管理》是金融学专业的必修课，课程详细介绍有关金融风险及其所包含的各类主要风险的定义、特性等一些基本概念和基本知识，在此基础上全面、系统、深入地介绍、阐释、分析了各类金融风险的辨识理论、方法以及市场风险、信用风险、操作风险和流动性风险这四类主要风险的各种度量理论、方法与技术。 本课程着重培养学生们的金融风险管理意识，支撑专业学习成果中相应指标点的达成。课程目标对学生的能力要求如下：（1）理解金融风险的概念及其特点；了解风险的诱因、风险发生时所可能导致的经济结果；掌握市场风险、信用风险、操作风险、流动性风险等各风险类型的概念、基本特点及各类风险之间的相互关系。（2）理解金融风险辨识的概念及原则；识别金融风险的类型和受险部位；掌握几种主要的金融风险辨识方法。（3）掌握金融风险主要类型的风险度量方法的基本原理及计算方法。
default.en: This finance course is intended for students who want to increase their familiarity with the practical applications of financial management. The four modules provide students with an opportunity to acquire a high level of expertise in central areas of financial management of firms, covering topics such as firm valuation, financing, investments, as well as risk management. While each of the modules cover different aspects of the financial management of companies, module 1-3 constitute the basis for the understanding of the fourth module.

default.zh: 本课程以管理思想发展的时间脉络，对各个阶段的管理思想的起源、形成和发展进行系统讲授，让学生了解工业革命之前的管理、工业革命早期的管理，理解科学管理时代以及现当代的管理思想，掌握各个阶段重要的管理理论，洞察时代发展的方向，理解和分析管理实践中的重要现象。本课程中涉及的重要理论包括古典管理理论、行为科学理论、科学管理理论、人际关系学派、决策理论、战略管理理论、营销管理理论、权变管理理论、品质管理理论、跨文化理论等。本课程的重点在于理解各个理论产生的时代背景、掌握各个理论的核心内容以及其在现代管理实践中的应用、深度理解管理与文化、管理与科学之间的关系。
default.en: This course systematically teaches the origin, formation, and development of management thoughts in different time stages. Through this course, students can understand management thoughts before the industrial revolution, in the early stage of the industrial revolution, in the era of scientific management as well as in modern and contemporary times. After this course, students should master important management theories in each stage, and gain insight into the development direction in management, understand and analyze important phenomena in management practice. Important theories covered in this course include classical management theory, behavioral science theory, scientific management theory, interpersonal relationship school, decision theory, strategic management theory, marketing management theory, contingency management theory, quality management theory, cross-cultural theory, etc. The focus of this course is to understand the historical background of each theory, master the core content of each theory and its application in modern management practice, and deeply understand the relationship between management and culture, management and science.

default.zh: 本课程以如何管理和领导高绩效团队为核心，基于团队流程的原理和经典理论，并结合企业在互联网和新经济下的组织和工作设计要求，在理论和实践两方面对组织的团队协作问题进行学习探讨。课程设计以体验式教学为主，通过学员在不同的团队协作情境中完成任务和挑战的心理、行为、及与环境互动等方面的体验，来促进其对于团队协作的理解，培养其管理协作的技能和领导能力。
default.en: This course is designed around managing and leading high performing teams. The class is structured into two themes: (1) an introduction of classic theories and principles of team dynamics, (2) an experiential approach to learning and practice of key team collaboration concepts and models in the context of new organizational and work design under the internet-based platforms and economy. Through performing in various teamwork settings, students are expected to understand the psychological and behavioral processes facing team tasks and challenges, as well as to develop skills and competence in managing collaboration in organizations.

default.zh: 组织行为学是研究在组织中以及组织与环境相互作用，人们从事工作的心理活动和行为反应规律性的科学。它采用系统分析的方法，综合运用心理学、社会学、社会心理学、人类学、生理学、经济学和政治学等知识，研究一定组织中人的心理和行为的规律性，从而提高各级领导者和管理者对人的行为预测和引导能力，并以此为基础，设计与改进提高组织效能，从而更有效地实现组织预定的目标。 组织行为学是管理类各专业的一门专业基础课程。本课程的目标是通过系统讲授、案例分析、互动研讨、作业实践等环节，帮助学生掌握组织管理过程的普遍规律、基本原理和应用方法，能够运用所学理论分析管理中存在的各种心理现象与行为，培养正确处理和协调人际关系的能力，逐步提高分析问题和解决问题的能力，最终提高管理能力，也为进一步学习其他相关课程打下组织行为学的扎实基础。
default.en: Organizational Behavior is an introductory course which analyses human behavior at work with a focus on issues of personality, motivation, group interaction, occupational stress and health and organizational change. The course integrates knowledge from psychology, sociology, social psychology, anthropology and political science to examine issues related to aspects of the working environment and to the relationship between managerial strategies, organizational structures and their effects on performance, health and autonomy. The success of an organization depends entirely upon the actions of those within it. The individual’s behavior may be affected by many factors. The working environment, the groups he/she interacts with, the rules and roles within which he/she must operate, authority structures and the individual’s own perspectives are but a few. The practicing manager needs to understand these factors if he/she is to accurately assess the needs of working individuals.

default.zh: 战略管理是管理的重要部分之一，是在企业面对激烈变化的环境、残酷的市场竞争情况下，企业管理人员为了企业长期的生存和发展，确定和选择达到目标的动态管理过程。通过本课程的教学，使学生了解战略管理的基础知识，理解战略管理的基本概念，掌握进行战略分析、战略选择理论，帮助学生树立战略管理观念和思想，培养学生独立思考的能力，为他们以后从事相关实践工作和理论研究奠定基础。
default.en: Strategic management is an important component of management, which is a dynamic management process in which enterprise managers determine and choose to achieve goals for the long-term survival and development of the enterprise in the face of fierce changes in the environment and fierce market competition. Through the teaching of this course, students will understand the basic knowledge of strategic management, understand the basic concepts of strategic management, master the basic methods of strategic analysis and strategic selection, help students establish strategic management concepts and ideas, cultivate their independent thinking ability, and lay a foundation for their practical work and theoretical research in the future.

default.zh: 目前，公司治理已成为全球经济管理理论界与实物界最关注的话题之一。公司治理是通过正式或非正式的、内部的或外部的制度或机制来协调公司与所有利害相关者之间的利益关系，以保证公司决策的科学化，从而维护公司各方利益，以实现企业可持续发展的制度安排。本门课程是开给大三工商管理学生的专业必修课，旨在培养他们专业知识，专业技能和专业素质。课程主要涵盖：股东大会与股东权益、董事会治理、监事会治理以及经理层的激励与约束等内部治理以及政府治理、产品市场、资本市场以及经理人市场的市场约束、债权人以及社区等外部治理。
default.en: Recently, corporate governance has become one of the hottest topics in both academic and industry. Corporate governance is an institutional arrangement which include a formal or informal, internal or external mechanism in order to coordinate the interests of the company and all stakeholders. The core of corporate governance is the decision-making so as to safeguard the interests of all parties and to achieve the everlasting development of the corporation. This course is open for third year student majoring in Business Administration, which aims to develop their professional knowledge, skills and ability. The main contents of corporate governance include internal governance such as shareholders 'meeting and shareholders' equity, board governance, board of supervisors governance and managerial incentives and constraints, as well as the external governance which is related to the regulation of government, the constrain of product markets, capital markets and manager markets and the governance of creditors and community.

default.zh: 领导力是高素质人才能力体系的重要组成部分，沟通能力是领导力的重要体现。《领导力与沟通》通过对沟通能力的系统讲授和训练，提高学生沟通技能，继而达到提升领导力的目的。课程以对领导力的理解为切入点，分别从领导的职能和领导者的日常工作重点两个角度，让学生领会沟通能力在领导力中的重要作用。无论领导的三个基本职能，即确定目标、寻找路径和激励和培养下属，还是在日常的管理活动中，领导者有70%的时间花在沟通上，并且管理中70%的问题来源于沟通，沟通活动都是领导工作的主体内容。关于对沟通能力的理解，课程注重思维和技能的训练。课程带领学生系统地理解沟通基本概念及特征、管理沟通过程与要素、基本沟通技能，如倾听与反馈、演讲、写作、招聘面试等，课程贯穿始终地强调有效沟通的三个关键词：良好意愿（goodwill）、换位思考（you-attitude）和可信度（credibility）。通过对项目答辩、社团活动组织与呈现、个人成长面试等真实组织环境中学生沟通技能综合运用的实践模拟，培养学生分析和解决实际管理问题、鼓励创造性思维、注重系统性思考的领导能力训练，为培养适应未来不确定环境下管理企业的优秀领导者奠定通识性素质基础。
default.en: ？Leadership is the core elements of the ability system of highly qualified personnel, and communication ability is an important manifestation of leadership. Through teaching and training systematically, will promote students' communication ability, and then achieve the goal of improving students' leadership. The course takes the understanding of leadership as the breakthrough point, and makes the students understand the important role of communication ability in leadership from two perspectives, namely, the functions of lead and the daily management focuses of leaders. Not only achieving the three basic functions of lead, determining target, finding path, and supervising and cultivating subordinates, but also in the daily management activities, the leaders have 70% of time spent in communication, and in management 70% of the problems derived from communication. Communication is the main content of leadership. With regard to the understanding of communication skills, the course focuses on the training of thinking and skills. The course will guide students to systematically understand the basic concepts and characteristics of communication, communication process and management elements, and basic communication skills, such as listening and feedback, speech, writing, interviews, meetings and so on. Throughout the course, three key words will be emphasized: good will, you-attitude, and credibility. By simulating the real organization environment, such as project defense, organization and presentation of university activities, recruitment interview and so on, the students could comprehensively use the communication skill, which could improve students' ability to analyze and solve practical management problems, encourage creative thinking, concentrate on the leadership training of systematic thinking, in order to cultivate general foundation for future excellent leaders to adapt to uncertain management surroundings.

default.zh: 国际企业管理作为管理学科一个独立的分支是在近几十年发展起来的，它借助于社会学、人类学、政治经济学、国际贸易、国际商法及工商管理等学科的理论，形成了完整的理论体系和框架，涉及企业在国际范围内的产品、技术、人员、信息、资金等要素的流动和管理。国际企业管理课程主要介绍国际企业管理的基本理论和基本方法，是理论与实际相结合的一门课程。 20世纪90年代以来，新一轮经济全球化浪潮显示出不可阻挡之势。作为推动全球经济一体化主体的国际企业正扮演着越来越重要的角色——世界贸易与投资总额的2/3是由它们来完成的。经济全球化的迅速发展和中国加入世贸组织，使中国市场和世界市场几乎完全融为一体，中国企业将面临更加激烈的国际市场的竞争。如果我们仍然停留在对外贸易、一般的劳务输出和工程承包上，不仅不能分享全球化的利益，还会继续落后，甚至被排挤到边缘化的状态。因此，中国企业必须融入到全球经济大潮中，找准自己的比较优势，进行准确的国际分工定位。国际企业管理课程根据我国企业现实需要和发展实践，讲授多种企业国际化的经营理论和方法，通过大量中外企业国际化经营成功和失败案例的分析，以期提高学生独立思考、分析问题和解决问题的能力，同时培养兼具国际视野和管理能力的优秀人才。
