default.en: International Business Management has developed as an independent branch of the management discipline in recent decades, it has formed a complete theoretical system and framework by the theory of sociology, anthropology, political economy, international trade, international commercial law, business administration and other disciplines, involving the flow and management of product, technology, employee, information, capital and other elements within the world. International Business Management Course mainly introduces the basic theories and methods of international business management, is a course which combines the theory with practice. Since the 1990s, a new wave of economic globalization tidal wave has shown an irresistible force. International enterprises, as a mainstay to push forward global economic integration, are playing an increasingly important role----two-thirds of the quantum of world trade and investment is fulfilled by them. The rapid development of economic globalization and China's entry into the WTO has almost integrated the Chinese market and world market, and Chinese enterprises will face more fiercely competition in the international market. If we still remain in foreign trade, general labor export and project contracting, it not only can not share the benefits of globalization, but will continue to lag behind, and even be marginalized into brinkmanship. Therefore, Chinese enterprises must be integrated themselves into the global economic tide, find their own comparative advantages, and position the international division of labor accurately. International Business Management Course provides a variety of international business theories and methods according to the real need and evelopment practice of China's enterprises, through a large number of successful and failure case analysis of Chinese and foreign enterprises internationalization, so as to improve students’ ability of thinking independently, analysing and solving problems, cultivate large numbers of talents who unites international vision and administrative capacity.

default.zh: 本课程希望帮助学生了解创业基础理论、掌握识别创业机会的方法，准确捕捉市场痛 点、进行初步产品功能和服务设计，了解创业完整过程，并建立创业企业的商业模式和盈利方案，进行财务分析和融资规划。激发学生的创业激情，开发学生的创业潜能，使学生锻炼创业创意、创业计划宣讲及路演的实战技能；了解和掌握创业计划撰写的理论基础；了解和掌握创业计划撰写中关于市场分析、营销管理知识及方法，商业模式、生产计划/经商计划、财务分析、风险分析等等方法，具备分析和解决企业管理实践中积淀的系统问题的能力；熟悉和掌握常见企业创业的准备过程和实际管理过程，得到在企业创业准备和具体企业管理过程中的每一个环节的管理技能获得的基本训练，逐步具有应用先进工具解决创业企业实际管理问题的能力。
default.en: This course is expected to help students understand the basic theory of entrepreneurship, master the method of identifying entrepreneurial opportunities, accurately capture the market pain points, conduct preliminary product function and service design, establish the business model and profit plan of entrepreneurial firm, and conduct financial analysis and financing planning.Stimulate students' entrepreneurial passion, develop students' entrepreneurial potential, practice the practical skills of business plan presentation and road show; Understand and master the theoretical basis of business plan writing; Understand and master the knowledge and methods of market analysis, marketing management, business model, production plan/business plan, financial analysis, risk analysis and other methods in business plan writing, and have the ability to analyze and solve systemic problems accumulated in enterprise management practice; Familiar with and master the common preparation process and actual management process of enterprise entrepreneurship, get the basic training of management skills in every link of enterprise entrepreneurship preparation and specific enterprise management process, and gradually have the ability to apply advanced tools to solve practical management problems of entrepreneurial enterprises.

default.zh: 运营管理是一门非常重要的课程，它关注的是如何创造人们赖以生存的产品和服务。越来越多的公司也认识到有效的运营管理可以提高产品和服务水平，进而提高收入。本课程主要讲授了生产与运作的基本概念、生产与运作战略、产品与服务开发、运营网络设计与布置、工作设计、生产计划、质量管理等内容。另外，鉴于全球化、数字化、社会责任及可持续发展给企业运营带来的影响，本课程还将指导学生共同分析生产与运作管理在未来发展面临的挑战和机遇。 在教学过程中，教师将结合具体教学内容，组织案例研讨和自主学习。通过本课程的教学，使学生能够了解生产与运作管理的基础知识，掌握生产与运作管理的基本概念和各项生产与运作工作的理论、方法，并结合案例讨论使学生熟练应用课程规定的内容，帮助学生树立系统管理观念和思想，培养学生独立思考的能力，为他们以后从事相关实践工作和理论研究奠定基础。
default.en: Production and Operations Management is important. It is concerned with creating the products and services upon which we all depend. More and more companies have come to realize that effective production and operations management gives the potential to improve revenues and, at the same time, enables goods and services to be produced more efficiently. This course mainly introduces the basic concepts of production and operations, operations strategy, products and services design, operations network design and layout, job design, production plan, quality management, etc. Otherwise, in view of the impact of globalization, digitalization, social responsibility and sustainable development on operations management, this course will guide students to analyze the challenges and opportunities of production and operations management in the future. During the class, teachers will integrate case learning and self-directed learning on the basis of teaching content. This course will help the students understand the basic concepts of production and operations management, and help them master the theory and methods of production and operations management. By discussing the cases in class, the students can not only establish the system of management knowledge but also strengthen their ability to think independently. All in all, this course will help them lay a foundation for their future studying and working.

default.zh: 本课程以管理思想发展的时间脉络，对各个阶段的管理思想的起源、形成和发展进行系统讲授，让学生了解工业革命之前的管理、工业革命早期的管理，理解科学管理时代以及现当代的管理思想，掌握各个阶段重要的管理理论，洞察时代发展的方向，理解和分析管理实践中的重要现象。本课程中涉及的重要理论包括古典管理理论、行为科学理论、科学管理理论、人际关系学派、决策理论、战略管理理论、营销管理理论、权变管理理论、品质管理理论、跨文化理论等。本课程的重点在于理解各个理论产生的时代背景、掌握各个理论的核心内容以及其在现代管理实践中的应用、深度理解管理与文化、管理与科学之间的关系。

Through this course, students can understand management thoughts before the industrial revolution, in the early stage of the industrial revolution, in the era of scientific management as well as in modern and contemporary times. After this course, students should master important management theories in each stage, and gain insight into the development direction in management, understand and analyze important phenomena in management practice. Important theories covered in this course include classical management theory, behavioral science theory, scientific management theory, interpersonal relationship school, decision theory, strategic management theory, marketing management theory, contingency management theory, quality management theory, cross-cultural theory, etc. The focus of this course is to understand the historical background of each theory, master the core content of each theory and its application in modern management practice, and deeply understand the relationship between management and culture, management and science.

default.zh: 消费心理学是市场营销专业的专业必修课之一，本课程的教学内容主要包括：消费心理学的研究对象、内容、意义及其研究方法，消费者的心理活动过程，消费者的需要、动机与行为，消费者的个性心理特征，不同消费群体的消费心理，商品、价格与消费心理等。通过本课程的学习，使学生系统掌握消费心理学的基本理论和基本知识，正确理解和掌握消费者的消费心理和行为的基本规律，掌握不同消费群体的消费心理，能够应用消费心理学的理论和方法分析消费者的消费心理和行为，为制定营销策略提供理论依据。除了专业的市场营销与消费者心理、行为的专业知识之外，本门课程还致力于引导学生学习正确的企业社会责任感，无论作为营销者还是管理者，了解消费者之余树立正确的、有道德伦理的观念都是不可或缺的。在整门课程中，每一章节、每一单元都并非独立存在的，而是息息相关的，从现象到本质，从消费者的内在到外在体现，从微观的个人消费者再到整个消费者集体集群，这门课程围绕消费者将探讨众多的相关概念与之间的关联，最终到这些概念是如何影响营销者决策。从概念到应用，从书本到实际，这门课程需要学生把书上学会的概念，充分消化理解并运用到解决实际问题中去。
default.en: Consumer psychology and behavior is one of the professional courses of marketing professional, this course mainly includes: the research object of consumer psychology and behavior content, significance and research methods, psychological process of consumer, consumer needs, consumer motivation and actions, personality psychological characteristics, different consumer groups, consumer psychology, commodity prices and consumption psychology. Through this course, make students master the basic theory of the system of consumer psychology and basic knowledge, basic rules of correct understanding and grasp of consumer psychology and behavior, grasp the different consumer groups of consumer psychology, to use the theory and method of consumer psychology analysis of consumer psychology and behavior, and provide a theoretical basis for the formulation of the marketing strategy. Besides the core professional knowledge of marketing and consumer psychology as well as consumer behavior, this course dedicates to guide students to learn corporate social responsibility, no matter a marketer or a manager, the concept of morality and ethics is essential besides knowing about consumers. Throughout this course, every single chapter, every single unit is not separated from each other, instead, they are in one ecosystem. From phenomenon to essence, from consumers’ inner-personal to inter-personal, from micro individual to social groups, this course talks about a number of major concepts about consumer and the association between the concepts, and finally how these concepts affect marketers’ decision. From concepts to application, from textbook to reality, this course requires students to utilize the concepts from text to understand, digest, and eventually apply to solving real problems.

default.zh: 产品策略是市场营销4P组合的核心，是价格策略、分销策略和促销策略的基础。在大数据及互联网技术日益获得更广泛应用的今天，在产品革新速度加快，产品经理已成为新兴产业和亟待创新的传统产业急需的高端人才。本课程从市场营销视角，帮助学生树立正确的产品观，正确运用产品相关的市场调研、竞争调研方法，掌握产品创新机遇，设计合理的产品企划和创新路线，学会运用组织内外部资源完成面向产品变革管理的协同。 学生经过本课程的训练，应达到以下要求： 课程目标1：能正确辨别产品的几个层次；能识别产品处于生命周期的什么位置；能制定产品各个阶段的营销对策；学会对产品组合进行分析；了解产品设计的一般步骤和不同的设计立足点。 课程目标2：能独立评估产品机遇、进行合理的产品调研和产品设计，完成规范的产品企划书。 思政目标1：能在产品调研、设计、开发、实施过程中，识别、判断相关法律、伦理与社会责任问题，并做出正确的选择。
default.en: This course integrates the theories and methods of law, ethics, management, sociology and other disciplines to provide students with basic knowledge of law and ethics. Law and business ethics are not only the basic norms of behavior to maintain social justice and economic order, but also the basic guarantee for the long-term healthy development of enterprises. This course adopts the method of case teaching and combines with the needs of management majors to train students to establish legal consciousness, conscious moral integrity and enhance their sense of responsibility. Course objective 1: Be familiar with concepts, theories, laws and regulations related to corporate law, ethics and social responsibility Objective 2: Use relevant theories to identify and analyze problems in corporate legal, ethical and social responsibility practices and make the right decisions Product strategy is the core of marketing 4P combination, is the basis of price strategy, distribution strategy and promotion strategy. In today's increasingly widely used big data and Internet technology, the speed of product innovation is accelerating, and product managers have become high-end talents urgently needed in emerging industries and traditional industries in need of innovation. From the perspective of marketing, this course helps students establish a correct view of products, correctly use product-related market research and competitive research methods, grasp product innovation opportunities, design reasonable product planning and innovation routes, and learn to use internal and external resources to complete the collaboration for product change management. After training in this course, students should meet the following requirements: Course objective 1: Be able to correctly identify several levels of products; Identify where the product is in its life cycle; Be able to develop marketing strategies for each stage of the product; Learn to analyze the product portfolio; Understand the general steps of product design and the different design footholds. Course Objective 2: Be able to independently evaluate product opportunities, conduct reasonable product research and design, and complete standardized product plans. Ideological and political Goal 1: Be able to identify and judge relevant legal, ethical and social responsibility issues in the process of product research, design, development and implementation, and make the right choice. Ideological and political goal 1: To cultivate students' modern business ethics and professional ethics.

default.zh: 定价管理是市场营销专业的专业核心课，在培养学生战略定价思维、商品市场价值和成本评估、产品生命周期等方面有着重要的作用。本课程依据定价管理的一般步骤，参照定价策略的体系框架，在充分研究、借鉴和吸收国内外定价管理研究成果的基础上，借助微观经济学、产业经济学、微积分等数理模型和分析工具，系统阐述国内外定价管理决策过程中经典的数理定价模型，包括成本加成定价、客户驱动型定价、市场份额驱动型定价等，本课程将系统讲授价值创造、价格结构、价格和价值的沟通、价格政策、价格水平、产品生命周期定价战略、成本评估定价、盈利性定价、定价博弈、价格敏感度测量以及定价中的限制性因素等方面的内容。
default.en: Pricing management is the core course of marketing, which plays an important role in cultivating students' strategic pricing thinking, commodity market value and cost evaluation, and product life cycle. This course is based on the general steps of pricing management, refers to the system framework of pricing strategy, on the basis of fully researching, borrowing and absorbing domestic and foreign pricing management research results, with the help of microeconomics, industrial economics, calculus and other mathematical models and analytical tools, systematically expound the classic mathematical pricing models in the decision-making process of domestic and foreign pricing management, including cost-plus pricing, customer-driven pricing, market share-driven pricing, etc., this course will systematically teach value creation, price structure, price and value communication, Content on price policy, price levels, product lifecycle pricing strategy, cost assessment pricing, profitability pricing, pricing games, price sensitivity measurement, and limiting factors in pricing.

default.zh: 《中级财务会计A》是会计专业非常重要的一门专业核心课程，是学习后续专业课如高级财务会计等课程的基础，在培养学生运用所学专业知识解决实际问题、独立操作处理实务等方面占有重要的地位。本课程主要讲授会计确认、计量、记录与报告的基本理论与方法，系统讲解企业持续经营条件下会计要素变动的主要交易和事项的会计处理程序。通过本课程教学，着重培养学生们分析、解决企业日常会计处理过程中的常见问题的能力，使同学们能够运用会计基本理论知识解释资产负债表和利润表等项目的生成过程。
default.en: 《Intermediate Financial Accounting A》 is a very important specialized core curriculum for the financial management, the foundation for learning other professional courses such as Advanced Financial Accounting. Learning this course can cultivate students solving and handling practical problems independently by using professional knowledge. In this course, students can systematically get the basic theories and methods of accounting confirmation, measurement, recording and reporting, and transactions accounting procedures changing of accounting elements of enterprise in going-concern concept. Through the course teaching, students can also get the abilities of analyze and solve daily accounting bookkeeper problems in enterprise, prepare the financial statements (Balance Sheet and the Income Statement) by using the basic accounting theory knowledge, and can explain the financial statements items generation.

default.zh: 《成本与管理会计》在教学中可分为成本会计和管理会计两部分进行。《成本会计》是会计专业学生继基础会计学和财务会计学以后非常重要的专业核心课，与中级财务会计以及高级财务会计共同构成了财务会计体系的核心课程。在培养学生提高实务能力和分析解决问题能力等方面占有重要的地位。本课程主要使学生熟悉费用的分类，理解成本核算的一般程序，掌握要素费用的核算、辅助生产费用的核算、制造费用的核算、废品损失和停工损失的核算、生产费用在完工产品与在产品之间分配的方法，熟练掌握产品成本计算的基本方法，能解决成本核算的实际问题，培养学生解决会计专门课题的能力。《管理会计》是现代企业会计的一个重要分支，它将会计与管理结合起来，运用现代管理科学的成果，通过对企业经营活动的决策、预算、控制、考核、评价等，实现企业的全面管理，为加强企业管理、提高经济效益服务。本课程主要使学生理解管理会计信息的含义、掌握管理会计决策、预算、控制、考核、评价等信息加工的各种方法和技术、和理解管理会计信息对管理的影响。
default.en: Accounting can be divided into two parts in teaching: cost accounting and management accounting. Cost Accounting is a very important core course for accounting students, following basic accounting and financial accounting. Together with intermediate and advanced financial accounting, it forms the core course of the financial accounting system. It plays an important role in cultivating students' practical skills and problem-solving abilities. This course aims to familiarize students with the classification of costs, understand the general procedures of cost accounting, master the accounting of factor costs, auxiliary production costs, manufacturing costs, waste and downtime losses, and the method of allocating production costs between finished and in progress products. Students will also be proficient in the basic methods of product cost calculation and be able to solve practical problems in cost accounting, Cultivate students' ability to solve accounting related topics. Management Accounting is an important branch of modern enterprise accounting, which combines accounting and management, utilizes the achievements of modern management science, and achieves comprehensive management of enterprises through decision-making, budgeting, control, assessment, and evaluation of business activities, serving to strengthen enterprise management and improve economic efficiency. This course mainly aims to help students understand the meaning of management accounting information, master various methods and techniques for information processing such as management accounting decision-making, budgeting, control, assessment, and evaluation, and understand the impact of management accounting information on management.

default.zh: 《财务分析A》是学习会计学基础、财务管理、中级财务会计等课程后的一门理论性和应用性相结合的课程。主要介绍财务分析的基本理论、分析方法和应用，包括筹资活动、投资活动、经营和分销活动的分析与估算，以及企业的财务能力（盈利能力、偿债能力、运营能力和发展能力）。本课程的目标是一方面使学生掌握和应用财务分析理论和方法，同时了解财务分析发展的前沿趋势；另一方面，培养学生综合分析和解决问题的能力，使学生能够利用企业财务信息分析评价企业经营活动。
default.en: “Financial Analysis A” is a course that combines theoretical and practical elements, offered after completing foundational courses in accounting, financial management, and intermediate financial accounting. This course primarily covers fundamental theories, analytical methods, and applications of financial analysis, including the analysis and estimation of financing activities, investment activities, as well as operational and distribution activities. It also addresses a company’s financial capabilities, such as profitability, credit ability, operation ability and development ability. The objectives of this course are twofold. Firstly, it aims to equip students with the knowledge and application of financial analysis theories and methods, while keeping them informed about the latest trends in financial analysis. Secondly, it fosters students’ ability to comprehensively analyze and solve problems, enabling them to utilize financial information to evaluate a company’s business activities.

default.zh: 《商业银行理论与实务》是金融专业的基础课。本门课程的教学目的是从理论与实际相联系的角度出发，阐明商业银行管理学的基本知识和基本理论,帮助学生开阔分析问题的思路,提供解决问题的原则和方法,以便为今后的学习打下良好的理论基础。《商业银行理论与实务》课程的主要内容是：系统地介绍和讨论商业银行发展历程、商业银行的职能及其经营方针，全面介绍当前商业银行的各类业务，包括负债业务、资产业务、资本业务、传统的中间业务和新兴表外业务及其操作程序，以及商业银行的风险管理和经营创新活动，并对商业银行经营发展趋势进行预测和展望。
default.en: The curriculum of Theory and Practice of Commercial Bank mainly introduces basic theories and practice about modern commercial bank, which is also a special lesson for the undergraduates whose major aim at finance. The teaching target of this curriculum is to expound basic knowledge and theories of modern commercial bank management, help widening students’ thought of analyzing problems, provide principles and methods of solving problems, in order to lay good theoretic foundation for future study. The chief content of this course includes the development process, function and management policies of commercial banks. It describes management activities of commercial banks, includes liabilities management, assets management, capitals management, intermediate operations management, off-balance sheet activities management, bank risk managements and innovative financial strategies. And it also looks to the future of the management of modern commercial banks

default.zh: 《中央银行理论与实务》课程全面介绍中央银行，让学生了解和洞察现代中央银行在金融市场和经济发展中的角色和功能，思考背后的理论以及实际操作实践。本课程将系统探讨中央银行，同时会提供一种易于理解的格式和风格，适合宏观经济学背景较少的一般学生。本课程将介绍理论如何在实践中应用，并指导学生进一步研究中央银行的具体问题，培养学生对中央银行政策做出有根据判断的能力。本课程主要包括：中央银行职能的演变；现代货币政策实践的理论背景；货币政策制度，包括汇率目标、货币供应增长目标、风险管理方法、通胀目标和非常规货币政策；货币政策的市场运作和传导机制等。
default.en: Central Banking takes a comprehensive look at the topic of central banking, and provides students with an understanding and insights into the roles and functions of modern central banks in advanced as well as emerging economies, theories behind their thinking, and actual operations practices. The course takes a systematic approach to the topic, while providing an accessible format and style that is appropriate for general students with only a minimal macroeconomic background. Theoretical reviews and examples of how the theories are applied in practice are presented in an easy-to-understand manner and serve as a guide for students to further investigate specific ancillary central banking topics and as a means to make informed judgments about central bank actions. Important topics covered in the course include: Evolution of central banking functions; theoretical backgrounds that are the foundation to the modern practice of monetary policy; monetary policy regimes, including exchange rate targeting, money supply growth targeting, the risk management approach, inflation targeting, and unconventional monetary policy; actual practice in market operations and transmission mechanisms of monetary policy, etc.

default.zh: 金融工程是20世纪90年代初西方国家出现的一门新兴金融学科。它运用工程技术的方法设计、开发和实施新型金融产品，创造性地解决金融问题，在把金融科学的研究推进到一个新的发展阶段的同时，对金融产业乃至整个经济领域产生了极其深远的影响。本课程由四部分构成：（1）简介部分——对金融工程进行了生动的概述；（2）知识背景部分——使学生掌握必要的分析工具以便领会以后章节中对金融工程的深入讨论；（3）金融工具部分——重点讲述CAPM、套利定价模型、期权定价模型等常见金融工具；（4）金融策略部分——介绍近几年发展出来的用于管理金融风险并使回报最大化的实物期权等创新性金融策略及应用。
default.en: Financial Engineering is a new financial subject which has its origin in some western nations in 1990’s . It uses the engineering methods to design, develop and implement innovative financial instruments and processes, and creatively solve problems in finance. The course promotes financial science to a new developing phase, and deeply influences the financial domain and the whole economic field. This curriculum is divided into four sections. At first, the introductory section provides an interesting overview of financial engineering. Secondly, a background section ensures that the students have the necessary analytical tools to appreciate in depth the discussions of financial engineering presented in subsequent chapters. Thirdly, the financial instruments section describes the pricing of futures, forwards , swaps, options. In addition, the section of financial strategies includes innovative financial strategies that have been developed in recent years to manage financial risk and maximize returns.

It uses the engineering methods to design, develop and implement innovative financial instruments and processes, and creatively solve problems in finance. The course promotes financial science to a new developing phase, and deeply influences the financial domain and the whole economic field. This curriculum is divided into four sections. At first, the introductory section provides an interesting overview of financial engineering. Secondly, a background section ensures that the students have the necessary analytical tools to appreciate in depth the discussions of financial engineering presented in subsequent chapters. Thirdly, the financial instruments section describes the pricing of futures, forwards , swaps, options. In addition, the section of financial strategies includes innovative financial strategies that have been developed in recent years to manage financial risk and maximize returns.

default.zh: 国际结算是国际经济与贸易专业毕业生必备的专业知识和必须完整掌握的专业技能，是一门非常重要的主干专业课程。课程的主要内容包括：国际结算概述、国际银行清算、国际结算中汇票、本票和支票等的概念、内容及票据行为、汇款方式、托收方式及其运用、信用证概述、开立信用证的流程及信用证的主要内容、跟单信用证及其分类、各类跟单信用证的运用、国际结算中的运输单据、发票、保险单等的形式及主要内容、单据审核的基本要求、银行保函及其运用等，在课程中突出课程思政的要素，介绍和分析人民币结算发展的情况以及我国企业运用多种结算工具开展业务取得的成绩和效果。通过本课程的学习，使学生透彻掌握国际结算的基本知识和主要方法，了解相关的国际惯例及其主要内容，并能够熟练运用各种支付工具和支付方式，了解单据制作和审核的要求。
default.en: International Settlement is an essential professional course for international economic and trade students who must be fully mastered professional skills, which is a very important trunk professional courses.The main contents of the course include: International Settlement overview, international bank settlement,the concept of bills of exchange, promissory notes and cheques in international settlements,content and bill behavior,method of remittance collection methods and their use,the letter of credit, the procedure of opening the L / C and the main contents of the L / C, documentary credits and their classification,the use of documentary credits, the forms and main contents of transport documents, invoices and insurance policies in international settlement, the basic requirements for document review, bank guarantee and its application, etc. Highlighting the ideological and political elements of the course, introducing and analyzing the development of RMB settlement, as well as the achievements and effects of Chinese enterprises in using a variety of settlement tools to carry out business. Through the study of this course, students will be able to master the basic knowledge and the main methods of international settlement.This course will help students to understand relevant international practice and its main contents better , skillfully use various payment tools and payment methods,understand the requirements of document making.

default.zh: 本课程为数字经济专业方向的核心课程，旨在利用理论分析以及经验分析阐述数字技术对企业行为以及市场结构的影响。课程将由经济学中的产业组织理论出发，对生产、效用、供需关系、定价策略、市场结构等基本原理进行讨论。 再结合数字技术密集型产业通常具有的高固定成本、低边际成本、用户高转换成本、以及强网络效应等特征，与传统行业的生产和消费间进行比较，总结数字技术产业独特的竞争模式。因此，该课程的讨论对象涵盖网络搜索、线上平台等经济生活中常见的数字技术密集型产业。同时，引入搜索理论、双边市场模型、定价模型、信息机制设计等理论框架，并结合实证分析结果、案例研究、最新政策法规研读等，对数字产业进行深入剖析。最后通过学习产业分析的一般方法和范式来掌握产业分析报告的写作。学生将通过该课程了解数字技术相关产业在国内外的发展现状， 掌握分析数字技术经济影响的经济学理论，培养运用经济学方法论专业分析问题和解决问题的能力，以及进行产业分析的专业写作能力。
default.en: As a core curriculum for students in the major of digital economics, this course provides theoretical and empirical discussions on digital technology intensive industries. Students will learn production, consumption, demand-supply system, pricing, market structure from the industrial organization theories. Further, given the characteristics of high fixed cost, lost marginal cost, high switching cost for users, and strong network effect in digital technologies, the course compares the digital technology industries to traditional industries and summarizes the unique behaviors in the digital technology industries. Therefore, this course covers topics on, but not limit to, search engines and online platforms which are business common in daily life. Moreover, the course provides theoretical foundations for searching theory, dual-sides market, pricing model, and information design. Empirical studies, case studies, and policy studies are also included to provide a deep insight into the digital technology industries. The last, students will learn the methods and norms in the writing of professional industry analysis report. Through this course, students will have a better understanding of the development of digital technology industries worldwide, and mastering economics theories in industrial organization, and cultivate the ability to analyze and solve issues, and the ability to write professional report.

default.zh: 本课程讲授我国数字经济发展过程中核心的治理议题，包括数字治理导论、数字政府变革、数字经济的新业态治理、数字技术与经济政策研究、数字城市治理、数字社区治理、数字技术治理、全球视野下的数字治理等八部分内容。通过学习，学生可以充分了解当前数字治理中的前沿问题、学科理论与实践经验，并能够结合已有经济学、管理学、社会学等学科理论解释数字经济发展中的现象与问题，综合运用构建模型，数据分析、实验等方法分析解决当前的治理难题，评估治理效果。
default.en: This course systematically teaches core digital governance issues during the development of digital economic in China, including introduction, digital government reforms, new digital economy forms governance, digital technology and economic policy research, digital city governance, digital community governance, digital technology governance, and global digital governance. Through learning, students can fully understand the frontier issues, discipline theory and practical experience in digital governance, and use economics, management, sociology theory to explain the phenomena and problems in the development of digital economy. Meanwhile, students can adopt multiple approaches such as building model, data analysis and experiment to solve different governance problems and evaluate governance effect.

default.zh: 数字经济是现代化经济体系的重要组成部分，是世界科技革命和产业变革的前沿，也是新一轮国际竞争的重点领域。这门课程可以使学生全面地掌握数字经济的发展现状及数字经济运行规律，并能够运用基本经济学原理解释数字经济发展的相关问题，有助于学生理解当代经济的复杂性和未来的发展趋势。 课程主要围绕当下我国数字经济发展的重要问题，通过理论与案例相结合的方式，为学生供多元的学习模式。课程系统讲授数字经济的基本内容和理论框架，以及典型的数字技术和数字人才体系。同时，在介绍数字经济如何驱动产业变革的基础上，分析数字经济下的公司治理创新及其对企业管理和治理模式的影响。此外，本课程还将介绍在数字经济背景下，政府治理的新模式和政策框架，对国内外数字经济政策的发展进行比较分析，探究如何通过有效的数字经济政策促进国家发展。
default.en: The digital economy is a crucial component of the modern economic system, representing the cutting edge of the global technological revolution and industrial transformation, and emerging as a focal point in the new era of international competition. This course aims to provide students with a thorough understanding of the current state of digital economy development and its operational dynamics. Additionally, students will learn to apply fundamental economic principles to analyze issues related to digital economy growth, thereby gaining insights into the complexity of contemporary economic systems and future trends. The course will focus on key issues surrounding the development of the digital economy in China, using a blend of theoretical frameworks and case studies to offer a multifaceted learning experience. It will systematically cover the core concepts and theoretical underpinnings of the digital economics, including prevalent digital technologies and talent systems. Building on the examination of how the digital economy drives industrial transformation, the course will also explore innovations in corporate governance within this context and their implications for management and governance structures. Moreover, it will introduce new models of government governance and policy frameworks relevant to the digital economy, conducting a comparative analysis of digital economy policies both domestically and internationally, and investigating how effective digital economy policies can contribute to national development.

default.zh: 本课程围绕微积分、线性代数、最优化方法、常微分方程等基本数学分析工具，系统阐述以上数学方法在经济学分析中的应用。具体内容包括经济学中的均衡分析、比较静态分析、最优化和动态经济分析。1.1）通过本课程的学习，旨在让学生掌握经数理经济学的基本方法，使其能够独立自主地围绕具体经济问题进行经济模型建模、比较静态分析、最优化分析和动态经济分析等。 2.本课程在强化数学论证的同时，强调数学工具在经济学分析中的实际应用，2.1)旨在培养研究生应用数学工具解决实际经济问题的能力。2.2)同时，通过本课程的学习，使学生掌握数理经济学的基本理论和方法，为后续课程以及今后的科学研究打下坚实基础。
default.en: This course revolves around basic mathematical analysis tools such as calculus, linear algebra, optimization methods, and ordinary differential equations, and systematically elaborates on the application of the above mathematical methods in economic analysis. The specific content includes equilibrium analysis, comparative static analysis, optimization, and dynamic economic analysis in economics. 1.1) Through the study of this course, the aim is to enable students to master the basic methods of mathematical economics, enabling them to independently model economic models, compare static analysis, optimization analysis, and dynamic economic analysis around specific economic problems. 2. While strengthening mathematical reasoning, this course emphasizes the practical application of mathematical tools in economic analysis. 2.1) The aim is to cultivate the ability of graduate students to apply mathematical tools to solve practical economic problems. 2.2) At the same time, through the study of this course, students will master the basic theories and methods of mathematical economics, laying a solid foundation for subsequent courses and future scientific research.

default.zh: 信息技术基础是信息管理与信息系统专业学生的一门重要的专业知识课，是学习计算机知识必须学习的一门课程。该课程对深入掌握计算机编程、系统分析与设计、管理信息系统等专业知识是必不可少的内容。本课程让学生掌握计算机基本信息描述、操作系统、计算机网络的基础知识，培养学生进行大信息系统综合设计时充分运用计算机知识的能力。 本课程主要讲授计算机中操作系统的进程、线程、并发性协调、存储器管理技术、系统调度、设备控制；讲授Internet网络、互联网络原理和布局、分布式系统；介绍分布式系统、云存储、云计算、物联网控制基础。针对本专业的培养目标对于计算机知识的需求，着重培养学生们运用计算机的能力。采用累加式考试，包括平时与课堂参与占40%，期末考核占60%。 针对本专业的培养目标对于计算机知识的需求，着重培养学生们运用计算机的能力。信息管理与信息系统专业的学生需要学习系统分析与系统设计知识，需要掌握企业ERP系统设计和工作原理，需要掌握分布式网络开发技术等内容，本课程的内容所讲述的知识既是计算机专业核心知识又能为信息管理与信息系统专业学习其他计算机知识提供重要支持。
default.en: The foundation of information technology is an important professional knowledge course for students majoring in information management and information systems, and it is a necessary course for learning computer knowledge. This course is essential for in-depth mastery of professional knowledge such as computer programming, system analysis and design, and management information systems. This course aims to enable students to master the basic knowledge of computer information description, operating systems, and computer networks, and cultivate their ability to fully utilize computer knowledge in the comprehensive design of large information systems. This course mainly teaches the processes, threads, concurrency coordination, memory management techniques, system scheduling, and device control of operating systems in computers; Lecture on Internet networks, principles and layout of Internet networks, and distributed systems; Introduce the basics of distributed systems, cloud storage, cloud computing, and IoT control. In response to the training objectives of this major and the demand for computer knowledge, the focus is on cultivating students' ability to use computers. Adopting a cumulative exam, which includes 40% of daily and classroom participation, and 60% of final exams. In response to the training objectives of this major and the demand for computer knowledge, the focus is on cultivating students' ability to use computers. Students majoring in Information Management and Information Systems need to learn system analysis and design knowledge, master the design and working principles of enterprise ERP systems, and master distributed network development technology. The knowledge covered in this course is not only the core knowledge of computer science, but also provides important support for students majoring in Information Management and Information Systems to learn other computer knowledge.

default.zh: 数据仓库与数据挖掘是管理科学与工程系本科生的专业核心课，在培养学生信息管理与信息系统应用方面的综合分析能力、综合设计能力等方面占有重要的地位。本课程主要讲授数据仓库与数据挖掘的原理、概念、方法和技术，课程主要包括2大方面内容：（1）数据仓库方面上，剖析数据仓库的通用框架、数据仓库模型、数据仓库规划、设计和实现过程、OLAP技术；（2）数据挖掘方面上，讲述数据的基本类型、数据预处理方法、关联规则挖掘、分类技术（如决策树、贝叶斯分类器、随机森林、感知机、BP神经网络、SVM模型、距离判别分析、kNN模型、逻辑回归、Softmax回归、深度学习、集成学习等）、空间变换、聚类模型和离群点分析、核方法、尺度学习等。按培养目标和学时要求，课程中平衡算法细节、工作原理、宏观思想、应用案例四个层次的知识学习。通过本课程的课堂教学、实践动手操作等环节，着重培养学生在数据仓库上的综合分析与设计能力，加强学生对数据挖掘知识的学习理解，培养学生的数据分析与数据挖掘能力。采用累加式考试，包括平时与课堂参与占40%，结课考核占60%。
default.en: Data warehouse and data mining are the professional core courses for undergraduates of management science and engineering department. They play an important role in cultivating students' comprehensive analysis ability and comprehensive design ability in information management and information system application. This course mainly introduces the principles, concepts, methods and technologies of data warehouse and data mining. The course mainly includes two aspects: (1) in the aspect of data warehouse, it analyzes the general framework of data warehouse, data warehouse model, data warehouse planning, design and implementation process, and OLAP technology（ 2) In the aspect of data mining, it describes the basic types of data, data preprocessing methods, association rules mining, classification technology, (such as decision tree, Bayesian classifier, random forest, perceptron, BP neural network, SVM model, distance discriminant analysis, kNN model, logical regression, Softmax regression, deep learning, integrated learning, etc.), spatial transformation, clustering model and outlier analysis, kernel method, scale learning, etc. According to the training objectives and class hour requirements, the curriculum balances four levels of knowledge learning: algorithm details, working principles, macro ideas, and application cases and so on. Through the classroom teaching, practical operation and other links of this course, it focuses on cultivating students' comprehensive analysis and design ability in data warehouse, strengthening students' learning and understanding of data mining knowledge, and cultivating students' data analysis and data mining ability. The cumulative test is adopted, including 40% classroom participation and 60% final examination.

default.zh: 本课程使学生通过理论授课和上机实践，掌握C程序设计的基本语法知识和基本编程技术，能够比较熟悉的使用C语言编写简单程序，并具备良好的实践能力。培养学生扎实的程序设计技能，为进一步学习信息系统专业相关技术课程特别是为将来从事信息系统和信息资源的软件开发打下良好的基础。 课程内容主要包括C语言基本数据类型、运算符与表达式、顺序、选择、循环程序设计、数组、指针、字符串、函数以及文件操作等信息管理与信息系统专业本科生必须掌握的基本内容。
default.en: The objectives of this course are making students to: master the basic grammar knowledge and programming skills; write simple program with C language fluently; have good practice and strong programming capability; build up strong bases for the further study of the courses related with information technique especially for the development of information system and information resource software in the future. The content of this course covers: C data types, simple arithmetic operations and expressions, sequence programming, case programming, iterative programming, array, pointer, string, function and file I/O operation, and so on. All techniques just mentioned are fundamentally required by the students in information management and system.

default.zh: 仿真是系统研究的有效方法之一。在管理实践中，仿真（模拟）的研究方法在很多关键决策中起到了非常重要的作用。本课程讲授仿真的一般理论，管理系统仿真（模拟）的一般原理、方法和过程，典型的管理系统模拟工具；进一步地通过实际案例的上机实验，掌握各种理论、工具的实际应用技巧。通过本课程的学习，让学员掌握管理系统仿真理论，能熟练地解决实际应用问题。
default.en: Simulation is one of the effective approaches for systematic research. In the management practice, the simulation (imitation) research methods played a very important role in a lot of key decision-making cases. Major object of this course is the general theory of simulation, the general principles, methodologies and process of management system simulation, and the typical simulation tools for management system simulation. There is lot of practical experiments on computer, as part of this course. It give students application skills after various theories.

default.zh: 运筹学是现代管理理论中的重要基础性内容，在科学技术体系中属于技术科学层次。它以管理决策问题为实际背景，以数学模型和定量分析方法为主要工具，其核心思想是实现系统的最优化。随着科学技术的发展与进步，运筹学在管理科学、工商管理、金融科学、经济学等领域取得了广泛的应用，其理论与方法已经成为以上各领域进行科学研究的重要工具。运筹学优化软件及建模实践是针对已学过运筹学的学生开设。 本课程的目的是能够使学生比较系统地掌握运筹学建模的基本概念、原理和方法，具备应用这些方法正确地分析和解决管理决策中实际问题的能力，熟练使用优化软件求解的能力、一定的抽象思维和推理能力等。 本课程特点是将现代管理中一门重要的定量决策技术学科的深刻（数学与经济）原理和丰富实际背景有机结合，将整体优化的系统观贯彻始终。教学形式主要是课堂讲授和软件教学。通过介绍基本的实用软件的使用方法，使学生具备会运用软件工具对各类运筹学模型进行求解和结果分析的能力，力争做到学以致用。
default.en: Operational Research belongs to technology science level in the Science & Technology System. Based on mathematical models and quantitative analysis methods, its primary aim is to solve management issues in practice to realize the optimum of the whole system. With the development of science and technology, as an important tool, it has obtained broad application in numerous fields, such as management science, business administration, finance, economics, etc. This course is set up for the students who have studied the Operational Research. This course aims to make students master the basic concepts, principles and methods of modeling in Operational Research and possess abilities to apply these theories to correctly analyze and solve the practical problems in management decision making, proficient skills in using optimization software to find solutions, abstract thinking, reasoning, etc. The characteristic of the course is that it combines the profound principles (mathematics and economics) of quantitative decision-making technology, which is an important subject in modern management, with abundant practical background accurately, and systemic concept which pays more attention to global optimization throughout the course. The main teaching forms are instructing in class and doing exercises in software. And some practical software tools are also inducted to provide the students with tools for model solution and result analysis, which help them to learn for application.

default.zh: 本课程聚焦固定收益证券的核心概念与实践应用，涵盖债券（国债、公司债、市政债）、抵押贷款支持证券（MBS）、资产支持证券（ABS）、利率衍生品及信用衍生品等。课程主要通过课堂问题解决与作业，结合案例分析，学习单只证券/组合层面的估值与风险管理。FIA课程技术性较强，注重对关键概念的深入理解与知识广度的平衡，并全程大量应用基础统计学与电子表格建模。
default.en: The Fixed Income Analysis (FIA) Class focuses on key concepts and pragmatic applications of various fixed income securities including bonds (treasury, corporate, municipal), mortgage-backed securities, asset-backed securities, interest rate derivatives, and credit derivatives. Valuation and risk management of fixed income securities on instrument/portfolio level will be learned mainly through problem solving in class and assignments, with case studies. FIA is technically demanding, and the course strikes a balance between deep understanding of critical concepts and broad knowledge base. Basic statistics and spreadsheet modeling will be used extensively throughout the course.

default.zh: 决策是我们改变未来生活的唯一手段。管理学大师西蒙也说过：“管理就是决策”。我们每天都要进行决策。有些决策属于例行公事，比如选择想看的电视节目。我们偶尔也会做出对自己及身边的人有深远影响的决策。获得决策能力是一项非凡的成就。尽管做出高质量决策的许多原则已广为流传了好几个世纪，但在我们的整个教育生涯中却很少强调这一问题。 本课程的重要概念不是传统定量化管理方法的延伸，而是未来决策应用的实战方法。本课程的目的在于提供一个掌握这种能力的机会，能够使你在做出任何所关注的决策时达成清晰的行动。获得决策能力的最大障碍之一在于我们自以为很擅长决策。然而，很容易证明，即使在相对简单的决策情境中，当人们仔细回顾时，他们也会认为当时所做的决策是不明智的。 决策过程中，我们所面临的最具有挑战性的现象就是不确定性。假设我们进行决策时所面临的每个方案都有一个视频，能够详尽地展示我们未来的生活历程，那么我们就可以很容易地做出决策。不确定性与所有重大决策都密不可分。我们必须学会在不确定性的海洋中冲浪，而非溺毙其中。我们必须形成“不确定性为决策的一个先导”这一清晰理念，即达成思维的清晰性。 决策分析中最重要的区别是决策和随之而来结果之间的区别。好的决策可以产生坏的结果，坏的决策也能够得到好的结果。决策的质量只取决于你在决策时所用的思维和分析的质量。 对一个决策适用的分析量，可以从几乎为零到巨量的计算机建模。本课程则提供了为了达成这一目标而必须掌握的基本原则、思想和方法。 课程需要掌握必要的计算，以及在计算机借助通用语言的实现方法。
default.en: Decision-making is the only way for us to change our future lives. Simon, a master of management, also said, "Management is decision-making." We make decisions every day. Some decisions are routine, such as choosing the TV programs you want to watch. Occasionally, we also make decisions that have a profound impact on ourselves and the people around us. Gaining decision-making ability is an extraordinary achievement. Although many principles of high-quality decision-making have been widely circulated for centuries, this issue has rarely been emphasized throughout our educational career. The important concept of this course is not the extension of the traditional quantitative management method, but the practical method of future decision-making application. The purpose of this course is to provide an opportunity to master this ability, so that you can take clear action when making any decision of concern. One of the biggest obstacles to gaining decision-making ability is that we think we are good at decision-making. However, it is easy to prove that even in relatively simple decision-making situations, when people look carefully, they will think that the decisions made at that time are unwise. The most challenging phenomenon we face in the decision-making process is uncertainty. Assuming that each plan we face when making decisions has a video that can show our future life in detail, then we can easily make decisions. Uncertainty is inseparable from all major decisions. We must learn to surf in the ocean of uncertainty instead of drowning in it. We must form a clear concept that "uncertainty is a guide to decision-making", that is, to achieve clarity of thinking. The most important difference in decision analysis is the difference between decision-making and the resulting results. Good decisions can produce bad results, and bad decisions can also produce good results. The quality of decision-making only depends on the quality of the thinking and analysis you use when making decisions. The amount of analysis applicable to a decision can be from almost zero to a huge amount of computer modeling. This course provides the basic principles, ideas and methods that must be mastered in order to achieve this goal. The course requires mastering the necessary calculations and the implementation method of the computer with the help of a common language.

default.zh: 通过学习本课程，学生在掌握Python数值计算、数据可视化、数据统计分析及预处理等基本技能基础上，进一步了解并掌握数据挖掘、机器学习等高级分析方法，并通过相关案例掌握如何利用数据分析方法结合其他管理知识解决实际问题。
default.en: Through learning this course, students will further understand and master advanced analysis methods such as data mining and machine learning on the basis of mastering basic skills such as Python numerical calculation, data visualization, data statistical analysis and preprocessing, and master how to use data analysis methods to solve practical problems in combination with other management knowledge through relevant cases.

default.zh: 随着商业的迅速发展、传统型公司的数字化转型、5G以及物联网等应用的普及，制造业、金融、医疗健康、零售等各个行业都在产生着庞大而丰富的数据资源。同时，伴随着软硬件以及技术的全面升级迭代，运用商业分析方法处理、利用海量数据并作出更准确、更智能的商业决策成为现代人面临的机遇与挑战。本课程依托大量研究和案例，涵盖了大数据和商务分析及相关领域的理论基础、国际前沿研究以及最新行业动态。预期通过课程学习让同学们掌握大数据分析的基本概念、一般思路与分析方法，了解大数据分析行业最新科学进展与行业创新应用，并在个人研究与实践中积极抓住机遇、应对挑战。
default.en: With the rapid growth of commerce, the digital transformation of traditional enterprises, and the widespread adoption of 5G and IoT, industries such as manufacturing, finance, healthcare, and retail are generating vast data resources on a daily basis. Simultaneously, analyzing massive amounts of data for making more accurate and intelligent business decisions presents both an opportunity and a challenge. This is based on the continuous updating and iteration of software, hardware, and analysis techniques in the modern era. In this course, students will be introduced to theories alongside cases, cutting-edge research, and the latest industry trends. It aims to equip them with the necessary foundations, skills, and methodologies related to big data analytics and it will enable them to seize opportunities and address challenges in the age of big data.

default.zh: 人工智能与大数据是信息技术的前沿领域，并将深刻改变人类社会的发展。人工智能的飞速发展离不开大数据的支持，而从大数据中挖掘有价值的信息也离不开人工智能技术的支持。本课程主要介绍人工智能与大数据的基本概念、理论和技术，人工智能与大数据的关系以及相关应用案例。通过本课程的学习，使学生初步具备利用人工智能及大数据技术解决优化、决策等问题的能力。
default.en: AI and big data are the frontier fields of information technology and will profoundly change the development of human society. The rapid development of AI is inseparable from the support of big data, and mining valuable information from big data is also inseparable from the support of AI technology. This course mainly introduces the basic concepts, theories and technologies of AI and big data, the relationship between AI and big data, and related application cases. Through the study of this course, students will initially have the ability to use AI and big data technology to solve optimization, decision-making and other problems.

default.zh: 课程以生成式人工智能（Generative AI）技术在商务分析领域的前沿应用为主线，系统讲授大语言模型（LLM）基础、智能体（Agent）开发方法，以及它们在商务分析中的应用。课程介绍Transformer模型、大模型的预训练和后训练、思维链和推理模型、模型上下文协议（MCP）、LangChain等核心技术，训练学生使用GenAI技术完成评论文本情感分析、专家评价、基于知识的推荐等商务分析任务，指导学生基于LangChain和Dify.AI平台搭建能自主完成商务分析任务的智能体。课程旨在提升学生在大模型时代的创新思维和实践能力，助力其成长为面向未来的数智化商务分析人才。
default.en: The course takes the cutting-edge applications of Generative AI technology in the field of business analysis as the main line, systematically teaching the basics of large language models (LLMs), the development methods of agents, and their applications in business analysis. The course introduces core technologies such as the Transformer model, pre-training and post-training of large models, chain-of-thought and reasoning models, the Model Context Protocol (MCP), and LangChain. It trains students to use GenAI technology to complete business analysis tasks such as sentiment analysis of review texts, expert evaluation, and knowledge-based recommendations. It also guides students to build agents based on the LangChain and Dify.AI platforms that can independently complete business analysis tasks. The course aims to enhance students' innovative thinking and practical abilities in the era of large models, helping them grow into digital and intelligent business analysis talents for the future.

default.zh: 本课程介绍机器学习的基本概念、主要方法以及在数据分析中的实际应用。课程将从机器学习的基本原理出发，系统讲解监督学习与非监督学习的核心算法，并结合实际案例帮助学生理解如何在真实数据环境中构建、评估和解释机器学习模型。
default.en: This module introduces the fundamental concepts, methods, and applications of machine learning in data analytics. The course begins with the basic principles of machine learning and then explores core supervised and unsupervised learning algorithms. Through practical examples and case studies, students will learn how to build, evaluate, and interpret machine learning models using real-world datasets.

default.zh: 本课程《世界经济新格局下的全球战略管理》由哈尔滨工业大学经济与管理学院开设，是面向本科生的专业选修课，计1学分，共16学时。课程由悉尼科技大学商学院Wen Helena Li高级讲师（副教授）与哈工大经管学院刘潍教授共同讲授，采用双语教学。课程旨在系统引入全球战略管理的核心理论与前沿实践，帮助学生深刻理解企业在复杂多变的国际环境中制定与实施竞争战略的逻辑与方法。 课程内容紧扣世界经济新格局，涵盖四大核心板块：一是全球化与全球战略，剖析地缘政治、经济政策、技术变革等宏观力量如何重塑企业全球经营的底层逻辑；二是行业竞争与核心竞争力，讲授如何分析国际行业动态并构建企业可持续的竞争优势；三是制度与治理焦点，深入探讨不同国家的政治、法律、文化制度差异，以及跨国运营中的公司治理与合规挑战；四是全球战略前沿实践，聚焦新兴经济体企业（特别是中国企业）的国际化战略、全球价值链布局、战略联盟以及企业社会责任等议题。 教学采用“中外双师接力授课”的创新模式。高水平外国专家负责前半程，以英文讲授全球化、行业竞争、核心竞争力及制度焦点等理论基础；本校教师负责后半程，结合中国与全球商业实践，主讲国外市场分析与选择、跨国公司结构治理与全球社会责任。课程通过案例教学、互动研讨和小组汇报等形式，引导学生批判性地分析全球战略管理的前沿问题，着力培养其战略思维、跨文化理解与决策能力。课程的最终考核为小组汇报展示，旨在检验学生对理论工具的综合应用能力及团队协作水平。 通过本课程的学习，学生将能够系统掌握全球战略管理的分析框架，形成广阔的国际视野，为未来从事跨国经营、咨询、金融及相关管理工作奠定坚实的知识与能力基础。
default.en: Global Strategic Management in the New World Economic Landscape is a 1-credit (16-hour) elective course offered by the School of Management at Harbin Institute of Technology. The course is jointly delivered by Senior Lecturer (Associate Professor) Wen Helena Li from the UTS Business School, University of Technology Sydney, and Professor Wei Liu from Harbin Institute of Technology. It adopts a bilingual teaching model designed to provide undergraduates with a systematic introduction to the core theories and cutting-edge practices of global strategic management, equipping students with the logic and methods needed for formulating and implementing competitive strategies in a complex international environment. The curriculum focuses closely on the evolving world economic landscape and consists of four key modules: (1) Globalization and Global Strategy, analysing how macro forces like geopolitics, economic policies, and technological change reshape the fundamentals of global business; (2) Industry Competition and Core Competence, teaching how to assess international industry dynamics and build sustainable competitive advantages; (3) Institutional and Governance Focus, exploring differences in political, legal, and cultural institutions across countries, as well as corporate governance and compliance challenges in multinational operations; and (4) Frontier Practices in Global Strategy, addressing the internationalization strategies of emerging-economy firms (especially Chinese firms), global value chain configuration, strategic alliances, and corporate social responsibility. The course adopts an innovative “dual-expert relay teaching” format. The overseas expert leads the first half, delivering lectures in English on theoretical foundations such as globalization, industry competition, core competence, and institutional focus. The HIT faculty member then takes over the second half, integrating both Chinese and global business practices to cover foreign market analysis, strategic choices, multinational corporate structure and governance, and global social responsibility. Through case studies, interactive seminars, and group presentations, students critically examine frontier issues in global strategic management, with a strong emphasis on developing strategic thinking, cross-cultural understanding, and decision-making acumen. The final assessment is a group presentation, designed to evaluate students’ ability to comprehensively apply analytical tools and demonstrate effective teamwork. Upon completion of the course, students will have mastered the analytical frameworks of global strategic management and developed a broad international perspective, laying a solid foundation for future careers in multinational management, consulting, finance, and other related fields.

default.zh: 《商业数据分析与高级定量方法》是哈尔滨工业大学经济与管理学院开设的专业选修课，计1学分，共16学时。课程由悉尼大学商学院Yi Li副教授与哈工大经管学院刘潍教授联合讲授，采用双语教学。本课程旨在帮助学生系统掌握商业数据分析与高级定量研究方法，培养学生在科研探索与商业实践中运用数据驱动决策的核心能力。 课程内容采用"基础+前沿"的模块化设计，由本校教师与外聘教师接力授课。前半程为基础方法模块，由本校教师讲授课程导论、数据分析基础、回归分析与模型诊断、面板数据与时间序列分析，并通过商业数据分析项目实战强化学生的实操能力。后半程为前沿方法模块，由外聘教师以英文讲授文本分析与自然语言处理、情感分析与主题建模、机器学习基础与分类预测，以及定性比较分析（fsQCA）等前沿定量方法。 课程强调理论与实践深度融合，采用案例教学、软件实操与项目驱动相结合的教学模式，引导学生以Python和Stata为主要工具，完整经历从数据清洗、建模分析到结果解读的全流程训练。学生不仅能够掌握描述性统计、推断统计、回归分析、面板数据、文本分析、机器学习及fsQCA等核心方法的基本原理与适用场景，还能熟练运用相关软件独立完成商业数据分析项目或学术研究中的实证分析。 本课程以小组项目报告为考核方式，注重培养学生的问题定义、数据获取、方法选择、结果解读及报告撰写能力，同时强调代码可复现性的学术规范。课程既服务于本科生继续深造所需的科研能力培养，也对接企业数据分析岗位的实际需求，具有鲜明的应用性与时代性。
default.en: Business Data Analytics and Advanced Quantitative Methods is a 1-credit (16-hour) elective course offered by the School of Economics and Management at Harbin Institute of Technology. The course is jointly delivered by Associate Professor Yi Li from the University of Sydney Business School and Professor Wei Liu from HIT. Adopting a bilingual teaching model, this course aims to equip students with a systematic understanding of business data analytics and advanced quantitative research methods, cultivating the ability to make data-driven decisions in both academic research and business practice. The curriculum is structured into two interconnected modules using a "foundations + frontiers" approach. The first half, taught by the HIT faculty, covers the fundamentals, including course introduction and data analytics basics, regression analysis and model diagnostics, panel data and time series analysis, and a hands-on business data analytics project to consolidate practical skills. The second half, delivered in English by the overseas expert, focuses on cutting-edge quantitative methods, including textual analysis and natural language processing, sentiment analysis and topic modeling, machine learning fundamentals and classification/prediction, and qualitative comparative analysis (fsQCA). The course emphasizes the deep integration of theory and practice through case-based teaching, software labs, and project-driven learning. Using Python and Stata as the primary analytical tools, students will complete the full workflow from data cleaning and model building to result interpretation. By the end of the course, students will not only grasp the principles and appropriate application scenarios of core methods—such as descriptive and inferential statistics, regression analysis, panel data models, textual analysis, machine learning, and fsQCA—but also be proficient in independently conducting business data analytics projects or empirical analysis for academic research. Assessment is based on a group project report, which emphasizes problem definition, data acquisition, method selection, result interpretation, and report writing, while also highlighting the academic norm of code reproducibility. This course serves both to prepare students for graduate studies and to meet the practical needs of data analytics roles in industry, making it highly relevant and applicable to contemporary developments.

default.zh: 旨在为学生提供必要的知识和技能，使其能够在可持续发展的背景下理解一系列气候变化与粮食安全相关管理议题。课程将从全球、国家和地方不同尺度来分析相关问题与挑战。完成本课程后，学生将具备在地方、国家及国际层面的公共、私营及社会部门中，参与制定应对气候变化相关策略与方案的能力。
default.en: The aim is to provide students with the knowledge and skills necessary to understand a range of climate change and food security topics in the context of sustainable development management. Particular attention will be paid to appreciating global, national, and local scale perspectives and issues. Following completion of this module, students will be well positioned to contribute to devising climate change responses and plans in a wide range of local, national, international public, private and civic contexts.

default.zh: 《出口管理理论与实践》是哈尔滨工业大学经济与管理学院开设的面向本科生的专业选修课，计1学分，共16学时。课程由悉尼大学商学院Gracy J.Y. Yang教授与哈工大经管学院罗雨濛助理研究员联合讲授，采用双语教学。本课程旨在帮助学生系统掌握企业出口管理的核心理论、全流程操作实务及前沿发展趋势，培养学生在复杂多变的国际环境中，为企业制定并实施有效出口战略的综合能力。 课程内容紧扣企业出口运营的真实链条，采用“实务基础+战略拓展”的双模块设计，遵循“理论基础-运营执行-风险与拓展”的逻辑链条，由本校教师与外聘教师接力授课。前四次课为“实务核心基础”模块，由本校教师以中文讲授，聚焦出口业务的关键操作环节，系统讲解国际支付方式与贸易融资工具的原理及风险比较、跨境电子商务的运营逻辑、平台选择与定价模型；国际贸易术语的精要与实战应用、出口单据管理与货运物流协同，以及出口风险管理与绩效评估等核心内容，系统夯实学生的实务操作基础。后四次课为“战略准备与深层拓展”模块，由外聘教师以英文讲授，结合国际真实案例并围绕企业出口的前端决策与深层逻辑展开：涵盖企业出口的动机与障碍分析、出口准备度评估、海外市场选择与进入模式比较、国际渠道伙伴关系的建立与管理，以及国际销售合同的法律维度、知识产权保护与灰色市场应对等前沿议题，聚焦跨境电子商务、服务出口及可持续贸易等前沿领域。 课程强调“学以致用、做中求学”，采用案例教学、情境模拟与小组汇报的融合教学模式。学生将以小组形式选定一个真实企业或产品，完整经历从出口战略规划、市场分析到运营计划制定的全流程训练，并在课堂上进行全英文汇报展示。课程最终考核为小组汇报，重点检验学生从出口战略规划、市场分析到运营方案设计，利用支付方式、市场进入模式等理论工具解决实际出口问题的能力，以及跨文化沟通与团队协作水平，为学生未来从事跨国经营、国际商务咨询及相关管理工作奠定坚实基础，为中国企业“走出去”储备高素质专业人才。
default.en: Export Management: Theory and Practice is a 1-credit (16-hour) optional course offered by the School of Management at Harbin Institute of Technology (HIT). The course is jointly taught by Professor Gracy J.Y. Yang from the University of Sydney Business School and Assistant Professor Yumeng Luo from HIT’s School of Management, adopting a bilingual teaching approach. The course aims to equip students with a systematic understanding of core theories in corporate export management, practical operational procedures across the entire export lifecycle, and cutting-edge industry trends. Furthermore, it seeks to cultivate students’ comprehensive capabilities in formulating and implementing effective export strategies for enterprises within a complex and dynamic international environment. The curriculum is structured closely around the real-world chain of corporate export operations, adopting a dual-module design of “Practical Foundations + Strategic Expansion” that follows the logical progression of “Theoretical Foundations – Operational Execution – Risk and Expansion,” delivered through a relay teaching model by HIT faculty and the overseas expert. The first four sessions focus on the “Core Practical Foundations” module, taught in Chinese by the HIT faculty, keeping eyes on the key operational aspects of export business. This module systematically covers the principles of international payment methods and trade finance instruments, along with their risk comparisons; the operational logic, platform selection, and pricing models of cross-border e-commerce; the essentials and practical application of International Commercial Terms; export documentation management and freight logistics coordination; as well as export risk management and performance evaluation, thereby solidly strengthening students’ practical operational foundations. The subsequent four sessions comprise the “Strategic Preparation and Advanced Expansion” module, taught in English by the overseas expert. Drawing on real international cases, this module centers on the front-end decision-making and underlying logic of corporate exporting, covering: analysis of firms’ export motivations and barriers, export readiness assessment, overseas market selection and entry mode comparisons, the establishment and management of international channel partnerships, as well as cutting-edge topics such as the legal dimensions of international sales contracts, intellectual property protection, and grey market responses, with a focus on frontier areas including cross-border e-commerce, service exports, and sustainable trade. The course emphasizes the principles of “learning by doing and doing by learning,” employing an integrated teaching model that combines case studies, situational simulations, and group presentations. Students will work in teams to select a real firm or product and undertake full-process training spanning export strategy planning, market analysis, and operational plan development, culminating in a final presentation delivered entirely in English. The course assessment is based on the group presentation, which evaluates students’ ability to apply theoretical tools such as payment methods and market entry modes to solve real-world export challenges, as well as their cross-cultural communication and teamwork skills. This course lays a solid foundation for students pursuing future careers in multinational operations, international business consulting, and related management fields, while equipping them as high-caliber professionals to support Chinese enterprises in their “going global” endeavors.

default.zh: 本课程旨在系统培养学生的法语语言基础与跨文化沟通能力。通过掌握语音、词汇、语法等基本语言技能，学生将具备初步的法语听说读写能力，并能理解中法语言表达的差异。同时，课程注重自主学习能力与文化意识的培养，为后续学习和国际交流奠定坚实基础。学生能够掌握基础的法语语音（35个音素及26个字母）、语调（陈述句，疑问句及强调句），具有基础的词汇、语法（动词变位，名词阴阳性等）、句型、对话、写作等法语语言基本功。学生能够初步理解法语在词汇、句式运用、语法、篇章表达方面的与中文表达不同之处，并能够在输出语言时做到相对灵活的转换。学生能够掌握科学的语言知识体系，具备初步自主学习的能力，了解初步法国文化特征，具备初级的跨文化理解和沟通能力。
default.en: This course is designed to systematically build students’ foundational French and cross-cultural communication skills. By mastering basic phonetics, vocabulary and grammar, students will acquire elementary listening, speaking, reading and writing abilities in French and become aware of key differences between French and Chinese expression. The course also fosters autonomous learning and cultural awareness, laying a solid basis for further study and international exchange. Upon completion, students will: command basic French sounds (35 phonemes and 26 letters) and intonation patterns (declarative, interrogative and emphatic sentences); possess fundamental vocabulary and grammar (verb conjugation, gender of nouns, etc.) and be able to use basic sentence patterns, dialogues and short written texts; recognize and contrast French and Chinese usage at the lexical, syntactic, grammatical and discourse levels, and carry out simple, flexible transfer when producing French; understand a scientific approach to language learning, begin to study independently, gain initial insight into French culture, and demonstrate elementary cross-cultural understanding and communication skills.

default.zh: 证券投资学 课程是研究证券投资的本质及其运动规律的一门综合性、应用性学科，全面了解与掌握证券投资工具——股票、债券、证券投资基金和其它衍生金融工具的特点、种类，证券投资的程序方法，选时与选股的投资分析方法——基本分析和技术分析的熟练运用，实用的证券投资的策略和技巧，证券投资组合构建与管理的基本方法，规避投资风险的技巧，掌握投资者的知识、技术、资金、心理、能力、策略的有效结合能力，以实现投资的收益、安全与流动的最佳目标。
default.en: Securities investment principles course is the study of securities investment, the nature and the law of motion of a comprehensive, applied science, the comprehensive understanding and mastering the securities investment tools, stocks, bonds, securities investment funds and other derivative financial instruments the characteristics, the types of securities investment program, method, choose with stock selection of investment analysis, fundamental analysis and technical analysis of skillfully use, practical securities investment strategies and skills, portfolio construction and management of the basic method, avoiding the risk of investment skills, grasps the investors knowledge, technology, capital, psychological, and the power, and the effective combination of the strategy ability, so as to realize the investment income, security and flow of the best goal.

default.zh: 《计量经济学与时间序列分析》是经济学类的核心课程，是经济管理专业本科生的专业基础课，是一门理论性与实践性都很强的课程。该课程系统地介绍将计量经济学理论应用于经济领域的研究方法，使学生在掌握计量经济学的基本理论、基本方法的基础上，联系实际的经济问题，培养学生独立地分析问题和解决问题的能力，为解决实际经济问题奠定扎实的基础。课程提供掌握计量经济学的基本概念、理论和方法，同时给出许多案例来认识如何运用基本理论和方法来对实际经济问题进行分析和研究。
default.en: “Econometrics and Time Series Analysis”is a core course in economics and a professional foundation course for undergraduate students majoring in economic management. It is a course with strong theoretical and practical significance. This course systematically introduces the research methods of applying econometric theory to the economic field, enabling students to grasp the basic theories and methods of econometrics, connect them with practical economic problems, cultivate students' ability to independently analyze and solve problems, and lay a solid foundation for solving practical economic problems. The course provides a grasp of the basic concepts, theories, and methods of econometrics, and provides many cases to understand how to apply basic theories and methods to analyze and research practical economic problems.

default.zh: 创新管理是工商管理专业学生重要的专业课，在培养学生创新思维、提高学生创新能力等方面发挥着重要作用。课程主要讲授创新的基本概念和基本原理、创新动力机制及激励、创新模式、创新系统等内容。通过本课程的教学活动，使学生掌握有关创新的经典理论和常用方法与工具，并学会运用这些理论和方法分析创新实践活动，解决创新实际问题，使学生明确创新是企业实施差异化和低成本竞争战略的基础，只有不断创新才能保证企业保持持续竞争优势。本门课程主要通过课堂讲授方式，并要求学生积极参课堂讨论与案例分析，理解创新价值、掌握创新的基本概念和基本原理、组织创新和技术创新管理重点，明确并掌握技术创新激励的类型、优缺点和适用范围，理解并掌握技术创新过程模式以技术创新系统构成及运行；能够运用创新管理的知识，进行创新方案和策略制定，具备分析和解决创新实践问题的能力。
default.en: Innovation management is an important course for students majoring in business administration, which plays an important role in cultivating students' innovative thinking, improving students' innovation ability and other aspects. The course mainly focuses on the basic concepts and principles of innovation, innovation mechanism and incentives, the innovation model, the innovative system, etc. Through the teaching activities of the course, students can understand the classical theories and common methods of innovation, learn to analyze the innovation activities and solve the practical problems by using these theories and methods, and realize that innovation is the basis of differentiation and low-cost competition strategies for an enterprise and only continuous innovation can guarantee the sustainable competition advantages for an enterprise. In this course, through lectures, active participation in discussion and case analysis, students can understand innovation value, master the basic concepts and principles of innovation, key of organization and technology innovation management, understand and master various types, advantages, disadvantages and application scopes of innovation incentives, master technology innovation process mode and innovation system construction and operation, then can design the innovation project and strategy, analyze and solve innovation problems through using the knowledge of innovation management.

default.zh: 项目管理是工商管理专业学生非常重要的专业核心课。企业制胜的关键在于一个又一个项目的成功，项目管理的理论和方法从根本上决定了企业的经营成败与运作效率。有效的项目管理可以提高项目实施的资源利用效率、降低成本、保证质量。 通过本课程的学习，使学生掌握项目管理的基本知识、基本原理和基本方法，具备从事项目管理的基本能力。培养学生具备项目管理的意识，强化学生应用项目管理的理念，引导学生使用项目管理的方法，学习项目过程、范围、组织、进度、成本、质量、采购等方面的技能，引导学生用项目管理的思维和行为准则开展工作，强化学生分析和解决问题的能力。
default.en: Project management is a very important core course for students majoring in business administration. The key to the success of an enterprise lies in the success of one project after another. The theories and methods of project management fundamentally determine the success or failure of an enterprise and its operational efficiency. Effective project management can improve the resource utilization efficiency of project implementation, reduce costs, and ensure the quality. Upon the completion of this course, students are expected to do the following: 1) Master the basic knowledge, principles and methods of project management on project process, scope, organization, schedule, cost, quality, procurement and etc. 2) Develop the awareness of project management. 3) Develop the ability to engage in project management. 4) Strengthen the application of project management concepts/methods and the ability to analyze and solve practical problems. 5) Use the thinking and code of conduct of project management at work.

default.zh: 本课程以如何识别企业经营管理问题并提出有效解决方案为核心，基于企业诊断技术和方法，并结合企业管理相关专业知识，在实践层面对企业经营实践进行学习探讨。本课程主要基于讲授法和企业走访实践的教学方法进行设计，通过学生在企业实际环境下的访谈、调研和方案撰写等活动，培育问题解决意识和管理者心态，促进其对于企业经营管理实践的理解，培养其综合运用管理知识解决问题能力。
default.en: This course focuses on identifying enterprise management problems and proposing effective solutions accordingly. With the improvement of diagnostic technologies and relevant professional knowledge of enterprise management provided, this course discusses management practices at a practical level through expository teaching strategies and corporate site visits. Students can learn the knowledge through interviews, conducting a survey and proposal writing in the actual enterprise environment. This course aims at cultivating students' awareness of problem-solving and managers' mentality , promoting their understanding of enterprise operation and management practice, together with cultivating their ability to comprehensively use management knowledge to solve problems in the reality.

default.zh: 通过本课程的学习，使学生掌握跨文化管理的基础知识和基本理论，了解跨文化管理的研究方法，为其分析和解决跨文化管理问题提供理论框架。通过练习、讨论培养学生的文化敏锐度，使其充分认识到企业管理中跨文化问题的存在，意识到跨文化冲突的潜在威胁。并通过案例分析和角色扮演，让学生掌握在实践中应对跨文化冲突的技能，培养在跨文化的企业环境中适应生存的能力，以及作为管理者进行跨文化管理的能力。
default.en: This course presents participants essential knowledge and theory of cross-cultural management, acquaints them with research methods and provides a theoretical framework for analyzing and solving related issues. With sufficient practice and discussion, this course aims to cultivate students’ cultural sensitivity so that they can fully recognize the existence of cross-cultural issues in business management and realize the potential threat of cross-cultural conflicts. Through case studies and role-playing, students can master skills in dealing with cross-cultural conflicts. These activities can also enable them to adapt to the cross-cultural corporate environment and enhance their ability to manage across culture.

default.zh: 领导力是高素质人才能力体系的重要组成部分，沟通能力是领导力的重要体现。《领导力与沟通》通过对沟通能力的系统讲授和训练，提高学生沟通技能，继而达到提升领导力的目的。课程以对领导力的理解为切入点，分别从领导的职能和领导者的日常工作重点两个角度，让学生领会沟通能力在领导力中的重要作用。无论领导的三个基本职能，即确定目标、寻找路径和激励和培养下属，还是在日常的管理活动中，领导者有70%的时间花在沟通上，并且管理中70%的问题来源于沟通，沟通活动都是领导工作的主体内容。关于对沟通能力的理解，课程注重思维和技能的训练。课程带领学生系统地理解沟通基本概念及特征、管理沟通过程与要素、基本沟通技能，如倾听与反馈、演讲、写作、招聘面试等，课程贯穿始终地强调有效沟通的三个关键词：良好意愿（goodwill）、换位思考（you-attitude）和可信度（credibility）。通过对项目答辩、社团活动组织与呈现、个人成长面试等真实组织环境中学生沟通技能综合运用的实践模拟，培养学生分析和解决实际管理问题、鼓励创造性思维、注重系统性思考的领导能力训练，为培养适应未来不确定环境下管理企业的优秀领导者奠定通识性素质基础。
default.en: ？Leadership is the core elements of the ability system of highly qualified personnel, and communication ability is an important manifestation of leadership. Through teaching and training systematically, will promote students' communication ability, and then achieve the goal of improving students' leadership. The course takes the understanding of leadership as the breakthrough point, and makes the students understand the important role of communication ability in leadership from two perspectives, namely, the functions of lead and the daily management focuses of leaders. Not only achieving the three basic functions of lead, determining target, finding path, and supervising and cultivating subordinates, but also in the daily management activities, the leaders have 70% of time spent in communication, and in management 70% of the problems derived from communication. Communication is the main content of leadership. With regard to the understanding of communication skills, the course focuses on the training of thinking and skills. The course will guide students to systematically understand the basic concepts and characteristics of communication, communication process and management elements, and basic communication skills, such as listening and feedback, speech, writing, interviews, meetings and so on. Throughout the course, three key words will be emphasized: good will, you-attitude, and credibility. By simulating the real organization environment, such as project defense, organization and presentation of university activities, recruitment interview and so on, the students could comprehensively use the communication skill, which could improve students' ability to analyze and solve practical management problems, encourage creative thinking, concentrate on the leadership training of systematic thinking, in order to cultivate general foundation for future excellent leaders to adapt to uncertain management surroundings.

default.zh: 本门课程紧扣服务企业及企业服务经营管理的客观规律，以顾客需求管理为中心，采用管理理论、操作方法、案例相结合的手法论述了市场营销在服务业的应用系统。该课程要求学生掌握服务市场营销的基本原理与基本技能，系统了解服务服务管理的各种要素及其运行的程序与内在联系，并且对服务业营销有一个全新的认识。 课程目标1: 熟悉服务营销的基本概念和原理 课程目标2: 运用服务营销的基本理论解决实践问题 思政目标1：培养学生诚实无欺、互惠互利、不断创新的职业操守
default.en: This course is closely related to the objective laws of service enterprises and enterprise service management, taking customer demand management as the center, and discusses the application system of marketing in the service industry by combining management theory, operation method and case study. This course requires students to master the basic principles and basic skills of service marketing, systematically understand the various elements of service management and its operation procedures and internal links, and have a new understanding of service marketing. Objective 1: Familiarize yourself with the basic concepts and principles of service marketing Course Objective 2: Apply the basic theory of service marketing to solve practical problems Ideological and political goal 1: Cultivate students' professional ethics of honesty, mutual benefit and continuous innovation

default.zh: 本课程侧重于使用营销模型来探索消费者行为。通过对消费者行为的研究和分析，系统地研究了消费者的消费过程、影响消费者的因素以及消费者的购买过程等几个方面的内容。课程阅读内容涵盖营销科学领域的经典文章和最新文章。主题包括消费者行为、社交媒体、人工智能、基于位置的服务、品牌、广告、促销、新兴商业模式和竞争等，是一门强调理论与实践紧密结合，理性与能力同步发展的课程。
default.en: This course focuses on using marketing models to explore consumer behaviors. Through the research and analysis of consumer behaviors, it systematically studies several aspects of content, such as the consumer's consumption process, the factors affecting consumers and the consumer's purchase process. Course readings cover both classic and state-of-the-art articles in marketing science. The substantial topics include consumer behavior, social media, AI, location-based service (LBS), branding, advertising, promotions, emerging business models, and competition. It is a course that emphasizes the close integration of theory and practice, and the simultaneous development of rationality and ability.

default.zh: 《资产评估学》是财会学科以及其他管理学科的专业基础课程，包含着资产评估原理、资产评估方法、资产评估程序和资产评估技能的系统性教学内容。课程包括：总论（包括：资产评估的一般概念和基本理论）、资产评估的基本方法（包括：市场法、成本法和收益法）、机器设备评估、房地产评估、无形资产评估、长期投资评估、流动资产评估等。本课程在对资产评估的理论、概念、方法等进行系统介绍的基础上，着重对各单项资产的评估进行重点介绍。通过本课程的学习，旨在使学生掌握资产评估的基本原理和方法，掌握常见资产类型评估的基本技能，能够独立对单项资产进行评估，能够协助进行企业价值评估。
default.en: Asset Appraisal is regarded as the main specialized course of the financial management and accounting curriculum, which includes principle, methods, process and skills of asset appraisal. The main content is as follows: Introduction (including the general concepts and basic theories), basic methods (including market approach, cost approach and income approach), machinery and equipment appraisal, real estate appraisal, long-term investment appraisal, current assets appraisal, intangible assets appraisal and firm value appraisal, etc. Based on the introduction to the theory, concepts and methods of asset appraisal, the course emphasizes on the single assets appraisal. Learning this course aims to make the students have the basic principle, approaches and skills of asset appraisal well in hand.

default.zh: 税务会计是以纳税人为会计主体，以货币为主要计量单位，依据税收法规，运用会计基本理论和方法，对税务资金运动进行联系、系统、全面的核算与筹划，其目的是在于使纳税人在不违反税收法规的前提下，及时准确的缴纳税金，并向税务部门提供税务信息的会计学科。因此税务会计是一门应用性很强的专业课程。通过该课程的学习可以使学生能够全面掌握税务会计的特点、各主要税种的应纳税额计算及核算、纳税申报表的填制和申报，税收筹划的基础及方法。为学生将来就业奠定坚实的税务会计专业知识和业务基础。该课程的具体内容包括：税务会计的概念及基础理论、增值税、消费税、企业所得税、个人所得税及其他主要税种的会计核算，纳税申报表的填列和申报，纳税筹划原理等。
default.en: Tax accounting is an accounting discipline that takes taxpayers as the accounting subject, takes currency as the main measurement unit, and uses basic accounting theories and methods to conduct contact, systematic and comprehensive accounting and planning for tax fund movement according to tax laws and regulations. Its purpose is to enable taxpayers to pay taxes in a timely and accurate manner without violating tax laws and regulations, and provide tax information to tax departments. Therefore, tax accounting is a professional course with strong application. Through the study of this course, students can fully grasp the characteristics of tax accounting, the calculation and accounting of tax payable of various major taxes, the filling and declaration of tax returns, and the basis and methods of tax planning. To lay a solid professional knowledge and business foundation of tax accounting for students' future employment. The specific contents of this course include: the concept and basic theory of tax accounting, accounting of value-added tax, consumption tax, enterprise income tax, individual income tax and other major taxes, filling and declaration of tax returns, tax planning principles, etc.

default.zh: 国际会计是会计学专业的一门前沿类课程。通过本课程的学习，使学生了解世界各主要国家的会计的理论和实务以及各国会计惯例和差异，拓宽知识面，以适应我国经济与社会改革发展向国际惯例靠拢的需要。了解在经济全球化快速发展的今天，会计的跨国沟通、交流和协调的重要性。通过对国际会计课程的讲授，使学生掌握国际比较会计、国际财务会计、国际管理会计这三大部分的基本理论和基本方法。
default.en: International accounting is an advanced course for major in accounting. Through the study of this course, students will understand the theory and practice of accounting in the major countries of the world, and the accounting conventions and differences in various countries. Students then can widen their scope of knowledge to meet the needs of the developing of China's economic and social reform in order to moving closer to the international conventions practice. Students also can understand the importance of accounting transnational communication, communication and coordination in the rapid development of economic globalization. Students will grasp the basic theory and methods of three parts in comparative international accounting, international financial accounting, and international management accounting.

default.zh: 金融企业财务管理是财务管理专业学生必修的专业理论课，是财务管理专业学生所需的基本知识之一。在教学过程中，先要向学生阐述社会主义市场经济的框架及其优越性，使得金融企业在面对金融危机、实施风险控制、履行社会责任、进行流程设计都有独特的优越性和特点，并且优于西方国家的金融企业。在金融企业实践中，要注意金融思维的意识形态问题，坚定中国共产党的领导不动摇。在此基础上，古为今用，洋为中用，树立民族自信，进行有中国特色的金融实践运用。在教学过程中综合运用先修课程中所学到的有关知识与技能，结合讨论课与案例课教学，使学生对金融企业运营规律、监管政策、财务管理方法等有深刻的理解，对学生进行专业技能的培养与综合分析问题、解决问题能力的培养，为学生以后从事金融企业财务管理工作打下基础。
default.en: Financial management of financial enterprises is a required professional theoretical course for students majoring in financial management and one of the basic knowledge required by students majoring in financial management. In the teaching process, we should first explain the framework of socialist market economy and its advantages to students, so that financial enterprises have unique advantages and characteristics in facing financial crisis, implementing risk control, fulfilling social responsibilities, and designing processes, and are superior to financial enterprises in western countries. In the practice of financial enterprises, we should pay attention to the ideological issues of financial thinking and firm the leadership of the CPC. On this basis, make the past serve the present, make foreign countries serve China, build national confidence, and carry out financial practice with Chinese characteristics. In the teaching process, the relevant knowledge and skills learned in the prerequisite courses are comprehensively used, combined with the discussion course and case course teaching, to enable students to have a deep understanding of the operating laws, regulatory policies, financial management methods, etc. of financial enterprises, and to cultivate students' professional skills and ability to comprehensively analyze and solve problems, so as to lay a foundation for students to engage in financial management of financial enterprises in the future.

default.zh: 衍生金融工具是财务管理专业学生必修的专业理论课，是财务管理专业学生所需的基本知识之一。在教学过程中综合运用先修课程中所学到的有关知识与技能，结合讨论课与案例课教学，使学生了解社会主义市场经济环境中，主要衍生金融工具的特征、应用、风险控制及定价原理，达到能够结合企业实际业务特点，设计或选择适合企业需求的衍生金融工具流程，同时兼顾企业社会责任的履行，服务于国家总体经济部署，成为社会主义市场经济有益的微观经济个体。通过本课程的学习，培养学生发现问题—分析问题—解决问题的能力，专注严谨、 精益求精的工匠精神，个人奋斗目标与民族伟大复兴同频共振意识，激发学生 为中华之崛起而努力学习的斗志，树立科技强国的远大抱负。对于学生个人来说，可以使学生深入了解社会主义金融市场及其投资工具，走向社会后无论从专业角度还是家庭资产管理角度都获益良多。
default.en: Derivative financial instruments is a required professional theoretical course for students majoring in financial management, and is one of the basic knowledge required by students majoring in financial management.
