The water supply system project mainly includes the function, planning and design principle, water quantity calculation, etc. ; the hydraulic calculation theory and method of the water transmission and distribution pipeline, the design and operation management of the water intake structure and the auxiliary structure of the pipeline, etc.; the drainage system project mainly includes the function, planning and design principle, water quantity calculation, hydraulic calculation theory and method, the operation management of auxiliary structures and pipeline system, etc.; the pump and pump station mainly include the basic working principle and design calculation of the pump, the design and operation management of the pump station, etc. Through the teaching of the course, students have the basic skills in planning, design and operation management of water supply and drainage system, ability to solve the complex engineering problems and systematically design urban water supply and drainage systems by using professional knowledge. Students can simultaneously understand the achievements and shortcomings in the development of China's water supply and drainage system, enhancing their sense of honor, mission, and responsibility. These knowledge and abilities lay the foundation for further scientific research and engineering practice related to urban water supply and drainage system engineering.

default.zh: 《环境影响评价与规划管理A》环境科学与工程专业学生的专业核心课程，是关于环境质量现状与变异规律的原理、方法的技术应用，以及在可持续发展理论、区域复合生态系统理论、环境政策学理论等相关学科理论与技术支持下，将环境影响评价、规划与环境管理有机地结的理论与方法。本课程针对环境科学与工程专业的特点，紧密联系环境科学与工程学科中的实际问题，在理论、方法、技术规范学习的同时注重建设项目环境影响评价实际案例教学及相应的规划与管理实际案例的作用，使学生能够从环境影响评价出发，以可持续发展的理念指定合理的规划管理方案。
default.en: “Environmental Impact Assessment, Planning and Management A” is a core course for students majoring in environmental science and engineering . It is about the technical application of the principles and methods of the status and variation of environmental quality. Under the theoretical and technical support of sustainable development theory, regional complex ecosystem theory, environmental policy theory and other related disciplines, the course will develop the theory and method of integrating environmental impact assessment, planning and environmental management. Aiming at the characteristics of environmental science and engineering, this course is closely related to practical problems in the discipline of environmental science and engineering. While learning theories, methods and technical norms, it pays attention to the practical case teaching of environmental impact assessment of construction projects and the corresponding practical cases of planning and management. Students can provide reasonable planning and management programs with the concept of sustainable development base on environmental impact assessment.

default.zh: 《水源工程原理》课程作为高等学校给排水科学与工程专业的专业课，全面介绍水源工程的现代理论、方法和工程要素。通过课程学习，使学生了解水资源概况、水循环与水资源开发利用状况、水资源评价、水资源供需平衡分析，掌握取水构筑物形式构造、设计计算、施工、运维等方面的知识。 课程目标对学生的能力要求如下： 课程目标1. 了解水资源概况，掌握水循环与水资源开发利用状况、水资源评价、水资源供需平衡分析的基本理论及计算方法；（支撑毕业要求7） 课程目标2. 了解取水构筑物水源及位置选择的原则，掌握取水构筑物设计、计算方法，具备分析和解决复杂工程问题的能力。（支撑毕业要求1、3）
default.en: Principles of Water Source Engineering, as a specialized course for the Water Supply and Drainage Science and Engineering major in higher education institutions, provides a comprehensive introduction to the modern theories, methods, and engineering elements of water source engineering. Through this course, students will learn about the general situation of water resources, the water cycle, the status of water resources development and utilization, water resources assessment, and water resources supply-demand balance analysis. They will master knowledge related to the types, structures, design calculations, construction, operation, and maintenance of water intake structures. The course objectives set the following competency requirements for students: · Course Objective 1: Understand the general situation of water resources; master the basic theories and calculation methods for the water cycle, the status of water resources development and utilization, water resources assessment, and water resources supply-demand balance analysis. (Supports Graduation Requirement 7) · Course Objective 2: Understand the principles for selecting water sources and sites for intake structures; master the design and calculation methods for intake structures; be equipped with the ability to analyze and solve complex engineering problems. (Supports Graduation Requirements 1 and 3)

default.zh: 《水工程输配系统（1）》是给水排水工程专业本科生的重要主干课程之一，针对给水工程中水的输送、分配的管道系统的工程设计及计算理论所需求的内容，系统地论述管道系统的功能、布置原理、水量计算、水力计算理论和方法、工程优化设计理论和方法及管道系统的运行管理理论及实践。 本课程的主要任务是通过课堂教学、案例剖析和课程设计等环节培养学生的工程思维和专业知识的应用能力，支撑专业学习成果中相应指标点的达成。使学生系统完整地学习和掌握给水管道系统的基本概念、工程设计和运行管理的基础理论和方法；使学生初步掌握给水管道系统规划、管道系统的设计和计算及运行管理方面的基本技能，初步具备给水管道系统设计和管理的工程实践能力；培养学生对给水管道工程基础理论的理解、掌握和分析运用能力，初步具备给水管道系统的科学研究能力。 该课程的主要特点是工程实践性强，反映出工程设计的基本环节。
default.en: “Water Transmission and Distribution System (1) ” is one of the main courses for the undergraduate students of water supply and drainage engineering. Aiming at design and calculation of water transportation and distribution of water supply engineering, functions, arrangement, water yield and hydraulic calculation theory and methods of pipe system will be discussed. The course will also introduce engineering optimization design theory and methods and operational management and practice of pipe system. The main objective of this course is to train engineering thinking and professional knowledge application ability of students, supporting professional learning. Through this course, students could master basic conceptions of water supply system, theory and methods of engineering design and operational management. The students could possess the ability of water supply system planning, design, calculation and operational management. They could possess the ability of design and management of water supply pipeline system. The students will be trained to possess the ability of understanding, analyzing and applying basic theories of water supply engineering. They will be able to do the research of water supply system. The main characteristic of this course is its strong engineering practicality, reflecting basic step of engineering design.

default.zh: 《水工程输配系统（2）》是城市水系统工程专业重要主干课程之一，课程系统地讲授了城市排水体制、排水系统布置原理、管段流量计算、水力计算理论和方法、排水管道工程设计方法、排水管道的智慧化运行管理，使学生掌握城市污水、雨水收集及排放所需管道系统的设计和现代化运行管理方面的专业知识。
default.en: "Water Transmission and Distribution System（2）" is one of the important backbone courses of urban water system engineering. The course systematically teaches the urban drainage system, drainage system layout principles, pipe flow calculation, hydraulic calculation theory and methods, drainage pipeline engineering design methods, and intelligent operation and management of drainage pipelines, enabling students to master urban sewage Professional knowledge in the design and modern operation management of pipeline systems required for rainwater collection and discharge. The main task of this course is to cultivate students' engineering thinking and professional knowledge application abilities through classroom teaching, case analysis, and course design, supporting the achievement of corresponding indicators in professional learning outcomes.

default.zh: 《城市供水系统智能化》是城市水系统工程专业的重要主干课程之一，针对城市水系统工程中水的输送、分配过程，系统论述管网水力计算理论及方法、管网优化设计理论及方法，并基于此，论述如何通过计算机编程、软件应用等智慧化手段，实现管道系统的设计、计算、模型构建及运维管理。
default.en: As a core course in the Urban Water Systems Engineering curriculum, Intelligentization of Urban Water Supply Systems focuses on the processes of water transmission and distribution within urban water infrastructure. It systematically elaborates on the theories and methods for hydraulic calculation and optimal design of pipeline networks. Building upon this foundation, the course discusses how to apply smart solutions, such as computer programming and software applications, to achieve the design, calculation, modeling, operation, and maintenance of pipeline systems.

default.zh: 《城市排水系统计算与模拟》是城市水系统工程专业重要主干课程之一，课程系统地讲授了城市排水体制、排水系统布置原理、管段流量计算、水力计算理论和方法、排水管道工程设计方法、排水管道的智慧化运行管理，使学生掌握城市污水、雨水收集及排放所需管道系统的设计和现代化运行管理方面的专业知识。本课程的主要任务是通过课堂教学、案例剖析和课程设计等环节培养学生的工程思维和专业知识的应用能力，支撑专业学习成果中相应指标点的达成。
default.en: "Calculation and Simulation of Urban Drainage System" is one of the important backbone courses of urban water system engineering. The course systematically teaches the urban drainage system, drainage system layout principles, pipe flow calculation, hydraulic calculation theory and methods, drainage pipeline engineering design methods, and intelligent operation and management of drainage pipelines, enabling students to master urban sewage Professional knowledge in the design and modern operation management of pipeline systems required for rainwater collection and discharge. The main task of this course is to cultivate students' engineering thinking and professional knowledge application abilities through classroom teaching, case analysis, and course design, supporting the achievement of corresponding indicators in professional learning outcomes.

default.zh: 《城市水环境规划》是城市水系统工程本科生的专业主干课之一。本课程以城市“人水和谐”为目标，以城市水环境发展历程为线索，以水环境中的物质循环、能量流动和信息传递分析为着眼点，阐述探讨城市与水环境之间的相互关系，明确城市水安全、水资源、水生态、水景观、水文化、水管理和水经济体系建设的重要内涵。通过课堂学习，了解城市水健康循环理论、城市水环境规划原则及方式、城市水环境容量与恢复、城市水环境健康循环方略、城市水环境生态调控、健康城市水环境建设与修复、水生态经济与水文化传承等，使学生掌握城市水环境规划基本概念与规划思路；结合案例分析和课程设计，进一步明确健康城市水环境的思想和理念，使学生学会应用宏观的、超前的、基础的视角看待城市水问题演化，依据最新的理论、理念、方法和技术来规划设计城市的水环境。
default.en: Urban Water Environment Planning is one of the main major courses for urban water system engineering undergraduates. This course takes the development of the urban water environment as the mainline. It focuses on analyzing material circulation, energy flow, and information transmission in the water environment, aiming at the urban development with harmony between human and water environment. Importantly, the relationship between the city and the water environment, including urban water security, water resources, water ecology, water landscape, water culture, water management, and water economic system construction, would be expounded and explored in this course. Through classroom teaching, students need to learn about healthy cycling of water, urban water environment planning principles and methods, urban water environment capacity and its restoration, urban water environment cycle strategy, urban water environment ecological regulation, construction and restoration of healthy urban water environment, ecological water economy, and inheritance of water culture. In addition to mastering the basic concepts and planning ideas of urban water environment, students must also further understand a healthy urban water environment by learning the actual planning case and planning the urban water environment system. Finally, students are hoped to analyze the evolution of urban water issues by themselves with a macro, advanced and basic perspective, and independently design the urban water environment based on the latest theories, ideas, methods and technologies.

default.zh: 城市水系统生态学是一门研究生物与城市水环境之间相互关系的科学，它涉及到生物种群、群落、生态系统以及全球生态系统的各个方面。在《城市水系统生态学》课程中，学生将学习生态学的基本概念、原理和方法，以及生态学在城市水环境保护、生态恢复和可持续发展等领域的应用。掌握生态学的基本概念、原理和方法，理解生物与城市水环境之间的相互作用和相互依赖关系学习如何运用生态学的知识，分析和解决城市水环境保护、生态恢复和可持续发展等实际问题培养学生对城市水生态环境的热爱和保护意识，树立可持续发展的观念。培养学生的实验设计、数据分析和科学研究的技能，提高其独立思考和解决问题的能力。
default.en: Urban water system ecology is a science that studies the relationship between organisms and urban water environment. It involves all aspects of biological population, community, ecosystem and global ecosystem. In the course "Ecology of Urban Water Systems", students will learn the basic concepts, principles and methods of ecology, as well as its application in the fields of urban water environment protection, ecological restoration and sustainable development. Master the basic concepts, principles and methods of ecology, understand the interaction and interdependence between organisms and urban water environment, learn how to apply the knowledge of ecology, analyze and solve practical problems such as urban water environment protection, ecological restoration and sustainable development, and cultivate students' love for urban water ecological environment and protection consciousness, and establish the concept of sustainable development. Develop students' skills in experimental design, data analysis and scientific research, and improve their ability to think independently and solve problems.

default.zh: 面向生态文明建设国家战略，服务于海绵城市建设、黑臭水体治理及智慧水务等城市水系统重构层面的复杂工程问题等国家重大需求，以“保护城市水资源、提升城市水环境、重构城市水生态、保障城市水安全”为导向，国民经济可持续发展的关键所在。《海绵城市原理与应用》是《城市水系统工程专业》核心课。全面介绍了海绵城市相关的基本知识、方法和技能，设计洪水基本理论和设计计算、海绵城市设计技术措施、案例分析等。通过本课程的学习可以让学生掌握海绵城市原理与应用的基本理论和设计计算方法，提高分析和解决实际工程问题的能力，具备海绵城市原理与应用相关规划、设计和管理的能力。
default.en: Facing the national strategy of ecological civilization construction, it serves the important needs of the country, such as the construction of Sponge City, the treatment of black and smelly water body and the complex engineering problems in the reconstruction of urban water system, such as the intelligent water affairs, etc. , the key to sustainable development of national economy is to protect urban water resources, improve urban water environment, reconstruct urban water ecology and ensure urban water security. The principle and application of sponge city is the core course of urban water system engineering. The basic knowledge, methods and skills of sponge city, basic theory and calculation of design flood, technical measures of sponge city design and case analysis are introduced. Through the study of this course, students can master the basic theory and design calculation method of Sponge City, and improve the ability of analyzing and solving practical engineering problems, ability to plan, design and manage sponge city principles and applications.

default.zh: 课程从宏观层面对景观学科的理论体系进行梳理，使学生能够较为全面地了解与掌握地质、地貌、水文、土壤、生物多样性等相关方向的基本研究方式与重点，进而能够更深入地在景观生态学、景观文化、可持续设计、保护生态学等研究方向进行研究与学习。在课程理论学习的基础上逐步消化与理解景观生态学的设计宗旨与秉持原则，将其转化为具体方案设计中的知识点与技巧。通过课程的理论讲授与实践学习，使学生对景观学的主要研究领域有一定程度的熟悉与掌握，并通过文献查询、对比分析等学习方式来锻炼论文写作能力，最终形成具有较高学术水平的课程作业成果。
default.en: The course combs the theoretical system of landscape science from a macro level, enabling students to comprehensively understand and master the basic research methods and priorities of geology, geomorphology, hydrology, soil, biodiversity and other related directions, so as to carry out more in-depth research and study in landscape ecology, landscape culture, sustainable design, conservation ecology and other research directions. On the basis of the learning of curriculum theory, we will gradually digest and understand the design purposes and principles of landscape ecology, and convert them into knowledge points and skills in specific scheme design. Through the theoretical teaching and practical learning of the course, students will have a certain degree of familiarity and mastery of the main research fields of landscape science, and exercise their paper writing ability through literature inquiry, comparative analysis and other learning methods, and finally form a higher academic level of the course work results.

default.zh: 普通生物学是高等院校环境生态专业的一门重要的专业基础课，将主要讲述环境污染防治及生态修复工程中涉及的有关生物学原理。与污染控制微生物学各所侧重，本课程尤其以细胞学、植物学和动物学为核心，讲述环境生态工程所涉及的具有共性的基本生物现象和基本生物过程背后的生物学原理。使学生具有从事环境生态工程领域工作所需的相关生物学相关知识，掌握生态环境污染预防与控制的生物学基本理论和基本技能，并能将所学生物学原理用于解决复杂生态环境问题。本课程向上承接环境学、生态学原理及应用等专业基础课程，向下承接环境系统工程、环境生态工程等专业核心课程。本课程针对环境生态专业的特点，在理论学习的同时紧密联系环境生态学科中的生物学问题，同时也注重生物学原理在环境生态工程应用的实际案例讲解。 （1）本课程教学目标： 1.使学生具有从事环境生态工程领域工作所需的相关生物学相关知识，掌握生态环境污染预防与控制的生物学基本理论和基本技能，并能将所学生物学知识用于解决复杂生态环境问题。 2.培养学生运用现代化的分析检测设备和技术手段对生物学相关的环境生态过程进行系统分析的能力，能够基于生物学的基本原理面向环境治理、生态修复及生态管理等领域复杂工程问题，开发、选择与使用恰当的生物技术和生物资源。 （2）本课程的主要内容 1. 普通生物学绪论：主要介绍生物的生物的基本特征、生物界的多层次组织结构等生物学基本内容，明确本课程在环境生态工程中的任务、定位及主要研究对象。 2. 生物的基本结构：简述生命起源基本假说、细胞周期等概念，重点讲解重要大分子的单体结构特色与大分子—小分子间的化学转化，结合环境污染案例讲述细胞结构损伤及细胞死亡的途径。 3. 细胞代谢与细胞信号：重点介绍生物的能量代谢基本过程和关键酶系、物质的跨膜运输的方式和原理、细胞呼吸作用以及细胞信号和通讯的概念和基本过程。 4. 植物细胞的结构：主要介绍植物体的基本特征与分类，重点强调植物细胞结构特征并详细讲解重要内膜系统及其生理功能。 5. 植物的生存环境与生态作用：主要讲授地球的物理环境圈层和生物圈、环境因子的分类和生态学分析、水和土壤环境中关键生态因子对植物的影响、水和土壤环境中污染物对植物的影响。 6. 植物摄取水和矿质营养：主要介绍水分和植物细胞的关系，讲解植物的水分与矿质营养的摄取与运输，举例说明植物在土壤修复中的作用。 7. 植物的光合作用：讲述光合色素的化学特性与光学特性，重点讲解光合作用的机理及影响光合作用的因素，介绍植物对光能的利用途径及光合产物的转运。 8. 动物与环境：重点讲解生物与环境关系的基本原理，说明污染物在环境中的行为及其生态效应。 9. 生态系统的组成与特征：掌握生态系统的结构：三大功能类群＋无机环境，及食物链、食物网、营养级等概念。重点掌握生态系统的物质生产、能量流动和信息传递过程。 10. 环境污染对生物的影响：简述不同生境的典型污染对生物的生态作用，重点讲解主要的生物多样性评价指标及其生态学意义。 11. 生态修复前沿技术探讨：举例说明生态修复领域的热点问题，重点引导学生分析生态修复领域热点问题中的生物学原理及其应用。 （3）本课程主要教材： 1.《陈阅增普通生物学(第四版)》，主编吴相钰、陈守良、葛明德， 2014年高等教育出版社出版 2.《植物生理学(第五版)(中译本)》，主编(美)Lincoln Taiz等，宋纯鹏等译,2015年科学出版社。
default.en: General Biology is an important foundational course for the Environmental Ecology major at institutions of higher education. It primarily addresses biological principles related to environmental pollution control and ecological restoration engineering. Unlike the more specialized focus of Pollution Control Microbiology, this course centers on cytology, botany, and zoology, discussing the common basic biological phenomena and underlying principles that are relevant to environmental ecological engineering. The aim is to equip students with the biological knowledge necessary for working in the field of environmental ecological engineering, a mastery of the fundamental biological theories and skills for the prevention and control of ecological environmental pollution, and the ability to apply biological principles to solve complex ecological environmental problems. This course builds upon foundational courses such as Environmental Science and Principles and Applications of Ecology, and leads into core courses like Environmental Systems Engineering and Environmental Ecological Engineering. Tailored to the characteristics of the Environmental Ecology major, the course integrates theoretical learning with biological issues in environmental ecology while emphasizing practical case studies where biological principles are applied in environmental ecological engineering projects.

default.zh: 生态毒理学是一门多学科交叉发展起来的科学，它的学习不仅需要综合应用多种学科知识，同时还必须学习相关的新概念、新理论、新技术，即可以帮助学生进一步提高环境意识，提高综合应用多种学科知识分析问题、解决问题的能力，同时还可以学习到以往未曾接触过的，关于生态毒理学的科学理论、实验手段和应用技术。总之，生态毒理学是一门综合性很强的科学，它对培养学生综合技能有着非常重要的作用，是环境生态工程等专业学生的必修课程。
default.en: Ecotoxicology is a multidisciplinary science that has developed through the integration of various fields. Its study not only requires the comprehensive application of knowledge from multiple disciplines, but also necessitates learning about new concepts, theories, and technologies. This can help students further enhance their environmental awareness and improve their ability to analyze and solve problems by integrating knowledge from various disciplines. Additionally, students can learn about scientific theories, experimental methods, and application techniques in ecotoxicology that they may not have encountered before. In summary, ecotoxicology is a highly integrated science that plays a very important role in cultivating students' comprehensive skills. It is a required course for students in environmental ecology engineering and related majors.

default.zh: 生物化学基础是运用化学的方法和理论研究生命物质的科学，主要任务是研究生命物质的化学组成、结构及生命活动过程中各种化学变化的基础生命科学。它研究生物体组成成分，如糖、脂、蛋白质、核酸、酶等的性质，结构及结构与功能的关系，研究生物体各种物质的新陈代谢，生物体的遗传信息的传递。在生命科学大发展的今天，生物化学作为环境学科多门主干课程的基础支撑课程，对学生后期专业研学至关重要。可以说，生物化学基础理论与实验课程在环境学科本科生的课程体系中，起着承上启下、多学科贯穿的重要作用，为进一步学习后续专业课程奠定坚实的理论基础。
default.en: The basic of biochemistry is the science that applies chemical methods and theories to study living materials, with the main task of studying the chemical composition, structure, and various chemical changes in the process of life activities of living materials as the foundation of life science. It studies the properties, structure, and relationship between structure and function of the components of living organisms, such as sugars, lipids, proteins, nucleic acids, enzymes, etc. It studies the metabolism of various substances in living organisms and the transmission of genetic information. In the era of great development in life sciences, biochemistry, as a fundamental supporting course for multiple backbone courses in environmental science, is crucial for students to pursue their professional studies in the later stage. It can be said that the basic theory and experimental courses of biochemistry play an important role in the curriculum system of undergraduate students in environmental science in bridging the gap and integrating multiple disciplines, laying a solid theoretical foundation for further learning of subsequent professional courses.

default.zh: 污染控制理论与技术是环境生态工程专业的一门重要专业核心课。该课程从理论上系统深入的阐述了大气污染控制工程及固体废物处理与处置工程所涉及的原理及过程，体现了环境生态工程专业多介质污染联合治理的特色。本课程的主要研究内容包括燃烧与大气污染、大气污染气象学、颗粒物去除原理、技术及装置、硫化物及氮化物的污染控制；还包括固废收集及预处理、厌氧处理、热处理及资源化处理及填埋等技术。此外，本课程还包括四个实验。通过课程学习及实验操作，培养学生识别大气及固废污染的能力，并运用相关理论提出解决问题的能力。
default.en: Theory and Technology Pollution Control is an important course for students majored in environmental and ecological engineering. This course systematically and deeply expounds the principles and processes involved in air pollution control and solid waste treatment and disposal, and embodies the characteristics of multi-media pollution joint control in environmental and ecological engineering. The main research contents of this course include combustion and air pollution, meteorology of air pollution, principles, technologies and devices for particulate matter removal, pollution control of sulfide and nitride, solid waste collection and pretreatment, anaerobic treatment, heat treatment and resource treatment and landfill treatment. In addition, the course includes four experiments. Students will develop the ability to identify air and solid waste pollution, and apply relevant theories to propose and solve problems through course learning and experimental operation.

default.zh: 环境决策支持系统是环境科学专业的必修课。该课程是一门计算机技术与环境科学的交叉学科，是研究如何更好的利用计算机技术来预防和控制环境污染的课程，它为决策者提供分析问题、建立模型、模拟决策过程和方案的环境，调用各种信息资源和分析工具，帮助决策者提高环境决策水平和质量。本课程针对计算机技术发展现状和环境科学专业特点，紧密联系当前出现的主要环境污染问题，在理论学习的同时注重环境科学与工程实际案例教学的作用，通过课堂教学和实验教学达成以下目标：第一，使学生能够将环境大数据分析方法、知识库系统、数据库设计方法、地理信息系统、全球定位系统、遥感技术等基本科学理论和方法应用到建立环境决策支持系统中，进而运用系统得到预防与控制环境污染的合理决策方案；第二，通过GIS软件的上机学习、GPS接收仪的操作练习，使得同学们获得对于环境空间数据的获取、分析和处理的能力，进而更好的分析空间现象，解决环境问题。
default.en: Environmental Decision Support System (EDSS) is a compulsory course of the major of environmental science. As an interdiscipline of computer science and environmental science, this course focus on environmental pollution controlling based on computer technology. EDSS provides the deciders a platform for analyzing problems, building models, simulating decision making processes and projects, and helps the deciders improve the environmental decision-making levels and quality. This course integrates the current situation of computer technology and the characteristics of environmental science with major environmental pollution problems, and combines the theoretical study with actual project case. The mainly teaching objects: Firstly, help the students to apply basic scientific theories and methods including environment big data analysis method, knowledge base system, database design method, geographic information system, global positioning system, and remote sensing technology to EDSS, and obtain an optimal plan for preventing and controlling environmental pollution. Secondly, based on the application of GIS and the operation of GPS receiver, help the students to obtain, analyze, and process environmental data, analyze the spatial phenomena, and solve the environmental problems.

default.zh: 环境统计学是统计学基本原理应用到环境领域的学科，是一门关于收集、整理和分析环境领域统计数据的方法论科学，其目的在于揭示环境问题与现象的数量表现、数量关系以及规律性。通过本课程的学习，使学生了解和掌握统计设计、统计调查、统计整理和统计分析的基本理论和方法。在教学的过程中除引入应用于环境领域的实例教学，培养学生的统计学思想方法的应用能力，教学引入Excel和SPSS软件完成统计计算操作，加强对统计学方法的应用训练，提高学生的计算机应用能力。
default.en: This course focuses on the application of statistics in the environmental sciences. Environemt Statistics is a scientific methodology for collecting, organizing, and analyzing data related to the environment to identify environmental issues, trends, and relationships quantitatively. The course aims to equip students with a solid understanding of fundamental statistical theories and methods, including statistical design, data collection, organization, and analysis. Practical applications in environmental fields are integrated into the curriculum to enhance students' proficiency in applying statistical reasoning. Instruction will involve the use of Excel and SPSS software for calculations, aiming to enhance students' adeptness on statistical methods and computer applications.

default.zh: 智慧水务管理概论是环境专业的选修课。智慧水务是智慧城市的重要组成部分，是综合运用现代科学技术，以创新思维、科技赋能来加强和统筹城市规划、建设和管理的新模式，通过数字化手段，对城市的供水、排水设施系统的运行全程进行实时监测，及早发现问题和解决问题，以智慧手段提高城市的韧性，也是推进城市生命线安全工程建设的重要内容。智慧水务管理概论是一门信息技术与环境科学与工程技术的交叉学科，是研究如何更好的利用现代信息技术解决如城市内涝防治、城市水资源保护、黑臭水体治理等问题的课程。本课程针对信息技术发展现状和环境科学与工程专业特点，紧密联系当前出现的主要城市水务问题，在理论学习的同时注重环境科学与工程实际案例教学的作用，通过课堂教学和实践教学助力水务行业交叉学科拔尖创新人才培养。
default.en: Introduction to Smart Water Management is an elective course for environmental majors. Smart water management is an essential part of smart cities, representing a new model that comprehensively applies modern science and technology, empowered by innovative thinking and technology, to enhance and coordinate urban planning, construction, and management. Through digital means, it involves real-time monitoring of the city's water supply and drainage system operations, promptly identifying and solving problems. This approach aims to improve the city's resilience with smart measures and is a crucial aspect of advancing the construction of urban lifeline safety projects. Introduction to Smart Water Management is an interdisciplinary subject that intersects information technology with environmental science and engineering. It explores how to better utilize modern information technology to address issues such as urban waterlogging prevention, urban water resource protection, and the management of polluted and foul-smelling water bodies. This course is tailored to the current state of information technology development and the characteristics of the environmental science and engineering discipline. It closely relates to the main urban water issues emerging today, emphasizing the role of actual environmental science and engineering case studies in theoretical learning. Through classroom and practical teaching, the course aims to support the training of top innovative talents in interdisciplinary fields within the water industry.

default.zh: 生态环境大数据分析是一门生态专业本科生的课程，这门课程是将当前国际前沿研究热点问题应用到生态环境研究领域的一个新兴交叉学科的课程。该课程从生态环境数据的基本分析方法入手，抽象的方法会以图表及案例的方式向同学们介绍，尽量做到让这门课程通俗易懂。并且针对每种分析方法都介绍了生态环境领域相关的实例。这不仅让学生理解数据分析方法的基本概念、原理，还学会了如何运用数据分析方法对生态环境实际数据和案例进行分析和应用，有效的避免了大数据分析挖掘过程中的枯燥、难懂的普遍问题，能够让同学们对课程内容真正产生兴趣，并学以致用，将上述知识和方法应用到生态环境大数据分析及应用中，获取数据价值，指导生态环境管理实践。同时为了避免数据分析方法的枯燥性和抽象性，本课程还设置了上机课，上机课程与课堂授课紧密联系，在课堂授课中介绍的方法，通过上机操作都可以掌握并理解，因此这门课程是将理论学习与实践操作紧密有机结合的课程。在上机课中，学生学会利用当前较为流行的软件python中的各种数据挖掘工具对生态数据进行处理分析等操作，为后续生态环境领域其它研究工作的深入开展打好基础。
default.en: Ecological Environment Big Data Analysis is a course for undergraduate students majoring in ecology, which is an emerging interdisciplinary course that applies current international cutting-edge research hotspots to the field of ecological environment research. This course starts with the basic analysis methods of ecological environment data, and abstract methods will be introduced to students in the form of charts and cases, striving to make this course easy to understand. And relevant examples in the field of ecological environment were introduced for each analysis method. This not only enables students to understand the basic concepts and principles of data analysis methods, but also learns how to apply data analysis methods to analyze and apply actual ecological environment data and cases, effectively avoiding the tedious and difficult to understand common problems in the process of big data analysis and mining. It can make students truly interested in the course content and apply the above knowledge and methods to ecological environment big data analysis and application, obtain data value, and guide ecological environment management practice. At the same time, in order to avoid the dryness and abstraction of data analysis methods, this course also includes a computer course. The computer course is closely related to classroom teaching, and the methods introduced in classroom teaching can be mastered and understood through computer operation. Therefore, this course is a closely organic combination of theoretical learning and practical operation. In the computer class, students learn to use various data mining tools in the popular software Python to process and analyze ecological data, laying a foundation for further research in the field of ecological environment.

default.zh: 该课程除了涉及Python的基本理论知识，基础上机操作练习以外，还涉及目前比较流行的机器学习（模型应用）的内容，注重生态大数据的机器学习研究。可以根据学生的实际情况，调整教学难度，让同学们在短短的16课时就能够对Python有较好的掌握。
default.en: This course not only covers the basic theoretical knowledge of Python and basic computer operation exercises, but also covers the popular content of machine learning (model application), focusing on the research of machine learning in ecological big data. The teaching difficulty can be adjusted according to the actual situation of students, so that they can have a good grasp of Python in just 16 class hours.

default.zh: 环境与生物统计学是运用数理统计的原理和方法来分析和解释环境领域与生物界各种现象的一门科学。本课程在介绍统计原理和各种统计方法的同时，注重培养学生熟练应用的能力，使学生了解环境科学与工程以及生物学试验的任务、要求，掌握科学试验设计的原则和技术，能熟练制定试验方案，进行生物科学试验的设计，并能根据生物统计学原理正确选用统计分析模型，进行数据的处理与分析，分析和解释试验结果中的数量变化，从而做出符合科学实际的推断。
default.en: Biostatistics provides the essential methodological and quantitative underpinning necessary for much of ecological research, environmental science, environmental engineering et al. Environment and biostatistics is an innovative field that involves the design, analysis, and interpretation of data for studies in biology and environmental science. Focus on training students to master the various methods and technology of biostatistics. The development and application of techniques to better understand such data is the fundamental concern in the course. The theories and application of statistical methods to the design and analysis will be taught to studies in microbiology, environmental science and engineering research.

default.zh: 《环境生态风险评价》在介绍生态风险评价相关理论及国内外进展的基础上，使学生了解环境风险评价的基本概念和应用发展现状，掌握环境风险评价的一般流程，方法以及模型应用，增强学生对人类活动与生态环境关系有的认识。
default.en: On the basis of introducing the relevant theories of ecological risk assessment and the progress at home and abroad,, students will understand the basic concepts and application development status of environmental risk assessment, master the general process, methods and model application of environmental risk assessment, enhance their understanding of the relationship between human activities and the ecological environment.

default.zh: 《水系统信息化技术》是给排水科学与工程专业与城市水系统工程专业本科生的选修课，主要目的是对水系统信息化相关的基本概念、关键技术和典型应用给予综合介绍，使学生对水系统信息化技术的发展有较为全面的了解并掌握相应工程技术的概貌。本课程的特色在于与大数据、人工智能等相关领域知识相结合，建立本专业与计算机专业之间的联系与“接口”。同时，课程内容结合水系统信息化技术的最新进展和发展趋势,强调水系统信息化技术在实际水务工作中的应用,使学生了解行业技术前沿,支撑学习成果中相应指标点的达成，为从事相关工作做好准备。课程主要讲解水系统信息化技术中智慧水利、智慧水务等系统的相关理念和关键技术，以及城市水系统监测及预警模型的基本架构及应用场景。旨在培养学生具有综合应用多种信息化手段解决实际水系统工程问题的能力，进一步培养与时俱进、发展新方法和新技术的创新思维和创新能力。
default.en: “Water system information technology” is an elective course for undergraduates majoring in Science and engineering of water supply and drainage and Urban water system engineering, the main objective is to give a comprehensive introduction to the basic concepts, key technologies and typical applications related to water system informatization, to enable students to have a more comprehensive understanding of the development of water system information technology and grasp the general situation of the corresponding engineering technology. The characteristic of this course is to combine the knowledge of big data, artificial intelligence and other related fields, and establish the connection and“Interface” between this major and computer major. At the same time, the content of the course, combined with the latest progress and development trend of water system information technology, emphasizes the application of water system information technology in the actual water affairs work, so that students can understand the leading edge of industry technology, support learning results in the corresponding indicators to achieve points, in order to prepare for related work. This course mainly introduces the related concepts and key technologies of Intelligent Water Conservancy and intelligent water affair in water system information technology, as well as the basic structure and application scenario of urban water system monitoring and early warning model. The aim is to develop students' ability to solve practical systems engineering problems through a comprehensive application of various information-based means, and to further develop their innovative thinking and ability to keep abreast of the times and develop new methods and technologies.

default.zh: 智能水厂是以智能化的方法，利用先进的模拟和信息技术来改变传统水务业务系统的运作方式，以提高决策、运营和管理能力。而水厂的管控则向“数字化精细管理、智能化全流程控制”的趋势发展，站在水厂整体运维的角度，解决水厂设备、生产和运维的疑难问题。 课程任务是通过智能控制技术的发展与特点、智慧水系统、城市供水数据采集与监视控制（SCADA）系统、城市水系统监测模型及水处理典型工艺单元的智能控制等内容培养学生了解和掌握与水工艺智能控制有关的基本知识，以及人工智能及自动化技术在水科学与工程中的各种应用，并具有进一步钻研水工艺智能控制技术的能力。
default.en: The intelligent water plant uses the advanced simulation and information technology to change the operation mode of the traditional water business system in order to improve the ability of decision-making, operation and management. The management and control of waterworks is developing towards“Digital fine management and intelligent whole process control”, which solves the problems of equipment, production and operation of waterworks. The task of this course is to train students to understand and master the basic knowledge related to intelligent control of water technology through the development and characteristics of intelligent control technology, intelligent water system, urban water supply data collection and monitoring control (SCADA) system, urban water system monitoring model and intelligent control of typical process units of water treatment, and artificial intelligence and automation in water science and engineering applications, and has the ability to further study the water technology of intelligent control technology.

default.zh: 《城市雨洪模拟与控制》是《城市水系统工程专业》核心主干课。这是一门结合了给水排水、水文、水利和计算机等多学科专业知识的课程，具有很强的理论性和实践性。该课程的主要内容包括海绵城市雨洪管理规划、城市雨水系统设计理论、雨水管网建模基础、常见的城市雨洪管理模型（SWMM）, 城市防洪排涝技术与方法、工程案例分析等。课程以海绵城市建设规划为引导，以雨洪预测、模拟、控制和排除为技术手段，使学生掌握城市雨水收集、调蓄、下渗、回用和排放等设计计算方法。本课程设置案例设计，让学生根据背景资料提出城市雨洪控制设计方案；通过建立水力水文模型，验证各方案在不同暴雨强度下的排水能力；然后分析结果并不断优化方案；得出最终设计方案。通过本课程的学习可以让学生掌握城市雨洪控制的基本理论和设计计算方法，提高分析和解决实际工程问题的能力，具备城市雨洪控制相关规划、设计和管理的能力。
default.en: Urban Stormwater Simulation and Control is the core course of Urban Water System Engineering. This is a course that combines multi-disciplinary expertise such as water supply and drainage, hydrology, water conservancy and computer, with strong theoretical and practical characteristics. The main contents of this course include sponge city stormwater management planning, urban stormwater system design theory, stormwater pipe network modeling basis, common urban stormwater management model (SWMM), urban flood control and drainage technology and methods, project case analysis, etc. Guided by sponge city construction planning, the course uses stormwater prediction, simulation, control and elimination as technical means to enable students to master the design and calculation methods of urban rainwater collection, regulation and storage, infiltration, reuse and discharge. This course provides case design, allowing students to propose urban stormwater control design scheme according to background information; Through the establishment of hydraulic hydrological model, the drainage capacity of each scheme under different rainstorm intensity was verified. Then analyze the results and continuously optimize the scheme; Come up with the final design.Through the study of this course, students can master the stormwater control, improve the ability to analyze and solve practical engineering problems, and acquire the ability of planning, design and management of urban stormwater control.

default.zh: 本课程积极响应海绵城市建设、黑臭水体治理及智慧水务等城市水系统重构层面国际前沿科学与工程问题及国家的重大需求，以“保护城市水资源、提升城市水环境、重构城市水生态、保障城市水安全”为导向，从污染物水文地质学基础、地下水污染调查、地下水污染的评价、模拟与预测以及地下水污染防治四个方面较全面、系统地介绍有关地下水污染与防治的基本概念、基本理论、基本模型和技术方法。通过本课程的学习，使学生掌握有关地下水污染与防治的基本概念、基本理论和基本方法，具备从事地下水污染与防治的科学研究与实践的基本能力，并能够综合运用专业知识解决当前我国城市水系统发展过程中面临的水环境问题。 本课程的重点内容包括：地下水污染、地下水污染源和地下水污染物的概念和地下水污染的特点及四种污染途径，地下水污染源和污染物的分类与特征；污染物在地下水中运移的水动力弥散理论和方程；污染物在地下水中经历的主要物理、化学和生物过程；地下水污染调查的主要方法、内容和步骤；国内外研究趋势以及我国地下水污染现状；地下水污染现状评价的主要方法和步骤；地下水污染的“以防为主、以治为辅”的基本策略（含《全国地下水污染防治规划》）等。
default.en: This course responds positively to the sponge city construction, black smelly water body management and intelligent water affairs and other urban water system reconstruction level of international frontier science and engineering issues and the country's major needs, to “protect urban water resources, enhance the urban water environment, reconstruct urban water ecology, safeguard urban water security” as the guide, from the pollutants hydrogeology foundation, It introduces the basic concepts, basic theories, basic models and technical methods of groundwater pollution and prevention in a comprehensive and systematic way in four aspects: investigation of groundwater pollution, evaluation, simulation and prediction of groundwater pollution and prevention of groundwater pollution. Through the study of this course, students will master the basic concepts, basic theories and basic methods of groundwater pollution and prevention, have the basic ability to engage in groundwater pollution and prevention of scientific research and practice, and be able to comprehensively utilize their professional knowledge to solve the current water environment problems facing the development of China's urban water system. The key contents of this course include: the concepts of groundwater pollution, groundwater pollution sources and groundwater pollutants and the characteristics of groundwater pollution and the four pollution pathways, the classification and characteristics of groundwater pollution sources and pollutants; the hydrodynamic dispersion theory and equations of pollutant transport in groundwater; the main physical, chemical and biological processes experienced by the pollutants in groundwater; the main methods, contents and steps of groundwater pollution investigation; domestic and international research trends and the groundwater environment problems faced in the development of China's urban water system. The main methods, contents and steps of groundwater pollution investigation; research trends at home and abroad and the current status of groundwater pollution in China; the main methods and steps of groundwater pollution status evaluation; the basic strategy of “preventing and treating” groundwater pollution (including the National Groundwater Pollution Prevention and Control Plan).

default.zh: 本课程立足于传统建筑给排水的智能化发展，结合行业发展趋势，系统讲解建筑给水、排水、消防、热水等子系统的智能化升级体系。课程聚焦物联网、传感监测、自动控制与大数据等关键技术，解析智能水务设备选型、系统集成及运行逻辑。同时融合绿色建筑、海绵城市、水资源回收与源分离等前沿理念，结合 BIM 协同设计等工程应用方向，衔接理论知识与实践场景。通过课程学习，可帮助同学们完善专业知识体系，掌握智慧水务核心技术，夯实工程设计、运维管理与技术研发的专业基础，适配智慧城市与绿色建筑领域的行业发展需求。
default.en: This course focuses on the intelligent development of traditional building water supply and drainage. Combined with industry development trends, it systematically elaborates the intelligent upgrading system of building water supply, drainage, fire protection, hot water and other subsystems. Centering on key technologies such as the Internet of Things, sensor monitoring, automatic control and big data, the course analyzes the selection of intelligent water service equipment, system integration and operational logic. It also integrates cutting-edge concepts including green buildings, sponge cities, water resource recycling and source separation, and incorporates engineering application directions such as BIM collaborative design to connect theoretical knowledge with practical scenarios. Upon completion of this course, students will improve their professional knowledge system, master core technologies of smart water services, and consolidate the professional foundation for engineering design, operation and maintenance management, as well as technological research and development, so as to adapt to the industry development demands in the fields of smart cities and green buildings.

default.zh: 《城市水系统智慧化》是城市水系统工程专业的专业选修课之一，课程讲授了水处理工艺单元的机理模型与数据模型以及智慧水务方面的内容。本课程的主要任务是通过课堂讲授、邀请国际知名专家讲授的环节培养学生的工程思维和专业知识的应用能力，支撑专业学习成果中相应指标点的达成。 课程目标对学生的能力要求如下： 课程目标1. 掌握给水处理工艺系统设计原理和计算理论方法；（支撑毕业要求1） 课程目标2. 了解给水处理工艺系统技术发展方向，具备对常见工程问题进行研究分析的能力；（支撑毕业要求2） 课程目标3. 掌握给水处理工艺系统工程设计的基本方法，具备分析和解决复杂工程问题的能力；（支撑毕业要求3） 课程目标4. 具有利用机理模型和数据模型分析研究水工艺处理工艺的相关理论；（支撑毕业要求4） 课程目标5. 了解智慧水务发展历史和技术特点，了解城市给水处理工艺系统对社会健康、安全和文化的影响；（支撑毕业要求6） 课程目标6. 了解城市给水处理工艺系统建设对环境、社会和可持续发展的影响。（支撑毕业要求7）
default.en: "Intelligent urban water system" is one of the elective courses in the field of urban water system engineering. The course covers the mechanistic models and data models of water treatment process units, as well as content related to smart water management. The main objective of this course is to cultivate students' engineering thinking and the application ability of professional knowledge through classroom lectures and sessions with internationally renowned experts, supporting the achievement of corresponding indicators in professional learning outcomes. The course objectives for students' abilities are as follows: Course Objective 1: Master the design principles and theoretical calculation methods of water treatment process systems; (Supporting graduation requirement 1) Course Objective 2: Understand the technological development direction of water treatment process systems, and have the ability to research and analyze common engineering problems; (Supporting graduation requirement 2) Course Objective 3: Master the basic methods of engineering design for water treatment process systems, and have the ability to analyze and solve complex engineering problems; (Supporting graduation requirement 3) Course Objective 4: Utilize mechanistic models and data models to analyze the relevant theories of water treatment processes; (Supporting graduation requirement 4) Course Objective 5: Understand the historical development and technical characteristics of smart water management, and comprehend the impact of urban water treatment process systems on social health, safety, and culture; (Supporting graduation requirement 6) Course Objective 6: Understand the impact of the construction of urban water treatment process systems on the environment, society, and sustainable development. (Supporting graduation requirement 7)

default.zh: 课程旨在系统介绍自然资源管理的基本理论、治理框架及可持续发展实践。课程内容涵盖自然资源系统特征、产权制度设计、适应性治理模式以及全球可持续发展目标的实施策略。通过案例分析，学生将掌握自然资源综合治理方法，理解社会-生态系统的复杂性，并培养制定可持续资源管理方案的能力。本课程为环境科学、生态学及相关专业学生提供必要的专业知识基础，帮助其形成系统的自然资源治理思维
default.en: course designed to provide a systematic understanding of natural resource management theories, governance frameworks, and sustainable development practices. The curriculum covers the characteristics of natural resource systems, property rights design, adaptive governance models, and implementation strategies for global sustainability goals. Through case studies, students will learn integrated approaches to natural resource management, comprehend the complexity of social-ecological systems, and develop skills to formulate sustainable resource management plans. This course offers essential professional knowledge for students majoring in environmental science, ecology, and related fields, helping them build systematic thinking in natural resource governance

default.zh: 本课程旨在引导学生认识复杂的全球环境问题，并深入探讨其背后的能源与环境之间的相互关系。课程将重点介绍和讨论与能源-环境关联相关的主要物理化学过程及其现象。本课程将深入探讨能源系统与全球环境变化间的动态关系，重点关注可持续能源发展所需的科学与技术。学生将系统学习传统能源与可再生能源的环境影响，包括它们在气候变化、空气污染、水污染以及生态系统破坏等方面所扮演的角色。课程内容涵盖碳循环、大气科学与全球变暖、能源转换中的氧化还原过程及相关环境效应、多种能源-环境关联议题，以及国际环境协议等。通过课堂讲授、案例分析与小组讨论，学生将建立对能源生产与消耗如何影响全球环境的基础性理解。
default.en: This course aims to introduce the complex global environmental problems and the underlying energy-environment nexus. The physicochemical processes and phenomena that are related with the energy-environment nexus will be introduced and discussed. This course explores the dynamic relationship between energy systems and global environmental change, with a focus on the scientific and technological dimensions of sustainable energy development. Students will examine the environmental impacts of conventional and renewable energy sources, including their roles in climate change, air and water pollution, and ecosystem disruption. Topics include the carbon cycle, atmospheric science and global warming, redox processes in energy conversion and the related environmental processes, various energy-environment nexus issues, and international environmental agreements. Through lectures, case studies, and group discussions, students will gain a foundational understanding of how energy production and consumption shape global environmental outcomes.

default.zh: 本课程旨在介绍高级氧化工艺在水处理中的基本原理与应用。课程内容包括高级氧化技术（如紫外光解、臭氧氧化、芬顿工艺、光催化等）的原理、活性氧物种及其生成机制、反应动力学以及降解机理等。
default.en: The goal of this course is to provide fundamentals and applications of advanced oxidation processes (AOPs) in water treatment. Topics of the course cover the principle of AOP technologies (UV photolysis, Ozonation, Fenton process, photocatalysis, etc.), the role of reactive oxygen species (ROSs) and their generation, reaction kinetics, and degradation mechanisms.

default.zh: 课程以全球能源转型和国家建设新型能源系统为大背景、针对未来能源领域前沿性、交叉性、不确定性，重点探讨绿色氢能、核聚变能、新型储能、新能源电力系统、绿电算力协同等未来能源核心领域的基本概念、主要原理与当前产业发展阶段。使学生理解未来能源系统跨领域、多技术融合的核心逻辑，能够分辨不同技术路线的技术优势、适用场景与亟待突破的关键问题。课程鼓励学生合理运用AI工具整合跨领域信息，形成对复杂技术路线或整体解决方案的系统认知。帮助学生树立面向未来的创新探索意识；养成问题导向的学习与研究习惯，激发对前沿问题的好奇心；培养跨学科进行整合思考的能力；深刻认识到能源转型对我国生态文明建设、全球可持续发展的重要意义。
default.en: The course is set against the backdrop of global energy transition and the construction of new energy systems nationwide, addressing the cutting-edge, intersectional, and uncertain aspects of future energy. It focuses on exploring the basic concepts, main principles, and current stages of industrial development in core areas of future energy, such as green hydrogen energy, nuclear fusion energy, new energy storage, new energy power systems, and green power computing power collaboration. Students will understand the core logic of cross-disciplinary and multi-technology integration in future energy systems, enabling them to distinguish the technical advantages, applicable scenarios, and key issues urgently needed for breakthroughs in different technological routes. The course encourages students to skillfully use AI tools to integrate cross-disciplinary information and develop a systematic understanding of complex technical routes or overall solutions. Help students develop a forward-looking awareness of innovation and exploration; Develop problem-oriented learning and research habits to stimulate curiosity about cutting-edge issues; Cultivate the ability to think integrally across disciplines; Deeply recognize the important significance of energy transition for China's ecological civilization construction and global sustainable development.

default.zh: 《核科学与技术导论》是“核工程与核技术”强基计划的概论性课程，让学生对核科学技术的基本原理和应用有一个全面了解和较深入的认识，使低年级学生在较短的学时内综合了解核工程与技术的主要知识、基本原理和应用，对学科和专业建立全面、准确、概括的认识。在内容选取上力求反映现代核科学与技术的发展趋势，注意与工程实际相结合。主要包括核裂变、核聚变、核燃料、核电站、核动力、核武器，核技术应用部分主要包括加速器、核探测与核测量、放射医学与核医学、核地学、辐射成像、辐射加工、工业及农业应用等知识。培养能够综合应用所学知识，发现和分析解决核科学与技术概论实际问题的能力。
default.en: Introduction to Nuclear Science and Technology is an introductory course of the Strong Foundation Program for Nuclear Engineering and Technology. It provides students with a comprehensive and in-depth understanding of the basic principles and applications of nuclear science and technology, enabling lower grade students to comprehensively understand the main knowledge, basic principles, and applications of nuclear engineering and technology in a short period of time, and establish a comprehensive, accurate, and summarized understanding of the discipline and major. Strive to reflect the development trends of modern nuclear science and technology in content selection, and pay attention to combining it with engineering practice. Mainly including nuclear fission, nuclear fusion, nuclear fuel, nuclear power plants, nuclear power, nuclear weapons. The application of nuclear technology mainly includes knowledge of accelerators, nuclear detection and measurement, radiation medicine and nuclear medicine, nuclear geology, radiation imaging, radiation processing, industrial and agricultural applications, etc. Cultivate the ability to comprehensively apply learned knowledge, discover and analyze practical problems in nuclear science and technology introduction.

default.zh: 飞行器动力领域正在经历从旧航空航天向新航空航天转变的过程，新技术层出不穷，企业盛衰加快，内在逻辑难寻。成本视角是理解技术优胜劣汰、产业兴衰的核心视角之一，但也偏偏是理工科教学的盲区。能源学院立足长远，决定开设这门课程，培养学生控制成本的基本意识，和审视技术优劣、选择发展路径的基本视角。 本门课程首先介绍成本管理的概念，它在欧美和前苏联体系中的不同形式，以及新时代我国航空航天产业的成本管理。之后本门课程会用四节课的时间，介绍成本的不同分类，和各自的主要计算方法，包括固定成本与变动成本的平衡，采购与生产成本的平衡，资本成本的计算等。再之后，综合上述不同成本构成，讲解本量利分析中保本点和保利点的计算方法。另一方面，将花一节课的时间，讲解成本控制中的目标成本与标准成本概念，结合实例展示成本控制的重要性。最后，将花一节课的时间，结合飞动某一细分领域，展示全面预算的编制过程，成本构成分析和成本控制的主要方向。 本门课程的主要考核方式为大作业，结合学生自选飞动新技术，从成本分析角度分析技术前景。
default.en: Aircraft propulsion is undergoing a transformation from old aerospace to new aerospace, with new technologies emerging endlessly, accelerating the rise and fall of enterprises, and the inherent logic is difficult to find. The cost perspective is one of the core perspectives for understanding the survival of the fittest in technology and the rise and fall of industries, but it is also a blind spot in science and engineering teaching. Based on the long-term perspective, the Energy College has decided to offer this course to cultivate students' basic awareness of cost control, as well as a basic perspective of examining the advantages and disadvantages of technology and choosing development paths. This course first introduces the concept of cost management, its different forms in the systems of Europe, America, and the former Soviet Union, as well as the cost management of China's aerospace industry in the new era. Afterwards, this course will take four lectures to introduce the different classifications of costs and their main calculation methods, including the balance between fixed and variable costs, the balance between procurement and production costs, and the calculation of capital costs. Afterwards, taking into account the different cost components mentioned above, we will explain the calculation methods of breakeven points and breakeven points in cost volume profit analysis. On the other hand, we will spend one lecture explaining the concepts of target cost and standard cost in cost control, and demonstrate the importance of cost control through examples. Finally, we will spend one lecture, combined with propulsion sub field, to demonstrate the process of comprehensive budget preparation, cost composition analysis, and the main direction of cost control. The main assessment method for this course is a final essay, combined with students' self selected new technologies, and analyzing the technological prospects from a cost analysis perspective.

default.zh: 本课程为能源动力类专业的一门重要技术基础课，面向能源科学与工程、飞行器动力工程专业、核工程与核技术专业的本科生，讲授流体力学的基本概念和基本理论，以及流体平衡和运动的基本规律，使学生了解流体的基本概念和性质，掌握流体静力学、流体运动学、流体动力学、流动阻力与损失等方面的基础知识和基本理论，并通过一定数量的实验和习题，使学生对流体力学具有足够的感性认识和实际动手的能力，基本掌握运用流体力学知识解决工程实际计算和问题分析的能力。本课程的教学注重培养学生的兴趣，着重培养学生对工程流体力学基础理论知识的掌握，不仅为学生学习后续的专业课程提供必要的基础理论知识，而且也为学生将来继续深造打下坚实的基础。本课程主要培养学生具有以下几方面的能力： （1）正确理解流体的性质及流动现象，运用数学知识对流体力学的重要理论公式进行推导和应用，掌握流体力学问题的计算方法； （2）能够运用流体力学的理论和方法对能源动力领域的流动问题进行分析和计算，锻炼学生能够从复杂的自然现象和工程应用中提炼问题、分析问题和解决问题的能力； （3）能够运用流体力学的理论和方法，结合专业知识进行科学实验，并能对实验过程和结果进行正确分析，得出合理有效的结论。
default.en: This course is an important technical foundation course for energy and power majors. It is aimed at undergraduate students majoring in energy science and engineering, aircraft power engineering, nuclear engineering and nuclear technology. It teaches the basic concepts and theories of fluid mechanics, as well as the basic laws of fluid balance and motion, enabling students to understand the basic concepts and properties of fluids, master fluid statics, fluid kinematics, and fluid dynamics Basic knowledge and theories related to flow resistance and loss, and through a certain number of experiments and exercises, enable students to have sufficient perceptual understanding and practical skills in fluid mechanics, and have a basic grasp of the ability to apply fluid mechanics knowledge to solve engineering practical calculations and problem analysis. The teaching of this course focuses on cultivating students' interest and mastering the basic theoretical knowledge of engineering fluid mechanics. It not only provides students with necessary basic theoretical knowledge for subsequent professional courses, but also lays a solid foundation for their future further studies. This course mainly cultivates students' abilities in the following aspects: (1) Correctly understand the properties and flow phenomena of fluids, use mathematical knowledge to derive and apply important theoretical formulas in fluid mechanics, and master the calculation methods of fluid mechanics problems; (2) Be able to apply the theories and methods of fluid mechanics to analyze and calculate flow problems in the field of energy and power, and exercise students' ability to extract, analyze, and solve problems from complex natural phenomena and engineering applications; (3) Able to apply the theories and methods of fluid mechanics, combine professional knowledge to conduct scientific experiments, and correctly analyze the experimental process and results to draw reasonable and effective conclusions.

default.zh: 航空是指载人或不载人的飞行器在地球大气层中的航行活动，航天是指载人或不载人的航天器在地球大气层之外的航行活动，又称空间飞行或宇宙航行。人类为了扩大社会生产，必然要开拓新的活动空间。从陆地到海洋，从海洋到大气层，再到宇宙空间，就是这样一个人类逐渐扩展活动范围的过程。航空航天是人类拓展大气层和宇宙空间的产物。经过百余年的快速发展，航空航天已经成为21世纪最活跃和最有影响的科学技术领域之一，该领域取得的重大成就标志着人类文明的最新发展，也表征着一个国家科学技术的先进水平。本课程以飞行器(航空器和航天器)为中心，阐述了航空航天领域涉及的基本概念、基本原理和基础知识，梳理了航空航天发展过程中的技术特点、发展规律及最新动态，系统地、完整地再现了航空航天技术的发展历程及技术成果，为航空航天专业领域本科生的初级入门课程，为未来进一步学习相关理论知识、认识和了解航空航天专业打好基础。
default.en: Aviation refers to the navigation activities of manned or unmanned vehicles in the Earth's atmosphere, and spaceflight refers to the navigation activities of manned or unmanned spacecraft outside the Earth's atmosphere, also known as space flight or cosmic voyage. In order to expand social production, mankind is bound to open up new space for activities. From the land to the sea, from the sea to the atmosphere, and then to the cosmic space, is such a process of human gradually expanding the scope of activities. Aerospace is the product of human expansion of the atmosphere and cosmic space. After more than a hundred years of rapid development, aerospace has become one of the most active and influential fields of science and technology in the 21st century, and the major achievements in this field mark the latest development of human civilization and characterize the advanced level of science and technology of a country. This course takes aircraft (aircraft and spacecraft) as the center, elaborates the basic concepts, basic principles and fundamental knowledge involved in the field of aerospace, sorts out the technical characteristics, development laws and latest developments in the process of aerospace development, systematically and completely reproduces the development history and technical achievements of aerospace technology, and is an introductory course for undergraduates in the field of aerospace, for further study in the future. It is an introductory course for undergraduates in the field of aerospace and provides a good foundation for further study of relevant theoretical knowledge, understanding and appreciation of aerospace profession.

default.zh: 工程热力学是研究热能有效利用以及热能和机械能等其它能量转换规律及其应用的工程技术科学。课程的主要目标是使学生掌握热力学的基本规律，并能正确运用这些规律对热工过程和热力循环进行分析和计算。该课程的主要内容包括：热力学的基本概念，热力学第一定律和第二定律，气体的热力性质和热力过程，气体的流动与压缩，气体动力循环，水蒸气的性质和蒸汽动力循环，制冷循环。
default.en: Engineering thermodynamics is an engineering technical science that studies the effective utilization of thermal energy and the conversion laws between thermal energy and other energies including mechanical energy etc. The main goal of the course is to enable students to master the basic laws of thermodynamics and to correctly use these laws to analyze and calculate thermal processes and thermodynamic cycles. The main contents of this course include: basic concepts of thermodynamics, the first and second laws of thermodynamics, thermodynamic properties and thermodynamic processes of gases, flow and compression of gases, gas power cycle, properties of water vapor and steam power cycle, refrigeration cycle.

default.zh: 热力学基础是热工技术理论的基础，是研究热能的传递、热能有效利用以及热能和机械能等其它能量转换规律及其应用的工程技术学科。课程的主要目标是使学生掌握工程热力学的基本概念与方程，并能正确运用这些方程对热工过程进行分析和计算。本课程不仅为学生学习有关专业课程提供必要的基础理论知识，而且为学生毕业后从事热能利用、热设计、热管理和热控制等方面的专业技术工作和科学研究工作打下必要的理论基础。在教学过程中结合本课程特点，注意培养学生辨证思维和逻辑推理的能力；训练其建立热力学和传热学模型的能力；着重培养学生对热工问题的判断、计算和综合能力分析能力；着重培养学生的创新精神和实践能力。
default.en: Thermodynamics is the foundation of thermal technology theory, which is an engineering and technical discipline that studies the transfer and effective utilization of thermal energy, as well as other energy conversion laws and their applications such as thermal and mechanical energy. The main objective of the course is to enable students to master the basic concepts and equations of engineering thermodynamics, and to be able to correctly apply these equations to analyze and calculate thermal processes. This course not only provides students with necessary basic theoretical knowledge for studying relevant professional courses, but also lays a necessary theoretical foundation for students to engage in professional technical work and scientific research in areas such as thermal energy utilization, thermal design, thermal management, and thermal control after graduation. In the teaching process, combining the characteristics of this course, pay attention to cultivating students' dialectical thinking and logical reasoning abilities; Train their ability to establish thermodynamic and heat transfer models; Emphasize the cultivation of students' ability to judge, calculate, and analyze thermal engineering problems comprehensively; Emphasis is placed on cultivating students' innovative spirit and practical abilities.

default.zh: 传热学是研究温差驱动下热量传递规律的一门科学，主要内容包括：导热基本定律，稳态导热，非稳态导热，导热问题数值解法，单相对流换热理论，对流换热的实验关联式，沸腾与凝结换热，热辐射基本定律，物体辐射特性，表面辐射换热，火焰辐射换热，传热过程及换热器，传质学等。通过本门课程的学习，使学生对热量传递这一普遍存在的现象有深入理性的认识，掌握传热学的基本理论、基本定律及基本计算，并初步具有解决实际传热问题的能力。传热学是热能动力、机械制造、航空航天、材料加工、电子电气、建筑工程等相关专业的一门技术基础课
default.en: Heat transfer is about the movement of thermal energy from high temperature place to low temperature place . The course includes: the basic laws of heat conduction and steady state heat conduction, unsteady state heat conduction, and numerical heat conduction, convection heat transfer, the condensation and boiling heat transfer, the basic laws of thermal radiation, radiative properties of materials, the surface radiative heat exchange, fire radiative heat exchange, heat transfer process and heat exchanger, mass transfer. Heat Transfer is a fundamental course for the undergraduates who are majoring in thermal energy power, machine manufacturing, aeronautics and space, material processing, electronics or electrical engineering.

default.zh: 数字电路与嵌入式系统是一门交叉性学科很强的课程，它涵盖了电子科学与技术、计算机工程、软件工程等多个领域，是集成电路设计与集成系统专业的学科基础选修课程。本课从嵌入式系统应用的角度，全面介绍了数字电路基本概念和嵌入式系统开发技术，重点阐述了核心内容和关键环节的知识点。通过这门课程，使学生了解嵌入式系统的应用，不仅扩大了学生的视野，还能对今后从事核工业领域的嵌入式系统设计与开发有一定的促进作用。在教学过程中结合本课程特点，注意培养学生辨证思维和逻辑推理的能力；训练其建立嵌入式系统及数字电路相关问题的判断、计算和综合能力分析能力；着重培养学生的创新精神和实践能力。 本课程的主要目标为：（1）了解微型计算机及嵌入式系统的基本硬件组成、工作原理和体系结构；（2）掌握嵌入式系统接口、端口的概念；掌握嵌入式系统堆栈、中断、IO及各种外设的基本概念和机制；掌握嵌入式系统的C语言编程；能够综合运用嵌入式系统的理论知识进行嵌入式程序开发；（3）激发学生动手实践的兴趣，培养学生分析和解决实际问题的能力，全面提高学生的职业素养。
default.en: Digital Circuitry and Embedded Systems is a course with strong interdisciplinary attributes, encompassing various fields such as electronic science and technology, computer engineering, software engineering, and more. It is a foundational elective course for students specializing in integrated circuit design and integrated systems. From the perspective of embedded systems applications, this course offers a comprehensive introduction to the basic concepts of digital circuits and the development techniques of embedded systems, emphasizing the core content and critical aspects of the subject matter. Through this course, students not only broaden their horizons by understanding the applications of embedded systems but also gain valuable insights that can significantly benefit their future endeavors in the design and development of embedded systems within the nuclear industry sector. In line with the course's characteristics, the teaching process is designed to cultivate students' dialectical thinking and logical reasoning skills; train their judgment, calculation, and comprehensive analysis abilities regarding embedded systems and digital circuit-related issues; and focus on fostering students' spirit of innovation and practical abilities. The primary objectives of this course are: (1) to understand the basic hardware components, working principles, and architecture of microcomputers and embedded systems; (2) to grasp the concepts of embedded system interfaces and ports; to understand the basic concepts and mechanisms of embedded system stacks, interrupts, I/O, and various peripherals; to master C language programming for embedded systems; and to be able to apply theoretical knowledge of embedded systems comprehensively in the development of embedded programs; (3) to stimulate students' interest in hands-on practice, develop their ability to analyze and solve practical problems, and enhance their overall professional competence.

default.zh: 核工程具有规模庞大、结构复杂、材料特殊、环境恶劣、安全性与可靠性要求极高等显著特点，由核工程引出的力学问题能否有效、可信地解决，事关国家战略安全和国计民生。同时，工程力学课程是航天、机械、材料、能源、建筑等专业必修的专业基础课，是基础课和专业课之间的桥梁，起承上启下的作用。核工程力学课程最基础的内容包括理论力学静力学、材料力学和核工程原理部分。本课程通过课堂上的理论教学，旨在使学生掌握刚体的基本概念和公理、力系的简化和平衡，以及应力应变分析中最基本的概念、原理和方法及其在核工程中的应用，培养学生分析和解决工程结构强度、刚度和稳定性问题的能力。
default.en: Most of nuclear engineering problems have large scale, complex structure, special materials, harsh environment, as well as extremely high safety and reliability requirements. Whether the mechanical problems induced by nuclear engineering can be effectively and credibly solved is a matter of national strategic security and national economy and people’s livelihood. At the same time, engineering mechanics courses are compulsory professional basic courses for aerospace, machinery, materials, energy, architecture and other majors. It is a bridge between basic courses and professional courses, and serves as a link between the previous and the next. The most basic content of the nuclear engineering mechanics course includes theoretical mechanics statics, material mechanics and nuclear engineering principles. Through theoretical teaching in class, this course aims to enable students to master the basic concepts and axioms of rigid bodies, the simplification and balance of force systems, and the most basic concepts, principles and methods in stress-strain analysis and their applications in nuclear engineering. Cultivate students' ability to analyze and solve the problems of engineering structure strength, stiffness and stability.

default.zh: 《数理方程与特殊函数》课程旨在介绍数学物理中的基本方程及其解法，特别是特殊函数的性质和应用。本课程涵盖了偏微分方程、积分方程以及它们的解析解和数值解方法。学生将学习到如何应用这些数学工具来解决物理、工程和其他科学领域中的问题。课程内容包括贝塞尔函数、勒让德多项式等特殊函数，以及它们在量子力学、电磁学和流体力学中的应用。通过本课程，学生不仅能够掌握解决复杂物理问题的数学方法，还能深入理解这些问题的物理背景。
default.en: The course "Mathematical Equations and Special Functions" is designed to introduce the fundamental equations in mathematical physics and their solutions, with a particular emphasis on the properties and applications of special functions. The course covers partial differential equations, integral equations, and their analytical and numerical solution methods. Students will learn how to apply these mathematical tools to solve problems in physics, engineering, and other scientific fields. The course content includes special functions such as Bessel functions, Legendre polynomials, along with their applications in quantum mechanics, electromagnetism, and fluid dynamics. Through this course, students will not only master the mathematical methods to tackle complex physical problems but also gain a deep understanding of the physical context of these problems.

default.zh: 核反应堆物理分析II”是辅修核反应堆工程专业的基础理论课程和核心课程。课程的主要目标是培养学生具备从事核反应堆工程领域或相关工作的基础知识，任务是使学生掌握核反应堆基础理论知识和基本原理，具备应用数学工具和数值方法解决反应堆工程中实际问题的初步技能，为今后学习其他专业课程和毕业后从事核反应堆物理计算、核反应堆设计等工作奠定理论基础。
default.en: The main objective of the course is to cultivate students with the elementals in the field of nuclear reactor engineering or related work. The task is to enable students to master the basic theoretical information and principles of nuclear reactors, and to have preliminary skills in applying mathematical tools and numerical methods to solve practical problems in reactor engineering. This will create the fundamentals for future studies of other professional courses and work of post-graduation in nuclear reactor physics calculation, nuclear reactor design, etc.

default.zh: 核工程热流基础I课程主要涉及核工程与核技术中的流体力学理论及分析。主要包括以下内容：核工程流体力学的基本概念，流体的性质，压强与流体静力学，流体运动学，伯努利方程与能量方程，流动系统的动量分析，量纲分析与模型化，内流，流体流动的微分分析，纳维-斯托克斯方程的近似解，阻力和升力，可压缩流动，计算流体力学导论。课程内容涉及核工程与核技术中以及工业生产及生活中流体力学的典型示例。课程内容同时包括核工程与核技术领域相关科技创新理念与项目学习知识，以及核工程与核技术中的流体流动形态、气泡运动、池沸腾等现象和流体运动基本规律的相关实验技能。
default.en: The course of Fundamentals of thermal fluid in Nuclear Engineering I mainly involves the theory and analysis of fluid mechanics in nuclear engineering and technology. The main content includes the following: basic concepts of fluid mechanics in nuclear engineering, properties of fluids, pressure and fluid statics, fluid kinematics, Bernoulli equation and energy equation, momentum analysis of flow systems, dimensional analysis and modeling, differential analysis of internal flow and fluid flow, approximate solutions to the Navier Stokes equation, drag and lift, compressible flow, and introduction to computational fluid mechanics. The course content covers typical examples of fluid mechanics in nuclear engineering and technology, as well as in industrial production and daily life. The course content includes both scientific and technological innovation concepts and project learning knowledge related to nuclear engineering and technology, as well as experimental skills related to fluid flow patterns, bubble motion, pool boiling, and basic laws of fluid motion in nuclear engineering and technology.

default.zh: 核反应堆热工水力学课程是核工程专业一门专业课，着重讲述了反应堆热工水力计算的基本模型和计算方法。课程需要掌握各种核反应堆结构材料的基本热物理性质；掌握核反应堆热工分析中涉及的堆芯释热、传热、流体力学等方面的基本知识和计算原理；掌握核反应堆稳态热工设计原理，了解单通道模型和子通道模型热工设计的步骤和计算方法；了解核反应堆瞬态热工水力分析中的基本模型和方法。课程的教学目的是使本科学生在学习了反应堆物理学、传热学、工程流体力学等课程中的核反应、流动、传热基本原理基础上，进一步了解、掌握对相关反应堆中热工分析的原理与计算方法，扩大知识面，培养根据基本原理进行技术研发、创新的能力。课程教学以课堂讲授为主，辅之以适当的课堂讨论。通过资料搜集、分析整理、评判，培养学生主动获取知识能力。通过课程学习实现以下三个目标：（1）牢固地掌握核反应堆中堆芯热量输运过程，深刻了解热量的来源及去处；（2）掌握反应堆内热输运的计算方法，了解压水堆热工分析计算的核心问题；（3）理解压水反应堆中热量传递涉及的基本原理和方法以及目前存在的主要问题的与解决方向，并增强工程实践能力、逻辑思维能力、创新意识。
default.en: The course is mainly concentrated on the theoretical models and calculation methods in the nuclear reactors. The basic thermal properties of materials used in the nuclear reactors are studied. The principal knowledge and calculation methods for heat transfer, fluid mechanism and releasing heat properties used in the analysis of thermodynamics and hydraulics of nuclear reactor are mustered. The thermodynamic and hydraulic methods at the steady state are understood. The single channel and sub-channel thermodynamic and hydraulic calculation methods and processes are performed. The basic theoretical models and calculation methods of instantaneous thermodynamic and hydraulic are performed. The purpose of the course is to make sure that the undergraduate study the basic principles of nuclear reaction、flow and heat transfer from the Reactor physics、Heat Transfer 、Engineering Fluid Mechanics and other courses, Further understand and master the principle and implementation scheme of thermal environment simulation in related numerical simulation technology, Expand the scope of knowledge and cultivate the ability of development and innovation based on the principle. Course teaching is mainly taught in class, supplemented by appropriate class discussion. By collecting and analyzing data can trained students acquire knowledge ability ;by topic designing、demonstrating and preliminary design training can cultivated students practical ability emphatically.These objectives can be achieved through this course: (1) Masting the heat transport process of nuclear reactor firmly and understanding the basic principles and main ways to improve the efficiency of heat transfer;(2) Grasping the calculation method of heat transport in the reactor and understanding the core problem of thermal analysis calculation of pressurized water reactor;(3) Understanding the basic principle and main technology of heat transfer in pressurized water reactor as well as the main problems existing at present, and enhance engineering practice ability, logical thinking ability and innovation consciousness.

default.zh: 核工程热流基础II是能源与环境领域以及核工程领域重要的基础课程，是培养学生掌握和综合运用传热理论知识解决传热工程问题的重要环节。本课程总共40学时（其中实验4学时），课程的主要内容及课时安排包括了：绪论，主要内容包括三种基本传热方式（导热、对流及热辐射）及其基本计算公式及传热过程简介。导热基本原理，主要内容包括导热微分方程的定解条件：初始条件和三类边界条件。稳态导热，主要内容第一类边界条件下大平板、长圆筒壁一维稳态导热计算。非稳态导热，主要内容包括第三类边界条件下一维非稳态导热计算，准稳态导热。导热问题数值解，主要内容包括导热微分方程的离散方法——控制容积法。导热问题的数值编程及商业软件操作，主要内容简单二维稳态导热问题编程，商业软件使用方法。对流传热的理论基础，主要内容包括对流换热的特点及分类，换热基本公式等。单相对流传热的实验关联式，主要包括相似原理，准则方程，努谢尔特准则，普朗特准则，雷诺准则等。相变对流传热，主要包括凝结现象，膜状凝结分析解及实验关联式等。热辐射基本定律及物体的辐射特性，主要包括黑体，辐射力，光谱辐射力，普朗克定律，维恩位移定律等。辐射换热，主要包括黑体间的辐射换热，角系数，角系数的性质及求解等。实验，主要包括准稳态法测不良导体的导热系数，空气横掠单管对流换热系数的测定等。
default.en: Fundamentals of thermo-fluid in nuclear engineering II is an important basic course in the field of energy and environment and nuclear engineering, and is an important part of cultivating students to master and comprehensively apply theoretical knowledge of heat transfer to solve heat transfer engineering problems. A total of 40 courses (including 4 courses of experiments), the main content of the course and the class schedule include: Introduction, the main content includes three basic heat transfer methods (heat conduction, convection and heat radiation) and their basic calculation formulas and an introduction to the heat transfer process. The basic principle of thermal conductivity, the main content includes the definite solution conditions of differential equations for thermal conductivity: initial conditions and three types of boundary conditions. Steady-state thermal conductivity, the main content of the first type of boundary conditions of large plates, long cylinder walls one-dimensional steady-state thermal conductivity calculation. Non-steady state thermal conductivity, the main contents include one-dimensional non-steady state thermal conductivity calculation under the third type of boundary conditions, quasi-steady state thermal conductivity. Numerical solution of thermal conductivity problem, the main content includes the discrete method of thermal conductivity differential equation - control volume method. Numerical programming of thermal conductivity problems and commercial software operation, the main content includes simple two-dimensional steady-state thermal conductivity problem programming, and commercial software usage methods. The theoretical basis of convective heat transfer, the main contents include the characteristics and classification of convective heat transfer, the basic formula of heat exchange, etc. Experimental correlation formulas for heat transfer, mainly including similarity principle, criterion equation, Nuchert criterion, Plante criterion, Reynolds criterion, etc. Phase change convective heat transfer, mainly including condensation phenomenon, membrane condensation analysis and solution, and experimental correlation formula. The basic law of thermal radiation and the radiation characteristics of objects, mainly including blackbody, radiation force, spectral radiation force, Planck's law, Wien displacement law, etc. Radiative heat transfer, mainly including radiative heat transfer between black bodies, angular coefficients, the properties and solutions of angular coefficients, etc. The experiment mainly includes the measurement of the thermal conductivity of the poor conductor by the quasi-steady-state method and the determination of the convective heat transfer coefficient of the single tube by air sweeping.

default.zh: 本课程是核工程与核技术专业方向的一门专业基础课。核技术电动力学应用基础是宏观电磁现象的经典理论，是研究电磁场的基本属性、运动规律以及电磁场与物质相互作用的一门重要基础理论课，对培养学生掌握电磁和光现象与规律、运用所学知识处理电磁问题能力、科学研究意识与基本素养等方面具有重要作用。本课程面向核工程与核技术专业方向本科生开设。课程目标要求如下：（1）通过对电磁运动基本规律的学习，加深对电磁场基本性质的理解；（2）通过学习电磁场运动规律和狭义相对论，更深刻领会电磁场的物质性，帮助加深辩证唯物主义世界观；（3）通过在课程中适当引入科技前沿，促进教学内容与学术前沿和现实直接对接。
default.en: This course is a basic course of Nuclear Engineering and Nuclear Technology. The foundation of the application of electrodynamics in nuclear technology is the classical theory of macroscopic electromagnetic phenomena, which is an important basic theoretical course to study the basic properties and motion laws of electromagnetic field and the interaction between electromagnetic field and matter. It plays an important role in training students to master electromagnetic and light phenomena and laws, apply the knowledge to solve electromagnetic problems, and have scientific research awareness and basic literacy. This course is designed for undergraduates majoring in Nuclear Engineering and Nuclear Technology. The course objectives are as follows: (1) By studying the basic laws of electromagnetic motion, deepen the understanding of the basic properties of the electromagnetic field; (2) By studying the laws of electromagnetic field motion and the special theory of relativity, gain a deeper understanding of the materiality of the electromagnetic field and help deepen dialectical materialism world view; (3) Promote direct connection between teaching content and academic frontiers and reality by appropriately introducing technological frontiers into courses.

default.zh: 本课程主要讲述流体的基本概念和属性，尤其是流体与刚体和固体在力学行为方面的区别。以此为基础和出发点，介绍流体静平衡所遵循规律及点压和面压的计算方法，并以介绍流体运动的一系列基本概念为前提，推求流体力学的三大基本方程。然后介绍管路系统的水力计算和流体出流计算以及水击现象的基本概念。本课程以讲述流体力学基本概念、基础知识和基本原理为主，着重培养学生解决工程问题的能力。并通过一定数量习题和实验，使学生具有足够的感性认识和实际动手的能力。
default.en: This course introduces the basic concepts and properties of fluids, especially the differences between the fluid and the solid in mechanical actions. Based on this, the course introduces the fluid statics and the calculation of pressure at a point and pressure forces on surfaces. By illustrating the basic principle of fluid kinematics as premise, the three fundamental equations of fluid mechanics are deduced. Then we introduced the hydraulic calculation of flows in pipelines, orifice outlet flow and the basic concepts of water hammer. The course emphasizes basic concepts of fluid mechanics, and cultivates students to get enough perceptual knowledge and practical abilities through a certain amount of exercises and experiments.

default.zh: 工程热力学是研究热能和机械能相互转换规律及热能有效利用的科学。工程热力学课程是能源动力、机械、化工、市政、航空航天等多个工程类专业的重要技术基础课之一。本课程的教学目的和主要任务是使学生掌握能量转换的基本规律，并能正确运用这些规律进行热工过程和热力循环的分析计算。本课程的学习不仅为学生学习专业课程提供必要的基础理论知识，而且为学生毕业后解决生产实际问题和参加科学研究工作打下一定的理论基础。
default.en: Engineering Thermodynamics mainly concerns on the transforming rules between thermal energy and mechanical energy, together with the effective utilization of energy. It is the main elementary courses for undergraduates majoring engineering, such as thermal engineering, astronautic and aeronautic engineering, municipal engineering and so on. The main purpose and mission of the course is to make the students master basic rules of energy transformation, and perform calculation for the thermal process and cycle. It can not only provide a necessary theory foundation for the undergraduates, but also form a certain basis for the attendants to solve the practical industrial problem and to participate in scientific research.

default.zh: 传热学是研究温差驱动下热量传递规律的一门技术科学，主要内容包括：导热基本定律，稳态导热，非稳态导热，导热问题数值解法，单相对流换热理论，对流换热的实验关联式，沸腾与凝结换热，热辐射基本定律，物体辐射特性，表面辐射换热，火焰辐射换热，传热过程及换热器等。传热学课程，是热能动力、机械制造、航空航天、材料加工、电子电气、建筑工程等相关专业的一门技术基础课。通过本门课程的学习，使学生对热量传递这一普遍存在的现象有深入理性的认识，掌握传热学的基本理论、基本定律及基本计算，并初步具有解决实际传热问题的能力。
default.en: Heat transfer is about the movement of thermal energy from high temperature place to low temperature place . The course includes: the basic laws of heat conduction and steady state heat conduction, unsteady state heat conduction, and numerical heat conduction, convection heat transfer, the condensation and boiling heat transfer, the basic laws of thermal radiation, radiative properties of materials, the surface radiative heat exchange, fire radiative heat exchange, heat transfer process and heat exchanger, mass transfer. Heat Transfer is a fundamental course for the undergraduates who are majoring in thermal energy power, machine manufacturing, aeronautics and space, material processing, electronics or electrical engineering.

default.zh: 传热学与流体力学、工程热力学并称能源动力类三大支柱课程，在热能动力、机械制造、航空航天、化工、材料加工、冶金、电子与电气、建筑工程等生产技术领域中存在大量的传热问题。传热学是相关各学科专业的一门重要技术基础课，通过本门课程的学习，使学生对热量传递这一普遍存在的物理现象有理性的认识，掌握传热学的基本理论、基本定律及基本计算，为解决以后课程学习或工作中涉及到的热问题，打下坚实的理论基础。
default.en: Heat transfer, fluid mechanics and engineering thermodynamics are known as the three pillar courses of energy and power, and there are a lot of heat transfer problems in the production technology fields of thermal energy and power, mechanical manufacturing, aerospace, chemical industry, material processing, metallurgy, electronics and electrical, and building engineering. Heat transfer is an important basic technical course for related disciplines. Through the study of this course, students can have a rational understanding of the universal physical phenomenon of heat transfer, master the basic theory, basic law and basic calculation of heat transfer, and lay a solid theoretical foundation for solving the heat problems involved in future course study or work.

default.zh: 气体动力学是能源与动力工程专业、飞行器动力工程专业的基础课，主要阐述气体动力学基本概念和气体运动所遵循的基本方程。通过对典型流动现象的分析，帮助学生建立起气体动力学的基本概念，掌握气体运动的基本规律，能够对简单的流动现象给出正确的解释，为专业课的学习打下基础。 课程内容包括：流体力学、热力学基础知识及场论初步；气体运动基本方程组；滞止参数与气动函数；膨胀波和激波；一维定常可压缩管道流动。
default.en: GASDYNAMICS is one of the major fundamental courses for the undergraduate students in Energy and Power Engineering as well as Flight Vehicle Power Engineering, focusing on the basic concepts of aerodynamics and the basic equations governing the gas flow. The purpose of this course is to help the student understand the basic principles of aerodynamics through the analysis of the typical flow phenomena, and to have the ability to reveal the mechanisms of some simple flow phenomena. The contents of GASDYNAMICS include Fundamental Knowledge of Fluid Mechanics and Thermodynamics as well as Field Theory; Three-Dimensional Flow Equations; Stagnation Parameters and Aerodynamic Functions; Expansion Wave and Shock Wave; One-Dimensional Equations of Steady Pipe Flow.

default.zh: 可压缩气体动力学是压缩空气储能的关键基础，本课程的目的是使学生熟悉和掌握用于储能的压缩气体动力学基本知识，有别于常规气体动力学，本课程更注重储能中气体动力学的使用背景。通过对课程的学习，引导学生用气体动力学基本知识，快速分析压缩空气储能关键参数变化规律，掌握压缩气体动力学可压流动等特性，具备根据实际需要进行全面考虑和分析，具备用于压缩空气储能技术的气体动力学基本知识。
default.en: Compressible aerodynamics is key foundation for energy storage. The purpose of this course is to familiarize students with and master the basic knowledge of compressed aerodynamics used for energy storage. Unlike conventional aerodynamics, this course focuses more on the background of the use of aerodynamics in energy storage.
