default.zh: 《抽水蓄能技术及应用》主要阐述抽水蓄能系统的运行原理及其在新型电力系统中的作用。着重讲解抽水蓄能系统的组成和运行特性、过渡过程水力稳定性与控制、抽水蓄能机组在新型电力系统中的作用及其应用。它是能源科学与工程专业的一门选修专业课，是从事抽水蓄能相关研究的基础。
default.en: Pumped Storage Technology and Utilization mainly describes the operation principle of pumped storage system and its role in the new power system. It focuses on the composition and operation characteristics of pumped storage system, hydraulic stability and control of transition process, the role of pumped storage unit in new power system and its application. It is an elective professional course of energy science and engineering, and it is the basis of related research on pumped storage.

default.zh: 能源技术发展到今天，智能化和节能成为主旋律，区域能源系统是实现这一目标的关键，是国家能源学科发展的重要方向。 区域能源系统是一种利用多能互补和智慧能源技术的区域级综合能源系统，该系统可实现能源的梯级利用，提高综合能源利用效率，减少污染物排放。区域能源系统能量来源和用户终端多样化，是一个涉及多能流、多尺度、多学科、多领域的复杂系统。 为此，本课程以完成区域能源系统设计为目标，采用项目式的分组合作进行研讨式学习，培养学生沟通能力、项目管理能力、团队合作协同攻关的能力。
default.en: Nowadays, with the development of energy technology, intelligence and energy conservation have become the main theme. Distributed energy system is the key to achieve this goal and an important direction of the national energy discipline. The distributed energy system is a regional integrated energy system that uses multi energy complementation and smart energy technology. The system can realize the step utilization of energy, improve the integrated energy utilization efficiency and reduce pollutant emissions. The distributed energy system has diversified energy sources and user terminals, which is a complex system involving multiple energy flows, multi-scale, multidisciplinary and multi subject. For this reason, this course aims to design a distributed energy system for a special purpose. Group cooperation based on project is adopted with discussion learning approach. The abilities of communication, project management, team cooperation to tackle key problems will be improved.

default.zh: 《粒子模拟算法与应用》是一门面向理工科学生的课程，旨在介绍粒子模拟的基本原理、算法实现及其在物理、化学、生物、材料、工程等领域的广泛应用。通过本课程，学生将学习粒子运动方程的数值求解方法（如Verlet算法）、粒子间相互作用形式、以及场与粒子的耦合过程，并通过编程实践掌握粒子模拟的基本技能。课程采用理论讲解与案例分析相结合的教学方式，帮助学生培养解决实际问题的能力，为未来的科研和工程实践奠定基础。
default.en: Particle Simulation Algorithms and Applications is a course designed for students in science and engineering disciplines, aiming to introduce the fundamental principles, algorithmic implementations, and wide-ranging applications of particle simulation in fields such as physics, chemistry, biology, materials science, and engineering. Through this course, students will learn numerical methods for solving particle motion equations (e.g., the Verlet algorithm), forms of particle interactions, and the coupling processes between fields and particles. They will also gain hands-on programming experience to master the essential skills of particle simulation. The course combines theoretical instruction with case studies, helping students develop problem-solving abilities and laying a solid foundation for future research and engineering practice.

default.zh: 本课程针对航空发动机和燃气轮机中的关键部件——压气机和涡轮，讲授压气机和涡轮的三维气动设计方法，并通过项目学习增强理解和掌握。本课程从叶轮机械的基本理论出发，将学生的专业知识拓展到叶轮机械三维气动设计领域，更加侧重理论知识的应用方法，提高学生独立分析能力和科研素养。 本课程在以下三方面给予学生具体指导：（1）学习并掌握压气机/涡轮的三维气动设计基础理论及方法——包括气动设计体系、几何和气动参数的选取、子午流道设计方法、叶型设计方法、以及叶片三维积叠设计方法等等；（2）培养独立设计压气机/涡轮的叶型设计、子午通流设计、以及三维叶片设计能力；（3）通过数值模拟验证学生提出的气动设计方案，激发学生的学习兴趣，促进学生更加深入的学习和探索，提高学生在叶轮机械领域的独立工作能力和科研素养。
default.en: This course provides three dimensional aerodynamic design theory and method of the key parts of aircraft engines and gas turbine - compressor and turbine, and through the way of project learning to enhance the effect of student understanding and mastering. This course contains not only the turbomachinery machine basic theory, but also the turbomachinery aerodynamic design method, and lays a lot of emphasis on the application of theoretical knowledge, in order to improve the students' independent analysis ability and scientific literacy. This course gives specific guidance to students in the following three areas: 1. To learn and master the three-dimensional aerodynamic design basic theory and method of gas compressor / turbine, including the aerodynamic design process, selection of geometric and aerodynamic parameters, the meridian channel design method, blade profile design method, and three-dimensional stacked design method etc. 2. Independently work capability of gas compressor / turbine, including blade profile design, the meridian channel design, and three-dimensional blade design. 3. Numerical simulation validation of the aerodynamic design provided by students, to stimulate the student's study interest, to promote the student further study and the exploration, to enhance student's independent work ability and scientific literacy in the turbomachinery machine domain.

default.zh: 微纳米流体力学是近年来在流体力学、表界面科学及其交叉学科领域中发展起来的一个全新学科分支。诺贝尔物理学奖得主理查·费曼曾在“There’s plenty of room at the bottom”一文中指出，在微小化物质领域存在大量有价值的科学问题。随着物质尺寸的不断微小化，其表面积与体积之比迅速增大，使得纳米微流体呈现出与宏观尺度下截然不同的流动特征及规律，表界面效应逐渐凸显，从而带来一系列崭新的物理现象，以及十分广阔的应用前景和潜在的重大经济价值。例如，在微机电领域（MEMS）和微流控芯片（Microchips）中，通过对微尺度流体输运的精确控制，实现了化学分析、药物筛选、细胞培养等多种功能。本课程旨在使学生深入了解目前国际上关于微纳尺度流体力学以及表界面学等领域的最新基础研究与应用成果，激发学生的科研探索兴趣，并培养其应用创新能力。课程将强调对生活中和工业生产中常见现象的物理机制分析方法，训练学生从实际问题中抽象出典型微纳米流体问题的能力。通过本课程的学习，学生将掌握微纳米尺度下流体流动的基本概念与规律，并能够运用这些基本原理分析常见生活及工程问题，同时了解微纳流控技术在能源动力、机械、生物、材料与化学工程等领域的具体应用。
default.en: Micro/nanofluidics is a novel disciplinary branch that has emerged in recent years within the fields of fluid mechanics, interfacial science and the interdisciplinary domains. Nobel laureate Richard Feynman highlighted in his seminal essay "There’s Plenty of Room at the Bottom" the abundance of valuable scientific challenges in the realm of miniaturized matter. As material dimensions shrink to microscopic scales, the surface-to-volume ratio increases dramatically, endowing nano/microfluidic systems with flow characteristics and principles fundamentally distinct from those observed at macroscopic scales. This pronounced interfacial dominance gives rise to novel physical phenomena, along with expansive application prospects and significant potential economic value. For instance, in microelectromechanical systems (MEMS) and microfluidic chips, precise control of microscale fluid transport has enabled diverse functionalities ranging from chemical analysis and drug screening to cell culture. This course aims to provide students with an in-depth understanding of cutting-edge fundamental research and applied advancements in micro/nanofluidics and interfacial science on the international stage, while stimulating scientific curiosity and fostering applied innovation capabilities. This course also emphasizes analytical methodologies for deciphering physical mechanisms underlying common phenomena in daily life and industrial processes, training students to abstract practical challenges into representative micro/nanofluidic problems. Through systematic learning, students will master fundamental concepts governing fluid behavior at micro/nano scales, acquire the ability to apply these principles to analyze real-world and engineering problems, and gain insights into concrete applications of micro/nanofluidic technologies across energy systems, mechanical engineering, biotechnology, materials science, and chemical engineering.

default.zh: 《湍流模型基本理论及应用》课程通过介绍计算流体力学（CFD）仿真中常用湍流模型的基本概念和基本理论，以及在湍流数值计算中的工程应用，使学生学习湍流模型的基本提出思路和使用方法。课程将使用最简单、直接的教学方式和工具，提供可以线上运行的算例，降低对学生的先修课程要求，提高跨学科、跨专业选修此课程的可能性。本课程旨在帮助学生花费较少的代价，在课程结束时掌握数值计算、湍流理论和湍流模型等方面的基本理论知识，熟悉应用流程，为后续的科研和专业课打下基础。本课程的主要目标是使学生系统掌握湍流模型及其在计算流体力学中的应用，培养解决实际工程问题和科研探索能力。
default.en: The course "Fundamental Theory and Applications of Turbulence Models" introduces the basic concepts and fundamental theories of commonly used turbulence models in computational fluid dynamics (CFD) simulations, as well as their engineering applications in numerical turbulence calculations. Students will learn the principles behind turbulence model development and their practical implementation. The course adopts a simple and direct teaching approach, utilizing accessible tools and providing online executable examples to minimize prerequisite requirements. This makes it more accessible for students from diverse academic backgrounds and disciplines. By the end of the course, students will have acquired essential theoretical knowledge in numerical computation, turbulence theory, and turbulence modeling, as well as familiarity with application processes. This will provide a solid foundation for future research and advanced coursework. The primary objective of the course is to equip students with a systematic understanding of turbulence models and their applications in CFD, while fostering problem-solving skills for real-world engineering challenges and scientific research.

default.zh: 在全球能源结构加速转型的背景下，太阳能作为最具开发潜力的可再生能源之一，已成为实现碳达峰与碳中和目标的核心支柱。本课程立足于能源科学、热物理与材料工程的交叉领域，系统阐述太阳能热利用的关键理论与技术进展，通过理论与实践结合的教学模式，引导学生掌握太阳能从资源评估到能量转换、存储及系统集成的全链条知识体系，培养解决复杂光热工程问题的能力。 第一部分：能源挑战与太阳能使命 课程以全球能源现状为切入点，剖析化石能源引发的环境危机与资源瓶颈，揭示可再生能源发展的紧迫性。通过对比风能、水能及生物质能的技术经济性，阐明太阳能的独特优势——广泛分布、零碳排放与近乎无限的资源储量。回溯太阳能利用历史，从公元前人类利用凸透镜聚光取火，至20世纪真空管集热器与光伏电池的技术突破，梳理政策扶持、材料创新与工程实践如何共同推动太阳能从辅助能源跃升为未来能源主力。作为课程导引，本部分将明确课程目标：围绕光热转换的核心场景，构建从太阳辐射物理本质到复杂热力系统设计的完整知识框架。 第二部分：太阳辐射的定量化解析 太阳能利用的起点是精准评估辐射资源的时空分布。课程从太阳核聚变能量释放机制出发，解析太阳常数（1361 W/m2）的物理意义及其与地日距离的动态关联。基于大气层对辐射的散射、吸收作用（如臭氧层对紫外线的过滤，水蒸气对红外波段的削弱），建立地外辐射至地表接收的衰减模型。为应对工程实际需求，课程重点引入倾斜表面辐射接收量的计算方法，结合天文几何参数（太阳高度角、赤纬角）与大气透射率修正，指导学生掌握集热器布局优化的理论工具。 第三部分：传热科学与材料特性的共轭耦合 太阳能集热系统的效率优化依赖于对传热过程与材料辐射特性的深刻理解。课程深入探讨集热器的能量传递三环节：吸热板对光能的高效吸收、热能向传热介质的定向转移，以及透明盖板与保温层对热损失的最小化控制。通过引入努塞尔数关联式与热损系数模型，定量分析对流、传导与辐射的交互作用。同时，聚焦光谱选择性材料（如黑铬涂层）的“高吸收-低发射”特性，揭示其如何突破传统黑体材料的热辐射限制，为低温、中温及高温集热场景提供差异化的材料解决方案。 第四部分：集热装置与热存储技术创新 作为光热转换的核心设备，太阳能集热器的性能直接决定系统能效。课程以平板式集热器为典型范例，剖析其吸热流道设计、选择性涂层应用与真空保温技术的协同机制，结合效率方程（η=η？？aΔT/G）阐释温度差、辐照度与热损的动力学平衡。对比分析真空管与平板集热器在低温热水与中温热发电场景的适用性差异。针对太阳能的间歇性挑战，课程系统讲解显热储热（水罐储热的热力学响应）、潜热储热（相变材料的固-液相变调控）及热化学储能（如金属氧化物可逆反应的高能量密度优势），探讨不同储热方式在响应速度、容量与成本上的工程取舍策略。 第五部分：从组件到系统的集成实践 太阳能热水系统与热发电技术的教学模块，着力于培养学生的系统工程思维。在太阳能热水系统设计中，课程以热力学循环为脉络，详解集热器阵列、储热水箱、循环泵与辅助加热设备的匹配逻辑，结合季节辐照度变化与热负荷需求，指导学生完成系统容量配置与管路优化。在热发电技术领域，聚焦槽式聚光（抛物面反射镜的线聚焦特性）与塔式聚光（定日镜场的点聚焦能流汇聚）两大主流技术，对比分析传热工质（导热油、熔融盐）的温度适应性，探讨布雷顿循环与斯特林循环的热功转换效率边界，并通过案例研究（如西班牙Gemasolar电站的24小时持续发电实践）印证技术可行性。 第六部分：辐射特性测量的实验赋能 面向工程实践需求，课程设置光谱选择性测量的实验教学环节。通过演示光谱仪对材料法向反射率、透射率的精准测定，揭示涂层表面的光谱响应特性与集热效率的关联规律。进一步引入积分球装置测量材料的半球反射率，深化学生对各向异性辐射行为的认知。基于实验数据，指导学生完成选择性吸收涂层的性能评估报告，并尝试提出针对特定应用场景（如高温聚焦式集热）的材料改性方案。 本课程突破传统能源学科的理论边界，强调多物理场耦合分析（光-热-材料-流体）与工程经济性评价的双重视角。通过理论推演、数值仿真与实验操作的有机结合，使学生能够独立完成太阳能热利用系统的初步设计与性能预测，并理解技术创新的潜在方向（如纳米流体强化传热、人工智能驱动的聚光场控制）。课程最终目标是为能源行业输送具备扎实理论基础、创新意识与实践能力的复合型人才，助力太阳能技术在建筑供暖、工业蒸汽与清洁电力领域的规模化应用。
default.en: This course examines solar energy as a critical solution to global energy challenges, combining theoretical foundations in thermodynamics, optics, and materials science with practical engineering applications. Students will master solar resource assessment, thermal conversion processes, storage technologies, and system integration strategies to address real-world energy demands. 1. Energy Transition and Solar Energy's Role The course begins by analyzing the environmental and geopolitical risks of fossil fuels, emphasizing solar energy's potential for scalability and sustainability. A historical overview traces milestones like the discovery of the photovoltaic effect and modern CSP (Concentrated Solar Power) systems. By contrasting solar with other renewables, students gain insights into its unique advantages: geographic flexibility, low maintenance, and compatibility with energy storage. 2. Solar Radiation Dynamics The physics of solar radiation is explored, starting with fusion reactions in the Sun and the concept of extraterrestrial solar flux (1,361 W/m2). Atmospheric effects—including scattering by aerosols and absorption by ozone—are modeled to predict ground-level irradiance. Students learn to calculate radiation on inclined surfaces using solar geometry (declination, hour angles) and atmospheric transmittance, enabling optimized solar field layouts. 3. Heat Transfer and Material Innovations The interplay between heat transfer and material properties drives solar collector efficiency. Conduction-convection-radiation coupling is analyzed, with formulas like the Nusselt correlation quantifying convective losses. Spectrally selective coatings are highlighted for their ability to maximize solar absorption (>90%) while minimizing thermal emission (<10%), with case studies on black chromium and advanced nanoceramic films. 4. Collector Technologies and Thermal Storage Flat-plate and evacuated tube collectors are compared in terms of cost, temperature ranges, and climatic adaptability. For instance, vacuum insulation in tubes reduces convective losses, enabling efficient operation in cold regions. Thermal storage solutions—sensible heat (water tanks), latent heat (phase-change materials like paraffin), and thermochemical systems (metal oxide redox reactions)—are evaluated for capacity, response time, and scalability. 5. System Integration: From Water Heating to Power Generation Design principles for solar water heating systems cover collector sizing, heat exchanger configurations, and antifreeze strategies for cold climates. In CSP technologies, parabolic troughs (using synthetic oil) and solar towers (molten salt storage) are analyzed for their operational temperatures (>400°C) and synergy with Rankine cycles. Case studies demonstrate 24/7 power generation through hybrid systems integrating thermal storage. 6. Experimental Characterization Lab sessions focus on measuring radiative properties. Spectrophotometry identifies the absorption/emission spectra of materials, while integrating spheres quantify hemispherical reflectance. Students correlate these properties with collector efficiency and propose material optimizations. Graduates will master multiphysics modeling of solar thermal systems, assess techno-economic viability, and innovate solutions for energy storage and grid integration. The course bridges academia and industry, preparing students for roles in clean energy R&D, system design, and policy advocacy.

default.zh: 氢能原理与技术课程以培养氢能全产业链科学和技术人才为目标，涵盖基础理论、核心技术和实践应用模块，学生需具备数学、物理、化学、英语等基础知识，课程将强化数理化基础与工程思维，课程核心内容涵盖制氢技术：电解水制氢、天然气重整、生物质制氢等，储运技术：高压气态储氢、低温液态储氢、固体储氢材料等，应用技术：燃料电池技术、氢燃气轮机、氢动力循环系统等，并探讨氢能安全与综合能源：氢安全、氢能及综合能源系统、氢能燃烧技术等。课程具备跨学科融合特性：融合动力工程、材料科学、电化学等方向，目标培养双碳领域复合型人才。
default.en: The Hydrogen Energy Principles and Technology course aims to cultivate scientific and technical talents of the whole hydrogen energy industry chain, covering basic theory, core technology and practical application modules. Students are required to have basic knowledge of mathematics, physics, chemistry, English, etc. The course will strengthen the basic knowledge of mathematics, physics, chemistry and engineering thinking, and the core content of the course covers hydrogen production technology:

default.zh: 我国发电用煤占煤炭消耗量的60%左右，在役电站锅炉90%以上采用煤粉燃烧方式。煤粉燃烧普遍存在NOx排放量高、稳燃能力差、结渣、高温腐蚀等问题。NOx是产生雾霾的主要前驱物之一。迫切需要通过燃烧理论的创新，为开发高效、稳燃、防结渣及高温腐蚀、低污染煤燃烧技术提供理论支撑。本课程在燃烧基本知识介绍的基础上，通过介绍三高区理论、水平浓淡燃烧理论、中心给粉燃烧理论、多次引射分级燃烧理论，引导学生理解和掌握煤燃烧理论的创新历程，了解燃烧理论在洁净低碳发电技术的应用以及理论的创新带来的技术创新和突破。掌握通过实验的总结、分析，凝炼、提出理论的科学研究方法。培养学生的创新意识和研发能力。课程主要通过课堂讲授及研讨交流的形式展开。在培养学生科研能力的同时，还着重强调拓宽学术视野，加深学生对科学研究和工程实践之间联系的认识。
default.en: In China, coal used for power generation accounts for about 60% of coal consumption, and more than 90% of utility boilers in service use pulverized coal for combustion. There are many problems in pulverized coal combustion, such as high NOx emissions, poor combustion stability, slagging and high temperature corrosion. NOx is one of the major precursors of the fog and haze. It is urgent to meet the combustion with high combustion efficiency and low NO x emission, and to solve the problems of flame stability, slagging and fire side high-temperature corrosion of furnace water-cooled wall tubes through the innovation of coal combustion theory. Based on the introduction of the basic knowledge of combustion, this course introduces the three high zones theory, the horizontal bias combustion theory, the central-fuel-rich swirling combustion theory and the multiple-injection and multiple-staging combustion theory, so as to guide students to understand and master the innovation process of combustion theory. It makes students fully understand the application of coal combustion theory in clean power generation technology and the technological innovation and breakthrough bring by theory development. Students can experience the scientific research methods of summarizing, analyzing, condensing and putting forward theories through doing experiments by themselves. It can cultivate the innovative consciousness, research and development ability of students. Classes are conducted in the forms of lectures and discussions. While cultivating students' research capabilities, it also emphasizes broadening academic horizons and deepening students' understanding of the connection between scientific research and engineering practice.

default.zh: 通过课程认知实习，使学生将所学的理论知识与现实应用场景结合起来，使学生了解和掌握基本应用方向和方式。培养学生理论联系实际，开拓学生视野，引领学生树立航天报国之志，将所学理论更好地应用于实践，同时加深学生与学院飞行器动力工程专业实验室间的交流联系。使学生了解我国航空航天动力技术发展现状，培养学生作为航天人的家国情怀，点燃学生作为航天人的骄傲自豪和使命感，成为指引他们投身中国航天事业的明灯。
default.en: Through course cognitive internships, students can combine their theoretical knowledge with practical application scenarios, enabling them to understand and master basic application directions and methods. Cultivate students to connect theory with practice, broaden their horizons, lead them to establish the aspiration of serving the country through aerospace, better apply the theories they have learned to practice, and deepen the communication and connection between students and the laboratory of the college's Aerospace Power Engineering major. To enable students to understand the current development status of China's aerospace power technology, cultivate their patriotism as astronauts, ignite their pride and sense of mission as astronauts, and become a guiding light for them to devote themselves to China's aerospace industry.

default.zh: 通过认知实习，让学生能够基于工程相关背景知识进行合理分析，评价专业工程实践和复杂工程问题解决方案对社会、健康、安全、法律以及文化的影响，并理解应承担的责任；能够理解和评价针对复杂工程问题的专业工程实践对环境、社会可持续发展的影响。通过实习，培养人文社会科学素养、社会责任感，能够在工程实践中理解并遵守工程职业道德和规范，履行责任。能够就复杂工程问题与业界同行及社会公众进行有效沟通和交流，包括撰写报告和设计文稿、陈述发言、清晰表达或回应指令，具备一定的国际视野，能够在跨文化背景下进行沟通和交流。具有自主学习和终身学习的意识，有不断学习和适应发展的能力。
default.en: Through Professional Cognition Practice, students are able to conduct reasonable analysis based on engineering related background knowledge, evaluate the impact of professional engineering practices and complex engineering problem solutions on society, health, safety, law, and culture, and understand the responsibilities they should undertake; Be able to understand and evaluate the impact of professional engineering practices targeting complex engineering problems on environmental and social sustainable development. Through internships, cultivate humanistic and social science literacy, a sense of social responsibility, and be able to understand and abide by engineering professional ethics and norms in engineering practice, fulfilling responsibilities. Capable of effective communication and exchange with industry peers and the public on complex engineering issues, including writing reports and design drafts, presenting speeches, clearly expressing or responding to instructions, possessing a certain international perspective, and able to communicate and exchange in cross-cultural contexts. Having the awareness of self-directed learning and lifelong learning, and the ability to continuously learn and adapt to development.

default.zh: 生产实习是高等教育工科专业实践教学非常重要的一环，作为能够亲临实践现场的一门课程，其能够实现结合基础课程、知识，训练学生运用专业知识解决实际问题的能力，实现基础知识与实践操作相结合，贯通从基本原理学习到实际产品研发和生产之间的各种环节，充分增强学生实践创新的能力，这对学生当前的学习和今后的工作都有很重要的作用。通过生产实习培养学生观察问题、分析问题和解决问题的能力，特别要培养学生综合运用所学知识与实际相联系，提高工程实践能力和创新能力，培养学生的团结合作精神，树立正确的职业道德理想。
default.en: Production Practice is a very important part of practical teaching in higher education engineering majors. As a course that allows for hands-on experience, it can combine basic courses and knowledge, train students to apply professional knowledge to solve practical problems, combine basic knowledge with practical operations, connect various links from basic principle learning to actual product development and production, and fully enhance students' practical innovation ability. This plays an important role in students' current learning and future work. Through production internships, we aim to cultivate students' abilities to observe, analyze, and solve problems, particularly in integrating their knowledge with practice, improving their engineering and innovation abilities, fostering a spirit of unity and cooperation, and establishing correct professional ethics.

default.zh: 毕业实习是毕业实习是重要的实践性教学环节，其目的是巩固所学的理论知识，使理论紧密结合生产实践，使学生获得实际生产技术和管理知识，培养学生理论联系实际，提高其在生产实践中调查研究、观察问题、分析问题以及解决问题的能力和方法，为毕业设计打下基础。通过毕业实习，还应使学生了解现代化生产方式和先进制造技术，培养艰苦创业的精神和社会事业心与责任感。 课程培养目标如下： （1）通过毕业实习课程，提高其在生产实践中调查研究、观察问题、分析问题以及解决问题的能力和方法，为毕业设计打下基础。 （2）通过毕业实习课程，学生了解专业相关技术和原理，熟悉专业发展，掌握专业相关根本原理、主要方法和基本原则，增强专业的实践知识和感性认识。 （3）通过毕业实习课程，学生积极参加实习实践，培养学生的动手能力、分析问题和创新的能力，为科研工作打下一定的基础。 （4）增强理论联系实际能力、工程实践能力、逻辑思维能力、创新意识。培养艰苦创业的精神和社会事业心与责任感。
default.en: Fieldwork for Graduation is an important practical teaching link for graduation practice. Its purpose is to consolidate the theoretical knowledge learned, closely integrate theory with production practice, enable students to obtain practical production technology and management knowledge, train students to integrate theory with practice, improve their ability and methods to investigate, observe, analyze and solve problems in production practice, and lay a foundation for graduation design. Through graduation internships, students should also learn about modern production methods and advanced manufacturing technologies, cultivate a spirit of hard work and entrepreneurship, as well as a sense of social responsibility and dedication. The training objectives of the course are as follows: (1) Through gFieldwork for Graduation, improve their ability and methods to investigate, observe, analyze and solve problems in production practice, and lay a foundation for graduation design. (2) Through graduation internship courses, students will understand the relevant technologies and principles of their profession, become familiar with professional development, master the fundamental principles, main methods, and basic principles related to their profession, and enhance their practical knowledge and intuitive understanding of the profession. (3) Through graduation internship courses, students actively participate in internship practice, cultivate their hands-on ability, problem-solving and innovation abilities, and lay a certain foundation for scientific research work. (4) Enhance the ability to connect theory with practice, engineering practice, logical thinking, and innovation awareness. Cultivate a spirit of hard work and entrepreneurship, as well as a sense of social responsibility and dedication.

default.zh: 毕业论文（设计）是本科生专业培养的最后一个环节，是通过实践教学全面锻炼和提升学生专业综合能量和素养的关键环节。其课程目标包括： 1、培养学生综合运用所学的知识（基础课、技术基础课、专业方向课等方面的知识），分析和解决工程技术问题的能力。 2、进一步深化和扩展所学的基础知识、专业知识，提高实验动手能力；提高自学能力和独立工作的能力，使学生受到工程师的基本训练，培养其开展科学研究工作的初步能力。 3、培养学生的表达能力和团队精神，培养创新意识和创新精神，树立正确的人生观、价值观，在思想政治素质方面得到进一步的提高。
default.en: The graduation thesis (design) is the final stage of undergraduate professional training, and it is a key link to comprehensively exercise and enhance students' professional comprehensive energy and literacy through practical teaching. The course objectives include: 1. Cultivate the ability of students to comprehensively apply the knowledge they have learned (basic courses, technical basic courses, professional direction courses, etc.), analyze and solve engineering and technical problems. 2. Further deepen and expand the basic and professional knowledge learned, and improve experimental hands-on ability; Improve self-learning ability and independent work ability, provide students with basic training as engineers, and cultivate their preliminary ability to carry out scientific research work. 3. Cultivate students' expression ability and team spirit, cultivate innovative consciousness and spirit, establish correct outlook on life and values, and further improve their ideological and political qualities.

default.zh: 《大学外语》是面向非英语专业本科生开设的一门外语必修课。本课程涵盖听说读写四项技能的综合训练，旨在提高学生外语综合水平和应用能力。本课程结合文本讲解听力技巧，通过真实语料提高听力理解能力；借助主题任务培养口语表达能力；通过文本阅读与分析，巩固阅读技能，提高阅读效率和文本分析能力；以读促写，将阅读技能应用于外文写作训练，培养写作能力和批判性思维能力。教学内容以主题单元设计展开，展现多元文化、拓展国际视野、涵养中国情怀。课程采用累加式考核方式，由课程成绩50%和期末综合考试成绩50%构成学期总成绩。
default.en: College Foreign Language is a required foreign language course for freshmen. It contains an integrated foreign language skill training, progressing from listening and speaking to reading and writing, aiming to improve the overall foreign language proficiency and application ability of undergraduates. Listening skills are explicated in combination with text analyses as taught in reading. Authentic materials are used to motivate listening comprehension. Speaking ability is to be developed in thematic units. Through text reading and analysis, reading skills are consolidated, and reading efficiency and text-analysis ability are improved. Reading skills are subsequently applied to promoting writing ability as well as critical thinking ability. Thematic tasks are assigned to showcase rich multiculturalism, expand international perspectives, and cultivate Chinese sentiments. The course adopts the cumulative assessment method and the total score for one semester is composed of 50% of the course performance and 50% of the final proficiency test.

default.zh: 外语综合（1）课程是面向未来技术学院一年级本科生发展级开设的一门必修课，旨在提高学生英语综合能力及英语应用技能，并为进一步参与各领域国际交流打下坚实的基础。本课程以雅思听、说、读、写技能要求为标准，精选听、说、读、写训练素材。听力材料精选自不同生活场景素材；口语训练涉及各种话题；阅读训练紧扣题型并精选材料；写作涵盖各类图表作文和论述文写作技能训练。本课程同时侧重扩大学生的词汇量，熟悉复杂语法结构，扩展背景知识。最终学生在听力方面能够基本无障碍听懂日常对话、学术讨论、讲座以及各种媒体信息；在口语方面能够迅速整理思路，清晰准确地表达观点，从容参与日常交流及各种场合的口语互动；在阅读方面能够快速准确地接纳学术期刊和论著的文字信息和各种媒体文字信息；在写作方面能够准确地描述科学数据和各种图表，有条理地分析多种社会领域问题并提出解决方案，清晰流畅地表达较复杂的学术观点。
default.en: Integrated Skills of English （I）is a a compulsory course designed for first-year undergraduate students in the School of Future Technology who are enrolled in the Development Level of College English. It aims to develop students’ comprehensive abilities of the English language (listening, speaking, reading and writing) so that solid foundation will be laid for the students to communicate and interact internationally in various fields and on different occasions. This course covers four parts (listening, speaking, reading and writing) and teaching materials are carefully collected strictly according to the requirements of IELTS tests. Listening materials are chosen from different situations in real life; speaking materials include all kinds of related topics; reading materials closely model IELTS tests; writing materials cover seven possible variations for task 1 and three possible variations for task 2. This course also helps students to develop lexical and syntactic skills specifically focusing on the building of vocabulary and the understanding of complex sentence structures as well as the broadening of their English background knowledge. At the end of this course, students’ comprehensive abilities are good enough to understand daily conversations, academic lectures and seminars, etc. in English; speak English fluently and clearly; read English journal articles and books with accurate comprehension; write English essays cohesively and coherently and describe information given in charts and graphs logically and clearly.

default.zh: 外语综合（2）课程是面向未来技术学院一年级本科生发展级开设的一门必修课，旨在培养他们在高等教育环境中的学术英语能力与素养。本课程围绕科技文献阅读、学术论文撰写与宣读、学术讨论等核心技能展开，提升学生的学术英语思辨能力，强调学术英语的实际应用能力，采用“以成果为导向”的学术英语教学法，帮助学生进行论文撰写、投稿沟通和参加国际会议。本课程的主要教学内容包括：1. 学术英语素养培养──掌握国际学术交流所需的语言规范；2. 科技论文阅读与分析──深入理解并解析科技论文的结构；3. 学术论文写作──撰写符合学术规范的论文；4. 国际学术交流—论文投稿、回应审稿意见、制作学术海报、学术报告展示等。课程教材选用《学术英语理工进阶》，内容涵盖研究准备、论文结构分析与写作、学术交流等多个模块。通过课堂互动、案例分析和项目驱动式学习，学生将掌握从研究选题到成果展示的完整学术流程，为后续学术发展奠定坚实基础。本课程具有以下特色：首先是学科导向，紧密结合工程背景──本课程立足计算机科学与航空航天两大工程类学科，精选相关领域的词汇、案例和实践任务，强化学生在科研环境中的语言应用能力，并培养其学术规范意识；二是课题驱动，结合竞赛实践──课程采用“课项结合”与“课赛结合”机制，学生可基于大一年度项目的研究过程与数据撰写学术论文，并有机会参加“中国大学生5分钟科研英语演讲大赛”，在实践中提升学术表达能力；三是模拟国际学术交流全过程──课程包括学术论文投稿、回应审稿意见、会议海报制作及学术成果展示等环节，使学生在模拟真实学术环境的过程中积累经验，提高国际学术交流能力。通过本课程的学习，学生将具备在学术研究、国际学术交流及科技创新领域使用英语进行有效沟通的能力，为未来的科研与职业发展奠定扎实的语言基础。
default.en: Integrated Skills of English (II) is a a compulsory course designed for first-year undergraduate students in the School of Future Technology who are enrolled in the Development Level of College English. It aims to cultivate their academic English proficiency and literacy within a higher education environment. The course focuses on key academic skills such as reading scientific literature, writing and presenting academic papers, and participating in academic discussions, with an emphasis on enhancing students’ critical thinking in academic English and practical application skills. Employing an outcome-oriented approach to academic English instruction, the course guides students through the processes of academic writing, submission communication, and participation in international conferences. The course covers four core areas: 1. Academic English Literacy Development – Mastering the linguistic norms required for international academic communication; 2. Scientific Paper Reading and Analysis – Understanding and analyzing the structure of scientific research papers; 3. Academic Paper Writing – Composing research papers that adhere to academic conventions; 4. International Academic Communication – Engaging in academic paper submission, responding to reviewers’ comments, creating academic posters, and delivering academic presentations. The course adopts the textbook Advanced Academic English for Science and Engineering, which includes modules on research preparation, paper structure analysis and writing, and academic communication. Through interactive classroom activities, case studies, and project-based learning, students will gain a comprehensive understanding of the academic research process, from topic selection to presenting their findings. This course has the following key features. Firstly, it adopts discipline-oriented approach aligned with engineering fields. Secondly, it is project-driven learning integrated with competition practice – the course follows a “course-project integration” and “course-competition integration” model, allowing students to write academic papers based on their first-year research projects and data. Thirdly, it simulates international academic exchange process. By completing this course, students will acquire the ability to effectively communicate in English within academic research, international scholarly exchange, and technological innovation, equipped with a strong linguistic foundation for future scientific research and career development.

default.zh: 《外语综合3》是面向未来技术学院二年级学生开设的一门英语选修课。该课程旨在提高学生学术英语技能以及英语综合技能，能够达到雅思考试的语言要求并能进行国际交流。教学内容主要包括提高雅思听、说、读、写综合能力，阅读科技文献、撰写学术论文、宣读论文、参加学术讨论等。该课程采用“以结果为导向”的学术英语教学法，结合正式期刊或会议论文，训练学术英语写作技能，培养学术素养。本课程采用形成性和终结性评价相结合的累加式考核方式，包括小组汇报、论文写作和演讲，以及英语水平测试等。
default.en: Integrated Skills of English III is an optional English course for sophomores from the School of Future Technology of HIT. The aim of this course is to develop students’ comprehensive abilities of the English language and academic English abilities to reach the requirements of IELTS tests and communicate internationally in various fields. This course covers developing comprehensive abilities for IELTS (listening, speaking, reading and writing), reading academic literature, writing and presenting academic papers, and attending academic panel discussions etc. The course adopts outcome-oriented teaching method and uses official journal articles and conference papers as teaching materials so that students’ academic English writing skills are acquired, academic quality improved and four skills of English listening, speaking, reading and writing developed at the same time. Based on the theories of formative and summative assessments, the course employs an accumulative grading system, including group reports, paper writings and presentations, and an English proficiency test.

default.zh: 《大学外语（俄语LP2）》是为能源学院中俄联合办学一年级学生在第二学期开设的必修课程，该课程在整个知识结构中占有重要地位。通过听说读写的全面训练，培养学生的俄语基本功，为其学习后续课程、掌握俄语的实际运用能力打下扎实的基础。本课程的主要目标是使学生在掌握 《大学外语（俄语LP1）》的条件下继续学习俄语语言（语音、语法、词汇）知识，培养学生具有听、说、读、写的基本技能和初步的言语交际能力，掌握一般的俄罗斯国情知识，培养学生具有自主学习获取和更新专业知识的能力。本课程贯彻以话题为纲的原则，所提供的对话、课文和所涉及到的词汇主要是日常生活题材，在日常生活题材范围内教授常用的词语、句式，讲授实用的基础语法，通过大量练习把语法知识转化为语言技能。同时，注重教材中更多文化元素的发掘，以提高学生的兴趣，增加对俄罗斯的了解。
default.en: "College Foreign Language (Russian LP2)" is a compulsory course offered in the second semester for first-year students of the Energy Institute jointly run by China and Russia. This course occupies an important position in the entire knowledge structure. Through comprehensive training in listening, speaking, reading, and writing, students will be trained in their basic Russian skills, laying a solid foundation for their ability to learn subsequent courses and master the practical application of Russian. The main goal of this course is to enable students to continue learning Russian language (pronunciation, grammar, vocabulary) knowledge under the condition of mastering "College Foreign Language (Russian LP1)", cultivate students' basic skills in listening, speaking, reading, and writing, and preliminary verbal communication skills, master general knowledge of Russian national conditions, and cultivate students' ability to independently learn, acquire, and update professional knowledge. This course follows the principle of taking topics as the main topic, and provides dialogues, texts, and vocabulary related to daily life topics. It teaches commonly used words and sentence patterns within the scope of daily life topics, teaches practical basic grammar, converts grammatical knowledge into language skills through a large amount of practice, and focuses on exploring more cultural elements in the textbooks to enhance students' interest and increase their understanding of Russia.

Training in listening and speaking should be prominent. In the classroom, students should have as much listening and speaking practice as possible to gradually improve their language quality. default.zh: 大学外语（俄语LP4）面向中俄联合校园二年级学生，旨在使学生熟练朗读俄语的同时，进一步加强语法、词汇等基础知识的学习，具有听、说、读、写、译的基本技能和初步的言语交际能力，掌握一定的俄罗斯国情文化知识，从而为提高阶段的学习奠定坚实的基础。
default.en: College foreign language (Russian LP4) for the Chinese and Russian joint campus sophomore students, aims to make students proficient in reading Russian at the same time, further strengthen the learning of grammar, vocabulary and other basic knowledge, with listening, speaking, reading, writing, translation of the basic skills and preliminary verbal communication ability, master a certain Russian cultural knowledge, so as to improve the stage of learning to lay a solid foundation.

default.zh: 大学外语（俄语LP5）面向中俄联合校园二年级学生，本课程在提高学生语言基本功、培养实际运用语言的能力、提升学生的语篇交际能力等方面占重要的地位。本课程将提高学生对课文的鉴赏能力、提高相关技能的运用水平。通过对阅读材料的全面分析，学生理解所读文章的背景知识、文章体裁、写作特点、语言知识，理解文章蕴含的深层次意义。在一般社会文化、历史、人文、环境和科技等题材范围内教授最常用的词语和句式，培养学生听说读写言语技能，发展叙述的交际能力，同时侧重独白语能力的培养，为其学习后续课程打下坚实的基础。
default.en: College Foreigh Language (Russian LP5) is a Russian major course offered in the spring semester of the second grade jointly run by Chinese and Russian universities. This course plays an important role in improving the basic skills of students, cultivating practical ability to use language, and improving students’ discourse competence ability. This course will improve students' appreciation of the text and improve the level of relevant skills. Through the comprehensive analysis of reading materials, students understand the background knowledge of the article, article genre, writing characteristics, language knowledge and the deep implication of the article. In the general social culture, history, humanities, environment and science and technology within the scope of the subject to teach the most commonly used words and sentences, to train students’ speech skills of listening, speaking, reading and writing, and develop their narrative communication skills. At the same time, it focuses on the cultivation of monologue ability, and lays a solid foundation for their follow-up courses.

default.zh: 大学外语（俄语LP6）面向中俄联合校园二年级学生，本课程在提高学生语言基本功，培养实际运用语言的能力，提升学生的语篇交际能力等方面占重要的地位。本课程将提高学生对课文的鉴赏能力、提高相关技能的运用水平。通过对阅读材料的全面分析，学生理解所读文章的背景知识、文章体裁、写作特点、语言知识，理解文章蕴含的深层次意义。在一般社会文化、历史、人文、环境和科技等题材范围内教授最常用的词语和句式，培养学生听说读写言语技能，发展叙述的交际能力，同时侧重独白语能力的培养，为其学习后续课程打下坚实的基础。
default.en: College Foreigh Language (Russian LP6) is a Russian major course offered by the students in the summer semester of the second grade jointly run by Chinese and Russian universities. This course plays an important role in improving the basic skills of students, cultivating practical ability to use language, and improving students’ discourse competence ability. This course will improve students' appreciation of the text and improve the level of relevant skills. Through the comprehensive analysis of reading materials, students understand the background knowledge of the article, article genre, writing characteristics, language knowledge and the deep implication of the article. In the general social culture, history, humanities, environment and science and technology within the scope of the subject to teach the most commonly used words and sentences, to train students’ speech skills of listening, speaking, reading and writing, and develop their narrative communication skills. At the same time, it focuses on the cultivation of monologue ability, and lays a solid foundation for their follow-up courses.

default.zh: 英语二外（高起点）(1)的教学对象是具有一定英语基础的日语和俄语专业本科生，目的是强化学生英语交流及获取信息的能力, 提高学生英语听说读写的综合能力，特别是培养学生对不同体裁和风格的英语文章的理解、赏析和应用的能力，使其在今后的工作和社会交往中能用英语有效地进行口头和书面交流；同时培养学生批判性跨文化意识，提高其跨文化差异敏感性和本民族文化身份认同，并为其后续的英语语言学习和实际应用奠定良好的基础。
default.en: College English （Intermediate）（1） is designed for the students majoring in Japanese and Russian who have learned English as a foreign language in high schools. The course aims to enhance the students’ competence to communicate in English and to obtain information in English, and to develop their comprehensive ability of listening, speaking, reading and writing in English. The students will read and appreciate English texts of different genres, and they will develop their skills in written and oral communication. Meanwhile, the course will help the students to develop their cultural awareness, cross-cultural sensitivity and cultural identity so as to build a good foundation for their future study and application of English.

default.zh: 英语二外（高起点）(2) 是英语二外（高起点）(1)的延续，目的是强化学生用英语获取信息和交流的能力，特别是培养学生对不同体裁和风格的英语文章的理解和赏析的能力，提高英语听说读写译的综合能力，为其后续的英语语言学习奠定良好的基础；同时培养学生的思辨能力，为其在今后的工作和社会交往中能用英语有效地解决现实问题做准备。本课程采用累加式考核方式，考核内容包括课堂表现、口头报告、课后习题作业、课堂测试和期末考试。
default.en: This course is designed for Russian majors and Japanese majors who have learned College English (Intermediate) (1). It aims to enhance students’ competence to obtain information as well as communicate in English. Students will be able to understand and appreciate English texts of different genres and styles, improve skills of listening, speaking, reading, writing, and translation, which will lay a good foundation for their future English study. Meanwhile, the course cultivates students’ critical thinking and prepares them to solve practical problems effectively in English in their future work and social communication. The final score is achieved by adding up the scores of the following: in-class performance, presentation, assignments, quizzes and final exam.

default.zh: 《英语二外（高起点）(3)》是日语和俄语专业三年级高起点学生的二外课程，是英语二外（高起点）(2)的延续性课程，共36学时。本课程讲授议论文、短篇小说等不同体裁的文章，通过讲解词汇、语法、篇章等语言知识和课文所涉及到的英语国家历史、地理、政治、哲学、文学等文化方面的知识，并辅之以相应的听、说、读、写、译等各项英语实践技能的训练。经过本课程的学习，学生能够打下扎实的英语语言基础，增强用英语获取知识和交流的技能，增加对英语国家文化的了解，提高综合的英语应用能力、跨文化交流能力和思辨能力。本课程采用累加式考核方式，考核内容包括课堂出勤及表现、口头报告、课后习题作业、课堂测试和期末考试。
default.en: College English (Intermediate) (3), with 36 class hours, is the second foreign language course for third-year Japanese and Russian majors, and also the further development of College English (Intermediate) (2). It focuses on the following: the teaching of basic knowledge of the English language including vocabulary, grammar, discourse etc.; the instruction of English-speaking countries’ history, geography, politics, philosophy, literature and other aspects in culture; and the cultivation of listening, speaking, reading, writing, and translation skills. The course aims to enable students to lay a solid foundation of the English language, enhance their competence to obtain information and communicate in English, increase the understanding of English-speaking countries’ culture, and develop the integrated ability of English application and promote intercultural communication and critical thinking. The final score is achieved by adding up the scores of the following: attendance, in-class performance, presentation, after-class assignments, quizzes and final exam.

default.zh: 英语二外（零起点）(1)是日语和俄语专业二年级学生的专业必修课，是培养学生的英语语言能力的入门性课程，旨在为学生进一步学习英语打下牢固的基础。本课程通过对英语语音、词性、时态等基本语法、对话和百字左右的课文的学习，使学生能够掌握英语语音知识，熟练地使用音标进行拼读单词；掌握所学材料涉及到的词汇和语法知识以及英语国家的文化背景知识，理解对话的交际价值和课文的意义；初步培养学生的听、说、读、写能力，英语语言的综合运用能力和跨文化交际能力。本课程考试成绩采用累加式，包括课堂参与、平时作业、课堂测试和期末考试成绩。
default.en: As a required course for sophomores majoring in Japanese and Russian, this course is an elementary one to cultivate students’ ability to use the English language. The ultimate goal is to lay a solid foundation for students’ further English learning.By learning English pronunciation, fundamental grammar concerning parts of speech and tenses, dialogues and texts of about 100 words, students will be enabled to acquire the knowledge of English pronunciation, pronounce words with the help of phonetic symbols proficiently, grasp the usages of words and expressions, acquaint themselves with related cultural settings, understand the communicative and informative meanings of dialogues and the texts, develop their skills of listening, speaking, reading, and writing in English, improve their comprehensive abilities of using the English language, and thus cultivate their cross-cultural communicative competence. Students’ performances will be evaluated with regard to class participation, assignments, quizzes, and the final exam.

default.zh: 英语二外（零起点）(2)是日语和俄语专业二年级学生的专业必修课，是初步培养学生英语语言能力的课程，旨在为学生进一步学习英语打下牢固的基础。本课程通过对情态动词、被动语态、不定式、各种从句等英语基本语法、日常情景对话和200-300字课文的学习，使学生能够掌握所学材料涉及到的语言和文化背景知识，理解对话的交际功能和课文的意义；合理利用教材，通过多种形式的教学活动，培养学生的听、说、读、写、译能力、英语语言的综合运用能力和跨文化交际能力。本课程考试成绩采用累加式，包括课堂参与、平时作业、课堂测试和期末考试成绩。
default.en: Aimed at cultivating students’ ability to use the English language, this course is a required one for sophomores majoring in Japanese and Russian. The ultimate goal is to lay a solid foundation for students’ further English learning in the future. By learning fundamental English grammar such as modal verbs, passive voice, infinitives and clauses, dialogues with settings of everyday life and texts of 200 to 300 words, students will be enabled to grasp related linguistic and cultural knowledge, understand the communicative and informative meanings of dialogues and texts, develop skills of listening, speaking, reading, writing and translation through effective use of the textbook and various in-class activities, improve their comprehensive abilities of using the English language, and thus cultivate their cross-cultural communicative competence. Students’ performances will be evaluated with regard to class participation, assignments, quizzes, and the final exam.

default.zh: 英语二外（零起点）(3)是日语和俄语专业高年级零起点学生的二外课程，是英语二外（零起点）(2)的延续性课程。本课程主要讲授英语语法、对话和短文，传授学生英语语言和文化知识。学生将掌握基本英语语言能力，培养听、说、读、写、译等各种语言技能，进而提高其英语口头表达能力、阅读能力和跨文化交际能力。本课程教授的语法主要包括虚拟语气、代词it、verb-ing形式、倒装、标点符号的用法、平行句、强调句和其它重点句型，每个单元包括日常情景对话和400词左右的课文。本课程采用累加式考核方式，包括课堂测试、课后作业和期末考试。
default.en: College English (Preliminary) (3) is the second foreign language course for higher-level Japanese and Russian major students, and also the further development of College English (Preliminary)(2). The course provides students with English grammar, dialogues, and short passages, and it aims to inform students of language and culture knowledge. The students should master fundamental English language competence and foster the skills in listening, speaking, reading, writing and translation, so as to improve their English speaking ability, reading competence, and intercultural communication competence. The contents include the subjunctive mood, the pronoun it, verb-ing form, inversion, the use of punctuation marks, parallel structure, emphasis sentences, and other important sentences and structures. There are dialogues and 400-word texts in each unit. The course evaluation is cumulative, which includes in-class presentation, after-class assignments, and final exam.

default.zh: 基础英语(1)是二学位第一年级的专业必修课，在培养学生语言基本功及语言综合运用能力方面占重要的地位，本课程为后续专业学习奠定扎实的基础。本课程侧重于听、说、读、写、译等各项语言基本技能的培养，培养学生综合的语言运用能力。通过本课程的学习，学生应该了解和熟悉与课文相关的背景知识，扩大知识面；熟练运用所学关键词语、句式，解释重要语句、理解课文主旨；熟悉文章的体裁、结构、内容、写作技巧；具备分析，欣赏和批判的能力；掌握综合运用语言的能力，能把所学知识得体地输出。本课程考试成绩采用累加式，包括课堂参与、课后练习、期末考试等成绩。
default.en: Fundamental English (1), as a compulsory course for the first year Second- majors, plays an indispensable role in consolidating students’ language skills for subsequent other major-related courses. The teaching contents focus on cultivating the students’ abilities in listening, speaking reading, writing and translation with the purpose of improving the students’ comprehensive English skills. Through this course, students are expected to learn about the background information related to the texts, broadening their horizon; to skillfully apply the key vocabulary and sentence structure in their own language practice and paraphrase the difficult sentences and get the main idea of the text; to get familiar with the different genres and writing techniques; to develop the analytic, appreciative, and critical abilities; to appropriately output what they have learned from the text. The final assessment of the course consists of the following part: classroom participation; exercises of each text, and final written examination.

default.zh: 基础英语(2)作为英语专业（第二学士学位）一年级春季学期的主干课程，共64学时。课程侧重于英语基础知识的教学以及听、说、读、写、译等各项英语实践技能的综合培养，课程教学中同时兼顾英美国家地理、历史、政治、文学、经济等方面文化知识的教育。在本课程的教学过程中，通过对语言点的详细阐释、功能性会话的练习、篇章结构的整体把握、相关背景文化知识的介绍、以及相关问题的讨论，学生能够打下扎实的英语语言基础，增强英语交流技能，增加对英语国家文化的了解，提高综合的英语应用能力。课程采用累加式考核形式，包括课堂讨论、课后作业和期末考试等。
default.en: Fundamental English II, with 64 class hours, is the main course in the first year spring semester of the English major (second bachelor’s degree). It focuses on the teaching of basic knowledge of English language, the cultivation of skills including listening, speaking, reading, writing, and translation, and the instruction of English-speaking countries’ culture in geography, history, politics, literature, economy and other aspects. The course, by means of explanation on language points, drills of functional dialogue, mastery of discourse structures, introduction to relevant cultural background knowledge and discussion of relevant issues, aims to enable students to form a solid basis of English language, enhance the skills in English communication, increase the understanding of English-speaking countries’ culture, and develop the integrated ability of English application. The final score is achieved by adding up the score of following items: discussion in class, homework and final examination.

default.zh: 英语听力（1）课程中文简介 一、课程基本信息 课程代码：22FL22132 课程名称：英语听力（1） 总学时：64 理论学时：64 学分：4.0 开课单位：外国语学院 授课对象：英语专业第二学士学位学生 开课学期：1秋 先修课程：大学英语 二、课程简介 英语听力（1）是为英语专业第二学士学位学生开设的专业基础课程，旨在帮助学生熟悉和运用英语语音知识，学习听力技巧，听懂难度中等、语速适中、长度较短的各种题材和体裁的听力材料，以帮助学生利用英语获取信息，开阔眼界，增长知识。该课程通过倾听大量符合英语国家现实语境的材料，帮助学生掌握和操练基本听力技巧，累积词汇，促进英语口语习得，熟悉热门话题，了解英语国家的文化和习俗，提高跨文化交际能力。本课程利用多媒体手段辅助教学，选取最具时效性的听音材料，创造融真实性、知识性、交际性和趣味性为一体的课堂教学氛围，指导学生巩固基础语音知识，熟悉各种语音变体；听懂基本的日常英语对话、情节简单的英语故事、语速适中的英语演讲，简短的英语新闻、以及其它各种场合及场景下的英语信息；能够概括大意，抓住细节，完成听写和复述，速记关键信息。本课程的考核采用累加式评价，涵盖课堂表现和期末考试。
default.en: Introduction to [English Listening (1)] 1. General Information Course Code：22FL22132 Course Title：English Listening (1) Credit Hours：64 Lecture：64 Credit(s)：4.0 Offering Department: School of International Studies Students: Second Degree English Majors Term: Fall, First Year Prerequisites: Open 2. Course Description English Listening (1) is a basic training course for Second Degree English Majors. It aims to help students practise the knowledge of phonetics and learn basic listening skills so as to understand English materials of intermediary level, moderate speaking rate, and medium length, covering various topics and multiple genres. It provides a platform for students to receive information, broaden their vision, and increase their knowledge in diverse fields. With abundant listening materials in real contexts in English speaking countries, this course helps students grasp basic listening skills, enrich their vocabulary, facilitate their acquisition of spoken English, get updated on hot topics, and increase their exposure to cultures and customs of English speaking countries so as to improve their cross-cultural communicative competence. The course chooses the latest materials and uses multi-media to create a class atmosphere that is authentic, informative, communicative and recreational. Through study and practice, on the basis of solidifying their knowledge of phonetics and recognizing variants of sounds, students are instructed to understand short conversations, stories with simple plot, lectures of appropriate speaking rate, short news reports， and English in other situations. They can also recognize the main idea, identify details, accomplish dictation and rephrasing, and take notes of important messages. The grading system consists of class participation and the final examination.

default.zh: 英语听力（2） 课程中文简介 一、课程基本信息 课程代码：22FL22133 课程名称：英语听力（2） 总学时：64 理论学时：64 学分：4.0 开课单位：外国语学院 授课对象：英语专业第二学士学位学生 开课学期：1春 先修课程：英语听力(1) 二、课程简介 英语听力（2）是为英语专业第二学士学位学生开设的专业基础课程，旨在帮助学生巩固已有的语音知识和听力技巧，学习新的听力技能和听力理解方法，听懂相较于英语听力（1）难度稍大、语速稍快、篇幅稍长的各种题材和体裁的英语材料，以帮助学生利用英语获取信息，开阔眼界，提高归纳总结、逻辑分析和甄别批判能力。该课程通过倾听大量符合英语国家现实语境的材料，帮助学生掌握和操练听力技巧，累积词汇，熟悉热门话题，了解英语国家的文化和习俗，提高跨文化交际能力和思辨能力。本课程利用多媒体手段辅助教学，选取最具时效性的听音材料，创造融真实性、知识性、交际性和趣味性为一体的课堂教学氛围，指导学生熟悉各种英语变体和语调，听懂中等难度的日常英语对话、采访、故事、演讲、新闻和其它场景的英语材料， 完成概括大意、辨认细节、复述要义、速记信息和列提纲等听力任务。本课程的考核采用累加式评价，涵盖课堂表现、作业、测验和期末考试。
default.en: Introduction to [English Listening (2)] 1. General Information Course Code：22FL22133 Course Title：English Listening (2) Credit Hours：64 Lecture：64 Credit(s)：4.0 Offering Department: School of International Studies Students: Second Degree English Majors Term: Spring, First Year Prerequisites: Listening Critically: Work and Life 2. Course Description English Listening (2) is a basic training course for Second Degree English Majors. It aims to solidify students’ knowledge of phonetics and listening skills and to learn new strategies of listening comprehension so as to understand English materials of higher level, faster speaking rate, and greater length than those in English Listening (1), covering various topics and multiple genres. It provides a platform for students to receive information, broaden their vision, and improve their ability of summarization, analysis and critical thinking. With abundant listening materials in real contexts in English speaking countries, this course helps students practise and grasp listening skills, enrich their vocabulary, get updated on hot topics, and increase their exposure to cultures and customs of English speaking countries so as to improve their cross-cultural communicative competence and critical thinking. The course chooses the latest materials and uses multi-media to create a class atmosphere that is authentic, informative, communicative and recreational. Through study and practice, familiarized with different variants and intonations, students are instructed to understand conversations, stories, interviews, lectures, news reports, and English in other situations featured by moderate speaking rate and length. They can also accomplish the tasks of recognizing the main idea, identifying details, retelling, notetaking, and outlining. The grading system consists of class participation, homework, quizzes, and the final examination.

default.zh: 英语基础写作是英语专业（第二学士学位）的必修课,旨在培养学生用英语写作的习惯，鼓励学生利用英语的交际功能，通过写作表达思想。学生将在用词、语法、句法、段落、修辞等不同层面了解英语写作的特点，掌握英语写作统一性、连贯性和充实性等基本原则、不同文体类型的英语的语言和结构特征及英汉书面语表达上的异同；培养学生掌握写故事概要的要领，用自己的话写出约150字的主要情节；使他们掌握段落的基本结构以及写作要领，就有关自己的生活和经历写出格式规范、内容充实、语言基本流畅、含有约150个字的完整的段落；使他们学会写常用的便条以及有关校园活动的通知。
default.en: Basic English Writing is a compulsory course for English majors (second bachelor’s degree), aiming to cultivate students’ habits of writing in English, encourage them to utilize the communicative functions of English, and express their thoughts through writing. Students will acquire an understanding of the characteristics of English writing at various levels, such as vocabulary, grammar, syntax, paragraphs, and rhetoric. They will also master the fundamental principles of unity, coherence, and richness in English writing, as well as the language and structural features of different genres and the similarities and differences between English and Chinese written expressions. The course aims to train students in grasping the essentials of writing story outlines, using their own words to write a main plot of about 150 words. Additionally, students will acquire the basic structure and writing techniques of paragraphs, enabling them to write well-structured, content-rich, linguistically fluent paragraphs of approximately 150 words, focusing on their own lives and experiences. Finally, students will learn how to write commonly used notes and campus activity announcements.

default.zh: 英语学术写作是英语第二学位的专业必修课，是学生撰写毕业论文和学术期刊论文的基础。课程主要讲授学术论文写作方法，重点是使学生掌握现代语言学会（MLA)和美国心理学会(APA)的学术论文格式，掌握如何按照学术写作规范确定文章结构并陈述主要观点。本课程结合英语专业本科毕业论文写作规范，主要内容包括选择题目、查阅和筛选文献资料、文体与格式、论文主要观点、提纲和行文、APA和MLA格式、摘要、关键词和绪论、正文主要章节、结论和参考文献。
default.en: Academic English Writing is a compulsive course for English major students, and also the foundation of writing graduation thesis and articles in academic journals. This course provides students with the skills and techniques of writing academic papers. The students will master MLA and APA style, and learn how to organize the structure and express the main points of an academic paper. This course collaborates with the writing standard of English major thesis, and the contents cover subject selection, retrieving references, genre and format, thesis statement, contents, APA and MLA style, abstract, key words, introduction, main body, conclusion and references.

default.zh: 高级英语是英语专业（第二学士学位）二年级秋季学期的专业基础课。课程目标将价值塑造、知识传授和能力培养融为一体。本课程主要传授学生英语语言知识和国内外文化知识，在开展听说读写译等活动的过程中，引导学生全面分析阅读材料，理解所读文章的背景知识，掌握篇章结构、写作特点和语言知识，理解文章蕴含的深层次意义。课程旨在提升学生的高阶阅读能力、写作能力、翻译能力、口语表达能力和思辨能力。 本课程采用累加式考核方式，考核环节包括课堂表现、测验、作业和期末考试等。
default.en: Advanced English is a course for English minor students in the second year. The course integrates value shaping, knowledge imparting, and skill development as its objectives. It mainly focuses on teaching students English language and cultural knowledge from both domestic and international perspectives. Through activities such as listening, speaking, reading, writing, and translation, it guides students to comprehensively analyze reading materials, understand the background knowledge of the articles, master text structure, writing characteristics, and linguistic knowledge, and comprehend the deep meanings contained within the articles. The course aims to enhance students’ advanced reading, writing, translation, oral expression, and critical thinking abilities. This course adopts an accumulative evaluation method, which includes class performance, quizzes, assignments, and a final examination.

default.zh: 英语高级听力是英语专业二年级学生专业必修课，对培养学生语言综合使用能力和培养学生获取和更新专业知识的能力。通过对不同体裁和不同语速的英语语音材料的学习和理解，使学生能够逐渐无障碍地通过语音输入得到准确信息，并达到进一步理解、交流和学习的目的，并为学习后续课程打下坚实的基础。本课程在英语听力(2)的基础上，进一步培养学生对所听材料进行预测、分析、判断、归纳，领会说话人的态度、感情和意图的能力，使学生进一步正确掌握语音，熟悉各种英语变体，听懂正常语速的，有关政治、经济、文化、教育、科技等英语新闻、演讲等语音材料。通过本课程的学习学生可以进一步掌握英语语言发音规律，词语在句子中的轻重读规律及词语连读规律；了解和熟悉课文背景知识，了解和熟悉相关人文社会科学知识及数学与自然科学知识，了解和熟悉相关国家社会、历史与文化知识；获取对所听语言信息的综合分析能力，通过理解背景知识和上下文逻辑关系理解整片语言的信息；获取跨文化交际能力和思辨能力，能够结合中国文化和国情对所听信息进行批判性理解，对作者的观点进行批判性分析和解读。具有获取和更新专业知识的能力，能够利用所听到的信息补充知识储存。本课的考核方法包括课下完成对听力内容的精听、课上的积极参与和期末考试。
default.en: Advanced English Listening is a required course for second year English major students. Continued from Listening II, it aims to train students to use English as a tool to gain more knowledge related to their special fields and it further facilities students to gradually be able to obtain precise information through aural input, so that they can understand, communicate with and learn about the language, which will form a firm foundation for their future studies. This course helps student learn to predict, analyze, make judgments about and understand the speakers’ attitudes, emotions and intentions. In addition, they can understand information spoken at different speeds about politics, economy, culture, education, science and technology. Through this course, students can learn more about how English individual words and sentences are correctly pronounced and stressed, grasp the correct way of articulating the words and expressions of the language and learn to understand information through relevant contexts. Meanwhile through vast amount of information input, their background knowledge about English and many other related fields will be broadened, and they will also learn to make their own critical judgments about what they are hearing. The final grades of the course will include how well students finish the listening assignments, how well they participate in the class and their performance in the final examination.

default.zh: 英语演讲课面向英语第二学位的本科生开课，是一门综合技能必修课，旨在培养学生“说”的能力，训练学生语言表达的连贯性、思维的逻辑性、以及独立思考和思辨能力。课程内容分为基础理论、实例分析和实践三个环节，注重学生的实际演练，着重训练三种类型的演讲—自我介绍、信息性演讲和说服性演讲。课程讲授公共演讲的基本知识和技巧，包括英语演讲的选题、确立演讲主题、谋篇布局的方法，演讲稿的撰写和分析，同时也训练学生在演讲过程中对身体语言的使用，例如姿态、眼神、动作等。本课程考试成绩采用累加式，包括课堂演讲、平时测验和期末笔试。
default.en: English Public Speaking is a course for the second-year students of the English Department. It is a comprehensive skill-training course, aiming to develop the students’ “speaking” skills through the training of language use, logic and independent and critical thinking ability. It consists of three parts: theory introduction, speech analysis and speech practice, and will focus on applying the principles of public speaking to three types of speeches, namely self-introductory speeches, informative speeches and persuasive speeches. It will lead the students to explore how to choose a topic, how to decide on the theme, how to organize the speech, how to analyze a speech and how to deliver a prepared speech. Meanwhile the non-verbal factors will also be dealt with in class, such as gestures, eye-contact and hand movements. The evaluation of the course consists of three parts: speeches, quizzes and the final exam.

default.zh: 英汉笔译是英语专业（第二学士学位）的专业必修课，对于培养学生的对翻译的基本认识，翻译技巧有很重要的意义。学生通过对翻译基础的全面分析，理解翻译的要求，掌握英汉翻译的基本技巧。本课程将提高学生的翻译能力以及相关技能的运用水平，为其学习后续课程打下坚实的基础。本课程的目的是让学生掌握翻译的基本原理，并通过大量的实践，具备一定的翻译能力，掌握不同文体（主要是应用文体）的英汉翻译的基本特点和技巧，最后能够借助字典翻译一般难度的文章。本课程的主要内容包括英语和汉语之间的差别，如形合与意合等；翻译的基本原理、标准、技巧，如增词、减词、转换等；不同层次的翻译，如词语层、句子层、段落层、篇章层等；不同文体的翻译，如文学文体、科技文体、旅游文体、新闻文体、广告文体等。学习本课程，学生需将翻译理论与翻译实践紧密结合，进而掌握翻译基本原理、不同文体（主要为应用文体）英汉翻译基本特点、不同文体英汉翻译的技巧。本课程将通过大量实践培养学生翻译能力，让其学习英译汉的技巧、层次、难点、疑点、文体、译文质量评估等相关知识，并采用启发式、互动式教学法，培养学生独立思考、分析问题和解决问题的能力。
default.en: English-Chinese Translation is a required course for English majors pursuing a second bachelor’s degree, which holds significant importance in cultivating students’ basic understanding of translation and translation skills. Through a comprehensive analysis of translation fundamentals, students will grasp the essential requirements and fundamental skills of English-Chinese translation. This course aims to improve students’ translation ability and application of related skills, laying a solid foundation for subsequent courses. The course aims to enable students to master the basic principles of translation, acquire certain translation capabilities through extensive practice, and grasp the basic characteristics and techniques of English-Chinese translation in different genres, primarily focusing on applied text types. By the end of this course, students will be able to translate general difficulty articles with the aid of a dictionary. The course covers a wide range of topics, including differences between English and Chinese, such as formalization and semantic unification, basic principles, standards, and skills of translation, such as insertion, deletion, and transformation, translation at different levels, such as word level, sentence level, paragraph level, and discourse level, and the translation of different genres, such as literary style, technical style, tourism style, news style, and advertising style. When learning this course, students need to closely combine translation theory with translation practice, thereby mastering the basic principles of translation and the fundamental characteristics and skills of English-Chinese translation in different genres, mainly applied text types. The course will foster students’ translation ability in extensive practice, enabling them to learn the skills, levels, difficulties, ambiguities, genres, and quality assessment of English-Chinese translation, and adopt heuristic and interactive teaching methods, cultivating students’ independent thinking, problem analysis, and resolution abilities.

default.zh: 法语 1 作为中法数学菁英班法语选修体系的第一阶段课程，以培养学生运用法语开展专业学习与国际学术交流的核心能力为导向。课程聚焦数学法语语法的继续学习与学术跨文化能力提升，实现听说读写全维度进阶。本课程在教授专业法语知识、法语国家文化知识，构建法语语言知识体系以及中西方文化知识体系的同时，培养学生掌握相关人文社会科学知识、语言综合使用能力、跨文化交流能力及思辨能力。
default.en: French 1, as the first stage of the French elective system of the Sino-French Mathematics Elite Programme, is oriented to the development of students' core competence in the use of French in their professional studies and international academic exchanges. The course focuses on the further study of French grammar in mathematics and the improvement of academic intercultural competence, and achieves the full-dimensional advancement of listening, reading, writing and speaking. The course teaches professional French knowledge, knowledge of French-speaking countries and cultures, and builds a knowledge system of the French language as well as knowledge systems of Chinese and Western cultures, while at the same time cultivating students' knowledge of relevant humanities and social sciences, their ability to use the language in an integrated manner, and their ability to communicate cross-culturally and to think critically.

The course focuses on the further study of French grammar in mathematics and the improvement of academic intercultural competence, and achieves the full-dimensional advancement of listening, reading, writing and speaking. The course teaches professional French knowledge, knowledge of French-speaking countries and cultures, and builds a knowledge system of the French language as well as knowledge systems of Chinese and Western cultures, while at the same time cultivating students' knowledge of relevant humanities and social sciences, their ability to use the language in an integrated manner, and their ability to communicate cross-culturally and to think critically.

default.zh: 法语选修 4 作为中法数学菁英班法语选修体系的第四阶段课程，以培养学生运用法语开展专业学习与国际学术交流的核心能力为导向。课程聚焦数学法语语法的继续学习与学术跨文化能力提升，实现听说读写全维度进阶。本课程在教授专业法语知识、法语国家文化知识，构建法语语言知识体系以及中西方文化知识体系的同时，培养学生掌握相关人文社会科学知识、语言综合使用能力、跨文化交流能力及思辨能力。
default.en: French elective 4, as the fourth stage of the French elective system of the Sino-French Mathematics Elite Programme, is oriented to the development of students' core competence in the use of French in their professional studies and international academic exchanges. The course focuses on the further study of French grammar in mathematics and the improvement of academic intercultural competence, and achieves the full-dimensional advancement of listening, reading, writing and speaking. The course teaches professional French knowledge, knowledge of French-speaking countries and cultures, and builds a knowledge system of the French language as well as knowledge systems of Chinese and Western cultures, while at the same time cultivating students' knowledge of relevant humanities and social sciences, their ability to use the language in an integrated manner, and their ability to communicate cross-culturally and to think critically.

default.zh: 《基础俄语（3）》是俄语专业二年级学生的专业课，旨在使学生熟练朗读俄语的同时，进一步加强语法、词汇等基础知识的学习，具有听、说、读、写、译的基本技能和初步的言语交际能力，掌握俄罗斯国情文化知识，从而为提高阶段的学习奠定坚实的基础。 本课程是基础阶段重要的言语训练时期，应做到听、说、读、写、译全面发展。为贯彻交际性原则，本阶段听说训练占突出位置，重视培养学生的言语交际能力。课堂上应使学生有尽量多的听说实践，提升语音、音调素质，逐步提高言语质量。同时也要重视读、译和写的训练，培养阅读习惯，加大词汇量，逐步增加阅读量，提高阅读速度，使阅读成为学生获取知识的主要途径之一；培养学生正确理解俄语语义的能力，对比分析俄汉两种语言表达上的差异，掌握简单的互译技巧；进行严格的笔语训练，使学生能够运用所学的词语、语句等手段表达较为复杂的思想， 及早解决思想丰富而表达匮乏的矛盾逐步提高书面表达思想的能力。此阶段教学注重听、说、读、写、译能力的综合训练，全面发展，正确处理口语与笔语、理解与表达、准确与熟练的关系，进一步培养学生独立学习的能力。
default.en: Practice Russian （3） is a professional compulsory course of the second year of Russian majors. It aims to enable students to read Russian fluently and to further strengthen the learning of basic knowledge such as grammar and vocabulary, to develop students' basic skills in listening, speaking, reading, writing and translation, initial verbal communication skills and general knowledge of Russian national conditions, so as to lay a solid foundation for the study of the enhancement phase. This course is an important period of speech training in the basic stage, to comprehensively develop listening, speaking, reading, writing, and translation. Teaching must pay attention to comprehensive training of listening, speaking, reading, writing, translation ability. In order to implement the communicative principle, listening and speaking training occupies a prominent position in this stage, and attaches great importance to the cultivation of students' verbal communicative ability. In class, students should have as much listening and speaking practice as possible, improve pronunciation, tone quality, and gradually improve the quality of speech. At the same time, we should also pay attention to the training of reading, translation and writing, cultivate the reading habit, increase the vocabulary, gradually increase the amount of reading, improve reading speed, so that reading becomes one of the main ways for students to acquire knowledge. Cultivate students' ability to correctly understand Russian semantics, compare and analyze the differences in expression between Russian and Chinese, and master simple translation skills; Strict pen language training enables students to express more complex thoughts with the words and sentences they have learned, solve the contradiction of rich thoughts and lack of expression as early as possible, and gradually improve the ability to express thoughts in writing, comprehensive development, and correct handling of relationship between spoken and written language, understanding and expression, accurate and skilled, Further cultivate students' ability of independent study.

default.zh: 本课程通过训练俄语初学者的听力和口语表达能力，全面发展学生的俄语语言能力、俄语交际能力和俄语综合运用能力，提高学生的语言表达兴趣和准确接收、理解及输出俄语信息的技能。在授课的同时教授学生现代俄语语言的应用能力，培养学生的自主学习的能力。通过以标准语音为基础的句型学习、课文朗读、对话互动与文本听写，提高学生听、说、读、写的各项俄语微技能，以及熟练运用俄语进行社会交际的综合实践能力。
default.en: This course aims to train students' listening and oral expression abilities, comprehensively develop their Russian language ability, Russian communication ability, and comprehensive Russian application ability, improve their language expression interest, and accurately receive, understand, and output Russian information skills. Teach students the application ability of modern Russian language while teaching, and cultivate students' autonomous learning ability. Through sentence pattern learning based on standard pronunciation, text reading, dialogue interaction, and text dictation, students can improve their various Russian micro skills in listening, speaking, reading, and writing, as well as their comprehensive practical ability to skillfully use Russian for social communication.

default.zh: 俄语口语（3）是俄语专业二年级学生的专业基础课，在培养学生形成扎实的俄语听说能力方面占重要的地位。本课程通过教授标准的俄语语音语调、基本词汇、基本俄语句型及典型情境中的对话，将培养学生过硬的俄语语言基本功和实际运用语言的能力，提高俄语会话技能，为其学习后续课程、通过俄语专业四、八级考试打下坚实的基础。
default.en: Spoken Russian (3) is a professional basic course for sophomores majoring in Russian, and plays an important role in cultivating students' solid Russian listening and speaking abilities. By teaching standard Russian pronunciation and intonation, basic vocabulary, basic Russian sentence patterns, and dialogues in typical situations, this course will cultivate students' excellent basic Russian language skills and practical ability to use the language, improve their Russian conversational skills, and lay a solid foundation for their learning of subsequent courses and passing the Russian language majors' Band 4 and Band 8 exams.

default.zh: 《俄语实践语法（3）》是俄语专业二年级学生的专业必修课，在讲授基础语言知识和提高学生语言表达准确性方面起到重要作用。教学过程中采取多媒体教学法和互动式教学法，为学生提供准确、直观的语法范例，深入详尽地讲解各种俄语词法、句法项目，同时指导学生进行大量的语法实践练习，力求将语法知识学习与技能训练相结合，不仅帮助学生牢固掌握最基本的语法知识，而且致力于提高学生灵活运用所学语言知识的能力，提升学生的言语质量，提高口头和书面表达的准确性，为中、高级阶段的俄语学习打下坚实的基础。
default.en: 《Practical Russian Grammar（3）》is a compulsory course for second-year students majoring in Russian, which plays an important role in teaching basic language knowledge and improving the accuracy of language expression. The teaching process adopts multimedia teaching method and interactive teaching method. Provide students with accurate and intuitive examples of grammar, in-depth and detailed explanation of various Russian lexical, syntactic projects, meanwhile guide students to practice a lot of grammar practice, and try to combine grammar knowledge with skill training. This course not only help students to master the most basic grammatical knowledge, but also improves students' ability of flexible use of the language knowledge, the quality of the words of the students, and the accuracy of the oral and written expression, and lays a solid foundation for the middle and advanced stage of Russian learning.

default.zh: 《俄语实践语法（2）》是俄语专业一年级学生的必修课，在培养学生俄语语言基础知识方面占有重要地位。通过对俄语词类基本知识和各类句子结构模式的讲解和训练，学生要在运用各类句子模式的过程中逐步掌握词的构形熟巧，并在常用的简单句和复合句句子模式的范围内，熟练进行句式转换，提高语言运用能力。本课程主要传授学生俄语语法基础知识，通过大量练习把讲授的语法基础知识转化为语言技能, 为支撑专业学习成果中相应指标点的达成打下基础。
default.en: “Practice Russian grammar（2）” is a compulsory course for first-grade students majoring in Russian and plays an important role in cultivating students' basic knowledge of Russian language. Through the explanation and training of the basic knowledge of Russian word class and the structure of various sentences, students should master and perfect the construction of words in the process of using various sentence patterns, and in the commonly used simple sentences and compound sentences pattern scope develop proficiency in the sentence conversion, improve language skills. This course mainly teaches students the basic knowledge of Russian grammar, and converts the basic knowledge of grammar taught into language skills through a large amount of practice, laying a foundation for supporting the achievement of corresponding indicators in professional learning outcomes.

default.zh: 《基础俄语（4）》是俄语专业二年级学生的专业课，本课程在提高学生语言基本功，培养实际运用语言的能力，提升学生的语篇交际能力等方面占重要的地位。本课程将提高学生对课文的鉴赏能力、提高相关技能的运用水平。通过对阅读材料的全面分析，学生理解所读文章的背景知识、文章体裁、写作特点、语言知识，理解文章蕴含的深层次意义。在一般社会文化、历史、人文、环境和科技等题材范围内教授最常用的词语和句式，培养学生听说读写言语技能，发展叙述的交际能力，同时侧重独白能力的培养，为其学习后续课程打下坚实的基础。
default.en: Basic Russian（4）is a professional course of the second year of Russian majors. This course plays an important role in improving the basic skills of students, cultivating practical ability to use language, and improving students’ discourse competence ability. This course will improve students' appreciation of the text and improve the level of relevant skills. Through the comprehensive analysis of reading materials, students understand the background knowledge of the article, article genre, writing characteristics, language knowledge and the deep implication of the article. In the general social culture, history, humanities, environment and science and technology within the scope of the subject to teach the most commonly used words and sentences, to train students’ speech skills of listening, speaking, reading and writing, and develop their narrative communication skills. At the same time, it focuses on the cultivation of monologue ability, and lays a solid foundation for their follow-up courses. This course includes practice hours and extracurricular tutoring hours.

default.zh: 本课程通过训练学生的听力和口语表达能力，全面发展学生的俄语语言能力、俄语交际能力和俄语综合运用能力，提高学生的语言表达兴趣和准确接收、理解及输出俄语信息的技能。在授课的同时教授学生现代俄语语言的应用能力，培养学生的自主学习的能力。通过以标准语音为基础的句型学习、课文朗读、对话互动与文本听写，提高学生听、说、读、写的各项俄语微技能，以及熟练运用俄语进行社会交际的综合实践能力。
default.en: This course aims to comprehensively develop students' Russian language ability, Russian communication ability, and comprehensive Russian application ability by training Russian beginners' listening and oral expression abilities, and improve students' interest in language expression and skills of accurately receiving, understanding, and outputting Russian information. Teach students the application ability of modern Russian language while teaching, and cultivate students' autonomous learning ability. Through sentence pattern learning based on standard pronunciation, text reading, dialogue interaction, and text dictation, students can improve their various Russian micro skills in listening, speaking, reading, and writing, as well as their comprehensive practical ability to skillfully use Russian for social communication.

default.zh: 俄语口语（4）是俄语专业二年级学生的专业基础课，在培养学生形成扎实的俄语听说能力方面占重要的地位。本课程通过教授标准的俄语语音语调、基本词汇、基本俄语句型及典型情境中的对话、独白，将培养学生过硬的俄语语言基本功和实际运用语言的能力，提高俄语会话和叙述能力，为其学习后续课程、通过俄语专业八级考试打下坚实的基础。
default.en: Spoken Russian (4) is a professional basic course for sophomores majoring in Russian, and plays an important role in cultivating students' solid Russian listening and speaking abilities. By teaching standard Russian pronunciation and intonation, basic vocabulary, basic Russian sentence patterns, and dialogues and monologues in typical situations, this course will cultivate students' excellent basic skills in the Russian language and their ability to actually use the language, improve their conversational and narrative skills in Russian, and lay a solid foundation for their learning of subsequent courses and passing the Band 8 examination for Russian majors.

default.zh: 俄语实践语法（4）是俄语专业二年级学生的专业必修课，在讲授基础语言知识和提高学生语言表达准确性方面起到重要作用。教学过程中采取多媒体教学法和互动式教学法，为学生提供准确、直观的语法范例，深入详尽地讲解各种俄语词法、句法项目，同时指导学生进行大量的语法实践练习，力求将语法知识学习与技能训练相结合，不仅帮助学生牢固掌握最基本的语法知识，而且致力于提高学生灵活运用所学语言知识的能力，提升学生的言语质量，提高口头和书面表达的准确性，为中、高级阶段的俄语学习打下坚实的基础。
default.en: 《Practical Russian Grammar（4）》is a compulsory course for second-year students majoring in Russian, which plays an important role in teaching basic language knowledge and improving the accuracy of language expression. The teaching process adopts multimedia teaching method and interactive teaching method. Provide students with accurate and intuitive examples of grammar, in-depth and detailed explanation of various Russian lexical, syntactic projects, meanwhile guide students to practice a lot of grammar practice, and try to combine grammar knowledge with skill training. This course not only help students to master the most basic grammatical knowledge, but also improves students' ability of flexible use of the language knowledge, the quality of the words of the students, and the accuracy of the oral and written expression, and lays a solid foundation for the middle and advanced stage of Russian learning.

default.zh: 俄语口语（2）是俄语专业低年级学生的专业基础课，在培养学生形成初步的俄语听说能力方面占重要的地位。本课程通过教授标准的俄语语音语调、基本词汇、基本俄语句型及典型情境中的对话，将培养学生的俄语语言基本功和实际运用语言的能力，提高俄语会话技能，为其学习后续课程、通过俄语专业四、八级考试打下坚实的基础。
default.en: Spoken Russian (2) is a professional basic course for junior students majoring in Russian, and plays an important role in cultivating students' preliminary listening and speaking abilities in Russian. By teaching standard Russian pronunciation and intonation, basic vocabulary, basic Russian sentence patterns, and dialogues in typical situations, this course will cultivate students' basic Russian language skills and practical ability to use the language, improve their Russian conversational skills, and lay a solid foundation for their learning of subsequent courses and passing the Russian Specialized Test Band 4 and Band 8.

default.zh: 高级俄语（1）是俄语专业高年级学生的必修课，该课程既是学生通过与教师、同学的共同活动，逐步掌握俄语知识和技能的学习过程，又是学生在俄语学习实践中磨砺意志、发展思维、陶冶情操、形成个性、开阔国际视野、提高人文素养、培养爱国主义精神的发展过程。本课程将教会学生掌握外语的方法，培养外语思维和解决未来工作可能面临的各种问题的能力，并为其学习后续课程、通过俄语专业八级考试打下坚实的基础。 本课程旨在发展和完善学生的语言基本功，增加词汇量和提高口笔语交际能力。与此同时，还要提高学生对社会、文化、政治、经济、科技等题材文章及近代文艺作品的分析理解能力，并在此基础上着重培养和发展学生的各项语言技能。
default.en: Advanced Russian（1） is a compulsory course for senior students majoring in Russian. The course is not only a learning process for a student who, through the common activities of teachers and students, gradually learns the Russian knowledge and skills, but also a development process for students in Russian learning practice to sharpen the will, develop thinking, cultivate sentiments, form individuality, broaden international vision, improve humanistic quality and cultivate the spirit of patriotism. This course will teach students methods to master foreign language, develop foreign language thinking and the ability to solve the problems that future work may face, and lay a solid foundation for their follow-up courses, and through the Russian major in the eighth grade examinations. This course aims to develop and improve the basic skills of students, increase vocabulary and improve the communicative competence of oral and writing. At the same time, we should also improve students 'ability of analysis and understanding of social, cultural, political, economic, scientific and other essay articles and modern literary and artistic works, and on this basis, focus on cultivating and developing students' language skills.
