default.zh: 本门课程将立足俄罗斯当代生活，从俄语母语者视角出发对俄罗斯的历史、民俗传统、文学文化、教育等多角度进行较为全面的介绍，使俄语系学生对俄罗斯国情有基本了解。
default.en: The course based on contemporary situation in Russia, gives a comprehensive introduction to Russian history, folk traditions, literature and culture, education and other aspects from the perspective of Russian native speakers, so that the junior students of the Russian Department can have a basic understanding of Russia.

default.zh: 《综合俄语1》是为中俄联合校园一年级第一学期开设的一门必修课程，旨在为刚进入大学学习俄语的零起点学生和少数有一定俄语基础的高起点学生打下扎实的语音基础，培养其基本拼写书写能力和拼读朗读能力，同时使学生掌握一定数量的俄语基本词汇和句子的用法，获取最基本的语法知识，熟练掌握最基本的语法变化形式和用法，具备初步的语言基础知识和初步的语言交际能力，掌握一般的俄罗斯国情知识，为其学习后续课程打下坚实的基础。
default.en: Comprehensive Russian 1 is a professional compulsory course offered in the first semester of the first year of Sino-Russian joint campus School of Mathematics and School of Chemistry. This course aims at laying a solid foundation of voice for students who have just entered the Russian language program and a few students with a certain Russian base, developing their basic spelling writing skills and spelling reading skills, meanwhile keeping students in a certain amount of Russian basic vocabulary and the use of the sentence, getting the most basic knowledge of grammar, and master the most basic forms and usage of grammar, with the basic language knowledge and the initial communication skills, to master the general knowledge of the Russian national conditions, and finally laying a solid foundation for their follow-up courses.

default.zh: 《俄语基础语法1》是面向数学、物理专业一年级第一学期开设的一门必修课,专门讲授俄语基本语法知识。授课学时24，课程学分1。 课程旨在使数学、物理专业的学生在俄语学习之初获取最基本的俄语语法知识，构筑俄语语法知识的基本框架，熟练掌握最基本的语法变化形式、特点、用法和规则，同时了解语法规则适用的场景，促进针对语法项目而编排的句型、对话、课文等言语训练内容的学习，为俄语实践教学打下牢固的基础。
default.en: 《Basic Russian Grammer 1》is a a required Russian course offered in the first semester of the first year for the Mathematics major and Physics major freshmen. It is a major course devoted to Russian basic grammar knowledge. The teaching hours are 24, and course credit is 1. This course aims to make students acquire the most basic Russian grammar knowledge in Russian language at the beginning of Russian learning, build the basic framework of Russian grammar knowledge, master the most basic forms of grammatical changes, features, usage and rules, and meanwhile understand grammar rules applicable to the scene, to promote the learning of speech training content organized for grammar items, such as sentence pattern, dialogue, text, etc, lay a solid foundation for the Russian practice teaching.

default.zh: 本课程通过训练俄语初学者的听力和口语表达能力，全面发展学生的俄语语言能力、俄语交际能力和俄语综合运用能力，提高学生的语言表达兴趣和准确接收、理解及输出俄语信息的技能。在授课的同时教授学生现代俄语语言的应用能力，培养学生的自主学习的能力。通过以标准语音为基础的句型学习、课文朗读、对话互动与文本听写，提高学生听、说、读、写的各项俄语微技能，以及熟练运用俄语进行社会交际的综合实践能力。
default.en: This course aims to comprehensively develop students' Russian language ability, Russian communication ability, and comprehensive Russian application ability by training Russian beginners' listening and oral expression abilities, and improve students' interest in language expression and skills of accurately receiving, understanding, and outputting Russian information. Teach students the application ability of modern Russian language while teaching, and cultivate students' autonomous learning ability. Through sentence pattern learning based on standard pronunciation, text reading, dialogue interaction, and text dictation, students can improve their various Russian micro skills in listening, speaking, reading, and writing, as well as their comprehensive practical ability to skillfully use Russian for social communication.

default.zh: 《俄罗斯历史与文化》主要讲授俄罗斯历史和文化的基本知识，并要求课外阅读相关的参考书籍。教材选取外语教学与研究出版社出版的《俄罗斯历史》和《俄罗斯文化》，内容涵盖千余年的俄罗斯历史和文化发展。本课程主要以中文讲授，在学生具备了一定的俄语语言基础之上，辅之以俄文讲授，重点是使学生了解俄罗斯的历史与文化，同时又能对学生进行基础的俄语语言训练，全面提高学生的历史文化素养和语言能力。
default.en: "Russian History and Culture" mainly teaches the basic knowledge of Russian history and culture, and requires extra-curricular reading related reference books. The textbooks are "Russian History" and "Russian Culture" published by the Foreign Language Teaching and Research Press. The content covers more than a thousand years of Russian history and cultural development. This course is mainly taught in Chinese, on the basis that students have a certain foundation of Russian language, supplemented by Russian teaching, the focus is to enable students to understand the history and culture of Russia, and at the same time to provide students with basic Russian language training, comprehensively improve students' historical and cultural literacy and language ability.

default.zh: 本课程通过训练俄语初学者的听力和口语表达能力，全面发展学生的俄语语言能力、俄语交际能力和俄语综合运用能力，提高学生的语言表达兴趣和准确接收、理解及输出俄语信息的技能。在授课的同时教授学生现代俄语语言的应用能力，培养学生的自主学习的能力。通过以标准语音为基础的句型学习、课文朗读、对话互动与文本听写，提高学生听、说、读、写的各项俄语微技能，以及熟练运用俄语进行社会交际的综合实践能力。
default.en: This course aims to train students' listening and oral expression abilities, comprehensively develop their Russian language ability, Russian communication ability, and comprehensive Russian application ability, improve their language expression interest, and accurately receive, understand, and output Russian information skills. Teach students the application ability of modern Russian language while teaching, and cultivate students' autonomous learning ability. Through sentence pattern learning based on standard pronunciation, text reading, dialogue interaction, and text dictation, students can improve their various Russian micro skills in listening, speaking, reading, and writing, as well as their comprehensive practical ability to skillfully use Russian for social communication.

default.zh: 本课程通过训练学生的听力和口语表达能力，全面发展学生的俄语语言能力、俄语交际能力和俄语综合运用能力，提高学生的语言表达兴趣和准确接收、理解及输出俄语信息的技能。在授课的同时教授学生现代俄语语言的应用能力，培养学生的自主学习的能力。通过以标准语音为基础的句型学习、课文朗读、对话互动与文本听写，提高学生听、说、读、写的各项俄语微技能，以及熟练运用俄语进行社会交际的综合实践能力。
default.en: This course aims to comprehensively develop students' Russian language ability, Russian communication ability, and comprehensive Russian application ability by training Russian beginners' listening and oral expression abilities, and improve students' interest in language expression and skills of accurately receiving, understanding, and outputting Russian information. Teach students the application ability of modern Russian language while teaching, and cultivate students' autonomous learning ability. Through sentence pattern learning based on standard pronunciation, text reading, dialogue interaction, and text dictation, students can improve their various Russian micro skills in listening, speaking, reading, and writing, as well as their comprehensive practical ability to skillfully use Russian for social communication.

default.zh: 本课程通过训练学生的听力和口语表达能力，全面发展学生的俄语语言能力、俄语交际能力和俄语综合运用能力，提高学生的语言表达兴趣和准确接收、理解及输出俄语信息的技能。在授课的同时教授学生现代俄语语言的应用能力，培养学生的自主学习的能力。通过以标准语音为基础的句型学习、课文朗读、对话互动与文本听写，提高学生听、说、读、写的各项俄语微技能，以及熟练运用俄语进行社会交际的综合实践能力。
default.en: This course aims to train students' listening and oral expression abilities, comprehensively develop their Russian language ability, Russian communication ability, and comprehensive Russian application ability, improve their language expression interest, and accurately receive, understand, and output Russian information skills. Teach students the application ability of modern Russian language while teaching, and cultivate students' autonomous learning ability. Through sentence pattern learning based on standard pronunciation, text reading, dialogue interaction, and text dictation, students can improve their various Russian micro skills in listening, speaking, reading, and writing, as well as their comprehensive practical ability to skillfully use Russian for social communication.

default.zh: 本课程通过训练学生的专业俄语听力和口语表达能力，全面发展学生的专业俄语语言能力、俄语综合运用能力，提高学生的专业语言表达和准确接收、理解及输出专业俄语信息的技能。在授课的同时教授学生专业俄语语言的应用能力，培养学生的自主学习能力。从飞行器发动机整体结构，到发动机各个部件，以及发动机基本工作原理，本着从易到难、重点突出的原则，提高学生听、说、读、写的各项专业俄语技能，以及熟练运用专业俄语的综合实践能力。
default.en: This course aims to train students in their professional Russian listening and speaking abilities, comprehensively develop their professional Russian language abilities and comprehensive Russian language application abilities, and improve their professional language expression and skills in accurately receiving, understanding, and outputting professional Russian information. Teach students the application ability of professional Russian language while teaching, and cultivate their self-learning ability. From the overall structure of the aircraft engine, to the various components of the engine, as well as the basic working principles of the engine, based on the principle of starting from easy to difficult and highlighting the key points, we aim to improve students' professional Russian skills in listening, speaking, reading, and writing, as well as their comprehensive practical ability to proficiently use professional Russian.

default.zh: 《俄语基础语法1》是面向化学专业一年级第一学期开设的一门必修课,专门讲授俄语基本语法知识。授课学时24，课程学分1。 课程旨在使化学专业的学生在俄语学习之初获取最基本的俄语语法知识，构筑俄语语法知识的基本框架，熟练掌握最基本的语法变化形式、特点、用法和规则，同时了解语法规则适用的场景，促进针对语法项目而编排的句型、对话、课文等言语训练内容的学习，为俄语实践教学打下牢固的基础。
default.en: 《Basic Russian Grammer 1》is a required Russian course offered in the first semester of the first year for the chemistry major freshmen. It is a major course devoted to Russian basic grammar knowledge. The teaching hours are 24, and course credits are 1. This course aims to make students acquire the most basic Russian grammar knowledge in Russian language at the beginning of Russian learning, build the basic framework of Russian grammar knowledge, master the most basic forms of grammatical changes, features, usage and rules, and meanwhile understand grammar rules applicable to the scene, to promote the learning of speech training content organized for grammar items, such as sentence pattern, dialogue, text, etc, lay a solid foundation for the Russian practice teaching.

default.zh: 《综合俄语2》是公共俄语一年级学生第二学期的课程，该课程在整个知识结构中占有重要地位。通过听说读写的全面训练，培养学生的俄语基本功，为其学习后续课程、掌握俄语的实际运用能力打下扎实的基础。本课程的主要目标是使学生在掌握综合俄语1的条件下继续学习俄语语言（语音、语法、词汇）知识，培养学生具有听、说、读、写的基本技能和初步的言语交际能力，掌握一般的俄罗斯国情知识，培养学生具有自主学习获取和更新专业知识的能力。本课程所提供的对话、课文和所涉及到的词汇主要是日常生活题材。
default.en: Comprehensive Russian 2 is a course offered in the second semester of the first year of Public Russian, which occupies an important position throughout the knowledge structure. Through the comprehensive training of listening, speaking, reading and writing, the Russian basic skills of the students are trained to lay a solid foundation for learning the follow-up courses and mastering the actual use of Russian. The main goal of this course is to enable students to continue to learn Russian language (voice, grammar, vocabulary) knowledge under the conditions of mastering Comprehensive Russian 1, and to develop students' basic skills in listening, speaking, reading and writing, initial verbal communication skills and general knowledge of Russian national conditions, to develop the ability of students to independently learn to acquire and update the professional knowledge. The conversation provided in this course, the text and the vocabulary involved are mainly the theme of daily life.

default.zh: 《俄语基础语法2》是中俄联合校园一年级学生的必修课，在培养学生俄语语言基础知识方面占有重要地位。通过对俄语词类基本知识和各类句子结构模式的讲解和训练，学生要在运用各类句子模式的过程中逐步掌握和完善词的构形熟巧，并在常用的简单句和复合句句子模式的范围内，熟练进行句式转换，提高语言运用能力。本课程将使学生熟练掌握俄语语法的形态变化及基本特点，为其后续学习打下基础。
default.en: Basic Russian Grammar 2 is a compulsory course set up for the first-year students jointly trained by China and Russia, which plays an important role in cultivating students' basic knowledge of Russian language. Through the explanation and training of the basic knowledge of Russian speech and various sentence structure modes, students should gradually master and perfect the word formation in the process of using various sentence modes, and proficiently convert sentence patterns in the range of commonly used simple sentences and compound sentences, so as to improve the language application ability. This course will enable students to master the morphological changes and basic characteristics of Russian grammar, and lay a foundation for their subsequent study.

default.zh: 《综合俄语3》是物理学院中俄联合校园二年级学生的必修课，旨在使学生熟练朗读俄语的同时，进一步加强语法、词汇等基础知识的学习，具有听、说、读、写、译的基本技能和初步的言语交际能力，掌握一定的俄罗斯国情文化知识，从而为提高阶段的学习奠定坚实的基础。 本课程是基础阶段重要的言语训练时期，要做到听、说、读、写、译全面发展。教学中必须注重听、说、读、写、译能力的综合训练，全面发展，正确处理口语与笔语，理解与表达，准确与熟练的关系。
default.en: Integrated Russian 3 is a compulsory course for second year students at the Sino-Russian Joint Campus of the Faculty of Physics. It aims to enable students to become proficient in reading Russian aloud while further strengthening their basic knowledge of grammar and vocabulary, to have basic skills in listening, speaking, reading, writing and translation and preliminary communicative skills in speech, and to acquire a certain amount of knowledge of Russian national culture, thus laying a solid foundation for the advanced stage of study.

default.zh: 《俄语基础语法3》是中俄联合校园二年级学生的必修课，在讲授基础语言知识和提高学生语言表达准确性方面起到重要作用。教学过程中采取多媒体教学法和互动式教学法，为学生提供准确、直观的语法范例，深入详尽地讲解各种俄语词法、句法项目，同时指导学生进行大量的语法实践练习，力求将语法知识学习与技能训练相结合，不仅帮助学生牢固掌握最基本的语法知识，而且致力于提高学生灵活运用所学语言知识的能力，提升学生的言语质量，提高口头和书面表达的准确性。
default.en: Basic Russian Grammar 3 is a compulsory course for second-grade students of the Sino-Russian Joint Campus, which plays an important role in teaching basic language knowledge and improving the accuracy of language expression. The teaching process adopts multimedia teaching method and interactive teaching method. Provide students with accurate and intuitive examples of grammar, in-depth and detailed explanation of various Russian lexical, syntactic projects, meanwhile guide students to practice a lot of grammar practice, and try to combine grammar knowledge with skill training. This course not only help students to master the most basic grammatical knowledge, but also improves students' ability of flexible use of the language knowledge, the quality of the words of the students, and the accuracy of the oral and written expression.

default.zh: 《综合俄语4》是物理学院中俄联合校园二年级学生的必修课，本课程在提高学生语言基本功，培养实际运用语言的能力，提升学生的语篇交际能力等方面占重要的地位。本课程将提高学生对课文的鉴赏能力、提高相关技能的运用水平。通过对阅读材料的全面分析，学生理解所读文章的背景知识、文章体裁、写作特点、语言知识，理解文章蕴含的深层次意义。在一般社会文化、历史、人文、环境和科技等题材范围内教授最常用的词语和句式，培养学生听说读写言语技能，发展叙述的交际能力，同时侧重独白语能力的培养，为其学习后续课程打下坚实的基础。
default.en: Integrated Russian 4 is a compulsory course for second year students at the Sino-Russian Joint Campus of the Faculty of Physics. This course occupies an important position in improving students' basic language skills, cultivating the ability to actually use language, and enhancing students' discourse communication skills.This course will improve students' ability to appreciate the text and improve the level of use of related skills.Through a comprehensive analysis of the reading materials, students understand the background knowledge, genre of the article, writing characteristics, and language knowledge of the article they read, and understand the deep meaning of the article.Teach the most commonly used words and sentence patterns within the scope of general social culture, history, humanities, environment, science and technology, cultivate students' listening, speaking, reading, writing and speech skills, and develop narrative communication skills. At the same time, focus on the cultivation of monologue ability, and lay a solid foundation for their follow-up courses.

default.zh: 《俄语基础语法4》是中俄联合校园二年级学生的必修课，在讲授基础语言知识和提高学生语言表达准确性方面起到重要作用。教学过程中采取多媒体教学法和互动式教学法，为学生提供准确、直观的语法范例，深入详尽地讲解各种俄语词法、句法项目，同时指导学生进行大量的语法实践练习，力求将语法知识学习与技能训练相结合，不仅帮助学生牢固掌握最基本的语法知识，而且致力于提高学生灵活运用所学语言知识的能力，提升学生的言语质量，提高口头和书面表达的准确性，为中、高级阶段的俄语学习打下坚实的基础。
default.en: Russian Basic Grammar 4 is a compulsory course for second-grade students of the Sino-Russian Joint Campus, which plays an important role in teaching basic language knowledge and improving the accuracy of students' language expression. Through the detailed explanation and drilling of Russian lexical and syntactic projects, students can firmly master the most basic grammar knowledge. In addition, this course strives to combine grammar knowledge learning with skills training, improve students' ability to flexibly use the language knowledge they have learned, improve students' speech quality, and lay a solid foundation for Russian learning in the middle and advanced stages.

default.zh: 《法汉/汉法翻译》课程的目的是让学生了解基本的翻译原理，在翻译原理的指导之上，通过大量的实践，掌握一定的翻译能力，掌握不同文体的法汉/汉法翻译的基本特点和技巧。其预期目标是能够借助工具字典翻译一般难度的文章。 汉法翻译实践涉及汉语语言的运用，对于法语专业的学生来说，显然可以弥补他们在汉语学习方面的不足。另外，加强学生汉语能力的培养也有助于对学生进行思想教育，提高对本族语语言文化的认识、了解和理解。而且，对汉语语言文化的了解更有助于提高学生的语言潜能，从而使学生能够更有效地学习法语。
default.en: French-Chinese/Chinese-French Translation, The purpose of this course is to let students understand the basic principles of translation, on the guidance of translation principles, through a lot of practice, master certain translation ability, the basic characteristics and skills of different styles of French-Chinese/Chinese-French translation. The intended goal is to be able to translate articles of average difficulty with the help of a tool dictionary. Chinese-french translation practice involves the use of The Chinese language, and for French majors, it can obviously make up for their deficiencies in Chinese learning. In addition, strengthening the cultivation of students' Chinese ability can also help students to carry out ideological education and improve their knowledge, understanding and understanding of their own language and culture. Moreover, the understanding of Chinese language and culture is more conducive to improving students' language potential, so that students can learn French more effectively.

default.zh: 《基础俄语（1）》是国际组织与全球治理专业选修课。课程主要分为语音导论和基础课两部分，通过语音语调的讲解与练习培养学生的俄语阅读、听辨能力。基础课采用讲授+练习的教学模式，讲解俄语语法现象，通过语篇阅读、对话、问答、翻译等形式进行课堂练习，巩固语法知识，培养学生的俄语听、说、读、写等综合语言能力。拓展俄语国家语言、文化、历史等知识，培养学生的语言沟通能力、跨文化交际能力。
default.en: Basic Russian (1) is an elective course in International Organizations and Global Governance. The course is mainly divided into two parts: introduction to phonetics and basic class, which develops students' Russian reading and listening skills through phonetic intonation lectures and exercises. The basic course adopts the teaching mode of lecture + practice, explaining Russian grammatical phenomena and conducting class exercises in the form of discourse reading, dialogue, Q&A and translation to consolidate grammatical knowledge and develop students' comprehensive language skills in Russian listening, speaking, reading and writing. The course expands knowledge of the language, culture and history of Russian-speaking countries, and develops students' language communication skills and cross-cultural communication skills.

default.zh: 《基础日语（1）》是为国际组织与全球治理专业本科大三学生开设的选修课。通过听、说、读、写、译等基本训练，使学生掌握日语入门阶段的基础知识、基本技能及日语学习策略，为进一步学习日语打下良好的基础。本阶段课程主要讲授日语语音，基础语法。内容包括语音知识和基本句式的判断句、「こそあど」系列词的用法、描写句，涉及名词、形容词等基础语法现象。为初级阶段学习打下良好的基础，通过本课程的学习，学生的各项技能应达到《大学日语第二外语教学大纲》（非日语专业本科用）所描述的能力要求。课程采取累加式考核方式，包括课堂表现和课后作业20%，课堂贡献10%，期末考查70%。
default.en: Basic Japanese (1) is an elective course for junior students majoring in International Organizations and Global Governance. Through elementary training in listening, speaking, reading, writing, and translating and so on, students shall master the basic knowledge, fundamental language skills, and learning strategy of Japanese, so as to lay a solid foundation for further Japanese learning. The course is mainly about Japanese phonology and basic grammer, including the phonological knowledge, the basic sentence patterns, the use of the word「こそあど」and its derivatives, the descriptive sentences, and basic grammatical phenomena such as nouns, adjectives and so on. By the end of the course, the Japanese skills of students shall be up to the standard of The Syllabus of College Japanese as a Second Language (for non-Japanese majors). The course adopts the cumulative assessment method, including 30% assessment at ordinary time（Classroom performance and homework after class are 20%, Classroom contribution is 10%）and 70% of the final grades.

default.zh: 《基础德语（一）》是国际组织与全球治理专业限选课。本课程主要讲授德语语音、德语简单常用词汇、德语入门语法知识，指导学生学习德语的初阶语法、日常生活简单场景下的基本词汇和套用句型，初步了解德语国家国情与文化，为培养中德跨文化交际能力打下基础。通过本课程的学习，学生能够熟练使用德语日常交际的词汇、表达方式和句法，有助于学生在国际组织工作，使他们更快地融入国际组织。
default.en: Basic German (1) is a elective course for international Organizations and Global Governance. This course mainly teaches German phonetics, simple common German vocabulary and introduction to German grammar, instructs students to learn the elementary Grammar of German, basic vocabulary and sentence patterns in simple situations of daily life, preliminarily understand the national conditions and culture of German-speaking countries, and lays a foundation for the cultivation of German intercultural communication ability. Through the study of this course, students can skillfully use the vocabulary, expressions and syntax of daily communication in German, which will help students to work in international organizations and integrate into international organizations faster.

default.zh: 国际组织文秘实务是国际组织与全球治理专业的选修课，本课程的教学目的在于传授学生在国际组织中用英语从事文秘工作和其他人力资源相关工作所需要的基本知识，使学生掌握与文秘、公关、人力资源管理等工作职位相关的基本知识和技能。教学内容涉及较低层次的办公室工作职责、秘书职责、商务礼仪、会议组织、电话英语、文件归档等内容和较高层次的市场调查、公共关系、人力资源管理、工作面试、领导力等。本课程培养学生文秘英语的口头表达能力和各种办公室文书的撰写能力，具体包括电话留言、文件归档表格、会议日程安排、会议记录、市场调查计划、公关策划、人力资源管理计划等文件的撰写。课程通过一系列的讲座、研讨和项目培养学生的分析问题能力、解决问题能力、辩证思考问题能力、创造性思维能力和团队工作能力。
default.en: Secretarial Practice in International Organizations is an elective course for the major of International Relations and International Organizations. It aims to provide students with the knowledge of secretarial occupation and other jobs related to human resources. Students are to mater the knowledge and skills of secretaries, public relations and human resources. It informs students of the beginning level knowledge such as the role and scope of secretaries, business etiquette, meeting organizations, telephone English and filing, and the advanced level knowledge such as marketing research, public relations, human resources management, job interview and leadership. This course focuses on improving students' oral proficiency of secretarial English and written skills of office documents such as telephone message, filing forms, meeting agenda, meeting minutes, marketing research plan, public relations scheme and human resources management scheme. Students will develop their competence of analyzing questions, solving questions, critical thinking, creative thinking and team work through a series of lectures, seminars and projects.

default.zh: 《国际组织文献阅读》是国际组织与全球治理专业所设考查课程之一。本课程将国际组织文献视为国际组织及其所承载的政治、经济、文化、意识形态等意义的符号载体以及国际组织开展活动和施加影响力的主要媒介手段，在培养学生语篇理解能力、训练学生正确运用语篇阅读策略的基础上，引导学生认识和分析各类文献体裁，深度理解文献的语篇意义，通过比较和语境分析对文献开展批判性阅读，通过文献阅读促进学生对国际组织、国际关系产生深刻的认识，为未来从事以语言为媒介的相关国际组织工作打下基础。课程内容涉及国际组织文献概况、文献阅读基本能力训练、主要文献类别的学习和阅读实践等。
default.en: Reading International Organization Documents and Writings is an elective course for students majoring in International Organizations and Global Governance. The course builds on the conception of international organization documents (IODs) as part and parcel of a semiotic system in which political, economic, cultural and ideological meanings represented by international organizations are activated and propagated, with IODs employed as a primary medium of communication that enables the international organizations to wield their power. On this basis, a syllabus has been designed to first develop students’ competence in understanding discourse embedded in IODs and choosing reading strategies essential for thorough comprehension of IODs. The course will then help students develop knowledge about IODs as interconnected genres with discoursal meanings to be fathomed and cognized at multiple depths and dimensions. It is also one of the intents of the course to promote students’ critical reading of IODs through comparison and context analysis, which will lead to their grasp of the institutional significance and administration of international organizations within a global context shaped by international relations.

default.zh: 本课程旨在帮助学生在较短时间内系统掌握知识产权法的核心知识体系。课程内容涵盖著作权及相关权利、专利法、商标法以及域名法律规制等知识产权主要制度，并特别聚焦于软件、人工智能、物联网和大数据等数字时代新兴技术领域的法律问题。通过融合法律理论、比较法研究与当前执法实践，课程引导学生深入理解知识产权法在法律体系中的地位与作用。完成本课程后，学生将掌握国际知识产权法律框架、相关司法判例和发展趋势，能够准确识别知识产权客体，解释并适用国内外法律规范，起草与分析许可协议，论证法律决策，预见并规避潜在风险，并有效应对涉及国际保护的复杂或非典型执法情境，从而具备在数字时代处理知识产权事务的综合能力。
default.en: This course is designed to help students systematically master the core knowledge framework of intellectual property (IP) law in a relatively short period. It covers the main institutions of IP law—including copyright and related rights, patent law, trademark law, and the legal regulation of domain names—and places particular emphasis on legal issues arising in emerging technological fields of the digital era, such as software, artificial intelligence, the Internet of Things, and big data. By integrating legal theory, comparative jurisprudence, and current enforcement practices, the course guides students toward a deep understanding of the role and significance of IP law within the broader legal system. Upon completion, students will have acquired a solid grasp of international IP legal frameworks, relevant judicial precedents, and evolving trends; they will be able to accurately identify IP subject matter, interpret and apply both domestic and international legal norms, draft and analyze licensing agreements, justify legal decisions, anticipate and mitigate potential risks, and effectively address complex or atypical enforcement scenarios involving international rights protection—thereby developing comprehensive competencies for managing IP matters in the digital age.

default.zh: 毕业论文是为英语第二学位学生设置的实践教学环节。学生在教师的指导下，通过独立研究撰写一篇字数为不少于7000词、符合国际学术论文规范的英语研究论文。毕业论文包括选题、开题、中期检查和论文答辩等环节，以培养学生综合运用基本语言技能和专业知识的能力，提高其分析与解决实际问题的能力，培养其创新精神，从而获得从事科学研究工作的初步能力。通过毕业论文的撰写，学生应该针对本学科文学、文化、语言学、翻译等方向上某个具体课题，开展较为深入的研究，并能够遵守学术英语写作规范，撰写完整的毕业论文。论文需具备一定的创新点，为学术界贡献新发现和新知识。毕业论文考核由开题、中期、结题验收、答辩等四个主要环节组成，综合考虑评审和指导教师对论文的综合评价。
default.en: Graduation Thesis is a practice course offered to the English seniors. Under the guidance of supervisors and through independent work, students will write a thesis of no less than 7000 English words following MLA or APA style. The procedure of graduation thesis consists of the selection of topics, oral defense of the proposal, mid-term inspection and oral defense of the thesis. It aims to cultivate students’ ability to use basic language skills and professional knowledge, improve their ability to analyze and solve practical problems, and cultivate their creative thinking. Students will acquire the ability to do preliminary academic research. For writing a graduation thesis, students are required to conduct in-depth studies on specific topics in English literature, culture, linguistics and/or translation. They are also trained to write a complete thesis adhering to the standard of academic English writing.

default.zh: 认识实习课程通过派遣学生到企事业单位参观学习、听取企事业单位的相关介绍，了解企事业单位的运作，开拓视野，同时使学生的对自己所学俄语专业具有全面的认识，进一步提高俄语听、说、读、写、译的实践能力，为以后专业课的学习打下坚实的基础。
default.en: The Cognition Internship Program aims to provide students with a comprehensive understanding of their Russian majors by sending them to visit and learn from enterprises and institutions, listening to relevant introductions from enterprises and institutions, and broadening their horizons. It also aims to further improve their practical abilities in listening, speaking, reading, writing, and translating Russian, laying a solid foundation for future professional courses.

default.zh: 《写作与沟通》课程是为低年级本科生开设的全校公共必修课程。课程以“无专业门槛，有学理深度”为理念， 通过“主题式”小班研讨教学，一对一面批和朋辈评议等形式，培养学生批判性思维和逻辑思维能力，拓宽学生视野，提升学生的口头和书面沟通能力，完成学理性文章的写作训练。
default.en: Writing and Communication is a compulsory public course for junior undergraduates. The course has the concept of "no professional threshold, with depth of learning". Through the form of "theme" small-class discussion teaching, peer review and peer evaluation, it cultivates students 'critical thinking and logical thinking ability, broadens students' horizons, improves students' oral and written communication skills, and completes the writing training of rational articles.

default.zh: 本课程适合以汉语为第二语言的汉语初学者。课程旨在培养学生听、说、读、写的能力，因此，本课程将训练学生掌握汉语发音、汉语基本语法及日常生活必需的交流方式的教学，同时，在课堂上介绍相关的中国文化知识及中国现状。通过学习，学生可以掌握汉语拼音和基本的汉语语法知识，具有初步的听说读写能力，能够满足日常生活、学习以及一般场合的交际需要。
default.en: This course is suitable for Chinese beginners who speak Chinese as a second language. This course aims to develop students' ability of listening, speaking, reading and writing. Therefore, this course will train students to master the teaching of Chinese pronunciation, basic Chinese grammar and communication methods necessary for daily life. At the same time, it will introduce relevant knowledge of Chinese culture and the current situation of China in class. Through learning, students can master Chinese pinyin and basic knowledge of Chinese grammar, and have preliminary listening, speaking, reading and writing skills, which can meet the needs of daily life, learning and communication in general occasions.

default.zh: 本课程适合以汉语为第二语言的汉语初学者。课程旨在培养学生听、说、读、写的能力，因此，本课程将训练学生掌握汉语发音、汉语基本语法及日常生活必需的交流方式的教学，同时，在课堂上介绍相关的中国文化知识及中国现状。通过学习，学生可以掌握汉语拼音和基本的汉语语法知识，具有初步的听说读写能力，能够满足日常生活、学习以及一般场合的交际需要。
default.en: This course is suitable for Chinese beginners who speak Chinese as a second language. This course aims to develop students' ability of listening, speaking, reading and writing. Therefore, this course will train students to master the teaching of Chinese pronunciation, basic Chinese grammar and communication methods necessary for daily life. At the same time, it will introduce relevant knowledge of Chinese culture and the current situation of China in class. Through learning, students can master Chinese pinyin and basic knowledge of Chinese grammar, and have preliminary listening, speaking, reading and writing skills, which can meet the needs of daily life, learning and communication in general occasions.

default.zh: 本课程是语言技能训练课程，会帮助学生在初级汉语基础上继续积累扩大汉语词汇量，学习汉语搭配使用方法，训练学生进一步巩固扩展和深化一些语法项目，提升学生汉语阅读理解能力，锻炼学生运用所学词语、结构和句式进行正确的汉语口语表达和书面表达，从而提高学生的汉语交际能力。
default.en: This course is a language skills training course, which will help students accumulate and expand Chinese vocabulary on the basis of elementary Chinese, learn Chinese collocation methods, train students to further consolidate and expand and deepen some grammar items, improve students' Chinese reading comprehension ability, and train students to use the words, structures and sentence patterns learned to correctly express Chinese in oral and written language. So as to improve students' Chinese communicative competence.

default.zh: 《社会科学研究方法》课程是一门面向社会科学大类的通识课程，其可以作为所有社会科学类本科生的基础知识。课程旨在通过对社会科学研究的理论和方法进行全面系统的介绍，使学生从基础理论、具体研究方法、研究技术和撰写规范四个层次，定性研究和定量研究两个方面，在理论与实践相结合的基础上，掌握并运用对社会科学研究的问题提出、数据收集、文献综述、研究设计和评估的各种方法、技术，了解熟悉社会科学研究的原理、逻辑策略和科学程序，培养学生以科学的方法认识、分析和解决经济问题的实践能力，为撰写研究报告与学术论文打下坚实的基础。本课程具体包括研究方法概论、研究提案、文献综述、研究设计、数据的获取、理论建构与实证研究、论文的撰写等内容。
default.en: “Research Methods of Social Sciences” is a general course and can be used as the basic knowledge of all social sciences for all undergraduates. The course aims to introduce the theories and methods of Social Sciences’ research in a comprehensive and systematic way to enable students to grasp and apply Social Sciences research’s problem posing, data collection, literature review, and all the methods of research design and evaluation and be familiar with Social Sciences’research principles, logical strategy, and scientific program from the four levels of basic theory, specific research methods, research techniques, and writing specifications and two aspects of qualitative research and quantitative research and on the basis of the combination of theory and practice, and cultivate students’ practical ability to understand, analyze, and solve Social Sciences’ problems in a scientific way in order to lad a solid foundation for the writing of research reports and academic papers. The course specifically covers introduction of research methods, research proposals, literature review, research design, data acquisition, qualitative research and quantitative research, and the writing of research reports and academic papers.

default.zh: 大数据是是社会科学定量研究最主要的材料。对社会各领域大数据的处理与分析是人文社科大类学生必须掌握的方法与技术。本课程从社会科学与计算科学交叉学术视角出发，力图让学生掌握大数据分析的基础知识，包括了解大数据的基础知识、大数据分析的基本逻辑与原则、大数据分析的生命周期、大数据分析的工具、平台及用例。在此基础上，本课程还希望学生掌握大数据分析的方法、技术与模型，熟练使用社会科学通用的数据分析平台，并据此掌握基于R语言的大数据模型建立与分析方法，理解并掌握基于R语言的社会大数据案例分析综合技术。
default.en: Big data is the primary material for quantitative research in social sciences. The processing and analysis of big data across various social fields are essential methods and techniques that students in the humanities and social sciences must master. This course adopts an interdisciplinary academic perspective combining social sciences and computational sciences, aiming to equip students with the foundational knowledge of big data analysis. This includes understanding the fundamentals of big data, the basic logic and principles of big data analysis, the lifecycle of big data analysis, as well as the tools, platforms, and use cases for big data analysis. Building on this foundation, the course also aims for students to master the methods, techniques, and models of big data analysis, become proficient in using the common data analysis platforms in social sciences, and learn to establish and analyze big data models based on R language. Moreover, students will understand and master comprehensive techniques for analyzing social big data cases based on R language.

default.zh: 本课程面向本科生开设，系统阐释社会治理基础理论、实践模式与前沿发展。课程梳理社会治理历史脉络、核心内涵与中国特色社会治理体系，介绍社会控制、治理理论、社会资本等经典理论；讲解治理原则、运行程式与实践方法，围绕社区、贫困、社会组织、公共安全重点领域展开实务分析。同时聚焦数字时代变革，讲授大数据、互联网赋能下的治理创新，探讨数据治理、虚拟社会治理、智能社会治理等前沿议题。课程兼顾理论深度与现实案例，引导学生理解当代中国社会治理实践，培育运用治理思维观察、分析社会现实问题的能力。
default.en: This course is designed for undergraduate students and provides a systematic introduction to the fundamental theories, practical models and emerging developments in social governance. It examines the historical development, core concepts and the social governance system with Chinese characteristics, while introducing classical theories such as social control, governance theory and social capital. The course also explains the principles, operating mechanisms and practical approaches of social governance, and offers applied analyses of key areas including community governance, poverty governance, social organizations and public security. In addition, the course focuses on the transformations brought about by the digital age, examining governance innovations enabled by big data and Internet technologies, and exploring emerging topics such as data governance, virtual social governance and intelligent social governance. Combining theoretical foundations with real-world case studies, the course helps students develop a comprehensive understanding of contemporary social governance practices in China and cultivates their ability to observe and critically analyze social issues from a governance perspective.

default.zh: 《经济思想史A》一课旨在通过系统讲授经济学产生与发展的历史,帮助学生了解学科发展的延续性与连贯性，理解应该如何借助于对经济思想史的融会贯通来切实把握经济学的演变过程，并据此来进一步探究经济学的发展与变化规律。本课通过对经济学主要流派的讲述来梳理经济思想史的演化脉络。本课的讲授特点是强调对基本经济概念的提炼过程、理论联系实际的逻辑形成过程的阐述与剖析，以此来帮助学生提高对经济热点问题的分析与洞察能力。
default.en: The course History of Economic Thoughts A aims to help students understand the continuity and coherence of the development of economics and comprehend how to take hold of the evolutionary processes of economics by means of the mastery of history of economic thoughts through the systematic instructions on the history of generation and development of economics, and accordingly further explore the laws of developments and changes of economics. The course sorts out the evolutionary context through the narration of the main schools of economics. The course is characterized by emphasizing elaborations and analysis on the refining processes of basic economic concepts and the formation of logical processes in combination with theories and practices in order to help students improve analytical abilities and insights about economic hot issues.

default.zh: 《中国概况》是我国高校依据教育部相关文件要求面向国际学生开设的公共必修课程，具有基础性、公共性和通识性特点。课程的任务是全面反映中国思想、中国经验、中国式现代化道路和当代中国经济社会发展取得的巨大成就，“展现可信、可爱、可敬的中国形象”。在知识层面上，课程帮助学生构建基本的知识框架，对中国各方面形成整体、准确的认识。在情感发展层面上，课程培养学生的共情能力，引导学生理解、认同中国，正确看待中国的方针政策。在能力培养层面上，课程培养学生的跨文化交际能力，帮助学生成为中外经济文化交流的使者，初步具备”讲好中国故事”的意识和能力。
default.en: “Understanding China” is a compulsory public course for international students, established by Chinese universities in accordance with the guidelines of the Ministry of Education. It can be categorically seen as a general education course which provides foundational and universal academic knowledge and skill sets for international students in China. This course provides a comprehensive overview of Chinese thought, China’s unique developmental path, its approach to modernization, and its profound contemporary socio-economic achievements, aiming to present a credible, appealing, and respectable image of the nation. The course is structured to build an accurate knowledge framework for understanding China, while also fostering cultural empathy and a nuanced perspective on its policies. Furthermore, it is designed to enhance students’ cross-cultural communication skills, preparing them to act as cultural ambassadors and empowering them with the foundational ability to effectively share China’s story with the world.

default.zh: 社会管理属于人类社会生活的一个重要领域，而社会管理的社会学正是社会学理论知识及其实践经验在社会管理领域的尝试和应用。本课程在对西方社会管理思想演进的脉络进行把握的基础上，结合案例分析，对社会管理的理论架构进行探索性学习。主要内容包括社会管理学的研究对象与方法、西方社会管理思想演进、社会管理的主体与客体、社会管理的规律与程式、社会管理的机制以及主要领域的社会管理问题。
default.en: The social management is an important field in human social life, and the sociology about social management is a trial and application of sociological theory and practical experience in the field of social management. Being based on the grasp of the sequence of thought about the evolution of social management thought in Western and combining with the case analysis, this course is an exploratory study which is about the theoretical framework of social management. The main contents of this course include the object and the methods to study the social management, the evolution of social management thought in Western, the subject and object in the social management, the laws and programs of social management, the social management mechanism and some problem in the main areas of social management.

default.zh: 《社会科学研究方法》课程是一门通识课程，其可以作为所有社会科学类本科生的基础知识。课程旨在通过对社会科学研究的理论和方法进行全面系统的介绍，使学生从基础理论、具体研究方法、研究技术和撰写规范四个层次，定性研究和定量研究两个方面，在理论与实践相结合的基础上，掌握并运用对经济学研究的问题提出、数据收集、文献综述、研究设计和评估的各种方法、技术，了解熟悉社会科学研究的原理、逻辑策略和科学程序，培养学生以科学的方法认识、分析和解决经济问题的实践能力，为撰写研究报告与学术论文打下坚实的基础。本课程具体包括研究方法概论、研究提案、文献综述、研究设计、数据的获取、定性研究与定量研究、研究报告与学术论文的撰写等内容。
default.en: “Research Methods of Social Sciences” is a general course and can be used as the basic knowledge of all social sciences for all undergraduates. The course aims to introduce the theories and methods of Social Sciences’ research in a comprehensive and systematic way to enable students to grasp and apply Social Sciences research’s problem posing, data collection, literature review, and all the methods of research design and evaluation and be familiar with Social Sciences’research principles, logical strategy, and scientific program from the four levels of basic theory, specific research methods, research techniques, and writing specifications and two aspects of qualitative research and quantitative research and on the basis of the combination of theory and practice, and cultivate students’ practical ability to understand, analyze, and solve Social Sciences’ problems in a scientific way in order to lad a solid foundation for the writing of research reports and academic papers. The course specifically covers introduction of research methods, research proposals, literature review, research design, data acquisition, qualitative research and quantitative research, and the writing of research reports and academic papers.

default.zh: 社会学概论是社会学专业入门基础课，秉承社会学研究人与社会关系的主旨，介绍了社会学的基本概念（如社会化、文化、社会群体、社会组织、社会制度、社区、社会分层、社会流动等）、基本理论、基本方法，突出社会学本土化研究的特色。通过本课程的学习有助于学生掌握社会学的基本概念、知识和相关的理论，达到比较系统地了解社会知识、增强分析社会的能力、提高科学文化素质和专业技能的目标。
default.en: As an elementary course for undergraduate sociology program, Introduction to Sociology provides an overview of the relationship between human and society. It introduces basic concepts of sociology, such as socialization, culture, social groups, social organizations, social institution, community, social stratification, and social mobility. It briefly mentions fundamental theories and methods of sociology. Meanwhile, it emphasizes the indigenized sociological studies. As the semester progresses, students will gradually acquire systematic knowledge of sociology and enhance their ability to analyze social problems.

default.zh: 本课程为专业基础课，秉承社会学研究人与社会关系的主旨，介绍社会学的基本概念、基本理论、基本方法，突出社会学本土化研究的特色，是社会学专业本科生的入门课。
default.en: This course is a foundational course for the major, adhering to the core objective of sociological research—exploring the relationship between individuals and society; it introduces the fundamental concepts, theories, and methods of sociology, emphasizes the distinctive characteristics of localized sociological research, and serves as an introductory course for undergraduate students majoring in Sociology.

default.zh: 习近平法治思想是马克思主义法治理论中国化最新成果，是习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想的重要组成部分，是全面依法治国的根本遵循和行动指南。本课程主要内容是总结习近平法治思想形成发展的时代背景，对其形成发展的实践逻辑、理论逻辑和历史逻辑进行剖析；对习近平法治思想的四个意义（政治意义、理论意义、实践意义、世界意义）进行分析；深刻阐释习近平法治思想的核心要义以及科学方法，理顺包括政治、法治、德治等方面的重大关系。
default.en: Xi Jinping thought of rule of law is the latest achievement of Marxist theory of rule of law in China. It is an important part of Xi Jinping thought of socialism with Chinese characteristics in the new era.The main content of this course is to summarize the historical background of the formation and development of Xi Jinping thought of rule of law, and analyze the practical logic, theoretical logic and historical logic of its formation and development. The four meanings of Xi Jinping thought of the rule of law (political significance, theoretical significance, practical significance, world significance) are analyzed. The core meaning and scientific method of Xi Jinping thought of rule of law are deeply explained, and the important relations including politics, rule of law and rule of virtue are sorted out.

default.zh: 经济学原理课程的主旨是阐述经济学的标准理论和分析方法，强调规范化的经济分析方法。通过较严密的逻辑推理和较简洁的数学语言对经济问题进行刻画和描述。同时，尝试将经济学基本原理和中国经济改革与发展的现实情况相结合，启发学生分析和解决实际经济问题的思路。通过本课程的学习，同学们可以深刻地理解经济学的简化、模型化的思考方法，掌握对经济问题定量分析的技巧，产生对实际经济问题思考的兴趣和具备解决实际问题的能力。 经济学原理课程主要分析讲授现代西方经济学有关微观经济分析的主要模型，市场均衡和比较静态分析，弹性理论，生产技术和生产函数，成本函数，范围经济，不完全竞争厂商理论，一般均衡理论与福利经济理论。内容由浅入深，由实证到规范、定性分析与定量分析相结合，理论讲述与实际应用相结合。考虑到西方经济学内容庞杂，流派甚多，经济学原理主要以基础内容为主。具体包括：需求和弹性理论、弹性与收益的关系、恩格尔法则、消费者福利变化的度量、生产技术和生产函数、联合生产和范围经济、垄断市场的价格决定、寡头市场的价格决定、不完全竞争要素市场、一般均衡分析、外部性及其解决办法以及公共物品和公共选择理论。
default.en: The main purpose of the Principles of Economics course is to elaborate the standard theories and analytical methods of microeconomics, emphasizing the standardized economic analysis methods. Through more rigorous logical reasoning and more concise mathematical language, economic problems are described and described. At the same time, it tries to combine the basic principles of economics with the reality of China's economic reform and development to inspire students to analyze and solve practical economic problems. Through the study of this course, students can deeply understand the simplified and modeling thinking methods of economics, master the skills of quantitative analysis of economic problems, develop interest in thinking about practical economic problems and have the ability to solve practical problems. Principles of Economics analyses and teaches the main models of microeconomics analysis in modern Western economics, market equilibrium and comparative static analysis, elasticity theory, production techniques and production functions, cost functions, economies of scope, imperfectly competitive firm theory, general equilibrium theory, and welfare economic theory. The content is from simple to deep, from empirical to normative, combining qualitative analysis with quantitative analysis, combining theory with practical application. Considering that the content of western economics is very complicated and there are many schools, the primary microeconomics mainly focuses on the basic content. These include: demand and elasticity theory, the relationship between elasticity and returns, Engel's Law, measures of changes in consumer welfare, production techniques and production functions, joint production and scope economies, price determination in monopoly markets, price determination in oligopolistic markets, factor markets of imperfect competition, general equilibrium analysis, externalities and their solutions, and public goods and public choice theory.

default.zh: 本课程主要介绍从先秦到近代中国社会思想史的学术发展脉络。在内容设定上，包括：春秋战国时期的社会思想（老子、孔子、墨子、孟子、庄子、荀子、韩非）、秦汉时期的社会思想（董仲舒、王充）、魏晋南北朝时期的社会思想（何晏、王弼）、隋唐五代时期的社会思想（韩愈）、宋元明清时期的社会思想（二程、朱子、王守仁、李贽、王夫之等人的思想），以及近代社会思想（龚自珍、魏源、洪秀全、康有为、孙中山），探讨其现代性意义。
default.en: This course introduces the development of Chinese social thoughts from Qin Dynasty to modern China, which can be divided into six parts. In the first part, it introduces the social thoughts in the Spring and Autumn Period, including the social thoughts of Lao Tzu, Confucius, Mozi, Mencius, Zhuangzi, Xunzi and Han Fei. In the second part, it focuses on social thoughts of Dong Zhongshu and Wang Chong in Qin and Han dynasties. In the following part, social thoughts of He Yan and Wang Bi who lived in Wei, Jin and the Southern and Northern Dynasties will be discussed. The fourth part, Sui, Tang and the Five Dynasties, takes Han Yu’s social thoughts for instance. In the fifth part, this course explains the social thoughts of Cheng Hao, Cheng Yi, Zhu Xi, Wang Shouren, Li Zhi, and Wang Fuzhi in Song, Yuan, Ming, and Qing Dynasties. In the last part, it provides an overview of social thoughts in modern China by examining the social thoughts of Gongzizhen, Wei Yuan, Hong Xiuquan Kang Youwei, and Sun Yat-sen. In addition, it explores the modern significance of all social thoughts.

default.zh: 社会人类学是研究人类文化发展、变迁规律的一门人文学科。它阐述社会人类学的基本理论和基本科学观念，探讨人类社会文化现象的基本方法，是社会学的重要相关学科。它主要研究人类的体质和社会文化，是近代以来成为独立学科的。本课程的教学目的在于：为学生系统地了解和掌握人类社会文化活动的一般特点及其规律，进而运用人类学知识更好地认识自己、认识社会提供基本的知识框架和基础，并为下一步深入学习社会学专业课作好准备。 社会人类学课程是社会学专业的专业基础课。对社会人类学的学习，几乎可以说是成为新一代社会学学者的必要过程。通过社会人类学理论、历史与方法的学习，使学生更加了解人类和人类社会本体，有助于进一步掌握社会分析工具，实现改造和优化社会的任务。
default.en: Social Anthropology studies the development and laws of human culture. As a new autonomous discipline, it is closely related to sociology, discussing the basic theories, scientific concepts, and research methods of human physical and socio-cultural phenomena. It requires the students to master the general characteristics and laws of social and cultural activities so that they can achieve a better understanding on self and society with an anthropological knowledge framework. This course provides a foundation for the follow-up sociological courses. This course will help students to learn more about human beings and human society, which enables them go further to understand, transform and optimize the society.

default.zh: 经济社会学是经济学和社会学的交叉课程，主要以经济和社会现象的相互关系为研究对象，运用社会学的理论和方法，把经济现象置于广阔的社会背景中进行分析研究。本课程主要介绍经济社会学的定义、从经济社会学到新经济社会学的发展、经济行为、交换行为、消费行为、经济制度、企业与产业组织、劳动力市场、社会资本、文化、网络与经济等，使学生能从社会学的角度对各种经济问题进行分析，探索经济行为和经济现象背后折射的社会问题。
default.en: Economic sociology is a cross-curricular course of economics and sociology, which mainly takes the interrelationship between economic and social phenomena as the object of study, applies sociological theories and methods, and analyzes and researches the economic phenomena in a broad social context. This course introduces the definition of economic sociology, the development of economic sociology from economic sociology to new economic sociology, economic behavior, exchange behavior, consumption behavior, economic system, enterprise and industrial organization, labor market, social capital, culture, network and economy, etc., so as to enable the students to analyze the various economic problems from the sociological point of view, and to explore the social problems behind the economic behaviors and economic phenomena.

default.zh: 作为社会学学科的专业基础课，本门课程勾勒对社会学理论发展进行“古典”“现代”“当代”三阶段分期的依据；阐明古典社会学在19世纪中叶产生的历史及知识背景，介绍孔德、马克思、涂尔干、帕累托、韦伯、齐美尔等古典社会学家的理论主张;梳理现代社会学理论的演化脉络，讲授结构功能主义、社会冲突论、符号互动论、社会交换论、现象学社会学、常人方法论等理论流派的学说；立足20世纪中后期以来社会学理论发展的综合取向，讲解吉登斯、哈贝马斯、布迪厄、埃利亚斯、福柯、贝克、波德里亚等当代社会学家的理论主张。
default.en: As a fundamental course in sociology, this course will outline the basis for dividing the development of sociological theory into three stages: classical, modern, and contemporary times. The Course will elucidate the historical and intellectual background of the emergence of classical sociology in the mid-19th century, and introduce the theoretical propositions of classical sociologists such as Comte, Marx, Durkheim, Pareto, Weber, and Simmel. Then it will also sort out the evolution of modern sociological theories and teach theories such as structural functionalism, social conflict theory, symbolic interactionism, social exchange theory, phenomenological sociology, and Ethnomethodology. Finally Based on the comprehensive orientation of sociological theory development since the mid to late 20th century, the course will explain the theoretical propositions of contemporary sociologists such as Giddens, Habermas, Bourdieu, Elias, Foucault, Beck, and Baudrillard.

default.zh: 社会学概论是社会学专业入门基础课，秉承社会学研究人与社会关系的主旨，介绍了社会学的基本概念（如社会化、文化、社会群体、社会组织、社会制度、社区、社会分层、社会流动等）、基本理论、基本方法，突出社会学本土化研究的特色。通过本课程的学习有助于学生掌握社会学的基本概念、知识和相关的理论，达到比较系统地了解社会知识、增强分析社会的能力、提高科学文化素质和专业技能的目标。
default.en: As an elementary course for undergraduate sociology program, Introduction to Sociology provides an overview of the relationship between human and society. It introduces basic concepts of sociology, such as socialization, culture, social groups, social organizations, social institution, community, social stratification, and social mobility. It briefly mentions fundamental theories and methods of sociology. Meanwhile, it emphasizes the indigenized sociological studies. As the semester progresses, students will gradually acquire systematic knowledge of sociology and enhance their ability to analyze social problems.

default.zh: 社会学研究方法是社会学学科的三大支柱之一，也是社会学专业一门重要的基础课程。研究方法不仅是社会学研究人员必须掌握的基本功，同时，也越来越广泛地运用于政治学、传播学、人口学、心理学、管理学、教育学等社会科学的研究中，以及政府和企业政策研究等实际工作中。学习和掌握社会学研究方法，将有助于我们理解社会学及相关社会科学的基本内容，也有助于我们理解社会学家以及社会科学家在探索社会世界的奥秘，回答各种有关人类社会、人类社会行为以及各种社会现象和社会问题时所做的一切。本课程结合国内外社会研究方法的发展趋势和高等学校社会研究方法课程教学的实际，对社会研究方法的基本概念、基本原理和基本方式进行了简明晓畅的介绍。在内容安排上，本课程注重实际研究的逻辑程序和定量、定性研究方式的不同方法和技术，以及论文写作中一些特定的研究方法和技巧。
default.en: Sociological research methods is one of the three pillars of the discipline of sociology and an important basic course for sociology majors. Research methods are not only the basic skills that sociology researchers must master, but also are more and more widely used in the research of social sciences such as political science, communication, demography, psychology, management, education and other social sciences, as well as in practical work such as governmental and corporate policy research. Learning and mastering sociological research methods will help us understand the basic contents of sociology and related social sciences, as well as what sociologists as well as social scientists do in exploring the mysteries of the social world and answering all kinds of questions about human societies, human social behaviors as well as all kinds of social phenomena and social problems. Combining the development trend of social research methods at home and abroad and the actual teaching of social research methods courses in higher education, this course provides a concise and lucid introduction to the basic concepts, basic principles and basic approaches of social research methods. In terms of content arrangement, this course focuses on the logical procedures of actual research and the different methods and techniques of quantitative and qualitative research approaches, as well as some specific research methods and techniques in dissertation writing.

default.zh: 本课程试图打破对社会学理论的狭隘理解，引导学生从社会思想史的角度了解社会学经典论题的古典来源，了解早期社会学发展所面临的时代议题；通过梳理托克维尔、韦伯、马克思、涂尔干、齐美尔、帕累托、曼海姆等人的古典社会学理论，为学生学习现当代社会学理论做好必要的知识准备，通过介绍结构功能主义、冲突理论、社会交换论等理论流派的观点，为学生把握现当代社会学理论发展的趋势提供帮助；本门课程的讲授有助于学生们认识经典的魅力、提高他们阅读经典的能力，建立完整的社会学理论知识链条；有助于拓宽学生的社会学视野，完善学生的知识结构。
default.en: This course attempts to break away from the narrow understanding of sociological theory so that it can guide the students to understand classical sociological topics from the perspective of the history of social thoughts. It also introduces classical sociological theory of Tocqueville, Weber, Marx, Durkheim, Simmel, Pareto, and Mannheim in order to help the students to achieve a solid proficiency in fundamental knowledge for further study. By introducing the opinions of structural functionism, conflictive theory, and social interchange theory, this course is designed to make students clearly master the growing trend of modern and contemporary sociological theory. Above all, this course tries to establish a complete knowledge chain of sociological theory, broaden students’ sociological horizon, and make their knowledge structure much better.

default.zh: 门课程旨在通过知识社会学分析与理论流派梳理，加深学生对现代社会学与古典社会学的关系、对各种非帕森斯与反帕森斯的理论思潮的认识；立足上世纪中后期以来社会学理论发展的总体趋势，介绍以哈贝马斯、布迪厄、埃利亚斯、福柯等人为代表的当代社会学家克服后帕森斯时代社会学理论碎片化的局限、进行社会学理论的新综合的种种努力，加深学生对当代社会学前沿议题的了解；在完成本课程后，学生将对西方社会学理论自古典、现代直至当代的演化逻辑形成清晰的脉络，为学生们的后续学习与研究打下良好的基础。
default.en: From the perspective of knowledge sociology and theoretical school study, this course tries to deepen students’ understanding not only on the relation between modern sociology and classical sociology but also on the theoretical thoughts of non-Parsonsism and anti-Parsonsism. By analyzing the development trend of sociological theory after 1950s, this course will introduce the new theoretical integrative efforts done by Habermas, Bourdieu, Elias, Foucault and etc., in order to overcome the limits of theoretical pieces in post-Parsons era. It will deepen students’ understanding on contemporary sociology frontier. By completing this course, students will achieve a clear idea on western sociological theories evolutional logic and prepare well for subsequent study and research.

default.zh: 统计学原理是经济学专业基础课程之一。本课程秉承“大统计”思想，主要讲授数据搜集、整理与分析的一些基本原理与方法，分为描述统计与推断统计两部分。重点使学生了解统计学的理论基础、发展趋势与前沿热点；了解和掌握描述统计的基本方法和原理，包括统计数据的收集，数据分布特征的测度等内容；掌握推断统计的基本方法和原理，包括假设检验、方差分析、列联分析、相关与回归分析、时间序列分析等内容。着重培养学生对经济类数据进行综合分析的能力，能够通过大量数据显示的数量规律性，揭示隐含于数据背后的变量之间的联系。 本课程考试成绩采用累加式，包括平时表现、课后作业和期末考试三部分。
default.en: Principle of Statistics is one of the most important courses to all the students in Economics .Based on the opinion "general statistics", the students are introduced some basic principles and methods about how to collect, collate and analyze the data. The course includes two parts: descriptive statistics and extrapolative statistics. After finishing the course, students should know the theoretical foundation, tendency and advanced studies of Statistics; be familiar to the basic principles and methods of descriptive statistics, including data collection and data distribution characteristics e.g. ; be familiar to the basic principles and methods of extrapolative statistics, including hypothesis testing, analysis of variance, analysis of contingency, analysis of correlation and regression, and analysis of time series. Meanwhile we focus on cultivating students to improve their ability to analyze economic data and reveal the link between the variables by the means of the quantitative regularity of large numbers of data. The score consists of three parts: usual performance, homework and final exam.

default.zh: 统计学原理D是经济学专业的基础课程之一。本课程秉承“大统计”思想，主要讲授数据搜集、整理与分析的一些基本原理与方法，分为描述统计与推断统计两部分。重点使学生了解统计学的理论基础、发展趋势与前沿热点；了解和掌握描述统计的基本方法和原理，包括统计数据的收集，数据分布特征的测度等内容；掌握推断统计的基本方法和原理，包括参数估计、假设检验、方差分析、列联分析、相关与回归分析等内容。着重培养学生对经济类数据进行综合分析的能力，能够通过大量数据显示的数量规律性，揭示隐含于数据背后的变量之间的联系。 本课程考试成绩采用累加式，包括课后作业和期末考试两部分。
default.en: Principle of Statistics D is one of the most important courses to all the students majoring in economics .Based on the opinion "general statistics", the students are introduced some basic principles and methods about how to collect, collate and analyze the data. The course includes two parts: descriptive statistics and extrapolative statistics. After finishing the course, students should know the theoretical foundation, tendency and advanced studies of Statistics; be familiar to the basic principles and methods of descriptive statistics, including data collection and data distribution characteristics e.g. ; be familiar to the basic principles and methods of extrapolative statistics, including parameter estimation，hypothesis testing, analysis of variance, analysis of contingency, analysis of correlation and regression, and analysis of time series. Meanwhile we focus on cultivating students to improve their ability to analyze economic data and reveal the link between the variables by the means of the quantitative regularity of large numbers of data. The score consists of three parts: homework and final exam.

default.zh: 经济学是“社会科学的皇后，最古老的艺术，最新颖的科学”，大经济学家凯恩斯说过“许多 实行家自以为不受任何学说之影响，却往往当了某个已故经济学家的奴隶”意思就是，我们每一个人日常生活中自觉不自觉的收到经济学家的思想，经济学思维的影响，例如我们是选择就业还是读研？是出国还是考博？是学文科还是学理科？农民是种粮还是种菜？工厂生产手机还是生产桌椅？等等，凡此种种，都是经济学的一种思维模式。理解了经济学思维，就能根据收益和成本，而不是根据一时兴起的奇思妙想做出很好的做出选择和判断。 经济学导论课旨在为新入学经济学专业的学生们开启一扇通往经济学其妙殿堂的门。导论课将帮助学生初步了解什么是经济学、如何学习经济学、学习经济学的作用与意义、已经未来发展趋势，包括学科本身的发展以及学生自身的发展。导论课还将向学生介绍未来四年所学课程的大致内容，以便帮助其更好的做好学习的准备。导论课的终极目标应该是启发、引导学生对经济学的好奇与热爱，因为喜爱是最好的老师。
default.en: Economics is the "queen of social sciences, the oldest art, and the most innovative science," said the great economist Keynes Practitioners who think they are not influenced by any theory often become slaves to a deceased economist. "This means that each and every one of us consciously or unconsciously receives the influence of economists' thoughts and economic thinking in our daily lives, such as whether we choose employment or graduate school? Are you going abroad or pursuing a doctoral degree? Are you studying humanities or science? Do farmers grow grain or vegetables? Does the factory produce mobile phones or tables and chairs? Wait, all of these are a mode of thinking in economics. By understanding economic thinking, one can make good choices and judgments based on benefits and costs, rather than just whimsical ideas. The Introduction to Economics course aims to open a door to the mysteries of economics for new students majoring in International Economics and Trade and Economics. The introduction course will help students gain a preliminary understanding of what economics is, how to learn economics, the role and significance of learning economics, the current and future development trends, including the development of the subject itself and the development of students themselves. The introduction course will also introduce students to the general content of the courses they will learn in the next four years, in order to help them better prepare for learning. The ultimate goal of the introduction course should be to inspire and guide students' curiosity and love for economics, because love is the best teacher.

default.zh: 微观经济学A课程的主旨是阐述微观经济学的标准理论和分析方法，强调规范化的经济分析方法。通过较严密的逻辑推理和较简洁的数学语言对经济问题进行刻画和描述。同时，尝试将经济学基本原理和中国经济改革与发展的现实情况相结合，启发学生分析和解决实际经济问题的思路。通过本课程的学习，同学们可以深刻地理解经济学的简化、模型化的思考方法，掌握对经济问题定量分析的技巧，产生对实际经济问题思考的兴趣和具备解决实际问题的能力。 微观经济学A主要分析讲授现代西方经济学有关微观经济分析的主要模型，市场均衡和比较静态分析，弹性理论，生产技术和生产函数，成本函数，范围经济，不完全竞争厂商理论，一般均衡理论与福利经济理论。内容由浅入深，由实证到规范、定性分析与定量分析相结合，理论讲述与实际应用相结合。考虑到西方经济学内容庞杂，流派甚多，初级微观经济学主要以基础内容为主。具体包括：需求和弹性理论、弹性与收益的关系、恩格尔法则、消费者福利变化的度量、生产技术和生产函数、联合生产和范围经济、垄断市场的价格决定、寡头市场的价格决定、不完全竞争要素市场、一般均衡分析、外部性及其解决办法以及公共物品和公共选择理论。
default.en: The main purpose of the microeconomics A course is to elaborate the standard theories and analytical methods of microeconomics, emphasizing the standardized economic analysis methods. Through more rigorous logical reasoning and more concise mathematical language, economic problems are described and described. At the same time, it tries to combine the basic principles of economics with the reality of China's economic reform and development to inspire students to analyze and solve practical economic problems. Through the study of this course, students can deeply understand the simplified and modeling thinking methods of economics, master the skills of quantitative analysis of economic problems, develop interest in thinking about practical economic problems and have the ability to solve practical problems. Microeconomics A analyses and teaches the main models of microeconomics analysis in modern Western economics, market equilibrium and comparative static analysis, elasticity theory, production techniques and production functions, cost functions, economies of scope, imperfectly competitive firm theory, general equilibrium theory, and welfare economic theory. The content is from simple to deep, from empirical to normative, combining qualitative analysis with quantitative analysis, combining theory with practical application. Considering that the content of western economics is very complicated and there are many schools, the primary microeconomics mainly focuses on the basic content. These include: demand and elasticity theory, the relationship between elasticity and returns, Engel's Law, measures of changes in consumer welfare, production techniques and production functions, joint production and scope economies, price determination in monopoly markets, price determination in oligopolistic markets, factor markets of imperfect competition, general equilibrium analysis, externalities and their solutions, and public goods and public choice theory.

default.zh: 宏观经济学A是第二学士学位经济学专业的基础课程。本课程以整个国民经济活动作为考察对象，以国内生产总值为切入点，主要讲授影响、决定国民收入总量的一些基本原理，以及政府依据这些规律性对经济进行调整的政策选择。重点使学生掌握宏观经济学的理论基础、了解其发展趋势及前沿热点；掌握决定国民收入的三大模型、宏观经济政策的类型与特点、失业与通货膨胀的关系、经济增长与经济周期的基本原理与模型等内容，并能运用这些基本原理对现实经济问题进行一定的剖析。 本课程考试成绩采用累加式，包括平时表现、课后作业和期末考试三部分。
default.en: Macroeconomics A is one of the basic courses to all the students in Economics , including the ones who will get the second bachelor degree. The lesson takes the whole national economic activity as the study object. Based on GDP, the students are introduced some basic principles and how the government to adjust the economy using these laws. After finishing the course, students should know the theoretical foundation, tendency and advanced studies of Macroeconomics, be familiar to the three models of national income, the type and characteristics of macroeconomic policies, the relationship between unemployment and inflation, the basic principles and models of economic increase and economic periods. Meanwhile we focus on cultivating students to master the basic theory of macroeconomics, to improve their ability to analyze some realistic macroeconomic problem under the scientific theory frame. The score consists of three parts: usual performance, homework and final exam .

default.zh: 计量经济学是经济学的一个分支学科，为经济理论、统计学和数学三者的结合。作为一门经济学科，计量经济学的主要内容强调经济学的内涵与外延。基础经济计量学是一门用以培养学生方法的研究，为进一步进行理论探讨的基础课。本课程讲授的主要内容有：计量经济的研究方法、简单线性回归模型、多元线性回归模型、多重共线性、异方差性、自相关性、分布滞后模型与自回归模型、虚拟变量回归。 计量经济学是经济学专业的重要课程，本课程的教学目的是让学生掌握基础计量经济学的基本原理、方法、模型及其应用，掌握运用基本的计量经济分析方法进行经济学定量实证分析的能力，并为进一步学习高级计量课程打下基础。即通过该门课程的教学，使学生掌握计量经济学的基础理论，在对经济问题进行定性分析的基础上，掌握并能运用所学计量方法，利用相关软件、能够建立实用的计量经济学应用模型，并通过模型假定的检验学会揭示社会的经济现象的规律。本课程的教学设计旨在通过帮助学生掌握计量经济学的基本概念与方法，掌握常用的计量经济学模型，提高学生实际问题解决能力，培养学生思维能力、创造力等素质，以便更加适应未来的社会发展与应用需求。
default.en: Econometrics is a subdiscipline of economics that combines economic theory, statistics, and mathematics. As a branch of economics, econometrics emphasizes the essence and scope of economics. Basic econometrics is a foundational course that aims to teach students the methods for further theoretical exploration. The main topics covered in this course include research methods in econometrics, simple linear regression models, multiple linear regression models, multicollinearity ,heteroscedasticity, autocorrelation, distributed lag models, autoregressive models, and dummy variable regression. Econometrics is an important course in the field of economics. The educational objectives of this course are to equip students with the basic principles, methods, models, and applications of foundational econometrics. Students will learn how to utilize fundamental econometric analysis methods for quantitative empirical analysis in economics, laying the foundation for further study in advanced econometrics courses. Through this course, students are expected to grasp the fundamental theories of econometrics. They will be able to apply econometric methods learned in the course to conduct quantitative analysis of economic issues, establish practical econometric application models using relevant software, and learn to reveal the laws of economic phenomena in society by testing the assumptions of the models. The teaching design of this course aims to help students master the fundamental concepts and methods of econometrics, understand commonly used econometric models, enhance their problem-solving skills, and cultivate qualities such as critical thinking and creativity. This prepares them to adapt better to future societal development and application demands.

default.zh: 《经济学研究方法》课程是一门基础课程，其可以作为所有社会科学类本科生的基础知识。课程旨在通过对经济学研究的理论和方法进行全面系统的介绍，使学生从基础理论、具体研究方法、研究技术和撰写规范四个层次，定性研究和定量研究两个方面，在理论与实践相结合的基础上，掌握并运用对经济学研究的问题提出、数据收集、文献综述、研究设计和评估的各种方法、技术，了解熟悉经济学研究的原理、逻辑策略和科学程序，培养学生以科学的方法认识、分析和解决经济问题的实践能力，为撰写研究报告与学术论文打下坚实的基础。本课程具体包括研究方法概论、研究提案、文献综述、研究设计、数据的获取、定性研究与定量研究、研究报告与学术论文的撰写等内容。
default.en: “Research Methods of Economics” is a general course and can be used as the basic knowledge of all social sciences for all undergraduates. The course aims to introduce the theories and methods of economic research in a comprehensive and systematic way to enable students to grasp and apply economic research’s problem posing, data collection, literature review, and all the methods of research design and evaluation and be familiar with economic research’s principles, logical strategy, and scientific program from the four levels of basic theory, specific research methods, research techniques, and writing specifications and two aspects of qualitative research and quantitative research and on the basis of the combination of theory and practice, and cultivate students’ practical ability to understand, analyze, and solve economic problems in a scientific way in order to lad a solid foundation for the writing of research reports and academic papers. The course specifically covers introduction of research methods, research proposals, literature review, research design, data acquisition, qualitative research and quantitative research, and the writing of research reports and academic papers.

default.zh: 习近平法治思想是马克思主义法治理论中国化最新成果，是习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想的重要组成部分，是全面依法治国的根本遵循和行动指南。本课程主要内容是总结习近平法治思想形成发展的时代背景，对其形成发展的实践逻辑、理论逻辑和历史逻辑进行剖析；对习近平法治思想的四个意义（政治意义、理论意义、实践意义、世界意义）进行分析；深刻阐释习近平法治思想的核心要义以及科学方法，理顺包括政治、法治、德治等方面的重大关系。 目标在于 1.引导学生全面而深刻地把握习近平法治思想的基本精神、核心要义和实践要求，增强坚定走中国特色社会主义法治道路、为全面建设社会主义现代化法治强国而奋斗的政治意识、理论自觉和实践定力。 2.引导学生分辨是非对错，提高政治站位，自觉抵制各种错误观点，提高分析和解决复杂的法律和社会问题的能力。 3.以习近平法治思想为基点，培养学生社会主义核心价值观，树立执法司法为民的法治意识，弘扬法治精神。
default.en: Xi Jinping thought of rule of law is the latest achievement of Marxist theory of rule of law in China. It is an important part of Xi Jinping thought of socialism with Chinese characteristics in the new era.The main content of this course is to summarize the historical background of the formation and development of Xi Jinping thought of rule of law, and analyze the practical logic, theoretical logic and historical logic of its formation and development. The four meanings of Xi Jinping thought of the rule of law (political significance, theoretical significance, practical significance, world significance) are analyzed. The core meaning and scientific method of Xi Jinping thought of rule of law are deeply explained, and the important relations including politics, rule of law and rule of virtue are sorted out. The goal is to guide students to comprehensively and deeply grasp the basic spirit, core essentials and practical requirements of Xi Jinping thought of the rule of law, and strengthen their political consciousness, theoretical consciousness and practical determination to firmly take the road of socialist rule of law with Chinese characteristics and strive to build a socialist modern country with the rule of law in an all-round way. 2. Guide students to distinguish right from wrong, improve their political position, consciously resist all kinds of wrong views, and improve their ability to analyze and solve complex legal and social problems. 3. Based on Xi Jinping thought of the rule of law, cultivate students' core socialist values, establish the awareness of the rule of law for the people, and promote the spirit of the rule of law. Values, establish law enforcement and justice for the people's awareness of the rule of law, promote the spirit of the rule of law.

default.zh: 法理学课程中始终贯穿“全面依法治国”的思想，为培养以习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想为引领，以“立德树人”为根本任务，打造具有法学特色的思想政治教育体系、实践育人体系，为全面依法治国培养输送中国特色社会主义法治人才，为实现中华民族伟大复兴中国梦努力培养担当民族复兴大任的合格建设者和可靠接班人。开设理论法学课程，意在帮助学生树立马克思主义法律观和中国特色社会主义法治理念，培养法律思维方式和提高法律理论素质，从而为有效学习其他法学课程奠定理论和方法论基础。
default.en: Efforts will be made to cultivate qualified builders and reliable successors responsible for the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation and the Chinese Dream. The purpose of offering theoretical law courses is to help students establish Marxist legal views and the concept of socialist rule of law with Chinese characteristics, cultivate legal thinking methods, and improve legal theoretical quality, thereby laying a theoretical and methodological foundation for effective learning of other legal courses.

default.zh: 宪法与行政法理论是高等学校法学教育体系中公法学的重要核心课程。宪法与行政法理论是以宪法、行政实体法现象为研究对象的一门法律科学，是研究公法的基本原理与规律的知识体系。宪法与行政法理论是法学知识体系的重要组成部分。宪法、行政实体法现象通常包括宪法与行政法规范、宪法制度与行政主体、宪法意识与宪法、行政法治秩序等。通过本课程学习，使学生掌握宪法与行政法的基本原理，了解我国现行宪法与行政法的基本制度、基本规则，为学生进一步学习奠定坚实的理论基础。
default.en: The theory of Constitution and administrative law is an important core course of public law in the system of law education in colleges and universities. The theory of Constitution and administrative law is a legal science which takes the phenomenon of constitution and administrative substantive law as its research object. The theory of Constitution and administrative law is an important part of legal knowledge system. The phenomena of constitution and administrative substantive law usually include constitution and administrative law norm, constitution system and administrative subject, constitution consciousness and constitution, administrative legal order and so on. Through this course, students can master the basic principles of Constitution and administrative law, understand the basic system and rules of our country's current constitution and administrative law, and lay a solid theoretical foundation for further study

default.zh: 民法总论是法学专业学生非常重要的专业基础课，是学习后续专业课如物权法、合同法、侵权行为法、亲属法与继承法等课程的基础，在培养学生法学思维与专业能力等方面占有重要地位。本课程主要讲述民事法律关系主体、民事法律关系客体以及民事法律关系变动。通过对民事法律关系主体、民事法律关系客体以及民事法律关系变动基础理论的讲授、现行法律的评析、各类案件的研讨，培养学生的理论研究创新能力、法律解读评判能力以及案件分析处理能力。经过本门课程的学习，学生不仅掌握民法总论方面的基本理论，为今后从事民法学的理论研究奠定良好的基础；而且掌握民法总论方面的相关法律规定以及典型案例，为今后从事法律实务工作奠定良好的基础。本门课程考试成绩采用累加式，包括论文和期末考试。
default.en: The general introduction of civil law is a very important basic course for students majoring in law. It is the basis of studying follow-up specialized courses, such as property law, contract law, tort law, kinship law and Inheritance Law. It plays an important role in training students' legal thinking and professional ability. This course mainly deals with the subject of civil legal relation, the object of civil legal relation and the change of civil legal relation. Through the teaching of civil legal relations subject, the civil legal relations object and the civil law relations change,and the analysis of current legal, and the discussioneach kind of case , we will train students' ability of theoretical research, innovation, legal interpretation, judgment and case analysis. After study of this course, students not only master the basic theory of the civil law in order to lay a good foundation for the theoretical study of civil law in the future, but also grasp the relevant provisions of the civil law general rules and typical cases in order to lays a good foundation for legal practice in the future. The course examination results are cumulative,paper and final exams.

default.zh: 刑法学是高等学校法学教育的一门重要主干课程，由刑法总论与刑法各论构成。刑法总论是刑法学的基本理论部分，是各论的基础。刑法总论主要系统而较为深入地论述刑法通论、犯罪总论、刑罚总论方面的刑法基本原理与刑法总则规范，刑法通论主要包括刑法的概念、任务、效力、基本原则等内容；犯罪总论主要包括犯罪的概念、犯罪构成、正当化行为、故意犯罪的停止形态、共同犯罪和罪数形态等内容；刑罚总论主要包括刑罚体系和量刑行刑制度；刑法各论主要介绍我国刑法的具体犯罪。通过总论部分的学习，使学生掌握刑法的基本原理，了解我国刑法总则的基本规则，为学生进一步学习刑法各论奠定坚实的理论基础。课程教学注重理论联系实际，注重采用互动式、启发式教学方法，并要求学生撰写读书笔记以锻炼其法律思维能力。
default.en: Criminal law is one of the key courses in the legal science education of higher educational institutions, and it is divided two parts –general provisions of the criminal law and specific provisions, and the former is the basic part. The general provisions of criminal law discusses systematically and thoroughly the basic principles of the criminal law and criteria of the general provitions of the criminal law concerning the general survey of the criminal law, general provision of crimes and general provisions of punishment. Including the concept and the aim of the criminal law, basic principles of the criminal law, the scope of validity of the criminal law, the concept of crime, the constitution of the crime, justifiable acts, the suspended situation of intentonal crime, joint crimes, the form of quantity of crime, the system and types of punishments, measurement of punishments, the system of the measurement of punishment, the system of the execution of punishment, annihilation of punishment. The specific provisions of criminal law discusses specific crimes. The judicial practice is paid more attention during this course , and students’ papers should be handed in before examination.

default.zh: 民法总论是法学专业学生非常重要的专业基础课，是学习后续专业课如物权法、合同法、侵权行为法、亲属法与继承法等课程的基础，在培养学生法学思维与专业能力等方面占有重要地位。本课程主要讲述民事法律关系主体、民事法律关系客体以及民事法律关系变动。通过对民事法律关系主体、民事法律关系客体以及民事法律关系变动基础理论的讲授、现行法律的评析、各类案件的研讨，培养学生的理论研究创新能力、法律解读评判能力以及案件分析处理能力。经过本门课程的学习，学生不仅掌握民法总论方面的基本理论，为今后从事民法学的理论研究奠定良好的基础；而且掌握民法总论方面的相关法律规定以及典型案例，为今后从事法律实务工作奠定良好的基础。本门课程考试成绩采用累加式，包括作业和期末考试。
default.en: The general introduction of civil law is a very important basic course for students majoring in law. It is the basis of studying follow-up specialized courses, such as property law, contract law, tort law, kinship law and Inheritance Law. It plays an important role in training students' legal thinking and professional ability. This course mainly deals with the subject of civil legal relation, the object of civil legal relation and the change of civil legal relation. Through the teaching of civil legal relations subject, the civil legal relations object and the civil law relations change,and the analysis of current legal, and the discussioneach kind of case , we will train students' ability of theoretical research, innovation, legal interpretation, judgment and case analysis. After study of this course, students not only master the basic theory of the civil law in order to lay a good foundation for the theoretical study of civil law in the future, but also grasp the relevant provisions of the civil law general rules and typical cases in order to lays a good foundation for legal practice in the future. The course examination results are cumulative,and final exams.

default.zh: 宪法学是高等学校法学教育的一门重要主干课程。宪法学主要系统而较为深入地论述宪法基本原理、历史发展、我国现行宪法所规定的基本制度。通过宪法学学习，使学生掌握宪法的基本原理，了解我国宪法的基本原则、基本制度，为学生进一步学习其他部门法学奠定坚实的理论基础。课程教学注重理论联系实际，注重采用互动式、启发式教学方法，并要求学生撰写读书笔记以锻炼其法律思维能力。
default.en: Constitution is one of the key courses in the legal science education of higher educational institutions. The main system of constitutional jurisprudence mainly discusses the basic principles of constitution, the development of history and the basic system stipulated in the present constitution of China.Through the study of constitutional law, make the students master the basic principles of the constitution, to understand the basic principles of our constitution, the basic system, for the students to further study other department law lay a solid theoretical basis.The course teaching focuses on the theory and practice, emphasizes the use of interactive and heuristic teaching methods, and requires students to write reading notes to exercise their legal thinking ability.

default.zh: 国际法主要是研究国家之间关系的一般原则、规则和制度的部门法学学科。本课程介绍了国际法的研究对象、国际法的主体、国际法的效力根据、国际法的基本原则、国际法与国内法的关系；讨论国际法上的国家、国际法上的居民及国家领土的法律制度，诸如国际法上的承认与继承、国际法上的国家责任、引渡与庇护、国家领土的取得等；研究国际海洋法、航空法、外层空间法和国际组织法的法律规则、制度；探讨外交特权与豁免的内容、条约的缔结与适用、国际争端的解决等问题；了解中国对重大国际问题和国际事件的立场和观点。
default.en: International law discussing the general principles, rules and institutions of the relationship between nations is a subject of department law. This course presents objects of international law research, subjects of international law, theories as to the basis of international law, the basic principles of international law, relation between international law and municipal law; approaches legal system about state, population and state territory in international law, such as recognition and succession of international law, state responsibility of international law, extradition and asylum, acquisition of state territory…etc; discusses legal rules and institutions about the law of the sea, air of law, outer space law, international organizations of law; probes some topics of the content of diplomatic and consular immunities, conclusion and application of treaties, solutions to the international disputes; masters the standpoint and viewpoint of Chinese government on important international topics and affairs.

default.zh: 《民事诉讼法》是全国高等学校法学专业14门核心课程之一。其研究的主要对象有两大方面：一方面是民事诉讼法律规范，包括形式的民事诉讼法和实质的民事诉讼法；一方面是中国的民事诉讼实践，从民事诉讼活动和民事审判经验中，探索规律和问题，把具体经验系统化、理论化。这门课程主要包括四部分内容：一是民事诉讼法的基本理论，内容包括民事诉讼法概述、诉与诉权、民事诉讼法律关系及民事诉讼法和民事诉讼实践的关系，揭示民事诉讼法的概貌，为学生学习民事诉讼法奠定初步的理论基础；二是民事诉讼法的基本原则和重要制度，即详细介绍了民事诉讼的基本原则、民事审判的基本制度、主管与管辖、诉讼当事人、民事诉讼证据、诉讼保障制度等；三是民事诉讼程序，即包括审判程序和执行程序，重点突出有关审判程序的内容；四是涉外民事诉讼的特别规定。
default.en: Civil procedural law is one of 14 key courses in the legal science education of higher educational institutes. The main object that it studies contains two sides: one is the norms of civil procedural law, include the formal civil procedural law and the substantial civil procedural law; the other is the civil litigious practices of China, so that we investigate the regulation and problems from the civil litigious activities and the experience of civil trial, and turn concrete experiences into system and theories. This course includes the four-part contents: first, the basic theories of the civil procedural law, the contents includes the summary of civil procedural law, action and right of action, jural relations to civil proceedings and the relation between the civil procedural law and the civil litigious practices, to provide students with the basic theories of the civil procedural law; second, the basic principle and important systems of the civil procedural law, namely that it introduces the basic principles of civil proceedings, the basic systems of civil trial, charge and domination, the litigants, evidences of civil litigation, the protective systems of litigation in details etc.. third, the civil procedure, that includes procedure of trial and procedure of enforcement, outstanding contents concerning procedure of trial; forth, the special provisions about civil proceedings concerning foreign interests.
