default.zh: 《刑事诉讼法》是国家教育部规定的法学16门主干课程之一。刑事诉讼法是国家制定和认可的有关刑事诉讼程序的法律规范，是司法机关和刑事诉讼参与人进行刑事诉讼必须遵守的行为规范，它关系到对犯罪的公正、文明惩治和公民合法权益的切实保护。在现代文明的法治国家，刑事诉讼法是非常重要的基本法律部门之一。 刑事诉讼法学是以刑事诉讼法和刑事诉讼司法实践为研究对象的一门科学，是现代法学体系中不可或缺的基础性学科，是各类法学专业学生学习的必修课程。本课程以我国《刑事诉讼法》为依据，将系统介绍刑事司法的原理、原则、制度和基本要求，其内容主要包括：刑事诉讼法原则、专门机关与诉讼参与人、管辖、回避、强制措施、附带民事诉讼、辩护和代理、证据制度、立案、侦查、起诉、第一审、第二审、死刑复核程序、审判监督程序、执行程序等。本课程的学习以中国刑事诉讼制度和理论为基础，同时与先进国家的刑事诉讼制度和理论进行比较。 本课程是一门理论性和实践性很强的课程，通过学习，要掌握刑事诉讼的基本理论和基本知识，全面和准确了解我国刑事诉讼法及其相关司法解释的基本内容，初步学会侦查工作、起诉工作、辩护工作和审判工作所需要掌握的基本知识和技能，为今后从事刑事司法工作奠定基础。
default.en: 《Criminal procedure law》 is one of 16 core courses specified by the State Legal Education Commission of the Ministry of Education. Criminal procedure law is the legal norms on the criminal procedure made and recognized by China, both the judiciary authorities and the participants in the criminal procedure must obey the legal norms, and it concerns criminal justice, punishment civilization and the protection of citizen’s legal rights. In the modern country of rule of law, the criminal procedure law is a very important law. The study object of the criminal procedure laws is the criminal procedure law and the criminal procedure practice, it is an essential basic subject and it is a required course of legal students.According to the Chinese《Criminal procedure law》, the course will introduce the criminal judicial principles, theories,systems and requirements. The contents of the course include the principles of the criminal procedure law, the specialized agencies and the litigant participants, jurisdiction, withdrawal, evidence, compulsory measures, defence and representation, incidental civil actions, filing a case, investigation, initiation of public prosecution, procedure of first instance, procedure of second instance, procedure for review of death sentences, procedure of trial supervision and execution, etc. The Chines criminal procedure systems and theory is the basis of the study of this course and compare with the criminal procedure systems and theory of the advanced countries. The criminal procedure law is a subject which is sound theoretical basis and feasible applicability. By studying this subject, the students should master the basic theory and knowledge of the criminal procedure law, understand the contents of the criminal procedure law and judicial interpretation entirely and exactly, and learn the knowledge and skills of the investigation, prosecution, defense and trial and lay a solid foundation for the criminal judicial works.

default.zh: 行政法与行政诉讼法学是以行政法律关系为研究对象的法学分支学科，其目标是建设法治政府，其实质是规范行政权力依法行使。行政法与行政诉讼法是构建法治国家所必需的重要组成部分。课程以行政权的规制为核心确立了行政主体、行政行为与行政救济三大主体内容，重点使学生了解行政法学的理论基础、发展趋势及前沿内容；熟悉行政权的运行机制，能够对行政救济渠道有全面的了解。 课程主要内容包括行政法的一般原理、行政法主体、行政行为、行政程序、行政复议、行政诉讼等基本问题。本课程考试成绩采用累加式，包括期末笔试、平时作业和课堂表现三个部分。
default.en: The administrative law and administrative litigation law is a branch of law that is subject to the relationship of administrative law. Its goal is to build a government of rule of law, which is to regulate the exercise of administrative power in accordance with the law. Administrative law and administrative procedure law are important components necessary to build a country under the rule of law. Course with the regulation of executive power as the core to establish the administrative subject, administrative act and administrative remedy three main content, the key to make the students understand the theoretical basis of administrative law, development trend and frontier content; Familiar with the operation mechanism of administrative power, can have a comprehensive understanding of administrative relief channels. The main contents of the course include the general principle of administrative law, administrative law subject, administrative action, administrative procedure, administrative reconsideration, administrative litigation and other basic issues. The results of this course are cumulative, including the final written exam, normal assignments and classroom performance.

default.zh: 《法理学A》课程中始终贯穿“全面依法治国”的思想，为培养以习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想为引领，以“立德树人”为根本任务，打造具有法学特色的思想政治教育体系、实践育人体系，为全面依法治国培养输送中国特色社会主义法治人才，为实现中华民族伟大复兴中国梦努力培养担当民族复兴大任的合格建设者和可靠接班人。开设理论法学课程，意在帮助学生树立马克思主义法律观和中国特色社会主义法治理念，培养法律思维方式和提高法律理论素质，从而为有效学习其他法学课程奠定理论和方法论基础。
default.en: The concept of "comprehensive rule of law" has always been embedded in the course of "Jurisprudence A".In order to cultivate the ideology of socialism with Xi Jinping Chinese characteristics in the new era, with the fundamental task of "cultivating morality and cultivating people", we will create an ideological and political education system and practical education system with legal characteristics, cultivate and transport socialist rule of law talents with Chinese characteristics for comprehensive rule of law, and strive to cultivate qualified builders and reliable successors responsible for the great task of national rejuvenation in order to achieve the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation and the Chinese Dream.The purpose of offering theoretical law courses is to help students establish Marxist legal views and the concept of socialist rule of law with Chinese characteristics, cultivate legal thinking methods, and improve legal theoretical quality, thereby laying a theoretical and methodological foundation for effective learning of other legal courses.

default.zh: 宪法学是高等学校法学教育的一门重要主干课程。宪法学主要系统而较为深入地论述宪法基本原理、历史发展、我国现行宪法所规定的基本制度。通过宪法学学习，使学生掌握宪法的基本原理，了解我国宪法的基本原则、基本制度，为学生进一步学习其他部门法学奠定坚实的理论基础。课程教学注重理论联系实际，注重采用互动式、启发式教学方法，并要求学生撰写读书笔记以锻炼其法律思维能力。
default.en: Constitution is one of the key courses in the legal science education of higher educational institutions. The main system of constitutional jurisprudence mainly discusses the basic principles of constitution, the development of history and the basic system stipulated in the present constitution of China.Through the study of constitutional law, make the students master the basic principles of the constitution, to understand the basic principles of our constitution, the basic system, for the students to further study other department law lay a solid theoretical basis.The course teaching focuses on the theory and practice, emphasizes the use of interactive and heuristic teaching methods, and requires students to write reading notes to exercise their legal thinking ability.

default.zh: 民法总论是法学专业学生非常重要的专业基础课，是学习后续专业课如物权法、合同法、侵权行为法、亲属法与继承法等课程的基础，在培养学生法学思维与专业能力等方面占有重要地位。本课程主要讲述民事法律关系主体、民事法律关系客体以及民事法律关系变动。通过对民事法律关系主体、民事法律关系客体以及民事法律关系变动基础理论的讲授、现行法律的评析、各类案件的研讨，培养学生的理论研究创新能力、法律解读评判能力以及案件分析处理能力。经过本门课程的学习，学生不仅掌握民法总论方面的基本理论，为今后从事民法学的理论研究奠定良好的基础；而且掌握民法总论方面的相关法律规定以及典型案例，为今后从事法律实务工作奠定良好的基础。本门课程考试成绩采用累加式，包括作业和期末考试。
default.en: The general introduction of civil law is a very important basic course for students majoring in law. It is the basis of studying follow-up specialized courses, such as property law, contract law, tort law, kinship law and Inheritance Law. It plays an important role in training students' legal thinking and professional ability. This course mainly deals with the subject of civil legal relation, the object of civil legal relation and the change of civil legal relation. Through the teaching of civil legal relations subject, the civil legal relations object and the civil law relations change,and the analysis of current legal, and the discussioneach kind of case , we will train students' ability of theoretical research, innovation, legal interpretation, judgment and case analysis. After study of this course, students not only master the basic theory of the civil law in order to lay a good foundation for the theoretical study of civil law in the future, but also grasp the relevant provisions of the civil law general rules and typical cases in order to lays a good foundation for legal practice in the future. The course examination results are cumulative, homework and final exams.

default.zh: 本课程是针对高级阶段的三年级留学生的口语学习课程，要求学生能够结合课文就学习、社会生活的各种话题进行课堂讨论和辩论，能较系统、完整地发表自己的见解，能够进行成段表达，最终要求学生能具有大段地自如表达的能力。本课程的教材共分十个主题，由主课文、注释、练习、补充材料四部分组成。内容涉及当代中国社会的家庭、婚姻、教育、工作、法律、人际关系、环境、体育运动、汉字文化、饮食文化、年俗及交通等。
default.en: This course is learning how to speak,aimed at advanced stages of third-grade students .This course require students to be able to have class discussion and debate according to topics about study and social life, which have been learned in the texts.They should be more systematic and completely to express their opinion, capable to express a paragraph ,eventually,students should be able to have the ability to express a large portion fluently. The course material is divided into 10 themes, including four parts,such as the main text, notes, exercises, supplementary materials. The contents covers contemporary Chinese society, family, marriage, education, work, legal, interpersonal relations, environment, sport, Chinese culture, food culture, the annual customs and transport.

default.zh: 本课程从外国人在中国的生活、工作、游览等方面中选取话题，力求实用，使学习者感兴趣，并以情景会话的方式来表现，会话的情节生动、富有情趣，富有时代感地体现了当代汉语语言和蕴涵在语言中的中国文化。课文讲解的内容力求避免语法术语，并以实例模仿为主，使学习者易于理解和掌握较复杂的句式和语法内容。旨在帮助学生提高基本口头交际的能力，同时也促进留学生更好地学习汉语。
default.en: This course selects topics from foreigners life,work and travel in China.It is useful and practical,so that students are interested in it.The form of the text is dialogue.The dialogue is interesting and contemporary.It reflect the Chinese culture in language.The teacher doesn't use grammatical term.The students can understand the complex sentence and grammar in practice. We can not only help students improve communication ability, but also help them study Chinese language better.

We can not only help students improve communication ability, but also help them study Chinese language better.

default.zh: 听力课程主要是通过系统的听力技能的训练，提高中级学生的听力水平。使留学生在听的过程中学习更多的语言知识，特别是容易听错、理解错的词语、句型、语气以及容易造成听力障碍的文化背景，从而提高留学生的语言交际能力。同时注重留学生在时政、经济、教育、文体、娱乐等方面的听力练习，也能使其更深入学习汉语和中国文化。
default.en: The intermediate students listening level can be improved through a systematic training in listening skills.This is the main purpose of listening courses.In the process of listening，students can learn more knowledge of the language.We should pay more attention to the words,sentences, modal and cultural background that are easy to be misunderstood.So the students' language communication ability can be improved.At the same time,we pay attention to listening exercises about current affairs,economy,education,sports,entertainment and so on.Then the students can learning Chinese language and culture deeply.

default.zh: 听力课程主要是通过系统的听力技能的训练，提高中级学生的听力水平。使留学生在听的过程中学习更多的语言知识，特别是容易听错、理解错的词语、句型、语气以及容易造成听力障碍的文化背景，从而提高留学生的语言交际能力。同时注重留学生在时政、经济、教育、文体、娱乐等方面的听力练习，也能使其更深入学习汉语和中国文化。

default.zh: 本课是为初学汉语的外国人设计的。 全书共40课，另有复习课8课。40课内容包括“问候”、“相识”等交际功能项目近30个，生词8OO个左右以及汉语基本语法。每课分句子、会话、替换与扩展、生词、语法、练习等六部分。课程注重培养初学者运用汉语进行交际的能力，采用交际功能与语法结构相结合的方法编写。将现代汉语中最常用、最基本的部分通过生活中常见的语境展现出来，使学习者能较快地掌握基本会话301句，并在此基础上通过替换与扩展练习，达到能与中国人进行简单交际的目的，为进一步学习打下良好的基础。
default.en: This course is designed for foreigners who have just started to learn Chinese.40 lessons include nearly 30 socially functional project such as greetings, acquaintance and so on.These lessons also include 800 new words and basic grammar of Chinese.Each lesson have six parts of sentences, Conversation,replacement and expansion, new words, grammar and exercises.The courses focus on training beginners' ability to use Chinese for communication.The textbook is written by the method of combining communicative function with the grammatical structure.The most commonly used and the basic part of modern Chinese is showed in language environment of Common life.Learners can quickly master basic conversational 301 sentences, achieve the purpose of simple communication with Chinese people and lay a good foundation for further learning.

default.zh: 本课是为初学汉语的外国人设计的。 全书共40课，另有复习课8课。40课内容包括“问候”、“相识”等交际功能项目近30个，生词8OO个左右以及汉语基本语法。每课分句子、会话、替换与扩展、生词、语法、练习等六部分。课程注重培养初学者运用汉语进行交际的能力，采用交际功能与语法结构相结合的方法编写。将现代汉语中最常用、最基本的部分通过生活中常见的语境展现出来，使学习者能较快地掌握基本会话301句，并在此基础上通过替换与扩展练习，达到能与中国人进行简单交际的目的，为进一步学习打下良好的基础。
default.en: This course is designed for foreigners who have just started to learn Chinese.40 lessons include nearly 30 socially functional project such as greetings, acquaintance and so on.These lessons also include 800 new words and basic grammar of Chinese.Each lesson have six parts of sentences, Conversation,replacement and expansion, new words, grammar and exercises.The courses focus on training beginners' ability to use Chinese for communication.The textbook is written by the method of combining communicative function with the grammatical structure.The most commonly used and the basic part of modern Chinese is showed in language environment of Common life.Learners can quickly master basic conversational 301 sentences, achieve the purpose of simple communication with Chinese people and lay a good foundation for further learning.

default.zh: 本课程为一年级留学生设置。通过大量听说练习，使学生具有初步的听说能力，能够满足日常生活、学习以及一般场合的最基本的口头交际需要。初期将教授声、韵、调等语音内容。在学生具备初步会话能力的基础上，教师运用课本所提供的材料安排教学，将语言点融会到交际会话中。学生能听懂单句、一般场合的对话和短文。
default.en: This course is set for foreign students of grade one. By a lot of listening and speaking training, Students have preliminary listening and speaking ability. They are able to meet the basic oral communication needs of daily life, learning, and general occasions. At first, we will study the sound, rhyme, tone. When the students have preliminary conversation skills, teachers arrangement the process of teaching by using materials in the textbook and mix the language point to the communication session. Students understand the single sentence, the dialogue in general occasions and essay.

default.zh: 本课程为一年级留学生设置。通过大量听说练习，使学生具有初步的听说能力，能够满足日常生活、学习以及一般场合的最基本的口头交际需要。初期将教授声、韵、调等语音内容。在学生具备初步会话能力的基础上，教师运用课本所提供的材料安排教学，将语言点融会到交际会话中。学生能听懂单句、一般场合的对话和短文。

They are able to meet the basic oral communication needs of daily life, learning, and general occasions. At first, we will study the sound, rhyme, tone. When the students have preliminary conversation skills, teachers arrangement the process of teaching by using materials in the textbook and mix the language point to the communication session. Students understand the single sentence, the dialogue in general occasions and essay.

default.zh: 社会统计学是社会学专业的学生必须掌握的方法与技术。但统计学庞杂的计算使得计算机的应用成为其重要的技术支撑。SPSS是优秀的统计软件，目前在我国的应用范围正在迅速扩大。作为社会学，社会工作者学会使用SPSS已成为精确、快捷地进行社会学研究的必要能力之一。本课程的主要内容包括：基于SPSS软件的各种窗口的介绍；菜单、对话框、选项、按钮等的操作方法；数据文件的建立与数据的录入；录入误差的消除；数据的排序、排秩、选择、插入、重新编码；数据文件的转置、合并、分割、汇总；描述统计；平均值分析与T检验；相关分析；回归分析；多选变量分析；非参数检验；统计图表的绘制与编辑等。
default.en: Social Statistics and its computer application are the elementary and necessary knowledge and skills for sociology undergraduates. As one of the widespread statistic tools, proficient SPSS operation is the required ability for sociologists and social workers. This course introduces windows, menus, dialog boxes, options, and buttons in SPSS. It requires the students to achieve a solid proficiency in operations of files, data, and charts. Operations of files include establishing, transposing, merging, splitting, and summarizing files. Basic operations of data include ranking, selecting, inserting, re-encoding data, as well as elimination of errors. Data analyzing operations include descriptive statistics, means analysis and T-test, correlation analysis, regression analysis, multi-selection multivariate analysis, and non-parametric test.

default.zh: 了解算法与数据结构是透彻理解计算科学、数据科学、现代统计应用的前提。随着计算思维在自然社会科学中的日益广泛应用，学生在各类科研与工程问题中需要基于算法与数据结构实现高效代码与程序开发。本课程基于经典的C语言对经典数据结构与算法进行深入讲解：在C的编程环境下，如何通过一系列经典的数据存储机制，有效地实现各类算法。通过本课程，学生将深刻理解数据结构的基本形式，理解并熟练运用递归、搜索、排序、树与图等不同类别的经典算法。
default.en: Understanding algorithms and data structures is a prerequisite for a thorough understanding of computer science, data science, and modern statistical applications. As computational thinking is increasingly applied in the natural and social sciences, students need to implement efficient code and program development based on algorithms and data structures for various research and engineering problems. This course provides an in-depth explanation of classic data structures and algorithms using the classic C language: it demonstrates how to effectively implement various algorithms through a series of classic data storage mechanisms in C programming environments. Through this course, students will gain a deep understanding of the basic forms of data structures and become proficient in using different categories of classic algorithms such as recursion, searching, sorting, trees, and graphs.

default.zh: 《国际法治专题》课程是贯彻执行习近平法治思想核心要义的重要课程。 课程旨在提升学生参与全球治理和涉外法治体系建设的意识，培养运用国际法和应对全球性挑战的能力。 通过本课程的学习，全面掌握国际法的基本原理，了解和分析国际法的原则、规范以及典型案例；融会贯通国际法与国内法的关系；学会运用客观的立场、观点和方法从国际法角度去研究和评判国际重大事件；提高研究国际法律问题的能力及水平，理解我国的对外政策，捍卫我国主权及国家利益；服务于中国走向世界，以负责任大国形象参与国际事务和构建人类命运共同体的大局。
default.en: The course of International Rule of Law is an important course to implement the core meaning of Xi Jinping's thought on the rule of law. The course aims to enhance students' awareness of participation in global governance and the construction of a foreign-related law system, and cultivate the ability to apply international law and cope with global challenges. Through the study of this course, we can fully grasp the basic principles of international law, understand and analyze the principles and norms and typical cases; integrate the relationship between international law and domestic law; learn to use objective positions, viewpoints and methods to study and judge international events; improve the study of international legal issues, understand China's foreign policy, defend our sovereignty and national interests; serve China to the world, participate in international affairs as a responsible major country and build a community with a shared future for mankind.

default.zh: 社会统计学是社会学专业的学生必须掌握的方法与技术。但统计学庞杂的计算使得计算机的应用成为其重要的技术支撑。SPSS与r是世界最优秀的统计软件，目前在我国的应用范围正在迅速扩大。作为社会学，社会工作者学会使用SPSS/r已成为精确、快捷地进行社会学研究的必要能力之一。本课程的主要内容包括：基于SPSS及r软件的各种窗口的介绍；菜单、对话框、选项、按钮等的操作方法；数据文件的建立与数据的录入；录入误差的消除；数据的排序、排秩、选择、插入、重新编码；数据文件的转置、合并、分割、汇总；描述统计；平均值分析与T检验；相关分析；回归分析；多选变量分析；非参数检验；统计图表的绘制与编辑等。
default.en: Social Statistics and its computer application are the elementary and necessary knowledge and skills for sociology undergraduates. As one of the widespread statistic tools, proficient SPSS/R operation is the required ability for sociologists and social workers. This course introduces windows, menus, dialog boxes, options, and buttons in SPSS and r. It requires the students to achieve a solid proficiency in operations of files, data, and charts. Operations of files include establishing, transposing, merging, splitting, and summarizing files. Basic operations of data include ranking, selecting, inserting, re-encoding data, as well as elimination of errors. Data analyzing operations include descriptive statistics, means analysis and T-test, correlation analysis, regression analysis, multi-selection multivariate analysis, and non-parametric test.

default.zh: 《中国当代经济》一课采取问题导向，兼顾理论性与政策性。本课旨在通过系统讲授中国经济所取得的成就及所面临的挑战，向学生展示中国经济发展的概貌，阐释中国经济增长的原因与影响，进而揭示中国经济改革与发展的逻辑与原理。通过对相关理论、政策和具体案例的剖析来梳理中国当代经济的成长轨迹，以理论研究与实证研究相结合的方式来讲解中国当代经济的发展历程和基本规律。
default.en: The course Economy of Contemporary China is characterized by an issue-orientation taking into account theories and policies. The course aims to systematically teach the achievements and challenges of China’s economy, to show students the general situation of China’s economic development, to explain the causes and effects of China’s economic growth, and then to reveal the logic and principles of China’s economic reform and development. Each lecture focuses on a specific issue to explain the development course and basic laws of China’s contemporary economy in combination with theoretical and empirical research through the analysis of relevant theories, policies, and concrete cases.

default.zh: 本课程为社会治理辅修专业的选修课，课程内容合法学理论与部门法为一体，集法治理念和法律规则于一身，熔法治理论和实践为一炉，旨在对学生普及法学知识，掌握法治一般原理，了解国内法律的主要规定及其精神，增强法治意识，养成法治思维模式，提升运用法律手段处理公共事务的能力和素质。
default.en: This course is an optional course for the minor major of Social governance. It integrates legal theories and departmental laws, integrates legal concepts and rules, and integrates legal theories and practices. It aims to popularize legal knowledge, master the general principles of the rule of law, understand the main provisions and spirit of domestic laws, enhance the awareness of the rule of law, and cultivate the thinking mode of the rule of law for students. Enhance the ability and quality of handling public affairs by legal means.

default.zh: 本课程主要介绍社会心理学的基本问题、理论及研究方法。结合社会学视角与心理学知识，对社会认知和社会关系等重要范畴予以分析阐释，剖析日常现象背后的社会心理机制。本课程的目标是使学生了解社会心理学的基本问题意识与理论框架，掌握社会心理学的分析方法，更深入的理解文化现象的社会成因，提升对于社会科学的总体认识水平，并初步掌握心理干预的社会工作技巧。
default.en: This course introduces the issues, fundamental theories, and research methods of Social Psychology. With the combination of sociological perspective and psychological knowledge, we will analyze and interpret the important concepts of social cognition and social relations. Furthermore, the social psychological mechanisms behind daily phenomena will be explored in the course. The aim of this course is to enable students to understand the basic issues and the theoretical framework of social psychology, master the social psychological methods, reach an in-depth understanding on the social causes of the cultural phenomena, get a better sense of social sciences, and initially grasp the psychological intervention skills.

default.zh: 本课程将从社会学专业视角出发，对社会保障理念、制度及其实践进行系统的、理性的概括和思辨。具体内容包括：社会保障的基本概念、社会保障功能以及社会保障理论基础。同时针对社会保障体系中所涉及的养老保险制度、医疗保险制度、失业保险制度、工伤保险制度、生育保险制度也将结合具体的实践进行分析，并将涉及社会救助及社会福利的相关内容。在学习的过程中，学生将全面了解世界各国及我国当前的社会保障制度的发展状况。
default.en: This course systematically summaries and analyze the concepts and practice of social security system from sociological perspective. As the beginning of this course, it introduces the basic concepts, theories, and function of social security. Next, it discusses theories and practices of pension insurance system, medical insurance system, unemployment insurance, industrial injury insurance, maternity insurance, social assistance, and social welfare. Above all, it helps the students to acquire a comprehensive knowledge of current development of social security system in the world, especially in China.

default.zh: 组织社会学是当代社会学研究的重要方向之一，组织社会学也是社会学专业学生的必修课之一。本课以社会学理论为基础，全面分析和阐述组织的含义、组织目标、组织的分类、组织的结构与设计、组织文化、组织决策、组织权力、组织领导、组织内的群体等内容；并通过对实际案例的解析帮助学生理解复杂组织的构成要素及其意义；并试图从方法论上建立起整体上分析组织现象的视角和能力，同时能够为组织实际发展提供解决问题的方案。
default.en: As a required course for undergraduate sociology program, Sociology of Organization is one of the important research directions of contemporary sociology. Based on the sociological theory, this course comprehensively discusses and analyzes a wide range of issues, such as the meaning of the organization, organizational goals, organizational classification, organizational structure, organizational design, organizational culture, organizational decision making, organizational power, organizational leadership, organizational groups, etc. It explains the elements and its meaning of complex organization by actual case analysis. Additionally, it attempts to interpret organizational phenomena from a methodological holism. In addition, sociology of organization is a highly practice-oriented discipline which aims to provide solutions for actual organizational problems.

default.zh: 社会工作概论课程是社会学专业主干课之一。社会工作是一整套科学方法，属于应用性社会科学。它主要讲授社会工作的领域内涵，相关的理论模式，实施的方法以及具体的应用。要求学生不仅要熟悉与社会工作相关的基本概念及其涵义，而且要了解社会工作发轫的背景与其在国外与国内的发展过程；理解把握社会工作相关的理论及其几种主要的社会工作模式；还要求学生熟练掌握各种社会工作方法，并能用理论分析和指导实际的社会工作实务。
default.en: Introduction to Social Work is a main course for sociology undergraduates. Social work belongs to the application-oriented social sciences with a set of scientific methods. This course mainly discusses the connotation, theoretical models, implementation methods, and the specific application of social work. It introduces the background of social work’s appearance and development in both China and abroad. The students are required to achieve a solid proficiency in the basic concepts, theories, methods, and modes of social work that prepare them for future actual social work practices.

default.zh: 社会统计学是社会学专业的学生必须掌握的方法与技术。但统计学庞杂的计算使得计算机的应用成为其重要的技术支撑。SPSS与r是世界最优秀的统计软件，目前在我国的应用范围正在迅速扩大。作为社会学，社会工作者学会使用SPSS/r已成为精确、快捷地进行社会学研究的必要能力之一。本课程的主要内容包括：基于SPSS及r软件的各种窗口的介绍；菜单、对话框、选项、按钮等的操作方法；数据文件的建立与数据的录入；录入误差的消除；数据的排序、排秩、选择、插入、重新编码；数据文件的转置、合并、分割、汇总；描述统计；平均值分析与T检验；相关分析；回归分析；多选变量分析；非参数检验；统计图表的绘制与编辑等。
default.en: Social Statistics and its computer application are the elementary and necessary knowledge and skills for sociology undergraduates. As one of the widespread statistic tools, proficient SPSS/R operation is the required ability for sociologists and social workers. This course introduces windows, menus, dialog boxes, options, and buttons in SPSS and r. It requires the students to achieve a solid proficiency in operations of files, data, and charts. Operations of files include establishing, transposing, merging, splitting, and summarizing files. Basic operations of data include ranking, selecting, inserting, re-encoding data, as well as elimination of errors. Data analyzing operations include descriptive statistics, means analysis and T-test, correlation analysis, regression analysis, multi-selection multivariate analysis, and non-parametric test.

default.zh: 社会统计学是教育部规定的社会学专业的十门主干课程之一。社会统计学作为从数量方面描述社会状况、社会发展和社会问题的一门学科，其作用和地位也更显突出。本课程将系统阐述社会统计学的基本原理和方法。内容包括：社会统计资料搜集和整理、综合指标测量法、概率论基础和统计推断、动态分析法和指数分析法等等。本课程根据变量的四个层次（定类、定序、定距、定比），以社会统计的实践过程为经，以社会统计学的原理和方法为纬，组成一个较为完整的篇章结构和知识体系。
default.en: Social Statistics is one of the ten main courses of sociology according to the stipulation of the Ministry of Education. As to describing social conditions, social development and social problems from the quantitative aspect, this course has a prominent role and status in sociological education. It systematically introduces the basic principles and methods of social statistics, including data collection and collation, aggregative indicator measuring, probability theory, statistical inference, dynamic analysis, and index analysis. This course provides an integrated knowledge system of the practice and theories of social statistics.

default.zh: 社会人类学是研究人类文化发展、变迁规律的一门人文学科。它阐述社会人类学的基本理论和基本科学观念，探讨人类社会文化现象的基本方法，是社会学的重要相关学科。它主要研究人类的体质和社会文化，是近代以来成为独立学科的。本课程的教学目的在于：为学生系统地了解和掌握人类社会文化活动的一般特点及其规律，进而运用人类学知识更好地认识自己、认识社会提供基本的知识框架和基础，并为下一步深入学习社会学专业课作好准备。 社会人类学课程是社会学专业的专业基础课。对社会人类学的学习，几乎可以说是成为新一代社会学学者的必要过程。通过社会人类学理论、历史与方法的学习，使学生更加了解人类和人类社会本体，有助于进一步掌握社会分析工具，实现改造和优化社会的任务。
default.en: Social Anthropology studies the development and laws of human culture. As a new autonomous discipline, it is closely related to sociology, discussing the basic theories, scientific concepts, and research methods of human physical and socio-cultural phenomena. It requires the students to master the general characteristics and laws of social and cultural activities so that they can achieve a better understanding on self and society with an anthropological knowledge framework. This course provides a foundation for the follow-up sociological courses. This course will help students to learn more about human beings and human society, which enables them go further to understand, transform and optimize the society.

default.zh: 本课程主要介绍社会心理学的基本问题、理论及研究方法。结合社会学视角与心理学知识，对社会认知和社会关系等重要范畴予以分析阐释，剖析日常现象背后的社会心理机制。本课程的目标是使学生了解社会心理学的基本问题意识与理论框架，掌握社会心理学的分析方法，更深入的理解文化现象的社会成因，提升对于社会科学的总体认识水平，并初步掌握心理干预的社会工作技巧。
default.en: This course introduces the issues, fundamental theories, and research methods of social psychology. With the combination of sociological perspective and psychological knowledge, we will analyze and interpret the important concepts of social cognition and social relations. Furthermore, the social psychological mechanisms behind daily phenomena will be explored in the course. The aim of this course is to enable students to understand the basic issues and the theoretical framework of social psychology, master the social psychological methods, reach an in-depth understanding on the social causes of the cultural phenomena, get a better sense of social sciences, and initially grasp the psychological intervention skills.

default.zh: 社区研究是社会学的重要组成部分。本课程运用社区研究方法，对社区的构成要素，社区结构与功能，城市社区组织，城市的社会结构，城市社会问题，农村社区特征，农村家庭和组织，农村社会分层与流动等进行分析，使学生在了解社区发展进程的基础上，掌握社区研究的相关理论。此外，本课程还选择一些经典的社区研究成果进行专题分析，旨在培养学生的社区研究兴趣，学会社区研究方法，在实证研究成果的基础上了解社区研究的最新进展。
default.en: Community Research is an important part of undergraduate sociological program. This course analyzes the elements, structure, and function of both urban community and rural community using community research methods and related theories. To be specific, it analyzes community-based organizations, urban social structure, urban social problems, rural families, characteristics of rural community, rural social stratification, and rural social mobility. In addition, it provides a detailed analysis of several classic community researches to promote students’ interests in community research. It helps students to figure out how to deploy an empirical community research and grasp the latest development of this field.

default.zh: 本课程主要介绍从先秦到近代中国社会思想史的学术发展脉络。在内容设定上，包括：春秋战国时期的社会思想（老子、孔子、墨子、孟子、庄子、荀子、韩非）、秦汉时期的社会思想（董仲舒、王充）、魏晋南北朝时期的社会思想（何晏、王弼）、隋唐五代时期的社会思想（韩愈）、宋元明清时期的社会思想（二程、朱子、王守仁、李贽、王夫之等人的思想），以及近代社会思想（龚自珍、魏源、洪秀全、康有为、孙中山），探讨其现代性意义。
default.en: This course introduces the development of Chinese social thoughts from Qin Dynasty to modern China, which can be divided into six parts. In the first part, it introduces the social thoughts in the Spring and Autumn Period, including the social thoughts of Lao Tzu, Confucius, Mozi, Mencius, Zhuangzi, Xunzi and Han Fei. In the second part, it focuses on social thoughts of Dong Zhongshu and Wang Chong in Qin and Han dynasties. In the following part, social thoughts of He Yan and Wang Bi who lived in Wei, Jin and the Southern and Northern Dynasties will be discussed. The fourth part, Sui, Tang and the Five Dynasties, takes Han Yu’s social thoughts for instance. In the fifth part, this course explains the social thoughts of Cheng Hao, Cheng Yi, Zhu Xi, Wang Shouren, Li Zhi, and Wang Fuzhi in Song, Yuan, Ming, and Qing Dynasties. In the last part, it provides an overview of social thoughts in modern China by examining the social thoughts of Gongzizhen, Wei Yuan, Hong Xiuquan Kang Youwei, and Sun Yat-sen. In addition, it explores the modern significance of all social thoughts.

default.zh: 经济社会学是经济学和社会学的交叉课程，主要以经济和社会现象的相互关系为研究对象，运用社会学的理论和方法，把经济现象置于广阔的社会背景中进行分析研究。本课程主要介绍经济社会学的定义、从经济社会学到新经济社会学的发展、经济行为、交换行为、消费行为、经济制度、企业与产业组织、劳动力市场、社会资本、文化、网络与经济等，使学生能从社会学的角度对各种经济问题进行分析，探索经济行为和经济现象背后折射的社会问题。
default.en: Economic sociology is a cross-curricular course of economics and sociology, which mainly takes the interrelationship between economic and social phenomena as the object of study, applies sociological theories and methods, and analyzes and researches the economic phenomena in a broad social context. This course introduces the definition of economic sociology, the development of economic sociology from economic sociology to new economic sociology, economic behavior, exchange behavior, consumption behavior, economic system, enterprise and industrial organization, labor market, social capital, culture, network and economy, etc., so as to enable the students to analyze the various economic problems from the sociological point of view, and to explore the social problems behind the economic behaviors and economic phenomena.

default.zh: 发展社会学是社会学的主干课之一，是随着发展中国家现代化过程的启动而诞生的。发展社会学可以说是发展理论拓展的最为引人注目的一个领域，它成功地将社会学的一些理论、范式和研究方法融入到发展问题的研究中，推动了发展理论的深入。本课程共十二章，分为三篇，分别为：社会发展的理论阐释、现代化发展的历史进程、现代化发展的现实解读，重点讲授以“传统－现代”为核心概念和以“核心－边陲”为核心概念的社会发展理论、现代化发展的历史进程、现代化在社会各个层面的表现。通过课程的学习，使学生掌握发展社会学的基本知识和基础理论，具备一定的解读现实社会发展问题的能力，提升学生的专业素养和社会责任感。
default.en: Sociology of Development is one of the main courses of sociology, which is born with the modernization of developing countries. Among the research of development, sociology of development is a remarkable area since it successfully absorbs sociological theories, paradigms and research methods into its studies. This course consists of twelve chapters, which are divided into three parts: theoretical explanation of social development, historical process of modernization development, and realistic interpretation of modernization development. Through the study of the course, students will master the basic knowledge and theory of development sociology, have certain ability to interpret the real social development issues, and enhance their professional quality and social responsibility.

default.zh: 国际经济学是向学生传授国际贸易领域与国际金融领域的理论进展、政策实践，以及国际贸易与国际金融之间关联关系的一门学科，是帮助学生理解开放经济中不断变化的国际经济问题的重要学科。通过本课程的学习，要求学生掌握国际贸易、国际金融的基本原理，理解国际贸易与国际金融的关联，具有运用国际贸易与国际金融的经典理论分析、解释、预测与贸易、金融相关的国际经济现象的能力。
default.en: International economics is a discipline aimed at imparting to students the theoretical advancements and policy practices in the fields of international trade and international finance, as well as the interconnectedness between international trade and international finance. It constitutes a crucial area of study for fostering an understanding of the continually evolving issues within the realm of international economics in an open economy. Through the study of this course, students are required to acquire a fundamental grasp of the principles underlying international trade and international finance. Furthermore, they are expected to comprehend the interrelations between international trade and international finance and develop the capacity to apply classical theories in the analysis, interpretation, prediction, and assessment of international economic phenomena related to trade and finance.

default.zh: 货币银行学A 课程简介 课程编码： 22HS31282 课程中文名称：货币银行学A 课程英文名称：Monetary Banking 总学时：40 讲课学时：40 实验： 习题： 上机： 学 分：2.5 先修课程：政治经济学、宏观经济学 货币银行学是一门重要的经济类专业基础课程，主要介绍货币，信用，金融市场，金融工具，各类金融机构如商业银行、中央银行，货币供求等基本理论以及货币当局的相关货币政策。 本门课程的主要任务是培养学生掌握货币、信用、金融和银行业务的基本理论、基本知识和基本技能，了解货币、金融运行的一般规律，具备进行金融操作的初步能力。 本课程主要内容包括：货币信用的本质特征与经济的关系；西方国家货币、资本市场的作用及运行机制；金融机构的分类和商业银行的经营管理；货币政策的制定与执行以及通货膨胀的成因，后果与治理措施。
default.en: Introduction to Monetary Banking A 1.General Information Course Code： 22HS31282 Course Title： Monetary Banking A Credit Hours： 40 Lecture： 40 Lab： 0 Computer Lab: 0 Practical: 0 Tutoring: 0 Credit(s)： 2.5 Offering Department: Department of Economics, School of Social Sciences Students: Undergraduate majoring in Economics(Second Bachelor's Degree) Term: Fall /First Prerequisites: Macroeconomics Political Economics 2.Course Description Monetary Banking A is a very important basic course for the economic specialty. It introduces the basic theories of money, credit financial market, commercial bank , central bank ,supply and demand of money as well as policy of authoritative bank. The main task of the course is to cultivate the students to have a good command of the basic theory, basic knowledge and basic technique of money credit finance and bank. The other one is to understand the general law of money and finance .The last one is to gain the initial ability to conduct financial operations. The main contents of this course include: the relationship between the essential characteristics of money credit and economy; The role and operation mechanism of currency and capital markets in Western countries; Classification of financial institutions and management of commercial banks; The formulation and implementation of monetary policy and the causes, consequences and governance of inflation. Author: Yangzunliang Reviewer： Zhangxin Date：October 22, 2023

default.zh: 产业经济学是以产业为研究对象的一门学科。产业经济学的主要内容：研究市场和企业微观运行的产业组织；研究产业间相互联系及联系方式的产业结构；研究产业之间投入产出联系的产业关联，企业、相关企业、科研单位及政府机构等之间相互作用的产业集群；研究整个产业空间分布和集合的产业布局；研究产业结构演进趋势和动态比较优势的产业竞争力等。
default.en: Industrial Economics is a subject which studies the industry. Its main contents are market and the industrial organizations. It also studies the interrelation and the way linked among industries; Industrial Economics studies relationship between input and output, and also the enterprises, research unites and governmental organizations. Industrial Economics studies the spatial distribution and collection of the entire industry of industrial layout. Industrial Economics studies evolution trends and dynamic comparative advantage of the industrial structure.

default.zh: 随着经济全球化和区域经济一体化的发展，世界各国和各地区经济相互联系、相互依赖的程度不断加深，世界上任何国家的生产和生活都不可能完全闭关自守，都要或多或少地依赖于其他国家的生产，依赖于国际分工和国际交换，正是这种错复杂的经济联系，构成了世界经济整体。
default.en: With the development of economic globalization and regional economic integration, the economies of countries and regions in the world are increasingly interconnected and interdependent. It is impossible for any country in the world to be completely isolated in its production and life. It is more or less dependent on the production of other countries and on the international division of labor and international exchange. Makes up the world economy as a whole.

default.zh: 本课程旨在理解和掌握财政学的基本原理和概念，从经济学的角度分析和解释政府的财政职能、影响资源和收入分配的方式以及政府公共财政政策。具体内容有：福利经济学、公共财政的职能、公共品理论、外部效应及其纠正、公共决策机制、成本—收益分析、公共消耗性、财政转移性支出、财政收入、税收理论、税收归宿、税收效应、以及中国财政税收和公共政策改革。结合案例对财政理论与实践能够有较深、较广的认识，关注国内外财政政策变化取向、运用及其实施效果。
default.en: The purpose of this course is to understand and grasp the basic principles and the concept of finance,We will analysis and interpret the the Government's financial functions,the way that effects the resources and income distribution,and the the Government's public finance policy from an economic view.It includes the following sections: Welfare economics, the Functions of Public Finance,the Theory of Public Goods, External Effects and its correction, Public Decision-making Mechanism,Cost-Benefit analysis,Public Expending,Financial Transfer Expending,Revenue, Tax Theory, Tax incidence, Tax effect,and China's fiscal revenue and public policy reform.We will give some cases in order to deepen the understanding of the financial theory and practice,and we will also pay attention to the changes of the fiscal policy and the use of it.

default.zh: 西方经济学说史是用以培养学生吸取经济学历史知识的重要的专业课，该课程旨在使学生了解和掌握西方经济思想史的历史脉络，了解经济思想史上经济学大师们的生平、著作、经济理论观点及其渊源、延续等。该课程对他们的经济学说作客观真实的叙述，然后实事求是地批判其缺点或指出其可能有的有点，体现较为公正的评议，并着重分析经济学说史中继承和发展的规律性。本课程借鉴国内外科研成果，考虑到经济学专业的特点，注重历史实事，侧重理性分析，采取课外读书与课堂讨论相组合的方法，重点内容是西方经济思想上著名经济学大师的基本思想之来龙去脉。
default.en: The history of Western economics is an important professional elective course dedicating on students’ understanding on the history of economics. The course aims to enable students to understand and master the history of Western economic thought in history, to understand the whole life and publications of the economics masters and aware of their point of views of economic theory, the origins, continuity and so on. The description of their economics in this course is objective and real, and the criticism of its shortcomings or the shortcomings it would have is realistic. All of these reflect a kind of fair evaluation, and focus on analyzing the laws of inheritance and development in the history of economics. This course draws lessons from domestic and foreign scientific research, considers the characteristics of economics, and focuses on historical facts and rational analysis. Combining extra-curricular reading with class discussion, the highlights are the context of basic ideas of well-known economists in the western economic thought.Real estate investment analysis is an important application-oriented professional course. The contents of the course include: Introduction to real estate investment, the analysis of real estate investment market, the contents of the real estate market research, the methods of marketing research, the real estate investment market forecasting, the real estate developing process and government administration, the basic data analysis of real estate investment projects, the real estate investment estimation and financing, the real estate investment financial evaluation and some evaluation cases, the uncertainty analysis of real estate investment (main uncertain factors and functions of the analysis), and the investment strategy of real estate.

default.zh: 《中国当代经济A》一课采取问题导向，兼顾理论性与政策性。本课旨在通过系统讲授中国经济所取得的成就及所面临的挑战，向学生展示中国经济发展的概貌，阐释中国经济增长的原因与影响，进而揭示中国经济改革与发展的逻辑与原理。通过对相关理论、政策和具体案例的剖析来梳理中国当代经济的成长轨迹，以理论研究与实证研究相结合的方式来讲解中国当代经济的发展历程和基本规律。
default.en: The course Economy of Contemporary China A is characterized by an issue-orientation taking into account theories and policies. The course aims to systematically teach the achievements and challenges of China’s economy, to show students the general situation of China’s economic development, to explain the causes and effects of China’s economic growth, and then to reveal the logic and principles of China’s economic reform and development. Each lecture focuses on a specific issue to explain the development course and basic laws of China’s contemporary economy in combination with theoretical and empirical research through the analysis of relevant theories, policies, and concrete cases.

default.zh: 《经济思想史B》一课旨在通过系统讲授经济学产生与发展的历史,帮助学生了解学科发展的延续性与连贯性，理解应该如何借助于对经济思想史的融会贯通来切实把握经济学的演变过程，并据此来进一步探究经济学的发展与变化规律。本课通过对经济学主要流派的讲述来梳理经济思想史的演化脉络。本课的讲授特点是强调对基本经济概念的提炼过程、理论联系实际的逻辑形成过程的阐述与剖析，以此来帮助学生提高对经济热点问题的分析与洞察能力。
default.en: The course History of Economic Thoughts B aims to help students understand the continuity and coherence of the development of economics and comprehend how to take hold of the evolutionary processes of economics by means of the mastery of history of economic thoughts through the systematic instructions on the history of generation and development of economics, and accordingly further explore the laws of developments and changes of economics. The course sorts out the evolutionary context through the narration of the main schools of economics. The course is characterized by emphasizing elaborations and analysis on the refining processes of basic economic concepts and the formation of logical processes in combination with theories and practices in order to help students improve analytical abilities and insights about economic hot issues.

default.zh: 《转轨经济学》是国际经济与贸易专业本科生重要的选修课。本课程在教学的过程中，综合了国际贸易学、货币银行学、宏观经济学等知识，向学生介绍在苏联解体后，俄罗斯经济改革的起因、理论依据、其国内各产业结构的调整以及俄罗斯经济改革后的全面后果。让同学运用已经学习过的“世界经济学”、“西方经济学”等专业知识，来认识俄罗斯经济转轨的起因、发展、成绩与缺陷。进而让学生对转轨经济有充分的认识。
default.en: Transition Economics is an important elective course for undergraduates majoring in international economics and trade. In the course of teaching, this course integrates the knowledge of international trade, money and banking, macroeconomics, etc., and introduces to students the causes and theoretical basis of Russia's economic reform after the collapse of the Soviet Union, the adjustment of its domestic industrial structure, and the overall consequences of Russia's economic reform. Let students apply the professional knowledge of "world economics" and "Western economics" that they have already learned to understand the causes, development, achievements and defects of Russia's economic transition. Then let the students have a full understanding of the transition economy.

default.zh: 《当代世界经济与政治》是一门交叉边缘学科，它以第二次世界大战后的世界经济、政治与国际关系的发展变化为主线，对当代世界经济、世界政治、时代主题与国际秩序进行宏观概括和综合分析，对发达资本主义国家、社会主义国家、发展中国家等不同类型国家的经济、政治和对外战略进行分类介绍和分析，对中国国际地位的发展变化、对外战略思想以及对外关系进行总地分析，应用马克思主义的时代观、国家观、民族观、战争与和平理论、经济与政治相互关系的理论、世界各国相互依赖的思想、和平外交思想来分析问题。本课程本着“学生的创新能力不是教出来的，也不是学出来的，而是练出来的”教学理念，“致知在格物，物格而后知至”，把实践教学贯穿于学生培养全过程，使学生学有所成、学有所用。学生可以在学习之中体验到快乐，主动学习，能够根据经济环境的具体情景灵活应用所学知识，形成高素质、强能力、善动手、易就业的优势，体现哈工大人的“规格严格，功夫到家”，并于深邃之处见素质，微细之处见功夫。
default.en: Modern World Economy and Politics A is a cross-cutting edge science, which regards the development and changes of world economy, politics and international relations as the main line after World War II. It carries out the macro-general and comprehensive analysis of contemporary world economy, world politics, time subject and international order. It carries out the classified introduction and analysis to the economy, politics and external strategies of developed capitalist countries, socialist countries, developing countries. It carries out the analysis of developments and changes of China's international status, strategic thinking as well as external relations. It applied the time concept, the state concept, nationality concept of Marxist, war and peace theory, the relationship between economic and political theory, the thought of interdependence of all countries in the world, and the peaceful foreign idea to analyze the problem. This course is in line with the teaching philosophy of "the innovation ability of students is not taught, not to learn, but the practice ", "knowledge depends on the practice, we understand it after practicing", so the practice teaching is carried out through the full process of the cultivation of students, so that the students have learned something and use it. The students can experience the happiness in the learning, they take the active learning, and they can make the flexible application of knowledge according to the specific situation in the economic environment to form the advantages of high quality and strong ability to start work. It also manifests the spirit of Harbin institute of Technology, and we can see the quality in the deep place and kung fu in the fine place.

default.zh: 课程旨在提升学生参与全球治理和涉外法治体系建设的意识，培养运用国际法和应对全球性挑战的能力。 通过本课程的学习，全面掌握国际法的基本原理，了解和分析国际法的原则、规范以及典型案例；融会贯通国际法与国内法的关系；学会运用客观的立场、观点和方法从国际法角度去研究和评判国际重大事件；提高研究国际法律问题的能力及水平，理解我国的对外政策，捍卫我国主权及国家利益；服务于中国走向世界，以负责任大国形象参与国际事务和构建人类命运共同体的大局。
default.en: The course aims to enhance students' awareness of participation in global governance and the construction of a foreign-related law system, and cultivate the ability to apply international law and cope with global challenges. Through the study of this course, we can fully grasp the basic principles of international law, understand and analyze the principles and norms and typical cases; integrate the relationship between international law and domestic law; learn to use objective positions, viewpoints and methods to study and judge international events; improve the study of international legal issues, understand China's foreign policy, defend our sovereignty and national interests; serve China to the world, participate in international affairs as a responsible major country and build a community with a shared future for mankind.

default.zh: 物权法是法学专业学生非常重要的专业基础课，是学习后续专业课如合同法、侵权行为法、亲属法与继承法等课程的基础，在培养学生法学思维与专业能力等方面占有重要地位。本课程主要讲述所有权、有益物权、担保物权和占有。通过对其基础理论的讲授、现行法律的评析、各类案件的研讨，培养学生的理论研究创新能力、法律解读评判能力以及案件分析处理能力。经过本门课程的学习，学生不仅掌握物权法方面的基本理论，为今后从事民法学的理论研究奠定良好的基础；而且掌握物权法方面的相关法律规定以及典型案例，为今后从事法律实务工作奠定良好的基础。本门课程考试成绩采用累加式，包括论文报告和期末考试。
default.en: Property law is a very important professional foundation course for law students, and it is the foundation for learning subsequent professional courses such as contract law, tort law, Family law, and inheritance law. It plays an important role in cultivating students' legal thinking and professional abilities. This course mainly discusses ownership, beneficial property rights, security rights, and possession. By teaching basic theories, evaluating current laws, and discussing various cases, students' theoretical research and innovation abilities, legal interpretation and judgment abilities, and case analysis and processing abilities are cultivated. After studying this course, students not only master the basic theories of property law, but also lay a solid foundation for future theoretical research in civil law; Moreover, mastering the relevant legal provisions and typical cases of property law lays a solid foundation for future legal practice work. The exam results for this course are cumulative, including paper reports and final exams.

default.zh: 侵权责任法是法学专业学生非常重要的专业基础课，是前期专业课如民法总论、物权法、合同法等课程的逆向思维课程，在培养学生法学思维与专业能力等方面占有重要地位。 本课程主要讲述侵权责任概述、侵权行为的归责原则、一般侵权行为的构成要件、侵害财产权与人身权的行为、侵权责任的方式与侵权责任的承担、数人侵权行为与责任、各类侵权责任。通过基础理论的讲授、现行法律的评析、各类案件的研讨，使学生不仅掌握侵权责任法方面的基本理论，为今后从事民法学的理论研究奠定良好的基础；而且掌握侵权责任法方面的相关法律规定以及典型案例，为今后从事法律实务工作奠定良好的基础。本门课程考试成绩采用累加式，包括出勤和论文。
default.en: Tort liability law is an important part of civil law，Including the concept of the infringement, tort liability law protection range，Tort liability imputation principle,Tort liability of the defense,The concept of joint tort characteristics,The specific standard of personal injury compensation with the project, The application of the mental damage compensation,The guardian, legal, education institutions, special provisions of the main responsibility, such as the Internet,The division of traffic accident tort liability and responsibility main body,The application of the medical damage compensation,Product liability,Damage caused by the animal responsibility imputation principle and responsibility main body,Environmental infringement, Objects cause person damage liability and the damage caused by the highly dangerous homework, etc.The word tort liability law sounds far away from life and seems to have nothing to do with your major, but in fact it exists in every aspect of life. The implementation of tort liability law is a blessing for the common people to protect their rights.I believe that what I have learned will be useful in my future life. The course examination results are cumulative, attendance and paper.

default.zh: 《证据法学》是高等学校法学教育的一门必修课程，是我国法学体系中的重要分支，证据制度是诉讼法中最重要的基本制度，证据法律规范是在诉讼中正确运用证据查明案件事实真实情况和正确适用法律的前提和保障。证据学采用了比较和历史的研究方法，探求现代证据立法的精神和发展规律，研究论述了证据学的研究对象、体系、研究方法以及与相邻法律学科的关系，明确界定了诉讼证据的本质属性、证明任务和证明对象、证明责任、证据运用的规则、证据收集和判断等理论问题，并且通过联系我国丰富的诉讼实践经验和当前整个司法制度，对今后的诉讼产生重大的理论和实践指导意义。
default.en: Evidence Science is one of the compulsory courses in the legal science education of higher educational institutes, which is the important branch in the legal system of our country. In procedural law, evidence system is the most important and basic, and in litigations， legal norms of evidence is the premise and protection in finding out the truly facts by using evidence and norms correctly. Through the comparative and historical method of studying, evidence science investigates the spirit of the modern evidence law enacted and the regulation of development, by studying to discuss the theories such as the research object、 system、 the method of studying and the relation of the close legal science, and define the essence of litigious evidence, the mission and objects of proving, the rule of evidence used, collecting evidence and judging evidence etc., and by analysing enrich experience in litigious practice and the whole judiciary of China, in the future, it is the important meaning in guiding theoretic study and practice.

default.zh: 合同法是调整市场经济关系的基本法，是民商法的重要组成部分，在社会主义市场经济中发挥着重要的作用。本课程主要讲述合同法学基本理论及合同法基本制度，使学生熟悉并掌握我国合同法律制度的内容，了解合同法在民法体系中的地位、了解合同债权与物权的区别。内容包括：合同法的概念、性质、基本原则。合同的订立、合同的成立与生效、合同的履行、变更、转让和终止、违约责任等；同时，介绍各种合同的订立履行规则。要求学生在学习本课程后，对我国的合同法制度所了解，了解并掌握合同法理论研究的前沿动向，能够娴熟运用合同法基本原理处理解决合同实务问题。 本课程考试成绩采用累加式，包括平时表现、测试和期末考试三部分。
default.en: Contract law is the basic law to adjust the relation of market economy. It is an important part of civil and commercial law, and plays an important role in the socialist market economy.This course focuses on the basic theory and the basic system of Contract Law, which enable the students to be familiar with and master the contract law system of our country, to have a general idea of the status of the Contract Law in the Civil Law System, to distinguish contract creditor's rights from property rights. The content mainly include: the concept, nature and basic principles of the Contract Law; conclusion of contracts, formation and validity of contracts; performance of contracts, the amendment, assignment and termination of contracts, breach of contracts, etc.; At the same time, the course also introduces rules entering into various contracts. This course requires students to have a general understanding of the contract law system of our country, to understand and master the forefront trends of the theory of Contract Law, to apply the basic principles of the Contract Law to solve the practical problems of contracts skillfully. The result of this course is cumulative, including daily performance, testing and final examination.

default.zh: 知识产权法是法学专业核心主干课，属于民法学科的重要分支，是与物权法、债权法并列的专门财产法律制度。在知识经济时代和全球经济一体化进程中，知识产权法在经济贸易、科学技术等领域具有重要作用。知识产权法主要讲授著作权、专利权、商标权的原理和基本制度。 通过本课程的学习使学生系统掌握知识产权法的基本理论、基本制度、基本原则，培养学生运用知识产权法理论以及知识产权法律、法规、政策来分析和解决现实生活中的实际问题的能力。本课程考试成绩采用累加式，包括平时表现、测试和期末考试三部分。
default.en: Intellectual property law is an important professional basic course ，and it is tied with Property law、law of obligations in property law system. On the one hand it is an important branch of civil law, on the other hand It is also a relatively independent field law. In the era of knowledge economy and the process of global economic integration, intellectual property law has an important function in economy and trade、science and technology and other fields. The principle and basic system of copyright, patent right and trademark right is the core of teaching. By learning the course, students can master the basic theory, the basic system and the basic principles of intellectual property law, can analyze and solve practical problems in life by using the theory、laws、regulations and policies of intellectual property law. The result of this course is cumulative, including daily performance , testing and final examination.

default.zh: 刑法学是高等学校法学教育的一门重要主干课程，由刑法总论与刑法各论构成。刑法总论是刑法学的基本理论部分，是各论的基础。刑法总论主要系统而较为深入地论述刑法通论、犯罪总论、刑罚总论方面的刑法基本原理与刑法总则规范，刑法通论主要包括刑法的概念、任务、效力、基本原则等内容；犯罪总论主要包括犯罪的概念、犯罪构成、正当化行为、故意犯罪的停止形态、共同犯罪和罪数形态等内容；刑罚总论主要包括刑罚体系和量刑行刑制度。通过总论部分的学习，使学生掌握刑法的基本原理，了解我国刑法总则的基本规则，为学生进一步学习刑法各论奠定坚实的理论基础。课程教学注重理论联系实际，注重采用互动式、启发式教学方法，并要求学生撰写读书笔记以锻炼其法律思维能力。
default.en: Criminal law is one of the key courses in the legal science education of higher educational institutions, and it is divided two parts –general provisions of the criminal law and specific provisions, and the former is the basic part. The general provisions of criminal law discusses systematically and thoroughly the basic principles of the criminal law and criteria of the general provitions of the criminal law concerning the general survey of the criminal law, general provision of crimes and general provisions of punishment. Including the concept and the aim of the criminal law, basic principles of the criminal law, the scope of validity of the criminal law, the concept of crime, the constitution of the crime, justifiable acts, the suspended situation of intentonal crime, joint crimes, the form of quantity of crime, the system and types of punishments, measurement of punishments, the system of the measurement of punishment, the system of the execution of punishment, annihilation of punishment. The judicial practice is paid more attention during this course , and students’ papers should be handed in before examination.

default.zh: 国际法主要是研究国家之间关系的一般原则、规则和制度的部门法学学科。本课程介绍了国际法的研究对象、国际法的主体、国际法的效力根据、国际法的基本原则、国际法与国内法的关系；讨论国际法上的国家、国际法上的居民及国家领土的法律制度，诸如国际法上的承认与继承、国际法上的国家责任、引渡与庇护、国家领土的取得等；研究国际海洋法、航空法、外层空间法和国际组织法的法律规则、制度；探讨外交特权与豁免的内容、条约的缔结与适用、国际争端的解决等问题；了解中国对重大国际问题和国际事件的立场和观点。
default.en: Course Description： International law discussing the general principles, rules and institutions of the relationship between nations is a subject of department law. This course presents objects of international law research, subjects of international law, theories as to the basis of international law, the basic principles of international law, relation between international law and municipal law; approaches legal system about state, population and state territory in international law, such as recognition and succession of international law, state responsibility of international law, extradition and asylum, acquisition of state territory…etc; discusses legal rules and institutions about the law of the sea, air of law, outer space law, international organizations of law; probes some topics of the content of diplomatic and consular immunities, conclusion and application of treaties, solutions to the international disputes; masters the standpoint and viewpoint of Chinese government on important international topics and affairs.

default.zh: 行政法与行政诉讼法学是以行政法律关系为研究对象的法学分支学科，其目标是建设法治政府，其实质是规范行政权力依法行使。行政法与行政诉讼法是构建法治国家所必需的重要组成部分。课程以行政权的规制为核心确立了行政主体、行政行为与行政救济三大主体内容，重点使学生了解行政法学的理论基础、发展趋势及前沿内容；熟悉行政权的运行机制，能够对行政救济渠道有全面的了解。 课程主要内容包括行政法的一般原理、行政法主体、行政行为、行政程序、行政复议、行政诉讼等基本问题。本课程考试成绩采用累加式，包括期末笔试、课程论文和文献综述三个部分。
default.en: The administrative law and administrative litigation law is a branch of law that is subject to the relationship of administrative law. Its goal is to build a government of rule of law, which is to regulate the exercise of administrative power in accordance with the law. Administrative law and administrative procedure law are important components necessary to build a country under the rule of law. Course with the regulation of executive power as the core to establish the administrative subject, administrative act and administrative remedy three main content, the key to make the students understand the theoretical basis of administrative law, development trend and frontier content; Familiar with the operation mechanism of administrative power, can have a comprehensive understanding of administrative relief channels. The main contents of the course include the general principle of administrative law, administrative law subject, administrative action, administrative procedure, administrative reconsideration, administrative litigation and other basic issues. The results of this course are cumulative, including the final written exam, course assignment, and literature synthesis.

default.zh: 中国法律史是高等学校法学专业的一门专业核心课,系统论述了中国近五千年的法律发展历史，全面阐述了法律史学科的基本理论和主要内容。其基本任务在于揭示中国法律制度发展的一般内在规律，探讨中国法律文化的内在逻辑，使学生了解中华法系的世界意义，培养正确的法律观，更好地理解当代中国现行的法律制度。
default.en: The Legal History of China is one of the core courses in the legal science education of higher educational institutions .It dissertates systemically the basic theory and the main contents of the 5000 years long history of the Chinese law. Revealing the inherent law of the development of Chinese legal system, talking about the inner logic of Chinese legal culture, understanding the global significance of Chinese System，correcting the concept of law, and giving a deeper understanding of the current legal system of China are the basic tasks of this course.

default.zh: 法律职业伦理是法学与伦理学两大领域交叉的新兴边缘学科，它研究的是整个法律现象中的道德问题，包括法律中的道德问题，比如刑法、民法中的道德问题，更包括法律实践中的道德问题。本课程主要研习法律职业人员在职务活动中的道德准则、规范与养成。它所包含的理念将指导法律人的整个职业生涯。在本课程中学生将学到他所赖做人及谋生的规则以及忽视这些规则的后果。 课程主要内容包括法律职业伦理概述、形成及社会功能；法律职业伦理的基本原则与基本规则；法官职业伦理、检察官职业伦理、律师职业伦理。本课程考试成绩采用累加式，包课程大作业和考试两个部分。
default.en: Course Description： Legal professional ethics is the intersection of two fields of law and ethics emerging edge discipline, it is the study of the whole legal phenomenon of ethical issues, including ethical issues of the law, such as the moral problems in criminal law, civil law, more including ethical problems in legal practice. This course focuses on the ethics, norms and cultivation of legal professionals in the activities. It contains ideas that will guide the law's entire career. In this course, middle school students will learn the rules of his life and his livelihood and the consequences of ignoring them. The main contents include the introduction of legal professional ethics, formation and social function; Basic principles and basic rules of legal professional ethics; Judge professional ethics, public prosecutor's work ethic, lawyer professional ethics. The examination results of this course are cumulative, including two parts: course project and examination.

default.zh: 刑法学是高等学校法学教育的一门重要主干课程，由刑法总论与刑法各论构成。刑法总论是刑法学的基本理论部分，是各论的基础。刑法总论主要系统而较为深入地论述刑法通论、犯罪总论、刑罚总论方面的刑法基本原理与刑法总则规范，刑法通论主要包括刑法的概念、任务、效力、基本原则等内容；犯罪总论主要包括犯罪的概念、犯罪构成、正当化行为、故意犯罪的停止形态、共同犯罪和罪数形态等内容；刑罚总论主要包括刑罚体系和量刑行刑制度。通过总论部分的学习，使学生掌握刑法的基本原理，了解我国刑法总则的基本规则，为学生进一步学习刑法各论奠定坚实的理论基础。课程教学注重理论联系实际，注重采用互动式、启发式教学方法，并要求学生撰写读书笔记以锻炼其法律思维能力。
default.en: Criminal law is one of the key courses in the legal science education of higher educational institutions, and it is divided two parts –general provisions of the criminal law and specific provisions, and the former is the basic part. The general provisions of criminal law discusses systematically and thoroughly the basic principles of the criminal law and criteria of the general provitions of the criminal law concerning the general survey of the criminal law, general provision of crimes and general provisions of punishment. Including the concept and the aim of the criminal law, basic principles of the criminal law, the scope of validity of the criminal law, the concept of crime, the constitution of the crime, justifiable acts, the suspended situation of intentonal crime, joint crimes, the form of quantity of crime, the system and types of punishments, measurement of punishments, the system of the measurement of punishment, the system of the execution of punishment, annihilation of punishment. The judicial practice is paid more attention during this course , and students’ papers should be handed in before examination.

default.zh: 本课程适合以汉语为第二语言的汉语初学者。课程旨在培养学生听、说、读、写的能力，因此，本课程将训练学生掌握汉语发音、汉语基本语法及日常生活必需的交流方式的教学，同时，在课堂上介绍相关的中国文化知识及中国现状。通过学习，学生可以掌握汉语拼音和基本的汉语语法知识，具有初步的听说读写能力，能够满足日常生活、学习以及一般场合的交际需要。
default.en: This course is suitable for Chinese beginners who speak Chinese as a second language. This course aims to develop students' ability of listening, speaking, reading and writing. Therefore, this course will train students to master the teaching of Chinese pronunciation, basic Chinese grammar and communication methods necessary for daily life. At the same time, it will introduce relevant knowledge of Chinese culture and the current situation of China in class. Through learning, students can master Chinese pinyin and basic knowledge of Chinese grammar, and have preliminary listening, speaking, reading and writing skills, which can meet the needs of daily life, learning and communication in general occasions.

default.zh: 本课程适合以汉语为第二语言的汉语初学者。课程旨在帮助学生识记汉字字词，建立字形-字音-字义之间的联系，培养学生对字词、词组、句子、段落、篇章的意义和内容的理解能力，并使学生了解相关的中国文化常识。
default.en: This course is suitable for Chinese beginners who speak Chinese as a second language. The course aims to help students memorize Chinese characters and words, establish the relationship between font, character sound and character meaning, cultivate students' ability to understand the meaning and content of words, phrases, sentences, paragraphs and chapters, and make students understand the relevant Chinese cultural knowledge.

default.zh: 本课程适合以汉语为第二语言的汉语初学者。课程旨在培养学生听、说、读、写的能力，因此，本课程将训练学生掌握汉语基本语法及日常生活必需的交流方式，同时，在课堂上会介绍相关的中国文化知识及中国现状。通过学习，学生可以掌握基本的汉语语法知识，具有初步的听说读写能力，能够满足日常生活、学习以及一般场合的交际需要。
default.en: This course is suitable for learners with basic knowledge of Chinese as their second language. This course aims to develop students' ability of listening, speaking, reading and writing. Therefore, this course will train students to master the basic Chinese grammar and communication methods necessary for daily life. At the same time, the class will introduce relevant knowledge of Chinese culture and the current situation of China. Through learning, students can master the basic knowledge of Chinese grammar, have the initial ability of listening, speaking, reading and writing, and can meet the needs of daily life, learning and communication in general occasions.

default.zh: 本课程适合以汉语为第二语言的汉语初学者。课程旨在帮助学生识记汉字字词，建立字形-字音-字义之间的联系，增强语感，习得初步的阅读技巧，提高阅读速度和阅读理解力。同时，丰富的阅读材料也使留学生们更全面地了解中国和中国文化，进而成为知华、友华、爱华的汉语人才。
default.en: This course is suitable for Chinese beginners who speak Chinese as a second language. The course aims to help students memorize Chinese characters and words, establish their understanding of the relationship among font, character sound and character meaning, enhance their language sense, pick up preliminary reading skills to improve their reading speed and hence, their reading comprehension. Furthermore, diversified reading materials enable them to have a full picture of China and Chinese culture so that they would know China，befriend China and love China.

default.zh: 本课程是语言技能训练课程，会帮助学生在初级汉语基础上继续积累扩大汉语词汇量，学习汉语搭配使用方法，训练学生进一步巩固扩展和深化一些语法项目，提升学生汉语阅读理解能力，锻炼学生运用所学词语、结构和句式进行正确的汉语口语表达和书面表达，从而提高学生的汉语交际能力。
default.en: This course is a language skills training course, which will help students accumulate and expand Chinese vocabulary on the basis of elementary Chinese, learn Chinese collocation methods, train students to further consolidate and expand and deepen some grammar items, improve students' Chinese reading comprehension ability, and train students to use the words, structures and sentence patterns learned to correctly express Chinese in oral and written language. So as to improve students' Chinese communicative competence.

default.zh: 中级阅读这门课程对于留学生二年级学生相对较难。因此要求讲解过程中列举丰富多彩的、生动有趣的贴合学生生活的鲜活例子，这样才能使受教育者充满兴趣，才能真正有效地做好教学工作。本课程以单元为教学单位，课文题材涉及生活的各个方面，体裁多样又兼顾知识性。使学生在学习巩固语法知识的同时，熟悉各种常见的文体与词汇，扩大词汇量，提高阅读能力。
default.en: The course of intermediate reading is a little bit difficult for overseas students of grade two, so it requests the teacher provide abundant and interesting examples so as to make the students have more interest. The work of teaching will be more effective. The textbook is composed of several units. The texts involve all aspects of life. The subjects are diverse and don't neglect the knowledge. In the class, the students can study the grammar, familiar with a variety of common vocabulary, expand the number of vocabulary and improve reading ability.

default.zh: 写作是大多数留学生学习汉语过程中面临的难题，即使是一些口语不错的留学生，写起来也往往是错误百出。本课程通过句、段、篇的渐进式写作训练，使留学生逐步增强汉语思维能力，排除母语干扰，掌握正确的语法，了解常用的文体，熟悉汉语书写格式，从而能够用汉语写出结构完整、语法规范、标点正确、表达流利的文章。
default.en: Writing is difficult in the process of studying Chinese. Some students are good at speaking.But they have lots of mistakes in writing.In this course,the students do exercises from sentence, paragraph, to chapter. They gradually enhance the ability of Chinese thinking,eliminate mother-tongue interference,master the correct grammar,understand common literary style,and are familiar with Chinese writing format.They can write articles in which the structure is intact,the syntax is standardized,the punctuation is correct and the language is fluent.

So as to improve students' Chinese communicative competence.
