Some students are good at speaking.But they have lots of mistakes in writing.In this course,the students do exercises from sentence, paragraph, to chapter. They gradually enhance the ability of Chinese thinking,eliminate mother-tongue interference,master the correct grammar,understand common literary style,and are familiar with Chinese writing format.They can write articles in which the structure is intact,the syntax is standardized,the punctuation is correct and the language is fluent.

default.zh: 本课程为三年级留学生开设，贯穿全学年，是汉语专业高级阶段的基础必修课。本课程是以阅读理解为基础，以重点词语和常用句式为基本内容，以准确而得体的口语和书面语表达为训练目标的语言技能课。可以使学生进一步扩大词汇量，提高词语辨析和运用能力、快速阅读能力及大段表达能力，使学生在较高层次上理解和欣赏汉语丰富多彩的语言现象。此外，它可为其他基础课程的学习、为更高阶段的汉语学习打下良好的基础。
default.en: The course is a basic compulsory course for advanced stage students of Chinese Language major.It is setted for the third year foreign students,and it will continue through the whole academic year. This course is skills-training course,which based on reading comprehension, its basic content focus on important words and common sentence patterns and its target is accurate and dignified expression of spoken and written language. This course enable students to expand vocabulary, improve their capacity of analysis and use on words, quickly reading ability and the ability to express large segment, so that students can understand and appreciate rich linguistic phenomenon of Chinese language at a high level. In addition, it can lay a good foundation for the study of other courses and a higher level studying for Chinese language.

default.zh: 本课程是一门旨在提高留学生阅读和文学鉴赏能力的课程。它通过对经典文学作品的深入研读，帮助学生多方面地了解中国文学、文化、历史及社会等，培养学生文学理解能力和文学鉴赏能力。本课程以《留学生中国文学读本》为参考教材，深入浅出地介绍中国文学与文化。由中国成语故事讲起，逐渐深入介绍中国古典诗词，再到赏析中国现当代经典散文，最后带领学生走进现当代小说世界，一起品读经典小说，感受中国文学魅力，领略中华文化的风采。
default.en: This is a course designed to improve the reading and literature appreciation ability of international students. It helps students to understand Chinese literature, culture, history and society in various aspects through in-depth study of classic literary works, and develops students’ literary comprehension and literary appreciation. The course uses “Readings in Chinese Literature for International Students” as a reference textbook to introduce Chinese literature and culture in an in-depth manner. Starting from Chinese idiom stories, the course gradually introduces classical Chinese poems, then analyzes classic modern and contemporary Chinese prose, and finally leads students into the world of modern and contemporary novels, so that they can read classic novels together, feel the charm of Chinese literature, and appreciate the elegance of Chinese culture.

default.zh: 本课程的授课对象为三年级留学生，是对二年级后期写作课程的延伸。他们已经具备了基本的写作知识，能够写出叙述文体等，需要进一步了解和学习其他文体特征、惯用书写格式，以及写作的不同要求和应注意的问题。本课程选择了小传、游记、记叙文、说明文、议论文等文体，引导学生逐步掌握运用汉语构建语篇，写出基本符合汉语表达习惯的、不同文体风格的作文来。本课程体现了文体的多样化、实用性。
default.en: This course is an extension of the second-year writing course for third-year foreign students. They already have the basic writing knowledge, can write the narrative style and so on, need to further understand and study other style characteristic, the idiomatic writing format, as well as the writing different request and the question which should pay attention. This course selects biographies, travel notes, narrative, expository, argumentative and other styles to guide students to gradually master the use of Chinese text construction, write a composition that basically conforms to the Chinese expression habit, different style. This course embodies the variety and practicability of literary styles.

default.zh: 本课程为专业基础课。本课强调社会经济生活的“嵌入性”，认为经济系统和经济行为应该从社会整体的系统的角度来分析，也就是要考虑各种社会学因素的影响。本课程有助于帮助学生掌握经济社会学的发展过程和一般理论，建构自己的知识体系，提高专业素养；开阔学生的社会和专业视野，帮助学生摆脱经济学视野的局限性，树立经济与社会的综合意识，提高学生解释和理解社会经济生活的能力。
default.en: This course is a professional foundation course. This lesson emphasizes the "embeddedness" of socio-economic life, believing that economic systems and behaviors should be analyzed from the perspective of the overall social system, that is, the influence of various sociological factors should be considered. This course helps students master the development process and general theories of economic sociology, construct their own knowledge system, and improve their professional competence; Expand students' social and professional perspectives, help them overcome the limitations of economic perspectives, establish a comprehensive awareness of economics and society, and enhance their ability to explain and understand socio-economic life.

default.zh: 质性研究方法课程是社会学专业的核心课程，秉承社会学研究对规范性方法的需求，介绍质性研究方法的基本概念、主要类型及其适用范畴，突出社会学研究科学化、规范化、本土化的特色。通过本课程的学习，学生能够了解和掌握质性研究方法的基本概念和主要类型，提升利用质性研究方法开展学术研究的能力，在此基础上增强社会学专业的问题意识，并将专业知识应用到社会调查和社会实践中。
default.en: The course of qualitative research methods is the core course of the sociology major, which adheres to the needs of sociological research for normative methods, introduces the basic concepts, main types and applicable categories of qualitative research methods, and highlights the characteristics of scientific, standardized and localized sociological research. Through the study of this course, students will be able to understand and master the basic concepts and main types of qualitative research methods, improve their ability to use qualitative research methods to carry out academic research, enhance their awareness of problems in sociology, and apply their professional knowledge to social investigation and social practice.

default.zh: 编程能力与统计方法是计算社会科学前沿交叉领域专业的学生精确、快捷地进行社会研究所需要掌握的必要技能。R语言，作为统计领域的最重要的定量研究工具，一直是相关专业学生学习的重点。而Python作为通用型编程语言，近年来在数据科学领域快速崛起。本课程旨在为学生提供社会数据分析的基础知识与技能，重点使用R与Python这两种流行的数据分析工具。课程内容覆盖数据收集、清洗、可视化和基础统计分析等关键技术，帮助学生掌握如何从社会科学数据中提取有价值的信息。通过实际操作练习与案例分析，学生将能够将理论应用于实践，并在实际数据分析中提升解决问题的能力。
default.en: Programming skills and statistical methods are essential competencies for students in interdisciplinary fields of computational social science, enabling them to conduct social research accurately and efficiently. R, as the most important quantitative research tool in the field of statistics, has always been a focal point for students in related disciplines. Meanwhile, Python, as a general-purpose programming language, has rapidly gained prominence in the field of data science in recent years. This course aims to provide students with foundational knowledge and skills in social data analysis, focusing on the two popular data analysis tools, R and Python. The curriculum covers key techniques such as data collection, cleaning, visualization, and basic statistical analysis, helping students learn how to extract valuable insights from social science data. Through hands-on practice and case analysis, students will be able to apply theory to practice and enhance their problem-solving capabilities in real-world data analysis..

default.zh: 数字社会工作课程是专业主干课之一。社会工作是一整套科学方法，属于应用性社会科学。它主要讲授数字社会工作的领域内涵，相关的理论模式，实施的方法以及具体的应用。要求学生不仅要熟悉与社会工作相关的基本概念及其涵义，而且要了解社会工作发轫的背景与其在国外与国内的发展过程；理解把握数字社会工作相关的理论及其几种主要的社会工作模式；还要求学生熟练掌握各种社会工作方法，并能用理论分析和指导实际的社会工作实务。
default.en: This is a main course for the undergraduates. Social work belongs to the application-oriented social sciences with a set of scientific methods. This course mainly discusses the connotation, theoretical models, implementation methods, and the specific application of social work. It introduces the background of social work’s appearance and development in both China and abroad. The students are required to achieve a solid proficiency in the basic concepts, theories, methods, and modes of social work that prepare them for future actual social work practices.

default.zh: 人类学有两大任务，一是理解什么是人，二是理解人性是如何透过多元的文化表现出来。数码科技的蓬勃发展给这两者都带来了新的作用力。数字人类学课程通过对人类学理论的学习和它与数码科技相互关系的探究，试图得出一个结论，那便是“数码科技对人类到底意味着什么？” 本课程在对数字人类学相关理论梳理的基础上，结合数字人类学研究方法，探讨数字时代人类学的新发展，从网络空间下的人类社会、数字技术对人类文化的影响、政治生活领域的数码人类学等方面，探究数码科技对人类社会带来的影响，并辅以一定案例进行教学，试图通过课程学习，让学生真正理解数字时代的人类学相关知识，帮助他们更好的理解人类，理解世界。
default.en: Anthropology has two major tasks: one is to understand what it means to be human, and the other is to understand how human nature is expressed through diverse cultures. The rapid development of digital technology has brought new forces to both. The Digital Anthropology course, through the study of anthropological theories and the exploration of their relationship with digital technology, attempts to reach a conclusion: what does digital technology mean to humanity? Based on a review of relevant theories in digital anthropology and combined with research methods in this field, this course explores the new developments of anthropology in the digital age. It delves into the human society in the cyberspace, the impact of digital technology on human culture, and digital anthropology in the political life domain, among others, to investigate the influence of digital technology on human society. It also uses certain cases for teaching, aiming to enable students to truly understand the relevant knowledge of anthropology in the digital age through the course, helping them better understand humanity and the world.

default.zh: 普通心理学是研究心理学基本原理和心理现象的一般规律的心理学，是所有心理学分支的最基础和一般的学科。在普通心理学中，心理现象一般规律的研究常分为几个领域：感觉与知觉；学习与记忆；思维与言语；情感与意志；人格与个别心理特征。这些领域包括了人的心理活动的极为重要的方面。在心理学许多分支中，普通心理学占有特殊的地位。它从更广阔的理论角度来研究心理现象，是心理学的基础研究领域，对心理学的发展起重要作用，并能反映出心理学的发展水平和倾向。
default.en: General psychology is a discipline that studies the basic principles and general laws of psychological phenomena, and is the most fundamental and general discipline of all branches of psychology. In general psychology, the study of the general laws of psychological phenomena is often divided into several fields: sensation and perception; Learning and memory; Thinking and speech; Emotions and willpower; Personality and individual psychological characteristics. These fields include extremely important aspects of human psychological activity. In many branches of psychology, general psychology holds a special position. It studies psychological phenomena from a broader theoretical perspective and is a fundamental research field in psychology, playing an important role in the development of psychology and reflecting its level and tendency of development.

default.zh: 通过本课程教学介绍社会工作理论的基础部分。从社会工作理论缘起、理论流派的发展和主要的理论视角的教授和研究开始，使学生全面了解西方社会工作基础理论的内容，尤其要熟练掌握实践性理论的内涵和应用。课程以西方社会工作理论发展史为基点，通过厘清社会工作理论演进，从心理动力理论、行为理论、系统视角等几个方面介绍西方社会工作理论，内容从社会工作经典理论入手，结合中国社会工作理论发展的基础和实践经验，介绍中国社会工作理论的发端。夯实学生理论知识学习广度和深度，完善学生的知识结构。
default.en: This course will introduce the fundamental parts of social work theory. By discussion through the beginning of the social work theories, theoretical schools and some perspectives, students will understand the fundamental parts of social work theories, especially grasp the practical theories. This course will introduce from psychological dynamics, behaviors theories to the systematical perspectives by the evolution of western social work theories. Finally with Chinese practices, it will introduce the beginning of China social work theories.

default.zh: 中国社会课程将在加强学生研究方法的训练及拓展学生研究视野的前提下，帮助学生了解中国社会发展的脉络，加深学生对中国社会的认识。一方面，本门课程结合国内外社会学发展的最新前沿成果，向学生介绍口述史、社会记忆等研究方法与研究视角，提高学生的方法论素养；另一方面，本门课程将有针对性地向学生介绍中国社会变迁研究的经典文献及主要成果，通过讲授现代中国社会的形成、当代中国的经济改革与社会变迁、政治治理与社会结构、社会生活与社会阶层等内容，使学生对中国社会、特别是当代中国社会的概貌有清晰的了解及深刻的认识。
default.en: The course will help students to understand the characteristics and development logic of Chinese society and deepen their recognitions by enhancing their proficiency in research methods and expanding their research perspectives. On the one hand, this course introduces research fields, methods and perspectives newly developed in western and domestic sociology, such as oral history and social memory, in order to improve students’ methodological attainments. On the other hand, this course provides a clear overview of contemporary society in China, by systemically introducing the selected research cases and documents on Chinese social change, and focusing on the formation of modern China, the economic reform and social change, political governance and social structure, social life and social stratification in contemporary China.

default.zh: 世界文明史课程是社会学专业的一门基础课程，是一门用以帮助学生掌握世界各主要文明发展的历史的技术基础课，主要介绍各大文明在文化、思想、制度等领域的发展及其与社会、经济领域的发展的关系。本课程对由古埃及、两河流域、古希腊、古罗马构成的西方文化体系有所侧重，为学生学习中西方古代社会思想史部分所涉及的理论提供一定的社会、历史背景，并能从总体上为学生在社会学专业课程涉及的各种理论提供丰富的佐证或用于验证这些理论的材料。
default.en: History of World Civilizations is a foundation course of undergraduate sociology program. It is designed to help students to know about the history and development of the world's major civilizations. This course introduces the culture, ideology, the institution of major civilizations as well as their social and economic connection. It focuses on Egypt, Two River Area, Greece and Roman, which on the one hand gives a social and historical background to students when learning the social thoughts of ancient Western history, on the other hand provides rich evidences and materials for validating sociology theories.

default.zh: 本课程主要介绍当代传播学的基本理论和基本模式，探讨传播学方法，揭示包括网络传播在内的各种传播现象和发展规律。内容包括：传播的概念,传播学的形成与发展的历史,大众传播的结构、功能与社会控制,传播的过程、结构及其理论,大众传播者研究，传播者在大众传播中的地位与作用,媒介主持人的素质,大众传播的内容分析,传媒与大众文化的关系,大众传播的受众研究,大众传播的效果研究，以及大众传媒对现代人日常媒介生活的影响等。
default.en: This course introduces the fundamental theories and modes of Contemporary Communication. It explores the methods of communication studies and reveals the general laws of communication area. In this course, we discuss a wide range of content, such as the concepts of communication, the history of communication as well as the structure, function and social control of mass communication. We also explore the process, structure and theory of mass communication. Meanwhile, some research about mass communicators, such as their quality and function in mass communication, also will be involved. At last, we conduct analysis of mass media content, the relationship between the media and popular culture, mass media audience, and the effect of the mass media on modern life.

default.zh: 社会问题选讲是一门讲授中国当代社会问题现状，并传授学生如何通过社会理论解读社会问题的专业基础课。本课程为双语教学，通过对当代主要社会问题的基本状况、特征的分析和对其进行的解读，使学生：掌握当代中国主要社会问题的特征及致使其产生的主要社会因素；掌握社会问题的主要研究方法；学会使用社会学的方法分析和解决社会问题。本课程是社会学专业的专业基础课。对于运用专业知识认识、解读社会问题的课程，其重要性在于对培养学生运用社会学理论进行实际问题分析的能力。
default.en: This is a specialized foundation and bilingual course for sociological undergraduates which discusses social problems of contemporary China. It requires the students to have a good understanding on the characteristics of major social problems in contemporary China and their social causes. The importance of this course is that it can lead students to analyze and interpret these issues using social theories and social methods acquired in this course.

default.zh: 本课程将通过梳理文化概念在社会学理论中独特的地位，引导学生对文化与社会、意义与结构等社会学的基本问题进行反思；通过介绍文化社会学的理论渊源——英国文化研究与欧美的文化社会学，帮助学生把握文化社会学的学科属性；通过对符号与仪式分析、文化霸权与后殖民主义、社会分层与亚文化、时尚与消费研究、文化生产与文化接受、身体与性别文化等问题的介绍，引导学生阅读文化社会学的经典著作，帮助学生了解社会学的文化维度，通过向学生讲授文化社会学的分析方法与分析逻辑，提高学生利用社会学理论分析文化现象的能力。
default.en: This course will guide students to rethink the primary pairwise problems of sociology, such as culture and society as well as meaning and structure, by emphasizing the special position of culture in sociological theory. It will introduce British cultural studies and western cultural sociology, the origin of cultural sociology, which helps students to get intimate knowledge on the characteristics of cultural sociology. By exploring key issues of culture sociology, such as analysis of symbols and rituals, cultural hegemony, post-colonialism, subculture, research of fashion and consuming, production and reception of culture, and culture of body and gender, it requires students to understand the cultural dimension of sociology. It also requires them to read the classics of cultural sociology so as to improve their abilities to analyze cultural phenomena.

default.zh: 人口社会学课程是社会学的重要分支学科。主要研究和分析人口的规模、组成、分布、增减、流动、变化等人口现象，揭示人口问题和人口发展变化的规律，探寻人口发展与社会发展的关系。课程主要是培养学生掌握人口社会学基本理论、基本知识，进一步培养和提高学生的社会学理论素养和研究能力。掌握人口社会学的研究方法，具有运用定量分析方法和测量技术分析人口现象的能力。了解当今世界的人口发展态势，培养学生运用社会学理论分析阐释社会现象，进而提出应用性对策的能力。人口社会学侧重两大视角来增进对人类社会与人口问题的认识。一是结构差异性视角。人口的异质性或变异性是所有社会科学的基础。通过总体逻辑思维，通过在分组或个人特征的差异性上来研究把握总体现象。二是人口变迁视角。也是历史变迁的长时段视角。人口自身再生产有其自身的变化规律，如人口转变、人口变动周期性、人口增长惯性等等，都需要长时段的时间维度考察，而人口变迁的视角恰恰是我们把握人口变化规律的重要手段。 在社会变迁的研究中，人口学家提供了队列分析和生命历程的思路。
default.en: The Sociology for Demography, or Sociology of Population, is a sub-field of sociology, focusing on population phenomena such as size, composition, distribution, growth, movement, and change. It seeks to uncover the principles of population issues and its developmental changes, exploring the relationship between population development and social evolution. The course aims to equip students with the foundational theories and knowledge of the Sociology of Population, further nurturing and enhancing their theoretical understanding of sociology and their research capabilities. The course ensures students are well-informed about current global population development trends and nurtures their capability to apply sociological theories to interpret social phenomena, subsequently proposing practical solutions. Two main perspectives are stressed here. First, the Perspective of Structural Differences. The heterogeneity or variability of populations is fundamental to all social sciences. By employing population thinking, the discipline studies and comprehends general phenomena based on differences in group or individual characteristics. Second, the Demographic Transition Perspective. The natural reproduction of a population follows its own principles of change, such as demographic transitions, cyclical population changes, inertia of population growth, etc. All of these require a long-term time dimension for investigation. In studies of social transitions, scholars in this field offer insights through cohort analysis and the concept of the life course.

default.zh: 本课程将从社会学专业视角出发，对社会保障理念、制度及其实践进行系统的、理性的概括和思辨。具体内容包括：社会保障的基本概念、社会保障功能以及社会保障理论基础。同时针对社会保障体系中所涉及的养老保险制度、医疗保险制度、失业保险制度、工伤保险制度、生育保险制度也将结合具体的实践进行分析，并将涉及社会救助及社会福利的相关内容。在学习的过程中，学生将全面了解世界各国及我国当前的社会保障制度的发展状况。
default.en: This course systematically summaries and analyze the concepts and practice of social security system from sociological perspective. As the beginning of this course, it introduces the basic concepts, theories, and function of social security. Next, it discusses theories and practices of pension insurance system, medical insurance system, unemployment insurance, industrial injury insurance, maternity insurance, social assistance, and social welfare. Above all, it helps the students to acquire a comprehensive knowledge of current development of social security system in the world, especially in China.

default.zh: 作为一个新兴的交叉学科研究领域，计算社会科学在近年来得到了来自社会科学领域的关注。本课程对计算社会科学的基础理论与研究进展进行了全面的讲述。特别地，本课程从心理学、行为学、神经科学等多学科交叉的研究视角出发，重点讲述了个体研究相关的前沿理论。同时，本课程也对实验科学的研究范式与数据分析方法进行了讲授。通过本课程，学生可以更加深入的了解计算社会科学的相关理论、作为计算社会科学基础的个体行为心理研究、以及实验科学研究方法，对传统社会学研究理论与方法形成补充。
default.en: As an emerging interdisciplinary research field, Computational Social Science has gained attention from the social science community in recent years. This course provides a comprehensive overview of the foundational theories and research advancements in Computational Social Science. Specifically, the course focuses on cutting-edge theories related to individual research from interdisciplinary perspectives, including psychology, behavioral science, and neuroscience. Additionally, the course covers research paradigms and data analysis methods in experimental science. Through this course, students will gain a deeper understanding of the relevant theories in Computational Social Science, individual behavior psychology as the foundation of Computational Social Science, and experimental research methods, which complement traditional sociological research theories and methods.

default.zh: 家庭社会学是社会学一个重要分支学科。本课程主要研究家庭的基本结构、功能及其演化的客观规律，阐释家庭和社会的相互关系以及家庭在社会中的地位与作用。 （1）通过本课程的学习，让学生了解社会学在性别、婚姻及家庭领域的相关理论，掌握家庭形态的历史发展过程和相关概念，学会用社会学理论分析性别、婚姻及家庭领域出现的社会问题。 （2）从社会学视角研究家庭，是从社会学的根本价值目标出发研究如何维系社会与家庭之间的协调关系。旨在使学生明晰是在社会发生重大变迁时去研究、探索如何避免或减少社会与家庭之间的不协调，使社会和家庭保持一种动态的平衡关系。同时，探索作为社会生活基本单位的家庭在社会影响下的演变规律，探索家庭与社会相互作用的机制及其对社会发展的影响也有重大的理论意义。
default.en: Sociology of Family is an important branch of sociology. This course mainly studies the basic structure, function, and objective laws of the evolution of the family, explains the mutual relationship between the family and society, as well as the status and role of the family in society. (1) Through the study of this course, students will understand the relevant theories of sociology in the fields of gender, marriage, and family, master the historical development process and related concepts of family forms, and learn to use sociological theories to analyze social problems that arise in the fields of gender, marriage, and family. (2) Studying the family from a sociological perspective is a study of how to maintain a harmonious relationship between society and the family from the fundamental value goals of sociology. The aim is to make it clear to students that studying and exploring how to avoid or reduce the disharmony between society and family during major social changes, and to maintain a dynamic balance between society and family. At the same time, exploring the evolution laws of the family as the basic unit of social life under social influence, exploring the mechanisms of interaction between the family and society, and its impact on social development also have significant theoretical significance.

Additionally, the course covers research paradigms and data analysis methods in experimental science. Through this course, students will gain a deeper understanding of the relevant theories in Computational Social Science, individual behavior psychology as the foundation of Computational Social Science, and experimental research methods, which complement traditional sociological research theories and methods.

default.zh: 家庭社会学是社会学一个重要分支学科。本课程主要研究家庭的基本结构、功能及其演化的客观规律，阐释家庭和社会的相互关系以及家庭在社会中的地位与作用。 （1）通过本课程的学习，让学生了解社会学在性别、婚姻及家庭领域的相关理论，掌握家庭形态的历史发展过程和相关概念，学会用社会学理论分析性别、婚姻及家庭领域出现的社会问题。 （2）从社会学视角研究家庭，是从社会学的根本价值目标出发研究如何维系社会与家庭之间的协调关系。旨在使学生明晰是在社会发生重大变迁时去研究、探索如何避免或减少社会与家庭之间的不协调，使社会和家庭保持一种动态的平衡关系。同时，探索作为社会生活基本单位的家庭在社会影响下的演变规律，探索家庭与社会相互作用的机制及其对社会发展的影响也有重大的理论意义。
default.en: Sociology of Family is an important branch of sociology. This course mainly studies the basic structure, function, and objective laws of the evolution of the family, explains the mutual relationship between the family and society, as well as the status and role of the family in society. (1) Through the study of this course, students will understand the relevant theories of sociology in the fields of gender, marriage, and family, master the historical development process and related concepts of family forms, and learn to use sociological theories to analyze social problems that arise in the fields of gender, marriage, and family. (2) Studying the family from a sociological perspective is a study of how to maintain a harmonious relationship between society and the family from the fundamental value goals of sociology. The aim is to make it clear to students that studying and exploring how to avoid or reduce the disharmony between society and family during major social changes, and to maintain a dynamic balance between society and family. At the same time, exploring the evolution laws of the family as the basic unit of social life under social influence, exploring the mechanisms of interaction between the family and society, and its impact on social development also have significant theoretical significance.

default.zh: 本课程将从社会学专业视角出发，对社会保障理念、制度及其实践进行系统的、理性的概括和思辨。具体内容包括：社会保障的基本概念、社会保障功能以及社会保障理论基础。同时针对社会保障体系中所涉及的养老保险制度、医疗保险制度、失业保险制度、工伤保险制度、生育保险制度也将结合具体的实践进行分析，并将涉及社会救助及社会福利的相关内容。在学习的过程中，学生将全面了解世界各国及我国当前的社会保障制度的发展状况。
default.en: This course systematically summaries and analyze the concepts and practice of social security system from sociological perspective. As the beginning of this course, it introduces the basic concepts, theories, and function of social security. Next, it discusses theories and practices of pension insurance system, medical insurance system, unemployment insurance, industrial injury insurance, maternity insurance, social assistance, and social welfare. Above all, it helps the students to acquire a comprehensive knowledge of current development of social security system in the world, especially in China.

default.zh: 社会学名著选读关注的是社会学学科发展史上的经典著作。通过引导学生有选择地研究和阅读一些社会学经典著作，期望学生能够对近百年以来一些经典社会学名著有更具体的理解。这会最终有助于学生深入了解国外社会学研究的状况和进一步增长社会学知识，并为毕业论文及今后可能进行的研究工作进一步夯实理论基础，了解一些重要的、基础理论文献。我们试图把阅读原著融合到对社会学学派和社会学历史的发展过程的理解之中，并使对社会学名著的阅读与对其所解释的社会生活和所处的社会历史背景的理解相联系。
default.en: This course studies and introduces important sociology classics in last century. Besides an overview of western sociology development and sociology knowledge, it requires students to read them thoroughly based on their understanding of the intellectual history of sociology and the background of the book. It helps students to get a more concrete and in-deep understanding of sociology classics and social theories, which prepares them for thesis and future scholarly research.

default.zh: 公共政策分析是高等院校社会学、政治学、行政管理学等专业的一门重要课程。该课程与社会实际结合紧密，强调对学生综合运用所学的社会学理论分析社会管理中的实际问题能力的培养。具有多学科交叉的特点。 本课程主要介绍公共政策问题的由来，公共政策的地位、功能、结构、特点，以及现代公共政策分析的框架、要素与原则。同时简要介绍分析方法；本课程的主要内容包括现代公共政策的基本理论及现代公共政策分析方法两大部分。该课程有助于加深学生对先修课程中所学理论的理解，提高学生分析实际问题的能力，为学生毕业后从事社会管理工作打下基础。
default.en: Public Policy Analysis is an important course for sociology, political sciences, and administration management. It is a cross-discipline course with high practicability. It emphasizes the ability of analyzing and resolving the practical problems in social management with sociological view. After introducing the origin of public policy problems, this course will discuss the status, function, structure, and feature of the public policy, with the conceptual framework, elements, and principles of public policy analysis being followed. Generally speaking, the basic theories and analysis methods are the most important contents of the course. It prepares the students for better work of social management after graduation.

default.zh: 本课程主要讲授作为心理学与人力资源管理的交叉学科的应用心理学。一方面它是工业与组织心理学的一个分支，随着工业与组织心理学在多个方向上迅速发展，人力资源管理已经越来越成为工业与组织心理学关注的重要领域；另一方面，作为人力资源管理的一个分支，人力资源管理的前身是人事管理，当人在组织中越来越被看做“人力资源”的时候，“人事管理”也就开始逐步被“人力资源管理”所取代。本课程尝试打破基础心理学的结构框架，在简单呈现心理学研究基本程序、概念和原则的基础上，将心理学的基本知识和理论纳入到人力资源管理的各个功能模块，针对人力资源管理中的工作分析、招聘、培训、绩效、领导激励人际关系等诸方面内容分别介绍特定领域中最常涉及的心理学知识和理论。学生通过本课程的学习，可以了解和初步掌握心理学知识和理论应用到实际的基本规律和方法，进而能够把心理学理论和实践的工具方法结合起来。
default.en: This course mainly teaches applied psychology as an interdisciplinary field between psychology and human resource management. On the one hand, it is a branch of industrial and organizational psychology. With the rapid development of industrial and organizational psychology in multiple directions, human resource management has become an increasingly important field of concern in industrial and organizational psychology; On the other hand, as a branch of human resource management, the predecessor of human resource management was personnel management. As people were increasingly seen as "human resources" in organizations, "personnel management" began to be gradually replaced by "human resource management". This course attempts to break the structural framework of basic psychology. Based on a simple presentation of the basic procedures, concepts, and principles of psychological research, it incorporates the basic knowledge and theories of psychology into various functional modules of human resource management. It introduces the most commonly involved psychological knowledge and theories in specific fields, focusing on job analysis, recruitment, training, performance, leadership motivation, and interpersonal relationships in human resource management. Through the study of this course, students can understand and initially master the basic laws and methods of applying psychological knowledge and theory to practice, and then be able to combine psychological theory with practical tools and methods.

default.zh: 本课程通过学习大数据、云计算、区块链、人工智能等前沿技术推动城市管理手段、管理模式、管理理念创新的实践经验，发现大数据治理从数字化到智能化再到智慧化的演进过程。了解当前我国大数据社会治理的现实需求、治理效果、政策焦点和导向，探究当前或未来政策与公众期望之间差距形成的原因，以及弥合差距的可行路径。学习基于公众满意度的大数据社会治理服务质量提升模型，认识各地方政府信息服务能力可视化程度。学习大数据社会治理创新发展的空间连通与地区互助策略，为发挥大数据和社会治理决策的科学性、推进我国大数据社会治理精细化提供有效参考。
default.en: This course discovers the evolution process of big data governance from digitalization to intelligence to intelligence by learning the practical experience of big data, cloud computing, blockchain, artificial intelligence and other cutting-edge technologies to promote the innovation of urban management methods, management models and management concepts. To understand the current practical needs, governance effects, policy focus and orientation of big data social governance in China, and to explore the reasons for the gap between current or future policies and public expectations, as well as feasible ways to bridge the gap. Learn the big data social governance service quality improvement model based on public satisfaction, and understand the visualization degree of information service capabilities of local governments. This paper will study the spatial connectivity and regional mutual assistance strategies for the innovative development of big data social governance, so as to provide an effective reference for giving full play to the scientificity of big data and social governance decision-making and promoting the refinement of big data social governance in China.

default.zh: 本课程分别从身体技术、社会互动、社会阶层等社会学的主题探讨人工智能的社会功能，又从家居出行、工作休闲、媒体传播、环境和社会可持续发展、文化变迁等领域分析了人工智能在社会不同层面的影响，同时探讨了人工智能的越轨行为及风险治理，最后分析了人工智能技术创新、智能社会的建设及在此基础上的人工智能社会学的发展。迈向行动的人工智能社会学不仅指出了智能社会中的社会问题，同时也能够尝试提出促讲问题解决的行动方案。有助于学生做出关于人工智能技术发展和智能社会的建设的智识上的思考与回应。
default.en: This course explores the social functions of AI from sociological topics such as body technology, social interaction, and social class respectively, and also analyzes the impact of AI at different levels of society from the fields of home travel, work and leisure, media communication, environmental and social sustainability, and cultural change, and at the same time explores transgressions of AI and risk governance, and finally analyzes the technological innovations of AI, the smart society construction and the development of AI sociology based on it. Toward an action-oriented sociology of AI not only points out the social problems in the smart society, but also tries to propose action programs for problem solving. It will help students to think and respond intellectually about the development of AI technology and the building of a smart society.

default.zh: 本课程主要介绍当代传播学的基本理论和基本模式，探讨传播学方法，揭示包括网络传播在内的各种传播现象和发展规律。内容包括：传播的概念,传播学的形成与发展的历史,大众传播的结构、功能与社会控制,传播的过程、结构及其理论,大众传播者研究，传播者在大众传播中的地位与作用,媒介主持人的素质,大众传播的内容分析,传媒与大众文化的关系,大众传播的受众研究,大众传播的效果研究，以及大众传媒对现代人日常媒介生活的影响等。
default.en: This course introduces the fundamental theories and modes of Contemporary Communication. It explores the methods of communication studies and reveals the general laws of communication area. In this course, we discuss a wide range of content, such as the concepts of communication, the history of communication as well as the structure, function and social control of mass communication. We also explore the process, structure and theory of mass communication. Meanwhile, some research about mass communicators, such as their quality and function in mass communication, also will be involved. At last, we conduct analysis of mass media content, the relationship between the media and popular culture, mass media audience, and the effect of the mass media on modern life.

default.zh: 人口社会学课程是社会学的重要分支学科。主要研究和分析人口的规模、组成、分布、增减、流动、变化等人口现象，揭示人口问题和人口发展变化的规律，探寻人口发展与社会发展的关系。课程主要是培养学生掌握人口社会学基本理论、基本知识，进一步培养和提高学生的社会学理论素养和研究能力。掌握人口社会学的研究方法，具有运用定量分析方法和测量技术分析人口现象的能力。了解当今世界的人口发展态势，培养学生运用社会学理论分析阐释社会现象，进而提出应用性对策的能力。人口社会学侧重两大视角来增进对人类社会与人口问题的认识。一是结构差异性视角。人口的异质性或变异性是所有社会科学的基础。通过总体逻辑思维，通过在分组或个人特征的差异性上来研究把握总体现象。二是人口变迁视角。也是历史变迁的长时段视角。人口自身再生产有其自身的变化规律，如人口转变、人口变动周期性、人口增长惯性等等，都需要长时段的时间维度考察，而人口变迁的视角恰恰是我们把握人口变化规律的重要手段。 在社会变迁的研究中，人口学家提供了队列分析和生命历程的思路。
default.en: The Sociology for Demography, or Sociology of Population, is a sub-field of sociology, focusing on population phenomena such as size, composition, distribution, growth, movement, and change. It seeks to uncover the principles of population issues and its developmental changes, exploring the relationship between population development and social evolution. The course aims to equip students with the foundational theories and knowledge of the Sociology of Population, further nurturing and enhancing their theoretical understanding of sociology and their research capabilities. The course ensures students are well-informed about current global population development trends and nurtures their capability to apply sociological theories to interpret social phenomena, subsequently proposing practical solutions. Two main perspectives are stressed here. First, the Perspective of Structural Differences. The heterogeneity or variability of populations is fundamental to all social sciences. By employing population thinking, the discipline studies and comprehends general phenomena based on differences in group or individual characteristics. Second, the Demographic Transition Perspective. The natural reproduction of a population follows its own principles of change, such as demographic transitions, cyclical population changes, inertia of population growth, etc. All of these require a long-term time dimension for investigation. In studies of social transitions, scholars in this field offer insights through cohort analysis and the concept of the life course.

default.zh: 中国社会课程将在加强学生研究方法的训练及拓展学生研究视野的前提下，帮助学生了解中国社会发展的脉络，加深学生对中国社会的认识。一方面，本门课程结合国内外社会学发展的最新前沿成果，向学生介绍口述史、社会记忆等研究方法与研究视角，提高学生的方法论素养；另一方面，本门课程将有针对性地向学生介绍中国社会变迁研究的经典文献及主要成果，通过讲授现代中国社会的形成、当代中国的经济改革与社会变迁、政治治理与社会结构、社会生活与社会阶层等内容，使学生对中国社会、特别是当代中国社会的概貌有清晰的了解及深刻的认识。
default.en: The course will help students to understand the characteristics and development logic of Chinese society and deepen their recognitions by enhancing their proficiency in research methods and expanding their research perspectives. On the one hand, this course introduces research fields, methods and perspectives newly developed in western and domestic sociology, such as oral history and social memory, in order to improve students’ methodological attainments. On the other hand, this course provides a clear overview of contemporary society in China, by systemically introducing the selected research cases and documents on Chinese social change, and focusing on the formation of modern China, the economic reform and social change, political governance and social structure, social life and social stratification in contemporary China.

default.zh: 对社会福利的内涵及其与其他相关概念的区别与联系进行了辨析，介绍了国内外社会政策学者构建的经典的社会福利政策分析框架，讨论了讨论社会福利的生产、组织和输送，并描述了我国社会福利发展的具体情况，同时就福利服务的输送涉及较多的领域进行了重点介绍，分析了我国社会福利制度的特征和未来。
default.en: This course systematically summaries and analyze the concepts and practice of social welfare system from sociological perspective. As the beginning of this course, it introduces the basic concepts and function of social welfare. Next, it discusses theories and practices. Above all, it helps the students to acquire a comprehensive knowledge of current development of social welfare system in the world, especially in China.

default.zh: 社会政策是党和政府在特定时间为实现或服务于一定的社会工作和管理的目标所采取的政府行为准则，它是一系列政策、策略、法规、措施、办法、方法、规章、条例等的总称，是国家对社会公共事务实行有效管理的重要手段。同时，社会政策也是国家治理现代化的本质要求，是实现社会治理的重要路径。 通过课程的学习，希望学生能够了解社会政策的基本概念和各国社会政策的发展历史，掌握社会政策的形成、发展、调整的相关知识，并在此基础上将社会政策分析的理论和方法与社会治理相结合，从而形成实现社会治理的有效路径。
default.en: Social policy is the government code of conduct adopted by the Party and the government at a specific time to achieve or serve certain social work and management goals, it is a series of policies, strategies, regulations, measures, methods, methods, rules, regulations, etc., is an important means for the state to effectively manage social and public affairs. At the same time, social policy is also the essential requirement of national governance modernization and an important path to achieve social governance. Through the study of the course, it is hoped that students can understand the basic concepts of social policy and the development history of social policies in various countries, master the relevant knowledge of the formation, development and adjustment of social policies, and combine the theories and methods of social policy analysis with social governance on this basis, so as to form an effective path to achieve social governance.

default.zh: 数字时代的公共治理是当前公共管理研究中的前沿领域。各种新技术为政府赋能，极大的提高了治理效率与治理效能，细化了治理精度，拓展了治理领域，在理念、组织、流程等多个领域带来了新的变革。 本课程在总结国内外现有实践创新与经验的基础上，结合理论发展，讲授数字时代公共治理过程中的数字政府组织建设、数字时代的行政程序、数据共享与开放等具体制度的完善等相关内容。
default.en: Public governance in the digital age is a frontier field in current public management research. Various new technologies have empowered the government, greatly improved governance efficiency and governance effectiveness, refined governance accuracy, expanded the field of governance, and brought new changes in concepts, organizations, processes and other fields. On the basis of summarizing the existing practical innovations and experiences at home and abroad, this course combines theoretical development to teach the construction of digital government organizations, administrative procedures in the digital era, and the improvement of specific systems such as data sharing and openness in the process of public governance in the digital era.

default.zh: 本课程是《社会心理学基础》的拓展课程。由教师组织学生开展社会心理学实战操作，包括理论建构、实战设计、实战操作和实战报告等阶段。通过互动式、参与式的教学方法，依托认知心理治疗、叙事心理治疗、心理分析等实战理论和操作范式，让学生真实接触并思考具体的社会心理现象，并培养个人的团队工作技能。课程不设正式考核，每个学生的课程分数由其他学生和教师根据课堂表现共同给出。
default.en: This course is the expansion of “Foundation of Social Psychology”. Students are required to deploy social psychology experiments in the class, including a series of phases of theoretical construction, experimental design, experimental operation and experimental reports. By interactive and participatory teaching, this course allows students to experience and analyze specific social psychological phenomena. Besides, their team work skills will be improved during the experiments. There is no formal examination for the course, since each student's course grade will be given by other students and teachers based on classroom performance.

default.zh: 当代政治社会学仍是一个发展中的学科，还没有形成完全一致的体系和方法论。从一定程度上，政治社会学可以看作是用社会学的观点和方法研究政治现象的一门综合性学科。它着重研究政治系统与社会环境的相互关系，探讨政治体系在社会结构中的存在条件等。通过从社会学的角度去观察和解释政治生活，解读政治现象的社会基础。课程首先梳理政治社会学的理论根基，然后具体围绕着如下几个重要问题展开教学：政党与政治团体、革命的比较研究、政治参与与社会运动、都市政治、转型中国的政治以及风险社会的政治问题等。
default.en: Contemporary political sociology is still a developing discipline observing and analyzing political phenomena with sociological methods from sociological perspective. It has not formed a mature methodology or theory. This course mainly focuses on issues including the relationship between political system and social environment, the structural conditions of existence of political system, and so on. Generally speaking, it explains the social foundation of political phenomena. This course firstly examines the theoretical foundation of political sociology then discusses several important issues including political parties, political groups, comparative study of revolution, political participation, social movements, urban politics, risk society, and political problem in transforming China.

default.zh: 公共管理课程以公共部门的管理（特别是政府管理）作为研究对象，是一门培养学生综合运用所学的社会学科学相关领域（如政治学、社会学、心理学和管理学）综合知识的专业课，该课程与社会实际结合紧密，强调培养学生分析社会公共领域问题的能力。 公共管理是高等院校社会学、行政管理学等专业的一门重要课程，该课程有助于加深学生对先修课程中所学理论的理解，提高学生分析实际问题的能力，为学生毕业后从事行政管理工作打下基础。
default.en: With the public sector, especially the government, as the object of study, Public Management is a specialized course applying knowledge of social sciences, such as political science, sociology, psychology, and management, which closely connects with social realities. It emphasizes the development of the ability of students to resolve the problems of the public sphere. Public Management is an important course for sociology and administration management. By providing students a better theoretical sense and a higher problem-solving ability, this course paves a way for the administrative work after graduation.

default.zh: 组织社会学是当代社会学研究的重要方向之一，组织社会学也是社会学专业学生的必修课之一。本课以社会学理论为基础，全面分析和阐述组织的含义、组织目标、组织的分类、组织的结构与设计、组织文化、组织决策、组织权力、组织领导、组织内的群体等内容；并通过对实际案例的解析帮助学生理解复杂组织的构成要素及其意义；并试图从方法论上建立起整体上分析组织现象的视角和能力，同时能够为组织实际发展提供解决问题的方案。
default.en: As a required course for undergraduate sociology program, Sociology of Organization is one of the important research directions of contemporary sociology. Based on the sociological theory, this course comprehensively discusses and analyzes a wide range of issues, such as the meaning of the organization, organizational goals, organizational classification, organizational structure, organizational design, organizational culture, organizational decision making, organizational power, organizational leadership, organizational groups, etc. It explains the elements and its meaning of complex organization by actual case analysis. Additionally, it attempts to interpret organizational phenomena from a methodological holism. In addition, sociology of organization is a highly practice-oriented discipline which aims to provide solutions for actual organizational problems.

default.zh: 本课程将通过梳理文化概念在社会学理论中独特的地位，引导学生对文化与社会、意义与结构等社会学的基本问题进行反思；通过介绍文化社会学的理论渊源——英国文化研究与欧美的文化社会学，帮助学生把握文化社会学的学科属性；通过对符号与仪式分析、文化霸权与后殖民主义、社会分层与亚文化、时尚与消费研究、文化生产与文化接受、身体与性别文化等问题的介绍，引导学生阅读文化社会学的经典著作，帮助学生了解社会学的文化维度，通过向学生讲授文化社会学的分析方法与分析逻辑，提高学生利用社会学理论分析文化现象的能力。
default.en: This course will guide students to rethink the primary pairwise problems of sociology, such as culture and society as well as meaning and structure, by emphasizing the special position of culture in sociological theory. It will introduce British cultural studies and western cultural sociology, the origin of cultural sociology, which helps students to get intimate knowledge on the characteristics of cultural sociology. By exploring key issues of culture sociology, such as analysis of symbols and rituals, cultural hegemony, post-colonialism, subculture, research of fashion and consuming, production and reception of culture, and culture of body and gender, it requires students to understand the cultural dimension of sociology. It also requires them to read the classics of cultural sociology so as to improve their abilities to analyze cultural phenomena.

default.zh: 本课是为了提高本专业学生的专业素养和专业能力而设。由不同研究领域的专家学者定期来我校为学生们介绍各自的研究所长及研究成果，使学生们能够尽早接触社会学研究的前沿，并藉此丰富学生们的社会学理论和实践知识。同时，讲座将有针对性地根据学生的学习需要展开，采取灵活的教学方式，使学生们在领略专家学者的学术风采的同时亦能充分地表达自己的学术追求与学术思想。
default.en: This course aims to improve the students' professional quality. Experts from different research fields give regular lectures about their research results so that students can expand their theoretical knowledge and practical knowledge. The lecture schedule balances the frontiers in sociology theory with students’ learning needs.

default.zh: 社会工作实务课程要求学生获得专业社会工作者具有多元技能。本课程主要内容包括总体社会工作实务、社会工作实务目标、微观、中观和宏观实务目标设定、社会工作实务的价值观，案件评估、个案工作技术和方法。要求达到学生以专业的要求帮助人们提高其解决和应对问题的能力，帮助他们获得所需的资源，促进个体与个体、群体与群体、个体和群体与环境之间的相互作用，促成组织对人们及其社会政策的影响。
default.en: Introduction to Social Work is a main course for sociology undergraduates. Social work belongs to the application-oriented social sciences with a set of scientific methods. This course mainly discusses the connotation, theoretical models, implementation methods, and the specific application of social work. It introduces the background of social work’s appearance and development. The students are required to achieve a solid proficiency in the basic concepts, theories, methods, and modes of social work that prepare them for future actual social work practices.

default.zh: 本课程主要介绍人工智能与心理动力学的交叉思维与问题共识的基本问题、理论及研究方法。结合人工智能研究的视角与心理动力学知识，对人工智能演进的逻辑、个案、技术伦理与心理动力学关心的群体心理动力、群体潜意识的呈现、挫折心理与创伤心理的动力溯源等重要范畴予以分析阐释，剖析日常现象背后的心理动力机制与人工智能情境下的心理风险与认知成本。本课程的目标是使学生了解心理动力学的基本问题意识、理论框架，掌握心理动力学与人工智能的交叉分析方法，更深入的理解技术演进过程中社会现象的心理动力成因，提升对于技术思维与心理规律发生发展的认识水平，并初步掌握心理动力治疗中将潜意识意识化的动力治愈原理，并尝试将人工智能的思维范式与心理干预的一般原理和方法结合，提高学生的自我心理成长和技术思维多元延展的能力。
default.en: This course mainly introduces the basic problems, theories, and research methods of cross thinking and problem consensus between artificial intelligence and psychodynamics. Combining the perspective of artificial intelligence research and the knowledge of psychological dynamics, this paper analyzes and explains the logic, individual cases, technical ethics, and important categories of group psychological dynamics that concern the evolution of artificial intelligence, the presentation of group subconscious consciousness, and the tracing of motivation for frustration and trauma psychology. It also analyzes the psychological driving mechanisms behind daily phenomena and the psychological risks and cognitive costs in artificial intelligence contexts. The goal of this course is to enable students to understand the basic problem awareness and theoretical framework of psychodynamics, master the cross analysis methods of psychodynamics and artificial intelligence, have a deeper understanding of the causes of social phenomena in the process of technological evolution, improve their understanding of the development of technological thinking and psychological laws, and preliminarily grasp the dynamic healing principle of subconscious consciousness in psychodynamic therapy, And try to combine the thinking paradigm of artificial intelligence with the general principles and methods of psychological intervention, to improve students' ability to self psychological growth and diverse extension of technical thinking.

default.zh: WTO规则与应用课程中英文简介 一、课程基本信息 课程代码： 22HS32218 课程名称： WTO规则与应用 总学时： 16 理论学时： 16 实验学时：0 上机学时： 0 实践学时： 0 课外辅导学时：0 学分：1 开课单位：社会科学学院 授课对象：经济学专业 开课学期：4秋 先修课程：国际经济学 二、课程简介 《WTO规则与应用》是一门用以培养学生国际贸易知识能力的选修课，本课程将多边贸易体制（WTO）与国际贸易的实际应用结合起来，在多边贸易体制框架下讲述当代国际贸易的理论、政策措施及实践。主要培养目的是:培养理论联系实际的能力；掌握WTO与国际贸易的基本理论、基本知识和基本技能，了解在多边贸易体制下国际贸易的运作程序和一般规律；把握WTO的发展趋向及其对国际贸易的影响。本课程主要讲授世界贸易组织框架下的主要规则及其应用，主要内容包括：货物贸易规则、服务贸易规则、与贸易有关的投资与知识产权保护规则、促进公平贸易规则、贸易争端解决规则、例外和保障措施规则等。
default.en: Introduction to WTO Rules and Application 1.General Information Course Code： 22HS32218 Course Title： WTO Rules and Application Credit Hours： 16 Lecture： 16 Lab： 0 Computer Lab: 0 Practical: 0 Tutoring: 0 Credit(s)： 1 Offering Department: Department of Economics, School of Social Sciences Students: Undergraduate majoring in Economics Term: Fall /Forth Prerequisites: International Economics 2.Course Description WTO Rules and Application is a selective course aimed at cultivating students’ capacity of international trade knowledge. This course combines the multilateral trading system (WTO) and the practical application of international trade, and elaborates the theory, policy and practice of the contemporary international trade under the framework of the multilateral international trading system. The main goals are: To cultivate the capacity of relating theory with practice. To grasp the basic theory, knowledge and skills of WTO and international trade and know about the operational procedures and general laws of international trade under the multilateral trading system. To grasp the trend of WTO and its effects on international trade. This course mainly tells about the rules of WTO and their application, including rules of trade in goods, rules of trade in services, rules of the trade-related investment and intellectual property rights protection, rules of promoting fair trade, rules of trade dispute settlement, rules of exception and safeguards and so on.

default.zh: 近年来，人工智能和自动化技术迅速发展，并已达到一个拐点。 这无疑将对人类的未来产生深远的影响。人工智能和自动化的快速进步如何影响商业、就业、经济，和最重要的你？您个人可以做些什么来保持劳动力竞争力? 越来越多的工作岗位被人工智能取代的市场？在本课程中，我们将探讨这项强大的新技术的经济和社会影响。我们将讨论与人工智能有关的社会， 经济，和学术话题， 比如聊天机器人的智能与我们的智能相同吗？他们会取代以前由高技能人类工人（例如律师、医生和软件工程师）担任的工作吗？我们会爱上聊天机器人吗？它们也会爱上我们吗？为什么这么多开发聊天机器人的专家担心它们可能会毁灭人类？我们能做些什么来阻止他们毁灭人类？我们是否有一天能够将我们的思想“上传”到计算机服务器，实际上我们自己也成为聊天机器人？ 我们将结合多个学科的知识，包括计算机科学、心理学、社会学和经济学来探索研究这些问题。学生的作业将侧重于对现有基于人工智能的技术的原创研究，以及对我们希望人工智能如何塑造未来社会的批判性反思。
default.en: In recent years, artificial intelligence and automation technologies have developed rapidly and have reached an inflection point. This will undoubtedly have a profound impact on the future of mankind. How will rapid advances in artificial intelligence and automation affect business, jobs, the economy, and most importantly, you? What can you personally do to stay competitive in the workforce? A market where more and more jobs are being replaced by AI? In this course, we will explore the economic and social impact of this powerful new technology. We will discuss social, economic, and academic topics related to AI, such as is chatbot intelligence the same as ours? Will they replace jobs previously held by highly skilled human workers, such as lawyers, doctors, and software engineers? Will we fall in love with chatbots? Will they fall in love with us too? Why are so many experts developing chatbots worried that they might destroy humans? What can we do to stop them from destroying humanity? Will we one day be able to "upload" our thoughts to a computer server, in effect becoming chatbots ourselves? We will combine knowledge from multiple disciplines, including computer science, psychology, sociology, and economics to explore these questions. Students' assignments will focus on original research into existing AI-based technologies as well as critical reflection on how we want AI to shape society in the future.

default.zh: 《电子商务》是高等学校经济学科的专业必修科。本课程系统地向学生讲述了电子商务研究的基本内容，认识电子商务的发展趋势、电子商务运作的社会环境和技术环境，以使其掌握电子商务的基本理论、电子商务信息的收集与整理方法、网络营销策略与促销方法，掌握电子支付的理论与流程、网络交易安全基本思路与方法、物流基本原理等内容。
default.en: Electronic Commerce is a compulsory course of economics in colleges and universities. This course systematically tells students the basic content of e-commerce research, understands the development trend of e-commerce, the social environment and technical environment of e-commerce operation, so that they can master the basic theory of e-commerce, the collection and arrangement methods of e-commerce information, network marketing strategies and promotion methods. Master the theory and process of electronic payment, basic ideas and methods of network transaction security, basic principles of logistics and so on.

default.zh: 市场营销学是一门以消费者为中心的企业全方位的市场活动及其发展规律为研究对象的科学。它是研究企业如何将自己生产的产品或劳务引导到消费者或用户中去，指导企业成功地开拓市场的一门新兴学科。本课程主要包括市场营销概述；市场营销环境包括微观和宏观即企业内、外部环境以及市场营销的社会文化环境、政治法律环境、经济环境与技术环境；市场调研；市场细分、目标市场选择与定位；消费者行为分析；市场竞争战略；产品策略；价格策略；销售渠道策略；促销策略等内容。
default.en: Marketing is a new subject which mainly studies how the enterprise guides its products or services to consumers or users, and guides enterprises to develop new markets successfully.This course mainly aims to train the students to establish a correct concept of the market, theory with practice and innovation; grasp the basic theory and basic methods of marketing; exploring the law of marketing; through case analysis to cultivate students' ability to analyze and solve problems.At the same time, this course can also provide the necessary theoretical guidance for marketing personnel.This course mainly includes an overview of marketing; marketing environment analysis: the analysis includes marketing and cultural environment, economic environment and political environment; Market Research; market segmentation, target market selection and market positioning; consumer behavior analysis; competitive strategy; product strategy; price strategy; channel strategy; content promotion strategy.And through the study of these content, grasp the formation and development of marketing, understand the scientific connotation of marketing and marketing management tasks. Mastering the fundamentals of marketing This theory and method have the ability to solve practical problems by using what they have learned.

default.zh: 本课程是国际经济与贸易、经济学专业的一门专业基础课，是一门融贸易业务与英语为一体的专业课，本课程主要研究如何用地道的外贸英语与外商建立关系，如何进行询盘、报盘、还盘、接受，商讨装运、支付、保险及索赔等。其主要任务是培养学生具有在业务活动中正确地使用英语的能力，以及对外进行各项业务联系和通讯活动的能力；能翻译、写出内容确切、表达得体、符合规范、语句通顺、没有语法错误的信函。本课程本着“学生的创新能力不是教出来的，也不是学出来的，而是练出来的”教学理念，“致知在格物，物格而后知至”，把实践教学贯穿于学生培养全过程，使学生学有所成、学有所用。学生可以在学习之中体验到快乐，主动学习，能够根据经济环境的具体情景灵活应用所学知识，形成高素质、强能力、善动手、易就业的优势，体现哈工大人的“规格严格，功夫到家”，并于深邃之处见素质，微细之处见功夫。
default.en: Professional English is an important specialized course, it is also an important course that mix the foreign trade business and English. This course mainly studies how to use the real foreign trade English to build the foreign relations, how to make an inquiry, offer, counter-offer, acceptance, to talk about shipment, payment, insurance and claims. Its main task is to cultivate students with the ability to use English correctly in business activities, as well as the international business relations and communication activities; So they can translate and write the business correspondence that the content is exact, the expression is proper, and it should conform to the specifications, its sentence is fluent and there are no letter grammar mistakes. This course is in line with the teaching philosophy of "the innovation ability of students is not taught, not to learn, but the practice ", "knowledge depends on the practice, we understand it after practicing", so the practice teaching is carried out through the full process of the cultivation of students, so that the students have learned something and use it. The students can experience the happiness in the learning, they take the active learning, and they can make the flexible application of knowledge according to the specific situation in the economic environment to form the advantages of high quality and strong ability to start work. It also manifests the spirit of Harbin institute of Technology, and we can see the quality in the deep place and kung fu in the fine place.

default.zh: 该课程旨在提高经济系学生的学术研究水平，同时为毕业打下良好基础。通过该课程的学习，使学生掌握研究课题选择的方式方法，掌握论文撰写的技巧，检验学生对专业知识和技能的掌握程度，使学生可以通过互联网、学校图书馆、学院资料室等途径收集和处理资料的能力，掌握本专业学科的基本研究方法和学习方法，具备提出问题、分析问题和思考问题的能力。
default.en: Research topics and thesis writing is a professional limited elective course, aimed at improving students’ academic research ability, while laying a good foundation for graduation. Through the study of this course, students can master how to choose research methods, master the skills of writing paper, test students' mastery of professional knowledge and skills, so that students can have the ability to collect and process information through the Internet and school libraries, know the basic research methods and learning methods for the subject, have the ability to ask questions, analyze problems and think about problems.

default.zh: 一、课程基本信息 课程代码： 22HS32285 课程名称： 国际经济合作A 总学时： 24 理论学时： 24 实验学时：0 上机学时： 0 实践学时： 0 课外辅导学时：0 学分：1.5 开课单位：社会科学学院 授课对象：经济学专业(第二学士学位) 开课学期：2秋 先修课程：国际经济学A 二、课程简介 《国际经济合作》是经济学专业学生选修的专业主干课程之一，本课程主要内容包括:重点分析国际间各种生产要素流动的客观规律，介绍西方有关国家国际经济合作的理论政策和惯例，侧重讲授当代国际经济合作发展的客观基础与巩固、主要方式、业务程序以及中国参加国际经济合作的方针政策及实务知识。通过教学，培养学生树立正确的专业思想，使其掌握各类国际经济合作项目基本理论，基本知识和基本技能，了解当代国际经济合作的运作程序，具备进行国际经济合作实践的初步能力。
default.en: Introduction to International Economic Cooperation A 1.General Information Course Code： 22HS32285 Course Title： International Economic Cooperation A Credit Hours： 24 Lecture： 24 Lab： 0 Computer Lab: 0 Practical: 0 Tutoring: 0 Credit(s)： 1.5 Offering Department: Department of Economics, School of Social Sciences Students: Undergraduate majoring in Economics(Second Bachelor's Degree) Term: Fall /Second Prerequisites: International Economics A 2.Course Description International Economic Cooperation is a specialized essential course of the students majored in l economy . This course mainly analyses the objective law of the key factors movement in the world .It also introduces the theories, policies and customs of international economic cooperation in western countries. The current international Cooperation development objective foundations main types, business orders as well as China’s principles and policies in taking part in international economic cooperation. By means of teaching we can cultivate the student attitude towards the major make them master all kinds of basic theories, knowledge, skills of international economic cooperation. It also makes the students understand the operation orders of current international cooperation .So that the students can have the abilities of international cooperation.

default.zh: 企业会计实务是一门重要的专业基础课，也是一门重要的入门课。主要包括必须掌握的一些财务会计基础知识与方法，如会计的基本概念与原则、会计核算的基本方法尤其是会计科目与账户的设置、借贷记账法的运用，以及有关会计的基本实务，如会计凭证的填制与审核、会计账簿的设置与登记和会计报表的编制与分析等。由于会计学原理是一门既有较强的理论性，又有很强的实践性的课程，学习时应着重掌握会计核算的各种基本方法，既要知其然，又要知其所以然，既要学会操作，又要弄清道理，要能独立地进行操作核算。本课程本着“学生的创新能力不是教出来的，也不是学出来的，而是练出来的”教学理念，“致知在格物，物格而后知至”，把实践教学贯穿于学生培养全过程，使学生学有所成、学有所用。学生可以在学习之中体验到快乐，主动学习，能够根据经济环境的具体情景灵活应用所学知识，形成高素质、强能力、善动手、易就业的优势，体现哈工大人的“规格严格，功夫到家”，并于深邃之处见素质，微细之处见功夫。
default.en: Enterprise Accounting Practice is an important specialized basic course, it is also an important elementary course. It includes some essential basic knowledge and methods such as the basic concept and principle, the basic method for the setting of accounting account, the application of debit and credit method and the basic practice for accounting, such as the filling in and checking of accounting voucher, the setting and registration of accounting books and drawing up and analysis of report forms. Because accounting is the mix of theory and practice, we should master all kinds of basic methods of accounting and know the hows and the whys. We should learn operation and the theory so that we can operate independently. This course is in line with the teaching philosophy of "the innovation ability of students is not taught, not to learn, but the practice ", "knowledge depends on the practice, we understand it after practicing", so the practice teaching is carried out through the full process of the cultivation of students, so that the students have learned something and use it. The students can experience the happiness in the learning, they take the active learning, and they can make the flexible application of knowledge according to the specific situation in the economic environment to form the advantages of high quality and strong ability to start work. It also manifests the spirit of Harbin institute of Technology, and we can see the quality in the deep place and kung fu in the fine place.

default.zh: 投资项目评估是用以培养学生吸取经济学知识的重要的专业基础课，本课程主要研究如何应用技术经济学的投资项目效果分析和决策的理论与方法，进行各种投资项目的评价和决策，以达到提高投资收益、降低投资风险、优化资源配置的目的。其主要任务是培养学生：掌握资金的等值计算的方法，并能理论联系实际，具有创新精神；掌握投资效果评价指标；了解当前关于投资评价的热点及新理论。具有准确、快速分析相关资料的能力。本课程研究的重点是对投资项目进行可靠评价，以便于在实践环节进行可行性研究。
default.en: nvestment and project appraisal is an important and basic course dedicating on students’ understanding on economics. This course mainly concerns how to apply theories and methods of the investment project evaluation analysis and decision making in the technical economics field, and how to conduct appraisal and reach decisions toward investment projects so as to meet the goals of elevating investment profit, reducing investment risks, optimizing resource allocation, etc. Its major tasks are to help students to master the method of equivalence calculation of costs in an innovative way to integrate the theories with the practice, to master the investment evaluation index system, to understand the hot topics and new theories concerning investment evaluation at present, and to possess the capability of analyzing relevant financial data accurately and promptly. The course focuses on the reliability appraisal of investment project in order to conduct the feasibility study in practical aspects.

default.zh: 在过去的四十年里，人们对供应链管理的兴趣不断增长。许多企业认识到制造成本的减少可以通过有效管理供应链来实现。随着制造业运营外包的持续增加，供应链管理的区域化和全球化也愈益凸显和重要。《供应链管理》一课从供应链管理的基本概念与理论框架入手，系统讲授供应管理，供应链协调，供应链的不确定性与风险管理，供应链集成与外包决策等内容，帮助学生掌握有效管理供应链所需的理论基础、实践工具与决策支持系统，培养学生的战略思维能力，使其能运用经济全球化的思维逻辑来把握当今和未来的商业脉动与企业经营。
default.en: Interest in supply chain management has grown over the past four decades. Many companies realize that reduction of manufacturing costs could be achieved by managing their supply chains effectively. As offshoring of manufacturing operations continue to rise, regionalization and globalization of supply chain management become more and more obvious and important. The course Supply Chain Management systematically lectures on supply management, supply chain coordination, uncertainties and risk management of supply chains, integration of supply chains and offshoring decision-makings from the basic concepts and theoretical framework of supply chain management to help students master the required theoretical basis, practical tools, and decision support systems to effectively manage supply chains, to develop students’ strategic thinking ability, so that they can use the thinking logic of SCM to grasp the current and future business pulses and enterprise managements.

default.zh: 《国际结算》是国际经济与贸易、金融等专业本科生的专业必修课程。通过本门课程的学习，学生应初步对国际结算业务有一个全面、细致的了解；能准确理解国际结算基本概念；熟知国际结算业务分类；掌握国际结算各种具体方式的适用范围、操作流程；了解国际结算相关法律；具备进行国际结算实务的理论基础。
default.en: International Settlement is a compulsory course for undergraduates majoring in international economics, trade and finance. Through the study of this course, students should initially have a comprehensive and detailed understanding of international settlement business; Can accurately understand the basic concepts of international settlement; Familiar with international settlement business classification; Master the scope of application and operation process of various specific methods of international settlement; Understanding of international settlement laws; Have a theoretical basis for international settlement practice.

default.zh: WTO规则与应用课程A 一、课程基本信息 课程代码： 22HS32290 课程名称： WTO规则与应用A 总学时： 24 理论学时： 24 实验学时：0 上机学时： 0 实践学时： 0 课外辅导学时：0 学分：1.5 开课单位：社会科学学院 授课对象：经济学专业(第二学士学位) 开课学期：2春 先修课程：国际经济学 A 二、课程简介 《WTO规则与应用》是一门用以培养学生国际贸易知识能力的选修课，本课程将多边贸易体制（WTO）与国际贸易的实际应用结合起来，在多边贸易体制框架下讲述当代国际贸易的理论、政策措施及实践。主要培养目的是:培养理论联系实际的能力；掌握WTO与国际贸易的基本理论、基本知识和基本技能，了解在多边贸易体制下国际贸易的运作程序和一般规律；把握WTO的发展趋向及其对国际贸易的影响。本课程主要讲授世界贸易组织框架下的主要规则及其应用，主要内容包括：货物贸易规则、服务贸易规则、与贸易有关的投资与知识产权保护规则、促进公平贸易规则、贸易争端解决规则、例外和保障措施规则等。
default.en: Introduction to WTO Rules and Application A 1.General Information Course Code： 22HS32290 Course Title： WTO Rules and Application A Credit Hours： 24 Lecture： 24 Lab： 0 Computer Lab: 0 Practical: 0 Tutoring: 0 Credit(s)： 1.5 Offering Department: Department of Economics, School of Social Sciences Students: Undergraduate majoring in Economics(Second Bachelor's Degree) Term: Spring /Second Prerequisites: International Economics 2.Course Description WTO Rules and Application A is a selective course aimed at cultivating students’ capacity of international trade knowledge. This course combines the multilateral trading system (WTO) and the practical application of international trade, and elaborates the theory, policy and practice of the contemporary international trade under the framework of the multilateral international trading system. The main goals are: To cultivate the capacity of relating theory with practice. To grasp the basic theory, knowledge and skills of WTO and international trade and know about the operational procedures and general laws of international trade under the multilateral trading system. To grasp the trend of WTO and its effects on international trade. This course mainly tells about the rules of WTO and their application, including rules of trade in goods, rules of trade in services, rules of the trade-related investment and intellectual property rights protection, rules of promoting fair trade, rules of trade dispute settlement, rules of exception and safeguards and so on. Author: Yangzunliang Reviewer： Zhangxin Date：October 22, 2023

default.zh: 证券投资是用以培养学生吸取经济学知识的重要的专业课，本课程主要研究股票市场、债券市场和其它金融衍生市场的基本运行规律，包括证券监管的有效性分析和证券发行上市、流通的特征分析。我们在分析的过程中力求其主要任务是培养学生：掌握股票的技术分析方法和基本分析方法，并能理论联系实际，具有创新精神；掌握证券市场的基本理论、基本概念；了解当前国际证券投资的研究前沿、热点及新理论。具有准确、快速分析相关资料的能力。本课程主要研究的是证券投资工具和证券市场，以及证券的基本分析和技术分析方法。
default.en: Securities investment is an important financial course aiming to help students acquire economics knowledge. This course mainly deals with the basic operation laws governing stock market, bond market and market of other financial derivatives, including effective analysis of securities supervision and characteristics analysis of going on the market and circulation of securities. The major tasks of this course are to help students master the methods of technical analysis and basic analysis on stocks in an innovative way in integrating the theories with the practice, to master the basic theories and basic concepts concerning the securities market, to understand the research frontiers, hot topics and new theories concerning the current international securities investment, and to possess the capabilities of analyzing relevant data accurately and promptly. The course mainly focuses on securities investment tools and securities market, as well as the methods of basic analysis and technical analysis of securities.

default.zh: 经济学是诸多学科中的显学，究其原因在于经济学家是参与国家治理最广泛的一个群体，他们的思想与理论塑造了形形色色的国家经济。本课程主要讲授与评析20世纪30年代以来的西方经济学的流派和它们的奠基人，当代西方经济学学派林立，各家流派的奠基人既是睿智的学者，也是主要经济体的经济决策顾问，他们留给这个世界的既有智慧的结晶，也有实实在在的产业政策。这正是经济学统治整个世界实际证据。通过本课程的教学，向学生介绍从二战以来在国际范围内占据过主导的经济学流派以及这些流派的奠基人，让学生们知晓当今世界经济如何演化到这个模样，从而提升学生认知世界的基础能力，更好地理解习近平主席所倡导的“命运共同体”理念和“协同治理”范式，也激发学生们对社会科学的兴趣。
default.en: Economics is the most prominent subject among all the subjects. The reason is that economists deeply attend the national governance, and their thoughts and theories mould different economic systems. This course will introduce and review the dominating economic theory systems and their founders. There are so many modern economic theory systems, whose founders are sagacious scholars and economic counselors for decision-making.They give their wisdom and concrete industry policies. It is the actual evidence that economy rules this world. Through teaching, we introduce the dominant economic theory systems and their founders since the second world war. Let the students know how the world economy evolves, in order to improve their cognitive competence. Let them understand chairman Xi Jinping’s proposes which are “community with common future” and “cooperative governance”. And then, motivating students’ interest in social science.

default.zh: 网络经济学是20世纪90年代中后期伴随着网络技术的进步和信息产业的发展而产生的，它是专门研究各种网络经济运行方式的科学。网络经济学针对网络经济这一新兴现象进行探讨，从理论层面对网络经济进行剖析。本课程立足数字网络时代经济运行规律，系统讲解网络外部性、数字产品、平台经济、网络市场竞争等核心理论，剖析网络经济运行机制与政策规制逻辑，培养学生了解数字经济领域前沿发展动态和运用经济学理论分析数字经济现实问题的能力。
default.en: Network economics emerged in the mid-to-late 1990s alongside advancements in network technology and the development of the information industry. It is a discipline dedicated to studying various operational models of network economies. Focusing on the emerging phenomenon of network economies, it provides theoretical analysis of this field. This course is grounded in the economic laws of the digital network era, systematically explaining core theories such as network externalities, digital products, platform economies, and online market competition. It dissects the operational mechanisms of network economies and the logic of policy regulation, aiming to cultivate students' ability to grasp cutting-edge developments in the digital economy and apply economic theories to analyze real-world issues in this domain.

default.zh: 行为经济学是一门与心理学有机结合，通过可控实验、调查等方式考察人们在不完全理性的市场中参与各种经济活动时的行为模式，分析影响行为的内外部因素，理解并解释经济现象，以检验并修正先验理论，提出自己的理论的一门现代经济学学科。本课程主要的教学目的是：通过对本课程的主要内容即包括对行为经济学和主流经济学的比较、参照系和偏好、实验经济学的理论和方法、国内外实验结果分析等理论的学习，使学生了解并掌握行为经济学的内核是实用的经济学，它将行为分析理论与经济运行规律、心理学与经济科学有机结合起来，以发现当今经济学模型中的错误或遗漏，进而修正主流经济学关于人的理性、自利、完全信息、效用最大化及偏好一致基本假设的不足。并且通过这些内容的学习了解掌握行为经济学与传统经济学的差异；达到学校对本科毕业生培养方案规定的个性化发展课程目标。
default.en: Behavioral economics is an organic combination of psychology, through controlled experiments and investigation, investigation of people involved in various economic activities in the irrational market behavior when mode, internal and external factors affecting behavior, understand and explain the economic phenomenon, in order to test and revise the transcendental theory, put forward a modern economics discipline its own theory. The main teaching purpose of this course is: through the main content of this course, the comparison of behavioral economics and mainstream economics reference system and preference, experimental economics theories and methods at home and abroad, analysis of the experimental results including learning theory, to enable students to understand and master of behavioral economics is the kernel of practical economics,And through the study of these content, understand the difference between behavioral economics and traditional economics, to achieve the goal of personalized development curriculum stipulated by the school graduate training program.

default.zh: 知识产权法是法学专业核心主干课，是与物权法、债权法并列的专门财产法律制度。知识产权法学既是民法学科的重要分支，也是相对独立的领域法学。在知识经济时代和全球经济一体化进程中，知识产权法在经济贸易、科学技术等领域具有重要作用。知识产权法主要讲授著作权、专利权、商标权的原理和基本制度。 通过本课程的学习使学生系统掌握知识产权法的基本理论、基本制度、基本原则，培养学生运用知识产权法理论以及知识产权法律、法规、政策来分析和解决现实生活中的实际问题的能力。本课程考试成绩采用累加式，包括平时表现、测试和期末考试三部分。
default.en: Intellectual property law is an important professional basic course ，and it is tied with Property law、law of obligations in property law system. On the one hand it is an important branch of civil law, on the other hand It is also a relatively independent field law. In the era of knowledge economy and the process of global economic integration, intellectual property law has an important function in economy and trade、science and technology and other fields. The principle and basic system of copyright, patent right and trademark right is the core of teaching. By learning the course, students can master the basic theory, the basic system and the basic principles of intellectual property law, can analyze and solve practical problems in life by using the theory、laws、regulations and policies of intellectual property law. The result of this course is cumulative, including daily performance, testing and final examination.

default.zh: 物权法是法学专业学生非常重要的专业基础课，是学习后续专业课如合同法、侵权行为法、亲属法与继承法等课程的基础，在培养学生法学思维与专业能力等方面占有重要地位。本课程主要讲述所有权、有益物权、担保物权和占有。通过对其基础理论的讲授、现行法律的评析、各类案件的研讨，培养学生的理论研究创新能力、法律解读评判能力以及案件分析处理能力。经过本门课程的学习，学生不仅掌握物权法方面的基本理论，为今后从事民法学的理论研究奠定良好的基础；而且掌握物权法方面的相关法律规定以及典型案例，为今后从事法律实务工作奠定良好的基础。本门课程考试成绩采用累加式，包括论文报告和期末考试。
default.en: Property law is a very important professional foundation course for law students, and it is the foundation for learning subsequent professional courses such as contract law, tort law, Family law, and inheritance law. It plays an important role in cultivating students' legal thinking and professional abilities. This course mainly discusses ownership, beneficial property rights, security rights, and possession. By teaching basic theories, evaluating current laws, and discussing various cases, students' theoretical research and innovation abilities, legal interpretation and judgment abilities, and case analysis and processing abilities are cultivated. After studying this course, students not only master the basic theories of property law, but also lay a solid foundation for future theoretical research in civil law; Moreover, mastering the relevant legal provisions and typical cases of property law lays a solid foundation for future legal practice work. The exam results for this course are cumulative, including paper reports and final exams.

default.zh: 合同法是调整市场经济关系的基本法，是民商法的重要组成部分，在社会主义市场经济中发挥着重要的作用。本课程主要讲述合同法学基本理论及合同法基本制度，使学生熟悉并掌握我国合同法律制度的内容，了解合同法在民法体系中的地位、了解合同债权与物权的区别。内容包括：合同法的概念、性质、基本原则。合同的订立、合同的成立与生效、合同的履行、变更、转让和终止、违约责任等；同时，介绍各种合同的订立履行规则。要求学生在学习本课程后，对我国的合同法制度所了解，了解并掌握合同法理论研究的前沿动向，能够娴熟运用合同法基本原理处理解决合同实务问题。 本课程考试成绩采用累加式，包括平时表现、测试和期末考试三部分。
default.en: Contract law is the basic law to adjust the relation of market economy. It is an important part of civil and commercial law, and plays an important role in the socialist market economy.This course focuses on the basic theory and the basic system of Contract Law, which enable the students to be familiar with and master the contract law system of our country, to have a general idea of the status of the Contract Law in the Civil Law System, to distinguish contract creditor's rights from property rights. The content mainly include: the concept, nature and basic principles of the Contract Law; conclusion of contracts, formation and validity of contracts; performance of contracts, the amendment, assignment and termination of contracts, breach of contracts, etc.; At the same time, the course also introduces rules entering into various contracts. This course requires students to have a general understanding of the contract law system of our country, to understand and master the forefront trends of the theory of Contract Law, to apply the basic principles of the Contract Law to solve the practical problems of contracts skillfully. The result of this course is cumulative, including daily performance, testing and final examination.

default.zh: 侵权责任法是法学专业学生非常重要的专业基础课，是前期专业课如民法总论、物权法、合同法等课程的逆向思维课程，在培养学生法学思维与专业能力等方面占有重要地位。 本课程主要讲述侵权责任概述、侵权行为的归责原则、一般侵权行为的构成要件、侵害财产权与人身权的行为、侵权责任的方式与侵权责任的承担、数人侵权行为与责任、各类侵权责任。通过基础理论的讲授、现行法律的评析、各类案件的研讨，使学生不仅掌握侵权责任法方面的基本理论，为今后从事民法学的理论研究奠定良好的基础；而且掌握侵权责任法方面的相关法律规定以及典型案例，为今后从事法律实务工作奠定良好的基础。本门课程考试成绩采用累加式，包括报告和论文。
default.en: Tort liability law is an important part of civil law，Including the concept of the infringement, tort liability law protection range，Tort liability imputation principle,Tort liability of the defense,The concept of joint tort characteristics,The specific standard of personal injury compensation with the project, The application of the mental damage compensation,The guardian, legal, education institutions, special provisions of the main responsibility, such as the Internet,The division of traffic accident tort liability and responsibility main body,The application of the medical damage compensation,Product liability,Damage caused by the animal responsibility imputation principle and responsibility main body,Environmental infringement, Objects cause person damage liability and the damage caused by the highly dangerous homework, etc.The word tort liability law sounds far away from life and seems to have nothing to do with your major, but in fact it exists in every aspect of life. The implementation of tort liability law is a blessing for the common people to protect their rights.I believe that what I have learned will be useful in my future life. The course examination results are cumulative, including paper reports and paper.

default.zh: 亲属法与继承法是法学专业学生非常重要的专业基础课，在培养学生法学思维与专业能力等方面占有重要地位。本课程主要讲述婚姻家庭关系与继承关系。通过对其基础理论的讲授、现行法律的评析、各类案件的研讨，培养学生的理论研究创新能力、法律解读评判能力以及案件分析处理能力。经过本门课程的学习，学生不仅掌握婚姻家庭与继承方面的基本理论，为今后从事民法学的理论研究奠定良好的基础；而且掌握婚姻家庭与继承方面的相关法律规定以及典型案例，为今后从事法律实务工作奠定良好的基础。本门课程考试成绩采用累加式，包括作业与论文报告。
default.en: Family law and inheritance law are very important professional foundational courses for law students, playing an important role in cultivating their legal thinking and professional abilities. This course mainly discusses marriage and family relationships and inheritance relationships. By teaching basic theories, evaluating current laws, and discussing various cases, students' theoretical research and innovation abilities, legal interpretation and judgment abilities, and case analysis and processing abilities are cultivated. After studying this course, students not only master the basic theories of marriage, family, and inheritance, but also lay a solid foundation for future theoretical research in civil law; Moreover, mastering the relevant legal provisions and typical cases related to marriage, family, and inheritance lays a solid foundation for future legal practice work. The exam results for this course are cumulative, homework and paper reports.

default.zh: 本课程旨在介绍商事法律体系中基本原理及商事主体法律制度、商事行为法律制度，主要包括商法总论（商法体系及渊源、商法基本原则等）、公司法、证券法、保险法、破产法。其中，商法总论与公司法、证券法、保险法是整个课程的核心内容。通过本课程的教学，使学生的民商法理论和知识得以巩固和提高，使学生掌握商事行为的具体规则，理解各行为的专业性和技术性特点，巩固和提高商事法律基本原理，能够熟练地应用商法理论去分析问题和解决问题。
default.en: This course aims to introduce the fundamental principles and subject system of the commercial law and commercial conducts. Include ：the part of general introduction (business law system and it’s source、the fundamental principles, etc.) 、company law、securities acts、insurance law、bankruptcy law. Among them, the part of general introduction、company law 、securities acts and insurance law are the core of the course content.In this course, the students are required to consolidate theory and knowledge， the students are required to master the detailed rules of commercial conducts, understand the specialty and technicality, consolidate the fundamentals and heighten ability to analyze and solve problems.

default.zh: 劳动与社会保障法是法学专业核心主干课，包括劳动法和社会保障法两部分。劳动法调整劳动关系以及与劳动关系密切联系的其他关系，对协调劳动关系，促进经济发展与社会进步有重要的意义。社会保障法是与全体社会成员有着密切关系的法律，涉及社会保险、社会救助、社会福利和社会优抚等人们基本生活的诸多方面，其宗旨是保障全体社会成员的基本生活，维护社会的稳定。 通过全面学习劳动与社会保障法的基本理论、基本知识，加强学生对劳动与社会保障法的立法理念的理解，提高学生劳动与社会保障法的理论水平以及运用劳动与社会保障基本理论解决实际问题的能力。本课程考试成绩采用累加式，包括平时表现、测试和期末考试三部分。
default.en: Labor and Social Security Law is an important professional basic course. It covers two topics: Labor Law 、Social Security Law. Labor law regulates labor relations and other relations closely related to labor relations，and it is of great significance to coordinate labor relations and promote economic development and social progress. Social security law is closely related to all social members of the law, relating to social insurance, social relief, social welfare and social care etc. The purpose of Social security law is to protect the basic life of all members of society and maintain social stability. Through teaching the basic theory and the basic knowledge of Labor and Social Security Law, we can Enhance students’ understanding of the legislative concept and the theoretical level about labor and social security law, furthermore foster the students’ ability to analyze and solve practical problems in life by using the theory of Labor and Social Security Law. The result of this course is cumulative, including daily performance, testing and final examination.

default.zh: 一、课程基本信息 课程代码：22HS32328 课程名称：国际私法A 总学时：32 理论学时：32 实验学时： 0 上机学时：0 实践学时：0 课外辅导学时：0 学分：2 开课单位：人文社科学部 授课对象：法学二学位 开课学期：2秋 先修课程：国际法，民法 二、课程简介（黑体、小四、加粗、段前段后0.5、行距20磅） 国际私法是以涉外民商事法律关系为调整对象，以解决法律冲突为中心任务，以冲突规范为基本规范，同时包括统一实体规范，外国人民事法律地位规范及国际民事诉讼和仲裁程序规范在内的独立的法律部门。课程以冲突法的学习为核心内容，使学生了解涉外民商事领域法律冲突是如何产生的，掌握国际私法基本规则和涉外民商事法律冲突的法律适用方法，最终达到使学生能在未来实际生活中运用上述知识解决实际问题的目的。
default.en: 1.General Information Course Code：22HS32328 Course Title：Private international law Credit Hours：32 Lecture：32 Lab：0 Computer Lab: 0 Practical: 0 Tutoring: 0 Credit(s)：2 Offering Department: Faculty of Humanities and Social Sciences Students: Second degree in law Term: Autumn, second year Prerequisites: International law, Civil law 2.Course Description Private international law is an independent legal department that takes the foreign civil and commercial legal relations as the adjustment object, takes the legal conflict as the central task, the conflict norms as the basic standard, including the unified entity norms, the civil legal status of foreigners and the international civil litigation and arbitration procedures. The course takes the study of conflict law as the core content, enabling students to understand how the legal conflicts in the field of foreign civil and commercial affairs arise, master the basic rules of international private law and the legal application methods of foreign civil and commercial laws conflict, and finally enable students to use the above knowledge to solve practical problems in the future practical life.

default.zh: 国际经济法课程是一门用以培养学生掌握国际经济法基本原理和知识的专业核心课。它是每一个法律专业学生必修课程之一。改革开放以后，中国的对外经济交往日益频繁，特别是在中国成为WTO成员后，国家更加需要涉外法律类人才。因此，国际经济法课程的基本目标是培养适应对外经济交往需要，既懂国内法、又懂国际条约和国际商业惯例的涉外专业法律人才。本课程的主要内容包括：国际经济法基础理论、《联合国国际货物买卖合同公约》、《国际贸易术语解释通则》、国际货物运输法律制度、国际贸易结算和支付法及国际投资法等。在教学过程中学生需综合运用先修课程中所学到的有关法律知识和原理，结合各种国际经济法经典案例教学，接受涉外经济法律人才所需的基本训练，为其进一步学习有关专业课程和日后从事涉外经济法律工作打下坚实的基础。
default.en: The course of International Economic Law is a professional core course aimed at cultivating students' mastery of the basic principles and knowledge of international economic law.
