It is one of the mandatory courses for every law major student. After the reform and opening up, China's foreign economic exchanges have become increasingly frequent, especially after China became a member of the WTO, the country has a greater need for foreign-related legal talents. Therefore, the basic goal of the International Economic Law course is to cultivate foreign-related professional legal talents who meet the needs of foreign economic exchanges, understand both domestic law, international treaties, and international business practices. The main content of this course includes: basic theory of International Economic Law, United Nations Convention on Contracts for the International Sale of Goods, Incoterms, legal system for international carriage of goods, international trade payment law, and International Investment Law. In the teaching process, students need to comprehensively apply the relevant legal knowledge and principles learned in the prerequisite courses, combine various classic cases of international economic law teaching, receive basic training required by foreign-related economic and legal talents, and lay a solid foundation for them to further learn relevant professional courses and engage in foreign-related economic and legal work in the future.

default.zh: 宏观经济学B以整个国民经济活动作为考察对象，以国内生产总值为切入点，主要讲授影响、决定国民收入总量的一些基本原理，以及政府依据这些规律性对经济进行调整的政策选择。重点使学生掌握宏观经济学的理论基础、了解其发展趋势及前沿热点；掌握决定国民收入的三大模型、失业与通货膨胀的关系、经济增长的基本原理与模型等内容，并能运用这些基本原理对现实经济问题进行一定的剖析。 本课程考试成绩采用累加式，包括平时表现、课后作业和期末考试三部分。
default.en: Macroeconomics B takes the whole national economic activity as the study object. Based on GDP, the students are introduced some basic principles and how the government to adjust the economy using these laws. After finishing the course, students should know the theoretical foundation, tendency and advanced studies of Macroeconomics, be familiar to the three models of national income, the relationship between unemployment and inflation, the basic principles and models of economic growth. Meanwhile we focus on cultivating students to master the basic theory of macroeconomics, to improve their ability to analyze some realistic macroeconomic problem under the scientific theory frame. The score consists of three parts: usual performance, homework and final exam .

default.zh: 西方法律思想史是一部以研究西方法律思想的产生、发展和流变为研究对象的学科，属于法学体系中的理论基础课程。本课程的教学目的在于，通过对西方法律思想演变过程的了解和掌握，扩大学生的知识视野，掌握西方两大法系的相关法律理论和制度的演变，并体验法律思想对法律制度的重要影响。
default.en: The history of Western legal thought is a discipline that focuses on studying the emergence, development, and evolution of Western legal thought, and belongs to the theoretical foundation curriculum in the legal system. The teaching purpose of this course is to broaden students' knowledge horizons, master the relevant legal theories and systems of the two major Western legal systems, and experience the important impact of legal thinking on the legal system by understanding and mastering the evolution process of Western legal thought.

default.zh: 《管理学》课程通过对管理的一般性问题的研究，致力于研究管理者如何有效地管理其所在的组织. 课程通过管理基本理论的讲授、管理基本思想的介绍和管理思维的培养来提升学生的管理悟性。通过本课程学习，使学生掌握管理的基础知识和基本理论，了解和掌握管理理论的产生、发展和作用，了解管理过程即计划、组织、领导、控制四个阶段及具体的活动内容，并结合课堂讨论和案例分析培养学生的管理思维，及综合分析和解决管理问题的能力。
default.en: "Principles of Management " is based on the research of corporate organization, and is devoted to the study of how managers can effectively manage their organization through the study of the general problems of management. The course introduces the basic theory and ideas of management and cultivates management thought for students to enhance their management savvy. Studying this course, students can master the basic knowledge and theory of management; understand and master the generation, development and function of management theory; understand the management process which has four stages: planning, organization, leadership and control and specific activities in each stage. And then, with classroom discussions, case studies and role play, the management thought of student and the ability to comprehensively analyze and address management issues can be well developed.

default.zh: 《人工智能法学概论》是一门交叉法学课程，是为培养学生人工智能与法律的相关 理论知识和应用能力而设置的选修课。本课程主要关注对人工智能的法律规制，力图将人工智能纳入法治轨道，使科技向善，技术风险可控，使学生能系统掌握与人工智能相关的法律和政策，认识人工智能带来的风险以及法律规制的必要性，熟悉人工智能在立法、执法和司法实践中的应用及影响，提高学生人工智能法学的理论水平，培养学生分析问题和解决问题的能力。
default.en: An Introduction to Artificial Intelligence Law is an interdisciplinary law course designed to cultivate students' relevant theoretical knowledge and application abilities in artificial intelligence and law. This mainly focuses on the legal regulation of artificial intelligence, aiming to incorporate artificial intelligence into the track of the rule of law, to make technology good and controllable, and enable students to systematically master the relevant laws and policies of artificial intelligence, to understand the risks brought by artificial intelligence and the necessity of legal regulation, to be familiar with application and influence of artificial intelligence in legislative, executive and judicial practice, and to improve students' theoretical level of artificial intelligence law, and to cultivate students' ability analyze and solve problems. is an interdisciplinary law course designed to cultivate students' relevant theoretical knowledge and application abilities in artificial intelligence and law. This mainly focuses on the legal regulation of artificial intelligence, aiming to incorporate artificial intelligence into the track of the rule of law, to make technology good and controllable, and enable students to systematically master the relevant laws and policies of artificial intelligence, to understand the risks brought by artificial intelligence and the necessity of legal regulation, to be familiar with application and influence of artificial intelligence in legislative, executive and judicial practice, and to improve students' theoretical level of artificial intelligence law, and to cultivate students' ability analyze and solve problems.

default.zh: 法学二学位“习近平国际经济法治思想”课程简介 课程编号：HS74006 课程名称：习近平国际经济法治思想：WTO全球市场规则体系与中国实践研究 开课院系： 人文社科学部 人文社科与法学学院法律系 赵宏瑞 考核方式：课程论文PPT+课后学业进步表现 课程目标和基本要求：（200字左右） 本课程致力于打通本硕博，涵盖多学科，内涵文理交叉，培养新时代习近平法治思想下的具有人类命运共同体“文明观”的涉外法治人才。 本课程有待达成的具体目标如下： 课程目标1. 厚基础——立足习近平“统筹国内法治与涉外法治”思想，从WTO规则体系22个协定看中国经济全球发展，深化学生的具有学术功底的爱国主义。 课程目标2. 强创新——以“网络主权、数据主权、网络空间国际治理”为主线，串联WTO规则体系所塑造的世界市场、竞争规则、主权例外、治理体制，启发学生多视角、多方向、多学科交叉的数字经济规则意识。 课程主要内容：（1000~1500字） 习近平国际经济法治思想，是习近平法治思想的核心组成部分之一。随着2021年5月28日教育部印发《关于推进习近平法治思想纳入高校法治理论教学体系的通知》和2021年9月1日《习近平法治思想概论》教材出版发行，我国法学高等教育核心课程体系已经开始形成“习近平法治思想+10门核心课+特色专业必修课”的新模式。本课程以“习近平国际经济法治思想：WTO规则体系全球治理与中国改革方案”为视阈，聚焦习近平法治思想中的国际经济法治思想，将其落实到中国加入WTO后的20余年来的法治发展与实践中，分为六大模块，总括WTO规则体系22个全球性协定，总体地展示习近平在国内外讲话中引领国际经济发展的新思想、新战略、新法治、新秩序。六大模块分为： 1、导论：从习近平“改革开放是改变中国命运的关键一招”看WTO规则 2、建制：WTO构筑了全球性国际经济组织：马拉喀什协定与中国“入世” 3、市场：GATT 1947构筑的全球市场——最惠国、国民待遇等市场联通性 4、竞争：全球市场竞争规则——WTO的22个协定系统构建世界市场秩序 5、例外：贸易政策的合规与例外——国家安全例外、一般例外与长臂管辖 6、改革：WTO改革博弈——中国对全球贸易投资便利化与电子商务的引领 本课程立足国家战略，围绕全部现行有效的WTO国际经济法治规则体系，辅以阐释“文明总量理论”、“货币总量理论”、“法律总量理论”、“网络主权理论”、 “数字文明理论”、“全球合规理论”，介绍国内外代表性观点和案例，构建人类命运共同体的国际经济法治观。 本课程聚焦前沿问题，重点既在于“宽”、更在于“尖”，其难点是在“宽”与“尖”之间把握网络时代国际经济法治领域中的学术热点与前沿问题，树立以“社科总量方法论”为特色的“计算社会科学”国际化研究新范式。 本课程采用多元教学手段，组织学生提出“国际经济法与社会治理”领域中的具体问题并分组讨论、专题辩论、模拟抗辩，以提高国际经济治理的法治思维、达成课程目标。 课程主要教材： 1.习近平法治思想概论[M]，高等教育出版社. 2021-9-1. 主要参考文献： 1.WTO网站、IMF网站、WB网站、UN网站； 2.中国人大网、中国政府网； 3.[德]斯宾格勒 著，吴琼 译，《西方的没落》（全译本 全二卷），上海三联书店，2014年1月。 4.[英]阿诺德·约瑟夫·汤因比？著，[英]D·C·萨默维尔？编，郭小凌，杜挺广，梁洁 等 译，《历史研究（套装上下卷）[A Study of History]》，上海人民出版社，2010年1月。 5.[美]威尔·杜兰？著，幼狮文化公司？译，《世界文明史（全24册）》（1935-1968年首版），东方出版社，1999年1月。 6.[美]塞缪尔·P. 亨廷顿？著，周琪 等 译，《文明的冲突与世界秩序的重建（修订版）》（1996年），新华出版社，2010年1月。 7.[美]贾雷德·戴蒙德？著；？谢延光？译，《枪炮、病菌与钢铁：人类社会的命运（修订版）》（1997年），上海译文出版社，2006年4月。 8.[美]伊恩·莫里斯？著，李阳 译，《文明的度量：社会发展如何决定国家命运》（2013年），中信出版社，2014年5月。 9.[英]李约瑟 著，[英]罗南 改编，上海交通大学科学史系 译，《中华科学文明史》，上海人民出版社，2014年3月。 10.赵宏瑞: 世界文明总量论[M]，中国法制出版社. 2015；中国货币总量论[M]，中国经济出版社. 2013；网络主权论[M]，九州出版社. 2018。 11.Niall Ferguson. Civilization: The West and the Rest[M]. Penguin Group,2011. 12.Geoffrey Parsons Miller. The Law of Governance, Risk Management, And Compliance[M]. Wolters Kluwer. 2017.
default.en: Second degree in Law: Course Description on “Xi Jinping’s Rule of Law Thoughts on Intl. Economic Law” Course ID: HS74006 Teaching Department: Department of Humanities and Social Sciences, School of Humanities, Social Sciences and Law, Department of Law, Zhao Hongrui Assessment method: Course paper PPT+academic progress performance after class Course objectives and basic requirements: Taking "network sovereignty, data sovereignty, and international governance of cyberspace" as the main line, linking the world market, competition rules, sovereignty exceptions, and governance system shaped by the WTO rule system, inspiring students' awareness of digital economic rules from multiple perspectives, directions, and disciplines. Main content of the course is divided into six parts: 1.Introduction: Xi Jinping’s "Reform and opening up is a key move to change China's destiny" and the international economic system 2.Institutionalization: why WTO is the most important multilateral system from the Marrakech Agreement to China's WTO Accession Protocol 3.Marketization: GATT 1947 and the global market -- MFN and National Treatment Forge Transnational Connectivity 4.Competition: Operation Rules of the World Economy -- Global Market Order Regulated within WTO’s 22 agreements system 5.Protection: Compliance and Exceptions to International Economic Practice -- General Exceptions, National Security Exceptions and Long-Arm Jurisdiction 6.Practice: China Leads the Facilitation of Global Trade, Investment and E-Commerce -- Prospect of WTO Reform Main textbooks for the course: Introduction to Xi Jinping’s Rule of Law Thoughts[M]. Higher Education Press 2021-9-1. Main references: 1. WTO website, IMF website, WB website, UN website; 2. China National People's Congress website and China Government website; 3. [German] Spengler, translated by Wu Qiong, "The Decline of the West" (full translation in two volumes), Shanghai Sanlian Bookstore, January 2014. 4. Arnold Joseph Toynbee, edited by D.C. Somerville, translated by Guo Xiaoling, Du Tingguang, Liang Jie, et al., "A Study of History", Shanghai People's Publishing House, January 2010.

default.zh: 本课程以课堂讲授为主，采用启发式教学方式，通过案例分析和课堂讨论，激发学生的学习积极性，结合实务案例进行剖析，达到培养学生独立思考、分析问题和解决问题的能力。使学生全面系统地掌握网络空间治理及数据、信息安全法律法规的基本理论与基本知识，了解中国的网络信息安全立法和司法现状；掌握我国网络安全法、数据安全法、电子商务法、个人信息保护法等基本制度；培养和提高学生信息安全意识。通过本课程的学习，使学生在主修专业的学习及未来工作中，能够在数据活动及网络信息安全活动中，遵守相关法律法规的规定，具备在网络数据及信息安全活动中基本的法律素养，能够正确运用所学的网络法律知识，强化主修专业的网络数据信息安全从业道德规范。
default.en: This course mainly focuses on classroom teaching, and adopts heuristic teaching method, stimulates students' enthusiasm for learning through case analysis and classroom discussion, and analyzes them with practical cases, so as to cultivate students' ability to think independently, analyze and solve problems. For students to comprehensively and systematically master the basic theories and knowledge of cyberspace governance, data and information security laws and regulations, understand the legislative and judicial situation of network information security in China; master the basic systems of Chinese Cyber Security Law, Data Security Law, Electronic Commerce Law and Personal Information Protection law; cultivate and improve students' awareness of information security. Through the study of this course, In the major study and future work, students can abide by the relevant laws and regulations in data activities and network information security activities, have basic legal literacy in data and network information security activities, correctly apply the network law knowledge they have learned, and strengthen the ethics of network data information security practitioners in major majors.

default.zh: 法律社会学课程是面向法学专业（第二学士学位）的专业方向选修课程，侧重于学生对法律社会学知识的综合运用，通过社会学和法律知识的交叉运用，深入理解法律社会学的基本概念，主要理论和运行领域，使得学生通过法律分析和社会认知，确保法律制度和法治建设得以促进国家社会治理现代化。通过本课程的理论学习和案例教学，使得学生掌握法律社会学领域相关的基础知识和社会实践技能，熟悉法律社会学的理论、方法和发展趋势，深度理解法律与社会变迁、法律与社会冲突、法律与社会控制、法律与社会整合、法律与社会政策、法律与社会文化，以及法律与中国式现代化等之间的关系。
default.en: The Sociology of law course is a professional-oriented elective for law majors (second bachelor's degree) . It focuses on the integrated application of Sociology of law knowledge through the cross-fertilization of sociological and legal knowledge, an in-depth understanding of the basic concepts of Sociology of law, the main theoretical and operational areas, enables students to ensure that legal and rule-of-law development contributes to the modernization of the country's social governance through legal analysis and social cognition. Through theoretical studies and case studies, students will acquire basic knowledge and social skills related to the Sociology of law field, and become familiar with the theories, methods and trends of Sociology of law, a deep understanding of law and social change, law and social conflict, law and social control, law and social integration, law and social policy, law and social culture, and the relationship between law and chinese-style modernization.

default.zh: 法律经济学是法学与经济学的交叉学科与重要方法论，它主要是借鉴经济学的原理和方法以研究法律制度的形成、结构、过程、效率及未来发展，具有突出的实用性和鲜明的时代特色。自20世纪60年代在美国诞生以来，已汇聚而成国际性的法律经济学运动，扩展至全球不同国家和领域，展现出对法治实践的独特分析思路及广阔前景，为中国特色法律体系的构建提供了崭新视角，其借鉴作用极大。 本课程从认识法学与经济学基本原理出发，以案例分析为主要教学手段，以制度变迁与制度绩效评价为主要内容，试图通过法经济学最新研究成果的体现，使学生了解制度的重要性，人的选择与制度的关系，掌握基本分析制度的方法与完善制度的具体路径。
default.en: Legal economics is an interdisciplinary subject and a crucial methodology in the field of law and economics. It primarily draws upon economic principles and methods to examine the formation, structure, process, efficiency, and future development of legal systems. With its exceptional practicality and distinct contemporary characteristics, it has evolved into an international movement since its inception in the United States during the 1960s. This movement has expandedLegal economics is an interdisciplinary subject and a crucial methodology in the field of law and economics. It primarily draws upon economic principles and methods to examine the formation, structure, process, efficiency, and future development of legal systems. With its exceptional practicality and distinct contemporary characteristics, it has evolved into It has been extended to different countries and fields in the world, showing a unique analysis of the practice of the rule of law and broad prospects, providing a new perspective for the construction of the legal system with Chinese characteristics, and its reference is of great significance. This course starts from the understanding of the basic principles of law and economics, takes case analysis as the main teaching method, and institutional change and institutional performance evaluation as the main content. Through the embodiment of the latest research results of law and economics, it attempts to make students understand the importance of the system, the relationship between people's choice and the system, and master the basic analysis methods of the system and the specific path to improve the system.

default.zh: 《法律英语》是法学专业学生的专业选修课。它是法律科学和英语语言学有机结合而形成的一门新兴交叉学科，是专门用途英语（ESP）的重要分支之一，也是高校英语、法学等专业教学改革的新方向。随着大学英语教学改革不断深化，国内许多高校在法学、商学、国际关系等专业的本科课程中开设了法律英语，探索新的人才培养模式。本课程的基本目标是培养适应对外政治和经济交往需要，既懂国内法、国际法又懂英语的专业法律人才。本课程的主要内容包括：国际法、宪法、合同法和WTO法中的英文专业术语、短语及表达。在教学过程中学生需综合运用先修课程中所学到的有关法律知识，结合各种英文法律和判例的研读，接受涉外法律人才所需的基本学术训练，为其进一步学习有关法学专业课程和日后从事法律研究和实务工作打下坚实的基础。
default.en: Legal English is an elective course for law students. It is an emerging interdisciplinary field formed by the organic combination of legal science and English linguistics. It is an important branch of English for Specific Purposes (ESP) and a new direction for teaching reform in majors such as English and law in universities. With the continuous deepening of college English teaching reform, many domestic universities have opened Legal English courses in undergraduate programs such as law, business, and international relations, exploring new talent cultivation models. The basic goal of this course is to cultivate professional legal talents who are adaptable to the needs of foreign political and economic exchanges, and understand both domestic and international law as well as English. The main content of this course includes English professional terms, phrases, and expressions in international law, constitution, contract law, and WTO law. In the teaching process, students need to comprehensively apply the relevant legal knowledge learned in the prerequisite courses, combined with the study of various English laws and precedents, and receive basic academic training required by foreign-related legal talents, laying a solid foundation for their further study of relevant legal courses and future legal research and practical work.

default.zh: 计算机软件保护是面向法学专业（第二学士学位）的专业课程，侧重于学生对计算机软件保护知识的综合运用，通过工程技术和法律知识的交叉运用，深入理解软件保护的基本概念、主要方法和应用领域，使得学生通过综合运用技术手段和法律保护，确保软件的知识产权得到充分保护。通过本课程的学生，使得学生掌握计算机软件保护领域相关的基础知识和技能，熟悉计算机软件保护的理论和方法，掌握计算机软件保护涉及知识产权法律框架中的各种概念、原则和规定。
default.en: Computer Software Protection is a specialized course for law majors (second bachelor's degree), focusing on the comprehensive application of students' knowledge of computer software protection, through the cross-application of engineering technology and legal knowledge, in-depth understanding of the basic concepts, main methods and application fields of software protection, so as to make students ensure that the intellectual property rights of the software are adequately protected through the comprehensive application of technical means and legal protection. Through this course, students master the basic knowledge and skills related to the field of computer software protection, familiarize themselves with the theories and methods of computer software protection, and master the concepts, principles and provisions of the legal framework of intellectual property rights related to computer software protection.

default.zh: 文献检索课程是一门以信息源及其相关检索系统为研究对象的工具性方法课，帮助学生了解文献信息和文献检索的基本知识，掌握信息获取的正确渠道、各类型检索工具的使用方法和基本的检索技巧；培养学生的信息素养，使学生具备信息获取、评价、分析、利用的能力；增强学生信息道德意识，树立正确的世界观和价值观；培养学生自主学习和终身学习习惯，提高科研水平，达到知识、能力、素质协调发展的目的。重点内容从如下几方面展开： 1.培养良好的信息素养和信息道德：包括理解信息的本质，培养获取信息的能力和效率，掌握评价和筛选、分析、利用信息的能力。 2.文献检索基本知识：掌握一般检索工具的使用方法和检索技巧，具备获取学术文献和信息的能力；了解常用学术资源数据库和文件管理软件的使用方法。 3.知识产权基础知识：了解知识产权与创新的内在联系，知识产权保护相关法律和原则，掌握专利信息的检索、分析和利用能力，了解专利信息数据库的使用方法。
default.en: The course of Literature Retrieval and Application is a tool based method course that focuses on information sources and related retrieval systems. It helps students understand the basic knowledge of literature information and literature retrieval, master the correct channels for information acquisition, the use of various types of retrieval tools, and basic retrieval skills; Cultivate students' information literacy, enabling them to have the ability to acquire, evaluate, analyze, and utilize information; Enhance students' awareness of information ethics, establish correct worldviews and values; Cultivate students' habits of self-directed and lifelong learning, improve their research level, and achieve the goal of coordinated development of knowledge, ability, and quality. The key content will be elaborated from the following aspects: 1.Cultivate good information literacy and information ethics: including understanding the essence of information, cultivating the ability and efficiency to obtain information, and mastering the ability to evaluate, screen, analyze, and utilize information. 2.Basic knowledge of literature retrieval: Master the usage methods and retrieval skills of general retrieval tools, and have the ability to obtain academic literature and information; Understand the usage methods of commonly used academic resource databases and file management software. 3.Basic knowledge of intellectual property: Understand the inherent connection between intellectual property and innovation, relevant laws and principles of intellectual property protection, master the ability to search, analyze and utilize patent information, and understand the usage methods of patent information databases.

default.zh: 应急管理是一门融合管理学、法学、社会学、政治学、传播学、心理学和信息科学等多学科知识的新兴学科，既包括宏观层面的应急管理与决策基础理论知识，也包括应用层面的应急管理全生命周期实践过程。本课程主要对应急管理的基础理论知识和现实发展历程进行介绍，重点讲述应急管理法制体系、应急预防与准备、监测与预警、处置与救援、恢复与重建等应急管理过程。课程以文献阅读为基础，结合课堂讲授与讨论等教学方式，旨在让学生深入理解应急管理法制的基本知识和突发事件的事前、事发、事中和事后所涉及的全过程应急管理知识，并能够结合中国应急管理的实践来系统地研究国家治理体系和治理能力现代化进程中的应急管理问题，提升学生的专业素养、应急管理观念和对基本应急管理问题的处理能力，为学生以后开展应急管理领域的科研、教学、交流和社会服务奠定良好的基础。
default.en: Emergency management is an emerging discipline that integrates multi-disciplinary knowledge such as management, law, sociology, politics, communication science, psychology, and information science. It includes both the basic theoretical knowledge of emergency management and decision-making at the macro level and the practical process of the entire lifecycle of emergency management at the application level. This course mainly introduces the basic theoretical knowledge and practical development history of emergency management, focusing on the emergency management legal system, emergency management process of prevention and preparedness, monitoring and early warning, handling and rescue, recovery and reconstruction. Based on literature reading and combined with teaching methods such as classroom teaching and discussion, the course aims to enable students to have a deep understanding of the basic knowledge of emergency management legal system and the whole process of emergency management knowledge in emergencies, enable students to systematically study emergency management issues in the process of modernization of national governance system and governance capacity based on emergency management practice in China, and improve students’ professional literacy and emergency management concepts. It lays a good foundation for students to carry out scientific research, teaching, communication and social services in the field of emergency management in the future.

default.zh: 法律文书写作实训课是法学专业的一门实践课程，专注于培养学生在各类法律事务中撰写专业文书的能力。课程内容涵盖了法律文书的基础理论知识，包括其定义、特点、分类以及重要作用。同时，着重训练常用诉讼类法律文书，如刑事、民事、行政诉讼中的起诉状、答辩状、代理词等的写作技巧；也深入探讨非诉讼类法律文书，像合同、仲裁文书、法律意见书的起草与审查要点。使学生具备独立撰写基本法律文书的能力，为未来从事法律职业打下坚实基础。
default.en: It is a practical course in the law major, focusing on cultivating students' ability to write professional legal documents in various legal affairs. The course content covers the basic theoretical knowledge of legal documents, including their definitions, characteristics, classifications, and important functions. At the same time, it focuses on training the writing skills of common litigation - related legal documents, such as the writing techniques of indictments, pleadings, and representation statements in criminal, civil, and administrative litigations. It also deeply explores the drafting and review key points of non - litigation legal documents, such as contracts, arbitration documents, and legal opinions.

default.zh: 模拟法庭是法学专业（第二学位）的选修课。通过刑事诉讼控辩与审判、民事诉讼代理与审判的演练，有机地将法学理论、法律规定与司法实践结合起来，增强学生对司法程序的感性认知水平，培养基本法律实务技能，课程目标包括：1.初步掌握从事法律实务必须具备的基本思辨能力、口头表达能力、写作能力；2.具备从事法律实务工作的基本证据意识、程序意识；3.全方位培养和训练学生的法律职业素养和职业技能。
default.en: Moot court is an optional course for law majors (second degree) . Through the practice of criminal prosecution and trial, civil litigation agency and trial, it organically combines the theory of law, legal provisions and judicial practice, and enhances the students' perceptual cognition level of judicial procedure, develop basic legal skills. Objectives: 1. Have a basic grasp of the legal practice must have the basic ability to reason, oral expression, writing skills; 2. Basic awareness of evidence and procedure in legal practice; 3. To cultivate and train students' legal professional quality and professional skills in an all-round way.

default.zh: 物权法是法学专业学生非常重要的专业基础课，是学习后续专业课如合同法、侵权行为法、亲属法与继承法等课程的基础，在培养学生法学思维与专业能力等方面占有重要地位。本课程主要讲述所有权、有益物权、担保物权和占有。通过对其基础理论的讲授、现行法律的评析、各类案件的研讨，培养学生的理论研究创新能力、法律解读评判能力以及案件分析处理能力。经过本门课程的学习，学生不仅掌握物权法方面的基本理论，为今后从事民法学的理论研究奠定良好的基础；而且掌握物权法方面的相关法律规定以及典型案例，为今后从事法律实务工作奠定良好的基础。本门课程考试成绩采用累加式，包括论文报告和期末考试。
default.en: Property law is a very important professional foundation course for law students, and it is the foundation for learning subsequent professional courses such as contract law, tort law, Family law, and inheritance law. It plays an important role in cultivating students' legal thinking and professional abilities. This course mainly discusses ownership, beneficial property rights, security rights, and possession. By teaching basic theories, evaluating current laws, and discussing various cases, students' theoretical research and innovation abilities, legal interpretation and judgment abilities, and case analysis and processing abilities are cultivated. After studying this course, students not only master the basic theories of property law, but also lay a solid foundation for future theoretical research in civil law; Moreover, mastering the relevant legal provisions and typical cases of property law lays a solid foundation for future legal practice work. The exam results for this course are cumulative, including paper reports and final exams.

default.zh: 合同法是调整平等主体之间交易关系的法律规范的总称，是市场经济的基本法律制度。课程以讲述合同法的基本理论和基本制度为核心内容，使学生理解并掌握基本原理、具体法律制度及其相应规范，并能在实践中灵活运用，分析处理合同实务问题。主要内容包括：合同法的概念、性质、基本原则，合同的成立，合同的内容和形式，合同的效力，合同的履行，合同的保全，合同的变更和转让，合同权利义务的终止，违约责任。本课程考试成绩采用累加式，包括平时表现、测试和期末考试三部分。
default.en: Contract law is the general term for legal norms that regulate the transactional relationships between equal parties, and is the basic legal system of a market economy. This course focuses on the basic theory and the basic system of Contract Law, which enable the students to apply the basic principles of the Contract Law to solve the practical problems of contracts skillfully. The content mainly include: the concept, nature and basic principles of the Contract Law; conclusion of contracts, formation and validity of contracts; performance of contracts, the amendment, assignment and termination of contracts, breach of contracts. The result of this course is cumulative, including daily performance, testing and final examination.

default.zh: 法理学以整个法律现象的共同规律和共同性问题作为研究对象，例如，法起源、演进、变化、消亡的规律，法运行的规律，法的定义、功能、体系、价值，法律关系、法律行为、法治问题，等等。因此，法理学在法学体系中具有特殊地位，是法学的一般理论、基础理论和方法论。本课程系法理学课程的组成部分之一，主要是针对法学研究领域的基础和前沿问题，做深入的专题研究，深化学生的法学理论知识，提高学生运用理论知识分析、解决实际问题的实践能力，以及形成严谨的法律思维。本课程与本专业第一学期开设的《法理学》是前后连贯、相互配套的一个整体。学习本课程要求有较好的法律基础，同时具备相应的哲学、社会学知识，有一定的理论抽象和思维能力。
default.en: Jurisprudence focuses on the common laws and issues of the entire legal phenomenon, such as the laws of the origin, evolution, change, and extinction of law, the laws of the operation of law, the definition, function, system, value of law, legal relationships, legal acts, and issues related to the rule of law. Therefore, jurisprudence holds a special position in the legal system and is the general theory, fundamental theory, and methodology of law. This course is one of the components of the jurisprudence course, mainly focusing on the fundamental and cutting-edge issues in the field of legal research, conducting in-depth thematic research, deepening students' theoretical knowledge of law, improving their practical ability to analyze and solve practical problems using theoretical knowledge, and forming rigorous legal thinking. This course is a coherent and complementary whole with the course "Jurisprudence" offered in the first semester of this major. Studying this course requires a good legal foundation, as well as corresponding knowledge of philosophy and sociology, as well as a certain level of theoretical abstraction and thinking ability.

default.zh: 本课程旨在介绍商事法律体系中基本原理及商事主体法律制度、商事行为法律制度，主要包括商法总论（商法体系及渊源、商法基本原则等）、公司法、证券法、保险法、破产法。其中，商法总论与公司法、证券法、保险法是整个课程的核心内容。通过本课程的教学，使学生们的民商法理论和知识得以巩固和提高，使学生掌握商事行为的具体规则，理解各行为的专业性和技术性特点，巩固和提高商事法律基本原理，能够熟练地应用商法理论去分析问题和解决问题。
default.en: This course aims to introduce the fundamental principles and subject system of the commercial law and commercial conducts. Include ：the part of general introduction (business law system and it’s source、the fundamental principles, etc.) 、company law、securities acts、insurance law、bankruptcy law. Among them, the part of general introduction、company law 、securities acts and insurance law are the core of the course content.In this course, the students are required to consolidate theory and knowledge， the students are required to master the detailed rules of commercial conducts, understand the specialty and technicality, consolidate the fundamentals and heighten ability to analyze and solve problems.

default.zh: 本课程内容包括中国的行政区划、地理历史、民族人口、科技教育、传统思想、民俗民生等知识。课程以课堂讲授为主，配合丰富详实的视觉资料，并进行适当讨论，使学生了解相应的中国人文与社会发展的基本情况，帮助其更好地适应在中国的学习生活，并具备深入研究专门领域的中国文化基础，以便胜任今后与中国有关的工作。
default.en: The content of this course includes China's administrative divisions, geography and history, ethnic population, science and technology education, traditional thought, folk customs and people's livelihood knowledge. The course is mainly taught in class, combined with rich and detailed visual materials and appropriate discussion, so that students can understand the basic situation of the corresponding human and social development in China, help them better adapt to the study and life in China, and have the foundation of in-depth study of Chinese culture in specialized fields, in order to be competent in the future work related to China.

default.zh: 本课程是为汉语言文学专业留学生开设的理论技能课程，目的在于让学生比较系统地了解现代汉语语法项目，把过去接触到的比较分散的语法知识整合起来，使其更加系统化，提高学生的语言表达能力，为进入高阶汉语的学习打下基础。
default.en: This course is a theoretical skills course for international students majoring in Chinese language and literature. It aims to enable students to systematically understand modern Chinese grammar items, integrate the relatively scattered grammar knowledge in the past, make it more systematic, improve students' language expression ability, and lay a foundation for advanced Chinese learning.

default.zh: 修辞，是语言运用的高级技巧。在世界各国的语言和文学中，修辞有相同的，也有不同的。汉语修辞十分复杂，因此需要系统的理论学习，本课程讲解常见的修辞方法，并进行大量的实例分析和练习，要求学生能够运用常见的修辞方法造句。本课程对提高学生的写作水平有较大的帮助。
default.en: Rhetoric is the use of high-level language skills. In the languages and literatures of different coutries in the world, rhetoric have same points, but also have some different aspects.Rhetoric of Chinese language is very complex, requiring systematic study in theories. This course explain the common figures of speech, and do a lot of case analysis and exercises,requiring students to be able to use common rhetoric methods to make sentences. This course will help students to improve thier writing skills.

default.zh: 本课程力图囊括中国传统文化的器物、制度和理念等三个主要方面。主要内容涉及中国文化的起源与发展，核心价值与主要特征，重要的科技和文化发明等。旨在通过学习本课程，可以使留学生更广泛地了解汉字、词汇和文学作品的发生与背景，从而更深刻领悟文学作品的含义。同时，作为在中国学习和生活的外国人，也有必要了解中国文化发展的历史，熟悉中华民族的民俗礼仪，从而消除生活与学习中的文化隔阂。
default.en: This course seeks to include three main aspects：the artifacts of traditional Chinese culture,institutions and ideas.The main contents involve the origin and development of Chinese culture,core values and the main features,important scientific and cultural inventions.So the students can learn the cultural background of Chinese word and literature.Then they can deeply understand the meaning of the literary works.At the same time,the students live and study in China as foreigners.It is necessary for them to understand the history of Chinese cultural and be familiar with Chinese custom and etiquette.The cultural barriers in life and study will be eliminated.

default.zh: 中华民族具有五千年的文明史，留学生对此缺乏了解。本课程概要地讲授中国从远古社会到当今的历史，重点讲授中国封建社会的形成、发展、衰落的过程，中国古代思想文化主要特点和成就，以及中华民族逐渐走向繁荣富强的历史。通过本课程，留学生对中国历史的朝代变迁、重要历史事件和人物有一个大概的了解，有助于学生学习中国的语言文学，并更深刻地理解中国文化和国情。
default.en: Foreign students lack understanding of Chinese nation’s five thousand years of history of civilization.This course is an overview of China history from ancient society to today, which focused on the formation , development and decline of China's feudal society , the main characteristics and achievements of ideology and culture in ancient China, as well as gradually moved toward the prosperity. Through this course, students can take a general understanding about dynasties of Chinese history, important historical events and figures.This course can help them to learn the Chinese language and literature, deepen the understanding of Chinese culture and national conditions.

default.zh: 电影与文学有着密切的联系，观看电影，也是学习汉语的捷径。本课程的主要目的是帮助学生了解、学习影视文学作品及提高对文学作品的分析能力。同时，选择文学作品改编的电影，可以帮助学生更简捷、快速地了解文学作品，提高留学生的文艺修养和和分析能力。
default.en: Movies are closely related to literature. Watching Movies is also a shortcut to learning Chinese. The main purpose of this course is to help students understand, learn film and television literature and improve the ability to analyze literary works. At the same time, the choice of film adaptation of literary works can help students understand literary works more simply and quickly, and improve their literary and artistic cultivation and analytical ability.

default.zh: 本课程主要包括汉字的产生与演变的历史，汉字的独特的造字方式，造字方式对识读的帮助，现代汉字的规范化要求，汉字与中国传统文化的关系等。其中汉字的六种造字法是本课程最关键最基础的内容，另外，了解汉字的结构演变和书写历史，对提高学生对汉字的兴趣、使用规范化汉语也很有裨益。因为是汉字基础课程，所以适合安排在二年级。但本课教材生字很多，听讲难度较高，所以要求学生具备较高水平的汉语听力，并在课前一定预习。从教学目标来看，要求学生通过本课程的学习，了解中国汉字的基本特点，能够熟练分析汉字造字方式，从而根据形音要素理解字的意义，并在此基础上规范地使用汉字与汉语。汉字在世界上独树一帜，其发生与使用都有鲜明特征，其历史变迁和构造方式也十分复杂，学习难度也很大。通过学习《汉字的故事》，学生学可以知晓汉字发展的历史，了解汉字的造字原理，从而更快捷地识读、记忆汉字，更深刻准确地理解汉字的字义。另外，汉字的发生演变与生活和历史有密切关系，学习汉字学，有助于了解中国文化的方方面面。
default.en: This course mainly includes the history of the emergence and evolution of Chinese characters, the unique way of making Chinese characters, the help of the way of making Chinese characters to read, the standardization requirements of modern Chinese characters, and the relationship between Chinese characters and traditional Chinese culture. Among them, the six forms of Chinese characters are the most crucial and basic content of this course. In addition, understanding the structural evolution and writing history of Chinese characters is also helpful to improve students' interest in Chinese characters and use standardized Chinese. Because it is a basic course of Chinese characters, it is suitable for the second grade. However, there are a lot of new words in this course, and it is difficult to listen to it, so students are required to have a high level of Chinese listening and preview before class. From the perspective of teaching objectives, students are required to understand the basic characteristics of Chinese characters through the study of this course, and be able to skillfully analyze the way of Chinese character formation, so as to understand the meaning of characters according to the elements of shape and sound, and on this basis, use Chinese characters and Chinese in a standardized way. Chinese character is unique in the world, its occurrence and use have distinct characteristics, its historical change and structure are also very complicated, and it is difficult to learn. By learning "The Story of Chinese Characters", students can know the history of the development of Chinese characters, understand the principle of Chinese characters, so as to read and remember Chinese characters more quickly, and understand the meaning of Chinese characters more deeply and accurately. In addition, the evolution of Chinese characters is closely related to life and history, and learning Chinese characters helps to understand all aspects of Chinese culture.

default.zh: 通过本课程教学介绍社会工作理论的基础部分。从社会工作理论缘起、理论流派的发展和主要的理论视角的教授和研究开始，使学生全面了解西方社会工作基础理论的内容，尤其要熟练掌握实践性理论的内涵和应用。课程以西方社会工作理论发展史为基点，通过厘清社会工作理论演进，从心理动力理论、行为理论、系统视角等几个方面介绍西方社会工作理论，内容从社会工作经典理论入手，结合中国社会工作理论发展的基础和实践经验，介绍中国社会工作理论的发端。夯实学生理论知识学习广度和深度，完善学生的知识结构。
default.en: This course will introduce the fundamental parts of social work theory. By discussion through the beginning of the social work theories, theoretical schools and some perspectives, students will understand the fundamental parts of social work theories, especially grasp the practical theories. This course will introduce from psychological dynamics, behaviors theories to the systematical perspectives by the evolution of western social work theories. Finally with Chinese practices, it will introduce the beginning of China social work theories.

default.zh: 普通心理学是研究心理学基本原理和心理现象的一般规律的心理学，是所有心理学分支的最基础和一般的学科。在普通心理学中，心理现象一般规律的研究常分为几个领域：感觉与知觉；学习与记忆；思维与言语；情感与意志；人格与个别心理特征。这些领域包括了人的心理活动的极为重要的方面。在心理学许多分支中，普通心理学占有特殊的地位。它从更广阔的理论角度来研究心理现象，是心理学的基础研究领域，对心理学的发展起重要作用，并能反映出心理学的发展水平和倾向。
default.en: General psychology is a discipline that studies the basic principles and general laws of psychological phenomena, and is the most fundamental and general discipline of all branches of psychology. In general psychology, the study of the general laws of psychological phenomena is often divided into several fields: sensation and perception; Learning and memory; Thinking and speech; Emotions and willpower; Personality and individual psychological characteristics. These fields include extremely important aspects of human psychological activity. In many branches of psychology, general psychology holds a special position. It studies psychological phenomena from a broader theoretical perspective and is a fundamental research field in psychology, playing an important role in the development of psychology and reflecting its level and tendency of development.

default.zh: 作为一个新兴的交叉学科研究领域，计算社会科学在近年来得到了来自社会科学领域的关注。本课程对计算社会科学的基础理论与研究进展进行了全面的讲述。特别地，本课程从心理学、行为学、神经科学等多学科交叉的研究视角出发，重点讲述了个体研究相关的前沿理论。同时，本课程也对实验科学的研究范式与数据分析方法进行了讲授。通过本课程，学生可以更加深入的了解计算社会科学的相关理论、作为计算社会科学基础的个体行为心理研究、以及实验科学研究方法，对传统社会学研究理论与方法形成补充。
default.en: As an emerging interdisciplinary research field, Computational Social Science has gained attention from the social science community in recent years. This course provides a comprehensive overview of the foundational theories and research advancements in Computational Social Science. Specifically, the course focuses on cutting-edge theories related to individual research from interdisciplinary perspectives, including psychology, behavioral science, and neuroscience. Additionally, the course covers research paradigms and data analysis methods in experimental science. Through this course, students will gain a deeper understanding of the relevant theories in Computational Social Science, individual behavior psychology as the foundation of Computational Social Science, and experimental research methods, which complement traditional sociological research theories and methods.

default.zh: 家庭社会学是社会学一个重要分支学科。本课程主要研究家庭的基本结构、功能及其演化的客观规律，阐释家庭和社会的相互关系以及家庭在社会中的地位与作用。 （1）通过本课程的学习，让学生了解社会学在性别、婚姻及家庭领域的相关理论，掌握家庭形态的历史发展过程和相关概念，学会用社会学理论分析性别、婚姻及家庭领域出现的社会问题。 （2）从社会学视角研究家庭，是从社会学的根本价值目标出发研究如何维系社会与家庭之间的协调关系。旨在使学生明晰是在社会发生重大变迁时去研究、探索如何避免或减少社会与家庭之间的不协调，使社会和家庭保持一种动态的平衡关系。同时，探索作为社会生活基本单位的家庭在社会影响下的演变规律，探索家庭与社会相互作用的机制及其对社会发展的影响也有重大的理论意义。
default.en: Sociology of Family is an important branch of sociology. This course mainly studies the basic structure, function, and objective laws of the evolution of the family, explains the mutual relationship between the family and society, as well as the status and role of the family in society. (1) Through the study of this course, students will understand the relevant theories of sociology in the fields of gender, marriage, and family, master the historical development process and related concepts of family forms, and learn to use sociological theories to analyze social problems that arise in the fields of gender, marriage, and family. (2) Studying the family from a sociological perspective is a study of how to maintain a harmonious relationship between society and the family from the fundamental value goals of sociology. The aim is to make it clear to students that studying and exploring how to avoid or reduce the disharmony between society and family during major social changes, and to maintain a dynamic balance between society and family. At the same time, exploring the evolution laws of the family as the basic unit of social life under social influence, exploring the mechanisms of interaction between the family and society, and its impact on social development also have significant theoretical significance.

default.zh: 社会政策是党和政府在特定时间为实现或服务于一定的社会工作和管理的目标所采取的政府行为准则，它是一系列政策、策略、法规、措施、办法、方法、规章、条例等的总称，是国家对社会公共事务实行有效管理的重要手段。同时，社会政策也是国家治理现代化的本质要求，是实现社会治理的重要路径。 通过课程的学习，希望学生能够了解社会政策的基本概念和各国社会政策的发展历史，掌握社会政策的形成、发展、调整的相关知识，并在此基础上将社会政策分析的理论和方法与社会治理相结合，从而形成实现社会治理的有效路径。
default.en: Social policy is the government code of conduct adopted by the Party and the government at a specific time to achieve or serve certain social work and management goals, it is a series of policies, strategies, regulations, measures, methods, methods, rules, regulations, etc., is an important means for the state to effectively manage social and public affairs. At the same time, social policy is also the essential requirement of national governance modernization and an important path to achieve social governance. Through the study of the course, it is hoped that students can understand the basic concepts of social policy and the development history of social policies in various countries, master the relevant knowledge of the formation, development and adjustment of social policies, and combine the theories and methods of social policy analysis with social governance on this basis, so as to form an effective path to achieve social governance.

default.zh: 灾害社会治理B是一门融合管理学、社会学、政治学、传播学、心理学、法学和信息科学等多学科知识的新兴学科，既包括宏观层面的灾害社会学与灾害治理决策基础理论知识，也包括应用层面的灾害社会治理全生命周期实践过程。本课程主要对灾害社会治理的基础理论知识和现实发展历程进行介绍，重点讲述灾害与人何环境、灾害与社会、灾害与社会变迁、灾害与社会组织、灾害文化、灾害心理、灾时行为与社会秩序、灾害与信息传播、灾害社会的能动性、防灾减灾与应急管理、灾后恢复重建与可持续发展等与灾害社会治理相关的重要内容。课程以文献阅读为基础，结合课堂讲授与讨论等教学方式，旨在让学生深入理解灾害社会治理的全过程应急管理知识，并能够结合中国灾害社会治理的实践来系统地研究国家治理体系和治理能力现代化进程中的灾害社会治理问题，提升学生的专业素养、灾害治理观念和对基本灾害社会治理问题的处理能力，为学生以后开展灾害社会治理领域的科研、教学、交流和社会服务奠定良好的基础。
default.en: Disaster social governance B is an emerging discipline that integrates multi-disciplinary knowledge such as management, sociology, politics, communication science, psychology, law, and information science. It includes both the basic theoretical knowledge of disaster sociology and disaster management decision-making at the macro level, and the life-cycle practice process of disaster social governance at the application level. This course mainly introduces the basic theoretical knowledge and practical development process of disaster social governance, focusing on the disaster and human, disaster and environment, disaster and society, disaster and social change, disaster and social organization, disaster culture, disaster psychology, behavior during disaster and social order, disaster and information dissemination, initiative of disaster society, disaster prevention and reduction and emergency management, post-disaster recovery and reconstruction and sustainable development. Based on literature reading and combined with teaching methods such as classroom teaching and discussion, the course aims to enable students to have a deep understanding of the whole process of emergency management knowledge of disaster social governance, and to systematically study disaster social governance issues in the process of modernization of national governance system and governance capacity based on disaster social governance practice in China, and improve students’ professional literacy and disaster management concept and ability to deal with basic disaster social governance issues, and lay a good foundation for students to carry out scientific research, teaching, communication and social services in the field of disaster social governance in the future.

default.zh: 毕业论文是学生在教师的指导下自主开展的一次具有创新性的科研活动，要求学生独立完成包括选题、文献考察、研究设计、实践调查、数据或资料分析、提出结论等一系列的具体环节，是对学生的学习及实践技能的一次全面检验。毕业论文旨在考察学生对所学的理论知识与方法知识进行综合运用的能力，评估学生对本专业的各种基础知识掌握的扎实程度以及创新应用能力。
default.en: A creative Capstone Project is needed for sociological students to obtain Bachelor degree. It consists of a series of research activities with high innovation, including proposing a selected subject of this study, fulfilling a thorough literature review in this academic sector, working out a targeted study design, conducting the social survey, collecting the information and data, analyzing the data or the interview transcription, and drawing the conclusions. Capstone Project is designed for students to examine their social investigative capacity and their capacity in using sociological theory.

default.zh: 毕业论文撰写是经济学专业教学计划规定的最后一个环节。通过毕业论文撰写，锻炼学生综合运用所学专业的基础理论和基本方法，对国际上以及我国对外经济贸易活动中出现的问题，对我国外经贸企业以及外贸生产企业在深化改革和经营管理中所出现的问题进行分析研究，探讨提高我国外经贸管理水平，提高企业经营管理水平的途径和方法，提出政策和措施以及改进的建议和方案，以培养学生独立分析问题和解决问题的能力。
default.en: Graduation Design is the last part of teaching plans for students major in Economic. By designing gradation thesis, the skills of using the basic theories and basic methods of major to analysis the problems exist in the international trade & China's foreign economic trade activities and to do research on the problems of China foreign trade enterprises，which are produced in the process of deepening reform and management will be exercised. To explore methods of improving the level of foreign trade and economic management and the enterprise management, meanwhile, to propose policies and measures as well as suggestions for improvement. By this way, achieve the aims that improve students’ abilities for independent analysis and solve problems.

default.zh: 毕业论文是法学教育的最后一个环节，为对本专业学生集中进行科学研究训练而要求学生在毕业前独立撰写的论文。目的在于培养学生的法学研究能力，加强综合运用所学知识、理论和技能解决实际问题的训练，从总体上考查学生学习所达到的学业水平。论文题目由教师指定或由学生提出，经教师同意确定。均应是本专业学科发展或实践中提出的理论问题和实际问题。通过这一环节，应使学生受到有关科学研究选题，查阅、评述文献，制订研究方案，设计进行科学实验或社会调查，处理数据或整理调查结果，对结果进行分析、论证并得出结论，撰写论文等项初步训练。学生应当认真阅读并严格遵守学校的本科论文写作规范要求。
default.en: Graduation thesis is the last link of law education, which is required to be written independently before graduation for the purpose of scientific research training. The purpose is to cultivate the students' ability of legal research, strengthen the training of comprehensively using the knowledge, theory and skills to solve practical problems, and examine the students' academic level in general. The title of the thesis shall be designated by the teacher or proposed by the students with the consent of the teacher. Both should be theoretical and practical problems raised in the development or practice of the discipline. Through this link, the students should receive some preliminary training, such as selecting scientific research topics, consulting and commenting literature, formulating research plans, designing scientific experiments or social surveys, processing data or sorting out survey results, analyzing and demonstrating the results, drawing conclusions, and writing papers. Students should carefully read and strictly abide by the University's undergraduate thesis writing requirements.

default.zh: 本课程为实践类课程，面向三年级留学生，在课程设计上，以前修的听力和口语课程为基础，进一步强化日常用语和习惯用法；实行讲授与实践结合，但以实践为主。通过本课程，留学生能增强汉语交际能力和生活能力, 进一步适应中国社会，为今后的学习、生活和工作奠定基础。
default.en: This course is a practical course for third-year students. In the course design, based on the previous listening and speaking courses, it will further strengthen the daily expressions and idioms, but practice is the main thing. Through this course, foreign students can enhance the ability of Chinese communication and life, further adapt to the Chinese society, for the future study, life and work to lay the foundation.

default.zh: 电磁场与电磁波课程提供了经典电磁理论的基本物理原理，数学方法及其典型应用的介绍。课程从标量场、矢量和矢量场等数学概念出发，介绍了静电场、恒定电场、恒定磁场，然后给出了时变电磁场并推出了麦克斯韦方程组，从而给出电磁波传播及辐射的基本规律。尽管需要学生们具有物理和微积分的基础知识，但是课程仍然给出了足够的矢量运算等数学准备知识。课程中的例题和习题帮助学生测试是否掌握了相关知识，有助于同学们掌握那些抽象的、难以可视化的知识。
default.en: The Electromagnetic Field and Electromagnetic Wave course provides an introduction to the basic physical principles, mathematical methods, and typical applications of classical electromagnetic theory. Starting from the mathematical concepts of scalar field, vector field and vector field, the course introduces electrostatic field, constant electric field and constant magnetic field, then gives the time-varying electromagnetic field and deduces Maxwell equations, thus giving the basic laws of electromagnetic wave propagation and radiation. Although students are required to have a basic knowledge of physics and calculus, the course still gives enough mathematical preparation knowledge such as vector operations. Examples and exercises in the course help students test whether they have mastered relevant knowledge, and help students grasp the abstract and difficult to visualize knowledge.

default.zh: 本课程主要讲述六个学科的主体内容，即理论力学、材料力学、机械原理、机械零件、仪器零件、公差，是非机类专业必修的一门主干课程。主要讲述机械中通用零、部件及常用精密机械机构的工作原理及设计方法。主要内容有静力学、材料力学、平面四连杆机构、齿轮传动、凸轮与间歇机构、联接、轴与联轴器、支承、导轨、公差、带传动、螺旋传动、弹性元件和微机械。 通过本课的学习，可使学生综合应用多门课程知识，掌握通用机械的基本原理，通用机械零、部件的设计方法，培养学生具有设计精密机械传动机构及机械结构的能力，也为学生进一步学习专业课和今后从事精密机械技术工作打下基础。 开设的必修实验有：开锁器结构设计实验；柔性导轨与铰链的分析与设计；光机电一体化实训系统；公差综合实验。选修实验有弹性开关动态特性测试；组合机构类型分析与结构设计。
default.en: The course includes six subjects, such as Theoretical Mechanics, Material Mechanics, Mechanical Principle, Mechanical Part, Instrument Component and Tolerance, which is a kernel compulsory course for non-mechanical specialty. It mainly introduces operating principles and design methods of general parts, general components and ordinary precision mechanism. The main content includes statics, material mechanics, plane four-bar linkage, gear drive, cam and intermittent, join, axis and coupling, bearing, guide way, tolerance, tape handler, screw-driven, elastic element, micro-mechanism. Via learning the curriculum, students can comprehensively apply much course knowledge, master basic principle of universal machine and design methods of general parts, general components and ordinary mechanism, which can cultivate students the ability of designing actuating mechanism and machine structure and supply with basic information for professional lessons and mechanical technique work in the future. Compulsory experiments established are shown as follows: Unlocking engine structural design experiment, analysis and design for flexible guide way and hinge, Electro-mechanical integrated training system, comprehensive experiment of tolerance. Elective experiments are shown as follows: Elastic switch dynamic characteristic testing, type analysis and design for combined mechanism.

default.zh: 本课程主要讲述六个学科的主体内容，即理论力学、材料力学、机械原理、机械零件、仪器零件、公差，是非机类专业必修的一门主干课程。主要讲述机械中通用零、部件及常用精密机械机构的工作原理及设计方法。主要内容有静力学、材料力学、平面四连杆机构、齿轮传动、凸轮与间歇机构、联接、轴与联轴器、支承、导轨、公差、带传动、螺旋传动、弹性元件和微机械。 通过本课的学习，可使学生综合应用多门课程知识，掌握通用机械的基本原理，通用机械零、部件的设计方法，培养学生具有设计精密机械传动机构及机械结构的能力，也为学生进一步学习专业课和今后从事精密机械技术工作打下基础。 开设的必修实验有：开锁器结构设计实验；柔性导轨与铰链的分析与设计；光机电一体化实训系统；公差综合实验。选修实验有弹性开关动态特性测试；组合机构类型分析与结构设计。
default.en: The course includes six subjects, such as Theoretical Mechanics, Material Mechanics, Mechanical Principle, Mechanical Part, Instrument Component and Tolerance, which is a kernel compulsory course for non-mechanical specialty. It mainly introduces operating principles and design methods of general parts, general components and ordinary precision mechanism. The main content includes statics, material mechanics, plane four-bar linkage, gear drive, cam and intermittent, join, axis and coupling, bearing, guide way, tolerance, tape handler, screw-driven, elastic element, micro-mechanism. Via learning the curriculum, students can comprehensively apply much course knowledge, master basic principle of universal machine and design methods of general parts, general components and ordinary mechanism, which can cultivate students the ability of designing actuating mechanism and machine structure and supply with basic information for professional lessons and mechanical technique work in the future. Compulsory experiments established are shown as follows: Unlocking engine structural design experiment, analysis and design for flexible guide way and hinge, Electro-mechanical integrated training system, comprehensive experiment of tolerance. Elective experiments are shown as follows: Elastic switch dynamic characteristic testing, type analysis and design for combined mechanism.

default.zh: 本课程主要研究成像规律和成像仪器。学生通过本门课程的学习，对现有光学系统应具有分解、分析的能力，了解各基本功能元素及相互关系和作用。另一方面，应具有外形尺寸的结构设计、将基本元素组合集成为系统的能力。对于光电、光学类专业，本门课程还是许多专业课的基础。 本课程包括几何光学、典型光学系统和像差理论三大部分。几何光学部分以高斯光学理论为核心内容，包括了光线光学的基本概念与成像理论、球面和平面光学系统及其成像原理、理想光学系统原理、光能和光束限制等基础内容；典型光学系统部分包括了眼睛、显微镜与照明系统、望远镜与转像系统、摄影光学系统和投影光学系统等成像原理、光束限制、放大倍率及其外形尺寸计算；像差理论详细叙述了光学系统的轴上点像差、轴外点像差和色差的形成原因、概念、现象、基本计算、典型结构的像差特征和校正像差的基本方法，使学生具胡结构设计和计算的能力。
default.en: The course mainly research in imaging law and imaging instrument. Through studying of the course, students will have the ability to analyze the existing optical system, to understand the mutual relations and actions between the basic function units. And students will able to do structural design in dimensions, and to integrate the basic unit into a system. The course is still the basis of many professional courses for the students major in opto-electronic and optics. The course includes Geometrical Optics, Typical Optical System and Theory of Aberration. Theory of Gaussian Optics is the core content of Geometrical Optics, comprising basic definitions and imaging theory of ray optics, optical system and imaging principle of sphere and plane, principle of the ideal optical system, energy and optical limiting theory and so on. Typical Optical System consists of imaging principle, optical limiting, magnification and dimension calculation of eye, microscope and illuminative system, telescope and optical inversion system, photo-optical system and projection optical system. Aberration theory states reason of formation, concept, phenomena, basic calculation, characterization of aberration, the basic approach of aberration correction of spherical aberration, off-axis aberration and chromatic aberration in detail, making students have the capacity for structural design and calculation.

default.zh: 《嵌入式系统及应用》以单片机为例，介绍嵌入式处理器的组成原理、指令系统、软件设计、串行通讯、接口技术与应用的一门课程，具有较强的理论性和鲜明的实践性。嵌入式处理器是测量与控制仪表、控制系统的核心部件，硬件设计原理是其根本，软件设计方法是其精髓。学生通过本课程的学习，熟悉单片机的硬件结构和指令系统，掌握嵌入式系统的开发流程，以及嵌入式系统的硬件电路设计方法，初步掌握C51的编程与调试方法，为后续的专业课程和实践教学环节（如毕业设计）奠定坚实理论与实践基础。 课程涵盖如下内容： 1、介绍AT89S52单片机的引脚功能、片内存储器结构、时钟电路、复位电路； 2、介绍的C51语言指令系统，包括数据类型、存储类型、函数组成、程序设计方法； 3、介绍嵌入式软硬件开发环境与使用方法，包括Proteus和Keil等； 4、介绍AT89S52单片机的中断系统、定时器/计数器、串行口的结构与工作原理； 5、介绍AT89S52单片机与LED数码管、LCD液晶显示器、键盘等外设的接口设计方法； 6、以I2C总线、单总线、SPI总线为例，介绍单片机的串行扩展技术； 7、介绍AT89S52单片机与ADC和DAC的硬件接口设计与驱动程序设计。
default.en: Embedded System and Application is a course that integrates the principle of embedded processor, instruction system, software design, serial communication, interface technology and application based on Micro Controller Unit (MCU). It has strong theory and distinct practicality. Embedded processor is the core component of measurement and control instrument and system. The principle of hardware design is its foundation, and the software design method is its essence. Through the course of learning, students will be familiar with the hardware structure and command system of SCM, and master the development process of embedded system, microcomputer embedded system design method, preliminary programming and debugging method of C51 language. It will lay a solid foundation of theory and practice for professional courses and graduation project. The course introduces the following content. 1．Pin function of AT89S52 microcontroller, as well as the memory structure, the clock circuit, and the reset circuit. 2．C51 language instruction system, including data types, storage types, functions, programming design methods. 3．Development tools and application method of embedded software and hardware, including Proteus and Keil. 4．Structures and working principles of the interrupt system, timer / counter, serial interface. 5．Peripheral interface design of LED, LCD, and keyboard. 6．Serial extension technologies of single chip microcomputer such as the single bus, SPI, and I2C bus. 7．Hardware interface designs and driver designs of AT89S52 microcontroller and ADC/DAC.

default.zh: “工程光学（2）”课程主要面向哈尔滨工业大学仪器类和辅修专业本科生开设，通过课程的学习，使学生能够运用运用麦克斯韦电磁理论分析光在各向同性介质和各向异性介质中的传播规律；掌握光的干涉、光的衍射、光的偏振等特性及这些特性在光电仪器和精密仪器领域应用的基础理论；通过实验与工程实践，培养学生综合运用专业基础知识和工程技术进行系统设计、实验以及数据分析和处理的能力。为学生未来从事光电测量与仪器设计等相关技术领域的学习、研究、开发打下基础。
default.en: The course "Engineering Optics (2)" is mainly offered to undergraduate students majoring in instrumentation and related minors at Harbin Institute of Technology.After this course, the students can obtain the ability of analyzing the propagation laws of light in isotropic and anisotropic materials by using the Maxwell electromagnetic theory, and master the properties of interference, diffraction and polarization of light and their related applications on precision photoelectric instruments. Besides, by experiments and engineering training, this course can cultivate students the ability on system design based on professional knowledge and skills, and the ability on processing and analysis of experimental data. This course can lay the basis for students’ research activities on photoelectric measurement and instruments in the near future.

default.zh: 《误差理论与不确定度分析》 为我校测控技术与仪器和光电信息科学与工程(光电仪器方向)两个本科专业学生的重要专业基础课。开设时间为大三春季学期，总学时为42学时，包含38学时课堂授课学时和2学时实验学时和2学时上机学时。先修课程为高等数学、大学物理、电路、机械学基础和概率论与数理统计等课程。 课堂内容包括：1. 概述(测量、测量误差和数理统计的基本概念、有效数字和舍入规则)；2. 测量误差的规律性及其表述(随机误差、正态分布和非正态分布的随机误差、系统误差的特征及其表述)；3. 测量误差的传递(定义法、线性化法、线性叠加法则和传递系数的计算)；4. 一般测量问题中的数据处理方法(算术平均值和加权算数平均值原理、测量数据的修正)；5. 不确定度的估计和合成(不确定度的表征参数与估计、标准不确定度、扩展不确定度和算术平均值不确定度的合成，t分布合成扩展不确定度、不确定度的自由度、误差间相关关系和相关系数的估计)；6. 不确定度合成规则的应用(1/3原则和等作用原则)；7. 最小二乘法(原理、正规方程、正规方程的解算和精度估计)；8. 线性回归(一元线性回归)。 实验内容为电感测微仪的参数特性测试。 上机内容为按照t分布合成扩展不确定度编程。
default.en: Error theory and uncertainty analysis》is a key professional basic course for the undergraduate students majored in measurement technology & instrument and optoelectronic information science & engineering (photoelectric instrument direction) in our school. The opening hours are set in junior spring semester, and the total hours are 42 hours, including 38 hours of class course, 2 hours of measurement experiment and 2 hours of computer programming. Prerequisites courses for this course are higher mathematics, universal physics, circuit, basic mechanics and probability theory and mathematical statistics. The contents of the class include: 1. Overview (the basic concept of measurement, measurement error and mathematical statistics, effective figures and rounding rules); 2. Measurement error regularity and its expression (random error, normal distribution and non-normal distribution random error, systematic error’s characteristics and its expression); 3. Measurement error’s transmission (definition method, linearization method, linear superposition rule and the calculation of the transfer coefficient); 4. General data processing methods in ordinary measurement problem (the principles of arithmetic mean and the weighted arithmetic mean method, the correction of the measured data); 5. The estimation and synthesis of the uncertainty (the characterization parameters and estimates of uncertainty, the synthesis of standard uncertainty, extended uncertainty and arithmetic mean uncertainty , t-distribution synthesize extension uncertainty, the freedom of uncertainty, error correlation and correlation coefficient estimation); 6. Application of uncertainty synthesis rules (1/3 principle and equivalence principle); 7. Least Square Method (principle, normal equation, normal equation’s solution and precision estimation); 8. Linear regression (one variable linear regression). The experimental content is the parameter characteristic testing of the inductance micrometer. The contents of the computer operation are programming method according to the t-distribution synthesis extension uncertainty.

default.en: ‘Fundamentals of Automatic Control and Intelligence’ is a professional basic course. It mainly studies elementary theory of classical control, modern control and intelligent control. Contents of the course are given as follows: (1) Components and requirements of automatic control systems. (2) Mathematical models of control systems. (3) Time-domain analysis methods of control systems. (4) Frequency-domain methods of control systems (5) Basic principles of modern control

default.zh: 课程主要面向仪器科学与技术及相关专业大二年级本科生开设。课程主要讨论确知信号描述和分析的基本方法；讨论线性时不变系统的基本概念，系统表征和分析的基本方法；讨论系统对信号的作用机理；讨论典型信号、典型系统的基本特征和应用特点。
default.en: The course is mainly aimed at second year undergraduate students majoring in Instrument Science and Technology and related majors. The course mainly discusses the basic methods of describing and analyzing deterministic signals; Discuss the basic concepts of linear time invariant systems, as well as the fundamental methods for system characterization and analysis; Discuss the mechanism of the system's impact on signals; Discuss the basic characteristics and application features of typical signals and systems.

default.zh: 数字信号处理课程是电子类、信息类等专业的重要专业基础课，是一门理论性较强的课程。本课程以离散傅里叶变换和数字滤波器为重点，强调离散时间信号和系统的基本理论和分析方法，强调理论与实践、原理与应用相结合。 课程主要内容为：信号的取样理论及其应用；离散时间信号和系统在时域、频域和z域的分析方法；离散傅里叶变换的概念、计算及其应用；数字滤波器的结构、IIR滤波器和FIR滤波器的设计原理。 本课程旨在奠定学生在数字信号处理领域的基本理论基础，通过理论知识与应用方法的有机结合，培养学生利用数字信号处理方法解决实际问题的能力。为学生未来从事电子、信息及相关技术领域的学习、研究、开发打下重要的基础
default.en: Digital Signal Processing is a professional basic course for students majoring electronics and information, and it is a course with strong theoretical requirements. In this course, Discrete Fourier Transform and Digital Filter are the main points. We focus on the basic theory and analytical method on discrete time signal and system. We emphasis on the combination of theory and practice, and we also focus on the relationship between principle and application. The main points of course are: Sampling theory of signal and its application; analytical method for discrete-time signal in time-domain, frequency domain and z-domain; concept, computation and application of Discrete Fourier Transform; basic structure of digital filter; and the design principle of FIR and IIR filter. The purpose of this course is to help students to establish a theoretical basis in digital signal processing field. Through combination of theoretical knowledge and practical application, students are trained to have the ability of solving practical problems using basic digital signal processing methods. The course will benefit the students in further study, research, and development in the fields of electronics and information.

default.zh: 本课程是仪器科学与技术学科的一门主干专业技术基础课，主要研究成像规律和成像仪器。学生通过本门课程的学习，对现有光学系统应具有分解、分析的能力，了解各基本功能元素及相互关系和作用。另一方面，应具有外形尺寸的结构设计、将基本元素组合集成为系统的能力。对于光电、光学类专业，本门课程还是许多专业课的基础。 本课程包括几何光学、典型光学系统和像差理论三大部分。几何光学部分以高斯光学理论为核心内容，包括了光线光学的基本概念与成像理论、球面和平面光学系统及其成像原理、理想光学系统原理、光能和光束限制等基础内容；典型光学系统部分包括了眼睛、显微镜与照明系统、望远镜与转像系统、摄影光学系统和投影光学系统等成像原理、光束限制、放大倍率及其外形尺寸计算；像差理论详细叙述了光学系统的轴上点像差、轴外点像差和色差的形成原因、概念、现象、基本计算、典型结构的像差特征和校正像差的基本方法，使学生具胡结构设计和计算的能力。
default.en: The course is a major basic technical course in discipline of Instrumentation Science and Technology which is mainly research in imaging law and imaging instrument. Through studying of the course, students will have the ability to analyze the existing optical system, to understand the mutual relations and actions between the basic function units. And students will able to do structural design in dimensions, and to integrate the basic unit into a system. The course is still the basis of many professional courses for the students major in opto-electronic and optics. The course includes Geometrical Optics, Typical Optical System and Theory of Aberration. Theory of Gaussian Optics is the core content of Geometrical Optics, comprising basic definitions and imaging theory of ray optics, optical system and imaging principle of sphere and plane, principle of the ideal optical system, energy and optical limiting theory and so on. Typical Optical System consists of imaging principle, optical limiting, magnification and dimension calculation of eye, microscope and illuminative system, telescope and optical inversion system, photo-optical system and projection optical system. Aberration theory states reason of formation, concept, phenomena, basic calculation, characterization of aberration, the basic approach of aberration correction of spherical aberration, off-axis aberration and chromatic aberration in detail, making students have the capacity for structural design and calculation.

default.zh: 物理光学是一门将光作为电磁波并用电磁理论研究光的传播规律和特性的基础课程，它是光学领域中最基础但又异常活跃的重要组成部分。课程将以光的波动为主基调，运用麦克斯韦电磁理论分析光在各向同性介质和各向异性介质中的传播规律、光的干涉、光的衍射、光的偏振等特性。使学生从光波动的本质上认识光的传播及光与物质相互作用过程中所遵循的规律，掌握物理光学的基本原理和分析方法，了解物理光学的新技术、新应用和新成就。本课程为学生未来从事光、电、仪器及相关技术领域的学习、研究、开发打下重要基础。
default.en: Physical Optics is a foundation course focused on the study of light propagation laws and characteristics by taking light as an electromagnetic wave and using electromagnetic theory, and it is not only the most important foundation but also an extraordinarily active part in optics field. The course introduces the propagation laws of light in isotropic and anisotropic materials based on the wave-motion of light and Maxwell electromagnetic theory. The optical characteristics of interference, diffraction and polarization of light are introduced. Through the study of the course, students will understand the propagation laws of light and the interaction between light and materials at the viewpoint of wave-motion nature of light, learn the basic theories and analytical methods of physical optics, and know the new technology, new achievements and new applications of physical optics. The course will benefit the students in further study, research and development in the fields of optics, electronics, instrument and relative field.

default.zh: 本课程主要讲述六个学科的主体内容，即理论力学、材料力学、机械原理、机械零件、仪器零件、公差，是非机类专业必修的一门主干课程。主要讲述机械中通用零、部件及常用精密机械机构的工作原理及设计方法。主要内容有静力学、材料力学、平面四连杆机构、齿轮传动、凸轮与间歇机构、联接、轴与联轴器、支承、导轨、公差、带传动、螺旋传动、弹性元件和微机械。 通过本课的学习，可使学生综合应用多门课程知识，掌握通用机械的基本原理，通用机械零、部件的设计方法，培养学生具有设计精密机械传动机构及机械结构的能力，也为学生进一步学习专业课和今后从事精密机械技术工作打下基础。 开设的必修实验有：开锁器结构设计实验；柔性导轨与铰链的分析与设计；光机电一体化实训系统；公差综合实验。选修实验有弹性开关动态特性测试；组合机构类型分析与结构设计。
default.en: The course includes six subjects, such as Theoretical Mechanics, Material Mechanics, Mechanical Principle, Mechanical Part, Instrument Component and Tolerance, which is a kernel compulsory course for non-mechanical specialty. It mainly introduces operating principles and design methods of general parts, general components and ordinary precision mechanism. The main content includes statics, material mechanics, plane four-bar linkage, gear drive, cam and intermittent, join, axis and coupling, bearing, guide way, tolerance, tape handler, screw-driven, elastic element, micro-mechanism. Via learning the curriculum, students can comprehensively apply much course knowledge, master basic principle of universal machine and design methods of general parts, general components and ordinary mechanism, which can cultivate students the ability of designing actuating mechanism and machine structure and supply with basic information for professional lessons and mechanical technique work in the future. Compulsory experiments established are shown as follows: Unlocking engine structural design experiment, analysis and design for flexible guide way and hinge, Electro-mechanical integrated training system, comprehensive experiment of tolerance. Elective experiments are shown as follows: Elastic switch dynamic characteristic testing, type analysis and design for combined mechanism.

default.zh: 互换性与测量技术基础课程目的使学生掌握互换性、标准化的概念及机械零部件精度设计的基本原理和方法；了解典型零件极限与配合标准的组成和应用以及各种典型零件制造精度的确定方法。进一步加强学生基本理论、基本知识和基本技能的学习和训练。不仅进一步培养学生分析问题和解决问题的能力，还要培养学生独立工作能力及动手能力。 课程主要内容包括互换性和标准化的基本概念，尺寸精度设计，几何精度设计，表面粗糙度精度设计，典型零部件精度设计（滚动轴承、平键、花键、螺纹等）、尺寸链的计算等。
default.en: The purpose of the subject “Fundamentals of interchangeability and measurement technology” is to help students have a good mastery of the concepts of interchangeability and standardization, basic principles and design methods of machine parts; and know the composition and application of limiting and matching standards of typical parts, and the method for deciding manufacturing accuracy of typical parts; and to help students further study and train basic theory, knowledge and skill; and cultivate the ability of analyzing and solving problems and the ability of independently working and operating. Its main content includes: the design principle of geometric accuracy of mechanical parts——interchangeability and standardizationsize, dimensional accuracy design basis, geometric accuracy design basis, surface roughness, precision design of typical components accuracy(rolling bearing, flat key, rectangle spline,screw thread)，precision design of gear drive, calculation of dimension chain .

default.zh: 课程主要面向精密仪器及智能化类专业本科生开设。本课程教授学生测量的基本概念、基本流程和经典方法，并培养解决测试与检测具体问题的能力。在课程的学习中，使学生学会如何在测试与检测任务中，将光、机、电、控制紧密配合电以解决工程实际中的测量问题；通过实验与工程实践，培养学生综合运用测试技术的方法和手段进行测量系统设计、实验以及信号分析和数据处理的能力。为学生未来从事精密仪器、精密工程、精密测控等相关技术领域的学习、研究、开发打下基础，同时也能更多地了解测试技术的前沿和发展趋势，扩展学生的视野，提高学生继续深入学习测量领域内容的积极性。
default.en: The course is mainly designed for undergraduate students majoring in precision instruments and intelligent engineering. This course teaches students the basic concepts, processes, and classical methods of measurement, while also fostering their ability to solve specific testing and detection problems. Through the study of the course, students learn how to integrate optics, mechanics, electronics, and control to solve measurement problems in engineering practice. Through experiments and engineering practices, students develop the ability to comprehensively apply testing techniques for measurement system design, experiments, signal analysis, and data processing. This course lays a foundation for students to engage in learning, research, and development in fields related to precision instruments, precision engineering, and precision measurement and control, while also enabling them to understand more about the forefront and trends of testing technology, broaden their horizons, and enhance their enthusiasm for further study in the field of measurement.

default.zh: 本课程主要面向测控技术与仪器本科生开设。通过本课程学习，使学生能够掌握自动控制元件的基本知识包括自动控制系统中执行、放大、测量元件的结构特点和工作原理及其在工程实际中的应用；能够把控制元件与光、机、电有机的结合起来，具有工程设计的基础知识和初步的工程设计能力；通过实验课培养实验技能，对典型自动控制元件结构及自动控制系统有更深刻的认识。教学过程中强调专业知识的深度和理论与实际应用的有机结合，为今后从事理论研究和工程设计工作打下坚实的基础。
default.en: This course is primarily designed for undergraduate students majoring in Measurement and Control Technology and Instrument. Through this course, students will acquire essential knowledge of automatic control components, including the structural characteristics and working principles of components involved in execution, amplification, and measurement within automatic control systems, and applying them in engineering practice. Additionally, students will develop the ability to integrate control components with optics, mechanics, and electronics, acquiring foundational knowledge and initial engineering design skills. Practical skills will be cultivated through experimental sessions, fostering a deeper understanding of the structures of typical automatic control components and control systems. The teaching process emphasizes the depth of professional knowledge and the organic integration of theory with practical applications, so as to lay a solid foundation for theoretical research and engineering design in the future.

default.zh: 感知器件是智能时代的核心关键器件，在机器人、物联网、智慧城市、智能医疗、智能交通、智能制造等领域有着极为重要的应用前景。感知材料是多种重要感知器件的核心关键，决定了感知器件的性能和应用性。《感知材料与器件》课程旨在向本科生提供感知材料和感知器件的重要知识。通过本课程的学习，学生能够掌握传感材料和感知器件的基础知识、最新进展和应用趋势，培养创新意识、辩证思维和理论与实践相结合的能力，具备在相关工程领域开展研究工作的良好素质。本课程的主要内容包括感知材料与器件简介、光感知材料与器件、热感知材料与器件、力感知材料与器件、气体感知材料与器件、生物芯片、纳米感知材料与器件、柔性感知材料与器件、智能感知材料与智能感知器件、感知材料与感知器件前沿进展。
default.en: Sensing devices are the key devices in the intelligent era, and have important application prospects in robots, the Internet of Things, smart cities, intelligent medicine, intelligent transportation, intelligent manufacturing and other fields. Sensing materials are at the core of many important sensing devices, which determines the performance and applications of sensing devices. The course of Sensing Materials and Devices aims to provide undergraduate students with important knowledge of sensing materials and sensing devices. Through the study of this course, students can master the basic knowledge, the latest progress and application trends of sensing materials and sensing devices, cultivate their innovative consciousness, dialectical thinking and the ability to integrate theory with practice, and have good quality of conducting research in relevant engineering fields. The course includes concepts and background of sensing materials and devices, optical sensing materials and devices, thermal sensing materials and devices, force sensing materials and devices, gas sensing materials and devices, biochips, sensing nanomaterials and nanosensors, flexible sensing materials and devices, smart sensing materials and smart sensing devices, and the cutting-edge developments of sensing materials and devices.

default.zh: “人工智能基础”是一门技术基础课，主要介绍人工智能的基本概念、 基本原理。课程的主要目标是让学生了解人工智能技术的基本特点，为学生掌握人工智能在工程实际中的应用奠定基础。课程内容主要包括： (1) 人工智能概述 (2) 知识表示 (3) 推理 (4) 搜索策略 (5) 机器学习与深度学习 (6) 神经网络 (7) 智能控制
default.en: “Fundamentals of Artificial Intelligence” is a foundational technical course that primarily introduces the basic concepts and principles of artificial intelligence. Its aim is to provide students with a fundamental understanding of the essential characteristics of artificial intelligence technology, laying the groundwork for their practical engineering applications. The course content includes: (1) Overview of Artificial Intelligence (2) Knowledge Representation (3) Inference (4) Search Strategies (5) Machine Learning and Deep Learning (6) Neural Networks (7) Intelligent Control

default.zh: “人工智能基础”是一门技术基础课，主要介绍人工智能的基本概念、 基本原理。课程的主要目标是让学生了解人工智能技术的基本特点，为学生掌握人工智能在工程实际中的应用奠定基础。课程内容主要包括： (1) 人工智能概述 (2) 知识表示 (3) 推理 (4) 搜索策略 (5) 机器学习与深度学习 (6) 神经网络 (7) 智能控制

Its aim is to provide students with a fundamental understanding of the essential characteristics of artificial intelligence technology, laying the groundwork for their practical engineering applications. The course content includes: (1) Overview of Artificial Intelligence (2) Knowledge Representation (3) Inference (4) Search Strategies (5) Machine Learning and Deep Learning (6) Neural Networks (7) Intelligent Control

default.zh: 通过课程的学习，学生能够掌握视觉感知系统核心部件特性和参数计算方法，能够根据应用场景需要构建视觉感知系统；掌握图像预处理、图像分割、特征提取、特征匹配等方法，能够构建深度学习网络实现图像目标检测和语义分割；能够在视觉感知领域从事工程设计、技术开发、项目管理等工作。
default.en: Through the course, students will be able to master the core components and parameter calculation methods of visual perception systems, and be able to construct visual perception systems according to the needs of application scenarios; Master methods such as image preprocessing, image segmentation, feature extraction, and feature matching, and be able to construct deep learning networks to achieve image object detection and semantic segmentation; Capable of working in the field of visual perception, including engineering design, technical development, and project management.

default.zh: 本课程主要面向仪器类专业本科生开设，在大三学年夏季学期进行。主要以仪器领域知名企业的技术专家和高管为授课教师，通过课程的学习，使仪器类学生能够对“四个面向”和仪器强国有更深入的了解，对当前智能制造和高端装备领域对仪器类人才的需求，以及在仪器领域发展对知识体系的需要有更深入的了解，对数字化、网络化、智能化等新技术在仪器产业的应用有更深入的了解；通过产业专家对学科发展与社会产业结构的关系、发展趋势、就业前景等进行针对性的介绍，使学生认识到仪器科学与技术的重要性，引导学生建立正确的学习理念、增强专业认同、树立正确的择业观，为学生进一步学习有关专业课程和日后从事仪器类相关技术领域工作打下基础。
default.en: This course is mainly aimed at undergraduate students majoring in instruments and is conducted in the summer semester of their junior year. The course mainly focuses on technical experts and executives from well-known enterprises in the field of instruments. Through the learning of the course, students in the field of instruments can have a deeper understanding of the "four orientations" and the instrument power. They can also have a deeper understanding of the current demand for instrument talents in the fields of intelligent manufacturing and high-end equipment, as well as the need for knowledge systems in the development of the instrument field. They can also have a deeper understanding of digitization, networking A deeper understanding of the application of new technologies such as intelligence in the instrument industry; By providing targeted introductions by industry experts on the relationship between disciplinary development and social industrial structure, development trends, employment prospects, etc., students will recognize the importance of instrument science and technology, guide them to establish correct learning concepts, enhance professional identity, and establish correct career choices, laying a foundation for further learning of relevant professional courses and future work in the field of instrument related technology.

default.zh: 课程设计是“精密机械学基础（1）（2）”课程的一个重要教学环节。通过课程设计不仅加强了理论与实际的联系，进一步巩固所学课程的内容，而且要求学生综合地应用先修课程（制图、力学、金属工艺学等）中的知识，学会使用有关技术资料，完成一个简单仪表或仪器装置的设计，既完成一个工程技术人员在机械设计方面所必须具备的基本技能训练，它也是培养学生分析和解决工程实际问题能力的重要环节之一。
default.en: Course design is an important teaching segment for the course of Fundamentals of Precision Mechanics (1) (2), by which can stress the link between theory and practice and solidify the course content. Moreover, students are required to synthetically apply the knowledge of pre-elective courses such as Mechanical Drawing, Mechanics and Mental Technology, to make use of corresponding technical information and design and accomplish simple instrument equipment. It can offer not only fundamental skill training in the field of machinery design, but also important practice of cultivating students with the ability of analyzing and solving problem.

default.zh: 随着社会发展，生命科学与人类健康、环境保障、工业与技术产业发展的关系日益紧密。科学技术的发展和融合呼唤高水平的复合型人才，不仅要有良好的数、理、化和专业基础知识，还要有生命科学和信息科学的相关知识。为此，21世纪的高等教育知识体系中，需要具备生命科学的知识及其理念。本课程是面向全校学生开出的核心课程，旨在扩大学生的知识面，培养学生生命科学的思维方式，将生命科学的思想、方法运用到他们所从事的工作领域。通过学习生命科学的基础知识和基本理论，使学生了解生命科学的最新成就和发展趋势。
default.en: With the development of society, the relationship between life science and human health, environmental protection, the development of industry and technology industry is becoming increasingly close. The development and integration of science and technology calls for high level of compound talents, not only a good math, science, chemistry and professional basic knowledge, but also related knowledge of life science and information science. Therefore, in the twenty-first Century higher education knowledge system, the knowledge and concept of life science were needed. This course is a core course for all students. It aims at expanding students' knowledge, cultivating students' thinking mode of life science, and applying the ideas and methods of life science to their work field. By learning the basics of life science and basic theory, it will help students to understand the latest achievements of life science and development trends.

default.zh: 生命科学发展日新月异，尤其是进入21世纪以来，生命科学各领域突破层出不穷，以生命科学为服务对象的交叉学科发展方兴未艾。为了使学生熟悉生命科学前沿发展的状况和现代生物技术的发展趋势，我们开设生命科学基础与现代技术课程，课程基本内容涵盖生物化学、遗传学、肿瘤细胞生物学、免疫学、生物信息学和神经生物学等生命学科中发展最为迅速的学科。具体包括以下内容：1.从生命大分子（包括蛋白质、核酸和糖）的基本结构与功能出发认识生命活动的基本机制；2. 认识生命遗传信息传递的基本规律、遗传的细胞与分子基础、基因工程与基因编辑；3. 了解肿瘤流行病学现状，掌握肿瘤微环境的概念和特点，认识肿瘤最新治疗方法的基本原理； 4. 理解并掌握免疫学基本概念、原理、免疫与疾病；5. 学习生物信息学的研究范畴、组学数据、生物分子网路、生物大数据与人工智能；6. 了解神经系统的组成与基本功能，神经元结构与功能，动作电位，神经突触，神经生物学研究的新技术。
default.en: Life science has been developing rapidly. The breakthroughs in various fields of life science have emerged one after another especially since the 21st century. The development of interdisciplinary subjects serving life science is in the ascendant. In order to familiarize students with the frontier development of life science and the development trend of modern biotechnology, we set up the course of Fundamentals of Life Science and Modern Technology. The course contents include basic biochemistry, genetics, cancer cell biology, immunology, bioinformatics and neurobiology and discipline of the fastest growing fields in the life. To be specific: 1. To understand the basic mechanism of life activities from the basic structure and function of life macromolecules (including proteins, nucleic acids and glycans); 2. To understand the basic laws of genetic information transmission, the cellular and molecular basis of heredity, genetic engineering and gene editing; 3.
