default.en: Properties of complex numbers, Some elementary functions, Analytic functions, Complex integrals, Cauchy’s theorem, Cauchy’s integral formula, Maximum modulus theorem and harmonic functions, Convegent series of analytic functions, Power series and Taylor’s theorem, Laurent series and classifications of singularities, Calculation of residues, The resiedue theorem, Evaluation of definite integral, Basic theory of comformal mappings, Fractional linear and Schwarz-Christoffel transformations, Analytic continuation and Riemann surface, Rouch’s theorem and principle of the argument, Mapping properties of analytic functions, Riemann’s theorem, Asymptotic methods, Basic properties of harmonic functions, Construction of harmonic functions, The Poission representation.

default.zh: 近世代数是数学专业的核心课程，以研究代数结构（如群、环、域、模等）及其关系为核心，具有高度抽象性和广泛适用性。其教学要求和特点如下： 一、教学要求 核心内容： - 群论：群的定义、子群、循环群、正规子群、商群、同态基本定理、对称群与置换。 - 环论：环的定义、理想、商环、整环/域、唯一分解整环、欧几里得整环、多项式环。 - 域论：域的定义、域扩张、代数扩张域超越扩张、分裂域有限域。 - 基本应用：拉格朗日定理、中国剩余定理。 - 技能要求： - 能证明简单定理（如“阶为素数的群必为循环群”）。 - 熟悉典型例子：剩余类群、置换群、矩阵群、唯一分解整环、欧几里得整环、多项式环。 二、课程特点 1. 抽象性与公理化 - 以公理定义结构（如群的四条公理），强调严格逻辑推导。 - 例子：从“对称性”抽象出群的定义，从“整数运算”抽象出环和域。 2. 结构性思维 - 关注对象的整体性质（如阶、同构、子结构、商结构）而非单个元素。 - 例子：研究群的同态定理而非单个群元素的运算。 3. 广泛联系性 - 与数论、几何、拓扑、密码学、物理（如晶体对称性）等领域深度关联。 - 例子：伽罗瓦理论链接域扩张与多项式求根。 4. 阶梯式难度 - 从具体例子（如置换群、整数环）过渡到抽象理论（如自由群、诺特环）。 - 高阶内容（如范畴语言、同调代数）需要较强的适应能力。
default.en: Modern algebra is a core course in mathematics. It focuses on studying algebraic structures (such as groups, rings, fields, modules, etc.) and their relationships. It is highly abstract and widely applicable. Its teaching requirements and characteristics are as follows: 1. Teaching requirements Core content: - Group theory: definition of group, subgroup, cyclic group, normal subgroup, quotient group, fundamental theorem of homomorphism, symmetric group and permutation. - Ring theory: definition of ring, ideal, quotient rings, integral domain/field, unique fatorization domains, Euclidean domains, polynomial rings. - Field theory: definition of field, field extension, algebraic extension field transcendental extension, splitting fields, finite fields. - Basic application: Lagrange's theorem, Chinese remainder theorem. - Skill requirements: - Able to prove simple theorems (such as "a group with a prime order must be a cyclic group"). - Familiar with typical examples: remainder group, permutation group, matrix group, unique decomposition integral ring, Euclidean domains, polynomial rings. 2. Course features 1. Abstractness and Axiomatization - Define structures with axioms (such as the four axioms of groups), emphasizing strict logical deduction. - Example: abstract the definition of groups from "symmetry", and abstract rings and fields from "integer operations". 2. Structural thinking - Focus on the overall properties of objects (such as order, isomorphism, substructure, quotient structure) rather than individual elements. - Example: Study the homomorphism theorem of groups rather than the operations of individual group elements. 3. Extensive connections - Deeply related to number theory, geometry, topology, cryptography, physics (such as crystal symmetry) and other fields. - Example: Galois theory links field expansion with polynomial root finding. 4. Step-by-step difficulty - From concrete examples (such as permutation groups, integer rings) to abstract theories (such as free groups, Noetherian rings). - High-level content (such as categorical language, homological algebra) requires strong adaptability.

default.zh: 本课程为数学分析的进阶课程。我们将采用比较现代的观点，介绍多变元微积分的基础知识，并将以此为基础，介绍一般流形上基于微分形式等基本工具的分析。本课程同时配备旨在增进理解的大量练习题。课程也将为微分几何、代数拓扑、泛函分析、实变与复变函数、微分方程等后续课程做准备。
default.en: This course is an advanced course on mathematical analysis. Adopting a modern point of view, we shall introduce multivariable calculus, and based on this, introduce analysis on general manifolds using basic tools such as differential forms. This course will be accompanied by an abundant supply of problem sets aiming to enhance comprehension. The course also serves as preparation to subsequent courses such as differential geometry, algebraic topology, functional analysis, real and complex analysis and differential equations et cetera.

default.zh: 本课程旨在培养学生运用基础拓扑学理论和方法解决问题的能力，同时为后续课程奠定必要的理论基础。课程分为两部分：第一部分重点讲解点集拓扑学的基本概念，第二部分将引导学生初步了解代数拓扑学。 在第一部分中，学生将学习拓扑空间中的核心概念，包括收敛性、连续性、连通性、分离公理、紧致性以及拓扑空间的紧化。课程还将探讨如何通过积拓扑、和拓扑及商拓扑等方法从已有拓扑构造新的拓扑空间，并介绍一致收敛、一致空间和贝尔纲定理等工具。这些概念和方法在数学的诸多领域（如泛函分析、高等测度与概率论以及严格分析）中均有广泛应用。 第二部分将介绍如何通过给拓扑空间赋予群结构来研究其性质，学生将学习在数学论证中运用同伦和基本群等概念。这些工具将帮助学生抽象地分析空间的结构特性，并为后续课程（如微分拓扑、泛函分析、高等代数几何和群论）打下基础。作为应用，课程将演示如何计算某些空间的基本群，并展示如何利用这些工具证明重要定理，如布劳威尔不动点定理和代数基本定理。
default.en: The course aims to develop students' ability to solve problems using the theories and methods of basic topology, while also laying the necessary theoretical foundation for subsequent courses. The course will have two parts: The first part focuses on basic notions of point-set topology, the second part will introduce students to the beginnings of algebraic topology. In the first part, students will learn to use the core concepts of convergence and continuity in topological spaces, as well as connectedness and separation axioms, compactness, and compactifications of topological spaces. We will also study various ways of making new topologies from old ones such as product, sum, and quotient topologies. We will also touch upon more specific tools such as uniform convergence and uniform spaces, as well as the Baire category theorem. These tools and ideas are used in nearly every mathematical field, for instance, in functional analysis, advanced measure and probability theory, and hard analysis. In the second part, students will be introduced to the methods of attaching groups to topological spaces in order to gain information about these spaces. Thus, they will learn to use concepts such as homotopy and fundamental groups in their mathematical arguments. These tools will enable students to abstractly analyze the structural properties of spaces and lay the groundwork for advanced courses like differential topology, functional analysis, advanced algebraic geometry and advanced group theory. As applications, we will show how to compute the fundamental groups of some spaces and we will also show how these tools can be used to prove important theorems like the Brouwer fixed point theorem and the fundamental theorem of algebra.

default.zh: 常微分方程是数学与应用数学、物理学、工程学等领域的核心课程之一，主要研究包含未知函数及其导数的方程，并探讨其解的存在性、唯一性、稳定性及实际应用。课程通常从一阶微分方程的基本解法入手，涵盖可分离变量、齐次方程、线性方程及恰当方程等经典类型，随后扩展到高阶线性微分方程，特别是常系数线性方程的特征根法与拉普拉斯变换。此外，课程还会涉及微分方程组的解法，如矩阵指数法，以及稳定性理论的初步概念，例如相平面分析和李雅普诺夫函数。在应用方面，常微分方程广泛用于描述动力系统、人口模型、电路振荡、机械振动等实际问题，学生将通过建模与求解过程深刻理解数学工具在自然科学与工程技术中的桥梁作用。 其主要内容：一阶ODE解法、高阶线性ODE、线性方程组的特征解法等、 稳定性与定性理论、数值方法、主要的应用案例。
default.en: Ordinary Differential Equations (ODEs) form a foundational subject in mathematics, physics, and engineering, focusing on equations that involve unknown functions and their derivatives. The course typically begins with analytical techniques for first-order ODEs, including separable variables, homogeneous equations, linear equations, and exact equations. It then progresses to higher-order linear differential equations, emphasizing methods like characteristic roots and Laplace transforms for constant-coefficient systems. Students also explore systems of ODEs solved via matrix exponentials and gain introductory insights into stability theory, such as phase plane analysis and Lyapunov functions. Practical applications are a key component, with ODEs modeling dynamical systems, population growth, electrical circuits, and mechanical vibrations. Through problem-solving and modeling exercises, learners develop the ability to translate real-world phenomena into mathematical frameworks, highlighting the interdisciplinary power of ODEs in science and technology. The key topics as follows: First-order ODEs、Higher-order Linear ODEs、Systems of ODEs involving eigenvalue solutions method. Stability & Qualitative Theory、Numerical Methods、Real world applications.

default.zh: 点集拓扑学是数学系相关专业的专业基础课，是进一步学习代数拓扑，拓扑群，微分拓扑，黎曼几何，泛函分析，李群等后继课的基础。在培养学生抽象思维能力，逻辑分析和推理能力以及表达能力方面占有重要地位。 本课程主要讲授一般拓扑空间的结构，以及这些空间的分类。本课程可以使学生了解现代数学的特点，熟悉抽象数学的分析问题和处理问题的方式，掌握经典抽象空间的性质，通过本课程的课堂教学，着重培养学生严谨的逻辑分析和推理能力，以及运用抽象理论。方法和工具解决实际问题的能力。
default.en: General topology is a professional basic course for the related majors of the Department of Mathematics, and it is the basis for further learning algebraic topology, topological groups, differential topology, Riemannian geometry, functional analysis, Li Qun and other subsequent courses. It occupies an important position in training students' abstract thinking ability, logical analysis and reasoning ability and expression ability. This course mainly teaches the structure of general topological spaces and the classification of these spaces. This course enables students to understand the characteristics of modern mathematics, familiar with the analysis problems of abstract mathematics and the way to deal with problems, master the nature of classic abstract space, through the classroom teaching of this course, focus on training students' rigorous logic analysis and reasoning ability Abstract theory. Methods and tools to solve practical problems.

default.zh: 本课程将介绍数值代数领域的重要数值方法及理论，着重讨论线性方程组及非线性方程组的直接方法和迭代方法，详细阐述数值格式的构造流程、稳定性分析及计算精度等。特别地，在学习向量范数及矩阵范数的基础上，对于线性方程组，将关注消元法、三角分解法、共轭梯度法、正交对角化法等，且也会介绍如Jacobi迭代和Gauss-Seidel迭代的构造过程及收敛性判定。对于非线性方程及方程组，将简要叙述单点迭代法及其收敛性，将详细给出Newton法及其在单根和重根上的收敛阶。通过本课程的学习，不仅让同学们掌握经典的数值方法，更提高解决实际工程问题的能力。
default.en: This course will introduce some important numerical methods and theory in the field of numerical algebra. The direct and iterative methods for solving linear and nonlinear system of equations will be discussed. Construction procedure, stability analysis and computational accuracy of numerical schemes will be explained in detail. In particular, based on the knowledge of vector and matrix norms, the elimination methods, the triangular decomposition methods, the conjugate gradient method as well as the orthogonal diagonalization methods will be concerned for solving linear systems of equations. The construction and convergence judgment of Jacobi and Gauss-Seidel iterative methods will also be presented. For nonlinear equations and systems, The Picard iterative process and its convergence analysis will be briefly given. The Newton method and the convergence order at single and multiple roots will be illustrated in detail. After auditing the current course, students are expected to grasp classical numerical methods and to enhance the ability in solving practical engineering problems.

default.zh: 数值逼近是面向数学类专业本科学生非常重要的专业核心课，是学习后续专业课的基础。课程主要讲授常见逼近问题的数值方法的基本原理、构造方式、分析方式等，重点使学生了解数值逼近的理论基础、研究热点、发展趋势及前沿应用；熟悉和掌握常见的数值逼近方法的构造和分析方法，并具有解决实际问题的能力；掌握常见的数值逼近中的实践工具，逐步具有应用先进工具解决实际逼近问题的能力。 本课程主要讲授内容包括误差分析及避免误差的方法、多项式插值方法、曲线拟合方法、最佳一致和平方逼近、数值积分和数值微分方法等。本课程在教学中会穿插平时测评，课后有作业。 课程最后的成绩采用累加式，综合考虑期末、平时和上机报告等。
default.en: Numerical approximation is a very important course for undergraduate students in mathematics department. It is also the basis in their sequel studies. This course introduces basic principle of numerical methods for approximation problems, the corresponding analytic methods, and their recent applications. After finishing this course, the students should familiar with common approximation methods and analytic methods, and has the ability to solve practical problems. They should also familiar with practice tools, and gradually have the ability to use advanced tools to solve practical approximation problems. The main contents of this course include error analysis and methods to avoid errors, polynomial interpolation methods, curve fitting methods, uniformly best and least-square approximation, numerical integration and numerical differentiation methods. This course will be interspersed in the teaching of the small evaluations, and some homework. The final results of the course are cumulative, taking into account the final exam, homework, reports and so on.

default.zh: 本课程的目的是介绍群论和环论的基本内容。主要涉及以下概念：群，子群，正规子群，商群，群同构，群作用，环，理想及商环，环同构，模，商模，模同构，域，代数扩张，分裂域，Galois群。
default.en: The course aims to give a basic introduction to the theory of groups and rings. The main concepts to be discussed are as follows: group, subgroup, normal subgroup, quotient group, group isomorphism, group action, ring, ideal and quotient ring, ring isomorphism, module, quotient module, module isomorphism, field, algebraic extension, splitting field, Galois group.

default.zh: 《近世代数》是“数学与应用数学专业”专业的重要专业基础课。“数学与应用数学专业”专业课程可分为“分析”、“代数”、“几何”三条线。在“代数”这条线中，“高等代数”起基础作用课；“近世代数”课起承上启下作用。《高等代数》课主要讲授代数学十七、十八世纪的成果，《近世代数》课则讲授十九、二十世纪的成果，并为进一步学习现代数学打好基础，也为后续专业课程“李群与李代数”、“有限群表示”、“代数拓扑”、“代数几何”等打下基础。近世代数是培养学生掌握基本抽象代数结构及抽象数学思维方式的一门专业课，其主要目标是使得学生： 1．了解抽象的代数结构及公理化思想，提高数学素养以及自主学习能力； 2．熟悉基本的代数概念，掌握群论与环论的基础知识； 3．具有初步的理论推导及较强的抽象思维能力。
default.en: Modern Algebra is an important basic course of mathematics and applied mathematics.Mathematics and applied mathematics major professional courses can be roughly divided into three fields: Analysis, Algebra, and Geometry.In the field of algebra, Advanced Algebra plays a fundamental role, and Modern Algebra serves as a bridge between the preceding and the following.Advanced Algebra course is mainly about algebra in the 17th and 18th centuries, and Modern Algebra course is about achievement of algebra in the 19th and 20th centuries, and provides a basis for further study of modern mathematics, and also for the follow-up professional courses Lie Group and Lie Algebra and Finite Group Representation, Algebraic Topology, Algebraic Geometry, etc. Modern Algebra is a specialized course to train students to master basic abstract algebraic structure and abstract mathematical thinking mode. Its main goal is to train students to have the following abilities: 1．Understand the abstract algebraic structure and axiomatic thought, improve mathematical literacy and autonomous learning ability; 2．Familiar with basic algebraic concepts, grasp the basic knowledge of group theory and ring theory; 3．Has the preliminary theory derivation and the strong abstract thinking ability.

default.zh: 随着计算科学与技术的进步和发展，科学与工程计算的应用范围已扩大到许多的学科领域。数值分析是研究用计算机求解各种数学问题的数值方法及其理论的一门学科，是应用性很强的数学类课程，是工程学乃至社会科学研究中非常重要的基础工具，也是工程数学与计算机应用的桥梁。数值计算已与理论方法、实验方法并列成为科学研究的第三种基本手段。该课程介绍将连续的数学模型离散化，通过计算机程序在有限步骤内求得数值近似解的方法。通过一系列的实验帮助学生掌握基本的误差分析方法、求解非线性方程（组）和线性方程组的方法、用插值及拟合近似计算函数值、连续函数平方逼近、计算近似定积分、求解微分方程初边值问题的方法等。通过学习，学生将掌握经典算法的基本理论、使用技巧，并能够灵活应用以解决实际问题。
default.en: With the development of computer science and technology, the application of scientific and engineering computing has been extended to many fields. Numerical analysis is a subject that studies the numerical methods and theories of solving various mathematical problems by computer, it is a mathematics course with strong application. It is a very important basic tool in engineering and social science research. It is also a bridge between engineering mathematics and computer application. Numerical calculation has become the third basic method of scientific research, along with theoretical method and experimental method. This course introduces the method of discretizing continuous mathematical models and obtaining numerical approximate solutions in finite steps through computer programs. Through a series of experiments to help students to master basic error analysis method, solving the nonlinear equation (system) and the method of linear equations, using interpolation and approximation to calculate the function value, continuous function square approximation, computing the approximate definite integral, as well as the method for solving initial boundary value problems of differential equations, etc. Through the study, students will master the basic theory and skills of classical algorithms, and be able to apply them flexibly to solve practical problems.

default.zh: 数值分析主要研究在计算机上使用各种各样数值方法解决科研和工程中的实际数学问题，它既有纯数学的高度抽象性与严密科学性的特点，又有实际试验的高度技术性和广泛性的特点，内柔丰富、理论完整、实用性强。
default.en: Numerical analysis primarily investigates the use of various numerical methods on computers to solve practical mathematical problems in scientific research and engineering. It combines the high level of abstraction and rigorous scientific nature of pure mathematics with the highly technical and broadly applicable characteristics of practical experimentation. The discipline is rich in content, complete in theory, and highly practical.

default.zh: 离散数学是研究离散量的结构及其相互关系的数学学科，是现代数学的一个重要分支。离散的含义是指不同的连接在一起的元素，主要是研究基于离散量的结构和相互间的关系，其对象一般是有限个或可数个元素。本课程目标是通过离散数学的学习，不但可以掌握处理离散结构的描述工具和方法，为后续课程的学习创造条件，而且可以提高抽象思维和严格的逻辑推理能力，为将来参与创新性的研究和开发工作打下坚实的基础。
default.en: Discrete mathematics is a branch of modern mathematics, which studies the structure and relationship of discrete quantities. The meaning of discreteness refers to different connected elements. It mainly studies the structure based on discreteness and the relationship between them. Its objects are generally finite or countable elements. The goal of this course is not only to master the description tools and methods of dealing with discrete structure, to create conditions for the follow-up course learning, but also to improve the ability of abstract thinking and strict logic reasoning, and to lay a solid foundation for participating in innovative research and development in the future.

default.zh: 数值分析是信息与计算科学专业和数学与应用数学专业的一门专业核心课程，它是科学与工程计算的核心。本课程通常也称为矩阵代数，是以计算机为工具来求解各种数学模型的主要课程。随着计算机存储量及运算能力的加强，以及舍入误差理论的进一步完善，使得数值分析的教学内容逐渐发展成为借助矩阵约化过程来求解矩阵线性代数方程组、特征值问题和最小二乘问题。本课程是通过理论研究和实际问题的解决让学生掌握数值分析的基本知识和基本方法，使得学生掌握经典的矩阵计算方法并能应用于求解分析各种数值问题。
default.en: Numerical algebra is a core course of the students major in information and computing science or mathematics and applied mathematics. It is the core of science and engineering computing. This course, also commonly known as matrix algebra, is the main course for solving various mathematical models using computers as a tool. With the enhancement of computer storage and operation capacity as well as the improvement of rounding error theory, the teaching content of numerical algebra has gradually developed into solving matrix linear algebra equations, eigenvalue problems and least squares problems by matrix reduction process. This course enables students to master basic knowledge and methods of numerical algebra through theoretical research and practical problem solving, so that students can master the classical matrix calculation method and use this method to analyze and solve various numerical problems.

default.zh: 以下是《近世代数2》的典型课程内容与教学要求框架，可根据具体学时和学生背景调整： 一、课程内容大纲 1. 模论 - 基本概念：模、子模、商模、模同态。 - 自由模与有限生成模：基、秩、结构定理（Euclid整环上有限生成模的分解）。 2. 域论进阶（Advanced Field Theory） - 代数扩张：代数闭包、有限域的结构（GF(p？)）。 - 可分性与正规扩张：本原元定理、分裂域的唯一性。 - 无限维扩张：超越基（可选）。 3. 伽罗瓦理论（Galois Theory） - 基本定理：伽罗瓦对应（中间域 ？ 子群）、正规扩张与正规子群。 - 应用：尺规作图问题、方程根式解的判据（阿贝尔群与可解群）。 - 示例：计算x？ - a的伽罗瓦群。 4. 可选扩展内容 - 交换代数基础：希尔伯特基定理、局部化。 - 表示论初步：群表示与模的联系（如k[G]-模）。 - 代数数论示例：代数整数环的Dedekind整性（可选）。
default.en: The following is a typical course content and teaching requirement framework for "Modern Algebra II", which can be adjusted according to specific hours and student background: I. Course Content Outline 1. Module Theory - Basic concepts: module, submodule, quotient module, module homomorphism. - Free modules and finitely generated modules: basis, rank, structure theorem (decomposition of finitely generated modules on Euclid domains). 2. Advanced Field Theory - Algebraic extension: algebraic closure, structure of finite fields (GF(p？)). - Divisibility and normal extension: primitive element theorem, uniqueness of split fields. - Infinite dimensional extension: transcendental basis (optional). 3. Galois Theory - Basic theorem: Galois correspondence (intermediate field ？ subgroup), normal extension and normal subgroup. - Application: ruler and compass construction problem, criterion for radical solution of equation (Abelian group and solvable group). - Example: Compute the Galois group of x？ - a. 4. Optional extensions - Commutative algebra foundation: Hilbert basis theorem, localization. - Introduction to representation theory: the connection between group representations and modules (such as k[G]-modules). - Algebraic number theory example: Dedekind integrity of the algebraic integer ring (optional).

default.zh: 本课程以单变量及多变量实函数的可测性、可积性为研究对象，通过抽象测度、勒贝格测度、可测函数的定义与性质，建立勒贝格积分理论。随后讨论勒贝格积分理论中的几个重要定理，如乘积测度的构造、变量替换公式、Lp空间理论等，最后讨论不同的收敛类型的定义以及它们之间的关系。
default.en: This course focuses on the measurability and integrability of real-valued functions of single and multiple variables. It begins with the definitions and properties of abstract measures, Lebesgue measures, and measurable functions, establishing the foundation of Lebesgue integration theory. Subsequently, key theorems within Lebesgue integration theory are discussed, such as the construction of product measures, change of variables formulas, and the theory of L^p spaces. Finally, different modes of convergence are examined, along with the relationships between them.

default.zh: 数理逻辑是研究推理的数学分支，研究自然和社会中思维、逻辑的推理规律。通过本课程学习，培养学生学会运用所学知识分析和解决实际问题的能力。 （1）理解数理逻辑的基本概念、基本理论和方法，熟悉两种重要的逻辑体系，即命题逻辑和谓词逻辑；掌握命题逻辑推理系统和谓词逻辑推理系统。 （2）熟练运用命题逻辑推理系统和谓词逻辑推理系统解决实际推理问题。 （3）培养学生的逻辑思维能力。
default.en: Mathematical logic is a branch of mathematics that studies the laws of reasoning in thinking and logic in nature and society. Through the study of this course, students are trained to apply the knowledge they have learned to analyze and solve practical problems. (1) Understand the basic concepts, theories, and methods of mathematical logic, be familiar with two important logical systems, namely propositional logic and predicate logic; master the propositional logic reasoning system and predicate logic reasoning system. (2) Skillfully use the propositional logic reasoning system and predicate logic reasoning system to solve practical reasoning problems. (3) Cultivate students' logical thinking abilities.

default.zh: 本课程系统讲授数学各领域通用的基本推理工具与思想方法，旨在帮助学生建立严格的数学思维框架，提升逻辑推理与抽象概括能力。 课程内容涵盖集合论基础、命题逻辑与量词、数学归纳法、实数的公理化体系、数列与不等式、复数运算、多项式与有理分式分解，以及各类数值函数与映射的性质分析。此外，课程还专门介绍计算优化技巧与快速心算规则，强化学生的计算效率与实际问题解决能力。 教学采用课堂讲授、手写作业、自主研读与讨论答疑相结合的方式。考核以大作业形式进行，综合考查学生对基本概念、推理方法和应用技巧的掌握程度。通过本课程的学习，学生将为后续分析学、代数学及算法理论等进阶课程奠定坚实的逻辑与方法论基础。
default.en: The course systematically introduces the general reasoning tools and fundamental methodologies common to various branches of mathematics, aiming to cultivate rigorous mathematical thinking and enhance students’ abilities in logical deduction and abstract generalization. The syllabus covers basic set theory, propositional logic and quantifiers, mathematical induction, the axiomatic construction of real numbers, sequences and inequalities, complex numbers and their geometric representation, polynomials and partial fraction decomposition, as well as the properties of numerical functions and mappings. Special attention is given to computational optimization techniques and mental arithmetic rules, reinforcing students’ efficiency in calculation and their capacity to tackle practical problems. Instruction combines lectures, handwritten assignments, independent study, and discussion sessions. Assessment is based on a comprehensive final project that evaluates students’ understanding of core concepts, reasoning methods, and application skills. This course prepares students for advanced studies in analysis, algebra, algorithm theory, and other related fields by providing a solid logical and methodological foundation.

default.zh: 本课程将介绍数学专业英语的基本词汇、语法和表达方式，并通过阅读、写作和口语练习等方式，帮助学生掌握数学领域的英语表达和交流能力。课程内容涵盖数学基础概念、数学符号、数学公式、数学理论等各个方面，涉及代数、几何、概率统计等各个领域。学生将学习如何正确地使用数学专业英语来表达和解释数学概念、理论和问题，并能够阅读和理解英语数学文献。本课程的学习目标是培养学生的英语表达和交流能力，使学生能够正确地使用英语表达数学思想和观点，并能够与国际同行进行学术交流。学生将通过讲解、讨论、练习和阅读等多种方式，掌握数学专业英语的基本知识和技能，提高在数学领域的英语阅读和写作能力，以及在学术交流中的英语口语能力。本课程适合数学专业的学生和需要使用英语进行数学学习和研究的人员。通过本课程的学习，学生将能够更好地适应国际化的学术环境，提高自身的学术水平和竞争力。 课程目标1. 掌握基本数学专业词汇及表达方法。具备阅读英文数学文章及数学专业学术论文能力，数学学术及教学文章的英汉互译技巧。掌握英文数学学术论文的检索方法。 课程目标2. 能用英语书写文章摘要、学术交流信件等。用英语做简单的学术报告。
default.en: This course mainly introduces the knowledge of reading, writing and making reports in mathematics English. Through the course learning, students can master the basic vocabulary of English for mathematics, the essentials of writing and the precautions for making reports. Course Objective 1: Master the basic mathematical vocabulary and expression methods. Possess the ability to read English mathematics articles and academic papers in mathematics, and English-Chinese translation skills for mathematics academic and teaching articles. Master the retrieval method of English mathematics academic papers. Course Objective 2: Ability to write abstracts, academic communication letters, etc. in English. Make simple academic reports in English.

default.zh: 课程包含热带（幂等）数学这一快速发展的数学分支。该学科研究具有幂等运算的代数系统理论及其应用。热带数学能将传统意义上非线性的各类问题转化为热带代数中的线性问题，从而简化形式分析和求解过程。虽然沿用基础数学概念，但热带数学采用与传统数学截然不同的问题处理方式。通过学习，学生既能了解传统数学基本概念在不同数学框架下的应用，又能掌握运用新数学语言与方法解决经典及新型实际问题的能力，最终有效培养学生的创新能力。
default.en: Mathematical Foundations of Computer Science (B) contains tropical (idempotent) mathematics, which is a rapidly growing branch of mathematics. It deals with the theory and applications of algebraic systems with idempotent operations. The application of tropical mathematics allows various problems, which are nonlinear in the ordinary sense, to be transformed into linear problems in tropical algebra, and hence facilitates the formal analysis and simplifies the derivation of solution. Tropical mathematics utilizes basic mathematical concepts but exploits different ways to handle problems than the conventional mathematics. It offers students opportunities to see both how basic concepts of conventional mathematics may work in a different setting and how to solve classical and novel applied problems by using new mathematical language and methods. As a result, it is helpful to train students to obtain innovation ability.

default.zh: 应用数学（B）课程涵盖热带最优化，这是热带数学的一个分支领域。该学科主要研究在热带（幂等）代数体系下构建并求解的最优化问题。针对一系列热带最优化问题，可以直接获得解析形式的解。在某些情况下，热带最优化方法能够为传统数学无法解析求解的问题提供直接解决方案。本课程旨在展示新型最优化模型与方法，同时演示经典最优化问题的新解法，更有助于培养学生获得创新能力。
default.en: Applied Mathematics (B) contains tropical optimization, which is an area of tropical mathematics. It deals with optimization problems formulated and solved in the framework of tropical (idempotent) algebra. For a number of tropical optimization problems, analytical solutions can be obtained in a direct form. In some cases, methods and techniques of tropical optimization offer a direct solution to problems that have no analytical solutions available in terms of conventional mathematics. The aim of the course is both to show new models and methods of optimization and to demonstrate new solutions to known optimization problems. It is also helpful to train students to obtain innovation ability.

default.zh: 掌握本课程的目标在于提升数学基础训练水平，获得解决数学问题的技能，培养数学文化素养，理解数学在各专业活动领域中的作用。课程目标还包括运用微分方程与积分方程理论的基本概念和方法。微分方程和积分方程作为基础数学概念，在解决实际问题中具有最广泛的应用价值。
default.en: The goals of mastering the course are to improve the level of fundamental training in mathematics; acquiring skills in solving mathematical problems; nurturing a mathematical culture and understanding the role of mathematics in various areas of professional activity. The goals of mastering the course are to apply the basic concepts and methods of the theory of differential and integral equations. Differential and integral equations are one of the basic mathematical concepts most widely used in solving practical problems.

default.zh: 本课程为数学与应用数学专业夏季学期开设的组合计算课程，总学时36（理论16，课外辅导20），1学分，先修数学分析和高等代数。系统介绍组合数学基本概念与计数方法，涵盖排列与置换、莫比乌斯反演、生成函数、二进制展开、递归关系与斐波那契数列。通过理论讲解与例题，培养运用组合工具解决算术、分析及离散结构问题的能力。教学方式包括课堂讲授、问题驱动、讨论与课外辅导。考核由平时测验（40%）和期末闭卷考试（60%）组成。课程旨在为学生奠定组合数学基础，揭示数学各分支之间的联系，提升抽象思维。 基础数学(A)（康托尔集合论）是面向数学与应用数学专业中外合作办学项目开设的夏季学期选修课，总学时36（理论16、课外辅导20），1学分，先修数学分析（1）和高等代数（1）。课程系统介绍集合论的基本思想和核心方法，包括等势与无限的不同层次、良序集合的比较与刚性定理、超限归纳与超限递归、基数算术与序数基础，以及组合集合论的初步内容。通过学习，学生将掌握基本集合论工具，培养严格逻辑推理能力和抽象思维方式，为学习算法理论和现代数学各分支奠定基础。考核采用平时测验（40%）与期末闭卷笔试（60%）相结合的方式。
default.en: This course is a combinatorial computing course offered in the summer semester for students in the Mathematics and Applied Mathematics program. It comprises a total of 36 contact hours (16 hours of lectures and 20 hours of tutorials), carries 1 credit, and has Mathematical Analysis and Advanced Algebra as prerequisites. The course systematically introduces the fundamental concepts and enumeration methods of combinatorics, covering permutations, M？bius inversion, generating functions, binary expansions, recurrence relations, and Fibonacci numbers. Through theoretical exposition and worked examples, it cultivates the ability to apply combinatorial tools to problems in arithmetic, analysis, and discrete structures. Instructional methods include lectures, problem-driven learning, discussions, and tutorials. Assessment consists of regular quizzes (40%) and a final closed-book examination (60%). The course aims to provide students with a solid foundation in combinatorics, reveal connections among various branches of mathematics, and enhance abstract thinking. Fundamental Mathematics (A) (Cantor’s Set Theory) is an elective course offered in the summer semester for the Sino-foreign cooperative education programme in Mathematics and Applied Mathematics. The course has a total of 36 credit hours (comprising 16 hours of lectures and 20 hours of tutorial support) and carries 1 credit. Prerequisites for this course are Mathematical Analysis (1) and Advanced Algebra (1). The course systematically introduces the fundamental ideas and core methods of set theory, including equinumerosity and the hierarchy of infinities, comparison of well-ordered sets and the rigidity theorem, transfinite induction and transfinite recursion, cardinal arithmetic and the basics of ordinal numbers, as well as introductory topics in combinatorial set theory. Through this course, students will acquire basic tools in set theory, develop the ability to engage in rigorous logical reasoning and abstract thinking, and lay the foundation for further study in algorithmic theory and various branches of modern mathematics. Assessment will be conducted through a combination of regular quizzes (accounting for 40%) and a final closed-book written examination (accounting for 60%).

default.zh: 本课程旨在复习不定积分的基本方法并教授定积分的计算。学生将熟练掌握各种积分技巧，能够自信地识别并应用适当的积分方法，并处理定积分的计算问题。课程内容包括不定积分的基本方法回顾、定积分的特殊计算和转换、近似积分方法以及积分与级数的关系，还包括积分计算中一些特殊函数（如伽马函数、指数积分和椭圆积分）的应用。通过问题导向和互动式教学，结合多媒体教学工具，学生将在课堂上深入理解和练习这些积分技巧。
default.en: This course reviews the basic methods of indefinite integration and teaches the computation of definite integrals. Students will become proficient in various integration techniques, confidently identify and apply appropriate integration methods, and handle the calculation of definite integrals. The curriculum includes a review of fundamental indefinite integration methods, special calculations and transformations of definite integrals, methods of approximate integration, and the relationship between integrals and series. It also covers the application of special functions in integral calculus, such as the gamma function, exponential integral, and elliptic integrals. Through problem-based and interactive teaching, supplemented by multimedia tools, students will gain a deep understanding and practical skills in these integration techniques.

default.zh: 本课程探讨积分微积分在物理和几何中的实际应用。学生将学习如何在科学、技术和工程领域中识别和解决通过积分微积分的应用来处理的问题，从而增强应用这些数学工具解决实际问题的信心。 课程涵盖积分微积分的基础理论，包括区间函数、可加函数以及积分微积分的基本定理。课程提供了将适当的问题简化为积分形式的一般算法，并通过简单示例进行初步理解。 在几何应用方面，学生将学习使用积分计算曲线之间的面积、曲线的弧长、旋转曲面的面积、旋转体的体积（使用圆盘法和壳层法）以及质心。课程还将介绍第一和第二帕普斯-古尔丁定理，并探讨极坐标在这些计算中的应用。 在力学和物理应用方面，学生将学习计算转动惯量，并通过积分理解功和能量等概念。课程强调将自然现象的描述简化为能够获得定量结果的形式，并通过各种科学领域的实际示例进行支持。 此外，课程还涉及统计应用，教授学生使用积分计算函数的平均值、方差和标准差。还将介绍如何在涉及点状物体的问题中使用Dirac delta函数和Heaviside阶跃函数。 通过问题导向和互动式教学方法，并辅以多媒体工具，学生将深入了解如何将积分微积分应用于几何、自然科学和统计学中的各种问题。
default.en: This course explores the practical applications of integral calculus in physics and geometry. Students will learn to recognize and address problems in science, technology, and engineering through the use of integral calculus, building confidence in applying these mathematical tools to real-world scenarios. The curriculum covers the foundational theory of integral calculus, including interval functions, additive functions, and the key theorem of integral calculus. It provides a general algorithm for reducing suitable problems to integration and offers simple examples for initial understanding. In geometry, students will apply integrals to calculate areas between curves, arc lengths, surface areas of revolution, volumes of revolution using disk and shell methods, and centroids. The course also introduces the 1st and 2nd Pappus–Guldinus theorems and explores the use of polar coordinates in these calculations. In the realm of mechanics and physics, students will learn to compute moments of inertia and understand concepts like work and energy through integration. The course emphasizes reducing natural phenomena descriptions to forms yielding quantitative results, supported by practical examples across various scientific fields. Additionally, the course delves into statistical applications, teaching students to calculate the average value of a function, variance, and standard deviation using integrals. It also introduces the use of Dirac delta function and Heaviside step function in solving problems involving point-like objects. Through problem-based and interactive teaching methods, supplemented by multimedia tools, students will develop a deep understanding of how to apply integral calculus to diverse problems in geometry, natural science, and statistics.

default.zh: 初等概率论是数学系各专业学生必修的重要专业基础课，是概率与统计专业学生学习随机过程、随机分析等后续课程的基础。与数学专业的其他课程相比，初等概率论有如下不同之处。一方面，初等概率论研究的是与自然界以及社会生活中的随机现象的规律，与日常生活有密切联系。另一方面，概率现象的数学刻画以及数学结果的严格证明往往较为复杂和抽象。本课程将通过课堂教学、讨论等环节，带领学生们认识如何刻画和研究“随机性现象”，建立概率思想，掌握重要的数学结果。本课程将为学生讲授初等概率理论的基本思想、方法、理论及应用。
default.en: Elementary Probability Theory is a crucial foundational course for all majors in the mathematics department, serving as the basis for subsequent studies in stochastic processes and stochastic analysis for students specializing in probability and statistics. Compared to other mathematics courses, Elementary Probability Theory has the following distinctions. On one hand, it examines the laws governing random phenomena in nature and social life, maintaining a close connection with daily life. On the other hand, the mathematical modeling of probabilistic phenomena and the rigorous proofs of mathematical results are often complex and abstract. This course will guide students in understanding how to characterize and study "random phenomena," establish probabilistic thinking, and master key mathematical results through classroom instruction and discussions. The course will impart the fundamental ideas, methods, theories, and applications of elementary probability theory to students.

default.zh: 生产实习是一门重要的实践教学课程，对于学生从学校走入社会从事实际的工作具有指导作用。数学系生产实习工作是利用计算机从事辅助设计，完成教师所指定题目的实习报告。 本次课程使用的是PHOTOSHOP CS2软件，教师首先对软件的使用进行讲解，并指导学生完成一个独立实例的设计工作，从而锻炼学生的分析问题、解决问题以及团队合作的精神。为了保证实习效果，实习过程安排在数学实验中心进行，便于教师及时指导操作。
default.en: Production practice is a very important lacture that can supervise the stuedents who will come into society for practice use.The work of production practice in Harbin Institute of Technology Mathematic is a Computer-Aided Design that in a position to finish the practice report of the teacher's appointment. We use PHOTOSHOP CS2 in this lecture.The teacher will explain the method of use of the software and lead the student to complete the case unaided.Thereby it can make the student have ability of analyse and slove the problem by themselves and also have the spirit of team work.In order to assurance the effect of practice, the course of practice is arranged in the lab of Mathematic to offer the teachers' coach in a convenient way.

default.zh: 生产实习在理工科本科教学中占有重要地位，是非常重要的综合实践教学环节。学生通过生产实习走向科研、企业和事业单位，了解科研、现代化生产过程以及企业管理，学习生产实践知识、技术管理知识和技术开发知识。学生在实习中将理论和实践结合起来，学以致用，进一步培养独立思考问题的能力以及团队协作精神，在生产实践中学习观察问题、分析问题和解决问题的方法，特别要培养学生的实践能力和创新意识。通过实习，扩大学生的视野，培养学生热爱专业，热爱社会，为未来的学习及工作打下良好的基础。
default.en: Internship plays an important role in undergraduate education in science and engineering, serving as a crucial component of comprehensive practical teaching. Through internships, students transition to scientific research, enterprises, and career units, gaining an understanding of scientific research, modern production processes, and enterprise management. They acquire knowledge of practical production, technical management, and technology development. By integrating theory and practice during internships, students apply what they have learned and further develop their ability to think independently and collaborate in teams. They learn to observe, analyze, and solve problems in production practices, with a focus on cultivating practical skills and fostering innovation. Internships broaden students' horizons, nurture their passion for their field, and for society, laying a solid foundation for their future learning and work.

default.zh: 本课程为未来技术学院开设，是设计与制造系列课程中的第一门。主要研究用正投影法绘制工程图样的理论和方法。课程的主要授课目标是培养学生的空间想象、空间思维能力；学习运用正确、规范的工程标准表达设计思想，绘制基本工程图的能力；运用工程图和三维建模表达设计思想的理念；培养学生建立标准化意识和创新研发意识。
default.en: This course is for school of future technology, and it is the first course in the design and manufacturing series. The course studies the theory and method of drawing engineering drawings with orthographic projection method. The main objectives of the course are to develop students' spatial imagination and spatial thinking ability; to learn the ability to use the correct and standardized engineering standards to express design ideas and to draw basic engineering drawings; to cultivate students' awareness of standardization and innovative.

default.zh: 《设计与制造（2）》是一门用以培养学生机械设计能力的技术基础课，旨在培养学生综合运用先修课程中所学知识和技能，解决机械工程实际问题的能力，结合各种实践教学环节，进行机械工程技术人员所需的基本训练，为学生进一步学习有关专业课程和日后从事机械设计工作打下基础，因此在近机械类专业的教学计划中占有重要地位和作用，是高等工科院校中近机械类专业一门主干课程，在人才培养的教学计划中占有重要的地位。 本课程主要研究： 机械的组成及课程的研究对象；机械零件设计概述；常用工程材料及钢的热处理；极限与配合；机械运动简图及自由度；连杆机构的功能及设计原理；凸轮机构的功能、强度计算及结构设计；带传动的应用基础及普通V带传动设计；齿轮机构的传动原理、齿轮传动失效形式与设计准则、圆柱直齿轮传动强度计算、圆柱斜齿轮强度计算、齿轮传动结构设计、齿轮传动效率与润滑；蜗杆传动类型、普通圆柱蜗杆失效形式、设计准则和材料选择；轮系的分类及应用、定轴轮系、周转轮系、混合轮系传动比计算；间歇机构的工作原理；螺纹连接的类型、标准件、预紧和防松、螺栓连接的强度计算、螺栓组设计；轴的结构设计、强度及刚度计算、键连接、花键连接；滚动轴承的构造、代号及其类型选择、滚动轴承的失效形式及选择计算、轴系部件结构、润滑与密封；摩擦磨损及润滑基本知识、滑动轴承的结构和轴瓦材料、非液体摩擦轴承设计计算、液体动压和静压滑动轴承原理；联轴器、离合器及制动器的类型、应用及选择； 本课程的主要任务是培养学生： 掌握机构分析与设计的基本理论和基本方法；具有对机械系统运动方案创新设计的初步能力； 掌握设计或选用通用机械零部件的基本理论、基本知识和基本技能，具有设计机械传动装置和一般机械的能力；具有运用标准、规范，查阅技术资料的能力、计算能力、绘图能力；了解机械设计的新理论、新方法。
default.en: Design and Manufacturing(2) is a technical basic course designed to cultivate students 'mechanical design ability. It aims to cultivate students' comprehensive application of the knowledge and skills acquired in the prerequisite courses to solve the practical problems of mechanical engineering. The basic training for the technicist of machine engineering coupled with the practical teaching establishes the basis for the students to study professional curriculum or work for the machine design project. Therefore, Design and Manufacturing(2) is a major course and plays an important role in the teaching program related to the mechanical engineering, is a major course in mechanical engineering in higher engineering colleges and universities, occupying an important position in the teaching plan of personnel training. The main contents include:The composition of machinery and the object of study of the course; mechanical parts design overview; common engineering materials and heat treatment of steel; limits and fits; mechanical motion sketches and degrees of freedom; the function of the mechanical linkage and design principles; cam mechanism function, strength calculation and structural design; the application of the foundation of the belt drive and ordinary V-belt drive design; gear mechanism transmission principles, gear transmission failure forms and design guidelines, strength calculation of cylindrical spur gear transmission ,strength calculation of cylindrical helical gears, structural design of gear transmission, efficiency and lubrication of gear transmission; types of worm drive, failure form of common cylindrical worm, design guidelines and material selection; classification and application of wheel system, fixed shaft wheel system, turnover wheel system, mixed wheel system transmission ratio calculation; working principle of intermittent mechanism; type of screw connection, standard parts, pre tightening and anti-loosening, strength calculation of bolt connection, bolt group design; structural design, strength and stiffness calculation of shaft, key connection, spline connection the structure, code and type selection of rolling bearings, failure form and selection calculation of rolling bearings, shafting component structure, lubrication and sealing; basic knowledge of friction, wear, and lubrication, structure of sliding bearings and bearing pad materials, design and calculation of non-liquid friction bearings, principles of hydrodynamic and hydrostatic sliding bearings; type, application, and selection of couplings, clutches, and brakes;The main task of this course is to train students: Basic theory and method for the structural analysis and design; Primary ability of innovative design of mechanical system motion scheme.Basic theory, knowledge and technology for the design/option of the universal mechanical parts and the ability for the design of mechanical transmission device. Ability for reading, calculation and drawing based on the criterion and laws.. Experimental theory and methods for the machine design basis and the primary ability for experimental research. New theory and methods for the machine design.

default.zh: 智能装备类专业导论以智能装备的设计和应用为目标，针对智能装备类专业所涵盖学科专业的特点、发展历程、学科领域主要研究内容、学科发展与社会产业结构的关系、就业前景等发展趋势等进行针对性的介绍，使学生认识到智能技术的重要性，引导学生建立正确的学习理念、增强专业认同、树立正确的择业观，提供大学专业学习引导，为学生进一步学习有关专业课程和日后从事相关技术领域工作打下基础，在培养学生机械系统综合设计能力、提高解决复杂机械工程问题的能力等方面占有重要的地位。
default.en: The course of Introduction to Intelligent Equipment Specialty aims to introduce the characteristics, development history, main research contentsd, the relationship between disciplinary development and social industrial structure, and employment prospects of the intelligent equipment specialty. Through targeted introductions, students can recognize the importance of intelligent technology, establish correct learning concepts, enhance professional identity, and form correct career views. This course also provides guidance for university studies, lays a foundation for further learning of related professional courses and future work in related technical fields, and plays an important role in cultivating students' comprehensive design capabilities for mechanical systems and improving their abilities to solve complex mechanical engineering problems.

default.zh: 本门课程是为机械类专业和近机械类学生开设的一门技术基础课，主要研究用投影法绘制工程图样和解决空间几何问题的理论和方法，主要内容如下：机械制图的基本知识，介绍有关《机械制图》的国家标准及有关绘图的一些基础技能；投影的基础理论，点、直线和平面的投影，平面立体和曲面立体的投影，截交线和相贯线的画法；组合体的画法及组合体的尺寸标注，通过这部分内容的学习，使学生能够将各种空间几何形体，正确地用三视图表达出来；学习机件的表达方法等,使学生了解有关机械图的有关知识,能够画出和读懂中等复杂程度图样。
default.en: This course is a technical basic course for mechanical and near-mechanical students. It mainly studies the theory and method of drawing engineering drawings and solving spatial geometric problems by projection method. The main contents are as follows: basic knowledge of mechanical drawing, introduction National Standards for Mechanical Drawing and some basic skills related to mapping; basic theory of projection, projection of points, lines and planes, projection of plane solids and curved surfaces, The drawing method of the intersecting line,; the drawing of the combined body and the dimensioning of the combined body, through the study of this part, the students can use various spatial geometric shapes correctly. Learning of machine expression, enable the students to understand the relevant knowledge about the mechanical drawings, and to draw and read drawings with medium comlexities.

default.zh: 工程制图基础B是为非机类专业开设的一门技术基础课，主要研究用投影法绘制工程图样和解决空间几何问题的理论和方法。使学生学会运用工程图表达设计思想的理念，作为学生最先接触的一门工程技术类课程，承担着转变学生思维观念和引领学生建立工程意识的任务。课程的主要授课目标是培养学生的空间想象、空间思维能力；学习运用正确、规范的工程标准表达设计思想，绘制基本工程图的能力。
default.en: This course is a technical basic course for non-mechanical students. It mainly studies the theory and method of drawing engineering drawings and solving spatial geometric problems by projection method. Students can learn to use engineering drawings to express the idea of design ideas. As an engineering technology course that students first contact, they undertake to change students' thinking concepts and lead students to the task of building engineering awareness. The main objectives of the course are to develop students' spatial imagination and spatial thinking ability; to learn the ability to use the correct and standardized engineering standards to express design ideas and to draw basic engineering drawings.

default.zh: 画法几何与阴影透视是一门建筑类专业必修的技术基础课。它分为投影理论、建筑阴影、建筑透视三部分。其中投影理论部分着重研究解决空间几何问题的理论和方法，为培养学生空间想象力和创新能力打下良好的基础；建筑阴影部分研究绘制建筑立面阴影和轴测图上的阴影，为学生做好建筑物的立面图阴影提供准备；建筑透视部分研究绘制透视图以及透视图的阴影，使学生能够达到初步设计的能力，同时它又为学生学习后续课程和完成课程设计和毕业设计打下基础。
default.en: Descriptive Geometry and Shadow Perspective is a compulsory technical basic courcomplete course design and grase for the Building Profession Students. It is divided into three parts: projection theory, architectural shadow, and architectural perspective. The projection theory part focuses on the theory and method of solving spatial geometry problems, and lays a good foundation for cultivating students' spatial imagination and innovation ability; the architectural shadow part studies the shadows on the building facade shadows and the axonometric drawings, and prepares for the students. The elevation of the building's elevations provides preparation; the architectural perspective section draws perspectives and perspectives to enable students to achieve initial design capabilities, while at the same time laying the groundwork for students to follow-up courses and duation design.

default.zh: 本课程是一门土木类专业必修的技术基础课，主要培养绘图能力。本课程分为投影理论、制图基础和专业制图三部分。投影理论着重研究解决空间几何问题的理论和方法，包括点、直线和平面的投影，立体的投影，轴测投影等；制图基础着重研究各种表达方法；专业制图主要研究运用国家标准规范绘制和阅读工程图样方法，使学生掌握阅读并且绘制简单工程图样的能力。
default.en: This course is a compulsory fundamental course for civil engineering specialties. The general purpose is to cultivate and train the students' ability of sketching. This course contains three parts, which are projection theory, drawing fundamental and civil engineering graphics. The projection theory introduces theories and methods of solving geometric problems in space, including projections of points, lines and planes, multi-faceted orthographic and isometric projections of solids. In the part of civil engineering drawing fundamental, students will learn different expression method. Civil engineering graphics presents reading and drawing civil engineering ghrapics by using national standards, and grants the students capability of reading and drawing civil engineering ghrapics.

default.zh: 建筑工程制图是建筑类专业必修的技术基础课，包括建筑工程制图，计算机绘图两部分。建筑工程制图主要研究用运用国家标准规范绘制和阅读建筑工程图样方法，计算机绘图主要培养学生操作绘图软件进行工程图绘制的能力。为培养学生的绘图、读图和建立空间想象能力打下必要的基础，使学生具备初步设计能力。
default.en: This course is a compulsory fundamental course for architectural engineering specialties，it contains two parts, which are architectural engineering ghrapics and computer draughting. Architectural engineering ghrapics presents reading and drawing architectural engineering ghrapics by using national standards of civil engineering and grants, and computer draughting presents the abilities of drawing architectural engineering ghrapics by using computer software. Students are trained to have abilities of drawing, reading and spatial imagining, then have the preliminary ability of design.

default.zh: 建筑工程制图是纯英授课体系中建筑类专业必修的技术基础课，包括建筑工程制图，计算机绘图两部分。建筑工程制图主要研究运用国家标准规范绘制和阅读建筑工程图样方法，计算机绘图主要培养学生操作绘图软件进行工程图绘制的能力。使学生具备初步运用工程图进行设计能力。
default.en: Architectural engineering drawing is a mandatory foundational technical course for architecture majors within a fully English-taught curriculum. It comprises two main components: architectural engineering drawing and computer-aided drafting. The former focuses on the methods of creating and interpreting architectural drawings in accordance with national standards and regulations. The latter aims to cultivate students' proficiency in utilizing drafting software to produce engineering drawings. Ultimately, this course equips students with the preliminary ability to apply engineering drawings in architectural design.

default.zh: 本课程是一门交通运输类专业必修的技术基础课，主要培养绘图能力。本课程分为投影理论、制图基础和专业制图三部分。投影理论着重研究解决空间几何问题的理论和方法，包括点、直线和平面的投影，立体的投影等；制图基础着重研究各种表达方法；专业制图主要研究运用国家标准规范绘制和阅读工程图样方法，使学生掌握阅读并且绘制中等难度工程图样的能力。
default.en: This course is a compulsory fundamental course for transportation engineering specialties. The general purpose is to cultivate and train the students' ability of sketching. This course contains three parts, which are projection theory, drawing fundamental and civil engineering graphics. The projection theory introduces theories and methods of solving geometric problems in space, including projections of points, lines and planes, multi-faceted orthographic. In the part of engineering drawing fundamental, students will learn different expression method. Engineering graphics presents reading and drawing engineering ghrapics by using national standards, and grants the students capability of reading and drawing engineering ghrapics.

default.zh: 制图技术基础是建筑类专业必修的技术基础课。理解建筑与机械领域组合体的形成方式（叠加、切割、综合），能分析复杂形体的几何构成逻辑。本课程目标是培养学生掌握国家制图标准（GB/ISO）中组合体的视图配置、剖面图/断面图表达方法，区分建筑（如梁板柱节点）与机械（如箱体类零件）的表达差异。
default.en: Fundamentals of Cartography Technology is a compulsory technical basic course for architecture majors. Understand the formation mode (superposition, cutting and synthesis) of the assembly in the field of architecture and machinery, and analyze the geometric composition logic of complex bodies. The goal of this course is to train students to master the view configuration, sectional view/sectional view expression method of assembly in national drawing standard (GB/ISO), and to distinguish the expression differences between buildings (such as beam-column joints) and machinery (such as box parts).

default.zh: 画法几何与阴影透视是一门给需要纯英文授课的建筑类专业必修的技术基础课。它分为投影理论、建筑阴影、建筑透视三部分。其中投影理论部分着重研究解决空间几何问题的理论和方法，为培养学生空间想象力和创新能力打下良好的基础；建筑阴影部分研究绘制建筑立面阴影和轴测图上的阴影，为学生做好建筑物的立面图阴影提供准备；建筑透视部分研究绘制透视图以及透视图的阴影，使学生能够达到初步设计的能力，同时它又为学生学习后续课程和完成课程设计和毕业设计打下基础。
default.en: Descriptive Geometry and Shadow Perspective is a compulsory technical basic courcomplete course design and grase for the Building Profession Students. It is divided into three parts: projection theory, architectural shadow, and architectural perspective. The projection theory part focuses on the theory and method of solving spatial geometry problems, and lays a good foundation for cultivating students' spatial imagination and innovation ability; the architectural shadow part studies the shadows on the building facade shadows and the axonometric drawings, and prepares for the students. The elevation of the building's elevations provides preparation; the architectural perspective section draws perspectives and perspectives to enable students to achieve initial design capabilities, while at the same time laying the groundwork for students to follow-up courses and duation design.

default.zh: 工程图样是人们用来表达和交流设计思想的重要工具，是工程技术部门一项重要技术文件，是工程界的共同“语言”，是工程技术人员必须掌握的知识，是从事技术工作的基础。机械工程制图是研究绘制和阅读工程图样的一门技术基础课，它既有系统的理论又有较强的实践性和技术性。本课程主要学习标准件和常用件，用投影理论绘制零件图和装配图的方法。为培养学生的绘图、读图和建立空间想象能力打下必要的基础，同时，又是学生学习后续课程和完成课程设计和毕业设计不可缺少的基础。
default.en: Engineering drawings are important tools used by people to express and exchange design ideas. They are an important technical document of the engineering and technical department. They are the common "language" of the engineering community, the knowledge that engineering and technical personnel must master, and the basis for engaging in technical work. Mechanical engineering drawing is a technical basic course for studying drawing and reading engineering drawings. It has both systematic theory and strong practicality and technicality. This course studies standard parts and common parts, and focuses on the method of drawing part and assembly drawings using projection theory. It lays the necessary foundation for cultivating students' drawing, reading and establishing spatial imagination. At the same time, it is also an indispensable foundation for students to learn follow-up courses and complete curriculum design and graduation design.

default.zh: 机械设计基础课程B是一门用以培养学生机械设计能力的技术基础课，旨在培养学生综合运用先修课程中所学知识和技能，解决机械工程实际问题的能力，结合各种实践教学环节，进行机械工程技术人员所需的基本训练，为学生进一步学习有关专业课程和日后从事机械设计工作打下基础，因此在近机械类专业的教学计划中占有重要地位和作用，是高等工科院校中近机械类专业一门主干课程，在人才培养的教学计划中占有重要的地位。 本课程主要研究： 机械的组成及课程的研究对象；机械零件设计概述；常用工程材料及钢的热处理；极限与配合；机械运动简图及自由度；连杆机构的功能及设计原理；凸轮机构的功能、强度计算及结构设计；带传动的应用基础及普通V带传动设计；齿轮机构的传动原理、齿轮传动失效形式与设计准则、圆柱直齿轮传动强度计算、圆柱斜齿轮强度计算、齿轮传动结构设计、齿轮传动效率与润滑；蜗杆传动类型、普通圆柱蜗杆失效形式、设计准则和材料选择；轮系的分类及应用、定轴轮系、周转轮系、混合轮系传动比计算；间歇机构的工作原理；螺纹连接的类型、标准件、预紧和防松、螺栓连接的强度计算、螺栓组设计；轴的结构设计、强度及刚度计算、键连接、花键连接；滚动轴承的构造、代号及其类型选择、滚动轴承的失效形式及选择计算、轴系部件结构、润滑与密封；摩擦磨损及润滑基本知识、滑动轴承的结构和轴瓦材料、非液体摩擦轴承设计计算、液体动压和静压滑动轴承原理；联轴器、离合器及制动器的类型、应用及选择； 本课程的主要任务是培养学生： 掌握机构分析与设计的基本理论和基本方法；具有对机械系统运动方案创新设计的初步能力； 掌握设计或选用通用机械零部件的基本理论、基本知识和基本技能，具有设计机械传动装置和一般机械的能力；具有运用标准、规范，查阅技术资料的能力、计算能力、绘图能力； 掌握机械设计基础的实验原理和方法，具有进行实验研究的初步能力；了解机械设计的新理论、新方法。
default.en: Machine Design Basis B is a technical basic course designed to cultivate students 'mechanical design ability. It aims to cultivate students' comprehensive application of the knowledge and skills acquired in the prerequisite courses to solve the practical problems of mechanical engineering. The basic training for the technicist of machine engineering coupled with the practical teaching establishes the basis for the students to study professional curriculum or work for the machine design project. Therefore, Machine Design Basis B is a major course and plays an important role in the teaching program related to the mechanical engineering, is a major course in mechanical engineering in higher engineering colleges and universities, occupying an important position in the teaching plan of personnel training. The main contents include:The composition of machinery and the object of study of the course; mechanical parts design overview; common engineering materials and heat treatment of steel; limits and fits; mechanical motion sketches and degrees of freedom; the function of the mechanical linkage and design principles; cam mechanism function, strength calculation and structural design; the application of the foundation of the belt drive and ordinary V-belt drive design; gear mechanism transmission principles, gear transmission failure forms and design guidelines, strength calculation of cylindrical spur gear transmission ,strength calculation of cylindrical helical gears, structural design of gear transmission, efficiency and lubrication of gear transmission; types of worm drive, failure form of common cylindrical worm, design guidelines and material selection; classification and application of wheel system, fixed shaft wheel system, turnover wheel system, mixed wheel system transmission ratio calculation; working principle of intermittent mechanism; type of screw connection, standard parts, pre tightening and anti-loosening, strength calculation of bolt connection, bolt group design; structural design, strength and stiffness calculation of shaft, key connection, spline connection the structure, code and type selection of rolling bearings, failure form and selection calculation of rolling bearings, shafting component structure, lubrication and sealing; basic knowledge of friction, wear, and lubrication, structure of sliding bearings and bearing pad materials, design and calculation of non-liquid friction bearings, principles of hydrodynamic and hydrostatic sliding bearings; type, application, and selection of couplings, clutches, and brakes;The main task of this course is to train students: Basic theory and method for the structural analysis and design; Primary ability of innovative design of mechanical system motion scheme.Basic theory, knowledge and technology for the design/option of the universal mechanical parts and the ability for the design of mechanical transmission device. Ability for reading, calculation and drawing based on the criterion and laws.. Experimental theory and methods for the machine design basis and the primary ability for experimental research. New theory and methods for the machine design.

default.en: Machine Design Basis C is a technical basic course designed to cultivate students 'mechanical design ability. It aims to cultivate students' comprehensive application of the knowledge and skills acquired in the prerequisite courses to solve the practical problems of mechanical engineering. The basic training for the technicist of machine engineering coupled with the practical teaching establishes the basis for the students to study professional curriculum or work for the machine design project. Therefore, Machine Design Basis C is a major course and plays an important role in the teaching program related to the mechanical engineering, is a major course in mechanical engineering in higher engineering colleges and universities, occupying an important position in the teaching plan of personnel training. The main contents include:The composition of machinery and the object of study of the course; mechanical parts design overview; mechanical motion sketches and degrees of freedom; the function of the mechanical linkage and design principles; cam mechanism function, strength calculation and structural design; the application of the foundation of the belt drive and ordinary V-belt drive design; gear mechanism transmission principles, gear transmission failure forms and design guidelines, strength calculation of cylindrical spur gear transmission ,strength calculation of cylindrical helical gears, structural design of gear transmission, efficiency and lubrication of gear transmission; types of worm drive, failure form of common cylindrical worm, design guidelines and material selection; classification and application of wheel system, fixed shaft wheel system, turnover wheel system, mixed wheel system transmission ratio calculation; type of screw connection, standard parts, pre tightening and anti-loosening, strength calculation of bolt connection; structural design, strength and stiffness calculation of shaft, key connection, spline connection the structure, code and type selection of rolling bearings, failure form and selection calculation of rolling bearings, shafting component structure, lubrication and sealing. The main task of this course is to train students: Basic theory and method for the structural analysis and design; Primary ability of innovative design of mechanical system motion scheme. Basic theory, knowledge and technology for the design/option of the universal mechanical parts and the ability for the design of mechanical transmission device. Ability for reading, calculation and drawing based on the criterion and laws.. New theory and methods for the machine design.

default.zh: 机械原理课程是高等院校中机械类专业一门主干课程，该课程对培养学生机械系统的分析、设计能力，解决复杂机械工程问题的能力方面具有重要地位。 机械原理课程主要讲授以下内容：机构的组成原理；机构运动简图的绘制；机构运动分析的原理与方法；机构力分析的原理与方法；连杆机构的功能及设计原理、设计方法；凸轮机构的功能与设计方法；齿轮机构的传动原理与设计方法；齿轮传动系统的分析与设计；间歇机构的工作原理与设计方法；机械系统动力学分析方法；刚性转子静平衡、动平衡的原理与试验方法；机械系统运动方案设计方法。 通过机械原理课程的课堂教学、机械基础实验、大作业、课程设计及课外习题辅导等环节，培养学生利用机械设计基础理论和机械设计方法来解决复杂机械工程问题的能力、增强创新意识，培养学生的钻研精神、科学素养和社会责任感。
default.en: Machinery theory course is a main course in mechanical major in higher college. The course plays an important role in the cultivating of students' ability to analyze and design mechanical system, and the ability to solve complex mechanical engineering problems. The machinery theory A course mainly teaches the following contents: the composition principle of the mechanism; drawing the mechanical motion diagram; the principle and method of mechanism kinematic analysis; the principle and method of mechanism force analysis; the function, design principle and design method of linkage mechanism; the function and design method of cam mechanism; the drive principle and design method of gear mechanism; the analysis and design of the gear transmission system; the working principle and design method of intermittent mechanism; the dynamics analysis method of mechanical system; the static balance and dynamic balance principle and test method of rigid rotor; the kinetic scheme design of mechanical system. The machinery theory A course focuses on cultivating the students’ innovation sense and ability of using mechanical design theories and methods to solve complex mechanical enginnering problems through classroom teaching, experiments, curriculum design and other aspects.

The machinery theory B course mainly teaches the following contents: the composition principle of the mechanism; drawing the mechanical motion diagram; the principle and method of mechanism kinematic analysis; the principle and method of mechanism force analysis; the function, design principle and design method of linkage mechanism; the function and design method of cam mechanism; the drive principle and design method of gear mechanism; the analysis and design of the gear transmission system; the working principle and design method of intermittent mechanism; the kinetic scheme design of mechanical system. The machinery theory B course focuse on cultivating the students’ innovation sense and ability of using mechanical design theories and methods to solve complex mechanical enginnering problems through classroom teaching, outside class homework and other aspects.

default.zh: 机械设计课程是普通高等院校中机械类专业的主干课程之一，主要讲授在一般工作条件和常用参数范围内的通用机械零部件的工作原理、结构特点、基本设计理论和设计计算方法。通过本课程的课堂教学、实验、大作业和机械设计课程设计等环节，着重培养学生利用机械设计基础理论和机械设计方法来解决复杂机械工程问题的能力，增强创新意识。 课程主要内容包括： (1) 机械设计概论：课程性质、内容、学习方式；机械设计一般方法和过程；精度设计基础；摩擦学基础； (2) 机械零部件工作能力设计：螺纹联接的类型、标准件、预紧和防松，单个螺栓联接的强度计算，螺栓组设计，螺旋传动；带传动的应用基础，普通V带传动设计；齿轮传动类型、失效形式、材料、计算载荷，齿轮结构、润滑，圆柱直齿轮传动强度计算，圆柱斜齿轮强度计算，参数选择及许用应力；蜗杆传动类型，普通圆柱蜗杆传动设计；轴的结构、强度及刚度计算；滚动轴承的构造、代号及其类型选择，滚动轴承的寿命计算；滑动轴承的结构和轴瓦材料，非液体摩擦轴承设计计算，液体动压滑动轴承的计算；弹簧材料及许用应力，圆柱螺旋弹簧设计； (3) 机械结构设计：轴毂连接：键连接、花键连接及其它连接形式；轴承部件组合结构设计、安装与拆卸、润滑与密封；联轴器、离合器：联轴器与离合器的类型、特点和应用；机械系统传动方案设计、案例分析。
default.en: Course Description： Machinery Design A is one of the main courses for mechanical majors in colleges and universities. It mainly covers the working principle, structural characteristics, basic design theory and design calculation methods of general machine elements under general working conditions and common parameters. Through the classroom teaching, experiments, assignments and design project, the ability of students to solve complex mechanical engineering problems by using the basic theory and methodology of mechanical design, as well as the awareness of innovation, is enhanced. The main contents of this course includes: (1) Introduction to mechanical design: course nature, content and learning method; General methods and processes of mechanical design; precision design fundamentals; fundamentals of tribology; (2) Working capacity design of machine elements: type of threaded connection, standard parts, pre-tightening and anti-loosening, strength calculation of the single bolted connection, design of bolt group, screw transmission; The application foundation of belt drive, V belt drive design; Gear transmission classification, failure modes of gear transmission, material, calculated load, gear structure, lubrication, strength calculation of cylindrical spur and helical gear transmission, parameter selection and allowable stress; Classification of worm transmission, ordinary cylindrical worm drive design; Structure, strength and stiffness of shafts; Structure, code and selection of rolling bearings, life calculation; Structure and bearing material of sliding bearing, non-fluid friction bearing design and calculation, fluid dynamic pressure sliding bearing calculation; Spring material and allowable stress, cylindrical helical spring design; (3) Design of mechanical structures: Key connection, spline connection and other connection forms; Structural design, installation and disassembly, lubrication and sealing of bearing components; Types, characteristics and applications of couplings and clutches; Mechanical system transmission scheme design, case analysis.

default.zh: 机械设计课程是高等工科院校中机械大类专业的主干课程，主要讲授在一般工作条件和常用参数范围内的通用机械零部件的工作原理、结构特点、基本设计理论和设计计算方法。通过本课程的课堂教学、实验和后续的机械设计课程设计等环节，着重培养学生利用机械设计基础理论和机械设计方法来解决复杂机械工程问题的能力，增强创新意识。课程主要内容包括： 机械零件设计概述；螺纹联接的类型、标准件、预紧和防松，单个螺栓联接的强度计算，螺栓组设计，螺旋传动；键联接、花键联接；带传动的应用基础，普通V带传动设计；齿轮传动类型、失效形式、材料、计算载荷，齿轮结构、润滑，圆柱直齿轮传动强度计算，圆柱斜齿轮强度计算，参数选择及许用应力；蜗杆传动类型，普通圆柱蜗杆传动设计；轴的结构设计、强度及刚度计算；滚动轴承的构造、代号及其类型选择，滚动轴承的寿命计算，轴系部件结构、润滑与密封；滑动轴承的结构和轴瓦材料，非液体摩擦轴承设计计算，液体动压滑动轴承的计算；联轴器、离合器及制动器的类型、应用及选择；弹簧材料及许用应力，圆柱螺旋弹簧设计；机械传动系统的功能、特点、分类与设计。
default.en: It is main one of courses of the major of mechanical engineering for institution of higher education, which mainly covers working principles ,characteristics of mechanical structures, basic theories and calculation methods of mechanical design under general working conditions and common parameters’ range of general mechanical elements. The course covers missions which is needed compulsorily including the parts of classroom instruction and teaching ,classical mechanical experiments and subsequent curriculum design of mechanical design, which aims to cultivate the abilities to solve complicated problems of mechanical engineering using basic theories and methods of mechanical design and improve the consciousness of innovation. the content of the course mainly includes are as follows: Summary of design of mechanical elements; types of threaded connection; standard components; pretightening force and locking; strength calculation of single bolted joints, design of group bolted joints; screw-drive; key connection and spline connection; basis of application of belt drive; design of general V-belt drive; gear drive which consists of failure modes, materials, calculation of specified load, structures, and lubrication; strength calculation and the methods to choose the parameters and permissible stress of cylindrical spur gear drive and cylindrical helical gear drive, types of worm gear; design of general cylindrical wormgearing; Structure design, strength calculation and rigidity calculation of the shaft; the configuration, code and selection of type of the rolling bearing, life calculation of the rolling bearing; structure, lubrication and sealing of the shaft components; structure and pad materials of sliding bearings, design and calculation of sliding bearings with non-liquid lubrication, calculation of sliding bearings with hydrodynamic lubrication; main types ,applications and selections of couplings ,clutches and brakes; materials and permissible stress of springs ; design of cylindrical helical compression and extension springs; functions, characteristics, types and design of the system of mechanical transmission.

default.zh: 本课程面向机械类和近机类专业的学生，通过本门课程实践使学生：了解机械制造的一般过程，熟悉机械零件的常用加工方法及其所用主要设备的工作原理和典型结构、工夹量具的使用以及安全操作规程，了解机械制造工艺知识和新工艺、新技术在机械制造中的应用。本课程以实践教学为主，学生通过独立操作，在训练过程中将制造工艺的基本理论、知识和实践结合起来，同时同时培养学生包括理论联系实际、科学作风、热爱劳动、爱护公物、规格严格、功夫到家、质量和经济的平衡等综合素质。在质量和经济观念、理论联系实际、科学作风、热爱劳动、爱护公物等工程技术人员应具有的基本素质方面得到培养和锻炼。
default.en: This course is aimed at mechanical and near mechanical majors. In this course, students participate in practice: understanding the general process of mechanical manufacturing; Familiar with common machining methods of mechanical parts and its working principle of the main used equipment, its typical structure, the use of the tool, fixture and measuring devices, safety operation technology; Understanding the mechanical manufacturing process knowledge and some application of new techniques, technology in the machinery manufacturing. This course is given priority to practical teaching, and students should conduct an independent operation. In the training process, the basic process theory, process knowledge and basic craft practice are studied, while training and exercise the concepts of quality and economic, theory with practice, scientific, love of labor, and take good care of public property. Engineering and technical personnel should have these basic qualities.

default.zh: 本课程面向近机类和非机械类专业的学生，通过本门课程实践使学生：了解机械制造的一般过程，熟悉机械零件的常用加工方法及其所用主要设备的工作原理和典型结构、工夹量具的使用以及安全操作规程，了解机械制造工艺知识和新工艺、新技术在机械制造中的应用。本课程以实践教学为主，学生通过独立操作，在训练过程中将制造工艺的基本理论、知识和实践结合起来，同时同时培养学生包括理论联系实际、科学作风、热爱劳动、爱护公物、规格严格、功夫到家、质量和经济的平衡等综合素质。在质量和经济观念、理论联系实际、科学作风、热爱劳动、爱护公物等工程技术人员应具有的基本素质方面得到培养和锻炼。
default.en: This course is aimed at near mechanical and non mechanical majors. In this course, students participate in practice: understanding the general process of mechanical manufacturing; Familiar with common machining methods of mechanical parts and its working principle of the main used equipment, its typical structure, the use of the tool, fixture and measuring devices, safety operation technology; Understanding the mechanical manufacturing process knowledge and some application of new techniques, technology in the machinery manufacturing. This course is given priority to practical teaching, and students should conduct an independent operation. In the training process, the basic process theory, process knowledge and basic craft practice are studied, while training and exercise the concepts of quality and economic, theory with practice, scientific, love of labor, and take good care of public property. Engineering and technical personnel should have these basic qualities.

default.zh: 本课程主要内容包括：电子元器件的识别及常用测试仪器使用，印刷电路板的设计与制造，电子焊装工艺，训练产品制作，电器维修，机械设备的电器控制等。通过电子工艺技术训练使学生初步接触电子产品的生产实际，了解并掌握一般电工电子知识和技能，培养学生的工程实践能力和创新意识，为后续课程，特别是课程设计、毕业设计等积累必要的知识和技能；通过实践操作对学生进行实践动手能力和工程素质的培养，并为今后从事有关电子技术工作奠定实践基础。
default.en: This course includes: identification of electronic components and use of common test instruments, the design and manufacture of printed circuit board (PCB), assembly SMT, making the training production, maintaining electrical apparatus, electric control of mechanical equipment, etc. The students will make the initial contact with the actual production of electronic products by the electronic process technology training. They will understand and master of the knowledge and skills of general electric and electronic. They will cultivate the operational ability and creative mindset, and accumulate the necessary knowledge and skills for subsequent courses, curriculum and graduation design. Through the practical operation, their work style can be cultured, and the practice basis can be laid for them engaging in the work related to the electronic technology in the future.

default.zh: 本门课程是为工业设计专业的学生开设的一门专业基础课，主要研究用投影法绘制工程图的理论和方法，是从事技术工作的基础。主要内容如下：组合体的画法及组合体的尺寸标注；学习机件的表达方法,学习标准件和常用件，用投影理论绘制零件图和装配图的方法。为培养学生的绘图、读图和建立空间想象能力打下必要的基础，同时，又是学生学习后续课程和完成课程设计和毕业设计不可缺少的基础。
default.en: This course is a professional foundation course for students majoring in industrial design. It mainly studies the theory and method of drawing engineering drawings, and is the basis for engaging in technical work. The main contents are as follows: the drawing of the combined body and the dimensioning of the combined body;the method of machine expression; standard parts and common parts; and the method of drawing part and assembly drawings using projection theory. It lays the necessary foundation for cultivating students' drawing, reading and establishing spatial imagination. At the same time, it is also an indispensable foundation for students to learn follow-up courses and complete curriculum design and graduation design.

default.zh: 机械工程材料及成形技术基础课程是重要的机械类专业核心课程之一，是在工程训练的实践基础上，使学生获得常用工程材料及毛坯或零件的成形工艺知识，培养成形工艺分析的初步能力及创新意识，支撑专业学习要求中相应指标点的达成，并为学习其他有关课程及今后从事机械设计和制造工作奠定必要的基础。课程主要内容包括：金属材料学基础、非金属材料学基础、工程材料的力学性能、材料热处理、材料表面工程技术、材料选择、金属液态成形、金属塑性成形、连接成形、粉末冶金成形、高分子材料成形、陶瓷及复合材料成形。
default.en: Fundamentals of Mechanical Engineering Materials and Manufacturing Technology is one of the important mechanical basic courses. It is based on the practice of engineering training, causes the student to obtain knowledge of common engineering materials and blank or parts forming technology, cultivates the preliminary analysis ability of the forming process and innovation consciousness, supports the achievement of corresponding indicator points in the professional learning requirements, and lays the necessary foundation for the study of other related courses and future mechanical design and manufacturing work. The contents include: basis of metal material science, basis of non-metallic materials, mechanical properties of engineering materials, material heat treatment, surface engineering technology, material selection, casting, welding, powder metallurgy shaping, polymer materials forming, ceramics and composite materials forming .

default.zh: 机械设计基础实验是机械设计基础课程的重要实践环节，要求学生认知机械设备与机械，加深对基本理论的理解和验证，培养分析问题和解决问题的能力，获得实际设计的基本工程训练能力。机械设计基础课程还担负着培养学生具有综合设计能力和创新设计能力的任务。本实验主要包括机械组成及典型机械零部件认识与分析实验、机构运动简图测绘与分析、齿轮范成原理与齿轮参数测定、轴系部件设计与分析实验、机械系统运动方案及结构分析实验五项，共计16学时。在实验教学中，基于小班（或中班）上课形式，采用启发式教学模式。教学过程以教师讲解和指导为基础，学生动手实践为主体，以分组的形式完成实验内容。本实验按照百分制，采用累加式计分方法，对课程目标的达成度进行考核。通过这些实验，学生可以更好地理解机械设计的基础知识，培养实践能力和创新思维，为以后从事机械设计相关工作打下坚实的基础。
default.en: Mechanical design basis experiment is an important practical link in the basic course of mechanical design. It requires students to recognize mechanical equipment and machinery, deepen their understanding and verification of basic theories, cultivate their ability to analyze and solve problems, and acquire basic engineering training abilities in practical design. The basic course of mechanical design also bears the task of cultivating students' comprehensive and innovative design abilities. This experiment mainly includes five experiments: understanding and analyzing mechanical composition and typical mechanical components, mapping and analysis of mechanism motion diagram, measuring gear generation principles and gear parameters, designing and analyzing shaft components, and conducting mechanical system motion scheme and structural analysis experiments, totaling 16 class hours. In experimental teaching, heuristic teaching mode is adopted based on the small class (or middle class) teaching format. The teaching process is based on the teacher's explanation and guidance, with students' hands-on practice as the main body, and the experimental content is completed in groups. This experiment uses a cumulative scoring method based on a percentage system to assess the achievement of course objectives. Through these experiments, students can better understand the basic knowledge of mechanical design, cultivate practical abilities and innovative thinking, and lay a solid foundation for future work related to mechanical design.

default.zh: 本课程主要讲授控制理论的基本原理与基本知识及其在机械工程中的应用，以典型机电系统位置伺服系统为例，贯彻控制系统建模、分析及设计的始终，主要介绍机电系统的数学模型的建立方法、传递函数及结构图；典型一阶、二阶及高阶系统的时域分析；典型环节的频率特性极坐标图、对数坐标图及频率特性的性能指标分析；控制系统的稳定性判据及相对稳定性分析、稳态误差的计算；PID校正、非线性系统控制；控制器离散化方法、数字控制系统设计与校正；模糊控制、神经网络；基于控制原理的控制系统分析与设计。
default.en: The course is mainly taught the basic principles characteristics and basic knowledge of control theory and its application especially in mechanical engineering. The methods of modeling, analysis and design are introduced combined with a typical electromechanical control system, for example, an position servo system. The mathematical modeling method, transfer function and block diagram of electromechanical systems are provided. The time-domain analysis of a typical first-order, a second-order and a higher order systems are presented; the polar diagram, logarithmic plot and the analysis of performance indicators of frequency characteristics for a typical control system are presented; the control system stability criterion and the relative stability of the composition of the computer control system analysis, the calculation of the steady-state error are introduced, PID correction, control of nonlinear system, controller discretization method, design and calibration of digital control system, fuzzy control, neural network and automatic control based design and analyze of control system.

default.zh: 机械原理课程是普通高等学校机械类专业的主干课程。 机械基础实验（机械原理）B是机械原理理论课程教学配套的重要实践环节（独立设课）。在实验教学中通过设立部分验证性实验，使学生进一步加深理解课堂教学的内容；通过设立一些综合性、设计性实验，培养学生的理论联系实际的能力、机械系统运动方案设计能力及机构设计的创新意识和能力；通过强调学生参与实验的全过程，培养学生的动手操作能力；通过设立较多的选修实验，满足学生的求知欲，促进学生的个性发展。 重视学生知识、能力、素质三方面的培养，培养学生理论联系实际的能力和动手操作能力、机械系统运动方案设计能力及机构设计的创新意识和能力。使学生了解机械在实际工程领域中的作用，树立正确的人生职业观，培养学生的创新能力，发扬工匠精神，满足时代需求。
default.en: Mechanical principles is the main course of mechanical majors. The experiment teaching of mechanical principle B is an important practical link in the course teaching of mechanical principle. Mechanical basic experiment (Mechanical Principle) B is an important practical link in the teaching of mechanical principle theory course (independent course). In the experimental teaching, through the establishment of partial verification experiments, students can further understand the content of classroom teaching; Through the establishment of some comprehensive and designed experiments, the students' ability to combine theory with practice, the ability to design mechanical system motion program, and the innovative awareness and ability of institutional design are cultivated. Emphasis should be placed on the cultivation of students' knowledge, ability and quality, and the ability of combining theory with practice and practical operation, the design ability of mechanical system motion scheme and the innovation consciousness and ability of institutional design. To make students understand the role of machinery in the field of practical engineering, establish a correct view of life and career, cultivate students' innovation ability, carry forward the spirit of artisans, and meet the needs of The Times.

default.zh: 机械原理课程是普通高等学校机械类专业的主干课程。 机械基础实验（机械原理）A是机械原理理论课程教学配套的重要实践环节（独立设课）。本实验课程从培养学生动手实践能力、设计能力、创新能力的角度出发，设计了综合性、设计性实验，以套餐的形式满足学生个性化的需求，鼓励学生结合课程的理论知识，在实验室完成创新作品。 重视学生知识、能力、素质三方面的培养，培养学生理论联系实际的能力和动手操作能力、机械系统运动方案设计能力及机构设计的创新意识和能力。使学生了解机械在实际工程领域中的作用，树立正确的人生职业观，培养学生的创新能力，发扬工匠精神，满足时代需求。
default.en: Mechanical principles is the main course of mechanical majors. The experiment teaching of mechanical principle is an important practical link in the course teaching of mechanical principle. In the experimental teaching, through the establishment of partial verification experiments, students can further understand the content of classroom teaching; Through the establishment of some comprehensive and designed experiments, the students' ability to combine theory with practice, the ability to design mechanical system motion program, and the innovative awareness and ability of institutional design are cultivated. Through emphasizing students' participation in the whole process of the experiment, students' practical ability is cultivated. By setting up more elective experiments, students can satisfy their thirst for knowledge and promote their personality development. Emphasis should be placed on the cultivation of students' knowledge, ability and quality, and the ability of combining theory with practice and practical operation, the design ability of mechanical system motion scheme and the innovation consciousness and ability of institutional design. To make students understand the role of machinery in the field of practical engineering, establish a correct view of life and career, cultivate students' innovation ability, carry forward the spirit of artisans, and meet the needs of The Times.

default.zh: 机械设计实验教学是《机械设计》课程教学中重要的实践环节。包括机械组成及典型机械零部件认识与分析实验、带传动实验、轴系部件设计与分析实验、摩擦学基础实验、滑动轴承实验和机械系统运动方案及结构分析实验。在实验教学中通过设立部分验证性实验，使学生进一步加深理解课堂教学的内容。了解机械零件、部件的结构与其工作能力之间的关系；初步掌握机械传动方案及其结构、机械零件、部件机构设计的思路与基本方法。通过设立一些综合性、设计性实验，培养学生的理论联系实际的能力、机械结构设计能力及创新意识。
default.en: Theory of Machines and Mechanisms experiment course is an important practice part in this course.
