There are experiments as follows: Mechanical components and mechanical parts understanding and analysis of typical experiment，Belt transmission and Euler's formula experiment，Bearing parts design and analysis experiment，Sliding bearing experiment，Tribology experiment，Motion scheme of mechanical system and structure analysis experiment. In order to make students further understand what taught in classroom teaching, in the experiment teaching set up a part of the verification experiments. Understand the relationship between the structure and working ability of machine parts; Preliminary master the mechanical transmission scheme and basic methods and thoughts of mechanical parts, components and structure design. Some comprehensive designing experiments cultivate students' ability to integrate theory with practice and innovation consciousness and innovation ability of the mechanical structure design.

default.zh: 机械工程材料及成形技术基础课程是重要的机械类专业核心课程之一，是在工程训练的实践基础上，使学生获得常用工程材料及毛坯或零件的成形工艺知识，培养成形工艺分析的初步能力及创新意识，支撑专业学习要求中相应指标点的达成，并为学习其他有关课程及今后从事机械设计和制造工作奠定必要的基础。课程主要内容包括：金属材料学基础、非金属材料学基础、工程材料的力学性能、材料热处理、材料表面工程技术、材料选择、金属液态成形、金属塑性成形、连接成形、粉末冶金成形、高分子材料成形、陶瓷及复合材料成形。
default.en: Fundamentals of Mechanical Engineering Materials and Manufacturing Technology is one of the important mechanical basic courses. It is based on the practice of engineering training, causes the student to obtain knowledge of common engineering materials and blank or parts forming technology, cultivates the preliminary analysis ability of the forming process and innovation consciousness, supports the achievement of corresponding indicator points in the professional learning requirements, and lays the necessary foundation for the study of other related courses and future mechanical design and manufacturing work. The contents include: basis of metal material science, basis of non-metallic materials, mechanical properties of engineering materials, material heat treatment, surface engineering technology, material selection, casting, welding, powder metallurgy shaping, polymer materials forming, ceramics and composite materials forming .

default.zh: 流体力学和传热学作为力学重要分支，在机械、动力、航空、航天、冶金、化工、水利等诸多工程领域中起着重要作用。其工程背景和生动案例，能够有效激发学生自主学习热情和创新意识，从而增强其服务国家建设的责任和信心。机械设备中常采用流体作为介质，实现动力传递与控制、润滑与支撑、换热与热控制等功能。从事机械工程的人员只有掌握了流体和传热的基本运动规律才能真正了解这些设备的性能和运行规律，才能正确地从事设计和运行管理。本课程是机械工程的技术基础，课程内容紧密结合机械工程有关的工程实际，注重培养学生的物理直觉，为将来从事流体力学方面工程设计打下良好基础。通过课程的学习，使学生能够综合应用工程流体力学和传热学的基本原理和规律，合理有效地建立工程流体力学和传热学理论模型，正确处理机械工程领域中出现的孔口流动、间隙流动、管路损失计算、传热等复杂的工程问题。
default.en: Fluid mechanics and heat transfer, as the important branches of mechanics, play an important role in machinery, power, aviation, aerospace, metallurgy, chemical industry, water conservancy and many other engineering fields. This course is oriented to mechanical engineering applications, and systematically introduces the basic concepts and viewpoints of fluid mechanics and heat transfer, basic theories and commonly used analysis methods, the related engineering basic knowledge and the engineering application topics.The basic theory part includes the mechanical properties of fluid, hydrostatic mechanics, fluid kinematics, hydrodynamic basic equations, ideal fluid flow laws and applications, viscous fluid flow, heat conduction, heat transfer by convection, radiation heat transfer, etc. The engineering application topics cover some typical hydrodynamic and heat transfer problems in mechanical engineering, including orifice and gap flow, fluid lubrication, micro-nano flow, biological fluid dynamics, UAV fluid dynamics and heat exchangers, etc. This course is the technical foundation of mechanical engineering. The content of the course is closely combined with the engineering practice related to mechanical engineering, focusing on cultivating students' physical intuition, and laying a good foundation for the fluid mechanics engineering design in the future. Through the study of course, enable students to comprehensive application of engineering fluid dynamics and heat transfer of basic principle and law, reasonable and effectively establish engineering fluid dynamics and heat transfer theoretical model, correct dealing with mechanical engineering orifice flow, gap flow, pipeline loss calculation, heat transfer and other complex engineering problems.

default.zh: 本课程主要讲授控制理论的基本原理与基本知识及其在机械工程中的应用，以典型机电系统位置伺服系统为例，贯彻控制系统建模、分析及设计的始终，主要介绍机电系统的数学模型的建立方法、传递函数及结构图；典型一阶、二阶及高阶系统的时域分析；典型环节的频率特性极坐标图、对数坐标图及频率特性的性能指标分析；控制系统的稳定性判据及相对稳定性分析、稳态误差的计算；PID校正、非线性系统控制；控制器离散化方法、数字控制系统设计与校正；模糊控制、神经网络；基于控制原理的控制系统分析与设计。
default.en: The course is mainly taught the basic principles characteristics and basic knowledge of control theory and its application especially in mechanical engineering. The methods of modeling, analysis and design are introduced combined with a typical electromechanical control system, for example, an position servo system. The mathematical modeling method, transfer function and block diagram of electromechanical systems are provided. The time-domain analysis of a typical first-order, a second-order and a higher order systems are presented; the polar diagram, logarithmic plot and the analysis of performance indicators of frequency characteristics for a typical control system are presented; the control system stability criterion and the relative stability of the composition of the computer control system analysis, the calculation of the steady-state error are introduced, PID correction, control of nonlinear system, controller discretization method, design and calibration of digital control system, fuzzy control, neural network and automatic control based design and analyze of control system.

default.zh: “机械基础课程设计”是与“机械原理”和“机械设计”理论课程相配套的重要实践教学环节，是对理论课程所授内容的综合运用和升华。在教学过程中要综合运用先修课程中所学到的有关知识与技能，进行机械工程技术人员所需的基本训练，为学生进一步学习有关专业课程和日后从事机械设计工作打下基础，在培养学生机械系统综合设计能力、解决复杂机械工程问题能力等方面占有重要地位。 本课程作为培养学生机械设计能力的重要实践环节，从整机出发，强调系统思维，以步进式工件输送机（或其他机械系统）为例，进行总体机械系统方案的设计与选择，完成设计计算及结构设计。综合培养学生的设计、计算、绘图（二维及三维图，可选）和查图表的能力，着重培养学生的正确的设计思想、创新思维，培养学生的创新意识、创新精神和创新能力及综合运用知识的能力。
default.en: This course is an important practical teaching link that is matched with the theoretical courses of "Mechanical Principles" and "Mechanical Design". It is a comprehensive application and sublimation of the content taught in the theoretical courses. In the teaching process, it is necessary to comprehensively apply the relevant knowledge and skills learned in the prerequisite courses, provide basic training for mechanical engineering technicians, and lay a foundation for students to further learn relevant professional courses and engage in mechanical design work in the future. It plays an important role in cultivating students' comprehensive mechanical system design ability and ability to solve complex mechanical engineering problems. As an important practical part of cultivating students' mechanical design ability, this course starts from the whole machine and emphasizes system thinking. Taking the example of a stepper workpiece conveyor (or other mechanical systems), it designs and selects the overall mechanical system scheme, completes design calculations and structural design. To comprehensively cultivate students' abilities in design, calculation, drawing (two-dimensional and three-dimensional diagrams, optional), and chart lookup, with a focus on cultivating their correct design thinking and innovative thinking, as well as their innovative consciousness, spirit, and ability to apply knowledge comprehensively.

default.zh: “机械基础创新实验”是“设计与制造（2）”课程后的一个综合创新型实验，从系统的角度出发，从机构、结构到整机完成一个完整的训练过程。包括：机构的创新设计综合实验、PPCNC综合实验、机械运动方案设计综合训练、实物制作四个实验项目。本课程重视学生知识、能力、素质三方面的培养，培养学生理论联系实际的能力和动手操作能力、机械系统运动方案设计能力及机构设计的创新意识和能力。使学生了解机械在实际工程领域中的作用，树立正确的人生职业观，培养学生的创新能力，发扬工匠精神，满足时代的需求。采用讲课、实践、讨论、线上学习等多种形式进行，围绕机械系统运动方案的主题，设计从易到难，从简入繁，从机构、零部件到系统，从借鉴到创新。实验项目贯穿了认识、组装、设计、调试、创新设计、加工制作、安装调试、总结提升的过程，强调“做中学”“学中做”“做中创”的教学思路。介绍机构综合、创新方法、创新大赛，提升创新兴趣和创新能力。把三维设计、数字加工、增材制造引入课堂，使学生进一步明确设计、制造、组装调试的相互关系。学习Solidworks、MasterCAM、cura等软件的使用，熟悉个人数控机床的使用、FDM打印机的使用。
default.en: The " Innovative Experiments for Mechanical Fundamentals " is a comprehensive innovative experiments following the course "Design and Manufacturing (2)". From a systematic perspective, it contains a complete training process from mechanism, structure to the entire machine. This course includes four experimental projects: comprehensive experiment on innovative mechanism design, PPCNC comprehensive experiment, comprehensive training on mechanical kinematic scheme design, and physical production. This course emphasizes the cultivation of students' knowledge, abilities, and qualities, cultivating their ability to integrate theory with practice, hands-on operation, mechanical system kinematic scheme design, and innovative awareness and ability in mechanism design. It enables students to understand the role of machinery in the practical engineering field, establish a correct outlook on life and career, cultivate students' innovation ability, promote the spirit of craftsmanship, and meet the needs of the times. Adopting various forms such as lectures, practice, discussions and online learning, the design revolves around the theme of mechanical system kinematic schemes from easy to difficult, from simple to complex, from mechanisms, components and parts to the entire machine, and from borrowing to innovation. The experimental projects run through the process of understanding, assembly, design, commissioning, innovative design, processing and manufacturing, summary and improvement, emphasizing the teaching ideas of "learning by doing", "doing by learning", and "creating by doing". This course introduces mechanisms synthesis, innovative methods, and relative competitions to enhance innovative interest and ability. This course also Introduces 3D design, numerical control machining, and additive manufacturing into the classroom, enabling students to further clarify the interrelationships between design, manufacturing, assembly, and commissioning. Learn the use of Solidworks, MasterCAM, Cura and other softwares, and be familiar with the use of personal CNC machine tools and FDM printers.

default.zh: 机械工程材料是人类生产和社会发展的重要物质基础，是推动科技进步的重要力量。面向创新人才培养需求，课程内容力求具有高度实用性及与其他专业课程的契合度，注重社会发展、国家战略需求，在夯实基本理论的同时，融入行业最新技术、聚焦学术前沿，以材料的成分、组织、结构、性能、工艺、应用为主线，系统阐述金属材料、陶瓷材料、高分子材料和复合材料的基本原理、基本知识和工程应用三个层次的内容，与其他专业类课程共同构建完整的知识体系。课程主要内容包括：金属材料学基础、非金属材料学基础、工程材料的力学性能、材料热处理、材料表面工程技术、材料选择。
default.en: Mechanical engineering materials is important material basis for human production and social development, and important force to promote scientific and technological progress. For the training of innovative talents, the course content strives to be highly practical and fit with other professional courses, pays attention to social development and national strategic needs, and integrates the latest technology in the industry and focuses on the academic frontier while consolidating basic theories. The main line is the composition, organization, structure, performance, process and application of materials. It systematically expounds the basic principles, basic knowledge and engineering application of metal materials, ceramic materials, polymer materials and composite materials, and builds a complete knowledge system together with other professional courses. The contents include: basis of metal material science, basis of non-metallic materials, mechanical properties of engineering materials, material heat treatment, surface engineering technology and material selection.

default.zh: “设计与制造（3）”面向未来技术学院机械设计制造及其自动化专业本科生开课，是机械工程类专业平台课中最重要的课程之一。通过本课程的学习，培养学生主动思考和深入探究的学习态度，扎实掌握未来从事机械专业所必备的基础知识，有效提升学生的综合工程素质，以及解决工程实际问题的能力，为后续课程的学习和今后可能从事的工作奠定坚实基础。 本课程根据专业的发展主要讲授必备的专业基础知识点，包括机械制造过程的基础知识、金属切削与磨削原理、金属切削刀具与数控刀具基础、机床夹具设计原理、机械加工质量的影响因素分析及其控制、机械加工工艺规程设计、机器的装配工艺等。本课程包括课堂授课、翻转课堂、课后大作业等环节，最终成绩采用累加式，包括在线讨论、课堂任务（3项）、课外虚仿实践（1项）、大作业（1个）和期末考试，总成绩以百分计，满分100分。
default.en: The “Design and Manufacturing (3)” is one of the most important courses of the mechanical engineering class platform for the undergraduate students in School of Future Technology majoring in mechanical design, manufacturing & automation. It can cultivate the students’ initiative thinking sense and the in-depth learning attitude, equip students with the professional knowledge necessary for the mechanical career they may pursue in the future, effectively improve the comprehensive engineering quality of students and their ability to solve the practical problems, and lay the foundation for the follow-up courses the students will learn as well as their potential future work. The “Design and Manufacturing (3)” course addresses the necessary professional knowledge on the basis of the development of the manufacturing technology, involving the fundamentals of machining processes, the principle of metal-cutting and grinding technology, the fundamentals of metal-cutting tools and numerical control tools, the design principle of machine tool clamp, the analysis of factors influencing the machining quality and the control approaches, the design of machining process planning, the assembly technology of machine, etc. This course includes classroom lectures, flipped classroom, homework, and so on. The final academic record will be accumulated by all the involved links, including online discussion, three types of classroom tasks, one extracurricular virtual simulation practice, one big project and the final examination, with the total score in percent out of 100 points.

default.zh: 智能制造是当前制造技术的核心发展方向，智能制造是实施《中国制造2025》的核心科技。本门课程介绍机械制造基础知识、数控加工与编程、计算机辅助工艺设计、计算机辅助质量控制等内容。通过本课程的学习，全面的了解制造技术的发展过程，深刻理解我国智能制造发展的技术路径。
default.en: Intelligent manufacturing is the core development direction of current manufacturing technology, and it is the core technology for implementing "Made in China 2025". This course introduces basic knowledge of mechanical manufacturing, CNC machining and programming, computer-aided process design, computer-aided quality control, and other contents. Through the study of this course, we will have a comprehensive understanding of the development process of manufacturing technology and a profound understanding of the technological path of intelligent manufacturing development in China.

default.zh: 目前从学术研究到工程应用，机器人引起了学界和工业界越来越多的关注与兴趣。机器人技术是一门高度交叉的前沿技术，它集机械工程、计算机科学、控制理论与控制工程、电子工程、传感技术、人工智能、仿生学、社会学等诸学科知识之大成，是一项综合性很强的新技术。本课程主要介绍机器人技术的基本理论与工程实际应用，使学生对机器人技术有一个全面、深入的认识。本课程选取了机器人技术中最经典的几个主题（机器人系统、运动学、运动规划等）进行理论学习，并分别介绍机器人技术在航天、工业、特种环境的应用实例，开拓学生视野的同时培养学生创新意识，提高分析、发现、研究和解决问题的能力。
default.en: Currently, from academic research to engineering applications, robots have attracted increasing attention and interest from both academia and industry. Robotics technology is a highly interdisciplinary cutting-edge technology that integrates knowledge from various disciplines such as mechanical engineering, computer science, control theory and control engineering, electronic engineering, sensing technology, artificial intelligence, bionics, sociology, etc. It is a highly comprehensive new technology. This course mainly introduces the basic theory and practical engineering applications of robotics technology, enabling students to have a comprehensive and in-depth understanding of robotics technology. This course selects several classic topics in robotics technology (robot systems, kinematics, motion planning, etc.) for theoretical learning, and introduces the application examples of robotics technology in aerospace, industry, and special environments, expanding students' horizons while cultivating their innovation awareness and improving their ability to analyze, discover, research, and solve problems.

default.zh: “人工智能及其应用”是一门面向大学生开设的导论性课程。随着科技的飞速发展，人工智能（Artificial Intelligence，简称AI）已经成为当今时代最热门、最具潜力的技术领域之一。本课程旨在帮助学生掌握人工智能的基本原理、技术和方法，了解其在不同领域中的应用现状和前景，为未来的学习和工作打下坚实的基础。 课程内容涵盖了人工智能的多个核心领域，包括知识的表示、确定性推理、不确定性推理、搜索求解策略、机器学习、神经网络、自然语言处理等。通过学习，学生可以了解人工智能的基本概念和发展历程，掌握常用的算法和技术，理解其在实际应用中的工作原理。同时，课程还注重培养学生的实践能力和创新思维，通过案例分析、项目实践等方式，让学生亲身体验人工智能技术的魅力和挑战。 通过本课程的学习，学生将全面掌握人工智能的基本原理和技术，了解其在各个领域中的应用现状和前景，为未来的学习和工作奠定坚实的基础。
default.en: "Artificial Intelligence and Its Applications" is an introductory course designed for university students. With the rapid development of technology, artificial intelligence (AI) has become one of the hottest and most promising technical fields of our time. This course aims to help students grasp the basic principles, techniques, and methodologies of AI, understand its current application status and future prospects in different fields, and lay a solid foundation for their future studies and careers. The course content covers multiple core areas of AI, including machine learning, neural networks, data mining, natural language processing, etc. Through learning, students can understand the basic concepts and development history of AI, master commonly used algorithms and techniques, and comprehend their working principles in practical applications. At the same time, the course focuses on cultivating students' practical abilities and innovative thinking, allowing them to experience the charm and challenges of AI technology through case analysis, project practice, and other methods. Through this course, students will comprehensively grasp the basic principles and techniques of AI, understand its current application status and future prospects in various fields, and lay a solid foundation for their future studies and careers.

default.zh: 机械原理课程是高等院校中机械类专业一门主干课程，该课程对培养学生机械系统的分析、设计能力，解决复杂机械工程问题的能力方面具有重要地位。 机械原理课程主要讲授以下内容：机构的组成原理；机构运动简图的绘制；机构运动分析的原理与方法；机构力分析的原理与方法；连杆机构的功能及设计原理、设计方法；凸轮机构的功能与设计方法；齿轮机构的传动原理与设计方法；齿轮传动系统的分析与设计；间歇机构的工作原理与设计方法；机械系统动力学分析方法；刚性转子静平衡、动平衡的原理与试验方法；机械系统运动方案设计方法。 通过机械原理课程的课堂教学、机械基础实验、大作业及课外习题辅导等环节，培养学生利用机械设计基础理论和机械设计方法来解决复杂机械工程问题的能力、增强创新意识，培养学生的钻研精神、科学素养和社会责任感。
default.en: Machinery theory course is a main course in mechanical major in higher college. The course plays an important role in the cultivating of students' ability to analyze and design mechanical system, and the ability to solve complex mechanical engineering problems. The machinery theory A course mainly teaches the following contents: the composition principle of the mechanism; drawing the mechanical motion diagram; the principle and method of mechanism kinematic analysis; the principle and method of mechanism force analysis; the function, design principle and design method of linkage mechanism; the function and design method of cam mechanism; the drive principle and design method of gear mechanism; the analysis and design of the gear transmission system; the working principle and design method of intermittent mechanism; the dynamics analysis method of mechanical system; the static balance and dynamic balance principle and test method of rigid rotor; the kinetic scheme design of mechanical system. The machinery theory A course focuses on cultivating the students’ innovation sense and ability of using mechanical design theories and methods to solve complex mechanical enginnering problems through classroom teaching, experiments, curriculum design and other aspects.

default.zh: 产品设计工程是产品设计专业本科教学的专业核心课程之一，课程从设计的工程实现的角度思考，对产品设计专业相关的工程基础包括工程力学基础、材料与加工工艺、电工电路、先进能源、机械原理、机械设计基础、工艺装备等方面知识及其应用进行了全面系统的讲解，使学生更好地理解设计和产品实现的工程基础。该课程是强化产品设计与工业技术接轨的关键，拓展源自工程技术的设计思维，增强学生的综合设计素质及解决复杂设计问题的能力，使艺术和技术融合于产品而实现。 该课程分两个单元讲授，第一个单元主要讲授工程力学基础、材料与加工工艺、电工电路、先进能源等方面知识及其应用，第二个单元主要讲授机械原理、机械设计基础、工艺装备等方面知识及其应用。本课程为第一个单元，系统地归纳了有关设计实现的诸多力学及其结构、材料及其成型等方面的工程基础知识，作为产品设计基于工程技术的跨学科课程，注重启发性和代表性。在构建完整的产品设计相关的工程技术知识体系外，增加了工程技术应用和创新方面的优秀案例，提高学生对产品设计工程基础知识学习的兴趣。
default.en: Engineering for Product Design is one of the core courses in undergraduate teaching of Product Design major. The course considers the engineering implementation of design and provides a comprehensive and systematic explanation of the engineering foundations related to Product Design major, including engineering mechanics, materials and processing technology, electrical circuits, advanced energy, mechanical principles, mechanical design fundamentals, and process equipment, as well as their applications. This helps students better understand the engineering foundations of design and product implementation. This course is the key to strengthening the integration of product design with industrial technology, expanding design thinking derived from engineering technology, enhancing students' comprehensive design quality and ability to solve complex design problems, and integrating art and technology into products. This course is taught in two units. The first unit mainly covers the basics of engineering mechanics, materials and processing technology, electrical circuits, advanced energy, and their applications. The second unit mainly covers mechanical principles, mechanical design fundamentals, process equipment, and their applications. This course unit systematically summarizes various engineering fundamentals related to design implementation, including mechanics and mechanical structures, materials and their forming. As an interdisciplinary course based on engineering technology for product design, it emphasizes inspiration and representativeness. In addition to building a complete engineering and technical knowledge system related to product design, excellent cases of engineering technology application and innovation have been added to enhance students' interest in learning the basic knowledge of product design engineering.

default.zh: 产品设计工程是产品设计专业本科教学的专业核心课程之一，课程从设计的工程实现的角度思考，对产品设计专业相关的工程基础包括工程力学基础、材料与加工工艺、电工电路、先进能源、机械原理、机械设计基础、工艺装备等方面知识及其应用进行了全面系统的讲解，使学生更好地理解设计和产品实现的工程基础。该课程是强化产品设计与工业技术接轨的关键，拓展源自工程技术的设计思维，增强学生的综合设计素质及解决复杂设计问题的能力，使艺术和技术融合于产品而实现。 该课程分两个单元讲授，第一个单元主要讲授工程力学基础、材料与加工工艺、电工电路、先进能源等方面知识及其应用，第二个单元主要讲授机械原理、机械设计基础、工艺装备等方面知识及其应用。本课程为第二个单元，归纳了有关设计实现的诸多结构设计和生产方面的工程基础知识，作为产品设计基于工程技术的跨学科课程，注重启发性和代表性。在构建完整的产品设计相关的工程技术知识体系外，增加了教学和科研过程中的诸多优秀案例，特别是工程技术应用和创新方面的优秀作品，提高学生对产品设计工程基础知识学习的兴趣。
default.en: Engineering for Product Design is one of the core courses in undergraduate teaching of Product Design major. The course considers the engineering implementation of design and provides a comprehensive and systematic explanation of the engineering foundations related to Product Design major, including engineering mechanics, materials and processing technology, electrical circuits, advanced energy, mechanical principles, mechanical design fundamentals, and process equipment, as well as their applications. This helps students better understand the engineering foundations of design and product implementation. This course is the key to strengthening the integration of product design with industrial technology, expanding design thinking derived from engineering technology, enhancing students' comprehensive design quality and ability to solve complex design problems, and integrating art and technology into products. This course is taught in two units. The first unit mainly covers the basics of engineering mechanics, materials and processing technology, electrical circuits, advanced energy, and their applications. The second unit mainly covers mechanical principles, mechanical design fundamentals, process equipment, and their applications. This course unit summarizes various engineering fundamentals related to structural design and production in design implementation. As an interdisciplinary course based on engineering technology for product design, it emphasizes inspiration and representativeness. In addition to building a complete engineering and technical knowledge system related to product design, many excellent cases from teaching and research processes have been added, especially outstanding works in engineering technology application and innovation, to enhance students' interest in learning the basic knowledge of product design engineering.

default.zh: 《运筹学》是工业工程本科专业的一门专业基础课，主要介绍一些优化分析方法和实用运筹学模型，为后续课程奠定数量分析的基础理论方法。本课程主要内容包括：线性规划原理及方法；对偶理论；运输问题；整数规划及0-1规划；目标规划；图与网络分析；动态规划，涵盖运筹学的主要分支。 本课程面向工业工程专业本科生，以讲授模型分析方法为主。通过本课程的学习，使学生能够掌握运筹学的一些主要理论和方法，培养学生能运用模型来研究解决工业过程中实际问题的能力；通过原理介绍、算法讲解、案例分析等，使学生建立起整体优化的观念和系统分析的能力；通过介绍基本的实用软件（如LINDO、EXCEL等）的使用方法，使学生具备会运用软件工具对各类运筹学模型进行求解和结果分析的能力，力争做到学以致用。同时，为后续工业工程其他课程的学习奠定基础。
default.en: “Operations Research” is a fundamental course for the students major in Industrial Engineering, which is designed to introduce basic methods of optimization analysis and practical models to the students. It facilitates the students to lay a good theoretical foundation of quantitative analysis for the successive courses. The course covers the main branches of operations research, such as linear programming principle and method, dual theory, transportation problem, integer programming and 0-1 programming, goal programming, graph and network analysis, dynamic programming, etc. This course is oriented to the undergraduate students in Industrial Engineering by means of analyzing models mainly. Through the study of this course, the students are aimed to master some primary theories and methods of operations research and are taught to apply them to solve the practical problems in industrial processes. It also enables the students to understand the concept of global optimization and the capability of systematical analysis via the introduction of the principles and the explanation of algorithms as well as the case study. And some practical software such as LINDO and EXCEL are also inducted to provide the students with tools for model solution and result analysis, which help them to learn for application. This course will lay a foundation for students to learn the other courses of industrial engineering.

default.zh: 《基础工业工程》是教育部管理科学与工程学科教学指导委员会规定的工业工程专业的一门主干课程，也是工业工程专业本科学生专业课程培养的首要课程。课程目标是： 1．树立不断改进的“工业工程意识”，掌握工作研究与现场管理的基本理论、基本知识和基本技能，具有对生产系统与服务系统进行设计、改善和实施的能力，并能够应用工业工程的基本原理，对生产系统与服务系统进行科学预测和评价； 2．具有综合运用数学、物理和社会科学方面的专门知识和技术，结合工程分析和设计的原理与方法，帮助生产系统与服务系统的上下各级管理人员在业务运作的设想、计划、实施、控制方法等方面开展研究的能力，以期达到更有效地利用人力、物料和经济资源，保证人员、物料、设备、能源和信息构成的集成系统的有效运行。 本课程主要讲授工业工程的基本概念、方法研究（包含程序分析、作业分析与动作分析）与作业测定（包含秒表时间研究、工作抽样、预定动作时间标准法、标准资料法等）的经典内容、现场管理方法以及工业工程的发展趋势。 本课程采用累加式计分方法按照百分制进行考核：平时成绩占10分；2次大作业占30分；期末考试占60分。
default.en: “Fundament of Industrial Engineering” is a core course for Industry Engineering (IE) specialty stipulated by the teaching guiding committee of management science and engineering discipline of the Ministry of Education. This course is also the first course for IE undergraduate. The objectives of this course include the following three aspects: (1) To establish the Industrial engineering consciousness of “Continuous Improvement”, to master the basic knowledge of work study and worksite management, and be able to forecast and evaluate the production system and the service system. (2) To possess the ability to carry out research on the planning, implementation and control methods of business operation of the management personnel of the production system and the service system, so as to effectively utilize manpower, materials and economic resources, ensure the efficient operation of the production system and the service system. This course mainly teaches the basic concepts of industrial engineering, the classic content of the method study (including program analysis, operation analysis and motion analysis), operation measurement method (including time study by stopwatch, work sampling, Predetermined time System, standard data, etc.), the worksite management method, and the development trend of industrial engineering. In this course, the cumulative scoring method is adopted: quiz for 10 points; the two major projects account for 30 points; the final exam account for 60 points.

default.zh: 财务管理学是一门以提高经济效益为目的、以运筹资金为对象，阐明财务管理的基本理论和基本方法的应用型经济管理学科。教学以企业资金运动为中心内容，以资金的筹集、投资、资金营运、收入分配为框架，讲授财务管理的基本概念、管理原则、管理制度等理论问题，使学生掌握预测、决策、计划、控制、分析等业务方法。 通过学习财务管理学，明确财务管理的含义、目标和特点，认识做好财务管理工作对于提高企业经济效益的重要意义；理解财务管理的基本内容，各种财务活动的联系以及财务活动同其他各种经济活动的联系；掌握财务管理的各种业务方法，学会运用财务管理的知识和技能为经营战略和经营决策服务。通过本课程的学习掌握现代财务管理的基本理论，基本方法和基本技能，将为学生毕业后从事企业、事业等单位的经济管理工作奠定良好的知识基础，具备从事经济管理工作所必需的财务管理业务知识和工作能力。
default.en: Financial management aims to improve economic benefits, and takes planning and management fund as the object. The course expounds fundamental financial control theory and methods of applicability economic management discipline. The teaching focuses on the movement of enterprise funds, and takes the fund raising, investment, consumption, income and distribution as framework. It expounds the basic concepts, management principles, management system and other theoretical issues of financial management, so that students can master the business methods of prediction, decision-making, planning, control and analysis. By studying financial management, the students can understand the meaning, the goal and the characteristics, and know the importance being ready for financial management working to improving the enterprise economic effect. It helps to understand fundamental financial management contents, the connection of various financing activities and the connection of financing activities with other various economic activity; master the methods of financial management, and learn to serve the economic strategy and decision making by using the financial management knowledge and skills. It will lay a good foundation for students to engage in financial management or other economic management work in enterprises, institutions and other units after graduation, and have the necessary financial management knowledge and working ability to engage in economic management work.

default.zh: 本课程是机械设计制造及其自动化专业本科生必修的基础课。学生通过学习机械信号分析方法、测量装置基本特性等掌握机械量测量的仪器选用原则；通过学习传感器原理及其应用、调理电路原理及测试系统设计等，掌握测试技术的基本技能；通过基础和合实验，提升自身动手能力及创新能力。通过对课程内容的学习，使学生掌握机械工程测试技术的基本概念、基本理论和基本方法；了解测试技术在机械工程领域的应用及发展方向；为培养工程技术研究人员打下坚实的理论基础。同时，本课程结合实验教学，培养学生的实际动手能力以及分析问题和解决问题的能力。
default.en: This course is a compulsory basic course for undergraduate students majoring in Mechanical Design, Manufacturing and Automation. Students can master the principles of instrument selection for mechanical quantity measurement by studying mechanical signal analysis methods, basic characteristics of measuring devices, etc; By learning the principles and applications of sensors, adjusting circuit principles, and designing testing systems, one can master the basic skills of testing technology; Through basic and collaborative experiments, enhance one's hands-on and innovative abilities. By studying the course content, students will master the basic concepts, theories, and methods of mechanical engineering testing technology; Understand the application and development direction of testing technology in the field of mechanical engineering; To lay a solid theoretical foundation for cultivating engineering and technical researchers. At the same time, this course combines experimental teaching to cultivate students' practical hands-on abilities as well as their ability to analyze and solve problems.

default.zh: 本课程是机械设计制造及其自动化专业本科生必修的基础课。学生通过学习机械信号分析方法、测量装置基本特性等掌握机械量测量的仪器选用原则；通过学习传感器原理及其应用、调理电路原理及测试系统设计等，掌握测试技术的基本技能；通过基础和合实验，提升自身动手能力及创新能力。通过对课程内容的学习，使学生掌握机械工程测试技术的基本概念、基本理论和基本方法；了解测试技术在机械工程领域的应用及发展方向；为培养工程技术研究人员打下坚实的理论基础。同时，本课程结合实验教学，培养学生的实际动手能力以及分析问题和解决问题的能力。
default.en: This course is a compulsory basic course for undergraduate students majoring in Mechanical Design, Manufacturing and Automation. Students can master the principles of instrument selection for mechanical quantity measurement by studying mechanical signal analysis methods, basic characteristics of measuring devices, etc; By learning the principles and applications of sensors, adjusting circuit principles, and designing testing systems, one can master the basic skills of testing technology; Through basic and collaborative experiments, enhance one's hands-on and innovative abilities. By studying the course content, students will master the basic concepts, theories, and methods of mechanical engineering testing technology; Understand the application and development direction of testing technology in the field of mechanical engineering; To lay a solid theoretical foundation for cultivating engineering and technical researchers. At the same time, this course combines experimental teaching to cultivate students' practical hands-on abilities as well as their ability to analyze and solve problems.

default.zh: 先进的设计方法是实现智能制造的基础。本课程着重讲述系统分析设计方法、创造性设计方法、可靠性设计、有限元法、优化设计方法等系列设计方法。课程讲授中，力求理论与实际结合，融合典型科研工程实例，使得学生能够开阔视野、了解新产品的开发过程和初步掌握产品开发中的创新思维和方法，以适应科学技术发展的要求。同时，在课堂讲授过程中适当增加以英语教学为手段的双语教学内容，锻炼学生利用专业外语了解学科发展前沿、掌握现代机械设计理论与应用的重要能力。
default.en: Advanced design method is the basement for the implementation of intelligent manufacturing. This course includes systematic analysis method, creation design, reliability design, finite element method, optimal design technique etc. The lecture can focus on the combination between theory and practice, involving the research application of design theory. The content in the course tries to broaden the vision of student, understand the process of product development and master the technique of creation design to meet the requirement of Science & Technology. Meanwhile, it introduces the state-of-the-art of modern design method with the tool of English lecture. The course can practise the ability of student to understand the current development of mechanical discipline and master the modern design theory and application for mechanical product.

default.zh: 本课程主要讲授生产系统智能化管理的基本原理、基本理论、基本方法和实际应用的相关内容，包括生产管理的基本概念和重要意义，生产设施选址与布局优化，库存控制，生产作业计划；还包括生产系统建模方法概述，活动循环图法，排队系统模型，库存系统模型，加工系统模型，系统建模与仿真输入分析和结果分析的基本方法，生产系统仿真软件应用实例等。
default.en: The course focus on the basic principle and theory , the basic method and practical application about Intelligent Management of production system. It contains the basic concepts and significance, the general steps of production management, Site selection and layout optimization of production facilities, Inventory control, Production job planning. It also contains the overview about production system modeling methods, the movable cycle graph, queuing system model, waiting line system model, inventory system model, manufacturing system model. It includes the basic method about input analysis and result analysis of Modeling and Simulation, simulation software system and the application examples about production system simulation software.

default.zh: 空间技术概论主要包括空间环境工程学和航天技术两大部分，是飞行器制造专业必修的专业课之一，是从事空间技术方面的科研、生产、管理等工作不可缺少的专业课程。 空间环境工程学部分主要讲授空间环境对航天器的影响、空间环境的模拟方法与试验技术、空间环境的利用等。内容包括真空、磁场、微重力、空间碎片与微流星体、原子氧、等离子体、空间辐射、月球等空间环境对航天器的影响及其模拟技术，内容涉及地球近地轨道、行星表面、太阳系等不同空间范围，课程所覆盖的知识面广，是一门多学科交叉的宇航专业课程。通过本课程的学习能够使学生深入了解和掌握空间环境的分类、效应、模拟方法、试验测试技术等知识点，培养学生在航天器与空间环境相互作用方面的综合分析问题和解决问题的能力，为将来从事航天器设计、控制、试验、科研开发等工作奠定理论与技术基础。 航天技术部分主要讲授国内外航天器基本概念和原理结构等，内容包括航天技术综述、航天技术的发展概况、航天器运行轨道、人造卫星、有效载荷与卫星应用、载人航天、月球与行星探测等，课程覆盖内容广、涉及技术深，是一门多学科交叉的宇航专业课程。通过本课程的学习，能够使学生掌握有关航天器的基本概念、系统组成及工作原理，了解空间技术的发展状况和趋势等知识点，为将来从事航天器设计、控制、试验、科研开发等工作奠定理论与技术基础。
default.en: The Introduction of Space Technology mainly includes two major parts: space environmental engineering and aerospace technology. It is one of the required professional courses for aircraft manufacturing specialty and an indispensable professional course for scientific research, production, management and other work in space technology. The space environment engineering part mainly teaches the impact of space environment on spacecraft, simulation methods and test technologies of space environment, and utilization of space environment. The content includes vacuum, magnetic field, microgravity, space debris and micrometeoroids, atomic oxygen, plasma, space radiation, moon and other space environment impacts on spacecraft and its simulation technology. The content involves the Earth's near-Earth orbit, planetary surface, solar system and other different space ranges. The course covers a wide range of knowledge and is a multidisciplinary aerospace professional course. Through the study of this course, students can deeply understand and master the classification, effect, simulation method, test and test technology and other knowledge points of space environment, cultivate students' ability to comprehensively analyze and solve problems in the interaction between spacecraft and space environment, and lay a theoretical and technical foundation for future work in spacecraft design, control, test, scientific research and development. The aerospace technology part mainly teaches the basic concepts, principles and structures of domestic and foreign spacecraft, including the overview of aerospace technology, the development of aerospace technology, spacecraft operation orbit, artificial satellites, payloads and satellite applications, manned spaceflight, lunar and planetary exploration, etc. The course covers a wide range of contents and involves deep technology, and is a multidisciplinary aerospace professional course. Through the study of this course, students can master the basic concept, system composition and working principle of spacecraft, understand the development status and trend of space technology and other knowledge points, and lay a theoretical and technical foundation for future work in spacecraft design, control, test, scientific research and development.

default.zh: 《飞行器制造工程专题》课程讲授的目的是通过对专业性质、专业特点、专业内涵、专业研究方向等方面的深入分析与讲解，使学生深入了解专业的内涵，同时使学生了解本专业科学与技术研究的范畴和目前本专业重点科研方向和科研成果，从而能够更进一步地体会到本专业在国家建设与发展进程中所起到的重要作用，使学生进一步明确学习目，提高学生的学习动力和学习兴趣，增加创新意识，支撑专业学习成果中相应指标点的达成。本课程在飞行器制造工程专业的教学计划中占有重要的地位和作用，是一门重要的必修课程。
default.en: The purpose of the course "Aircraft Manufacture Engineering Introduction" is to deeply analyze and explain the characteristics, connotations, and research directions of the profession, so that students can have a deep understanding of the connotation of the profession. At the same time, students can understand the scope of scientific and technological research in their profession, as well as the current key research directions and achievements of their profession, In this way, students can further appreciate the important role that their major plays in the process of national construction and development, clarify their learning objectives, improve their learning motivation and interest, increase their innovation awareness, and support the achievement of corresponding indicators in the professional learning outcomes. This course occupies an important position and role in the teaching plan of aircraft manufacturing engineering, and is an important compulsory course.

default.zh: 随着我国工程技术水平的提升，机械、电气、控制等学科交叉融合越来越普遍，对工程师要求更严格。国家经济发展和技术创新背景下，工科大学生需要具备专业知识和技能，提高跨学科整合能力，培养创新意识和创新能力，满足产业发展需求。 《机电系统动力学》是专业基础课程，讲授机电系统动力学基础理论、建模和分析方法，以及典型机电系统的动力学问题。教学目标是理解机电系统动力学原理，学习和掌握动态特性和响应规律。学生将建立对机电系统动力学的全面认知，将实际问题抽象为数学模型，具备分析和解决实际工程问题的能力。课程还介绍机电系统动力学领域的新理论、新技术和新知识。 课程目标包括了解和掌握机电系统动力学的基本理论、知识和技能，掌握解决复杂机电工程问题所需的机械基础知识，了解机电系统动力学的发展趋向。学生将学习动力学建模和分析方法，应用基本原理解决问题；对复杂问题，选择使用工程工具和信息技术工具进行模拟、预测和分析。培养学生了解机械、电气、控制等领域，解决机械振动、动力学响应和控制问题的能力，应用知识于机电系统的设计、分析和优化。 教学方法包括课堂授课、课外辅导和大作业等环节。采用小班教学，倡导启发式教学和混合教学方法。精选教学内容，采用案例教学、多媒体资料和工程实例等多种形式，鼓励小组讨论和解决方案提出，培养团队协作和创新思维。 《机电系统动力学》课程旨在培养学生综合能力，提供基础知识和技能，适应工程领域的发展趋势。通过学习，学生将全面了解机电系统动力学，并初步具备分析和解决实际工程问题的能力。
default.en: With the advancement of our country's engineering and technological standards, there is an increasing trend towards interdisciplinary integration of fields such as mechanical, electrical, and control, demanding engineers to meet higher standards. Against the backdrop of national economic development and technological innovation, engineering students must acquire professional knowledge and skills, enhance their ability to integrate interdisciplinary concepts, develop innovative awareness and aptitude, and meet the demands of industrial progress. The course "Mechatronics System Dynamics" lays the foundation by imparting the fundamental principles, modeling techniques, and analysis methods in the domain of mechatronics system dynamics, along with addressing dynamic issues unique to mechatronics systems. The main objective is to foster an understanding of the principles behind mechatronics system dynamics and enable students to apprehend and apply dynamic characteristics and response patterns. This course equips students with a comprehensive comprehension of mechatronics system dynamics, the ability to abstract practical problems into mathematical models, and the competence to analyze and solve practical engineering problems. Additionally, the course introduces novel theories, technologies, and knowledge relevant to the field of mechatronics system dynamics. The objectives of the course encompass grasping a firm understanding of the basic principles, knowledge, and skills of mechatronics system dynamics, acquiring the mechanical foundation required to solve intricate mechatronics engineering problems, and assimilating insights into the development trends of mechatronics system dynamics. In this course, students will learn modeling and analysis techniques, and employ fundamental principles to problem-solving. For complex problems, students will select appropriate engineering and information technology tools for simulation, prediction, and analysis. It promotes students' ability to comprehend various domains like mechanical, electrical, and control, and resolve issues pertaining to mechanical vibration, dynamic response, and control, while utilizing their knowledge for the design, analysis, and optimization of mechatronic systems. The teaching methodologies encompass classroom teaching, extracurricular tutoring and large assignments. Adopting small class teaching, encouraging heuristic teaching methods and blended learning. The course content is meticulously curated, making use of case studies, multimedia resources, and engineering examples, stimulating group discussions and encouraging collaborative proposals of solutions, thereby cultivating teamwork and fostering innovative thinking. The course "Mechatronics System Dynamics" aims to nurture students' comprehensive abilities, impart essential knowledge and skills, and enable them to adapt to the emerging trends within the engineering domain. Through this course, students will develop a holistic understanding of mechatronics system dynamics and gain initial proficiency in the analysis and resolution of real-world engineering problems.

default.zh: 传感与测试技术是机械电子工程专业本科生必需掌握的一门专业基础课，是学生们后续专业课程的基础之一。课程主要讲授传感与测试技术的基本概念，典型传感器（电阻式传感器、电容式传感器、电感式传感器、压电式传感器、磁电式传感器、光传感器、温度传感器）的工作原理、结构、特性和应用案例，信号调理和抗干扰技术。本课程可以使学生掌握传感与测试技术的基础知识和使用方法，对机械领域中出现的测量问题有明确认识和解决思路，培养学生利用所学知识在相关技术领域从事科研和开发工作的能力。
default.en: Transducer and Measurement Technology is one of the must be mastered specialty basic courses to the students of Mechanical electronic engineering, which is a knowledge foundation of the letter specialty lessons. In this course, basic concepts and general properties working principle, basic structure, running characteristics and application of commonly used transducers such as resistance transducer, capacity transducer, inductance transducer, piezoelectricity transducer, magnetism electricity transducer, photoelectricity transducer, and thermology transducer are introduced. In addition, signal conditioning technology and anti-jamming technology are also introduced in this course. This course can enable students to master basic knowledge and application of transducer and measurement technology, have a clear understanding and solution to the measurement problem in mechanical engineering. This course can also cultivate students’ ability to do scientific research and development in related fields.

default.zh: 本门课程是机器人工程专业的专业核心课程之一，也是学生们学习后续其他专业课的基础。传感器是机器人系统的重要组成部分，机器人检测技术是机器人系统可靠、良好运行的重要技术基础。课程阐述各种典型传感器的工作原理、结构形式、一些工程设计方法和选用的基本知识，也对各种传感器检测技术进行叙述，以及学习各种传感器的应用。通过本门课程的学习，使学生了解机器人系统所应用的传感器基本原理及检测方法，使学生具备一定的机器人传感系统设计与分析能力。
default.en: This course is one of the core courses of robot engineering, which is a knowledge foundation of the latter specialty lessons. Sensor is a very important part of the robot system. Measurement technology is also an important technical basis for reliable and good operation of robot system. This course explains the working principle, structural form, some engineering design methods and the selection of the basic knowledge. Measurement techniques are also described, and the application of various sensors is studied. After learning this course, students can understand the basic principle and structural composition of the robot system. Students also have the basic ability to design a sensor system and measuring system in robot systems.

default.zh: 本门课程是机器人工程辅修专业的专业核心课程之一，也是学生们学习后续其他专业课的基础。传感器是机器人系统的重要组成部分，机器人检测技术是机器人系统可靠、良好运行的重要技术基础。课程阐述各种典型传感器的工作原理、结构形式、一些工程设计方法和选用的基本知识，也对各种传感器检测技术进行叙述，以及学习各种传感器的应用。通过本门课程的学习，使学生了解机器人系统所应用的传感器基本原理及检测方法，使学生具备一定的机器人传感系统设计与分析能力。
default.en: This course is one of the core courses of robot engineering minor, which is a knowledge foundation of the latter specialty lessons. Sensor is a very important part of the robot system. Measurement technology is also an important technical basis for reliable and good operation of robot system. This course explains the working principle, structural form, some engineering design methods and the selection of the basic knowledge. Measurement techniques are also described, and the application of various sensors is studied. After learning this course, students can understand the basic principle and structural composition of the robot system. Students also have the basic ability to design a sensor system and measuring system in robot systems.

default.zh: 《机器人学基础》课程是机器人工程专业的一门基础课程，主要讲授机器人学相关的技术内容。从机器人的产生及发展入手，系统的介绍机器人的概念及特点，讲解系统构成、分类及设计方法，精要讲述机器人运动的数学描述与计算方法、机器人运动学、静力学、动力学的数学建模方法，机器人运动轨迹规划的基本理论和方法，并介绍相关控制基础知识。结合工程仿真软件，在教学中将数学建模方法在计算机软件中得以实现，加深学生对数学建模方法理解的同时，了解机器人设计与分析中的计算机辅助建模方法。最终，让学生掌握对机器人建模与分析的相关理论体系及建模方法，奠定今后机器人研究的相关理论基础。
default.en: "Fundamentals of Robotics" is a foundation course for Robot Engineering, mainly concerned with robotics-related technical content. Starting from the development of robots, this course will systematically introduce the concept and feature, system composition, classification and design method for robots and intensively introduce kinematics, statics, dynamics, trajectory planning theory, control and methods for robot analysis and modelling. The students can also utilize the learned methods by computing software, which will deepen the students’ understanding of robot design and analysis by computer-aided modelling methods. Finally, the students should master the theoretical system for robot analysis and modelling and establish the theoretical foundation for robot research in future.

default.zh: 机器人视觉课程是一门用以培养学生从事机器人视觉应用能力的课程。课程目标是使学生了解机器人视觉技术的概念及发展历程、理解视觉技术基础、熟悉常用的视觉设备；初步掌握视觉标定、视觉测量、视觉识别等常用机器人视觉技术。通过本门课的学习，希望学生了解本领域研究现状及主要方法，掌握机器人视觉的常用方法和基本理论，培养学生机器人视觉设计过程中的应用知识的能力。本门课程是理论结合实践课程，在一定程度上将高年级本科生从专业基础知识逐步带入到机器人视觉工程应用过程。许多学习内容和相关知识与当前的机器人热点研究方向息息相关，教学内容和案例具有鲜明的时代特点，生动的演示体验和良好的互动效果。在教学过程中要综合运用先修课程中所学到的有关知识与技能，结合各种实践教学环节，进行技术人员所需的基本训练，为学生进一步学习有关专业课程和日后工作打下基础。
default.en: Robot vision course is a compulsory course for minor degree, makes students to engage in the potential applications of robotic vision. The aim of the course is to enable students to know the concept and development of robotic vision, understand some basic technologies, familiarize with common robot vision equipment and also, some preliminary and useful common skills such as visual calibration, visual measurement and recognition. Through the study of this course, students are hoped to understand the current situation and main methods in the field of robot vision, master the basic theories of robot vision, the design of robot vision. This course is a combination of theory and practice. To some extent, it gradually brings senior undergraduates from basic professional knowledge to the applications of robotic vision engineering. Many learning contents are closely related to the current hotspot research directions of robots. The teaching contents of this course have distinct characteristics of state-of-art technologies, vivid demonstration and good interactive effect. With knowledge and skills acquired in the pre-course introduced, the teaching process carries out the basic training methods combined with various practical teaching steps, so as to establish the fundamentals for students who wish to further study the relevant professional courses and work in the future.

default.zh: 随着以深度学习为代表的机器学习技术在计算机视觉、自然语言处理、大数据分析等领域得到成功应用，人工智能将引领新一轮工业革命，将大大改善和影响人类的未来生活。“人工智能基础与应用”是智能制造工程专业的核心课程，课程紧密结合智能制造的国家发展规划和行业发展需求及尖端人才培养需求，系统地介绍了人工智能的基本原理、方法和应用技术，具体内容包括绪论、Python：人工智能开发语言、数据回归预测、分类器、聚类分析、听觉智能——语音识别、视觉智能——图像识别等，是从事与人工智能相关领域工作人员所必需的专业知识，是进一步发展智能制造的技术基础。通过本课程理论联系实际的学习，使学生掌握从事人工智能技术和智能制造所必备的基础知识和应用经验，增强学生的综合工程素质及解决复杂工程问题的能力，为后续课程的学习及可能开展的科学研究和工程实践奠定坚实的理论基础。
default.en: With the successful application of machine learning technology represented by deep learning in computer vision, natural language processing, big data analysis and other fields, artificial intelligence (AI) will lead a new round of industrial revolution, and will greatly improve and affect the future life of mankind. "Fundamentals of Artificial Intelligence and its Applications" is the core course of the intelligent manufacturing engineering specialty. The course closely combines the national development planning of intelligent manufacturing, the industry development needs and the training needs of cutting-edge talents, and systematically introduces the basic principles, methods and application technologies of AI. The specific contents include introduction of AI, Python: artificial intelligence development language, data regression prediction, classifier, clustering analysis, auditory intelligence--speech recognition, visual intelligence-- image recognition, etc. is the necessary professional knowledge for workers engaged in the field related to artificial intelligence. And it is the technical basis for further development of intelligent manufacturing. Through the study of integrating theory with practice in this course, students can master the basic knowledge and application experience necessary for AI technology and intelligent manufacturing, enhance their comprehensive engineering quality and ability to solve complex engineering problems, and lay a solid theoretical foundation for the study of subsequent courses and possible scientific research and engineering practice.

default.zh: 通过8次高端人才讲座，了解机器人的总体发展现状，最新的科研成果和发展方向，使学生了解机器人方向要学习哪些内容，开阔学生专业视野，增长专业见识，明确专业学习目标，为进一步探索和深入学习专业知识做好准备。
default.en: Through 8 lectures for high-end talents, students will understand the overall development status of robots, the latest scientific research achievements and development direction, so that students can understand what content to learn in the direction of robots, broaden their professional vision, increase their professional insight, clarify their professional learning goals, and prepare for further exploration and in-depth learning of professional knowledge.

default.zh: 通过7次专家讲座和1次调研交流，进一步了解机器人技术与系统全国重点实验室的科研成果和发展方向，开阔学生专业视野，增长专业见识，明确专业学习目标，为进一步探索和深入学习专业知识做好准备。
default.en: Through 7 expert lectures and 1 survey and exchange, further understand the scientific research achievements and development direction of the National Key Laboratory of Robotics Technology and system, broaden students' professional vision, increase professional insight, clarify professional learning objectives, and prepare for further exploration and in-depth study of professional knowledge.

default.zh: 先进制造技术是集机械、电子、信息、材料、能源和管理等各项先进技术而发展起来的高新技术，它是发展国民经济的重要基础技术之一。先进制造技术是制造业为提高竞争力以适应时代的要求形成的一个高技术群，经过发展，已形成了完整的体系结构。先进制造技术是当今生产力的主要构建因素，也是国民经济不可或缺的支柱。它承担着为国民经济各个部门和科学技术领域提供装备、工具和检测仪器等关键任务，并成为国民经济和科学技术赖以生存和发展的重要手段。尤其值得注意的是，在航空、航天、微电子、光电子、激光、分子生物和核能等尖端科技领域中，没有先进制造技术作为基础将无法实现这些领域内相关科学与工程目标。因此，作为机械制造及自动化专业前沿方向之一，特别对于从事机械制造专业研究的学生而言，掌握先进制造技术内容至关重要。本课程基于航空航天和医疗保健等领域介绍先进技术的新理念和装备技术，旨在使学生熟悉国外先进制造技术前沿、开阔学生思维、拓展知识面、掌握先进技术。
default.en: Advanced manufacturing technology encompasses a comprehensive range of cutting-edge machinery, electronics, information systems, materials, energy sources, and management techniques developed through high-tech advancements. It stands as a pivotal foundational technology crucial for the advancement of national economies. This sophisticated amalgamation of technologies has been strategically adopted by the manufacturing industry to enhance its competitiveness and align with contemporary demands. Over time, it has evolved into a well-structured system that underpins industrial progress. Advanced manufacturing technology plays a pivotal role in today's productivity and serves as an indispensable pillar of the national economy. It assumes crucial responsibilities in supplying equipment, tools, and testing instruments for various sectors of the national economy, as well as science and technology domains. Moreover, it has emerged as a vital means for the survival and advancement of both the national economy and scientific research. Notably, within cutting-edge fields like aviation, aerospace, microelectronics, optoelectronics, lasers, molecular biology, and nuclear energy; advanced manufacturing technology stands as an essential foundation without which achieving relevant scientific breakthroughs or engineering milestones would be unattainable. Hence, proficiency in advanced manufacturing technology is of paramount importance for students involved in mechanical manufacturing research, as it represents a pioneering domain within the field of automation and mechanical engineering. This course will introduce the new concept and equipment technology of advanced technologies based on the fields of aerospace and health care. The aim of the course is to make students familiar with the frontier of foreign advanced manufacturing technology, broad their thinking, expand their knowledge and master advanced technology.

default.zh: 面向智能制造的三维视觉技术及其应用》是一门综合性、专业性都很强的课程，以典型项目中三维视觉应用技术为基础，培养学生对工程项目中的常见工程问题与解决方案的了解，同时加深对工程项目相关理论知识的理解并培养学生面向具体工程项目的评估及方案的能力。 教学目的：让学生能够熟练运用所学的理论知识，解决实际工程问题。通过理论知识、典型项目分析与实践，通过课程的学习，学生可以提高自己的实践能力和创新能力，为将来从事工程相关工作打下坚实的基础。 教学内容：教学内容主要包括机器视觉技术应用、机器人视觉系统、人工智能技术应用等方面。通过介绍工程项目中相关技术的应用，学生可以加深对理论知识的理解，学生需要根据实际工程项目的需求，进行机器视觉技术评估和项目方案设计；学会对智能制造中工程应用项目进行问题梳理分析、机器视觉方案选择及评估，确保技术在工程项目中的顺利应用。 考核方式：课程的评价方式主要包括实验报告、设计方案。学生需要按照要求撰写课程报告，学生需要按照实际工程项目的需求，对设计过程进行总结和分析，并设计出合理的方案，并进行方案评价和改进。
default.en: 3D Vision Technology and Application for Intelligent Manufacturing" is a comprehensive and professional course, based on the application technology of 3D vision in typical projects. This course cultivates student to deal with engineering problems in engineering projects. According to the understanding of relevant theoretical knowledge, students can evaluate and offer project solutions. Teaching objective: To enable students to proficiently apply the theoretical knowledge learned and solve practical engineering problems. Through theoretical knowledge learning, typical project analysis, and practicing, students can improve their practical and innovative abilities through course learning, laying a solid foundation for future engineering related work. Teaching content: The teaching content includes the application of machine vision technology, robot vision systems, and artificial intelligence technology. By introducing the application of relevant technologies in engineering projects, students can deepen their understanding of theoretical knowledge. They need to evaluate machine vision technology and design project plans based on the actual needs of engineering projects. Learn to sort out and analyze engineering application projects in intelligent manufacturing, select and evaluate machine vision solutions, and ensure the smooth application of technology in engineering projects. Assessment method: The evaluation method of the course mainly includes experimental reports and design plans. Students need to write course reports according to requirements. They need to summarize and analyze the design process according to the actual needs of engineering projects, design reasonable plans, and evaluate and improve the plans.

default.zh: 本课程特聘我国深空探测科学与工程领域高水平专家参与授课，以月球、火星、小天体以及太阳系边际采样探测与资源利用规划与先进案例为主线，主要讲授星球采样探测与资源利用领域国际前沿与发展态势、国内外深空探测创新案例解析、国内外科学与技术差距分析等内容。通过课程讲授、创新案例研讨等形式，向广大学生传授深空探测领域的新知识、新观点、新需求和新动向，树立为国助力情怀、拔高职业发展规划。
default.en: This course has specially invited high-level experts in the field of China's deep space exploration science and engineering to participate in teaching. It takes the planning and advanced cases of sampling exploration and resource utilization of the moon, Mars, small celestial bodies and the edge of the solar system as the main line, and mainly teaches the international frontiers and development trends in the field of planetary sampling exploration and resource utilization, and the analysis of the gap between domestic and foreign science and technology. Through course, it imparts new knowledge, new perspectives, new demands and new trends in the field of deep space exploration to students, strengthen their autonomous learning ability and elevate their career development plans.

default.zh: 讲授增材制造技术所涵盖的基本加工原理与工艺，如何正确选择制造工艺、材料、合理分析增材制造过程表面质量、面型精度、后处理工艺并提出控制方法的知识基础；掌握金属与非金属增材制造设计的基本知识；掌握激光选区熔化（SLM），直接能量沉积（DED）等立体光固化（SLA）, 熔融沉积成型(FDM)中影响加工尺寸与精度的主要因素；了解CAD三维结构设计与切片软件轨迹规划的选用原则和基本设计计算过程。分析高温合金（如Inconel 718）、钛合金（Ti6Al4V）、陶瓷基复合材料等在航空航天环境下的性能优化。通过ANSYS、COMSOL模拟熔池动态、残余应力分布，预测打印缺陷。
default.en: The course covers the fundamental processing principles and techniques involved in additive manufacturing, including how to correctly select manufacturing processes and materials, as well as the rational analysis of surface quality, dimensional accuracy, and post-processing techniques in additive manufacturing, along with proposed control methods. It also provides a foundational understanding of the basic knowledge required for designing metal and non-metal additive manufacturing. Additionally, it delves into the key factors influencing processing dimensions and accuracy in techniques such as SLM, DED, SLA, and FDM. The lecture further explains the selection principles for CAD-based 3D structural design and slicing software trajectory planning, along with the fundamental design calculation process. It analyzes the performance optimization of materials like superalloys (e.g., Inconel 718), titanium alloys (Ti6Al4V), and ceramic matrix composites in aerospace environments. Through ANSYS and COMSOL simulations, it models molten pool dynamics and residual stress distribution to predict printing defects.

default.zh: 本课程系统介绍增材制造技术的基本概念、工艺原理、材料体系及工程应用。课程内容涵盖增材制造的发展历程与技术分类，重点讲授激光粉末床熔融、电子束熔融、熔融沉积成形、立体光刻等典型工艺方法，并结合金属、聚合物、陶瓷及复合材料等材料体系，分析材料选择、工艺参数和零件性能之间的关系。课程还将围绕工艺优化、常见缺陷、后处理技术和质量控制方法展开教学，并通过航空航天、生物医疗、汽车制造和工业生产等领域的典型案例，帮助学生理解增材制造在先进制造中的应用价值。通过课堂讲授、案例分析、实践任务和小组汇报，培养学生分析和解决增材制造相关工程问题的能力。
default.en: This course provides a systematic introduction to the fundamental concepts, process principles, material systems, and engineering applications of additive manufacturing technology. The course covers the development history and classification of additive manufacturing, with emphasis on typical processes such as Laser Powder Bed Fusion, Electron Beam Melting, Fused Deposition Modeling, and Stereolithography. It also discusses metals, polymers, ceramics, and composite materials used in additive manufacturing, and analyzes the relationships among material selection, process parameters, and part performance. In addition, the course addresses process optimization, common defects, post-processing techniques, and quality control methods. Through case studies in aerospace, biomedical engineering, automotive manufacturing, and industrial production, students will understand the application value of additive manufacturing in advanced manufacturing. Lectures, case analyses, practical tasks, and group presentations will be used to develop students’ ability to analyze and solve engineering problems related to additive manufacturing.

default.zh: 数字信号与图像处理是高等工科院校中机械电子工程专业一门主干课程，课程主要时间离散信号、时间离散信号处理系统(算法)和数字图像处理算法的基本概念，主要特性，使学生掌握基本设计理论和设计方法，着重培养学生数字信号处理系统的综合分析和设计能力，数字图像基本分析，处理能力增强创新意识。 课程数字信号处理部分主要包括离散时间信号和离散时间系统的典型特性，作用机制，实现方式和典型的数字信号处理系统分析，设计方法，包括傅里叶变换，z变换的收敛性和其它性质，数字滤波器的基本结构等。数字图像处理部分主要包括数字图像基础，空间域滤波和频域滤波方法。 本课程考试成绩采用累积式，包括期末笔试，实验报告1（数字信号处理部分）和实验报告2（数字图像处理部分）三部分。
default.en: Digital signal and image processing is mechanical and electronic engineering of Engineering Colleges in a professional course, the main course of time discrete signal and discrete time signal processing system (algorithm), digital image processing methods, the main characteristics of the basic concept, and make the students master the basic theory and design method, comprehensive analysis and design on cultivating the students' ability of digital signal processing system, enhancement innovation consciousness. The course’s digital signal processing part mainly includes the typical characteristics of discrete time signals and discrete time system mechanism, implementation method and typical digital signal processing system analysis, design method, including fast Fourier transform, convergence and other properties of the Z transform, structure of digital filters. In the digital image processing part, major contents include fundamental of image, spatial and frequency filters. The examination results in this course are cumulative, including the final examination, two experimental reports (about digital signal processing and digital image processing, respectively).

default.zh: 机器人设计实践Ⅰ是机械电子工程、机器人工程专业本科生必需掌握的一门专业实践课，是学生们后续专业课程的基础之一。课程主要讲授协作机器人的基本概念，协作机器人核心零部件的工作原理、选型以及集成策略，典型模块化关节和协作机器人的设计案例，协作机器人设计、加工、装配、调试流程及方法。本课程可以使学生掌握协作机器人的基础知识和设计方法，着重培养学生进行机电一体化产品的设计以及工程实践能力，为将来从事机器人领域的研发工作打下基础。
default.en: Robot design practice I is a professional practice course that must be mastered by undergraduates majoring in mechatronics engineering、robotics engineering. It is one of the foundations of students' follow-up professional courses. The course mainly teaches the basic concepts of cobots, the working principle, selection and integration strategy of the core components of cobots, the design cases of typical modular joints and cobots, and the design, processing, assembly and debugging processes and methods of cobots. This course can enable students to master the basic knowledge and design methods of cobots, and focus on cultivating students' ability to design mechatronic products and engineering practice, laying a foundation for future research and development in the field of robotics.

default.zh: 该课程面向我校未来技术学院智能机器人特色班开设，课程内容涵盖机械设计与制造、机电一体化、工业机器人专业、计算机辅助设计与制造、电气自动化技术、数控技术、计算机控制技术、机电一体化技术、精密机械技术等相关专业内容，主动打破传统专业学科壁垒，推动专业学科交叉融合，促进理工结合、工工交叉，助力未来技术学院扎实推进新工科建设再深化、再拓展、再突破、再出发，推行多学科交叉融合的课程体系建设。 课程以工程训练实训课程优势资源为基础，通过课赛融合，以赛促学的方式促进学生多学科交叉融合的实践与创新能力提升。本课程在学习机械设计基础、公差与配合、机械制造基础、应用电子技术等课程的基础上，进一步培养学生综合运用机械设计、公差与配合、机械制造、机电一体化和应用电子技术等专业基础理论和综合应用的能力。通过使用Solid works、NX等三维数字化设计软件，掌握机器人的结构设计基本方法，并将其应用于实际项目当中。同时通过课程配套的机器人设备及工具实验室，供学生进行机器人的实体构建与调试实验，实操各类机械加工设备、电子调试设备以及编程与控制单元，并将学科竞赛和校级自主品牌竞赛、学生活动社团作为课程的“出口”，以此提升学生的知识理解和综合实践能力。
default.en: This course is designed for the intelligent robot specialty class of our school's Future Technology Institute. The course content covers related professional fields such as mechanical design and manufacturing, mechatronics, industrial robotics, computer-aided design and manufacturing, electrical automation technology, numerical control technology, computer control technology, mechatronics technology, precision machinery technology, etc. It actively breaks through the traditional barriers of professional disciplines, promotes the integration and intersection of professional disciplines, facilitates the combination of science and engineering, the intersection of various engineering fields, and helps the Future Technology Institute to solidly promote the deepening, expansion, breakthrough, and re-launch of the construction of new engineering disciplines, and implement a curriculum system that promotes multi-disciplinary integration. Based on the advantageous resources of engineering training and practical courses, this course promotes students' practical and innovative abilities in multi-disciplinary integration through the integration of competitions and learning. On the basis of learning basic mechanical design, tolerance and fit, basic manufacturing technology, applied electronics technology, etc., this course further cultivates students' ability to comprehensively apply professional basic theories such as mechanical design, tolerance and fit, manufacturing, mechatronics, and applied electronics technology. By using Solid works, NX and other three-dimensional digital design software, students can master the basic methods of structural design for robots and apply them to actual projects. At the same time, through the robot equipment and tool laboratory provided by the course, students can conduct physical construction and debugging experiments of robots, operate various types of mechanical processing equipment, electronic debugging equipment, programming and control units, and take subject competitions and school-level independent brand competitions, student activities and associations as the "exit" of the course. In this way, it enhances students' knowledge understanding and comprehensive practical ability.

default.zh: 本课程是面向全校各年级各专业本科生开放的选修课。 学生围绕“励志摆件的精雕细刻”主题，完成“图形绘制”、“数控编程”、“数控雕刻”和“手工雕刻”四个实验项目。 通过本课程的实践锻炼，使学生在参加劳动实践的过程中，出力流汗，磨练意志，树立正确的劳动观，感悟劳动精神，培养规范意识、安全意识、质量意识和专注的品质。
default.en: This course is an elective course for undergraduate students of all grades and majors in HIT. Students will complete four experimental projects, namely, "graphic drawing", "CNC programming", "CNC carving", and "manual carving", around the theme of "exquisite carving of inspirational ornaments" The practical training of this course will temper students’ willpowers. It is also benifit to establish correct values on labor and feel the spirit of labor. During the process of participating in labor practice, standardization awareness, safety awareness, quality awareness will also be trained.

default.zh: 机械产品创新设计及仿真是进行产品创新、技术创新的重要手段，是智能制造的关键基础。要适应制造业数字化、智能化的发展趋势，就必须最大化发挥机械产品三维设计技术对制造业人才提升的效能。课程目的在于促进学生的实践能力和创新精神，引导大学生对数字样机技术与应用能力，培养其创新设计能力、综合设计能力和团队协作能力。加强学生设计能力培养和工程实践训练，提高学生针对实际需求，通过创新思维进行机械设计的能力。同时吸引、鼓励学生踊跃参加课外科技活动，为优秀人才脱颖而出提供条件。运用三维工具来实现模型的虚拟创建，修改，完善，分析等一系列的数字化操作。学生在学习过程中主动地去寻找答案、解决难题，既得到满意的机械设计作品又学到足够的知识。
default.en: Innovative Design and Simulation of Mechanical Products is an important means of product innovation and technology innovation, and is the key basis of intelligent manufacturing. In order to adapt to the development trend of digital and intelligent manufacturing industry, we must maximize the effect of three-dimensional design technology of mechanical products on the promotion of manufacturing talents. The purpose of this course is to promote students' practical ability and innovative spirit, guide college students' ability of digital prototype technology and application, and cultivate their innovative design ability, comprehensive design ability and team cooperation ability. Strengthen the cultivation of students' design ability and engineering practice training, and improve the students' ability of mechanical design through innovative thinking according to the actual needs. At the same time, attract and encourage students to actively participate in extracurricular science and technology activities, so as to provide conditions for outstanding talents to stand out. A series of digital operations such as virtual creation, modification, improvement and analysis of the model are realized by using 3D tools. In the process of learning, students take the initiative to find answers and solve problems, so as to obtain satisfactory mechanical design works and learn enough knowledge.

default.zh: 本课程采用课赛融合的新教学模式，课程以设计并制作机器人为主，竞赛为辅，机器人设计包括机器人机械结构设计及制作、电路板设计及制作、arduino程序编写（图形化编程、代码编程），通过团队协作完成机器人联合调试，最终进行竞技比赛。 本课程特点：1、理论实践相结合，通过学习机器人相关理论知识，运用到机器人实践课程中。2、内容从入门到精通，适用于初学者。3、本课程的实践课程，注重赛课融合的教学模式，以竞赛作为出口，学习机器人相关内容，最终，利用竞技机器人并完成竞赛。4、以学生为中心，通过任务及竞赛作为驱动，充分调动学生的能动性及创造性。
default.en: This course adopts a new teaching mode integrating competition with class. The course focuses on robot design and production, supplemented by competition. Robot design includes robot mechanical structure design and production, circuit board design and production, arduino programming (graphic programming, code programming). Through team cooperation to complete the robot joint debugging, and finally competitive competition. Features of this course: 1. Combining theory and practice, we can learn the theoretical knowledge related to robots and apply it to the practical course of robots. 2, content from entry to mastery, suitable for beginners. 3. The practical course of this course focuses on the teaching mode of integration of competition and lessons, takes competition as the export to learn related contents of robots, and finally uses competitive robots to complete the competition. 4. Student-centered, driven by tasks and competitions, fully mobilize students' initiative and creativity.

default.zh: 创新设计的内容为仿生机械，学生利用一个学期的业余时间完成创新设计内容。具体分为创新设计动员、方案设计、方案评审、中期检查、答辩和评定成绩五个阶段。在教师的启发和指导下，学生以组为单位根据兴趣以及收集的相关资料确定一种或几种仿生机械作为研究对象，提出较为完整的机构实现方案和控制方案，并自主地进行相关内容科技文献检索、方案设计、虚拟仿真、绘制加工图纸、撰写设计说明书并进行答辩。对方案设计合理、结构设计正确的优秀作品，按所绘制加工图纸进行制造、装配、调试，达到设计性能要求，并在第五学期评奖。通过机构综合实现生物的动作行为，通过控制达到动作的协调运动。培养学生对机械系统及控制系统综合设计能力和创新能力，增强学生科研开发和工程实践能力，培养学生的团队协作精神。
default.en: The content of the innovative design is bionic; the students take advantage of the spare time of a semester to complete the innovative design. Specific divided into five stages of the mobilization of innovative design, program design, program evaluation, mid-term examination, the respondent and assessment scores. Under the inspiration and guidance of teachers, student group as a unit identify one or several bionic as an object of study based on the interest and the collection of information, put forward a more complete organization and control programs, and independent retrieval related scientific literature, program design, virtual simulation, drawing machining drawing, writing design specifications and the respondent. For the program design is reasonable, correct structure design outstanding works, manufacturing, assembly, commissioning in accordance with the machining drawing drawn, to achieve the design performance requirements, and in the fifth semester awards. Achieve biological action behavior by institutions, and to achieve co-ordination action by controlling. Train Students’ mechanical system and control system design and innovative ability, Enhance students' research and development and engineering practice, and students’ teamwork Spirit.

default.zh: 生物安全与医学伦理是一门新兴的交叉学科。其中生物安全学是一门研究生物性传染媒介对生态环境和人类健康产生威胁或潜在影响的学科，与农林、食品、环境、医学等领域都密不可分。生物安全不仅是科学问题，更是关系到生态、食品等诸多领域，影响到国家经济发展和社会和谐与稳定的问题。伴随这社会和科学的发展，人类逐渐解决了粮食、医药、环保等问题。但同时也面对着新的挑战，各种生物入侵、各类传染性疾病、转基因生物及食品安全性、基因生物技术等，引起了人们对这些实际问题和潜在风险的关注。医学伦理学是人文学科与自然科学联系最紧密、影响最深刻和最直接的交叉学科，是生命科学技术与卫生事业发展的政策、策略与立法的基础，具有实践性、跨文化性和全球性。本课程旨在研究各个时代的医德关系和医德现象，揭示医德的起源、本质、作用和发展规律，研究医德评价的标准和方法，力图结合我国社会主义医疗体制改革过程中出现的新的现实问题，尝试对现代医疗生活中出现的种种令人费解的道德难题加以探讨，并进行多方面的实践归纳和深层次的理论分析，回答现代医疗实践和医学发展中提出的伦理难题。
default.en: Biosafety and medical ethics are a new interdisciplinary subject. Among them, biosafety is a subject that studies the threat or potential impact of biological infectious agents on the ecological environment and human health, which is inseparable from agriculture and forestry, food, environment, medicine and other fields. Biosafety is not only a scientific problem, but also related to ecology, food and many other fields, affecting national economic development and social harmony and stability. With the development of society and science, human beings have gradually solved the problems of food, medicine, environmental protection and so on. But at the same time, it is also facing new challenges, such as various biological invasions, various infectious diseases, genetically modified organisms and food safety, which have attracted people's attention to these practical problems and potential risks. Medical ethics is an interdisciplinary subject with the closest connection between Humanities and natural science, the most profound and direct influence. It is the basis of policies, strategies and legislation for the development of life science and technology and health undertakings. It is practical, cross-cultural and global. This course aims to study the relationship and phenomenon of medical ethics in various times, reveal the origin, essence, function and development law of medical ethics, study the standards and methods of medical ethics evaluation, try to combine the new practical problems in the process of China's socialist medical system reform, try to explore various puzzling moral problems in modern medical life, and conduct various practical induction and deep-seated theoretical analysis, answer the ethical problems raised in modern medical practice and medical development.

default.zh: 一、 课程导言：什么是生物物理学？ 生命是什么？这个古老的问题在21世纪正通过一门充满活力的交叉学科——生物物理学——得到前所未有的深刻解答。我们不再仅仅满足于描述生命现象（如细胞分裂、神经冲动、肌肉收缩），而是渴望从物理学的基本原理出发， 定量地、可预测地 理解生命过程的底层逻辑。 本课程将以诺贝尔奖得主薛定谔的经典著作《生命是什么？》为思想起点，以菲利普·纳尔逊教授的经典教材《生物物理学：能量、信息、生命》为蓝本，带领大家开启一场探索生命奥秘的定量之旅。我们将学习生命系统如何巧妙地利用物理定律，在分子尺度上处理能量与信息，最终涌现出不可思议的生命活动。 二、 核心教材与课程理念 菲利普·纳尔逊的这本书被誉为生物物理学领域的“圣经”之一，其成功之处在于它完美地平衡了物理的严谨与生物的趣味。本书及本课程的核心理念是： 1. 物理第一性原理： 我们坚信，生命现象尽管复杂，但依然遵循基本的物理定律（热力学、统计力学、量子力学）。课程将从这些最基本的原理出发，推导出理解生命所需的工具和概念。 2. 定量化与建模：我们将摒弃“大概是”、“可能是”的定性描述，转而追求“是多少”、“为什么是这个数值”的定量回答。你将学会如何为生物过程构建简单的物理模型，并进行估算。 3. “自下而上”的探索：课程重点聚焦在分子和细胞尺度，从构成生命的分子机器（如蛋白质、DNA）的工作原理入手，逐步构建对细胞乃至更复杂系统的理解。 三、 课程核心内容模块 本课程将围绕教材的核心脉络“能量、信息、生命”三大主题展开，主要涵盖以下模块： 模块一：生命的热力学基础——能量的游戏 生命是开放的非平衡系统，其核心在于能量转换。本模块将探讨： 生命与热力学第二定律：生命如何通过消耗能量来创造局部的有序，以对抗宇宙中无处不在的熵增？ 自由能：生命的货币：深入理解吉布斯自由能的概念。它是驱动所有生化反应（从ATP水解到DNA合成）的真正推手。 化学势与驱动力：学习如何计算粒子从高浓度流向低浓度、或者被电势差驱动时所蕴含的能量。 模块二：分子机器与随机性——生命在纳米世界的舞蹈 在细胞这个拥挤而嘈杂的纳米世界里，随机热运动占主导地位。本模块将揭示生命如何利用而非对抗这种随机性： 扩散：生命的交通方式：学习分子如何通过随机行走（布朗运动）在细胞内找到它的目标。这解释了为什么小分子扩散迅速，而大分子却步履蹒跚。 分子马达与定向运动：探索驱动蛋白、肌球蛋白等“微型机器人”如何将化学能（ATP）转化为机械能，实现物质的定向运输和肌肉收缩。我们将用简单的随机模型（“棘轮模型”）来理解其工作原理。 速率与能垒：利用阿伦尼乌斯方程和过渡态理论，理解温度、活化能如何决定一个生化反应的快慢。 模块三：信息与生命——从序列到功能 生命不仅是物质的、能量的，更是信息的。 信息论基础： 从香农熵的角度理解DNA序列、蛋白质序列所承载的信息量。 基因调控与“决策”：构建物理模型来解释基因开关（如λ噬菌体开关）如何像电路一样工作，基于输入信号（蛋白质浓度）做出“开”或“关”的决策。这将引入协同结合、希尔方程等关键概念。 自组装：信息如何构建结构：学习病毒衣壳、细胞膜等复杂结构如何通过分子间弱相互作用的精确指令（编码在分子自身的信息中）自发地组装起来。 模块四：神经生物物理学——电脉冲与信息处理 静息膜电位：从能斯特方程和唐南平衡出发，定量推导出细胞膜内外电势差的来源。 动作电位：深入霍奇金-赫胥黎模型，理解电压门控离子通道如何协同工作，产生和传导全或无的电信号脉冲，这是神经系统信息编码的基础。 四、 课程特色与学习方法 跨学科思维：本课程是物理、化学、生物学和工程学思想的熔炉。你将学会用物理学的工具解决生物学问题。 重视数量级估算： 课程强调“信封背面计算”（back-of-the-envelope calculation），培养你凭借基本常数和简单推理，对生物物理问题（如一个细胞有多少个ATP分子？一个马达蛋白的力有多大？）进行快速估算的能力，这是科研中极其重要的技能。 适度的数学工具：课程将使用到微积分、概率论和基础微分方程。但请放心，重点是概念的理解而非复杂的数学推导。教材会循序渐进地介绍所需数学知识。 五、 结语 《生物物理学：能量、信息、生命》及其所代表的课程，为我们提供了一副全新的“眼镜”。戴上它，你看待生命世界的视角将彻底改变：一个细胞的运作不再神秘，它是一台精妙绝伦的、由物理定律驱动的分子机器；一段DNA不仅是蓝图的载体，更是一个信息存储的设备；一个神经脉冲不仅是电信号，更是一个可控的物理波。 欢迎加入我们，共同解密生命在能量与信息维度上的物理诗篇。
default.en: I. Course Introduction: What is Biophysics? What is life? Biophysics addresses this ancient question by applying physics' fundamental principles to understand life processes quantitatively and predictably , moving beyond mere description of phenomena like cell division or nerve impulses. Using Schr？dinger's “What is Life?” as a starting point and Nelson's Biological Physics: Energy, Information, Life as a guide, this course explores how living systems utilize physical laws at the molecular scale to process energy and information. II. Core Textbook and Course Philosophy Nelson's textbook, a field "bible," balances physical rigor with biological fascination. The course philosophy is: 1. Physical First Principles: Life obeys fundamental physical laws (thermodynamics, statistical mechanics, quantum mechanics). We derive understanding from these principles. 2. Quantification and Modeling: We pursue quantitative answers ("how much?", "why this value?") by building simple physical models and performing estimations. 3. "Bottom-Up" Exploration: Focus is on the molecular and cellular scales, starting from molecular machines (proteins, DNA) to build an understanding of complex systems. III. Course Core Content Modules The course revolves around the themes "Energy, Information, Life." Module 1: Thermodynamic Foundations of Life – The Energy Game Life is an open, non-equilibrium system based on energy conversion. Life and the Second Law: How life creates local order by consuming energy to counter entropy. Free Energy: The Currency of Life: Gibbs free energy as the driver of biochemical reactions. Chemical Potential and Driving Forces: Calculating energy from particle concentration gradients or electrical potentials. Module 2: Molecular Machines and Randomness – Life's Dance in the Nano-World This module explores harnessing random thermal motion. Diffusion: Life's Transportation System: Molecular targeting via random walks (Brownian motion). Molecular Motors and Directed Motion: How kinesin/myosin convert ATP to mechanical energy for transport/contraction, explained via stochastic models. Rates and Energy Barriers: How temperature/activation energy determine reaction rates (Arrhenius equation, transition state theory). Module 3: Information and Life – From Sequence to Function Life is matter, energy, and information. Information Theory Basics: Shannon entropy and information in DNA/protein sequences. Gene Regulation and "Decision Making": Physical models of genetic switches (e.g., lambda phage) making on/off decisions, introducing cooperative binding/Hill equation. Self-Assembly: How information in molecules guides spontaneous assembly of structures (viral capsids, membranes) via weak interactions. Module 4: Neurobiophysics – Electrical Pulses and Information Processing Resting Membrane Potential: Deriving the membrane potential origin (Nernst equation, Donnan equilibrium). Action Potential: How voltage-gated ion channels generate/propagate signals (Hodgkin-Huxley model), the basis of neural encoding. IV. Course Features and Learning Approach Interdisciplinary Thinking: A melting pot of physics, chemistry, biology, and engineering. Order-of-Magnitude Estimation: Cultivating "back-of-the-envelope calculation" skills for rapid estimation using fundamental constants. Moderate Mathematical Tools: Using calculus, probability, and basic differential equations with a focus on conceptual understanding. V. Conclusion Biological Physics: Energy, Information, Life offers a new lens: a cell becomes a physical molecular machine; DNA, an information storage device; a nerve impulse, a controllable wave. Join us to decipher the physical poetry of life across energy and information.

default.zh: “新医科”是国家为应对新科技革命和产业变革提出的“四新”之一，是为了适应新一轮科技革命和产业变革的要求，提出的从治疗为主到兼具预防治疗、康养的生命健康全周期医学的新理念。其具体内容包括精准医学、转化医学、新型医疗设备、新生物检测方法、新生物医药材料等。本课程是新医学科学与技术综合实验的第一部分，旨在向学生介绍新医学的基本概念和研究内容。本课程的主要内容包括人类、动植物遗传物质的提取、分析，以及生物电信号的检测。通过实验课的方式让学生体会新医学给医学发展带来的革命性变化，激励学生将来投身新医学产业和科研工作。
default.en: “New Medical Science” is included in the “4 news” that is proposed to respond to the new technological revolution and industrial update. It is a new concept that contains not only the diagnosis and treatment of diseases but also disease prevention and rehabilitation. A wide range od research fields including precision medicine, translational medicine, new medical equipment, new methods of biosensing, and new medical materials can be included in new medical science and technology. This course is the first part of the “Comprehensive Experiments of New Medical Science and Technology”. It aims at introducing basic concepts and content of new medical science to the students. The main content of the course includes the extraction and analysis of the hereditary substance, and detection of bio signals. It will let the students realize the revolutionary changes brought by new medicine to the development of medicine and encourage students to engage in the industry and research of new medical science.

default.zh: 本课程面向医学与健康学院一年级学生开设，培养学生的科学与工程思维，促进学生的计算思维与生物、医学等思维交叉融合形成复合型思维，为学生今后设计、构造和应用各种计算系统求解生物医学学科问题奠定思维基础。
