The study of the thermal part mainly establishes the basic concepts, laws and research methods to describe the macro thermophysical process, including the concept of temperature, the three laws of thermodynamics, the zeroth law of thermodynamics, entropy, enthalpy, phase change, etc; In the part of molecular kinetic theory, the relationship between microscopic phenomena and macroscopic thermal phenomena is mainly established. Through the preliminary establishment of the physical image of statistical physics, the basic physical concepts and processes such as particle distribution function, thermal balance, Maxwell distribution, Boltzmann distribution and transport process are learned. Through the course study, students can master the basic theory of heat, including the micro essence of thermal phenomena, the basic macro and micro description of thermal movement, understand the materiality of electromagnetic fields, understand the dialectical thinking and unity of opposites between micro and macro systems, lay the foundation for the subsequent general physics course of micro description of matter, and make necessary preparations for the theoretical physics course of thermodynamics and statistical physics. At the same time, students should master the knowledge and methods of applying thermal theory, analyze phenomena and solve problems, and have the preliminary ability to use thermal methods to study related problems.

default.zh: 基础物理实验Ⅰ课程是以经典和现代物理学丰富而广泛的内涵为基础，系统地训练学生进行较具普遍性的实验方法和技能的课程。通过本课程课，不仅使学生能加深理解所学的物理学基本原理，而且使其科学实践能力得到了增强，科学素养也提高了。 本课程的目的在于让学生掌握一些典型实验技术知识，实验结果评判分析的能力，使其掌握基本实验仪器的使用方法，希望为其将来进一步从事科研、研发、生产等方面的工作打下良好基础。 除了基本实验之外，课程包含许多综合类型的和具有挑战性的自主设计性实验题目，其目的在于提高学生的兴趣，激励其具备独立解决问题的能力。课程刻意引入了获得诺贝尔物理学奖的实验，以期让学生理解一些重大发现通过物理实验对人类对自然界观念认识的改变以及对人类生产生活方式的改变的重大意义。 作为课程基础，本课程将对其它实践性教学起到重要帮助作用。
default.en: “Fundamentals Physics Experiments Ⅰ” is the course which systematically trains the students with more general experimental methods and skills based on the rich and comprehensive contents of classical and modern physics. Through the course, for the students, not only the basic principles of physics can be understood deeply, but also the scientific ability and quality for practice is enhanced. The aim of this course is to acquaint the students with some typical knowledge for experimental techniques and some methods to judge and analyze the results, to let them to master some basic instruments for scientific experiments. We hope this effort may benefit to them to engage the scientific research, R&D, fabrication with a solid base. Besides some basic experiments, the course include may types of comprehensive experiments and some topics belonging to the sort of challenges that needs special design，the aim of which is to enhance the students' interests and encourage them to posses the ability to resolve problem independently. Some experiments, which gained the Nobel Prize in Physics are intentionally introduced into the course to expect the students to understand the significant meaning of some important finding for changing concepts or cognition to the Nature and the style of production and daily life of human being via the scientific physics experiments. As the foundation of many courses, this course will provide important assistance to the teaching process for the other practice courses.

default.zh: 《等离子体物理（1）》是应用物理学（中俄合作）专业的一门专业方向核心课程。本课程的教学目的是通过学习使学生了解物质第四态—等离子态的基本性质和基本规律、了解等离子体物理发展的新趋势，培养等离子体物理相关人才。本课程讲授等离子体物理基本概念，介绍等离子体物理中的单粒子轨道理论和磁流体力学理论。要求学生掌握如何利用单粒子轨道理论来解决等离子物理中的基本问题；了解等离子体微观现象和宏观现象之间、快过程和慢过程之间的不同和联系。
default.en: “Plasma Physics (1)” is a core specialized course in the Applied Physics (Sino-Russia Cooperation) program. The teaching objective of this course is to enable students to understand the fundamental properties and laws of the fourth state of matter—plasma, grasp the latest developments in plasma physics, and cultivate professionals in the field of plasma physics. The course covers basic concepts of plasma physics, introduces the single-particle orbit theory and magnetohydrodynamics in plasma physics. Students are required to master how to apply the single-particle orbit theory to solve fundamental problems in plasma physics, and to understand the differences and connections between microscopic and macroscopic phenomena, as well as fast and slow processes in plasma physics.

default.zh: （1）掌握等离子体物理的基本理论知识，了解等离子体科学技术的前沿和发展趋势； （2）培养学生理论联系实际、独立学习、独立解决问题的能力，学会运用等离子体物理基本理论解决与等离子体相关的基础物理问题和工程领域的相关问题； （3）了解等离子体科学在国民经济、人类生活、科学研究、军事等领域的重要作用。
default.en: (1) to master the basic theoretical knowledge of plasma physics and understand the frontiers and development trends of plasma science and technology; (2) to cultivate students' ability to combine theory with practice, learn independently and solve problems independently, and learn to apply the basic theory of plasma physics to solve basic physics problems related to plasma and related problems in the field of engineering; (3) to understand the important role of plasma science in national economy, human life, scientific research, military and other fields.

default.zh: 本课程是其他学院辅修物理的本科生的专业课，通过本课程的学习使学生掌握光电信号检测与处理的光辐射基础理论、光电转换器件的物理机理、光电检测技术的基本原理和信号处理的基本方法；掌握光电信号检测与处理系统的基本组成、原理、功能与技术参数，掌握放大、滤波与相关处理等基本技术；了解典型光电信号检测与处理系统的基本原理与使用方法，培养科学的物理学思想与研究方法。本课程使学生具备运用光电信号检测与处理方法研究相关问题的实践能力，并能够自主学习。本课程可以拓宽本科生的视野，扩大其知识面，使其了解与社会发展和人民生活息息相关的光电探测与处理方面的知识和相关领域的新技术新进展，为其以后开展相关领域的学术研究和技术开发工作打下基础。本课程综合了光电子学、模拟电路、数字电路等学科的内容，将这些知识有机结合、面向应用，因此它是一门跨学科的应用型课程，通过此课的学习能培养学生理论联系实际、多学科综合运用的能力，提高学生的工程技术能力，培养学生的创新意识。
default.en: This course is one of professional courses for undergraduate students minoring in physics from other colleges. This course includes basic theory of light radiation，physical theory of photon-electron conversion, theory of photo-electronic signal detection and analysis methods of signal processing. The basic structure, theory, function and parameters of photo-electronic signal detection and process system will be described in detail. Signal amplifying, filtering and other handling methods are introduced. Basic theories and applications of typical photo-electronic signal detection and process system are presented with scientific physics thinking and research approaches. This course enables students to have practical ability to apply photoelectric signal detection and process methods to research related problems, and to learn independently. This course can broaden the horizons of undergraduate students, expand their knowledge base, and enable them to understand the knowledge of optoelectronic detection and process that is closely related to social development and people's lives, as well as new technological advancements in related fields, laying a foundation for their future academic research and technological development in related fields.This course integrates optoelectronics, analog circuits, digital circuits systematically and practically, which makes this course a practical multi-subject course. Students will be trained to synthesize theories with practical and multi-subject applications through this course which helps improve their engineering abilities and creative thinking.

default.zh: 本课程是物理学院各专业本科生的专业课，通过本课程的学习使学生掌握光电信号检测与处理的光辐射基础理论、光电转换器件的物理机理、光电检测技术的基本原理和信号处理的基本方法；掌握光电信号检测与处理系统的基本组成、原理、功能与技术参数，掌握放大、滤波与相关处理等基本技术；了解典型光电信号检测与处理系统的基本原理与使用方法，培养科学的物理学思想与研究方法。本课程使学生具备运用光电信号检测与处理方法研究相关问题的实践能力，并能够自主学习。本课程可以拓宽本科生的视野，扩大其知识面，使其了解与社会发展和人民生活息息相关的光电探测与处理方面的知识和相关领域的新技术新进展，为其以后开展相关领域的学术研究和技术开发工作打下基础。本课程综合了光电子学、模拟电路、数字电路等学科的内容，将这些知识有机结合、面向应用，因此它是一门跨学科的应用型课程，通过此课的学习能培养学生理论联系实际、多学科综合运用的能力，提高学生的工程技术能力，培养学生的创新意识。
default.en: This course is one of professional courses for all students in School of Physics. This course includes basic theory of light radiation，physical theory of photon-electron conversion, theory of photo-electronic signal detection and analysis methods of signal processing. The basic structure, theory, function and parameters of photo-electronic signal detection and process system will be described in detail. Signal amplifying, filtering and other handling methods are introduced. Basic theories and applications of typical photo-electronic signal detection and process system are presented with scientific physics thinking and research approaches. This course enables students to have practical ability to apply photoelectric signal detection and process methods to research related problems, and to learn independently. This course can broaden the horizons of undergraduate students, expand their knowledge base, and enable them to understand the knowledge of optoelectronic detection and process that is closely related to social development and people's lives, as well as new technological advancements in related fields, laying a foundation for their future academic research and technological development in related fields.This course integrates optoelectronics, analog circuits, digital circuits systematically and practically, which makes this course a practical multi-subject course. Students will be trained to synthesize theories with practical and multi-subject applications through this course which helps improve their engineering abilities and creative thinking.

default.zh: 《现代光学测量原理与技术A》课程注重光学基本理论与应用紧密结合，重点介绍了光学精密测试所涉及的光学测量方法及其特点，对在工业、军事、生物和医学等领域进行光学精密测试具有较高的参考价值。本课程首先讲述现代光学测量的发展现状与趋势、光学测量方法的分类、光学测量系统的典型类别，从光源到探测的匹配应用对典型光学测量系统进行了举例分析。然后分别讲述光干涉测量技术、激光全息测量技术、激光衍射测量技术以及激光测距和测速技术。通过学习本课程使学生掌握现代光学测量技术的基本概念和原理，能够自行分析和设计所需的光学测试系统，切实提高学生独立分析和解决光学测量问题的能力。
default.en: The course 《Principle and Technology of Modern Optical Measurement A》combines theory with technical applications, and focuses on the methods and their characteristics of optical precision measurement. It’s important for applications in industry, military, life science, medicine, and so on. In this course, we firstly introduce the fundamental of modern optical measurement technique, including the categories, system composing and the future trends. Typical optical measuring systems are analyzed with examples, and light sources, detectors and the match for both are highlighted. Then we introduce the laser interference, hologram, diffraction, ranging and speed measurement technologies. The course will give the students a theoretical background for analyze and design an optical measurement system independently, and improve the ability of analyzing and solving problems during optical testing by one’s own.

default.zh: 本课程旨在培养学生对俄罗斯艺术文化的基本认识。课程和课程目标是让学生熟悉俄罗斯文化中最重要的现象，提供文化和艺术领域的知识，形成分析艺术作品的技能和能力，提供文化术语领域的基本知识。在学习过程中，学生将熟悉与俄罗斯文化相关的主要国家现实，熟悉俄罗斯艺术、文化和文学领域的顶尖大师的杰作及其作品的具体特点。因此，该门课程将发展学生对于艺术史、文学史和文化史的基本能力。
default.en: The course is aimed at forming students' basic ideas about Russian art culture. The course and program objective is to acquaint students with the most important phenomena of Russian culture, to provide knowledge in the field of culture and art, to form skills and abilities to analyze a work of art, to provide basic knowledge in the field of cultural terminology. In the course of study students will familiarize themselves with the main country realities related to the culture of Russia, with the masterpieces of the leading masters of art, culture and literature of Russia and the specific features of their works. Thus, students will develop basic competencies in the history of art, literature and culture.

default.zh: 导波光学主要研究光在部分受限空间或结构中的传播特性，与光在自由空间中的传播行为有很大的不同，是光子芯片应用技术以及微纳光子学基础研究领域的核心课程，也是物理学相关专业不可或缺的知识构成部分。通过对本课程的学习，学生能够深入理解有关光波导的重要概念和理论分析方法，掌握典型波导及波导器件的工作原理、光在波导结构中传播的基本特性，并且能够设计基本的光波导结构与器件。本课程以导波光学的基本原理和典型应用为主要内容，包括平面介质光波导的传输及耦合特性，包括波导色散方程的推导和求解，本征模和有效传播常数的概念，以及基于平面波导的常用光子器件；同时矩形和圆形介质光波导的基本传输特性和模式特点也是重要内容；此外，近年来发展的金属表面等离激元波导、光子晶体光波导、拓扑光波导等，这些新型波导结构的传输特性，波导模式存在的条件，色散方程及本征模特性等内容也有讲解。本课程采用累加式方法计算总成绩，综合考虑平时成绩及期末考试。
default.en: Guided wave optics (GWO) emphasizes on the properties of light propagation in partially confined spaces or structures, which are quite different from those in free spaces. GWO is one of the key core courses for the photonic chip technology and fundamental researches in nanophotonics, and is also an indispensable part in knowledge system for majorities in physics. Through the study of this course, students will deep understand the conceptions and methods in GWO, mastering the operation principles and propagation properties of light in waveguides. Also, the design of waveguides should also be understood by the students. The main contents of this course include the fundamental theories and applications of GWO, including the propagation and coupling of planar waveguides. In this part, the students should derive and solve the dispersion equation of the waveguide, and clearly understand the conception of eigen mode and effective propagation constant, and the functional devices based on the optical waveguides. Further, the properties of rectangular waveguide and circular fiber are also vital in this course. In addition, for the surface plasmonic polariton waveguide, photonic crystal waveguide, topological waveguide proposed recently, the exist conditions of guiding mode, dispersion equations, and the properties of eigenmodes will be covered also. The final score of this course is accumulated by two parts of usual performances and the final examination.

default.zh: 生命安全培训的目标是形成在紧急情况（紧急情况）下具有人、社会和环境综合保护领域高等教育的专家的安全型人格、思想态度、基本知识、技能和能力，该专家具有健康生活方式和保健技术的技能，并熟悉劳动保护的要求。 通过培训，形成了有效的专业活动与确保人的安全、环境以及物质和文化价值不受各种自然威胁的要求不可分割的统一思想，并使毕业生准备使用主要的保护方法，免受自然、人为、生物、社会和军事政治紧急情况的可能后果。
default.en: The goal of life safety training is to form the qualities of a safe type of personality, ideological attitudes, basic knowledge, skills, and abilities of a specialist with higher education in the field of comprehensive protection of man, society, and the environment in emergency situations (emergencies), who has the skills of a healthy lifestyle and health-saving technologies and is familiar with the requirements of labour protection. As a result of the training, the formation of an idea of the inseparable unity of effective professional activity with the requirements of ensuring safety and security of the man, the environment, and material and cultural values from threats of various nature is achieved and the readiness of the graduate to use the main methods of protection from the possible consequences of natural, man-made, biological, social, and military-political emergencies is ensured.

default.zh: 本课程首先介绍有关光电功能材料现状，如电光材料、压电及热电材料、光信息材料等；在光电材料的性质方面介绍材料的介电性质、压电性质、电光性质及材料的一些非线性效应，如电光效应、弹光效应、声光效应等；非线性光学性质包括非线性光学极化、相位匹配等；然后介绍光电功能陶瓷、单晶的制备方法及光电功能材料的性质检测技术。在对有机、无机等光电功能材料深入讲授的基础上，介绍各种力、热、光、电、热等高性能如光开关、调制器、偏转器等。 《光电功能材料与器件》是专业限选课，除了讲授相关的基础知识外，还将介绍学生毕业后走向工作岗位可能需要的相关知识和技术，提高学生的学习兴趣。
default.en: First, the course introduces the current conditions of optical-electric functional materials, such as electro-optic materials, piezoelectric materials and Optical information material，etc. About the properties of the optical-electro functional materials, we focus on the dielectric, piezoelectric, electro-optic properties and other nonlinear effects. For example, electro-optic effects and Elastic light effect, acoustooptic effect. Nonlinear optical properties include nonlinear optical polarization, phase matching and so on. Second, the growth methods and Property detection technology of optical-electro functional ceramics, single crystal are described. Based on the in depth study of organic and inorganic photoelectric functional materials, we introduce the high-performance optical switches, modulators, deflectors, etc The course of Optical-Electric Functional Materials and Device is the Major required course, In addition to teaching the relevant basic knowledge not only the interrelated rudiments should be introduce, we will also introduce relevant knowledge and skills that students may need to move into the workplace after graduation.

default.zh: 本课程旨在系统掌握俄罗斯从古代至现代的历史。通过学习，学生将理解俄罗斯历史的核心议题及其在世界历史进程中的地位，研究俄罗斯国家形态形成与发展的广泛问题，掌握有关该国社会政治、社会经济及文化历史最新学术研究成果。 课程同时涵盖国家疆域形成的独特性、政治经济发展特征及文化传统等专题内容，特别关注俄罗斯历史上形成的多民族国家特性，以及不同族群间相互包容的传统。
default.en: The objective of this course is to provide a systematic understanding of Russian history. Through this course, students will comprehend the core issues of Russian history and its place in the global historical process, examine a wide range of topics related to the formation and development of the Russian state, and master the latest academic research findings concerning the country's socio-political, socio-economic, and cultural history. The curriculum also covers specialized content including the distinct characteristics of national territorial formation, features of political and economic development, and cultural traditions. Particular attention is paid to Russia's historically formed characteristics as a multi-ethnic state and the tradition of mutual tolerance among different ethnic groups.

default.zh: 计算光学成像在光学基础上，融入多维光学信息，如相位、偏振、轨道角动量等物理量，以信息传递为计算主线，结合数学和信息处理技术感知光场信息，解译和获取更高维度的数据信息。这种成像技术是光学、计算机、信息等学科交叉而形成的。计算光学成像技术正朝着更高分辨率、更远作用距离、更广观察视场、更小结构体积、更强环境适应方向发展。《计算光学成像原理与技术》课程在已修过的数学分析、线性代数、光学等课程基础上，介绍计算光学成像原理、技术、应用。学习计算光学成像的数值算法，应用光学衍射、光学元件的数学模型与算法解决不同光学成像系统中的信息处理问题，为光学成像领域创新性人才储备信息理论和计算技术。 本课程具体内容包括计算光学成像理论、技术、应用。理论部分内容包括以快速傅里叶变换、角谱等技术的计算光学成像方法。计算光学成像包括关联成像(鬼成像)、压缩感知成像、CT成像、计算全息成像、非视域成像、编码孔径成像、相位成像、光场相机、自适应光学成像、合成孔径成像、受激发损耗显微成像、偏振成像等为例，讲授计算光学成像原理与技术，使学生具备从基础数学和光学理论到应用研究转化的基础能力、创新意识、科研认知。
default.en: On the basis of optics, computational optical imaging integrates multi-dimensional optical information, such as phase, polarization, orbital angular momentum and other physical quantities, takes information transmission as the main line of calculation, and combines mathematics and information processing technology to perceive light field information. interpret and obtain higher-dimensional data information. This kind of imaging technology is formed by the intersection of optics, computer, information and other disciplines. Computational optical imaging technology is developing in the direction of higher resolution, longer operating distance, wider field of view, smaller structural volume and stronger environmental adaptation. The course “principles and techniques of Computational Optical Imaging” introduces the principle, technology and application of computational optical imaging on the basis of mathematical analysis, linear algebra, optics and other courses. Learn the numerical algorithm of computational optical imaging, apply the mathematical models and algorithms of optical diffraction and optical elements to solve the problems of information processing in different optical imaging systems, and reserve information theory and computing technology for innovative talents in the field of optical imaging. The specific content of this course includes the theory, technology and application of computational optical imaging. The theoretical part includes the computational optical imaging method based on fast Fourier transform, angular spectrum and so on. Computational optical imaging includes correlation imaging (also called as ghost imaging), compressed sensing imaging, CT imaging, computer holographic imaging, non-field imaging, coded aperture imaging, phase imaging, light field camera, adaptive optical imaging, synthetic aperture imaging, excited loss microscopic imaging, polarization imaging, etc., as examples, teach the principles and techniques of computational optical imaging. So that students have the basic ability, innovative consciousness and scientific research cognition to transform from basic mathematics and optical theory to applied research.

default.zh: 该课程的主要目标是让学生熟悉圣彼得堡国立大学的历史，了解在圣彼得堡国立大学工作的著名科学家在不同时期和年份的活动，展示圣彼得堡国立大学对俄罗斯文化发展的贡献。为了实现这一目标，设定了以下任务：讲述大学和科学院的历史思想，讲述彼得大帝在教育和科学领域的改革，讲述大学第一批教授的活动，讲述凯瑟琳大帝时期和俄罗斯历史上其他时期大学的发展；讲述与圣彼得堡国立大学有关的文化、文学和艺术人物的传记，介绍他们的主要作品；以展示圣彼得堡州立大学如今的文化和艺术发展。学生将获得文化研究、艺术和文学领域的新知识，发展文化分析的基本能力。
default.en: The main goal of the course is to familiarize students with the history of St. Petersburg State University, to give information about the activities of famous scientists who worked at St. Petersburg State University in different epochs and years, to show the contribution of St. Petersburg State University to the development of Russian culture. To realize this goal the following tasks are set: to tell about the idea of the history of the university and the Academy of Sciences, about the reforms of Peter the Great in the field of education and science, about the activity of the first professors of the university, about the development of the university during the period of Catherine the Great and other epochs in the history of Russia; to tell about the figures of culture, literature and art, whose biography was connected with St. Petersburg State University, to present their main works; to show how culture and art are developing in St. Petersburg State University nowadays. Students will gain new knowledge in the field of cultural studies, art and literature, develop basic competencies in cultural analysis.

default.zh: 通过光与物质相互作用可以诱发新的物理和化学现象，进一步拓展人们认识材料和应用材料的新维度。现代光化学和光与物质相互作用理论是现代物理发展的成果，对电子激发态的研究所建立的新概念、新理论和新方法大大开拓了人们对物质认识的深度和广度,对了解自然界的光合作用和生命过程、对太阳能的利用、环境的保护、开创新的反应途径、寻求新的材料提供了重要基础,在新能源、新材料和信息处理新技术等高技术领域中发挥着越来越重要的作用。本课程是为物理系本科生开设的一门选修课。安排在第四学期，原子物理和光学等基础课程之后，我们结合物理专业的学科特点，对课程的结构进行了合理的优化和设置。主要内容包括化学键理论、分子轨道理论、化学热力学、化学动力学、激发态原理等基本知识，同时结合一些常见的光学材料的结构特点，揭示物质微观结构与性质的内在联系。课程从物质结构入手，层层深入，由基础理论逐渐拓展光电信息材料在相关领域的应用、光电器件结构和工作原理，从物质结构入手，层层深入，由基础理论逐渐拓展光电信息材料在相关领域的应用。
default.en: The interaction between light and matter can induce new physical and chemical phenomena, further expanding people's understanding and application of materials in new dimensions. Modern photochemistry and the theory of the interaction between light and matter are achievements of the development of modern physics. The new concepts, theories, and methods established in the study of electronic excited states have greatly improved understanding of matter. Achievements in the fields of photochemistry and photophysics are playing an increasingly important role in high-tech fields.This course is an interdisciplinary course for undergraduates majoring in Photoelectric Information Engineering and technology in the Department of Physics. It aims at introducing the optical phenomena and chemical reactions caused by the interaction between light and matter from the point of view of physics, especially optics, and expounding the important optical phenomena and the mechanism of photochemical reactions. The relationship between material structure and optical properties of materials is established. According to the characteristics of physics, this course will selectively introduce the basic knowledge of structural chemistry and chemical reaction, and appropriately introduce the preparation methods of materials chemistry which are interesting in the field of physics. The aim is to cultivate students'interest in photochemistry and improve their skills in solving chemical problems.

default.zh: 半导体物理学是近年来迅速发展的半导体技术及其产业的核心基础。本课程作为一门以应用为背景的基础技术课程，以半导体中的电子状态、半导体中杂质和缺陷能级、半导体中载流子的统计分布为基础理论，深入探讨半导体中载流子的漂移运动及对导电特性影响、非平衡载流子注入与复合基本物理过程。随后从半导体PN结的形成和杂质电荷分布、PN结能带图等基本物理机理出发，重点介绍非平衡状态下的理想PN结模型及其电流电压方程，从而分析影响PN结电流电压特性偏离理想方程的各种因素。 本课程的任务是使学生掌握半导体物理学这门课的基本概念、理论和方法，在教学中逐步提高学生对半导体物理问题的理解能力、推理能力、分析能力和计算能力。对于半导体的基本概念和理论要强调简明易懂和深入浅出，对于理论方法和问题分析的教学要着重在理论的清晰性和问题的具体性方面。要求学生基于半导体物理学的基础理论能够对半导体中载流子和PN结有机融合有较为透彻的理解和深刻的掌握。通过典型问题的重点教学，培养学生具备举一反三、触类旁通的深入学习和研究半导体物理的能力。为学生从事光电信息科学与工程方面的科研、教学及新型半导体器件研发奠定理论基础。
default.en: Semiconductor physics is the core foundation of semiconductor technology and semiconductor industry, which has developed rapidly in recent years. As a basic technical course with an application background, this course takes the electronic states in semiconductors, impurity and defect energy levels in semiconductors, and the statistical distribution of carriers in semiconductors as the basic theory, and provides an in-depth discussion of the drifting motion of carriers in semiconductors and its effect on the conductive properties, the basic physical processes of non-equilibrium carrier injection and compounding. The course then focuses on the ideal PN junction model and its current-voltage equations in a non-equilibrium state, starting from the formation of semiconductor PN junctions and the basic physical mechanisms such as impurity charge distribution and the PN junction energy band diagram, so as to analyze the various factors affecting the deviation of the PN junction current-voltage characteristics from the ideal equations. The task of this course is to enable students to master the basic concepts, theories and methods of the subject of semiconductor physics, and to gradually improve their understanding, reasoning, analyzing and computational skills of semiconductor physics problems. The basic concepts and theories of semiconductors are emphasized in terms of simplicity and depth, and the teaching of theoretical methods and problem analysis is focused on the clarity of theory and the specificity of problems. Students are required to have a thorough understanding and profound grasp of the organic fusion of carriers and PN junctions in semiconductors based on the fundamental theory of semiconductor physics. Through the focus on typical problems, students will be able to develop the ability to learn and study semiconductor physics in depth. This will provide students with the theoretical foundation for research and teaching in optoelectronic information science and engineering and for the development of new semiconductor devices.

default.zh: 本课程是光电信息科学与工程专业的专业选修课之一。生物光子学研究光和生物样品之间的相互作用，是融合了光子学和生物学的一个前沿交叉学科，是光子学在生物领域的延伸。光子学可以用于光学诊断和光学疗法；反过来，生物材料为未来的技术应用提供了一个新的光子介质。生物光子学导论课程的任务是系统讲解生物光子这一前沿交叉领域，包括光生物学，传统光学生物成像，扫描荧光共聚焦荧光成像，非线性光学显微成像，光学生物传感，光动力疗法，激光组织工程学，光镊和光剪和生物光子材料。本课程的目的是通过学习使学生理解生物光子学领域的各项技术及其基于的基本原理，了解生物光子学的最新进展，从而为从事生物光子学的研究和应用打下坚实的基础。本课程还将帮助学生了解科学研究的一般过程，激发学生对从事科学研究的兴趣。
default.en: The course of Introduction to Biophotonics is a one of the optional courses for the major of optoelectronic information science and engineering. Biophotonics deals with the interactions between light and biology specimens. It is an interdisciplinary subject combining photonics and biology, which is an extension of photonics into biology. Photonics can be used in optical diagnosis and optical therapy. Meanwhile, biomaterials provide a new optical medium for future technological applications. The course is to systematically teach biophotonics, which includes photobiology, traditional bioimaging, scanning confocal microscopy, nonlinear optical microscopy, optical biosensors, photodynamic therapy, laser tissue engineering, laser tweezers, laser scissors and biomaterials for photonics. The objective is to help students understand the various technology and the basic principles and know the recent progress, which could lay a strong foundation for biophotonics researches and applications. Meanwhile, this course will help students know how to do scientific research, and stimulate their interests in scientific researches.

default.zh: 本课程是面向大二、大三学生开设的小班课程，主要讲授光电传感材料与器件的物理基础与性能评估方法。从基本材料体系出发，探索不同材料、不同工作模式下光电传感方法与器件评估新方法。突出研究性、科学性和前沿科技。 目标1：通过讲授光电传感材料的物理效应，器件物理基础以及光学测试方法前沿知识和发展趋势，培养学生独立思考、解决问题以及科学研究能力。 目标2：结合实际测试方法讲授，培养学生理论联系实际的创新能力，培养发现问题，解决问题的研究能力，并能够准确表达学术成果的科技交流能力。
default.en: This course is a small-class course designed for sophomore and junior students, mainly covering the physical fundamentals and performance evaluation methods of photoelectric sensing materials and devices. Starting from basic material systems, it explores new methods for photoelectric sensing and device evaluation under different materials and working modes. It emphasizes research, scientificity and cutting-edge technology.

default.zh: ““高等光学”课程是物理学院光电信息科学与工程和应用物理专业本科生重要的专业基础课之一。本课程以光的电磁理论为主线，在经典物理学框架之内深层次揭示光的波动本性以及光波在各种线性介质和界面传播行为。课程主要内容包括光波的电磁理论描述；波动方程以及不同种类解的形式所表示的光波场的物理性质；光场偏振特性；光波在各向同性的电介质、金属及界面上的传播、反射和折射特性等。本课程旨在指导学生深入理解光的电磁波动理论的基本概念和基本物理规律，掌握一些典型的处理光学物理问题的数学方法，使学生建立一个完整系统的理论光学的框架，为深入学习现代光学（如非线性光学、量子光学、信息光学等）奠定扎实的理论基础。
default.en: 《Advanced Opticsis》is a fundamental course for the undergraduates majored in Opt-electric information Science and Engineering, and Applied Physics. Based on the electromagnetic theory of light, the course reveals the wave nature of light and the propagation properties in various linear media and on the surfaces. The course includes the electromagnetic descriptions of light, wave equation and its solutions, the characteristics of the different light fields, the propagation, reflection and refraction of light in dielectric media, metals and on the surfaces, polarization of light, and so on. The course motivates to instruct the undergraduates to understand the insights of fundamental concepts and physical laws of the electromagnetic waves, to grasp necessary mathematical methods of solving the problems of the Classical Optical Physics, and to establish an integral theory framework of theoretical optics. Such trainings will benefit the students for the further studies in modern optics such as Nonlinear Optics, Quantum Optics and Information Optics.

default.zh: 《等离子体物理》是应用物理学、核物理学及物理相关专业的一门专业选修课程。本课程的教学目的是通过学习使学生了解物质第四态—等离子态的基本性质和基本规律、了解等离子体物理发展的新趋势，培养等离子体物理相关人才。本课程讲授等离子体物理基本概念，介绍等离子体物理中的三种描述方法：单粒子方法、流体方法和动理学方法。要求学生掌握如何利用这三种方法来解决等离子物理中的基本问题；了解等离子体微观现象和宏观现象之间、快过程和慢过程之间的不同和联系。
default.en: Plasma physics is a specified optional course for applied physics major, nuclear physics major and other related majors in physics. The teaching purpose of this course is to enable students to understand the basic properties and laws of the fourth state of matter-plasma state, understand the new trend of plasma physics development, and cultivate plasma physics related talents through learning. This course teaches the basic concepts of plasma physics and introduces three description methods in plasma physics: single particle method, fluid method and kinetic method. Students are required to master how to use these three methods to solve basic problems in plasma physics; Understand the differences and connections between micro and macro phenomena of plasma and between fast and slow processes.

default.zh: 《能源材料与物理》是物理学院的专业选修课。课程内容包括：（1）新能源概念与特点，物理学在能源科学中的重要作用；（2）离子导电与氧化物燃料电池物理机制；（3）嵌入化合物与锂离子电池的电极材料及其物理机制；（4）超级电容器概念及其物理原理；（5）半导体光伏效应与太阳电池材料；（6）氢能的概念、特点与应用，储氢材料；（7）核能材料的辐照效应、核燃料与核反应堆。
default.en: Energy materials and physics is one of the selective courses for the School of Physics. This course introduces the functional materials used in the new energy systems and devices, as well as the related basic physical principles, material systems, and some applications. This course includes: (1) the concept and characteristics of new energy, the essential effect of physics on energy science, (2) the physical mechanisms of fast ionic conduction, and solid oxide fuel cell, (3) intercalation compounds, the electrode materials, and the related physical mechanism of Lithium-ion battery, (4) the concept and mechanism of the supercapacitor, (5) photovoltaic effect of semiconductors and solar battery, (6) the concept, characteristics, and applications of hydrogen energy, hydrogen storage materials, (7) radiation effect of nuclear materials, nuclear fuel, and reactor.

default.zh: 加速器物理是物理学院本科生核物理轨道专业选修课。加速器物理以研究带电粒子在电磁场中加速和传输为对象。伴随着加速原理和技术的不断创新，新的加速器不断出现，性能不断提高。借助高性能的加速器，许多相关学科，如粒子物理、核物理、材料科学、生命科学、医药工程、食品科学等都得到了极大地丰富和发展。 本课程主要讲授加速器的基本理论、原理、结构和计算方法与工具。通过本课程的学习，使学生掌握粒子加速和传输原理，对加速器理论和技术研究的最新进展有较为充分的了解，培养学生分析问题和解决问题的能力，为利用加速器开展原子核物理、核技术应用方面的研究工作提供基础理论知识。 本课程在保持传统教学严谨、扎实等优点的基础上，使学生在掌握基本概念、原理、理论方法和计算工具的同时，了解相关领域的研究前沿和热点、以及与其它自然科学分支的联系，重点培养科学思维方法、创新意识和解决具体问题的能力，为后继课程的学习与未来的科研奠定坚实基础。
default.en: Accelerator physics is an elective course for undergraduate students majoring in nuclear physics in the School of Physics. Accelerator physics focuses on studying the acceleration and transmission of charged particles in electromagnetic fields. With the continuous innovation of acceleration principle and technology, new accelerators continue to emerge and their performance continues to improve. With the help of high-performance accelerators, many related disciplines, such as particle physics, nuclear physics, material science, life science, medical engineering, food science, have been greatly enriched and developed. This course mainly teaches the basic theory, principle, structure and computing tools of the accelerator. This course enables students to master particle acceleration and transmission principles, fully understand the latest progress in accelerator theory and technology research, cultivate students' ability to analyze and solve problems, and provide basic theoretical knowledge for research on nuclear physics and nuclear technology applications using accelerators. On the basis of maintaining the advantages of rigorous and solid traditional teaching, this course enables students to master the basic concepts, principles, theoretical methods and computing tools, understand the research frontiers and hot-spots in related fields, as well as the links with other natural science branches, and focus on cultivating scientific thinking methods, innovation awareness and the ability to solve specific problems, so as to lay a solid foundation for the study of subsequent courses and future scientific research.

default.zh: 专业认知实习是本科教学中非常重要的实践环节，其目的是给新入学学生对专业总体认知的机会，以增加学生对专业的感性认识。深入工程实体让学生了解道路桥梁的构成、内部结构及损坏现象，了解道路桥梁的结构形式和相应的使用功能，并初步认识各种道路建筑材料和施工机械，了解道路施工工艺和施工管理等方面的知识。通过认知实习使学生初步了解专业概况，建立起初步的工程意识，激发学生对专业后续课程的求知欲，为学习专业基础课和专业课奠定感性认识的基础。
default.en: Professional recognition practice is a very important practical link in undergraduate teaching. Its purpose is to give new students the opportunity to overall cognition of the major, so as to increase students' perceptual understanding of the major. In-depth engineering entities let students understand the composition, internal structure and damage phenomenon of roads and Bridges, understand the structural form and corresponding use function of roads and Bridges, and a preliminary understanding of various road building materials and construction machinery, understand the road construction technology and construction management of knowledge. Through cognitive practice, students can have a preliminary understanding of the major, establish a preliminary engineering awareness, stimulate students' thirst for knowledge for the follow-up courses of the major, and lay a foundation for perceptual understanding of professional basic courses and professional courses.

default.zh: 《智能交通导论》是为学生较全面、概括地了解智能交通类各个专业方向的面貌、学习与研究的主要内容、科学与技术发展趋势、历史沿革与社会角色等而设置的。
本课程是道路桥梁与渡河工程专业和交通工程专业的一门必修课，是研究工程活动与地质环境之间相互关系的一门学科。本课程的教学目标在于使学生了解交通运输工程中经常遇到的工程地质现象和问题，以及这些现象和问题对工程建筑设计、施工和营用过程中的影响，并能正确处理和合理利用自然地质条件，了解各种工程地质勘察要求和方法，能够正确布置勘察任务、合理利用勘察成果解决设计和施工问题。
default.en: This course is for road and bridge engineering, transportation engineering. The course is a subject to study the relationship between human engineering activities and geological environment. The main contents of this course include: introduction; mineral and rock; geological structure; groundwater; adverse geological phenomena; engineering geological problems; in-situ testing technology; engineering geological investigation; typical case analysis. This course could make students understand the engineering geological phenomena and problems often encountered in engineering construction, and these phenomena and problems of engineering construction design, construction and effect of camp in the process, and to correctly handle and rational use of natural geological conditions, understand the requirements and methods of engineering geological investigation, correctly layout survey the task, reasonable use of survey results solve the problem of design and construction.

default.zh: 本课程是面向交通运输工程学科开设的专业基础课。主要介绍土的组成、土的物理性质及分类、土的渗透性及土中水的渗流、土中应力、变形及强度、土压力及土坡稳定，以及地基承载力。通过课程的学习，使学生能够综合运用先修课程和本课程中所学到的有关知识与技能，为学生进一步学习道路、桥梁和交通工程专业课程和日后从事交通行业的工作打下基础。
default.en: This course is a professional foundation course for the Department of Traffic and Transportation Engineering. It mainly introduces the composition of soil, the physical properties and classification of soil, the permeability of soil and the seepage of water in soil, stress, deformation and strength in soil, earth pressure and soil slope stability, and the bearing capacity of foundation. Through the study of the course, students will be able to apply the relevant knowledge and skills learned in the prerequisite course and this course in a comprehensive manner, and lay the foundation for further study of professional courses in road, bridge and traffic engineering and future careers in the transportation industry.

default.zh: 结构力学是交通运输、土木工程、机械工程、航空航天工程等相关专业的核心课程之一。它主要研究载荷作用下的结构的内部应力、应变和位移的关系，为学生提供了分析和设计各种工程结构所必需的理论基础。结构力学不仅仅是一套理论或数学工具，随着现代工程结构的发展和技术的进步，结构力学的知识在设计、评估和优化复杂结构中起着至关重要的作用。此外，随着计算技术的进步，计算机辅助分析和设计在结构工程中的应用已经变得普遍，本课程的学习将为研究生期间的有限单元法等数值方法的学习，打下坚实理论基础。 结构力学不仅是一个纯理论的学科，它直接关系到工程实践和现实中的问题解决。通过结构力学的学习，学生将掌握基础的计算方法和分析技能，能够应对实际的工程设计、施工和维护中出现的各种问题。此外，结构力学还为学生提供了多种现代计算工具和模拟技术的使用经验，培养他们的实际操作能力和工程判断力，为将来的职业生涯打下坚实的基础。 在结构力学的教学过程中，不仅要求学生掌握固有的理论知识，还要培养他们的创新思维和综合素质。面对复杂的工程问题，学生需要学会独立思考，综合运用所学的知识来寻找最佳的解决方案。此外，结构力学还与其他学科如材料科学、数学、计算机科学等紧密相连，要求学生具备跨学科的学习和研究能力，这将极大地提高他们在工程界和学术界的竞争力。
default.en: Structural Mechanics is one of the core courses in related disciplines such as transportation, civil engineering, mechanical engineering, aerospace engineering, etc. It mainly studies the relationship between internal stress, strain, and displacement of structures under load, providing students with the theoretical foundation necessary for analyzing and designing various engineering structures. Structural Mechanics is not merely a set of theoretical or mathematical tools with the development of modern engineering structures and technological advancements. Knowledge of Structural Mechanics plays a crucial role in the design, assessment, and optimization of complex structures. Furthermore, with the advancement of computational technology, the application of computer-aided analysis and design in structural engineering has become widespread. The study of this course will lay a solid theoretical foundation for learning numerical methods such as the finite element method during graduate studies. Structural Mechanics is not purely theoretical. It directly relates to engineering practice and real-world problem-solving. Through the study of Structural Mechanics, students will acquire fundamental computational methods and analytical skills to address various issues encountered in practical engineering design, construction, and maintenance. Additionally, Structural Mechanics provides students with experience in the use of various modern computational tools and simulation techniques, cultivating their practical skills and engineering judgment, and laying a solid foundation for their future careers. Students are not only required to master the inherent theoretical knowledge but also to develop their innovative thinking and comprehensive abilities. Faced with complex engineering problems, students need to learn to think independently, and integrate their knowledge to find optimal solutions. Moreover, Structural Mechanics is closely linked with other disciplines such as materials science, mathematics, computer science, etc., requiring students to possess interdisciplinary learning and research abilities, which will greatly enhance their competitiveness in both the engineering industry and academia.

default.zh: 本课程是交通运输类专业的专业技术基础课，是学习后续专业课的基础。课程主要介绍土木工程材料的基本理论、基本知识和新型土木工程材料基本组成、生产与配制原理、性质与应用。通过学习，使学生掌握有关土木工程材料的基本理论知识以及主要土木工程材料的组成、性质、应用；了解土木工程材料性质与其组成、结构的关系以及性能改善的途径，了解土木工程材料与设计参数以及施工措施选择的相互关系；并能够合理的选择、使用、运输和储存土木工程材料；为学生今后从事道路桥梁工程与交通工程设计、施工以及道路材料研究奠定基础。 课程内容主要包括绪论、土木工程材料的基本性质、常用石材、气硬性胶凝材料、各种水泥、混凝土、建筑钢材、合成高分子防水材料与改性沥青防水材料、建筑塑料等。 课程考试采用累加式，包括期末考试、作业、课程论文三部分。
default.en: This course is a compulsory course and technical foundation course to the students in the major of Road and Bridge Engineering and Traffic Engineering. The course introduces basic theories and knowledge of construction materials and composition, production principle, performance and applications of new construction materials. By studying this course, students could learn the composition, properties and application of construction materials. Students also could learn the relationship between composition and properties of building materials and the way to improve properties， and the relationship between properties of building materials and design parameters or construction methods. Students could choose, use, transport and store construction materials properly. This course is the base for students’ future career in roads and bridges design, constructions or research of construction materials. The content of the course includes introduction, basic properties of building materials, stones, air hardening binding materials, cement and cement concrete, building steel, synthetic polymer waterproof materials, modified asphalt waterproof materials, construction plastic. The learning evaluation includes final exam, homework and course work.

default.zh: 数据库技术与应用课程从数据库基本概念出发，重点讲解数据库的基本原理和基础知识，包括数据库系统结构、关系模型、关系代数、数据库规范化理论、ER模型等。在讲解上述基础知识的同时，以数据库系统结构为主线，辅以概念数据库设计、逻辑数据库设计、物理数据库设计等设计方法及实例。在数据库管理系统原理方面，重点讲解查询优化技术、并发控制技术、灾难恢复技术及完整性约束规则。在上述内容的讲解过程中，结合大量以数据库查询语言SQL实现的实例。通过实例的学习使学生掌握当前数据库系统中主流查询语言的使用技巧，增强学生的动手能力。 实践环节分为两部分。一部分以讨论课程为主，由授课老师指定数据库领域相关专题，由学生自主完成该领域的研究工作。另一部分为实验学时，通过对数据库的设计、实现等环节的实际操作加深对数据库技术的理解。
default.en: The course Database Technology and Applications starts from the fundamentals of database, especially focuses on basic theories and knowledge, such as database system structure, relational model, relational algebra, database Normal Form system, ER model. Upon these fundamentals, database system structure goes through the whole course, along with conception database design, logical database design, physical database design, and so on. The main parts of database management system are query optimal, parallel control, recovery and complete constraint rules. There are lots of examples, which are realized by SQL, among the explanations during lectures. The target of choosing SQL is to build the ability to use the state of art database management system. In the experimental part, it can be divided into two parts. One part is seminars. The topics are given by the lecturer and students finish the researche. The other part is experimental classes, in which students have to finish the database design and realization.

default.zh: 地理信息系统是一种兼有存储、管理、分析、显示与应用地理信息的计算机系统，是分析和处理海量数据的通用技术。目前，GIS已广泛应用于交通规划、建设、运营、维护等交通运输领域，成为交通信息化工程的关键支撑技术之一。本课程以课堂讲授为主，结合实验教学，达到如下教学目的： 1. 使学生了解地理信息系统的基本概念、研究内容与应用； 2. 使学生理解空间数据的结构及其相互关系，元数据的概念与作用等； 3. 使学生掌握空间数据的采集、编辑及空间信息处理方法，空间数据的分析功能； 4. 使学生了解GIS工程设计方法以及标准化的相关内容 5. 使学生了解GIS的高级技术 6. 使学生掌握地理信息系统软件的应用与基本操作。 7. 为后续专业课程的学习打下坚实的基础
default.en: GIS (geographic information system) is a computer system which has comprehensive functions of storage, management, analysis, display of geographic information. GIS is a universal technology for mass data analysis and processing. GIS has been broadly applied in various transportation areas of planning, construction, operation and maintance, which is one of key technologies for transportation information engineering. The objective is following: 1) Knowing about concept, core content, and application of GIS 2) Understanding structure and relationship of spatial data 3) Grasping technology of collecting ,editing, and spatial analyzing 4) Learning about designing method and standard of GIS engineering 5) Learning about advanced technology of GIS 6) Grasping basic operations on GIS software 7) Laying a solid foundation for the successive courses

default.zh: 测量学A是道路桥梁与渡河专业的一门技术基础课，通过学习本课使学生掌握测量学的基本原理，测量仪器的基本构造及其操作，以及测量学在交通工程中的应用。主要包括水准测量、角度测量、误差理论、控制测量、地形图测绘、道路与桥梁施工测量、全站仪及应用、全球定位系统等内容。使学生具备进行地形图测绘，道路与桥梁勘测及施工测量的能力。是一门理论与实践结合很强的课程。除实验课外，课程结束后安排1周测量实习，要求学生独立完成道路中线测量和纵断面测绘工作。
default.en: Surveying A is a fundamental technical course offered for the majors of roads, bridges. Finishing this course, students will master the basic principles of surveying, structure and operation of surveying instruments, and the surveying application in transportation engineering. The course mainly includes leveling measurement, angle measurement, error theory, control measurement, topographic mapping, road and bridge construction surveying, total station and application, global positioning system, and other contents. After the study, students may have the ability to conduct topographic mapping, road and bridge surveying, and construction surveying. It’s a practical course, which demands a week practice for the route engineering surveys

default.zh: 测量学C是土木工程（建筑工程、土木工程材料）、城市地下空间工程、工程管理专业的一门技术基础课，通过学习本课使学生掌握测量学的基本原理，测量仪器的基本构造及其操作，以及测量学在土木工程施工中的应用。主要包括水准测量、角度测量、控制测量、地形图测绘、建筑工程测量、全站仪及应用等内容。使学生具备进行土木工程测量能力。是一门理论与实践结合很强的课程。除实验课外，课程结束后安排2周测量实习，要求学生独立完成大比例尺地形图测绘和建筑工程施工放样工作。
default.en: Surveying C is a technical foundation course offered for the majors of civil engineering (building engineering, civil engineering materials), urban underground space engineering, and engineering management. Finishing this course, students can master the principles of surveying, the basic structure and operation of surveying instruments, and the surveying application on civil engineering construction. This course mainly includes leveling, angle measurement, control measurement, topographic mapping, construction engineering measurement, total station and application. After the study, students may have the ability to conduct civil engineering surveying. It’s a practical course, which demands a two-week practice on mapping and staking out.

default.zh: 测量实习C是测量学课程教学结束后的一个重要实践教学环节，在测量实习环节中，学生能够将前期所学测量学的基本知识、测量仪器的基本构造及使用方法、测量基本要素的观测和数据处理方法、控制测量、大比例尺地形图测绘、建筑工程测量等测量理论和实践过程系统化，为学生创造理论联系实际的条件，进一步巩固和提高所学测量学的理论知识和测量仪器的基本操作技能，测量实习C对土木工程、城市与地下空间工程专业学生具有重要意义。
default.en: Surveying practice C is an important practical teaching after a survey class. In a surveying practice session, students are able to review and deepen the basic knowledge on learning, such as the elementary contents of surveying, surveying instruments’ structures and uses, the observations of the basic elements, data processing, control surveys, large - scale topography surveying and mapping, construction engineering surveys and systematizing the practice processes. It would create a simulation for students to use proper theories in practices so as to further consolidate and to master the surveying critical knowledge, as well as to improve their skills to operate surveying instruments. Thus, surveying practice C course is necessary for the civil engineering professional educations.

default.zh: 测量学D是给排水科学与工程、环境工程专业的一门技术基础课，通过学习本课使学生掌握测量学的基本原理，测量仪器的基本构造及其操作，以及测量学在土木工程施工中的应用。主要包括水准测量、角度测量、地形图测绘、地形图基本知识等内容。使学生对地形图测绘常识和测设基础知识有所了解。
default.en: Surveying D is a fundamental technical course offered for the majors of Water Supply & Drainage Science Engineering, Environmental Engineering. Finishing this course, students will master the principles of surveying, the basic structure and operation of measuring instruments, and the application of surveying in civil engineering construction. The teaching contents includes leveling, angle measurement, topographic mapping, and basic knowledge of topographic maps. The study enables students to have a preliminary understanding of topographic mapping and basic survey knowledge.

default.zh: 《道路工程材料》是道路桥梁与渡河工程专业本科教学中的一门重要专业基础课。学习本课程旨在使学生掌握沥青混合料的原材料基本组成和性质以及沥青混合料的设计方法和路用性能评价方法，对道路施工材料有一个基本的认识，对培养学生在今后的实际施工中对材料性能的把握、质量的管理与控制有重要作用。该课程为今后学习路基路面工程、道路施工技术、路面结构设计原理等课程打好基础。
default.en: “Pavement Engineering Materials” is a fundamental professional course in the undergraduate curriculum for students majoring in Highway, Bridge, and River-Crossing Engineering. This course is designed to provide students with a comprehensive understanding of the basic composition and properties of asphalt mixture materials, as well as the principles of mixture design and methods for evaluating pavement performance. It offers foundational knowledge of road construction materials and plays a critical role in developing students’ ability to assess material properties, manage quality, and implement effective control strategies in practical construction scenarios. The course also lays the groundwork for advanced studies in subjects such as subgrade and pavement engineering, road construction techniques, and pavement structural design principles.

default.zh: 《道路勘测设计》是道路与渡河工程专业的一门专业核心课程，在该专业的教学计划中占有重要地位和作用。学习本课程旨在使学生掌握道路路线设计的基本理论，道路路线几何设计的基本方法和依据，道路交叉几何设计基本方法和依据，了解《公路工程技术标准》、《公路路线设计规范》和《城市道路设计规范》中线形设计有关标准、制定依据及其应用原则，掌握一种路线设计软件的使用，能独立完成各种地形条件下各种等级道路勘测、设计和放线工作；该课程的学习为学生毕业后从事道路总体设计、路线设计和路线勘察设计打下坚实的基础。今后学习路基路面工程、道路施工技术、路面结构设计原理等课程打好基础。
default.en: Road Survey and Design A" is a major trunk course of road and track engineering, which plays an important role in the teaching plan of this major. This course aims to enable students to master the basic theory of road route design, the basic method and basis of road route geometric design, the basic method and basis of road intersection geometric design, and understand the relevant standards, formulation basis and application principles of alignment design in Highway Engineering Technical Standards, Code for Highway Route Design and Code for Urban Road Design. Master the use of a route design software, can independently complete various grades of road survey, design and alignment under various terrain conditions; The study of this course lays a solid foundation for students to engage in overall road design, route design, plane crossover and three-dimensional crossover design after graduation. The future study of roadbed and pavement engineering, road construction technology, road structure design principles and other courses to lay a good foundation.

default.zh: 实习内容：中等地形难度下的道路一阶段施工图设计，包括现场选线、路线方案选定、定线、测角、中桩、基平、高程、横断面、地形、小桥涵、路线交叉和其他勘测资料的测量、调查及内业设计工作。

该课程旨在为学生提供钢筋混凝土结构设计的基本理论和实践知识。学生将学习如何应用相关设计规范，理解钢筋混凝土结构结构设计原理，并掌握依据规范进行结构设计计算的方法以及构造要求。课程内容包括但不限于以下几个方面： 1. 钢筋混凝土材料与性能：介绍混凝土和钢筋的基本性质，以及它们在结构中的应用。 2. 结构可靠度理论：结构设计可靠性的基本概念，极限状态设计基本原理。 3. 荷载与组合：学习不同类型的荷载以及它们如何影响结构，包括常见的活荷载、静荷载和地震荷载等。 4. 钢筋混凝土结构基本构件设计方法，包括：受弯构件正截面/斜截面强度、受压构件和偏压构件正截面强度设计、受扭构件截面设计、深受弯构件正截面强度设计等；以及基本构件正常使用极限状态设计等。 5. 计算工具与软件应用：介绍常用的结构设计软件，培养学生使用计算工具进行结构分析和设计的能力。 6. 结构施工与质量控制：简要介绍结构施工的基本原理，以及如何确保结构质量符合设计要求。 通过本课程的学习，学生将能够理解和应用钢筋混凝土结构设计的基本原理，具备进行结构设计和分析的基本技能，为未来从事相关工程领域的工作奠定坚实的基础。
default.en: The course aims to provide students with fundamental theories and practical knowledge of reinforced concrete structure design. Students will learn how to apply relevant design codes, understand the principles of reinforced concrete structure design, and master the methods of structural design calculations and construction requirements according to the codes. The course covers but is not limited to the following aspects: 1. Reinforced Concrete Materials and Properties: Introduction to the basic properties of concrete and steel reinforcement, as well as their applications in structures. 2. Structural Reliability Theory:Basic concepts of structural design reliability and the principles of limit state design. 3. Loads and Combinations:Study of different types of loads and how they affect structures, including common live loads, dead loads, and seismic loads. 4. Basic Design Methods for Reinforced Concrete Structural Components: Including the design of bending members in positive/negative sections and inclined sections, strength design of compressed members and eccentrically loaded members, section design of torsional members, strength design of deep bending members, and normal service limit state design of basic components. 5. Calculation Tools and Software Applications:Introduction to commonly used structural design software, fostering students' ability to use computational tools for structural analysis and design. 6. Structural Construction and Quality Control: Brief introduction to the basic principles of structural construction and how to ensure that the structural quality meets design requirements. Through the study of this course, students will be able to understand and apply the fundamental principles of reinforced concrete structure design, possessing essential skills for structural design and analysis, laying a solid foundation for future work in related engineering fields.

default.zh: 《交通力学》是面向交通运输工程、土木工程、水利科学与工程等专业本科生开设的重要专业基础课，课程系统讲授简单构件的受力分析、内力与变形计算、强度与刚度校核等静力学与材料力学核心内容，并引入车辆动力学基础（包括本构关系、1/4车辆模型等），帮助学生理解车辆行驶过程中的力学响应规律，掌握工程设计中强度建模与分析的基本思路。课程共48学时，涵盖从静力学公理、平面与空间力系、轴向拉压、扭转、弯曲内力与应力、弯曲变形、应力状态分析与强度理论，到组合变形及车路耦合动力学分析等完整知识体系，旨在培养学生对简单构件及车辆-道路系统进行正确受力分析、应力与位移计算、强度与刚度校核的能力，并能够将实际工程问题合理简化为力学模型。通过理论讲授、工程案例分析与课后计算训练相结合的方式，课程注重逻辑思维与工程计算能力的培养，强化严谨求实的科学态度与规范意识，同时依托我国交通工程实践案例增强学生的专业使命感与社会责任感。课程目标与工程教育认证标准中的工程知识、问题分析、研究能力、工程与社会、环境与可持续发展、职业规范及终身学习等毕业要求紧密对接，为后续专业课程学习及工程设计与科研实践奠定坚实基础。
default.en: Traffic Mechanics is a vital foundational professional course for undergraduate students majoring in Transportation Engineering, Civil Engineering, Hydraulic Science and Engineering, and other related disciplines. This course systematically delivers core content of statics and mechanics of materials, including force analysis of simple structural members, calculation of internal forces and deformations, as well as strength and stiffness verification. It also introduces fundamentals of vehicle dynamics (such as constitutive relations and the quarter-car model), enabling students to grasp mechanical response patterns during vehicle operation and master fundamental frameworks for strength modeling and analysis in engineering design. Taught over 48 class hours, the curriculum forms a complete knowledge system spanning statics axioms, planar and spatial force systems, axial tension and compression, torsion, internal forces and stresses of bending beams, bending deformation, stress state analysis and strength theories, combined deformations, and vehicle-road coupled dynamic analysis. The course targets the cultivation of students’ competencies: performing accurate force analysis, stress and displacement computation, and strength-stiffness checks for simple components and vehicle-road systems, alongside the capability to rationally simplify practical engineering challenges into mechanical models. Integrating theoretical lectures, engineering case studies and after-class computational exercises, the course prioritizes the development of logical thinking and engineering calculation proficiency, fostering a rigorous, pragmatic scientific mindset and standardized operational awareness. Drawing on domestic transportation engineering practices in China, it also strengthens students’ professional mission and sense of social responsibility. Aligned closely with the graduate outcomes specified in engineering education accreditation criteria—covering engineering knowledge, problem analysis, research capabilities, engineering-society interactions, environmental sustainability, professional ethics, and lifelong learning—the course lays a solid theoretical groundwork for subsequent specialized coursework, engineering design work, and scientific research practices.

default.zh: 《交通工程基础》是交通设备与控制工程专业学生的技术基础课程。该课程以道路交通基本特性为研究对象，主要讲解道路交通的基本理论和研究方法。通过本课程的学习，使学生掌握道路、车辆、人的有关交通特性，交通三参数(车速、流量、密度)特性及其它们的相互关系，描述交通流及其特性的基本理论、模型和方法，交通流及其有关现象的交通数据的调查与分析方法等。
default.en: This course is the basic course of traffic equipment and control to prepare for follow-up professional study. It regards basic characteristics of the road traffic as the research object, explain the basic theories and research approach of the road traffic engineering. Through the study of this course, students could grasp the basic traffic characteristics of road, vehicle and person, the three basic traffic parameters ( speed, volume and density ) and the correlation of each others, the method, model and the basic theory of traffic flow, the investigate methods of traffic relevant phenomenon and basic theories and methods of traffic management and control.

default.zh: 运输经济学是经济学的一个分支，它是以经济学的理论和分析方法，探讨与交通有关的各种问题的一门学科。本课程主要结合近年来国内外交通运输经济学的最新进展，从交通运输需求、交通运输成本、运价原理、交通方式选择、运输市场、交通经济政策、交通项目工程经济分析等七部分开展授课。 课程目标为：通过课堂启发式教学与课后阅读材料相结合，使学生能够熟练地运用经济理论与方法，与工程项目实践紧密联系，研究如何有效地在交通运输和其他经济活动之间分配资源，科学地认识交通发展和运作中的内在经济规律，掌握交通中经济问题的理论知识，提出可行的交通经济政策发展建议。为学习后续的专业课程创造良好的先决条件，为本专业知识的掌握，独立工作能力的培养，打下坚实的基础。
default.en: Transportation economics is a branch of economics. It is a discipline that discusses various problems related to transportation with the theory and analysis methods of economics. This course mainly combines the latest development of transportation economics at home and abroad in recent years, and carries out lectures in seven parts: transportation demand, transportation cost, price principle, transportation mode selection, transportation market, transportation economic policy, and transportation project economic analysis. The course objectives are: Through the combination of classroom heuristic teaching and after-class reading materials, students can proficiently apply economic theories and methods, closely connect with engineering project practice, study how to effectively allocate resources between transportation and other economic activities, scientifically understand the internal economic laws in the development and operation of transportation, and master the theoretical knowledge of economic issues in transportation. To put forward feasible suggestions for the development of transport economic policies. To create a good prerequisite for the study of subsequent professional courses, for the master of this professional knowledge, independent work ability training, lay a solid foundation.

default.zh: 数据结构与算法是面向计算机专业和交叉学科的一门重要基础课程，也是介于数学、计算机硬件和计算机软件三者之间的核心课程。数据结构这一门课的内容不仅是一般程序设计（特别是非数值性程序设计）的基础，而且是需要应用计算机进行信息表示和处理的专业基础课。通过课堂教学、课外练习和上机实习，使学生理解和掌握各种数据结构（物理结构和逻辑结构）的概念及其相关的算法。 （1）熟悉并了解目前常用数据结构在计算机和交通信息学科中的基本应用，学习线性表、堆栈、数组、树形结构、图形结构等多种典型数据结构，尤其是深入理解图形结构和图论在交通路网可达性、最短路径求解等多个关键领域的应用，掌握基于图形结构为交通路网建模的基本方法。 （2）要求学生从算法和数据结构的相互依存关系中掌握算法设计的思想和基本技能，能对给定的交通学科实际问题，建立准确的问题模型，设计有效的问题求解方法，选择合理的数据结构及其运算集，设计有效的算法。经过上机实习和课程设计的训练，使学生能够编制简单程序，将所学到的知识付诸实现。
default.en: Data structure and algorithm is an important basic course for computer specialty and interdisciplinary subject, and also a core course between mathematics, computer hardware and computer software. The content of data structure is not only the basis of general programming (especially non-numerical programming), but also the specialized basic course of information representation and processing by computer. Through classroom teaching, extra-curricular exercises and computer practice, students can understand and master the concepts of various data structures (physical and logical structures) and related algorithms. (1) Familiar with and understand the basic application of data structures in computer and traffic information disciplines. Learn many typical data structures, such as linear tables, stacks, arrays, tree structures, graph structures, etc. Especially, deeply understand the application of graph structure and graph theory in many key areas such as traffic network accessibility, shortest path solution, and master the application of graph structure as traffic route. The basic method of network modeling. (2) Students are required to master the idea and basic skills of algorithm design from the interdependence between algorithm and data structure. They can build accurate problem models, design effective problem solving methods, select reasonable data structure and its operation set, and design effective algorithms for a given practical traffic problem. Through the training of computer practice and curriculum design, students can compile simple programs and put the knowledge they have learned into practice.

default.zh: 运筹学是管理类各专业的专业基础课，主要介绍一些优化分析方法和实用运筹学模型，为后续课程奠定数量分析的基础理论方法。本课程主要内容包括：线性规划原理及方法；对偶理论；运输问题；整数规划及0-1规划，涵盖运筹学的主要分支。通过本课程的学习，使学生能够掌握运筹学的一些主要理论和方法，培养学生能运用模型来研究解决管理中实际问题的能力。
default.en: Operations Research is the specialized basic course in all managerial majors, which is designed to introduce some methods of optimization analysis and some practical models to the students. It helps the students to lay a good theoretical foundation of quantitative analysis for their successive courses. And it covers the main branches of operations research, i.e. linear programming principle and method, dual theory, transportation problem, integer programming and 0-1 programming. Through the study of this course, the students are aimed to master some primary theories and methods of operations research and are taught to apply them to solve the practical management problems.

default.zh: 本课程主要学习确知信号及线性时不变系统的特性及分析方法，。具体内容包括信号与系统的基本概念、理论及特性；连续离散信号与系统的时域、频域、复频域及Z域分析；状态变量分析；信号与系统分析方法在滤波、通信等领域的应用以及仿真实验。 通过本课程的学习，使学生理解信号与系统的物理概念、掌握信号与系统的分析方法，了解信号与系统的应用。重点理解掌握各种信号的描述及其时域特性、频率特征，系统的数学模型以及线性时不变系统的时域分析、频域分析，状态变量分析的方法。初步具备应用信号与系统的观点和方法处理实际问题的能力，为进一步学习后续课程和今后参加工作奠定坚实的基础。
default.en: This course mainly deals with the characteristic and analysis theory of certain signal and LTI system. The contents mainly include the basic concept and theories of the signal and system; the time domain/ frequency domain/ S domain/ Z domain analysis of continuous/discrete signals and systems; application in filter and communication field; simulation experiment etc. By study this course, students could understand the physical concepts of signals and systems, master the analysis methods for signals and systems, and understand the applications of signals and systems. Students should emphasis on the understanding and mastery of the description of various signals and their characteristic of time/frequency domain; mathematic model of systems and the analysis theories in time/frequency domain and state variable analysis methods. The course requests students understand above-mentioned various analysis method have the ability of concrete application to solve practical problem.

default.zh: 自动控制原理是交通学院开设的一门重要课程，旨在使学生掌握自动控制系统的基本理论和设计方法，培养学生在交通领域的自动控制技术应用能力。通过本课程的学习，学生将了解自动控制系统的基本原理、系统分析方法以及设计技巧，为后续专业课程的学习和工程实践打下坚实的基础。 课程内容主要包括：介绍自动控制系统的定义、组成及分类，让学生了解自动控制的基本原理和应用范围；学习如何建立控制系统的数学模型，包括传递函数、状态空间描述等，为后续分析与设计奠定基础；分析控制系统的动态性能，包括稳定性、快速性和准确性等，掌握时域性能指标的计算方法；介绍控制系统的频域特性，学习如何通过频域分析评估系统的性能，并理解频域与时域之间的关系；学习控制系统的设计方法，包括串联校正、反馈校正等，掌握如何调整系统参数以改善性能；了解现代控制理论的发展概况，包括状态空间描述、自适应控制、鲁棒控制等，为深入研究提供思路。 本课程采用课堂讲授、案例分析、仿真实验等多种教学方法，以增强学生的实践能力和对交通特色的理解。自动控制原理课程结合交通特色，不仅使学生掌握了自动控制系统的基本理论和设计方法，还培养了学生在交通领域中的实际应用能力。通过本课程的学习，学生能够深入理解交通系统的运行规律，掌握自动控制技术在交通领域中的关键技术，为未来的交通工程设计和智能交通系统研发提供有力支持。 本课程的考核与评价将注重理论与实践相结合，全面评价学生的学习成果。考核方式包括平时成绩、仿真实验成绩和期末考试等。平时成绩将根据学生的课堂表现、作业完成情况和参与度进行评定；仿真实验成绩将根据学生的实验操作能力和实验报告质量进行评价；期末考试则将对学生在整个课程中的学习成果进行全面检验。
default.en: The course of Automatic Control Principles, offered by the School of Transportation, is a significant course aimed at equipping students with fundamental theories and design methods of automatic control systems, fostering students' application abilities in automatic control technology within the field of transportation. Through the study of this course, students will comprehend the basic principles, system analysis methods, and design techniques of automatic control systems, laying a solid foundation for further specialized courses and engineering practices. The content of the course mainly includes: Introduction to the definition, components, and classification of automatic control systems, enabling students to understand the basic principles and application scope of automatic control: Learning how to establish mathematical models of control systems, including transfer functions, state-space descriptions, etc., laying the foundation for subsequent analysis and design; Analyzing the dynamic performance of control systems, including stability, speed, accuracy, etc., mastering the calculation methods of time-domain performance indicators; Introducing the frequency-domain characteristics of control systems, learning how to evaluate system performance through frequency-domain analysis, and understanding the relationship between frequency domain and time domain; Learning control system design methods, including series correction, feedback correction, etc., mastering how to adjust system parameters to improve performance; Understanding the development overview of modern control theory, including state-space description, adaptive control, robust control, etc., providing ideas for in-depth research; The course adopts various teaching methods such as classroom teaching, case analysis, simulation experiments, etc., to enhance students' practical abilities and understanding of transportation characteristics. By combining with the characteristics of transportation, the Automatic Control Principles course not only enables students to master the basic theories and design methods of automatic control systems but also cultivates practical application abilities in the field of transportation. Through the study of this course, students can deeply understand the operating laws of transportation systems, master the key technologies of automatic control in the field of transportation, and provide strong support for future transportation engineering design and intelligent transportation system development. The assessment and evaluation of this course will focus on the combination of theory and practice, comprehensively evaluating students' learning outcomes. Assessment methods include routine grades, simulation experiment scores, and final exams. Routine grades will be evaluated based on students' classroom performance, completion of assignments, and participation. Simulation experiment scores will be evaluated based on students' experimental operation abilities and the quality of experimental reports. The final exam will comprehensively examine students' learning outcomes throughout the course.

default.zh: 《路基路面工程A》是道路桥梁与渡河工程专业（桥梁工程方向）的专业核心课程，以路基工程和路面工程的设计原则、方法及理论为主体，通过较系统的理论学习，旨在培养本科生具备从事路基工程和路面工程设计的理论基础、专业知识、专业技能、创新思维和综合素养。 课程以路基工程和路面工程的设计理论与方法为主体，通过较系统的理论学习，使学生掌握路基路面工程的基本原理与方法，建立相应的知识体系。包括：掌握路基路面工程的基本特点和性能要求，能够分析路基路面工程破坏的主要机理，理解自然环境和交通荷载对路基路面的影响规律，掌握一般路基设计、路基边坡稳定性设计、路基防护与加固、挡土墙设计、路基排水设计、沥青路面结构设计、水泥混凝土路面结构设计与桥面铺装设计的基本原则、方法和主要内容，了解路基路面施工概况。引导学生认识路基路面工程的地域性、系统性、不确定性等特征，具有因地制宜选择路基路面工程技术的初步能力，具有理论联系实际及综合分析一般工程实际问题的能力；具有运用行业标准、规范、相关技术资料和专用软件进行路基路面结构设计的能力。立足翻转课堂和师生互动，培育现代路基路面工程思维，培育现代技术人员应具有的写作表达、综合集成、科研创新、团队协作等素养。 课程采用累加式考核方法，包括平时测试、项目学习、翻转课堂和期末笔试。
default.en: " Road Subgrade and Pavement Engineering A" is a Road engineering and Bridge Engineering (bridge engineering direction) professional core courses, the design principle and method of subgrade and pavement engineering and theory as the main body, through systematic theoretical study, aims at cultivating the undergraduates have engaged in road base engineering and pavement engineering design theory, professional knowledge professional skills, creative thinking and comprehensive qualities. The course takes the design theory and method of subgrade engineering and pavement engineering as the main body, through the systematic theory study, enable students to master the basic principles and methods of subgrade and pavement engineering, and establish the corresponding knowledge system. Including: master the basic features and performance requirements of subgrade and pavement engineering, to analyze the main failure mechanism of subgrade and pavement engineering, understand the influence of natural environment and traffic load on the subgrade pavement, master general roadbed design, subgrade slope stability design, subgrade protection and reinforcement, retaining wall design, subgrade drainage design, structural design of asphalt pavement, the structure design of cement concrete pavement and bridge deck pavement design principle, method and main content, understand the situation of roadbed construction. To guide students to understand the roadbed project regional, systematic, uncertainties and other characteristics, has the ability to select the initial pavement subgrade engineering technology, has the ability to integrate theory with practice and comprehensive analysis of the general engineering actual problem; ability to have the subgrade pavement structure design using industry standards, regulations and relevant technical data and special software. Based on the flipped classroom and the interaction between teachers and students, the thinking of modern subgrade and pavement engineering is cultivated, and the writing, expression, integration, scientific research innovation and team cooperation of modern technical personnel should be cultivated. The course adopts the cumulative assessment method, including the usual test, project learning, flipped classroom and final written examination.

default.zh: 本课程是道路桥梁与渡河工程专业的一门必修课。通过实践教学环节为学生提供理论联系实际的机会，加深其对路基土的基本物理力学性质了解，掌握粒度成分分析、液塑限测试、压缩试验、剪切试验、含水量测试、击实试验、CBR试验和渗透系数试验的目的、试验设计方法和原则、测量方法；熟练掌握比重计、锥式液限仪、固结仪、直剪仪、击实仪、CBR仪、渗透系数仪等设备的性能和操作方法。目的在于培养学生分析解决问题能力和动手能力，使其掌握专业相关基本实践技能，养成严谨求实的实验精神，为其今后的从事相关工作奠定基础。
default.en: This course is a required course for the students of road and bridge engineering. The main contents are as follows: particle distribution analysis, liquid limit and plastic limit test, consolidation test, direct shear test, soil moisture test, soil compaction test, CBR test and soil permeability coefficient test. These practice and opportunities for students could enhance their understanding of the basic physical and mechanical properties of subgrade soil, and help them to know the method and principle of measuring methods and equipment. It could cultivate students' ability to analyze and solve problems and practical skills, enable them to master professional related basic practical skills, and develop rigorous and realistic spirit of experiment, laying the foundation for their future related work.

default.zh: 本课程是道路桥梁与渡河工程专业的一门专业课。主要内容为：集料筛分试验、集料表观密度试验、混合料配合比设计、沥青混合料马歇尔试件制备、沥青混合料马歇尔指标测试、沥青三大指标试验（针入度、延度、软化点）。通过实践教学环节为学生提供理论联系实际的机会，加深其对沥青及沥青混合料材料组成、结构和性能间相互关系的理解和认识，掌握集料及沥青性能的测试及评价方法，熟练掌握沥青混合料的配合比设计过程及方法，熟练掌握有关仪器设备的性能和操作方法。通过本门课程，培养学生分析解决问题的能力，养成严谨求实的实验精神，为今后从事相关工作奠定基础。
default.en: Course Description: The course is a professional course for Road Bridge and River-crossing Engineering. Main course contents are: aggregate screening test, aggregate apparent density test, asphalt mixture proportion design, preparation of Marshall specimen, Marshall test of asphalt mixture, three major indexes tests of asphalt (penetration, ductility and softening point). By providing the chance for students to improve their theory knowledge with practice, it’s to enhance their understanding on the relationship of material components, material structure and performance of asphalt and asphalt mixture, to master performance tests and evaluating method of aggregate and asphalt, to have a good command of proportion design process and method of asphalt mixture, and to grasp performance and operation method of the instrument concerned. Through the course, it’s to train students on the ability of problem analysis and solving, and improve rigorous experiment spirit, to incept the foundation for relevant work in the future.

default.zh: 《结构设计原理（2）A》以预应力混凝土构件作为基本研究对象，紧密结合现行规范，系统介绍了预应力混凝土结构设计的基本原理和方法，重点阐述了预应力损失的计算、预应力混凝土结构持久状况承载能力极限状态与正常使用极限状态的计算、持久状况和短暂状况构件的应力验算。其中，常见的预应力损失包括六项，即摩擦损失、锚具变形损失、混凝土弹性压缩损失、钢筋应力松弛损失与混凝土收缩徐变损失；针对受弯构件，持久状况承载能力极限状态计算包括正截面承载力计算与斜截面承载力计算，持久状况正常使用极限状态计算包括抗裂性、裂缝宽度（部分预应力混凝土B类构件）以及变形计算；应力验算包括全预应力混凝土及部分预应力混凝土A类构件使用阶段的应力验算、部分预应力混凝土B类构件开裂后的应力验算、预应力混凝土受弯构件短暂状况应力验算。最后，以预应力混凝土简支梁为例，详细论述了预应力混凝土结构设计的主要内容和计算步骤，包括截面设计、配筋设计以及各种状态的承载能力计算与应力验算。
default.en: Philosophy of Structural Design （2）A in prestressed concrete members as a fundamental object of study, combining the current specification, systematically introduces the basic principles and methods of the design of prestressed concrete structure, focused on the calculation of prestress losses, prestressed concrete structure persistent situation ultimate limit states and serviceability limit states, persistent and short situations stress checking of components. Among them, the prestress losses includes six items, that is loss of the friction, loss of the anchorage deformation, loss of elastic compression of concrete, loss of stress relaxation, loss of creep and shrinkage of concrete; for flexural members, the calculation of persistent situation ultimate limit states includes the normal section bearing capacity and inclined section bearing capacity, the calculation of persistent situation serviceability limit states includes the calculation of cracking resistance, crack width (partial prestressed concrete class B component) and deformations. The stress checking includes the stress checking of fully prestressed concrete in the use stag, partial prestressed concrete class A component in the use stage, partial prestressed concrete class B component after cracking, short situation of flexural prestressed concrete. Finally, a case study of prestressed simply supported beam, the design of main contents and calculated steps of prestressed concrete structure are described in detail, including the design of cross-sectional, reinforcement design, stress checking and calculation of bearing capacity in various states.

default.zh: 《结构设计原理（2）B》以预应力混凝土构件作为基本研究对象，紧密结合现行规范，系统介绍了预应力混凝土结构设计的基本原理和方法，重点阐述了预应力损失的计算、预应力混凝土结构持久状况承载能力极限状态与正常使用极限状态的计算、持久状况和短暂状况构件的应力验算、钢结构设计方法、钢材基本性能、钢桥疲劳设计方法、钢结构连接以及轴心受力构件。
default.en: "Philosophy of Structural Design （2）B" takes prestressed concrete components as the main research object, closely integrating with current standards, systematically introduces the basic principles and methods of prestressed concrete structure design, and focuses on elaborating the calculation of prestress loss, the calculation of the ultimate state and serviceability limit state of the durability of prestressed concrete structures, the stress verification of components in both the long-term and short-term conditions, the design methods for steel structures, the basic properties of steel, the fatigue design methods for steel bridges, the connections of steel structures, and the steel trusses.

default.zh: 本课程主要讲授桥梁工程的基本概念、功能以及国内外发展概况，通过对工程上常用的梁桥、拱桥、斜拉桥、悬索桥等典型桥梁结构形式的讲解，使学生掌握各类常用桥梁结构形式的特点、力学原理、构造以及设计建造方法。通过本课程的学习，使学生了解桥梁工程的基本内涵、国内外的发展趋势以及主要的技术等知识，形成从事工程管理的职业规范和项目管理的基本能力和素质。
default.en: This course mainly teaches the basic concepts, functions and development overview of bridge engineering at home and abroad. Through the explanation of typical bridge structural forms commonly used in engineering, such as beam bridge, arch bridge, cable-stayed bridge and suspension bridge, students can master the characteristics, mechanical principles, structure and design and construction methods of various common bridge structural forms. Through the study of this course, students can understand the basic connotation of bridge engineering, the development trend at home and abroad, the main technology and other knowledge, and form the professional norms engaged in engineering management and the basic ability and quality of project management.

default.zh: 本课属于专业基础课，主要讲述桥涵水文的基本知识和常用的桥涵水文计算方法。本课通过课堂教学、完成作业等教学环节使学生掌握桥梁涵洞水文学的基本概念、计算原理、施工要求，能够计算大中桥的设计洪峰流量、小桥的设计洪峰流量、大中桥桥孔跨径长度、桥面标高、桥位处的冲刷深度、以及基础埋深。通过本课程的学习，使学生对桥涵水文计算加深理解，培养学生对于工程结构物设计的科学方法，并使得学生提高解决工程实际问题的综合能力。
default.en: This course belongs to professional basic courses, mainly about the bridge culvert basic knowledge of hydrology and bridges and culverts commonly used hydrologic and hydraulic calculation methods. This course through classroom teaching, homework and other educational links to enable students to master the bridges and culverts the basic concepts of hydrology, calculation principles, construction requirements, to calculate the design peak flow of large and medium bridges, bridge design peak flow of large and medium bridges cross-bridge opening Path length, deck elevation, the bridge is located at the scour depth, as well as the foundation depth. Through this course of study, so that students of the bridge culvert to deepen understanding of hydrologic and hydraulic calculations, to develop students in engineering structures design of the scientific method, and to enable students to solve practical engineering problems to improve the comprehensive capacity.

default.zh: 结构设计原理（3）是桥梁工程方向学生重要的专业基础课，是学习后续专业课如钢桥、桥梁工程等课程的基础，在培养学生桥梁结构整体分析能力、综合设计能力等方面占有重要地位。 本课程主要讲授钢结构桥梁、钢-混凝土组合梁桥、钢管混凝土拱桥的结构特点、构件基本形式和设计原理，使学生能深入了解掌握基本构件受力特点及设计方法。内容包括钢材基本力学性能，钢材疲劳，连接设计，构件压、弯设计，强度与稳定；组合结构构造特点及共同工作原理，截面设计，稳定分析，挠度与裂缝计算，温度应力分析，收缩与徐变，剪力键；钢管混凝土轴心受力及偏压构件的基本力学性能、强度及稳定设计等。 通过课堂教学、课后作业等环节着重培养学生桥梁结构的结构分析与设计能力，提升学生专业知识运用能力，增加创新意识。
default.en: Principle of Structural Design (3) is one of the most important courses to all the students in Bridge Engineering Department, which is a foundation knowledge of the later specialty lessons such as Design of Steel Bridge, Bridge Engineering. It is helpful to cultivate students’ ability of structural analysis and designing. Principle of Structural Design (3) mainly introduces structural characteristic of steel bridge, composite bridge and concrete filled steel tube arch bridge, member’s design, basic principle. It includes the following knowledge: basic behavior of steel, steel fatigue, connecting design, steel member’s compressing and bending design, strength and stability; cooperation principle of composite structure, section design, stability calculation, deflection and crack analysis, temperature stress analysis, shrink and creep, design of shear resistant key; behavior of axial loading concrete filled steel tube, it’s strength and stability design. After finishing the lesson, students would know the theoretical foundation, advanced tendency and applications of the above structures, be familiar to the basic designing and analyzing methods of the ordinary structural members, and have the ability of innovation.

default.zh: 物理化学是一门重要的基础课程，是一门难教、难学的课程，是物理学与化学最早相互渗透的一门交叉的边缘学科，是材料、化学及化工、生物、医学等学科的理论基础，被称为“理论化学”、“化学的灵魂”。因此，该课程对学生明晰道路材料的物理化学本质，深刻理解专业内涵具有重要的意义，对培养学生创造能力，提高学生素质有极其重要的作用。旨在使学生在先行课程基础上，运用物理和数学的有关理论与方法，研究中物质化学运动的普遍规律，从理论上给予更深刻、更本质的说明，是化学、材料相关专业研究生入学的必考课程。
default.en: 1. Physical chemistry is a crucial foundational course that poses challenges in both teaching and learning. It serves as an interdisciplinary bridge between physics and chemistry, where the two fields converge. This subject forms the theoretical basis for materials science, chemistry, chemical engineering, biology, medicine, and other disciplines. It is widely recognized as "theoretical chemistry" and "the essence of chemical studies." Consequently, this course holds immense significance in enabling students to comprehend the physical and chemical properties of road materials while gaining a deep understanding of their professional implications. Moreover, it plays a pivotal role in fostering students' creativity and enhancing their overall quality. The primary objective is to equip students with the necessary theories and methodologies from physics and mathematics to explore the fundamental laws governing chemical reactions more comprehensively and profoundly than previous courses have allowed. As such, it stands as a compulsory requirement for graduate programs in chemistry or related fields.

default.zh: 本课程是道路桥梁与渡河工程专业（道路材料工程方向）本科生的基础课，内容涉及道路材料工程材料后续课程中最具共性的基础知识，主要介绍材料科学的基础理论和普遍规律，内容包括原子的键合、不同材料的晶体结构、材料中的缺陷、材料中的原子运动、材料的形变、相变过程和固相反应、相图等内容。通过这一课程的学习，使学生掌握材料科学的基础科学理论，理解材料的组成、结构和性能的关系，阐明相关材料形成过程的本质，阐述如何应用基础理论来解决生产实际问题，为生产、研究和开发新材料提供理论依据。
default.en: The course of Foundations of Materials Science is an elementary course for students in the major of Roads, Bridges and River Cross Engineering (Road Materials). This course mainly introduces basic theories and common rules of materials to students, including interatomic bonding, crystal structure of different materials, deficiency, diffusion, deformation of materials, solidifying of materials and phase diagram, phase transformation and solid phase reaction.
