Students could learn the basic scientific theories of materials and the nature of forming process of materials, and they also could learn how to apply these theories to solve the problems in production, research or development of materials.

default.zh: 本课程是道路桥梁与渡河工程专业（道路材料工程方向）学生的专业基础课。本课程的教学目的在于使学生掌握无机材料的力学性能（理论强度、断裂、变形、纤维增强增韧）、热学性能、光学性能、电学性能、磁学性能的各种基本概念，以及各种基本性能的原理与微观机制，并了解无机材料结构与性能的关系、控制和改善各种性能的措施。通过本课程的学习，使学生了解并掌握无机材料性能的基本概念，以及主要的应用及质量控制方法，为学生今后从事道路材料设计，以及功能材料研究奠定基础。
default.en: This course is a specialized core course for the students of road and bridge engineering major. The main content of this course is an introduction to the materials properties, including mechanical properties（theoretical strength，fracture，deformation，fiber reinforced）, thermal properties, optical properties and electrical properties. This course also gives a basic introduction to the theories and mechanisms on the relationship between the microstructure and properties, and the methods how to improve and control the final properties of inorganic materials.

default.zh: 《混凝土材料科学》是道路桥梁与渡河工程专业(道路材料工程方向) 的一门专业课程，主要介绍普通水泥混凝土的主要原材料及其作用，新拌混凝土的工作性、混凝土的微观与宏观结构、混凝土变形（自收缩、干缩、温度变形）、混凝土耐久性（抗冻性、抗化学侵蚀、碱集料反应）、力学性能（强度理论、断裂、徐变）等的基本要求、机理、影响因素、模型及评估以及混凝土配合比设计基本原则与理论，为学生进一步学习相关专业课程和日后从事混凝土材料研究、生产、施工和应用奠定基础。
default.en: This course is a specialized core course for the students of road and bridge engineering major. It is mainly to introduce raw materials of ordinary cement concrete and their functions to students, as well as the requirements, theories, influence factors, models and assessment of fresh concrete workability, micro and macro structures, concrete deformation (self-shrinkage, drying shrinkage, carbonized shrinkage and temperature deformation), durability (frost resistance, carbonization，resistance to chemical attack, alkali-aggregate reaction and reinforcement corrosion), and mechanic performance (strength theory, fracture and creep). Mix design theory of ordinary concrete and several special concretes are also introduced in this course. Students could learn the basic knowledge and skills for design and use new materials in roads and bridges field.

default.zh: 《道路复合材料》课程为道路桥梁与渡河工程专业（材料方向）本科生课程。本课程结合道路材料、土建材料等工程材料的应用实例介绍了复合材料的基础知识，包括复合材料概述、复合材料基体、复合材料增强体、水泥基复合材料、聚合物基复合材料，并从复合理论、界面理论出发，介绍了以水泥基复合材料和聚合物基复合材料为主的道路复合材料的设计基础。
default.en: The course "Composite Materials for Road" is a course for undergraduates majoring in Road Bridge and river crossing engineering (material direction). This course introduces the basic knowledge of composite materials in combination with application examples of engineering materials such as road materials and civil materials, including overview of composite materials, composite matrix, composite reinforcement, cement-based composite materials and polymer-based composite materials, and starts from composite theory and interface theory. This paper introduces the design basis of road composite materials, which mainly consists of cement-based composite materials and polymer-based composite materials.

default.zh: 本课程为道路桥梁与渡河工程专业道路材料工程方向的一门核心专业课，是材料学专业学生的主干课、必修课，也适合土建类其他专业学生。主要讲述有关混凝土施工技术、制品生产技术、性能检验与评价方面的专业课，主要向学生介绍现代混凝土的施工过程与施工技术、常用制品的生产技术、混凝土工程质量的检验与评价、预应力混凝土技术、活性粉末混凝土、高性能混凝土等。通过该课程的学习，使学生掌握常用混凝土的生产与施工工艺技术等，掌握各种施工对混凝土性能的影响，为学生今后从事该方向的研究、开发和应用奠定基础。课程内容主要包括模板工程、钢筋工程、计量与搅拌、混凝土的密实成型工艺、混凝土的养护与质量检查、预应力混凝土、活性粉末混凝土、超高性能混凝土、高性能混凝土、自密实混凝土、快速修补材料、冬季施工混凝土、磷酸镁水泥等。
default.en: This course is a specialized core course for the students of road and bridge engineering major. It is also suitable for other students of civil engineering major. The main content of this course is an introduction to the concrete technology, including formwork engineering, reinforcement engineering, measuring and mixing engineering, manufacturing technique of ordinary and special type of concrete, testing and evaluation for concrete engineering, prestressed concrete technology, reactive powder concrete, ultra-high performance concrete, high performance concrete, self-compacting concrete, rapid repaired materials, winter- construction concrete, and Magnesium Phosphate cement concrete, etc. Through the course, the students can get a general comprehension to the production and construction technology of concrete, as well as the effect of construction on concrete properties. The students will have the ability to do corresponding researches and work on new type of cement concrete. The learning evaluation includes final exam, course work and test course.

default.zh: 本课程内容包括材料基本性质实验、水泥性能测试、骨料级配测试等验证性实验，和普通混凝土配合比设计、路用混凝土配合比设计、大流动性混凝土配合比设计等综合性设计型试验。通过对原材料各项性质的测试，得到主要性能参数，进而完成配合比的初步计算、试配过程，并测试抗压强度等力学性能。其中，对于大流动性混凝土配合比设计，要求学生自主选择原材料，完成设计和试配过程，以各小组间的竞赛方式进行，从而提高学生学习的主动性和创造性。
default.en: The course of Proportion Design of Cement Concrete mainly gives lab classes about replication experiments, such as basic properties test of materials, test of cement properties and grading test of aggregates, and comprehensive design experiments, including proportions design of ordinary concrete, pavement concrete and flowable concrete. Students could learn test methods and experiment skills, and they could also learn the calculation of proportions, mixture process and obtain data of materials properties. For the flowable concrete, students have opportunity to choose raw materials, finish the proportions and mix it by themselves, which is carried out as a competition between different groups to improve students’ initiative and creative.

default.zh: 《路用基层与透水材料设计试验》课程是道路桥梁与渡河工程专业（道路材料工程方向）的一门专业课。主要内容为：无机结合料稳定材料的击实实验、无侧限抗压强度实验、水泥稳定材料中水泥剂量测试实验及透水混凝土配合比设计实验。实验课以坚持以学生为主体的原则、教师仅进行必要的讲解，全部实验项目均由学生自己动手完成。课程设计的实验项目包含验证类实验和综合设计类实验两大类。其中验证类实验可以帮助学生强化理论知识、熟悉仪器设备的操作，培养良好的实验习惯；综合设计类实验可以充分发挥学生的主观能动性，培养学生的创新意识和创新能力。通过实践教学环节为学生提供理论联系实际的机会，加深其对道路基层材料及透水路面材料组成、结构和性能间相互关系的理解和认识，掌握路面基层材料及透水路面材料性能的测试方法及配合比设计方法和原则，熟练掌握有关仪器设备的性能和操作方法。从而培养学生分析解决问题的能力和动手能力，使其掌握专业相关基本实践技能，养成严谨求实的实验精神，为其今后的从事相关工作奠定基础。
default.en: This course is a specialized course for the students of road and bridge engineering major. This course gives laboratory classes about replication experiments including beating experiment, unlimited compressive strength experiment, cement content of cement-stabilized materials and design of pervious concrete. This course adheres to the principle of student-centered approach. The teachers only provides the necessary explanations, and the students complete all the experimental projects by themselves. This course includes both validation experiments and design experiments. Verification experiments can help students strengthen their theoretical knowledge, familiarize themselves with the operation of instruments and equipment, and cultivate good experimental habits; Design experiments can fully tap into students' initiation ability. This course gives a chance for student to use the theory and knowledge they have learnt, and also makes student understand the relationship among compose, structure and properties. Furthermore, this course is to enable students to understand the test method of road base and pervious materials and the operational approach of equipment. The course provides the basement for the study in graduate design phase and work in transportation and roads.

default.zh: 综合运输概论课程是交通工程专业的专业课，设置目的是使学生了解交通运输工程的特点、性质、内容及其分类，熟悉各种运输方式规划、设计、运营管理的方法，为将来深入学习和从事本专业工作打下良好基础。课程主要介绍运输的性质、分类、组成和意义，交通运输的发展阶段，各种运输方式的技术经济特性及评价；运输系统规划的阶段和步骤，土地使用—运输系统模型，活动系统需求和运输系统供应的平衡问题；铁路运输系统、道路运输系统、水路运输系统、航空运输系统、管道运输系统五种运输方式的特点、分类、设备、站场选择以及管理技术；综合运输系统的概念、系统构成，各种运输方式的合理配置与分工协调。课程考核采用平时考核（根据出勤和课堂表现）、课内讲演、期末考试相结合的方式。 课程学习的具体目标包括：（1）培养交通运输系统工程基本素养；（2）掌握综合交通运输系统的特点、性质、内容、分类等基础理论知识，了解综合运输发展现状、前沿发展趋势和行业发展的相关法规、政策措施；（3）熟悉各种运输方式规划、设计、运营、管理的基本方法，为将来各专业课的深入学习打下坚实的基础；（4）通过课堂小组讨论，培养学生的组织管理能力及团队协作能力、较强的表达能力和人际交往能力。
default.en: An Introduction to Transportation’ is a major course of the transportation engineering. Through the course, students can realize the feature, character, composition and classification of transportation, make familiar with planning, design, and operating management methods of various transportation modes, and pave a firm base for future study and work. The course mainly introduces feature, classification, composition and meaning of transportation, developing stage of transportation, and technology and economic features and evaluation of transportation. The stage and process of transportation system planning, land using-transportation system model, the question on the balance between activity system demand and transportation system supply will also be introduced. The feature, classification, equipment, choice of the station, and management technology of five transportation modes, including railway transportation system, road transportation system, waterway transportation system, aviation transportation system and pipeline transportation system, will be introduced in detail. The concept and composition of the integrated transportation system will be introduced at last, and the division and cooperation between different modes will be discussed. The examination of this course includes regular grades which are grading by their attendances and other behaviors in class, presentation in class, and final exam. The specified goals of this course include: (1) the students’ basic literacy of transportation engineering can be cultivated; (2) the students can know basic knowledge on the feature, character, composition, and classification of the integrated transportation system, and the students can also know the state of the art and developing trend of transportation, as well as some relative law, regulation and policy; (3) the students can be familiar with the planning, design, operation, and management methods of various transportation modes, and thus pave a solid base for future study and work; (4) the students’ management ability, collaboration ability, expression ability, and interpersonal skill can be improved during the team work.

default.zh: 本课程系交通工程专业核心课程，以道路交通为研究对象，主要讲解道路交通的信号控制方法，以此达到提高道路交通通行效率、确保交通安全的目的。课程内容涉及：交通信号设置依据及分类、单个交叉口的交通信号控制理论与方法（包括定时信号控制、感应信号控制和环形交叉口信号控制）、公交优先信号控制方法、干线协调交通信号控制理论与方法、区域交通信号协调控制系统和快速干道交通控制方法。本课程的设置目标：通过系统学习使学生掌握道路交通信号控制的基本理论和方法，了解交通信号控制研究领域的现状、前沿发展趋势及现行道路交通信号灯设置规范中的相关规定，而且能够运用高新技术（如通讯技术、控制技术、计算机技术等）和先进装备对动态交通流进行合理调控、应用所学知识解决城市道路及公路交叉口的交通信号设计、改善和评价等实际工程问题，并具备开展道路交通信号控制领域科学研究的基本素质与创新意识。
default.en: Traffic control is a core course of traffic engineering professional. It takes road traffic as the research object, mainly introduces the traffic signal control method to improve road traffic efficiency and ensure traffic safety. The content of the course includes: the setting basis and classification of road traffic signal, the theory and method of traffic signal control at single intersection (including the fixed signal control, actuated？signal？control and roundabout signal control), the traffic signal control method for bus priority, the traffic signal control theory and method for arterial coordinated, the traffic signal control system of regional coordination, and expressway traffic control methods. The curriculum goal: (1) to make students master the basic theory and method of road traffic signal control by systematic learning; (2) understand the current situation and frontier development trend of traffic signal control research, also the relevant regulations of current road traffic signal setting norms; (3) can use high-and-new technology (such as communication technology, control technology, computer technology etc.) and advanced equipment to reasonably regulate the dynamic traffic flow, and apply the knowledge to solve the practical engineering problems such as traffic signal design, improvement and evaluation of urban road and highway intersection, and have the basic quality and innovation consciousness in scientific research of road traffic signal control.

default.zh: 交通系统工程课程是为交通工程专业开设的专业课，是交通系统研究的方法论，它把系统工程的理论和方法推广应用到交通系统，重点探讨了解决实际交通问题的思路和方法。简化系统方法本身介绍，侧重方法应用，选取各种理论方法在交通领域针对性的应用案例，注重处理实际问题的方法，注重理论的完整性和在实际应用中的连续性。通过课程学习可以使学生掌握交通系统的规划、设计、建设、管理与研究的整体过程及应用的各种方法；掌握系统工程的在交通领域的实际应用及解决交通系统实际问题的思路和方法；了解各类方法理论的未来发展方向及研究思路。
default.en: Traffic System Engineering is a specialized course for traffic engineering majors. It is the methodology of traffic system research. It extends the theories and methods of system engineering to traffic systems and focuses on the ideas and methods to solve practical traffic problems. The introduction of the simplified system method itself, focusing on the application of the method, selecting a variety of theoretical methods in the field of transportation targeted application cases, paying attention to the method of dealing with practical problems, paying attention to the integrity of the theory and the continuity in practical application. Through the course study, students can master the overall process of planning, design, construction, management and research of traffic system and various methods of application; Master the practical application of system engineering in the field of transportation and the ideas and methods to solve the practical problems of transportation system; Understand the future development direction and research ideas of various methods and theories.

default.zh: 本课程系交通设备与控制工程专业课程。该课程以道路交通为研究对象，主要讲解道路交通的管理与组织方法，以此达到提高道路交通效率，确保交通安全的目的。通过该课程，学生应理解城市交通管理的基本目的、原则与方法，学会如何按照既定的交通法规，根据道路的具体情况，运用各种手段、方法和工具，采取各种限制措施，对交通进行科学的组织和指挥；学会运用现代化技术（通讯技术、控制技术、计算机技术等）和装置对动态交通流进行准确的调度，使其通畅运行；了解先进国家的城市交通管理的方法和技术，以及城市交通管理的发展趋势。
default.en: This course is for traffic equipment and control engineering. It regards road traffic as the research object, explains the management of road traffic mainly, to raise road traffic efficiency and ensure traffic safety. Through this course, students should understand the method, principle and the basic purpose of city traffic management. According to the established traffic regulations and the specific condition of road, students should learn how to utilize various means, method and tools, adopting various restriction measures, carry out traffic organization. Students should learn with modern technology (communication technology, control technology and computer technical etc.) and facilities to regulate traffic flow accurately to make it unobstructed run, know the urban traffic management and the method of traffic control and technology of advanced country, as well as the development tendency of urban traffic management.

default.zh: 技术正以前所未有的速度和规模重塑全球交通运输格局。未来的智慧交通系统将在人工智能驱动下实现全域感知互联、数据智能决策、动态资源优化配置、清洁能源驱动及全流程自主化运行。本课程聚焦AI赋能的交通基础设施创新实践，重点涵盖四大前沿方向：1）基于深度学习的道路表面病害智能识别技术，实现毫米级裂缝与破损的实时检测；2）探地雷达与人工智能融合的隐蔽病害诊断体系，突破地下结构无损检测技术瓶颈；3）无人机多光谱巡检系统，构建三维立体的基础设施健康监测网络；4）道路大模型开发与应用，通过多模态数据融合提升基础设施全生命周期管理能力。课程深度融合《国家综合立体交通网规划纲要》要求，结合数字孪生、智能养护等国家战略需求，培养具备AI技术与交通工程跨界创新能力的新型人才，助力建设安全可靠、智慧韧性的新一代交通基础设施体系。
default.en: Technology is reshaping global transportation with unprecedented speed and scale. The future intelligent transportation system, powered by artificial intelligence, will achieve omnidirectional perception and connectivity, data-driven decision-making, dynamic resource optimization, clean energy propulsion, and fully autonomous operations. This course focuses on AI-empowered innovation in transportation infrastructure, emphasizing four cutting-edge domains: 1) Deep learning-based intelligent recognition for road surface defects, enabling real-time detection of millimeter-level cracks and damages; 2) Ground-penetrating radar integrated with AI for subsurface defect diagnosis, breaking through non-destructive testing barriers; 3) UAV-based multi-spectral inspection systems constructing 3D infrastructure health monitoring networks; 4) Development and application of transportation large models, enhancing lifecycle management through multimodal data fusion. Aligned with China's National Comprehensive 3D Transportation Network Plan, the course addresses strategic needs including digital twins and smart maintenance, cultivating interdisciplinary talents with AI-transportation integration capabilities to build safer, smarter, and more resilient next-generation transportation infrastructure systems.

default.zh: 《AI+交通行为分析》课程立足国家交通强国建设战略需求，使学生能够熟练地运用行为科学、系统科学、信息科学理论与方法，与交通项目实践紧密联系，研究如何有效地分析交通参与者中的出行者、运营者等行为，科学地认识交通行为对交通资源分配、交通安全的影响，并能够提出切实可行的引导行为的策略建议。 交通行为学是交通运输工程学科的基础科学理论之一，涉及交通科学、行为科学、系统科学、信息科学、实验、计算等科学理论与方法，是多学科综合的基础理论，通过融合人工智能、大数据等前沿技术，能够进一步提升智慧交通领域拔尖创新人才的培养。
default.en: The course "AI + Traffic Behavior Analysis" is based on the strategic needs of the national transportation power construction. It enables students to skillfully apply theories and methods from behavioral science, systems science, and information science, closely integrating with practical traffic projects. It focuses on how to effectively analyze the behaviors of traffic participants such as travelers and operators, scientifically understand the impact of traffic behavior on traffic resource allocation and traffic safety, and be able to propose practical and feasible strategies for guiding behavior. Traffic behavior science is one of the fundamental scientific theories in the discipline of transportation engineering. It involves theories and methods from traffic science, behavioral science, systems science, information science, experiments, and computing, among others. It is a comprehensive basic theory that integrates multiple disciplines. By integrating cutting-edge technologies such as artificial intelligence and big data, it can further enhance the cultivation of top-notch innovative talents in the field of intelligent transportation.

default.zh: AI赋能的结构设计原理课程简介 《AI赋能的结构设计原理》是为道路桥梁与渡河工程专业本科生量身打造的一门专业选修课程，旨在通过人工智能技术与传统结构设计的深度融合，培养学生在复杂工程实践中运用人工智能技术解决实际问题的综合能力。课程以钢筋混凝土结构设计为核心基础，系统整合AI技术，突破传统设计模式中依赖经验试错、高重复性劳动的局限性，推动学生从理论认知到实践创新的全方位提升。课程总学时为32学时，内容涵盖结构设计的基本原理与AI技术的应用逻辑，注重理论与实践的结合，通过智慧教学系统、互动式课堂及虚拟仿真实验，构建“学习-反馈-实践”的闭环教学模式，为学生适应未来智能建造与数字化工程领域的需求奠定坚实基础。 课程内容分为基础理论学习与AI技术应用两大核心部分。基础理论学习聚焦于钢筋混凝土结构设计的核心知识体系，包括极限状态设计方法、结构可靠度分析、承载能力与正常使用极限状态，以及混凝土与钢筋的力学性能研究。通过深入讲解受弯构件的正截面与斜截面承载能力计算、受压与受扭构件的复合受力分析，以及深梁设计中拉-压杆模型的建模原理等知识，使学生能够系统掌握结构设计的基本逻辑与规范要求。在此基础上引入人工智能，探讨AI在结构设计中的底层逻辑与实现路径，包括AI辅助编程工具的开发、自动化设计流程的构建、复杂受力场景的模拟与优化，以及虚拟仿真实验在结构破坏形态分析中的应用。通过将AI技术嵌入设计全流程，引导学生探索智能算法在荷载组合优化、参数敏感性分析及工程问题诊断中的潜力，培养其技术开发与工程实践的双重能力。 课程采用“AI讲伴+学伴”的智慧教学模式，实现教学全链条的智能化与个性化。课前，教师通过AI系统推送预习任务，学生需回顾数学与力学基础知识，AI学伴实时检测预习内容中的错误并提供修正建议，确保学生进入课堂前具备必要的知识储备。课中，嵌入式AI讲伴与教师协同授课，AI通过语音识别自动标注重难点内容，同步展示相关工程案例、行业规范及前沿技术动态，帮助学生快速理解抽象概念。课堂互动采用匿名问答机制，学生通过AI学伴自由提问，问题汇总后由教师集中解答，既缓解传统课堂中“不敢问、答不上”的困境，又提升师生互动效率。课后，教师根据线上及线下的反馈数据，通过国产大模型生成分层题库，检验学生的阶段性学习成果。学生答题后由系统自动批改并通过AI学伴反馈学生薄弱点，建立各个学生的薄弱知识库及知识图谱，使学生更有针对性地学习。另外，针对混凝土结构试验成本高、周期长的特点，课程引入虚拟仿真实验替代实体试验，通过高精度模拟呈现结构在不同荷载下的力学响应与破坏过程，增强学生对理论知识的直观理解。此外，教师还可引导学生探索AI工具开发，编写代码优化设计算法或构建特定工程场景的解决方案，进一步强化AI技术应用能力。 本课程考核体系兼顾理论学习与实践创新，共有课堂互动与课后练习（5次）、虚拟仿真实验（2次）、AI应用、AI工具开发及期末考试（线上+线下）五个考核环节，分数占比分别为10%、10%、20%、10%、50%。通过多元化的评价机制，不仅能检验学生对结构设计原理的掌握程度，更能培养其利用AI技术解决复杂工程问题的创新能力。课程以《结构设计原理（第3版）》为核心教材，辅以《钢筋混凝土基本构件》《Design of Concrete Structures》等国内外经典著作，确保理论深度与工程实践的平衡。拓展资源包括AI开发工具包、行业前沿数据库及虚拟仿真平台，可为学生提供丰富的学习素材与实践环境。 通过该课程的学习，学生不仅能够掌握钢筋混凝土结构设计的基本原理、熟练使用AI进行简单结构设计计算，还能够利用AI对复杂工程问题进行研究，包括规划、设计、实验、分析与解释数据等，并初步具备应用技术开发能力，形成“工程师+开发者”的复合思维模式，为学生未来参与智能桥梁设计、数字化施工管理及智慧城市建设等领域提供技术储备与创新视野，助力其成为推动工程领域智能化转型的核心力量。
default.en: "AI-Enabled Structural Design Principles" is a specialized elective course tailored for undergraduate students majoring in Road, Bridge and River Engineering. It aims to cultivate students' comprehensive ability to solve practical problems in complex engineering practices by deeply integrating artificial intelligence technology with traditional structural design. The course takes the design of reinforced concrete structures as its core foundation and systematically integrates AI technology, breaking through the limitations of traditional design models that rely on experience-based trial and error and repetitive labor. It promotes an all-round improvement of students from theoretical cognition to practical innovation. The course lasts for a total of 32 class hours, covering the basic principles of structural design and the application logic of AI technology. It emphasizes the combination of theory and practice and builds a closed-loop teaching model of "learning - feedback - practice" through a smart teaching system, interactive classrooms, and virtual simulation experiments, laying a solid foundation for students to adapt to the demands of future intelligent construction and digital engineering fields. The course content is divided into two core parts: basic theoretical learning and AI technology application. Basic theoretical learning focuses on the core knowledge system of reinforced concrete structure design, including limit state design methods, structural reliability analysis, bearing capacity and normal service limit state, as well as the mechanical properties of concrete and steel. Through in-depth explanations of the calculation of the bearing capacity of flexural members' normal and inclined sections, the composite force analysis of compression and torsion members, and the modeling principle of the tension-compression bar model in deep beam design, students can systematically master the basic logic and normative requirements of structural design. On this basis, AI is introduced to explore the underlying logic and implementation paths of AI in structural design, including the development of AI-assisted programming tools, the construction of automated design processes, the simulation and optimization of complex force scenarios, and the application of virtual simulation experiments in the analysis of structural failure modes. By embedding AI technology into the entire design process, students are guided to explore the potential of intelligent algorithms in load combination optimization, parameter sensitivity analysis, and engineering problem diagnosis, cultivating their dual capabilities in technology development and engineering practice.

default.zh: 作为交通基础设施资产的托管人，各国地方道路管理部门都在努力制定高效的资产管理计划和投资计划。这种计划是建立在风险评估基础上的。原则上，是将始终有限的投资与当地道路管理部门他的风险承受能力进行权衡。 好的资产管理和投资计划是建立在全生命周期资产管理视野的基础上的。 它是对服务水平、风险评估、投资策略、社会资源和能力的整体思考， 还是建立在对不断增长的交通需求的良好预测的基础上。 本课程将涉及上述各个方面基础知识，并讨论如何运用这些知识来影响基础设施管理的决策制定。
default.en: The bridge structure experiment includes visual inspection of the bridge structure and grading assessment, the key technical, theoretical analysis and test methods of bridge static and dynamic load test, the nondestructive inspection technology of concrete structures and test data processing and analysis. Through data analysis to the bridge static and dynamic tests ,non-destructive experiment and visual inspection，the results can accurately evaluate the technical condition and the operating performance of the existing bridge structures and provides the scientific basis for the bridge quality comprehensive evaluation and the determination bridge existing supporting capacity and the bridge structure remaining life forecast.

default.zh: 针对交通基础设施长期服役安全评估以及韧性恢复与评价难题，结合俄罗斯交通基础设施运维和管养的实际与案例，讲解交通设施事故分析、仿生方法在交通设施设计中的应用、聚合物复合材料在交通建设中的应用、交通设施运营管理、预应力钢筋混凝土桥梁结构、钢筋受到腐蚀开裂的计算模型和计算方法已及恶劣运营环境评估其耐久性的数学模型方法等知识，使不同年级的学生有不同的收获，为交通基础设施的安全运维提供基础知识积累。
default.en: For the long-term service safety assessment of transport infrastructure and toughness recovery and evaluation of difficult problems, combined with the Russian transport infrastructure operation and maintenance of the actual and case studies, explaining the analysis of transport facilities accidents, bionic methods in the design of transport facilities, polymer composites in transport construction, transport facilities operation and management, prestressed reinforced concrete bridge structures, the corrosion and cracking of steel reinforcement by the calculation model and calculation method has been and the harsh operating environment to assess the durability of the mathematical model method and so on, so that different levels of students have different gains to provide the basic knowledge accumulation. This course is designed to provide students of different grades with different gains, and to build up basic knowledge for the safe operation and maintenance of transport infrastructure.

default.zh: 本课程为道路桥梁与渡河工程专业的核心专业课，是材料学专业学生的主干课、必修课，也适合土建类其他专业学生。主要讲述国内外结构混凝土劣化与修补现状、钢筋混凝土的劣化机理与种类、结构混凝土的修补原理与修复材料，修复技术及修复后的性能评价等内容的专业课，主要向学生介绍结构混凝土的劣化机理及修复材料、修补技术等。通过本课程的学习，使学生掌握常用结构混凝土的劣化机理及种类、传统和新型修补材料的性能特征及修补技术、性能评价等，为学生今后从事该方向的研究、开发和工程应用奠定基础。课程内容主要包括国内外钢筋混凝土结构劣化与修补现状、钢筋混凝土的劣化机理与种类、结构混凝土的修补原理与设计、混凝土修补材料、混凝土的修补技术、混凝土修补体系的性能评价等。
default.en: This course is a specialized core course for the students of road and bridge engineering major. It is also suitable for other students of civil engineering major. The main content of this course is an introduction to the degradation and repair technology of structural concrete and reinforced concrete, including degradation and repair research status of reinforced concrete, degradation mechanism and types, repairing mechanism and repairing materials, repairing technology and performance evaluation. Through the course, the students can get a general comprehension to degradation mechanism, destroyed types, performance and repairing technology of all kinds of repairing materials and performance evaluation system of repaired concrete structure. The students will have the ability to do corresponding researches and work on repair technology of structural concrete.

default.zh: 《自动驾驶控制理论基础及应用》是一门专注于自动驾驶技术中控制理论的本科生课程。本课程深入探讨自动驾驶系统中的核心技术，特别强调滑膜控制和神经网络控制在自动驾驶车辆中的应用。滑膜控制以其强大的鲁棒性和适应性，在处理系统不确定性和外部干扰方面表现出色。而神经网络控制则利用其学习能力，对复杂非线性系统进行建模和控制。通过本课程的学习，学生将能够理解这些先进控制策略的原理，掌握其在自动驾驶车辆中的实际应用，并为未来在智能交通系统及自动驾驶领域的研究和工作打下坚实的基础。
default.en: 《 The Fundamentals and Applications of Autonomous Driving Control Theory》is an undergraduate course focused on control theory in autonomous driving technology. This course deeply discusses the core technology of auto drive system, with special emphasis on the application of synovial control and neural network control in automatic driving vehicles. Synovial control performs well in dealing with system uncertainties and external disturbances due to its strong robustness and adaptability. Neural network control utilizes its learning ability to model and control complex nonlinear systems. Through the study of this course, students will be able to understand the principles of these advanced control strategies, master their practical applications in autonomous vehicles, and lay a solid foundation for future research and work in the fields of intelligent transportation systems and autonomous driving.

default.zh: 本课程综合了车辆动力学、控制理论、传感器技术、计算机仿真等多个学科领域的知识，旨在通过理论讲授、实验操作和项目实践，使学生掌握智能驾驶车辆的动力学建模、仿真分析和控制策略设计。课程内容从智能驾驶系统的基本概念出发，深入探讨车辆运动学和动力学的基础知识，介绍各种传感器和感知系统的工作原理，以及如何将这些技术应用于智能驾驶车辆的控制和决策。学生将学习如何构建智能驾驶车辆的动力学模型，并利用专业仿真软件进行模拟和分析，以验证和优化控制算法。
default.en: It focuses on the core principles and practical applications of intelligent driving technology. This course integrates knowledge from multiple disciplines such as vehicle dynamics, control theory, sensor technology, and computer simulation. The aim is to enable students to master the dynamic modeling, simulation analysis, and control strategy design of intelligent driving vehicles through theoretical lectures, experimental operations, and project practice. The course content starts from the basic concepts of intelligent driving systems, delves into the fundamental knowledge of vehicle kinematics and dynamics, introduces the working principles of various sensors and perception systems, and how to apply these technologies to the control and decision-making of intelligent driving vehicles. Students will learn how to construct dynamic models of intelligent driving vehicles and use professional simulation software for simulation and analysis to validate and optimize control algorithms.

default.zh: 通过实习的参观、走访和专业人士的介绍，进一步了解的道路桥梁工程有关规划、设计、施工、管理和研究等方面的工作性质，使学生更加热爱他即将从事的事业，在未来的工作中找到一个合适的定位和确定明确的奋斗目标。毕业实习的另一个目的就是为毕业设计（论文）做前期的准备工作，收集毕业设计相关的资料，深入理解毕业设计（论文）的意义。
default.en: Through the internship visit, visit and the introduction of professionals, Students can further understand the nature of the planning, design, construction, management and research of road and bridge engineering, so that students can love the career they will be engaged in more, find a suitable positioning and determine a clear goal in the future work. Another purpose of the graduation internship is to do the preparatory work for the graduation design (thesis), collect the information related to the graduation design, and deeply understand the significance of the graduation project (thesis).

default.zh: 毕业论文（设计）是一门必修课。本科教学最后一个重要的综合训练教学环节，是对本科整个教学过程的总结，是培养学生综合运用所学的基本理论、基础知识和基本技能进行科学研究能力的初步训练，是培养和提高学生分析问题、解决道路桥梁与渡河工程复杂工程问题能力的重要环节，也是学生毕业与学位资格认定的重要依据。毕业论文（设计）既是对本科各教学环节的延续，又是对之前各教学环节的深化和检验，具有独立性、综合性、实践性的突出特点。通过毕业论文（设计），使学生对所学过的基础理论和专业知识进行一次全面、系统地回顾和总结，通过对具体题目的分析和设计，使理论与实践相结合，巩固和发展所学理论知识，掌握正确的思维方法和基本技能，使学生具备解决本专业复杂工程问题的能力。
default.en: The graduation thesis (design) is a compulsory course. The last important comprehensive training and teaching link of undergraduate teaching is the summary of the entire teaching process of undergraduate, the preliminary training of cultivating students' ability to comprehensively use the basic theories, basic knowledge and basic skills they have learned to conduct scientific research, the important link of cultivating and improving students' ability to analyze problems and solve complex engineering problems of roads, bridges and river crossing projects, and the important basis for students' graduation and degree qualification. The graduation thesis (design) is not only a continuation of the teaching links of the undergraduate, but also a deepening and test of the previous teaching links, which has the outstanding characteristics of independence, comprehensiveness and practicality. Through the graduation thesis (design), students will have a comprehensive and systematic review and summary of the basic theories and professional knowledge they have learned, and through the analysis and design of specific topics, the theory and practice will be combined, the theoretical knowledge will be consolidated and developed, and the correct thinking methods and basic skills will be mastered, so that students will have the ability to solve complex engineering problems in their majors.

default.zh: 《混凝土材料科学课程设计》是道路桥梁与渡河工程专业(先进材料工程方向) 的一门专业课程，要求从多个混凝土性能要求侧重点不同的典型工程案例中任选一个作为设计目标，完成混凝土材料设计，并撰写设计书。旨在帮助学生理解和消化混凝土材料科学相关理论知识，掌握常用特种混凝土配合比设计理论与方法，合理选用原材料，正确确定和计算混凝土中各材料用量，掌握原材料与混凝土性能及使用条件之间的关系，制定研究方案、技术路线，引导学生在实践中运用理论知识解决复杂工程问题，培养学生综合分析问题的能力及创新精神。
default.en: "Curriculum Design of Concrete Materials Science" is a specialized core course for the students of road and bridge engineering major (advanced materials engineering direction). According to a number of typical engineering cases with different emphasis on concrete performance requirements and design goals, students can choose one of them to accomplish concrete material design and corresponding design books. It can help students understand and digest the relevant theoretical knowledge of concrete material science, master the mix design theory and design methods of commonly used and special concrete. It contains that reasonably select raw materials, correctly determine and calculate the amount of each material in concrete, master the relationship between raw materials and the performance and use conditions of concrete and formulate the research plans and technical routes. It aims to guide students to apply theoretical knowledge to solving complex engineering problems in practice, and cultivate students' ability to comprehensively analyze problems and innovation mind.

default.zh: 《道路复合材料课程设计》课程为道路桥梁与渡河工程专业（材料方向）本科生必修课，是《道路复合材料》的课程设计部分。本课程拟利用《道路复合材料》课程的理论知识，从材料的角度，解决实际道路工程领域中出现的问题，并撰写项目策划书1份。本课程主要是进一步促进学生能够灵活运用《道路复合材料》的理论知识解决道路工程领域中的复合材料问题，培养学生学科交叉方面的学术创新能力，推动智能交通的发展，最终培养交通强国的建设者和接班人。
default.en: Curriculum Design of Composite Materials for Road is a required course for undergraduates majoring in Road Bridge and river Crossing Engineering (Material direction). It is the curriculum design part of Composite Materials for Road. This course intends to use the theoretical knowledge of "Composite Materials for Road" course to solve the problems in the field of practical road engineering from the perspective of materials, and write a project plan. The main purpose of this course is to further promote students' ability to flexibly apply the theoretical knowledge of Composite Materials for Road to solve the problem of composite materials in the field of road engineering, cultivate students' academic innovation ability in interdisciplinary aspects, promote the development of intelligent transportation, and finally train builders and successors of powerful transportation countries.

default.zh: 通过交通控制课程设计，目的是使学生掌握用数解法和图解法进行干线交通信号协调控制方案设计的原理、步骤、注意事项和计算方法，提高其分析问题和解决问题的能力。
default.en: Through the course design of traffic control, the purpose is to make students grasp the principle, procedures, precautions and calculation methods of arterial traffic signal coordination control scheme design by numerical method and graphical method, and to improve their ability to analyze and solve problems.

default.zh: 系统地学习《交通系统工程》课程，了解一般的系统工程分析思维方法之后，通过编程实践进一步掌握并体验系统分析方法的特点及优点，提高分析及解决实际问题的能力。课程设计要求掌握最短路距离及最短路线的求解方法，为以后的相关交通专业课程学习奠定基础。
default.en: After systematically learning the course "Traffic System Engineering" and understanding the general system engineering analytical thinking method, students will further master and experience the characteristics and advantages of system analysis method through programming practice, and improve my ability to analyze and solve practical problems. The course design requires a master of the shortest distance and the shortest route solving method, which lays a foundation for the future study of related transportation courses.

default.zh: 通过本课程的设计训练，使学生深入理解城市可持续更新理念以及城市环境对居住建筑的制约关系，利用欧洲在城市更新方面的经验，了解城市住宅更新趋势及模式，从更加全面地视域集成促进城市可持续发展的住区设计体系。
default.en: Through the design training of this course, students can have an in-depth understanding of the restriction relationship between urban environment and residential buildings, understand various spatial combinations of residential buildings, get familiar with the architectural design codes of residential buildings, and design residential forms that meet different living requirements of different living objects.

default.zh: 20世纪快速的城市化为人类带来了很多好处，例如高效的工业生产，技术进步和公共卫生的改善，中国是最杰出的实践者和见证者之一。然而，由于城市的集聚和人类生物学遗产之间的矛盾，城市无限的增长和有限生态系统的萎缩，快速的城镇化进程不可避免地需要寻求新的模式。因此，21世纪需要寻找新的能与自然共存的城市形态和建筑类型，将资源消耗与交通和信息的高度联通相结合，借助大数据、数据链、人工智能等技术，创造能够满足多样性生活需求的后工业生活方式。课程要求学生通过学术研讨、概念设计、方案设计提出哈尔滨未来发展模式，创造未来美好世界。
default.en: XX century rapid urbanization has brought many benefits like high productivity of industry, technology advances and improvement of public health. China is one of the most remarkable evidences. However urbanization process comes to a moment now when it inevitably collapses due to inherit contradictions between urban densities and human biology, unlimited growth of cities and shrinking of limited ecosystems supporting urbanized world. Thus XXI century needs to invent new urban spaces and buildings’ types that will coexist with the nature, combine autonomy in resource consumption and high connectivity in transport and information flows, and provide diversity of post-industrial lifestyles where all functions can be in one place. The course calls students to discuss, conceptualize and design solutions for Harbin future matching this new better world.

default.zh: 概述智慧城市能源计量的背景和意义；智慧城市中的能源供应构成及相关参量的计量脉络；节能减排评价体系中碳排放、碳足迹及碳中和的定义及内涵；水、热、油、气、电等能源使用过程的工程计量实践案例展示。
default.en: Summarize the background and significance of energy metering in smart city; The composition of energy supply in smart city and the measurement of relevant parameters; The definition and connotation of carbon emission, carbon footprint and carbon neutralization in the evaluation system of energy conservation and emission reduction; project practice of energy metering for water, heat, oil, gas, electricity and other energy use processes.

default.zh: 本课程涉及目前国际上从事表面科学研究的学者所感兴趣的各种表面及界面上结构以及超快过程的表征，并通过表征来揭示界面微观结构及其动力学与宏观物理化学性质的关系。在本课程中，我将介绍在基础研究和应用表面分析中都非常有效的最前沿的主要分析技术的理论和实践。
default.en: This course deals with the characterisation and understanding of the surface of substrates, how they function and react which are all of interest to surface scientists. Within this course, I will introduce the theory and practice of the principal techniques that have shown themselves to be effective in both basic research and in applied surface analysis.

default.zh: 有机材料广泛应用于电化学电源，如电池、超级电容器和燃料电池。在本课程中，学生了解先进有机材料的主要功能，了解电化学反应的现象和基本规律以及相关的物理过程。通过本课程的学习，提高学生对氧化还原活性材料、固体聚合物电解质、导电聚合物和功能粘合剂的基本知识的理解能力。
default.en: Organic materials are widely used in electrochemical power sources, such as batteries, supercapacitors and fuel cells. In the course, the students learn the main functions of advanced organic materials, understand phenomena and underlying laws of electrochemical reactions and relevant physical processes involved. Through this course, the students can build up the abilities of understand the basics of redox-active materials, solid polymer electrolytes, conducting polymers and functional binders.

default.zh: 土木工程与人工智能的结合迎来了难得的战略机遇期。《土木工程机器学习导论》是契合国家智慧土木工程战略需求，响应教育部关于开展新工科建设的号召而开设的新课程。本课程旨在重点培养学生运用机器学习方法分析土木工程（大）数据的能力，并为相关课程的学习及科学研究奠定数据分析理论和方法基础。主要内容包括最优化与概率基础理论、线性回归分析、多变量分析、核方法、决策树和随机森林、神经网络、贝叶斯与高斯过程模型等适用于土木工程（大）数据分析的基本理论与计算方法。
default.en: The combination of civil engineering and artificial intelligence usher in a period of rare strategic opportunities. The new course of “Introduction to Machine Learning in Civil Engineering” is set up to meet the national strategic need of intelligent civil engineering and in response to the call of Ministry of Education for “Emerging Engineering Education”. Through the course, we focus on cultivating the students' ability to use machine learning methods to analyze civil engineering (big) data, and lay the foundation for data analysis theories and methods for related course study and scientific research. The main contents of the course are the basic theories and calculation methods suitable for civil engineering (big) data analysis, which includes: optimization and probability theories, linear regressions, multivariate analysis, kernel methods, decision tree and random forest, neural networks, and Bayesian inference and Gaussian process.

default.zh: 本课程用于提高学生开展实验研究的能力，包括设计搭建实验平台，实验实施，和实验数据处理与分析。通过本课程的学习使学生掌握信号处理，数据采集，数据简化，数据精度，仪器响应，数据统计以及撰写实验报告。本课程会介绍多种应用于机械工程的实验方法和设备工具。理论讲解结合课后作业和撰写实验报告，加深学生对课堂理论教学内容的深入理解，扩展学生的专业知识，培养学习学科交叉思维能力，为学生进一步深造打好基础。
default.en: This course is used to improve the ability of students to carry out experimental research, including the design and construction of experimental platform, experimental implementation, and experimental data processing and analysis. Through the study of this course, students can master signal processing, data acquisition, data simplification, data accuracy, instrument response, data statistics and write experimental report. This course will introduce a variety of experimental methods, equipment and tools used in mechanical engineering. Theoretical explanation combined with homework after class and writing experiment report can deepen in-depth understanding of classroom theoretical teaching content, expand the professional knowledge, cultivate interdisciplinary thinking ability, and lay a good foundation for further study of students.

default.zh: 课程讲述非饱和土的基本原理、研究的基本方法以及非饱和土力学的研究进展和应用。包括：非饱和土的简介、状态变量及其度量、水土特征曲线、非饱和土渗流、非饱和土的强度、非饱和土的变形等。
default.en: This course introduces the basic principles and research methods of unsaturated soils. In addition, some recent developments and applications are also introduced. The content of this course are as follows: Introduction to Unsaturated Soil Mechanics; State Variables and their Measurement; The Soil-Water Characteristic Curve; Seepage through Unsaturated Soils; Shear Strength of Unsaturated Soils; Volume Change & Deformation of Unsaturated Soils.

default.zh: 目前，多媒体等非结构化数据占互联网流量的80%左右。同时，超过70%-80%的潜在可用信息以非结构化的形式存在，如音频/视频信息、社交网络关系、用户购买习惯、环境数据等。本课程将讨论和探索多媒体应用中的机器学习技术，目标如下：（1）理解AI的概念。（2）了解多媒体大数据应用需求。（3）获得实现AI模型的实践经验。（4）积累AI模型调试经验。（5）了解最先进的人工智能算法。 教学内容主要包括（1）机器学习介绍，（2）深度学习（BP，CNN，RNN），（3）非结构化数据索引，（4）大数据应用（如多媒体大数据应用），（5）机器学习/深度学习中的可信计算，（6）加密图像的隐私问题和分类。采用讲授法、演示法和实验法组合的教学方式。 这是一门本科水平的课程，专为对大数据处理和机器学习应用感兴趣的学生设计。要求学生积极参与课堂讨论、实验操作。本课程的最终成绩以课程设计为基础，学生可以单独或两人一组进行课程设计。
default.en: Nowadays, unstructured data such as multimedia data account for around 80% of Internet traffic. Meanwhile, more than 70%–80% potentially usable information exists in unstructured formats, e.g., audio/video information, social network relations, users’ purchasing habits, environmental data, etc. This course will discuss and explore machine learning techniques for multimedia applications with the following objectives: (1) Understanding the concept of AI. (2) Understanding the requirements of multimedia big data applications. (3) Obtaining hand-on experience on implementing AI models. (4) Gaining experience on debugging AI model. (5) Knowing the state-of-the-art AI algorithms. The teaching content mainly includes (1) Introduction to machine learning. (2) Deep learning (BP, CNN and RNN). (3) Indexing for unstructured data. (4) Big Data Applications (e.g., multimedia big data applications). (5) Trustworthy computing in machine learning/deep learning. (6) Privacy concerns and classification over encryption images. This is an undergraduate level course designed for students who are interested in big data processing and machine learning applications. Students are required to actively participate in the class discussions, lab operations. The final grade of this course is based on the course projects, and the students may conduct the course projects individually or in a group of two students.

default.zh: 软件测试是保障软件质量的重要手段，在软件开发中占有重要的地位。本课程对软件测试理论与技术进行深入的讲解。课程内容涵盖了软件质量工程、软件测试概念、原则和演化过程的介绍、以及软件测试基础理论与技术，如测试数据生成、测试预言设计、测试驱动设计，以及测试输出分析等技术与方法。通过本课程的学习，使学生能掌握软件测试的基础理论和方法，为未来从事软件工程以及与应用相关领域的研究奠定理论基础。
default.en: Software testing is an important means of ensuring software quality and holds an important position in software development. This course provides an in-depth explanation of software testing theory and technology. The course content covers an introduction to software quality engineering, software testing concepts, principles, and evolutionary processes, as well as basic theories and techniques of software testing, such as test data generation, test prediction design, test driven design, and test output analysis. Through the study of this course, students will be able to master the basic theories and methods of software testing, laying a theoretical foundation for future research in software engineering and related fields.

default.zh: 《服务计算前沿技术》重点介绍服务计算的基本概念，包括Web服务的关键标准、Web服务架构SOA等，学生将重点学习在Web服务的服务发现、服务推荐、服务组合等相关技术。课程基于当前大数据，物联网，云服务和智慧城市等的应用背景，介绍服务计算在IoT和云计算两个重点领域中的新发展和新技术，特别是在这两个领域中服务模型的新形式，以及在不同领域中目前存在的挑战，培养学生对于新技术的自我学习能力，进一步提高学生的自学能力和解决实际问题的能力，培养学生的综合素质。 课程具体目标如下： 课程目标1：理解服务计算的基本概念、原理、关键标准，能够对服务计算领域的基本问题进行分析。 课程目标2：掌握服务计算中服务发现、服务选择、服务流程组合等相关技术，能够实现在大量的服务中发现、或者通过流程组合，实现满足符合功能需求的服务。 课程目标3：了解IoT和云计算两个领域中，前沿的服务计算发展方向和技术，通过文献检索，能够分析服务计算的新应用、新技术的发展趋势和可能存在的问题。
default.en: Advanced Web Service Technologies will provide students an opportunity to understand the basic concepts behind service computing, and new service computing development and research directions, particularly giving the consideration of recent exciting application areas such as big data, the Internet of Things, cloud computing and smart cities, especially in these two fields, the new forms of service models and the current challenges in different fields aim to cultivate students' self-learning ability towards new technologies, further improve their self-learning ability and problem-solving ability, and cultivate their comprehensive qualities. The specific objectives of the course are as follows: Course objective 1: Understand the basic concepts, principles, and key standards of service computing, and be able to analyze basic problems in the field of service computing. Course objective 2: Master relevant technologies such as service discovery, service selection, and service process composition in service computing, and be able to discover a large number of services or achieve services that meet functional requirements through process composition. Course objective 3: Understand the cutting-edge development directions and technologies of service computing in the fields of IoT and cloud computing. Through literature search, be able to analyze the new applications, development trends, and potential problems of service computing.

default.zh: 电磁兼容是研究电子系统或器件之间的干扰机理、干扰测量、如何设计干扰和受扰设备以减轻干扰水平或增强敏感设备的抗扰度的一门课程。 通过这一课程将学习到电磁兼容现象及其出现的原因，学会如何在电子设计过程中实现电磁兼容。本课程将以电子系统以及信号完整性为背景，重新学习基本的电路概念，使同学们对这些概念以及基本电路参数之间的相互作用有更深的理解。
default.en: Electromagnetic Compatibility is the study of how one electronic system or device interferes with another, how this can be measured and how both the victim and the threat can be better designed to minimise both the level of interference and the response of the victim. This module studies EMC phenomena, their causes, electronic design mitigation. It does this by setting EMC firmly into the concepts of electronics and signal integrity: revisiting basic circuit concepts but interpreting them in a way that develops a deeper understanding of those concepts and the interaction of basic circuit parameters.

default.zh: 本课程概述了电化学能量转换和存储装置(如电池、超级电容器、燃料电池和电解槽)工作的基本原理，旨在使学生了解化学能和电能相互转换的热力学原理、能量转化存储装置的工作原理以及它们的工程应用。该课程总结了上述技术在性能、寿命、安全性和成本方面所面临的挑战，突出了它们在实现能源清洁化方面的重要作用。
default.en: This course provides an overview of the fundamental principles underpinning the operation of electrochemical energy conversion and storage devices, such as batteries, supercapacitors, fuel cells and electrolysers. It is designed to give the students an understanding of the thermodynamic principles underpinning the interconversion of chemical and electrical energy, the basic theory of operation of the devices and how they are used in a range of engineering applications. The course summarizes the challenges of increasing the performance, lifetime and safety of these technologies, while continuing to drive down their cost, and highlights their role in enabling decarbonisation of the energy sector.

default.zh: 经贸英文报刊文章选读课旨在培养具备国际视野和商业沟通能力的人才。本课程将扩展学生经贸及商务英语词汇量、提升英文经贸文章的阅读理解能力，掌握长难句子的分析方法，提高阅读速度，从而直接获取第一手的国际市场资讯，快速全面了解国际商贸的最新行情和动态，有的放矢的做出决策。课程内容选自《时代周刊》《福布斯》《VOA》《BBC》等多种英文报刊。要求学生具备良好的英语基础，至少具备大学英语四级水平。
default.en: Selected Readings on International Business & Economics from Western Journals is one of the major optional courses for students in Economics and Trade and all the other majors in the School of Management, Harbin Institute of Technology. Through reading and analyzing relative articles in the field of business and economics on English newspaper, magazines, web and academic journals, this course will help the students understand the characteristics of economic articles, improve reading skill, vocabulary, as well as analysis ability. Meanwhile, enable the students to collect the latest international business information, trace the developments of prevailing world economy with broader vision, exercise their logic thinking and enlarge their international business background knowledge.

default.zh: 热机，是能够将热源提供的一部分热量转化成为对外输出的机械能的机器。由于向热机提供热能的热源实际上可以由任何种类的能量提供，因此热机涵盖了广泛的应用，在人类生活中发挥着重要的作用。从现代交通工具中使用的内燃机，到火力发电厂中的蒸汽机，热机的应用和发展推动了社会的快速发展。 本课程从热力学基础理论出发，详尽地介绍了气体循环和蒸汽循环两类热机的理论和应用，重点介绍了一类特殊的朗肯循环——有机朗肯循环的发展和应用价值，并在课程的最后介绍了热机在核能中的应用。 通过本课程的学习，让学生了解各类热机的发展历程、工作原理、应用背景和研究前沿，为学生今后在相关领域的科研实践打下坚实的基础。
default.en: Heat engine is a machine that can convert part of the heat provided by a heat source into mechanical energy for external output. Since the heat source that supplies thermal energy to the engine can thus be powered by virtually any kind of energy, the heat engine covers a wide range of applications and plays an important role in human life. From internal combustion engines used in modern vehicles to steam engines in thermal power plants, the application and development of heat engines have promoted the rapid development of society. Starting from the basic theory of thermodynamics, this course introduces in detail the theories and applications of two types of heat engines, gas cycle and steam cycle, and focuses on the development and application value of a special type of Rankine cycle—Organic Rankine Cycle. Finally, the application of heat engine in nuclear energy is introduced. Through the study of this course, students will be able to understand the development process, working principle, application background and research frontiers of various heat engines, and lay a solid foundation for their future scientific research in related fields.

default.zh: 许多科学设备和实验都需要超高真空，普通的真空泵可能无法在高抽速下实现超真空。在这种情况下，需要使用低温泵。本课程将讲授真空技术的基本概念，介绍适用于每个真空级别的泵类型，例如油/干式粗/前级泵，扩散泵，涡轮分子泵，离子泵和低温泵等。对于低温泵，我们将介绍工作液，安全预防措施，以及相关工作原理。以高能物理同步加速器辐射电子加速器领域为例，介绍每个泵在实际应用中的工作原理与技术。
default.en: many scientific equipment and experiment require ultra-high vacuum , normal vacuum pumps may not be able achieve the ultra-vacuum at the high pumping speed. When this is the case, cryo pump is required. We will build the basic concept of vacuum technology, the pumps type for each vacuum level such as oil/dry rough/fore pumps, diffusion pumps, turbo molecular pumps, ion pumps and cryogenic pumps. For the cryo pump, we induce the working fluid, the safety precaution, working principle. In between we will add some practical application examples for each pumps in the field of high energy physics, synchrotron radiation electron accelerator.

default.zh: 俄罗斯是横跨欧亚大陆、领土面积世界第一的国家。独特的社会、历史、人文和地理因素造就了俄罗斯艺术独具一格的特征。《俄罗斯文化艺术》阐释相关的美学理论和文化艺术赏析知识，系统讲解俄罗斯文化艺术的发展，赏析俄罗斯具有代表性的文化艺术作品。本课程通过对美学知识的传授和俄罗斯文化艺术的欣赏，使学生不仅能够了解俄罗斯文化艺术的发展脉络和，掌握俄罗斯当今俄罗斯的文化艺术，而且具备一定的欣赏能力，从而丰富学生的人文文化素养。
default.en: Russia is the world's largest country across the Eurasian continent and the largest territory in the world. Unique social, historical, humanistic and geographical factors have created unique characteristics of Russian art. "Russian Culture and Art" explains related aesthetic theories and cultural and artistic appreciation knowledge, systematically explains the development of Russian culture and art, and appreciates representative Russian cultural and artistic works. Through the teaching of aesthetics and the appreciation of Russian culture and art, this course enables students to not only understand the development context of Russian culture and art, and master the current Russian culture and art in Russia, but also have a certain appreciation ability, thereby enriching students' humanistic and cultural literacy .

default.zh: 本课程适合以汉语为目的语的零起点的学习者。在该阶段，培养听、说能力比读、写能力更重要。因此，本课程用一学年的时间，完成汉语发音、基本语法以及日常生活必需的交流方式的教学，同时，在课堂上介绍相关的中国文化知识及中国现状。通过一年的学习，学生应当掌握汉语拼音和基本的汉语语法知识，具有初步的听说读写能力，能够满足日常生活、学习以及一般场合的交际需要。
default.en: This course is suitable for beginners of Chinese as the target language learners.At this stage,Listening, speaking ability is more important than reading and writing ability.Therefore,this course with the school year to complete the Chinese pronunciation, basic grammar, and the teaching of the daily necessities of life exchanges.At the same time，introduce the relevant knowledge of Chinese culture and present situation of China.By one year of study，students should master the Pinyin and basic knowledge of Chinese grammar，have preliminary ability of listening, speaking, reading and writing,and be able to meet the communication needs of daily life, learning, and general occasions.

default.zh: 中级汉语课程是土木学院、化工学院留学生的综合课、必修课。它以语言技能训练为主，并辅之必要的语言知识、文化背景知识教学的讲授。整个教学过程要进行听、说、读、写的综合训练。本课程采用对外汉语系列教材：《汉语教程》，每课由课文、生词、词语搭配与扩展、语法例释、练习等部分组成。内容详尽、难度适宜。通过学习可以进一步扩大学生的词汇量，巩固、补充、扩展、深化基本语法项目，逐步提高阅读能力。
default.en: Intermediate Chinese course is a comprehensive and compulsory course for international students in the School of Civil Engineering and the School of Chemical Engineering. It mainly focuses on language skills training, supplemented by the teaching of necessary language knowledge and cultural background knowledge. The entire teaching process requires comprehensive training in listening, speaking, reading, and writing. This course adopts the series of textbooks for teaching Chinese as a foreign language: "Chinese Tutorial". Each lesson consists of text, new words, word combinations and extensions, grammar examples, exercises, and other parts. The content is detailed and the difficulty is appropriate. Through learning, students can further expand their vocabulary, consolidate, supplement, expand, and deepen basic grammar items, and gradually improve their reading ability.

default.zh: 中级汉语课程是土木学院、化工学院留学生的综合课、必修课。它以语言技能训练为主，并辅之必要的语言知识、文化背景知识教学的讲授。整个教学过程要进行听、说、读、写的综合训练。本课程采用对外汉语系列教材：《成功之路*起步篇》，每课由正课文、生词、词语搭配与扩展、语法例释、副课文、练习等部分组成。内容详尽、难度适宜。通过学习可以进一步扩大学生的词汇量，巩固、补充、扩展、深化基本语法项目，逐步提高阅读能力。
default.en: Intermediate Chinese language is a comprehensive and obligatory course. It's main aim is language skills training.At the same time the teacher introduce the necessary knowledge of the language and cultural background. The entire teaching process includes comprehensive training of listening, speaking, reading and writing.This course uses the textbook: the "bridge - Practical Chinese Intermediate tutorials".Each lesson consists of six parts:positive text, new words,words expansion, grammar, vice text and exercises.The content is detailed and the difficulty is very suitable.Through the study,students can expand vocabulary,consolidate, supplement, extend, and deepen the basic grammar items, and gradually increase the reading ability.

default.zh: 课程涵盖了弹性介质中超声波和声波传播的基础科学，以及该科学在无损检测中的应用。介绍了控制超声波传播的数学方程式，并将其作为开发在实际情况下用于建模超声波传播的技术的基础。
default.en: The material in this course covers the underlying science of ultrasonic and acoustic wave propagation in elastic media, and the application of this science to NDT. The mathematical equations that govern the propagation of ultrasonic waves are introduced and used as a foundation to develop the techniques used in modelling ultrasonic wave propagation in practical situations.

default.zh: 近年来，应用于生物学的数学建模已成为在某些生物现象的理解和决策方面相当活跃和有前途的研究领域。这些现象包括例如特定人群中流行病的出现、细菌的增殖动态或简单的疾病（如阿尔茨海默氏症等）的演变等等。在本课程的框架内，我们将研究对生物现象的不同建模方法，包括：常微分方程方法和考虑空间的偏微分方程的研究方法。
default.en: Mathematical modeling applied to biology has become in recent years a fairly active and promising field of research in the understanding and decision support of certain biological phenomena. Among these phenomena we can cite for example the appearance of an epidemic in a given population, the proliferation dynamics of a bacterium or simply the evolution of a disease such as Alzheimer's etc. Within the framework of this course, we will be interested in the different approaches of modeling biological phenomena: a compartmental approach which often leads to ordinary differential equations and a non-compartmental approach which often leads to partial differential equations that takes into account space.

default.zh: 本课程主要讲授各种典型智能材料的基本特性、智能结构的设计与控制方法，结合智能结构的应用特点，阐述智能材料及智能结构系统在精密机械、微机电、航空航天、生物医学等工程领域的应用实例。本课程通过介绍智能材料（例如压电材料、挠曲电材料、形状记忆材料、电/磁/光致变材料、电/磁流变材料、聚电解质材料、热释电材料、磁光材料、超导体等）与智能结构的基本特性、设计原理、控制机制及发展方向，使学生建立智能结构系统的总体概念，帮助学生了解智能材料与智能结构在精密机械、微机电系统、航空航天、生物医学等领域中的应用和潜在发展方向，使学生能够综合应用所学知识，掌握利用智能结构控制技术从事相关研究的先进手段和方法。在本课程中，学生将学习最先进的智能结构和结构电子技术的设计和应用案例，利用智能材料、结构及其控制手段，以团队合作的形式进行独立研究和开发，通过课程设计等环节提升创新实践和团队协作的能力。
default.en: This course primarily focuses on the fundamental characteristics of various typical smart materials and the design and control methods of smart structures. Combining the application characteristics of smart structures, it elaborates on the application examples of smart materials and smart structure systems in engineering fields such as precision machinery, microelectronics, aerospace, and biomedical engineering. By introducing smart materials (such as piezoelectric materials, flexoelectric materials, shape memory materials, electro/magneto/photo-responsive materials, electro/magneto-rheological materials, polyelectrolyte materials, pyroelectric materials, magneto-optical materials, superconductors, etc.) and their basic characteristics, design principles, control mechanisms, and development trends, this course enables students to establish a comprehensive concept of smart structure systems. It helps students understand the application and potential development directions of smart materials and smart structures in fields such as precision machinery, microelectronics, aerospace, and biomedical engineering. Students will be able to integrate their knowledge and master advanced methods and techniques for utilizing smart structure control technology in related research. In this course, students will learn the design and application examples of cutting-edge smart structures and structural electronics technology. They will engage in independent research and development using smart materials, structures, and their control methods in a collaborative team format. Through course design and other activities, students will enhance their abilities in innovation and teamwork.

default.zh: 随着高性能半导体器件需求的日益旺盛，新型半导体材料制备工艺已进入高速发展阶段。本课程以离子束为核心手段，从对半导体材料的掺杂、缺陷改性与半导体材料加工三个方面入手，详细介绍离子束对现代半导体材料与器件领域的贡献。通过本课程的学习，使得学生了解离子束与半导体材料作用的机理，半导体材料同质异质掺杂的物理现象，离子束加工的应用背景。为学生从事半导体材料与离子束相关研究工作积累知识。
default.en: Due to intensive demand of high performance of semiconductor device, novel process of semiconductor has been developing quickly. Based on the ion beams, our lessons will focus on the doping, defect engineering as well as etching in semiconductors, detailly describing the contribution of ion beams to semiconductor and related device. Through the study of this lessons, students will learn deeply the mechanism of interaction between ion beams and matrix atoms, physical phenomenon of hyper-doping in semiconductors as well as background of ion beam etching, accumulating more acknowledge for application of ion beams in semiconductors.

default.zh: 随着数字化、多媒体、互联网等科技的高速发展，为满足国家创意产业与制造业发展的需求，培养技术与艺术结合的交叉性创新设计人才，当下数字媒体的设计与开发迎来了新的机遇与挑战。基于目前最先进、功能最强大、最流行的三维场景、人物交互设计引擎Unity3D，本课程将提供学生一个绝佳的机会对数字媒体的设计与开发有一个基本、全面的了解和掌握。 Unity3D支持当今几乎所有的数字媒体平台，包括Windows10， Mac，安卓（Android），苹果（IOS）和WWW等。用Unity3D可以在很大程度上降低设计和开发的入门难度，充分激发学生的兴趣。本课程将主要覆盖设计的基本理论，以及开发中最基本但又最重要的环节，包括C#编程，场景的设计，物体的控制，声效，动画，纹理，光照等。借鉴和采用西方发达国家的教学模式，老师将主要用英语授课（包括课堂讲座，实验，答疑等）。 不过对于游戏理论和开发的难点、要点， 会根据情况用中文讲解或补充。
default.en: This course will provide an excellent opportunity for students to design and develop interactive media, based on Unity3D which is the most popular and powerful 3D engine. Students will learn and master the fundamental and yet important aspect of design and development of digital media (such as animation, graphics, games, virtual reality, etc.), including scene design, control of objects, user interaction, sound, animation, texture, lighting and so on.
